text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֱלֹהִים אֶל נֹחַ וְאֶל בָּנָיו אִתּוֹ לֵאמֹֽר׃
translation: God spoke to Noah and to his sons with him, saying, (Genesis 9:8)

text: וַיִּפֹּל אַבְרָם עַל פָּנָיו וַיְדַבֵּר אִתּוֹ אֱלֹהִים לֵאמֹֽר׃
translation: Abram fell on his face. God talked with him, saying, (Genesis 17:3)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר אַבְרָהָם אֶל הָֽאֱלֹהִים לוּ יִשְׁמָעֵאל יִחְיֶה לְפָנֶֽיךָ׃
translation: Abraham said to God, "Oh that Ishmael might live before you!" (Genesis 17:18)

text: וַֽיהֹוָה אָמָר הַֽמְכַסֶּה אֲנִי מֵֽאַבְרָהָם אֲשֶׁר אֲנִי עֹשֶֽׂה׃
translation: The LORD said, "Will I hide from Abraham what I do, (Genesis 18:17)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲבִימֶלֶךְ הִנֵּה אַרְצִי לְפָנֶיךָ בַּטּוֹב בְּעֵינֶיךָ שֵֽׁב׃
translation: Abimelech said, "Behold, my land is before you. Dwell where it pleases you." (Genesis 20:15)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֵּה נָא זָקַנְתִּי לֹא יָדַעְתִּי יוֹם מוֹתִֽי׃
translation: He said, "See now, I am old. I don't know the day of my death. (Genesis 27:2)

text: וְעַתָּה בְנִי שְׁמַע בְּקֹלִי לַאֲשֶׁר אֲנִי מְצַוָּה אֹתָֽךְ׃
translation: Now therefore, my son, obey my voice according to that which I command you. (Genesis 27:8)

text: וַיִּֽיטְבוּ דִבְרֵיהֶם בְּעֵינֵי חֲמוֹר וּבְעֵינֵי שְׁכֶם בֶּן חֲמֽוֹר׃
translation: Their words pleased Hamor and Shechem, Hamor's son. (Genesis 34:18)

text: וְאֵלֶּה בְּנֵי שׁוֹבָל עַלְוָן וּמָנַחַת וְעֵיבָל שְׁפוֹ וְאוֹנָֽם׃
translation: These are the children of Shobal: Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shepho, and Onam. (Genesis 36:23)

text: וַיַּרְא יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת בְּנֵי יוֹסֵף וַיֹּאמֶר מִי אֵֽלֶּה׃
translation: Israel saw Joseph's sons, and said, "Who are these?" (Genesis 48:8)

text: הִקָּבְצוּ וְשִׁמְעוּ בְּנֵי יַעֲקֹב וְשִׁמְעוּ אֶל יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲבִיכֶֽם׃
translation: Assemble yourselves, and hear, you sons of Jacob. Listen to Israel, your father. (Genesis 49:2)

text: וַיְדַבֵּר מֹשֶׁה אֶת מֹעֲדֵי יְהוָה אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
translation: So Moses declared to the children of Israel the appointed feasts of the LORD. (Leviticus 23:44)

text: בֶּן שְׁלֹשִׁים שָׁנָה דָּוִד בְּמָלְכוֹ אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה מָלָֽךְ׃
translation: David was thirty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned forty years. (2 Samuel 5:4)

text: וַיֹּֽאמֶר לוֹ הַמֶּלֶךְ לֵךְ בְּשָׁלוֹם וַיָּקָם וַיֵּלֶךְ חֶבְרֽוֹנָה׃
translation: The king said to him, "Go in peace." So he arose and went to Hebron. (2 Samuel 15:9)

text: וַיֵּצֵא הַמֶּלֶךְ וְכָל הָעָם בְּרַגְלָיו וַיַּעַמְדוּ בֵּית הַמֶּרְחָֽק׃
translation: The king went out, and all the people after him; and they stayed in Beth Merhak. (2 Samuel 15:17)

text: וְהִנֵּה עוֹדֶנָּה מְדַבֶּרֶת עִם הַמֶּלֶךְ וְנָתָן הַנָּבִיא בָּֽא׃
translation: Behold, while she was still talking with the king, Nathan the prophet came in. (1 Kings 1:22)

text: וְֽהַמֶּלֶךְ וְכָל יִשְׂרָאֵל עִמּוֹ זֹבְחִים זֶבַח לִפְנֵי יְהוָֽה׃
translation: The king, and all Israel with him, offered sacrifice before the LORD. (1 Kings 8:62)

text: וַיִּגְדַּל הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה מִכֹּל מַלְכֵי הָאָרֶץ לְעֹשֶׁר וּלְחָכְמָֽה׃
translation: So King Solomon exceeded all the kings of the earth in riches and in wisdom. (1 Kings 10:23)

text: וַיְסַפֵּר הָעֶבֶד לְיִצְחָק אֵת כָּל הַדְּבָרִים אֲשֶׁר עָשָֽׂה׃
translation: The servant told Isaac all the things that he had done. (Genesis 24:66)

text: וַיֵּצֵא חֲמוֹר אֲבִֽי שְׁכֶם אֶֽל יַעֲקֹב לְדַבֵּר אִתּֽוֹ׃
translation: Hamor the father of Shechem went out to Jacob to talk with him. (Genesis 34:6)

text: וַיְדַבֵּר אֱלֹהִים אֶל מֹשֶׁה וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו אֲנִי יְהוָֽה׃
translation: God spoke to Moses, and said to him, "I am the LORD. (Exodus 6:2)

text: וַיְהִי בְּיוֹם דִּבֶּר יְהוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
translation: On the day when the LORD spoke to Moses in the land of Egypt, (Exodus 6:28)

text: וַיִּנָּחֶם יְהוָה עַל הָרָעָה אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר לַעֲשׂוֹת לְעַמּֽוֹ׃
translation: So the LORD turned away from the evil which he said he would do to his people. (Exodus 32:14)

text: וַיְכַל מֹשֶׁה מִדַּבֵּר אִתָּם וַיִּתֵּן עַל פָּנָיו מַסְוֶֽה׃
translation: When Moses was done speaking with them, he put a veil on his face. (Exodus 34:33)

text: וַיֵּרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהוָה אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה וַיָּמֶת גַּם אֹתֽוֹ׃
translation: The thing which he did was evil in the LORD's sight, and he killed him also. (Genesis 38:10)

text: אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יַעֲשֶׂה כָמוֹהָ לְהָרִיחַ בָּהּ וְנִכְרַת מֵעַמָּֽיו׃
translation: Whoever shall make any like that, to smell of it, he shall be cut off from his people." (Exodus 30:38)

text: וּבַחֲרֹשֶׁת אֶבֶן לְמַלֹּאת וּבַחֲרֹשֶׁת עֵץ לַעֲשׂוֹת בְּכָל מְלָאכָֽה׃
translation: and in cutting of stones for setting, and in carving of wood, to work in all kinds of workmanship. (Exodus 31:5)

text: וְהַמְּלָאכָה הָיְתָה דַיָּם לְכָל הַמְּלָאכָה לַעֲשׂוֹת אֹתָהּ וְהוֹתֵֽר׃
translation: For the stuff they had was sufficient to do all the work, and too much. (Exodus 36:7)

text: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם אֶת חֻקֹּתַי וַעֲשִׂיתֶם אֹתָם אֲנִי יְהוָה מְקַדִּשְׁכֶֽם׃
translation: You shall keep my statutes, and do them. I am the LORD who sanctifies you. (Leviticus 20:8)

text: כָּל מְלֶאכֶת עֲבֹדָה לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ וְהִקְרַבְתֶּם אִשֶּׁה לַיהוָֽה׃
translation: You shall do no regular work. You shall offer an offering made by fire to the LORD.'" (Leviticus 23:25)

text: וַתִּקְרֶאןָ לָעָם לְזִבְחֵי אֱלֹהֵיהֶן וַיֹּאכַל הָעָם וַיִּֽשְׁתַּחֲוּוּ לֵֽאלֹהֵיהֶֽן׃
translation: for they called the people to the sacrifices of their gods. The people ate and bowed down to their gods. (Numbers 25:2)

text: לֹא תְִּירָאוּם כִּי יְהוָה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶם הוּא הַנִּלְחָם לָכֶֽם׃
translation: You shall not fear them; for the LORD your God himself fights for you." (Deuteronomy 3:22)

text: אֶת יְהוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ תִּירָא וְאֹתוֹ תַעֲבֹד וּבִשְׁמוֹ תִּשָּׁבֵֽעַ׃
translation: You shall fear the LORD your God; and you shall serve him, and shall swear by his name. (Deuteronomy 6:13)

text: וְזָבַחְתָּ שְׁלָמִים וְאָכַלְתָּ שָּׁם וְשָׂמַחְתָּ לִפְנֵי יְהוָה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ׃
translation: You shall sacrifice peace offerings, and shall eat there. You shall rejoice before the LORD your God. (Deuteronomy 27:7)

text: וַתֹּאמֶר גָּלָה כָבוֹד מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל כִּי נִלְקַח אֲרוֹן הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃
translation: She said, "The glory has departed from Israel; for God's ark has been taken." (1 Samuel 4:22)

text: וַיֵּלֶךְ דָּוִד הָלוֹךְ וְגָדוֹל וַיהוָה אֱלֹהֵי צְבָאוֹת עִמּֽוֹ׃
translation: David grew greater and greater, for the LORD, the God of Armies, was with him. (2 Samuel 5:10)

text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֵלָיו לֹא אֲדֹנִי וַעֲבָדֶיךָ בָּאוּ לִשְׁבָּר אֹֽכֶל׃
translation: They said to him, "No, my lord, but your servants have come to buy food. (Genesis 42:10)

text: וַֽיַּעֲלוּ מִמִּצְרָיִם וַיָּבֹאוּ אֶרֶץ כְּנַעַן אֶֽל יַעֲקֹב אֲבִיהֶֽם׃
translation: They went up out of Egypt, and came into the land of Canaan, to Jacob their father. (Genesis 45:25)

text: וַיַּעַבְרוּ מִשָּׁם הַר אֶפְרָיִם וַיָּבֹאוּ עַד בֵּית מִיכָֽה׃
translation: They passed from there to the hill country of Ephraim, and came to the house of Micah. (Judges 18:13)

text: וַיִּֽתְקַבְּצוּ כֹּל זִקְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיָּבֹאוּ אֶל שְׁמוּאֵל הָרָמָֽתָה׃
translation: Then all the elders of Israel gathered themselves together and came to Samuel to Ramah. (1 Samuel 8:4)

text: וַיָּקָם יוֹאָב וַיֵּלֶךְ גְּשׁוּרָה וַיָּבֵא אֶת אַבְשָׁלוֹם יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
translation: So Joab arose and went to Geshur, and brought Absalom to Jerusalem. (2 Samuel 14:23)

text: וַיָּבֹא חוּשַׁי רֵעֶה דָוִד הָעִיר וְאַבְשָׁלֹם יָבֹא יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
translation: So Hushai, David's friend, came into the city; and Absalom came into Jerusalem. (2 Samuel 15:37)

text: קוּם הִתְהַלֵּךְ בָּאָרֶץ לְאָרְכָּהּ וּלְרָחְבָּהּ כִּי לְךָ אֶתְּנֶֽנָּה׃
translation: Arise, walk through the land in its length and in its width; for I will give it to you." (Genesis 13:17)

text: וַתִּכְלֶינָה שֶׁבַע שְׁנֵי הַשָּׂבָע אֲשֶׁר הָיָה בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
translation: The seven years of plenty, that were in the land of Egypt, came to an end. (Genesis 41:53)

text: וַיּוֹצֵא יוֹסֵף אֹתָם מֵעִם בִּרְכָּיו וַיִּשְׁתַּחוּ לְאַפָּיו אָֽרְצָה׃
translation: Joseph brought them out from between his knees, and he bowed himself with his face to the earth. (Genesis 48:12)

text: וְנָתְנָה הָאָרֶץ פִּרְיָהּ וַאֲכַלְתֶּם לָשֹׂבַע וִֽישַׁבְתֶּם לָבֶטַח עָלֶֽיהָ׃
translation: The land shall yield its fruit, and you shall eat your fill, and dwell therein in safety. (Leviticus 25:19)

text: וַיִּסְעוּ מִקָּדֵשׁ וַֽיַּחֲנוּ בְּהֹר הָהָר בִּקְצֵה אֶרֶץ אֱדֽוֹם׃
translation: They traveled from Kadesh, and encamped in Mount Hor, in the edge of the land of Edom. (Numbers 33:37)

text: רַק הַדָּם לֹא תֹאכֵלוּ עַל הָאָרֶץ תִּשְׁפְּכֶנּוּ כַּמָּֽיִם׃
translation: Only you shall not eat the blood. You shall pour it out on the earth like water. (Deuteronomy 12:16)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר פַּרְעֹה אֶֽל יַעֲקֹב כַּמָּה יְמֵי שְׁנֵי חַיֶּֽיךָ׃
translation: Pharaoh said to Jacob, "How old are you?" (Genesis 47:8)

text: וַיִּמָּלֵא שִׁבְעַת יָמִים אַחֲרֵי הַכּוֹת יְהוָה אֶת הַיְאֹֽר׃
translation: Seven days were fulfilled, after the LORD had struck the river. (Exodus 7:25)

text: בַּיּוֹם הַשֵּׁנִי הִקְרִיב נְתַנְאֵל בֶּן צוּעָר נְשִׂיא יִשָּׂשכָֽר׃
translation: On the second day Nethanel the son of Zuar, prince of Issachar, gave his offering. (Numbers 7:18)

text: הַנֹּגֵעַ בְּמֵת לְכָל נֶפֶשׁ אָדָם וְטָמֵא שִׁבְעַת יָמִֽים׃
translation: "He who touches the dead body of any man shall be unclean seven days. (Numbers 19:11)

text: אַתָּה עֹבֵר הַיּוֹם אֶת גְּבוּל מוֹאָב אֶת עָֽר׃
translation: "You are to pass over Ar, the border of Moab, today. (Deuteronomy 2:18)

text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה בְּעֶצֶם הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה לֵאמֹֽר׃
translation: The LORD spoke to Moses that same day, saying, (Deuteronomy 32:48)

text: וַתָּמָת רָחֵל וַתִּקָּבֵר בְּדֶרֶךְ אֶפְרָתָה הִוא בֵּית לָֽחֶם׃
translation: Rachel died, and was buried on the way to Ephrath (also called Bethlehem). (Genesis 35:19)

text: וַיֵּלֶךְ אִישׁ מִבֵּית לֵוִי וַיִּקַּח אֶת בַּת לֵוִֽי׃
translation: A man of the house of Levi went and took a daughter of Levi as his wife. (Exodus 2:1)

text: לֹא כֵן עַבְדִּי מֹשֶׁה בְּכָל בֵּיתִי נֶאֱמָן הֽוּא׃
translation: My servant Moses is not so. He is faithful in all my house. (Numbers 12:7)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר יָרָבְעָם בְּלִבּוֹ עַתָּה תָּשׁוּב הַמַּמְלָכָה לְבֵית דָּוִֽד׃
translation: Jeroboam said in his heart, "Now the kingdom will return to David's house. (1 Kings 12:26)

text: וַיָּקֶם מִזְבֵּחַ לַבָּעַל בֵּית הַבַּעַל אֲשֶׁר בָּנָה בְּשֹׁמְרֽוֹן׃
translation: He raised up an altar for Baal in the house of Baal, which he had built in Samaria. (1 Kings 16:32)

text: אֲחִי בֶּן עַבְדִּיאֵל בֶּן גּוּנִי רֹאשׁ לְבֵית אֲבוֹתָֽם׃
translation: Ahi the son of Abdiel, the son of Guni, chief of their fathers' houses. (1 Chronicles 5:15)

text: וְאִישׁ כִּי יַכֶּה כָּל נֶפֶשׁ אָדָם מוֹת יוּמָֽת׃
translation: "'He who strikes any man mortally shall surely be put to death. (Leviticus 24:17)

text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אִישׁ אֶל אָחִיו נִתְּנָה רֹאשׁ וְנָשׁוּבָה מִצְרָֽיְמָה׃
translation: They said to one another, "Let's choose a leader, and let's return into Egypt." (Numbers 14:4)

text: וְאֵלֶּה שְׁמוֹת הָאֲנָשִׁים לְמַטֵּה יְהוּדָה כָּלֵב בֶּן יְפֻנֶּֽה׃
translation: These are the names of the men: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh. (Numbers 34:19)

text: וַיָּמָת אֱלִימֶלֶךְ אִישׁ נָעֳמִי וַתִּשָּׁאֵר הִיא וּשְׁנֵי בָנֶֽיהָ׃
translation: Elimelech, Naomi's husband, died; and she was left with her two sons. (Ruth 1:3)

text: אָנֹכִי הֹלֵךְ בְּדֶרֶךְ כָּל הָאָרֶץ וְחָזַקְתָּ וְהָיִיתָֽ לְאִֽישׁ׃
translation: "I am going the way of all the earth. You be strong therefore, and show yourself a man; (1 Kings 2:2)

text: וַיְהִי דְּבַר הָֽאֱלֹהִים אֶל שְׁמַעְיָה אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים לֵאמֹֽר׃
translation: But the word of God came to Shemaiah the man of God, saying, (1 Kings 12:22)

text: וַיִּקַּח מֹשֶׁה אֶת הַמַּטֶּה מִלִּפְנֵי יְהוָה כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּֽהוּ׃
translation: Moses took the rod from before the LORD, as he commanded him. (Numbers 20:9)

text: וַיִּסְעוּ מֵעַלְמֹן דִּבְלָתָיְמָה וַֽיַּחֲנוּ בְּהָרֵי הָעֲבָרִים לִפְנֵי נְבֽוֹ׃
translation: They traveled from Almon Diblathaim, and encamped in the mountains of Abarim, before Nebo. (Numbers 33:47)

text: וְזֹאת הַתּוֹרָה אֲשֶׁר שָׂם מֹשֶׁה לִפְנֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
translation: This is the law which Moses set before the children of Israel. (Deuteronomy 4:44)

text: פָּנִים בְּפָנִים דִּבֶּר יְהוָה עִמָּכֶם בָּהָר מִתּוֹךְ הָאֵֽשׁ׃
translation: The LORD spoke with you face to face on the mountain out of the middle of the fire, (Deuteronomy 5:4)

text: וַיִּנָּֽגְעוּ יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וְכָל יִשְׂרָאֵל לִפְנֵיהֶם וַיָּנֻסוּ דֶּרֶךְ הַמִּדְבָּֽר׃
translation: Joshua and all Israel made as if they were beaten before them, and fled by the way of the wilderness. (Joshua 8:15)

text: וַיַּרְא שָׁאוּל אֲשֶׁר הוּא מַשְׂכִּיל מְאֹד וַיָּגָר מִפָּנָֽיו׃
translation: When Saul saw that he behaved himself very wisely, he stood in awe of him. (1 Samuel 18:15)

text: וְאֶתְּנָה בְרִיתִי בֵּינִי וּבֵינֶךָ וְאַרְבֶּה אוֹתְךָ בִּמְאֹד מְאֹֽד׃
translation: I will make my covenant between me and you, and will multiply you exceedingly." (Genesis 17:2)

text: לָכֵן אֱמֹר הִנְנִי נֹתֵן לוֹ אֶת בְּרִיתִי שָׁלֽוֹם׃
translation: Therefore say, 'Behold, I give to him my covenant of peace. (Numbers 25:12)

text: וְאִם אֵין לוֹ בַּת וּנְתַתֶּם אֶת נַחֲלָתוֹ לְאֶחָיו׃
translation: If he has no daughter, then you shall give his inheritance to his brothers. (Numbers 27:9)

text: וְעַתַּי הֹלִיד אֶת נָתָן וְנָתָן הוֹלִיד אֶת זָבָֽד׃
translation: Attai became the father of Nathan, and Nathan became the father of Zabad, (1 Chronicles 2:36)

text: וַאֲחֵיהֶם הַלְוִיִּם נְתוּנִים לְכָל עֲבוֹדַת מִשְׁכַּן בֵּית הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃
translation: These are those who served, and their sons. Of the sons of the Kohathites: Heman the singer, the son of Joel, the son of Samuel, (1 Chronicles 6:33)

text: וַיָּנוּסוּ בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִפְּנֵי יְהוּדָה וַיִּתְּנֵם אֱלֹהִים בְּיָדָֽם׃
translation: The children of Israel fled before Judah, and God delivered them into their hand. (2 Chronicles 13:16)

text: וַיֵּלֶךְ מִשָּׁם יִצְחָק וַיִּחַן בְּנַֽחַל גְּרָר וַיֵּשֶׁב שָֽׁם׃
translation: Isaac departed from there, encamped in the valley of Gerar, and lived there. (Genesis 26:17)

text: וַיִּֽהְיוּ אֵלֶּה בְנֵֽי לֵוִי בִּשְׁמֹתָם גֵּרְשׁוֹן וּקְהָת וּמְרָרִֽי׃
translation: These were the sons of Levi by their names: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari. (Numbers 3:17)

text: וְשָׂמוּ אֶת שְׁמִי עַל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַאֲנִי אֲבָרֲכֵֽם׃
translation: "So they shall put my name on the children of Israel; and I will bless them." (Numbers 6:27)

text: וְיָד תִּהְיֶה לְךָ מִחוּץ לַֽמַּחֲנֶה וְיָצָאתָ שָׁמָּה חֽוּץ׃
translation: You shall have a trowel among your weapons. It shall be, when you relieve yourself, you shall dig with it, and shall turn back and cover your excrement; (Deuteronomy 23:13)

text: וַֽיִּקְרְאוּ שֵֽׁם הַמָּקוֹם הַהוּא בֹּכִים וַיִּזְבְּחוּ שָׁם לַֽיהוָֽה׃
translation: They called the name of that place Bochim, and they sacrificed there to the LORD. (Judges 2:5)

text: וַיֵּלֶךְ מִשָּׁם אֶל הַר הַכַּרְמֶל וּמִשָּׁם שָׁב שֹׁמְרֽוֹן׃
translation: He went from there to Mount Carmel, and from there he returned to Samaria. (2 Kings 2:25)

text: וַיִּשְׁמַע רְאוּבֵן וַיַּצִּלֵהוּ מִיָּדָם וַיֹּאמֶר לֹא נַכֶּנּוּ נָֽפֶשׁ׃
translation: Reuben heard it, and delivered him out of their hand, and said, "Let's not take his life." (Genesis 37:21)

text: וַיְהִי כִּרְאוֹתָהּ כִּֽי עָזַב בִּגְדוֹ בְּיָדָהּ וַיָּנָס הַחֽוּצָה׃
translation: When she saw that he had left his garment in her hand, and had run outside, (Genesis 39:13)

text: מֵעֶקְרוֹן וָיָמָּה כֹּל אֲשֶׁר עַל יַד אַשְׁדּוֹד וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃
translation: from Ekron even to the sea, all that were by the side of Ashdod, with their villages. (Joshua 15:46)

text: עַֽל דַּעְתְּךָ כִּי לֹא אֶרְשָׁע וְאֵין מִיָּדְךָ מַצִּֽיל׃
translation: Although you know that I am not wicked, there is no one who can deliver out of your hand. (Job 10:7)

text: כִּֽי נָטָה אֶל אֵל יָדוֹ וְאֶל שַׁדַּי יִתְגַּבָּֽר׃
translation: Because he has stretched out his hand against God, and behaves himself proudly against the Almighty, (Job 15:25)

text: גַּם כֹּחַ יְדֵיהֶם לָמָּה לִּי עָלֵימוֹ אָבַד כָּֽלַח׃
translation: Of what use is the strength of their hands to me, men in whom ripe age has perished? (Job 30:2)

text: וַיֵּרֶד שִׁמְשׁוֹן תִּמְנָתָה וַיַּרְא אִשָּׁה בְּתִמְנָתָה מִבְּנוֹת פְּלִשְׁתִּֽים׃
translation: Samson went down to Timnah, and saw a woman in Timnah of the daughters of the Philistines. (Judges 14:1)

text: וַיֵּלֶךְ אֵֽלִיָּהוּ לְהֵרָאוֹת אֶל אַחְאָב וְהָרָעָב חָזָק בְּשֹׁמְרֽוֹן׃
translation: Elijah went to show himself to Ahab. The famine was severe in Samaria. (1 Kings 18:2)

text: הֶן כֹּל רָאֲתָה עֵינִי שָֽׁמְעָה אָזְנִי וַתָּבֶן לָֽהּ׃
translation: "Behold, my eye has seen all this. My ear has heard and understood it. (Job 13:1)

text: לָכֵן יְרֵאוּהוּ אֲנָשִׁים לֹֽא יִרְאֶה כָּל חַכְמֵי לֵֽב׃
translation: Therefore men revere him. He doesn't regard any who are wise of heart." (Job 37:24)

text: מִשָּׁמַיִם הִבִּיט יְהוָה רָאָה אֶֽת כָּל בְּנֵי הָאָדָֽם׃
translation: The LORD looks from heaven. He sees all the sons of men. (Psalms 33:13)

text: מִֽי הָאִישׁ הֶחָפֵץ חַיִּים אֹהֵב יָמִים לִרְאוֹת טֽוֹב׃
translation: Keep your tongue from evil, and your lips from speaking lies. (Psalms 34:13)

text: וְאַתֵּנָה יְדַעְתֶּן כִּי בְּכָל כֹּחִי עָבַדְתִּי אֶת אֲבִיכֶֽן׃
translation: You know that I have served your father with all of my strength. (Genesis 31:6)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר פַּרְעֹה עֲלֵה וּקְבֹר אֶת אָבִיךָ כַּאֲשֶׁר הִשְׁבִּיעֶֽךָ׃
translation: Pharaoh said, "Go up, and bury your father, just like he made you swear." (Genesis 50:6)

text: וְקִישׁ אֲבִֽי שָׁאוּל וְנֵר אֲבִֽי אַבְנֵר בֶּן אֲבִיאֵֽל׃
translation: Kish was the father of Saul, and Ner the father of Abner was the son of Abiel. (1 Samuel 14:51)

text: וַיִּשְׁכַּב אַחְאָב עִם אֲבֹתָיו וַיִּמְלֹךְ אֲחַזְיָהוּ בְנוֹ תַּחְתָּֽיו׃
translation: So Ahab slept with his fathers; and Ahaziah his son reigned in his place. (1 Kings 22:40)

text: וַיִּשְׁכַּב מְנַחֵם עִם אֲבֹתָיו וַיִּמְלֹךְ פְּקַחְיָה בְנוֹ תַּחְתָּֽיו׃
translation: Menahem slept with his fathers, and Pekahiah his son reigned in his place. (2 Kings 15:22)

text: וַיִּשְׁכַּב חִזְקִיָּהוּ עִם אֲבֹתָיו וַיִּמְלֹךְ מְנַשֶּׁה בְנוֹ תַּחְתָּֽיו׃
translation: Hezekiah slept with his fathers, and Manasseh his son reigned in his place. (2 Kings 20:21)

text: וַיְצַו יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶת הַכֹּהֲנִים לֵאמֹר עֲלוּ מִן הַיַּרְדֵּֽן׃
translation: Joshua therefore commanded the priests, saying, "Come up out of the Jordan!" (Joshua 4:17)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל הַגִּשׁוּ אֵלַי הָעֹלָה וְהַשְּׁלָמִים וַיַּעַל הָעֹלָֽה׃
translation: Saul said, "Bring the burnt offering to me here, and the peace offerings." He offered the burnt offering. (1 Samuel 13:9)

text: וַיַּעַל מֶֽלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל וְיהוֹשָׁפָט מֶֽלֶךְ יְהוּדָה רָמֹת גִּלְעָֽד׃
translation: So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah went up to Ramoth Gilead. (1 Kings 22:29)

text: וַיַּעַל דָּוִיד בִּדְבַר גָּד אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר בְּשֵׁם יְהוָֽה׃
translation: David went up at the saying of Gad, which he spoke in the LORD's name. (1 Chronicles 21:19)

text: מִֽי יַעֲלֶה בְהַר יְהוָה וּמִי יָקוּם בִּמְקוֹם קָדְשֽׁוֹ׃
translation: Who may ascend to the LORD's hill? Who may stand in his holy place? (Psalms 24:3)

text: רַבּוֹת בָּנוֹת עָשׂוּ חָיִל וְאַתְּ עָלִית עַל כֻּלָּֽנָה׃
translation: "Many women do noble things, but you excel them all." (Proverbs 31:29)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה אֶל קֹרַח שִׁמְעוּ נָא בְּנֵי לֵוִֽי׃
translation: Moses said to Korah, "Hear now, you sons of Levi! (Numbers 16:8)

text: וַיְהִי יְהוָה אֶת יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וַיְהִי שָׁמְעוֹ בְּכָל הָאָֽרֶץ׃
translation: So the LORD was with Joshua; and his fame was in all the land. (Joshua 6:27)

text: וְלֹא שָׁמֵעוּ כִּי אִֽם כְּמִשְׁפָּטָם הָֽרִאשׁוֹן הֵם עֹשִֽׂים׃
translation: However they didn't listen, but they did what they did before. (2 Kings 17:40)

text: אִם אַיִן אַתָּה שְֽׁמַֽע לִי הַחֲרֵשׁ וַאֲאַלֶּפְךָ חָכְמָֽה׃
translation: If not, listen to me. Hold your peace, and I will teach you wisdom." (Job 33:33)

text: אַנְשֵׁי לֵבָב יֹאמְרוּ לִי וְגֶבֶר חָכָם שֹׁמֵעַֽ לִֽי׃
translation: Men of understanding will tell me, yes, every wise man who hears me: (Job 34:34)

text: שְׁמַע עַמִּי וְאָעִידָה בָּךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל אִם תִּֽשְׁמַֽע לִֽי׃
translation: There shall be no strange god in you, neither shall you worship any foreign god. (Psalms 81:9)

text: וַתֹּאמֶר אֶל עֲבָדֶיךָ הוֹרִדֻהוּ אֵלָי וְאָשִׂימָה עֵינִי עָלָֽיו׃
translation: You said to your servants, 'Bring him down to me, that I may set my eyes on him.' (Genesis 44:21)

text: וּמִבְּנֵי עָדִין עֶבֶד בֶּן יוֹנָתָן וְעִמּוֹ חֲמִשִּׁים הַזְּכָרִֽים׃
translation: Of the sons of Adin, Ebed the son of Jonathan; and with him fifty males. (Ezra 8:6)

text: שַׂמֵּחַ נֶפֶשׁ עַבְדֶּךָ כִּי אֵלֶיךָ אֲדֹנָי נַפְשִׁי אֶשָּֽׂא׃
translation: Bring joy to the soul of your servant, for to you, Lord, do I lift up my soul. (Psalms 86:4)

text: כִּֽי זָכַר אֶת דְּבַר קָדְשׁוֹ אֶֽת אַבְרָהָם עַבְדּֽוֹ׃
translation: For he remembered his holy word, and Abraham, his servant. (Psalms 105:42)

text: וְהָיָה בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא וְקָרָאתִי לְעַבְדִּי לְאֶלְיָקִים בֶּן חִלְקִיָּֽהוּ׃
translation: It will happen in that day that I will call my servant Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, (Isaiah 22:20)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר בָּרוּךְ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי שֵׁם וִיהִי כְנַעַן עֶבֶד לָֽמוֹ׃
translation: He said, "Blessed be the LORD, the God of Shem. Let Canaan be his servant. (Genesis 9:26)

text: זֹאת נַחֲלַת בְּנֵֽי זְבוּלֻן לְמִשְׁפְּחוֹתָם הֶֽעָרִים הָאֵלֶּה וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃
translation: This is the inheritance of the children of Zebulun according to their families, these cities with their villages. (Joshua 19:16)

text: זֹאת נַחֲלַת מַטֵּה בְנֵֽי יִשָּׂשכָר לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם הֶעָרִים וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃
translation: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Issachar according to their families, the cities with their villages. (Joshua 19:23)

text: זֹאת נַחֲלַת מַטֵּה בְנֵֽי נַפְתָּלִי לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם הֶעָרִים וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃
translation: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Naphtali according to their families, the cities with their villages. (Joshua 19:39)

text: וּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הַיֹּשְׁבִים בְּעָרֵי יְהוּדָה וַיִּמְלֹךְ עֲלֵיהֶם רְחַבְעָֽם׃
translation: But as for the children of Israel who lived in the cities of Judah, Rehoboam reigned over them. (1 Kings 12:17)

text: וּמִֽמִּשְׁפְּחוֹת בְּנֵי קְהָת וַיְהִי עָרֵי גְבוּלָם מִמַּטֵּה אֶפְרָֽיִם׃
translation: Bukki his son, Uzzi his son, Zerahiah his son, (1 Chronicles 6:51)

text: וּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הַיֹּֽשְׁבִים בְּעָרֵי יְהוּדָה וַיִּמְלֹךְ עֲלֵיהֶם רְחַבְעָֽם׃
translation: But as for the children of Israel who lived in the cities of Judah, Rehoboam reigned over them. (2 Chronicles 10:17)

text: וַיִּסַּע וַיֵּלֶךְ וַיָּשָׁב סַנְחֵרִיב מֶֽלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר וַיֵּשֶׁב בְּנִֽינְוֵֽה׃
translation: So Sennacherib king of Assyria departed, went home, and lived at Nineveh. (2 Kings 19:36)

text: וּבְנֵי גָד לְנֶגְדָּם יָֽשְׁבוּ בְּאֶרֶץ הַבָּשָׁן עַד סַלְכָֽה׃
translation: The sons of Gad lived beside them in the land of Bashan to Salecah: (1 Chronicles 5:11)

text: כִּי שָׁמָּה יָשְׁבוּ כִסְאוֹת לְמִשְׁפָּט כִּסְאוֹת לְבֵית דָּוִֽיד׃
translation: For there are set thrones for judgment, the thrones of David's house. (Psalms 122:5)

text: וַיִּסַּע וַיֵּלֶךְ וַיָּשָׁב סַנְחֵרִיב מֶֽלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר וַיֵּשֶׁב בְּנִֽינְוֵֽה׃
translation: So Sennacherib king of Assyria departed, went away, returned to Nineveh, and stayed there. (Isaiah 37:37)

text: וַיֵּשֶׁב בְּמִדְבַּר פָּארָן וַתִּֽקַּֽח לוֹ אִמּוֹ אִשָּׁה מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
translation: He lived in the wilderness of Paran. His mother got a wife for him out of the land of Egypt. (Genesis 21:21)

text: וְיָשַׁבְתָּ עִמּוֹ יָמִים אֲחָדִים עַד אֲשֶׁר תָּשׁוּב חֲמַת אָחִֽיךָ׃
translation: Stay with him a few days, until your brother's fury turns away— (Genesis 27:44)

text: תֵּצֵא רוּחוֹ יָשֻׁב לְאַדְמָתוֹ בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא אָבְדוּ עֶשְׁתֹּנֹתָֽיו׃
translation: His spirit departs, and he returns to the earth. In that very day, his thoughts perish. (Psalms 146:4)

text: הוֹצִיא עַם עִוֵּר וְעֵינַיִם יֵשׁ וְחֵרְשִׁים וְאָזְנַיִם לָֽמוֹ׃
translation: Bring out the blind people who have eyes, and the deaf who have ears. (Isaiah 43:8)

text: וַיֵּצֵא נֹחַ וּבָנָיו וְאִשְׁתּוֹ וּנְשֵֽׁי בָנָיו אִתּֽוֹ׃
translation: Noah went out, with his sons, his wife, and his sons' wives with him. (Genesis 8:18)

text: הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ יָצָא עַל הָאָרֶץ וְלוֹט בָּא צֹֽעֲרָה׃
translation: The sun had risen on the earth when Lot came to Zoar. (Genesis 19:23)

text: וַיְבָרֶךְ יַעֲקֹב אֶת פַּרְעֹה וַיֵּצֵא מִלִּפְנֵי פַרְעֹֽה׃
translation: Jacob blessed Pharaoh, and went out from the presence of Pharaoh. (Genesis 47:10)

text: אָֽנֹכִי יְהוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר הוֹצֵאתִיךָ מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם מִבֵּית עֲבָדִֽים׃
translation: "I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage. (Exodus 20:2)

text: וַיָּשָׁב יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וְכָל יִשְׂרָאֵל עִמּוֹ אֶל הַֽמַּחֲנֶה הַגִּלְגָּֽלָה׃
translation: Joshua returned, and all Israel with him, to the camp to Gilgal. (Joshua 10:15)

text: וַיָּשָׁב יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וְכָל יִשְׂרָאֵל עִמּוֹ אֶל הַֽמַּחֲנֶה הַגִּלְגָּֽלָה׃
translation: Joshua returned, and all Israel with him, to the camp to Gilgal. (Joshua 10:43)

text: חַכְמוֹת שָׂרוֹתֶיהָ תַּעֲנֶינָּה אַף הִיא תָּשִׁיב אֲמָרֶיהָ לָֽהּ׃
translation: Her wise ladies answered her, Yes, she returned answer to herself, (Judges 5:29)

text: וַיֻּגַּד לִשְׁלֹמֹה כִּי הָלַךְ שִׁמְעִי מִירוּשָׁלִַם גַּת וַיָּשֹֽׁב׃
translation: Solomon was told that Shimei had gone from Jerusalem to Gath, and had come again. (1 Kings 2:41)

text: וַיָּשׁוּבוּ הַמַּלְאָכִים אֵלָיו וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם מַה זֶּה שַׁבְתֶּֽם׃
translation: The messengers returned to him, and he said to them, "Why is it that you have returned?" (2 Kings 1:5)

text: וַיָּשָׁב יְהוֹשָׁפָט מֶֽלֶךְ יְהוּדָה אֶל בֵּיתוֹ בְּשָׁלוֹם לִֽירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
translation: Jehoshaphat the king of Judah returned to his house in peace to Jerusalem. (2 Chronicles 19:1)

text: אִם בְּחֻקֹּתַי תֵּלֵכוּ וְאֶת מִצְוֺתַי תִּשְׁמְרוּ וַעֲשִׂיתֶם אֹתָֽם׃
translation: "'If you walk in my statutes and keep my commandments, and do them, (Leviticus 26:3)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ אָנִי לֵךְ אֱמֹר לַאדֹנֶיךָ הִנֵּה אֵלִיָּֽהוּ׃
translation: He answered him, "It is I. Go, tell your lord, 'Behold, Elijah is here!'" (1 Kings 18:8)

text: וְעַתָּה אַתָּה אֹמֵר לֵךְ אֱמֹר לַאדֹנֶיךָ הִנֵּה אֵלִיָּֽהוּ׃
translation: Now you say, 'Go, tell your lord, "Behold, Elijah is here."' (1 Kings 18:11)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ לֵךְ לְשָׁלוֹם וַיֵּלֶךְ מֵאִתּוֹ כִּבְרַת אָֽרֶץ׃
translation: He said to him, "Go in peace." So he departed from him a little way. (2 Kings 5:19)

text: יֵלְכוּ מֵחַיִל אֶל חָיִל יֵרָאֶה אֶל אֱלֹהִים בְּצִיּֽוֹן׃
translation: LORD, God of Armies, hear my prayer. Listen, God of Jacob. Selah. (Psalms 84:8)

text: וַיִּגְדַּל הָאִישׁ וַיֵּלֶךְ הָלוֹךְ וְגָדֵל עַד כִּֽי גָדַל מְאֹֽד׃
translation: The man grew great, and grew more and more until he became very great. (Genesis 26:13)

text: כְּֽדַעְתְּכֶם יָדַעְתִּי גַם אָנִי לֹא נֹפֵל אָנֹכִי מִכֶּֽם׃
translation: What you know, I know also. I am not inferior to you. (Job 13:2)

text: הִנֵּה נָא עָרַכְתִּי מִשְׁפָּט יָדַעְתִּי כִּֽי אֲנִי אֶצְדָּֽק׃
translation: See now, I have set my cause in order. I know that I am righteous. (Job 13:18)

text: יִכְבְּדוּ בָנָיו וְלֹא יֵדָע וְיִצְעֲרוּ וְֽלֹא יָבִין לָֽמוֹ׃
translation: His sons come to honor, and he doesn't know it. They are brought low, but he doesn't perceive it of them. (Job 14:21)

text: מַה יָּדַעְתָּ וְלֹא נֵדָע תָּבִין וְֽלֹא עִמָּנוּ הֽוּא׃
translation: What do you know that we don't know? What do you understand which is not in us? (Job 15:9)

text: כִּֽי יָדַעְתִּי מָוֶת תְּשִׁיבֵנִי וּבֵית מוֹעֵד לְכָל חָֽי׃
translation: For I know that you will bring me to death, to the house appointed for all living. (Job 30:23)

text: הוֹדִיעֵנוּ מַה נֹּאמַר לוֹ לֹא נַעֲרֹךְ מִפְּנֵי חֹֽשֶׁךְ׃
translation: Teach us what we will tell him, for we can't make our case by reason of darkness. (Job 37:19)

text: וַיָּמָת בֶּן הָאִשָּׁה הַזֹּאת לָיְלָה אֲשֶׁר שָׁכְבָה עָלָֽיו׃
translation: This woman's child died in the night, because she lay on it. (1 Kings 3:19)

text: וַיָּמָת הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיָּבוֹא שֹׁמְרוֹן וַיִּקְבְּרוּ אֶת הַמֶּלֶךְ בְּשֹׁמְרֽוֹן׃
translation: So the king died, and was brought to Samaria; and they buried the king in Samaria. (1 Kings 22:37)

text: וַיְהִי כְּמוֹת אַחְאָב וַיִּפְשַׁע מֶֽלֶךְ מוֹאָב בְּמֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
translation: But when Ahab was dead, the king of Moab rebelled against the king of Israel. (2 Kings 3:5)

text: וּבְנֵי נָדָב סֶלֶד וְאַפָּיִם וַיָּמָת סֶלֶד לֹא בָנִֽים׃
translation: The sons of Nadab: Seled and Appaim; but Seled died without children. (1 Chronicles 2:30)

text: וַיָּמָת שָׁאוּל וּשְׁלֹשֶׁת בָּנָיו וְכָל בֵּיתוֹ יַחְדָּו מֵֽתוּ׃
translation: So Saul died with his three sons; and all his house died together. (1 Chronicles 10:6)

text: כִּי אֵין בַּמָּוֶת זִכְרֶךָ בִּשְׁאוֹל מִי יֽוֹדֶה לָּֽךְ׃
translation: I am weary with my groaning. Every night I flood my bed. I drench my couch with my tears. (Psalms 6:6)

text: פְּקֻדֵיהֶם לְמַטֵּה אָשֵׁר אֶחָד וְאַרְבָּעִים אֶלֶף וַחֲמֵשׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃
translation: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Asher, were forty-one thousand five hundred. (Numbers 1:41)

text: אֶת הַיָּם אֶחָד וְאֶת הַבָּקָר שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר תַּחְתָּֽיו׃
translation: one sea, and the twelve oxen under it. (2 Chronicles 4:15)

text: בְּנֵי לֹד חָדִיד וְאוֹנוֹ שְׁבַע מֵאוֹת וְעֶשְׂרִים וְאֶחָֽד׃
translation: The children of Lod, Hadid, and Ono: seven hundred twenty-one. (Nehemiah 7:37)

text: בֶּן אָדָם שְׁתַּיִם נָשִׁים בְּנוֹת אֵם אַחַת הָיֽוּ׃
translation: "Son of man, there were two women, the daughters of one mother. (Ezekiel 23:2)

text: וְהָיָה אִם יִוָּתְרוּ עֲשָׂרָה אֲנָשִׁים בְּבַיִת אֶחָד וָמֵֽתוּ׃
translation: It will happen that if ten men remain in one house, they will die. (Amos 6:9)

text: וַֽיְהִי כָל הָאָרֶץ שָׂפָה אֶחָת וּדְבָרִים אֲחָדִֽים׃
translation: The whole earth was of one language and of one speech. (Genesis 11:1)

text: וַיִּקָּחֵם וַיַּֽעֲבִרֵם אֶת הַנָּחַל וַֽיַּעֲבֵר אֶת אֲשֶׁר לוֹ׃
translation: Jacob was left alone, and wrestled with a man there until the breaking of the day. (Genesis 32:24)

text: וָאֶקַּח אֶת הַלְוִיִּם תַּחַת כָּל בְּכוֹר בִּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
translation: I have taken the Levites instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel. (Numbers 8:18)

text: אַל תַּשְׁלִיכֵנִי מִלְּפָנֶיךָ וְרוּחַ קָדְשְׁךָ אַל תִּקַּח מִמֶּֽנִּי׃
translation: Then I will teach transgressors your ways. Sinners will be converted to you. (Psalms 51:13)

text: כִּי לֶקַח טוֹב נָתַתִּי לָכֶם תּֽוֹרָתִי אַֽל תַּעֲזֹֽבוּ׃
translation: for I give you sound learning. Don't forsake my law. (Proverbs 4:2)

text: שְׁמַע בְּנִי וְקַח אֲמָרָי וְיִרְבּוּ לְךָ שְׁנוֹת חַיִּֽים׃
translation: Listen, my son, and receive my sayings. The years of your life will be many. (Proverbs 4:10)

text: תֵּן לְחָכָם וְיֶחְכַּם עוֹד הוֹדַע לְצַדִּיק וְיוֹסֶף לֶֽקַח׃
translation: Instruct a wise person, and he will be still wiser. Teach a righteous person, and he will increase in learning. (Proverbs 9:9)

text: וְאַרְפַּכְשַׁד חַי חָמֵשׁ וּשְׁלֹשִׁים שָׁנָה וַיּוֹלֶד אֶת שָֽׁלַח׃
translation: Arpachshad lived thirty-five years and became the father of Shelah. (Genesis 11:12)

text: וַיְחִי רְעוּ שְׁתַּיִם וּשְׁלֹשִׁים שָׁנָה וַיּוֹלֶד אֶת שְׂרֽוּג׃
translation: Reu lived thirty-two years, and became the father of Serug. (Genesis 11:20)

text: וַיִּמְלֹךְ שְׁלֹמֹה בִֽירוּשָׁלִַם עַל כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵל אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָֽה׃
translation: Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel forty years. (2 Chronicles 9:30)

text: כִּי אֹרֶךְ יָמִים וּשְׁנוֹת חַיִּים וְשָׁלוֹם יוֹסִיפוּ לָֽךְ׃
translation: for they will add to you length of days, years of life, and peace. (Proverbs 3:2)

text: כִּי בִי יִרְבּוּ יָמֶיךָ וְיוֹסִיפוּ לְּךָ שְׁנוֹת חַיִּֽים׃
translation: For by me your days will be multiplied. The years of your life will be increased. (Proverbs 9:11)

text: וַֽיְחִי קֵינָן שִׁבְעִים שָׁנָה וַיּוֹלֶד אֶת מַֽהֲלַלְאֵֽל׃
translation: Kenan lived seventy years, then became the father of Mahalalel. (Genesis 5:12)

text: וַיִּישַׁר הַדָּבָר בְּעֵינֵי אַבְשָׁלֹם וּבְעֵינֵי כָּל זִקְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
translation: The saying pleased Absalom well, and all the elders of Israel. (2 Samuel 17:4)

text: וַיַּעַשׂ הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהוָה כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה מְנַשֶּׁה אָבִֽיו׃
translation: He did that which was evil in the LORD's sight, as Manasseh his father did. (2 Kings 21:20)

text: וַיַּעַשׂ הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהוָה כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר עָשׂוּ אֲבֹתָֽיו׃
translation: He did that which was evil in the LORD's sight, according to all that his fathers had done. (2 Kings 23:32)

text: וַיַּעַשׂ הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהוָה כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר עָשׂוּ אֲבֹתָֽיו׃
translation: He did that which was evil in the LORD's sight, according to all that his fathers had done. (2 Kings 23:37)

text: וַיַּעַשׂ הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהוָה כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה אָבִֽיו׃
translation: He did that which was evil in the LORD's sight, according to all that his father had done. (2 Kings 24:9)

text: וַיַּעַשׂ הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהוָה כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה יְהוֹיָקִֽים׃
translation: He did that which was evil in the LORD's sight, according to all that Jehoiakim had done. (2 Kings 24:19)

text: וְאַרְפַּכְשַׁד יָלַד אֶת שָׁלַח וְשֶׁלַח יָלַד אֶת עֵֽבֶר׃
translation: Arpachshad became the father of Shelah. Shelah became the father of Eber. (Genesis 10:24)

text: וַיִּשְׁלַח יַעֲקֹב וַיִּקְרָא לְרָחֵל וּלְלֵאָה הַשָּׂדֶה אֶל צֹאנֽוֹ׃
translation: Jacob sent and called Rachel and Leah to the field to his flock, (Genesis 31:4)

text: וַיֹּסֶף עוֹד בָּלָק שְׁלֹחַ שָׂרִים רַבִּים וְנִכְבָּדִים מֵאֵֽלֶּה׃
translation: Balak again sent princes, more, and more honorable than they. (Numbers 22:15)

text: וַיִּשְׁלַח יוֹאָב וַיַּגֵּד לְדָוִד אֶת כָּל דִּבְרֵי הַמִּלְחָמָֽה׃
translation: Then Joab sent and told David all the things concerning the war; (2 Samuel 11:18)

text: וַיִּשְׁלַח הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיַּאַסְפוּ אֵלָיו כָּל זִקְנֵי יְהוּדָה וִירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
translation: The king sent, and they gathered to him all the elders of Judah and of Jerusalem. (2 Kings 23:1)

text: וְאַרְפַּכְשַׁד יָלַד אֶת שָׁלַח וְשֶׁלַח יָלַד אֶת עֵֽבֶר׃
translation: Arpachshad became the father of Shelah, and Shelah became the father of Eber. (1 Chronicles 1:18)

text: אִם אֶשְׂמַח בְּפִיד מְשַׂנְאִי וְהִתְעֹרַרְתִּי כִּֽי מְצָאוֹ רָֽע׃
translation: "If I have rejoiced at the destruction of him who hated me, or lifted up myself when evil found him (Job 31:29)

text: מַה תִּתְהַלֵּל בְּרָעָה הַגִּבּוֹר חֶסֶד אֵל כָּל הַיּֽוֹם׃
translation: You love evil more than good, lying rather than speaking the truth. Selah. (Psalms 52:3)

text: אֲשֶׁר חָשְׁבוּ רָעוֹת בְּלֵב כָּל יוֹם יָגוּרוּ מִלְחָמֽוֹת׃
translation: They have sharpened their tongues like a serpent. Viper's poison is under their lips. Selah. (Psalms 140:3)

text: וַיַּעַשׂ הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהוָה כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה יְהוֹיָקִֽים׃
translation: He did that which was evil in the LORD's sight, according to all that Jehoiakim had done. (Jeremiah 52:2)

text: וַיַּרְא עֵשָׂו כִּי רָעוֹת בְּנוֹת כְּנָעַן בְּעֵינֵי יִצְחָק אָבִֽיו׃
translation: Esau saw that the daughters of Canaan didn't please Isaac, his father. (Genesis 28:8)

text: וַיְהִי עֵר בְּכוֹר יְהוּדָה רַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהוָה וַיְמִתֵהוּ יְהוָֽה׃
translation: Er, Judah's firstborn, was wicked in the LORD's sight. So the LORD killed him. (Genesis 38:7)

text: כִּֽי נַפְשׁוֹ בְּחַיָּיו יְבָרֵךְ וְיוֹדֻךָ כִּי תֵיטִיב לָֽךְ׃
translation: he shall go to the generation of his fathers. They shall never see the light. (Psalms 49:19)

text: חֲצֽוֹת לַיְלָה אָקוּם לְהוֹדוֹת לָךְ עַל מִשְׁפְּטֵי צִדְקֶֽךָ׃
translation: At midnight I will rise to give thanks to you, because of your righteous ordinances. (Psalms 119:62)

text: יָדַעְנוּ יְהוָה רִשְׁעֵנוּ עֲוֺן אֲבוֹתֵינוּ כִּי חָטָאנוּ לָֽךְ׃
translation: We acknowledge, LORD, our wickedness, and the iniquity of our fathers; for we have sinned against you. (Jeremiah 14:20)

text: עַמִּי מֶה עָשִׂיתִי לְךָ וּמָה הֶלְאֵתִיךָ עֲנֵה בִּֽי׃
translation: My people, what have I done to you? How have I burdened you? Answer me! (Micah 6:3)

text: וַיֵּלְכוּ גַּם אֶחָיו וַֽיִּפְּלוּ לְפָנָיו וַיֹּאמְרוּ הִנֶּנּֽוּ לְךָ לַעֲבָדִֽים׃
translation: His brothers also went and fell down before his face; and they said, "Behold, we are your servants." (Genesis 50:18)

text: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם אֶת הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה לְחָק לְךָ וּלְבָנֶיךָ עַד עוֹלָֽם׃
translation: You shall observe this thing for an ordinance to you and to your sons forever. (Exodus 12:24)

text: כָּל זָכָר בַּכֹּהֲנִים יֹאכַל אֹתָהּ קֹדֶשׁ קָֽדָשִׁים הִֽוא׃
translation: The anointed priest that will be in his place from among his sons shall offer it. By a statute forever, it shall be wholly burned to the LORD. (Leviticus 6:22)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר אָבִינוּ שֻׁבוּ שִׁבְרוּ לָנוּ מְעַט אֹֽכֶל׃
translation: Our father said, 'Go again and buy us a little food.' (Genesis 44:25)

text: וַתֵּצֵא אֵשׁ מִלִּפְנֵי יְהוָה וַתֹּאכַל אוֹתָם וַיָּמֻתוּ לִפְנֵי יְהוָֽה׃
translation: Fire came out from before the LORD, and devoured them, and they died before the LORD. (Leviticus 10:2)

text: לֶחֶם אֱלֹהָיו מִקָּדְשֵׁי הַקֳּדָשִׁים וּמִן הַקֳּדָשִׁים יֹאכֵֽל׃
translation: He shall eat the bread of his God, both of the most holy, and of the holy. (Leviticus 21:22)

text: פֶּן תֹּאכַל וְשָׂבָעְתָּ וּבָתִּים טוֹבִים תִּבְנֶה וְיָשָֽׁבְתָּ׃
translation: lest, when you have eaten and are full, and have built fine houses and lived in them; (Deuteronomy 8:12)

text: רַק אֶת דָּמוֹ לֹא תֹאכֵל עַל הָאָרֶץ תִּשְׁפְּכֶנּוּ כַּמָּֽיִם׃
translation: Only you shall not eat its blood. You shall pour it out on the ground like water. (Deuteronomy 15:23)

text: וַיִּשָּׂא לוֹ יְהוֹיָדָע נָשִׁים שְׁתָּיִם וַיּוֹלֶד בָּנִים וּבָנֽוֹת׃
translation: Jehoiada took for him two wives, and he became the father of sons and daughters. (2 Chronicles 24:3)

text: כֹּל הַמִּשְׁפָּחוֹת הַנִּשְׁאָרוֹת מִשְׁפָּחֹת מִשְׁפָּחֹת לְבָד וּנְשֵׁיהֶם לְבָֽד׃
translation: all the families who remain, every family apart, and their wives apart. (Zechariah 12:14)

text: וְהַנּוֹתֶרֶת מִן הַמִּנְחָה לְאַהֲרֹן וּלְבָנָיו קֹדֶשׁ קָֽדָשִׁים מֵאִשֵּׁי יְהוָֽה׃
translation: That which is left of the meal offering shall be Aaron's and his sons'. It is a most holy part of the offerings of the LORD made by fire. (Leviticus 2:3)

text: וְהַנּוֹתֶרֶת מִן הַמִּנְחָה לְאַהֲרֹן וּלְבָנָיו קֹדֶשׁ קָֽדָשִׁים מֵאִשֵּׁי יְהוָֽה׃
translation: That which is left of the meal offering shall be Aaron's and his sons'. It is a most holy part of the offerings of the LORD made by fire. (Leviticus 2:10)

text: כִּֽי יִקַּח אִישׁ אִשָּׁה וּבָא אֵלֶיהָ וּשְׂנֵאָֽהּ׃
translation: If any man takes a wife, and goes in to her, hates her, (Deuteronomy 22:13)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר מָנוֹחַ אֶל אִשְׁתּוֹ מוֹת נָמוּת כִּי אֱלֹהִים רָאִֽינוּ׃
translation: Manoah said to his wife, "We shall surely die, because we have seen God." (Judges 13:22)

text: וַיִּקְרָא מַלְאַךְ יְהוָה אֶל אַבְרָהָם שֵׁנִית מִן הַשָּׁמָֽיִם׃
translation: The LORD's angel called to Abraham a second time out of the sky, (Genesis 22:15)

text: וְהָיָה כִּֽי יִקְרָא לָכֶם פַּרְעֹה וְאָמַר מַה מַּעֲשֵׂיכֶֽם׃
translation: It will happen, when Pharaoh summons you, and will say, 'What is your occupation?' (Genesis 46:33)

text: וּמֹשֶׁה אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים בָּנָיו יִקָּרְאוּ עַל שֵׁבֶט הַלֵּוִֽי׃
translation: But as for Moses the man of God, his sons were named among the tribe of Levi. (1 Chronicles 23:14)

text: קְֽרָא נָא הֲיֵשׁ עוֹנֶךָּ וְאֶל מִי מִקְּדֹשִׁים תִּפְנֶֽה׃
translation: "Call now; is there any who will answer you? To which of the holy ones will you turn? (Job 5:1)

text: אִם קָרָאתִי וַֽיַּעֲנֵנִי לֹֽא אַאֲמִין כִּֽי יַאֲזִין קוֹלִֽי׃
translation: If I had called, and he had answered me, yet I wouldn't believe that he listened to my voice. (Job 9:16)

text: וַיִּקְרָא רָעָב עַל הָאָרֶץ כָּֽל מַטֵּה לֶחֶם שָׁבָֽר׃
translation: He called for a famine on the land. He destroyed the food supplies. (Psalms 105:16)

text: וַיַּשְׁכֵּם יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בַּבֹּקֶר וַיִּשְׂאוּ הַכֹּהֲנִים אֶת אֲרוֹן יְהוָֽה׃
translation: Joshua rose early in the morning, and the priests took up the LORD's ark. (Joshua 6:12)

text: וְאֵלֶּה הַשָּׂרִים אֲשֶׁר לוֹ עֲזַרְיָהוּ בֶן צָדוֹק הַכֹּהֵֽן׃
translation: These were the princes whom he had: Azariah the son of Zadok, the priest; (1 Kings 4:2)

text: וּבְנָיָהוּ בֶן יְהוֹיָדָע עַל הַצָּבָא וְצָדוֹק וְאֶבְיָתָר כֹּהֲנִֽים׃
translation: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the army; Zadok and Abiathar were priests; (1 Kings 4:4)

text: וַיָּבֹאוּ כֹּל זִקְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּשְׂאוּ הַכֹּהֲנִים אֶת הָאָרֽוֹן׃
translation: All the elders of Israel came, and the priests picked up the ark. (1 Kings 8:3)

text: מֵעַל שַׁעַר הַסּוּסִים הֶחֱזִיקוּ הַכֹּהֲנִים אִישׁ לְנֶגֶד בֵּיתֽוֹ׃
translation: Above the horse gate, the priests made repairs, everyone across from his own house. (Nehemiah 3:28)

text: מֵֽחַטֹּאת נְבִיאֶיהָ עֲוֺנוֹת כֹּהֲנֶיהָ הַשֹּׁפְכִים בְּקִרְבָּהּ דַּם צַדִּיקִֽים׃
translation: It is because of the sins of her prophets and the iniquities of her priests, that have shed the blood of the just in the middle of her. (Lamentations 4:13)

text: וַיִּתְחַזֵּק יוֹתָם כִּי הֵכִין דְּרָכָיו לִפְנֵי יְהוָה אֱלֹהָֽיו׃
translation: So Jotham became mighty, because he ordered his ways before the LORD his God. (2 Chronicles 27:6)

text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ לָאֵל סוּר מִמֶּנּוּ וְדַעַת דְּרָכֶיךָ לֹא חָפָֽצְנוּ׃
translation: They tell God, 'Depart from us, for we don't want to know about your ways. (Job 21:14)

text: כִּֽי יוֹדֵעַ יְהוָה דֶּרֶךְ צַדִּיקִים וְדֶרֶךְ רְשָׁעִים תֹּאבֵֽד׃
translation: For the LORD knows the way of the righteous, but the way of the wicked shall perish. (Psalms 1:6)

text: הַרְחֵק מֵעָלֶיהָ דַרְכֶּךָ וְאַל תִּקְרַב אֶל פֶּתַח בֵּיתָֽהּ׃
translation: Remove your way far from her. Don't come near the door of her house, (Proverbs 5:8)

text: כֹּה אָמַר יְהוָה צְבָאוֹת שִׂימוּ לְבַבְכֶם עַל דַּרְכֵיכֶֽם׃
translation: "This is what the LORD of Armies says: 'Consider your ways. (Haggai 1:7)

text: וַיָּקָם בִּלְעָם וַיֵּלֶךְ וַיָּשָׁב לִמְקֹמוֹ וְגַם בָּלָק הָלַךְ לְדַרְכּֽוֹ׃
translation: Balaam rose up, and went and returned to his place; and Balak also went his way. (Numbers 24:25)

text: לִבְנֵי עֻזִּיאֵל עַמִּינָדָב הַשָּׂר וְאֶחָיו מֵאָה וּשְׁנֵים עָשָֽׂר׃
translation: of the sons of Uzziel, Amminadab the chief, and his brothers one hundred twelve. (1 Chronicles 15:10)

text: לְאַרְבָּעָה וְעֶשְׂרִים לְרוֹמַמְתִּי עָזֶר בָּנָיו וְאֶחָיו שְׁנֵים עָשָֽׂר׃
translation: for the twenty-fourth to Romamti-Ezer, his sons and his brothers, twelve. (1 Chronicles 25:31)

text: וַתִּשְׁלַם הַֽחוֹמָה בְּעֶשְׂרִים וַחֲמִשָּׁה לֶאֱלוּל לַחֲמִשִּׁים וּשְׁנַיִם יֽוֹם׃
translation: So the wall was finished in the twenty-fifth day of Elul, in fifty-two days. (Nehemiah 6:15)

text: מַצְדִּיק רָשָׁע וּמַרְשִׁיעַ צַדִּיק תּוֹעֲבַת יְהוָה גַּם שְׁנֵיהֶֽם׃
translation: He who justifies the wicked, and he who condemns the righteous, both of them alike are an abomination to the LORD. (Proverbs 17:15)

text: אֹזֶן שֹׁמַעַת וְעַיִן רֹאָה יְהוָה עָשָׂה גַם שְׁנֵיהֶֽם׃
translation: The hearing ear, and the seeing eye, the LORD has made even both of them. (Proverbs 20:12)

text: וַיִּקַּח אַבְרָהָם צֹאן וּבָקָר וַיִּתֵּן לַאֲבִימֶלֶךְ וַיִּכְרְתוּ שְׁנֵיהֶם בְּרִֽית׃
translation: Abraham took sheep and cattle, and gave them to Abimelech. Those two made a covenant. (Genesis 21:27)

text: כִּי הִשְׂבִּיעַ נֶפֶשׁ שֹׁקֵקָה וְנֶפֶשׁ רְעֵבָה מִלֵּא טֽוֹב׃
translation: For he satisfies the longing soul. He fills the hungry soul with good. (Psalms 107:9)

text: שֶׁשׁ הֵנָּה שָׂנֵא יְהוָה וְשֶׁבַע תועבות תּוֹעֲבַת נַפְשֽׁוֹ׃
translation: There are six things which the LORD hates; yes, seven which are an abomination to him: (Proverbs 6:16)

text: כִּֽי יְהוָה יָרִיב רִיבָם וְקָבַע אֶת קֹבְעֵיהֶם נָֽפֶשׁ׃
translation: for the LORD will plead their case, and plunder the life of those who plunder them. (Proverbs 22:23)

text: מְצָאוּנִי הַשֹּׁמְרִים הַסֹּבְבִים בָּעִיר אֵת שֶׁאָהֲבָה נַפְשִׁי רְאִיתֶֽם׃
translation: The watchmen who go about the city found me; "Have you seen him whom my soul loves?" (Song of Solomon 3:3)

text: וְאִם אָסוֹן יִהְיֶה וְנָתַתָּה נֶפֶשׁ תַּחַת נָֽפֶשׁ׃
translation: But if any harm follows, then you must take life for life, (Exodus 21:23)

text: וּמַכֵּה נֶֽפֶשׁ בְּהֵמָה יְשַׁלְּמֶנָּה נֶפֶשׁ תַּחַת נָֽפֶשׁ׃
translation: He who strikes an animal mortally shall make it good, life for life. (Leviticus 24:18)

text: פְּקֻדֵיהֶם לְמַטֵּה זְבוּלֻן שִׁבְעָה וַחֲמִשִּׁים אֶלֶף וְאַרְבַּע מֵאֽוֹת׃
translation: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Zebulun, were fifty-seven thousand four hundred. (Numbers 1:31)

text: בְּנֵי לֹד חָדִיד וְאוֹנוֹ שְׁבַע מֵאוֹת עֶשְׂרִים וַחֲמִשָּֽׁה׃
translation: The children of Lod, Hadid, and Ono, seven hundred twenty-five. (Ezra 2:33)

text: הִנֵּה שֶׁבַע שָׁנִים בָּאוֹת שָׂבָע גָּדוֹל בְּכָל אֶרֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
translation: Behold, seven years of great plenty throughout all the land of Egypt are coming. (Genesis 41:29)

text: וּצְבָאוֹ וּפְקֻדָיו שִׁבְעָה וַחֲמִשִּׁים אֶלֶף וְאַרְבַּע מֵאֽוֹת׃
translation: His division, and those who were counted of it, were fifty-seven thousand four hundred. (Numbers 2:8)

text: וַיִּהְיוּ פְקֻדֵיהֶם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם אַלְפַּיִם שְׁבַע מֵאוֹת וַחֲמִשִּֽׁים׃
translation: Those who were counted of them by their families were two thousand seven hundred fifty. (Numbers 4:36)

text: אֵלֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹת מְנַשֶּׁה וּפְקֻדֵיהֶם שְׁנַיִם וַחֲמִשִּׁים אֶלֶף וּשְׁבַע מֵאֽוֹת׃
translation: These are the families of Manasseh. Those who were counted of them were fifty-two thousand seven hundred. (Numbers 26:34)

text: זֶה חֵֽלֶק אָדָם רָשָׁע מֵאֱלֹהִים וְנַחֲלַת אִמְרוֹ מֵאֵֽל׃
translation: This is the portion of a wicked man from God, the heritage appointed to him by God." (Job 20:29)

text: בֵּֽאלֹהִים בָּטַחְתִּי לֹא אִירָא מַה יַּעֲשֶׂה אָדָם לִֽי׃
translation: Your vows are on me, God. I will give thank offerings to you. (Psalms 56:12)

text: וַיִּֽירְאוּ כָּל אָדָם וַיַּגִּידוּ פֹּעַל אֱלֹהִים וּֽמַעֲשֵׂהוּ הִשְׂכִּֽילוּ׃
translation: The righteous shall be glad in the LORD, and shall take refuge in him. All the upright in heart shall praise him! (Psalms 64:10)

text: יְהוָה לִי לֹא אִירָא מַה יַּעֲשֶׂה לִי אָדָֽם׃
translation: The LORD is on my side. I will not be afraid. What can man do to me? (Psalms 118:6)

text: וְרִחַק יְהוָה אֶת הָאָדָם וְרַבָּה הָעֲזוּבָה בְּקֶרֶב הָאָֽרֶץ׃
translation: and the LORD has removed men far away, and the forsaken places are many within the land. (Isaiah 6:12)

text: מַה יִּתְאוֹנֵן אָדָם חָי גֶּבֶר עַל חטאו חֲטָאָֽיו׃
translation: Why should a living man complain, a man for the punishment of his sins? (Lamentations 3:39)

text: וַֽיַּעֲבֹר מָרְדֳּכָי וַיַּעַשׂ כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר צִוְּתָה עָלָיו אֶסְתֵּֽר׃
translation: So Mordecai went his way, and did according to all that Esther had commanded him. (Esther 4:17)

text: בָּא עַל עַיַּת עָבַר בְּמִגְרוֹן לְמִכְמָשׂ יַפְקִיד כֵּלָֽיו׃
translation: He has come to Aiath. He has passed through Migron. At Michmash he stores his baggage. (Isaiah 10:28)

text: עִבְרִי אַרְצֵךְ כַּיְאֹר בַּת תַּרְשִׁישׁ אֵין מֵזַח עֽוֹד׃
translation: Pass through your land like the Nile, daughter of Tarshish. There is no restraint any more. (Isaiah 23:10)

text: וְהַעֲבַרְתִּי אֶתְכֶם תַּחַת הַשָּׁבֶט וְהֵבֵאתִי אֶתְכֶם בְּמָסֹרֶת הַבְּרִֽית׃
translation: "I will cause you to pass under the rod, and I will bring you into the bond of the covenant. (Ezekiel 20:37)

text: וְשֶׁלַח חַי שְׁלֹשִׁים שָׁנָה וַיּוֹלֶד אֶת עֵֽבֶר׃
translation: Shelah lived thirty years, and became the father of Eber. (Genesis 11:14)

text: הִנֵּה אֲרוֹן הַבְּרִית אֲדוֹן כָּל הָאָרֶץ עֹבֵר לִפְנֵיכֶם בַּיַּרְדֵּֽן׃
translation: Behold, the ark of the covenant of the Lord of all the earth passes over before you into the Jordan. (Joshua 3:11)

text: וְלֹֽא יְחַלֵּל זַרְעוֹ בְּעַמָּיו כִּי אֲנִי יְהוָה מְקַדְּשֽׁוֹ׃
translation: He shall not profane his offspring among his people, for I am the LORD who sanctifies him.'" (Leviticus 21:15)

text: זֹאת עֲבֹדַת בְּנֵי קְהָת בְּאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד קֹדֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִֽׁים׃
translation: "This is the service of the sons of Kohath in the Tent of Meeting, regarding the most holy things. (Numbers 4:4)

text: וַיִּסְעוּ מֵעֶצְיוֹן גָּבֶר וַיַּחֲנוּ בְמִדְבַּר צִן הִוא קָדֵֽשׁ׃
translation: They traveled from Ezion Geber, and encamped at Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin. (Numbers 33:36)

text: כִּי בוֹ יִשְׂמַח לִבֵּנוּ כִּי בְשֵׁם קָדְשׁוֹ בָטָֽחְנוּ׃
translation: For our heart rejoices in him, because we have trusted in his holy name. (Psalms 33:21)

text: גָּדוֹל יְהוָה וּמְהֻלָּל מְאֹד בְּעִיר אֱלֹהֵינוּ הַר קָדְשֽׁוֹ׃
translation: Beautiful in elevation, the joy of the whole earth, is Mount Zion, on the north sides, the city of the great King. (Psalms 48:2)

text: הָרִימָה פְעָמֶיךָ לְמַשֻּׁאוֹת נֶצַח כָּל הֵרַע אוֹיֵב בַּקֹּֽדֶשׁ׃
translation: Lift up your feet to the perpetual ruins, all the evil that the enemy has done in the sanctuary. (Psalms 74:3)

text: וַיִּשָּׂא מְשָׁלוֹ וַיֹּאמַר אוֹי מִי יִחְיֶה מִשֻּׂמוֹ אֵֽל׃
translation: He took up his parable, and said, "Alas, who shall live when God does this? (Numbers 24:23)

text: וַיָּבֹאוּ כֹּל זִקְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּשְׂאוּ הַלְוִיִּם אֶת הָאָרֽוֹן׃
translation: All the elders of Israel came. The Levites took up the ark. (2 Chronicles 5:4)

text: שְׂאֵת פְּנֵי רָשָׁע לֹא טוֹב לְהַטּוֹת צַדִּיק בַּמִּשְׁפָּֽט׃
translation: To be partial to the faces of the wicked is not good, nor to deprive the innocent of justice. (Proverbs 18:5)

text: וְעַל כָּל הֶהָרִים הָרָמִים וְעַל כָּל הַגְּבָעוֹת הַנִּשָּׂאֽוֹת׃
translation: for all the high mountains, for all the hills that are lifted up, (Isaiah 2:14)

text: עַתָּה אָקוּם יֹאמַר יְהוָה עַתָּה אֵֽרוֹמָם עַתָּה אֶנָּשֵֽׂא׃
translation: "Now I will arise," says the LORD. "Now I will lift myself up. Now I will be exalted. (Isaiah 33:10)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר קַיִן אֶל יְהוָה גָּדוֹל עֲוֺנִי מִנְּשֹֽׂא׃
translation: Cain said to the LORD, "My punishment is greater than I can bear. (Genesis 4:13)

text: קוּם כִּֽי עָלֶיךָ הַדָּבָר וַאֲנַחְנוּ עִמָּךְ חֲזַק וַעֲשֵֽׂה׃
translation: Arise, for the matter belongs to you and we are with you. Be courageous, and do it." (Ezra 10:4)

text: וּמַאֲמַר אֶסְתֵּר קִיַּם דִּבְרֵי הַפֻּרִים הָאֵלֶּה וְנִכְתָּב בַּסֵּֽפֶר׃
translation: The commandment of Esther confirmed these matters of Purim; and it was written in the book. (Esther 9:32)

text: וַתַּבֵּט עֵינִי בְּשׁוּרָי בַּקָּמִים עָלַי מְרֵעִים תִּשְׁמַעְנָה אָזְנָֽי׃
translation: The righteous shall flourish like the palm tree. He will grow like a cedar in Lebanon. (Psalms 92:12)

text: כֹּה אָמַר אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה לֹא תָקוּם וְלֹא תִֽהְיֶֽה׃
translation: This is what the Lord GOD says: "It shall not stand, neither shall it happen." (Isaiah 7:7)

text: וַאֲנִי הִנְנִי מֵקִים אֶת בְּרִיתִי אִתְּכֶם וְאֶֽת זַרְעֲכֶם אַֽחֲרֵיכֶֽם׃
translation: "As for me, behold, I establish my covenant with you, and with your offspring after you, (Genesis 9:9)

text: וַיָּקָם אַבְרָהָם וַיִּשְׁתַּחוּ לְעַם הָאָרֶץ לִבְנֵי חֵֽת׃
translation: Abraham rose up, and bowed himself to the people of the land, to the children of Heth. (Genesis 23:7)

text: הֲרֹב דְּבָרִים לֹא יֵעָנֶה וְאִם אִישׁ שְׂפָתַיִם יִצְדָּֽק׃
translation: "Shouldn't the multitude of words be answered? Should a man full of talk be justified? (Job 11:2)

text: וַתֵּשְׁבוּ בְקָדֵשׁ יָמִים רַבִּים כַּיָּמִים אֲשֶׁר יְשַׁבְתֶּֽם׃
translation: So you stayed in Kadesh many days, according to the days that you remained. (Deuteronomy 1:46)

text: רַב לָכֶם סֹב אֶת הָהָר הַזֶּה פְּנוּ לָכֶם צָפֹֽנָה׃
translation: "You have encircled this mountain long enough. Turn northward. (Deuteronomy 2:3)

text: יָמִים רַבִּים עָשָׂה יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶת כָּל הַמְּלָכִים הָאֵלֶּה מִלְחָמָֽה׃
translation: Joshua made war a long time with all those kings. (Joshua 11:18)

text: וְעֶבְרֹן וּרְחֹב וְחַמּוֹן וְקָנָה עַד צִידוֹן רַבָּֽה׃
translation: and Ebron, Rehob, Hammon, and Kanah, even to great Sidon. (Joshua 19:28)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר אַל תִּירָא כִּי רַבִּים אֲשֶׁר אִתָּנוּ מֵאֲשֶׁר אוֹתָֽם׃
translation: He answered, "Don't be afraid, for those who are with us are more than those who are with them." (2 Kings 6:16)

text: אוֹ עִם שָׂרִים זָהָב לָהֶם הַֽמְמַלְאִים בָּתֵּיהֶם כָּֽסֶף׃
translation: or with princes who had gold, who filled their houses with silver; (Job 3:15)

text: כֹּחַ מַעֲשָׂיו הִגִּיד לְעַמּוֹ לָתֵת לָהֶם נַחֲלַת גּוֹיִֽם׃
translation: He has shown his people the power of his works, in giving them the heritage of the nations. (Psalms 111:6)

text: פֶּֽה לָהֶם וְלֹא יְדַבֵּרוּ עֵינַיִם לָהֶם וְלֹא יִרְאֽוּ׃
translation: They have mouths, but they don't speak. They have eyes, but they don't see. (Psalms 115:5)

text: אָזְנַיִם לָהֶם וְלֹא יִשְׁמָעוּ אַף לָהֶם וְלֹא יְרִיחֽוּן׃
translation: They have ears, but they don't hear. They have noses, but they don't smell. (Psalms 115:6)

text: פֶּֽה לָהֶם וְלֹא יְדַבֵּרוּ עֵינַיִם לָהֶם וְלֹא יִרְאֽוּ׃
translation: They have mouths, but they can't speak. They have eyes, but they can't see. (Psalms 135:16)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶם יַעֲקֹב אַחַי מֵאַיִן אַתֶּם וַיֹּאמְרוּ מֵחָרָן אֲנָֽחְנוּ׃
translation: Jacob said to them, "My relatives, where are you from?" They said, "We are from Haran." (Genesis 29:4)

text: לִֽיהוּדָה אֱלִיהוּ מֵאֲחֵי דָוִיד לְיִשָׂשכָר עָמְרִי בֶּן מִיכָאֵֽל׃
translation: of Judah, Elihu, one of the brothers of David; of Issachar, Omri the son of Michael; (1 Chronicles 27:18)

text: וַיֵּלְכוּ אֶחָיו לִרְעוֹת אֶׄתׄ צֹאן אֲבִיהֶם בִּשְׁכֶֽם׃
translation: His brothers went to feed their father's flock in Shechem. (Genesis 37:12)

text: וְאֶת אֲחִיכֶם קָחוּ וְקוּמוּ שׁוּבוּ אֶל הָאִֽישׁ׃
translation: Take your brother also, get up, and return to the man. (Genesis 43:13)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר פַּרְעֹה אֶל יוֹסֵף לֵאמֹר אָבִיךָ וְאַחֶיךָ בָּאוּ אֵלֶֽיךָ׃
translation: Pharaoh spoke to Joseph, saying, "Your father and your brothers have come to you. (Genesis 47:5)

text: וַיָּמָת יוֹסֵף וְכָל אֶחָיו וְכֹל הַדּוֹר הַהֽוּא׃
translation: Joseph died, as did all his brothers, and all that generation. (Exodus 1:6)

text: וְאִם אֵין לוֹ אַחִים וּנְתַתֶּם אֶת נַחֲלָתוֹ לַאֲחֵי אָבִֽיו׃
translation: If he has no brothers, then you shall give his inheritance to his father's brothers. (Numbers 27:10)

text: וַיְהִי בִישֻׁרוּן מֶלֶךְ בְּהִתְאַסֵּף רָאשֵׁי עָם יַחַד שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
translation: He was king in Jeshurun, when the heads of the people were gathered, all the tribes of Israel together. (Deuteronomy 33:5)

text: בְּנֵי לַעְדָּן הָרֹאשׁ יְחִיאֵל וְזֵתָם וְיוֹאֵל שְׁלֹשָֽׁה׃
translation: The sons of Ladan: Jehiel the chief, Zetham, and Joel, three. (1 Chronicles 23:8)

text: מִן בְּנֵי פֶרֶץ הָרֹאשׁ לְכָל שָׂרֵי הַצְּבָאוֹת לַחֹדֶשׁ הָרִאשֽׁוֹן׃
translation: He was of the children of Perez, the chief of all the captains of the army for the first month. (1 Chronicles 27:3)

text: כֹּל מִסְפַּר רָאשֵׁי הָאָבוֹת לְגִבּוֹרֵי חָיִל אַלְפַּיִם וְשֵׁשׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃
translation: The whole number of the heads of fathers' households, even the mighty men of valor, was two thousand six hundred. (2 Chronicles 26:12)

text: שְׂאוּ שְׁעָרִים רָֽאשֵׁיכֶם וְֽהִנָּשְׂאוּ פִּתְחֵי עוֹלָם וְיָבוֹא מֶלֶךְ הַכָּבֽוֹד׃
translation: Lift up your heads, you gates! Be lifted up, you everlasting doors, and the King of glory will come in. (Psalms 24:7)

text: שְׂאוּ שְׁעָרִים רָֽאשֵׁיכֶם וּשְׂאוּ פִּתְחֵי עוֹלָם וְיָבֹא מֶלֶךְ הַכָּבֽוֹד׃
translation: Lift up your heads, you gates; yes, lift them up, you everlasting doors, and the King of glory will come in. (Psalms 24:9)

text: וַֽתַּעֲנוּ אֹתִי וַתֹּאמְרוּ טֽוֹב הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר דִּבַּרְתָּ לַעֲשֽׂוֹת׃
translation: You answered me, and said, "The thing which you have spoken is good to do." (Deuteronomy 1:14)

text: מַשְׂכִּיל עַל דָּבָר יִמְצָא טוֹב וּבוֹטֵחַ בַּיהוָה אַשְׁרָֽיו׃
translation: He who heeds the Word finds prosperity. Whoever trusts in the LORD is blessed. (Proverbs 16:20)

text: טוֹב אֶרֶךְ אַפַּיִם מִגִּבּוֹר וּמֹשֵׁל בְּרוּחוֹ מִלֹּכֵד עִֽיר׃
translation: One who is slow to anger is better than the mighty; one who rules his spirit, than he who takes a city. (Proverbs 16:32)

text: טוֹב שֵׁם מִשֶּׁמֶן טוֹב וְיוֹם הַמָּוֶת מִיּוֹם הִוָּלְדֽוֹ׃
translation: A good name is better than fine perfume; and the day of death better than the day of one's birth. (Ecclesiastes 7:1)

text: וַאֲנִי הִנְנִי בְיֶדְכֶם עֲשׂוּ לִי כַּטּוֹב וְכַיָּשָׁר בְּעֵינֵיכֶֽם׃
translation: But as for me, behold, I am in your hand. Do with me what is good and right in your eyes. (Jeremiah 26:14)

text: לֹא תִדְרֹשׁ שְׁלֹמָם וְטֹבָתָם כָּל יָמֶיךָ לְעוֹלָֽם׃
translation: You shall not abhor an Edomite, for he is your brother. You shall not abhor an Egyptian, because you lived as a foreigner in his land. (Deuteronomy 23:7)

text: וּבְנֵי בִנְיָמִן מִגָּבַע מִכְמָשׂ וְעַיָּה וּבֵֽית אֵל וּבְנֹתֶֽיהָ׃
translation: The children of Benjamin also lived from Geba onward, at Michmash and Aija, and at Bethel and its towns, (Nehemiah 11:31)

text: הִנֵּה כָּל הַמֹּשֵׁל עָלַיִךְ יִמְשֹׁל לֵאמֹר כְּאִמָּה בִּתָּֽהּ׃
translation: "'"Behold, everyone who uses proverbs will use this proverb against you, saying, 'As is the mother, so is her daughter.' (Ezekiel 16:44)

text: וּלְלָבָן שְׁתֵּי בָנוֹת שֵׁם הַגְּדֹלָה לֵאָה וְשֵׁם הַקְּטַנָּה רָחֵֽל׃
translation: Laban had two daughters. The name of the elder was Leah, and the name of the younger was Rachel. (Genesis 29:16)

text: וְאַחַר יָלְדָה בַּת וַתִּקְרָא אֶת שְׁמָהּ דִּינָֽה׃
translation: Afterwards, she bore a daughter, and named her Dinah. (Genesis 30:21)

text: וְאֵלֶּה בְנֵֽי עֲנָה דִּשֹׁן וְאָהֳלִיבָמָה בַּת עֲנָֽה׃
translation: These are the children of Anah: Dishon and Oholibamah, the daughter of Anah. (Genesis 36:25)

text: כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה כֵּן עָשׂוּ בְּנוֹת צְלָפְחָֽד׃
translation: The daughters of Zelophehad did as the LORD commanded Moses: (Numbers 36:10)

text: וְגַם אֶת בֶּן הָאָמָה לְגוֹי אֲשִׂימֶנּוּ כִּי זַרְעֲךָ הֽוּא׃
translation: I will also make a nation of the son of the servant, because he is your child." (Genesis 21:13)

text: יִשָּׂא יְהוָה פָּנָיו אֵלֶיךָ וְיָשֵׂם לְךָ שָׁלֽוֹם׃
translation: The LORD lift up his face toward you, and give you peace.' (Numbers 6:26)

text: וַיְהִי כַּאֲשֶׁר זָקֵן שְׁמוּאֵל וַיָּשֶׂם אֶת בָּנָיו שֹׁפְטִים לְיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
translation: When Samuel was old, he made his sons judges over Israel. (1 Samuel 8:1)

text: וַיָּשֶׂם אֶת הָאֶחָד בְּבֵֽית אֵל וְאֶת הָאֶחָד נָתַן בְּדָֽן׃
translation: He set the one in Bethel, and the other he put in Dan. (1 Kings 12:29)

text: הֲזֹאת יָדַעְתָּ מִנִּי עַד מִנִּי שִׂים אָדָם עֲלֵי אָֽרֶץ׃
translation: Don't you know this from old time, since man was placed on earth, (Job 20:4)

text: קַח נָא מִפִּיו תּוֹרָה וְשִׂים אֲמָרָיו בִּלְבָבֶֽךָ׃
translation: Please receive instruction from his mouth, and lay up his words in your heart. (Job 22:22)

text: לֵב שָׂמֵחַ יֵיטִב פָּנִים וּבְעַצְּבַת לֵב רוּחַ נְכֵאָֽה׃
translation: A glad heart makes a cheerful face, but an aching heart breaks the spirit. (Proverbs 15:13)

text: לֵב חָכָם יַשְׂכִּיל פִּיהוּ וְעַל שְׂפָתָיו יֹסִיף לֶֽקַח׃
translation: The heart of the wise instructs his mouth, and adds learning to his lips. (Proverbs 16:23)

text: לֵב נָבוֹן יִקְנֶה דָּעַת וְאֹזֶן חֲכָמִים תְּבַקֶּשׁ דָּֽעַת׃
translation: The heart of the discerning gets knowledge. The ear of the wise seeks knowledge. (Proverbs 18:15)

text: בְּנִי אִם חָכַם לִבֶּךָ יִשְׂמַח לִבִּי גַם אָֽנִי׃
translation: My son, if your heart is wise, then my heart will be glad, even mine. (Proverbs 23:15)

text: וְנָתַתִּי לָכֶם רֹעִים כְּלִבִּי וְרָעוּ אֶתְכֶם דֵּעָה וְהַשְׂכֵּֽיל׃
translation: I will give you shepherds according to my heart, who will feed you with knowledge and understanding. (Jeremiah 3:15)

text: וַיֶּחֱזַק לֵב פַּרְעֹה וְלֹא שָׁמַע אֲלֵהֶם כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהוָֽה׃
translation: Pharaoh's heart was hardened, and he didn't listen to them, as the LORD had spoken. (Exodus 7:13)

text: עִזִּים מָאתַיִם וּתְיָשִׁים עֶשְׂרִים רְחֵלִים מָאתַיִם וְאֵילִים עֶשְׂרִֽים׃
translation: thirty milk camels and their colts, forty cows, ten bulls, twenty female donkeys and ten foals. (Genesis 32:15)

text: פְּקֻדֵיהֶם לְמַטֵּה רְאוּבֵן שִׁשָּׁה וְאַרְבָּעִים אֶלֶף וַחֲמֵשׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃
translation: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Reuben, were forty-six thousand five hundred. (Numbers 1:21)

text: פְּקֻדֵיהֶם לְמַטֵּה יִשָּׂשכָר אַרְבָּעָה וַחֲמִשִּׁים אֶלֶף וְאַרְבַּע מֵאֽוֹת׃
translation: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Issachar, were fifty-four thousand four hundred. (Numbers 1:29)

text: פְּקֻדֵיהֶם לְמַטֵּה בִנְיָמִן חֲמִשָּׁה וּשְׁלֹשִׁים אֶלֶף וְאַרְבַּע מֵאֽוֹת׃
translation: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Benjamin, were thirty-five thousand four hundred. (Numbers 1:37)

text: פְּקֻדֵיהֶם לְמַטֵּה נַפְתָּלִי שְׁלֹשָׁה וַחֲמִשִּׁים אֶלֶף וְאַרְבַּע מֵאֽוֹת׃
translation: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Naphtali, were fifty-three thousand four hundred. (Numbers 1:43)

text: וּצְבָאוֹ וּפְקֻדֵיהֶם חֲמִשָּׁה וְאַרְבָּעִים אֶלֶף וְשֵׁשׁ מֵאוֹת וַחֲמִשִּֽׁים׃
translation: His division, and those who were counted of them, were forty-five thousand six hundred fifty. (Numbers 2:15)

text: וְחֶצְרוֹן הוֹלִיד אֶת רָם וְרָם הוֹלִיד אֶת עַמִּֽינָדָֽב׃
translation: and Hezron became the father of Ram, and Ram became the father of Amminadab, (Ruth 4:19)

text: וְעַמִּֽינָדָב הוֹלִיד אֶת נַחְשׁוֹן וְנַחְשׁוֹן הוֹלִיד אֶת שַׂלְמָֽה׃
translation: and Amminadab became the father of Nahshon, and Nahshon became the father of Salmon, (Ruth 4:20)

text: וְשַׂלְמוֹן הוֹלִיד אֶת בֹּעַז וּבֹעַז הוֹלִיד אֶת עוֹבֵֽד׃
translation: and Salmon became the father of Boaz, and Boaz became the father of Obed, (Ruth 4:21)

text: וְעֹבֵד הוֹלִיד אֶת יִשָׁי וְיִשַׁי הוֹלִיד אֶת דָּוִֽד׃
translation: and Obed became the father of Jesse, and Jesse became the father of David. (Ruth 4:22)

text: וַיּוֹלֶד אַבְרָהָם אֶת יִצְחָק בְּנֵי יִצְחָק עֵשָׂו וְיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
translation: Abraham became the father of Isaac. The sons of Isaac: Esau and Israel. (1 Chronicles 1:34)

text: וְנַחְשׁוֹן הוֹלִיד אֶת שַׂלְמָא וְשַׂלְמָא הוֹלִיד אֶת בֹּֽעַז׃
translation: and Nahshon became the father of Salma, and Salma became the father of Boaz, (1 Chronicles 2:11)

text: חֲמֵשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה אַמָּה מִלְמַעְלָה גָּבְרוּ הַמָּיִם וַיְכֻסּוּ הֶהָרִֽים׃
translation: The waters rose fifteen cubits higher, and the mountains were covered. (Genesis 7:20)

text: וַיִּגְבְּרוּ הַמַּיִם עַל הָאָרֶץ חֲמִשִּׁים וּמְאַת יֽוֹם׃
translation: The waters flooded the earth one hundred fifty days. (Genesis 7:24)

text: וְלֹא הָיָה מַיִם לָעֵדָה וַיִּקָּהֲלוּ עַל מֹשֶׁה וְעַֽל אַהֲרֹֽן׃
translation: There was no water for the congregation; and they assembled themselves together against Moses and against Aaron. (Numbers 20:2)

text: מִשָּׁם נָסְעוּ הַגֻּדְגֹּדָה וּמִן הַגֻּדְגֹּדָה יָטְבָתָה אֶרֶץ נַחֲלֵי מָֽיִם׃
translation: From there they traveled to Gudgodah; and from Gudgodah to Jotbathah, a land of brooks of water. (Deuteronomy 10:7)

text: וַיָּשָׁב אִתּוֹ וַיֹּאכַל לֶחֶם בְּבֵיתוֹ וַיֵּשְׁתְּ מָֽיִם׃
translation: So he went back with him, ate bread in his house, and drank water. (1 Kings 13:19)

text: אוֹ חֹשֶׁךְ לֹֽא תִרְאֶה וְֽשִׁפְעַת מַיִם תְּכַסֶּֽךָּ׃
translation: or darkness, so that you can not see, and floods of waters cover you. (Job 22:11)

text: וַיִּגְדַּל הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה מִכֹּל מַלְכֵי הָאָרֶץ לְעֹשֶׁר וְחָכְמָֽה׃
translation: So King Solomon exceeded all the kings of the earth in riches and wisdom. (2 Chronicles 9:22)

text: וּגְדֵרוֹת בֵּית דָּגוֹן וְנַעֲמָה וּמַקֵּדָה עָרִים שֵׁשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃
translation: Gederoth, Beth Dagon, Naamah, and Makkedah; sixteen cities with their villages. (Joshua 15:41)

text: וּכְפַר העמני הָֽעַמֹּנָה וְהָֽעָפְנִי וָגָבַע עָרִים שְׁתֵּים עֶשְׂרֵה וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃
translation: Chephar Ammoni, Ophni, and Geba; twelve cities with their villages. (Joshua 18:24)

text: וּבֵית לְבָאוֹת וְשָֽׁרוּחֶן עָרִים שְׁלֹשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃
translation: Beth Lebaoth, and Sharuhen; thirteen cities with their villages; (Joshua 19:6)

text: וַיִּקַּח עֲשָׂרָה אֲנָשִׁים מִזִּקְנֵי הָעִיר וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁבוּ פֹה וַיֵּשֵֽׁבוּ׃
translation: Boaz took ten men of the elders of the city, and said, "Sit down here," and they sat down. (Ruth 4:2)

text: וְאֶת הַיָּם הָאֶחָד וְאֶת הַבָּקָר שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר תַּחַת הַיָּֽם׃
translation: the one sea; the twelve oxen under the sea; (1 Kings 7:44)

text: וַיַּחֲלֹשׁ יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶת עֲמָלֵק וְאֶת עַמּוֹ לְפִי חָֽרֶב׃
translation: Joshua defeated Amalek and his people with the edge of the sword. (Exodus 17:13)

text: וַיִּפְקֹד אֹתָם מֹשֶׁה עַל פִּי יְהוָה כַּאֲשֶׁר צֻוָּֽה׃
translation: Moses counted them according to the LORD's word, as he was commanded. (Numbers 3:16)

text: בִּדְבַר יְהוָה שָׁמַיִם נַעֲשׂוּ וּבְרוּחַ פִּיו כָּל צְבָאָֽם׃
translation: By the LORD's word, the heavens were made: all their army by the breath of his mouth. (Psalms 33:6)

text: וַיַּרְחִיבוּ עָלַי פִּיהֶם אָמְרוּ הֶאָח הֶאָח רָאֲתָה עֵינֵֽינוּ׃
translation: Yes, they opened their mouth wide against me. They said, "Aha! Aha! Our eye has seen it!" (Psalms 35:21)

text: וְעַתָּה בָנִים שִׁמְעוּ לִי וְאַל תָּסוּרוּ מֵאִמְרֵי פִֽי׃
translation: Now therefore, my sons, listen to me. Don't depart from the words of my mouth. (Proverbs 5:7)

text: עָרֵב לָאִישׁ לֶחֶם שָׁקֶר וְאַחַר יִמָּֽלֵא פִיהוּ חָצָֽץ׃
translation: Fraudulent food is sweet to a man, but afterwards his mouth is filled with gravel. (Proverbs 20:17)

text: כִּי כֹה אָמַר יְהוָה לְבֵית יִשְׂרָאֵל דִּרְשׁוּנִי וִֽחְיֽוּ׃
translation: For the LORD says to the house of Israel: "Seek me, and you will live; (Amos 5:4)

text: כֹּה אָמַר יְהוָה אֱלֹהָי רְעֵה אֶת צֹאן הַהֲרֵגָֽה׃
translation: The LORD my God says: "Feed the flock of slaughter. (Zechariah 11:4)

text: וְאָמַרְתָּ אֶל פַּרְעֹה כֹּה אָמַר יְהוָה בְּנִי בְכֹרִי יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
translation: You shall tell Pharaoh, 'The LORD says, Israel is my son, my firstborn, (Exodus 4:22)

text: וְהַנְּבִיאִים יִֽהְיוּ לְרוּחַ וְהַדִּבֵּר אֵין בָּהֶם כֹּה יֵעָשֶׂה לָהֶֽם׃
translation: The prophets will become wind, and the word is not in them. Thus it will be done to them." (Jeremiah 5:13)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר יִרְמְיָהוּ אֲלֵיהֶם כֹּה תֹאמְרֻן אֶל צִדְקִיָּֽהוּ׃
translation: Then Jeremiah said to them, "Tell Zedekiah: (Jeremiah 21:3)

text: כֹּֽה אָמַר יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל עָלֶיךָ בָּרֽוּךְ׃
translation: "The LORD, the God of Israel, says to you, Baruch: (Jeremiah 45:2)

text: וְלַעֲמֹד בַּבֹּקֶר בַּבֹּקֶר לְהֹדוֹת וּלְהַלֵּל לַיהוָה וְכֵן לָעָֽרֶב׃
translation: and to stand every morning to thank and praise the LORD, and likewise in the evening; (1 Chronicles 23:30)

text: אַֽדַבְּרָה וְלֹא אִירָאֶנּוּ כִּי לֹא כֵן אָנֹכִי עִמָּדִֽי׃
translation: then I would speak, and not fear him, for I am not so in myself. (Job 9:35)

text: אַתָּה נוֹרָא אַתָּה וּמִֽי יַעֲמֹד לְפָנֶיךָ מֵאָז אַפֶּֽךָ׃
translation: You pronounced judgment from heaven. The earth feared, and was silent, (Psalms 76:8)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם מֹשֶׁה עִמְדוּ וְאֶשְׁמְעָה מַה יְצַוֶּה יְהוָה לָכֶֽם׃
translation: Moses answered them, "Wait, that I may hear what the LORD will command concerning you." (Numbers 9:8)

text: וַֽיַּעְמֹד וַיְבָרֶךְ אֵת כָּל קְהַל יִשְׂרָאֵל קוֹל גָּדוֹל לֵאמֹֽר׃
translation: He stood and blessed all the assembly of Israel with a loud voice, saying, (1 Kings 8:55)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר קְרָא לָהּ וַיִּקְרָא לָהּ וַֽתַּעֲמֹד בַּפָּֽתַח׃
translation: He said, "Call her." When he had called her, she stood in the door. (2 Kings 4:15)

text: וַיִּֽתְהַלְּכוּ מִגּוֹי אֶל גּוֹי וּמִמַּמְלָכָה אֶל עַם אַחֵֽר׃
translation: They went about from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another people. (1 Chronicles 16:20)

text: וַֽיִּתְהַלְּכוּ מִגּוֹי אֶל גּוֹי מִמַּמְלָכָה אֶל עַם אַחֵֽר׃
translation: They went about from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another people. (Psalms 105:13)

text: רָם עַל כָּל גּוֹיִם יְהוָה עַל הַשָּׁמַיִם כְּבוֹדֽוֹ׃
translation: The LORD is high above all nations, his glory above the heavens. (Psalms 113:4)

text: כָּל מַלְכֵי גוֹיִם כֻּלָּם שָׁכְבוּ בְכָבוֹד אִישׁ בְּבֵיתֽוֹ׃
translation: All the kings of the nations sleep in glory, everyone in his own house. (Isaiah 14:18)

text: לָכֵן שִׁמְעוּ הַגּוֹיִם וּדְעִי עֵדָה אֶת אֲשֶׁר בָּֽם׃
translation: Therefore hear, you nations, and know, congregation, what is among them. (Jeremiah 6:18)

text: וְנִחַלְתְּ בָּךְ לְעֵינֵי גוֹיִם וְיָדַעַתְּ כִּֽי אֲנִי יְהוָֽה׃
translation: You will be profaned in yourself in the sight of the nations. Then you will know that I am the LORD."'" (Ezekiel 22:16)

text: הַר אֱלֹהִים הַר בָּשָׁן הַר גַּבְנֻנִּים הַר בָּשָֽׁן׃
translation: Why do you look in envy, you rugged mountains, at the mountain where God chooses to reign? Yes, the LORD will dwell there forever. (Psalms 68:16)

text: וַיְבִיאֵם אֶל גְּבוּל קָדְשׁוֹ הַר זֶה קָנְתָה יְמִינֽוֹ׃
translation: He brought them to the border of his sanctuary, to this mountain, which his right hand had taken. (Psalms 78:54)

text: כִּי קוֹל מַגִּיד מִדָּן וּמַשְׁמִיעַ אָוֶן מֵהַר אֶפְרָֽיִם׃
translation: For a voice declares from Dan, and publishes evil from the hills of Ephraim: (Jeremiah 4:15)

text: וַיֵּשֶׁב עֵשָׂו בְּהַר שֵׂעִיר עֵשָׂו הוּא אֱדֽוֹם׃
translation: Esau lived in the hill country of Seir. Esau is Edom. (Genesis 36:8)

text: וַהֲקֵמֹתָ אֶת הַמִּשְׁכָּן כְּמִשְׁפָּטוֹ אֲשֶׁר הָרְאֵיתָ בָּהָֽר׃
translation: You shall set up the tabernacle according to the way that it was shown to you on the mountain. (Exodus 26:30)

text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה בְּהַר סִינַי לֵאמֹֽר׃
translation: The LORD said to Moses on Mount Sinai, (Leviticus 25:1)

text: וַיִּקְרְבוּ בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל בְּנֵי בִנְיָמִן בַּיּוֹם הַשֵּׁנִֽי׃
translation: The children of Israel came near against the children of Benjamin the second day. (Judges 20:24)

text: וְזֹאת תּוֹרַת זֶבַח הַשְּׁלָמִים אֲשֶׁר יַקְרִיב לַיהוָֽה׃
translation: "'This is the law of the sacrifice of peace offerings, which one shall offer to the LORD: (Leviticus 7:11)

text: וְהִקְרִיב הַכֹּהֵן לִפְנֵי יְהוָה וְעָשָׂה אֶת חַטָּאתוֹ וְאֶת עֹלָתֽוֹ׃
translation: The priest shall present them before the LORD, and shall offer his sin offering and his burnt offering. (Numbers 6:16)

text: וְהָיָה כְּקָֽרָבְכֶם אֶל הַמִּלְחָמָה וְנִגַּשׁ הַכֹּהֵן וְדִבֶּר אֶל הָעָֽם׃
translation: It shall be, when you draw near to the battle, that the priest shall approach and speak to the people, (Deuteronomy 20:2)

text: כִּֽי תִקְרַב אֶל עִיר לְהִלָּחֵם עָלֶיהָ וְקָרָאתָ אֵלֶיהָ לְשָׁלֽוֹם׃
translation: When you draw near to a city to fight against it, then proclaim peace to it. (Deuteronomy 20:10)

text: וַיַּקְרֵב שְׁמוּאֵל אֵת כָּל שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּלָּכֵד שֵׁבֶט בִּנְיָמִֽן׃
translation: So Samuel brought all the tribes of Israel near, and the tribe of Benjamin was chosen. (1 Samuel 10:20)

text: עַיִן שְׁזָפַתּוּ וְלֹא תוֹסִיף וְלֹא עוֹד תְּשׁוּרֶנּוּ מְקוֹמֽוֹ׃
translation: The eye which saw him will see him no more, neither will his place see him any more. (Job 20:9)

text: וְעוֹד מְעַט וְאֵין רָשָׁע וְהִתְבּוֹנַנְתָּ עַל מְקוֹמוֹ וְאֵינֶֽנּוּ׃
translation: For yet a little while, and the wicked will be no more. Yes, though you look for his place, he isn't there. (Psalms 37:10)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה כֵּן דִּבַּרְתָּ לֹא אֹסִף עוֹד רְאוֹת פָּנֶֽיךָ׃
translation: Moses said, "You have spoken well. I will see your face again no more." (Exodus 10:29)

text: וּמִבֶּן חֲמִשִּׁים שָׁנָה יָשׁוּב מִצְּבָא הָעֲבֹדָה וְלֹא יַעֲבֹד עֽוֹד׃
translation: and from the age of fifty years they shall retire from doing the work, and shall serve no more, (Numbers 8:25)

text: וַיּוֹסֶף עוֹד יִפְתָּח וַיִּשְׁלַח מַלְאָכִים אֶל מֶלֶךְ בְּנֵי עַמּֽוֹן׃
translation: Jephthah sent messengers again to the king of the children of Ammon; (Judges 11:14)

text: וְלֹֽא יָכֹל עוֹד לְהָשִׁיב אֶת אַבְנֵר דָּבָר מִיִּרְאָתוֹ אֹתֽוֹ׃
translation: He could not answer Abner another word, because he was afraid of him. (2 Samuel 3:11)

text: וְדָוִד הוּא הַקָּטָן וּשְׁלֹשָׁה הַגְּדֹלִים הָלְכוּ אַחֲרֵי שָׁאֽוּל׃
translation: David was the youngest; and the three oldest followed Saul. (1 Samuel 17:14)

text: יְהוָה בְּצִיּוֹן גָּדוֹל וְרָם הוּא עַל כָּל הָֽעַמִּֽים׃
translation: The LORD is great in Zion. He is high above all the peoples. (Psalms 99:2)

text: וְֽאֶת רֶסֶן בֵּין נִֽינְוֵה וּבֵין כָּלַח הִוא הָעִיר הַגְּדֹלָֽה׃
translation: and Resen between Nineveh and the great city Calah. (Genesis 10:12)

text: וַיֵּלֶךְ דָּוִיד הָלוֹךְ וְגָדוֹל וַיהוָה צְבָאוֹת עִמּֽוֹ׃
translation: David grew greater and greater, for the LORD of Armies was with him. (1 Chronicles 11:9)

text: עֹשֶׂה גְדֹלוֹת עַד אֵין חֵקֶר וְנִפְלָאוֹת עַד אֵין מִסְפָּֽר׃
translation: He does great things past finding out; yes, marvelous things without number. (Job 9:10)

text: אֱלֹהִים בַּקֹּדֶשׁ דַּרְכֶּךָ מִי אֵל גָּדוֹל כֵּֽאלֹהִֽים׃
translation: You are the God who does wonders. You have made your strength known among the peoples. (Psalms 77:14)

text: וַיְדַבֵּר שְׁלֹשֶׁת אֲלָפִים מָשָׁל וַיְהִי שִׁירוֹ חֲמִשָּׁה וָאָֽלֶף׃
translation: The LORD gave Solomon wisdom, as he promised him. There was peace between Hiram and Solomon, and the two of them made a treaty together. (1 Kings 5:12)

text: פְּקֻדֵיהֶם לְמַטֵּה גָד חֲמִשָּׁה וְאַרְבָּעִים אֶלֶף וְשֵׁשׁ מֵאוֹת וַחֲמִשִּֽׁים׃
translation: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Gad, were forty-five thousand six hundred fifty. (Numbers 1:25)

text: פְּקֻדֵיהֶם לְמַטֵּה אֶפְרָיִם אַרְבָּעִים אֶלֶף וַחֲמֵשׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃
translation: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Ephraim, were forty thousand five hundred. (Numbers 1:33)

text: פְּקֻדֵיהֶם לְמַטֵּה מְנַשֶּׁה שְׁנַיִם וּשְׁלֹשִׁים אֶלֶף וּמָאתָֽיִם׃
translation: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Manasseh, were thirty-two thousand two hundred. (Numbers 1:35)

text: וּצְבָאוֹ וּפְקֻדֵיהֶם אַרְבָּעָה וְשִׁבְעִים אֶלֶף וְשֵׁשׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃
translation: His division, and those who were counted of them, were seventy-four thousand six hundred. (Numbers 2:4)

text: וּצְבָאוֹ וּפְקֻדָיו אַרְבָּעָה וַחֲמִשִּׁים אֶלֶף וְאַרְבַּע מֵאֽוֹת׃
translation: His division, and those who were counted of it, were fifty-four thousand four hundred. (Numbers 2:6)

text: וַיֻּגַּד לְשָׁאוּל לֵאמֹר הִנֵּה דָוִד בנוית בְּנָיוֹת בָּרָמָֽה׃
translation: Saul was told, saying, "Behold, David is at Naioth in Ramah." (1 Samuel 19:19)

text: הִתְבֹּנַנְתָּ עַד רַחֲבֵי אָרֶץ הַגֵּד אִם יָדַעְתָּ כֻלָּֽהּ׃
translation: Have you comprehended the earth in its width? Declare, if you know it all. (Job 38:18)

text: כִּי כָל מִשְׁפָּטָיו לְנֶגְדִּי וְחֻקֹּתָיו לֹא אָסִיר מֶֽנִּי׃
translation: I was also blameless with him. I kept myself from my iniquity. (Psalms 18:23)

text: וַיְּשָּֽׁמְעוּ הַדְּבָרִים אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר דָּוִד וַיַּגִּדוּ לִפְנֵֽי שָׁאוּל וַיִּקָּחֵֽהוּ׃
translation: When the words were heard which David spoke, they rehearsed them before Saul; and he sent for him. (1 Samuel 17:31)

text: וַיַּגִּדוּ עַבְדֵי שָׁאוּל לוֹ לֵאמֹר כַּדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה דִּבֶּר דָּוִֽד׃
translation: The servants of Saul told him, saying, "David spoke like this." (1 Samuel 18:24)

text: וַיַּגֵּד אֶבְיָתָר לְדָוִד כִּי הָרַג שָׁאוּל אֵת כֹּהֲנֵי יְהוָֽה׃
translation: Abiathar told David that Saul had slain the LORD's priests. (1 Samuel 22:21)

text: וַיִּבֶן אֶת בֵּֽית לֶחֶם וְאֶת עֵיטָם וְאֶת תְּקֽוֹעַ׃
translation: He built Bethlehem, Etam, Tekoa, (2 Chronicles 11:6)

text: לְדָוִד רִיבָה יְהוָה אֶת יְרִיבַי לְחַם אֶת לֹֽחֲמָֽי׃
translation: By David. Contend, LORD, with those who contend with me. Fight against those who fight against me. (Psalms 35:1)

text: מֵאָשֵׁר שְׁמֵנָה לַחְמוֹ וְהוּא יִתֵּן מַֽעֲדַנֵּי מֶֽלֶךְ׃
translation: "Asher's food will be rich. He will produce royal dainties. (Genesis 49:20)

text: וַיִּֽתְקַבְּצוּ יַחְדָּו לְהִלָּחֵם עִם יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וְעִם יִשְׂרָאֵל פֶּה אֶחָֽד׃
translation: they gathered themselves together to fight with Joshua and with Israel, with one accord. (Joshua 9:2)

text: וַיַּעַל יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וְכָֽל יִשְׂרָאֵל עִמּוֹ מֵעֶגְלוֹנָה חֶבְרוֹנָה וַיִּֽלָּחֲמוּ עָלֶֽיהָ׃
translation: Joshua went up from Eglon, and all Israel with him, to Hebron; and they fought against it. (Joshua 10:36)

text: וַיֵּצֵא גַעַל לִפְנֵי בַּעֲלֵי שְׁכֶם וַיִּלָּחֶם בַּאֲבִימֶֽלֶךְ׃
translation: Gaal went out before the men of Shechem, and fought with Abimelech. (Judges 9:39)

text: וַיִּזְכֹּר כִּי בָשָׂר הֵמָּה רוּחַ הוֹלֵךְ וְלֹא יָשֽׁוּב׃
translation: He remembered that they were but flesh, a wind that passes away, and doesn't come again. (Psalms 78:39)

text: וַיִּתְהַלֵּךְ חֲנוֹךְ אֶת הָֽאֱלֹהִים וְאֵינֶנּוּ כִּֽי לָקַח אֹתוֹ אֱלֹהִֽים׃
translation: Enoch walked with God, and he was not found, for God took him. (Genesis 5:24)

text: וְגַם לְלוֹט הַהֹלֵךְ אֶת אַבְרָם הָיָה צֹאן וּבָקָר וְאֹהָלִֽים׃
translation: Lot also, who went with Abram, had flocks, herds, and tents. (Genesis 13:5)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו אִם אֵין פָּנֶיךָ הֹלְכִים אַֽל תַּעֲלֵנוּ מִזֶּֽה׃
translation: Moses said to him, "If your presence doesn't go with me, don't carry us up from here. (Exodus 33:15)

text: וְהִתְהַלַּכְתִּי בְּתוֹכְכֶם וְהָיִיתִי לָכֶם לֵֽאלֹהִים וְאַתֶּם תִּהְיוּ לִי לְעָֽם׃
translation: I will walk among you, and will be your God, and you will be my people. (Leviticus 26:12)

text: וַיַּעַל שָׁאוּל מֵאַחֲרֵי פְּלִשְׁתִּים וּפְלִשְׁתִּים הָלְכוּ לִמְקוֹמָֽם׃
translation: Then Saul went up from following the Philistines; and the Philistines went to their own place. (1 Samuel 14:46)

text: וְעַל צְבָא מַטֵּה בְּנֵי יִשָׂשכָר נְתַנְאֵל בֶּן צוּעָֽר׃
translation: Nethanel the son of Zuar was over the army of the tribe of the children of Issachar. (Numbers 10:15)

text: וְעַל צְבָא מַטֵּה בְּנֵי זְבוּלֻן אֱלִיאָב בֶּן חֵלֽוֹן׃
translation: Eliab the son of Helon was over the army of the tribe of the children of Zebulun. (Numbers 10:16)

text: וְעַל צְבָא מַטֵּה בְנֵי גָד אֶלְיָסָף בֶּן דְּעוּאֵֽל׃
translation: Eliasaph the son of Deuel was over the army of the tribe of the children of Gad. (Numbers 10:20)

text: וְעַל צְבָא מַטֵּה בְּנֵי בִנְיָמִן אֲבִידָן בֶּן גִּדְעוֹנִֽי׃
translation: Abidan the son of Gideoni was over the army of the tribe of the children of Benjamin. (Numbers 10:24)

text: וְעַל צְבָא מַטֵּה בְּנֵי אָשֵׁר פַּגְעִיאֵל בֶּן עָכְרָֽן׃
translation: Pagiel the son of Ochran was over the army of the tribe of the children of Asher. (Numbers 10:26)

text: וְעַל צְבָא מַטֵּה בְּנֵי נַפְתָּלִי אֲחִירַע בֶּן עֵינָֽן׃
translation: Ahira the son of Enan was over the army of the tribe of the children of Naphtali. (Numbers 10:27)

text: חַי יְהוָה וּבָרוּךְ צוּרִי וְיָרֻם אֱלֹהֵי צוּר יִשְׁעִֽי׃
translation: The LORD lives! Blessed be my rock! Exalted be God, the rock of my salvation, (2 Samuel 22:47)

text: כִּֽי אֶשָּׂא אֶל שָׁמַיִם יָדִי וְאָמַרְתִּי חַי אָנֹכִי לְעֹלָֽם׃
translation: For I lift up my hand to heaven and declare, as I live forever, (Deuteronomy 32:40)

text: וַיִּשְׁפֹּט שְׁמוּאֵל אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל כֹּל יְמֵי חַיָּֽיו׃
translation: Samuel judged Israel all the days of his life. (1 Samuel 7:15)

text: וּמִלְחָמָה הָיְתָה בֵין רְחַבְעָם וּבֵין יָרָבְעָם כָּל יְמֵי חַיָּֽיו׃
translation: Now there was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam all the days of his life. (1 Kings 15:6)

text: כִּי עִם אַבְנֵי הַשָּׂדֶה בְרִיתֶךָ וְחַיַּת הַשָּׂדֶה הָשְׁלְמָה לָֽךְ׃
translation: For you will be allied with the stones of the field. The animals of the field will be at peace with you. (Job 5:23)

text: זְכֹר כִּי רוּחַ חַיָּי לֹא תָשׁוּב עֵינִי לִרְאוֹת טֽוֹב׃
translation: Oh remember that my life is a breath. My eye will no more see good. (Job 7:7)
