text: וַיַּךְ אֶת מוֹאָב וַיִּהְיוּ מוֹאָב עֲבָדִים לְדָוִיד נֹשְׂאֵי מִנְחָֽה׃
translation: He defeated Moab; and the Moabites became servants to David and brought tribute. (1 Chronicles 18:2)

text: וַיֵּרַע בְּעֵינֵי הָאֱלֹהִים עַל הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה וַיַּךְ אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
translation: God was displeased with this thing; therefore he struck Israel. (1 Chronicles 21:7)

text: הִנֵּה אֲדֹנָי יֽוֹרִשֶׁנָּה וְהִכָּה בַיָּם חֵילָהּ וְהִיא בָּאֵשׁ תֵּאָכֵֽל׃
translation: Behold, the Lord will dispossess her, and he will strike her power in the sea; and she will be devoured with fire. (Zechariah 9:4)

text: וּמַכֵּה בְהֵמָה יְשַׁלְּמֶנָּה וּמַכֵּה אָדָם יוּמָֽת׃
translation: He who kills an animal shall make it good; and he who kills a man shall be put to death. (Leviticus 24:21)

text: וְשָֽׁפְטוּ הָֽעֵדָה בֵּין הַמַּכֶּה וּבֵין גֹּאֵל הַדָּם עַל הַמִּשְׁפָּטִים הָאֵֽלֶּה׃
translation: then the congregation shall judge between the striker and the avenger of blood according to these ordinances. (Numbers 35:24)

text: וּנְתָנָהּ יְהוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בְּיָדֶךָ וְהִכִּיתָ אֶת כָּל זְכוּרָהּ לְפִי חָֽרֶב׃
translation: When the LORD your God delivers it into your hand, you shall strike every male of it with the edge of the sword; (Deuteronomy 20:13)

text: וְעָנוּ הַלְוִיִּם וְאָֽמְרוּ אֶל כָּל אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל קוֹל רָֽם׃
translation: With a loud voice, the Levites shall say to all the men of Israel, (Deuteronomy 27:14)

text: לָרֹכֵב בִּשְׁמֵי שְׁמֵי קֶדֶם הֵן יִתֵּן בְּקוֹלוֹ קוֹל עֹֽז׃
translation: Ascribe strength to God! His excellency is over Israel, his strength is in the skies. (Psalms 68:34)

text: נָשְׂאוּ נְהָרוֹת יְֽהוָה נָשְׂאוּ נְהָרוֹת קוֹלָם יִשְׂאוּ נְהָרוֹת דָּכְיָֽם׃
translation: The floods have lifted up, LORD, the floods have lifted up their voice. The floods lift up their waves. (Psalms 93:3)

text: כִּי אִם לַבִּינָה תִקְרָא לַתְּבוּנָה תִּתֵּן קוֹלֶֽךָ׃
translation: yes, if you call out for discernment, and lift up your voice for understanding; (Proverbs 2:3)

text: אֲלֵיכֶם אִישִׁים אֶקְרָא וְקוֹלִי אֶל בְּנֵי אָדָֽם׃
translation: "I call to you men! I send my voice to the sons of mankind. (Proverbs 8:4)

text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ הָעָם אֶל יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶת יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ נַעֲבֹד וּבְקוֹלוֹ נִשְׁמָֽע׃
translation: The people said to Joshua, "We will serve the LORD our God, and we will listen to his voice." (Joshua 24:24)

text: חֶרֶב יְרֵאתֶם וְחֶרֶב אָבִיא עֲלֵיכֶם נְאֻם אֲדֹנָי יְהוִֽה׃
translation: You have feared the sword; and I will bring the sword on you," says the Lord GOD. (Ezekiel 11:8)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ קְחוּ לִי חָרֶב וַיָּבִאוּ הַחֶרֶב לִפְנֵי הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
translation: The king said, "Get me a sword." So they brought a sword before the king. (1 Kings 3:24)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה לַמַּלְאָךְ וַיָּשֶׁב חַרְבּוֹ אֶל נְדָנָֽהּ׃
translation: Then the LORD commanded the angel, and he put his sword back into its sheath. (1 Chronicles 21:27)

text: אַף תָּשִׁיב צוּר חַרְבּוֹ וְלֹא הֲקֵימֹתוֹ בַּמִּלְחָמָֽה׃
translation: You have ended his splendor, and thrown his throne down to the ground. (Psalms 89:44)

text: וּבְנוֹתֶיהָ אֲשֶׁר בַּשָּׂדֶה בַּחֶרֶב תֵּהָרַגְנָה וְיָדְעוּ כִּי אֲנִי יְהוָֽה׃
translation: Her daughters who are in the field will be slain with the sword. Then they will know that I am the LORD.' (Ezekiel 26:6)

text: כִּי כֹּה אָמַר אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה חֶרֶב מֶֽלֶךְ בָּבֶל תְּבוֹאֶֽךָ׃
translation: For the Lord GOD says: "The sword of the king of Babylon will come on you. (Ezekiel 32:11)

text: כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה וַֽיִּפְקְדֵם בְּמִדְבַּר סִינָֽי׃
translation: As the LORD commanded Moses, so he counted them in the wilderness of Sinai. (Numbers 1:19)

text: וַיְצַו דָּוִיד לְכָל שָׂרֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לַעְזֹר לִשְׁלֹמֹה בְנֽוֹ׃
translation: David also commanded all the princes of Israel to help Solomon his son, saying, (1 Chronicles 22:17)

text: וַיַּעַשׂ נֹחַ כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה אֹתוֹ אֱלֹהִים כֵּן עָשָֽׂה׃
translation: Thus Noah did. He did all that God commanded him. (Genesis 6:22)

text: וַיְצַוּוּ אֶל יוֹסֵף לֵאמֹר אָבִיךָ צִוָּה לִפְנֵי מוֹתוֹ לֵאמֹֽר׃
translation: They sent a message to Joseph, saying, "Your father commanded before he died, saying, (Genesis 50:16)

text: וַיַּעַשׂ מֹשֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהוָה אֹתָם כֵּן עָשֽׂוּ׃
translation: Moses and Aaron did so. As the LORD commanded them, so they did. (Exodus 7:6)

text: וַיַּעַשׂ מֹשֶׁה כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהוָה אֹתוֹ כֵּן עָשָֽׂה׃
translation: Moses did so. According to all that the LORD commanded him, so he did. (Exodus 40:16)

text: וּבְנֵי שָׁמֶר אֲחִי ורוהגה וְרָהְגָּה יחבה וְחֻבָּה וַאֲרָֽם׃
translation: The sons of Shemer: Ahi, Rohgah, Jehubbah, and Aram. (1 Chronicles 7:34)

text: לְעוֹלָם אשמור אֶשְׁמָר לוֹ חַסְדִּי וּבְרִיתִי נֶאֱמֶנֶת לֽוֹ׃
translation: I will also make his offspring endure forever, and his throne as the days of heaven. (Psalms 89:29)

text: עֵת לְבַקֵּשׁ וְעֵת לְאַבֵּד עֵת לִשְׁמוֹר וְעֵת לְהַשְׁלִֽיךְ׃
translation: a time to seek, and a time to lose; a time to keep, and a time to cast away; (Ecclesiastes 3:6)

text: וּבְנָבִיא הֶעֱלָה יְהוָה אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל מִמִּצְרָיִם וּבְנָבִיא נִשְׁמָֽר׃
translation: Ephraim has bitterly provoked anger. Therefore his blood will be left on him, and his Lord will repay his contempt. (Hosea 12:14)

text: וְשָׁמַרְתָּ אֶת הַחֻקָּה הַזֹּאת לְמוֹעֲדָהּ מִיָּמִים יָמִֽימָה׃
translation: You shall therefore keep this ordinance in its season from year to year. (Exodus 13:10)

text: וְעֹשֶׂה חֶסֶד לַֽאֲלָפִים לְאֹהֲבַי וּלְשֹׁמְרֵי מצותו מִצְוֺתָֽי׃
translation: and showing loving kindness to thousands of those who love me and keep my commandments. (Deuteronomy 5:10)

text: וְֽאוּלָם כֻּלָּם תָּשֻׁבוּ וּבֹאוּ נָא וְלֹֽא אֶמְצָא בָכֶם חָכָֽם׃
translation: But as for you all, come back. I will not find a wise man among you. (Job 17:10)

text: מִֽי יִתֵּן יָדַעְתִּי וְאֶמְצָאֵהוּ אָבוֹא עַד תְּכוּנָתֽוֹ׃
translation: Oh that I knew where I might find him! That I might come even to his seat! (Job 23:3)

text: הֵן תְּנוּאוֹת עָלַי יִמְצָא יַחְשְׁבֵנִי לְאוֹיֵב לֽוֹ׃
translation: Behold, he finds occasions against me. He counts me for his enemy. (Job 33:10)

text: וַיְחֻנֶּנּוּ וַיֹּאמֶר פְּדָעֵהוּ מֵרֶדֶת שָׁחַת מָצָאתִי כֹֽפֶר׃
translation: then God is gracious to him, and says, 'Deliver him from going down to the pit, I have found a ransom.' (Job 33:24)

text: אִם לְשֵׁבֶט אִם לְאַרְצוֹ אִם לְחֶסֶד יַמְצִאֵֽהוּ׃
translation: whether it is for correction, or for his land, or for loving kindness, that he causes it to come. (Job 37:13)

text: תִּמְצָא יָדְךָ לְכָל אֹיְבֶיךָ יְמִֽינְךָ תִּמְצָא שֹׂנְאֶֽיךָ׃
translation: You will make them as a fiery furnace in the time of your anger. The LORD will swallow them up in his wrath. The fire shall devour them. (Psalms 21:9)

text: כִּי לֹא אִישׁ כָּמֹנִי אֶֽעֱנֶנּוּ נָבוֹא יַחְדָּו בַּמִּשְׁפָּֽט׃
translation: For he is not a man, as I am, that I should answer him, that we should come together in judgment. (Job 9:32)

text: כִּֽי יתרו יִתְרִי פִתַּח וַיְעַנֵּנִי וְרֶסֶן מִפָּנַי שִׁלֵּֽחוּ׃
translation: For he has untied his cord, and afflicted me; and they have thrown off restraint before me. (Job 30:11)

text: מַדּוּעַ אֵלָיו רִיבוֹתָ כִּי כָל דְּבָרָיו לֹא יַעֲנֶֽה׃
translation: Why do you strive against him, because he doesn't give account of any of his matters? (Job 33:13)

text: וַיַּעֲנוּ בְנֵי חֵת אֶת אַבְרָהָם לֵאמֹר לֽוֹ׃
translation: The children of Heth answered Abraham, saying to him, (Genesis 23:5)

text: וּבְנֵי שֵׂעִיר לוֹטָן וְשׁוֹבָל וְצִבְעוֹן וַֽעֲנָה וְדִישֹׁן וְאֵצֶר וְדִישָֽׁן׃
translation: The sons of Seir: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah, Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan. (1 Chronicles 1:38)

text: בְּנֵי עֲנָה דִּישׁוֹן וּבְנֵי דִישׁוֹן חַמְרָן וְאֶשְׁבָּן וְיִתְרָן וּכְרָֽן׃
translation: The son of Anah: Dishon. The sons of Dishon: Hamran, Eshban, Ithran, and Cheran. (1 Chronicles 1:41)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל הַפִּילוּ בֵּינִי וּבֵין יוֹנָתָן בְּנִי וַיִּלָּכֵד יוֹנָתָֽן׃
translation: Saul said, "Cast lots between me and Jonathan my son." Jonathan was selected. (1 Samuel 14:42)

text: וַיִּתֵּן יְהוָה דֶּבֶר בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּפֹּל מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל שִׁבְעִים אֶלֶף אִֽישׁ׃
translation: So the LORD sent a pestilence on Israel, and seventy thousand men of Israel fell. (1 Chronicles 21:14)

text: יִפְּלוּ בְמַכְמֹרָיו רְשָׁעִים יַחַד אָנֹכִי עַֽד אֶעֱבֽוֹר׃
translation: Let the wicked fall together into their own nets while I pass by. (Psalms 141:10)

text: הוֹלֵךְ תָּמִים יִוָּשֵׁעַ וְנֶעְקַשׁ דְּרָכַיִם יִפּוֹל בְּאֶחָֽת׃
translation: Whoever walks blamelessly is kept safe; but one with perverse ways will fall suddenly. (Proverbs 28:18)

text: וְנָפַל חָלָל בְּתֽוֹכְכֶם וִֽידַעְתֶּם כִּֽי אֲנִי יְהוָֽה׃
translation: The slain will fall among you, and you will know that I am the LORD. (Ezekiel 6:7)

text: וּרְדַפְתֶּם אֶת אֹיְבֵיכֶם וְנָפְלוּ לִפְנֵיכֶם לֶחָֽרֶב׃
translation: You shall chase your enemies, and they shall fall before you by the sword. (Leviticus 26:7)

text: וְעַתָּה יִגְדַּל נָא כֹּחַ אֲדֹנָי כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבַּרְתָּ לֵאמֹֽר׃
translation: Now please let the power of the Lord be great, according as you have spoken, saying, (Numbers 14:17)

text: אוֹדְךָ אֲדֹנָי אֱלֹהַי בְּכָל לְבָבִי וַאֲכַבְּדָה שִׁמְךָ לְעוֹלָֽם׃
translation: I will praise you, Lord my God, with my whole heart. I will glorify your name forever more. (Psalms 86:12)

text: וַיֹּאמַר אֲדֹנָי יֱהוִה בַּמָּה אֵדַע כִּי אִֽירָשֶֽׁנָּה׃
translation: He said, "Lord GOD, how will I know that I will inherit it?" (Genesis 15:8)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר בִּי אֲדֹנָי שְֽׁלַֽח נָא בְּיַד תִּשְׁלָֽח׃
translation: Moses said, "Oh, Lord, please send someone else." (Exodus 4:13)

text: אָמַרְתְּ לַֽיהוָה אֲדֹנָי אָתָּה טוֹבָתִי בַּל עָלֶֽיךָ׃
translation: My soul, you have said to the LORD, "You are my Lord. Apart from you I have no good thing." (Psalms 16:2)

text: אָוֶן אִם רָאִיתִי בְלִבִּי לֹא יִשְׁמַע אֲדֹנָֽי׃
translation: If I cherished sin in my heart, the Lord wouldn't have listened. (Psalms 66:18)

text: כָּלָה שְׁאֵרִי וּלְבָבִי צוּר לְבָבִי וְחֶלְקִי אֱלֹהִים לְעוֹלָֽם׃
translation: My flesh and my heart fails, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever. (Psalms 73:26)

text: וַאֲנַחְנוּ נְבָרֵךְ יָהּ מֵֽעַתָּה וְעַד עוֹלָם הַֽלְלוּ יָֽהּ׃
translation: but we will bless the LORD, from this time forward and forever more. Praise the LORD! (Psalms 115:18)

text: זִכְרוּ לְעוֹלָם בְּרִיתוֹ דָּבָר צִוָּה לְאֶלֶף דּֽוֹר׃
translation: Remember his covenant forever, the word which he commanded to a thousand generations, (1 Chronicles 16:15)

text: הוֹדוּ לַיהוָה כִּי טוֹב כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
translation: Oh give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever. (1 Chronicles 16:34)

text: הוּא יִבְנֶה לִּי בָּיִת וְכֹנַנְתִּי אֶת כִּסְאוֹ עַד עוֹלָֽם׃
translation: He will build me a house, and I will establish his throne forever. (1 Chronicles 17:12)

text: יְהוָה מֶלֶךְ עוֹלָם וָעֶד אָבְדוּ גוֹיִם מֵֽאַרְצֽוֹ׃
translation: The LORD is King forever and ever! The nations will perish out of his land. (Psalms 10:16)

text: וְאַחֲרָיו אֶלְעָזָר בֶּן דּוֹדוֹ הָאֲחוֹחִי הוּא בִּשְׁלוֹשָׁה הַגִּבֹּרִֽים׃
translation: After him was Eleazar the son of Dodo, the Ahohite, who was one of the three mighty men. (1 Chronicles 11:12)

text: מִבְּנֵי שְׁכַנְיָה בֶּן יַחֲזִיאֵל וְעִמּוֹ שְׁלֹשׁ מֵאוֹת הַזְּכָרִֽים׃
translation: Of the sons of Shecaniah, the son of Jahaziel; and with him three hundred males. (Ezra 8:5)

text: וּצְבָאוֹ וּפְקֻדֵיהֶם שְׁלֹשָׁה וַחֲמִשִּׁים אֶלֶף וְאַרְבַּע מֵאֽוֹת׃
translation: His division, and those who were counted of them, were fifty-three thousand four hundred. (Numbers 2:30)

text: אֵלֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹת יִשָּׂשכָר לִפְקֻדֵיהֶם אַרְבָּעָה וְשִׁשִּׁים אֶלֶף וּשְׁלֹשׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃
translation: These are the families of Issachar according to those who were counted of them, sixty-four thousand three hundred. (Numbers 26:25)

text: וְאַהֲרֹן בֶּן שָׁלֹשׁ וְעֶשְׂרִים וּמְאַת שָׁנָה בְּמֹתוֹ בְּהֹר הָהָֽר׃
translation: Aaron was one hundred twenty-three years old when he died in Mount Hor. (Numbers 33:39)

text: אֵלֶּה עָשָׂה בְּנָיָהוּ בֶּן יְהוֹיָדָע וְלוֹ שֵׁם בִּשְׁלֹשָׁה הַגִּבֹּרִֽים׃
translation: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada did these things, and had a name among the three mighty men. (2 Samuel 23:22)

text: לְדָן עֲזַרְאֵל בֶּן יְרֹחָם אֵלֶּה שָׂרֵי שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
translation: of Dan, Azarel the son of Jeroham. These were the captains of the tribes of Israel. (1 Chronicles 27:22)

text: וַיִּזְבַּח בָּלָק בָּקָר וָצֹאן וַיְשַׁלַּח לְבִלְעָם וְלַשָּׂרִים אֲשֶׁר אִתּֽוֹ׃
translation: Balak sacrificed cattle and sheep, and sent to Balaam, and to the princes who were with him. (Numbers 22:40)

text: וְצָדוֹק נַעַר גִּבּוֹר חָיִל וּבֵית אָבִיו שָׂרִים עֶשְׂרִים וּשְׁנָֽיִם׃
translation: Of the children of Benjamin, Saul's relatives: three thousand, for until then, the greatest part of them had kept their allegiance to Saul's house. (1 Chronicles 12:29)

text: לִבְנֵי קְהָת אוּרִיאֵל הַשָּׂר וְאֶחָיו מֵאָה וְעֶשְׂרִֽים׃
translation: of the sons of Kohath, Uriel the chief, and his brothers one hundred twenty; (1 Chronicles 15:5)

text: לִבְנֵי מְרָרִי עֲשָׂיָה הַשָּׂר וְאֶחָיו מָאתַיִם וְעֶשְׂרִֽים׃
translation: of the sons of Merari, Asaiah the chief, and his brothers two hundred twenty; (1 Chronicles 15:6)

text: לִבְנֵי גֵּרְשׁוֹם יוֹאֵל הַשָּׂר וְאֶחָיו מֵאָה וּשְׁלֹשִֽׁים׃
translation: of the sons of Gershom, Joel the chief, and his brothers one hundred thirty; (1 Chronicles 15:7)

text: לִשְׁלֹמֹה אֱֽלֹהִים מִשְׁפָּטֶיךָ לְמֶלֶךְ תֵּן וְצִדְקָתְךָ לְבֶן מֶֽלֶךְ׃
translation: By Solomon. God, give the king your justice; your righteousness to the royal son. (Psalms 72:1)

text: וּמִנְחָתָם וְנִסְכֵּיהֶם לַפָּרִים לָאֵילִם וְלַכְּבָשִׂים בְּמִסְפָּרָם כַּמִּשְׁפָּֽט׃
translation: and their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance; (Numbers 29:18)

text: וּמִנְחָתָם וְנִסְכֵּיהֶם לַפָּרִים לָאֵילִם וְלַכְּבָשִׂים בְּמִסְפָּרָם כַּמִּשְׁפָּֽט׃
translation: and their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance; (Numbers 29:21)

text: מִנְחָתָם וְנִסְכֵּיהֶם לַפָּרִים לָאֵילִם וְלַכְּבָשִׂים בְּמִסְפָּרָם כַּמִּשְׁפָּֽט׃
translation: their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance; (Numbers 29:24)

text: וּמִנְחָתָם וְנִסְכֵּיהֶם לַפָּרִים לָאֵילִם וְלַכְּבָשִׂים בְּמִסְפָּרָם כַּמִּשְׁפָּֽט׃
translation: and their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance, (Numbers 29:27)

text: וּמִנְחָתָם וְנִסְכֵּיהֶם לַפָּרִים לָאֵילִם וְלַכְּבָשִׂים בְּמִסְפָּרָם כַּמִּשְׁפָּֽט׃
translation: and their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance, (Numbers 29:30)

text: טֽוֹב לִי תֽוֹרַת פִּיךָ מֵאַלְפֵי זָהָב וָכָֽסֶף׃
translation: The law of your mouth is better to me than thousands of pieces of gold and silver. YODH (Psalms 119:72)

text: כֶּסֶף נִבְחָר לְשׁוֹן צַדִּיק לֵב רְשָׁעִים כִּמְעָֽט׃
translation: The tongue of the righteous is like choice silver. The heart of the wicked is of little worth. (Proverbs 10:20)

text: לִי הַכֶּסֶף וְלִי הַזָּהָב נְאֻם יְהוָה צְבָאֽוֹת׃
translation: The silver is mine, and the gold is mine,' says the LORD of Armies. (Haggai 2:8)

text: לֹא תַעֲשׂוּן אִתִּי אֱלֹהֵי כֶסֶף וֵאלֹהֵי זָהָב לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ לָכֶֽם׃
translation: You shall most certainly not make gods of silver or gods of gold for yourselves to be alongside me. (Exodus 20:23)

text: לַחְשֹׁב מַחֲשָׁבֹת לַעֲשׂוֹת בַּזָּהָב וּבַכֶּסֶף וּבַנְּחֹֽשֶׁת׃
translation: to devise skillful works, to work in gold, and in silver, and in bronze, (Exodus 31:4)

text: וְלַחְשֹׁב מַֽחַשָׁבֹת לַעֲשֹׂת בַּזָּהָב וּבַכֶּסֶף וּבַנְּחֹֽשֶׁת׃
translation: and to make skillful works, to work in gold, in silver, in bronze, (Exodus 35:32)

text: מִי הִקְדִּימַנִי וַאֲשַׁלֵּם תַּחַת כָּל הַשָּׁמַיִם לִי הֽוּא׃
translation: Will he make many petitions to you, or will he speak soft words to you? (Job 41:3)

text: רוּמָה עַל הַשָּׁמַיִם אֱלֹהִים עַל כָּל הָאָרֶץ כְּבוֹדֶֽךָ׃
translation: They have prepared a net for my steps. My soul is bowed down. They dig a pit before me. They fall into the middle of it themselves. Selah. (Psalms 57:6)

text: רוּמָה עַל שָׁמַיִם אֱלֹהִים וְעַל כָּל הָאָרֶץ כְּבוֹדֶֽךָ׃
translation: That your beloved may be delivered, save with your right hand, and answer us. (Psalms 108:6)

text: אִם אֶסַּק שָׁמַיִם שָׁם אָתָּה וְאַצִּיעָה שְּׁאוֹל הִנֶּֽךָּ׃
translation: If I ascend up into heaven, you are there. If I make my bed in Sheol, behold, you are there! (Psalms 139:8)

text: הַאֲזִינוּ הַשָּׁמַיִם וַאֲדַבֵּרָה וְתִשְׁמַע הָאָרֶץ אִמְרֵי פִֽי׃
translation: Give ear, you heavens, and I will speak. Let the earth hear the words of my mouth. (Deuteronomy 32:1)

text: וַיִּבֶן מִזְבְּחוֹת לְכָל צְבָא הַשָּׁמָיִם בִּשְׁתֵּי חַצְרוֹת בֵּית יְהוָֽה׃
translation: He built altars for all the army of the sky in the two courts of the LORD's house. (2 Kings 21:5)

text: וְיֵהוּא בָּא בַשָּׁעַר וַתֹּאמֶר הֲשָׁלוֹם זִמְרִי הֹרֵג אֲדֹנָֽיו׃
translation: As Jehu entered in at the gate, she said, "Do you come in peace, Zimri, you murderer of your master?" (2 Kings 9:31)

text: פִּתְחוּ לִי שַׁעֲרֵי צֶדֶק אָֽבֹא בָם אוֹדֶה יָֽהּ׃
translation: Open to me the gates of righteousness. I will enter into them. I will give thanks to the LORD. (Psalms 118:19)

text: אֹהֵב יְהוָה שַׁעֲרֵי צִיּוֹן מִכֹּל מִשְׁכְּנוֹת יַעֲקֹֽב׃
translation: The LORD loves the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob. (Psalms 87:2)

text: נוֹדָע בַּשְּׁעָרִים בַּעְלָהּ בְּשִׁבְתּוֹ עִם זִקְנֵי אָֽרֶץ׃
translation: Her husband is respected in the gates, when he sits among the elders of the land. (Proverbs 31:23)

text: תְּנוּ לָהּ מִפְּרִי יָדֶיהָ וִֽיהַלְלוּהָ בַשְּׁעָרִים מַעֲשֶֽׂיהָ׃
translation: Give her of the fruit of her hands! Let her works praise her in the gates! (Proverbs 31:31)

text: פִּתְחוּ שְׁעָרִים וְיָבֹא גוֹי צַדִּיק שֹׁמֵר אֱמֻנִֽים׃
translation: Open the gates, that the righteous nation may enter: the one which keeps faith. (Isaiah 26:2)

text: וּבְבֹאָהּ הִנֵּה בָאָה וְיָדְעוּ כִּי נָבִיא הָיָה בְתוֹכָֽם׃
translation: "When this comes to pass—behold, it comes—then they will know that a prophet has been among them." (Ezekiel 33:33)

text: וְשָׁכַנְתִּי בְּתוֹךְ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְהָיִיתִי לָהֶם לֵאלֹהִֽים׃
translation: I will dwell among the children of Israel, and will be their God. (Exodus 29:45)

text: וְנָתַתִּי מִשְׁכָּנִי בְּתוֹכְכֶם וְלֹֽא תִגְעַל נַפְשִׁי אֶתְכֶֽם׃
translation: I will set my tent among you, and my soul won't abhor you. (Leviticus 26:11)

text: וְשָׁכַנְתִּי בְּתוֹךְ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְלֹא אֶעֱזֹב אֶת עַמִּי יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
translation: I will dwell among the children of Israel, and will not forsake my people Israel." (1 Kings 6:13)

text: אוֹדֶה יְהוָה מְאֹד בְּפִי וּבְתוֹךְ רַבִּים אֲהַֽלְלֶֽנּוּ׃
translation: I will give great thanks to the LORD with my mouth. Yes, I will praise him among the multitude. (Psalms 109:30)

text: בְּחַצְרוֹת בֵּית יְהוָה בְּֽתוֹכֵכִי יְֽרוּשָׁלִָם הַֽלְלוּ יָֽהּ׃
translation: in the courts of the LORD's house, in the middle of you, Jerusalem. Praise the LORD! (Psalms 116:19)

text: הֵן צַדִּיק בָּאָרֶץ יְשֻׁלָּם אַף כִּֽי רָשָׁע וְחוֹטֵֽא׃
translation: Behold, the righteous shall be repaid in the earth, how much more the wicked and the sinner! (Proverbs 11:31)

text: פֶּן יִרְאֶה יְהוָה וְרַע בְּעֵינָיו וְהֵשִׁיב מֵעָלָיו אַפּֽוֹ׃
translation: lest the LORD see it, and it displease him, and he turn away his wrath from him. (Proverbs 24:18)

text: אַף כִּֽי אָנֹכִי אֶֽעֱנֶנּוּ אֶבְחֲרָה דְבָרַי עִמּֽוֹ׃
translation: How much less will I answer him, and choose my words to argue with him? (Job 9:14)

text: וְעַתָּה כִּי אַיִן פָּקַד אַפּוֹ וְלֹֽא יָדַע בַּפַּשׁ מְאֹֽד׃
translation: But now, because he has not visited in his anger, neither does he greatly regard arrogance, (Job 35:15)

text: אַף אָנִי בְּכוֹר אֶתְּנֵהוּ עֶלְיוֹן לְמַלְכֵי אָֽרֶץ׃
translation: I will keep my loving kindness for him forever more. My covenant will stand firm with him. (Psalms 89:28)

text: נָכוֹן לִבִּי אֱלֹהִים אָשִׁירָה וַאֲזַמְּרָה אַף כְּבוֹדִֽי׃
translation: Wake up, harp and lyre! I will wake up the dawn. (Psalms 108:2)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה אֲלֵהֶם אִישׁ אַל יוֹתֵר מִמֶּנּוּ עַד בֹּֽקֶר׃
translation: Moses said to them, "Let no one leave of it until the morning." (Exodus 16:19)

text: מִלְּבַד עֹלַת הַבֹּקֶר אֲשֶׁר לְעֹלַת הַתָּמִיד תַּעֲשׂוּ אֶת אֵֽלֶּה׃
translation: You shall offer these in addition to the burnt offering of the morning, which is for a continual burnt offering. (Numbers 28:23)

text: וַיָּקוּמוּ בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵל בַּבֹּקֶר וַיַּֽחֲנוּ עַל הַגִּבְעָֽה׃
translation: The children of Israel rose up in the morning and encamped against Gibeah. (Judges 20:19)

text: וְֽהַקֳּדָשִׁים בָּקָר שֵׁשׁ מֵאוֹת וְצֹאן שְׁלֹשֶׁת אֲלָפִֽים׃
translation: The consecrated things were six hundred head of cattle and three thousand sheep. (2 Chronicles 29:33)

text: וַֽיְהִי עֶרֶב וַֽיְהִי בֹקֶר יוֹם חֲמִישִֽׁי׃
translation: There was evening and there was morning, a fifth day. (Genesis 1:23)

text: וַיַּשְׁכִּימוּ בַבֹּקֶר וַיִּשָּׁבְעוּ אִישׁ לְאָחִיו וַיְשַׁלְּחֵם יִצְחָק וַיֵּלְכוּ מֵאִתּוֹ בְּשָׁלֽוֹם׃
translation: They rose up some time in the morning, and swore an oath to one another. Isaac sent them away, and they departed from him in peace. (Genesis 26:31)

text: יִפְקֹד יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵי הָרוּחֹת לְכָל בָּשָׂר אִישׁ עַל הָעֵדָֽה׃
translation: "Let the LORD, the God of the spirits of all flesh, appoint a man over the congregation, (Numbers 27:16)

text: וַעֲזַרְיָהוּ בֶּן עוֹדֵד הָיְתָה עָלָיו רוּחַ אֱלֹהִֽים׃
translation: The Spirit of God came on Azariah the son of Oded. (2 Chronicles 15:1)

text: לֹֽא יִתְּנֵנִי הָשֵׁב רוּחִי כִּי יַשְׂבִּעַנִי מַמְּרֹרִֽים׃
translation: He will not allow me to catch my breath, but fills me with bitterness. (Job 9:18)

text: אֲשֶׁר בְּיָדוֹ נֶפֶשׁ כָּל חָי וְרוּחַ כָּל בְּשַׂר אִֽישׁ׃
translation: in whose hand is the life of every living thing, and the breath of all mankind? (Job 12:10)

text: אֶחָד בְּאֶחָד יִגַּשׁוּ וְרוּחַ לֹא יָבוֹא בֵֽינֵיהֶֽם׃
translation: Lay your hand on him. Remember the battle, and do so no more. (Job 41:8)

text: אָזְנַיִם לָהֶם וְלֹא יַאֲזִינוּ אַף אֵין יֶשׁ רוּחַ בְּפִיהֶֽם׃
translation: They have ears, but they can't hear, neither is there any breath in their mouths. (Psalms 135:17)

text: וַיִּבֶן מֹשֶׁה מִזְבֵּחַ וַיִּקְרָא שְׁמוֹ יְהוָה נִסִּֽי׃
translation: Moses built an altar, and called its name "The LORD our Banner". (Exodus 17:15)

text: וְנָתַתָּה אֵת מִזְבַּח הָעֹלָה לִפְנֵי פֶּתַח מִשְׁכַּן אֹֽהֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃
translation: "You shall set the altar of burnt offering before the door of the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting. (Exodus 40:6)

text: וְאֵת כָּל חֶלְבּוֹ יָרִים מִמֶּנּוּ וְהִקְטִיר הַמִּזְבֵּֽחָה׃
translation: All its fat he shall take from it, and burn it on the altar. (Leviticus 4:19)

text: וַיַּעַשׂ בָּלָק כַּאֲשֶׁר אָמַר בִּלְעָם וַיַּעַל פָּר וָאַיִל בַּמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃
translation: Balak did as Balaam had said, and offered up a bull and a ram on every altar. (Numbers 23:30)

text: אָז יִבְנֶה יְהוֹשֻׁעַ מִזְבֵּחַ לַֽיהוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּהַר עֵיבָֽל׃
translation: Then Joshua built an altar to the LORD, the God of Israel, on Mount Ebal, (Joshua 8:30)

text: וַיִּבֶן שָׁאוּל מִזְבֵּחַ לַֽיהוָה אֹתוֹ הֵחֵל לִבְנוֹת מִזְבֵּחַ לַֽיהוָֽה׃
translation: Saul built an altar to the LORD. This was the first altar that he built to the LORD. (1 Samuel 14:35)

text: וַיַּעַל מֵעָלָיו אֱלֹהִים בַּמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר אִתּֽוֹ׃
translation: God went up from him in the place where he spoke with him. (Genesis 35:13)

text: וַאֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה לָכֶם בַּמִּדְבָּר עַד בֹּאֲכֶם עַד הַמָּקוֹם הַזֶּֽה׃
translation: and what he did to you in the wilderness until you came to this place; (Deuteronomy 11:5)

text: הִשָּׁמֶר לְךָ פֶּֽן תַּעֲלֶה עֹלֹתֶיךָ בְּכָל מָקוֹם אֲשֶׁר תִּרְאֶֽה׃
translation: Be careful that you don't offer your burnt offerings in every place that you see; (Deuteronomy 12:13)

text: וַיִּרְאוּ אִֽישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל כִּי מֵת אֲבִימֶלֶךְ וַיֵּלְכוּ אִישׁ לִמְקֹמֽוֹ׃
translation: When the men of Israel saw that Abimelech was dead, they each departed to his place. (Judges 9:55)

text: אֱלֹהִים הֵבִין דַּרְכָּהּ וְהוּא יָדַע אֶת מְקוֹמָֽהּ׃
translation: "God understands its way, and he knows its place. (Job 28:23)

text: וַיֵּלֶךְ יְהוָה כַּאֲשֶׁר כִּלָּה לְדַבֵּר אֶל אַבְרָהָם וְאַבְרָהָם שָׁב לִמְקֹמֽוֹ׃
translation: The LORD went his way as soon as he had finished communing with Abraham, and Abraham returned to his place. (Genesis 18:33)

text: לַשַּׁחַת יֽוֹרִדוּךָ וָמַתָּה מְמוֹתֵי חָלָל בְּלֵב יַמִּֽים׃
translation: They will bring you down to the pit. You will die the death of those who are slain in the heart of the seas. (Ezekiel 28:8)

text: יִרְעַם הַיָּם וּמְלֹאוֹ תֵּבֵל וְיֹשְׁבֵי בָֽהּ׃
translation: Let the sea roar with its fullness; the world, and those who dwell therein. (Psalms 98:7)

text: הַיָּם רָאָה וַיָּנֹס הַיַּרְדֵּן יִסֹּב לְאָחֽוֹר׃
translation: The sea saw it, and fled. The Jordan was driven back. (Psalms 114:3)

text: בְּשׂוּמוֹ לַיָּם חֻקּוֹ וּמַיִם לֹא יַֽעַבְרוּ פִיו בְּחוּקוֹ מוֹסְדֵי אָֽרֶץ׃
translation: when he gave to the sea its boundary, that the waters should not violate his commandment, when he marked out the foundations of the earth, (Proverbs 8:29)

text: וְנִשְּׁתוּ מַיִם מֵֽהַיָּם וְנָהָר יֶחֱרַב וְיָבֵֽשׁ׃
translation: The waters will fail from the sea, and the river will be wasted and become dry. (Isaiah 19:5)

text: כַּף אַחַת עֲשָׂרָה זָהָב מְלֵאָה קְטֹֽרֶת׃
translation: one golden ladle of ten shekels, full of incense; (Numbers 7:50)

text: כַּף אַחַת עֲשָׂרָה זָהָב מְלֵאָה קְטֹֽרֶת׃
translation: one golden ladle of ten shekels, full of incense; (Numbers 7:56)

text: כַּף אַחַת עֲשָׂרָה זָהָב מְלֵאָה קְטֹֽרֶת׃
translation: one golden ladle of ten shekels, full of incense; (Numbers 7:62)

text: כַּף אַחַת עֲשָׂרָה זָהָב מְלֵאָה קְטֹֽרֶת׃
translation: one golden ladle of ten shekels, full of incense; (Numbers 7:68)

text: כַּף אַחַת עֲשָׂרָה זָהָב מְלֵאָה קְטֹֽרֶת׃
translation: one golden ladle of ten shekels, full of incense; (Numbers 7:74)

text: כַּף אַחַת עֲשָׂרָה זָהָב מְלֵאָה קְטֹֽרֶת׃
translation: one golden ladle of ten shekels, full of incense; (Numbers 7:80)

text: לֹא הַמֵּתִים יְהַֽלְלוּ יָהּ וְלֹא כָּל יֹרְדֵי דוּמָֽה׃
translation: The dead don't praise the LORD, nor any who go down into silence, (Psalms 115:17)

text: וְהוּרַד הַמִּשְׁכָּן וְנָסְעוּ בְנֵֽי גֵרְשׁוֹן וּבְנֵי מְרָרִי נֹשְׂאֵי הַמִּשְׁכָּֽן׃
translation: The tabernacle was taken down; and the sons of Gershon and the sons of Merari, who bore the tabernacle, went forward. (Numbers 10:17)

text: כִּי לֹא בְמוֹתוֹ יִקַּח הַכֹּל לֹא יֵרֵד אַחֲרָיו כְּבוֹדֽוֹ׃
translation: Though while he lived he blessed his soul— and men praise you when you do well for yourself— (Psalms 49:18)

text: וַֽיְחִי יֶרֶד שְׁתַּיִם וְשִׁשִּׁים שָׁנָה וּמְאַת שָׁנָה וַיּוֹלֶד אֶת חֲנֽוֹךְ׃
translation: Jared lived one hundred sixty-two years, then became the father of Enoch. (Genesis 5:18)

text: אִם יֶשְׁךָ מְשַׁלֵּחַ אֶת אָחִינוּ אִתָּנוּ נֵרְדָה וְנִשְׁבְּרָה לְךָ אֹֽכֶל׃
translation: If you'll send our brother with us, we'll go down and buy you food; (Genesis 43:4)

text: וַיֵּרֶד מֹשֶׁה אֶל הָעָם וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶֽם׃
translation: So Moses went down to the people, and told them. (Exodus 19:25)

text: נִשְׁתְּוָנָא דִּי שְׁלַחְתּוּן עֲלֶינָא מְפָרַשׁ קֱרִי קָדָמָֽי׃
translation: The letter which you sent to us has been plainly read before me. (Ezra 4:18)

text: וְאַף שְׁמָהָתְהֹם שְׁאֵלְנָא לְּהֹם לְהוֹדָעוּתָךְ דִּי נִכְתֻּב שֻׁם גֻּבְרַיָּא דִּי בְרָאשֵׁיהֹֽם׃
translation: We asked them their names also, to inform you that we might write the names of the men who were at their head. (Ezra 5:10)

text: וּמָֽאנַיָּא דִּֽי מִתְיַהֲבִין לָךְ לְפָלְחָן בֵּית אֱלָהָךְ הַשְׁלֵם קֳדָם אֱלָהּ יְרוּשְׁלֶֽם׃
translation: The vessels that are given to you for the service of the house of your God, deliver before the God of Jerusalem. (Ezra 7:19)

text: אִם בֹּֽצְרִים בָּאוּ לָךְ לֹא יַשְׁאִרוּ עֽוֹלֵלוֹת אִם גַּנָּבִים בַּלַּיְלָה הִשְׁחִיתוּ דַיָּֽם׃
translation: If grape gatherers came to you, would they not leave some gleaning grapes? If thieves came by night, wouldn't they steal until they had enough? (Jeremiah 49:9)

text: וְכֵן יַעֲשֶׂה שָׁנָה בְשָׁנָה מִדֵּי עֲלֹתָהּ בְּבֵית יְהוָה כֵּן תַּכְעִסֶנָּה וַתִּבְכֶּה וְלֹא תֹאכַֽל׃
translation: So year by year, when she went up to the LORD's house, her rival provoked her. Therefore she wept, and didn't eat. (1 Samuel 1:7)

text: וַהֲקִימוּ כָהֲנַיָּא בִּפְלֻגָּתְהוֹן וְלֵוָיֵא בְּמַחְלְקָתְהוֹן עַל עֲבִידַת אֱלָהָא דִּי בִירוּשְׁלֶם כִּכְתָב סְפַר מֹשֶֽׁה׃
translation: They set the priests in their divisions and the Levites in their courses, for the service of God which is at Jerusalem, as it is written in the book of Moses. (Ezra 6:18)

text: וְאֶת הַבָּשָׂר וְאֶת הָעוֹר שָׂרַף בָּאֵשׁ מִחוּץ לַֽמַּחֲנֶֽה׃
translation: The meat and the skin he burned with fire outside the camp. (Leviticus 9:11)

text: וַיַּעַזְבוּ שָׁם אֶת אֱלֹֽהֵיהֶם וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִיד וַיִּשָּׂרְפוּ בָּאֵֽשׁ׃
translation: They left their gods there; and David gave a command, and they were burned with fire. (1 Chronicles 14:12)

text: וְשָׁבוּ הַכַּשְׂדִּים וְנִלְחֲמוּ עַל הָעִיר הַזֹּאת וּלְכָדֻהָ וּשְׂרָפֻהָ בָאֵֽשׁ׃
translation: The Chaldeans will come again, and fight against this city. They will take it and burn it with fire."' (Jeremiah 37:8)

text: יָבֹא אֱלֹהֵינוּ וְֽאַל יֶחֱרַשׁ אֵשׁ לְפָנָיו תֹּאכֵל וּסְבִיבָיו נִשְׂעֲרָה מְאֹֽד׃
translation: Our God comes, and does not keep silent. A fire devours before him. It is very stormy around him. (Psalms 50:3)

text: וְיָדְעוּ כִּֽי אֲנִי יְהוָה בְּתִתִּי אֵשׁ בְּמִצְרַיִם וְנִשְׁבְּרוּ כָּל עֹזְרֶֽיהָ׃
translation: They will know that I am the LORD when I have set a fire in Egypt, and all her helpers are destroyed. (Ezekiel 30:8)

text: וְשִׁלַּחְתִּי אֵשׁ בְּמָגוֹג וּבְיֹשְׁבֵי הָאִיִּים לָבֶטַח וְיָדְעוּ כִּי אֲנִי יְהוָֽה׃
translation: "I will send a fire on Magog and on those who dwell securely in the islands. Then they will know that I am the LORD. (Ezekiel 39:6)

text: כְּרַחֵם אָב עַל בָּנִים רִחַם יְהוָה עַל יְרֵאָֽיו׃
translation: Like a father has compassion on his children, so the LORD has compassion on those who fear him. (Psalms 103:13)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם יוֹסֵף אַל תִּירָאוּ כִּי הֲתַחַת אֱלֹהִים אָֽנִי׃
translation: Joseph said to them, "Don't be afraid, for am I in the place of God? (Genesis 50:19)

text: וַיְהִי כִּֽי יָֽרְאוּ הַֽמְיַלְּדֹת אֶת הָאֱלֹהִים וַיַּעַשׂ לָהֶם בָּתִּֽים׃
translation: Because the midwives feared God, he gave them families. (Exodus 1:21)

text: וְשָׁמַרְתָּ אֶת מִצְוֺת יְהוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לָלֶכֶת בִּדְרָכָיו וּלְיִרְאָה אֹתֽוֹ׃
translation: You shall keep the commandments of the LORD your God, to walk in his ways, and to fear him. (Deuteronomy 8:6)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ יְהוָה שָׁלוֹם לְךָ אַל תִּירָא לֹא תָּמֽוּת׃
translation: The LORD said to him, "Peace be to you! Don't be afraid. You shall not die." (Judges 6:23)

text: הִנֵּה עֵין יְהוָה אֶל יְרֵאָיו לַֽמְיַחֲלִים לְחַסְדּֽוֹ׃
translation: Behold, the LORD's eye is on those who fear him, on those who hope in his loving kindness, (Psalms 33:18)

text: וַיִּבְנוּ בְנֵי גָד אֶת דִּיבֹן וְאֶת עֲטָרֹת וְאֵת עֲרֹעֵֽר׃
translation: The children of Gad built Dibon, Ataroth, Aroer, (Numbers 32:34)

text: וּבְנֵי רְאוּבֵן בָּנוּ אֶת חֶשְׁבּוֹן וְאֶת אֶלְעָלֵא וְאֵת קִרְיָתָֽיִם׃
translation: The children of Reuben built Heshbon, Elealeh, Kiriathaim, (Numbers 32:37)

text: וַיִּקְרָא לִשְׁלֹמֹה בְנוֹ וַיְצַוֵּהוּ לִבְנוֹת בַּיִת לַיהוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
translation: Then he called for Solomon his son, and commanded him to build a house for the LORD, the God of Israel. (1 Chronicles 22:6)

text: וַיִּבֶן מִזְבְּחוֹת לְכָל צְבָא הַשָּׁמָיִם בִּשְׁתֵּי חַצְרוֹת בֵּית יְהוָֽה׃
translation: He built altars for all the army of the sky in the two courts of the LORD's house. (2 Chronicles 33:5)

text: עַד עוֹלָם אָכִין זַרְעֶךָ וּבָנִיתִי לְדֹר וָדוֹר כִּסְאֲךָ סֶֽלָה׃
translation: The heavens will praise your wonders, LORD, your faithfulness also in the assembly of the holy ones. (Psalms 89:5)

text: הָכֵן בַּחוּץ מְלַאכְתֶּךָ וְעַתְּדָהּ בַּשָּׂדֶה לָךְ אַחַר וּבָנִיתָ בֵיתֶֽךָ׃
translation: Prepare your work outside, and get your fields ready. Afterwards, build your house. (Proverbs 24:27)

text: וּבָא לְצִיּוֹן גּוֹאֵל וּלְשָׁבֵי פֶשַׁע בְּיַֽעֲקֹב נְאֻם יְהוָֽה׃
translation: "A Redeemer will come to Zion, and to those who turn from disobedience in Jacob," says the LORD. (Isaiah 59:20)

text: לָמָּה תָרִיבוּ אֵלָי כֻּלְּכֶם פְּשַׁעְתֶּם בִּי נְאֻם יְהוָֽה׃
translation: "Why will you contend with me? You all have transgressed against me," says the LORD. (Jeremiah 2:29)

text: כִּי לֹא מַחְשְׁבוֹתַי מַחְשְׁבוֹתֵיכֶם וְלֹא דַרְכֵיכֶם דְּרָכָי נְאֻם יְהוָֽה׃
translation: "For my thoughts are not your thoughts, and your ways are not my ways," says the LORD. (Isaiah 55:8)

text: אַל תִּירָא מִפְּנֵיהֶם כִּֽי אִתְּךָ אֲנִי לְהַצִּלֶךָ נְאֻם יְהוָֽה׃
translation: Don't be afraid because of them, for I am with you to rescue you," says the LORD. (Jeremiah 1:8)

text: וְגַם בַּיָּמִים הָהֵמָּה נְאֻם יְהֹוָה לֹֽא אֶעֱשֶׂה אִתְּכֶם כָּלָֽה׃
translation: "But even in those days," says the LORD, "I will not make a full end of you. (Jeremiah 5:18)

text: שִׁבְתְּךָ בְּתוֹךְ מִרְמָה בְּמִרְמָה מֵאֲנוּ דַֽעַת אוֹתִי נְאֻם יְהוָֽה׃
translation: Friends deceive each other, and will not speak the truth. They have taught their tongue to speak lies. They weary themselves committing iniquity. (Jeremiah 9:5)

text: אִם אָמַרְתִּי אֲסַפְּרָה כְמוֹ הִנֵּה דוֹר בָּנֶיךָ בָגָֽדְתִּי׃
translation: If I had said, "I will speak thus", behold, I would have betrayed the generation of your children. (Psalms 73:15)

text: עָלֶיהָ לִבְנֵיכֶם סַפֵּרוּ וּבְנֵיכֶם לִבְנֵיהֶם וּבְנֵיהֶם לְדוֹר אַחֵֽר׃
translation: Tell your children about it, and have your children tell their children, and their children, another generation. (Joel 1:3)

text: וְצָדוֹק בֶּן אֲחִיטוּב וַאֲחִימֶלֶךְ בֶּן אֶבְיָתָר כֹּהֲנִים וּשְׂרָיָה סוֹפֵֽר׃
translation: Zadok the son of Ahitub and Ahimelech the son of Abiathar were priests, Seraiah was scribe, (2 Samuel 8:17)

text: אֱלִיחֹרֶף וַאֲחִיָּה בְּנֵי שִׁישָׁא סֹפְרִים יְהוֹשָׁפָט בֶּן אֲחִילוּד הַמַּזְכִּֽיר׃
translation: Elihoreph and Ahijah, the sons of Shisha, scribes; Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud, the recorder; (1 Kings 4:3)

text: וְצָדוֹק בֶּן אֲחִיטוּב וַאֲבִימֶלֶךְ בֶּן אֶבְיָתָר כֹּהֲנִים וְשַׁוְשָׁא סוֹפֵֽר׃
translation: Zadok the son of Ahitub and Abimelech the son of Abiathar were priests; Shavsha was scribe; (1 Chronicles 18:16)

text: הַֽיְסֻפַּר לוֹ כִּי אֲדַבֵּר אִֽם אָמַר אִישׁ כִּי יְבֻלָּֽע׃
translation: Will it be told him that I would speak? Or should a man wish that he were swallowed up? (Job 37:20)

text: עַצְמוֹתָיו מָלְאוּ עלומו עֲלוּמָיו וְעִמּוֹ עַל עָפָר תִּשְׁכָּֽב׃
translation: His bones are full of his youth, but youth will lie down with him in the dust. (Job 20:11)

text: אֹהֵב צְדָקָה וּמִשְׁפָּט חֶסֶד יְהוָה מָלְאָה הָאָֽרֶץ׃
translation: He loves righteousness and justice. The earth is full of the loving kindness of the LORD. (Psalms 33:5)

text: אָנֹכִי יְהוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ הַֽמַּעַלְךָ מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם הַרְחֶב פִּיךָ וַאֲמַלְאֵֽהוּ׃
translation: But my people didn't listen to my voice. Israel desired none of me. (Psalms 81:11)

text: הִרְבֵּיתֶם חַלְלֵיכֶם בָּעִיר הַזֹּאת וּמִלֵּאתֶם חוּצֹתֶיהָ חָלָֽל׃
translation: You have multiplied your slain in this city, and you have filled its streets with the slain." (Ezekiel 11:6)

text: וּרְחֹבוֹת הָעִיר יִמָּלְאוּ יְלָדִים וִֽילָדוֹת מְשַׂחֲקִים בִּרְחֹֽבֹתֶֽיהָ׃
translation: The streets of the city will be full of boys and girls playing in its streets." (Zechariah 8:5)

text: אֶעֶרְכָה לְפָנָיו מִשְׁפָּט וּפִי אֲמַלֵּא תוֹכָחֽוֹת׃
translation: I would set my cause in order before him, and fill my mouth with arguments. (Job 23:4)

text: וְאַבְרָהָם זָקֵן בָּא בַּיָּמִים וַֽיהוָה בֵּרַךְ אֶת אַבְרָהָם בַּכֹּֽל׃
translation: Abraham was old, and well advanced in age. The LORD had blessed Abraham in all things. (Genesis 24:1)

text: וַֽיְבָרְכֵהוּ יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וַיִּתֵּן אֶת חֶבְרוֹן לְכָלֵב בֶּן יְפֻנֶּה לְנַחֲלָֽה׃
translation: Joshua blessed him; and he gave Hebron to Caleb the son of Jephunneh for an inheritance. (Joshua 14:13)

text: וַֽיְבָרֲכוּ הָעָם לְכֹל הָֽאֲנָשִׁים הַמִּֽתְנַדְּבִים לָשֶׁבֶת בִּירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
translation: The people blessed all the men who willingly offered themselves to dwell in Jerusalem. (Nehemiah 11:2)

text: יְֽהוָה עֹז לְעַמּוֹ יִתֵּן יְהוָה יְבָרֵךְ אֶת עַמּוֹ בַשָּׁלֽוֹם׃
translation: The LORD will give strength to his people. The LORD will bless his people with peace. (Psalms 29:11)

text: אֱלֹהִים יְחָנֵּנוּ וִֽיבָרְכֵנוּ יָאֵר פָּנָיו אִתָּנוּ סֶֽלָה׃
translation: That your way may be known on earth, and your salvation among all nations, (Psalms 67:2)

text: גִּבּוֹר בָּאָרֶץ יִהְיֶה זַרְעוֹ דּוֹר יְשָׁרִים יְבֹרָֽךְ׃
translation: His offspring will be mighty in the land. The generation of the upright will be blessed. (Psalms 112:2)

text: ואפרחו וְאֶפְרֹחָיו יְעַלְעוּ דָם וּבַאֲשֶׁר חֲלָלִים שָׁם הֽוּא׃
translation: His young ones also suck up blood. Where the slain are, there he is." (Job 39:30)

text: אַל תֶּאֱסֹף עִם חַטָּאִים נַפְשִׁי וְעִם אַנְשֵׁי דָמִים חַיָּֽי׃
translation: Don't gather my soul with sinners, nor my life with bloodthirsty men (Psalms 26:9)

text: שָׁפְכוּ דָמָם כַּמַּיִם סְֽבִיבוֹת יְֽרוּשָׁלִָם וְאֵין קוֹבֵֽר׃
translation: They have shed their blood like water around Jerusalem. There was no one to bury them. (Psalms 79:3)

text: אַנְשֵׁי דָמִים יִשְׂנְאוּ תָם וִֽישָׁרִים יְבַקְשׁוּ נַפְשֽׁוֹ׃
translation: The bloodthirsty hate a man of integrity; and they seek the life of the upright. (Proverbs 29:10)

text: וְהוֹלִיד בֵּן פָּרִיץ שֹׁפֵךְ דָּם וְעָשָׂה אָח מֵאַחַד מֵאֵֽלֶּה׃
translation: "If he fathers a son who is a robber who sheds blood, and who does any one of these things, (Ezekiel 18:10)

text: אַךְ בָּשָׂר בְּנַפְשׁוֹ דָמוֹ לֹא תֹאכֵֽלוּ׃
translation: But flesh with its life, that is, its blood, you shall not eat. (Genesis 9:4)

text: וּצְבָאוֹ וּפְקֻדָיו שִׁשָּׁה וְאַרְבָּעִים אֶלֶף וַחֲמֵשׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃
translation: His division, and those who were counted of it, were forty-six thousand five hundred. (Numbers 2:11)

text: וּצְבָאוֹ וּפְקֻדֵיהֶם חֲמִשָּׁה וּשְׁלֹשִׁים אֶלֶף וְאַרְבַּע מֵאֽוֹת׃
translation: His army, and those who were counted of them, were thirty-five thousand four hundred. (Numbers 2:23)

text: וּצְבָאוֹ וּפְקֻדֵיהֶם אֶחָד וְאַרְבָּעִים אֶלֶף וַחֲמֵשׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃
translation: His division, and those who were counted of them, were forty-one thousand five hundred. (Numbers 2:28)

text: אֵלֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹת בְּנֵֽי גָד לִפְקֻדֵיהֶם אַרְבָּעִים אֶלֶף וַחֲמֵשׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃
translation: These are the families of the sons of Gad according to those who were counted of them, forty thousand and five hundred. (Numbers 26:18)

text: אֵלֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹת יְהוּדָה לִפְקֻדֵיהֶם שִׁשָּׁה וְשִׁבְעִים אֶלֶף וַחֲמֵשׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃
translation: These are the families of Judah according to those who were counted of them, seventy-six thousand five hundred. (Numbers 26:22)

text: וַחֲשֻׁבָה וָאֹהֶל וּבֶרֶכְיָה וַֽחֲסַדְיָה יוּשַׁב חֶסֶד חָמֵֽשׁ׃
translation: and Hashubah, Ohel, Berechiah, Hasadiah, and Jushab Hesed, five. (1 Chronicles 3:20)

text: כִּֽי גֹאֲלָם חָזָק הֽוּא יָרִיב אֶת רִיבָם אִתָּֽךְ׃
translation: for their Defender is strong. He will plead their case against you. (Proverbs 23:11)

text: כִּֽי לְעֹשֵׂי הַמְּלָאכָה יִתְּנֻהוּ וְחִזְּקוּ בוֹ אֶת בֵּית יְהוָֽה׃
translation: Moreover they didn't demand an accounting from the men into whose hand they delivered the money to give to those who did the work; for they dealt faithfully. (2 Kings 12:15)

text: וַיִּמְלֹךְ יְהוֹשָׁפָט בְּנוֹ תַּחְתָּיו וַיִּתְחַזֵּק עַל יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
translation: Jehoshaphat his son reigned in his place, and strengthened himself against Israel. (2 Chronicles 17:1)

text: מַחֲזִיק בְּאָזְנֵי כָלֶב עֹבֵר מִתְעַבֵּר עַל רִיב לֹּֽא לֽוֹ׃
translation: Like one who grabs a dog's ears is one who passes by and meddles in a quarrel not his own. (Proverbs 26:17)

text: אִישׁ אֶת רֵעֵהוּ יַעְזֹרוּ וּלְאָחִיו יֹאמַר חֲזָֽק׃
translation: Everyone helps his neighbor. They say to their brothers, "Be strong!" (Isaiah 41:6)

text: כִּֽי פָדָה יְהוָה אֶֽת יַעֲקֹב וּגְאָלוֹ מִיַּד חָזָק מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃
translation: For the LORD has ransomed Jacob, and redeemed him from the hand of him who was stronger than he. (Jeremiah 31:11)

text: וְאֵת כָּל הָעֵדָה הַקְהֵל אֶל פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃
translation: and assemble all the congregation at the door of the Tent of Meeting." (Leviticus 8:3)

text: וַיִּקְרָא אֶל מֹשֶׁה וַיְדַבֵּר יְהוָה אֵלָיו מֵאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד לֵאמֹֽר׃
translation: The LORD called to Moses, and spoke to him from the Tent of Meeting, saying, (Leviticus 1:1)

text: וַיָּבֹא מֹשֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן אֶל פְּנֵי אֹהֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃
translation: On the next day, Moses went into the Tent of the Testimony; and behold, Aaron's rod for the house of Levi had sprouted, budded, produced blossoms, and bore ripe almonds. (Numbers 17:8)

text: וְלִזְבוּלֻן אָמַר שְׂמַח זְבוּלֻן בְּצֵאתֶךָ וְיִשָּׂשכָר בְּאֹהָלֶֽיךָ׃
translation: About Zebulun he said, "Rejoice, Zebulun, in your going out; and Issachar, in your tents. (Deuteronomy 33:18)

text: וַנֵּשֶׁב בָּֽאֳהָלִים וַנִּשְׁמַע וַנַּעַשׂ כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר צִוָּנוּ יוֹנָדָב אָבִֽינוּ׃
translation: but we have lived in tents, and have obeyed, and done according to all that Jonadab our father commanded us. (Jeremiah 35:10)

text: בְּיוֹם הַחֹדֶשׁ הָרִאשׁוֹן בְּאֶחָד לַחֹדֶשׁ תָּקִים אֶת מִשְׁכַּן אֹהֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃
translation: "On the first day of the first month you shall raise up the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting. (Exodus 40:2)

text: כִּי מַה חֶפְצוֹ בְּבֵיתוֹ אַחֲרָיו וּמִסְפַּר חֳדָשָׁיו חֻצָּֽצוּ׃
translation: For what does he care for his house after him, when the number of his months is cut off? (Job 21:21)

text: שִׁירוּ לַיהוָה שִׁיר חָדָשׁ שִׁירוּ לַיהוָה כָּל הָאָֽרֶץ׃
translation: Sing to the LORD a new song! Sing to the LORD, all the earth. (Psalms 96:1)

text: הֲשִׁיבֵנוּ יְהוָה אֵלֶיךָ ונשוב וְֽנָשׁוּבָה חַדֵּשׁ יָמֵינוּ כְּקֶֽדֶם׃
translation: Turn us to yourself, LORD, and we will be turned. Renew our days as of old. (Lamentations 5:21)

text: וַיְהִי בַּחֹדֶשׁ הָרִאשׁוֹן בַּשָּׁנָה הַשֵּׁנִית בְּאֶחָד לַחֹדֶשׁ הוּקַם הַמִּשְׁכָּֽן׃
translation: In the first month in the second year, on the first day of the month, the tabernacle was raised up. (Exodus 40:17)

text: וַיְהִי אֲרוֹן יְהוָה בִּשְׂדֵה פְלִשְׁתִּים שִׁבְעָה חֳדָשִֽׁים׃
translation: The LORD's ark was in the country of the Philistines seven months. (1 Samuel 6:1)

text: חָדְשֵׁיכֶם וּמוֹעֲדֵיכֶם שָׂנְאָה נַפְשִׁי הָיוּ עָלַי לָטֹרַח נִלְאֵיתִי נְשֹֽׂא׃
translation: My soul hates your New Moons and your appointed feasts. They are a burden to me. I am weary of bearing them. (Isaiah 1:14)

text: לְמַעַן תִּזְכְּרוּ וַעֲשִׂיתֶם אֶת כָּל מִצְוֺתָי וִהְיִיתֶם קְדֹשִׁים לֵֽאלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃
translation: so that you may remember and do all my commandments, and be holy to your God. (Numbers 15:40)

text: זָכוֹר אֵת אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה לְךָ עֲמָלֵק בַּדֶּרֶךְ בְּצֵאתְכֶם מִמִּצְרָֽיִם׃
translation: Remember what Amalek did to you by the way as you came out of Egypt, (Deuteronomy 25:17)

text: וְיוֹאָב בֶּן צְרוּיָה עַל הַצָּבָא וִיהוֹשָׁפָט בֶּן אֲחִילוּד מַזְכִּֽיר׃
translation: Joab the son of Zeruiah was over the army, Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was recorder, (2 Samuel 8:16)

text: וְיוֹאָב בֶּן צְרוּיָה עַל הַצָּבָא וִיהוֹשָׁפָט בֶּן אֲחִילוּד מַזְכִּֽיר׃
translation: Joab the son of Zeruiah was over the army; Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was recorder; (1 Chronicles 18:15)

text: וּמִבְּנֵי בֵבַי זְכַרְיָה בֶּן בֵּבָי וְעִמּוֹ עֶשְׂרִים וּשְׁמֹנָה הַזְּכָרִֽים׃
translation: Of the sons of Bebai, Zechariah the son of Bebai; and with him twenty-eight males. (Ezra 8:11)

text: וּמִבְּנֵי עַזְגָּד יוֹחָנָן בֶּן הַקָּטָן וְעִמּוֹ מֵאָה וַעֲשָׂרָה הַזְּכָרִֽים׃
translation: Of the sons of Azgad, Johanan the son of Hakkatan; and with him one hundred ten males. (Ezra 8:12)

text: לֹא תֵֽלְכוּן אַחֲרֵי אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים מֵאֱלֹהֵי הָֽעַמִּים אֲשֶׁר סְבִיבוֹתֵיכֶֽם׃
translation: You shall not go after other gods, of the gods of the peoples who are around you, (Deuteronomy 6:14)

text: וַֽיִּתְּנוּ לָהֶם אֶת חֶבְרוֹן בְּאֶרֶץ יְהוּדָה וְאֶת מִגְרָשֶׁיהָ סְבִיבֹתֶֽיהָ׃
translation: the son of Michael, the son of Baaseiah, the son of Malchijah, (1 Chronicles 6:40)

text: הִנֵּה מִטָּתוֹ שֶׁלִּשְׁלֹמֹה שִׁשִּׁים גִּבֹּרִים סָבִיב לָהּ מִגִּבֹּרֵי יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
translation: Behold, it is Solomon's carriage! Sixty mighty men are around it, of the mighty men of Israel. (Song of Solomon 3:7)

text: סָבִיב שְׁמֹנָה עָשָׂר אָלֶף וְשֵׁם הָעִיר מִיּוֹם יְהוָה שָֽׁמָּה׃
translation: "It shall be eighteen thousand reeds in circumference; and the name of the city from that day shall be, 'The LORD is there.' (Ezekiel 48:35)

text: דַּבֵּר אֶל הָעֵדָה לֵאמֹר הֵֽעָלוּ מִסָּבִיב לְמִשְׁכַּן קֹרַח דָּתָן וַאֲבִירָֽם׃
translation: "Speak to the congregation, saying, 'Get away from around the tent of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram!'" (Numbers 16:24)

text: וַיָּשֶׂם יִשְׂרָאֵל אֹֽרְבִים אֶל הַגִּבְעָה סָבִֽיב׃
translation: Israel set ambushes all around Gibeah. (Judges 20:29)

text: וְאֶת שְׂדֵה הָעִיר וְאֶת חֲצֵרֶיהָ נָתְנוּ לְכָלֵב בֶּן יְפֻנֶּֽה׃
translation: the son of Ethni, the son of Zerah, the son of Adaiah, (1 Chronicles 6:41)

text: וְעַל עֹשֵׂי מְלֶאכֶת הַשָּׂדֶה לַעֲבֹדַת הָאֲדָמָה עֶזְרִי בֶּן כְּלֽוּב׃
translation: Over those who did the work of the field for tillage of the ground was Ezri the son of Chelub. (1 Chronicles 27:26)

text: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה בָּעִיר וּבָרוּךְ אַתָּה בַּשָּׂדֶֽה׃
translation: You shall be blessed in the city, and you shall be blessed in the field. (Deuteronomy 28:3)

text: אָרוּר אַתָּה בָּעִיר וְאָרוּר אַתָּה בַּשָּׂדֶֽה׃
translation: You will be cursed in the city, and you will be cursed in the field. (Deuteronomy 28:16)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֽוֹנָתָן אֶל דָּוִד לְכָה וְנֵצֵא הַשָּׂדֶה וַיֵּצְאוּ שְׁנֵיהֶם הַשָּׂדֶֽה׃
translation: Jonathan said to David, "Come! Let's go out into the field." They both went out into the field. (1 Samuel 20:11)

text: וַיְהִי בַבֹּקֶר וַיֵּצֵא יְהוֹנָתָן הַשָּׂדֶה לְמוֹעֵד דָּוִד וְנַעַר קָטֹן עִמּֽוֹ׃
translation: In the morning, Jonathan went out into the field at the time appointed with David, and a little boy with him. (1 Samuel 20:35)

text: כָּל מִשְׁפְּחֹת הַשּׁוּחָמִי לִפְקֻדֵיהֶם אַרְבָּעָה וְשִׁשִּׁים אֶלֶף וְאַרְבַּע מֵאֽוֹת׃
translation: All the families of the Shuhamites, according to those who were counted of them, were sixty-four thousand four hundred. (Numbers 26:43)

text: מִן בְּנֵי הַלֵּוִי אַרְבַּעַת אֲלָפִים וְשֵׁשׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃
translation: Jehoiada was the leader of the household of Aaron; and with him were three thousand seven hundred, (1 Chronicles 12:27)

text: לְאַרְבָּעָה עָשָׂר מַתִּתְיָהוּ בָּנָיו וְאֶחָיו שְׁנֵים עָשָֽׂר׃
translation: for the fourteenth, Mattithiah, his sons and his brothers, twelve; (1 Chronicles 25:21)

text: בְּנֵי עֵילָם אַחֵר אֶלֶף מָאתַיִם חֲמִשִּׁים וְאַרְבָּעָֽה׃
translation: The children of the other Elam, one thousand two hundred fifty-four. (Ezra 2:31)

text: בְּנֵי עֵילָם אַחֵר אֶלֶף מָאתַיִם חֲמִשִּׁים וְאַרְבָּעָֽה׃
translation: The children of the other Elam: one thousand two hundred fifty-four. (Nehemiah 7:34)

text: כָּל הַלְוִיִּם בְּעִיר הַקֹּדֶשׁ מָאתַיִם שְׁמֹנִים וְאַרְבָּעָֽה׃
translation: All the Levites in the holy city were two hundred eighty-four. (Nehemiah 11:18)

text: פְּֽרִי צַדִּיק עֵץ חַיִּים וְלֹקֵחַ נְפָשׂוֹת חָכָֽם׃
translation: The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life. He who is wise wins souls. (Proverbs 11:30)

text: אַפִּרְיוֹן עָשָׂה לוֹ הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה מֵעֲצֵי הַלְּבָנֽוֹן׃
translation: King Solomon made himself a carriage of the wood of Lebanon. (Song of Solomon 3:9)

text: וְהָיוּ הָעֵצִים אֲֽשֶׁר תִּכְתֹּב עֲלֵיהֶם בְּיָדְךָ לְעֵינֵיהֶֽם׃
translation: The sticks on which you write will be in your hand before their eyes."' (Ezekiel 37:20)

text: וַיֵּלֶךְ אִתָּם וַיָּבֹאוּ הַיַּרְדֵּנָה וַֽיִּגְזְרוּ הָעֵצִֽים׃
translation: So he went with them. When they came to the Jordan, they cut down wood. (2 Kings 6:4)

text: בְּשׁוּבֵנִי וְהִנֵּה אֶל שְׂפַת הַנַּחַל עֵץ רַב מְאֹד מִזֶּה וּמִזֶּֽה׃
translation: Now when I had returned, behold, on the bank of the river were very many trees on the one side and on the other. (Ezekiel 47:7)

text: וְנָתְנוּ בְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֵן אֵשׁ עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וְעָרְכוּ עֵצִים עַל הָאֵֽשׁ׃
translation: The sons of Aaron the priest shall put fire on the altar, and lay wood in order on the fire; (Leviticus 1:7)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל שְֽׁמַֽע נָא בֶּן אֲחִיטוּב וַיֹּאמֶר הִנְנִי אֲדֹנִֽי׃
translation: Saul said, "Hear now, you son of Ahitub." He answered, "Here I am, my lord." (1 Samuel 22:12)

text: וְעַתָּה הִנֵּה אֲדֹנִיָּה מָלָךְ וְעַתָּה אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ לֹא יָדָֽעְתָּ׃
translation: Now, behold, Adonijah reigns; and you, my lord the king, don't know it. (1 Kings 1:18)

text: וְעַתָּה אַתָּה אֹמֵר לֵךְ אֱמֹר לַֽאדֹנֶיךָ הִנֵּה אֵלִיָּהוּ וַהֲרָגָֽנִי׃
translation: Now you say, 'Go, tell your lord, "Behold, Elijah is here".' He will kill me." (1 Kings 18:14)

text: אֲשֶׁר אָֽמְרוּ לִלְשֹׁנֵנוּ נַגְבִּיר שְׂפָתֵינוּ אִתָּנוּ מִי אָדוֹן לָֽנוּ׃
translation: "Because of the oppression of the weak and because of the groaning of the needy, I will now arise," says the LORD; "I will set him in safety from those who malign him." (Psalms 12:5)

text: גָּדוֹל אֲדוֹנֵינוּ וְרַב כֹּחַ לִתְבוּנָתוֹ אֵין מִסְפָּֽר׃
translation: Great is our Lord, and mighty in power. His understanding is infinite. (Psalms 147:5)

text: וָאַעַן וָֽאֹמַר אֶל הַמַּלְאָךְ הַדֹּבֵר בִּי מָה אֵלֶּה אֲדֹנִֽי׃
translation: Then I asked the angel who talked with me, "What are these, my lord?" (Zechariah 6:4)

text: תּוֹעֲבַת מְלָכִים עֲשׂוֹת רֶשַׁע כִּי בִצְדָקָה יִכּוֹן כִּסֵּֽא׃
translation: It is an abomination for kings to do wrong, for the throne is established by righteousness. (Proverbs 16:12)

text: כִּי שָׁמַרְתִּי דַּרְכֵי יְהוָה וְלֹא רָשַׁעְתִּי מֵאֱלֹהָֽי׃
translation: For I have kept the LORD's ways, and have not wickedly departed from my God. (2 Samuel 22:22)

text: יַרְשִֽׁיעֲךָ פִיךָ וְלֹא אָנִי וּשְׂפָתֶיךָ יַעֲנוּ בָֽךְ׃
translation: Your own mouth condemns you, and not I. Yes, your own lips testify against you. (Job 15:6)

text: עַל כֵּן לֹא יָקֻמוּ רְשָׁעִים בַּמִּשְׁפָּט וְחַטָּאִים בַּעֲדַת צַדִּיקִֽים׃
translation: Therefore the wicked shall not stand in the judgment, nor sinners in the congregation of the righteous. (Psalms 1:5)

text: כִּי לֹא אֵֽל חָפֵץ רֶשַׁע אָתָּה לֹא יְגֻרְךָ רָֽע׃
translation: The arrogant will not stand in your sight. You hate all workers of iniquity. (Psalms 5:5)

text: יָשׁוּבוּ רְשָׁעִים לִשְׁאוֹלָה כָּל גּוֹיִם שְׁכֵחֵי אֱלֹהִֽים׃
translation: For the needy shall not always be forgotten, nor the hope of the poor perish forever. (Psalms 9:18)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹשָׁפָט הַאֵין פֹּה נָבִיא לַיהוָה עוֹד וְנִדְרְשָׁה מֵאוֹתֽוֹ׃
translation: But Jehoshaphat said, "Isn't there here a prophet of the LORD, that we may inquire of him?" (1 Kings 22:7)

text: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי אֲבִיָּה וּדְרָכָיו וּדְבָרָיו כְּתוּבִים בְּמִדְרַשׁ הַנָּבִיא עִדּֽוֹ׃
translation: The rest of the acts of Abijah, his ways, and his sayings are written in the commentary of the prophet Iddo. (2 Chronicles 13:22)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹשָׁפָט הַאֵין פֹּה נָבִיא לַיהוָה עוֹד וְנִדְרְשָׁה מֵאֹתֽוֹ׃
translation: But Jehoshaphat said, "Isn't there here a prophet of the LORD besides, that we may inquire of him?" (2 Chronicles 18:6)

text: הִנְנִי עַל הַנְּבִיאִם נְאֻם יְהוָה הַלֹּקְחִים לְשׁוֹנָם וַֽיִּנְאֲמוּ נְאֻֽם׃
translation: Behold, I am against the prophets," says the LORD, "who use their tongues, and say, 'He says.' (Jeremiah 23:31)

text: כִּי אֲמַרְתֶּם הֵקִים לָנוּ יְהוָה נְבִאִים בָּבֶֽלָה׃
translation: Because you have said, "The LORD has raised us up prophets in Babylon," (Jeremiah 29:15)

text: וַיִּקְרָא צְפַנְיָה הַכֹּהֵן אֶת הַסֵּפֶר הַזֶּה בְּאָזְנֵי יִרְמְיָהוּ הַנָּבִֽיא׃
translation: Zephaniah the priest read this letter in the hearing of Jeremiah the prophet. (Jeremiah 29:29)

text: וּמֵהֶם עַל כְּלֵי הָעֲבוֹדָה כִּֽי בְמִסְפָּר יְבִיאוּם וּבְמִסְפָּר יוֹצִיאֽוּם׃
translation: Certain of them were in charge of the vessels of service, for these were brought in by count, and these were taken out by count. (1 Chronicles 9:28)

text: טוֹבָה חָכְמָה מִכְּלֵי קְרָב וְחוֹטֶא אֶחָד יְאַבֵּד טוֹבָה הַרְבֵּֽה׃
translation: Wisdom is better than weapons of war; but one sinner destroys much good. (Ecclesiastes 9:18)

text: נִבְלַע יִשְׂרָאֵל עַתָּה הָיוּ בַגּוֹיִם כִּכְלִי אֵֽין חֵפֶץ בּֽוֹ׃
translation: Israel is swallowed up. Now they are among the nations like a worthless thing. (Hosea 8:8)

text: שִׁמְעוֹן וְלֵוִי אַחִים כְּלֵי חָמָס מְכֵרֹתֵיהֶֽם׃
translation: "Simeon and Levi are brothers. Their swords are weapons of violence. (Genesis 49:5)

text: וַיִּקַּח מֹשֶׁה וְאֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן אֶת הַזָּהָב מֵֽאִתָּם כֹּל כְּלִי מַעֲשֶֽׂה׃
translation: Moses and Eleazar the priest took their gold, even all worked jewels. (Numbers 31:51)

text: וַיָּסֹבּוּ עֲשָׂרָה נְעָרִים נֹשְׂאֵי כְּלֵי יוֹאָב וַיַּכּוּ אֶת אַבְשָׁלוֹם וַיְמִיתֻֽהוּ׃
translation: Ten young men who bore Joab's armor surrounded and struck Absalom, and killed him. (2 Samuel 18:15)

text: פְּנֵה אֵלַי וְחָנֵּנִי תְּנָֽה עֻזְּךָ לְעַבְדֶּךָ וְהוֹשִׁיעָה לְבֶן אֲמָתֶֽךָ׃
translation: Turn to me, and have mercy on me! Give your strength to your servant. Save the son of your servant. (Psalms 86:16)

text: עֶשֶׂר אַמּוֹת אֹרֶךְ הַקָּרֶשׁ וְאַמָּה וַחֲצִי הָֽאַמָּה רֹחַב הַקֶּרֶשׁ הָאֶחָֽד׃
translation: Ten cubits shall be the length of a board, and one and a half cubits the width of each board. (Exodus 26:16)

text: עֶשֶׂר אַמֹּת אֹרֶךְ הַקָּרֶשׁ וְאַמָּה וַחֲצִי הָֽאַמָּה רֹחַב הַקֶּרֶשׁ הָאֶחָֽד׃
translation: Ten cubits was the length of a board, and a cubit and a half the width of each board. (Exodus 36:21)

text: אֶל פְּנֵי אֹרֶךְ אַמּוֹת הַמֵּאָה פֶּתַח הַצָּפוֹן וְהָרֹחַב חֲמִשִּׁים אַמּֽוֹת׃
translation: Facing the length of one hundred cubits was the north door, and the width was fifty cubits. (Ezekiel 42:2)

text: וּמְיֻסָּד אֲבָנִים יְקָרוֹת אֲבָנִים גְּדֹלוֹת אַבְנֵי עֶשֶׂר אַמּוֹת וְאַבְנֵי שְׁמֹנֶה אַמּֽוֹת׃
translation: The foundation was of costly stones, even great stones, stones of ten cubits and stones of eight cubits. (1 Kings 7:10)

text: שכנתי שֹׁכַנְתְּ עַל מַיִם רַבִּים רַבַּת אֽוֹצָרֹת בָּא קִצֵּךְ אַמַּת בִּצְעֵֽךְ׃
translation: You who dwell on many waters, abundant in treasures, your end has come, the measure of your covetousness. (Jeremiah 51:13)

text: וּמִלְחָמָה הָיְתָה בֵין רְחַבְעָם וּבֵין יָרָבְעָם כָּל הַיָּמִֽים׃
translation: There was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam continually. (1 Kings 14:30)

text: עֵת לֶֽאֱהֹב וְעֵת לִשְׂנֹא עֵת מִלְחָמָה וְעֵת שָׁלֽוֹם׃
translation: a time to love, and a time to hate; a time for war, and a time for peace. (Ecclesiastes 3:8)

text: וְאִם לֹא תַשְׁלִים עִמָּךְ וְעָשְׂתָה עִמְּךָ מִלְחָמָה וְצַרְתָּ עָלֶֽיהָּ׃
translation: If it will make no peace with you, but will make war against you, then you shall besiege it. (Deuteronomy 20:12)

text: וַיִּגַּשׁ יוֹאָב וְהָעָם אֲשֶׁר עִמּוֹ לַמִּלְחָמָה בַּֽאֲרָם וַיָּנֻסוּ מִפָּנָֽיו׃
translation: So Joab and the people who were with him came near to the battle against the Syrians, and they fled before him. (2 Samuel 10:13)

text: וַיֵּשְׁבוּ שָׁלֹשׁ שָׁנִים אֵין מִלְחָמָה בֵּין אֲרָם וּבֵין יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
translation: They continued three years without war between Syria and Israel. (1 Kings 22:1)

text: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ מִלְחָמָה עִם הַֽהַגְרִיאִים וִיטוּר וְנָפִישׁ וְנוֹדָֽב׃
translation: They made war with the Hagrites, with Jetur, and Naphish, and Nodab. (1 Chronicles 5:19)

text: אֵלֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹת הַשִּׁמְעֹנִי שְׁנַיִם וְעֶשְׂרִים אֶלֶף וּמָאתָֽיִם׃
translation: These are the families of the Simeonites, twenty-two thousand two hundred. (Numbers 26:14)

text: וַיִּשְׁפֹּט אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל בִּימֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים עֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָֽה׃
translation: He judged Israel twenty years in the days of the Philistines. (Judges 15:20)

text: וּבִשְׁנַת עֶשְׂרִים לְיָרָבְעָם מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל מָלַךְ אָסָא מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָֽה׃
translation: In the twentieth year of Jeroboam king of Israel, Asa began to reign over Judah. (1 Kings 15:9)

text: וּמִן הַדָּנִי עֹרְכֵי מִלְחָמָה עֶשְׂרִֽים וּשְׁמוֹנָה אֶלֶף וְשֵׁשׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃
translation: Of Asher, such as were able to go out in the army, who could set the battle in array: forty thousand. (1 Chronicles 12:36)

text: לְאֶחָד וְעֶשְׂרִים לְהוֹתִיר בָּנָיו וְאֶחָיו שְׁנֵים עָשָֽׂר׃
translation: for the twenty-first to Hothir, his sons and his brothers, twelve; (1 Chronicles 25:28)

text: לִשְׁנַיִם וְעֶשְׂרִים לְגִדַּלְתִּי בָּנָיו וְאֶחָיו שְׁנֵים עָשָֽׂר׃
translation: for the twenty-second to Giddalti, his sons and his brothers, twelve; (1 Chronicles 25:29)

text: וַיָּבֹא נַעֲמָן בסוסו בְּסוּסָיו וּבְרִכְבּוֹ וַיַּעֲמֹד פֶּֽתַח הַבַּיִת לֶאֱלִישָֽׁע׃
translation: So Naaman came with his horses and with his chariots, and stood at the door of the house of Elisha. (2 Kings 5:9)

text: פִּיהָ פָּתְחָה בְחָכְמָה וְתֽוֹרַת חֶסֶד עַל לְשׁוֹנָֽהּ׃
translation: She opens her mouth with wisdom. Kind instruction is on her tongue. (Proverbs 31:26)

text: וַיַּרְא יְהוָה כִּֽי שְׂנוּאָה לֵאָה וַיִּפְתַּח אֶת רַחְמָהּ וְרָחֵל עֲקָרָֽה׃
translation: The LORD saw that Leah was hated, and he opened her womb, but Rachel was barren. (Genesis 29:31)

text: וַיִּזְכֹּר אֱלֹהִים אֶת רָחֵל וַיִּשְׁמַע אֵלֶיהָ אֱלֹהִים וַיִּפְתַּח אֶת רַחְמָֽהּ׃
translation: God remembered Rachel, and God listened to her, and opened her womb. (Genesis 30:22)

text: וַיִּרְדְּפֵהוּ אֲבִימֶלֶךְ וַיָּנָס מִפָּנָיו וַֽיִּפְּלוּ חֲלָלִים רַבִּים עַד פֶּתַח הַשָּֽׁעַר׃
translation: Abimelech chased him, and he fled before him, and many fell wounded, even to the entrance of the gate. (Judges 9:40)

text: אֲדַבְּרָה וְיִֽרְוַֽח לִי אֶפְתַּח שְׂפָתַי וְאֶֽעֱנֶֽה׃
translation: I will speak, that I may be refreshed. I will open my lips and answer. (Job 32:20)

text: וּשְׂעִיר עִזִּים אֶחָד חַטָּאת מִלְּבַד עֹלַת הַתָּמִיד מִנְחָתָהּ וְנִסְכָּֽהּ׃
translation: and one male goat for a sin offering, in addition to the continual burnt offering, its meal offering, and its drink offering. (Numbers 29:16)

text: וּשְׂעִיר עִזִּים אֶחָד חַטָּאת מִלְּבַד עֹלַת הַתָּמִיד וּמִנְחָתָהּ וְנִסְכֵּיהֶֽם׃
translation: and one male goat for a sin offering, in addition to the continual burnt offering, with its meal offering and their drink offerings. (Numbers 29:19)

text: וּשְׂעִיר עִזִּים אֶחָד חַטָּאת מִלְּבַד עֹלַת הַתָּמִיד מִנְחָתָהּ וְנִסְכָּֽהּ׃
translation: and one male goat for a sin offering; in addition to the continual burnt offering, its meal offering, and its drink offering. (Numbers 29:25)

text: וְעַתָּה שָׂא נָא אֶת חַטָּאתִי וְשׁוּב עִמִּי וְאֶֽשְׁתַּחֲוֶה לַֽיהוָֽה׃
translation: Now therefore, please pardon my sin, and turn again with me, that I may worship the LORD." (1 Samuel 15:25)

text: כַּמָּה לִי עֲוֺנוֹת וְחַטָּאוֹת פִּֽשְׁעִי וְחַטָּאתִי הֹדִיעֵֽנִי׃
translation: How many are my iniquities and sins? Make me know my disobedience and my sin. (Job 13:23)

text: כִּֽי פְשָׁעַי אֲנִי אֵדָע וְחַטָּאתִי נֶגְדִּי תָמִֽיד׃
translation: Behold, I was born in iniquity. My mother conceived me in sin. (Psalms 51:5)

text: כִּי חֶסֶד חָפַצְתִּי וְלֹא זָבַח וְדַעַת אֱלֹהִים מֵעֹלֽוֹת׃
translation: For I desire mercy, and not sacrifice; and the knowledge of God more than burnt offerings. (Hosea 6:6)

text: וְהַמֶּלֶךְ וְכָל הָעָם זֹבְחִים זֶבַח לִפְנֵי יְהוָֽה׃
translation: Then the king and all the people offered sacrifices before the LORD. (2 Chronicles 7:4)

text: לֹא עַל זְבָחֶיךָ אוֹכִיחֶךָ וְעוֹלֹתֶיךָ לְנֶגְדִּי תָמִֽיד׃
translation: I don't rebuke you for your sacrifices. Your burnt offerings are continually before me. (Psalms 50:8)

text: הַזְּבָחִים וּמִנְחָה הִֽגַּשְׁתֶּם לִי בַמִּדְבָּר אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
translation: "Did you bring to me sacrifices and offerings in the wilderness forty years, house of Israel? (Amos 5:25)

text: וַיִּקְרָא פַרְעֹה אֶל מֹשֶׁה וּֽלְאַהֲרֹן וַיֹּאמֶר לְכוּ זִבְחוּ לֵֽאלֹהֵיכֶם בָּאָֽרֶץ׃
translation: Else, if you will not let my people go, behold, I will send swarms of flies on you, and on your servants, and on your people, and into your houses. The houses of the Egyptians shall be full of swarms of flies, and also the ground they are on. (Exodus 8:21)

text: כַּאֲשֶׁר יוּרַם מִשּׁוֹר זֶבַח הַשְּׁלָמִים וְהִקְטִירָם הַכֹּהֵן עַל מִזְבַּח הָעֹלָֽה׃
translation: as it is removed from the bull of the sacrifice of peace offerings. The priest shall burn them on the altar of burnt offering. (Leviticus 4:10)

text: בְּנֵי מְרָרִי מַחְלִי וּמֻשִׁי וְאֵלֶּה מִשְׁפְּחוֹת הַלֵּוִי לַאֲבוֹתֵיהֶֽם׃
translation: Eleazar became the father of Phinehas, Phinehas became the father of Abishua, (1 Chronicles 6:4)

text: אֵלֶּה בְנֵי שֵׁם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם לִלְשֹׁנֹתָם בְּאַרְצֹתָם לְגוֹיֵהֶֽם׃
translation: These are the sons of Shem, by their families, according to their languages, lands, and nations. (Genesis 10:31)

text: וְאֵלֶּה שְׁמוֹת בְּֽנֵי גֵרְשׁוֹן לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם לִבְנִי וְשִׁמְעִֽי׃
translation: These are the names of the sons of Gershon by their families: Libni and Shimei. (Numbers 3:18)

text: לִמְרָרִי מִשְׁפַּחַת הַמַּחְלִי וּמִשְׁפַּחַת הַמּוּשִׁי אֵלֶּה הֵם מִשְׁפְּחֹת מְרָרִֽי׃
translation: Of Merari was the family of the Mahlites and the family of the Mushites. These are the families of Merari. (Numbers 3:33)

text: בְּנֵי מְרָרִי לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם לְבֵית אֲבֹתָם תִּפְקֹד אֹתָֽם׃
translation: "As for the sons of Merari, you shall count them by their families, by their fathers' houses; (Numbers 4:29)

text: וַיִּֽהְיוּ פְּקֻדֵיהֶם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם לְבֵית אֲבֹתָם אַלְפַּיִם וְשֵׁשׁ מֵאוֹת וּשְׁלֹשִֽׁים׃
translation: even those who were counted of them, by their families, by their fathers' houses, were two thousand six hundred thirty. (Numbers 4:40)

text: וּפְקוּדֵי מִשְׁפְּחֹת בְּנֵי מְרָרִי לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם לְבֵית אֲבֹתָֽם׃
translation: Those who were counted of the families of the sons of Merari, by their families, by their fathers' houses, (Numbers 4:42)

text: וּמָה אֶֽעֱשֶׂה כִּֽי יָקוּם אֵל וְכִֽי יִפְקֹד מָה אֲשִׁיבֶֽנּוּ׃
translation: what then will I do when God rises up? When he visits, what will I answer him? (Job 31:14)

text: וְהַלְוִיִּם לְמַטֵּה אֲבֹתָם לֹא הָתְפָּקְדוּ בְּתוֹכָֽם׃
translation: But the Levites after the tribe of their fathers were not counted among them. (Numbers 1:47)

text: וּצְבָאוֹ וּפְקֻדֵיהֶם אַרְבָּעִים אֶלֶף וַחֲמֵשׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃
translation: His division, and those who were counted of them, were forty thousand five hundred. (Numbers 2:19)

text: וּצְבָאוֹ וּפְקֻדֵיהֶם שְׁנַיִם וּשְׁלֹשִׁים אֶלֶף וּמָאתָֽיִם׃
translation: His division, and those who were counted of them, were thirty-two thousand two hundred. (Numbers 2:21)

text: וּפְקֻדֵיהֶם בְּמִסְפַּר כָּל זָכָר מִבֶּן חֹדֶשׁ וָמָעְלָה שֵׁשֶׁת אֲלָפִים וּמָאתָֽיִם׃
translation: Those who were counted of them, according to the number of all the males from a month old and upward, were six thousand two hundred. (Numbers 3:34)

text: הָאֹמְרִים לָאֵל סוּר מִמֶּנּוּ וּמַה יִּפְעַל שַׁדַּי לָֽמוֹ׃
translation: who said to God, 'Depart from us!' and, 'What can the Almighty do for us?' (Job 22:17)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל וְלָמָּה תִּשְׁאָלֵנִי וַיהוָה סָר מֵעָלֶיךָ וַיְהִי עָרֶֽךָ׃
translation: Samuel said, "Why then do you ask me, since the LORD has departed from you and has become your adversary? (1 Samuel 28:16)

text: כִּי כָל משפטו מִשְׁפָּטָיו לְנֶגְדִּי וְחֻקֹּתָיו לֹא אָסוּר מִמֶּֽנָּה׃
translation: For all his ordinances were before me. As for his statutes, I didn't depart from them. (2 Samuel 22:23)

text: כִּֽי אָמַר אִיּוֹב צָדַקְתִּי וְאֵל הֵסִיר מִשְׁפָּטִֽי׃
translation: For Job has said, 'I am righteous, God has taken away my right. (Job 34:5)

text: אֲשֶׁר עַל כֵּן סָרוּ מֵֽאַחֲרָיו וְכָל דְּרָכָיו לֹא הִשְׂכִּֽילוּ׃
translation: because they turned away from following him, and wouldn't pay attention to any of his ways, (Job 34:27)

text: סוּר מֵרָע וַעֲשֵׂה טוֹב בַּקֵּשׁ שָׁלוֹם וְרָדְפֵֽהוּ׃
translation: The LORD's eyes are toward the righteous. His ears listen to their cry. (Psalms 34:15)

text: מַטֵּה זְבוּלֻן וְנָשִׂיא לִבְנֵי זְבוּלֻן אֱלִיאָב בֶּן חֵלֹֽן׃
translation: "The tribe of Zebulun: the prince of the children of Zebulun shall be Eliab the son of Helon. (Numbers 2:7)

text: וְמַטֵּה גָּד וְנָשִׂיא לִבְנֵי גָד אֶלְיָסָף בֶּן רְעוּאֵֽל׃
translation: "The tribe of Gad: the prince of the children of Gad shall be Eliasaph the son of Reuel. (Numbers 2:14)

text: וּמַטֵּה בִּנְיָמִן וְנָשִׂיא לִבְנֵי בִנְיָמִן אֲבִידָן בֶּן גִּדְעֹנִֽי׃
translation: "The tribe of Benjamin: the prince of the children of Benjamin shall be Abidan the son of Gideoni. (Numbers 2:22)

text: וּמַטֵּה נַפְתָּלִי וְנָשִׂיא לִבְנֵי נַפְתָּלִי אֲחִירַע בֶּן עֵינָֽן׃
translation: "The tribe of Naphtali: the prince of the children of Naphtali shall be Ahira the son of Enan. (Numbers 2:29)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו יְהוָה מזה מַה זֶּה בְיָדֶךָ וַיֹּאמֶר מַטֶּֽה׃
translation: The LORD said to him, "What is that in your hand?" He said, "A rod." (Exodus 4:2)

text: וְעָלָיו מַטֵּה מְנַשֶּׁה וְנָשִׂיא לִבְנֵי מְנַשֶּׁה גַּמְלִיאֵל בֶּן פְּדָהצֽוּר׃
translation: "Next to him shall be the tribe of Manasseh. The prince of the children of Manasseh shall be Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur. (Numbers 2:20)

text: וַיֵּיטֶב אֱלֹהִים לַֽמְיַלְּדֹת וַיִּרֶב הָעָם וַיַּֽעַצְמוּ מְאֹֽד׃
translation: God dealt well with the midwives, and the people multiplied, and grew very mighty. (Exodus 1:20)

text: וְנִשְׁמַרְתֶּם מְאֹד לְנַפְשֹֽׁתֵיכֶם לְאַהֲבָה אֶת יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃
translation: Take good heed therefore to yourselves, that you love the LORD your God. (Joshua 23:11)

text: אֶת חֻקֶּיךָ אֶשְׁמֹר אַֽל תַּעַזְבֵנִי עַד מְאֹֽד׃
translation: I will observe your statutes. Don't utterly forsake me. BETH (Psalms 119:8)

text: הִנֵּה קָטֹן נְתַתִּיךָ בַּגּוֹיִם בָּזוּי אַתָּה מְאֹֽד׃
translation: Behold, I have made you small among the nations. You are greatly despised. (Obadiah 1:2)

text: וְאַנְשֵׁי סְדֹם רָעִים וְחַטָּאִים לַיהוָה מְאֹֽד׃
translation: Now the men of Sodom were exceedingly wicked and sinners against the LORD. (Genesis 13:13)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲבִימֶלֶךְ אֶל יִצְחָק לֵךְ מֵֽעִמָּנוּ כִּֽי עָצַֽמְתָּ מִמֶּנּוּ מְאֹֽד׃
translation: Abimelech said to Isaac, "Go away from us, for you are much mightier than we." (Genesis 26:16)

text: אִם כֹּחַ אֲבָנִים כֹּחִי אִֽם בְּשָׂרִי נָחֽוּשׁ׃
translation: Is my strength the strength of stones? Or is my flesh of bronze? (Job 6:12)

text: הַעֵינֵי בָשָׂר לָךְ אִם כִּרְאוֹת אֱנוֹשׁ תִּרְאֶֽה׃
translation: Do you have eyes of flesh? Or do you see as man sees? (Job 10:4)

text: לָמָּה תִּרְדְּפֻנִי כְמוֹ אֵל וּמִבְּשָׂרִי לֹא תִשְׂבָּֽעוּ׃
translation: Why do you persecute me as God, and are not satisfied with my flesh? (Job 19:22)

text: נֹתֵן לֶחֶם לְכָל בָּשָׂר כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
translation: who gives food to every creature, for his loving kindness endures forever. (Psalms 136:25)

text: רִאשׁוֹן לְצִיּוֹן הִנֵּה הִנָּם וְלִירוּשָׁלִַם מְבַשֵּׂר אֶתֵּֽן׃
translation: I am the first to say to Zion, 'Behold, look at them;' and I will give one who brings good news to Jerusalem. (Isaiah 41:27)

text: וּבְיוֹם הֵרָאוֹת בּוֹ בָּשָׂר חַי יִטְמָֽא׃
translation: But whenever raw flesh appears in him, he shall be unclean. (Leviticus 13:14)

text: וָאֲצַוֶּה אֶתְכֶם בָּעֵת הַהִוא אֵת כָּל הַדְּבָרִים אֲשֶׁר תַּעֲשֽׂוּן׃
translation: I commanded you at that time all the things which you should do. (Deuteronomy 1:18)

text: תָּבוֹא בְכֶלַח אֱלֵי קָבֶר כַּעֲלוֹת גָּדִישׁ בְּעִתּֽוֹ׃
translation: You will come to your grave in a full age, like a shock of grain comes in its season. (Job 5:26)

text: אֲשֶׁר חָשַׂכְתִּי לְעֶת צָר לְיוֹם קְרָב וּמִלְחָמָֽה׃
translation: which I have reserved against the time of trouble, against the day of battle and war? (Job 38:23)

text: לֹֽא יֵבֹשׁוּ בְּעֵת רָעָה וּבִימֵי רְעָבוֹן יִשְׂבָּֽעוּ׃
translation: They shall not be disappointed in the time of evil. In the days of famine they shall be satisfied. (Psalms 37:19)

text: מְשַׂנְאֵי יְהוָה יְכַֽחֲשׁוּ לוֹ וִיהִי עִתָּם לְעוֹלָֽם׃
translation: But he would have also fed them with the finest of the wheat. I will satisfy you with honey out of the rock." (Psalms 81:16)

text: אַשְׁרֵי שֹׁמְרֵי מִשְׁפָּט עֹשֵׂה צְדָקָה בְכָל עֵֽת׃
translation: Blessed are those who keep justice. Blessed is one who does what is right at all times. (Psalms 106:3)

text: אִם בָּנֶיךָ חָֽטְאוּ לוֹ וַֽיְשַׁלְּחֵם בְּיַד פִּשְׁעָֽם׃
translation: If your children have sinned against him, he has delivered them into the hand of their disobedience. (Job 8:4)

text: בְּכָל זֹאת חָֽטְאוּ עוֹד וְלֹֽא הֶאֱמִינוּ בְּנִפְלְאוֹתָֽיו׃
translation: For all this they still sinned, and didn't believe in his wondrous works. (Psalms 78:32)

text: וְֽחֹטְאִי חֹמֵס נַפְשׁוֹ כָּל מְשַׂנְאַי אָהֲבוּ מָֽוֶת׃
translation: But he who sins against me wrongs his own soul. All those who hate me love death." (Proverbs 8:36)

text: חַטָּאִים תְּרַדֵּף רָעָה וְאֶת צַדִּיקִים יְשַׁלֶּם טֽוֹב׃
translation: Misfortune pursues sinners, but prosperity rewards the righteous. (Proverbs 13:21)

text: בָּז לְרֵעֵהוּ חוֹטֵא וּמְחוֹנֵן עניים עֲנָוִים אַשְׁרָֽיו׃
translation: He who despises his neighbor sins, but he who has pity on the poor is blessed. (Proverbs 14:21)

text: וְשֶׁבֶר פֹּשְׁעִים וְחַטָּאִים יַחְדָּו וְעֹזְבֵי יְהוָה יִכְלֽוּ׃
translation: But the destruction of transgressors and sinners shall be together, and those who forsake the LORD shall be consumed. (Isaiah 1:28)

text: פְּנֵי יְהוָה בְּעֹשֵׂי רָע לְהַכְרִית מֵאֶרֶץ זִכְרָֽם׃
translation: The righteous cry, and the LORD hears, and delivers them out of all their troubles. (Psalms 34:17)

text: יִהְיוּ נֶֽגֶד יְהוָה תָּמִיד וְיַכְרֵת מֵאֶרֶץ זִכְרָֽם׃
translation: Let them be before the LORD continually, that he may cut off their memory from the earth; (Psalms 109:15)

text: וְהִכְרַתִּי שׁוֹפֵט מִקִּרְבָּהּ וְכָל שָׂרֶיהָ אֶהֱרוֹג עִמּוֹ אָמַר יְהוָֽה׃
translation: and I will cut off the judge from among them, and will kill all its princes with him," says the LORD. (Amos 2:3)

text: מֵחֲמַס אָחִיךָ יַעֲקֹב תְּכַסְּךָ בוּשָׁה וְנִכְרַתָּ לְעוֹלָֽם׃
translation: For the violence done to your brother Jacob, shame will cover you, and you will be cut off forever. (Obadiah 1:10)

text: תָּרֹם יָדְךָ עַל צָרֶיךָ וְכָל אֹיְבֶיךָ יִכָּרֵֽתוּ׃
translation: The remnant of Jacob will be among the nations, among many peoples, like a lion among the animals of the forest, like a young lion among the flocks of sheep; who, if he goes through, treads down and tears in pieces, and there is no one to deliver. (Micah 5:8)

text: וְעַתָּה לְכָה נִכְרְתָה בְרִית אֲנִי וָאָתָּה וְהָיָה לְעֵד בֵּינִי וּבֵינֶֽךָ׃
translation: Now come, let's make a covenant, you and I. Let it be for a witness between me and you." (Genesis 31:44)

text: וּפְלִשְׁתִּים לָֽקְחוּ אֵת אֲרוֹן הָאֱלֹהִים וַיְבִאֻהוּ מֵאֶבֶן הָעֵזֶר אַשְׁדּֽוֹדָה׃
translation: Now the Philistines had taken God's ark, and they brought it from Ebenezer to Ashdod. (1 Samuel 5:1)

text: וְֽאֶת פַּתְרֻסִים וְאֶת כַּסְלֻחִים אֲשֶׁר יָצְאוּ מִשָּׁם פְּלִשְׁתִּים וְאֶת כַּפְתֹּרִֽים׃
translation: Pathrusim, Casluhim (which the Philistines descended from), and Caphtorim. (Genesis 10:14)

text: וַיָּגָר אַבְרָהָם בְּאֶרֶץ פְּלִשְׁתִּים יָמִים רַבִּֽים׃
translation: Abraham lived as a foreigner in the land of the Philistines many days. (Genesis 21:34)

text: וְשָׁאוּל וְהֵמָּה וְכָל אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּעֵמֶק הָֽאֵלָה נִלְחָמִים עִם פְּלִשְׁתִּֽים׃
translation: Now Saul, and they, and all the men of Israel were in the valley of Elah, fighting with the Philistines. (1 Samuel 17:19)

text: וְֽאֶת פַּתְרֻסִים וְאֶת כַּסְלֻחִים אֲשֶׁר יָצְאוּ מִשָּׁם פְּלִשְׁתִּים וְאֶת כַּפְתֹּרִֽים׃
translation: Pathrusim, Casluhim (where the Philistines came from), and Caphtorim. (1 Chronicles 1:12)

text: וַֽיְהִי לוֹ מִקְנֵה צֹאן וּמִקְנֵה בָקָר וַעֲבֻדָּה רַבָּה וַיְקַנְאוּ אֹתוֹ פְּלִשְׁתִּֽים׃
translation: He had possessions of flocks, possessions of herds, and a great household. The Philistines envied him. (Genesis 26:14)

text: כָּל זֹאת בָּאַתְנוּ וְלֹא שְׁכַחֲנוּךָ וְלֹֽא שִׁקַּרְנוּ בִּבְרִיתֶֽךָ׃
translation: Our heart has not turned back, neither have our steps strayed from your path, (Psalms 44:18)

text: וַיְצַו מֹשֶׁה אֶת הַלְוִיִּם נֹשְׂאֵי אֲרוֹן בְּרִית יְהוָה לֵאמֹֽר׃
translation: Moses commanded the Levites, who bore the ark of the LORD's covenant, saying, (Deuteronomy 31:25)

text: וְלִבָּם לֹא נָכוֹן עִמּוֹ וְלֹא נֶאֶמְנוּ בִּבְרִיתֽוֹ׃
translation: For their heart was not right with him, neither were they faithful in his covenant. (Psalms 78:37)

text: זָכַר לְעוֹלָם בְּרִיתוֹ דָּבָר צִוָּה לְאֶלֶף דּֽוֹר׃
translation: He has remembered his covenant forever, the word which he commanded to a thousand generations, (Psalms 105:8)

text: וַיִּזְכֹּר לָהֶם בְּרִיתוֹ וַיִּנָּחֵם כְּרֹב חסדו חֲסָדָֽיו׃
translation: He remembered for them his covenant, and repented according to the multitude of his loving kindnesses. (Psalms 106:45)

text: פְּדוּת שָׁלַח לְעַמּוֹ צִוָּֽה לְעוֹלָם בְּרִיתוֹ קָדוֹשׁ וְנוֹרָא שְׁמֽוֹ׃
translation: He has sent redemption to his people. He has ordained his covenant forever. His name is holy and awesome! (Psalms 111:9)

text: וְהַמָּן כִּזְרַע גַּד הוּא וְעֵינוֹ כְּעֵין הַבְּדֹֽלַח׃
translation: The manna was like coriander seed, and it looked like bdellium. (Numbers 11:7)

text: אַשְׁרֵיכֶם זֹרְעֵי עַל כָּל מָיִם מְשַׁלְּחֵי רֶֽגֶל הַשּׁוֹר וְהַחֲמֽוֹר׃
translation: Blessed are you who sow beside all waters, who send out the feet of the ox and the donkey. (Isaiah 32:20)

text: וְאַתָּה יִשְׂרָאֵל עַבְדִּי יַעֲקֹב אֲשֶׁר בְּחַרְתִּיךָ זֶרַע אַבְרָהָם אֹהֲבִֽי׃
translation: "But you, Israel, my servant, Jacob whom I have chosen, the offspring of Abraham my friend, (Isaiah 41:8)

text: כִּי הִנְנִי אֲלֵיכֶם וּפָנִיתִי אֲלֵיכֶם וְנֶעֱבַדְתֶּם וְנִזְרַעְתֶּֽם׃
translation: For, behold, I am for you, and I will come to you, and you will be tilled and sown. (Ezekiel 36:9)

text: וַֽאעַנֶּה אֶת זֶרַע דָּוִד לְמַעַן זֹאת אַךְ לֹא כָל הַיָּמִֽים׃
translation: I will afflict the offspring of David for this, but not forever.'" (1 Kings 11:39)

text: פִּרְיָמוֹ מֵאֶרֶץ תְּאַבֵּד וְזַרְעָם מִבְּנֵי אָדָֽם׃
translation: For they intended evil against you. They plotted evil against you which cannot succeed. (Psalms 21:11)

text: וַיִּשָּׂא יַעֲקֹב רַגְלָיו וַיֵּלֶךְ אַרְצָה בְנֵי קֶֽדֶם׃
translation: Then Jacob went on his journey, and came to the land of the children of the east. (Genesis 29:1)

text: וַנֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו כֵּנִים אֲנָחְנוּ לֹא הָיִינוּ מְרַגְּלִֽים׃
translation: We said to him, 'We are honest men. We are no spies. (Genesis 42:31)

text: וַיִּפְנוּ וַיַּעֲלוּ הָהָרָה וַיָּבֹאוּ עַד נַחַל אֶשְׁכֹּל וַֽיְרַגְּלוּ אֹתָֽהּ׃
translation: They turned and went up into the hill country, and came to the valley of Eshcol, and spied it out. (Deuteronomy 1:24)

text: וַיִּשְׁלַח דָּוִד מְרַגְּלִים וַיֵּדַע כִּֽי בָא שָׁאוּל אֶל נָכֽוֹן׃
translation: David therefore sent out spies, and understood that Saul had certainly come. (1 Samuel 26:4)

text: וְאַתְּ קוּמִי לְכִי לְבֵיתֵךְ בְּבֹאָה רַגְלַיִךְ הָעִירָה וּמֵת הַיָּֽלֶד׃
translation: Arise therefore, and go to your house. When your feet enter into the city, the child will die. (1 Kings 14:12)

text: כִּֽי אָמַרְתִּי פֶּן יִשְׂמְחוּ לִי בְּמוֹט רַגְלִי עָלַי הִגְדִּֽילוּ׃
translation: For I am ready to fall. My pain is continually before me. (Psalms 38:17)

text: וְֽהַלְוִיִּם וְיֵשׁוּעַ בֶּן אֲזַנְיָה בִּנּוּי מִבְּנֵי חֵנָדָד קַדְמִיאֵֽל׃
translation: and their brothers, Shebaniah, Hodiah, Kelita, Pelaiah, Hanan, (Nehemiah 10:10)

text: וַיֶּאֱסֹף דָּוִיד אֶת בְּנֵי אַֽהֲרֹן וְאֶת הַלְוִיִּֽם׃
translation: David gathered together the sons of Aaron and the Levites: (1 Chronicles 15:4)

text: וַיִּֽתְקַדְּשׁוּ הַכֹּהֲנִים וְהַלְוִיִּם לְהַעֲלוֹת אֶת אֲרוֹן יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
translation: So the priests and the Levites sanctified themselves to bring up the ark of the LORD, the God of Israel. (1 Chronicles 15:14)

text: וַיֶּאֱסֹף אֶת כָּל שָׂרֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְהַכֹּהֲנִים וְהַלְוִיִּֽם׃
translation: He gathered together all the princes of Israel, with the priests and the Levites. (1 Chronicles 23:2)

text: וּשְׁאָר יִשְׂרָאֵל הַכֹּהֲנִים הַלְוִיִּם בְּכָל עָרֵי יְהוּדָה אִישׁ בְּנַחֲלָתֽוֹ׃
translation: The residue of Israel, of the priests, and the Levites were in all the cities of Judah, everyone in his inheritance. (Nehemiah 11:20)

text: וְגַם מֵהֶם אֶקַּח לַכֹּהֲנִים לַלְוִיִּם אָמַר יְהוָֽה׃
translation: Of them I will also select priests and Levites," says the LORD. (Isaiah 66:21)

text: יְמִֽינְךָ יְהוָה נֶאְדָּרִי בַּכֹּחַ יְמִֽינְךָ יְהוָה תִּרְעַץ אוֹיֵֽב׃
translation: Your right hand, LORD, is glorious in power. Your right hand, LORD, dashes the enemy in pieces. (Exodus 15:6)

text: כִּֽי תֵצֵא מַחֲנֶה עַל אֹיְבֶיךָ וְנִשְׁמַרְתָּ מִכֹּל דָּבָר רָֽע׃
translation: If there is among you any man who is not clean by reason of that which happens to him by night, then shall he go outside of the camp. He shall not come within the camp; (Deuteronomy 23:10)

text: קָרְבָה אֶל נַפְשִׁי גְאָלָהּ לְמַעַן אֹיְבַי פְּדֵֽנִי׃
translation: You know my reproach, my shame, and my dishonor. My adversaries are all before you. (Psalms 69:19)

text: מֵאֹיְבַי תְּחַכְּמֵנִי מִצְוֺתֶךָ כִּי לְעוֹלָם הִיא לִֽי׃
translation: Your commandments make me wiser than my enemies, for your commandments are always with me. (Psalms 119:98)

text: וַאֲבַדְתֶּם בַּגּוֹיִם וְאָכְלָה אֶתְכֶם אֶרֶץ אֹיְבֵיכֶֽם׃
translation: You will perish among the nations. The land of your enemies will eat you up. (Leviticus 26:38)

text: אַֽל תַּעֲלוּ כִּי אֵין יְהוָה בְּקִרְבְּכֶם וְלֹא תִּנָּגְפוּ לִפְנֵי אֹיְבֵיכֶֽם׃
translation: Don't go up, for the LORD isn't among you; that way you won't be struck down before your enemies. (Numbers 14:42)

text: אֶבֶן מָאֲסוּ הַבּוֹנִים הָיְתָה לְרֹאשׁ פִּנָּֽה׃
translation: The stone which the builders rejected has become the cornerstone. (Psalms 118:22)

text: אֶֽבֶן חֵן הַשֹּׁחַד בְּעֵינֵי בְעָלָיו אֶֽל כָּל אֲשֶׁר יִפְנֶה יַשְׂכִּֽיל׃
translation: A bribe is a precious stone in the eyes of him who gives it; wherever he turns, he prospers. (Proverbs 17:8)

text: וְשַׂמְתִּי כַּֽדְכֹד שִׁמְשֹׁתַיִךְ וּשְׁעָרַיִךְ לְאַבְנֵי אֶקְדָּח וְכָל גְּבוּלֵךְ לְאַבְנֵי חֵֽפֶץ׃
translation: I will make your pinnacles of rubies, your gates of sparkling jewels, and all your walls of precious stones. (Isaiah 54:12)

text: וָאֵרֵד בֵּית הַיּוֹצֵר והנהו וְהִנֵּה הוּא עֹשֶׂה מְלָאכָה עַל הָאָבְנָֽיִם׃
translation: Then I went down to the potter's house, and behold, he was making something on the wheels. (Jeremiah 18:3)

text: צָֽמְתוּ בַבּוֹר חַיָּי וַיַּדּוּ אֶבֶן בִּֽי׃
translation: They have cut off my life in the dungeon, and have cast a stone on me. (Lamentations 3:53)

text: וְהַנִּמְצָא אִתּוֹ אֲבָנִים נָתְנוּ לְאוֹצַר בֵּית יְהוָה עַל יַד יְחִיאֵל הַגֵּרְשֻׁנִּֽי׃
translation: People with whom precious stones were found gave them to the treasure of the LORD's house, under the hand of Jehiel the Gershonite. (1 Chronicles 29:8)

text: כִּֽי עָלֶיךָ הֹרַגְנוּ כָל הַיּוֹם נֶחְשַׁבְנוּ כְּצֹאן טִבְחָֽה׃
translation: Wake up! Why do you sleep, Lord? Arise! Don't reject us forever. (Psalms 44:23)

text: צֹאנְכֶם יַעְשֹׂר וְאַתֶּם תִּֽהְיוּ לוֹ לַעֲבָדִֽים׃
