translation: He will take one tenth of your flocks; and you will be his servants. (1 Samuel 8:17)

text: וַיִּבְחַר בְּדָוִד עַבְדּוֹ וַיִּקָּחֵהוּ מִֽמִּכְלְאֹת צֹֽאן׃
translation: He also chose David his servant, and took him from the sheepfolds; (Psalms 78:70)

text: וַיְשַׂגֵּב אֶבְיוֹן מֵעוֹנִי וַיָּשֶׂם כַּצֹּאן מִשְׁפָּחֽוֹת׃
translation: Yet he lifts the needy out of their affliction, and increases their families like a flock. (Psalms 107:41)

text: בְּצֹאנָם וּבִבְקָרָם יֵֽלְכוּ לְבַקֵּשׁ אֶת יְהוָה וְלֹא יִמְצָאוּ חָלַץ מֵהֶֽם׃
translation: They will go with their flocks and with their herds to seek the LORD, but they won't find him. He has withdrawn himself from them. (Hosea 5:6)

text: גַּם צֹאנְכֶם גַּם בְּקַרְכֶם קְחוּ כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבַּרְתֶּם וָלֵכוּ וּבֵֽרַכְתֶּם גַּם אֹתִֽי׃
translation: Take both your flocks and your herds, as you have said, and be gone; and bless me also!" (Exodus 12:32)

text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה בְּמִדְבַּר סִינַי לֵאמֹֽר׃
translation: The LORD spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, saying, (Numbers 3:14)

text: וְאַחַר נָסְעוּ הָעָם מֵחֲצֵרוֹת וַֽיַּחֲנוּ בְּמִדְבַּר פָּארָֽן׃
translation: Afterward the people traveled from Hazeroth, and encamped in the wilderness of Paran. (Numbers 12:16)

text: וַיִּסְעוּ מִסֻּכֹּת וַיַּחֲנוּ בְאֵתָם אֲשֶׁר בִּקְצֵה הַמִּדְבָּֽר׃
translation: They traveled from Succoth, and encamped in Etham, which is in the edge of the wilderness. (Numbers 33:6)

text: וַיִּסְעוּ מִסֻּכֹּת וַיַּחֲנוּ בְאֵתָם בִּקְצֵה הַמִּדְבָּֽר׃
translation: They took their journey from Succoth, and encamped in Etham, in the edge of the wilderness. (Exodus 13:20)

text: וַיִּסְעוּ מִמִּדְבַּר סִינָי וַֽיַּחֲנוּ בְּקִבְרֹת הַֽתַּאֲוָֽה׃
translation: They traveled from the wilderness of Sinai, and encamped in Kibroth Hattaavah. (Numbers 33:16)

text: וַיַּעַל בְּנָיָהוּ בֶּן יְהוֹיָדָע וַיִּפְגַּע בּוֹ וַיְמִתֵהוּ וַיִּקָּבֵר בְּבֵיתוֹ בַּמִּדְבָּֽר׃
translation: Then Benaiah the son of Jehoiada went up and fell on him, and killed him; and he was buried in his own house in the wilderness. (1 Kings 2:34)

text: וְאֶלְעָשָׂה הֹלִיד אֶת סִֽסְמָי וְסִסְמַי הֹלִיד אֶת שַׁלּֽוּם׃
translation: and Eleasah became the father of Sismai, and Sismai became the father of Shallum, (1 Chronicles 2:40)

text: וְשַׁלּוּם הוֹלִיד אֶת יְקַמְיָה וִֽיקַמְיָה הֹלִיד אֶת אֱלִישָׁמָֽע׃
translation: and Shallum became the father of Jekamiah, and Jekamiah became the father of Elishama. (1 Chronicles 2:41)

text: וְשַׁבְתִּי בְשָׁלוֹם אֶל בֵּית אָבִי וְהָיָה יְהוָה לִי לֵאלֹהִֽים׃
translation: so that I come again to my father's house in peace, and the LORD will be my God, (Genesis 28:21)

text: וְשָׁאֲלוּ לְךָ לְשָׁלוֹם וְנָתְנוּ לְךָ שְׁתֵּי לֶחֶם וְלָקַחְתָּ מִיָּדָֽם׃
translation: They will greet you and give you two loaves of bread, which you shall receive from their hand. (1 Samuel 10:4)

text: פָּדָה בְשָׁלוֹם נַפְשִׁי מִקֲּרָב לִי כִּֽי בְרַבִּים הָיוּ עִמָּדִֽי׃
translation: God, who is enthroned forever, will hear and answer them. Selah. They never change and don't fear God. (Psalms 55:19)

text: רַבַּת שָֽׁכְנָה לָּהּ נַפְשִׁי עִם שׂוֹנֵא שָׁלֽוֹם׃
translation: My soul has had her dwelling too long with him who hates peace. (Psalms 120:6)

text: וְהֵמָּה כְּאָדָם עָבְרוּ בְרִית שָׁם בָּגְדוּ בִֽי׃
translation: But they, like Adam, have broken the covenant. They were unfaithful to me there. (Hosea 6:7)

text: וּרְשָׁעִים מֵאֶרֶץ יִכָּרֵתוּ וּבוֹגְדִים יִסְּחוּ מִמֶּֽנָּה׃
translation: But the wicked will be cut off from the land. The treacherous will be rooted out of it. (Proverbs 2:22)

text: כֹּפֶר לַצַּדִּיק רָשָׁע וְתַחַת יְשָׁרִים בּוֹגֵֽד׃
translation: The wicked is a ransom for the righteous, the treacherous for the upright. (Proverbs 21:18)

text: בְּכָל עֵת יִהְיוּ בְגָדֶיךָ לְבָנִים וְשֶׁמֶן עַל רֹאשְׁךָ אַל יֶחְסָֽר׃
translation: Let your garments be always white, and don't let your head lack oil. (Ecclesiastes 9:8)

text: מַדּוּעַ אָדֹם לִלְבוּשֶׁךָ וּבְגָדֶיךָ כְּדֹרֵךְ בְּגַֽת׃
translation: Why is your clothing red, and your garments like him who treads in the wine vat? (Isaiah 63:2)

text: כִּי בָגוֹד בָּגְדוּ בִּי בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל וּבֵית יְהוּדָה נְאֻם יְהוָֽה׃
translation: For the house of Israel and the house of Judah have dealt very treacherously against me," says the LORD. (Jeremiah 5:11)

text: מִן בְּנֵי שִׁמְעוֹן גִּבּוֹרֵי חַיִל לַצָּבָא שִׁבְעַת אֲלָפִים וּמֵאָֽה׃
translation: Of the children of Levi: four thousand six hundred. (1 Chronicles 12:26)

text: וְלִמְשֶֽׁלֶמְיָהוּ בָּנִים וְאַחִים בְּנֵי חָיִל שְׁמוֹנָה עָשָֽׂר׃
translation: Meshelemiah had sons and brothers, eighteen valiant men. (1 Chronicles 26:9)

text: לֹֽא יֶעְשַׁר וְלֹא יָקוּם חֵילוֹ וְלֹֽא יִטֶּה לָאָרֶץ מִנְלָֽם׃
translation: He will not be rich, neither will his substance continue, neither will their possessions be extended on the earth. (Job 15:29)

text: וְהָיָה בְּהֵֽעָלוֹת חֵיל הַכַּשְׂדִּים מֵעַל יְרֽוּשָׁלִָם מִפְּנֵי חֵיל פַּרְעֹֽה׃
translation: When the army of the Chaldeans had withdrawn from Jerusalem for fear of Pharaoh's army, (Jeremiah 37:11)

text: וְאָמַרְתָּ בִּלְבָבֶךָ כֹּחִי וְעֹצֶם יָדִי עָשָׂה לִי אֶת הַחַיִל הַזֶּֽה׃
translation: and lest you say in your heart, "My power and the might of my hand has gotten me this wealth." (Deuteronomy 8:17)

text: וַיֵּרָא אֵלָיו מַלְּאַךְ יְהוָה וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו יְהוָה עִמְּךָ גִּבּוֹר הֶחָֽיִל׃
translation: The LORD's angel appeared to him, and said to him, "The LORD is with you, you mighty man of valor!" (Judges 6:12)

text: וַיְחִי שְׂרוּג שְׁלֹשִׁים שָׁנָה וַיּוֹלֶד אֶת נָחֽוֹר׃
translation: Serug lived thirty years, and became the father of Nahor. (Genesis 11:22)

text: הֲֽלֹא אַתָּה תָּשׁוּב תְּחַיֵּנוּ וְעַמְּךָ יִשְׂמְחוּ בָֽךְ׃
translation: Show us your loving kindness, LORD. Grant us your salvation. (Psalms 85:7)

text: לֹֽא אָמוּת כִּי אֶֽחְיֶה וַאֲסַפֵּר מַֽעֲשֵׂי יָֽהּ׃
translation: I will not die, but live, and declare the LORD's works. (Psalms 118:17)

text: וַיְחִי מְתוּשֶׁלַח שֶׁבַע וּשְׁמֹנִים שָׁנָה וּמְאַת שָׁנָה וַיּוֹלֶד אֶת לָֽמֶךְ׃
translation: Methuselah lived one hundred eighty-seven years, then became the father of Lamech. (Genesis 5:25)

text: יְהוָה מֵמִית וּמְחַיֶּה מוֹרִיד שְׁאוֹל וַיָּֽעַל׃
translation: "The LORD kills and makes alive. He brings down to Sheol and brings up. (1 Samuel 2:6)

text: וַיִּשְׁמַע יְהוָה בְּקוֹל אֵלִיָּהוּ וַתָּשָׁב נֶֽפֶשׁ הַיֶּלֶד עַל קִרְבּוֹ וַיֶּֽחִי׃
translation: The LORD listened to the voice of Elijah; and the soul of the child came into him again, and he revived. (1 Kings 17:22)

text: וַיַּעַשׂ הַיָּשָׁר בְּעֵינֵי יְהוָה רַק לֹא בְּלֵבָב שָׁלֵֽם׃
translation: He did that which was right in the LORD's eyes, but not with a perfect heart. (2 Chronicles 25:2)

text: וְהָיוּ הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מְצַוְּךָ הַיּוֹם עַל לְבָבֶֽךָ׃
translation: These words, which I command you today, shall be on your heart; (Deuteronomy 6:6)

text: הוֹלֵךְ תָּמִים וּפֹעֵל צֶדֶק וְדֹבֵר אֱמֶת בִּלְבָבֽוֹ׃
translation: He who walks blamelessly and does what is right, and speaks truth in his heart; (Psalms 15:2)

text: וּבִקַּשְׁתֶּם אֹתִי וּמְצָאתֶם כִּי תִדְרְשֻׁנִי בְּכָל לְבַבְכֶֽם׃
translation: You shall seek me and find me, when you search for me with all your heart. (Jeremiah 29:13)

text: נִשָּׂא לְבָבֵנוּ אֶל כַּפָּיִם אֶל אֵל בַּשָּׁמָֽיִם׃
translation: Let's lift up our heart with our hands to God in the heavens. (Lamentations 3:41)

text: וְעַתָּה כֹּה אָמַר יְהוָה צְבָאוֹת שִׂימוּ לְבַבְכֶם עַל דַּרְכֵיכֶֽם׃
translation: Now therefore this is what the LORD of Armies says: 'Consider your ways. (Haggai 1:5)

text: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי יֹאשִׁיָּהוּ וַחֲסָדָיו כַּכָּתוּב בְּתוֹרַת יְהוָֽה׃
translation: Now the rest of the acts of Josiah and his good deeds, according to that which is written in the LORD's law, (2 Chronicles 35:26)

text: הוֹי הַחֹֽקְקִים חִקְקֵי אָוֶן וּֽמְכַתְּבִים עָמָל כִּתֵּֽבוּ׃
translation: Woe to those who decree unrighteous decrees, and to the writers who write oppressive decrees (Isaiah 10:1)

text: וַיְהִי בַבֹּקֶר וַיִּכְתֹּב דָּוִד סֵפֶר אֶל יוֹאָב וַיִּשְׁלַח בְּיַד אוּרִיָּֽה׃
translation: In the morning, David wrote a letter to Joab and sent it by the hand of Uriah. (2 Samuel 11:14)

text: לַעֲשׂוֹת בָּהֶם מִשְׁפָּט כָּתוּב הָדָר הוּא לְכָל חֲסִידָיו הַֽלְלוּ יָֽהּ׃
translation: to execute on them the written judgment. All his saints have this honor. Praise the LORD! (Psalms 149:9)

text: וְעַתָּה אִם תִּשָּׂא חַטָּאתָם וְאִם אַיִן מְחֵנִי נָא מִֽסִּפְרְךָ אֲשֶׁר כָּתָֽבְתָּ׃
translation: Yet now, if you will, forgive their sin—and if not, please blot me out of your book which you have written." (Exodus 32:32)

text: וַיִּכְתֹּב מֹשֶׁה אֶת הַשִּׁירָה הַזֹּאת בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא וַֽיְלַמְּדָהּ אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
translation: So Moses wrote this song the same day, and taught it to the children of Israel. (Deuteronomy 31:22)

text: וַיְכַל לְדַבֵּר אִתּוֹ וַיַּעַל אֱלֹהִים מֵעַל אַבְרָהָֽם׃
translation: When he finished talking with him, God went up from Abraham. (Genesis 17:22)

text: הָסֵר מֵעָלַי נִגְעֶךָ מִתִּגְרַת יָדְךָ אֲנִי כָלִֽיתִי׃
translation: When you rebuke and correct man for iniquity, you consume his wealth like a moth. Surely every man is but a breath." Selah. (Psalms 39:11)

text: וַיִּכְלוּ הַמַּיִם מִן הַחֵמֶת וַתַּשְׁלֵךְ אֶת הַיֶּלֶד תַּחַת אַחַד הַשִּׂיחִֽם׃
translation: The water in the container was spent, and she put the child under one of the shrubs. (Genesis 21:15)

text: עֶרְוַת כַּלָּֽתְךָ לֹא תְגַלֵּה אֵשֶׁת בִּנְךָ הִוא לֹא תְגַלֶּה עֶרְוָתָֽהּ׃
translation: "'You shall not uncover the nakedness of your daughter-in-law. She is your son's wife. You shall not uncover her nakedness. (Leviticus 18:15)

text: וַיְכַל מֹשֶׁה לְדַבֵּר אֶת כָּל הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה אֶל כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
translation: Moses finished reciting all these words to all Israel. (Deuteronomy 32:45)

text: וַיְכַל דָּוִיד מֵהַעֲלוֹת הָעֹלָה וְהַשְּׁלָמִים וַיְבָרֶךְ אֶת הָעָם בְּשֵׁם יְהוָֽה׃
translation: When David had finished offering the burnt offering and the peace offerings, he blessed the people in the LORD's name. (1 Chronicles 16:2)

text: קִרְיַת בַּעַל הִיא קִרְיַת יְעָרִים וְהָֽרַבָּה עָרִים שְׁתַּיִם וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃
translation: Kiriath Baal (also called Kiriath Jearim), and Rabbah; two cities with their villages. (Joshua 15:60)

text: אַל תִּירָא כִּֽי יַעֲשִׁר אִישׁ כִּֽי יִרְבֶּה כְּבוֹד בֵּיתֽוֹ׃
translation: for when he dies he will carry nothing away. His glory won't descend after him. (Psalms 49:17)

text: בְּקוּם רְשָׁעִים יִסָּתֵר אָדָם וּבְאָבְדָם יִרְבּוּ צַדִּיקִֽים׃
translation: When the wicked rise, men hide themselves; but when they perish, the righteous thrive. (Proverbs 28:28)

text: כִּֽי הִרְבָּה אֶפְרַיִם מִזְבְּחֹת לַחֲטֹא הָיוּ לוֹ מִזְבְּחוֹת לַחֲטֹֽא׃
translation: Because Ephraim has multiplied altars for sinning, they became for him altars for sinning. (Hosea 8:11)

text: וּמִבֶּטַח וּמִבֵּֽרֹתַי עָרֵי הֲדַדְעָזֶר לָקַח הַמֶּלֶךְ דָּוִד נְחֹשֶׁת הַרְבֵּה מְאֹֽד׃
translation: From Betah and from Berothai, cities of Hadadezer, King David took a great quantity of bronze. (2 Samuel 8:8)

text: וַיֶּאֱסֹף דָּוִד אֶת כָּל הָעָם וַיֵּלֶךְ רַבָּתָה וַיִּלָּחֶם בָּהּ וַֽיִּלְכְּדָֽהּ׃
translation: David gathered all the people together and went to Rabbah, and fought against it and took it. (2 Samuel 12:29)

text: וּמַעֲרָת וּבֵית עֲנוֹת וְאֶלְתְּקֹן עָרִים שֵׁשׁ וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃
translation: Maarath, Beth Anoth, and Eltekon; six cities with their villages. (Joshua 15:59)

text: לְשִׁשָּׁה עָשָׂר לַחֲנַנְיָהוּ בָּנָיו וְאֶחָיו שְׁנֵים עָשָֽׂר׃
translation: for the sixteenth to Hananiah, his sons and his brothers, twelve; (1 Chronicles 25:23)

text: בְּנֵי הָרָמָה וָגָבַע שֵׁשׁ מֵאוֹת עֶשְׂרִים וְאֶחָֽד׃
translation: The children of Ramah and Geba, six hundred twenty-one. (Ezra 2:26)

text: בְּנֵי סְנָאָה שְׁלֹשֶׁת אֲלָפִים וְשֵׁשׁ מֵאוֹת וּשְׁלֹשִֽׁים׃
translation: The children of Senaah, three thousand six hundred thirty. (Ezra 2:35)

text: אַנְשֵׁי הָֽרָמָה וָגָבַע שֵׁשׁ מֵאוֹת עֶשְׂרִים וְאֶחָֽד׃
translation: The men of Ramah and Geba: six hundred twenty-one. (Nehemiah 7:30)

text: שֵׁשֶׁת יָמִים תַּֽעֲבֹד וְעָשִׂיתָ כָּל מְלַאכְתֶּֽךָ׃
translation: You shall labor six days, and do all your work, (Exodus 20:9)

text: וַיָּבֹא אֱלִישָׁע הַבָּיְתָה וְהִנֵּה הַנַּעַר מֵת מֻשְׁכָּב עַל מִטָּתֽוֹ׃
translation: When Elisha had come into the house, behold, the child was dead, and lying on his bed. (2 Kings 4:32)

text: כִּי נַעַר יִשְׂרָאֵל וָאֹהֲבֵהוּ וּמִמִּצְרַיִם קָרָאתִי לִבְנִֽי׃
translation: "When Israel was a child, then I loved him, and called my son out of Egypt. (Hosea 11:1)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר מָנוֹחַ עַתָּה יָבֹא דְבָרֶיךָ מַה יִּֽהְיֶה מִשְׁפַּט הַנַּעַר וּמַעֲשֵֽׂהוּ׃
translation: Manoah said, "Now let your words happen. What shall the child's way of life and mission be?" (Judges 13:12)

text: וַיִּקְרָא דָוִד לְאַחַד מֵֽהַנְּעָרִים וַיֹּאמֶר גַּשׁ פְּגַע בּוֹ וַיַּכֵּהוּ וַיָּמֹֽת׃
translation: David called one of the young men and said, "Go near, and cut him down!" He struck him so that he died. (2 Samuel 1:15)

text: וַיֵּלֶךְ הַנַּעַר הַנַּעַר הַנָּבִיא רָמֹת גִּלְעָֽד׃
translation: So the young man, the young prophet, went to Ramoth Gilead. (2 Kings 9:4)

text: רֻֽטֲפַשׁ בְּשָׂרוֹ מִנֹּעַר יָשׁוּב לִימֵי עֲלוּמָֽיו׃
translation: His flesh will be fresher than a child's. He returns to the days of his youth. (Job 33:25)

text: זְכֹר רַחֲמֶיךָ יְהוָה וַחֲסָדֶיךָ כִּי מֵעוֹלָם הֵֽמָּה׃
translation: LORD, remember your tender mercies and your loving kindness, for they are from old times. (Psalms 25:6)

text: יְהִֽי חַסְדְּךָ יְהוָה עָלֵינוּ כַּאֲשֶׁר יִחַלְנוּ לָֽךְ׃
translation: Let your loving kindness be on us, LORD, since we have hoped in you. (Psalms 33:22)

text: עֲנֵנִי יְהוָה כִּי טוֹב חַסְדֶּךָ כְּרֹב רַחֲמֶיךָ פְּנֵה אֵלָֽי׃
translation: Don't hide your face from your servant, for I am in distress. Answer me speedily! (Psalms 69:17)

text: וְחַסְדִּי לֹֽא אָפִיר מֵֽעִמּוֹ וְלֹֽא אֲשַׁקֵּר בֶּאֱמוּנָתִֽי׃
translation: I will not break my covenant, nor alter what my lips have uttered. (Psalms 89:34)

text: כִּי טוֹב יְהֹוָה לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ וְעַד דֹּר וָדֹר אֱמוּנָתֽוֹ׃
translation: For the LORD is good. His loving kindness endures forever, his faithfulness to all generations. (Psalms 100:5)

text: הַֽלְלוּ יָהּ הוֹדוּ לַיהוָה כִּי טוֹב כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
translation: Praise the LORD! Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever. (Psalms 106:1)

text: וַיִּשְׁלַח הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיֶּאֱסֹף אֶת כָּל זִקְנֵי יְהוּדָה וִירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
translation: Then the king sent and gathered together all the elders of Judah and Jerusalem. (2 Chronicles 34:29)

text: וַיֵּלֶךְ מֹשֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן וַיַּאַסְפוּ אֶת כָּל זִקְנֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
translation: Moses and Aaron went and gathered together all the elders of the children of Israel. (Exodus 4:29)

text: וַיֵּאָסֵף מֹשֶׁה אֶל הַֽמַּחֲנֶה הוּא וְזִקְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
translation: Moses went into the camp, he and the elders of Israel. (Numbers 11:30)

text: וַיֹּסֶף עוֹד דָּוִד אֶת כָּל בָּחוּר בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל שְׁלֹשִׁים אָֽלֶף׃
translation: David again gathered together all the chosen men of Israel, thirty thousand. (2 Samuel 6:1)

text: וַיִּצָּֽעֲקוּ בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן וַֽיַּחֲנוּ בַּגִּלְעָד וַיֵּאָֽסְפוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַֽיַּחֲנוּ בַּמִּצְפָּֽה׃
translation: Then the children of Ammon were gathered together and encamped in Gilead. The children of Israel assembled themselves together and encamped in Mizpah. (Judges 10:17)

text: וְאָחִיו אָסָף הָעֹמֵד עַל יְמִינוֹ אָסָף בֶּן בֶּרֶכְיָהוּ בֶּן שִׁמְעָֽא׃
translation: Tahath his son, Uriel his son, Uzziah his son, and Shaul his son. (1 Chronicles 6:24)

text: וְעַל כָּל נַפְשֹׁת מֵת לֹא יָבֹא לְאָבִיו וּלְאִמּוֹ לֹא יִטַּמָּֽא׃
translation: He must not go in to any dead body, or defile himself for his father or for his mother. (Leviticus 21:11)

text: וָאֵרֶא כִּי נִטְמָאָה דֶּרֶךְ אֶחָד לִשְׁתֵּיהֶֽן׃
translation: I saw that she was defiled. They both went the same way. (Ezekiel 23:13)

text: לֹא יֵשְׁבוּ בְּאֶרֶץ יְהוָה וְשָׁב אֶפְרַיִם מִצְרַיִם וּבְאַשּׁוּר טָמֵא יֹאכֵֽלוּ׃
translation: They won't dwell in the LORD's land; but Ephraim will return to Egypt, and they will eat unclean food in Assyria. (Hosea 9:3)

text: וְכָל הַנּוֹגֵעַ בָּם יִטְמָא וְכִבֶּס בְּגָדָיו וְרָחַץ בַּמַּיִם וְטָמֵא עַד הָעָֽרֶב׃
translation: Whoever touches these things shall be unclean, and shall wash his clothes and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening. (Leviticus 15:27)

text: לֹא יִטַּמָּא בַּעַל בְּעַמָּיו לְהֵחַלּֽוֹ׃
translation: He shall not defile himself, being a chief man among his people, to profane himself. (Leviticus 21:4)

text: וְהַשֹּׂרֵף אֹתָהּ יְכַבֵּס בְּגָדָיו בַּמַּיִם וְרָחַץ בְּשָׂרוֹ בַּמָּיִם וְטָמֵא עַד הָעָֽרֶב׃
translation: He who burns her shall wash his clothes in water, and bathe his flesh in water, and shall be unclean until the evening. (Numbers 19:8)

text: כִּי גֶֽחָלִים אַתָּה חֹתֶה עַל רֹאשׁוֹ וַֽיהוָה יְשַׁלֶּם לָֽךְ׃
translation: for you will heap coals of fire on his head, and the LORD will reward you. (Proverbs 25:22)

text: לְיֵצֶר מִשְׁפַּחַת הַיִּצְרִי לְשִׁלֵּם מִשְׁפַּחַת הַשִּׁלֵּמִֽי׃
translation: of Jezer, the family of the Jezerites; of Shillem, the family of the Shillemites. (Numbers 26:49)

text: וַיְצַו עֲלֵיהֶם לֵאמֹר כֹּה תַעֲשׂוּן בְּיִרְאַת יְהוָה בֶּאֱמוּנָה וּבְלֵבָב שָׁלֵֽם׃
translation: He commanded them, saying, "You shall do this in the fear of the LORD, faithfully, and with a perfect heart. (2 Chronicles 19:9)

text: מִֽי יַגִּיד עַל פָּנָיו דַּרְכּוֹ וְהֽוּא עָשָׂה מִי יְשַׁלֶּם לֽוֹ׃
translation: Who will declare his way to his face? Who will repay him what he has done? (Job 21:31)

text: כִּי יַשְׁלִים חֻקִּי וְכָהֵנָּה רַבּוֹת עִמּֽוֹ׃
translation: For he performs that which is appointed for me. Many such things are with him. (Job 23:14)

text: וְאַתָּה יְהוָה חָנֵּנִי וַהֲקִימֵנִי וַֽאֲשַׁלְּמָה לָהֶֽם׃
translation: By this I know that you delight in me, because my enemy doesn't triumph over me. (Psalms 41:11)

text: וְגַם אֲנִי אוֹדֶךָּ כִּֽי תוֹשִׁעַ לְךָ יְמִינֶֽךָ׃
translation: Then I will also admit to you that your own right hand can save you. (Job 40:14)

text: יְשַׁוְּעוּ וְאֵין מוֹשִׁיעַ עַל יְהוָה וְלֹא עָנָֽם׃
translation: Then I beat them small as the dust before the wind. I cast them out as the mire of the streets. (Psalms 18:42)

text: הוֹשִׁיעֵנִי אֱלֹהִים כִּי בָאוּ מַיִם עַד נָֽפֶשׁ׃
translation: I sink in deep mire, where there is no foothold. I have come into deep waters, where the floods overflow me. (Psalms 69:2)

text: בְּצִדְקָתְךָ תַּצִּילֵנִי וּֽתְפַלְּטֵנִי הַטֵּֽה אֵלַי אָזְנְךָ וְהוֹשִׁיעֵֽנִי׃
translation: Deliver me in your righteousness, and rescue me. Turn your ear to me, and save me. (Psalms 71:2)

text: אַךְ קָרוֹב לִירֵאָיו יִשְׁעוֹ לִשְׁכֹּן כָּבוֹד בְּאַרְצֵֽנוּ׃
translation: Mercy and truth meet together. Righteousness and peace have kissed each other. (Psalms 85:10)

text: כִּי יְהוָה שֹׁפְטֵנוּ יְהוָה מְחֹקְקֵנוּ יְהוָה מַלְכֵּנוּ הוּא יוֹשִׁיעֵֽנוּ׃
translation: For the LORD is our judge. The LORD is our lawgiver. The LORD is our king. He will save us. (Isaiah 33:22)

text: וַיִּסְעוּ מֵאֹבֹת וַֽיַּחֲנוּ בְּעִיֵּי הָעֲבָרִים בִּגְבוּל מוֹאָֽב׃
translation: They traveled from Oboth, and encamped in Iye Abarim, in the border of Moab. (Numbers 33:44)

text: וְיָצָא מִבֵּֽית אֵל לוּזָה וְעָבַר אֶל גְּבוּל הָאַרְכִּי עֲטָרֽוֹת׃
translation: It went out from Bethel to Luz, and passed along to the border of the Archites to Ataroth; (Joshua 16:2)

text: וַיְהִי גְּבוּל נַחֲלָתָם צָרְעָה וְאֶשְׁתָּאוֹל וְעִיר שָֽׁמֶשׁ׃
translation: The border of their inheritance was Zorah, Eshtaol, Irshemesh, (Joshua 19:41)

text: וְעֵינֵיכֶם תִּרְאֶינָה וְאַתֶּם תֹּֽאמְרוּ יִגְדַּל יְהוָה מֵעַל לִגְבוּל יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
translation: Your eyes will see, and you will say, "The LORD is great—even beyond the border of Israel!" (Malachi 1:5)

text: וְאֶת הָעָם הֶעֱבִיר אֹתוֹ לֶעָרִים מִקְצֵה גְבוּל מִצְרַיִם וְעַד קָצֵֽהוּ׃
translation: As for the people, he moved them to the cities from one end of the border of Egypt even to the other end of it. (Genesis 47:21)

text: וַיְמָאֵן אֱדוֹם נְתֹן אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל עֲבֹר בִּגְבֻלוֹ וַיֵּט יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵעָלָֽיו׃
translation: Thus Edom refused to give Israel passage through his border, so Israel turned away from him. (Numbers 20:21)

text: וְכוּשׁ יָלַד אֶת נִמְרֹד הוּא הֵחֵל לִֽהְיוֹת גִּבֹּר בָּאָֽרֶץ׃
translation: Cush became the father of Nimrod. He began to be a mighty one in the earth. (Genesis 10:8)

text: וְכוּשׁ יָלַד אֶת נִמְרוֹד הוּא הֵחֵל לִהְיוֹת גִּבּוֹר בָּאָֽרֶץ׃
translation: Cush became the father of Nimrod. He began to be a mighty one in the earth. (1 Chronicles 1:10)

text: נְבִיאֶיהָ פֹּֽחֲזִים אַנְשֵׁי בֹּֽגְדוֹת כֹּהֲנֶיהָ חִלְּלוּ קֹדֶשׁ חָמְסוּ תּוֹרָֽה׃
translation: Her prophets are arrogant and treacherous people. Her priests have profaned the sanctuary. They have done violence to the law. (Zephaniah 3:4)

text: וְלֹֽא תִשָּׁבְעוּ בִשְׁמִי לַשָּׁקֶר וְחִלַּלְתָּ אֶת שֵׁם אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֲנִי יְהוָֽה׃
translation: "'You shall not swear by my name falsely, and profane the name of your God. I am the LORD. (Leviticus 19:12)

text: וְלֹא יְחַלְּלוּ אֶת קָדְשֵׁי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֵת אֲשֶׁר יָרִימוּ לַיהוָֽה׃
translation: The priests shall not profane the holy things of the children of Israel, which they offer to the LORD, (Leviticus 22:15)

text: וַתָּחֶל רוּחַ יְהוָה לְפַעֲמוֹ בְּמַחֲנֵה דָן בֵּין צָרְעָה וּבֵין אֶשְׁתָּאֹֽל׃
translation: The LORD's Spirit began to move him in Mahaneh Dan, between Zorah and Eshtaol. (Judges 13:25)

text: וַיְהִי בַּלַּיְלָה הַהוּא וַֽיְהִי דְּבַר יְהוָה אֶל נָתָן לֵאמֹֽר׃
translation: That same night, the LORD's word came to Nathan, saying, (2 Samuel 7:4)

text: וַֽיְהִי בַּלַּיְלָה הַהוּא וַיְהִי דְּבַר אֱלֹהִים אֶל נָתָן לֵאמֹֽר׃
translation: That same night, the word of God came to Nathan, saying, (1 Chronicles 17:3)

text: הִנֵּה הַלַּיְלָה הַהוּא יְהִי גַלְמוּד אַל תָּבֹא רְנָנָה בֽוֹ׃
translation: Behold, let that night be barren. Let no joyful voice come therein. (Job 3:7)

text: וָאֹמַר אַךְ חֹשֶׁךְ יְשׁוּפֵנִי וְלַיְלָה אוֹר בַּעֲדֵֽנִי׃
translation: If I say, "Surely the darkness will overwhelm me. The light around me will be night," (Psalms 139:11)

text: וַתַּגֵּשׁ לִפְנֵֽי שָׁאוּל וְלִפְנֵי עֲבָדָיו וַיֹּאכֵלוּ וַיָּקֻמוּ וַיֵּלְכוּ בַּלַּיְלָה הַהֽוּא׃
translation: She brought it before Saul and before his servants, and they ate. Then they rose up and went away that night. (1 Samuel 28:25)

text: זָכַרְתִּי בַלַּיְלָה שִׁמְךָ יְהוָה וָֽאֶשְׁמְרָה תּוֹרָתֶֽךָ׃
translation: I have remembered your name, LORD, in the night, and I obey your law. (Psalms 119:55)

text: כִּי לֵֽאלֹהֵי אָבִיו דָּרָשׁ וּבְמִצְוֺתָיו הָלָךְ וְלֹא כְּמַעֲשֵׂה יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
translation: but sought the God of his father, and walked in his commandments, and not in the ways of Israel. (2 Chronicles 17:4)

text: יְהִי כְבוֹד יְהוָה לְעוֹלָם יִשְׂמַח יְהוָה בְּמַעֲשָֽׂיו׃
translation: Let the LORD's glory endure forever. Let the LORD rejoice in his works. (Psalms 104:31)

text: טוֹב יְהוָה לַכֹּל וְרַחֲמָיו עַל כָּל מַעֲשָֽׂיו׃
translation: The LORD is good to all. His tender mercies are over all his works. (Psalms 145:9)

text: כִּי עֵֽינֵיכֶם הָֽרֹאֹת אֶת כָּל מַעֲשֵׂה יְהוָה הַגָּדֹל אֲשֶׁר עָשָֽׂה׃
translation: but your eyes have seen all of the LORD's great work which he did. (Deuteronomy 11:7)

text: תִּקְרָא וְאָנֹכִי אֶֽעֱנֶךָּ לְֽמַעֲשֵׂה יָדֶיךָ תִכְסֹֽף׃
translation: You would call, and I would answer you. You would have a desire for the work of your hands. (Job 14:15)

text: לְהָסִיר אָדָם מַעֲשֶׂה וְגֵוָה מִגֶּבֶר יְכַסֶּֽה׃
translation: that he may withdraw man from his purpose, and hide pride from man. (Job 33:17)

text: אַשְׁרֵי שֶׁאֵל יַעֲקֹב בְּעֶזְרוֹ שִׂבְרוֹ עַל יְהוָה אֱלֹהָֽיו׃
translation: Happy is he who has the God of Jacob for his help, whose hope is in the LORD, his God, (Psalms 146:5)

text: וַיִּשְׂאוּ אֶת שִׁבְרָם עַל חֲמֹרֵיהֶם וַיֵּלְכוּ מִשָּֽׁם׃
translation: They loaded their donkeys with their grain, and departed from there. (Genesis 42:26)

text: שֹׁמֵר כָּל עַצְמוֹתָיו אַחַת מֵהֵנָּה לֹא נִשְׁבָּֽרָה׃
translation: Evil shall kill the wicked. Those who hate the righteous shall be condemned. (Psalms 34:21)

text: אוֹ אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יִהְיֶה בוֹ שֶׁבֶר רָגֶל אוֹ שֶׁבֶר יָֽד׃
translation: or a man who has an injured foot, or an injured hand, (Leviticus 21:19)

text: וְיִמָּנַע מֵרְשָׁ<segtype="x-suspended">עִ<seg>ים אוֹרָם וּזְרוֹעַ רָמָה תִּשָּׁבֵֽר׃
translation: From the wicked, their light is withheld. The high arm is broken. (Job 38:15)

text: כֻּלָּם אֵלֶיךָ יְשַׂבֵּרוּן לָתֵת אָכְלָם בְּעִתּֽוֹ׃
translation: These all wait for you, that you may give them their food in due season. (Psalms 104:27)

text: כִּֽי הֶחֱלִיק אֵלָיו בְּעֵינָיו לִמְצֹא עֲוֺנוֹ לִשְׂנֹֽא׃
translation: The words of his mouth are iniquity and deceit. He has ceased to be wise and to do good. (Psalms 36:3)

text: דִּבְרֵי עֲוֺנֹת גָּבְרוּ מֶנִּי פְּשָׁעֵינוּ אַתָּה תְכַפְּרֵֽם׃
translation: Blessed is the one whom you choose and cause to come near, that he may live in your courts. We will be filled with the goodness of your house, your holy temple. (Psalms 65:4)

text: תְּֽנָה עָוֺן עַל עֲוֺנָם וְאַל יָבֹאוּ בְּצִדְקָתֶֽךָ׃
translation: Let them be blotted out of the book of life, and not be written with the righteous. (Psalms 69:28)

text: נָשָׂאתָ עֲוֺן עַמֶּךָ כִּסִּיתָ כָל חַטָּאתָם סֶֽלָה׃
translation: You have taken away all your wrath. You have turned from the fierceness of your anger. (Psalms 85:3)

text: אִם עֲוֺנוֹת תִּשְׁמָר יָהּ אֲדֹנָי מִי יַעֲמֹֽד׃
translation: If you, LORD, kept a record of sins, Lord, who could stand? (Psalms 130:3)

text: וְנָשְׂאוּ עֲוֺנָם כַּֽעֲוֺן הַדֹּרֵשׁ כַּעֲוֺן הַנָּבִיא יִֽהְיֶֽה׃
translation: They will bear their iniquity. The iniquity of the prophet will be even as the iniquity of him who seeks him, (Ezekiel 14:10)

text: וַיִּשְׁמַע שְׁמוּאֵל אֵת כָּל דִּבְרֵי הָעָם וַֽיְדַבְּרֵם בְּאָזְנֵי יְהוָֽה׃
translation: Samuel heard all the words of the people, and he rehearsed them in the ears of the LORD. (1 Samuel 8:21)

text: כִּי אֹזֶן שָׁמְעָה וַֽתְּאַשְּׁרֵנִי וְעַיִן רָאֲתָה וַתְּעִידֵֽנִי׃
translation: For when the ear heard me, then it blessed me, and when the eye saw me, it commended me, (Job 29:11)

text: הַאֲזִינָה זֹּאת אִיּוֹב עֲמֹד וְהִתְבּוֹנֵן נִפְלְאוֹת אֵֽל׃
translation: "Listen to this, Job. Stand still, and consider the wondrous works of God. (Job 37:14)

text: שִׁמְעִי בַת וּרְאִי וְהַטִּי אָזְנֵךְ וְשִׁכְחִי עַמֵּךְ וּבֵית אָבִֽיךְ׃
translation: So the king will desire your beauty, honor him, for he is your lord. (Psalms 45:11)

text: שִׁמְעוּ וְהַאֲזִינוּ אַל תִּגְבָּהוּ כִּי יְהוָה דִּבֵּֽר׃
translation: Hear, and give ear. Don't be proud, for the LORD has spoken. (Jeremiah 13:15)

text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֵלָיו שֵׁב נָא וּקְרָאֶנָּה בְּאָזְנֵינוּ וַיִּקְרָא בָרוּךְ בְּאָזְנֵיהֶֽם׃
translation: They said to him, "Sit down now, and read it in our hearing." So Baruch read it in their hearing. (Jeremiah 36:15)

text: כִּי מְבֹרָכָיו יִירְשׁוּ אָרֶץ וּמְקֻלָּלָיו יִכָּרֵֽתוּ׃
translation: For such as are blessed by him shall inherit the land. Those who are cursed by him shall be cut off. (Psalms 37:22)

text: צַדִּיקִים יִֽירְשׁוּ אָרֶץ וְיִשְׁכְּנוּ לָעַד עָלֶֽיהָ׃
translation: The righteous shall inherit the land, and live in it forever. (Psalms 37:29)

text: כִּי אֱלֹהִים יוֹשִׁיעַ צִיּוֹן וְיִבְנֶה עָרֵי יְהוּדָה וְיָשְׁבוּ שָׁם וִירֵשֽׁוּהָ׃
translation: The children also of his servants shall inherit it. Those who love his name shall dwell therein. (Psalms 69:36)

text: קַוֵּה אֶל יְהוָה וּשְׁמֹר דַּרְכּוֹ וִֽירוֹמִמְךָ לָרֶשֶׁת אָרֶץ בְּהִכָּרֵת רְשָׁעִים תִּרְאֶֽה׃
translation: Wait for the LORD, and keep his way, and he will exalt you to inherit the land. When the wicked are cut off, you shall see it. (Psalms 37:34)

text: וְהוֹצֵאתִי מִֽיַּעֲקֹב זֶרַע וּמִיהוּדָה יוֹרֵשׁ הָרָי וִירֵשׁוּהָ בְחִירַי וַעֲבָדַי יִשְׁכְּנוּ שָֽׁמָּה׃
translation: I will bring offspring out of Jacob, and out of Judah an inheritor of my mountains. My chosen will inherit it, and my servants will dwell there. (Isaiah 65:9)

text: וְהֵֽבֵאתִי רָעֵי גוֹיִם וְיָרְשׁוּ אֶת בָּֽתֵּיהֶם וְהִשְׁבַּתִּי גְּאוֹן עַזִּים וְנִחֲלוּ מְקַֽדְשֵׁיהֶֽם׃
translation: Therefore I will bring the worst of the nations, and they will possess their houses. I will also make the pride of the strong to cease. Their holy places will be profaned. (Ezekiel 7:24)

text: וְאֶתֵּן לָכֶם רַחֲמִים וְרִחַם אֶתְכֶם וְהֵשִׁיב אֶתְכֶם אֶל אַדְמַתְכֶֽם׃
translation: I will grant you mercy, that he may have mercy on you, and cause you to return to your own land. (Jeremiah 42:12)

text: אַל תִּֽירְאִי אֲדָמָה גִּילִי וּשְׂמָחִי כִּֽי הִגְדִּיל יְהוָה לַעֲשֽׂוֹת׃
translation: Land, don't be afraid. Be glad and rejoice, for the LORD has done great things. (Joel 2:21)

text: הִשָּׁמֶר לְךָ פֶּֽן תַּעֲזֹב אֶת הַלֵּוִי כָּל יָמֶיךָ עַל אַדְמָתֶֽךָ׃
translation: Be careful that you don't forsake the Levite as long as you live in your land. (Deuteronomy 12:19)

text: קִרְבָּם בָּתֵּימוֹ לְֽעוֹלָם מִשְׁכְּנֹתָם לְדֹר וָדֹר קָֽרְאוּ בִשְׁמוֹתָם עֲלֵי אֲדָמֽוֹת׃
translation: But man, despite his riches, doesn't endure. He is like the animals that perish. (Psalms 49:12)

text: תְּשַׁלַּח רוּחֲךָ יִבָּרֵאוּן וּתְחַדֵּשׁ פְּנֵי אֲדָמָֽה׃
translation: You send out your Spirit and they are created. You renew the face of the ground. (Psalms 104:30)

text: וְהָאִישׁ מֹשֶׁה ענו עָנָיו מְאֹד מִכֹּל הָֽאָדָם אֲשֶׁר עַל פְּנֵי הָאֲדָמָֽה׃
translation: Now the man Moses was very humble, more than all the men who were on the surface of the earth. (Numbers 12:3)

text: מִלְּבַד עֹלַת הַתָּמִיד וּמִנְחָתוֹ תַּעֲשׂוּ תְּמִימִם יִהְיוּ לָכֶם וְנִסְכֵּיהֶֽם׃
translation: Besides the continual burnt offering and its meal offering, you shall offer them and their drink offerings. See that they are without defect. (Numbers 28:31)

text: יֹאכַל בַּדֵּי עוֹרוֹ יֹאכַל בַּדָּיו בְּכוֹר מָֽוֶת׃
translation: The members of his body will be devoured. The firstborn of death will devour his members. (Job 18:13)

text: לְעֹשֵׂה נִפְלָאוֹת גְּדֹלוֹת לְבַדּוֹ כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
translation: to him who alone does great wonders, for his loving kindness endures forever; (Psalms 136:4)

text: וָאֹמַר אֲלֵכֶם בָּעֵת הַהִוא לֵאמֹר לֹא אוּכַל לְבַדִּי שְׂאֵת אֶתְכֶֽם׃
translation: I spoke to you at that time, saying, "I am not able to bear you myself alone. (Deuteronomy 1:9)

text: אַתָּה הָרְאֵתָ לָדַעַת כִּי יְהוָה הוּא הָאֱלֹהִים אֵין עוֹד מִלְבַדּֽוֹ׃
translation: It was shown to you so that you might know that the LORD is God. There is no one else besides him. (Deuteronomy 4:35)

text: יִֽהְיוּ לְךָ לְבַדֶּךָ וְאֵין לְזָרִים אִתָּֽךְ׃
translation: Let them be for yourself alone, not for strangers with you. (Proverbs 5:17)

text: שְׁמַע לְאָבִיךָ זֶה יְלָדֶךָ וְאַל תָּבוּז כִּֽי זָקְנָה אִמֶּֽךָ׃
translation: Listen to your father who gave you life, and don't despise your mother when she is old. (Proverbs 23:22)

text: וַיָּבוֹא אֵלַי אֲנָשִׁים מִזִּקְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֵּשְׁבוּ לְפָנָֽי׃
translation: Then some of the elders of Israel came to me and sat before me. (Ezekiel 14:1)

text: וְאִישׁ אוֹ אִשָּׁה כִּֽי יִהְיֶה בוֹ נָגַע בְּרֹאשׁ אוֹ בְזָקָֽן׃
translation: "When a man or woman has a plague on the head or on the beard, (Leviticus 13:29)

text: וַיָּקָם מֹשֶׁה וַיֵּלֶךְ אֶל דָּתָן וַאֲבִירָם וַיֵּלְכוּ אַחֲרָיו זִקְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
translation: Moses rose up and went to Dathan and Abiram; and the elders of Israel followed him. (Numbers 16:25)

text: וְדָוִיד זָקֵן וְשָׂבַע יָמִים וַיַּמְלֵךְ אֶת שְׁלֹמֹה בְנוֹ עַל יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
translation: Now David was old and full of days; and he made Solomon his son king over Israel. (1 Chronicles 23:1)

text: וַיִּזְקַן יְהוֹיָדָע וַיִּשְׂבַּע יָמִים וַיָּמֹת בֶּן מֵאָה וּשְׁלֹשִׁים שָׁנָה בְּמוֹתֽוֹ׃
translation: But Jehoiada grew old and was full of days, and he died. He was one hundred thirty years old when he died. (2 Chronicles 24:15)

text: וַיִּשְׁפֹּט אַחֲרָיו אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל עַבְדּוֹן בֶּן הִלֵּל הַפִּרְעָתוֹנִֽי׃
translation: After him, Abdon the son of Hillel the Pirathonite judged Israel. (Judges 12:13)

text: וַיִּשְׁפֹּט אַֽחֲרָיו אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל אִבְצָן מִבֵּית לָֽחֶם׃
translation: After him Ibzan of Bethlehem judged Israel. (Judges 12:8)

text: שָׁפְטֵנִי כְצִדְקְךָ יְהוָה אֱלֹהָי וְאַל יִשְׂמְחוּ לִֽי׃
translation: Vindicate me, LORD my God, according to your righteousness. Don't let them gloat over me. (Psalms 35:24)

text: יְהוָה לֹא יַעַזְבֶנּוּ בְיָדוֹ וְלֹא יַרְשִׁיעֶנּוּ בְּהִשָּׁפְטֽוֹ׃
translation: The LORD will not leave him in his hand, nor condemn him when he is judged. (Psalms 37:33)

text: קוּמָה אֱלֹהִים שָׁפְטָה הָאָרֶץ כִּֽי אַתָּה תִנְחַל בְּכָל הַגּוֹיִֽם׃
translation: Arise, God, judge the earth, for you inherit all of the nations. (Psalms 82:8)

text: הַנּוֹתֵן רוֹזְנִים לְאָיִן שֹׁפְטֵי אֶרֶץ כַּתֹּהוּ עָשָֽׂה׃
translation: who brings princes to nothing, who makes the judges of the earth meaningless. (Isaiah 40:23)

text: וְקִדַּשְׁתָּ אֹתָם וְהָיוּ קֹדֶשׁ קָֽדָשִׁים כָּל הַנֹּגֵעַ בָּהֶם יִקְדָּֽשׁ׃
translation: You shall sanctify them, that they may be most holy. Whatever touches them shall be holy. (Exodus 30:29)

text: כִּֽי שָֽׂבְעָה בְרָעוֹת נַפְשִׁי וְחַיַּי לִשְׁאוֹל הִגִּֽיעוּ׃
translation: I am counted among those who go down into the pit. I am like a man who has no help, (Psalms 88:4)

text: כִּֽי הָיוּ בְצֹעַן שָׂרָיו וּמַלְאָכָיו חָנֵס יַגִּֽיעוּ׃
translation: For their princes are at Zoan, and their ambassadors have come to Hanes. (Isaiah 30:4)

text: אַֽל תִּגְּעוּ בִּמְשִׁיחָי וּבִנְבִיאַי אַל תָּרֵֽעוּ׃
translation: "Don't touch my anointed ones! Do my prophets no harm!" (1 Chronicles 16:22)

text: מֵאֲנָה לִנְגּוֹעַ נַפְשִׁי הֵמָּה כִּדְוֵי לַחְמִֽי׃
translation: My soul refuses to touch them. They are as loathsome food to me. (Job 6:7)

text: וָאֱהִי נָגוּעַ כָּל הַיּוֹם וְתוֹכַחְתִּי לַבְּקָרִֽים׃
translation: For all day long I have been plagued, and punished every morning. (Psalms 73:14)

text: יִרְאוּ עינו עֵינָיו כִּידוֹ וּמֵחֲמַת שַׁדַּי יִשְׁתֶּֽה׃
translation: Let his own eyes see his destruction. Let him drink of the wrath of the Almighty. (Job 21:20)

text: מִנַּחַל בַּדֶּרֶךְ יִשְׁתֶּה עַל כֵּן יָרִים רֹֽאשׁ׃
translation: He will drink of the brook on the way; therefore he will lift up his head. (Psalms 110:7)

text: כִּי לָחֲמוּ לֶחֶם רֶשַׁע וְיֵין חֲמָסִים יִשְׁתּֽוּ׃
translation: For they eat the bread of wickedness and drink the wine of violence. (Proverbs 4:17)

text: וְכִי תֹאכְלוּ וְכִי תִשְׁתּוּ הֲלוֹא אַתֶּם הָאֹכְלִים וְאַתֶּם הַשֹּׁתִֽים׃
translation: When you eat and when you drink, don't you eat for yourselves and drink for yourselves? (Zechariah 7:6)

text: וַיִּסְעוּ מֵאָלוּשׁ וַֽיַּחֲנוּ בִּרְפִידִם וְלֹא הָיָה שָׁם מַיִם לָעָם לִשְׁתּֽוֹת׃
translation: They traveled from Alush, and encamped in Rephidim, where there was no water for the people to drink. (Numbers 33:14)

text: וַיְהִי הַיּוֹם וּבָנָיו וּבְנֹתָיו אֹֽכְלִים וְשֹׁתִים יַיִן בְּבֵית אֲחִיהֶם הַבְּכֽוֹר׃
translation: It fell on a day when his sons and his daughters were eating and drinking wine in their oldest brother's house, (Job 1:13)

text: נוֹתֵן לִבְהֵמָה לַחְמָהּ לִבְנֵי עֹרֵב אֲשֶׁר יִקְרָֽאוּ׃
translation: He provides food for the livestock, and for the young ravens when they call. (Psalms 147:9)

text: יְרָֽא אֶת יְהוָה בְּנִי וָמֶלֶךְ עִם שׁוֹנִים אַל תִּתְעָרָֽב׃
translation: My son, fear the LORD and the king. Don't join those who are rebellious, (Proverbs 24:21)

text: יֵצֵא אָדָם לְפָעֳלוֹ וְֽלַעֲבֹדָתוֹ עֲדֵי עָֽרֶב׃
translation: Man goes out to his work, to his labor until the evening. (Psalms 104:23)

text: יֶעֱרַב עָלָיו שִׂיחִי אָנֹכִי אֶשְׂמַח בַּיהוָֽה׃
translation: Let my meditation be sweet to him. I will rejoice in the LORD. (Psalms 104:34)

text: אָמַר וַיָּבֹא עָרֹב כִּנִּים בְּכָל גְּבוּלָֽם׃
translation: He spoke, and swarms of flies came, and lice in all their borders. (Psalms 105:31)

text: וְאֵת כָּל מַלְכֵי עֲרָב וְאֵת כָּל מַלְכֵי הָעֶרֶב הַשֹּׁכְנִים בַּמִּדְבָּֽר׃
translation: and all the kings of Arabia, all the kings of the mixed people who dwell in the wilderness; (Jeremiah 25:24)

text: הִֽתְהַֽלְלוּ בְּשֵׁם קָדְשׁוֹ יִשְׂמַח לֵב מְבַקְשֵׁי יְהוָֽה׃
translation: Glory in his holy name. Let the heart of those who seek the LORD rejoice. (1 Chronicles 16:10)

text: לְךָ אָמַר לִבִּי בַּקְּשׁוּ פָנָי אֶת פָּנֶיךָ יְהוָה אֲבַקֵּֽשׁ׃
translation: When you said, "Seek my face," my heart said to you, "I will seek your face, LORD." (Psalms 27:8)

text: הִֽתְהַלְלוּ בְּשֵׁם קָדְשׁוֹ יִשְׂמַח לֵב מְבַקְשֵׁי יְהוָֽה׃
translation: Glory in his holy name. Let the heart of those who seek the LORD rejoice. (Psalms 105:3)

text: לְמַעַן בֵּית יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ אֲבַקְשָׁה טוֹב לָֽךְ׃
translation: For the sake of the house of the LORD our God, I will seek your good. (Psalms 122:9)

text: אַנְשֵׁי רָע לֹא יָבִינוּ מִשְׁפָּט וּמְבַקְשֵׁי יְהוָה יָבִינוּ כֹֽל׃
translation: Evil men don't understand justice; but those who seek the LORD understand it fully. (Proverbs 28:5)

text: רַבִּים מְבַקְשִׁים פְּנֵי מוֹשֵׁל וּמֵיְהוָה מִשְׁפַּט אִֽישׁ׃
translation: Many seek the ruler's favor, but a man's justice comes from the LORD. (Proverbs 29:26)

text: הֲיִפָּלֵא מֵיְהוָה דָּבָר לַמּוֹעֵד אָשׁוּב אֵלֶיךָ כָּעֵת חַיָּה וּלְשָׂרָה בֵֽן׃
translation: Is anything too hard for the LORD? At the set time I will return to you, when the season comes around, and Sarah will have a son." (Genesis 18:14)

text: הַכֹּהֵן הַֽמְחַטֵּא אֹתָהּ יֹאכֲלֶנָּה בְּמָקוֹם קָדֹשׁ תֵּֽאָכֵל בַּחֲצַר אֹהֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃
translation: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying, (Leviticus 6:19)

text: אַתָּה תָקוּם תְּרַחֵם צִיּוֹן כִּי עֵת לְחֶֽנְנָהּ כִּי בָא מוֹעֵֽד׃
translation: For your servants take pleasure in her stones, and have pity on her dust. (Psalms 102:14)

text: וְאָנֹכִי יְהוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם עֹד אוֹשִֽׁיבְךָ בָאֳהָלִים כִּימֵי מוֹעֵֽד׃
translation: I have also spoken to the prophets, and I have multiplied visions; and by the ministry of the prophets I have used parables. (Hosea 12:10)

text: וַתַּהַר וַתֵּלֶד שָׂרָה לְאַבְרָהָם בֵּן לִזְקֻנָיו לַמּוֹעֵד אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר אֹתוֹ אֱלֹהִֽים׃
translation: Sarah conceived, and bore Abraham a son in his old age, at the set time of which God had spoken to him. (Genesis 21:2)

text: וְלָקַח אֶת שְׁנֵי הַשְּׂעִירִם וְהֶעֱמִיד אֹתָם לִפְנֵי יְהוָה פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃
translation: He shall take the two goats, and set them before the LORD at the door of the Tent of Meeting. (Leviticus 16:7)

text: אִם יַֽעַזְבוּ בָנָיו תּוֹרָתִי וּבְמִשְׁפָּטַי לֹא יֵלֵכֽוּן׃
translation: if they break my statutes, and don't keep my commandments; (Psalms 89:31)

text: מָֽה אָהַבְתִּי תוֹרָתֶךָ כָּל הַיּוֹם הִיא שִׂיחָתִֽי׃
translation: How I love your law! It is my meditation all day. (Psalms 119:97)

text: יְהוָה חָפֵץ לְמַעַן צִדְקוֹ יַגְדִּיל תּוֹרָה וְיַאְדִּֽיר׃
translation: It pleased the LORD, for his righteousness' sake, to magnify the law and make it honorable. (Isaiah 42:21)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר לִֽיהוּדָה לִדְרוֹשׁ אֶת יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵיהֶם וְלַעֲשׂוֹת הַתּוֹרָה וְהַמִּצְוָֽה׃
translation: for he took away the foreign altars and the high places, broke down the pillars, cut down the Asherah poles, (2 Chronicles 14:3)

text: תּוֹרַת אֱלֹהָיו בְּלִבּוֹ לֹא תִמְעַד אֲשֻׁרָיו׃
translation: The law of his God is in his heart. None of his steps shall slide. (Psalms 37:31)

text: אַשְׁרֵי תְמִֽימֵי דָרֶךְ הַֽהֹלְכִים בְּתוֹרַת יְהוָֽה׃
translation: ALEPH Blessed are those whose ways are blameless, who walk according to the LORD's law. (Psalms 119:1)

text: זֹאת נַחֲלַת בְּנֵי גָד לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם הֶעָרִים וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽם׃
translation: This is the inheritance of the children of Gad according to their families, the cities and its villages. (Joshua 13:28)

text: זֹאת נַחֲלַת מַטֵּה בְנֵֽי אָשֵׁר לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם הֶעָרִים הָאֵלֶּה וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃
translation: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Asher according to their families, these cities with their villages. (Joshua 19:31)

text: זֹאת נַחֲלַת מַטֵּה בְנֵי דָן לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם הֶֽעָרִים הָאֵלֶּה וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃
translation: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Dan according to their families, these cities with their villages. (Joshua 19:48)

text: אַשְׁרֵי הַגּוֹי אֲשֶׁר יְהוָה אֱלֹהָיו הָעָם בָּחַר לְנַחֲלָה לֽוֹ׃
translation: Blessed is the nation whose God is the LORD, the people whom he has chosen for his own inheritance. (Psalms 33:12)

text: יוֹדֵעַ יְהוָה יְמֵי תְמִימִם וְנַחֲלָתָם לְעוֹלָם תִּהְיֶֽה׃
translation: The LORD knows the days of the perfect. Their inheritance shall be forever. (Psalms 37:18)

text: עֶֽבֶד מַשְׂכִּיל יִמְשֹׁל בְּבֵן מֵבִישׁ וּבְתוֹךְ אַחִים יַחֲלֹק נַחֲלָֽה׃
translation: A servant who deals wisely will rule over a son who causes shame, and shall have a part in the inheritance among the brothers. (Proverbs 17:2)

text: וַיַּעַשׂ הָרָע כִּי לֹא הֵכִין לִבּוֹ לִדְרוֹשׁ אֶת יְהוָֽה׃
translation: He did that which was evil, because he didn't set his heart to seek the LORD. (2 Chronicles 12:14)

text: אִם אַתָּה הֲכִינוֹתָ לִבֶּךָ וּפָרַשְׂתָּ אֵלָיו כַּפֶּֽךָ׃
translation: "If you set your heart aright, stretch out your hands toward him. (Job 11:13)

text: חַיָּתְךָ יָֽשְׁבוּ בָהּ תָּכִין בְּטוֹבָתְךָ לֶעָנִי אֱלֹהִֽים׃
translation: The Lord announced the word. The ones who proclaim it are a great company. (Psalms 68:11)

text: הָגוֹ רָשָׁע לִפְנֵי מֶלֶךְ וְיִכּוֹן בַּצֶּדֶק כִּסְאֽוֹ׃
translation: Take away the wicked from the king's presence, and his throne will be established in righteousness. (Proverbs 25:5)

text: עֹשֵׂה אֶרֶץ בְּכֹחוֹ מֵכִין תֵּבֵל בְּחָכְמָתוֹ וּבִתְבוּנָתוֹ נָטָה שָׁמָֽיִם׃
translation: God has made the earth by his power. He has established the world by his wisdom, and by his understanding has he stretched out the heavens. (Jeremiah 10:12)

text: עֹשֵׂה אֶרֶץ בְּכֹחוֹ מֵכִין תֵּבֵל בְּחָכְמָתוֹ וּבִתְבוּנָתוֹ נָטָה שָׁמָֽיִם׃
translation: "He has made the earth by his power. He has established the world by his wisdom. By his understanding he has stretched out the heavens. (Jeremiah 51:15)

text: וְלִבְנֵי לֵוִי הַנּוֹתָרִים לִבְנֵי עַמְרָם שֽׁוּבָאֵל לִבְנֵי שׁוּבָאֵל יֶחְדְּיָֽהוּ׃
translation: Of the rest of the sons of Levi: of the sons of Amram, Shubael; of the sons of Shubael, Jehdeiah. (1 Chronicles 24:20)

text: הֲלֹא נִסַּע יִתְרָם בָּם יָמוּתוּ וְלֹא בְחָכְמָֽה׃
translation: Isn't their tent cord plucked up within them? They die, and that without wisdom.' (Job 4:21)

text: וַיְכַסּוּ מַיִם צָרֵיהֶם אֶחָד מֵהֶם לֹא נוֹתָֽר׃
translation: The waters covered their adversaries. There was not one of them left. (Psalms 106:11)

text: כִּֽי יְשָׁרִים יִשְׁכְּנוּ אָרֶץ וּתְמִימִים יִוָּתְרוּ בָֽהּ׃
translation: For the upright will dwell in the land. The perfect will remain in it. (Proverbs 2:21)

text: בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא יֵאָכֵל לֹֽא תוֹתִירוּ מִמֶּנּוּ עַד בֹּקֶר אֲנִי יְהוָֽה׃
translation: It shall be eaten on the same day; you shall leave none of it until the morning. I am the LORD. (Leviticus 22:30)

text: וַיִּוָּֽתְרוּ בִּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר לֹֽא חָלְקוּ אֶת נַֽחֲלָתָם שִׁבְעָה שְׁבָטִֽים׃
translation: Seven tribes remained among the children of Israel, which had not yet divided their inheritance. (Joshua 18:2)

text: וַיַּעַל עִמּוֹ גַּם רֶכֶב גַּם פָּרָשִׁים וַיְהִי הַֽמַּחֲנֶה כָּבֵד מְאֹֽד׃
translation: Both chariots and horsemen went up with him. It was a very great company. (Genesis 50:9)

text: וַיְקַנְאוּ לְמֹשֶׁה בַּֽמַּחֲנֶה לְאַהֲרֹן קְדוֹשׁ יְהוָֽה׃
translation: They envied Moses also in the camp, and Aaron, the LORD's saint. (Psalms 106:16)

text: דֶּגֶל מַחֲנֵה דָן צָפֹנָה לְצִבְאֹתָם וְנָשִׂיא לִבְנֵי דָן אֲחִיעֶזֶר בֶּן עַמִּֽישַׁדָּֽי׃
translation: "On the north side shall be the standard of the camp of Dan according to their divisions. The prince of the children of Dan shall be Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai. (Numbers 2:25)

text: וְנָסַע דֶּגֶל מַחֲנֵה בְנֵֽי אֶפְרַיִם לְצִבְאֹתָם וְעַל צְבָאוֹ אֱלִישָׁמָע בֶּן עַמִּיהֽוּד׃
translation: The standard of the camp of the children of Ephraim set forward according to their armies. Elishama the son of Ammihud was over his army. (Numbers 10:22)

text: וְהָיָה לִפְנֽוֹת עֶרֶב יִרְחַץ בַּמָּיִם וּכְבֹא הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ יָבֹא אֶל תּוֹךְ הַֽמַּחֲנֶה׃
translation: You shall have a place also outside of the camp where you go relieve yourself. (Deuteronomy 23:12)

text: וַיִּקְבְּצוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים אֶת כָּל מַחֲנֵיהֶם אֲפֵקָה וְיִשְׂרָאֵל חֹנִים בַּעַיִן אֲשֶׁר בְּיִזְרְעֶֽאל׃
translation: Now the Philistines gathered together all their armies to Aphek; and the Israelites encamped by the spring which is in Jezreel. (1 Samuel 29:1)

text: וַאֲנִי כִּמְעַט נטוי נָטָיוּ רַגְלָי כְּאַיִן שפכה שֻׁפְּכוּ אֲשֻׁרָֽי׃
translation: But as for me, my feet were almost gone. My steps had nearly slipped. (Psalms 73:2)

text: תְּפִלָּה לְדָוִד הַטֵּֽה יְהוָה אָזְנְךָ עֲנֵנִי כִּֽי עָנִי וְאֶבְיוֹן אָֽנִי׃
translation: A Prayer by David. Hear, LORD, and answer me, for I am poor and needy. (Psalms 86:1)

text: כִּֽי הִטָּה אָזְנוֹ לִי וּבְיָמַי אֶקְרָֽא׃
translation: Because he has turned his ear to me, therefore I will call on him as long as I live. (Psalms 116:2)

text: נָטִיתִי לִבִּי לַעֲשׂוֹת חֻקֶּיךָ לְעוֹלָם עֵֽקֶב׃
translation: I have set my heart to perform your statutes forever, even to the end. SAMEKH (Psalms 119:112)

text: רַבִּים רֹדְפַי וְצָרָי מֵעֵדְוֺתֶיךָ לֹא נָטִֽיתִי׃
translation: Many are my persecutors and my adversaries. I haven't swerved from your testimonies. (Psalms 119:157)

text: וְהַמַּטִּים עַֽקַלְקַלּוֹתָם יוֹלִיכֵם יְהוָה אֶת פֹּעֲלֵי הָאָוֶן שָׁלוֹם עַל יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
translation: But as for those who turn away to their crooked ways, the LORD will lead them away with the workers of iniquity. Peace be on Israel. (Psalms 125:5)

text: דָּרַשְׁתִּי אֶת יְהוָה וְעָנָנִי וּמִכָּל מְגוּרוֹתַי הִצִּילָֽנִי׃
translation: They looked to him, and were radiant. Their faces shall never be covered with shame. (Psalms 34:5)

text: הַצֵּל לְקֻחִים לַמָּוֶת וּמָטִים לַהֶרֶג אִם תַּחְשֽׂוֹךְ׃
translation: Rescue those who are being led away to death! Indeed, hold back those who are staggering to the slaughter! (Proverbs 24:11)

text: וְשֵׁם הָאֶחָד אֱלִיעֶזֶר כִּֽי אֱלֹהֵי אָבִי בְּעֶזְרִי וַיַּצִּלֵנִי מֵחֶרֶב פַּרְעֹֽה׃
translation: The name of the other was Eliezer, for he said, "My father's God was my help and delivered me from Pharaoh's sword." (Exodus 18:4)

text: לֹא תַסְגִּיר עֶבֶד אֶל אֲדֹנָיו אֲשֶׁר יִנָּצֵל אֵלֶיךָ מֵעִם אֲדֹנָֽיו׃
translation: He shall dwell with you, among you, in the place which he shall choose within one of your gates, where it pleases him best. You shall not oppress him. (Deuteronomy 23:16)

text: וַיַּעַשׂ לָהֶם כֵּן וַיַּצֵּל אוֹתָם מִיַּד בְּנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְלֹא הֲרָגֽוּם׃
translation: He did so to them, and delivered them out of the hand of the children of Israel, so that they didn't kill them. (Joshua 9:26)

text: הַהַצֵּל הִצִּילוּ אֱלֹהֵי הַגּוֹיִם אִישׁ אֶת אַרְצוֹ מִיַּד מֶלֶךְ אַשּֽׁוּר׃
translation: Has any of the gods of the nations ever delivered his land out of the hand of the king of Assyria? (2 Kings 18:33)

text: וַיַּעֲזֹב אֶת יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵי אֲבֹתָיו וְלֹא הָלַךְ בְּדֶרֶךְ יְהוָֽה׃
translation: and he abandoned the LORD, the God of his fathers, and didn't walk in the way of the LORD. (2 Kings 21:22)

text: וְעַתָּה מַה נֹּאמַר אֱלֹהֵינוּ אַֽחֲרֵי זֹאת כִּי עָזַבְנוּ מִצְוֺתֶֽיךָ׃
translation: "Now, our God, what shall we say after this? For we have forsaken your commandments, (Ezra 9:10)

text: וְיִבְטְחוּ בְךָ יוֹדְעֵי שְׁמֶךָ כִּי לֹֽא עָזַבְתָּ דֹרְשֶׁיךָ יְהוָֽה׃
translation: Sing praises to the LORD, who dwells in Zion, and declare among the people what he has done. (Psalms 9:11)

text: אַל תַּֽעַזְבֵנִי יְהוָה אֱלֹהַי אַל תִּרְחַק מִמֶּֽנִּי׃
translation: Hurry to help me, Lord, my salvation. (Psalms 38:22)

text: וַיַּעַזְבוּ אֶת יְהוָה וַיַּעַבְדוּ לַבַּעַל וְלָעַשְׁתָּרֽוֹת׃
translation: They abandoned the LORD, and served Baal and the Ashtaroth. (Judges 2:13)

text: כִּי לֹא תַעֲזֹב נַפְשִׁי לִשְׁאוֹל לֹֽא תִתֵּן חֲסִידְךָ לִרְאוֹת שָֽׁחַת׃
translation: For you will not leave my soul in Sheol, neither will you allow your holy one to see corruption. (Psalms 16:10)

text: וַיִּשְׁלַח מַלְאָכִים אֶל אַחְאָב מֶֽלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל הָעִֽירָה׃
translation: He sent messengers into the city to Ahab king of Israel and said to him, "Ben Hadad says, (1 Kings 20:2)

text: יְֽהִי דַרְכָּם חֹשֶׁךְ וַחֲלַקְלַקּוֹת וּמַלְאַךְ יְהוָה רֹדְפָֽם׃
translation: Let their way be dark and slippery, the LORD's angel pursuing them. (Psalms 35:6)

text: כִּי מַלְאָכָיו יְצַוֶּה לָּךְ לִשְׁמָרְךָ בְּכָל דְּרָכֶֽיךָ׃
translation: For he will put his angels in charge of you, to guard you in all your ways. (Psalms 91:11)

text: הַֽלְלוּהוּ כָל מַלְאָכָיו הַֽלְלוּהוּ כָּל צבאו צְבָאָֽיו׃
translation: Praise him, all his angels! Praise him, all his army! (Psalms 148:2)

text: חֲמַת מֶלֶךְ מַלְאֲכֵי מָוֶת וְאִישׁ חָכָם יְכַפְּרֶֽנָּה׃
translation: The king's wrath is a messenger of death, but a wise man will pacify it. (Proverbs 16:14)

text: וַיָּשָׁב הַמַּלְאָךְ הַדֹּבֵר בִּי וַיְעִירֵנִי כְּאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יֵעוֹר מִשְּׁנָתֽוֹ׃
translation: The angel who talked with me came again and wakened me, as a man who is wakened out of his sleep. (Zechariah 4:1)

text: וַֽיְהִי אַחֲרֵי כֵן וַיֶּאֱהַב אִשָּׁה בְּנַחַל שֹׂרֵק וּשְׁמָהּ דְּלִילָֽה׃
translation: It came to pass afterward that he loved a woman in the valley of Sorek, whose name was Delilah. (Judges 16:4)

text: וַיִּבְחַר אֶת שֵׁבֶט יְהוּדָה אֶֽת הַר צִיּוֹן אֲשֶׁר אָהֵֽב׃
translation: But chose the tribe of Judah, Mount Zion which he loved. (Psalms 78:68)

text: תּוֹעֲבַת יְהוָה דֶּרֶךְ רָשָׁע וּמְרַדֵּף צְדָקָה יֶאֱהָֽב׃
translation: The way of the wicked is an abomination to the LORD, but he loves him who follows after righteousness. (Proverbs 15:9)

text: רְצוֹן מְלָכִים שִׂפְתֵי צֶדֶק וְדֹבֵר יְשָׁרִים יֶאֱהָֽב׃
translation: Righteous lips are the delight of kings. They value one who speaks the truth. (Proverbs 16:13)

text: מָוֶת וְחַיִּים בְּיַד לָשׁוֹן וְאֹהֲבֶיהָ יֹאכַל פִּרְיָֽהּ׃
translation: Death and life are in the power of the tongue; those who love it will eat its fruit. (Proverbs 18:21)

text: וְעֹשֶׂה חֶסֶד לַאֲלָפִים לְאֹהֲבַי וּלְשֹׁמְרֵי מִצְוֺתָֽי׃
translation: and showing loving kindness to thousands of those who love me and keep my commandments. (Exodus 20:6)

text: וְיָדְעוּ מִצְרַיִם כִּי אֲנִי יְהוָה בְּהִכָּבְדִי בְּפַרְעֹה בְּרִכְבּוֹ וּבְפָרָשָֽׁיו׃
translation: The Egyptians shall know that I am the LORD when I have gotten myself honor over Pharaoh, over his chariots, and over his horsemen." (Exodus 14:18)

text: אֵלֶּה בָרֶכֶב וְאֵלֶּה בַסּוּסִים וַאֲנַחְנוּ בְּשֵׁם יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ נַזְכִּֽיר׃
translation: They are bowed down and fallen, but we rise up, and stand upright. (Psalms 20:8)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל בָּנָיו חִבְשׁוּ לִי הַחֲמוֹר וַיַּחְבְּשׁוּ לוֹ הַחֲמוֹר וַיִּרְכַּב עָלָֽיו׃
translation: He said to his sons, "Saddle the donkey for me." So they saddled the donkey for him; and he rode on it. (1 Kings 13:13)

text: וַיְהִי כִּרְאוֹת שָׂרֵי הָרֶכֶב כִּֽי לֹא מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל הוּא וַיָּשׁוּבוּ מֵאַחֲרָֽיו׃
translation: When the captains of the chariots saw that it was not the king of Israel, they turned back from pursuing him. (1 Kings 22:33)

text: וַיְהִי כִּרְאוֹת שָׂרֵי הָרֶכֶב כִּי לֹא הָיָה מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיָּשֻׁבוּ מֵאַחֲרָֽיו׃
translation: When the captains of the chariots saw that it was not the king of Israel, they turned back from pursuing him. (2 Chronicles 18:32)

text: וַהֲדָרְךָ צְלַח רְכַב עַֽל דְּבַר אֱמֶת וְעַנְוָה צֶדֶק וְתוֹרְךָ נוֹרָאוֹת יְמִינֶֽךָ׃
translation: Your arrows are sharp. The nations fall under you, with arrows in the heart of the king's enemies. (Psalms 45:5)

text: וּמִנְחָתָם וְנִסְכֵּהֶם לַפָּרִים לָאֵילִם וְלַכְּבָשִׂים בְּמִסְפָּרָם כְּמִשְׁפָּטָֽם׃
translation: and their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance, (Numbers 29:33)

text: מִנְחָתָם וְנִסְכֵּיהֶם לַפָּר לָאַיִל וְלַכְּבָשִׂים בְּמִסְפָּרָם כַּמִּשְׁפָּֽט׃
translation: their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bull, for the ram, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the ordinance, (Numbers 29:37)

text: הַמִּנְחָה וְהַחַטָּאת וְהָאָשָׁם הֵמָּה יֹֽאכְלוּם וְכָל חֵרֶם בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל לָהֶם יִהְיֶֽה׃
translation: They shall eat the meal offering, and the sin offering, and the trespass offering; and every devoted thing in Israel shall be theirs. (Ezekiel 44:29)

text: וַיָּלֶן שָׁם בַּלַּיְלָה הַהוּא וַיִּקַּח מִן הַבָּא בְיָדוֹ מִנְחָה לְעֵשָׂו אָחִֽיו׃
translation: two hundred female goats and twenty male goats, two hundred ewes and twenty rams, (Genesis 32:14)

text: לֹא תַעֲלוּ עָלָיו קְטֹרֶת זָרָה וְעֹלָה וּמִנְחָה וְנֵסֶךְ לֹא תִסְּכוּ עָלָֽיו׃
translation: You shall offer no strange incense on it, nor burnt offering, nor meal offering; and you shall pour no drink offering on it. (Exodus 30:9)

text: וְהֶעֱלָה הַכֹּהֵן אֶת הָעֹלָה וְאֶת הַמִּנְחָה הַמִּזְבֵּחָה וְכִפֶּר עָלָיו הַכֹּהֵן וְטָהֵֽר׃
translation: then the priest shall offer the burnt offering and the meal offering on the altar. The priest shall make atonement for him, and he shall be clean. (Leviticus 14:20)

text: וַיִּשְׁכַּב יְהוֹיָקִים עִם אֲבֹתָיו וַיִּמְלֹךְ יְהוֹיָכִין בְּנוֹ תַּחְתָּֽיו׃
translation: So Jehoiakim slept with his fathers, and Jehoiachin his son reigned in his place. (2 Kings 24:6)

text: וְאִם אִישׁ עָנִי הוּא לֹא תִשְׁכַּב בַּעֲבֹטֽוֹ׃
translation: If he is a poor man, you shall not sleep with his pledge. (Deuteronomy 24:12)

text: וַיִּשְׁכַּב דָּוִד עִם אֲבֹתָיו וַיִּקָּבֵר בְּעִיר דָּוִֽד׃
translation: David slept with his fathers, and was buried in David's city. (1 Kings 2:10)

text: וַיִּשְׁכַּב אָסָא עִם אֲבֹתָיו וַיָּמָת בִּשְׁנַת אַרְבָּעִים וְאַחַת לְמָלְכֽוֹ׃
translation: Asa slept with his fathers, and died in the forty-first year of his reign. (2 Chronicles 16:13)

text: יַחַד עַל עָפָר יִשְׁכָּבוּ וְרִמָּה תְּכַסֶּה עֲלֵיהֶֽם׃
translation: They lie down alike in the dust. The worm covers them. (Job 21:26)

text: כָּל שֹׁכֵב עִם בְּהֵמָה מוֹת יוּמָֽת׃
translation: "You shall not allow a sorceress to live. (Exodus 22:18)

text: עֵינַיִם הָיִיתִי לַֽעִוֵּר וְרַגְלַיִם לַפִּסֵּחַ אָֽנִי׃
translation: I was eyes to the blind, and feet to the lame. (Job 29:15)

text: לִפְנֵי אֶפְרַיִם וּבִנְיָמִן וּמְנַשֶּׁה עוֹרְרָה אֶת גְּבֽוּרָתֶךָ וּלְכָה לִישֻׁעָתָה לָּֽנוּ׃
translation: Turn us again, God. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved. (Psalms 80:3)

text: אִם זַךְ וְיָשָׁר אָתָּה כִּי עַתָּה יָעִיר עָלֶיךָ וְשִׁלַּם נְוַת צִדְקֶֽךָ׃
translation: If you were pure and upright, surely now he would awaken for you, and make the habitation of your righteousness prosperous. (Job 8:6)

text: הַחֵרְשִׁים שְׁמָעוּ וְהַעִוְרִים הַבִּיטוּ לִרְאֽוֹת׃
translation: "Hear, you deaf, and look, you blind, that you may see. (Isaiah 42:18)

text: הִנֵּה עַם בָּא מִצָּפוֹן וְגוֹי גָּדוֹל וּמְלָכִים רַבִּים יֵעֹרוּ מִיַּרְכְּתֵי אָֽרֶץ׃
translation: "Behold, a people comes from the north. A great nation and many kings will be stirred up from the uttermost parts of the earth. (Jeremiah 50:41)

text: וְאֶת עוֹר הַפָּר וְאֶת כָּל בְּשָׂרוֹ עַל רֹאשׁוֹ וְעַל כְּרָעָיו וְקִרְבּוֹ וּפִרְשֽׁוֹ׃
translation: He shall carry the bull's skin, all its meat, with its head, and with its legs, its innards, and its dung (Leviticus 4:11)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹנָתָן הִנֵּה אֲנַחְנוּ עֹבְרִים אֶל הָאֲנָשִׁים וְנִגְלִינוּ אֲלֵיהֶֽם׃
translation: Then Jonathan said, "Behold, we will pass over to the men, and we will reveal ourselves to them. (1 Samuel 14:8)

text: הוֹדִיעַ יְהוָה יְשׁוּעָתוֹ לְעֵינֵי הַגּוֹיִם גִּלָּה צִדְקָתֽוֹ׃
translation: The LORD has made known his salvation. He has openly shown his righteousness in the sight of the nations. (Psalms 98:2)

text: וְנַעֲמָן וַאֲחִיָּה וְגֵרָא הוּא הֶגְלָם וְהוֹלִיד אֶת עֻזָּא וְאֶת אֲחִיחֻֽד׃
translation: Naaman, Ahijah, and Gera, who carried them captive; and he became the father of Uzza and Ahihud. (1 Chronicles 8:7)

text: יְגַלּוּ שָׁמַיִם עֲוֺנוֹ וְאֶרֶץ מִתְקוֹמָמָה לֽוֹ׃
translation: The heavens will reveal his iniquity. The earth will rise up against him. (Job 20:27)

text: וְעַתָּה אֲגַלֶּה אֶת נַבְלֻתָהּ לְעֵינֵי מְאַהֲבֶיהָ וְאִישׁ לֹֽא יַצִּילֶנָּה מִיָּדִֽי׃
translation: I will lay waste her vines and her fig trees, about which she has said, 'These are my wages that my lovers have given me,' and I will make them a forest, and the animals of the field shall eat them. (Hosea 2:12)

text: עֶרְוַת אָבִיךָ וְעֶרְוַת אִמְּךָ לֹא תְגַלֵּה אִמְּךָ הִוא לֹא תְגַלֶּה עֶרְוָתָֽהּ׃
translation: "'You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father, nor the nakedness of your mother: she is your mother. You shall not uncover her nakedness. (Leviticus 18:7)

text: וַיֹּסִפוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לַעֲשׂוֹת הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהוָה וְאֵהוּד מֵֽת׃
translation: The children of Israel again did that which was evil in the LORD's sight, when Ehud was dead. (Judges 4:1)

text: אַחַת דִּבַּרְתִּי וְלֹא אֶֽעֱנֶה וּשְׁתַּיִם וְלֹא אוֹסִֽיף׃
translation: I have spoken once, and I will not answer; Yes, twice, but I will proceed no further." (Job 40:5)

text: יָמִים עַל יְמֵי מֶלֶךְ תּוֹסִיף שְׁנוֹתָיו כְּמוֹ דֹר וָדֹֽר׃
translation: He shall be enthroned in God's presence forever. Appoint your loving kindness and truth, that they may preserve him. (Psalms 61:7)

text: וַיֹּסֶף אַבְרָהָם וַיִּקַּח אִשָּׁה וּשְׁמָהּ קְטוּרָֽה׃
translation: Abraham took another wife, and her name was Keturah. (Genesis 25:1)

text: וַתִּקְרָא אֶת שְׁמוֹ יוֹסֵף לֵאמֹר יֹסֵף יְהוָה לִי בֵּן אַחֵֽר׃
translation: She named him Joseph, saying, "May the LORD add another son to me." (Genesis 30:24)

text: יֹסֵף יְהוָה עֲלֵיכֶם עֲלֵיכֶם וְעַל בְּנֵיכֶֽם׃
translation: May the LORD increase you more and more, you and your children. (Psalms 115:14)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר הָרֶם לָךְ וַיִּשְׁלַח יָדוֹ וַיִּקָּחֵֽהוּ׃
translation: He said, "Take it." So he put out his hand and took it. (2 Kings 6:7)

text: הֲתָרִים לָעָב קוֹלֶךָ וְֽשִׁפְעַת מַיִם תְּכַסֶּֽךָּ׃
translation: "Can you lift up your voice to the clouds, that abundance of waters may cover you? (Job 38:34)

text: כִּי יִצְפְּנֵנִי בְּסֻכֹּה בְּיוֹם רָעָה יַסְתִּרֵנִי בְּסֵתֶר אָהֳלוֹ בְּצוּר יְרוֹמְמֵֽנִי׃
translation: For in the day of trouble, he will keep me secretly in his pavilion. In the secret place of his tabernacle, he will hide me. He will lift me up on a rock. (Psalms 27:5)

text: גַּדְּלוּ לַיהוָה אִתִּי וּנְרוֹמְמָה שְׁמוֹ יַחְדָּֽו׃
translation: I sought the LORD, and he answered me, and delivered me from all my fears. (Psalms 34:4)

text: בְּשִׁמְךָ יְגִילוּן כָּל הַיּוֹם וּבְצִדְקָתְךָ יָרֽוּמוּ׃
translation: For you are the glory of their strength. In your favor, our horn will be exalted. (Psalms 89:17)

text: וֶֽאֶֽמוּנָתִי וְחַסְדִּי עִמּוֹ וּבִשְׁמִי תָּרוּם קַרְנֽוֹ׃
translation: I will set his hand also on the sea, and his right hand on the rivers. (Psalms 89:25)

text: בְּזֹאת יָבֹא אַהֲרֹן אֶל הַקֹּדֶשׁ בְּפַר בֶּן בָּקָר לְחַטָּאת וְאַיִל לְעֹלָֽה׃
translation: "Aaron shall come into the sanctuary with a young bull for a sin offering, and a ram for a burnt offering. (Leviticus 16:3)

text: פַּר אֶחָד בֶּן בָּקָר אַיִל אֶחָד כֶּֽבֶשׂ אֶחָד בֶּן שְׁנָתוֹ לְעֹלָֽה׃
translation: one young bull, one ram, one male lamb a year old, for a burnt offering; (Numbers 7:15)

text: פַּר אֶחָד בֶּן בָּקָר אַיִל אֶחָד כֶּֽבֶשׂ אֶחָד בֶּן שְׁנָתוֹ לְעֹלָֽה׃
translation: one young bull, one ram, one male lamb a year old, for a burnt offering; (Numbers 7:21)

text: פַּר אֶחָד בֶּן בָּקָר אַיִל אֶחָד כֶּֽבֶשׂ אֶחָד בֶּן שְׁנָתוֹ לְעֹלָֽה׃
translation: one young bull, one ram, one male lamb a year old, for a burnt offering; (Numbers 7:27)

text: פַּר אֶחָד בֶּן בָּקָר אַיִל אֶחָד כֶּֽבֶשׂ אֶחָד בֶּן שְׁנָתוֹ לְעֹלָֽה׃
translation: one young bull, one ram, one male lamb a year old, for a burnt offering; (Numbers 7:33)

text: פַּר אֶחָד בֶּן בָּקָר אַיִל אֶחָד כֶּֽבֶשׂ אֶחָד בֶּן שְׁנָתוֹ לְעֹלָֽה׃
translation: one young bull, one ram, one male lamb a year old, for a burnt offering; (Numbers 7:39)

text: אִם תּוּכַל הֲשִׁיבֵנִי עֶרְכָה לְפָנַי הִתְיַצָּֽבָה׃
translation: If you can, answer me. Set your words in order before me, and stand up. (Job 33:5)

text: וְנִלְחֲמוּ אֵלֶיךָ וְלֹא יוּכְלוּ לָךְ כִּֽי אִתְּךָ אֲנִי נְאֻם יְהוָה לְהַצִּילֶֽךָ׃
translation: They will fight against you, but they will not prevail against you; for I am with you", says the LORD, "to rescue you." (Jeremiah 1:19)

text: וַתֹּאמֶר רָחֵל נַפְתּוּלֵי אֱלֹהִים נִפְתַּלְתִּי עִם אֲחֹתִי גַּם יָכֹלְתִּי וַתִּקְרָא שְׁמוֹ נַפְתָּלִֽי׃
translation: Rachel said, "I have wrestled with my sister with mighty wrestlings, and have prevailed." She named him Naphtali. (Genesis 30:8)

text: לֹֽא אוּכַל אָנֹכִי לְבַדִּי לָשֵׂאת אֶת כָּל הָעָם הַזֶּה כִּי כָבֵד מִמֶּֽנִּי׃
translation: I am not able to bear all this people alone, because it is too heavy for me. (Numbers 11:14)

text: לֹא תוּכַל לִזְבֹּחַ אֶת הַפָּסַח בְּאַחַד שְׁעָרֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר יְהוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ נֹתֵן לָֽךְ׃
translation: You may not sacrifice the Passover within any of your gates which the LORD your God gives you; (Deuteronomy 16:5)

text: כֹּה אָמַר הַמֶּלֶךְ אַל יַשִּׁא לָכֶם חִזְקִיָּהוּ כִּי לֹֽא יוּכַל לְהַצִּיל אֶתְכֶֽם׃
translation: The king says, 'Don't let Hezekiah deceive you; for he will not be able to deliver you. (Isaiah 36:14)

text: צֹפְנֶיהָ צָֽפַן רוּחַ וְשֶׁמֶן יְמִינוֹ יִקְרָֽא׃
translation: restraining her is like restraining the wind, or like grasping oil in his right hand. (Proverbs 27:16)

text: וַיִּשְׁמַן יְשֻׁרוּן וַיִּבְעָט שָׁמַנְתָּ עָבִיתָ כָּשִׂיתָ וַיִּטֹּשׁ אֱלוֹהַ עָשָׂהוּ וַיְנַבֵּל צוּר יְשֻׁעָתֽוֹ׃
translation: But Jeshurun grew fat, and kicked. You have grown fat. You have grown thick. You have become sleek. Then he abandoned God who made him, and rejected the Rock of his salvation. (Deuteronomy 32:15)

text: ועשו יַעֲשׂוּ אֶת הַכֶּבֶשׂ וְאֶת הַמִּנְחָה וְאֶת הַשֶּׁמֶן בַּבֹּקֶר בַּבֹּקֶר עוֹלַת תָּמִֽיד׃
translation: Thus they shall prepare the lamb, the meal offering, and the oil, morning by morning, for a continual burnt offering." (Ezekiel 46:15)

text: עַל כֵּן יְזַבֵּחַ לְחֶרְמוֹ וִֽיקַטֵּר לְמִכְמַרְתּוֹ כִּי בָהֵמָּה שָׁמֵן חֶלְקוֹ וּמַאֲכָלוֹ בְּרִאָֽה׃
translation: Therefore he sacrifices to his net and burns incense to his dragnet, because by them his life is luxurious and his food is good. (Habakkuk 1:16)

text: וְאֵת מִזְבַּח הַזָּהָב וְאֵת שֶׁמֶן הַמִּשְׁחָה וְאֵת קְטֹרֶת הַסַּמִּים וְאֵת מָסַךְ פֶּתַח הָאֹֽהֶל׃
translation: the golden altar, the anointing oil, the sweet incense, the screen for the door of the Tent, (Exodus 39:38)

text: וְאֵיפָה לַפָּר וְאֵיפָה לָאַיִל יַעֲשֶׂה מִנְחָה וְלַכְּבָשִׂים כַּאֲשֶׁר תַּשִּׂיג יָדוֹ וְשֶׁמֶן הִין לָאֵיפָֽה׃
translation: He shall prepare a meal offering: an ephah for the bull, and an ephah for the ram, and for the lambs according as he is able, and a hin of oil to an ephah. (Ezekiel 46:7)

text: אֶת חֶלְקָת וְאֶת מִגְרָשֶׁהָ וְאֶת רְחֹב וְאֶת מִגְרָשֶׁהָ עָרִים אַרְבַּֽע׃
translation: Helkath with its pasture lands, and Rehob with its pasture lands: four cities. (Joshua 21:31)

text: תַּרְחִיב צַעֲדִי תַּחְתֵּנִי וְלֹא מָעֲדוּ קַרְסֻלָּֽי׃
translation: You have enlarged my steps under me. My feet have not slipped. (2 Samuel 22:37)

text: וְהָעִיר רַחֲבַת יָדַיִם וּגְדוֹלָה וְהָעָם מְעַט בְּתוֹכָהּ וְאֵין בָּתִּים בְּנוּיִֽם׃
translation: Now the city was wide and large; but the people were few therein, and the houses were not built. (Nehemiah 7:4)

text: בְּקָרְאִי עֲנֵנִי אֱלֹהֵי צִדְקִי בַּצָּר הִרְחַבְתָּ לִּי חָנֵּנִי וּשְׁמַע תְּפִלָּתִֽי׃
translation: You sons of men, how long shall my glory be turned into dishonor? Will you love vanity and seek after falsehood? Selah. (Psalms 4:2)

text: תַּרְחִיב צַעֲדִי תַחְתָּי וְלֹא מָעֲדוּ קַרְסֻלָּֽי׃
translation: I will pursue my enemies, and overtake them. I won't turn away until they are consumed. (Psalms 18:37)

text: וַיֵּצֵא הֲתָךְ אֶֽל מָרְדֳּכָי אֶל רְחוֹב הָעִיר אֲשֶׁר לִפְנֵי שַֽׁעַר הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
translation: So Hathach went out to Mordecai, to the city square which was before the king's gate. (Esther 4:6)

text: הַקַּיִן גִּבְעָה וְתִמְנָה עָרִים עֶשֶׂר וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃
translation: Kain, Gibeah, and Timnah; ten cities with their villages. (Joshua 15:57)

text: וְקַטָּת וְנַֽהֲלָל וְשִׁמְרוֹן וְיִדְאֲלָה וּבֵית לָחֶם עָרִים שְׁתֵּים עֶשְׂרֵה וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃
translation: Kattath, Nahalal, Shimron, Idalah, and Bethlehem: twelve cities with their villages. (Joshua 19:15)

text: וַאֲחֵיהֶם בְּחַצְרֵיהֶם לָבוֹא לְשִׁבְעַת הַיָּמִים מֵעֵת אֶל עֵת עִם אֵֽלֶּה׃
translation: Their brothers, in their villages, were to come in every seven days from time to time to be with them, (1 Chronicles 9:25)

text: וַיַּעֲמֹד יְהוֹשָׁפָט בִּקְהַל יְהוּדָה וִירוּשָׁלִַם בְּבֵית יְהוָה לִפְנֵי הֶחָצֵר הַחֲדָשָֽׁה׃
translation: Jehoshaphat stood in the assembly of Judah and Jerusalem, in the LORD's house, before the new court; (2 Chronicles 20:5)

text: שֶׁעֹֽמְדִים בְּבֵית יְהוָה בְּחַצְרוֹת בֵּית אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃
translation: you who stand in the LORD's house, in the courts of our God's house. (Psalms 135:2)

text: כִּי מְאַסְפָיו יֹאכְלֻהוּ וְהִֽלְלוּ אֶת יְהוָה וּֽמְקַבְּצָיו יִשְׁתֻּהוּ בְּחַצְרוֹת קָדְשִֽׁי׃
translation: but those who have harvested it will eat it, and praise the LORD. Those who have gathered it will drink it in the courts of my sanctuary." (Isaiah 62:9)

text: בְּפֶה חָנֵף יַשְׁחִת רֵעֵהוּ וּבְדַעַת צַדִּיקִים יֵחָלֵֽצוּ׃
translation: With his mouth the godless man destroys his neighbor, but the righteous will be delivered through knowledge. (Proverbs 11:9)

text: צַדִּיק הָרִאשׁוֹן בְּרִיבוֹ יבא וּבָֽא רֵעֵהוּ וַחֲקָרֽוֹ׃
translation: He who pleads his cause first seems right— until another comes and questions him. (Proverbs 18:17)

text: וַיְהִי מֵֽהַיּוֹם הַהוּא וָמָעְלָה וַיְשִׂמֶהָ לְחֹק וּלְמִשְׁפָּט לְיִשְׂרָאֵל עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּֽה׃
translation: It was so from that day forward that he made it a statute and an ordinance for Israel to this day. (1 Samuel 30:25)

text: וַיִּתְחַזֵּק שְׁלֹמֹה בֶן דָּוִיד עַל מַלְכוּתוֹ וַיהוָה אֱלֹהָיו עִמּוֹ וַֽיְגַדְּלֵהוּ לְמָֽעְלָה׃
translation: Solomon the son of David was firmly established in his kingdom, and the LORD his God was with him, and made him exceedingly great. (2 Chronicles 1:1)

text: פְּקֻדֵיהֶם בְּמִסְפַּר כָּל זָכָר מִבֶּן חֹדֶשׁ וָמָעְלָה פְּקֻדֵיהֶם שִׁבְעַת אֲלָפִים וַחֲמֵשׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃
translation: Those who were counted of them, according to the number of all the males from a month old and upward, even those who were counted of them were seven thousand five hundred. (Numbers 3:22)

text: וַיִּֽמְעֲלוּ בֵּאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵיהֶם וַיִּזְנוּ אַחֲרֵי אֱלֹהֵי עַמֵּי הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר הִשְׁמִיד אֱלֹהִים מִפְּנֵיהֶֽם׃
translation: They trespassed against the God of their fathers, and played the prostitute after the gods of the peoples of the land whom God destroyed before them. (1 Chronicles 5:25)

text: כִּי בְדִבְרֵי דָוִיד הָאַחֲרֹנִים הֵמָּה מִסְפַּר בְּנֵי לֵוִי מִבֶּן עֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה וּלְמָֽעְלָה׃
translation: For by the last words of David the sons of Levi were counted, from twenty years old and upward. (1 Chronicles 23:27)

text: וְאֵת הִתְיַחֵשׂ הַכֹּהֲנִים לְבֵית אֲבוֹתֵיהֶם וְהַלְוִיִּם מִבֶּן עֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה וּלְמָעְלָה בְּמִשְׁמְרוֹתֵיהֶם בְּמַחְלְקוֹתֵיהֶֽם׃
translation: and those who were listed by genealogy of the priests by their fathers' houses, and the Levites from twenty years old and upward, in their offices by their divisions; (2 Chronicles 31:17)

text: וַאֲרוֹן אֱלֹהִים נִלְקָח וּשְׁנֵי בְנֵֽי עֵלִי מֵתוּ חָפְנִי וּפִֽינְחָֽס׃
translation: God's ark was taken; and the two sons of Eli, Hophni and Phinehas, were slain. (1 Samuel 4:11)

text: וַיָּשֶׁב צָדוֹק וְאֶבְיָתָר אֶת אֲרוֹן הָאֱלֹהִים יְרוּשָׁלִָם וַיֵּשְׁבוּ שָֽׁם׃
translation: Zadok therefore and Abiathar carried God's ark to Jerusalem again; and they stayed there. (2 Samuel 15:29)

text: וַיִּשְׁאֲלוּ בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵל בַּֽיהוָה וְשָׁם אֲרוֹן בְּרִית הָאֱלֹהִים בַּיָּמִים הָהֵֽם׃
translation: The children of Israel asked the LORD (for the ark of the covenant of God was there in those days, (Judges 20:27)

text: וְנָסֵבָּה אֶת אֲרוֹן אֱלֹהֵינוּ אֵלֵינוּ כִּי לֹא דְרַשְׁנֻהוּ בִּימֵי שָׁאֽוּל׃
translation: Also, let's bring the ark of our God back to us again, for we didn't seek it in the days of Saul." (1 Chronicles 13:3)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ וַֽיַּעֲשׂוּ אֲרוֹן אֶחָד וַֽיִּתְּנֻהוּ בְּשַׁעַר בֵּית יְהוָה חֽוּצָה׃
translation: So the king commanded, and they made a chest, and set it outside at the gate of the LORD's house. (2 Chronicles 24:8)

text: וַיִּשְׂמְחוּ כָל הַשָּׂרִים וְכָל הָעָם וַיָּבִיאוּ וַיַּשְׁלִיכוּ לָאָרוֹן עַד לְכַלֵּֽה׃
translation: All the princes and all the people rejoiced, and brought in, and cast into the chest, until they had filled it. (2 Chronicles 24:10)

text: וַיָּמָת אֵלוֹן הַזְּבֽוּלֹנִי וַיִּקָּבֵר בְּאַיָּלוֹן בְּאֶרֶץ זְבוּלֻֽן׃
translation: Elon the Zebulunite died, and was buried in Aijalon in the land of Zebulun. (Judges 12:12)

text: וַיִּשָּׂאֻהוּ עַל הַסּוּסִים וַֽיִּקְבְּרוּ אֹתוֹ עִם אֲבֹתָיו בְּעִיר יְהוּדָֽה׃
translation: They brought him on horses and buried him with his fathers in the City of Judah. (2 Chronicles 25:28)

text: וַיִּשְׁכַּב בַּעְשָׁא עִם אֲבֹתָיו וַיִּקָּבֵר בְּתִרְצָה וַיִּמְלֹךְ אֵלָה בְנוֹ תַּחְתָּֽיו׃
translation: Baasha slept with his fathers, and was buried in Tirzah; and Elah his son reigned in his place. (1 Kings 16:6)

text: וַיִּשְׁכַּב עָמְרִי עִם אֲבֹתָיו וַיִּקָּבֵר בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן וַיִּמְלֹךְ אַחְאָב בְּנוֹ תַּחְתָּֽיו׃
translation: So Omri slept with his fathers, and was buried in Samaria; and Ahab his son reigned in his place. (1 Kings 16:28)

text: וַיִּשְׁכַּב יְהֽוֹאָחָז עִם אֲבֹתָיו וַֽיִּקְבְּרֻהוּ בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן וַיִּמְלֹךְ יוֹאָשׁ בְּנוֹ תַּחְתָּֽיו׃
translation: Jehoahaz slept with his fathers; and they buried him in Samaria; and Joash his son reigned in his place. (2 Kings 13:9)

text: וַיִּשְׂאוּ אֹתוֹ עַל הַסּוּסִים וַיִּקָּבֵר בִּירוּשָׁלִַם עִם אֲבֹתָיו בְּעִיר דָּוִֽד׃
translation: They brought him on horses, and he was buried at Jerusalem with his fathers in David's city. (2 Kings 14:20)

text: וְנָשִׂיא אֶחָד נָשִׂיא אֶחָד מִמַּטֶּה תִּקְחוּ לִנְחֹל אֶת הָאָֽרֶץ׃
translation: You shall take one prince of every tribe, to divide the land for inheritance. (Numbers 34:18)

text: וַיָּבֹא שָׁאוּל עַד עִיר עֲמָלֵק וַיָּרֶב בַּנָּֽחַל׃
translation: Saul came to the city of Amalek, and set an ambush in the valley. (1 Samuel 15:5)

text: עֲשֵֽׂה לָהֶם כְּמִדְיָן כְּֽסִֽיסְרָא כְיָבִין בְּנַחַל קִישֽׁוֹן׃
translation: who perished at Endor, who became as dung for the earth. (Psalms 83:10)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלַי הֲרָאִיתָ בֶן אָדָם וַיּוֹלִכֵנִי וַיְשִׁבֵנִי שְׂפַת הַנָּֽחַל׃
translation: He said to me, "Son of man, have you seen this?" Then he brought me and caused me to return to the bank of the river. (Ezekiel 47:6)

text: לֹא נָשׁוּב אֶל בָּתֵּינוּ עַד הִתְנַחֵל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אִישׁ נַחֲלָתֽוֹ׃
translation: We will not return to our houses until the children of Israel have all received their inheritance. (Numbers 32:18)

text: אֵלֶּה אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהוָה לְנַחֵל אֶת בְּנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּאֶרֶץ כְּנָֽעַן׃
translation: These are they whom the LORD commanded to divide the inheritance to the children of Israel in the land of Canaan. (Numbers 34:29)

text: הִגִּידוּ הַשָּׁמַיִם צִדְקוֹ וְרָאוּ כָל הָעַמִּים כְּבוֹדֽוֹ׃
translation: The heavens declare his righteousness. All the peoples have seen his glory. (Psalms 97:6)

text: וְיָשִׁירוּ בְּדַרְכֵי יְהוָה כִּי גָדוֹל כְּבוֹד יְהוָֽה׃
translation: Yes, they will sing of the ways of the LORD, for the LORD's glory is great! (Psalms 138:5)

text: רֹדֵף צְדָקָה וָחָסֶד יִמְצָא חַיִּים צְדָקָה וְכָבֽוֹד׃
translation: He who follows after righteousness and kindness finds life, righteousness, and honor. (Proverbs 21:21)

text: קוּמִי אוֹרִי כִּי בָא אוֹרֵךְ וּכְבוֹד יְהוָה עָלַיִךְ זָרָֽח׃
translation: "Arise, shine; for your light has come, and the LORD's glory has risen on you! (Isaiah 60:1)

text: מִי זֶה מֶלֶךְ הַכָּבוֹד יְהוָה עִזּוּז וְגִבּוֹר יְהוָה גִּבּוֹר מִלְחָמָֽה׃
translation: Who is the King of glory? The LORD strong and mighty, the LORD mighty in battle. (Psalms 24:8)

text: כֵּן בַּקֹּדֶשׁ חֲזִיתִיךָ לִרְאוֹת עֻזְּךָ וּכְבוֹדֶֽךָ׃
translation: Because your loving kindness is better than life, my lips shall praise you. (Psalms 63:3)

text: וַיֵּרָא יְהוָה אֶל שְׁלֹמֹה שֵׁנִית כַּאֲשֶׁר נִרְאָה אֵלָיו בְּגִבְעֽוֹן׃
translation: The LORD appeared to Solomon the second time, as he had appeared to him at Gibeon. (1 Kings 9:2)

text: וַיְהִי בַּיּוֹם הַשֵּׁנִי לְהָמִית אֶת גְּדַלְיָהוּ וְאִישׁ לֹא יָדָֽע׃
translation: The second day after he had killed Gedaliah, and no man knew it, (Jeremiah 41:4)

text: וְשֵֽׁם הַנָּהָר הַשֵּׁנִי גִּיחוֹן הוּא הַסּוֹבֵב אֵת כָּל אֶרֶץ כּֽוּשׁ׃
translation: The name of the second river is Gihon. It is the same river that flows through the whole land of Cush. (Genesis 2:13)

text: וְאַחַר יָצָא אָחִיו אֲשֶׁר עַל יָדוֹ הַשָּׁנִי וַיִּקְרָא שְׁמוֹ זָֽרַח׃
translation: Afterward his brother came out, who had the scarlet thread on his hand, and his name was called Zerah. (Genesis 38:30)

text: וְאִישַׁי הוֹלִיד אֶת בְּכֹרוֹ אֶת אֱלִיאָב וַאֲבִינָדָב הַשֵּׁנִי וְשִׁמְעָא הַשְּׁלִישִֽׁי׃
translation: and Jesse became the father of his firstborn Eliab, Abinadab the second, Shimea the third, (1 Chronicles 2:13)

text: וּבְנֵי יֹאשִׁיָּהוּ הַבְּכוֹר יוֹחָנָן הַשֵּׁנִי יְהוֹיָקִים הַשְּׁלִשִׁי צִדְקִיָּהוּ הָרְבִיעִי שַׁלּֽוּם׃
translation: The sons of Josiah: the firstborn Johanan, the second Jehoiakim, the third Zedekiah, and the fourth Shallum. (1 Chronicles 3:15)

text: יְהוָה אֱלֹהַי אִם עָשִׂיתִי זֹאת אִֽם יֶשׁ עָוֶל בְּכַפָּֽי׃
translation: if I have rewarded evil to him who was at peace with me (yes, I have plundered him who without cause was my adversary), (Psalms 7:4)

text: הֵן עַל כַּפַּיִם חַקֹּתִיךְ חוֹמֹתַיִךְ נֶגְדִּי תָּמִֽיד׃
translation: Behold, I have engraved you on the palms of my hands. Your walls are continually before me. (Isaiah 49:16)

text: וַֽיַּעֲמֹד לִפְנֵי מִזְבַּח יְהוָה נֶגֶד כָּל קְהַל יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּפְרֹשׂ כַּפָּֽיו׃
translation: He stood before the LORD's altar in the presence of all the assembly of Israel, and spread out his hands (2 Chronicles 6:12)

text: בַּעֲרוּץ נְחָלִים לִשְׁכֹּן חֹרֵי עָפָר וְכֵפִֽים׃
translation: so that they live in frightful valleys, and in holes of the earth and of the rocks. (Job 30:6)

text: כֵּן אֲבָרֶכְךָ בְחַיָּי בְּשִׁמְךָ אֶשָּׂא כַפָּֽי׃
translation: My soul shall be satisfied as with the richest food. My mouth shall praise you with joyful lips, (Psalms 63:5)

text: וַיִּרְעֵם כְּתֹם לְבָבוֹ וּבִתְבוּנוֹת כַּפָּיו יַנְחֵֽם׃
translation: So he was their shepherd according to the integrity of his heart, and guided them by the skillfulness of his hands. (Psalms 78:72)

text: וְשַׂמְתִּי כִסְאִי בְּעֵילָם וְהַאֲבַדְתִּי מִשָּׁם מֶלֶךְ וְשָׂרִים נְאֻם יְהוָֽה׃
translation: I will set my throne in Elam, and will destroy from there king and princes,' says the LORD. (Jeremiah 49:38)

text: יִלָּפְתוּ אָרְחוֹת דַּרְכָּם יַעֲלוּ בַתֹּהוּ וְיֹאבֵֽדוּ׃
translation: The caravans that travel beside them turn away. They go up into the waste, and perish. (Job 6:18)

text: זִֽכְרוֹ אָבַד מִנִּי אָרֶץ וְלֹא שֵׁם לוֹ עַל פְּנֵי חֽוּץ׃
translation: His memory will perish from the earth. He will have no name in the street. (Job 18:17)

text: כִּי לֹא לָנֶצַח יִשָּׁכַח אֶבְיוֹן תִּקְוַת ענוים עֲנִיִּים תֹּאבַד לָעַֽד׃
translation: Arise, LORD! Don't let man prevail. Let the nations be judged in your sight. (Psalms 9:19)

text: נִשְׁכַּחְתִּי כְּמֵת מִלֵּב הָיִיתִי כִּכְלִי אֹבֵֽד׃
translation: For I have heard the slander of many, terror on every side, while they conspire together against me, they plot to take away my life. (Psalms 31:13)

text: וּֽבְחַסְדְּךָ תַּצְמִית אֹיְבָי וְֽהַאֲבַדְתָּ כָּל צֹרֲרֵי נַפְשִׁי כִּי אֲנִי עַבְדֶּֽךָ׃
translation: In your loving kindness, cut off my enemies, and destroy all those who afflict my soul, for I am your servant. (Psalms 143:12)

text: וַתֵּלֶד עָדָה לְעֵשָׂו אֶת אֱלִיפָז וּבָשְׂמַת יָלְדָה אֶת רְעוּאֵֽל׃
translation: Adah bore to Esau Eliphaz. Basemath bore Reuel. (Genesis 36:4)

text: וַיֵּֽצְאוּ כָּל עֲדַת בְּנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִלִּפְנֵי מֹשֶֽׁה׃
translation: All the congregation of the children of Israel departed from the presence of Moses. (Exodus 35:20)

text: וַיִּסְעוּ מִקָּדֵשׁ וַיָּבֹאוּ בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵל כָּל הָעֵדָה הֹר הָהָֽר׃
translation: They traveled from Kadesh, and the children of Israel, even the whole congregation, came to Mount Hor. (Numbers 20:22)

text: שָׁמַרְתִּי פִקּוּדֶיךָ וְעֵדֹתֶיךָ כִּי כָל דְּרָכַי נֶגְדֶּֽךָ׃
translation: I have obeyed your precepts and your testimonies, for all my ways are before you. TAV (Psalms 119:168)

text: כִּמְעַט הָיִיתִי בְכָל רָע בְּתוֹךְ קָהָל וְעֵדָֽה׃
translation: I have come to the brink of utter ruin, among the gathered assembly." (Proverbs 5:14)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה אֶל הָעֵדָה זֶה הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהוָה לַעֲשֽׂוֹת׃
translation: Moses said to the congregation, "This is the thing which the LORD has commanded to be done." (Leviticus 8:5)

text: מֶלֶךְ דּוֹר לְנָפַת דּוֹר אֶחָד מֶֽלֶךְ גּוֹיִם לְגִלְגָּל אֶחָֽד׃
translation: the king of Dor in the height of Dor, one; the king of Goiim in Gilgal, one; (Joshua 12:23)

text: תָּבוֹא עַד דּוֹר אֲבוֹתָיו עַד נֵצַח לֹא יִרְאוּ אֽוֹר׃
translation: A man who has riches without understanding, is like the animals that perish. (Psalms 49:20)

text: וְאַתָּה יְהוָה לְעוֹלָם תֵּשֵׁב וְזִכְרְךָ לְדֹר וָדֹֽר׃
translation: You will arise and have mercy on Zion, for it is time to have pity on her. Yes, the set time has come. (Psalms 102:13)

text: אֹמַר אֵלִי אַֽל תַּעֲלֵנִי בַּחֲצִי יָמָי בְּדוֹר דּוֹרִים שְׁנוֹתֶֽיךָ׃
translation: Of old, you laid the foundation of the earth. The heavens are the work of your hands. (Psalms 102:25)

text: וַתֵּחָשֶׁב לוֹ לִצְדָקָה לְדֹר וָדֹר עַד עוֹלָֽם׃
translation: That was credited to him for righteousness, for all generations to come. (Psalms 106:31)

text: יְהוָה שִׁמְךָ לְעוֹלָם יְהוָה זִכְרְךָ לְדֹר וָדֹֽר׃
translation: Your name, LORD, endures forever; your renown, LORD, throughout all generations. (Psalms 135:13)

text: שְׁאָר יָשׁוּב שְׁאָר יַעֲקֹב אֶל אֵל גִּבּֽוֹר׃
translation: A remnant will return, even the remnant of Jacob, to the mighty God. (Isaiah 10:21)

text: כִּי אִם לִשְׁאֵרוֹ הַקָּרֹב אֵלָיו לְאִמּוֹ וּלְאָבִיו וְלִבְנוֹ וּלְבִתּוֹ וּלְאָחִֽיו׃
translation: except for his relatives that are near to him: for his mother, for his father, for his son, for his daughter, for his brother, (Leviticus 21:2)

text: וַיָּמוּתוּ גַם שְׁנֵיהֶם מַחְלוֹן וְכִלְיוֹן וַתִּשָּׁאֵר הָֽאִשָּׁה מִשְּׁנֵי יְלָדֶיהָ וּמֵאִישָֽׁהּ׃
translation: Mahlon and Chilion both died, and the woman was bereaved of her two children and of her husband. (Ruth 1:5)

text: וְהַנִּשְׁאָרִים יִשְׁמְעוּ וְיִרָאוּ וְלֹֽא יֹסִפוּ לַעֲשׂוֹת עוֹד כַּדָּבָר הָרָע הַזֶּה בְּקִרְבֶּֽךָ׃
translation: Those who remain shall hear, and fear, and will never again commit any such evil among you. (Deuteronomy 19:20)

text: מִי יוֹדֵעַ יָשׁוּב וְנִחָם וְהִשְׁאִיר אַֽחֲרָיו בְּרָכָה מִנְחָה וָנֶסֶךְ לַיהוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃
translation: Who knows? He may turn and relent, and leave a blessing behind him, even a meal offering and a drink offering to the LORD, your God. (Joel 2:14)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר אִם יָבוֹא עֵשָׂו אֶל הַמַּחֲנֶה הָאַחַת וְהִכָּהוּ וְהָיָה הַמַּחֲנֶה הַנִּשְׁאָר לִפְלֵיטָֽה׃
translation: Jacob said, "God of my father Abraham, and God of my father Isaac, the LORD, who said to me, 'Return to your country, and to your relatives, and I will do you good,' (Genesis 32:9)

text: וְחִלַּקְתֶּם אֶת הָאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת לָכֶם לְשִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
