translation: "So you shall divide this land to yourselves according to the tribes of Israel. (Ezekiel 47:21)

text: דָּן יָדִין עַמּוֹ כְּאַחַד שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
translation: "Dan will judge his people, as one of the tribes of Israel. (Genesis 49:16)

text: וַיַּשְׁכֵּם יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בַּבֹּקֶר וַיַּקְרֵב אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל לִשְׁבָטָיו וַיִּלָּכֵד שֵׁבֶט יְהוּדָֽה׃
translation: So Joshua rose up early in the morning and brought Israel near by their tribes. The tribe of Judah was selected. (Joshua 7:16)

text: שֶׁשָּׁם עָלוּ שְׁבָטִים שִׁבְטֵי יָהּ עֵדוּת לְיִשְׂרָאֵל לְהֹדוֹת לְשֵׁם יְהוָֽה׃
translation: where the tribes go up, even the LORD's tribes, according to an ordinance for Israel, to give thanks to the LORD's name. (Psalms 122:4)

text: אַתָּה בַּשֵּׁבֶט תַּכֶּנּוּ וְנַפְשׁוֹ מִשְּׁאוֹל תַּצִּֽיל׃
translation: Punish him with the rod, and save his soul from Sheol. (Proverbs 23:14)

text: שָׁבַר יְהוָה מַטֵּה רְשָׁעִים שֵׁבֶט מֹשְׁלִֽים׃
translation: The LORD has broken the staff of the wicked, the scepter of the rulers, (Isaiah 14:5)

text: אַחַת דִּבֶּר אֱלֹהִים שְׁתַּֽיִם זוּ שָׁמָעְתִּי כִּי עֹז לֵאלֹהִֽים׃
translation: Also to you, Lord, belongs loving kindness, for you reward every man according to his work. (Psalms 62:12)

text: אַתָּה הָאֵל עֹשֵׂה פֶלֶא הוֹדַעְתָּ בָעַמִּים עֻזֶּֽךָ׃
translation: You have redeemed your people with your arm, the sons of Jacob and Joseph. Selah. (Psalms 77:15)

text: גֶּֽבֶר חָכָם בַּעוֹז וְאִֽישׁ דַּעַת מְאַמֶּץ כֹּֽחַ׃
translation: A wise man has great power. A knowledgeable man increases strength, (Proverbs 24:5)

text: וְכָל הַנָּשִׁים אֲשֶׁר נָשָׂא לִבָּן אֹתָנָה בְּחָכְמָה טָווּ אֶת הָעִזִּֽים׃
translation: All the women whose heart stirred them up in wisdom spun the goats' hair. (Exodus 35:26)

text: וּשְׂעִיר עִזִּים אֶחָד לְחַטָּאת לַיהוָה עַל עֹלַת הַתָּמִיד יֵעָשֶׂה וְנִסְכּֽוֹ׃
translation: Also, one male goat for a sin offering to the LORD shall be offered in addition to the continual burnt offering and its drink offering. (Numbers 28:15)

text: וּשְׂעִיר עִזִּים אֶחָד חַטָּאת לְכַפֵּר עֲלֵיכֶֽם׃
translation: and one male goat for a sin offering, to make atonement for you; (Numbers 29:5)

text: לַיִשׁ גִּבּוֹר בַּבְּהֵמָה וְלֹא יָשׁוּב מִפְּנֵי כֹֽל׃
translation: The lion, which is mightiest among animals, and doesn't turn away for any; (Proverbs 30:30)

text: וְאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יִתֵּן שְׁכָבְתּוֹ בִּבְהֵמָה מוֹת יוּמָת וְאֶת הַבְּהֵמָה תַּהֲרֹֽגוּ׃
translation: "'If a man lies with an animal, he shall surely be put to death; and you shall kill the animal. (Leviticus 20:15)

text: בָּרוּךְ תִּֽהְיֶה מִכָּל הָעַמִּים לֹא יִהְיֶה בְךָ עָקָר וַֽעֲקָרָה וּבִבְהֶמְתֶּֽךָ׃
translation: You will be blessed above all peoples. There won't be male or female barren among you, or among your livestock. (Deuteronomy 7:14)

text: צֹנֶה וַאֲלָפִים כֻּלָּם וְגַם בַּהֲמוֹת שָׂדָֽי׃
translation: the birds of the sky, the fish of the sea, and whatever passes through the paths of the seas. (Psalms 8:8)

text: וַיְבָרֲכֵם וַיִּרְבּוּ מְאֹד וּבְהֶמְתָּם לֹא יַמְעִֽיט׃
translation: He blesses them also, so that they are multiplied greatly. He doesn't allow their livestock to decrease. (Psalms 107:38)

text: שֶֽׁהִכָּה בְּכוֹרֵי מִצְרָיִם מֵאָדָם עַד בְּהֵמָֽה׃
translation: He struck the firstborn of Egypt, both of man and animal. (Psalms 135:8)

text: שָׁמוֹר אֶת יוֹם הַשַׁבָּת לְקַדְּשׁוֹ כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוְּךָ יְהוָה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ׃
translation: "Observe the Sabbath day, to keep it holy, as the LORD your God commanded you. (Deuteronomy 5:12)

text: אִישׁ אִמּוֹ וְאָבִיו תִּירָאוּ וְאֶת שַׁבְּתֹתַי תִּשְׁמֹרוּ אֲנִי יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃
translation: "'Each one of you shall respect his mother and his father. You shall keep my Sabbaths. I am the LORD your God. (Leviticus 19:3)

text: וַיְהִי כִּשְׁמֹעַ בַּעְשָׁא וַיֶּחְדַּל מִבְּנוֹת אֶת הָרָמָה וַיַּשְׁבֵּת אֶת מְלַאכְתּֽוֹ׃
translation: When Baasha heard of it, he stopped building Ramah, and let his work cease. (2 Chronicles 16:5)

text: וְהִשְׁבַּתִּי זִמָּה מִן הָאָרֶץ וְנִֽוַּסְּרוּ כָּל הַנָּשִׁים וְלֹא תַעֲשֶׂינָה כְּזִמַּתְכֶֽנָה׃
translation: "'Thus I will cause lewdness to cease out of the land, that all women may be taught not to be lewd like you. (Ezekiel 23:48)

text: וְהִשְׁתַּחֲווּ עַם הָאָרֶץ פֶּתַח הַשַּׁעַר הַהוּא בַּשַּׁבָּתוֹת וּבֶחֳדָשִׁים לִפְנֵי יְהוָֽה׃
translation: The people of the land shall worship at the door of that gate before the LORD on the Sabbaths and on the new moons. (Ezekiel 46:3)

text: זָכוֹר אֶת יוֹם הַשַּׁבָּת לְקַדְּשֽׁוֹ׃
translation: "Remember the Sabbath day, to keep it holy. (Exodus 20:8)

text: אָז לֹא אֵבוֹשׁ בְּהַבִּיטִי אֶל כָּל מִצְוֺתֶֽיךָ׃
translation: Then I wouldn't be disappointed, when I consider all of your commandments. (Psalms 119:6)

text: בְּנִי אִם תִּקַּח אֲמָרָי וּמִצְוֺתַי תִּצְפֹּן אִתָּֽךְ׃
translation: My son, if you will receive my words, and store up my commandments within you, (Proverbs 2:1)

text: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם מִצְוֺתַי וַעֲשִׂיתֶם אֹתָם אֲנִי יְהוָֽה׃
translation: "Therefore you shall keep my commandments, and do them. I am the LORD. (Leviticus 22:31)

text: וְאִם לֹא תִשְׁמְעוּ לִי וְלֹא תַעֲשׂוּ אֵת כָּל הַמִּצְוֺת הָאֵֽלֶּה׃
translation: "'But if you will not listen to me, and will not do all these commandments, (Leviticus 26:14)

text: שָׁמוֹר תִּשְׁמְרוּן אֶת מִצְוֺת יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם וְעֵדֹתָיו וְחֻקָּיו אֲשֶׁר צִוָּֽךְ׃
translation: You shall diligently keep the commandments of the LORD your God, and his testimonies, and his statutes, which he has commanded you. (Deuteronomy 6:17)

text: וּנְתָנָם יְהוָה לִפְנֵיכֶם וַעֲשִׂיתֶם לָהֶם כְּכָל הַמִּצְוָה אֲשֶׁר צִוִּיתִי אֶתְכֶֽם׃
translation: The LORD will deliver them up before you, and you shall do to them according to all the commandment which I have commanded you. (Deuteronomy 31:5)

text: וּמִבְּנֵי בָּנִי מְשֻׁלָּם מַלּוּךְ וַעֲדָיָה יָשׁוּב וּשְׁאָל ירמות וְרָמֽוֹת׃
translation: Of the sons of Bani: Meshullam, Malluch, Adaiah, Jashub, Sheal, and Jeremoth. (Ezra 10:29)

text: חַיִּים שָׁאַל מִמְּךָ נָתַתָּה לּוֹ אֹרֶךְ יָמִים עוֹלָם וָעֶֽד׃
translation: His glory is great in your salvation. You lay honor and majesty on him. (Psalms 21:5)

text: אֲדֹנִי שָׁאַל אֶת עֲבָדָיו לֵאמֹר הֲיֵשׁ לָכֶם אָב אוֹ אָֽח׃
translation: My lord asked his servants, saying, 'Have you a father, or a brother?' (Genesis 44:19)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר לּוֹ מַלְאַךְ יְהוָה לָמָּה זֶּה תִּשְׁאַל לִשְׁמִי וְהוּא פֶלִאי׃
translation: The LORD's angel said to him, "Why do you ask about my name, since it is incomprehensible?" (Judges 13:18)

text: וַיִּיטַב הַדָּבָר בְּעֵינֵי אֲדֹנָי כִּי שָׁאַל שְׁלֹמֹה אֶת הַדָּבָר הַזֶּֽה׃
translation: This request pleased the Lord, that Solomon had asked this thing. (1 Kings 3:10)

text: וַתֹּאמֶר הֲשָׁאַלְתִּי בֵן מֵאֵת אֲדֹנִי הֲלֹא אָמַרְתִּי לֹא תַשְׁלֶה אֹתִֽי׃
translation: Then she said, "Did I ask you for a son, my lord? Didn't I say, 'Do not deceive me'?" (2 Kings 4:28)

text: וַיִּסְעוּ בָּרִאשֹׁנָה עַל פִּי יְהוָה בְּיַד מֹשֶֽׁה׃
translation: They first went forward according to the commandment of the LORD by Moses. (Numbers 10:13)

text: הַחֹדֶשׁ הַזֶּה לָכֶם רֹאשׁ חֳדָשִׁים רִאשׁוֹן הוּא לָכֶם לְחָדְשֵׁי הַשָּׁנָֽה׃
translation: "This month shall be to you the beginning of months. It shall be the first month of the year to you. (Exodus 12:2)

text: וַיֵּצֵא הַגּוֹרָל הָרִאשׁוֹן לִיהוֹיָרִיב לִֽידַעְיָה הַשֵּׁנִֽי׃
translation: Now the first lot came out to Jehoiarib, the second to Jedaiah, (1 Chronicles 24:7)

text: הֲרִאישׁוֹן אָדָם תִּוָּלֵד וְלִפְנֵי גְבָעוֹת חוֹלָֽלְתָּ׃
translation: "Are you the first man who was born? Or were you brought out before the hills? (Job 15:7)

text: אָבִיךָ הָרִאשׁוֹן חָטָא וּמְלִיצֶיךָ פָּשְׁעוּ בִֽי׃
translation: Your first father sinned, and your teachers have transgressed against me. (Isaiah 43:27)

text: כִּסֵּא כָבוֹד מָרוֹם מֵֽרִאשׁוֹן מְקוֹם מִקְדָּשֵֽׁנוּ׃
translation: A glorious throne, set on high from the beginning, is the place of our sanctuary. (Jeremiah 17:12)

text: דִּבְרֵי פִי חָכָם חֵן וְשִׂפְתוֹת כְּסִיל תְּבַלְּעֶֽנּוּ׃
translation: The words of a wise man's mouth are gracious; but a fool is swallowed by his own lips. (Ecclesiastes 10:12)

text: שִׁמְעוּ נָא תוֹכַחְתִּי וְרִבוֹת שְׂפָתַי הַקְשִֽׁיבוּ׃
translation: Hear now my reasoning. Listen to the pleadings of my lips. (Job 13:6)

text: אֲאַמִּצְכֶם בְּמוֹ פִי וְנִיד שְׂפָתַי יַחְשֹֽׂךְ׃
translation: but I would strengthen you with my mouth. The solace of my lips would relieve you. (Job 16:5)

text: נְצֹר לְשׁוֹנְךָ מֵרָע וּשְׂפָתֶיךָ מִדַּבֵּר מִרְמָֽה׃
translation: Depart from evil, and do good. Seek peace, and pursue it. (Psalms 34:14)

text: אֲדֹנָי שְׂפָתַי תִּפְתָּח וּפִי יַגִּיד תְּהִלָּתֶֽךָ׃
translation: The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit. O God, you will not despise a broken and contrite heart. (Psalms 51:17)

text: תַּבַּעְנָה שְׂפָתַי תְּהִלָּה כִּי תְלַמְּדֵנִי חֻקֶּֽיךָ׃
translation: Let my lips utter praise, for you teach me your statutes. (Psalms 119:171)

text: זְכֹר כִּֽי תַשְׂגִּיא פָעֳלוֹ אֲשֶׁר שֹׁרְרוּ אֲנָשִֽׁים׃
translation: "Remember that you magnify his work, about which men have sung. (Job 36:24)

text: מַמְלְכוֹת הָאָרֶץ שִׁירוּ לֵאלֹהִים זַמְּרוּ אֲדֹנָי סֶֽלָה׃
translation: to him who rides on the heaven of heavens, which are of old; behold, he utters his voice, a mighty voice. (Psalms 68:33)

text: שִֽׁירוּ לוֹ זַמְּרוּ לוֹ שִׂיחוּ בְּכָל נִפְלְאוֹתָֽיו׃
translation: Sing to him, sing praises to him! Tell of all his marvelous works. (Psalms 105:2)

text: הַֽמְשֹׁרְרִים בְּנֵי אָסָף מֵאָה עֶשְׂרִים וּשְׁמֹנָֽה׃
translation: The singers: the children of Asaph, one hundred twenty-eight. (Ezra 2:41)

text: הַֽמְשֹׁרְרִים בְּנֵי אָסָף מֵאָה אַרְבָּעִים וּשְׁמֹנָֽה׃
translation: The singers: the children of Asaph: one hundred forty-eight. (Nehemiah 7:44)

text: לַמְנַצֵּחַ לִבְנֵי קֹרַח עַֽל עֲלָמוֹת שִֽׁיר׃
translation: For the Chief Musician. By the sons of Korah. According to Alamoth. God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble. (Psalms 46:1)

text: וַיָּשָׁב שְׁמוּאֵל אַחֲרֵי שָׁאוּל וַיִּשְׁתַּחוּ שָׁאוּל לַֽיהוָֽה׃
translation: So Samuel went back with Saul; and Saul worshiped the LORD. (1 Samuel 15:31)

text: וְיִשְׁתַּחֲווּ לוֹ כָל מְלָכִים כָּל גּוֹיִם יַֽעַבְדֽוּהוּ׃
translation: Yes, all kings shall fall down before him. All nations shall serve him. (Psalms 72:11)

text: דְּאָגָה בְלֶב אִישׁ יַשְׁחֶנָּה וְדָבָר טוֹב יְשַׂמְּחֶֽנָּה׃
translation: Anxiety in a man's heart weighs it down, but a kind word makes it glad. (Proverbs 12:25)

text: וַיְהִי כַּאֲשֶׁר שָׁמַע עֶבֶד אַבְרָהָם אֶת דִּבְרֵיהֶם וַיִּשְׁתַּחוּ אַרְצָה לַֽיהוָֽה׃
translation: When Abraham's servant heard their words, he bowed himself down to the earth to the LORD. (Genesis 24:52)

text: וַתִּגַּשׁ גַּם לֵאָה וִילָדֶיהָ וַיִּֽשְׁתַּחֲווּ וְאַחַר נִגַּשׁ יוֹסֵף וְרָחֵל וַיִּֽשְׁתַּחֲוֽוּ׃
translation: Leah also and her children came near, and bowed themselves. After them, Joseph came near with Rachel, and they bowed themselves. (Genesis 33:7)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר הִשָּֽׁבְעָה לִי וַיִּשָּׁבַע לוֹ וַיִּשְׁתַּחוּ יִשְׂרָאֵל עַל רֹאשׁ הַמִּטָּֽה׃
translation: Israel said, "Swear to me," and he swore to him. Then Israel bowed himself on the bed's head. (Genesis 47:31)

text: שָׁמְעָה וַתִּשְׂמַח צִיּוֹן וַתָּגֵלְנָה בְּנוֹת יְהוּדָה לְמַעַן מִשְׁפָּטֶיךָ יְהוָֽה׃
translation: Zion heard and was glad. The daughters of Judah rejoiced because of your judgments, LORD. (Psalms 97:8)

text: וַיִּשְׂמְחוּ כִֽי יִשְׁתֹּקוּ וַיַּנְחֵם אֶל מְחוֹז חֶפְצָֽם׃
translation: Then they are glad because it is calm, so he brings them to their desired haven. (Psalms 107:30)

text: זֶה הַיּוֹם עָשָׂה יְהוָה נָגִילָה וְנִשְׂמְחָה בֽוֹ׃
translation: This is the day that the LORD has made. We will rejoice and be glad in it! (Psalms 118:24)

text: יִשְׂמַח יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּעֹשָׂיו בְּנֵֽי צִיּוֹן יָגִילוּ בְמַלְכָּֽם׃
translation: Let Israel rejoice in him who made them. Let the children of Zion be joyful in their King. (Psalms 149:2)

text: פִּקּוּדֵי יְהוָה יְשָׁרִים מְשַׂמְּחֵי לֵב מִצְוַת יְהוָה בָּרָה מְאִירַת עֵינָֽיִם׃
translation: The fear of the LORD is clean, enduring forever. The LORD's ordinances are true, and righteous altogether. (Psalms 19:9)

text: אָגִילָה וְאֶשְׂמְחָה בְּחַסְדֶּךָ אֲשֶׁר רָאִיתָ אֶת עָנְיִי יָדַעְתָּ בְּצָרוֹת נַפְשִֽׁי׃
translation: You have not shut me up into the hand of the enemy. You have set my feet in a large place. (Psalms 31:8)

text: לְהָשִׁיב נַפְשׁוֹ מִנִּי שָׁחַת לֵאוֹר בְּאוֹר הַֽחַיִּים׃
translation: to bring back his soul from the pit, that he may be enlightened with the light of the living. (Job 33:30)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֱלֹהִים יְהִי אוֹר וַֽיְהִי אֽוֹר׃
translation: God said, "Let there be light," and there was light. (Genesis 1:3)

text: הַבֹּקֶר אוֹר וְהָאֲנָשִׁים שֻׁלְּחוּ הֵמָּה וַחֲמֹרֵיהֶֽם׃
translation: As soon as the morning was light, the men were sent away, they and their donkeys. (Genesis 44:3)

text: חֹֽק חָג עַל פְּנֵי מָיִם עַד תַּכְלִית אוֹר עִם חֹֽשֶׁךְ׃
translation: He has described a boundary on the surface of the waters, and to the confines of light and darkness. (Job 26:10)

text: רַבִּים אֹמְרִים מִֽי יַרְאֵנוּ טוֹב נְֽסָה עָלֵינוּ אוֹר פָּנֶיךָ יְהוָֽה׃
translation: You have put gladness in my heart, more than when their grain and their new wine are increased. (Psalms 4:7)

text: הָאִירָה פָנֶיךָ עַל עַבְדֶּךָ הוֹשִׁיעֵנִי בְחַסְדֶּֽךָ׃
translation: Let me not be disappointed, LORD, for I have called on you. Let the wicked be disappointed. Let them be silent in Sheol. (Psalms 31:17)

text: מֶלֶךְ תִּרְצָה אֶחָד כָּל מְלָכִים שְׁלֹשִׁים וְאֶחָֽד׃
translation: the king of Tirzah, one: all the kings thirty-one. (Joshua 12:24)

text: בְּנֵי סְנָאָה שְׁלֹשֶׁת אֲלָפִים תְּשַׁע מֵאוֹת וּשְׁלֹשִֽׁים׃
translation: The children of Senaah: three thousand nine hundred thirty. (Nehemiah 7:38)

text: עֲשָׂה אֵל אֲחִֽי יוֹאָב בַּשְּׁלֹשִׁים אֶלְחָנָן בֶּן דֹּדוֹ בֵּית לָֽחֶם׃
translation: Asahel the brother of Joab was one of the thirty: Elhanan the son of Dodo of Bethlehem, (2 Samuel 23:24)

text: בֶּן שְׁלֹשִׁים וּשְׁתַּיִם שָׁנָה יְהוֹרָם בְּמָלְכוֹ וּשְׁמוֹנֶה שָׁנִים מָלַךְ בִּירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
translation: Jehoram was thirty-two years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eight years in Jerusalem. (2 Chronicles 21:5)

text: בֶּן שְׁמוֹנֶה שָׁנִים יֹאשִׁיָּהוּ בְמָלְכוֹ וּשְׁלֹשִׁים וְאַחַת שָׁנָה מָלַךְ בִּירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
translation: Josiah was eight years old when he began to reign, and he reigned thirty-one years in Jerusalem. (2 Chronicles 34:1)

text: בִּשְׁנַת שְׁמוֹנֶה עֶשְׂרֵה לִנְבֽוּכַדְרֶאצַּר מִירוּשָׁלִַם נֶפֶשׁ שְׁמֹנֶה מֵאוֹת שְׁלֹשִׁים וּשְׁנָֽיִם׃
translation: in the eighteenth year of Nebuchadnezzar, he carried away captive from Jerusalem eight hundred thirty-two persons; (Jeremiah 52:29)

text: שָׂנֵאתִי קְהַל מְרֵעִים וְעִם רְשָׁעִים לֹא אֵשֵֽׁב׃
translation: I hate the assembly of evildoers, and will not sit with the wicked. (Psalms 26:5)

text: תְּמוֹתֵת רָשָׁע רָעָה וְשֹׂנְאֵי צַדִּיק יֶאְשָֽׁמוּ׃
translation: The LORD redeems the soul of his servants. None of those who take refuge in him shall be condemned. (Psalms 34:22)

text: אֹהֲבֵי יְהוָה שִׂנְאוּ רָע שֹׁמֵר נַפְשׁוֹת חֲסִידָיו מִיַּד רְשָׁעִים יַצִּילֵֽם׃
translation: You who love the LORD, hate evil! He preserves the souls of his saints. He delivers them out of the hand of the wicked. (Psalms 97:10)

text: וַֽיּוֹשִׁיעֵם מִיַּד שׂוֹנֵא וַיִּגְאָלֵם מִיַּד אוֹיֵֽב׃
translation: He saved them from the hand of him who hated them, and redeemed them from the hand of the enemy. (Psalms 106:10)

text: וַיִּתְּנֵם בְּיַד גּוֹיִם וַֽיִּמְשְׁלוּ בָהֶם שֹׂנְאֵיהֶֽם׃
translation: He gave them into the hand of the nations. Those who hated them ruled over them. (Psalms 106:41)

text: יְהוָה לִי בְּעֹזְרָי וַאֲנִי אֶרְאֶה בְשֹׂנְאָֽי׃
translation: The LORD is on my side among those who help me. Therefore I will look in triumph at those who hate me. (Psalms 118:7)

text: לַשַּׁחַת קָרָאתִי אָבִי אָתָּה אִמִּי וַאֲחֹתִי לָֽרִמָּֽה׃
translation: if I have said to corruption, 'You are my father,' and to the worm, 'My mother,' and 'My sister,' (Job 17:14)

text: יַחְשֹׂךְ נַפְשׁוֹ מִנִּי שָׁחַת וְחַיָּתוֹ מֵעֲבֹר בַּשָּֽׁלַח׃
translation: He keeps back his soul from the pit, and his life from perishing by the sword. (Job 33:18)

text: וַיַּעַן יוֹאָב וַיֹּאמַר חָלִילָה חָלִילָה לִי אִם אֲבַלַּע וְאִם אַשְׁחִֽית׃
translation: Joab answered, "Far be it, far be it from me, that I should swallow up or destroy. (2 Samuel 20:20)

text: וִֽיחִי עוֹד לָנֶצַח לֹא יִרְאֶה הַשָּֽׁחַת׃
translation: For he sees that wise men die; likewise the fool and the senseless perish, and leave their wealth to others. (Psalms 49:10)

text: וַתִּקְרַב לַשַּׁחַת נַפְשׁוֹ וְחַיָּתוֹ לַֽמְמִתִֽים׃
translation: Yes, his soul draws near to the pit, and his life to the destroyers. (Job 33:22)

text: קוּמוּ וְנַעֲלֶה בַלָּיְלָה וְנַשְׁחִיתָה אַרְמְנוֹתֶֽיהָ׃
translation: Arise! Let's go up by night, and let's destroy her palaces." (Jeremiah 6:5)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה כָּבֵד לֵב פַּרְעֹה מֵאֵן לְשַׁלַּח הָעָֽם׃
translation: The LORD said to Moses, "Pharaoh's heart is stubborn. He refuses to let the people go. (Exodus 7:14)

text: וַתִּכְבַּד הַמִּלְחָמָה עַל שָׁאוּל וַיִּמְצָאֻהוּ הַמּוֹרִים בַּקָּשֶׁת וַיָּחֶל מִן הַיּוֹרִֽים׃
translation: The battle went hard against Saul, and the archers overtook him; and he was distressed by reason of the archers. (1 Chronicles 10:3)

text: כָּל גּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר עָשִׂיתָ יָבוֹאוּ וְיִשְׁתַּחֲווּ לְפָנֶיךָ אֲדֹנָי וִֽיכַבְּדוּ לִשְׁמֶֽךָ׃
translation: All nations you have made will come and worship before you, Lord. They shall glorify your name. (Psalms 86:9)

text: נִכְבָּדוֹת מְדֻבָּר בָּךְ עִיר הָאֱלֹהִים סֶֽלָה׃
translation: Glorious things are spoken about you, city of God. Selah. (Psalms 87:3)

text: יָסַפְתָּ לַגּוֹי יְהוָה יָסַפְתָּ לַגּוֹי נִכְבָּדְתָּ רִחַקְתָּ כָּל קַצְוֵי אָֽרֶץ׃
translation: You have increased the nation, O LORD. You have increased the nation! You are glorified! You have enlarged all the borders of the land. (Isaiah 26:15)

text: גָּדַר בַּעֲדִי וְלֹא אֵצֵא הִכְבִּיד נְחָשְׁתִּֽי׃
translation: He has walled me about, so that I can't go out. He has made my chain heavy. (Lamentations 3:7)

text: הוֹשִׁיעָה אֶת עַמֶּךָ וּבָרֵךְ אֶת נַחֲלָתֶךָ וּֽרְעֵם וְנַשְּׂאֵם עַד הָעוֹלָֽם׃
translation: Save your people, and bless your inheritance. Be their shepherd also, and bear them up forever. (Psalms 28:9)

text: אַל תִּתְרַע אֶת בַּעַל אָף וְאֶת אִישׁ חֵמוֹת לֹא תָבֽוֹא׃
translation: Don't befriend a hot-tempered man. Don't associate with one who harbors anger, (Proverbs 22:24)

text: דִּבְרֵי חֲכָמִים כַּדָּרְבֹנוֹת וּֽכְמַשְׂמְרוֹת נְטוּעִים בַּעֲלֵי אֲסֻפּוֹת נִתְּנוּ מֵרֹעֶה אֶחָֽד׃
translation: The words of the wise are like goads; and like nails well fastened are words from the masters of assemblies, which are given from one shepherd. (Ecclesiastes 12:11)

text: דּוֹדִי לִי וַאֲנִי לוֹ הָרֹעֶה בַּשּׁוֹשַׁנִּֽים׃
translation: My beloved is mine, and I am his. He browses among the lilies. (Song of Solomon 2:16)

text: אֲנִי לְדוֹדִי וְדוֹדִי לִי הָרֹעֶה בַּשׁוֹשַׁנִּֽים׃
translation: I am my beloved's, and my beloved is mine. He browses among the lilies. (Song of Solomon 6:3)

text: לָכֵן רֹעִים שִׁמְעוּ אֶת דְּבַר יְהוָֽה׃
translation: "'Therefore, you shepherds, hear the LORD's word: (Ezekiel 34:7)

text: וַאֲבִימֶלֶךְ לֹא קָרַב אֵלֶיהָ וַיֹּאמַר אֲדֹנָי הֲגוֹי גַּם צַדִּיק תַּהֲרֹֽג׃
translation: Now Abimelech had not come near her. He said, "Lord, will you kill even a righteous nation? (Genesis 20:4)

text: אִם הֲרָגָם וּדְרָשׁוּהוּ וְשָׁבוּ וְשִֽׁחֲרוּ אֵֽל׃
translation: When he killed them, then they inquired after him. They returned and sought God earnestly. (Psalms 78:34)

text: וַֽיִּצְבְּאוּ עַל מִדְיָן כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה וַיַּֽהַרְגוּ כָּל זָכָֽר׃
translation: They fought against Midian, as the LORD commanded Moses. They killed every male. (Numbers 31:7)

text: וְהָיָה כִּֽי יִרְאוּ אֹתָךְ הַמִּצְרִים וְאָמְרוּ אִשְׁתּוֹ זֹאת וְהָרְגוּ אֹתִי וְאֹתָךְ יְחַיּֽוּ׃
translation: It will happen that when the Egyptians see you, they will say, 'This is his wife.' They will kill me, but they will save you alive. (Genesis 12:12)

text: כִּי הָרֹג תַּֽהַרְגֶנּוּ יָֽדְךָ תִּֽהְיֶה בּוֹ בָרִֽאשׁוֹנָה לַהֲמִיתוֹ וְיַד כָּל הָעָם בָּאַחֲרֹנָֽה׃
translation: You shall stone him to death with stones, because he has sought to draw you away from the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage. (Deuteronomy 13:10)

text: וַיָּשֶׁב אֱלֹהִים אֵת רָעַת אֲבִימֶלֶךְ אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה לְאָבִיו לַהֲרֹג אֶת שִׁבְעִים אֶחָֽיו׃
translation: Thus God repaid the wickedness of Abimelech, which he did to his father in killing his seventy brothers; (Judges 9:56)

text: הֵן אַתֶּם מֵאַיִן וּפָעָלְכֶם מֵאָפַע תּוֹעֵבָה יִבְחַר בָּכֶֽם׃
translation: Behold, you are nothing, and your work is nothing. He who chooses you is an abomination. (Isaiah 41:24)

text: מִשְׁפָּט נִבְחֲרָה לָּנוּ נֵדְעָה בֵינֵינוּ מַה טּֽוֹב׃
translation: Let us choose for us that which is right. Let us know among ourselves what is good. (Job 34:4)

text: שָׁלַח מֹשֶׁה עַבְדּוֹ אַהֲרֹן אֲשֶׁר בָּֽחַר בּֽוֹ׃
translation: He sent Moses, his servant, and Aaron, whom he had chosen. (Psalms 105:26)

text: וְעַתָּה שְׁמַע יַעֲקֹב עַבְדִּי וְיִשְׂרָאֵל בָּחַרְתִּי בֽוֹ׃
translation: Yet listen now, Jacob my servant, and Israel, whom I have chosen. (Isaiah 44:1)

text: וַיִּסְעוּ מִבְּנֵי יַעֲקָן וַֽיַּחֲנוּ בְּחֹר הַגִּדְגָּֽד׃
translation: They traveled from Bene Jaakan, and encamped in Hor Haggidgad. (Numbers 33:32)

text: הִשָּׁמֶר אַל תֵּפֶן אֶל אָוֶן כִּֽי עַל זֶה בָּחַרְתָּ מֵעֹֽנִי׃
translation: Take heed, don't regard iniquity; for you have chosen this rather than affliction. (Job 36:21)

text: שֵׁשֶׁת יָמִים תַּֽעֲבֹד וְעָשִׂיתָ כָּל מְלַאכְתֶּֽךָ׃
translation: You shall labor six days, and do all your work; (Deuteronomy 5:13)

text: וּמְלָאכָה רַבָּה הָיָה לוֹ בְּעָרֵי יְהוּדָה וְאַנְשֵׁי מִלְחָמָה גִּבּוֹרֵי חַיִל בִּירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
translation: He had many works in the cities of Judah; and men of war, mighty men of valor, in Jerusalem. (2 Chronicles 17:13)

text: חָזִיתָ אִישׁ מָהִיר בִּמְלַאכְתּוֹ לִֽפְנֵֽי מְלָכִים יִתְיַצָּב בַּל יִתְיַצֵּב לִפְנֵי חֲשֻׁכִּֽים׃
translation: Do you see a man skilled in his work? He will serve kings. He won't serve obscure men. (Proverbs 22:29)

text: וְאֶת עַבְדֵיכֶם וְֽאֶת שִׁפְחוֹתֵיכֶם וְאֶת בַּחוּרֵיכֶם הַטּוֹבִים וְאֶת חֲמוֹרֵיכֶם יִקָּח וְעָשָׂה לִמְלַאכְתּֽוֹ׃
translation: He will take your male servants, your female servants, your best young men, and your donkeys, and assign them to his own work. (1 Samuel 8:16)

text: וַיִּֽתְנַדְּבוּ שָׂרֵי הָאָבוֹת וְשָׂרֵי שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְשָׂרֵי הָאֲלָפִים וְהַמֵּאוֹת וּלְשָׂרֵי מְלֶאכֶת הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
translation: Then the princes of the fathers' households, and the princes of the tribes of Israel, and the captains of thousands and of hundreds, with the rulers over the king's work, offered willingly; (1 Chronicles 29:6)

text: וַאֲנִי קִֽרֲבַת אֱלֹהִים לִי טוֹב שַׁתִּי בַּאדֹנָי יְהֹוִה מַחְסִי לְסַפֵּר כָּל מַלְאֲכוֹתֶֽיךָ׃
translation: But it is good for me to come close to God. I have made the Lord GOD my refuge, that I may tell of all your works. (Psalms 73:28)

text: הַלְלוּ יָהּ הַלְלוּ עַבְדֵי יְהוָה הַֽלְלוּ אֶת שֵׁם יְהוָֽה׃
translation: Praise the LORD! Praise, you servants of the LORD, praise the LORD's name. (Psalms 113:1)

text: כִּי גָבַר עָלֵינוּ חַסְדּוֹ וֶֽאֱמֶת יְהוָה לְעוֹלָם הַֽלְלוּ יָֽהּ׃
translation: For his loving kindness is great toward us. The LORD's faithfulness endures forever. Praise the LORD! (Psalms 117:2)

text: הַלְלוּ יָהּ הַֽלְלוּ אֶת שֵׁם יְהוָה הַֽלְלוּ עַבְדֵי יְהוָֽה׃
translation: Praise the LORD! Praise the LORD's name! Praise him, you servants of the LORD, (Psalms 135:1)

text: בָּרוּךְ יְהוָה מִצִּיּוֹן שֹׁכֵן יְֽרוּשָׁלִָם הַֽלְלוּ יָֽהּ׃
translation: Blessed be the LORD from Zion, who dwells in Jerusalem. Praise the LORD! (Psalms 135:21)

text: בְּכָל יוֹם אֲבָרֲכֶךָּ וַאֲהַלְלָה שִׁמְךָ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶֽד׃
translation: Every day I will praise you. I will extol your name forever and ever. (Psalms 145:2)

text: יִמְלֹךְ יְהוָה לְעוֹלָם אֱלֹהַיִךְ צִיּוֹן לְדֹר וָדֹר הַֽלְלוּ יָֽהּ׃
translation: The LORD will reign forever; your God, O Zion, to all generations. Praise the LORD! (Psalms 146:10)

text: וְדָרְשׁוּ הַשֹּׁפְטִים הֵיטֵב וְהִנֵּה עֵֽד שֶׁקֶר הָעֵד שֶׁקֶר עָנָה בְאָחִֽיו׃
translation: and the judges shall make diligent inquisition; and behold, if the witness is a false witness, and has testified falsely against his brother, (Deuteronomy 19:18)

text: דִּרְשׁוּ יְהוָה וְעֻזּוֹ בַּקְּשׁוּ פָנָיו תָּמִֽיד׃
translation: Seek the LORD and his strength. Seek his face forever more. (1 Chronicles 16:11)

text: דִּרְשׁוּ יְהוָה וְעֻזּוֹ בַּקְּשׁוּ פָנָיו תָּמִֽיד׃
translation: Seek the LORD and his strength. Seek his face forever more. (Psalms 105:4)

text: גְּדֹלִים מַעֲשֵׂי יְהוָה דְּרוּשִׁים לְכָל חֶפְצֵיהֶֽם׃
translation: The LORD's works are great, pondered by all those who delight in them. (Psalms 111:2)

text: אַשְׁרֵי נֹצְרֵי עֵדֹתָיו בְּכָל לֵב יִדְרְשֽׁוּהוּ׃
translation: Blessed are those who keep his statutes, who seek him with their whole heart. (Psalms 119:2)

text: בְּכָל לִבִּי דְרַשְׁתִּיךָ אַל תַּשְׁגֵּנִי מִמִּצְוֺתֶֽיךָ׃
translation: With my whole heart I have sought you. Don't let me wander from your commandments. (Psalms 119:10)

text: מִי חָכָם וְיִשְׁמָר אֵלֶּה וְיִתְבּֽוֹנְנוּ חַֽסְדֵי יְהוָֽה׃
translation: Whoever is wise will pay attention to these things. They will consider the loving kindnesses of the LORD. (Psalms 107:43)

text: אַל תְּהִי חָכָם בְּעֵינֶיךָ יְרָא אֶת יְהוָה וְסוּר מֵרָֽע׃
translation: Don't be wise in your own eyes. Fear the LORD, and depart from evil. (Proverbs 3:7)

text: שְׁמַע אַתָּה בְנִי וַחֲכָם וְאַשֵּׁר בַּדֶּרֶךְ לִבֶּֽךָ׃
translation: Listen, my son, and be wise, and keep your heart on the right path! (Proverbs 23:19)

text: עֲנֵה כְסִיל כְּאִוַּלְתּוֹ פֶּן יִהְיֶה חָכָם בְּעֵינָֽיו׃
translation: Answer a fool according to his folly, lest he be wise in his own eyes. (Proverbs 26:5)

text: אַרְבָּעָה הֵם קְטַנֵּי אָרֶץ וְהֵמָּה חֲכָמִים מְחֻכָּמִֽים׃
translation: "There are four things which are little on the earth, but they are exceedingly wise: (Proverbs 30:24)

text: לֹֽא רַבִּים יֶחְכָּמוּ וּזְקֵנִים יָבִינוּ מִשְׁפָּֽט׃
translation: It is not the great who are wise, nor the aged who understand justice. (Job 32:9)

text: הַֽאֵינְךָ רֹאֶה מָה הֵמָּה עֹשִׂים בְּעָרֵי יְהוּדָה וּבְחֻצוֹת יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
translation: Don't you see what they do in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem? (Jeremiah 7:17)

text: וַיַּרְא חָם אֲבִי כְנַעַן אֵת עֶרְוַת אָבִיו וַיַּגֵּד לִשְׁנֵֽי אֶחָיו בַּחֽוּץ׃
translation: Ham, the father of Canaan, saw the nakedness of his father, and told his two brothers outside. (Genesis 9:22)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר בּוֹא בְּרוּךְ יְהוָה לָמָּה תַעֲמֹד בַּחוּץ וְאָנֹכִי פִּנִּיתִי הַבַּיִת וּמָקוֹם לַגְּמַלִּֽים׃
translation: He said, "Come in, you blessed of the LORD. Why do you stand outside? For I have prepared the house, and room for the camels." (Genesis 24:31)

text: וַתִּסָּגֵר מִרְיָם מִחוּץ לַֽמַּחֲנֶה שִׁבְעַת יָמִים וְהָעָם לֹא נָסַע עַד הֵאָסֵף מִרְיָֽם׃
translation: Miriam was shut up outside of the camp seven days, and the people didn't travel until Miriam was brought in again. (Numbers 12:15)

text: מִכָּל צֹרְרַי הָיִיתִי חֶרְפָּה וְלִשֲׁכֵנַי מְאֹד וּפַחַד לִֽמְיֻדָּעָי רֹאַי בַּחוּץ נָדְדוּ מִמֶּֽנִּי׃
translation: I am forgotten from their hearts like a dead man. I am like broken pottery. (Psalms 31:12)

text: וְאִם בָּא לִרְאוֹת שָׁוְא יְדַבֵּר לִבּוֹ יִקְבָּץ אָוֶן לוֹ יֵצֵא לַחוּץ יְדַבֵּֽר׃
translation: All who hate me whisper together against me. They imagine the worst for me. (Psalms 41:7)

text: וַיִּפֶן אַחֲרָיו וַיִּרְאֵנִי וַיִּקְרָא אֵלָי וָאֹמַר הִנֵּֽנִי׃
translation: When he looked behind him, he saw me and called to me. I answered, 'Here I am.' (2 Samuel 1:7)

text: וַיִּפֶן אַבְנֵר אַֽחֲרָיו וַיֹּאמֶר הַאַתָּה זֶה עֲשָׂהאֵל וַיֹּאמֶר אָנֹֽכִי׃
translation: Then Abner looked behind him and said, "Is that you, Asahel?" He answered, "It is." (2 Samuel 2:20)

text: וַיִּפְנוּ מִשָּׁם הָֽאֲנָשִׁים וַיֵּלְכוּ סְדֹמָה וְאַבְרָהָם עוֹדֶנּוּ עֹמֵד לִפְנֵי יְהוָֽה׃
translation: The men turned from there, and went toward Sodom, but Abraham stood yet before the LORD. (Genesis 18:22)

text: פִּנִּיתָ לְפָנֶיהָ וַתַּשְׁרֵשׁ שָׁרָשֶׁיהָ וַתְּמַלֵּא אָֽרֶץ׃
translation: The mountains were covered with its shadow. Its boughs were like God's cedars. (Psalms 80:10)

text: פְּנֵה אֵלַי וְחָנֵּנִי כְּמִשְׁפָּט לְאֹהֲבֵי שְׁמֶֽךָ׃
translation: Turn to me, and have mercy on me, as you always do to those who love your name. (Psalms 119:132)

text: רָפְתָה דַמֶּשֶׂק הִפְנְתָה לָנוּס וְרֶטֶט הֶחֱזִיקָה צָרָה וַחֲבָלִים אֲחָזַתָּה כַּיּוֹלֵדָֽה׃
translation: Damascus has grown feeble, she turns herself to flee, and trembling has seized her. Anguish and sorrows have taken hold of her, as of a woman in travail. (Jeremiah 49:24)

text: וַיִּֽהְיוּ כָּל יְמֵי נֹחַ תְּשַׁע מֵאוֹת שָׁנָה וַחֲמִשִּׁים שָׁנָה וַיָּמֹֽת׃
translation: All the days of Noah were nine hundred fifty years, and then he died. (Genesis 9:29)

text: אֵלֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹת בְּנֵי אָשֵׁר לִפְקֻדֵיהֶם שְׁלֹשָׁה וַחֲמִשִּׁים אֶלֶף וְאַרְבַּע מֵאֽוֹת׃
translation: These are the families of the sons of Asher according to those who were counted of them, fifty-three thousand four hundred. (Numbers 26:47)

text: בְּנֵי עֵילָם אֶלֶף מָאתַיִם חֲמִשִּׁים וְאַרְבָּעָֽה׃
translation: The children of Elam, one thousand two hundred fifty-four. (Ezra 2:7)

text: בְּנֵי עָדִין אַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת חֲמִשִּׁים וְאַרְבָּעָֽה׃
translation: The children of Adin, four hundred fifty-four. (Ezra 2:15)

text: בְּנֵי אָרַח שֵׁשׁ מֵאוֹת חֲמִשִּׁים וּשְׁנָֽיִם׃
translation: The children of Arah: six hundred fifty-two. (Nehemiah 7:10)

text: בְּנֵי עֵילָם אֶלֶף מָאתַיִם חֲמִשִּׁים וְאַרְבָּעָֽה׃
translation: The children of Elam: one thousand two hundred fifty-four. (Nehemiah 7:12)

text: וַאֲנִי עָלֶיךָ בָטַחְתִּי יְהוָה אָמַרְתִּי אֱלֹהַי אָֽתָּה׃
translation: My times are in your hand. Deliver me from the hand of my enemies, and from those who persecute me. (Psalms 31:15)

text: כִּי לֹא הֶאֱמִינוּ בֵּאלֹהִים וְלֹא בָטְחוּ בִּֽישׁוּעָתֽוֹ׃
translation: because they didn't believe in God, and didn't trust in his salvation. (Psalms 78:22)

text: כְּמוֹהֶם יִהְיוּ עֹשֵׂיהֶם כֹּל אֲשֶׁר בֹּטֵחַ בָּהֶֽם׃
translation: Those who make them will be like them; yes, everyone who trusts in them. (Psalms 115:8)

text: כְּמוֹהֶם יִהְיוּ עֹשֵׂיהֶם כֹּל אֲשֶׁר בֹּטֵחַ בָּהֶֽם׃
translation: Those who make them will be like them, yes, everyone who trusts in them. (Psalms 135:18)

text: אַל תַּחֲרֹשׁ עַל רֵעֲךָ רָעָה וְהֽוּא יוֹשֵׁב לָבֶטַח אִתָּֽךְ׃
translation: Don't devise evil against your neighbor, since he dwells securely by you. (Proverbs 3:29)

text: בִּטְחוּ בַֽיהוָה עֲדֵי עַד כִּי בְּיָהּ יְהוָה צוּר עוֹלָמִֽים׃
translation: Trust in the LORD forever; for in the LORD, the LORD, is an everlasting Rock. (Isaiah 26:4)

text: וַיִּישַׁר הַדָּבָר בְּעֵינֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ וּבְעֵינֵי כָּל הַקָּהָֽל׃
translation: The thing was right in the eyes of the king and of all the assembly. (2 Chronicles 30:4)

text: וַיַּגִּישׁוּ אֶת שְׂעִירֵי הַֽחַטָּאת לִפְנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ וְהַקָּהָל וַיִּסְמְכוּ יְדֵיהֶם עֲלֵיהֶֽם׃
translation: They brought near the male goats for the sin offering before the king and the assembly; and they laid their hands on them. (2 Chronicles 29:23)

text: אֲסַפְּרָה שִׁמְךָ לְאֶחָי בְּתוֹךְ קָהָל אֲהַלְלֶֽךָּ׃
translation: You who fear the LORD, praise him! All you descendants of Jacob, glorify him! Stand in awe of him, all you descendants of Israel! (Psalms 22:23)

text: וִֽירֹמְמוּהוּ בִּקְהַל עָם וּבְמוֹשַׁב זְקֵנִים יְהַלְלֽוּהוּ׃
translation: Let them exalt him also in the assembly of the people, and praise him in the seat of the elders. (Psalms 107:32)

text: וַיָּקֻמוּ אֲנָשִׁים מִזִּקְנֵי הָאָרֶץ וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֶל כָּל קְהַל הָעָם לֵאמֹֽר׃
translation: Then certain of the elders of the land rose up, and spoke to all the assembly of the people, saying, (Jeremiah 26:17)

text: עֵת נִשְׁבֶּרֶת מִיַּמִּים בְּמַֽעֲמַקֵּי מָיִם מַעֲרָבֵךְ וְכָל קְהָלֵךְ בְּתוֹכֵךְ נָפָֽלוּ׃
translation: In the time that you were broken by the seas, in the depths of the waters, your merchandise and all your company fell within you. (Ezekiel 27:34)

text: וְעַתָּה הִנְנוּ בְיָדֶךָ כַּטּוֹב וְכַיָּשָׁר בְּעֵינֶיךָ לַעֲשׂוֹת לָנוּ עֲשֵֽׂה׃
translation: Now, behold, we are in your hand. Do to us as it seems good and right to you to do." (Joshua 9:25)

text: בַּיָּמִים הָהֵם אֵין מֶלֶךְ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל אִישׁ הַיָּשָׁר בְּעֵינָיו יַעֲשֶֽׂה׃
translation: In those days there was no king in Israel. Everyone did that which was right in his own eyes. (Judges 17:6)

text: בַּיָּמִים הָהֵם אֵין מֶלֶךְ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל אִישׁ הַיָּשָׁר בְּעֵינָיו יַעֲשֶֽׂה׃
translation: In those days there was no king in Israel. Everyone did that which was right in his own eyes. (Judges 21:25)

text: וַיַּעַשׂ אָסָא הַיָּשָׁר בְּעֵינֵי יְהוָה כְּדָוִד אָבִֽיו׃
translation: Asa did that which was right in the LORD's eyes, as David his father did. (1 Kings 15:11)

text: וַיַּעַשׂ הַיָּשָׁר בְּעֵינֵי יְהוָה כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה אֲמַצְיָהוּ אָבִֽיו׃
translation: He did that which was right in the LORD's eyes, according to all that his father Amaziah had done. (2 Kings 15:3)

text: וַיַּעַשׂ הַיָּשָׁר בְּעֵינֵי יְהוָה כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה דָּוִד אָבִֽיו׃
translation: He did that which was right in the LORD's eyes, according to all that David his father had done. (2 Kings 18:3)

text: וְאַמִּיץ לִבּוֹ בַּגִּבּוֹרִים עָרוֹם יָנוּס בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא נְאֻם יְהוָֽה׃
translation: He who is courageous among the mighty will flee away naked on that day," says the LORD. (Amos 2:16)

text: וְכֹל אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל בִּרְאוֹתָם אֶת הָאִישׁ וַיָּנֻסוּ מִפָּנָיו וַיִּֽירְאוּ מְאֹֽד׃
translation: All the men of Israel, when they saw the man, fled from him and were terrified. (1 Samuel 17:24)

text: וַיִּגַּשׁ יוֹאָב וְהָעָם אֲשֶׁר עִמּוֹ לִפְנֵי אֲרָם לַמִּלְחָמָה וַיָּנוּסוּ מִפָּנָֽיו׃
translation: So Joab and the people who were with him came near to the front of the Syrians to the battle; and they fled before him. (1 Chronicles 19:14)

text: וְכָל יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר סְבִיבֹתֵיהֶם נָסוּ לְקֹלָם כִּי אָֽמְרוּ פֶּן תִּבְלָעֵנוּ הָאָֽרֶץ׃
translation: All Israel that were around them fled at their cry; for they said, "Lest the earth swallow us up!" (Numbers 16:34)

text: וַיַּעֲלוּ מִן הָעָם שָׁמָּה כִּשְׁלֹשֶׁת אֲלָפִים אִישׁ וַיָּנֻסוּ לִפְנֵי אַנְשֵׁי הָעָֽי׃
translation: So about three thousand men of the people went up there, and they fled before the men of Ai. (Joshua 7:4)

text: וַיִּקְשְׁרוּ עָלָיו קֶשֶׁר בִּירוּשָׁלִַם וַיָּנָס לָכִישָׁה וַיִּשְׁלְחוּ אַֽחֲרָיו לָכִישָׁה וַיְמִתֻהוּ שָֽׁם׃
translation: They made a conspiracy against him in Jerusalem, and he fled to Lachish; but they sent after him to Lachish and killed him there. (2 Kings 14:19)

text: וַיִּשְׁמַע דָּוִד וַיִּשְׁלַח אֶת יוֹאָב וְאֵת כָּל הַצָּבָא הַגִּבֹּרִֽים׃
translation: When David heard of it, he sent Joab and all the army of the mighty men. (2 Samuel 10:7)

text: אֵלֶּה עָשָׂה בְּנָיָהוּ בֶּן יְהוֹיָדָע וְלוֹ שֵׁם בִּשְׁלוֹשָׁה הַגִּבֹּרִֽים׃
translation: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada did these things and had a name among the three mighty men. (1 Chronicles 11:24)

text: וַיִּשְׁמַע דָּוִיד וַיִּשְׁלַח אֶת יוֹאָב וְאֵת כָּל צָבָא הַגִּבּוֹרִֽים׃
translation: When David heard of it, he sent Joab with all the army of the mighty men. (1 Chronicles 19:8)

text: אֵֽין הַמֶּלֶךְ נוֹשָׁע בְּרָב חָיִל גִּבּוֹר לֹֽא יִנָּצֵל בְּרָב כֹּֽחַ׃
translation: There is no king saved by the multitude of an army. A mighty man is not delivered by great strength. (Psalms 33:16)

text: בָּרֲכוּ יְהוָה מַלְאָכָיו גִּבֹּרֵי כֹחַ עֹשֵׂי דְבָרוֹ לִשְׁמֹעַ בְּקוֹל דְּבָרֽוֹ׃
translation: Praise the LORD, you angels of his, who are mighty in strength, who fulfill his word, obeying the voice of his word. (Psalms 103:20)

text: וּֽלְנָעֳמִי מידע מוֹדַע לְאִישָׁהּ אִישׁ גִּבּוֹר חַיִל מִמִּשְׁפַּחַת אֱלִימֶלֶךְ וּשְׁמוֹ בֹּֽעַז׃
translation: Naomi had a relative of her husband's, a mighty man of wealth, of the family of Elimelech, and his name was Boaz. (Ruth 2:1)

text: וַיָּשֶׁב יְהוָה לִי כְּצִדְקָתִי כְּבֹרִי לְנֶגֶד עֵינָֽיו׃
translation: Therefore the LORD has rewarded me according to my righteousness, According to my cleanness in his eyesight. (2 Samuel 22:25)

text: וְאִישׁ כִּי יִהְיֶה צַדִּיק וְעָשָׂה מִשְׁפָּט וּצְדָקָֽה׃
translation: "But if a man is just, and does that which is lawful and right, (Ezekiel 18:5)

text: וּבְאָמְרִי לָֽרָשָׁע מוֹת תָּמוּת וְשָׁב מֵֽחַטָּאתוֹ וְעָשָׂה מִשְׁפָּט וּצְדָקָֽה׃
translation: Again, when I say to the wicked, "You will surely die," if he turns from his sin and does that which is lawful and right, (Ezekiel 33:14)

text: בְּשׁוּב צַדִּיק מִצִּדְקָתוֹ וְעָשָׂה עָוֶל וּמֵת בָּהֶֽם׃
translation: When the righteous turns from his righteousness and commits iniquity, he will even die therein. (Ezekiel 33:18)

text: לְאִישׁ כָּמוֹךָ רִשְׁעֶךָ וּלְבֶן אָדָם צִדְקָתֶֽךָ׃
translation: Your wickedness may hurt a man as you are, and your righteousness may profit a son of man. (Job 35:8)

text: וְצִדְקָתְךָ אֱלֹהִים עַד מָרוֹם אֲשֶׁר עָשִׂיתָ גְדֹלוֹת אֱלֹהִים מִי כָמֽוֹךָ׃
translation: God, your righteousness also reaches to the heavens. You have done great things. God, who is like you? (Psalms 71:19)

text: גַּם זֹה רָאִיתִי חָכְמָה תַּחַת הַשָּׁמֶשׁ וּגְדוֹלָה הִיא אֵלָֽי׃
translation: I have also seen wisdom under the sun in this way, and it seemed great to me. (Ecclesiastes 9:13)

text: אִם חָבֹל תַּחְבֹּל שַׂלְמַת רֵעֶךָ עַד בֹּא הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ תְּשִׁיבֶנּוּ לֽוֹ׃
translation: "If you lend money to any of my people with you who is poor, you shall not be to him as a creditor. You shall not charge him interest. (Exodus 22:25)

text: זַרְעוֹ לְעוֹלָם יִהְיֶה וְכִסְאוֹ כַשֶּׁמֶשׁ נֶגְדִּֽי׃
translation: It will be established forever like the moon, the faithful witness in the sky." Selah. (Psalms 89:37)

text: וְזָרַח הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ וּבָא הַשָּׁמֶשׁ וְאֶל מְקוֹמוֹ שׁוֹאֵף זוֹרֵחַֽ הוּא שָֽׁם׃
translation: The sun also rises, and the sun goes down, and hurries to its place where it rises. (Ecclesiastes 1:5)

text: יֵשׁ רָעָה אֲשֶׁר רָאִיתִי תַּחַת הַשָּׁמֶשׁ וְרַבָּה הִיא עַל הָאָדָֽם׃
translation: There is an evil which I have seen under the sun, and it is heavy on men: (Ecclesiastes 6:1)

text: וְסַבּוֹתִֽי אֲנִי לְיַאֵשׁ אֶת לִבִּי עַל כָּל הֶעָמָל שֶׁעָמַלְתִּי תַּחַת הַשָּֽׁמֶשׁ׃
translation: Therefore I began to cause my heart to despair concerning all the labor in which I had labored under the sun. (Ecclesiastes 2:20)

text: אִם צָדַקְתָּ מַה תִּתֶּן לוֹ אוֹ מַה מִיָּדְךָ יִקָּֽח׃
translation: If you are righteous, what do you give him? Or what does he receive from your hand? (Job 35:7)

text: כִּֽי עַד צֶדֶק יָשׁוּב מִשְׁפָּט וְאַחֲרָיו כָּל יִשְׁרֵי לֵֽב׃
translation: For judgment will return to righteousness. All the upright in heart shall follow it. (Psalms 94:15)

text: יָדַעְתִּי יְהוָה כִּי צֶדֶק מִשְׁפָּטֶיךָ וֶאֱמוּנָה עִנִּיתָֽנִי׃
translation: LORD, I know that your judgments are righteous, that in faithfulness you have afflicted me. (Psalms 119:75)

text: רֹאשׁ דְּבָרְךָ אֱמֶת וּלְעוֹלָם כָּל מִשְׁפַּט צִדְקֶֽךָ׃
translation: All of your words are truth. Every one of your righteous ordinances endures forever. SIN AND SHIN (Psalms 119:160)

text: הַזְכִּירֵנִי נִשָּׁפְטָה יָחַד סַפֵּר אַתָּה לְמַעַן תִּצְדָּֽק׃
translation: Put me in remembrance. Let us plead together. Declare your case, that you may be justified. (Isaiah 43:26)

text: שֻֽׁבוּ נָא אַל תְּהִי עַוְלָה ושבי וְשׁוּבוּ עוֹד צִדְקִי בָֽהּ׃
translation: Please return. Let there be no injustice. Yes, return again. My cause is righteous. (Job 6:29)

text: וַתֵּרֶב חָכְמַת שְׁלֹמֹה מֵֽחָכְמַת כָּל בְּנֵי קֶדֶם וּמִכֹּל חָכְמַת מִצְרָֽיִם׃
translation: So Hiram gave Solomon cedar timber and cypress timber according to all his desire. (1 Kings 5:10)

text: חֶבְלֵי שְׁאוֹל סְבָבוּנִי קִדְּמוּנִי מוֹקְשֵׁי מָֽוֶת׃
translation: In my distress I called on the LORD, and cried to my God. He heard my voice out of his temple. My cry before him came into his ears. (Psalms 18:6)

text: קֶדֶם יָדַעְתִּי מֵעֵדֹתֶיךָ כִּי לְעוֹלָם יְסַדְתָּֽם׃
translation: Of old I have known from your testimonies, that you have founded them forever. RESH (Psalms 119:152)

text: אָחוֹר וָקֶדֶם צַרְתָּנִי וַתָּשֶׁת עָלַי כַּפֶּֽכָה׃
translation: You hem me in behind and before. You laid your hand on me. (Psalms 139:5)

text: תִּתֵּן אֱמֶת לְיַֽעֲקֹב חֶסֶד לְאַבְרָהָם אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּעְתָּ לַאֲבֹתֵינוּ מִימֵי קֶֽדֶם׃
translation: You will give truth to Jacob, and mercy to Abraham, as you have sworn to our fathers from the days of old. (Micah 7:20)

text: וְהָיָה אִם זָרַע יִשְׂרָאֵל וְעָלָה מִדְיָן וַֽעֲמָלֵק וּבְנֵי קֶדֶם וְעָלוּ עָלָֽיו׃
translation: So it was, when Israel had sown, that the Midianites, the Amalekites, and the children of the east came up against them. (Judges 6:3)

text: וַיֵּלְכוּ כָל הָעָם אִישׁ לְבֵיתוֹ וַיִּסֹּב דָּוִיד לְבָרֵךְ אֶת בֵּיתֽוֹ׃
translation: All the people departed, each man to his house; and David returned to bless his house. (1 Chronicles 16:43)

text: וַהֲסִבּוֹתִי פָנַי מֵהֶם וְחִלְּלוּ אֶת צְפוּנִי וּבָאוּ בָהּ פָּרִיצִים וְחִלְּלֽוּהָ׃
translation: I will also turn my face from them, and they will profane my secret place. Robbers will enter into it, and profane it. (Ezekiel 7:22)

text: וַיַּמְלֵךְ מֶֽלֶךְ בָּבֶל אֶת מַתַּנְיָה דֹדוֹ תַּחְתָּיו וַיַּסֵּב אֶת שְׁמוֹ צִדְקִיָּֽהוּ׃
translation: The king of Babylon made Mattaniah, Jehoiachin's father's brother, king in his place, and changed his name to Zedekiah. (2 Kings 24:17)

text: וְיָֽרָבְעָם הֵסֵב אֶת הַמַּאְרָב לָבוֹא מֵֽאַחֲרֵיהֶם וַיִּֽהְיוּ לִפְנֵי יְהוּדָה וְהַמַּאְרָב מֵאַחֲרֵיהֶֽם׃
translation: But Jeroboam caused an ambush to come about behind them; so they were before Judah, and the ambush was behind them. (2 Chronicles 13:13)

text: שֵׁם הָֽאֶחָד פִּישׁוֹן הוּא הַסֹּבֵב אֵת כָּל אֶרֶץ הַֽחֲוִילָה אֲשֶׁר שָׁם הַזָּהָֽב׃
translation: The name of the first is Pishon: it flows through the whole land of Havilah, where there is gold; (Genesis 2:11)

text: וַיַּסֵּב אֲרוֹן יְהוָה אֶת הָעִיר הַקֵּף פַּעַם אֶחָת וַיָּבֹאוּ הַֽמַּחֲנֶה וַיָּלִינוּ בַּֽמַּחֲנֶֽה׃
translation: So he caused the LORD's ark to go around the city, circling it once. Then they came into the camp, and stayed in the camp. (Joshua 6:11)

text: מִֽי יִתֵּן הַחֲרֵשׁ תַּחֲרִישׁוּן וּתְהִי לָכֶם לְחָכְמָֽה׃
translation: Oh that you would be completely silent! Then you would be wise. (Job 13:5)

text: אָמַרְתִּי יָמִים יְדַבֵּרוּ וְרֹב שָׁנִים יֹדִיעוּ חָכְמָֽה׃
translation: I said, 'Days should speak, and multitude of years should teach wisdom.' (Job 32:7)

text: כִּֽי יְהוָה יִתֵּן חָכְמָה מִפִּיו דַּעַת וּתְבוּנָֽה׃
translation: For the LORD gives wisdom. Out of his mouth comes knowledge and understanding. (Proverbs 2:6)

text: אֱמֹר לַֽחָכְמָה אֲחֹתִי אָתְּ וּמֹדָע לַבִּינָה תִקְרָֽא׃
translation: Tell wisdom, "You are my sister." Call understanding your relative, (Proverbs 7:4)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר לָֽאָדָם הֵן יִרְאַת אֲדֹנָי הִיא חָכְמָה וְסוּר מֵרָע בִּינָֽה׃
translation: To man he said, 'Behold, the fear of the Lord, that is wisdom. To depart from evil is understanding.'" (Job 28:28)

text: לָדַעַת חָכְמָה וּמוּסָר לְהָבִין אִמְרֵי בִינָֽה׃
translation: to know wisdom and instruction; to discern the words of understanding; (Proverbs 1:2)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֵלָי מִצָּפוֹן תִּפָּתַח הָרָעָה עַל כָּל יֹשְׁבֵי הָאָֽרֶץ׃
translation: Then the LORD said to me, "Out of the north, evil will break out on all the inhabitants of the land. (Jeremiah 1:14)

text: הִנֵּה אֵלֶּה מֵרָחוֹק יָבֹאוּ וְהִֽנֵּה אֵלֶּה מִצָּפוֹן וּמִיָּם וְאֵלֶּה מֵאֶרֶץ סִינִֽים׃
translation: Behold, these shall come from afar, and behold, these from the north and from the west, and these from the land of Sinim." (Isaiah 49:12)

text: בְּנֵי גָד לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם לִצְפוֹן מִשְׁפַּחַת הַצְּפוֹנִי לְחַגִּי מִשְׁפַּחַת הַֽחַגִּי לְשׁוּנִי מִשְׁפַּחַת הַשּׁוּנִֽי׃
translation: The sons of Gad after their families: of Zephon, the family of the Zephonites; of Haggi, the family of the Haggites; of Shuni, the family of the Shunites; (Numbers 26:15)

text: וְזֶֽה יִהְיֶה לָכֶם גְּבוּל צָפוֹן מִן הַיָּם הַגָּדֹל תְּתָאוּ לָכֶם הֹר הָהָֽר׃
translation: "'This shall be your north border: from the great sea you shall mark out for yourselves Mount Hor. (Numbers 34:7)

text: וְיָצָא הַגְּבֻל זִפְרֹנָה וְהָיוּ תוֹצְאֹתָיו חֲצַר עֵינָן זֶֽה יִהְיֶה לָכֶם גְּבוּל צָפֽוֹן׃
translation: Then the border shall go to Ziphron, and it shall end at Hazar Enan. This shall be your north border. (Numbers 34:9)

text: וְזֶה גְּבוּל הָאָרֶץ לִפְאַת צָפוֹנָה מִן הַיָּם הַגָּדוֹל הַדֶּרֶךְ חֶתְלֹן לְבוֹא צְדָֽדָה׃
translation: "This shall be the border of the land: "On the north side, from the great sea, by the way of Hethlon, to the entrance of Zedad; (Ezekiel 47:15)

text: וַיֵּלֶךְ אֲבִימֶלֶךְ אֶל תֵּבֵץ וַיִּחַן בְּתֵבֵץ וַֽיִּלְכְּדָֽהּ׃
translation: Then Abimelech went to Thebez and encamped against Thebez, and took it. (Judges 9:50)

text: וְהַחֹנִים עָלָיו מַטֵּה יִשָּׂשכָר וְנָשִׂיא לִבְנֵי יִשָּׂשכָר נְתַנְאֵל בֶּן צוּעָֽר׃
translation: "Those who encamp next to him shall be the tribe of Issachar. The prince of the children of Issachar shall be Nethanel the son of Zuar. (Numbers 2:5)

text: וְהַחֹנִים עָלָיו מַטֵּה אָשֵׁר וְנָשִׂיא לִבְנֵי אָשֵׁר פַּגְעִיאֵל בֶּן עָכְרָֽן׃
translation: "Those who encamp next to him shall be the tribe of Asher. The prince of the children of Asher shall be Pagiel the son of Ochran. (Numbers 2:27)

text: וַיִּסְעוּ בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵרַעְמְסֵס וַֽיַּחֲנוּ בְּסֻכֹּֽת׃
translation: The children of Israel traveled from Rameses, and encamped in Succoth. (Numbers 33:5)

text: וַיִּסְעוּ מִדִּיבֹן גָּד וַֽיַּחֲנוּ בְּעַלְמֹן דִּבְלָתָֽיְמָה׃
translation: They traveled from Dibon Gad, and encamped in Almon Diblathaim. (Numbers 33:46)

text: חֹנֶה מַלְאַךְ יְהוָה סָבִיב לִֽירֵאָיו וַֽיְחַלְּצֵֽם׃
translation: Oh taste and see that the LORD is good. Blessed is the man who takes refuge in him. (Psalms 34:8)

text: וַיִּשְׁלַח הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה וַיִּקַּח אֶת חִירָם מִצֹּֽר׃
translation: King Solomon sent and brought Hiram out of Tyre. (1 Kings 7:13)

text: לֹא זָכְרוּ אֶת יָדוֹ יוֹם אֲֽשֶׁר פָּדָם מִנִּי צָֽר׃
translation: They didn't remember his hand, nor the day when he redeemed them from the adversary; (Psalms 78:42)

text: יֹאמְרוּ גְּאוּלֵי יְהוָה אֲשֶׁר גְּאָלָם מִיַּד צָֽר׃
translation: Let the redeemed by the LORD say so, whom he has redeemed from the hand of the adversary, (Psalms 107:2)

text: וַיָּשָׁב בַּצַּר לוֹ עַל יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיְבַקְשֻׁהוּ וַיִּמָּצֵא לָהֶֽם׃
translation: But when in their distress they turned to the LORD, the God of Israel, and sought him, he was found by them. (2 Chronicles 15:4)

text: הֲרִימוֹתָ יְמִין צָרָיו הִשְׂמַחְתָּ כָּל אוֹיְבָֽיו׃
translation: Yes, you turn back the edge of his sword, and haven't supported him in battle. (Psalms 89:43)

text: וַיֶּפֶר אֶת עַמּוֹ מְאֹד וַיַּֽעֲצִמֵהוּ מִצָּרָֽיו׃
translation: He increased his people greatly, and made them stronger than their adversaries. (Psalms 105:24)

text: סוּר מֵרָע וַעֲשֵׂה טוֹב וּשְׁכֹן לְעוֹלָֽם׃
translation: Depart from evil, and do good. Live securely forever. (Psalms 37:27)

text: תְּשִׂימֵנוּ מָדוֹן לִשְׁכֵנֵינוּ וְאֹיְבֵינוּ יִלְעֲגוּ לָֽמוֹ׃
translation: Turn us again, God of Armies. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved. (Psalms 80:7)

text: וְשָׁכַן בַּמִּדְבָּר מִשְׁפָּט וּצְדָקָה בַּכַּרְמֶל תֵּשֵֽׁב׃
translation: Then justice will dwell in the wilderness; and righteousness will remain in the fruitful field. (Isaiah 32:16)

text: וְעָשׂוּ לִי מִקְדָּשׁ וְשָׁכַנְתִּי בְּתוֹכָֽם׃
translation: Let them make me a sanctuary, that I may dwell among them. (Exodus 25:8)

text: הָרְפָאִים יְחוֹלָלוּ מִתַּחַת מַיִם וְשֹׁכְנֵיהֶֽם׃
translation: "The departed spirits tremble, those beneath the waters and all that live in them. (Job 26:5)

text: וַיֵּרָא אֵלָיו יְהוָה וַיֹּאמֶר אַל תֵּרֵד מִצְרָיְמָה שְׁכֹן בָּאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר אֹמַר אֵלֶֽיךָ׃
translation: The LORD appeared to him, and said, "Don't go down into Egypt. Live in the land I will tell you about. (Genesis 26:2)

text: רֹאשׁ מְסִבָּי עֲמַל שְׂפָתֵימוֹ יכסומו יְכַסֵּֽמוֹ׃
translation: Let burning coals fall on them. Let them be thrown into the fire, into miry pits, from where they never rise. (Psalms 140:10)

text: הַצִּילֵנִי מֵאֹיְבַי יְהוָה אֵלֶיךָ כִסִּֽתִי׃
translation: Deliver me, LORD, from my enemies. I flee to you to hide me. (Psalms 143:9)

text: כִּי תִּמָּלֵא הָאָרֶץ לָדַעַת אֶת כְּבוֹד יְהוָה כַּמַּיִם יְכַסּוּ עַל יָֽם׃
translation: For the earth will be filled with the knowledge of the LORD's glory, as the waters cover the sea. (Habakkuk 2:14)

text: וְאֵת כָּל חֶלְבּוֹ יַקְרִיב מִמֶּנּוּ אֵת הָֽאַלְיָה וְאֶת הַחֵלֶב הַֽמְכַסֶּה אֶת הַקֶּֽרֶב׃
translation: He shall offer all of its fat: the fat tail, and the fat that covers the innards, (Leviticus 7:3)

text: לְהַעֲלוֹת חֵמָה לִנְקֹם נָקָם נָתַתִּי אֶת דָּמָהּ עַל צְחִיחַ סָלַע לְבִלְתִּי הִכָּסֽוֹת׃
translation: That it may cause wrath to come up to take vengeance, I have set her blood on the bare rock, that it should not be covered." (Ezekiel 24:8)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוּדָה אֶל אֶחָיו מַה בֶּצַע כִּי נַהֲרֹג אֶת אָחִינוּ וְכִסִּינוּ אֶת דָּמֽוֹ׃
translation: Judah said to his brothers, "What profit is it if we kill our brother and conceal his blood? (Genesis 37:26)

text: אֲסַפֵּר כָּל עַצְמוֹתָי הֵמָּה יַבִּיטוּ יִרְאוּ בִֽי׃
translation: They divide my garments among them. They cast lots for my clothing. (Psalms 22:18)

text: אֵין מְתֹם בִּבְשָׂרִי מִפְּנֵי זַעְמֶךָ אֵין שָׁלוֹם בַּעֲצָמַי מִפְּנֵי חַטָּאתִֽי׃
translation: For my iniquities have gone over my head. As a heavy burden, they are too heavy for me. (Psalms 38:4)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ לָבָן אַךְ עַצְמִי וּבְשָׂרִי אָתָּה וַיֵּשֶׁב עִמּוֹ חֹדֶשׁ יָמִֽים׃
translation: Laban said to him, "Surely you are my bone and my flesh." Jacob stayed with him for a month. (Genesis 29:14)

text: כִּי כָל הַנֶּפֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר לֹֽא תְעֻנֶּה בְּעֶצֶם הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה וְנִכְרְתָה מֵֽעַמֶּֽיהָ׃
translation: For whoever it is who shall not deny himself in that same day shall be cut off from his people. (Leviticus 23:29)

text: וַיִּקָּבְצוּ כָֽל יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל דָּוִיד חֶבְרוֹנָה לֵאמֹר הִנֵּה עַצְמְךָ וּֽבְשָׂרְךָ אֲנָֽחְנוּ׃
translation: Then all Israel gathered themselves to David to Hebron, saying, "Behold, we are your bone and your flesh. (1 Chronicles 11:1)

text: וְעַצְמוֹת כֹּֽהֲנִים שָׂרַף עַל מזבחותים מִזְבְּחוֹתָם וַיְטַהֵר אֶת יְהוּדָה וְאֶת יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
translation: He burned the bones of the priests on their altars, and purged Judah and Jerusalem. (2 Chronicles 34:5)

text: תַּֽחַת צֶאֱלִים יִשְׁכָּב בְּסֵתֶר קָנֶה וּבִצָּֽה׃
translation: He lies under the lotus trees, in the covert of the reed, and the marsh. (Job 40:21)

text: קְנֵה חָכְמָה קְנֵה בִינָה אַל תִּשְׁכַּח וְאַל תֵּט מֵֽאִמְרֵי פִֽי׃
translation: Get wisdom. Get understanding. Don't forget, and don't deviate from the words of my mouth. (Proverbs 4:5)

text: הַשָּׂדֶה אֲשֶׁר קָנָה אַבְרָהָם מֵאֵת בְּנֵי חֵת שָׁמָּה קֻבַּר אַבְרָהָם וְשָׂרָה אִשְׁתּֽוֹ׃
translation: the field which Abraham purchased from the children of Heth. Abraham was buried there with Sarah, his wife. (Genesis 25:10)

text: זְכֹר עֲדָתְךָ קָנִיתָ קֶּדֶם גָּאַלְתָּ שֵׁבֶט נַחֲלָתֶךָ הַר צִיּוֹן זֶה שָׁכַנְתָּ בּֽוֹ׃
translation: Remember your congregation, which you purchased of old, which you have redeemed to be the tribe of your inheritance: Mount Zion, in which you have lived. (Psalms 74:2)

text: יָדַע שׁוֹר קֹנֵהוּ וַחֲמוֹר אֵבוּס בְּעָלָיו יִשְׂרָאֵל לֹא יָדַע עַמִּי לֹא הִתְבּוֹנָֽן׃
translation: The ox knows his owner, and the donkey his master's crib; but Israel doesn't know. My people don't consider." (Isaiah 1:3)

text: כֹּה אָמַר יְהוָה הָלוֹךְ וְקָנִיתָ בַקְבֻּק יוֹצֵר חָרֶשׂ וּמִזִּקְנֵי הָעָם וּמִזִּקְנֵי הַכֹּהֲנִֽים׃
translation: Thus said the LORD, "Go, and buy a potter's earthen container, and take some of the elders of the people and of the elders of the priests; (Jeremiah 19:1)

text: הַחֲרִישׁוּ מִמֶּנִּי וַאֲדַבְּרָה אָנִי וְיַעֲבֹר עָלַי מָֽה׃
translation: "Be silent! Leave me alone, that I may speak. Let come on me what will. (Job 13:13)

text: יְהוָה יִלָּחֵם לָכֶם וְאַתֶּם תַּחֲרִישֽׁוּן׃
translation: The LORD will fight for you, and you shall be still." (Exodus 14:14)

text: לֹֽא תַחֲרֹשׁ בְּשׁוֹר וּבַחֲמֹר יַחְדָּֽו׃
translation: You shall not plow with an ox and a donkey together. (Deuteronomy 22:10)

text: וַיִּכְרְתוּ שְׁנֵיהֶם בְּרִית לִפְנֵי יְהוָה וַיֵּשֶׁב דָּוִד בַּחֹרְשָׁה וִיהוֹנָתָן הָלַךְ לְבֵיתֽוֹ׃
translation: They both made a covenant before the LORD. Then David stayed in the woods and Jonathan went to his house. (1 Samuel 23:18)

text: יִרְאוּ גוֹיִם וְיֵבֹשׁוּ מִכֹּל גְּבֽוּרָתָם יָשִׂימוּ יָד עַל פֶּה אָזְנֵיהֶם תֶּחֱרַֽשְׁנָה׃
translation: The nations will see and be ashamed of all their might. They will lay their hand on their mouth. Their ears will be deaf. (Micah 7:16)

text: וַיַּרְא דָוִד כִּֽי יָצָא שָׁאוּל לְבַקֵּשׁ אֶת נַפְשׁוֹ וְדָוִד בְּמִדְבַּר זִיף בַּחֹֽרְשָׁה׃
translation: David saw that Saul had come out to seek his life. David was in the wilderness of Ziph in the woods. (1 Samuel 23:15)

text: בְּפֶשַֽׁע אֶרֶץ רַבִּים שָׂרֶיהָ וּבְאָדָם מֵבִין יֹדֵעַ כֵּן יַאֲרִֽיךְ׃
translation: In rebellion, a land has many rulers, but order is maintained by a man of understanding and knowledge. (Proverbs 28:2)

text: נָגִיד חֲסַר תְּבוּנוֹת וְרַב מַעֲשַׁקּוֹת שנאי שֹׂנֵא בֶצַע יַאֲרִיךְ יָמִֽים׃
translation: A tyrannical ruler lacks judgment. One who hates ill-gotten gain will have long days. (Proverbs 28:16)

text: לָמָּה לָנֶצַח תִּשְׁכָּחֵנוּ תַּֽעַזְבֵנוּ לְאֹרֶךְ יָמִֽים׃
translation: Why do you forget us forever, and forsake us for so long a time? (Lamentations 5:20)

text: בִּֽישִׁישִׁים חָכְמָה וְאֹרֶךְ יָמִים תְּבוּנָֽה׃
translation: With aged men is wisdom, in length of days understanding. (Job 12:12)

text: אֹרֶךְ יָמִים אַשְׂבִּיעֵהוּ וְאַרְאֵהוּ בִּֽישׁוּעָתִֽי׃
translation: I will satisfy him with long life, and show him my salvation." (Psalms 91:16)

text: הַתְּרוּמָה אֲשֶׁר תָּרִימוּ לַֽיהוָה אֹרֶךְ חֲמִשָּׁה וְעֶשְׂרִים אֶלֶף וְרֹחַב עֲשֶׂרֶת אֲלָפִֽים׃
translation: "The offering that you shall offer to the LORD shall be twenty-five thousand reeds in length, and ten thousand in width. (Ezekiel 48:9)

text: קָרְבוּ רִֽיבְכֶם יֹאמַר יְהוָה הַגִּישׁוּ עֲצֻמוֹתֵיכֶם יֹאמַר מֶלֶךְ יַעֲקֹֽב׃
translation: Produce your cause," says the LORD. "Bring out your strong reasons!" says the King of Jacob. (Isaiah 41:21)

text: וְגַם הַכֹּהֲנִים הַנִּגָּשִׁים אֶל יְהוָה יִתְקַדָּשׁוּ פֶּן יִפְרֹץ בָּהֶם יְהוָֽה׃
translation: Let the priests also, who come near to the LORD, sanctify themselves, lest the LORD break out on them." (Exodus 19:22)

text: וְהוּא עָבַר לִפְנֵיהֶם וַיִּשְׁתַּחוּ אַרְצָה שֶׁבַע פְּעָמִים עַד גִּשְׁתּוֹ עַד אָחִֽיו׃
translation: He himself passed over in front of them, and bowed himself to the ground seven times, until he came near to his brother. (Genesis 33:3)

text: וַתִּגַּשְׁןָ הַשְּׁפָחוֹת הֵנָּה וְיַלְדֵיהֶן וַתִּֽשְׁתַּחֲוֶֽיןָ׃
translation: Then the servants came near with their children, and they bowed themselves. (Genesis 33:6)

text: וַֽיִּגְּשׁוּ אֶל הָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר עַל בֵּית יוֹסֵף וַיְדַבְּרוּ אֵלָיו פֶּתַח הַבָּֽיִת׃
translation: They came near to the steward of Joseph's house, and they spoke to him at the door of the house, (Genesis 43:19)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל הָעָם הֱיוּ נְכֹנִים לִשְׁלֹשֶׁת יָמִים אַֽל תִּגְּשׁוּ אֶל אִשָּֽׁה׃
translation: He said to the people, "Be ready by the third day. Don't have sexual relations with a woman." (Exodus 19:15)

text: בְּנֵי שִׁמְעוֹן נְמוּאֵל וְיָמִין יָרִיב זֶרַח שָׁאֽוּל׃
translation: The sons of Simeon: Nemuel, Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, Shaul; (1 Chronicles 4:24)

text: כְּשִׁמְךָ אֱלֹהִים כֵּן תְּהִלָּתְךָ עַל קַצְוֵי אֶרֶץ צֶדֶק מָלְאָה יְמִינֶֽךָ׃
translation: Let Mount Zion be glad! Let the daughters of Judah rejoice because of your judgments. (Psalms 48:11)

text: וַאֲנִי תָמִיד עִמָּךְ אָחַזְתָּ בְּיַד יְמִינִֽי׃
translation: Nevertheless, I am continually with you. You have held my right hand. (Psalms 73:23)

text: תְּֽהִי יָדְךָ עַל אִישׁ יְמִינֶךָ עַל בֶּן אָדָם אִמַּצְתָּ לָּֽךְ׃
translation: So we will not turn away from you. Revive us, and we will call on your name. (Psalms 80:18)

text: גַּם שָׁם יָדְךָ תַנְחֵנִי וְֽתֹאחֲזֵנִי יְמִינֶֽךָ׃
translation: even there your hand will lead me, and your right hand will hold me. (Psalms 139:10)

text: וְשַׂמְתִּי בַיָּם יָדוֹ וּֽבַנְּהָרוֹת יְמִינֽוֹ׃
translation: He will call to me, 'You are my Father, my God, and the rock of my salvation!' (Psalms 89:26)

text: וְהָיָה כִּֽי יֹאמְרוּ אֲלֵיכֶם בְּנֵיכֶם מָה הָעֲבֹדָה הַזֹּאת לָכֶֽם׃
translation: It will happen, when your children ask you, 'What do you mean by this service?' (Exodus 12:26)

text: כִּי יִהְיוּ לוֹ לַעֲבָדִים וְיֵדְעוּ עֲבוֹדָתִי וַעֲבוֹדַת מַמְלְכוֹת הָאֲרָצֽוֹת׃
translation: Nevertheless they will be his servants, that they may know my service, and the service of the kingdoms of the countries." (2 Chronicles 12:8)

text: וְגַם לַלְוִיִּם אֵין לָשֵׂאת אֶת הַמִּשְׁכָּן וְאֶת כָּל כֵּלָיו לַעֲבֹדָתֽוֹ׃
translation: Also the Levites will no longer need to carry the tabernacle and all its vessels for its service." (1 Chronicles 23:26)

text: וְהָיָה מַעֲשֵׂה הַצְּדָקָה שָׁלוֹם וַֽעֲבֹדַת הַצְּדָקָה הַשְׁקֵט וָבֶטַח עַד עוֹלָֽם׃
translation: The work of righteousness will be peace, and the effect of righteousness, quietness and confidence forever. (Isaiah 32:17)

text: וְגַם עֹלָה לָרֹב בְּחֶלְבֵי הַשְּׁלָמִים וּבַנְּסָכִים לָעֹלָה וַתִּכּוֹן עֲבוֹדַת בֵּית יְהוָֽה׃
translation: Also the burnt offerings were in abundance, with the fat of the peace offerings and with the drink offerings for every burnt offering. So the service of the LORD's house was set in order. (2 Chronicles 29:35)

text: וְנָתַתִּי אוֹתָם שֹׁמְרֵי מִשְׁמֶרֶת הַבָּיִת לְכֹל עֲבֹדָתוֹ וּלְכֹל אֲשֶׁר יֵעָשֶׂה בּֽוֹ׃
translation: Yet I will make them performers of the duty of the house, for all its service and for all that will be done therein. (Ezekiel 44:14)

text: מִקִּבְרוֹת הַֽתַּאֲוָה נָסְעוּ הָעָם חֲצֵרוֹת וַיִּהְיוּ בַּחֲצֵרֽוֹת׃
translation: From Kibroth Hattaavah the people traveled to Hazeroth; and they stayed at Hazeroth. (Numbers 11:35)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר נִסְעָה וְנֵלֵכָה וְאֵלְכָה לְנֶגְדֶּֽךָ׃
translation: Esau said, "Let's take our journey, and let's go, and I will go before you." (Genesis 33:12)

text: וַיִּסְעוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַֽיַּחֲנוּ בְּאֹבֹֽת׃
translation: The children of Israel traveled, and encamped in Oboth. (Numbers 21:10)

text: מִשָּׁם נָסָעוּ וַֽיַּחֲנוּ בְּנַחַל זָֽרֶד׃
translation: From there they traveled, and encamped in the valley of Zered. (Numbers 21:12)

text: וַיִּסְעוּ מִמִּדְבַּר סִין וַֽיַּחֲנוּ בְּדָפְקָֽה׃
translation: They traveled from the wilderness of Sin, and encamped in Dophkah. (Numbers 33:12)

text: וַיִּסְעוּ מֵרְפִידִם וַֽיַּחֲנוּ בְּמִדְבַּר סִינָֽי׃
translation: They traveled from Rephidim, and encamped in the wilderness of Sinai. (Numbers 33:15)

text: בְּהִקָּבֵץ עַמִּים יַחְדָּו וּמַמְלָכוֹת לַעֲבֹד אֶת יְהוָֽה׃
translation: He weakened my strength along the course. He shortened my days. (Psalms 102:23)

text: הַכֹּל סָר יַחְדָּו נֶאֱלָחוּ אֵין עֹֽשֵׂה טוֹב אֵין גַּם אֶחָֽד׃
translation: They have all gone aside. They have together become corrupt. There is no one who does good, no, not one. (Psalms 14:3)

text: כִּי יֹאמַר הֲלֹא שָׂרַי יַחְדָּו מְלָכִֽים׃
translation: For he says, "Aren't all of my princes kings? (Isaiah 10:8)

text: הֲיֵלְכוּ שְׁנַיִם יַחְדָּו בִּלְתִּי אִם נוֹעָֽדוּ׃
translation: Do two walk together, unless they have agreed? (Amos 3:3)

text: וְכָל מִדְיָן וַעֲמָלֵק וּבְנֵי קֶדֶם נֶאֶסְפוּ יַחְדָּו וַיַּעַבְרוּ וַֽיַּחֲנוּ בְּעֵמֶק יִזְרְעֶֽאל׃
translation: Then all the Midianites and the Amalekites and the children of the east assembled themselves together; and they passed over, and encamped in the valley of Jezreel. (Judges 6:33)

text: כִּי יִרְאֶה חֲכָמִים יָמוּתוּ יַחַד כְּסִיל וָבַעַר יֹאבֵדוּ וְעָזְבוּ לַאֲחֵרִים חֵילָֽם׃
translation: Their inward thought is that their houses will endure forever, and their dwelling places to all generations. They name their lands after themselves. (Psalms 49:11)

text: אֵלֶּה בְּנֵי גִלְעָד אִיעֶזֶר מִשְׁפַּחַת הָאִֽיעֶזְרִי לְחֵלֶק מִשְׁפַּחַת הַֽחֶלְקִֽי׃
translation: These are the sons of Gilead: of Iezer, the family of the Iezerites; of Helek, the family of the Helekites; (Numbers 26:30)

text: לָאֵלֶּה תֵּחָלֵק הָאָרֶץ בְּנַחֲלָה בְּמִסְפַּר שֵׁמֽוֹת׃
translation: "To these the land shall be divided for an inheritance according to the number of names. (Numbers 26:53)

text: לְחֵלֶק יַגִּיד רֵעִים וְעֵינֵי בָנָיו תִּכְלֶֽנָה׃
translation: He who denounces his friends for plunder, even the eyes of his children will fail. (Job 17:5)

text: לְהַצִּילְךָ מֵאִשָּׁה זָרָה מִנָּכְרִיָּה אֲמָרֶיהָ הֶחֱלִֽיקָה׃
translation: to deliver you from the strange woman, even from the foreigner who flatters with her words, (Proverbs 2:16)

text: לִשְׁמָרְךָ מֵאִשָּׁה זָרָה מִנָּכְרִיָּה אֲמָרֶיהָ הֶחֱלִֽיקָה׃
translation: that they may keep you from the strange woman, from the foreigner who flatters with her words. (Proverbs 7:5)

text: וַיֵּצֵא יִרְמְיָהוּ מִירוּשָׁלִַם לָלֶכֶת אֶרֶץ בִּנְיָמִן לַחֲלִק מִשָּׁם בְּתוֹךְ הָעָֽם׃
translation: then Jeremiah went out of Jerusalem to go into the land of Benjamin, to receive his portion there, in the middle of the people. (Jeremiah 37:12)

text: יִרְדְּפֵם יַעֲבוֹר שָׁלוֹם אֹרַח בְּרַגְלָיו לֹא יָבֽוֹא׃
translation: He pursues them and passes by safely, even by a way that he had not gone with his feet. (Isaiah 41:3)

text: בְּיָדְךָ עִתֹּתָי הַצִּילֵנִי מִיַּד אוֹיְבַי וּמֵרֹדְפָֽי׃
translation: Make your face to shine on your servant. Save me in your loving kindness. (Psalms 31:16)

text: כָּל מִצְוֺתֶיךָ אֱמוּנָה שֶׁקֶר רְדָפוּנִי עָזְרֵֽנִי׃
translation: All of your commandments are faithful. They persecute me wrongfully. Help me! (Psalms 119:86)

text: כֵּן צְדָקָה לְחַיִּים וּמְרַדֵּף רָעָה לְמוֹתֽוֹ׃
translation: He who is truly righteous gets life. He who pursues evil gets death. (Proverbs 11:19)

text: קָרְבוּ רֹדְפֵי זִמָּה מִתּוֹרָתְךָ רָחָֽקוּ׃
translation: They draw near who follow after wickedness. They are far from your law. (Psalms 119:150)

text: הַקְשִׁיבָה אֶֽל רִנָּתִי כִּֽי דַלּוֹתִי מְאֹד הַצִּילֵנִי מֵרֹדְפַי כִּי אָמְצוּ מִמֶּֽנִּי׃
translation: Bring my soul out of prison, that I may give thanks to your name. The righteous will surround me, for you will be good to me. (Psalms 142:7)

text: הֵן בקדשו בִּקְדֹשָׁיו לֹא יַאֲמִין וְשָׁמַיִם לֹא זַכּוּ בְעֵינָֽיו׃
translation: Behold, he puts no trust in his holy ones. Yes, the heavens are not clean in his sight; (Job 15:15)

text: לׅׄוּלֵׅׄאׅׄ הֶאֱמַנְתִּי לִרְאוֹת בְּֽטוּב יְהוָה בְּאֶרֶץ חַיִּֽים׃
translation: I am still confident of this: I will see the goodness of the LORD in the land of the living. (Psalms 27:13)

text: וּבַדָּבָר הַזֶּה אֵֽינְכֶם מַאֲמִינִם בַּיהוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃
translation: Yet in this thing you didn't believe the LORD your God, (Deuteronomy 1:32)

text: וְעַתָּה יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל יֵֽאָמֵן דְּבָרְךָ אֲשֶׁר דִּבַּרְתָּ לְעַבְדְּךָ לְדָוִֽיד׃
translation: Now therefore, LORD, the God of Israel, let your word be verified, which you spoke to your servant David. (2 Chronicles 6:17)

text: הוֹשִׁיעָה יְהוָה כִּי גָמַר חָסִיד כִּי פַסּוּ אֱמוּנִים מִבְּנֵי אָדָֽם׃
translation: Everyone lies to his neighbor. They speak with flattering lips, and with a double heart. (Psalms 12:2)

text: הֶאֱמַנְתִּי כִּי אֲדַבֵּר אֲנִי עָנִיתִי מְאֹֽד׃
translation: I believed, therefore I said, "I was greatly afflicted." (Psalms 116:10)

text: עַל כֵּן יֹאמְרוּ הַמֹּשְׁלִים בֹּאוּ חֶשְׁבּוֹן תִּבָּנֶה וְתִכּוֹנֵן עִיר סִיחֽוֹן׃
translation: Therefore those who speak in proverbs say, "Come to Heshbon. Let the city of Sihon be built and established; (Numbers 21:27)

text: וּמִמַּטֵּה אָשֵׁר אֶת מָשָׁל וְאֶת מִגְרָשֶׁיהָ וְאֶת עַבְדּוֹן וְאֶת מִגְרָשֶֽׁיהָ׃
translation: Ashan with its pasture lands, and Beth Shemesh with its pasture lands; (1 Chronicles 6:59)

text: מִשְׁלֵי שְׁלֹמֹה בֶן דָּוִד מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
translation: The proverbs of Solomon, the son of David, king of Israel: (Proverbs 1:1)

text: מִשְׁלֵי שְׁלֹמֹה בֵּן חָכָם יְשַׂמַּח אָב וּבֵן כְּסִיל תּוּגַת אִמּֽוֹ׃
translation: The proverbs of Solomon. A wise son makes a glad father; but a foolish son brings grief to his mother. (Proverbs 10:1)

text: כִּֽי תֵשֵׁב לִלְחוֹם אֶת מוֹשֵׁל בִּין תָּבִין אֶת אֲשֶׁר לְפָנֶֽיךָ׃
translation: When you sit to eat with a ruler, consider diligently what is before you; (Proverbs 23:1)

text: גַּם אֵלֶּה מִשְׁלֵי שְׁלֹמֹה אֲשֶׁר הֶעְתִּיקוּ אַנְשֵׁי חִזְקִיָּה מֶֽלֶךְ יְהוּדָֽה׃
translation: These also are proverbs of Solomon, which the men of Hezekiah king of Judah copied out. (Proverbs 25:1)

text: זֶה הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהוָה אֶל מוֹאָב מֵאָֽז׃
translation: This is the word that the LORD spoke concerning Moab in time past. (Isaiah 16:13)

text: אַךְ שְׁתַּיִם אַל תַּעַשׂ עִמָּדִי אָז מִפָּנֶיךָ לֹא אֶסָּתֵֽר׃
translation: "Only don't do two things to me, then I will not hide myself from your face: (Job 13:20)

text: יָדַעְתָּ כִּי אָז תִּוָּלֵד וּמִסְפַּר יָמֶיךָ רַבִּֽים׃
translation: Surely you know, for you were born then, and the number of your days is great! (Job 38:21)

text: אָז רָאָהּ וַֽיְסַפְּרָהּ הֱכִינָהּ וְגַם חֲקָרָֽהּ׃
translation: then he saw it, and declared it. He established it, yes, and searched it out. (Job 28:27)

text: בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא אָז נָתַן דָּוִיד בָּרֹאשׁ לְהֹדוֹת לַיהוָה בְּיַד אָסָף וְאֶחָֽיו׃
translation: Then on that day David first ordained giving of thanks to the LORD by the hand of Asaph and his brothers. (1 Chronicles 16:7)

text: אָז יָשׁוּבוּ אוֹיְבַי אָחוֹר בְּיוֹם אֶקְרָא זֶה יָדַעְתִּי כִּֽי אֱלֹהִים לִֽי׃
translation: In God, I will praise his word. In the LORD, I will praise his word. (Psalms 56:10)

text: לַֽמְאַחֲרִים עַל הַיָּיִן לַבָּאִים לַחְקֹר מִמְסָֽךְ׃
translation: Those who stay long at the wine; those who go to seek out mixed wine. (Proverbs 23:30)

text: לִשְׂחוֹק עֹשִׂים לֶחֶם וְיַיִן יְשַׂמַּח חַיִּים וְהַכֶּסֶף יַעֲנֶה אֶת הַכֹּֽל׃
translation: A feast is made for laughter, and wine makes the life glad; and money is the answer for all things. (Ecclesiastes 10:19)

text: וּמַלְכִּי צֶדֶק מֶלֶךְ שָׁלֵם הוֹצִיא לֶחֶם וָיָיִן וְהוּא כֹהֵן לְאֵל עֶלְיֽוֹן׃
translation: Melchizedek king of Salem brought out bread and wine. He was priest of God Most High. (Genesis 14:18)

text: וְיַיִן לַנֶּסֶךְ רְבִיעִית הַהִין תַּעֲשֶׂה עַל הָעֹלָה אוֹ לַזָּבַח לַכֶּבֶשׂ הָאֶחָֽד׃
translation: You shall prepare wine for the drink offering, one fourth of a hin, with the burnt offering or for the sacrifice, for each lamb. (Numbers 15:5)

text: וְעַתָּה הִשָּׁמְרִי נָא וְאַל תִּשְׁתִּי יַיִן וְשֵׁכָר וְאַל תֹּאכְלִי כָּל טָמֵֽא׃
translation: Now therefore please beware and drink no wine nor strong drink, and don't eat any unclean thing; (Judges 13:4)

text: אַל לַֽמְלָכִים לְֽמוֹאֵל אַל לַֽמְלָכִים שְׁתוֹ יָיִן וּלְרוֹזְנִים או אֵי שֵׁכָֽר׃
translation: It is not for kings, Lemuel, it is not for kings to drink wine, nor for princes to say, 'Where is strong drink?' (Proverbs 31:4)

text: רָאִיתִי עֲבָדִים עַל סוּסִים וְשָׂרִים הֹלְכִים כַּעֲבָדִים עַל הָאָֽרֶץ׃
translation: I have seen servants on horses, and princes walking like servants on the earth. (Ecclesiastes 10:7)

text: וּמוֹצִיאִים סוּסִים מִמִּצְרַיִם לִשְׁלֹמֹה וּמִכָּל הָאֲרָצֽוֹת׃
translation: They brought horses for Solomon out of Egypt and out of all lands. (2 Chronicles 9:28)

text: וַיְהִי לִשְׁלֹמֹה אַרְבָּעִים אֶלֶף אֻרְוֺת סוּסִים לְמֶרְכָּבוֹ וּשְׁנֵים עָשָׂר אֶלֶף פָּרָשִֽׁים׃
translation: Now therefore command that cedar trees be cut for me out of Lebanon. My servants will be with your servants; and I will give you wages for your servants according to all that you say. For you know that there is nobody among us who knows how to cut timber like the Sidonians." (1 Kings 5:6)

text: וַיִּרְדְּפוּ מִצְרַיִם וַיָּבֹאוּ אַחֲרֵיהֶם כֹּל סוּס פַּרְעֹה רִכְבּוֹ וּפָרָשָׁיו אֶל תּוֹךְ הַיָּֽם׃
translation: The Egyptians pursued, and went in after them into the middle of the sea: all of Pharaoh's horses, his chariots, and his horsemen. (Exodus 14:23)

text: וַתַּעַן לָהֶם מִרְיָם שִׁירוּ לַֽיהוָה כִּֽי גָאֹה גָּאָה סוּס וְרֹכְבוֹ רָמָה בַיָּֽם׃
translation: Miriam answered them, "Sing to the LORD, for he has triumphed gloriously. He has thrown the horse and his rider into the sea." (Exodus 15:21)

text: וַיִּקְחוּ שְׁנֵי רֶכֶב סוּסִים וַיִּשְׁלַח הַמֶּלֶךְ אַחֲרֵי מַחֲנֵֽה אֲרָם לֵאמֹר לְכוּ וּרְאֽוּ׃
translation: Therefore they took two chariots with horses; and the king sent them out to the Syrian army, saying, "Go and see." (2 Kings 7:14)

text: הִבִּיטוּ אֵלָיו וְנָהָרוּ וּפְנֵיהֶם אַל יֶחְפָּֽרוּ׃
translation: This poor man cried, and the LORD heard him, and saved him out of all his troubles. (Psalms 34:6)

text: הָאֹמֵר לַצּוּלָה חֳרָבִי וְנַהֲרֹתַיִךְ אוֹבִֽישׁ׃
translation: who says to the deep, 'Be dry,' and 'I will dry up your rivers,' (Isaiah 44:27)

text: וַיַּךְ דָּוִיד אֶת הֲדַדְעֶזֶר מֶֽלֶךְ צוֹבָה חֲמָתָה בְּלֶכְתּוֹ לְהַצִּיב יָדוֹ בִּֽנְהַר פְּרָֽת׃
translation: David defeated Hadadezer king of Zobah, toward Hamath, as he went to establish his dominion by the river Euphrates. (1 Chronicles 18:3)

text: וַיְהִי מוֹשֵׁל בְּכָל הַמְּלָכִים מִן הַנָּהָר וְעַד אֶרֶץ פְּלִשְׁתִּים וְעַד גְּבוּל מִצְרָֽיִם׃
translation: He ruled over all the kings from the River even to the land of the Philistines, and to the border of Egypt. (2 Chronicles 9:26)

text: וַיַּךְ דָּוִד אֶת הֲדַדְעֶזֶר בֶּן רְחֹב מֶלֶךְ צוֹבָה בְּלֶכְתּוֹ לְהָשִׁיב יָדוֹ בִּֽנְהַר פְּרָֽת׃
translation: David also struck Hadadezer the son of Rehob, king of Zobah, as he went to recover his dominion at the River. (2 Samuel 8:3)

text: וַיֶּגֶל מֶֽלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל אַשּׁוּרָה וַיַּנְחֵם בַּחְלַח וּבְחָבוֹר נְהַר גּוֹזָן וְעָרֵי מָדָֽי׃
translation: The king of Assyria carried Israel away to Assyria, and put them in Halah, and on the Habor, the river of Gozan, and in the cities of the Medes, (2 Kings 18:11)

text: וַיַּעַשׂ קַרְנֹתָיו עַל אַרְבַּע פִּנֹּתָיו מִמֶּנּוּ הָיוּ קַרְנֹתָיו וַיְצַף אֹתוֹ נְחֹֽשֶׁת׃
translation: He made its horns on its four corners. Its horns were of one piece with it, and he overlaid it with bronze. (Exodus 38:2)

text: וְכֹל כֶּסֶף וְזָהָב וּכְלֵי נְחֹשֶׁת וּבַרְזֶל קֹדֶשׁ הוּא לַֽיהוָה אוֹצַר יְהוָה יָבֽוֹא׃
translation: But all the silver, gold, and vessels of bronze and iron are holy to the LORD. They shall come into the LORD's treasury." (Joshua 6:19)

text: וְאֶת בְּנֵי צִדְקִיָּהוּ שָׁחֲטוּ לְעֵינָיו וְאֶת עֵינֵי צִדְקִיָּהוּ עִוֵּר וַיַּאַסְרֵהוּ בַֽנְחֻשְׁתַּיִם וַיְבִאֵהוּ בָּבֶֽל׃
translation: They killed Zedekiah's sons before his eyes, then put out Zedekiah's eyes, bound him in fetters, and carried him to Babylon. (2 Kings 25:7)

text: קְחוּ מֵֽאִתְּכֶם תְּרוּמָה לַֽיהוָה כֹּל נְדִיב לִבּוֹ יְבִיאֶהָ אֵת תְּרוּמַת יְהוָה זָהָב וָכֶסֶף וּנְחֹֽשֶׁת׃
translation: 'Take from among you an offering to the LORD. Whoever is of a willing heart, let him bring it as the LORD's offering: gold, silver, bronze, (Exodus 35:5)

text: וָאָשֻׁב וָאֶשָּׂא עֵינַי וָֽאֶרְאֶה וְהִנֵּה אַרְבַּע מַרְכָּבוֹת יֹֽצְאוֹת מִבֵּין שְׁנֵי הֶֽהָרִים וְהֶהָרִים הָרֵי נְחֹֽשֶׁת׃
translation: Again I lifted up my eyes, and saw, and behold, four chariots came out from between two mountains; and the mountains were mountains of bronze. (Zechariah 6:1)

text: וַיַּעַשׂ הַמֶּלֶךְ רְחַבְעָם תַּחְתָּם מָגִנֵּי נְחֹשֶׁת וְהִפְקִיד עַל יַד שָׂרֵי הָרָצִים הַשֹּׁמְרִים פֶּתַח בֵּית הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
translation: King Rehoboam made shields of bronze in their place, and committed them to the hands of the captains of the guard, who kept the door of the king's house. (1 Kings 14:27)

text: מַה טֹּבוּ אֹהָלֶיךָ יַעֲקֹב מִשְׁכְּנֹתֶיךָ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
translation: How goodly are your tents, Jacob, and your dwellings, Israel! (Numbers 24:5)

text: אֲשֶׁר שַׂמְתִּי עֲרָבָה בֵיתוֹ וּֽמִשְׁכְּנוֹתָיו מְלֵֽחָה׃
translation: whose home I have made the wilderness, and the salt land his dwelling place? (Job 39:6)

text: וְהָיָה מִשְׁכָּנִי עֲלֵיהֶם וְהָיִיתִי לָהֶם לֵֽאלֹהִים וְהֵמָּה יִֽהְיוּ לִי לְעָֽם׃
translation: My tent also will be with them. I will be their God, and they will be my people. (Ezekiel 37:27)

text: וְאֵת צָדוֹק הַכֹּהֵן וְאֶחָיו הַכֹּהֲנִים לִפְנֵי מִשְׁכַּן יְהוָה בַּבָּמָה אֲשֶׁר בְּגִבְעֽוֹן׃
translation: and Zadok the priest and his brothers the priests, before the LORD's tabernacle in the high place that was at Gibeon, (1 Chronicles 16:39)

text: שְׁלַח אוֹרְךָ וַאֲמִתְּךָ הֵמָּה יַנְחוּנִי יְבִיאוּנִי אֶל הַֽר קָדְשְׁךָ וְאֶל מִשְׁכְּנוֹתֶֽיךָ׃
translation: Oh, send out your light and your truth. Let them lead me. Let them bring me to your holy hill, to your tents. (Psalms 43:3)

text: וַיַּפֵּל בְּקֶרֶב מַחֲנֵהוּ סָבִיב לְמִשְׁכְּנֹתָֽיו׃
translation: He let them fall in the middle of their camp, around their habitations. (Psalms 78:28)

text: וַיִּגְדַּל שְׁמוּאֵל וַֽיהוָה הָיָה עִמּוֹ וְלֹֽא הִפִּיל מִכָּל דְּבָרָיו אָֽרְצָה׃
translation: Samuel grew, and the LORD was with him and let none of his words fall to the ground. (1 Samuel 3:19)

text: בְּנֵי גִדֵּל בְּנֵי גַחַר בְּנֵי רְאָיָֽה׃
translation: the children of Giddel, the children of Gahar, the children of Reaiah, (Ezra 2:47)

text: בְּנֵי יַעְלָה בְנֵי דַרְקוֹן בְּנֵי גִדֵּֽל׃
translation: the children of Jaalah, the children of Darkon, the children of Giddel, (Ezra 2:56)

text: בְּנֵי חָנָן בְּנֵי גִדֵּל בְּנֵי גָֽחַר׃
translation: the children of Hanan, the children of Giddel, the children of Gahar, (Nehemiah 7:49)

text: בְּנֵי יַעְלָא בְנֵי דַרְקוֹן בְּנֵי גִדֵּֽל׃
translation: the children of Jaala, the children of Darkon, the children of Giddel, (Nehemiah 7:58)

text: אֲהַֽלְלָה שֵׁם אֱלֹהִים בְּשִׁיר וַאֲגַדְּלֶנּוּ בְתוֹדָֽה׃
translation: It will please the LORD better than an ox, or a bull that has horns and hoofs. (Psalms 69:31)

text: כִּי הוּא לִקְצוֹת הָאָרֶץ יַבִּיט תַּחַת כָּל הַשָּׁמַיִם יִרְאֶֽה׃
translation: For he looks to the ends of the earth, and sees under the whole sky. (Job 28:24)

text: וַיְהִי מִקְצֵה שִׁבְעַת יָמִים וַיְהִי דְבַר יְהוָה אֵלַי לֵאמֹֽר׃
translation: At the end of seven days, the LORD's word came to me, saying, (Ezekiel 3:16)

text: בַּיָּמִים הָהֵם הֵחֵל יְהוָה לְקַצּוֹת בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וַיַּכֵּם חֲזָאֵל בְּכָל גְּבוּל יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
translation: In those days the LORD began to cut away parts of Israel; and Hazael struck them in all the borders of Israel (2 Kings 10:32)

text: בָּאִים מֵאֶרֶץ מֶרְחָק מִקְצֵה הַשָּׁמָיִם יְהוָה וּכְלֵי זַעְמוֹ לְחַבֵּל כָּל הָאָֽרֶץ׃
translation: They come from a far country, from the uttermost part of heaven, even the LORD, and the weapons of his indignation, to destroy the whole land. (Isaiah 13:5)

text: וַיָּשֻׁבוּ הַמַּיִם מֵעַל הָאָרֶץ הָלוֹךְ וָשׁוֹב וַיַּחְסְרוּ הַמַּיִם מִקְצֵה חֲמִשִּׁים וּמְאַת יֽוֹם׃
translation: The waters continually receded from the earth. After the end of one hundred fifty days the waters receded. (Genesis 8:3)

text: שִׁירוּ לַֽיהוָה שִׁיר חָדָשׁ תְּהִלָּתוֹ מִקְצֵה הָאָרֶץ יוֹרְדֵי הַיָּם וּמְלֹאוֹ אִיִּים וְיֹשְׁבֵיהֶֽם׃
translation: Sing to the LORD a new song, and his praise from the end of the earth, you who go down to the sea, and all that is therein, the islands and their inhabitants. (Isaiah 42:10)

text: בְּפָרֵשׂ שַׁדַּי מְלָכִים בָּהּ תַּשְׁלֵג בְּצַלְמֽוֹן׃
translation: The mountains of Bashan are majestic mountains. The mountains of Bashan are rugged. (Psalms 68:15)

text: כַּפָּהּ פָּרְשָׂה לֶעָנִי וְיָדֶיהָ שִׁלְּחָה לָֽאֶבְיֽוֹן׃
translation: She opens her arms to the poor; yes, she extends her hands to the needy. (Proverbs 31:20)

text: כַּאֲשֶׁר יֵלֵכוּ אֶפְרוֹשׂ עֲלֵיהֶם רִשְׁתִּי כְּעוֹף הַשָּׁמַיִם אֽוֹרִידֵם אַיְסִרֵם כְּשֵׁמַע לַעֲדָתָֽם׃
translation: When they go, I will spread my net on them. I will bring them down like the birds of the sky. I will chastise them, as their congregation has heard. (Hosea 7:12)

text: וַיַּעֲמֹד שְׁלֹמֹה לִפְנֵי מִזְבַּח יְהוָה נֶגֶד כָּל קְהַל יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּפְרֹשׂ כַּפָּיו הַשָּׁמָֽיִם׃
translation: Solomon stood before the LORD's altar in the presence of all the assembly of Israel, and spread out his hands toward heaven; (1 Kings 8:22)

text: וְאֶת בְּשַׂר הַפָּר וְאֶת עֹרוֹ וְאֶת פִּרְשׁוֹ תִּשְׂרֹף בָּאֵשׁ מִחוּץ לַֽמַּחֲנֶה חַטָּאת הֽוּא׃
translation: But the meat of the bull, and its skin, and its dung, you shall burn with fire outside of the camp. It is a sin offering. (Exodus 29:14)

text: וְשָׂרַף אֶת הַפָּרָה לְעֵינָיו אֶת עֹרָהּ וְאֶת בְּשָׂרָהּ וְאֶת דָּמָהּ עַל פִּרְשָׁהּ יִשְׂרֹֽף׃
translation: One shall burn the heifer in his sight; her skin, and her meat, and her blood, with her dung, shall he burn. (Numbers 19:5)

text: וַיִּהְיוּ בָנִים לְשׁוֹבָל אֲבִי קִרְיַת יְעָרִים הָרֹאֶה חֲצִי הַמְּנֻחֽוֹת׃
translation: Shobal the father of Kiriath Jearim had sons: Haroeh, half of the Menuhoth. (1 Chronicles 2:52)

text: לַחֲצִי הַֽמְנַשֶּׁה גִּלְעָדָה יִדּוֹ בֶּן זְכַרְיָהוּ לְבִנְיָמִן יַעֲשִׂיאֵל בֶּן אַבְנֵֽר׃
translation: of the half-tribe of Manasseh in Gilead, Iddo the son of Zechariah; of Benjamin, Jaasiel the son of Abner; (1 Chronicles 27:21)

text: וַיֵּלֶךְ אַחֲרֵיהֶם הוֹשַׁעְיָה וַחֲצִי שָׂרֵי יְהוּדָֽה׃
translation: and after them went Hoshaiah, with half of the princes of Judah, (Nehemiah 12:32)

text: וְנָתַתָּה אֹתָהּ תַּחַת כַּרְכֹּב הַמִּזְבֵּחַ מִלְּמָטָּה וְהָיְתָה הָרֶשֶׁת עַד חֲצִי הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃
translation: You shall put it under the ledge around the altar beneath, that the net may reach halfway up the altar. (Exodus 27:5)

text: אַל נָא תְהִי כַּמֵּת אֲשֶׁר בְּצֵאתוֹ מֵרֶחֶם אִמּוֹ וַיֵּאָכֵל חֲצִי בְשָׂרֽוֹ׃
translation: Let her not, I pray, be as one dead, of whom the flesh is half consumed when he comes out of his mother's womb." (Numbers 12:12)

text: וְעַתָּה חַלֵּק אֶת הָאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת בְּנַחֲלָה לְתִשְׁעַת הַשְּׁבָטִים וַחֲצִי הַשֵּׁבֶט הַֽמְנַשֶּֽׁה׃
translation: Now therefore divide this land for an inheritance to the nine tribes and the half-tribe of Manasseh." (Joshua 13:7)

text: חֻקַּת עוֹלָם לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶם בְּכֹל מֽוֹשְׁבֹתֵיכֶם כָּל חֵלֶב וְכָל דָּם לֹא תֹאכֵֽלוּ׃
translation: "'It shall be a perpetual statute throughout your generations in all your dwellings, that you shall eat neither fat nor blood.'" (Leviticus 3:17)

text: וְאֵת חֵלֶב הַֽחַטָּאת יַקְטִיר הַמִּזְבֵּֽחָה׃
translation: The fat of the sin offering he shall burn on the altar. (Leviticus 16:25)

text: אֶת מִי יוֹרֶה דֵעָה וְאֶת מִי יָבִין שְׁמוּעָה גְּמוּלֵי מֵֽחָלָב עַתִּיקֵי מִשָּׁדָֽיִם׃
translation: Whom will he teach knowledge? To whom will he explain the message? Those who are weaned from the milk, and drawn from the breasts? (Isaiah 28:9)

text: וְאֶת כָּל חֶלְבּוֹ יַקְטִיר הַמִּזְבֵּחָה כְּחֵלֶב זֶבַח הַשְּׁלָמִים וְכִפֶּר עָלָיו הַכֹּהֵן מֵחַטָּאתוֹ וְנִסְלַח לֽוֹ׃
translation: All its fat he shall burn on the altar, like the fat of the sacrifice of peace offerings; and the priest shall make atonement for him concerning his sin, and he will be forgiven. (Leviticus 4:26)

text: לֹא קָנִיתָ לִּי בַכֶּסֶף קָנֶה וְחֵלֶב זְבָחֶיךָ לֹא הִרְוִיתָנִי אַךְ הֶעֱבַדְתַּנִי בְּחַטֹּאותֶיךָ הוֹגַעְתַּנִי בַּעֲוֺנֹתֶֽיךָ׃
translation: You have bought me no sweet cane with money, nor have you filled me with the fat of your sacrifices, but you have burdened me with your sins. You have wearied me with your iniquities. (Isaiah 43:24)

text: וְיָנַקְתְּ חֲלֵב גּוֹיִם וְשֹׁד מְלָכִים תִּינָקִי וְיָדַעַתְּ כִּי אֲנִי יְהוָה מֽוֹשִׁיעֵךְ וְגֹאֲלֵךְ אֲבִיר יַעֲקֹֽב׃
