translation: You will also drink the milk of the nations, and will nurse from royal breasts. Then you will know that I, the LORD, am your Savior, your Redeemer, the Mighty One of Jacob. (Isaiah 60:16)

text: מָלַךְ אֱלֹהִים עַל גּוֹיִם אֱלֹהִים יָשַׁב עַל כִּסֵּא קָדְשֽׁוֹ׃
translation: The princes of the peoples are gathered together, the people of the God of Abraham. For the shields of the earth belong to God. He is greatly exalted! (Psalms 47:9)

text: אַתָּה יְהוָה לְעוֹלָם תֵּשֵׁב כִּסְאֲךָ לְדֹר וָדֽוֹר׃
translation: You, LORD, remain forever. Your throne is from generation to generation. (Lamentations 5:19)

text: הוּא יִבְנֶה בַּיִת לִשְׁמִי וְכֹנַנְתִּי אֶת כִּסֵּא מַמְלַכְתּוֹ עַד עוֹלָֽם׃
translation: He will build a house for my name, and I will establish the throne of his kingdom forever. (2 Samuel 7:13)

text: וְהַֽעֲמַדְתִּיהוּ בְּבֵיתִי וּבְמַלְכוּתִי עַד הָעוֹלָם וְכִסְאוֹ יִהְיֶה נָכוֹן עַד עוֹלָֽם׃
translation: but I will settle him in my house and in my kingdom forever. His throne will be established forever."'" (1 Chronicles 17:14)

text: מְאַחֵז פְּנֵי כִסֵּה פַּרְשֵׁז עָלָיו עֲנָנֽוֹ׃
translation: He encloses the face of his throne, and spreads his cloud on it. (Job 26:9)

text: וַֽיהוָה לְעוֹלָם יֵשֵׁב כּוֹנֵן לַמִּשְׁפָּט כִּסְאֽוֹ׃
translation: He will judge the world in righteousness. He will administer judgment to the peoples in uprightness. (Psalms 9:8)

text: בְּנֵי רְאוּבֵן בְּכוֹר יִשְׂרָאֵל חֲנוֹךְ וּפַלּוּא חֶצְרוֹן וְכַרְמִֽי׃
translation: the sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel: Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi. (1 Chronicles 5:3)

text: וּבְנוֹ הַבְּכוֹר עַבְדּוֹן וְצוּר וְקִישׁ וּבַעַל וְנֵר וְנָדָֽב׃
translation: His firstborn son was Abdon, then Zur, Kish, Baal, Ner, Nadab, (1 Chronicles 9:36)

text: וּכְנַעַן יָלַד אֶת צִידֹן בְּכֹרוֹ וְאֶת חֵֽת׃
translation: Canaan became the father of Sidon (his firstborn), Heth, (Genesis 10:15)

text: וְאֵלֶּה שְׁמוֹת בְּֽנֵי אַהֲרֹן הַבְּכוֹר נָדָב וַאֲבִיהוּא אֶלְעָזָר וְאִיתָמָֽר׃
translation: These are the names of the sons of Aaron: Nadab the firstborn, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar. (Numbers 3:2)

text: וּכְנַעַן יָלַד אֶת צִידוֹן בְּכֹרוֹ וְאֶת חֵֽת׃
translation: Canaan became the father of Sidon his firstborn, Heth, (1 Chronicles 1:13)

text: וּבְנוֹ הַבְּכוֹר עַבְדּוֹן וְצוּר וְקִישׁ וּבַעַל וְנָדָֽב׃
translation: with his firstborn son Abdon, Zur, Kish, Baal, Nadab, (1 Chronicles 8:30)

text: וַיִּפְשְׁעוּ יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּבֵית דָּוִד עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּֽה׃
translation: So Israel rebelled against David's house to this day. (1 Kings 12:19)

text: בְּיָמָיו פָּשַׁע אֱדוֹם מִתַּחַת יַד יְהוּדָה וַיַּמְלִכוּ עֲלֵיהֶם מֶֽלֶךְ׃
translation: In his days Edom revolted from under the hand of Judah, and made a king over themselves. (2 Kings 8:20)

text: וַיִּפְשְׁעוּ יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּבֵית דָּוִיד עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּֽה׃
translation: So Israel rebelled against David's house to this day. (2 Chronicles 10:19)

text: בְּיָמָיו פָּשַׁע אֱדוֹם מִתַּחַת יַד יְהוּדָה וַיַּמְלִיכוּ עֲלֵיהֶם מֶֽלֶךְ׃
translation: In his days Edom revolted from under the hand of Judah, and made a king over themselves. (2 Chronicles 21:8)

text: זִכְרוּ זֹאת וְהִתְאֹשָׁשׁוּ הָשִׁיבוּ פוֹשְׁעִים עַל לֵֽב׃
translation: "Remember this, and show yourselves men. Bring it to mind again, you transgressors. (Isaiah 46:8)

text: וַיִּפְשַׁע מוֹאָב בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל אַחֲרֵי מוֹת אַחְאָֽב׃
translation: Moab rebelled against Israel after the death of Ahab. (2 Kings 1:1)

text: וּמֵאָשֵׁר יוֹצְאֵי צָבָא לַעֲרֹךְ מִלְחָמָה אַרְבָּעִים אָֽלֶף׃
translation: On the other side of the Jordan, of the Reubenites, the Gadites, and of the half-tribe of Manasseh, with all kinds of instruments of war for the battle: one hundred twenty thousand. (1 Chronicles 12:37)

text: בְּנֵי קִרְיַת עָרִים כְּפִירָה וּבְאֵרוֹת שְׁבַע מֵאוֹת וְאַרְבָּעִים וּשְׁלֹשָֽׁה׃
translation: The children of Kiriath Arim, Chephirah, and Beeroth, seven hundred forty-three. (Ezra 2:25)

text: אַנְשֵׁי קִרְיַת יְעָרִים כְּפִירָה וּבְאֵרוֹת שְׁבַע מֵאוֹת אַרְבָּעִים וּשְׁלֹשָֽׁה׃
translation: The men of Kiriath Jearim, Chephirah, and Beeroth: seven hundred forty-three. (Nehemiah 7:29)

text: אֵלֶּה בְנֵי בִנְיָמִן לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם וּפְקֻדֵיהֶם חֲמִשָּׁה וְאַרְבָּעִים אֶלֶף וְשֵׁשׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃
translation: These are the sons of Benjamin after their families; and those who were counted of them were forty-five thousand six hundred. (Numbers 26:41)

text: אֵלֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹת נַפְתָּלִי לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם וּפְקֻדֵיהֶם חֲמִשָּׁה וְאַרְבָּעִים אֶלֶף וְאַרְבַּע מֵאֽוֹת׃
translation: These are the families of Naphtali according to their families; and those who were counted of them were forty-five thousand four hundred. (Numbers 26:50)

text: וְהַיָּמִים אֲשֶׁר מָלַךְ שְׁלֹמֹה בִירוּשָׁלִַם עַל כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵל אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָֽה׃
translation: The time that Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel was forty years. (1 Kings 11:42)

text: מִסְפַּר צְעָדַי אַגִּידֶנּוּ כְּמוֹ נָגִיד אֲקָרֲבֶֽנּוּ׃
translation: I would declare to him the number of my steps. I would go near to him like a prince. (Job 31:37)

text: בִּֽהְיוֹתָם מְתֵי מִסְפָּר כִּמְעַט וְגָרִים בָּֽהּ׃
translation: when they were but a few men in number, yes, very few, and foreigners in it. (Psalms 105:12)

text: וַֽיְהִי מִסְפַּר הַיָּמִים אֲשֶׁר יָשַׁב דָּוִד בִּשְׂדֵה פְלִשְׁתִּים יָמִים וְאַרְבָּעָה חֳדָשִֽׁים׃
translation: The number of the days that David lived in the country of the Philistines was a full year and four months. (1 Samuel 27:7)

text: וְאֵלֶּה מִסְפָּרָם אֲגַרְטְלֵי זָהָב שְׁלֹשִׁים אֲגַרְטְלֵי כֶסֶף אָלֶף מַחֲלָפִים תִּשְׁעָה וְעֶשְׂרִֽים׃
translation: This is the number of them: thirty platters of gold, one thousand platters of silver, twenty-nine knives, (Ezra 1:9)

text: מָֽתְקוּ לוֹ רִגְבֵי נָחַל וְאַחֲרָיו כָּל אָדָם יִמְשׁוֹךְ וּלְפָנָיו אֵין מִסְפָּֽר׃
translation: The clods of the valley will be sweet to him. All men will draw after him, as there were innumerable before him. (Job 21:33)

text: וַיְהִי מִסְפָּרָם עִם אֲחֵיהֶם מְלֻמְּדֵי שִׁיר לַיהוָה כָּל הַמֵּבִין מָאתַיִם שְׁמוֹנִים וּשְׁמוֹנָֽה׃
translation: The number of them, with their brothers who were instructed in singing to the LORD, even all who were skillful, was two hundred eighty-eight. (1 Chronicles 25:7)

text: בְּתִשְׁעָה לַחֹדֶשׁ וַיֶּחֱזַק הָרָעָב בָּעִיר וְלֹא הָיָה לֶחֶם לְעַם הָאָֽרֶץ׃
translation: On the ninth day of the fourth month, the famine was severe in the city, so that there was no bread for the people of the land. (2 Kings 25:3)

text: בְּרָעָב פָּֽדְךָ מִמָּוֶת וּבְמִלְחָמָה מִידֵי חָֽרֶב׃
translation: In famine he will redeem you from death; in war, from the power of the sword. (Job 5:20)

text: וַיּוֹשֶׁב שָׁם רְעֵבִים וַיְכוֹנְנוּ עִיר מוֹשָֽׁב׃
translation: There he makes the hungry live, that they may prepare a city to live in, (Psalms 107:36)

text: וַיָּבֹאוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לִשְׁבֹּר בְּתוֹךְ הַבָּאִים כִּֽי הָיָה הָרָעָב בְּאֶרֶץ כְּנָֽעַן׃
translation: The sons of Israel came to buy among those who came, for the famine was in the land of Canaan. (Genesis 42:5)

text: לְהַצִּיל מִמָּוֶת נַפְשָׁם וּלְחַיּוֹתָם בָּרָעָֽב׃
translation: to deliver their soul from death, to keep them alive in famine. (Psalms 33:19)

text: וַיְהִי רָעָב בָּאָרֶץ וַיֵּרֶד אַבְרָם מִצְרַיְמָה לָגוּר שָׁם כִּֽי כָבֵד הָרָעָב בָּאָֽרֶץ׃
translation: There was a famine in the land. Abram went down into Egypt to live as a foreigner there, for the famine was severe in the land. (Genesis 12:10)

text: וּלְמַטֵּה בְנֵי דָן נָשִׂיא בֻּקִּי בֶּן יָגְלִֽי׃
translation: Of the tribe of the children of Dan a prince, Bukki the son of Jogli. (Numbers 34:22)

text: לִבְנֵי יוֹסֵף לְמַטֵּה בְנֵֽי מְנַשֶּׁה נָשִׂיא חַנִּיאֵל בֶּן אֵפֹֽד׃
translation: Of the children of Joseph: of the tribe of the children of Manasseh a prince, Hanniel the son of Ephod. (Numbers 34:23)

text: וּלְמַטֵּה בְנֵֽי אֶפְרַיִם נָשִׂיא קְמוּאֵל בֶּן שִׁפְטָֽן׃
translation: Of the tribe of the children of Ephraim a prince, Kemuel the son of Shiphtan. (Numbers 34:24)

text: וּלְמַטֵּה בְנֵֽי זְבוּלֻן נָשִׂיא אֱלִיצָפָן בֶּן פַּרְנָֽךְ׃
translation: Of the tribe of the children of Zebulun a prince, Elizaphan the son of Parnach. (Numbers 34:25)

text: וּלְמַטֵּה בְנֵֽי יִשָׂשכָר נָשִׂיא פַּלְטִיאֵל בֶּן עַזָּֽן׃
translation: Of the tribe of the children of Issachar a prince, Paltiel the son of Azzan. (Numbers 34:26)

text: וּלְמַטֵּה בְנֵי אָשֵׁר נָשִׂיא אֲחִיהוּד בֶּן שְׁלֹמִֽי׃
translation: Of the tribe of the children of Asher a prince, Ahihud the son of Shelomi. (Numbers 34:27)

text: יְֽהוָה מָה אָדָם וַתֵּדָעֵהוּ בֶּן אֱנוֹשׁ וַֽתְּחַשְּׁבֵֽהוּ׃
translation: LORD, what is man, that you care for him? Or the son of man, that you think of him? (Psalms 144:3)

text: וַאֲנִי יִסַּרְתִּי חִזַּקְתִּי זְרֽוֹעֹתָם וְאֵלַי יְחַשְּׁבוּ רָֽע׃
translation: Though I have taught and strengthened their arms, yet they plot evil against me. (Hosea 7:15)

text: הַלְהוֹכַח מִלִּים תַּחְשֹׁבוּ וּלְרוּחַ אִמְרֵי נֹאָֽשׁ׃
translation: Do you intend to reprove words, since the speeches of one who is desperate are as wind? (Job 6:26)

text: לָֽמָּה פָנֶיךָ תַסְתִּיר וְתַחְשְׁבֵנִי לְאוֹיֵב לָֽךְ׃
translation: Why do you hide your face, and consider me your enemy? (Job 13:24)

text: הֲזֹאת חָשַׁבְתָּ לְמִשְׁפָּט אָמַרְתָּ צִדְקִי מֵאֵֽל׃
translation: "Do you think this to be your right, or do you say, 'My righteousness is more than God's,' (Job 35:2)

text: אַשְֽׁרֵי אָדָם לֹא יַחְשֹׁב יְהוָה לוֹ עָוֺן וְאֵין בְּרוּחוֹ רְמִיָּה׃
translation: Blessed is the man to whom the LORD doesn't impute iniquity, in whose spirit there is no deceit. (Psalms 32:2)

text: וְתִיטַב לַֽיהוָה מִשּׁוֹר פָּר מַקְרִן מַפְרִֽיס׃
translation: The humble have seen it, and are glad. You who seek after God, let your heart live. (Psalms 69:32)

text: וְהִקְרִיב אַהֲרֹן אֶת פַּר הַחַטָּאת אֲשֶׁר לוֹ וְכִפֶּר בַּעֲדוֹ וּבְעַד בֵּיתֽוֹ׃
translation: "Aaron shall offer the bull of the sin offering, which is for himself, and make atonement for himself and for his house. (Leviticus 16:6)

text: פַּר אֶחָד בֶּן בָּקָר אַיִל אֶחָד כֶּֽבֶשׂ אֶחָד בֶּן שְׁנָתוֹ לְעֹלָֽה׃
translation: one young bull, one ram, one male lamb a year old, for a burnt offering; (Numbers 7:45)

text: פַּר אֶחָד בֶּן בָּקָר אַיִל אֶחָד כֶּֽבֶשׂ אֶחָד בֶּן שְׁנָתוֹ לְעֹלָֽה׃
translation: one young bull, one ram, one male lamb a year old, for a burnt offering; (Numbers 7:51)

text: פַּר אֶחָד בֶּן בָּקָר אַיִל אֶחָד כֶּֽבֶשׂ אֶחָד בֶּן שְׁנָתוֹ לְעֹלָֽה׃
translation: one young bull, one ram, one male lamb a year old, for a burnt offering; (Numbers 7:57)

text: פַּר אֶחָד בֶּן בָּקָר אַיִל אֶחָד כֶּֽבֶשׂ אֶחָד בֶּן שְׁנָתוֹ לְעֹלָֽה׃
translation: one young bull, one ram, one male lamb a year old, for a burnt offering; (Numbers 7:63)

text: עִיר פְּרוּצָה אֵין חוֹמָה אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר אֵין מַעְצָר לְרוּחֽוֹ׃
translation: Like a city that is broken down and without walls is a man whose spirit is without restraint. (Proverbs 25:28)

text: וַאֲנִי אֶֽהְיֶה לָּהּ נְאֻם יְהוָה חוֹמַת אֵשׁ סָבִיב וּלְכָבוֹד אֶֽהְיֶה בְתוֹכָֽהּ׃
translation: For, behold, I will shake my hand over them, and they will be a plunder to those who served them; and you will know that the LORD of Armies has sent me. (Zechariah 2:9)

text: וְשִׁחֲתוּ חֹמוֹת צֹר וְהָֽרְסוּ מִגְדָּלֶיהָ וְסִֽחֵיתִי עֲפָרָהּ מִמֶּנָּה וְנָתַתִּי אוֹתָהּ לִצְחִיחַ סָֽלַע׃
translation: They will destroy the walls of Tyre, and break down her towers. I will also scrape her dust from her, and make her a bare rock. (Ezekiel 26:4)

text: חוֹמָה הָיוּ עָלֵינוּ גַּם לַיְלָה גַּם יוֹמָם כָּל יְמֵי הֱיוֹתֵנוּ עִמָּם רֹעִים הַצֹּֽאן׃
translation: They were a wall to us both by night and by day, all the while we were with them keeping the sheep. (1 Samuel 25:16)

text: וַֽיְהִי מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל עֹבֵר עַל הַחֹמָה וְאִשָּׁה צָעֲקָה אֵלָיו לֵאמֹר הוֹשִׁיעָה אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
translation: As the king of Israel was passing by on the wall, a woman cried to him, saying, "Help, my lord, O king!" (2 Kings 6:26)

text: לֹא יִשָּׁמַע עוֹד חָמָס בְּאַרְצֵךְ שֹׁד וָשֶׁבֶר בִּגְבוּלָיִךְ וְקָרָאת יְשׁוּעָה חוֹמֹתַיִךְ וּשְׁעָרַיִךְ תְּהִלָּֽה׃
translation: Violence shall no more be heard in your land, nor desolation or destruction within your borders; but you will call your walls Salvation, and your gates Praise. (Isaiah 60:18)

text: אִם יַחְפֹּץ לָרִיב עִמּוֹ לֹֽא יַעֲנֶנּוּ אַחַת מִנִּי אָֽלֶף׃
translation: If he is pleased to contend with him, he can't answer him one time in a thousand. (Job 9:3)

text: הַבְּרָב כֹּחַ יָרִיב עִמָּדִי לֹא אַךְ הוּא יָשִׂם בִּֽי׃
translation: Would he contend with me in the greatness of his power? No, but he would listen to me. (Job 23:6)

text: וַֽתְּפַלְּטֵנִי מֵרִיבֵי עַמִּי תִּשְׁמְרֵנִי לְרֹאשׁ גּוֹיִם עַם לֹא יָדַעְתִּי יַעַבְדֻֽנִי׃
translation: You also have delivered me from the strivings of my people. You have kept me to be the head of the nations. A people whom I have not known will serve me. (2 Samuel 22:44)

text: תְּפַלְּטֵנִי מֵרִיבֵי עָם תְּשִׂימֵנִי לְרֹאשׁ גּוֹיִם עַם לֹא יָדַעְתִּי יַֽעַבְדֽוּנִי׃
translation: As soon as they hear of me they shall obey me. The foreigners shall submit themselves to me. (Psalms 18:44)

text: לָכֵן עֹד אָרִיב אִתְּכֶם נְאֻם יְהוָה וְאֶת בְּנֵי בְנֵיכֶם אָרִֽיב׃
translation: "Therefore I will yet contend with you," says the LORD, "and I will contend with your children's children. (Jeremiah 2:9)

text: רַבְתָּ אֲדֹנָי רִיבֵי נַפְשִׁי גָּאַלְתָּ חַיָּֽי׃
translation: Lord, you have pleaded the causes of my soul. You have redeemed my life. (Lamentations 3:58)

text: וַיַּרְא הָמָן כִּי אֵין מָרְדֳּכַי כֹּרֵעַ וּמִֽשְׁתַּחֲוֶה לוֹ וַיִּמָּלֵא הָמָן חֵמָֽה׃
translation: When Haman saw that Mordecai didn't bow down nor pay him homage, Haman was full of wrath. (Esther 3:5)

text: כִּֽי כָלִינוּ בְאַפֶּךָ וּֽבַחֲמָתְךָ נִבְהָֽלְנוּ׃
translation: For we are consumed in your anger. We are troubled in your wrath. (Psalms 90:7)

text: כְּעַל גְּמֻלוֹת כְּעַל יְשַׁלֵּם חֵמָה לְצָרָיו גְּמוּל לְאֹֽיְבָיו לָאִיִּים גְּמוּל יְשַׁלֵּֽם׃
translation: According to their deeds, he will repay as appropriate: wrath to his adversaries, recompense to his enemies. He will repay the islands their due. (Isaiah 59:18)

text: וְנִלְחַמְתִּי אֲנִי אִתְּכֶם בְּיָד נְטוּיָה וּבִזְרוֹעַ חֲזָקָה וּבְאַף וּבְחֵמָה וּבְקֶצֶף גָּדֽוֹל׃
translation: I myself will fight against you with an outstretched hand and with a strong arm, even in anger, in wrath, and in great indignation. (Jeremiah 21:5)

text: וְרוּחַ נְשָׂאַתְנִי וַתִּקָּחֵנִי וָאֵלֵךְ מַר בַּחֲמַת רוּחִי וְיַד יְהוָה עָלַי חָזָֽקָה׃
translation: So the Spirit lifted me up, and took me away; and I went in bitterness, in the heat of my spirit; and the LORD's hand was strong on me. (Ezekiel 3:14)

text: גּוּרוּ לָכֶם מִפְּנֵי חֶרֶב כִּֽי חֵמָה עֲוֺנוֹת חָרֶב לְמַעַן תֵּדְעוּן שדין שַׁדּֽוּן׃
translation: be afraid of the sword, for wrath brings the punishments of the sword, that you may know there is a judgment." (Job 19:29)

text: כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה בַּיּוֹם הַזֶּה צִוָּה יְהוָה לַעֲשֹׂת לְכַפֵּר עֲלֵיכֶֽם׃
translation: What has been done today, so the LORD has commanded to do, to make atonement for you. (Leviticus 8:34)

text: לְכָה דוֹדִי נֵצֵא הַשָּׂדֶה נָלִינָה בַּכְּפָרִֽים׃
translation: Let's go early up to the vineyards. Let's see whether the vine has budded, its blossom is open, and the pomegranates are in flower. There I will give you my love. (Song of Solomon 7:12)

text: שִׁבְעַת יָמִים יְכַפְּרוּ אֶת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וְטִֽהֲרוּ אֹתוֹ וּמִלְאוּ ידו יָדָֽיו׃
translation: Seven days shall they make atonement for the altar and purify it. So shall they consecrate it. (Ezekiel 43:26)

text: וְכֵן תַּֽעֲשֶׂה בְּשִׁבְעָה בַחֹדֶשׁ מֵאִישׁ שֹׁגֶה וּמִפֶּתִי וְכִפַּרְתֶּם אֶת הַבָּֽיִת׃
translation: So you shall do on the seventh day of the month for everyone who errs, and for him who is simple. So you shall make atonement for the house. (Ezekiel 45:20)

text: אִם כֹּפֶר יוּשַׁת עָלָיו וְנָתַן פִּדְיֹן נַפְשׁוֹ כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר יוּשַׁת עָלָֽיו׃
translation: If a ransom is imposed on him, then he shall give for the redemption of his life whatever is imposed. (Exodus 21:30)

text: כַּֽחַטָּאת כָּֽאָשָׁם תּוֹרָה אַחַת לָהֶם הַכֹּהֵן אֲשֶׁר יְכַפֶּר בּוֹ לוֹ יִהְיֶֽה׃
translation: "'As is the sin offering, so is the trespass offering; there is one law for them. The priest who makes atonement with them shall have it. (Leviticus 7:7)

text: כִּי חֹק לְיִשְׂרָאֵל הוּא מִשְׁפָּט לֵאלֹהֵי יַעֲקֹֽב׃
translation: He appointed it in Joseph for a covenant, when he went out over the land of Egypt, I heard a language that I didn't know. (Psalms 81:5)

text: יְהִֽי לִבִּי תָמִים בְּחֻקֶּיךָ לְמַעַן לֹא אֵבֽוֹשׁ׃
translation: Let my heart be blameless toward your decrees, that I may not be disappointed. KAPF (Psalms 119:80)

text: מַגִּיד דברו דְּבָרָיו לְיַעֲקֹב חֻקָּיו וּמִשְׁפָּטָיו לְיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
translation: He shows his word to Jacob, his statutes and his ordinances to Israel. (Psalms 147:19)

text: וַיַּעֲמִידֵם לָעַד לְעוֹלָם חָק נָתַן וְלֹא יַעֲבֽוֹר׃
translation: He has also established them forever and ever. He has made a decree which will not pass away. (Psalms 148:6)

text: וְזָכַרְתָּ כִּי עֶבֶד הָיִיתָ בְּמִצְרָיִם וְשָׁמַרְתָּ וְעָשִׂיתָ אֶת הַֽחֻקִּים הָאֵֽלֶּה׃
translation: You shall remember that you were a slave in Egypt. You shall observe and do these statutes. (Deuteronomy 16:12)

text: וַיַּעֲמִידֶהָ לְיַעֲקֹב לְחֹק לְיִשְׂרָאֵל בְּרִית עוֹלָֽם׃
translation: He confirmed it to Jacob for a statute, and to Israel for an everlasting covenant, (1 Chronicles 16:17)

text: וְהַנִּשְׁבֶּרֶת וַתַּֽעֲמֹדְנָה אַרְבַּע תַּחְתֶּיהָ אַרְבַּע מַלְכֻיוֹת מִגּוֹי יַעֲמֹדְנָה וְלֹא בְכֹחֽוֹ׃
translation: As for that which was broken, in the place where four stood up, four kingdoms will stand up out of the nation, but not with his power. (Daniel 8:22)

text: וְהָאֲנָקָה וְהַכֹּחַ וְהַלְּטָאָה וְהַחֹמֶט וְהַתִּנְשָֽׁמֶת׃
translation: the gecko, and the monitor lizard, the wall lizard, the skink, and the chameleon. (Leviticus 11:30)

text: מֵכִין הָרִים בְּכֹחוֹ נֶאְזָר בִּגְבוּרָֽה׃
translation: You still the roaring of the seas, the roaring of their waves, and the turmoil of the nations. (Psalms 65:7)

text: הִתְרַפִּיתָ בְּיוֹם צָרָה צַר כֹּחֶֽכָה׃
translation: If you falter in the time of trouble, your strength is small. (Proverbs 24:10)

text: רַגְלֵי חסידו חֲסִידָיו יִשְׁמֹר וּרְשָׁעִים בַּחֹשֶׁךְ יִדָּמּוּ כִּֽי לֹא בְכֹחַ יִגְבַּר אִֽישׁ׃
translation: He will keep the feet of his holy ones, but the wicked will be put to silence in darkness; for no man will prevail by strength. (1 Samuel 2:9)

text: הַחֲרִישׁוּ אֵלַי אִיִּים וּלְאֻמִּים יַחֲלִיפוּ כֹחַ יִגְּשׁוּ אָז יְדַבֵּרוּ יַחְדָּו לַמִּשְׁפָּט נִקְרָֽבָה׃
translation: "Keep silent before me, islands, and let the peoples renew their strength. Let them come near, then let them speak. Let's meet together for judgment. (Isaiah 41:1)

text: וְהַקָּאָת וְאֶֽת הָרָחָמָה וְאֶת הַשָּׁלָֽךְ׃
translation: the pelican, the vulture, the cormorant, (Deuteronomy 14:17)

text: יֵֽצְרוּ צַעֲדֵי אוֹנוֹ וְֽתַשְׁלִיכֵהוּ עֲצָתֽוֹ׃
translation: The steps of his strength will be shortened. His own counsel will cast him down. (Job 18:7)

text: וְעַד שַֽׂר הַצָּבָא הִגְדִּיל וּמִמֶּנּוּ הרים הוּרַם הַתָּמִיד וְהֻשְׁלַךְ מְכוֹן מִקְדָּשֽׁוֹ׃
translation: Yes, it magnified itself, even to the prince of the army; and it took away from him the continual burnt offering, and the place of his sanctuary was cast down. (Daniel 8:11)

text: וְאַנְשֵׁי קֹדֶשׁ תִּהְיוּן לִי וּבָשָׂר בַּשָּׂדֶה טְרֵפָה לֹא תֹאכֵלוּ לַכֶּלֶב תַּשְׁלִכוּן אֹתֽוֹ׃
translation: You shall do likewise with your cattle and with your sheep. It shall be with its mother seven days, then on the eighth day you shall give it to me. (Exodus 22:30)

text: אֲשֶׁר נִלְחַם אָבִי עֲלֵיכֶם וַיַּשְׁלֵךְ אֶת נַפְשׁוֹ מִנֶּגֶד וַיַּצֵּל אֶתְכֶם מִיַּד מִדְיָֽן׃
translation: (for my father fought for you, risked his life, and delivered you out of the hand of Midian; (Judges 9:17)

text: וַיְצַו פַּרְעֹה לְכָל עַמּוֹ לֵאמֹר כָּל הַבֵּן הַיִּלּוֹד הַיְאֹרָה תַּשְׁלִיכֻהוּ וְכָל הַבַּת תְּחַיּֽוּן׃
translation: Pharaoh commanded all his people, saying, "You shall cast every son who is born into the river, and every daughter you shall save alive." (Exodus 1:22)

text: לְהוֹדִֽיעֲךָ קֹשְׁטְ אִמְרֵי אֱמֶת לְהָשִׁיב אֲמָרִים אֱמֶת לְשֹׁלְחֶֽיךָ׃
translation: To teach you truth, reliable words, to give sound answers to the ones who sent you? (Proverbs 22:21)

text: כִּֽי חַסְדְּךָ לְנֶגֶד עֵינָי וְהִתְהַלַּכְתִּי בַּאֲמִתֶּֽךָ׃
translation: For your loving kindness is before my eyes. I have walked in your truth. (Psalms 26:3)

text: סְמוּכִים לָעַד לְעוֹלָם עֲשׂוּיִם בֶּאֱמֶת וְיָשָֽׁר׃
translation: They are established forever and ever. They are done in truth and uprightness. (Psalms 111:8)

text: וְֽאַל תַּצֵּל מִפִּי דְבַר אֱמֶת עַד מְאֹד כִּי לְמִשְׁפָּטֶךָ יִחָֽלְתִּי׃
translation: Don't snatch the word of truth out of my mouth, for I put my hope in your ordinances. (Psalms 119:43)

text: קָרוֹב אַתָּה יְהוָה וְֽכָל מִצְוֺתֶיךָ אֱמֶֽת׃
translation: You are near, LORD. All your commandments are truth. (Psalms 119:151)

text: וְיָמִים רַבִּים לְיִשְׂרָאֵל לְלֹא אֱלֹהֵי אֱמֶת וּלְלֹא כֹּהֵן מוֹרֶה וּלְלֹא תוֹרָֽה׃
translation: Now for a long time Israel was without the true God, without a teaching priest, and without law. (2 Chronicles 15:3)

text: בְּרֶגַע קָטֹן עֲזַבְתִּיךְ וּבְרַחֲמִים גְּדֹלִים אֲקַבְּצֵֽךְ׃
translation: "For a small moment I have forsaken you, but I will gather you with great mercies. (Isaiah 54:7)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל קִבְצוּ אֶת כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵל הַמִּצְפָּתָה וְאֶתְפַּלֵּל בַּעַדְכֶם אֶל יְהוָֽה׃
translation: Samuel said, "Gather all Israel to Mizpah, and I will pray to the LORD for you." (1 Samuel 7:5)

text: וַיִּשְׁלַח אַחְאָב בְּכָל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּקְבֹּץ אֶת הַנְּבִיאִים אֶל הַר הַכַּרְמֶֽל׃
translation: So Ahab sent to all the children of Israel, and gathered the prophets together to Mount Carmel. (1 Kings 18:20)

text: הוֹשִׁיעֵנוּ יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ וְקַבְּצֵנוּ מִֽן הַגּוֹיִם לְהֹדוֹת לְשֵׁם קָדְשֶׁךָ לְהִשְׁתַּבֵּחַ בִּתְהִלָּתֶֽךָ׃
translation: Save us, LORD, our God, gather us from among the nations, to give thanks to your holy name, to triumph in your praise! (Psalms 106:47)

text: וַיִּקָּבְצוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים וַיָּבֹאוּ וַיַּחֲנוּ בְשׁוּנֵם וַיִּקְבֹּץ שָׁאוּל אֶת כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵל וַֽיַּחֲנוּ בַּגִּלְבֹּֽעַ׃
translation: The Philistines gathered themselves together, and came and encamped in Shunem; and Saul gathered all Israel together, and they encamped in Gilboa. (1 Samuel 28:4)

text: וַיִּקָּבְצוּ יְהוּדָה לְבַקֵּשׁ מֵֽיְהוָה גַּם מִכָּל עָרֵי יְהוּדָה בָּאוּ לְבַקֵּשׁ אֶת יְהוָֽה׃
translation: Judah gathered themselves together to seek help from the LORD. They came out of all the cities of Judah to seek the LORD. (2 Chronicles 20:4)

text: לֹֽא יָסוּר מִנִּי חֹשֶׁךְ יֹֽנַקְתּוֹ תְּיַבֵּשׁ שַׁלְהָבֶת וְיָסוּר בְּרוּחַ פִּֽיו׃
translation: He will not depart out of darkness. The flame will dry up his branches. He will go away by the breath of God's mouth. (Job 15:30)

text: הֲיִוָּדַע בַּחֹשֶׁךְ פִּלְאֶךָ וְצִדְקָתְךָ בְּאֶרֶץ נְשִׁיָּֽה׃
translation: But to you, LORD, I have cried. In the morning, my prayer comes before you. (Psalms 88:13)

text: הַעֹזְבִים אָרְחוֹת יֹשֶׁר לָלֶכֶת בְּדַרְכֵי חֹֽשֶׁךְ׃
translation: who forsake the paths of uprightness, to walk in the ways of darkness, (Proverbs 2:13)

text: גַּם אֲנִי לֹא אֶחֱשָׂךְ פִּי אֲֽדַבְּרָה בְּצַר רוּחִי אָשִׂיחָה בְּמַר נַפְשִֽׁי׃
translation: "Therefore I will not keep silent. I will speak in the anguish of my spirit. I will complain in the bitterness of my soul. (Job 7:11)

text: הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ יֵהָפֵךְ לְחֹשֶׁךְ וְהַיָּרֵחַ לְדָם לִפְנֵי בּוֹא יוֹם יְהוָה הַגָּדוֹל וְהַנּוֹרָֽא׃
translation: "Yes, and what are you to me, Tyre and Sidon, and all the regions of Philistia? Will you repay me? And if you repay me, I will swiftly and speedily return your repayment on your own head. (Joel 3:4)

text: וַיַּרְא אֱלֹהִים אֶת הָאוֹר כִּי טוֹב וַיַּבְדֵּל אֱלֹהִים בֵּין הָאוֹר וּבֵין הַחֹֽשֶׁךְ׃
translation: God saw the light, and saw that it was good. God divided the light from the darkness. (Genesis 1:4)

text: וְלֹא תוֹתִירוּ מִמֶּנּוּ עַד בֹּקֶר וְהַנֹּתָר מִמֶּנּוּ עַד בֹּקֶר בָּאֵשׁ תִּשְׂרֹֽפוּ׃
translation: You shall let nothing of it remain until the morning; but that which remains of it until the morning you shall burn with fire. (Exodus 12:10)

text: וְהַנּוֹתָר בַּבָּשָׂר וּבַלָּחֶם בָּאֵשׁ תִּשְׂרֹֽפוּ׃
translation: What remains of the meat and of the bread you shall burn with fire. (Leviticus 8:32)

text: וּבַת אִישׁ כֹּהֵן כִּי תֵחֵל לִזְנוֹת אֶת אָבִיהָ הִיא מְחַלֶּלֶת בָּאֵשׁ תִּשָּׂרֵֽף׃
translation: "'The daughter of any priest, if she profanes herself by playing the prostitute, she profanes her father. She shall be burned with fire. (Leviticus 21:9)

text: וַיָּבֹא אֲבִימֶלֶךְ עַד הַמִּגְדָּל וַיִּלָּחֶם בּוֹ וַיִּגַּשׁ עַד פֶּתַח הַמִּגְדָּל לְשָׂרְפוֹ בָאֵֽשׁ׃
translation: Abimelech came to the tower and fought against it, and came near to the door of the tower to burn it with fire. (Judges 9:52)

text: וְיוֹקִים וְאַנְשֵׁי כֹזֵבָא וְיוֹאָשׁ וְשָׂרָף אֲשֶׁר בָּעֲלוּ לְמוֹאָב וְיָשֻׁבִי לָחֶם וְהַדְּבָרִים עַתִּיקִֽים׃
translation: and Jokim, and the men of Cozeba, and Joash, and Saraph, who had dominion in Moab, and Jashubilehem. These records are ancient. (1 Chronicles 4:22)

text: וְהַשֹּׂרֵף אֹתָם יְכַבֵּס בְּגָדָיו וְרָחַץ אֶת בְּשָׂרוֹ בַּמָּיִם וְאַחֲרֵי כֵן יָבוֹא אֶל הַֽמַּחֲנֶֽה׃
translation: He who burns them shall wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp. (Leviticus 16:28)

text: מִי לִי בַשָּׁמָיִם וְעִמְּךָ לֹא חָפַצְתִּי בָאָֽרֶץ׃
translation: Whom do I have in heaven? There is no one on earth whom I desire besides you. (Psalms 73:25)

text: וַיּוֹצִיאֵנִי לַמֶּרְחָב יְחַלְּצֵנִי כִּי חָפֵֽץ בִּֽי׃
translation: The LORD has rewarded me according to my righteousness. According to the cleanness of my hands, he has recompensed me. (Psalms 18:20)

text: מֵיְהוָה מִֽצְעֲדֵי גֶבֶר כּוֹנָנוּ וְדַרְכּוֹ יֶחְפָּֽץ׃
translation: A man's steps are established by the LORD. He delights in his way. (Psalms 37:23)

text: הַלְלוּ יָהּ אַשְׁרֵי אִישׁ יָרֵא אֶת יְהוָה בְּמִצְוֺתָיו חָפֵץ מְאֹֽד׃
translation: Praise the LORD! Blessed is the man who fears the LORD, who delights greatly in his commandments. (Psalms 112:1)

text: וֵֽאלֹהֵינוּ בַשָּׁמָיִם כֹּל אֲשֶׁר חָפֵץ עָשָֽׂה׃
translation: But our God is in the heavens. He does whatever he pleases. (Psalms 115:3)

text: כִּי לֹא אֶחְפֹּץ בְּמוֹת הַמֵּת נְאֻם אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה וְהָשִׁיבוּ וִֽחְיֽוּ׃
translation: For I have no pleasure in the death of him who dies," says the Lord GOD. "Therefore turn yourselves, and live! (Ezekiel 18:32)

text: כִּי לֹא יָדַעְתִּי אֲכַנֶּה כִּמְעַט יִשָּׂאֵנִי עֹשֵֽׂנִי׃
translation: For I don't know how to give flattering titles, or else my Maker would soon take me away. (Job 32:22)

text: הֲלֹא מְעַט יָמַי יחדל וַחֲדָל ישית וְשִׁית מִמֶּנִּי וְאַבְלִיגָה מְּעָֽט׃
translation: Aren't my days few? Stop! Leave me alone, that I may find a little comfort, (Job 10:20)

text: לָרַב תַּרְבֶּה נַחֲלָתוֹ וְלַמְעַט תַּמְעִיט נַחֲלָתוֹ אִישׁ לְפִי פְקֻדָיו יֻתַּן נַחֲלָתֽוֹ׃
translation: To the more you shall give the more inheritance, and to the fewer you shall give the less inheritance. To everyone according to those who were counted of him shall his inheritance be given. (Numbers 26:54)

text: וְיָצָא מֵהֶם תּוֹדָה וְקוֹל מְשַׂחֲקִים וְהִרְבִּתִים וְלֹא יִמְעָטוּ וְהִכְבַּדְתִּים וְלֹא יִצְעָֽרוּ׃
translation: Thanksgiving will proceed out of them with the voice of those who make merry. I will multiply them, and they will not be few; I will also glorify them, and they will not be small. (Jeremiah 30:19)

text: כִּמְעַט יַעֲבֹר עַבְדְּךָ אֶת הַיַּרְדֵּן אֶת הַמֶּלֶךְ וְלָמָּה יִגְמְלֵנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ הַגְּמוּלָה הַזֹּֽאת׃
translation: Please let your servant turn back again, that I may die in my own city, by the grave of my father and my mother. But behold, your servant Chimham; let him go over with my lord the king; and do to him what shall seem good to you." (2 Samuel 19:37)

text: וּשְׁאָר מִסְפַּר קֶשֶׁת גִּבּוֹרֵי בְנֵֽי קֵדָר יִמְעָטוּ כִּי יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵל דִּבֵּֽר׃
translation: and the residue of the number of the archers, the mighty men of the children of Kedar, will be few; for the LORD, the God of Israel, has spoken it." (Isaiah 21:17)

text: וְזֶה אֲשֶׁר תַּעֲשֶׂה עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ כְּבָשִׂים בְּנֵֽי שָׁנָה שְׁנַיִם לַיּוֹם תָּמִֽיד׃
translation: "Now this is that which you shall offer on the altar: two lambs a year old day by day continually. (Exodus 29:38)

text: אֶת הַכֶּבֶשׂ הָאֶחָד תַּעֲשֶׂה בַבֹּקֶר וְאֵת הַכֶּבֶשׂ הַשֵּׁנִי תַּעֲשֶׂה בֵּין הָעַרְבָּֽיִם׃
translation: The one lamb you shall offer in the morning; and the other lamb you shall offer at evening; (Exodus 29:39)

text: וַעֲשִׂיתֶם שְׂעִיר עִזִּים אֶחָד לְחַטָּאת וּשְׁנֵי כְבָשִׂים בְּנֵי שָׁנָה לְזֶבַח שְׁלָמִֽים׃
translation: You shall offer one male goat for a sin offering, and two male lambs a year old for a sacrifice of peace offerings. (Leviticus 23:19)

text: פַּר אֶחָד בֶּן בָּקָר אַיִל אֶחָד כֶּֽבֶשׂ אֶחָד בֶּן שְׁנָתוֹ לְעֹלָֽה׃
translation: one young bull, one ram, one male lamb a year old, for a burnt offering; (Numbers 7:69)

text: פַּר אֶחָד בֶּן בָּקָר אַיִל אֶחָד כֶּֽבֶשׂ אֶחָד בֶּן שְׁנָתוֹ לְעֹלָֽה׃
translation: one young bull, one ram, one male lamb a year old, for a burnt offering; (Numbers 7:75)

text: פַּר אֶחָד בֶּן בָּקָר אַיִל אֶחָד כֶּֽבֶשׂ אֶחָד בֶּן שְׁנָתוֹ לְעֹלָֽה׃
translation: one young bull, one ram, one male lamb a year old, for a burnt offering; (Numbers 7:81)

text: הֶן כָּל אֵלֶּה יִפְעַל אֵל פַּעֲמַיִם שָׁלוֹשׁ עִם גָּֽבֶר׃
translation: "Behold, God does all these things, twice, yes three times, with a man, (Job 33:29)

text: שָׁלֹשׁ פְּעָמִים בַּשָּׁנָה יֵרָאֶה כָּל זְכוּרְךָ אֶל פְּנֵי הָאָדֹן יְהוָֽה׃
translation: Three times in the year all your males shall appear before the Lord GOD. (Exodus 23:17)

text: וַיִּשְׁלְחוּ אֵלַי כַּדָּבָר הַזֶּה אַרְבַּע פְּעָמִים וָאָשִׁיב אוֹתָם כַּדָּבָר הַזֶּֽה׃
translation: They sent to me four times like this; and I answered them the same way. (Nehemiah 6:4)

text: אָחַזְתָּ שְׁמֻרוֹת עֵינָי נִפְעַמְתִּי וְלֹא אֲדַבֵּֽר׃
translation: I have considered the days of old, the years of ancient times. (Psalms 77:5)

text: וַיַּכְבֵּד פַּרְעֹה אֶת לִבּוֹ גַּם בַּפַּעַם הַזֹּאת וְלֹא שִׁלַּח אֶת הָעָֽם׃
translation: Pharaoh said, "I will let you go, that you may sacrifice to the LORD your God in the wilderness, only you shall not go very far away. Pray for me." (Exodus 8:28)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶם שִׁמְשׁוֹן נִקֵּיתִי הַפַּעַם מִפְּלִשְׁתִּים כִּֽי עֹשֶׂה אֲנִי עִמָּם רָעָֽה׃
translation: Samson said to them, "This time I will be blameless in the case of the Philistines when I harm them." (Judges 15:3)

text: אֵין קָדוֹשׁ כַּיהוָה כִּי אֵין בִּלְתֶּךָ וְאֵין צוּר כֵּאלֹהֵֽינוּ׃
translation: There is no one as holy as the LORD, for there is no one besides you, nor is there any rock like our God. (1 Samuel 2:2)

text: כִּי מִי אֵל מִבַּלְעֲדֵי יְהוָה וּמִי צוּר מִֽבַּלְעֲדֵי אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃
translation: For who is God, besides the LORD? Who is a rock, besides our God? (2 Samuel 22:32)

text: וַיַּעֲלֶה עָמְרִי וְכָל יִשְׂרָאֵל עִמּוֹ מִֽגִּבְּתוֹן וַיָּצֻרוּ עַל תִּרְצָֽה׃
translation: Omri went up from Gibbethon, and all Israel with him, and they besieged Tirzah. (1 Kings 16:17)

text: וַיָּבֹא נְבוּכַדְנֶאצַּר מֶֽלֶךְ בָּבֶל עַל הָעִיר וַעֲבָדָיו צָרִים עָלֶֽיהָ׃
translation: Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came to the city while his servants were besieging it, (2 Kings 24:11)

text: וְאֶת בֵּֽית צוּר וְאֶת שׂוֹכוֹ וְאֶת עֲדֻלָּֽם׃
translation: Beth Zur, Soco, Adullam, (2 Chronicles 11:7)

text: הוּא יִקְרָאֵנִי אָבִי אָתָּה אֵלִי וְצוּר יְשׁוּעָתִֽי׃
translation: I will also appoint him my firstborn, the highest of the kings of the earth. (Psalms 89:27)

text: הֲכִימֵי אֱנוֹשׁ יָמֶיךָ אִם שְׁנוֹתֶיךָ כִּימֵי גָֽבֶר׃
translation: Are your days as the days of mortals, or your years as man's years, (Job 10:5)

text: הִנֵּה כִי כֵן יְבֹרַךְ גָּבֶר יְרֵא יְהוָֽה׃
translation: Behold, this is how the man who fears the LORD is blessed. (Psalms 128:4)

text: מֵיהוָה מִצְעֲדֵי גָבֶר וְאָדָם מַה יָּבִין דַּרְכּֽוֹ׃
translation: A man's steps are from the LORD; how then can man understand his way? (Proverbs 20:24)

text: וַיַּגֵּד לָהֶם פָּעֳלָם וּפִשְׁעֵיהֶם כִּי יִתְגַּבָּֽרוּ׃
translation: then he shows them their work, and their transgressions, that they have behaved themselves proudly. (Job 36:9)

text: דִּבְרֵי אָגוּר בִּן יָקֶה הַמַּשָּׂא נְאֻם הַגֶּבֶר לְאִֽיתִיאֵל לְאִיתִיאֵל וְאֻכָֽל׃
translation: The words of Agur the son of Jakeh, the revelation: the man says to Ithiel, to Ithiel and Ucal: (Proverbs 30:1)

text: אֲנִי הַגֶּבֶר רָאָה עֳנִי בְּשֵׁבֶט עֶבְרָתֽוֹ׃
translation: I am the man who has seen affliction by the rod of his wrath. (Lamentations 3:1)

text: וְאֶת הַתִּנְשֶׁמֶת וְאֶת הַקָּאָת וְאֶת הָרָחָֽם׃
translation: the white owl, the desert owl, the osprey, (Leviticus 11:18)

text: חַנּוּן יְהֹוָה וְצַדִּיק וֵאלֹהֵינוּ מְרַחֵֽם׃
translation: The LORD is gracious and righteous. Yes, our God is merciful. (Psalms 116:5)

text: רַחֲמֶיךָ רַבִּים יְהוָה כְּֽמִשְׁפָּטֶיךָ חַיֵּֽנִי׃
translation: Great are your tender mercies, LORD. Revive me according to your ordinances. (Psalms 119:156)

text: אֲשֶׁר לֹא מוֹתְתַנִי מֵרָחֶם וַתְּהִי לִי אִמִּי קִבְרִי וְרַחְמָהֿ הֲרַת עוֹלָֽם׃
translation: because he didn't kill me from the womb. So my mother would have been my grave, and her womb always great. (Jeremiah 20:17)

text: אִמְרוּ לַאֲחֵיכֶם עַמִּי וְלַאֲחֽוֹתֵיכֶם רֻחָֽמָה׃
translation: lest I strip her naked, and make her bare as in the day that she was born, and make her like a wilderness, and set her like a dry land, and kill her with thirst. (Hosea 2:3)

text: תֵּן לָהֶם יְהוָה מַה תִּתֵּן תֵּן לָהֶם רֶחֶם מַשְׁכִּיל וְשָׁדַיִם צֹמְקִֽים׃
translation: Give them—LORD what will you give? Give them a miscarrying womb and dry breasts. (Hosea 9:14)

text: צוּר יְלָדְךָ תֶּשִׁי וַתִּשְׁכַּח אֵל מְחֹלְלֶֽךָ׃
translation: Of the Rock who became your father, you are unmindful, and have forgotten God who gave you birth. (Deuteronomy 32:18)

text: וְהַבְּרִית אֲשֶׁר כָּרַתִּי אִתְּכֶם לֹא תִשְׁכָּחוּ וְלֹא תִֽירְאוּ אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִֽים׃
translation: You shall not forget the covenant that I have made with you. You shall not fear other gods. (2 Kings 17:38)

text: שָׁכְחוּ אֵל מוֹשִׁיעָם עֹשֶׂה גְדֹלוֹת בְּמִצְרָֽיִם׃
translation: They forgot God, their Savior, who had done great things in Egypt, (Psalms 106:21)

text: חֶבְלֵי רְשָׁעִים עִוְּדֻנִי תּֽוֹרָתְךָ לֹא שָׁכָֽחְתִּי׃
translation: The ropes of the wicked bind me, but I won't forget your law. (Psalms 119:61)

text: נַפְשִׁי בְכַפִּי תָמִיד וְתֽוֹרָתְךָ לֹא שָׁכָֽחְתִּי׃
translation: My soul is continually in my hand, yet I won't forget your law. (Psalms 119:109)

text: וַתֹּאמֶר צִיּוֹן עֲזָבַנִי יְהוָה וַאדֹנָי שְׁכֵחָֽנִי׃
translation: But Zion said, "The LORD has forsaken me, and the Lord has forgotten me." (Isaiah 49:14)

text: וְהִקְטִירוֹ הַכֹּהֵן הַמִּזְבֵּחָה לֶחֶם אִשֶּׁה לַיהוָֽה׃
translation: The priest shall burn it on the altar: it is the food of the offering made by fire to the LORD. (Leviticus 3:11)

text: וּבְהַעֲלֹת אַהֲרֹן אֶת הַנֵּרֹת בֵּין הָעֲרְבַּיִם יַקְטִירֶנָּה קְטֹרֶת תָּמִיד לִפְנֵי יְהוָה לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶֽם׃
translation: When Aaron lights the lamps at evening, he shall burn it, a perpetual incense before the LORD throughout your generations. (Exodus 30:8)

text: וַיַּקְרֵב אֶת הַמִּנְחָה וַיְמַלֵּא כַפּוֹ מִמֶּנָּה וַיַּקְטֵר עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ מִלְּבַד עֹלַת הַבֹּֽקֶר׃
translation: He presented the meal offering, and filled his hand from there, and burned it upon the altar, in addition to the burnt offering of the morning. (Leviticus 9:17)

text: וְלֹא שָֽׁמְעוּ וְלֹא הִטּוּ אֶת אָזְנָם לָשׁוּב מֵרָֽעָתָם לְבִלְתִּי קַטֵּר לֵאלֹהִים אֲחֵרִֽים׃
translation: But they didn't listen and didn't incline their ear. They didn't turn from their wickedness, to stop burning incense to other gods. (Jeremiah 44:5)

text: וַיֶּאֱהַב שְׁלֹמֹה אֶת יְהוָה לָלֶכֶת בְּחֻקּוֹת דָּוִד אָבִיו רַק בַּבָּמוֹת הוּא מְזַבֵּחַ וּמַקְטִֽיר׃
translation: Solomon loved the LORD, walking in the statutes of David his father, except that he sacrificed and burned incense in the high places. (1 Kings 3:3)

text: וַיָּקֻמוּ וַיָּסִירוּ אֶת הַֽמִּזְבְּחוֹת אֲשֶׁר בִּירוּשָׁלִָם וְאֵת כָּל הַֽמְקַטְּרוֹת הֵסִירוּ וַיַּשְׁלִיכוּ לְנַחַל קִדְרֽוֹן׃
translation: They arose and took away the altars that were in Jerusalem, and they took away all the altars for incense and threw them into the brook Kidron. (2 Chronicles 30:14)

text: וְנֹבַח הָלַךְ וַיִּלְכֹּד אֶת קְנָת וְאֶת בְּנֹתֶיהָ וַיִּקְרָא לָה נֹבַח בִּשְׁמֽוֹ׃
translation: Nobah went and took Kenath and its villages, and called it Nobah, after his own name. (Numbers 32:42)

text: תְּבוֹאֵהוּ שׁוֹאָה לֹֽא יֵדָע וְרִשְׁתּוֹ אֲשֶׁר טָמַן תִּלְכְּדוֹ בְּשׁוֹאָה יִפָּל בָּֽהּ׃
translation: Let destruction come on him unawares. Let his net that he has hidden catch himself. Let him fall into that destruction. (Psalms 35:8)

text: הֹבִישׁוּ חֲכָמִים חַתּוּ וַיִּלָּכֵדוּ הִנֵּה בִדְבַר יְהוָה מָאָסוּ וְחָכְמַֽת מֶה לָהֶֽם׃
translation: The wise men are disappointed. They are dismayed and trapped. Behold, they have rejected the LORD's word. What kind of wisdom is in them? (Jeremiah 8:9)

text: וַיֵּלְכוּ בְּנֵי מָכִיר בֶּן מְנַשֶּׁה גִּלְעָדָה וַֽיִּלְכְּדֻהָ וַיּוֹרֶשׁ אֶת הָאֱמֹרִי אֲשֶׁר בָּֽהּ׃
translation: The children of Machir the son of Manasseh went to Gilead, took it, and dispossessed the Amorites who were therein. (Numbers 32:39)

text: וַֽיִּלְכְּדָהּ עָתְנִיאֵל בֶּן קְנַז אֲחִי כָלֵב וַיִּתֶּן לוֹ אֶת עַכְסָה בִתּוֹ לְאִשָּֽׁה׃
translation: Othniel the son of Kenaz, the brother of Caleb, took it: and he gave him Achsah his daughter as wife. (Joshua 15:17)

text: בִּשְׁנַת בֹּא תַרְתָּן אַשְׁדּוֹדָה בִּשְׁלֹח אֹתוֹ סַֽרְגוֹן מֶלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר וַיִּלָּחֶם בְּאַשְׁדּוֹד וַֽיִּלְכְּדָֽהּ׃
translation: In the year that Tartan came to Ashdod, when Sargon the king of Assyria sent him, and he fought against Ashdod and took it; (Isaiah 20:1)

text: וּבְנֵי מִדְיָן עֵיפָה וָעֵפֶר וַחֲנֹךְ וַאֲבִידָע וְאֶלְדָּעָה כָּל אֵלֶּה בְּנֵי קְטוּרָֽה׃
translation: The sons of Midian were Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida, and Eldaah. All these were the children of Keturah. (Genesis 25:4)

text: וּבְנֵי מִדְיָן עֵיפָה וָעֵפֶר וַחֲנוֹךְ וַאֲבִידָע וְאֶלְדָּעָה כָּל אֵלֶּה בְּנֵי קְטוּרָֽה׃
translation: The sons of Midian: Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida, and Eldaah. All these were the sons of Keturah. (1 Chronicles 1:33)

text: וְיָשֹׁב הֶעָפָר עַל הָאָרֶץ כְּשֶׁהָיָה וְהָרוּחַ תָּשׁוּב אֶל הָאֱלֹהִים אֲשֶׁר נְתָנָֽהּ׃
translation: and the dust returns to the earth as it was, and the spirit returns to God who gave it. (Ecclesiastes 12:7)

text: וַיַּעַן אַבְרָהָם וַיֹּאמַר הִנֵּה נָא הוֹאַלְתִּי לְדַבֵּר אֶל אֲדֹנָי וְאָנֹכִי עָפָר וָאֵֽפֶר׃
translation: Abraham answered, "See now, I have taken it on myself to speak to the Lord, although I am dust and ashes. (Genesis 18:27)

text: וְרַבִּים מִיְּשֵׁנֵי אַדְמַת עָפָר יָקִיצוּ אֵלֶּה לְחַיֵּי עוֹלָם וְאֵלֶּה לַחֲרָפוֹת לְדִרְאוֹן עוֹלָֽם׃
translation: Many of those who sleep in the dust of the earth will awake, some to everlasting life, and some to shame and everlasting contempt. (Daniel 12:2)

text: וַהֲצֵרֹתִי לָאָדָם וְהָֽלְכוּ כַּֽעִוְרִים כִּי לַֽיהוָה חָטָאוּ וְשֻׁפַּךְ דָּמָם כֶּֽעָפָר וּלְחֻמָם כַּגְּלָלִֽים׃
translation: I will bring such distress on men that they will walk like blind men because they have sinned against the LORD. Their blood will be poured out like dust and their flesh like dung. (Zephaniah 1:17)

text: בְּבוֹא הַזִּיפִים וַיֹּאמְרוּ לְשָׁאוּל הֲלֹא דָוִד מִסְתַּתֵּר עִמָּֽנוּ׃
translation: Hear my prayer, God. Listen to the words of my mouth. (Psalms 54:2)

text: וַיִּפְתְּ בַּסֵּתֶר לִבִּי וַתִּשַּׁק יָדִי לְפִֽי׃
translation: and my heart has been secretly enticed, and my hand threw a kiss from my mouth; (Job 31:27)

text: הַסְתֵּר פָּנֶיךָ מֵחֲטָאָי וְֽכָל עֲוֺנֹתַי מְחֵֽה׃
translation: Don't throw me from your presence, and don't take your Holy Spirit from me. (Psalms 51:11)

text: וַיִּסָּתֵר דָּוִד בַּשָּׂדֶה וַיְהִי הַחֹדֶשׁ וַיֵּשֶׁב הַמֶּלֶךְ על אֶל הַלֶּחֶם לֶאֱכֽוֹל׃
translation: So David hid himself in the field. When the new moon had come, the king sat himself down to eat food. (1 Samuel 20:24)

text: עַד אָנָה יְהוָה תִּשְׁכָּחֵנִי נֶצַח עַד אָנָה תַּסְתִּיר אֶת פָּנֶיךָ מִמֶּֽנִּי׃
translation: How long shall I take counsel in my soul, having sorrow in my heart every day? How long shall my enemy triumph over me? (Psalms 13:2)

text: שְׁגִיאוֹת מִֽי יָבִין מִֽנִּסְתָּרוֹת נַקֵּֽנִי׃
translation: Keep back your servant also from presumptuous sins. Let them not have dominion over me. Then I will be upright. I will be blameless and innocent of great transgression. (Psalms 19:13)

text: וְאִם חַי יְהֹוָה יֹאמֵרוּ לָכֵן לַשֶּׁקֶר יִשָּׁבֵֽעוּ׃
translation: Though they say, 'As the LORD lives,' surely they swear falsely." (Jeremiah 5:2)

text: דֶּֽרֶךְ שֶׁקֶר הָסֵר מִמֶּנִּי וְֽתוֹרָתְךָ חָנֵּֽנִי׃
translation: Keep me from the way of deceit. Grant me your law graciously! (Psalms 119:29)

text: עַל כֵּן כָּל פִּקּוּדֵי כֹל יִשָּׁרְתִּי כָּל אֹרַח שֶׁקֶר שָׂנֵֽאתִי׃
translation: Therefore I consider all of your precepts to be right. I hate every false way. PE (Psalms 119:128)

text: מֵרַע מַקְשִׁיב עַל שְׂפַת אָוֶן שֶׁקֶר מֵזִין עַל לְשׁוֹן הַוֺּֽת׃
translation: An evildoer heeds wicked lips. A liar gives ear to a mischievous tongue. (Proverbs 17:4)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר אַךְ עַמִּי הֵמָּה בָּנִים לֹא יְשַׁקֵּרוּ וַיְהִי לָהֶם לְמוֹשִֽׁיעַ׃
translation: For he said, "Surely, they are my people, children who will not deal falsely;" so he became their Savior. (Isaiah 63:8)

text: אֲשֶׁר עֲשִׁירֶיהָ מָלְאוּ חָמָס וְיֹשְׁבֶיהָ דִּבְּרוּ שָׁקֶר וּלְשׁוֹנָם רְמִיָּה בְּפִיהֶֽם׃
translation: Her rich men are full of violence, her inhabitants speak lies, and their tongue is deceitful in their speech. (Micah 6:12)

text: אֶרֶץ פְּרִי לִמְלֵחָה מֵרָעַת יֹשְׁבֵי בָֽהּ׃
translation: and a fruitful land into a salt waste, for the wickedness of those who dwell in it. (Psalms 107:34)

text: וּבַשָּׁנָה הַחֲמִישִׁת תֹּֽאכְלוּ אֶת פִּרְיוֹ לְהוֹסִיף לָכֶם תְּבוּאָתוֹ אֲנִי יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃
translation: In the fifth year you shall eat its fruit, that it may yield its increase to you. I am the LORD your God. (Leviticus 19:25)

text: בָּרוּךְ פְּרִֽי בִטְנְךָ וּפְרִי אַדְמָתְךָ וּפְרִי בְהֶמְתֶּךָ שְׁגַר אֲלָפֶיךָ וְעַשְׁתְּרוֹת צֹאנֶֽךָ׃
translation: You shall be blessed in the fruit of your body, the fruit of your ground, the fruit of your animals, the increase of your livestock, and the young of your flock. (Deuteronomy 28:4)

text: מִפְּרִי פִי אִישׁ יִשְׂבַּע טוֹב וּגְמוּל יְדֵי אָדָם ישוב יָשִׁיב לֽוֹ׃
translation: A man shall be satisfied with good by the fruit of his mouth. The work of a man's hands shall be rewarded to him. (Proverbs 12:14)

text: נִשְׁבַּֽע יְהוָה לְדָוִד אֱמֶת לֹֽא יָשׁוּב מִמֶּנָּה מִפְּרִי בִטְנְךָ אָשִׁית לְכִסֵּא לָֽךְ׃
translation: The LORD has sworn to David in truth. He will not turn from it: "I will set the fruit of your body on your throne. (Psalms 132:11)

text: אֲנִי יְהוָה חֹקֵר לֵב בֹּחֵן כְּלָיוֹת וְלָתֵת לְאִישׁ כדרכו כִּדְרָכָיו כִּפְרִי מַעֲלָלָֽיו׃
translation: "I, the LORD, search the mind. I try the heart, even to give every man according to his ways, according to the fruit of his doings." (Jeremiah 17:10)

text: בְּנֵי אָשֵׁר יִמְנָה וְיִשְׁוָה וְיִשְׁוִי וּבְרִיעָה וְשֶׂרַח אֲחוֹתָֽם׃
translation: The sons of Asher: Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi, and Beriah. Serah was their sister. (1 Chronicles 7:30)

text: וְאֵלֶּה אֲבִי עֵיטָם יִזְרְעֶאל וְיִשְׁמָא וְיִדְבָּשׁ וְשֵׁם אֲחוֹתָם הַצְלֶלְפּֽוֹנִי׃
translation: These were the sons of the father of Etam: Jezreel, Ishma, and Idbash. The name of their sister was Hazzelelponi. (1 Chronicles 4:3)

text: וְאֶת בָּשְׂמַת בַּת יִשְׁמָעֵאל אֲחוֹת נְבָיֽוֹת׃
translation: and Basemath, Ishmael's daughter, sister of Nebaioth. (Genesis 36:3)

text: וּבְנֵי פְדָיָה זְרֻבָּבֶל וְשִׁמְעִי וּבֶן זְרֻבָּבֶל מְשֻׁלָּם וַחֲנַנְיָה וּשְׁלֹמִית אֲחוֹתָֽם׃
translation: The sons of Pedaiah: Zerubbabel and Shimei. The sons of Zerubbabel: Meshullam and Hananiah; and Shelomith was their sister; (1 Chronicles 3:19)

text: וַתַּגֵּשׁ אֵלָיו לֶֽאֱכֹל וַיַּֽחֲזֶק בָּהּ וַיֹּאמֶר לָהּ בּוֹאִי שִׁכְבִי עִמִּי אֲחוֹתִֽי׃
translation: When she had brought them near to him to eat, he took hold of her and said to her, "Come, lie with me, my sister!" (2 Samuel 13:11)

text: ואחיתיהם וְאַחְיוֹתֵיהֶם צְרוּיָה וַאֲבִיגָיִל וּבְנֵי צְרוּיָה אַבְשַׁי וְיוֹאָב וַעֲשָׂה אֵל שְׁלֹשָֽׁה׃
translation: and their sisters were Zeruiah and Abigail. The sons of Zeruiah: Abishai, Joab, and Asahel, three. (1 Chronicles 2:16)

text: לֹא תֹּאכְלֶנּוּ עַל הָאָרֶץ תִּשְׁפְּכֶנּוּ כַּמָּֽיִם׃
translation: You shall not eat it. You shall pour it out on the earth like water. (Deuteronomy 12:24)

text: אֶשְׁפֹּךְ לְפָנָיו שִׂיחִי צָרָתִי לְפָנָיו אַגִּֽיד׃
translation: When my spirit was overwhelmed within me, you knew my route. On the path in which I walk, they have hidden a snare for me. (Psalms 142:3)

text: הִנֵּה נְשִׂיאֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אִישׁ לִזְרֹעוֹ הָיוּ בָךְ לְמַעַן שְׁפָךְ דָּֽם׃
translation: "'"Behold, the princes of Israel, everyone according to his power, have been in you to shed blood. (Ezekiel 22:6)

text: וְגַם עַל הָֽעֲבָדִים וְעַל הַשְּׁפָחוֹת בַּיָּמִים הָהֵמָּה אֶשְׁפּוֹךְ אֶת רוּחִֽי׃
translation: I will gather all nations, and will bring them down into the valley of Jehoshaphat; and I will execute judgment on them there for my people, and for my heritage, Israel, whom they have scattered among the nations. They have divided my land, (Joel 3:2)

text: וְעָנוּ וְאָמְרוּ יָדֵינוּ לֹא שפכה שָֽׁפְכוּ אֶת הַדָּם הַזֶּה וְעֵינֵינוּ לֹא רָאֽוּ׃
translation: They shall answer and say, "Our hands have not shed this blood, neither have our eyes seen it. (Deuteronomy 21:7)

text: בִּטְחוּ בוֹ בְכָל עֵת עָם שִׁפְכֽוּ לְפָנָיו לְבַבְכֶם אֱלֹהִים מַחֲסֶה לָּנוּ סֶֽלָה׃
translation: Surely men of low degree are just a breath, and men of high degree are a lie. In the balances they will go up. They are together lighter than a breath. (Psalms 62:9)

text: לֹא יְחַיֶּה רָשָׁע וּמִשְׁפַּט עֲנִיִּים יִתֵּֽן׃
translation: He doesn't preserve the life of the wicked, but gives justice to the afflicted. (Job 36:6)

text: רְאֵה עָנְיִי וַעֲמָלִי וְשָׂא לְכָל חַטֹּאותָֽי׃
translation: Consider my affliction and my travail. Forgive all my sins. (Psalms 25:18)

text: וַתֵּרֶא אֶת עֳנִי אֲבֹתֵינוּ בְּמִצְרָיִם וְאֶת זַעֲקָתָם שָׁמַעְתָּ עַל יַם סֽוּף׃
translation: "You saw the affliction of our fathers in Egypt, and heard their cry by the Red Sea, (Nehemiah 9:9)

text: יָדִין עַמְּךָ בְצֶדֶק וַעֲנִיֶּיךָ בְמִשְׁפָּֽט׃
translation: He will judge your people with righteousness, and your poor with justice. (Psalms 72:2)

text: אִם רָשַׁעְתִּי אַלְלַי לִי וְצָדַקְתִּי לֹא אֶשָּׂא רֹאשִׁי שְׂבַע קָלוֹן וּרְאֵה עָנְיִֽי׃
translation: If I am wicked, woe to me. If I am righteous, I still will not lift up my head, being filled with disgrace, and conscious of my affliction. (Job 10:15)

text: מִשֹּׁד עֲנִיִּים מֵאַנְקַת אֶבְיוֹנִים עַתָּה אָקוּם יֹאמַר יְהוָה אָשִׁית בְּיֵשַׁע יָפִיחַֽ לֽוֹ׃
translation: The LORD's words are flawless words, as silver refined in a clay furnace, purified seven times. (Psalms 12:6)

text: וַיַּעֲמֵד אֶת פָּנָיו וַיָּשֶׂם עַד בֹּשׁ וַיֵּבְךְּ אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃
translation: He settled his gaze steadfastly on him, until he was ashamed. Then the man of God wept. (2 Kings 8:11)

text: וַתִּשָּׂא כָּל הָעֵדָה וַֽיִּתְּנוּ אֶת קוֹלָם וַיִּבְכּוּ הָעָם בַּלַּיְלָה הַהֽוּא׃
translation: All the congregation lifted up their voice, and cried; and the people wept that night. (Numbers 14:1)

text: עַל נַהֲרוֹת בָּבֶל שָׁם יָשַׁבְנוּ גַּם בָּכִינוּ בְּזָכְרֵנוּ אֶת צִיּֽוֹן׃
translation: By the rivers of Babylon, there we sat down. Yes, we wept, when we remembered Zion. (Psalms 137:1)

text: וַתָּשֻׁבוּ וַתִּבְכּוּ לִפְנֵי יְהוָה וְלֹֽא שָׁמַע יְהוָה בְּקֹלְכֶם וְלֹא הֶאֱזִין אֲלֵיכֶֽם׃
translation: You returned and wept before the LORD, but the LORD didn't listen to your voice, nor turn his ear to you. (Deuteronomy 1:45)

text: הָלוֹךְ יֵלֵךְ וּבָכֹה נֹשֵׂא מֶֽשֶׁךְ הַזָּרַע בֹּֽא יָבוֹא בְרִנָּה נֹשֵׂא אֲלֻמֹּתָֽיו׃
translation: He who goes out weeping, carrying seed for sowing, will certainly come again with joy, carrying his sheaves. (Psalms 126:6)

text: בְּגַת אַל תַּגִּידוּ בָּכוֹ אַל תִּבְכּוּ בְּבֵית לְעַפְרָה עָפָר התפלשתי הִתְפַּלָּֽשִׁי׃
translation: Don't tell it in Gath. Don't weep at all. At Beth Ophrah I have rolled myself in the dust. (Micah 1:10)

text: וְהִתְקַדִּשְׁתֶּם וִהְיִיתֶם קְדֹשִׁים כִּי אֲנִי יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃
translation: "'Sanctify yourselves therefore, and be holy; for I am the LORD your God. (Leviticus 20:7)

text: כָּל זָכָר בַּכֹּהֲנִים יֹאכְלֶנּוּ בְּמָקוֹם קָדוֹשׁ יֵאָכֵל קֹדֶשׁ קָֽדָשִׁים הֽוּא׃
translation: Every male among the priests may eat of it. It shall be eaten in a holy place. It is most holy. (Leviticus 7:6)

text: וַיָּשׁוּבוּ וַיְנַסּוּ אֵל וּקְדוֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל הִתְווּ׃
translation: They turned again and tempted God, and provoked the Holy One of Israel. (Psalms 78:41)

text: כִּי לַֽיהוָה מָֽגִנֵּנוּ וְלִקְדוֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל מַלְכֵּֽנוּ׃
translation: Then you spoke in vision to your saints, and said, "I have given strength to the warrior. I have exalted a young man from the people. (Psalms 89:19)

text: יוֹדוּ שִׁמְךָ גָּדוֹל וְנוֹרָא קָדוֹשׁ הֽוּא׃
translation: Let them praise your great and awesome name. He is Holy! (Psalms 99:3)

text: רֽוֹמְמוּ יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ וְהִֽשְׁתַּחֲווּ לְהַר קָדְשׁוֹ כִּֽי קָדוֹשׁ יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃
translation: Exalt the LORD, our God. Worship at his holy hill, for the LORD, our God, is holy! (Psalms 99:9)

text: בֶּן אָדָם הוֹדַע אֶת יְרוּשָׁלִַם אֶת תּוֹעֲבֹתֶֽיהָ׃
translation: "Son of man, cause Jerusalem to know her abominations; (Ezekiel 16:2)

text: הֲתִשְׁפֹּט אֹתָם הֲתִשְׁפּוֹט בֶּן אָדָם אֶת תּוֹעֲבֹת אֲבוֹתָם הוֹדִיעֵֽם׃
translation: "Will you judge them, son of man? Will you judge them? Cause them to know the abominations of their fathers. (Ezekiel 20:4)

text: כִּי תוֹעֲבַת יְהוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ כָּל עֹשֵׂה אֵלֶּה כֹּל עֹשֵׂה עָֽוֶל׃
translation: For all who do such things, all who do unrighteously, are an abomination to the LORD your God. (Deuteronomy 25:16)

text: כִּֽי יְחַנֵּן קוֹלוֹ אַל תַּֽאֲמֶן בּוֹ כִּי שֶׁבַע תּוֹעֵבוֹת בְּלִבּֽוֹ׃
translation: When his speech is charming, don't believe him, for there are seven abominations in his heart. (Proverbs 26:25)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָי עוֹד תָּשׁוּב תִּרְאֶה תּוֹעֵבוֹת גְּדֹלוֹת אֲשֶׁר הֵמָּה עֹשִֽׂים׃
translation: He said also to me, "You will again see more of the great abominations which they do." (Ezekiel 8:13)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָי בֹּא וּרְאֵה אֶת הַתּוֹעֵבוֹת הָרָעוֹת אֲשֶׁר הֵם עֹשִׂים פֹּֽה׃
translation: He said to me, "Go in, and see the wicked abominations that they do here." (Ezekiel 8:9)

text: וּלְשׁוֹנִי תֶּהְגֶּה צִדְקֶךָ כָּל הַיּוֹם תְּהִלָּתֶֽךָ׃
translation: My tongue shall talk about your righteousness and about your praise all day long. (Psalms 35:28)

text: אָהַבְתָּ כָֽל דִּבְרֵי בָלַע לְשׁוֹן מִרְמָֽה׃
translation: The righteous also will see it, and fear, and laugh at him, saying, (Psalms 52:6)

text: אֵלָיו פִּֽי קָרָאתִי וְרוֹמַם תַּחַת לְשׁוֹנִֽי׃
translation: I cried to him with my mouth. He was extolled with my tongue. (Psalms 66:17)

text: שַׁתּוּ בַשָּׁמַיִם פִּיהֶם וּלְשׁוֹנָם תִּֽהֲלַךְ בָּאָֽרֶץ׃
translation: They have set their mouth in the heavens. Their tongue walks through the earth. (Psalms 73:9)

text: לְאָדָם מַֽעַרְכֵי לֵב וּמֵיְהוָה מַעֲנֵה לָשֽׁוֹן׃
translation: The plans of the heart belong to man, but the answer of the tongue is from the LORD. (Proverbs 16:1)

text: שֹׁמֵר פִּיו וּלְשׁוֹנוֹ שֹׁמֵר מִצָּרוֹת נַפְשֽׁוֹ׃
translation: Whoever guards his mouth and his tongue keeps his soul from troubles. (Proverbs 21:23)

text: וְעַתָּה הִנֵּה יָדַעְתִּי כִּי מָלֹךְ תִּמְלוֹךְ וְקָמָה בְּיָדְךָ מַמְלֶכֶת יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
translation: Swear now therefore to me by the LORD that you will not cut off my offspring after me, and that you will not destroy my name out of my father's house." (1 Samuel 24:21)

text: כִּֽי הַגּוֹי וְהַמַּמְלָכָה אֲשֶׁר לֹא יַעַבְדוּךְ יֹאבֵדוּ וְהַגּוֹיִם חָרֹב יֶחֱרָֽבוּ׃
translation: For that nation and kingdom that will not serve you shall perish; yes, those nations shall be utterly wasted. (Isaiah 60:12)

text: וְנֶאְמַן בֵּיתְךָ וּמַֽמְלַכְתְּךָ עַד עוֹלָם לְפָנֶיךָ כִּֽסְאֲךָ יִהְיֶה נָכוֹן עַד עוֹלָֽם׃
translation: Your house and your kingdom will be made sure forever before you. Your throne will be established forever."'" (2 Samuel 7:16)

text: וַיְהִי כַּאֲשֶׁר חָזְקָה הַמַּמְלָכָה בְּיָדוֹ וַיַּךְ אֶת עֲבָדָיו הַמַּכִּים אֶת הַמֶּלֶךְ אָבִֽיו׃
translation: As soon as the kingdom was established in his hand, he killed his servants who had slain the king his father, (2 Kings 14:5)

text: וַיְהִי כַּאֲשֶׁר חָזְקָה הַמַּמְלָכָה עָלָיו וַֽיַּהֲרֹג אֶת עֲבָדָיו הַמַּכִּים אֶת הַמֶּלֶךְ אָבִֽיו׃
translation: Now when the kingdom was established to him, he killed his servants who had killed his father the king. (2 Chronicles 25:3)

text: וְסִכְסַכְתִּי מִצְרַיִם בְּמִצְרַיִם וְנִלְחֲמוּ אִישׁ בְּאָחִיו וְאִישׁ בְּרֵעֵהוּ עִיר בְּעִיר מַמְלָכָה בְּמַמְלָכָֽה׃
translation: I will stir up the Egyptians against the Egyptians, and they will fight everyone against his brother, and everyone against his neighbor; city against city, and kingdom against kingdom. (Isaiah 19:2)

text: גֹּאֲלֵנוּ יְהוָה צְבָאוֹת שְׁמוֹ קְדוֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
translation: Our Redeemer, the LORD of Armies is his name, is the Holy One of Israel. (Isaiah 47:4)

text: רִיבָה רִיבִי וּגְאָלֵנִי לְאִמְרָתְךָ חַיֵּֽנִי׃
translation: Plead my cause, and redeem me! Revive me according to your promise. (Psalms 119:154)

text: וְאִם הַמַּקְדִּישׁ יִגְאַל אֶת בֵּיתוֹ וְיָסַף חֲמִישִׁית כֶּֽסֶף עֶרְכְּךָ עָלָיו וְהָיָה לֽוֹ׃
translation: If he who dedicates it will redeem his house, then he shall add the fifth part of the money of your valuation to it, and it shall be his. (Leviticus 27:15)

text: וְשָֽׁלְחוּ זִקְנֵי עִירוֹ וְלָקְחוּ אֹתוֹ מִשָּׁם וְנָתְנוּ אֹתוֹ בְּיַד גֹּאֵל הַדָּם וָמֵֽת׃
translation: then the elders of his city shall send and bring him there, and deliver him into the hand of the avenger of blood, that he may die. (Deuteronomy 19:12)

text: וְעַתָּה כִּי אָמְנָם כִּי אם גֹאֵל אָנֹכִי וְגַם יֵשׁ גֹּאֵל קָרוֹב מִמֶּֽנִּי׃
translation: Now it is true that I am a near kinsman. However, there is a kinsman nearer than I. (Ruth 3:12)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר לַגֹּאֵל חֶלְקַת הַשָּׂדֶה אֲשֶׁר לְאָחִינוּ לֶאֱלִימֶלֶךְ מָכְרָה נָעֳמִי הַשָּׁבָה מִשְּׂדֵה מוֹאָֽב׃
translation: He said to the near kinsman, "Naomi, who has come back out of the country of Moab, is selling the parcel of land, which was our brother Elimelech's. (Ruth 4:3)

text: כֵּן יִהְיֶה תָמִיד הֶעָנָן יְכַסֶּנּוּ וּמַרְאֵה אֵשׁ לָֽיְלָה׃
translation: So it was continually. The cloud covered it, and the appearance of fire by night. (Numbers 9:16)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֱלֹהִים לְיִשְׂרָאֵל בְּמַרְאֹת הַלַּיְלָה וַיֹּאמֶר יַעֲקֹב יַעֲקֹב וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֵּֽנִי׃
translation: God spoke to Israel in the visions of the night, and said, "Jacob, Jacob!" He said, "Here I am." (Genesis 46:2)

text: וּמַרְאֵה כְּבוֹד יְהוָה כְּאֵשׁ אֹכֶלֶת בְּרֹאשׁ הָהָר לְעֵינֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
translation: The appearance of the LORD's glory was like devouring fire on the top of the mountain in the eyes of the children of Israel. (Exodus 24:17)

text: וַיֹּסֶף וַיִּגַּע בִּי כְּמַרְאֵה אָדָם וַֽיְחַזְּקֵֽנִי׃
translation: Then one like the appearance of a man touched me again, and he strengthened me. (Daniel 10:18)

text: כְּמַרְאֵה סוּסִים מַרְאֵהוּ וּכְפָרָשִׁים כֵּן יְרוּצֽוּן׃
translation: Their appearance is as the appearance of horses, and they run as horsemen. (Joel 2:4)

text: וַהֲרִיחוֹ בְּיִרְאַת יְהוָה וְלֹֽא לְמַרְאֵה עֵינָיו יִשְׁפּוֹט וְלֹֽא לְמִשְׁמַע אָזְנָיו יוֹכִֽיחַ׃
translation: His delight will be in the fear of the LORD. He will not judge by the sight of his eyes, neither decide by the hearing of his ears; (Isaiah 11:3)

text: בֶּן אָדָם שִׂים פָּנֶיךָ אֶל צִידוֹן וְהִנָּבֵא עָלֶֽיהָ׃
translation: "Son of man, set your face toward Sidon, and prophesy against it, (Ezekiel 28:21)

text: וַיָּרָץ הַנַּעַר וַיַּגֵּד לְמֹשֶׁה וַיֹּאמַר אֶלְדָּד וּמֵידָד מִֽתְנַבְּאִים בַּֽמַּחֲנֶֽה׃
translation: A young man ran, and told Moses, and said, "Eldad and Medad are prophesying in the camp!" (Numbers 11:27)

text: בֶּן אָדָם שִׂים פָּנֶיךָ אֶל הָרֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְהִנָּבֵא אֲלֵיהֶֽם׃
translation: "Son of man, set your face toward the mountains of Israel, and prophesy to them, (Ezekiel 6:2)

text: בֶּן אָדָם שִׂים פָּנֶיךָ אֶל בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן וְהִנָּבֵא עֲלֵיהֶֽם׃
translation: "Son of man, set your face toward the children of Ammon, and prophesy against them. (Ezekiel 25:2)

text: בֶּן אָדָם שִׂים פָּנֶיךָ עַל הַר שֵׂעִיר וְהִנָּבֵא עָלָֽיו׃
translation: "Son of man, set your face against Mount Seir, and prophesy against it, (Ezekiel 35:2)

text: כִּי בְשֶׁקֶר הֵם נִבְּאִים לָכֶם בִּשְׁמִי לֹא שְׁלַחְתִּים נְאֻם יְהוָֽה׃
translation: For they prophesy falsely to you in my name. I have not sent them," says the LORD. (Jeremiah 29:9)

text: כִּֽי בְאַחַת יְדַבֶּר אֵל וּבִשְׁתַּיִם לֹא יְשׁוּרֶֽנָּה׃
translation: For God speaks once, yes twice, though man pays no attention. (Job 33:14)

text: וַיָּשַׂר אֲבִימֶלֶךְ עַל יִשְׂרָאֵל שָׁלֹשׁ שָׁנִֽים׃
translation: Abimelech was prince over Israel three years. (Judges 9:22)

text: וַֽיִּמְצָאָהּ מַלְאַךְ יְהוָה עַל עֵין הַמַּיִם בַּמִּדְבָּר עַל הָעַיִן בְּדֶרֶךְ שֽׁוּר׃
translation: The LORD's angel found her by a fountain of water in the wilderness, by the fountain on the way to Shur. (Genesis 16:7)

text: בֵּן פֹּרָת יוֹסֵף בֵּן פֹּרָת עֲלֵי עָיִן בָּנוֹת צָעֲדָה עֲלֵי שֽׁוּר׃
translation: "Joseph is a fruitful vine, a fruitful vine by a spring. His branches run over the wall. (Genesis 49:22)

text: וַיַּךְ שָׁאוּל אֶת עֲמָלֵק מֵֽחֲוִילָה בּוֹאֲךָ שׁוּר אֲשֶׁר עַל פְּנֵי מִצְרָֽיִם׃
translation: Saul struck the Amalekites, from Havilah as you go to Shur, which is before Egypt. (1 Samuel 15:7)

text: וַֽיְהִי לִי שׁוֹר וַחֲמוֹר צֹאן וְעֶבֶד וְשִׁפְחָה וָֽאֶשְׁלְחָה לְהַגִּיד לַֽאדֹנִי לִמְצֹא חֵן בְּעֵינֶֽיךָ׃
translation: The messengers returned to Jacob, saying, "We came to your brother Esau. He is coming to meet you, and four hundred men are with him." (Genesis 32:6)

text: כָּל עָרִים עֶשֶׂר וּמִגְרְשֵׁיהֶן לְמִשְׁפְּחוֹת בְּנֵֽי קְהָת הַנּוֹתָרִֽים׃
translation: All the cities of the families of the rest of the children of Kohath were ten with their pasture lands. (Joshua 21:26)

text: וַיִּתְּנוּ בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לַלְוִיִּם אֶת הֶעָרִים וְאֶת מִגְרְשֵׁיהֶֽם׃
translation: But Aaron and his sons offered on the altar of burnt offering, and on the altar of incense, for all the work of the most holy place, and to make atonement for Israel, according to all that Moses the servant of God had commanded. (1 Chronicles 6:49)

text: וְאֶת רָאמוֹת וְאֶת מִגְרָשֶׁיהָ וְאֶת עָנֵם וְאֶת מִגְרָשֶֽׁיהָ׃
translation: Hilen with its pasture lands, Debir with its pasture lands, (1 Chronicles 6:58)

text: וְאֶת קְדֵמוֹת וְאֶת מִגְרָשֶׁיהָ וְאֶת מֵיפַעַת וְאֶת מִגְרָשֶֽׁיהָ׃
translation: The children of Israel gave to the Levites the cities with their pasture lands. (1 Chronicles 6:64)

text: וְאֶת חֶשְׁבּוֹן וְאֶת מִגְרָשֶׁיהָ וְאֶת יַעְזֵיר וְאֶת מִגְרָשֶֽׁיהָ׃
translation: Some of the families of the sons of Kohath had cities of their borders out of the tribe of Ephraim. (1 Chronicles 6:66)

text: כָּל עָרֵי בְנֵֽי אַהֲרֹן הַכֹּֽהֲנִים שְׁלֹשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה עָרִים וּמִגְרְשֵׁיהֶֽן׃
translation: All the cities of the children of Aaron, the priests, were thirteen cities with their pasture lands. (Joshua 21:19)

text: בֹּשׁוּ כִּֽי בָטָח בָּאוּ עָדֶיהָ וַיֶּחְפָּֽרוּ׃
translation: They were distressed because they were confident. They came there, and were confounded. (Job 6:20)

text: בְּךָֽ יְהוָה חָסִיתִי אַל אֵבוֹשָׁה לְעוֹלָֽם׃
translation: In you, LORD, I take refuge. Never let me be disappointed. (Psalms 71:1)

text: וַאֲדַבְּרָה בְעֵדֹתֶיךָ נֶגֶד מְלָכִים וְלֹא אֵבֽוֹשׁ׃
translation: I will also speak of your statutes before kings, and will not be disappointed. (Psalms 119:46)

text: סָמְכֵנִי כְאִמְרָתְךָ וְאֶֽחְיֶה וְאַל תְּבִישֵׁנִי מִשִּׂבְרִֽי׃
translation: Uphold me according to your word, that I may live. Let me not be ashamed of my hope. (Psalms 119:116)

text: יֵבֹשׁוּ וְיִסֹּגוּ אָחוֹר כֹּל שֹׂנְאֵי צִיּֽוֹן׃
translation: Let them be disappointed and turned backward, all those who hate Zion. (Psalms 129:5)

text: וּבֹשׁ מוֹאָב מִכְּמוֹשׁ כַּאֲשֶׁר בֹּשׁוּ בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל מִבֵּית אֵל מִבְטֶחָֽם׃
translation: Moab will be ashamed of Chemosh, as the house of Israel was ashamed of Bethel, their confidence. (Jeremiah 48:13)

text: וַתָּקָם וַתֵּלֶךְ וַתָּסַר צְעִיפָהּ מֵעָלֶיהָ וַתִּלְבַּשׁ בִּגְדֵי אַלְמְנוּתָֽהּ׃
translation: She arose, and went away, and put off her veil from her, and put on the garments of her widowhood. (Genesis 38:19)

text: וִיהוֹשֻׁעַ הָיָה לָבֻשׁ בְּגָדִים צוֹאִים וְעֹמֵד לִפְנֵי הַמַּלְאָֽךְ׃
translation: Now Joshua was clothed with filthy garments, and was standing before the angel. (Zechariah 3:3)

text: בָּרֲכִי נַפְשִׁי אֶת יְהוָה יְהוָה אֱלֹהַי גָּדַלְתָּ מְּאֹד הוֹד וְהָדָר לָבָֽשְׁתָּ׃
translation: Bless the LORD, my soul. The LORD, my God, you are very great. You are clothed with honor and majesty. (Psalms 104:1)

text: כֹּהֲנֶיךָ יִלְבְּשׁוּ צֶדֶק וַחֲסִידֶיךָ יְרַנֵּֽנוּ׃
translation: Let your priests be clothed with righteousness. Let your saints shout for joy! (Psalms 132:9)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר לָאִישׁ לְבוּשׁ הַבַּדִּים אֲשֶׁר מִמַּעַל לְמֵימֵי הַיְאֹר עַד מָתַי קֵץ הַפְּלָאֽוֹת׃
translation: One said to the man clothed in linen, who was above the waters of the river, "How long will it be to the end of these wonders?" (Daniel 12:6)

text: שִׁבְעַת יָמִים יִלְבָּשָׁם הַכֹּהֵן תַּחְתָּיו מִבָּנָיו אֲשֶׁר יָבֹא אֶל אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד לְשָׁרֵת בַּקֹּֽדֶשׁ׃
translation: Seven days shall the son who is priest in his place put them on, when he comes into the Tent of Meeting to minister in the holy place. (Exodus 29:30)

text: אוֹדֶה יְהוָה בְּכָל לִבִּי אֲסַפְּרָה כָּל נִפְלְאוֹתֶֽיךָ׃
translation: I will be glad and rejoice in you. I will sing praise to your name, O Most High. (Psalms 9:2)

text: הֹדוּ לַיהוָה כִּי טוֹב כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
translation: Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever. (Psalms 107:1)

text: הוֹדוּ לַיהוָה כִּי טוֹב כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
translation: Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever. (Psalms 118:1)

text: הוֹדוּ לַיהוָה כִּי טוֹב כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
translation: Oh give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever. (Psalms 118:29)

text: הוֹדוּ לַיהוָה כִּי טוֹב כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
translation: Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever. (Psalms 136:1)

text: לְדָוִד אוֹדְךָ בְכָל לִבִּי נֶגֶד אֱלֹהִים אֲזַמְּרֶֽךָּ׃
translation: By David. I will give you thanks with my whole heart. Before the gods, I will sing praises to you. (Psalms 138:1)

text: אִיתַי בֶּן רִיבַי מִגִּבְעַת בְּנֵי בִנְיָמִן בְּנָיָה הַפִּרְעָתֹנִֽי׃
translation: Ithai the son of Ribai of Gibeah of the children of Benjamin, Benaiah the Pirathonite, (1 Chronicles 11:31)

text: וַיֵּלֶךְ שְׁמוּאֵל הָרָמָתָה וְשָׁאוּל עָלָה אֶל בֵּיתוֹ גִּבְעַת שָׁאֽוּל׃
translation: Then Samuel went to Ramah; and Saul went up to his house to Gibeah of Saul. (1 Samuel 15:34)

text: יִשְׂאוּ הָרִים שָׁלוֹם לָעָם וּגְבָעוֹת בִּצְדָקָֽה׃
translation: The mountains shall bring prosperity to the people. The hills bring the fruit of righteousness. (Psalms 72:3)

text: וַיֵּאָסְפוּ בְנֵֽי בִנְיָמִן מִן הֶעָרִים הַגִּבְעָתָה לָצֵאת לַמִּלְחָמָה עִם בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
translation: The children of Benjamin gathered themselves together out of the cities to Gibeah, to go out to battle against the children of Israel. (Judges 20:14)

text: וַיַּעַשׂ לוֹ יְהוֹשֻׁעַ חַֽרְבוֹת צֻרִים וַיָּמָל אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל גִּבְעַת הָעֲרָלֽוֹת׃
translation: Joshua made himself flint knives, and circumcised the sons of Israel at the hill of the foreskins. (Joshua 5:3)

text: וְגַם שָׁאוּל הָלַךְ לְבֵיתוֹ גִּבְעָתָה וַיֵּלְכוּ עִמּוֹ הַחַיִל אֲשֶׁר נָגַע אֱלֹהִים בְּלִבָּֽם׃
translation: Saul also went to his house in Gibeah; and the army went with him, whose hearts God had touched. (1 Samuel 10:26)

text: וַיִּיטַב הַדָּבָר בְּעֵינֵי פַרְעֹה וּבְעֵינֵי כָּל עֲבָדָֽיו׃
translation: The thing was good in the eyes of Pharaoh, and in the eyes of all his servants. (Genesis 41:37)

text: וַיִּיטַב הַדָּבָר בְּעֵינֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ וְהַשָּׂרִים וַיַּעַשׂ הַמֶּלֶךְ כִּדְבַר מְמוּכָֽן׃
translation: This advice pleased the king and the princes, and the king did according to the word of Memucan: (Esther 1:21)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֵלָי הֵיטִיבוּ אֲשֶׁר דִּבֵּֽרוּ׃
translation: The LORD said to me, "They have well said that which they have spoken. (Deuteronomy 18:17)

text: וַיִּיטַב בְּעֵינַי הַדָּבָר וָאֶקַּח מִכֶּם שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר אֲנָשִׁים אִישׁ אֶחָד לַשָּֽׁבֶט׃
translation: The thing pleased me well. I took twelve of your men, one man for every tribe. (Deuteronomy 1:23)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה הַהֵיטֵב חָרָה לָֽךְ׃
translation: The LORD said, "Is it right for you to be angry?" (Jonah 4:4)

text: וַיִּשְׁמַע מֹשֶׁה וַיִּיטַב בְּעֵינָֽיו׃
translation: When Moses heard that, it was pleasing in his sight. (Leviticus 10:20)

text: תַּֽחַת כָּל הַשָּׁמַיִם יִשְׁרֵהוּ וְאוֹרוֹ עַל כַּנְפוֹת הָאָֽרֶץ׃
translation: He sends it out under the whole sky, and his lightning to the ends of the earth. (Job 37:3)

text: אָגוּרָה בְאָהָלְךָ עוֹלָמִים אֶֽחֱסֶה בְסֵתֶר כְּנָפֶיךָ סֶּֽלָה׃
translation: For you, God, have heard my vows. You have given me the heritage of those who fear your name. (Psalms 61:5)

text: וְאַרְבָּעָה פָנִים לְאֶחָת וְאַרְבַּע כְּנָפַיִם לְאַחַת לָהֶֽם׃
translation: Everyone had four faces, and each one of them had four wings. (Ezekiel 1:6)

text: וְלָקַחְתָּ מִשָּׁם מְעַט בְּמִסְפָּר וְצַרְתָּ אוֹתָם בִּכְנָפֶֽיךָ׃
translation: You shall take a small number of these and bind them in the folds of your robe. (Ezekiel 5:3)

text: לֹא יִקַּח אִישׁ אֶת אֵשֶׁת אָבִיו וְלֹא יְגַלֶּה כְּנַף אָבִֽיו׃
translation: He who is emasculated by crushing or cutting shall not enter into the LORD's assembly. (Deuteronomy 23:1)

text: לֶאֱחֹז בְּכַנְפוֹת הָאָרֶץ וְיִנָּעֲרוּ רְשָׁ<segtype="x-suspended">עִ<seg>ים מִמֶּֽנָּה׃
translation: that it might take hold of the ends of the earth, and shake the wicked out of it? (Job 38:13)

text: וָאֶעֱשֶׂה לְמַעַן שְׁמִי לְבִלְתִּי הֵחֵל לְעֵינֵי הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר הוֹצֵאתִים לְעֵינֵיהֶֽם׃
translation: But I worked for my name's sake, that it should not be profaned in the sight of the nations, in whose sight I brought them out. (Ezekiel 20:14)

text: בִּלְתִּי כָּלֵב בֶּן יְפֻנֶּה הַקְּנִזִּי וִיהוֹשֻׁעַ בִּן נוּן כִּי מִלְאוּ אַחֲרֵי יְהוָֽה׃
translation: except Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite, and Joshua the son of Nun, because they have followed the LORD completely.' (Numbers 32:12)

text: וְאִישׁ שָׁכַב וְֽלֹא יָקוּם עַד בִּלְתִּי שָׁמַיִם לֹא יָקִיצוּ וְלֹֽא יֵעֹרוּ מִשְּׁנָתָֽם׃
translation: so man lies down and doesn't rise. Until the heavens are no more, they will not awake, nor be roused out of their sleep. (Job 14:12)

text: וְאִם אֹמְרִים אַתֶּם לֹא נֵשֵׁב בָּאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת לְבִלְתִּי שְׁמֹעַ בְּקוֹל יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃
translation: "'But if you say, "We will not dwell in this land," so that you don't obey the LORD your God's voice, (Jeremiah 42:13)

text: מַה נַּעֲשֶׂה לָהֶם לַנּוֹתָרִים לְנָשִׁים וַאֲנַחְנוּ נִשְׁבַּעְנוּ בַֽיהוָה לְבִלְתִּי תֵּת לָהֶם מִבְּנוֹתֵינוּ לְנָשִֽׁים׃
translation: How shall we provide wives for those who remain, since we have sworn by the LORD that we will not give them of our daughters to wives?" (Judges 21:7)

text: וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵיהֶם מַפִּיל אֲנִי תְחִנָּתִי לִפְנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ לְבִלְתִּי הֲשִׁיבֵנִי בֵּית יְהוֹנָתָן לָמוּת שָֽׁם׃
translation: then you shall tell them, 'I presented my supplication before the king, that he would not cause me to return to Jonathan's house, to die there.'" (Jeremiah 38:26)

text: בְּעַמּוּד עָנָן יְדַבֵּר אֲלֵיהֶם שָׁמְרוּ עֵדֹתָיו וְחֹק נָֽתַן לָֽמוֹ׃
translation: He spoke to them in the pillar of cloud. They kept his testimonies, the statute that he gave them. (Psalms 99:7)

text: וַיֵּרָא יְהוָה בָּאֹהֶל בְּעַמּוּד עָנָן וַיַּעֲמֹד עַמּוּד הֶעָנָן עַל פֶּתַח הָאֹֽהֶל׃
translation: The LORD appeared in the Tent in a pillar of cloud, and the pillar of cloud stood over the Tent's door. (Deuteronomy 31:15)

text: הַמַּרְגִּיז אֶרֶץ מִמְּקוֹמָהּ וְעַמּוּדֶיהָ יִתְפַלָּצֽוּן׃
translation: He shakes the earth out of its place. Its pillars tremble. (Job 9:6)

text: וַיֵּרֶד יְהוָה בְּעַמּוּד עָנָן וַֽיַּעֲמֹד פֶּתַח הָאֹהֶל וַיִּקְרָא אַהֲרֹן וּמִרְיָם וַיֵּצְאוּ שְׁנֵיהֶֽם׃
translation: The LORD came down in a pillar of cloud, and stood at the door of the Tent, and called Aaron and Miriam; and they both came forward. (Numbers 12:5)

text: וְהָיָה כְּבֹא מֹשֶׁה הָאֹהֱלָה יֵרֵד עַמּוּד הֶֽעָנָן וְעָמַד פֶּתַח הָאֹהֶל וְדִבֶּר עִם מֹשֶֽׁה׃
translation: When Moses entered into the Tent, the pillar of cloud descended, stood at the door of the Tent, and the LORD spoke with Moses. (Exodus 33:9)

text: וּבְעַמּוּד עָנָן הִנְחִיתָם יוֹמָם וּבְעַמּוּד אֵשׁ לַיְלָה לְהָאִיר לָהֶם אֶת הַדֶּרֶךְ אֲשֶׁר יֵֽלְכוּ בָֽהּ׃
translation: Moreover, in a pillar of cloud you led them by day; and in a pillar of fire by night, to give them light in the way in which they should go. (Nehemiah 9:12)

text: שְׁמַע יְהוָה וְחָנֵּנִי יְהוָה הֱֽיֵה עֹזֵר לִֽי׃
translation: You have turned my mourning into dancing for me. You have removed my sackcloth, and clothed me with gladness, (Psalms 30:11)

text: עֵזֶר הָרֹאשׁ עֹבַדְיָה הַשֵּׁנִי אֱלִיאָב הַשְּׁלִשִֽׁי׃
translation: Mishmannah the fourth, Jeremiah the fifth, (1 Chronicles 12:10)

text: יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּטַח בַּיהוָה עֶזְרָם וּמָגִנָּם הֽוּא׃
translation: Israel, trust in the LORD! He is their help and their shield. (Psalms 115:9)

text: תְּהִֽי יָדְךָ לְעָזְרֵנִי כִּי פִקּוּדֶיךָ בָחָֽרְתִּי׃
translation: Let your hand be ready to help me, for I have chosen your precepts. (Psalms 119:173)

text: עֶזְרִי מֵעִם יְהוָה עֹשֵׂה שָׁמַיִם וָאָֽרֶץ׃
translation: My help comes from the LORD, who made heaven and earth. (Psalms 121:2)

text: עֶזְרֵנוּ בְּשֵׁם יְהוָה עֹשֵׂה שָׁמַיִם וָאָֽרֶץ׃
translation: Our help is in the LORD's name, who made heaven and earth. (Psalms 124:8)

text: לְעֹבֵד אֱדֹם נֶגְבָּה וּלְבָנָיו בֵּית הָאֲסֻפִּֽים׃
translation: To Obed-Edom southward; and to his sons the storehouse. (1 Chronicles 26:15)

text: עָרֵי הַנֶּגֶב סֻגְּרוּ וְאֵין פֹּתֵחַ הָגְלָת יְהוּדָה כֻּלָּהּ הָגְלָת שְׁלוֹמִֽים׃
translation: The cities of the South are shut up, and there is no one to open them. Judah is carried away captive: all of them. They are wholly carried away captive. (Jeremiah 13:19)

text: וַיִּסַּע אַבְרָם הָלוֹךְ וְנָסוֹעַ הַנֶּֽגְבָּה׃
translation: Abram traveled, still going on toward the South. (Genesis 12:9)

text: וַיַּעַל אַבְרָם מִמִּצְרַיִם הוּא וְאִשְׁתּוֹ וְכָל אֲשֶׁר לוֹ וְלוֹט עִמּוֹ הַנֶּֽגְבָּה׃
translation: Abram went up out of Egypt—he, his wife, all that he had, and Lot with him—into the South. (Genesis 13:1)

text: וַיִּסַּע מִשָּׁם אַבְרָהָם אַרְצָה הַנֶּגֶב וַיֵּשֶׁב בֵּין קָדֵשׁ וּבֵין שׁוּר וַיָּגָר בִּגְרָֽר׃
translation: Abraham traveled from there toward the land of the South, and lived between Kadesh and Shur. He lived as a foreigner in Gerar. (Genesis 20:1)

text: לַמִּזְרָח הַלְוִיִּם שִׁשָּׁה לַצָּפוֹנָה לַיּוֹם אַרְבָּעָה לַנֶּגְבָּה לַיּוֹם אַרְבָּעָה וְלָאֲסֻפִּים שְׁנַיִם שְׁנָֽיִם׃
translation: Eastward were six Levites, northward four a day, southward four a day, and for the storehouse two and two. (1 Chronicles 26:17)

text: וְהֶעֱמַדְנוּ עָלֵינוּ מִצְוֺת לָתֵת עָלֵינוּ שְׁלִשִׁית הַשֶּׁקֶל בַּשָּׁנָה לַעֲבֹדַת בֵּית אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃
translation: for the show bread, for the continual meal offering, for the continual burnt offering, for the Sabbaths, for the new moons, for the set feasts, for the holy things, for the sin offerings to make atonement for Israel, and for all the work of the house of our God. (Nehemiah 10:33)

text: וְכֶסֶף פְּקוּדֵי הָעֵדָה מְאַת כִּכָּר וְאֶלֶף וּשְׁבַע מֵאוֹת וַחֲמִשָּׁה וְשִׁבְעִים שֶׁקֶל בְּשֶׁקֶל הַקֹּֽדֶשׁ׃
translation: The silver of those who were counted of the congregation was one hundred talents and one thousand seven hundred seventy-five shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary: (Exodus 38:25)

text: אֲדֹנִי שְׁמָעֵנִי אֶרֶץ אַרְבַּע מֵאֹת שֶֽׁקֶל כֶּסֶף בֵּינִי וּבֵֽינְךָ מַה הִוא וְאֶת מֵתְךָ קְבֹֽר׃
translation: "My lord, listen to me. What is a piece of land worth four hundred shekels of silver between me and you? Therefore bury your dead." (Genesis 23:15)

text: מֵאֵת בְּכוֹר בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לָקַח אֶת הַכָּסֶף חֲמִשָּׁה וְשִׁשִּׁים וּשְׁלֹשׁ מֵאוֹת וָאֶלֶף בְּשֶׁקֶל הַקֹּֽדֶשׁ׃
translation: from the firstborn of the children of Israel he took the money, one thousand three hundred sixty-five shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary; (Numbers 3:50)

text: וְאִם מִבֶּן שִׁשִּׁים שָׁנָה וָמַעְלָה אִם זָכָר וְהָיָה עֶרְכְּךָ חֲמִשָּׁה עָשָׂר שָׁקֶל וְלַנְּקֵבָה עֲשָׂרָה שְׁקָלִֽים׃
translation: If the person is from sixty years old and upward; if he is a male, then your valuation shall be fifteen shekels, and for a female ten shekels. (Leviticus 27:7)

text: וָאֶשְׁקֲלָה עַל יָדָם כֶּסֶף כִּכָּרִים שֵֽׁשׁ מֵאוֹת וַחֲמִשִּׁים וּכְלֵי כֶסֶף מֵאָה לְכִכָּרִים זָהָב מֵאָה כִכָּֽר׃
translation: I weighed into their hand six hundred fifty talents of silver, one hundred talents of silver vessels, one hundred talents of gold, (Ezra 8:26)

text: לַמְנַצֵּחַ אַל תַּשְׁחֵת מִזְמוֹר לְאָסָף שִֽׁיר׃
translation: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of "Do Not Destroy." A Psalm by Asaph. A song. We give thanks to you, God. We give thanks, for your Name is near. Men tell about your wondrous works. (Psalms 75:1)

text: לַמְנַצֵּחַ עַֽל ידיתון יְדוּתוּן לְאָסָף מִזְמֽוֹר׃
translation: For the Chief Musician. To Jeduthun. A Psalm by Asaph. My cry goes to God! Indeed, I cry to God for help, and for him to listen to me. (Psalms 77:1)

text: לַמְנַצֵּחַ אֶל שֹׁשַׁנִּים עֵדוּת לְאָסָף מִזְמֽוֹר׃
translation: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of "The Lilies of the Covenant." A Psalm by Asaph. Hear us, Shepherd of Israel, you who lead Joseph like a flock, you who sit above the cherubim, shine out. (Psalms 80:1)

text: לַמְנַצֵּחַ עַֽל הַגִּתִּית לִבְנֵי קֹרַח מִזְמֽוֹר׃
translation: For the Chief Musician. On an instrument of Gath. A Psalm by the sons of Korah. How lovely are your dwellings, LORD of Armies! (Psalms 84:1)

text: לַמְנַצֵּחַ לְדָוִד מִזְמוֹר יְהוָה חֲקַרְתַּנִי וַתֵּדָֽע׃
translation: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. LORD, you have searched me, and you know me. (Psalms 139:1)

text: וּמַתִּתְיָהוּ וֶאֱלִֽיפְלֵהוּ וּמִקְנֵיָהוּ וְעֹבֵד אֱדֹם וִֽיעִיאֵל וַעֲזַזְיָהוּ בְּכִנֹּרוֹת עַל הַשְּׁמִינִית לְנַצֵּֽחַ׃
translation: and Mattithiah, Eliphelehu, Mikneiah, Obed-Edom, Jeiel, and Azaziah, with harps tuned to the eight-stringed lyre, to lead. (1 Chronicles 15:21)

text: נִחַם יְהוָה עַל זֹאת לֹא תִהְיֶה אָמַר יְהוָֽה׃
translation: The LORD relented concerning this. "It shall not be," says the LORD. (Amos 7:3)

text: כְּאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר אִמּוֹ תְּנַחֲמֶנּוּ כֵּן אָֽנֹכִי אֲנַחֶמְכֶם וּבִירֽוּשָׁלִַם תְּנֻחָֽמוּ׃
translation: As one whom his mother comforts, so I will comfort you. You will be comforted in Jerusalem." (Isaiah 66:13)

text: שָׁמַעְתִּי כְאֵלֶּה רַבּוֹת מְנַחֲמֵי עָמָל כֻּלְּכֶֽם׃
translation: "I have heard many such things. You are all miserable comforters! (Job 16:2)

text: יְהִי נָא חַסְדְּךָ לְנַחֲמֵנִי כְּאִמְרָתְךָ לְעַבְדֶּֽךָ׃
translation: Please let your loving kindness be for my comfort, according to your word to your servant. (Psalms 119:76)

text: כָּלוּ עֵינַי לְאִמְרָתֶךָ לֵאמֹר מָתַי תְּֽנַחֲמֵֽנִי׃
translation: My eyes fail for your word. I say, "When will you comfort me?" (Psalms 119:82)

text: זָכַרְתִּי מִשְׁפָּטֶיךָ מֵעוֹלָם יְהוָה וָֽאֶתְנֶחָֽם׃
translation: I remember your ordinances of old, LORD, and have comforted myself. (Psalms 119:52)

text: לִשְׁמוֹנָה עָשָׂר לַחֲנָנִי בָּנָיו וְאֶחָיו שְׁנֵים עָשָֽׂר׃
translation: for the eighteenth to Hanani, his sons and his brothers, twelve; (1 Chronicles 25:25)

text: בִּשְׁנַת שְׁמוֹנֶה עֶשְׂרֵה לַמֶּלֶךְ יָרָבְעָם וַיִּמְלֹךְ אֲבִיָּה עַל יְהוּדָֽה׃
translation: In the eighteenth year of King Jeroboam, Abijah began to reign over Judah. (2 Chronicles 13:1)

text: אַנְשֵׁי בֵֽית לֶחֶם וּנְטֹפָה מֵאָה שְׁמֹנִים וּשְׁמֹנָֽה׃
translation: The men of Bethlehem and Netophah: one hundred eighty-eight. (Nehemiah 7:26)

text: וְאַחֲרָיו גַּבַּי סַלָּי תְּשַׁע מֵאוֹת עֶשְׂרִים וּשְׁמֹנָֽה׃
translation: After him Gabbai and Sallai, nine hundred twenty-eight. (Nehemiah 11:8)

text: וַיַּעַבְדוּ בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת עֶגְלוֹן מֶֽלֶךְ מוֹאָב שְׁמוֹנֶה עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָֽה׃
translation: The children of Israel served Eglon the king of Moab eighteen years. (Judges 3:14)

text: וְהַיָּמִים אֲשֶׁר מָלַךְ יֵהוּא עַל יִשְׂרָאֵל עֶשְׂרִים וּשְׁמֹנֶֽה שָׁנָה בְּשֹׁמְרֽוֹן׃
translation: The time that Jehu reigned over Israel in Samaria was twenty-eight years. (2 Kings 10:36)

text: וַחֲמֹרִים שְׁלֹשִׁים אֶלֶף וַחֲמֵשׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃
translation: thirty thousand five hundred donkeys, (Numbers 31:45)

text: גְּמַלֵּיהֶם אַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת שְׁלֹשִׁים וַחֲמִשָּׁה חֲמֹרִים שֵׁשֶׁת אֲלָפִים שְׁבַע מֵאוֹת וְעֶשְׂרִֽים׃
translation: their camels, four hundred thirty-five; their donkeys, six thousand seven hundred twenty. (Ezra 2:67)

text: גְּמַלִּים אַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת שְׁלֹשִׁים וַחֲמִשָּׁה חֲמֹרִים שֵׁשֶׁת אֲלָפִים שְׁבַע מֵאוֹת וְעֶשְׂרִֽים׃
translation: Their horses were seven hundred thirty-six; their mules, two hundred forty-five; (Nehemiah 7:68)

text: וַיִּפְרֹץ הָאִישׁ מְאֹד מְאֹד וַֽיְהִי לוֹ צֹאן רַבּוֹת וּשְׁפָחוֹת וַעֲבָדִים וּגְמַלִּים וַחֲמֹרִֽים׃
translation: The man increased exceedingly, and had large flocks, female servants and male servants, and camels and donkeys. (Genesis 30:43)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁכֶם אֶל חֲמוֹר אָבִיו לֵאמֹר קַֽח לִי אֶת הַיַּלְדָּה הַזֹּאת לְאִשָּֽׁה׃
translation: Shechem spoke to his father, Hamor, saying, "Get me this young lady as a wife." (Genesis 34:4)

text: וַיָּבֹא חֲמוֹר וּשְׁכֶם בְּנוֹ אֶל שַׁעַר עִירָם וַֽיְדַבְּרוּ אֶל אַנְשֵׁי עִירָם לֵאמֹֽר׃
translation: Hamor and Shechem, his son, came to the gate of their city, and talked with the men of their city, saying, (Genesis 34:20)

text: וְלֹא עָרַךְ אֵלַי מִלִּין וּבְאִמְרֵיכֶם לֹא אֲשִׁיבֶֽנּוּ׃
translation: for he has not directed his words against me; neither will I answer him with your speeches. (Job 32:14)

text: וַיַּעֲרֹךְ עָלָיו עֵרֶךְ לֶחֶם לִפְנֵי יְהוָה כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהוָה אֶת מֹשֶֽׁה׃
translation: He set the bread in order on it before the LORD, as the LORD commanded Moses. (Exodus 40:23)

text: וְהֶעֱרִיךְ הַכֹּהֵן אֹתָהּ בֵּין טוֹב וּבֵין רָע כְּעֶרְכְּךָ הַכֹּהֵן כֵּן יִהְיֶֽה׃
translation: and the priest shall evaluate it, whether it is good or bad. As the priest evaluates it, so it shall be. (Leviticus 27:12)

text: וְשָׁאוּל וְאִֽישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל נֶאֶסְפוּ וַֽיַּחֲנוּ בְּעֵמֶק הָאֵלָה וַיַּעַרְכוּ מִלְחָמָה לִקְרַאת פְּלִשְׁתִּֽים׃
translation: Saul and the men of Israel were gathered together, and encamped in the valley of Elah, and set the battle in array against the Philistines. (1 Samuel 17:2)

text: וְאֵת יֶתֶר הָעָם נָתַן בְּיַד אַבְשַׁי אָחִיו וַֽיַּעֲרֹךְ לִקְרַאת בְּנֵי עַמּֽוֹן׃
