translation: The rest of the people he committed into the hand of Abishai his brother; and he put them in array against the children of Ammon. (2 Samuel 10:10)

text: וְאֵת יֶתֶר הָעָם נָתַן בְּיַד אַבְשַׁי אָחִיו וַיַּעַרְכוּ לִקְרַאת בְּנֵי עַמּֽוֹן׃
translation: The rest of the people he committed into the hand of Abishai his brother; and they put themselves in array against the children of Ammon. (1 Chronicles 19:11)

text: וַיַּעַשׂ אוּרִיָּה הַכֹּהֵן כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה הַמֶּלֶךְ אָחָֽז׃
translation: Urijah the priest did so, according to all that King Ahaz commanded. (2 Kings 16:16)

text: בַּאֲשֻׁרוֹ אָחֲזָה רַגְלִי דַּרְכּוֹ שָׁמַרְתִּי וְלֹא אָֽט׃
translation: My foot has held fast to his steps. I have kept his way, and not turned away. (Job 23:11)

text: וְעַתָּה עָלַי תִּשְׁתַּפֵּךְ נַפְשִׁי יֹאחֲזוּנִי יְמֵי עֹֽנִי׃
translation: "Now my soul is poured out within me. Days of affliction have taken hold of me. (Job 30:16)

text: אָחָז בְּנוֹ חִזְקִיָּהוּ בְנוֹ מְנַשֶּׁה בְנֽוֹ׃
translation: Ahaz his son, Hezekiah his son, Manasseh his son, (1 Chronicles 3:13)

text: וּבְנֵי מִיכָה פִּיתוֹן וָמֶלֶךְ וְתַאְרֵעַ וְאָחָֽז׃
translation: The sons of Micah: Pithon, Melech, Tarea, and Ahaz. (1 Chronicles 8:35)

text: בָּעֵת הַהִיא שָׁלַח הַמֶּלֶךְ אָחָז עַל מַלְכֵי אַשּׁוּר לַעְזֹר לֽוֹ׃
translation: At that time King Ahaz sent to the kings of Assyria to help him. (2 Chronicles 28:16)

text: הֲיָדַעְתָּ חֻקּוֹת שָׁמָיִם אִם תָּשִׂים מִשְׁטָרוֹ בָאָֽרֶץ׃
translation: Do you know the laws of the heavens? Can you establish its dominion over the earth? (Job 38:33)

text: וְתָשֵׂם בַּסַּד רַגְלַי וְתִשְׁמוֹר כָּל אָרְחוֹתָי עַל שָׁרְשֵׁי רַגְלַי תִּתְחַקֶּֽה׃
translation: You also put my feet in the stocks, and mark all my paths. You set a bound to the soles of my feet, (Job 13:27)

text: אִם חֻקֹּתַי יְחַלֵּלוּ וּמִצְוֺתַי לֹא יִשְׁמֹֽרוּ׃
translation: then I will punish their sin with the rod, and their iniquity with stripes. (Psalms 89:32)

text: אֲנִי יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם בְּחֻקּוֹתַי לֵכוּ וְאֶת מִשְׁפָּטַי שִׁמְרוּ וַעֲשׂוּ אוֹתָֽם׃
translation: I am the LORD your God. Walk in my statutes, keep my ordinances, and do them. (Ezekiel 20:19)

text: אֶת מִשְׁפָּטַי תַּעֲשׂוּ וְאֶת חֻקֹּתַי תִּשְׁמְרוּ לָלֶכֶת בָּהֶם אֲנִי יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃
translation: You shall do my ordinances. You shall keep my statutes and walk in them. I am the LORD your God. (Leviticus 18:4)

text: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם אֶת כָּל חֻקֹּתַי וְאֶת כָּל מִשְׁפָּטַי וַעֲשִׂיתֶם אֹתָם אֲנִי יְהוָֽה׃
translation: "'You shall observe all my statutes and all my ordinances, and do them. I am the LORD.'" (Leviticus 19:37)

text: בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי נָשִׂיא לִבְנֵי זְבוּלֻן אֱלִיאָב בֶּן חֵלֹֽן׃
translation: On the third day Eliab the son of Helon, prince of the children of Zebulun, (Numbers 7:24)

text: וְהַנּוֹתָר מִבְּשַׂר הַזָּבַח בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי בָּאֵשׁ יִשָּׂרֵֽף׃
translation: but what remains of the meat of the sacrifice on the third day shall be burned with fire. (Leviticus 7:17)

text: וּבִנְיָמִן הוֹלִיד אֶת בֶּלַע בְּכֹרוֹ אַשְׁבֵּל הַשֵּׁנִי וְאַחְרַח הַשְּׁלִישִֽׁי׃
translation: Benjamin became the father of Bela his firstborn, Ashbel the second, Aharah the third, (1 Chronicles 8:1)

text: יְחַיֵּנוּ מִיֹּמָיִם בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי יְקִמֵנוּ וְנִחְיֶה לְפָנָֽיו׃
translation: After two days he will revive us. On the third day he will raise us up, and we will live before him. (Hosea 6:2)

text: וַֽיְהִי עֶרֶב וַֽיְהִי בֹקֶר יוֹם שְׁלִישִֽׁי׃
translation: There was evening and there was morning, a third day. (Genesis 1:13)

text: בָּנִים אֲשֶׁר יִוָּלְדוּ לָהֶם דּוֹר שְׁלִישִׁי יָבֹא לָהֶם בִּקְהַל יְהוָֽה׃
translation: When you go out and camp against your enemies, then you shall keep yourselves from every evil thing. (Deuteronomy 23:9)

text: אֵלֶּה מִבְּנֵי גָד רָאשֵׁי הַצָּבָא אֶחָד לְמֵאָה הַקָּטָן וְהַגָּדוֹל לְאָֽלֶף׃
translation: These are those who went over the Jordan in the first month, when it had overflowed all its banks; and they put to flight all who lived in the valleys, both toward the east and toward the west. (1 Chronicles 12:15)

text: יְבָרֵךְ יִרְאֵי יְהוָה הַקְּטַנִּים עִם הַגְּדֹלִֽים׃
translation: He will bless those who fear the LORD, both small and great. (Psalms 115:13)

text: וַיֶּאֱהַב יַעֲקֹב אֶת רָחֵל וַיֹּאמֶר אֶֽעֱבָדְךָ שֶׁבַע שָׁנִים בְּרָחֵל בִּתְּךָ הַקְּטַנָּֽה׃
translation: Jacob loved Rachel. He said, "I will serve you seven years for Rachel, your younger daughter." (Genesis 29:18)

text: וְאֶת אֲחִיכֶם הַקָּטֹן תָּבִיאוּ אֵלַי וְיֵאָמְנוּ דִבְרֵיכֶם וְלֹא תָמוּתוּ וַיַּעֲשׂוּ כֵֽן׃
translation: Bring your youngest brother to me; so will your words be verified, and you won't die." They did so. (Genesis 42:20)

text: וְלִמְפִיבֹשֶׁת בֵּן קָטָן וּשְׁמוֹ מִיכָא וְכֹל מוֹשַׁב בֵּית צִיבָא עֲבָדִים לִמְפִיבֹֽשֶׁת׃
translation: Mephibosheth had a young son, whose name was Mica. All who lived in Ziba's house were servants to Mephibosheth. (2 Samuel 9:12)

text: כִּֽי הִנֵּה יְהוָה מְצַוֶּה וְהִכָּה הַבַּיִת הַגָּדוֹל רְסִיסִים וְהַבַּיִת הַקָּטֹן בְּקִעִֽים׃
translation: "For, behold, the LORD commands, and the great house will be smashed to pieces, and the little house into bits. (Amos 6:11)

text: וַיְהִי נַעַר מִבֵּית לֶחֶם יְהוּדָה מִמִּשְׁפַּחַת יְהוּדָה וְהוּא לֵוִי וְהוּא גָֽר שָֽׁם׃
translation: There was a young man out of Bethlehem Judah, of the family of Judah, who was a Levite; and he lived there. (Judges 17:7)

text: יִרְאֵי יְהוָה הַֽלְלוּהוּ כָּל זֶרַע יַעֲקֹב כַּבְּדוּהוּ וְגוּרוּ מִמֶּנּוּ כָּל זֶרַע יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
translation: For he has not despised nor abhorred the affliction of the afflicted, neither has he hidden his face from him; but when he cried to him, he heard. (Psalms 22:24)

text: כִּי הִנֵּה אָֽרְבוּ לְנַפְשִׁי יָגוּרוּ עָלַי עַזִים לֹא פִשְׁעִי וְלֹא חַטָּאתִי יְהוָֽה׃
translation: I have done no wrong, yet they are ready to attack me. Rise up, behold, and help me! (Psalms 59:4)

text: וַיָּגָר מוֹאָב מִפְּנֵי הָעָם מְאֹד כִּי רַב הוּא וַיָּקָץ מוֹאָב מִפְּנֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
translation: Moab was very afraid of the people, because they were many. Moab was distressed because of the children of Israel. (Numbers 22:3)

text: הַקָּהָל חֻקָּה אַחַת לָכֶם וְלַגֵּר הַגָּר חֻקַּת עוֹלָם לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶם כָּכֶם כַּגֵּר יִהְיֶה לִפְנֵי יְהוָֽה׃
translation: For the assembly, there shall be one statute for you and for the stranger who lives as a foreigner, a statute forever throughout your generations. As you are, so the foreigner shall be before the LORD. (Numbers 15:15)

text: וַתָּקָם הָֽאִשָּׁה וַתַּעַשׂ כִּדְבַר אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים וַתֵּלֶךְ הִיא וּבֵיתָהּ וַתָּגָר בְּאֶֽרֶץ פְּלִשְׁתִּים שֶׁבַע שָׁנִֽים׃
translation: The woman arose, and did according to the man of God's word. She went with her household, and lived in the land of the Philistines for seven years. (2 Kings 8:2)

text: לֹא יַחֲבֹל רֵחַיִם וָרָכֶב כִּי נֶפֶשׁ הוּא חֹבֵֽל׃
translation: No man shall take the mill or the upper millstone as a pledge, for he takes a life in pledge. (Deuteronomy 24:6)

text: לֵאמֹר לְךָ אֶתֵּן אֶת אֶֽרֶץ כְּנָעַן חֶבֶל נַחֲלַתְכֶֽם׃
translation: saying, "To you I will give the land of Canaan, the lot of your inheritance," (Psalms 105:11)

text: כִּי חֵלֶק יְהֹוָה עַמּוֹ יַעֲקֹב חֶבֶל נַחֲלָתֽוֹ׃
translation: For the LORD's portion is his people. Jacob is the lot of his inheritance. (Deuteronomy 32:9)

text: לֵאמֹר לְךָ אֶתֵּן אֶֽרֶץ כְּנָעַן חֶבֶל נַחֲלַתְכֶֽם׃
translation: saying, "I will give you the land of Canaan, The lot of your inheritance," (1 Chronicles 16:18)

text: כִּֽי אֶל אֵל הֶאָמַר נָשָׂאתִי לֹא אֶחְבֹּֽל׃
translation: "For has any said to God, 'I am guilty, but I will not offend any more. (Job 34:31)

text: וְהָיִיתָ כְּשֹׁכֵב בְּלֶב יָם וּכְשֹׁכֵב בְּרֹאשׁ חִבֵּֽל׃
translation: Yes, you will be as he who lies down in the middle of the sea, or as he who lies on top of the rigging: (Proverbs 23:34)

text: וּבַחֹדֶשׁ הַשֵּׁנִי בְּשִׁבְעָה וְעֶשְׂרִים יוֹם לַחֹדֶשׁ יָבְשָׁה הָאָֽרֶץ׃
translation: In the second month, on the twenty-seventh day of the month, the earth was dry. (Genesis 8:14)

text: וְעַתָּה נַפְשֵׁנוּ יְבֵשָׁה אֵין כֹּל בִּלְתִּי אֶל הַמָּן עֵינֵֽינוּ׃
translation: but now we have lost our appetite. There is nothing at all except this manna to look at." (Numbers 11:6)

text: וַיִּתְפָּקֵד הָעָם וְהִנֵּה אֵֽין שָׁם אִישׁ מִיּוֹשְׁבֵי יָבֵשׁ גִּלְעָֽד׃
translation: For when the people were counted, behold, there were none of the inhabitants of Jabesh Gilead there. (Judges 21:9)

text: הֹבִישָׁה בַּת מִצְרָיִם נִתְּנָה בְּיַד עַם צָפֽוֹן׃
translation: The daughter of Egypt will be disappointed; she will be delivered into the hand of the people of the north." (Jeremiah 46:24)

text: וַיִּשְׁמְעוּ אֵלָיו יֹשְׁבֵי יָבֵישׁ גִּלְעָד אֵת אֲשֶׁר עָשׂוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים לְשָׁאֽוּל׃
translation: When the inhabitants of Jabesh Gilead heard what the Philistines had done to Saul, (1 Samuel 31:11)

text: וַֽיִּשְׁמְעוּ כֹּל יָבֵישׁ גִּלְעָד אֵת כָּל אֲשֶׁר עָשׂוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים לְשָׁאֽוּל׃
translation: When all Jabesh Gilead heard all that the Philistines had done to Saul, (1 Chronicles 10:11)

text: עֲלֵיהֶם עוֹף הַשָּׁמַיִם יִשְׁכּוֹן מִבֵּין עֳפָאיִם יִתְּנוּ קֽוֹל׃
translation: The birds of the sky nest by them. They sing among the branches. (Psalms 104:12)

text: וַיַּכּוּ בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא בַּפְּלִשְׁתִּים מִמִּכְמָשׂ אַיָּלֹנָה וַיָּעַף הָעָם מְאֹֽד׃
translation: They struck the Philistines that day from Michmash to Aijalon. The people were very faint; (1 Samuel 14:31)

text: יָדַעְתִּי כָּל עוֹף הָרִים וְזִיז שָׂדַי עִמָּדִֽי׃
translation: I know all the birds of the mountains. The wild animals of the field are mine. (Psalms 50:11)

text: הַמֵּת לְאַחְאָב בָּעִיר יֹאכְלוּ הַכְּלָבִים וְהַמֵּת בַּשָּׂדֶה יֹאכְלוּ עוֹף הַשָּׁמָֽיִם׃
translation: The dogs will eat he who dies of Ahab in the city; and the birds of the sky will eat he who dies in the field." (1 Kings 21:24)

text: מַלְּפֵנוּ מִבַּהֲמוֹת אָרֶץ וּמֵעוֹף הַשָּׁמַיִם יְחַכְּמֵֽנוּ׃
translation: who teaches us more than the animals of the earth, and makes us wiser than the birds of the sky?' (Job 35:11)

text: הַמֵּת לְבַעְשָׁא בָּעִיר יֹֽאכְלוּ הַכְּלָבִים וְהַמֵּת לוֹ בַּשָּׂדֶה יֹאכְלוּ עוֹף הַשָּׁמָֽיִם׃
translation: The dogs will eat Baasha's descendants who die in the city; and he who dies of his in the field, the birds of the sky will eat." (1 Kings 16:4)

text: וּגְבוּל עוֹג מֶלֶךְ הַבָּשָׁן מִיֶּתֶר הָרְפָאִים הַיּוֹשֵׁב בְּעַשְׁתָּרוֹת וּבְאֶדְרֶֽעִי׃
translation: and the border of Og king of Bashan, of the remnant of the Rephaim, who lived at Ashtaroth and at Edrei, (Joshua 12:4)

text: וַיֵּרָפוּ הַמַּיִם עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה כִּדְבַר אֱלִישָׁע אֲשֶׁר דִּבֵּֽר׃
translation: So the waters were healed to this day, according to Elisha's word which he spoke. (2 Kings 2:22)

text: אֵל נוּלְּדוּ לְהָרָפָא בְּגַת וַיִּפְּלוּ בְיַד דָּוִיד וּבְיַד עֲבָדָֽיו׃
translation: These were born to the giant in Gath; and they fell by the hand of David and by the hand of his servants. (1 Chronicles 20:8)

text: וַיִּשְׁמַע יְהוָה אֶל יְחִזְקִיָּהוּ וַיִּרְפָּא אֶת הָעָֽם׃
translation: The LORD listened to Hezekiah, and healed the people. (2 Chronicles 30:20)

text: אֲֽנִי אָמַרְתִּי יְהוָה חָנֵּנִי רְפָאָה נַפְשִׁי כִּי חָטָאתִי לָֽךְ׃
translation: My enemies speak evil against me: "When will he die, and his name perish?" (Psalms 41:5)

text: וְאָנֹכִי תִרְגַּלְתִּי לְאֶפְרַיִם קָחָם עַל זְרֽוֹעֹתָיו וְלֹא יָדְעוּ כִּי רְפָאתִֽים׃
translation: Yet I taught Ephraim to walk. I took them by their arms, but they didn't know that I healed them. (Hosea 11:3)

text: וְהִשְׁבַּתִּי לְמוֹאָב נְאֻם יְהוָה מַעֲלֶה בָמָה וּמַקְטִיר לֵאלֹהָֽיו׃
translation: Moreover I will cause to cease in Moab," says the LORD, "him who offers in the high place, and him who burns incense to his gods. (Jeremiah 48:35)

text: אַךְ הַבָּמוֹת לֹֽא סָרוּ עוֹד הָעָם מְזַבְּחִים וּֽמְקַטְּרִים בַּבָּמֽוֹת׃
translation: Jehoshaphat made peace with the king of Israel. (1 Kings 22:44)

text: רַק הַבָּמוֹת לֹא סָרוּ עוֹד הָעָם מְזַבְּחִים וּֽמְקַטְּרִים בַּבָּמֽוֹת׃
translation: Jehoash said to the priests, "All the money of the holy things that is brought into the LORD's house, in current money, the money of the people for whom each man is evaluated, and all the money that it comes into any man's heart to bring into the LORD's house, (2 Kings 12:4)

text: רַק הַבָּמוֹת לֹא סָרוּ עוֹד הָעָם מְזַבְּחִים וּֽמְקַטְּרִים בַּבָּמֽוֹת׃
translation: However the high places were not taken away. The people still sacrificed and burned incense in the high places. (2 Kings 14:4)

text: רַק הַבָּמוֹת לֹא סָרוּ עוֹד הָעָם מְזַבְּחִים וּֽמְקַטְּרִים בַּבָּמֽוֹת׃
translation: However, the high places were not taken away. The people still sacrificed and burned incense in the high places. (2 Kings 15:4)

text: נֹטֶה שָׁמַיִם לְבַדּוֹ וְדוֹרֵךְ עַל בָּמֳתֵי יָֽם׃
translation: He alone stretches out the heavens, and treads on the waves of the sea. (Job 9:8)

text: וַיְהִי דָוִד לְכָל דָּרְכָו מַשְׂכִּיל וַֽיהוָה עִמּֽוֹ׃
translation: David behaved himself wisely in all his ways; and the LORD was with him. (1 Samuel 18:14)

text: אִיּוֹב לֹא בְדַעַת יְדַבֵּר וּדְבָרָיו לֹא בְהַשְׂכֵּֽיל׃
translation: 'Job speaks without knowledge. His words are without wisdom.' (Job 34:35)

text: וַיָּבֶן וַיְדַבֵּר עִמִּי וַיֹּאמַר דָּנִיֵּאל עַתָּה יָצָאתִי לְהַשְׂכִּילְךָ בִינָֽה׃
translation: He instructed me and talked with me, and said, "Daniel, I have now come to give you wisdom and understanding. (Daniel 9:22)

text: וְעַתָּה מְלָכִים הַשְׂכִּילוּ הִוָּסְרוּ שֹׁפְטֵי אָֽרֶץ׃
translation: Now therefore be wise, you kings. Be instructed, you judges of the earth. (Psalms 2:10)

text: אַשְׂכִּילָה בְּדֶרֶךְ תָּמִים מָתַי תָּבוֹא אֵלָי אֶתְהַלֵּךְ בְּתָם לְבָבִי בְּקֶרֶב בֵּיתִֽי׃
translation: I will be careful to live a blameless life. When will you come to me? I will walk within my house with a blameless heart. (Psalms 101:2)

text: רֵאשִׁית חָכְמָה יִרְאַת יְהוָה שֵׂכֶל טוֹב לְכָל עֹשֵׂיהֶם תְּהִלָּתוֹ עֹמֶדֶת לָעַֽד׃
translation: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom. All those who do his work have a good understanding. His praise endures forever! (Psalms 111:10)

text: יֶאֱתָיוּ חַשְׁמַנִּים מִנִּי מִצְרָיִם כּוּשׁ תָּרִיץ יָדָיו לֵאלֹהִֽים׃
translation: Sing to God, you kingdoms of the earth! Sing praises to the Lord— Selah— (Psalms 68:32)

text: דֶּֽרֶךְ מִצְוֺתֶיךָ אָרוּץ כִּי תַרְחִיב לִבִּֽי׃
translation: I run in the path of your commandments, for you have set my heart free. HE (Psalms 119:32)

text: וּלְרִבְקָה אָח וּשְׁמוֹ לָבָן וַיָּרָץ לָבָן אֶל הָאִישׁ הַחוּצָה אֶל הָעָֽיִן׃
translation: Rebekah had a brother, and his name was Laban. Laban ran out to the man, to the spring. (Genesis 24:29)

text: וַיַּֽעַמְדוּ אִישׁ תַּחְתָּיו סָבִיב לַֽמַּחֲנֶה וַיָּרָץ כָּל הַֽמַּחֲנֶה וַיָּרִיעוּ ויניסו וַיָּנֽוּסוּ׃
translation: They each stood in his place around the camp, and all the army ran; and they shouted, and put them to flight. (Judges 7:21)

text: וַיָּרֻצוּ וַיִּקָּחֻהוּ מִשָּׁם וַיִּתְיַצֵּב בְּתוֹךְ הָעָם וַיִּגְבַּהּ מִכָּל הָעָם מִשִּׁכְמוֹ וָמָֽעְלָה׃
translation: They ran and got him there. When he stood among the people, he was higher than any of the people from his shoulders and upward. (1 Samuel 10:23)

text: וַתִּשְׁמַע עֲתַלְיָה אֶת קוֹל הָֽרָצִין הָעָם וַתָּבֹא אֶל הָעָם בֵּית יְהוָֽה׃
translation: When Athaliah heard the noise of the guard and of the people, she came to the people into the LORD's house; (2 Kings 11:13)

text: וַיַּעֲשֶׂה עָמְרִי הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהוָה וַיָּרַע מִכֹּל אֲשֶׁר לְפָנָֽיו׃
translation: Omri did that which was evil in the LORD's sight, and dealt wickedly above all who were before him. (1 Kings 16:25)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר יִשְׂרָאֵל לָמָה הֲרֵעֹתֶם לִי לְהַגִּיד לָאִישׁ הַעוֹד לָכֶם אָֽח׃
translation: Israel said, "Why did you treat me so badly, telling the man that you had another brother?" (Genesis 43:6)

text: אַֽל תִּגְּעוּ בִמְשִׁיחָי וְלִנְבִיאַי אַל תָּרֵֽעוּ׃
translation: "Don't touch my anointed ones! Do my prophets no harm!" (Psalms 105:15)

text: סֽוּרוּ מִמֶּנִּי מְרֵעִים וְאֶצְּרָה מִצְוֺת אֱלֹהָֽי׃
translation: Depart from me, you evildoers, that I may keep the commandments of my God. (Psalms 119:115)

text: מְחַשֵּׁב לְהָרֵעַ לוֹ בַּֽעַל מְזִמּוֹת יִקְרָֽאוּ׃
translation: One who plots to do evil will be called a schemer. (Proverbs 24:8)

text: אַל תִּתְחַר בַּמְּרֵעִים אַל תְּקַנֵּא בָּרְשָׁעִֽים׃
translation: Don't fret yourself because of evildoers, neither be envious of the wicked; (Proverbs 24:19)

text: הֲלֹא אֵיד לְעַוָּל וְנֵכֶר לְפֹעֲלֵי אָֽוֶן׃
translation: Is it not calamity to the unrighteous, and disaster to the workers of iniquity? (Job 31:3)

text: הַצִּילֵנִי מִפֹּעֲלֵי אָוֶן וּֽמֵאַנְשֵׁי דָמִים הוֹשִׁיעֵֽנִי׃
translation: For, behold, they lie in wait for my soul. The mighty gather themselves together against me, not for my disobedience, nor for my sin, LORD. (Psalms 59:3)

text: וַיּוֹשַׁע יְהוָה בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל וְהַמִּלְחָמָה עָבְרָה אֶת בֵּית אָֽוֶן׃
translation: So the LORD saved Israel that day; and the battle passed over by Beth Aven. (1 Samuel 14:23)

text: הֲלֹא יָדְעוּ פֹּעֲלֵי אָוֶן אֹכְלֵי עַמִּי אָכְלוּ לֶחֶם אֱלֹהִים לֹא קָרָֽאוּ׃
translation: There they were in great fear, where no fear was, for God has scattered the bones of him who encamps against you. You have put them to shame, because God has rejected them. (Psalms 53:5)

text: מִֽי יָקוּם לִי עִם מְרֵעִים מִֽי יִתְיַצֵּב לִי עִם פֹּעֲלֵי אָֽוֶן׃
translation: Who will rise up for me against the wicked? Who will stand up for me against the evildoers? (Psalms 94:16)

text: לַבְּקָרִים אַצְמִית כָּל רִשְׁעֵי אָרֶץ לְהַכְרִית מֵֽעִיר יְהוָה כָּל פֹּעֲלֵי אָֽוֶן׃
translation: Morning by morning, I will destroy all the wicked of the land, to cut off all the workers of iniquity from the LORD's city. (Psalms 101:8)

text: וְאַתָּה בֵּאלֹהֶיךָ תָשׁוּב חֶסֶד וּמִשְׁפָּט שְׁמֹר וְקַוֵּה אֶל אֱלֹהֶיךָ תָּמִֽיד׃
translation: A merchant has dishonest scales in his hand. He loves to defraud. (Hosea 12:7)

text: שְׂעִיר עִזִּים אֶחָד חַטָּאת מִלְּבַד חַטַּאת הַכִּפֻּרִים וְעֹלַת הַתָּמִיד וּמִנְחָתָהּ וְנִסְכֵּיהֶֽם׃
translation: one male goat for a sin offering, in addition to the sin offering of atonement, and the continual burnt offering, and its meal offering, and their drink offerings. (Numbers 29:11)

text: אַשְׁרֵי אֲנָשֶׁיךָ אַשְׁרֵי עֲבָדֶיךָ אֵלֶּה הָֽעֹמְדִים לְפָנֶיךָ תָּמִיד הַשֹּׁמְעִים אֶת חָכְמָתֶֽךָ׃
translation: Happy are your men, happy are these your servants who stand continually before you, who hear your wisdom. (1 Kings 10:8)

text: אַשְׁרֵי אֲנָשֶׁיךָ וְאַשְׁרֵי עֲבָדֶיךָ אֵלֶּה הָעֹמְדִים לְפָנֶיךָ תָּמִיד וְשֹׁמְעִים אֶת חָכְמָתֶֽךָ׃
translation: Happy are your men, and happy are these your servants, who stand continually before you and hear your wisdom. (2 Chronicles 9:7)

text: יָרֹנּוּ וְיִשְׂמְחוּ חֲפֵצֵי צִדְקִי וְיֹאמְרוּ תָמִיד יִגְדַּל יְהוָה הֶחָפֵץ שְׁלוֹם עַבְדּֽוֹ׃
translation: Let those who favor my righteous cause shout for joy and be glad. Yes, let them say continually, "May the LORD be magnified, who has pleasure in the prosperity of his servant!" (Psalms 35:27)

text: יָשִׂישׂוּ וְיִשְׂמְחוּ בְּךָ כָּֽל מְבַקְשֶׁיךָ וְיֹאמְרוּ תָמִיד יִגְדַּל אֱלֹהִים אֹהֲבֵי יְשׁוּעָתֶֽךָ׃
translation: But I am poor and needy. Come to me quickly, God. You are my help and my deliverer. LORD, don't delay. (Psalms 70:5)

text: תַּֽחַת עֶבֶד כִּי יִמְלוֹךְ וְנָבָל כִּי יִֽשְׂבַּֽע לָֽחֶם׃
translation: For a servant when he is king, a fool when he is filled with food, (Proverbs 30:22)

text: הַפֹּרְטִים עַל פִּי הַנָּבֶל כְּדָוִיד חָשְׁבוּ לָהֶם כְּלֵי שִֽׁיר׃
translation: who strum on the strings of a harp, who invent for themselves instruments of music, like David; (Amos 6:5)

text: וַתֹּאמֶר לִנְעָרֶיהָ עִבְרוּ לְפָנַי הִנְנִי אַחֲרֵיכֶם בָּאָה וּלְאִישָׁהּ נָבָל לֹא הִגִּֽידָה׃
translation: She said to her young men, "Go on before me. Behold, I am coming after you." But she didn't tell her husband, Nabal. (1 Samuel 25:19)

text: וּזְכַרְיָה וַעֲזִיאֵל וּשְׁמִֽירָמוֹת וִֽיחִיאֵל וְעֻנִּי וֶֽאֱלִיאָב וּמַעֲשֵׂיָהוּ וּבְנָיָהוּ בִּנְבָלִים עַל עֲלָמֽוֹת׃
translation: and Zechariah, Aziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Maaseiah, and Benaiah, with stringed instruments set to Alamoth; (1 Chronicles 15:20)

text: אָמַר נָבָל בְּלִבּוֹ אֵין אֱלֹהִים הִֽשְׁחִיתוּ וְהִֽתְעִיבוּ עָוֶל אֵין עֹֽשֵׂה טֽוֹב׃
translation: God looks down from heaven on the children of men, to see if there are any who understood, who seek after God. (Psalms 53:2)

text: עוּרָֽה הַנֵּבֶל וְכִנּוֹר אָעִירָה שָּֽׁחַר׃
translation: I will give thanks to you, LORD, among the nations. I will sing praises to you among the peoples. (Psalms 108:3)

text: וַאֲחַלֵּל שָׂרֵי קֹדֶשׁ וְאֶתְּנָה לַחֵרֶם יַעֲקֹב וְיִשְׂרָאֵל לְגִדּוּפִֽים׃
translation: Therefore I will profane the princes of the sanctuary; and I will make Jacob a curse, and Israel an insult." (Isaiah 43:28)

text: וּמִבְּנֵי חָרִם מַעֲשֵׂיָה וְאֵֽלִיָּה וּֽשְׁמַֽעְיָה וִיחִיאֵל וְעֻזִיָּֽה׃
translation: Of the sons of Harim: Maaseiah, Elijah, Shemaiah, Jehiel, and Uzziah. (Ezra 10:21)

text: וּבְנֵי חָרִם אֱלִיעֶזֶר יִשִּׁיָּה מַלְכִּיָּה שְׁמַֽעְיָה שִׁמְעֽוֹן׃
translation: Of the sons of Harim: Eliezer, Isshijah, Malchijah, Shemaiah, Shimeon, (Ezra 10:31)

text: וְיָשְׁבוּ בָהּ וְחֵרֶם לֹא יִֽהְיֶה עוֹד וְיָשְׁבָה יְרוּשָׁלִַם לָבֶֽטַח׃
translation: Men will dwell therein, and there will be no more curse; but Jerusalem will dwell safely. (Zechariah 14:11)

text: זֹבֵחַ לָאֱלֹהִים יָֽחֳרָם בִּלְתִּי לַיהוָה לְבַדּֽוֹ׃
translation: "Whoever has sex with an animal shall surely be put to death. (Exodus 22:19)

text: כָּל חֵרֶם אֲשֶׁר יָחֳרַם מִן הָאָדָם לֹא יִפָּדֶה מוֹת יוּמָֽת׃
translation: "'No one devoted to destruction, who shall be devoted from among men, shall be ransomed. He shall surely be put to death. (Leviticus 27:29)

text: וַיַּעַל מֹשֶׁה אֶל הָהָר וַיְכַס הֶעָנָן אֶת הָהָֽר׃
translation: Moses went up on the mountain, and the cloud covered the mountain. (Exodus 24:15)

text: כָּלָה עָנָן וַיֵּלַךְ כֵּן יוֹרֵד שְׁאוֹל לֹא יַעֲלֶֽה׃
translation: As the cloud is consumed and vanishes away, so he who goes down to Sheol will come up no more. (Job 7:9)

text: וְאִם לֹא יֵעָלֶה הֶעָנָן וְלֹא יִסְעוּ עַד יוֹם הֵעָלֹתֽוֹ׃
translation: but if the cloud wasn't taken up, then they didn't travel until the day that it was taken up. (Exodus 40:37)

text: מָחִיתִי כָעָב פְּשָׁעֶיךָ וְכֶעָנָן חַטֹּאותֶיךָ שׁוּבָה אֵלַי כִּי גְאַלְתִּֽיךָ׃
translation: I have blotted out, as a thick cloud, your transgressions, and, as a cloud, your sins. Return to me, for I have redeemed you. (Isaiah 44:22)

text: וַיְכַס הֶעָנָן אֶת אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וּכְבוֹד יְהוָה מָלֵא אֶת הַמִּשְׁכָּֽן׃
translation: Then the cloud covered the Tent of Meeting, and the LORD's glory filled the tabernacle. (Exodus 40:34)

text: וַיְהִי בְּצֵאת הַכֹּהֲנִים מִן הַקֹּדֶשׁ וְהֶעָנָן מָלֵא אֶת בֵּית יְהוָֽה׃
translation: It came to pass, when the priests had come out of the holy place, that the cloud filled the LORD's house, (1 Kings 8:10)

text: גָּבְהֵי שָׁמַיִם מַה תִּפְעָל עֲמֻקָּה מִשְּׁאוֹל מַה תֵּדָֽע׃
translation: They are high as heaven. What can you do? They are deeper than Sheol. What can you know? (Job 11:8)

text: וְֽלֹא יָדַע כִּֽי רְפָאִים שָׁם בְּעִמְקֵי שְׁאוֹל קְרֻאֶֽיהָ׃
translation: But he doesn't know that the departed spirits are there, that her guests are in the depths of Sheol. (Proverbs 9:18)

text: הֶעְמִֽיקוּ שִׁחֵתוּ כִּימֵי הַגִּבְעָה יִזְכּוֹר עֲוֺנָם יִפְקוֹד חַטֹּאותָֽם׃
translation: They have deeply corrupted themselves, as in the days of Gibeah. He will remember their iniquity. He will punish them for their sins. (Hosea 9:9)

text: רָחוֹק מַה שֶּׁהָיָה וְעָמֹק עָמֹק מִי יִמְצָאֶֽנּוּ׃
translation: That which is, is far off and exceedingly deep. Who can find it out? (Ecclesiastes 7:24)

text: וְהָיָה בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא וְשָֽׁבַרְתִּי אֶת קֶשֶׁת יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּעֵמֶק יִזְרְעֶֽאל׃
translation: It will happen in that day that I will break the bow of Israel in the valley of Jezreel." (Hosea 1:5)

text: וְקִרְיָתַיִם וְשִׂבְמָה וְצֶרֶת הַשַּׁחַר בְּהַר הָעֵֽמֶק׃
translation: Kiriathaim, Sibmah, Zereth Shahar in the mount of the valley, (Joshua 13:19)

text: וַיֵּצֵא סִיחֹן לִקְרָאתֵנוּ הוּא וְכָל עַמּוֹ לַמִּלְחָמָה יָֽהְצָה׃
translation: Then Sihon came out against us, he and all his people, to battle at Jahaz. (Deuteronomy 2:32)

text: וְהִנֵּה הַמַּלְאָךְ הַדֹּבֵר בִּי יֹצֵא וּמַלְאָךְ אַחֵר יֹצֵא לִקְרָאתֽוֹ׃
translation: 'Come, Zion! Escape, you who dwell with the daughter of Babylon.' (Zechariah 2:7)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו אֱדוֹם לֹא תַעֲבֹר בִּי פֶּן בַּחֶרֶב אֵצֵא לִקְרָאתֶֽךָ׃
translation: Edom said to him, "You shall not pass through me, lest I come out with the sword against you." (Numbers 20:18)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר לֹא תַעֲבֹר וַיֵּצֵא אֱדוֹם לִקְרָאתוֹ בְּעַם כָּבֵד וּבְיָד חֲזָקָֽה׃
translation: He said, "You shall not pass through." Edom came out against him with many people, and with a strong hand. (Numbers 20:20)

text: וַיֵּלֶךְ עֹבַדְיָהוּ לִקְרַאת אַחְאָב וַיַּגֶּד לוֹ וַיֵּלֶךְ אַחְאָב לִקְרַאת אֵלִיָּֽהוּ׃
translation: So Obadiah went to meet Ahab, and told him; and Ahab went to meet Elijah. (1 Kings 18:16)

text: וַיֵּצְאוּ מֹשֶׁה וְאֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן וְכָל נְשִׂיאֵי הָעֵדָה לִקְרָאתָם אֶל מִחוּץ לַֽמַּחֲנֶֽה׃
translation: Moses and Eleazar the priest, with all the princes of the congregation, went out to meet them outside of the camp. (Numbers 31:13)

text: וַיָּקָם מֹשֶׁה וִיהוֹשֻׁעַ מְשָׁרְתוֹ וַיַּעַל מֹשֶׁה אֶל הַר הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃
translation: Moses rose up with Joshua, his servant, and Moses went up onto God's Mountain. (Exodus 24:13)

text: הָכְרַת מִנְחָה וָנֶסֶךְ מִבֵּית יְהוָה אָֽבְלוּ הַכֹּהֲנִים מְשָׁרְתֵי יְהוָֽה׃
translation: The meal offering and the drink offering are cut off from the LORD's house. The priests, the LORD's ministers, mourn. (Joel 1:9)

text: עֵינַי בְּנֶֽאֶמְנֵי אֶרֶץ לָשֶׁבֶת עִמָּדִי הֹלֵךְ בְּדֶרֶךְ תָּמִים הוּא יְשָׁרְתֵֽנִי׃
translation: My eyes will be on the faithful of the land, that they may dwell with me. He who walks in a perfect way, he will serve me. (Psalms 101:6)

text: הַקְרֵב אֶת מַטֵּה לֵוִי וְֽהַעֲמַדְתָּ אֹתוֹ לִפְנֵי אַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֵן וְשֵׁרְתוּ אֹתֽוֹ׃
translation: "Bring the tribe of Levi near, and set them before Aaron the priest, that they may minister to him. (Numbers 3:6)

text: וְשֵׁרֵת בְּשֵׁם יְהוָה אֱלֹהָיו כְּכָל אֶחָיו הַלְוִיִּם הָעֹמְדִים שָׁם לִפְנֵי יְהוָֽה׃
translation: then he shall minister in the name of the LORD his God, as all his brothers the Levites do, who stand there before the LORD. (Deuteronomy 18:7)

text: וַאֲנַחְנוּ יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ וְלֹא עֲזַבְנֻהוּ וְכֹהֲנִים מְשָׁרְתִים לַֽיהוָה בְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן וְהַלְוִיִּם בַּמְלָֽאכֶת׃
translation: "But as for us, the LORD is our God, and we have not forsaken him. We have priests serving the LORD, the sons of Aaron, and the Levites in their work. (2 Chronicles 13:10)

text: וַיָּשָׁב בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא עֵשָׂו לְדַרְכּוֹ שֵׂעִֽירָה׃
translation: So Esau returned that day on his way to Seir. (Genesis 33:16)

text: אַחַד עָשָׂר יוֹם מֵֽחֹרֵב דֶּרֶךְ הַר שֵׂעִיר עַד קָדֵשׁ בַּרְנֵֽעַ׃
translation: It is eleven days' journey from Horeb by the way of Mount Seir to Kadesh Barnea. (Deuteronomy 1:2)

text: וַיִּשְׁלַח יַעֲקֹב מַלְאָכִים לְפָנָיו אֶל עֵשָׂו אָחִיו אַרְצָה שֵׂעִיר שְׂדֵה אֱדֽוֹם׃
translation: He commanded them, saying, "This is what you shall tell my lord, Esau: 'This is what your servant, Jacob, says. I have lived as a foreigner with Laban, and stayed until now. (Genesis 32:4)

text: וְהִקְרִיב אַהֲרֹן אֶת הַשָּׂעִיר אֲשֶׁר עָלָה עָלָיו הַגּוֹרָל לַיהוָה וְעָשָׂהוּ חַטָּֽאת׃
translation: Aaron shall present the goat on which the lot fell for the LORD, and offer him for a sin offering. (Leviticus 16:9)

text: וּשְׂעִיר חַטָּאת אֶחָד לְכַפֵּר עֲלֵיכֶֽם׃
translation: and one male goat for a sin offering, to make atonement for you. (Numbers 28:22)

text: שְׂעִיר עִזִּים אֶחָד לְכַפֵּר עֲלֵיכֶֽם׃
translation: and one male goat, to make atonement for you. (Numbers 28:30)

text: וַיָּמָת שָׁאוּל וַיִּמְלֹךְ תַּחְתָּיו בַּעַל חָנָן בֶּן עַכְבּֽוֹר׃
translation: Shaul died, and Baal Hanan the son of Achbor reigned in his place. (Genesis 36:38)

text: וַיָּמָת שָׁאוּל וַיִּמְלֹךְ תַּחְתָּיו בַּעַל חָנָן בֶּן עַכְבּֽוֹר׃
translation: Shaul died, and Baal Hanan the son of Achbor reigned in his place. (1 Chronicles 1:49)

text: לְעַבְדִּי קָרָאתִי וְלֹא יַעֲנֶה בְּמוֹ פִי אֶתְחַנֶּן לֽוֹ׃
translation: I call to my servant, and he gives me no answer. I beg him with my mouth. (Job 19:16)

text: חָֽנְנֵנִי יְהוָה רְאֵה עָנְיִי מִשֹּׂנְאָי מְרוֹמְמִי מִשַּׁעֲרֵי מָֽוֶת׃
translation: that I may show all of your praise. I will rejoice in your salvation in the gates of the daughter of Zion. (Psalms 9:14)

text: בֶּן דֶּקֶר בְּמָקַץ וּבְשַֽׁעַלְבִים וּבֵית שָׁמֶשׁ וְאֵילוֹן בֵּית חָנָֽן׃
translation: Ben Deker, in Makaz, in Shaalbim, Beth Shemesh, and Elon Beth Hanan; (1 Kings 4:9)

text: אֲשֶׁר אִם צָדַקְתִּי לֹא אֶעֱנֶה לִמְשֹׁפְטִי אֶתְחַנָּֽן׃
translation: Though I were righteous, yet I wouldn't answer him. I would make supplication to my judge. (Job 9:15)

text: וּלְבָנוֹן אֵין דֵּי בָּעֵר וְחַיָּתוֹ אֵין דֵּי עוֹלָֽה׃
translation: Lebanon is not sufficient to burn, nor its animals sufficient for a burnt offering. (Isaiah 40:16)

text: וַאֲנִי בַעַר וְלֹא אֵדָע בְּהֵמוֹת הָיִיתִי עִמָּֽךְ׃
translation: I was so senseless and ignorant. I was a brute beast before you. (Psalms 73:22)

text: עַד מָה יְהוָה תִּסָּתֵר לָנֶצַח תִּבְעַר כְּמוֹ אֵשׁ חֲמָתֶֽךָ׃
translation: Remember how short my time is, for what vanity you have created all the children of men! (Psalms 89:47)

text: וַיִּקְרָא שֵֽׁם הַמָּקוֹם הַהוּא תַּבְעֵרָה כִּֽי בָעֲרָה בָם אֵשׁ יְהוָֽה׃
translation: The name of that place was called Taberah, because the LORD's fire burned among them. (Numbers 11:3)

text: וְיֶתֶר הַקָּדֵשׁ אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁאַר בִּימֵי אָסָא אָבִיו בִּעֵר מִן הָאָֽרֶץ׃
translation: There was no king in Edom. A deputy ruled. (1 Kings 22:47)

text: בִּינוּ בֹּעֲרִים בָּעָם וּכְסִילִים מָתַי תַּשְׂכִּֽילוּ׃
translation: Consider, you senseless among the people; you fools, when will you be wise? (Psalms 94:8)

text: בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי נָשִׂיא לִבְנֵי אֶפְרָיִם אֱלִֽישָׁמָע בֶּן עַמִּיהֽוּד׃
translation: On the seventh day Elishama the son of Ammihud, prince of the children of Ephraim, (Numbers 7:48)

text: וַיָּמָת חֲנַנְיָה הַנָּבִיא בַּשָּׁנָה הַהִיא בַּחֹדֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִֽי׃
translation: So Hananiah the prophet died the same year in the seventh month. (Jeremiah 28:17)

text: הַשְּׁבִעִי יְשַׂרְאֵלָה בָּנָיו וְאֶחָיו שְׁנֵים עָשָֽׂר׃
translation: the seventh to Jesharelah, his sons and his brothers, twelve; (1 Chronicles 25:14)

text: עֵילָם הַחֲמִישִׁי יְהוֹחָנָן הַשִּׁשִּׁי אֶלְיְהוֹעֵינַי הַשְּׁבִיעִֽי׃
translation: Elam the fifth, Jehohanan the sixth, and Eliehoenai the seventh. (1 Chronicles 26:3)

text: בַּשְּׁבִיעִי בְּעֶשְׂרִים וְאֶחָד לַחֹדֶשׁ הָיָה דְּבַר יְהוָה בְּיַד חַגַּי הַנָּבִיא לֵאמֹֽר׃
translation: In the seventh month, in the twenty-first day of the month, the LORD's word came by Haggai the prophet, saying, (Haggai 2:1)

text: וַיִּשְׁבְּתוּ הָעָם בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִעִֽי׃
translation: So the people rested on the seventh day. (Exodus 16:30)

text: אֶרֶץ מִמֶּנָּה יֵֽצֵא לָחֶם וְתַחְתֶּיהָ נֶהְפַּךְ כְּמוֹ אֵֽשׁ׃
translation: As for the earth, out of it comes bread. Underneath it is turned up as it were by fire. (Job 28:5)

text: עִקֶּשׁ לֵב לֹא יִמְצָא טוֹב וְנֶהְפָּךְ בִּלְשׁוֹנוֹ יִפּוֹל בְּרָעָֽה׃
translation: One who has a perverse heart doesn't find prosperity, and one who has a deceitful tongue falls into trouble. (Proverbs 17:20)

text: אַךְ בִּי יָשֻׁב יַהֲפֹךְ יָדוֹ כָּל הַיּֽוֹם׃
translation: Surely he turns his hand against me again and again all day long. (Lamentations 3:3)

text: אוֹ כִי יָשׁוּב הַבָּשָׂר הַחַי וְנֶהְפַּךְ לְלָבָן וּבָא אֶל הַכֹּהֵֽן׃
translation: Or if the raw flesh turns again, and is changed to white, then he shall come to the priest. (Leviticus 13:16)

text: בַּֽחַלָּמִישׁ שָׁלַח יָדוֹ הָפַךְ מִשֹּׁרֶשׁ הָרִֽים׃
translation: He puts his hand on the flinty rock, and he overturns the mountains by the roots. (Job 28:9)

text: הָפַךְ לִבָּם לִשְׂנֹא עַמּוֹ לְהִתְנַכֵּל בַּעֲבָדָֽיו׃
translation: He turned their heart to hate his people, to conspire against his servants. (Psalms 105:25)

text: עַל שְׂדֵה אִישׁ עָצֵל עָבַרְתִּי וְעַל כֶּרֶם אָדָם חֲסַר לֵֽב׃
translation: I went by the field of the sluggard, by the vineyard of the man void of understanding. (Proverbs 24:30)

text: וְעַתָּה יוֹשֵׁב יְרוּשָׁלִַם וְאִישׁ יְהוּדָה שִׁפְטוּ נָא בֵּינִי וּבֵין כַּרְמִֽי׃
translation: "Now, inhabitants of Jerusalem and men of Judah, please judge between me and my vineyard. (Isaiah 5:3)

text: וּלְבִלְתִּי בְּנוֹת בָּתִּים לְשִׁבְתֵּנוּ וְכֶרֶם וְשָׂדֶה וָזֶרַע לֹא יִֽהְיֶה לָּֽנוּ׃
translation: and not to build houses for ourselves to dwell in. We have no vineyard, field, or seed; (Jeremiah 35:9)

text: שֵׁשׁ שָׁנִים תִּזְרַע שָׂדֶךָ וְשֵׁשׁ שָׁנִים תִּזְמֹר כַּרְמֶךָ וְאָסַפְתָּ אֶת תְּבוּאָתָֽהּ׃
translation: You shall sow your field six years, and you shall prune your vineyard six years, and gather in its fruits; (Leviticus 25:3)

text: כִּי כֹה אָמַר יְהוָה צְבָאוֹת אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל עוֹד יִקָּנוּ בָתִּים וְשָׂדוֹת וּכְרָמִים בָּאָרֶץ הַזֹּֽאת׃
translation: For the LORD of Armies, the God of Israel says: 'Houses and fields and vineyards will yet again be bought in this land.' (Jeremiah 32:15)

text: קוּם רֵד לִקְרַאת אַחְאָב מֶֽלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן הִנֵּה בְּכֶרֶם נָבוֹת אֲשֶׁר יָרַד שָׁם לְרִשְׁתּֽוֹ׃
translation: "Arise, go down to meet Ahab king of Israel, who dwells in Samaria. Behold, he is in the vineyard of Naboth, where he has gone down to take possession of it. (1 Kings 21:18)

text: קַח אֶת הַלְוִיִּם מִתּוֹךְ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְטִהַרְתָּ אֹתָֽם׃
translation: "Take the Levites from among the children of Israel, and cleanse them. (Numbers 8:6)

text: וּקְבָרוּם בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל לְמַעַן טַהֵר אֶת הָאָרֶץ שִׁבְעָה חֳדָשִֽׁים׃
translation: "'"The house of Israel will be burying them for seven months, that they may cleanse the land. (Ezekiel 39:12)

text: וּבָא הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ וְטָהֵר וְאַחַר יֹאכַל מִן הַקֳּדָשִׁים כִּי לַחְמוֹ הֽוּא׃
translation: When the sun is down, he shall be clean; and afterward he shall eat of the holy things, because it is his bread. (Leviticus 22:7)

text: וַיִּֽטַּהֲרוּ הַכֹּהֲנִים וְהַלְוִיִּם וַֽיְטַהֲרוּ אֶת הָעָם וְאֶת הַשְּׁעָרִים וְאֶֽת הַחוֹמָֽה׃
translation: The priests and the Levites purified themselves; and they purified the people, the gates, and the wall. (Nehemiah 12:30)

text: וְעַתָּה לֹא רָאוּ אוֹר בָּהִיר הוּא בַּשְּׁחָקִים וְרוּחַ עָבְרָה וַֽתְּטַהֲרֵֽם׃
translation: Now men don't see the light which is bright in the skies, but the wind passes, and clears them. (Job 37:21)

text: וְגַם שֶׁם עִיר הֲמוֹנָה וְטִהֲרוּ הָאָֽרֶץ׃
translation: Hamonah will also be the name of a city. Thus they will cleanse the land."' (Ezekiel 39:16)

text: הֲתֵדַע עַל מִפְלְשֵׂי עָב מִפְלְאוֹת תְּמִים דֵּעִֽים׃
translation: Do you know the workings of the clouds, the wondrous works of him who is perfect in knowledge? (Job 37:16)

text: תָּמִים אַתָּה בִּדְרָכֶיךָ מִיּוֹם הִבָּֽרְאָךְ עַד נִמְצָא עַוְלָתָה בָּֽךְ׃
translation: You were perfect in your ways from the day that you were created, until unrighteousness was found in you. (Ezekiel 28:15)

text: מַשְׁגֶּה יְשָׁרִים בְּדֶרֶךְ רָע בִּשְׁחוּתוֹ הֽוּא יִפּוֹל וּתְמִימִים יִנְחֲלוּ טֽוֹב׃
translation: Whoever causes the upright to go astray in an evil way, he will fall into his own trap; but the blameless will inherit good. (Proverbs 28:10)

text: תָּמִים תִּֽהְיֶה עִם יְהוָה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ׃
translation: You shall be blameless with the LORD your God. (Deuteronomy 18:13)

text: וָאֶהְיֶה תָמִים לוֹ וָאֶשְׁתַּמְּרָה מֵעֲוֺנִֽי׃
translation: I was also perfect toward him. I kept myself from my iniquity. (2 Samuel 22:24)

text: וָאֱהִי תָמִים עִמּוֹ וָאֶשְׁתַּמֵּר מֵעֲוֺנִֽי׃
translation: Therefore the LORD has rewarded me according to my righteousness, according to the cleanness of my hands in his eyesight. (Psalms 18:24)

text: בּוֹטֵחַ בְּלִבּוֹ הוּא כְסִיל וְהוֹלֵךְ בְּחָכְמָה הוּא יִמָּלֵֽט׃
translation: One who trusts in himself is a fool; but one who walks in wisdom is kept safe. (Proverbs 28:26)

text: אֵלֶיךָ זָעֲקוּ וְנִמְלָטוּ בְּךָ בָטְחוּ וְלֹא בֽוֹשׁוּ׃
translation: But I am a worm, and no man; a reproach of men, and despised by the people. (Psalms 22:6)

text: נֻסוּ מַלְּטוּ נַפְשְׁכֶם וְתִֽהְיֶינָה כַּעֲרוֹעֵר בַּמִּדְבָּֽר׃
translation: Flee! Save your lives! Be like the juniper bush in the wilderness. (Jeremiah 48:6)

text: הוֹי צִיּוֹן הִמָּלְטִי יוֹשֶׁבֶת בַּת בָּבֶֽל׃
translation: Many nations shall join themselves to the LORD in that day, and shall be my people; and I will dwell among you, and you shall know that the LORD of Armies has sent me to you. (Zechariah 2:11)

text: וַיִּמָּלֵט בֵּן אֶחָד לַאֲחִימֶלֶךְ בֶּן אֲחִטוּב וּשְׁמוֹ אֶבְיָתָר וַיִּבְרַח אַחֲרֵי דָוִֽד׃
translation: One of the sons of Ahimelech the son of Ahitub, named Abiathar, escaped and fled after David. (1 Samuel 22:20)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ דָּוִד אֵי מִזֶּה תָּבוֹא וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו מִמַּחֲנֵה יִשְׂרָאֵל נִמְלָֽטְתִּי׃
translation: David said to him, "Where do you come from?" He said to him, "I have escaped out of the camp of Israel." (2 Samuel 1:3)

text: אַשֻּׁרֵינוּ עַתָּה סבבוני סְבָבוּנוּ עֵינֵיהֶם יָשִׁיתוּ לִנְטוֹת בָּאָֽרֶץ׃
translation: They have now surrounded us in our steps. They set their eyes to cast us down to the earth. (Psalms 17:11)

text: תַּחַת אֲבֹתֶיךָ יִהְיוּ בָנֶיךָ תְּשִׁיתֵמוֹ לְשָׂרִים בְּכָל הָאָֽרֶץ׃
translation: I will make your name to be remembered in all generations. Therefore the peoples shall give you thanks forever and ever. (Psalms 45:17)

text: הַט אָזְנְךָ וּשְׁמַע דִּבְרֵי חֲכָמִים וְלִבְּךָ תָּשִׁית לְדַעְתִּֽי׃
translation: Turn your ear, and listen to the words of the wise. Apply your heart to my teaching. (Proverbs 22:17)

text: תַּמְשִׁילֵהוּ בְּמַעֲשֵׂי יָדֶיךָ כֹּל שַׁתָּה תַֽחַת רַגְלָֽיו׃
translation: All sheep and cattle, yes, and the animals of the field, (Psalms 8:7)

text: וְעַתָּה יֵרֶא פַרְעֹה אִישׁ נָבוֹן וְחָכָם וִישִׁיתֵהוּ עַל אֶרֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
translation: "Now therefore let Pharaoh look for a discreet and wise man, and set him over the land of Egypt. (Genesis 41:33)

text: וַיִּפֶן פַּרְעֹה וַיָּבֹא אֶל בֵּיתוֹ וְלֹא שָׁת לִבּוֹ גַּם לָזֹֽאת׃
translation: Pharaoh turned and went into his house, and he didn't even take this to heart. (Exodus 7:23)

text: מִֽי יִתֵּן טָהוֹר מִטָּמֵא לֹא אֶחָֽד׃
translation: Who can bring a clean thing out of an unclean? Not one. (Job 14:4)

text: יִרְאַת יְהוָה טְהוֹרָה עוֹמֶדֶת לָעַד מִֽשְׁפְּטֵי יְהוָה אֱמֶת צָֽדְקוּ יַחְדָּֽו׃
translation: They are more to be desired than gold, yes, than much fine gold, sweeter also than honey and the extract of the honeycomb. (Psalms 19:10)

text: וְרָאָהוּ הַכֹּהֵן וְהִנֵּה נֶהְפַּךְ הַנֶּגַע לְלָבָן וְטִהַר הַכֹּהֵן אֶת הַנֶּגַע טָהוֹר הֽוּא׃
translation: The priest shall examine him. Behold, if the plague has turned white, then the priest shall pronounce him clean of the plague. He is clean. (Leviticus 13:17)

text: כָּל צִפּוֹר טְהֹרָה תֹּאכֵֽלוּ׃
translation: Of all clean birds you may eat. (Deuteronomy 14:11)

text: כָּל עוֹף טָהוֹר תֹּאכֵֽלוּ׃
translation: Of all clean birds you may eat. (Deuteronomy 14:20)

text: לְהַבְדִּיל בֵּין הַטָּמֵא וּבֵין הַטָּהֹר וּבֵין הַֽחַיָּה הַֽנֶּאֱכֶלֶת וּבֵין הַֽחַיָּה אֲשֶׁר לֹא תֵאָכֵֽל׃
translation: to make a distinction between the unclean and the clean, and between the living thing that may be eaten and the living thing that may not be eaten.'" (Leviticus 11:47)

text: לָכֵן שִׁמְעִי נָא זֹאת עֲנִיָּה וּשְׁכֻרַת וְלֹא מִיָּֽיִן׃
translation: Therefore now hear this, you afflicted, and drunken, but not with wine: (Isaiah 51:21)

text: וַיֵּשְׁתְּ מִן הַיַּיִן וַיִּשְׁכָּר וַיִּתְגַּל בְּתוֹךְ אָהֳלֹֽה׃
translation: He drank of the wine and got drunk. He was uncovered within his tent. (Genesis 9:21)

text: אֲחִיאָם בֶּן שָׂכָר הַהֲרָרִי אֱלִיפַל בֶּן אֽוּר׃
translation: Ahiam the son of Sacar the Hararite, Eliphal the son of Ur, (1 Chronicles 11:35)

text: רַב מְחֽוֹלֵֽל כֹּל וְשֹׂכֵר כְּסִיל וְשֹׂכֵר עֹבְרִֽים׃
translation: As an archer who wounds all, so is he who hires a fool or he who hires those who pass by. (Proverbs 26:10)

text: תְּנוּ שֵׁכָר לְאוֹבֵד וְיַיִן לְמָרֵי נָֽפֶשׁ׃
translation: Give strong drink to him who is ready to perish, and wine to the bitter in soul. (Proverbs 31:6)

text: טוֹבִים הַשְּׁנַיִם מִן הָאֶחָד אֲשֶׁר יֵשׁ לָהֶם שָׂכָר טוֹב בַּעֲמָלָֽם׃
translation: Two are better than one, because they have a good reward for their labor. (Ecclesiastes 4:9)

text: מָגִנֵּנוּ רְאֵה אֱלֹהִים וְהַבֵּט פְּנֵי מְשִׁיחֶֽךָ׃
translation: For a day in your courts is better than a thousand. I would rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God, than to dwell in the tents of wickedness. (Psalms 84:10)

text: רַק בְּעֵינֶיךָ תַבִּיט וְשִׁלֻּמַת רְשָׁעִים תִּרְאֶֽה׃
translation: You will only look with your eyes, and see the recompense of the wicked. (Psalms 91:8)

text: וּבִשְׁנַת שְׁמֹנֶה עֶשְׂרֵה לַמֶּלֶךְ יָרָבְעָם בֶּן נְבָט מָלַךְ אֲבִיָּם עַל יְהוּדָֽה׃
translation: Now in the eighteenth year of King Jeroboam the son of Nebat, Abijam began to reign over Judah. (1 Kings 15:1)

text: גַּל עֵינַי וְאַבִּיטָה נִפְלָאוֹת מִתּוֹרָתֶֽךָ׃
translation: Open my eyes, that I may see wondrous things out of your law. (Psalms 119:18)

text: וַיְגַל אֵת מָסַךְ יְהוּדָה וַתַּבֵּט בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא אֶל נֶשֶׁק בֵּית הַיָּֽעַר׃
translation: He took away the covering of Judah; and you looked in that day to the armor in the house of the forest. (Isaiah 22:8)

text: שִׁבְתָּם וְקִֽימָתָם הַבִּיטָה אֲנִי מַנְגִּינָתָֽם׃
translation: You see their sitting down and their rising up. I am their song. (Lamentations 3:63)

text: אָמַרְתִּי לַֽהוֹלְלִים אַל תָּהֹלּוּ וְלָרְשָׁעִים אַל תָּרִימוּ קָֽרֶן׃
translation: Don't lift up your horn on high. Don't speak with a stiff neck." (Psalms 75:5)

text: הָאַיִל אֲשֶׁר רָאִיתָ בַּעַל הַקְּרָנָיִם מַלְכֵי מָדַי וּפָרָֽס׃
translation: The ram which you saw, that had the two horns, they are the kings of Media and Persia. (Daniel 8:20)

text: וַאֲדֹנִיָּהוּ יָרֵא מִפְּנֵי שְׁלֹמֹה וַיָּקָם וַיֵּלֶךְ וַֽיַּחֲזֵק בְּקַרְנוֹת הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃
translation: Adonijah was afraid because of Solomon; and he arose, and went, and hung onto the horns of the altar. (1 Kings 1:50)

text: וְהַֽהַרְאֵל אַרְבַּע אַמּוֹת וּמֵהָאֲרִאֵיל וּלְמַעְלָה הַקְּרָנוֹת אַרְבַּֽע׃
translation: The upper altar shall be four cubits; and from the altar hearth and upward there shall be four horns. (Ezekiel 43:15)

text: הַשְּׂמֵחִים לְלֹא דָבָר הָאֹמְרִים הֲלוֹא בְחָזְקֵנוּ לָקַחְנוּ לָנוּ קַרְנָֽיִם׃
translation: you who rejoice in a thing of nothing, who say, 'Haven't we taken for ourselves horns by our own strength?' (Amos 6:13)

text: וָאֶשָּׂא אֶת עֵינַי וָאֵרֶא וְהִנֵּה אַרְבַּע קְרָנֽוֹת׃
translation: I lifted up my eyes, and saw, and behold, a man with a measuring line in his hand. (Zechariah 2:1)

text: וַיֻּגַּד לְיוֹאָב הִנֵּה הַמֶּלֶךְ בֹּכֶה וַיִּתְאַבֵּל עַל אַבְשָׁלֹֽם׃
translation: The victory that day was turned into mourning among all the people, for the people heard it said that day, "The king grieves for his son." (2 Samuel 19:2)

text: וַיִּתְאַבֵּל אֶפְרַיִם אֲבִיהֶם יָמִים רַבִּים וַיָּבֹאוּ אֶחָיו לְנַחֲמֽוֹ׃
translation: Ephraim their father mourned many days, and his brothers came to comfort him. (1 Chronicles 7:22)

text: אֲבָל עוֹד הָעָם זֹבְחִים בַּבָּמוֹת רַק לַיהוָה אֱלֹהֵיהֶֽם׃
translation: Nevertheless the people still sacrificed in the high places, but only to the LORD their God. (2 Chronicles 33:17)

text: לֵב חֲכָמִים בְּבֵית אֵבֶל וְלֵב כְּסִילִים בְּבֵית שִׂמְחָֽה׃
translation: The heart of the wise is in the house of mourning; but the heart of fools is in the house of mirth. (Ecclesiastes 7:4)

text: וַיַּעַן יוֹנָתָן וַיֹּאמֶר לַאֲדֹנִיָּהוּ אֲבָל אֲדֹנֵינוּ הַמֶּֽלֶךְ דָּוִד הִמְלִיךְ אֶת שְׁלֹמֹֽה׃
translation: Jonathan answered Adonijah, "Most certainly our lord King David has made Solomon king. (1 Kings 1:43)

text: וַיְדַבֵּר מֹשֶׁה אֶת הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה אֶֽל כָּל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּֽתְאַבְּלוּ הָעָם מְאֹֽד׃
translation: Moses told these words to all the children of Israel, and the people mourned greatly. (Numbers 14:39)

text: עִבְדוּ אֶת יְהוָה בְּשִׂמְחָה בֹּאוּ לְפָנָיו בִּרְנָנָֽה׃
translation: Serve the LORD with gladness. Come before his presence with singing. (Psalms 100:2)

text: וְיָסְפוּ עֲנָוִים בַּֽיהוָה שִׂמְחָה וְאֶבְיוֹנֵי אָדָם בִּקְדוֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל יָגִֽילוּ׃
translation: The humble also will increase their joy in the LORD, and the poor among men will rejoice in the Holy One of Israel. (Isaiah 29:19)

text: הֲלוֹא נֶגֶד עֵינֵינוּ אֹכֶל נִכְרָת מִבֵּית אֱלֹהֵינוּ שִׂמְחָה וָגִֽיל׃
translation: Isn't the food cut off before our eyes, joy and gladness from the house of our God? (Joel 1:16)

text: תּוּבַלְנָה בִּשְׂמָחֹת וָגִיל תְּבֹאֶינָה בְּהֵיכַל מֶֽלֶךְ׃
translation: Your sons will take the place of your fathers. You shall make them princes in all the earth. (Psalms 45:16)

text: אוֹר זָרֻעַ לַצַּדִּיק וּֽלְיִשְׁרֵי לֵב שִׂמְחָֽה׃
translation: Light is sown for the righteous, and gladness for the upright in heart. (Psalms 97:11)

text: תּוֹחֶלֶת צַדִּיקִים שִׂמְחָה וְתִקְוַת רְשָׁעִים תֹּאבֵֽד׃
translation: The prospect of the righteous is joy, but the hope of the wicked will perish. (Proverbs 10:28)

text: וַיֶּאְסֹר אֶת רִכְבּוֹ וְאֶת עַמּוֹ לָקַח עִמּֽוֹ׃
translation: He prepared his chariot, and took his army with him; (Exodus 14:6)

text: עָלָיו עָלָה נְבוּכַדְנֶאצַּר מֶלֶךְ בָּבֶל וַיַּֽאַסְרֵהוּ בַּֽנְחֻשְׁתַּיִם לְהֹלִיכוֹ בָּבֶֽלָה׃
translation: Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up against him, and bound him in fetters to carry him to Babylon. (2 Chronicles 36:6)

text: וְאֶת עֵינֵי צִדְקִיָּהוּ עִוֵּר וַיַּאַסְרֵהוּ בַּֽנְחֻשְׁתַּיִם לָבִיא אֹתוֹ בָּבֶֽלָה׃
translation: Moreover he put out Zedekiah's eyes and bound him in fetters, to carry him to Babylon. (Jeremiah 39:7)

text: כִּֽי מִבֵּית הָסוּרִים יָצָא לִמְלֹךְ כִּי גַּם בְּמַלְכוּתוֹ נוֹלַד רָֽשׁ׃
translation: For out of prison he came out to be king; yes, even in his kingdom he was born poor. (Ecclesiastes 4:14)

text: כָּל נֵדֶר וְכָל שְׁבֻעַת אִסָּר לְעַנֹּת נָפֶשׁ אִישָׁהּ יְקִימֶנּוּ וְאִישָׁהּ יְפֵרֶֽנּוּ׃
translation: But if her husband says nothing to her from day to day, then he establishes all her vows or all her pledges which are on her. He has established them, because he said nothing to her in the day that he heard them. (Numbers 30:14)

text: לֶאְסֹר שָׂרָיו בְּנַפְשׁוֹ וּזְקֵנָיו יְחַכֵּֽם׃
translation: to discipline his princes at his pleasure, and to teach his elders wisdom. (Psalms 105:22)

text: הוֹד וְהָדָר פָּֽעֳלוֹ וְצִדְקָתוֹ עֹמֶדֶת לָעַֽד׃
translation: His work is honor and majesty. His righteousness endures forever. (Psalms 111:3)

text: אַף לֹֽא פָעֲלוּ עַוְלָה בִּדְרָכָיו הָלָֽכוּ׃
translation: Yes, they do nothing wrong. They walk in his ways. (Psalms 119:3)

text: גַּם מִיּוֹם אֲנִי הוּא וְאֵין מִיָּדִי מַצִּיל אֶפְעַל וּמִי יְשִׁיבֶֽנָּה׃
translation: Yes, since the day was, I am he. There is no one who can deliver out of my hand. I will work, and who can hinder it?" (Isaiah 43:13)

text: אֱלֹהִים בְּאָזְנֵינוּ שָׁמַעְנוּ אֲבוֹתֵינוּ סִפְּרוּ לָנוּ פֹּעַל פָּעַלְתָּ בִֽימֵיהֶם בִּימֵי קֶֽדֶם׃
translation: You drove out the nations with your hand, but you planted them. You afflicted the peoples, but you spread them abroad. (Psalms 44:2)

text: וְהָגִיתִי בְכָל פָּעֳלֶךָ וּֽבַעֲלִילוֹתֶיךָ אָשִֽׂיחָה׃
translation: Your way, God, is in the sanctuary. What god is great like God? (Psalms 77:13)

text: אַל תֹּאמַר כַּאֲשֶׁר עָֽשָׂה לִי כֵּן אֶֽעֱשֶׂה לּוֹ אָשִׁיב לָאִישׁ כְּפָעֳלֽוֹ׃
translation: Don't say, "I will do to him as he has done to me; I will repay the man according to his work." (Proverbs 24:29)

text: הָבִיאָה לַמּוּסָר לִבֶּךָ וְאָזְנֶךָ לְאִמְרֵי דָֽעַת׃
translation: Apply your heart to instruction, and your ears to the words of knowledge. (Proverbs 23:12)

text: וְלֹֽא לָמַדְתִּי חָכְמָה וְדַעַת קְדֹשִׁים אֵדָֽע׃
translation: I have not learned wisdom, neither do I have the knowledge of the Holy One. (Proverbs 30:3)

text: לִשְׁמֹר מְזִמּוֹת וְדַעַת שְׂפָתֶיךָ יִנְצֹֽרוּ׃
translation: that you may maintain discretion, that your lips may preserve knowledge. (Proverbs 5:2)

text: אֶת מִי נוֹעָץ וַיְבִינֵהוּ וַֽיְלַמְּדֵהוּ בְּאֹרַח מִשְׁפָּט וַיְלַמְּדֵהוּ דַעַת וְדֶרֶךְ תְּבוּנוֹת יוֹדִיעֶֽנּוּ׃
translation: Who did he take counsel with, and who instructed him, and taught him in the path of justice, and taught him knowledge, and showed him the way of understanding? (Isaiah 40:14)

text: דָּן דִּין עָנִי וְאֶבְיוֹן אָז טוֹב הֲלוֹא הִיא הַדַּעַת אֹתִי נְאֻם יְהוָֽה׃
translation: He judged the cause of the poor and needy; so then it was well. Wasn't this to know me?" says the LORD. (Jeremiah 22:16)

text: וּמֵעֵץ הַדַּעַת טוֹב וָרָע לֹא תֹאכַל מִמֶּנּוּ כִּי בְּיוֹם אֲכָלְךָ מִמֶּנּוּ מוֹת תָּמֽוּת׃
translation: but you shall not eat of the tree of the knowledge of good and evil; for in the day that you eat of it, you will surely die." (Genesis 2:17)

text: וַיִּרְכַּב עַל כְּרוּב וַיָּעֹף וַיֵּרָא עַל כַּנְפֵי רֽוּחַ׃
translation: He rode on a cherub, and flew. Yes, he was seen on the wings of the wind. (2 Samuel 22:11)

text: וַיִּרְכַּב עַל כְּרוּב וַיָּעֹף וַיֵּדֶא עַל כַּנְפֵי רֽוּחַ׃
translation: He made darkness his hiding place, his pavilion around him, darkness of waters, thick clouds of the skies. (Psalms 18:11)

text: וַיַּעַשׂ בְּבֵֽית קֹדֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִׁים כְּרוּבִים שְׁנַיִם מַעֲשֵׂה צַעֲצֻעִים וַיְצַפּוּ אֹתָם זָהָֽב׃
translation: In the most holy place he made two cherubim by carving, and they overlaid them with gold. (2 Chronicles 3:10)

text: וַיְצַף אֶת הַכְּרוּבִים זָהָֽב׃
translation: He overlaid the cherubim with gold. (1 Kings 6:28)

text: כַּנְפֵי הַכְּרוּבִים הָאֵלֶּה פֹּֽרְשִׂים אַמּוֹת עֶשְׂרִים וְהֵם עֹמְדִים עַל רַגְלֵיהֶם וּפְנֵיהֶם לַבָּֽיִת׃
translation: The wings of these cherubim spread themselves out twenty cubits. They stood on their feet, and their faces were toward the house. (2 Chronicles 3:13)

text: אַתְּ כְּרוּב מִמְשַׁח הַסּוֹכֵךְ וּנְתַתִּיךָ בְּהַר קֹדֶשׁ אֱלֹהִים הָיִיתָ בְּתוֹךְ אַבְנֵי אֵשׁ הִתְהַלָּֽכְתָּ׃
translation: You were the anointed cherub who covers. Then I set you up on the holy mountain of God. You have walked up and down in the middle of the stones of fire. (Ezekiel 28:14)

text: וַאֲהַבְתֶּם אֶת הַגֵּר כִּֽי גֵרִים הֱיִיתֶם בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
translation: Therefore love the foreigner, for you were foreigners in the land of Egypt. (Deuteronomy 10:19)

text: תּוֹרָה אַחַת וּמִשְׁפָּט אֶחָד יִהְיֶה לָכֶם וְלַגֵּר הַגָּר אִתְּכֶֽם׃
translation: One law and one ordinance shall be for you and for the stranger who lives as a foreigner with you.'" (Numbers 15:16)

text: גֵּר אָנֹכִי בָאָרֶץ אַל תַּסְתֵּר מִמֶּנִּי מִצְוֺתֶֽיךָ׃
translation: I am a stranger on the earth. Don't hide your commandments from me. (Psalms 119:19)

text: הַגֵּר אֲשֶׁר בְּקִרְבְּךָ יַעֲלֶה עָלֶיךָ מַעְלָה מָּעְלָה וְאַתָּה תֵרֵד מַטָּה מָּֽטָּה׃
translation: The foreigner who is among you will mount up above you higher and higher, and you will come down lower and lower. (Deuteronomy 28:43)

text: וַתֵּלֶד בֵּן וַיִּקְרָא אֶת שְׁמוֹ גֵּרְשֹׁם כִּי אָמַר גֵּר הָיִיתִי בְּאֶרֶץ נָכְרִיָּֽה׃
translation: She bore a son, and he named him Gershom, for he said, "I have lived as a foreigner in a foreign land." (Exodus 2:22)

text: וְהָיָה בַשֵּׁבֶט אֲשֶׁר גָּר הַגֵּר אִתּוֹ שָׁם תִּתְּנוּ נַחֲלָתוֹ נְאֻם אֲדֹנָי יְהוִֽה׃
translation: In whatever tribe the stranger lives, there you shall give him his inheritance," says the Lord GOD. (Ezekiel 47:23)

text: אֶרֶץ אַל תְּכַסִּי דָמִי וְֽאַל יְהִי מָקוֹם לְזַעֲקָתִֽי׃
translation: "Earth, don't cover my blood. Let my cry have no place to rest. (Job 16:18)

text: קוֹלִי אֶל יְהוָה אֶזְעָק קוֹלִי אֶל יְהוָה אֶתְחַנָּֽן׃
translation: I pour out my complaint before him. I tell him my troubles. (Psalms 142:2)

text: אִם עָלַי אַדְמָתִי תִזְעָק וְיַחַד תְּלָמֶיהָ יִבְכָּיֽוּן׃
translation: If my land cries out against me, and its furrows weep together; (Job 31:38)

text: זָעַקְתִּי אֵלֶיךָ יְהוָה אָמַרְתִּי אַתָּה מַחְסִי חֶלְקִי בְּאֶרֶץ הַֽחַיִּים׃
translation: Listen to my cry, for I am in desperate need. Deliver me from my persecutors, for they are too strong for me. (Psalms 142:6)

text: קוֹל זְעָקָה מִבָּבֶל וְשֶׁבֶר גָּדוֹל מֵאֶרֶץ כַּשְׂדִּֽים׃
translation: "The sound of a cry comes from Babylon, and of great destruction from the land of the Chaldeans! (Jeremiah 51:54)

text: מֵרֹב עֲשׁוּקִים יַזְעִיקוּ יְשַׁוְּעוּ מִזְּרוֹעַ רַבִּֽים׃
translation: "By reason of the multitude of oppressions they cry out. They cry for help by reason of the arm of the mighty. (Job 35:9)

text: וַיִּרְאֶהָ יְהוּדָה וַֽיַּחְשְׁבֶהָ לְזוֹנָה כִּי כִסְּתָה פָּנֶֽיהָ׃
translation: When Judah saw her, he thought that she was a prostitute, for she had covered her face. (Genesis 38:15)

text: וַיֵּשֶׁב יִשְׂרָאֵל בַּשִּׁטִּים וַיָּחֶל הָעָם לִזְנוֹת אֶל בְּנוֹת מוֹאָֽב׃
translation: Israel stayed in Shittim; and the people began to play the prostitute with the daughters of Moab; (Numbers 25:1)

text: וַיֵּלֶךְ שִׁמְשׁוֹן עַזָּתָה וַיַּרְא שָׁם אִשָּׁה זוֹנָה וַיָּבֹא אֵלֶֽיהָ׃
translation: Samson went to Gaza, and saw there a prostitute, and went in to her. (Judges 16:1)

text: וְהִנֵּה אִשָּׁה לִקְרָאתוֹ שִׁית זוֹנָה וּנְצֻרַת לֵֽב׃
translation: Behold, there a woman met him with the attire of a prostitute, and with crafty intent. (Proverbs 7:10)

text: אִֽישׁ אֹהֵב חָכְמָה יְשַׂמַּח אָבִיו וְרֹעֶה זוֹנוֹת יְאַבֶּד הֽוֹן׃
translation: Whoever loves wisdom brings joy to his father; but a companion of prostitutes squanders his wealth. (Proverbs 29:3)

text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ הַכְזוֹנָה יַעֲשֶׂה אֶת אֲחוֹתֵֽנוּ׃
translation: They said, "Should he deal with our sister as with a prostitute?" (Genesis 34:31)

text: וְאִישׁ זְרוֹעַ לוֹ הָאָרֶץ וּנְשׂוּא פָנִים יֵשֶׁב בָּֽהּ׃
translation: But as for the mighty man, he had the earth. The honorable man, he lived in it. (Job 22:8)

text: מֶה עָזַרְתָּ לְלֹא כֹחַ הוֹשַׁעְתָּ זְרוֹעַ לֹא עֹֽז׃
translation: "How have you helped him who is without power! How have you saved the arm that has no strength! (Job 26:2)

text: וְהֵם עַמְּךָ וְנַחֲלָתֶךָ אֲשֶׁר הוֹצֵאתָ בְּכֹחֲךָ הַגָּדֹל וּבִֽזְרֹעֲךָ הַנְּטוּיָֽה׃
translation: Yet they are your people and your inheritance, which you brought out by your great power and by your outstretched arm." (Deuteronomy 9:29)

text: גָּאַלְתָּ בִּזְרוֹעַ עַמֶּךָ בְּנֵי יַעֲקֹב וְיוֹסֵף סֶֽלָה׃
translation: The waters saw you, God. The waters saw you, and they writhed. The depths also convulsed. (Psalms 77:16)

text: אֲשֶׁר יָדִי תִּכּוֹן עִמּוֹ אַף זְרוֹעִי תְאַמְּצֶֽנּוּ׃
translation: No enemy will tax him. No wicked man will oppress him. (Psalms 89:22)

text: בְּיָד חֲזָקָה וּבִזְרוֹעַ נְטוּיָה כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
translation: with a strong hand, and with an outstretched arm, for his loving kindness endures forever; (Psalms 136:12)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר אַבְשָׁלוֹם אֶל אֲחִיתֹפֶל הָבוּ לָכֶם עֵצָה מַֽה נַּעֲשֶֽׂה׃
translation: Then Absalom said to Ahithophel, "Give your counsel what we shall do." (2 Samuel 16:20)

text: עִמּוֹ חָכְמָה וּגְבוּרָה לוֹ עֵצָה וּתְבוּנָֽה׃
translation: "With God is wisdom and might. He has counsel and understanding. (Job 12:13)

text: עֲצַת עָנִי תָבִישׁוּ כִּי יְהוָה מַחְסֵֽהוּ׃
translation: You frustrate the plan of the poor, because the LORD is his refuge. (Psalms 14:6)

text: יִֽתֶּן לְךָ כִלְבָבֶךָ וְֽכָל עֲצָתְךָ יְמַלֵּֽא׃
translation: We will triumph in your salvation. In the name of our God, we will set up our banners. May the LORD grant all your requests. (Psalms 20:5)

text: לֹא אָבוּ לַעֲצָתִי נָאֲצוּ כָּל תּוֹכַחְתִּֽי׃
translation: They wanted none of my counsel. They despised all my reproof. (Proverbs 1:30)

text: גַּם זֹאת מֵעִם יְהוָה צְבָאוֹת יָצָאָה הִפְלִיא עֵצָה הִגְדִּיל תּוּשִׁיָּֽה׃
translation: This also comes out from the LORD of Armies, who is wonderful in counsel, and excellent in wisdom. (Isaiah 28:29)

text: וַהֲשִׁמֹּתִי אֲנִי אֶת הָאָרֶץ וְשָֽׁמְמוּ עָלֶיהָ אֹֽיְבֵיכֶם הַיֹּשְׁבִים בָּֽהּ׃
translation: I will bring the land into desolation, and your enemies who dwell in it will be astonished at it. (Leviticus 26:32)

text: פְּנוּ אֵלַי וְהָשַׁמּוּ וְשִׂימוּ יָד עַל פֶּֽה׃
translation: Look at me, and be astonished. Lay your hand on your mouth. (Job 21:5)

text: שֹׁמּוּ שָׁמַיִם עַל זֹאת וְשַׂעֲרוּ חָרְבוּ מְאֹד נְאֻם יְהוָֽה׃
translation: "Be astonished, you heavens, at this and be horribly afraid. Be very desolate," says the LORD. (Jeremiah 2:12)

text: וְנָשַׁמּוּ בְּתוֹךְ אֲרָצוֹת נְשַׁמּוֹת וְעָרָיו בְּתוֹךְ עָרִים נַחֲרָבוֹת תִּֽהְיֶֽינָה׃
translation: "They will be desolate in the middle of the countries that are desolate. Her cities will be among the cities that are wasted. (Ezekiel 30:7)

text: וַהֲשִׁמֹּתִי אֶת פַּתְרוֹס וְנָתַתִּי אֵשׁ בְּצֹעַן וְעָשִׂיתִי שְׁפָטִים בְּנֹֽא׃
translation: I will make Pathros desolate, and will set a fire in Zoan, and will execute judgments on No. (Ezekiel 30:14)

text: אַךְ עַתָּה הֶלְאָנִי הֲשִׁמּוֹתָ כָּל עֲדָתִֽי׃
translation: But now, God, you have surely worn me out. You have made all my company desolate. (Job 16:7)

text: וְאַרְבָּעִים בָּאַמָּה הָיָה הַבָּיִת הוּא הַהֵיכָל לִפְנָֽי׃
translation: In front of the temple sanctuary was forty cubits long. (1 Kings 6:17)

text: וּמִכְּלֵי בֵּית יְהוָה הֵבִיא נְבוּכַדְנֶאצַּר לְבָבֶל וַיִּתְּנֵם בְּהֵיכָלוֹ בְּבָבֶֽל׃
translation: Nebuchadnezzar also carried some of the vessels of the LORD's house to Babylon, and put them in his temple at Babylon. (2 Chronicles 36:7)

text: וַאֲנִי בְּרֹב חַסְדְּךָ אָבוֹא בֵיתֶךָ אֶשְׁתַּחֲוֶה אֶל הֵֽיכַל קָדְשְׁךָ בְּיִרְאָתֶֽךָ׃
translation: Lead me, LORD, in your righteousness because of my enemies. Make your way straight before my face. (Psalms 5:8)

text: מֹר וַאֲהָלוֹת קְצִיעוֹת כָּל בִּגְדֹתֶיךָ מִֽן הֵיכְלֵי שֵׁן מִנִּי שִׂמְּחֽוּךָ׃
translation: Kings' daughters are among your honorable women. At your right hand the queen stands in gold of Ophir. (Psalms 45:9)

text: אַשְׁרֵי תִּֽבְחַר וּתְקָרֵב יִשְׁכֹּן חֲצֵרֶיךָ נִשְׂבְּעָה בְּטוּב בֵּיתֶךָ קְדֹשׁ הֵיכָלֶֽךָ׃
translation: By awesome deeds of righteousness, you answer us, God of our salvation. You who are the hope of all the ends of the earth, of those who are far away on the sea. (Psalms 65:5)

text: דִּמִּינוּ אֱלֹהִים חַסְדֶּךָ בְּקֶרֶב הֵיכָלֶֽךָ׃
translation: As is your name, God, so is your praise to the ends of the earth. Your right hand is full of righteousness. (Psalms 48:10)

text: יַסְגִּירֵנִי אֵל אֶל עֲוִיל וְעַל יְדֵי רְשָׁעִים יִרְטֵֽנִי׃
translation: God delivers me to the ungodly, and casts me into the hands of the wicked. (Job 16:11)

text: וְרָאָה הַכֹּהֵן אֶת הַנָּגַע וְהִסְגִּיר אֶת הַנֶּגַע שִׁבְעַת יָמִֽים׃
translation: The priest shall examine the plague, and isolate the plague seven days. (Leviticus 13:50)

text: וַתַּעַל וַתַּשְׁכִּבֵהוּ עַל מִטַּת אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים וַתִּסְגֹּר בַּעֲדוֹ וַתֵּצֵֽא׃
translation: She went up and laid him on the man of God's bed, and shut the door on him, and went out. (2 Kings 4:21)

text: וְלֹא הִסְגַּרְתַּנִי בְּיַד אוֹיֵב הֶֽעֱמַדְתָּ בַמֶּרְחָב רַגְלָֽי׃
translation: Have mercy on me, LORD, for I am in distress. My eye, my soul, and my body waste away with grief. (Psalms 31:9)

text: וְאָמַר פַּרְעֹה לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל נְבֻכִים הֵם בָּאָרֶץ סָגַר עֲלֵיהֶם הַמִּדְבָּֽר׃
translation: Pharaoh will say of the children of Israel, 'They are entangled in the land. The wilderness has shut them in.' (Exodus 14:3)

text: וְהַבָּא אֶל הַבַּיִת כָּל יְמֵי הִסְגִּיר אֹתוֹ יִטְמָא עַד הָעָֽרֶב׃
translation: "Moreover he who goes into the house while it is shut up shall be unclean until the evening. (Leviticus 14:46)

text: לִפְנֵי שֶׁבֶר יִגְבַּהּ לֵב אִישׁ וְלִפְנֵי כָבוֹד עֲנָוָֽה׃
translation: Before destruction the heart of man is proud, but before honor is humility. (Proverbs 18:12)

text: וַיִּגְבַּה יְהוָה צְבָאוֹת בַּמִּשְׁפָּט וְהָאֵל הַקָּדוֹשׁ נִקְדָּשׁ בִּצְדָקָֽה׃
translation: but the LORD of Armies is exalted in justice, and God the Holy One is sanctified in righteousness. (Isaiah 5:16)

text: וַֽתִּגְבְּהֶינָה וַתַּעֲשֶׂינָה תוֹעֵבָה לְפָנָי וָאָסִיר אֶתְהֶן כַּאֲשֶׁר רָאִֽיתִי׃
translation: They were arrogant and committed abomination before me. Therefore I took them away when I saw it. (Ezekiel 16:50)

text: בְּרֹב חָכְמָתְךָ בִּרְכֻלָּתְךָ הִרְבִּיתָ חֵילֶךָ וַיִּגְבַּהּ לְבָבְךָ בְּחֵילֶֽךָ׃
translation: By your great wisdom and by your trading you have increased your riches, and your heart is lifted up because of your riches—" (Ezekiel 28:5)

text: כִּי כִגְבֹהַּ שָׁמַיִם עַל הָאָרֶץ גָּבַר חַסְדּוֹ עַל יְרֵאָֽיו׃
translation: For as the heavens are high above the earth, so great is his loving kindness toward those who fear him. (Psalms 103:11)

text: הִנֵּה יַשְׂכִּיל עַבְדִּי יָרוּם וְנִשָּׂא וְגָבַהּ מְאֹֽד׃
translation: Behold, my servant will deal wisely. He will be exalted and lifted up, and will be very high. (Isaiah 52:13)

text: וּשְׂעִיר חַטָּאת אֶחָד מִלְּבַד עֹלַת הַתָּמִיד וּמִנְחָתָהּ וְנִסְכָּֽהּ׃
translation: and one male goat for a sin offering, in addition to the continual burnt offering, and its meal offering, and its drink offering. (Numbers 29:22)

text: וּשְׂעִיר חַטָּאת אֶחָד מִלְּבַד עֹלַת הַתָּמִיד וּמִנְחָתָהּ וְנִסְכָּֽהּ׃
translation: and one male goat for a sin offering, in addition to the continual burnt offering, and its meal offering, and its drink offering. (Numbers 29:28)

text: וּשְׂעִיר חַטָּאת אֶחָד מִלְּבַד עֹלַת הַתָּמִיד מִנְחָתָהּ וּנְסָכֶֽיהָ׃
translation: and one male goat for a sin offering; in addition to the continual burnt offering, its meal offering, and the drink offerings of it. (Numbers 29:31)

text: וּשְׂעִיר חַטָּאת אֶחָד מִלְּבַד עֹלַת הַתָּמִיד מִנְחָתָהּ וְנִסְכָּֽהּ׃
translation: and one male goat for a sin offering; in addition to the continual burnt offering, its meal offering, and its drink offering. (Numbers 29:34)

text: וּשְׂעִיר חַטָּאת אֶחָד מִלְּבַד עֹלַת הַתָּמִיד וּמִנְחָתָהּ וְנִסְכָּֽהּ׃
translation: and one male goat for a sin offering, in addition to the continual burnt offering, with its meal offering, and its drink offering. (Numbers 29:38)

text: עֹלַת שַׁבַּת בְּשַׁבַּתּוֹ עַל עֹלַת הַתָּמִיד וְנִסְכָּֽהּ׃
translation: this is the burnt offering of every Sabbath, in addition to the continual burnt offering and its drink offering. (Numbers 28:10)

text: מִן הַמִּלְחָמוֹת וּמִן הַשָּׁלָל הִקְדִּישׁוּ לְחַזֵּק לְבֵית יְהוָֽה׃
translation: They dedicated some of the plunder won in battles to repair the LORD's house. (1 Chronicles 26:27)

text: וְהָיְתָה כַשְׂדִּים לְשָׁלָל כָּל שֹׁלְלֶיהָ יִשְׂבָּעוּ נְאֻם יְהוָֽה׃
translation: Chaldea will be a prey. All who prey on her will be satisfied," says the LORD. (Jeremiah 50:10)

text: הִנֵּה יֽוֹם בָּא לַֽיהוָה וְחֻלַּק שְׁלָלֵךְ בְּקִרְבֵּֽךְ׃
translation: Behold, a day of the LORD comes, when your plunder will be divided within you. (Zechariah 14:1)

text: אֶשְׁתּוֹלְלוּ אַבִּירֵי לֵב נָמוּ שְׁנָתָם וְלֹא מָצְאוּ כָל אַנְשֵׁי חַיִל יְדֵיהֶֽם׃
translation: At your rebuke, God of Jacob, both chariot and horse are cast into a dead sleep. (Psalms 76:6)

text: מֵאֲרָם וּמִמּוֹאָב וּמִבְּנֵי עַמּוֹן וּמִפְּלִשְׁתִּים וּמֵֽעֲמָלֵק וּמִשְּׁלַל הֲדַדְעֶזֶר בֶּן רְחֹב מֶלֶךְ צוֹבָֽה׃
translation: of Syria, of Moab, of the children of Ammon, of the Philistines, of Amalek, and of the plunder of Hadadezer, son of Rehob, king of Zobah. (2 Samuel 8:12)

text: וַיֹּֽאמְרוּ דָּם זֶה הָחֳרֵב נֶֽחֶרְבוּ הַמְּלָכִים וַיַּכּוּ אִישׁ אֶת רֵעֵהוּ וְעַתָּה לַשָּׁלָל מוֹאָֽב׃
translation: They said, "This is blood. The kings are surely destroyed, and they have struck each other. Now therefore, Moab, to the plunder!" (2 Kings 3:23)

text: לְאַבְרָהָם לְמִקְנָה לְעֵינֵי בְנֵי חֵת בְּכֹל בָּאֵי שַֽׁעַר עִירֽוֹ׃
translation: to Abraham for a possession in the presence of the children of Heth, before all who went in at the gate of his city. (Genesis 23:18)

text: וַיַּצֵּל אֱלֹהִים אֶת מִקְנֵה אֲבִיכֶם וַיִּתֶּן לִֽי׃
translation: Thus God has taken away your father's livestock, and given them to me. (Genesis 31:9)

text: יַגִּיד עָלָיו רֵעוֹ מִקְנֶה אַף עַל עוֹלֶֽה׃
translation: Its noise tells about him, and the livestock also, concerning the storm that comes up. (Job 36:33)

text: וַתֵּלֶד עָדָה אֶת יָבָל הוּא הָיָה אֲבִי יֹשֵׁב אֹהֶל וּמִקְנֶֽה׃
translation: Adah gave birth to Jabal, who was the father of those who dwell in tents and have livestock. (Genesis 4:20)

text: וְאַבְרָם כָּבֵד מְאֹד בַּמִּקְנֶה בַּכֶּסֶף וּבַזָּהָֽב׃
translation: Abram was very rich in livestock, in silver, and in gold. (Genesis 13:2)

text: וְגַם עֵרֶב רַב עָלָה אִתָּם וְצֹאן וּבָקָר מִקְנֶה כָּבֵד מְאֹֽד׃
translation: A mixed multitude went up also with them, with flocks, herds, and even very much livestock. (Exodus 12:38)

text: וַיַּעַל מֹשֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן נָדָב וַאֲבִיהוּא וְשִׁבְעִים מִזִּקְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
translation: Then Moses, Aaron, Nadab, Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel went up. (Exodus 24:9)

text: פְּקֻדֵיהֶם לְמַטֵּה יְהוּדָה אַרְבָּעָה וְשִׁבְעִים אֶלֶף וְשֵׁשׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃
translation: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Judah, were seventy-four thousand six hundred. (Numbers 1:27)

text: הַלְוִיִּם בְּנֵי יֵשׁוּעַ וְקַדְמִיאֵל לִבְנֵי הוֹדַוְיָה שִׁבְעִים וְאַרְבָּעָֽה׃
translation: The Levites: the children of Jeshua and Kadmiel, of the children of Hodaviah, seventy-four. (Ezra 2:40)

text: וּמִבְּנֵי עֵילָם יְשַֽׁעְיָה בֶּן עֲתַלְיָה וְעִמּוֹ שִׁבְעִים הַזְּכָרִֽים׃
translation: Of the sons of Elam, Jeshaiah the son of Athaliah; and with him seventy males. (Ezra 8:7)

text: וּמִבְּנֵי בִגְוַי עוּתַי וזבוד וְזַכּוּר וְעִמּוֹ שִׁבְעִים הַזְּכָרִֽים׃
translation: Of the sons of Bigvai, Uthai and Zabbud; and with them seventy males. (Ezra 8:14)

text: הַלְוִיִּם בְּנֵֽי יֵשׁוּעַ לְקַדְמִיאֵל לִבְנֵי לְהוֹדְוָה שִׁבְעִים וְאַרְבָּעָֽה׃
translation: The Levites: the children of Jeshua, of Kadmiel, of the children of Hodevah: seventy-four. (Nehemiah 7:43)

text: לֹא כַחֲטָאֵינוּ עָשָׂה לָנוּ וְלֹא כַעֲוֺנֹתֵינוּ גָּמַל עָלֵֽינוּ׃
translation: He has not dealt with us according to our sins, nor repaid us for our iniquities. (Psalms 103:10)

text: וַיָּקָם יַעֲקֹב וַיִּשָּׂא אֶת בָּנָיו וְאֶת נָשָׁיו עַל הַגְּמַלִּֽים׃
translation: Then Jacob rose up, and set his sons and his wives on the camels, (Genesis 31:17)

text: יִגְמְלֵנִי יְהוָה כְּצִדְקִי כְּבֹר יָדַי יָשִׁיב לִֽי׃
translation: For I have kept the ways of the LORD, and have not wickedly departed from my God. (Psalms 18:21)

text: גְּמָלַתְהוּ טוֹב וְלֹא רָע כֹּל יְמֵי חַיֶּֽיה׃
translation: She does him good, and not harm, all the days of her life. (Proverbs 31:12)

text: וַתִּגְמֹל אֶת לֹא רֻחָמָה וַתַּהַר וַתֵּלֶד בֵּֽן׃
translation: Now when she had weaned Lo-Ruhamah, she conceived, and bore a son. (Hosea 1:8)

text: וַתִּשָּׂא רִבְקָה אֶת עֵינֶיהָ וַתֵּרֶא אֶת יִצְחָק וַתִּפֹּל מֵעַל הַגָּמָֽל׃
translation: Rebekah lifted up her eyes, and when she saw Isaac, she got off the camel. (Genesis 24:64)

text: מֵאִתְּךָ תְֽהִלָּתִי בְּקָהָל רָב נְדָרַי אֲשַׁלֵּם נֶגֶד יְרֵאָֽיו׃
translation: The humble shall eat and be satisfied. They shall praise the LORD who seek after him. Let your hearts live forever. (Psalms 22:26)

text: לְךָ דֻֽמִיָּה תְהִלָּה אֱלֹהִים בְּצִיּוֹן וּלְךָ יְשֻׁלַּם נֶֽדֶר׃
translation: You who hear prayer, all men will come to you. (Psalms 65:2)

text: נְדָרַי לַיהוָה אֲשַׁלֵּם נֶגְדָה נָּא לְכָל עַמּֽוֹ׃
translation: I will pay my vows to the LORD, yes, in the presence of all his people. (Psalms 116:14)

text: נְדָרַי לַיהוָה אֲשַׁלֵּם נֶגְדָה נָּא לְכָל עַמּֽוֹ׃
translation: I will pay my vows to the LORD, yes, in the presence of all his people, (Psalms 116:18)

text: טוֹב אֲשֶׁר לֹֽא תִדֹּר מִשֶׁתִּדּוֹר וְלֹא תְשַׁלֵּֽם׃
translation: When you vow a vow to God, don't defer to pay it; for he has no pleasure in fools. Pay that which you vow. (Ecclesiastes 5:4)

text: עָלַי אֱלֹהִים נְדָרֶיךָ אֲשַׁלֵּם תּוֹדֹת לָֽךְ׃
translation: For you have delivered my soul from death, and prevented my feet from falling, that I may walk before God in the light of the living. (Psalms 56:13)

text: לֹֽא הִשְׁמִידוּ אֶת הָֽעַמִּים אֲשֶׁר אָמַר יְהוָה לָהֶֽם׃
translation: They didn't destroy the peoples, as the LORD commanded them, (Psalms 106:34)

text: אֶרְדְּפָה אֹיְבַי וָאַשְׁמִידֵם וְלֹא אָשׁוּב עַד כַּלּוֹתָֽם׃
translation: I have pursued my enemies and destroyed them. I didn't turn again until they were consumed. (2 Samuel 22:38)

text: שׁוֹמֵר יְהוָה אֶת כָּל אֹהֲבָיו וְאֵת כָּל הָרְשָׁעִים יַשְׁמִֽיד׃
translation: The LORD preserves all those who love him, but he will destroy all the wicked. (Psalms 145:20)

text: וְנִשְׁמַד מוֹאָב מֵעָם כִּי עַל יְהוָה הִגְדִּֽיל׃
translation: Moab will be destroyed from being a people, because he has magnified himself against the LORD. (Jeremiah 48:42)

text: נִשְׁמְדוּ בְֽעֵין דֹּאר הָיוּ דֹּמֶן לָאֲדָמָֽה׃
translation: Make their nobles like Oreb and Zeeb, yes, all their princes like Zebah and Zalmunna, (Psalms 83:11)

text: תִּרְדֹּף בְּאַף וְתַשְׁמִידֵם מִתַּחַת שְׁמֵי יְהוָֽה׃
translation: You will pursue them in anger, and destroy them from under the heavens of the LORD. (Lamentations 3:66)

text: וַיָּחֶל לִבְנוֹת בַּחֹדֶשׁ הַשֵּׁנִי בַּשֵּׁנִי בִּשְׁנַת אַרְבַּע לְמַלְכוּתֽוֹ׃
translation: He began to build in the second day of the second month, in the fourth year of his reign. (2 Chronicles 3:2)

text: וּשְׁלֹמֹה יָשַׁב עַל כִּסֵּא דָּוִד אָבִיו וַתִּכֹּן מַלְכֻתוֹ מְאֹֽד׃
translation: Solomon sat on David his father's throne; and his kingdom was firmly established. (1 Kings 2:12)

text: וַיִּקָּבְצוּ יְרוּשָׁלִַם בַּחֹדֶשׁ הַשְּׁלִישִׁי לִשְׁנַת חֲמֵשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה לְמַלְכוּת אָסָֽא׃
translation: So they gathered themselves together at Jerusalem in the third month, in the fifteenth year of Asa's reign. (2 Chronicles 15:10)

text: וּמִלְחָמָה לֹא הָיָתָה עַד שְׁנַת שְׁלֹשִׁים וְחָמֵשׁ לְמַלְכוּת אָסָֽא׃
translation: There was no more war to the thirty-fifth year of Asa's reign. (2 Chronicles 15:19)

text: יְֽהוָה בַּשָּׁמַיִם הֵכִין כִּסְאוֹ וּמַלְכוּתוֹ בַּכֹּל מָשָֽׁלָה׃
translation: The LORD has established his throne in the heavens. His kingdom rules over all. (Psalms 103:19)

text: וּבָא בְּמַלְכוּת מֶלֶךְ הַנֶּגֶב וְשָׁב אֶל אַדְמָתֽוֹ׃
translation: He will come into the realm of the king of the south, but he will return into his own land. (Daniel 11:9)

text: וַיִּֽחַר אַף יְהוָה בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא וַיִּשָּׁבַע לֵאמֹֽר׃
translation: The LORD's anger burned in that day, and he swore, saying, (Numbers 32:10)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֶל קָיִן לָמָּה חָרָה לָךְ וְלָמָּה נָפְלוּ פָנֶֽיךָ׃
translation: The LORD said to Cain, "Why are you angry? Why has the expression of your face fallen? (Genesis 4:6)

text: וְהַמֶּלֶךְ דָּוִד שָׁמַע אֵת כָּל הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה וַיִּחַר לוֹ מְאֹֽד׃
translation: But when King David heard of all these things, he was very angry. (2 Samuel 13:21)

text: וַיִּחַר לִי מְאֹד כַּאֲשֶׁר שָׁמַעְתִּי אֶת זַֽעֲקָתָם וְאֵת הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵֽלֶּה׃
translation: I was very angry when I heard their cry and these words. (Nehemiah 5:6)

text: וַיַּחַר עָלַי אַפּוֹ וַיַּחְשְׁבֵנִי לוֹ כְצָרָֽיו׃
translation: He has also kindled his wrath against me. He counts me among his adversaries. (Job 19:11)

text: אֲזַי חַיִּים בְּלָעוּנוּ בַּחֲרוֹת אַפָּם בָּֽנוּ׃
translation: then they would have swallowed us up alive, when their wrath was kindled against us, (Psalms 124:3)

text: וַיִּשְׁלַח יִשְׂרָאֵל מַלְאָכִים אֶל סִיחֹן מֶֽלֶךְ הָאֱמֹרִי לֵאמֹֽר׃
translation: Israel sent messengers to Sihon king of the Amorites, saying, (Numbers 21:21)

text: לְסִיחוֹן מֶלֶךְ הָאֱמֹרִי וּלְעוֹג מֶלֶךְ הַבָּשָׁן וּלְכֹל מַמְלְכוֹת כְּנָֽעַן׃
translation: Sihon king of the Amorites, Og king of Bashan, and all the kingdoms of Canaan— (Psalms 135:11)

text: לְסִיחוֹן מֶלֶךְ הָאֱמֹרִי כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
translation: Sihon king of the Amorites, for his loving kindness endures forever; (Psalms 136:19)

text: וְדוֹר רְבִיעִי יָשׁוּבוּ הֵנָּה כִּי לֹא שָׁלֵם עֲוֺן הָאֱמֹרִי עַד הֵֽנָּה׃
translation: In the fourth generation they will come here again, for the iniquity of the Amorite is not yet full." (Genesis 15:16)

text: וָאֹמַר אֲלֵכֶם בָּאתֶם עַד הַר הָאֱמֹרִי אֲשֶׁר יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ נֹתֵן לָֽנוּ׃
translation: I said to you, "You have come to the hill country of the Amorites, which the LORD our God gives to us. (Deuteronomy 1:20)

text: וְעַל יָדוֹ בָנוּ אַנְשֵׁי יְרֵחוֹ וְעַל יָדוֹ בָנָה זַכּוּר בֶּן אִמְרִֽי׃
translation: Next to him the men of Jericho built. Next to them Zaccur the son of Imri built. (Nehemiah 3:2)

text: וְאֶֽעֶשְׂךָ לְגוֹי גָּדוֹל וַאֲבָרֶכְךָ וַאֲגַדְּלָה שְׁמֶךָ וֶהְיֵה בְּרָכָֽה׃
translation: I will make of you a great nation. I will bless you and make your name great. You will be a blessing. (Genesis 12:2)

text: כִּֽי תְשִׁיתֵהוּ בְרָכוֹת לָעַד תְּחַדֵּהוּ בְשִׂמְחָה אֶת פָּנֶֽיךָ׃
translation: For the king trusts in the LORD. Through the loving kindness of the Most High, he shall not be moved. (Psalms 21:7)

text: יִשָּׂא בְרָכָה מֵאֵת יְהוָה וּצְדָקָה מֵאֱלֹהֵי יִשְׁעֽוֹ׃
translation: He shall receive a blessing from the LORD, righteousness from the God of his salvation. (Psalms 24:5)

text: בְּרָכוֹת לְרֹאשׁ צַדִּיק וּפִי רְשָׁעִים יְכַסֶּה חָמָֽס׃
translation: Blessings are on the head of the righteous, but violence covers the mouth of the wicked. (Proverbs 10:6)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר בָּא אָחִיךָ בְּמִרְמָה וַיִּקַּח בִּרְכָתֶֽךָ׃
translation: He said, "Your brother came with deceit, and has taken away your blessing." (Genesis 27:35)

text: כָּל הַיּוֹם חוֹנֵן וּמַלְוֶה וְזַרְעוֹ לִבְרָכָֽה׃
translation: All day long he deals graciously, and lends. His offspring is blessed. (Psalms 37:26)

text: שִׁיתָה יְהוָה שָׁמְרָה לְפִי נִצְּרָה עַל דַּל שְׂפָתָֽי׃
translation: Set a watch, LORD, before my mouth. Keep the door of my lips. (Psalms 141:3)

text: וַיֵּצֵא אֲלֵהֶם לוֹט הַפֶּתְחָה וְהַדֶּלֶת סָגַר אַחֲרָֽיו׃
translation: Lot went out to them through the door, and shut the door after himself. (Genesis 19:6)

text: בַּחוּץ לֹא יָלִין גֵּר דְּלָתַי לָאֹרַח אֶפְתָּֽח׃
translation: (the foreigner has not camped in the street, but I have opened my doors to the traveler); (Job 31:32)

text: וַיְהִי כַּאֲשֶׁר נִבְנְתָה הַחוֹמָה וָאַעֲמִיד הַדְּלָתוֹת וַיִּפָּֽקְדוּ הַשּׁוֹעֲרִים וְהַמְשֹׁרְרִים וְהַלְוִיִּֽם׃
translation: Now when the wall was built and I had set up the doors, and the gatekeepers and the singers and the Levites were appointed, (Nehemiah 7:1)

text: וַיְצַו שְׁחָקִים מִמָּעַל וְדַלְתֵי שָׁמַיִם פָּתָֽח׃
translation: Yet he commanded the skies above, and opened the doors of heaven. (Psalms 78:23)

text: וְאֶת אִיזֶבֶל יֹאכְלוּ הַכְּלָבִים בְּחֵלֶק יִזְרְעֶאל וְאֵין קֹבֵר וַיִּפְתַּח הַדֶּלֶת וַיָּנֹֽס׃
translation: The dogs will eat Jezebel on the plot of ground of Jezreel, and there shall be no one to bury her.'" Then he opened the door and fled. (2 Kings 9:10)

text: וַיִּשְׁלַח שָׁאוּל מַלְאָכִים לָקַחַת אֶת דָּוִד וַתֹּאמֶר חֹלֶה הֽוּא׃
translation: When Saul sent messengers to take David, she said, "He is sick." (1 Samuel 19:14)

text: וּבַל יֹאמַר שָׁכֵן חָלִיתִי הָעָם הַיֹּשֵׁב בָּהּ נְשֻׂא עָוֺֽן׃
translation: The inhabitant won't say, "I am sick." The people who dwell therein will be forgiven their iniquity. (Isaiah 33:24)

text: וְגַם אֲנִי הֶחֱלֵיתִי הַכּוֹתֶךָ הַשְׁמֵם עַל חַטֹּאתֶֽךָ׃
translation: Therefore I also have struck you with a grievous wound. I have made you desolate because of your sins. (Micah 6:13)

text: בָּעֵת הַהִיא חָלָה אֲבִיָּה בֶן יָרָבְעָֽם׃
translation: At that time Abijah the son of Jeroboam became sick. (1 Kings 14:1)

text: וָאֹמַר חַלּוֹתִי הִיא שְׁנוֹת יְמִין עֶלְיֽוֹן׃
translation: I will remember the LORD's deeds; for I will remember your wonders of old. (Psalms 77:11)

text: יֵשׁ רָעָה חוֹלָה רָאִיתִי תַּחַת הַשָּׁמֶשׁ עֹשֶׁר שָׁמוּר לִבְעָלָיו לְרָעָתֽוֹ׃
translation: The sleep of a laboring man is sweet, whether he eats little or much; but the abundance of the rich will not allow him to sleep. (Ecclesiastes 5:12)

text: אֲנִי הִנֵּה בְרִיתִי אִתָּךְ וְהָיִיתָ לְאַב הֲמוֹן גּוֹיִֽם׃
translation: "As for me, behold, my covenant is with you. You will be the father of a multitude of nations. (Genesis 17:4)

text: הָסֵר מֵעָלַי הֲמוֹן שִׁרֶיךָ וְזִמְרַת נְבָלֶיךָ לֹא אֶשְׁמָֽע׃
translation: Take away from me the noise of your songs! I will not listen to the music of your harps. (Amos 5:23)

text: טוֹב מְעַט לַצַּדִּיק מֵהֲמוֹן רְשָׁעִים רַבִּֽים׃
translation: Better is a little that the righteous has, than the abundance of many wicked. (Psalms 37:16)

text: כֹּה אָמַר אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה וְהִשְׁבַּתִּי אֶת הֲמוֹן מִצְרַיִם בְּיַד נְבוּכַדְרֶאצַּר מֶלֶךְ בָּבֶֽל׃
translation: "'The Lord GOD says: "I will also make the multitude of Egypt to cease, by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon. (Ezekiel 30:10)

text: אֹהֵב כֶּסֶף לֹא יִשְׂבַּע כֶּסֶף וּמִֽי אֹהֵב בֶּהָמוֹן לֹא תְבוּאָה גַּם זֶה הָֽבֶל׃
translation: Moreover the profit of the earth is for all. The king profits from the field. (Ecclesiastes 5:9)

text: הֶחָמָס קָם לְמַטֵּה רֶשַׁע לֹא מֵהֶם וְלֹא מֵהֲמוֹנָם וְלֹא מֶהֱמֵהֶם וְלֹא נֹהַּ בָּהֶֽם׃
translation: Violence has risen up into a rod of wickedness. None of them will remain, nor of their multitude, nor of their wealth. There will be nothing of value among them. (Ezekiel 7:11)

text: לֹא יָשׁוּב עוֹד לְבֵיתוֹ וְלֹא יַכִּירֶנּוּ עוֹד מְקֹמֽוֹ׃
translation: He will return no more to his house, neither will his place know him any more. (Job 7:10)

text: וַיַּכֵּר יוֹסֵף אֶת אֶחָיו וְהֵם לֹא הִכִּרֻֽהוּ׃
translation: Joseph recognized his brothers, but they didn't recognize him. (Genesis 42:8)

text: הֲלֹא שְׁאֶלְתֶּם עוֹבְרֵי דָרֶךְ וְאֹתֹתָם לֹא תְנַכֵּֽרוּ׃
translation: Haven't you asked wayfaring men? Don't you know their evidences, (Job 21:29)

text: לֹֽא יִהְיֶה בְךָ אֵל זָר וְלֹא תִשְׁתַּחֲוֶה לְאֵל נֵכָֽר׃
translation: I am the LORD, your God, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt. Open your mouth wide, and I will fill it. (Psalms 81:10)

text: כִּי רוּחַ עָֽבְרָה בּוֹ וְאֵינֶנּוּ וְלֹא יַכִּירֶנּוּ עוֹד מְקוֹמֽוֹ׃
translation: For the wind passes over it, and it is gone. Its place remembers it no more. (Psalms 103:16)

text: וְלֹא הִכִּירוֹ כִּֽי הָיוּ יָדָיו כִּידֵי עֵשָׂו אָחִיו שְׂעִרֹת וַֽיְבָרְכֵֽהוּ׃
translation: He didn't recognize him, because his hands were hairy, like his brother Esau's hands. So he blessed him. (Genesis 27:23)

text: וַתָּבֹאנָה אֶל רְעוּאֵל אֲבִיהֶן וַיֹּאמֶר מַדּוּעַ מִהַרְתֶּן בֹּא הַיּֽוֹם׃
translation: When they came to Reuel, their father, he said, "How is it that you have returned so early today?" (Exodus 2:18)

text: כִּי רַגְלֵיהֶם לָרַע יָרוּצוּ וִֽימַהֲרוּ לִשְׁפָּךְ דָּֽם׃
translation: for their feet run to evil. They hurry to shed blood. (Proverbs 1:16)

text: וּלְבַב נִמְהָרִים יָבִין לָדָעַת וּלְשׁוֹן עִלְּגִים תְּמַהֵר לְדַבֵּר צָחֽוֹת׃
translation: The heart of the rash will understand knowledge, and the tongue of the stammerers will be ready to speak plainly. (Isaiah 32:4)

text: וַיְמַהֵר פַּרְעֹה לִקְרֹא לְמֹשֶׁה וּֽלְאַהֲרֹן וַיֹּאמֶר חָטָאתִי לַיהוָה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶם וְלָכֶֽם׃
translation: Then Pharaoh called for Moses and Aaron in haste, and he said, "I have sinned against the LORD your God, and against you. (Exodus 10:16)

text: וַתֶּחֱזַק מִצְרַיִם עַל הָעָם לְמַהֵר לְשַׁלְּחָם מִן הָאָרֶץ כִּי אָמְרוּ כֻּלָּנוּ מֵתִֽים׃
translation: The Egyptians were urgent with the people, to send them out of the land in haste, for they said, "We are all dead men." (Exodus 12:33)

text: הָאֹמְרִים יְמַהֵר יָחִישָׁה מַעֲשֵׂהוּ לְמַעַן נִרְאֶה וְתִקְרַב וְתָבוֹאָה עֲצַת קְדוֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל וְנֵדָֽעָה׃
