translation: who say, "Let him make haste, let him hasten his work, that we may see it; let the counsel of the Holy One of Israel draw near and come, that we may know it!" (Isaiah 5:19)

text: וְשָׁחַטְתָּ אֶת הַפָּר לִפְנֵי יְהוָה פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃
translation: You shall kill the bull before the LORD at the door of the Tent of Meeting. (Exodus 29:11)

text: וַֽיִּשְׁחֲטוּ אֶת הַפָּר וַיָּבִיאוּ אֶת הַנַּעַר אֶל עֵלִֽי׃
translation: They killed the bull, and brought the child to Eli. (1 Samuel 1:25)

text: וַֽתִּשְׁחֲטִי אֶת בָּנָי וַֽתִּתְּנִים בְּהַעֲבִיר אוֹתָם לָהֶֽם׃
translation: that you have slain my children and delivered them up, in causing them to pass through the fire to them? (Ezekiel 16:21)

text: וְשַׁחֲטוּ הַפָּסַח וְהִתְקַדְּשׁוּ וְהָכִינוּ לַאֲחֵיכֶם לַעֲשׂוֹת כִּדְבַר יְהוָה בְּיַד מֹשֶֽׁה׃
translation: Kill the Passover lamb, sanctify yourselves, and prepare for your brothers, to do according to the LORD's word by Moses." (2 Chronicles 35:6)

text: וְשַׁחֲטָה שֵׂטִים הֶעְמִיקוּ וַאֲנִי מוּסָר לְכֻלָּֽם׃
translation: The rebels are deep in slaughter, but I discipline all of them. (Hosea 5:2)

text: וְסָמַךְ אֶת יָדוֹ עַל רֹאשׁ הַֽחַטָּאת וְשָׁחַט אֶת הַחַטָּאת בִּמְקוֹם הָעֹלָֽה׃
translation: He shall lay his hand on the head of the sin offering, and kill the sin offering in the place of burnt offering. (Leviticus 4:29)

text: יִפְרְצֵנִי פֶרֶץ עַל פְּנֵי פָרֶץ יָרֻץ עָלַי כְּגִבּֽוֹר׃
translation: He breaks me with breach on breach. He runs at me like a giant. (Job 16:14)

text: עֵת לַהֲרוֹג וְעֵת לִרְפּוֹא עֵת לִפְרוֹץ וְעֵת לִבְנֽוֹת׃
translation: a time to kill, and a time to heal; a time to break down, and a time to build up; (Ecclesiastes 3:3)

text: וּפְרָצִים תֵּצֶאנָה אִשָּׁה נֶגְדָּהּ וְהִשְׁלַכְתֶּנָה הַהַרְמוֹנָה נְאֻם יְהוָֽה׃
translation: You will go out at the breaks in the wall, everyone straight before her; and you will cast yourselves into Harmon," says the LORD. (Amos 4:3)

text: וַיִּהְיוּ בְנֵי פֶרֶץ לְחֶצְרֹן מִשְׁפַּחַת הַֽחֶצְרֹנִי לְחָמוּל מִשְׁפַּחַת הֶחָמוּלִֽי׃
translation: The sons of Perez were: of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites; of Hamul, the family of the Hamulites. (Numbers 26:21)

text: וְהָעָם נִחָם לְבִנְיָמִן כִּֽי עָשָׂה יְהוָה פֶּרֶץ בְּשִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
translation: The people grieved for Benjamin, because the LORD had made a breach in the tribes of Israel. (Judges 21:15)

text: בְּנֵי יְהוּדָה פֶּרֶץ חֶצְרוֹן וְכַרְמִי וְחוּר וְשׁוֹבָֽל׃
translation: The sons of Judah: Perez, Hezron, Carmi, Hur, and Shobal. (1 Chronicles 4:1)

text: בְּנֵי נַפְתָּלִי יַחֲצִיאֵל וְגוּנִי וְיֵצֶר וְשַׁלּוּם בְּנֵי בִלְהָֽה׃
translation: The sons of Naphtali: Jahziel, Guni, Jezer, Shallum, and the sons of Bilhah. (1 Chronicles 7:13)

text: אֲשֶׁר לוֹ הַיָּם וְהוּא עָשָׂהוּ וְיַבֶּשֶׁת יָדָיו יָצָֽרוּ׃
translation: The sea is his, and he made it. His hands formed the dry land. (Psalms 95:5)

text: כִּי הוּא יָדַע יִצְרֵנוּ זָכוּר כִּי עָפָר אֲנָֽחְנוּ׃
translation: For he knows how we are made. He remembers that we are dust. (Psalms 103:14)

text: קוּם וְיָרַדְתָּ בֵּית הַיּוֹצֵר וְשָׁמָּה אַשְׁמִֽיעֲךָ אֶת דְּבָרָֽי׃
translation: "Arise, and go down to the potter's house, and there I will cause you to hear my words." (Jeremiah 18:2)

text: הַיֹּצֵר יַחַד לִבָּם הַמֵּבִין אֶל כָּל מַעֲשֵׂיהֶֽם׃
translation: he who fashions all of their hearts; and he considers all of their works. (Psalms 33:15)

text: וּבְנֵי נַפְתָּלִי יַחְצְאֵל וְגוּנִי וְיֵצֶר וְשִׁלֵּֽם׃
translation: The sons of Naphtali: Jahzeel, Guni, Jezer, and Shillem. (Genesis 46:24)

text: וַתַּעֲבֹר הַמִּנְחָה עַל פָּנָיו וְהוּא לָן בַּלַּֽיְלָה הַהוּא בַּֽמַּחֲנֶֽה׃
translation: He rose up that night, and took his two wives, and his two servants, and his eleven sons, and crossed over the ford of the Jabbok. (Genesis 32:22)

text: וַיִּלֹּנוּ הָעָם עַל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר מַה נִּשְׁתֶּֽה׃
translation: The people murmured against Moses, saying, "What shall we drink?" (Exodus 15:24)

text: אֹזֶן שֹׁמַעַת תּוֹכַחַת חַיִּים בְּקֶרֶב חֲכָמִים תָּלִֽין׃
translation: The ear that listens to reproof lives, and will be at home among the wise. (Proverbs 15:31)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר לְנַעֲרוֹ לְךָ וְנִקְרְבָה בְּאַחַד הַמְּקֹמוֹת וְלַנּוּ בַגִּבְעָה אוֹ בָרָמָֽה׃
translation: He said to his servant, "Come and let's draw near to one of these places; and we will lodge in Gibeah, or in Ramah." (Judges 19:13)

text: וְאַף אָמְנָם שָׁגִיתִי אִתִּי תָּלִין מְשׁוּגָתִֽי׃
translation: If it is true that I have erred, my error remains with myself. (Job 19:4)

text: נַפְשׁוֹ בְּטוֹב תָּלִין וְזַרְעוֹ יִירַשׁ אָֽרֶץ׃
translation: His soul will dwell at ease. His offspring will inherit the land. (Psalms 25:13)

text: וְרֹחַב הֶֽחָצֵר לִפְאַת קֵדְמָה מִזְרָחָה חֲמִשִּׁים אַמָּֽה׃
translation: The width of the court on the east side eastward shall be fifty cubits. (Exodus 27:13)

text: וְעַל גְּבוּל נַפְתָּלִי מִפְּאַת קָדִמָה עַד פְּאַת יָמָּה מְנַשֶּׁה אֶחָֽד׃
translation: "By the border of Naphtali, from the east side to the west side, Manasseh, one portion. (Ezekiel 48:4)

text: וְעַל גְּבוּל מְנַשֶּׁה מִפְּאַת קָדִמָה עַד פְּאַת יָמָּה אֶפְרַיִם אֶחָֽד׃
translation: "By the border of Manasseh, from the east side to the west side, Ephraim, one portion. (Ezekiel 48:5)

text: וְעַל גְּבוּל אֶפְרַיִם מִפְּאַת קָדִים וְעַד פְּאַת יָמָּה רְאוּבֵן אֶחָֽד׃
translation: "By the border of Ephraim, from the east side even to the west side, Reuben, one portion. (Ezekiel 48:6)

text: וְעַל גְּבוּל רְאוּבֵן מִפְּאַת קָדִים עַד פְּאַת יָמָּה יְהוּדָה אֶחָֽד׃
translation: "By the border of Reuben, from the east side to the west side, Judah, one portion. (Ezekiel 48:7)

text: וְעַל גְּבוּל בִּנְיָמִן מִפְּאַת קָדִימָה עַד פְּאַת יָמָּה שִׁמְעוֹן אֶחָֽד׃
translation: "By the border of Benjamin, from the east side to the west side, Simeon, one portion. (Ezekiel 48:24)

text: טֽוֹב לִי כִֽי עֻנֵּיתִי לְמַעַן אֶלְמַד חֻקֶּֽיךָ׃
translation: It is good for me that I have been afflicted, that I may learn your statutes. (Psalms 119:71)

text: הַלְאֵל יְלַמֶּד דָּעַת וְהוּא רָמִים יִשְׁפּֽוֹט׃
translation: "Shall any teach God knowledge, since he judges those who are high? (Job 21:22)

text: יַדְרֵךְ עֲנָוִים בַּמִּשְׁפָּט וִֽילַמֵּד עֲנָוִים דַּרְכּֽוֹ׃
translation: He will guide the humble in justice. He will teach the humble his way. (Psalms 25:9)

text: אֲלַמְּדָה פֹשְׁעִים דְּרָכֶיךָ וְחַטָּאִים אֵלֶיךָ יָשֽׁוּבוּ׃
translation: Lord, open my lips. My mouth will declare your praise. (Psalms 51:15)

text: אוֹדְךָ בְּיֹשֶׁר לֵבָב בְּלָמְדִי מִשְׁפְּטֵי צִדְקֶֽךָ׃
translation: I will give thanks to you with uprightness of heart, when I learn your righteous judgments. (Psalms 119:7)

text: חַסְדְּךָ יְהוָה מָלְאָה הָאָרֶץ חֻקֶּיךָ לַמְּדֵֽנִי׃
translation: The earth is full of your loving kindness, LORD. Teach me your statutes. TETH (Psalms 119:64)

text: הֵן אַתֶּם כֻּלְּכֶם חֲזִיתֶם וְלָמָּה זֶּה הֶבֶל תֶּהְבָּֽלוּ׃
translation: Behold, all of you have seen it yourselves; why then have you become altogether vain? (Job 27:12)

text: כִּֽי בַהֶבֶל בָּא וּבַחֹשֶׁךְ יֵלֵךְ וּבַחֹשֶׁךְ שְׁמוֹ יְכֻסֶּֽה׃
translation: for it comes in vanity, and departs in darkness, and its name is covered with darkness. (Ecclesiastes 6:4)

text: יְֽהוָה יֹדֵעַ מַחְשְׁבוֹת אָדָם כִּי הֵמָּה הָֽבֶל׃
translation: The LORD knows the thoughts of man, that they are futile. (Psalms 94:11)

text: וְשַׁבְתִּי אֲנִי וָאֶרְאֶה הֶבֶל תַּחַת הַשָּֽׁמֶשׁ׃
translation: Then I returned and saw vanity under the sun. (Ecclesiastes 4:7)

text: וַיְכַל בַּהֶבֶל יְמֵיהֶם וּשְׁנוֹתָם בַּבֶּהָלָֽה׃
translation: Therefore he consumed their days in vanity, and their years in terror. (Psalms 78:33)

text: מְשַׁמְּרִים הַבְלֵי שָׁוְא חַסְדָּם יַעֲזֹֽבוּ׃
translation: But I will sacrifice to you with the voice of thanksgiving. I will pay that which I have vowed. Salvation belongs to the LORD." (Jonah 2:9)

text: קוֹל יְהוָה יָחִיל מִדְבָּר יָחִיל יְהוָה מִדְבַּר קָדֵֽשׁ׃
translation: The LORD's voice shakes the wilderness. The LORD shakes the wilderness of Kadesh. (Psalms 29:8)

text: הִשְׁתַּחֲווּ לַיהוָה בְּהַדְרַת קֹדֶשׁ חִילוּ מִפָּנָיו כָּל הָאָֽרֶץ׃
translation: Worship the LORD in holy array. Tremble before him, all the earth. (Psalms 96:9)

text: הוֹי אֹמֵר לְאָב מַה תּוֹלִיד וּלְאִשָּׁה מַה תְּחִילִֽין׃
translation: Woe to him who says to a father, 'What have you become the father of?' or to a mother, 'What have you given birth to?'" (Isaiah 45:10)

text: כִּֽי עַתָּה מֵחוֹל יַמִּים יִכְבָּד עַל כֵּן דְּבָרַי לָֽעוּ׃
translation: For now it would be heavier than the sand of the seas, therefore my words have been rash. (Job 6:3)

text: מִלִּפְנֵי אָדוֹן חוּלִי אָרֶץ מִלִּפְנֵי אֱלוֹהַּ יַעֲקֹֽב׃
translation: Tremble, you earth, at the presence of the Lord, at the presence of the God of Jacob, (Psalms 114:7)

text: מִפָּנָיו יָחִילוּ עַמִּים כָּל פָּנִים קִבְּצוּ פָארֽוּר׃
translation: At their presence the peoples are in anguish. All faces have grown pale. (Joel 2:6)

text: טוֹב וְיָשָׁר יְהוָה עַל כֵּן יוֹרֶה חַטָּאִים בַּדָּֽרֶךְ׃
translation: Good and upright is the LORD, therefore he will instruct sinners in the way. (Psalms 25:8)

text: מִי זֶה הָאִישׁ יְרֵא יְהוָה יוֹרֶנּוּ בְּדֶרֶךְ יִבְחָֽר׃
translation: What man is he who fears the LORD? He shall instruct him in the way that he shall choose. (Psalms 25:12)

text: וְֽלֹא שָׁמַעְתִּי בְּקוֹל מוֹרָי וְלִֽמְלַמְּדַי לֹא הִטִּיתִי אָזְנִֽי׃
translation: I haven't obeyed the voice of my teachers, nor turned my ear to those who instructed me! (Proverbs 5:13)

text: וְעַתָּה לֵךְ וְאָנֹכִי אֶֽהְיֶה עִם פִּיךָ וְהוֹרֵיתִיךָ אֲשֶׁר תְּדַבֵּֽר׃
translation: Now therefore go, and I will be with your mouth, and teach you what you shall speak." (Exodus 4:12)

text: וּלְהוֹרֹת נָתַן בְּלִבּוֹ הוּא וְאָֽהֳלִיאָב בֶּן אֲחִיסָמָךְ לְמַטֵּה דָֽן׃
translation: He has put in his heart that he may teach, both he and Oholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan. (Exodus 35:34)

text: הוֹרֵנִי יְהוָה דַּרְכֶּךָ אֲהַלֵּךְ בַּאֲמִתֶּךָ יַחֵד לְבָבִי לְיִרְאָה שְׁמֶֽךָ׃
translation: Teach me your way, LORD. I will walk in your truth. Make my heart undivided to fear your name. (Psalms 86:11)

text: וַיָּבֹא וַיִּסְגֹּר הַדֶּלֶת בְּעַד שְׁנֵיהֶם וַיִּתְפַּלֵּל אֶל יְהוָֽה׃
translation: He went in therefore, and shut the door on them both, and prayed to the LORD. (2 Kings 4:33)

text: וַיַּסֵּב חִזְקִיָּהוּ פָּנָיו אֶל הַקִּיר וַיִּתְפַּלֵּל אֶל יְהוָֽה׃
translation: Then Hezekiah turned his face to the wall and prayed to the LORD, (Isaiah 38:2)

text: וַיַּסֵּב אֶת פָּנָיו אֶל הַקִּיר וַיִּתְפַּלֵּל אֶל יְהוָה לֵאמֹֽר׃
translation: Then he turned his face to the wall, and prayed to the LORD, saying, (2 Kings 20:2)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֵלָי אַל תִּתְפַּלֵּל בְּעַד הָעָם הַזֶּה לְטוֹבָֽה׃
translation: The LORD said to me, "Don't pray for this people for their good. (Jeremiah 14:11)

text: וּקְרָאתֶם אֹתִי וַֽהֲלַכְתֶּם וְהִתְפַּלַּלְתֶּם אֵלָי וְשָׁמַעְתִּי אֲלֵיכֶֽם׃
translation: You shall call on me, and you shall go and pray to me, and I will listen to you. (Jeremiah 29:12)

text: וְהָיָה כִּי הִרְבְּתָה לְהִתְפַּלֵּל לִפְנֵי יְהוָה וְעֵלִי שֹׁמֵר אֶת פִּֽיהָ׃
translation: As she continued praying before the LORD, Eli saw her mouth. (1 Samuel 1:12)

text: רָחוֹק מֵרְשָׁעִים יְשׁוּעָה כִּֽי חֻקֶּיךָ לֹא דָרָֽשׁוּ׃
translation: Salvation is far from the wicked, for they don't seek your statutes. (Psalms 119:155)

text: אַתָּה יָדַעְתָּ שִׁבְתִּי וְקוּמִי בַּנְתָּה לְרֵעִי מֵרָחֽוֹק׃
translation: You know my sitting down and my rising up. You perceive my thoughts from afar. (Psalms 139:2)

text: כִּי אֵין הָאִישׁ בְּבֵיתוֹ הָלַךְ בְּדֶרֶךְ מֵרָחֽוֹק׃
translation: For my husband isn't at home. He has gone on a long journey. (Proverbs 7:19)

text: בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי וַיִּשָּׂא אַבְרָהָם אֶת עֵינָיו וַיַּרְא אֶת הַמָּקוֹם מֵרָחֹֽק׃
translation: On the third day Abraham lifted up his eyes, and saw the place far off. (Genesis 22:4)

text: אֶשָּׂא דֵעִי לְמֵרָחוֹק וּלְפֹעֲלִי אֶֽתֵּֽן צֶֽדֶק׃
translation: I will get my knowledge from afar, and will ascribe righteousness to my Maker. (Job 36:3)

text: מִשָּׁם חָֽפַר אֹכֶל לְמֵרָחוֹק עֵינָיו יַבִּֽיטוּ׃
translation: From there he spies out the prey. His eyes see it afar off. (Job 39:29)

text: וְכִֽי יִמְכֹּר אִישׁ אֶת בִּתּוֹ לְאָמָה לֹא תֵצֵא כְּצֵאת הָעֲבָדִֽים׃
translation: "If a man sells his daughter to be a female servant, she shall not go out as the male servants do. (Exodus 21:7)

text: וַיִּֽחַר אַף יְהוָה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וַֽיִּמְכְּרֵם בְּיַד פְּלִשְׁתִּים וּבְיַד בְּנֵי עַמּֽוֹן׃
translation: The LORD's anger burned against Israel, and he sold them into the hand of the Philistines and into the hand of the children of Ammon. (Judges 10:7)

text: שָׁלַח לִפְנֵיהֶם אִישׁ לְעֶבֶד נִמְכַּר יוֹסֵֽף׃
translation: He sent a man before them. Joseph was sold for a slave. (Psalms 105:17)

text: הֲלוֹא נָכְרִיּוֹת נֶחְשַׁבְנוּ לוֹ כִּי מְכָרָנוּ וַיֹּאכַל גַּם אָכוֹל אֶת כַּסְפֵּֽנוּ׃
translation: Aren't we considered as foreigners by him? For he has sold us, and has also used up our money. (Genesis 31:15)

text: וְכִֽי יָמוּךְ אָחִיךָ עִמָּךְ וְנִמְכַּר לָךְ לֹא תַעֲבֹד בּוֹ עֲבֹדַת עָֽבֶד׃
translation: "'If your brother has grown poor among you, and sells himself to you, you shall not make him to serve as a slave. (Leviticus 25:39)

text: כִּֽי עֲבָדַי הֵם אֲשֶׁר הוֹצֵאתִי אֹתָם מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם לֹא יִמָּכְרוּ מִמְכֶּרֶת עָֽבֶד׃
translation: For they are my servants, whom I brought out of the land of Egypt. They shall not be sold as slaves. (Leviticus 25:42)

text: יְֽהוָה בֹּקֶר תִּשְׁמַע קוֹלִי בֹּקֶר אֶֽעֱרָךְ לְךָ וַאֲצַפֶּֽה׃
translation: For you are not a God who has pleasure in wickedness. Evil can't live with you. (Psalms 5:4)

text: וַיַּעַשׂ בַּדֵּי עֲצֵי שִׁטִּים וַיְצַף אֹתָם זָהָֽב׃
translation: He made poles of acacia wood and overlaid them with gold. (Exodus 37:4)

text: בְּֽכָל מָקוֹם עֵינֵי יְהוָה צֹפוֹת רָעִים וטוֹבִֽים׃
translation: The LORD's eyes are everywhere, keeping watch on the evil and the good. (Proverbs 15:3)

text: לֹא יַאֲמִין שׁוּב מִנִּי חֹשֶׁךְ וצפו וְצָפוּי הוּא אֱלֵי חָֽרֶב׃
translation: He doesn't believe that he will return out of darkness. He is waited for by the sword. (Job 15:22)

text: וְהַמִּצְפָּה אֲשֶׁר אָמַר יִצֶף יְהוָה בֵּינִי וּבֵינֶךָ כִּי נִסָּתֵר אִישׁ מֵרֵעֵֽהוּ׃
translation: and Mizpah, for he said, "The LORD watch between me and you, when we are absent one from another. (Genesis 31:49)

text: וְעָשִׂיתָ קַרְנֹתָיו עַל אַרְבַּע פִּנֹּתָיו מִמֶּנּוּ תִּהְיֶיןָ קַרְנֹתָיו וְצִפִּיתָ אֹתוֹ נְחֹֽשֶׁת׃
translation: You shall make its horns on its four corners. Its horns shall be of one piece with it. You shall overlay it with bronze. (Exodus 27:2)

text: וַיָּשִׂימוּ אֶת הַחֲלָבִים עַל הֶחָזוֹת וַיַּקְטֵר הַחֲלָבִים הַמִּזְבֵּֽחָה׃
translation: and they put the fat upon the breasts, and he burned the fat on the altar. (Leviticus 9:20)

text: כִּֽי צַדִּיק יְהוָה צְדָקוֹת אָהֵב יָשָׁר יֶחֱזוּ פָנֵֽימוֹ׃
translation: For the LORD is righteous. He loves righteousness. The upright shall see his face. (Psalms 11:7)

text: וְהִקְטִיר הַכֹּהֵן אֶת הַחֵלֶב הַמִּזְבֵּחָה וְהָיָה הֶֽחָזֶה לְאַהֲרֹן וּלְבָנָֽיו׃
translation: The priest shall burn the fat on the altar, but the breast shall be Aaron's and his sons'. (Leviticus 7:31)

text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהוָה אֶל גָּד חֹזֵה דָוִיד לֵאמֹֽר׃
translation: The LORD spoke to Gad, David's seer, saying, (1 Chronicles 21:9)

text: כָּל אָדָם חָֽזוּ בוֹ אֱנוֹשׁ יַבִּיט מֵרָחֽוֹק׃
translation: All men have looked on it. Man sees it afar off. (Job 36:25)

text: כְּמוֹ שַׁבְּלוּל תֶּמֶס יַהֲלֹךְ נֵפֶל אֵשֶׁת בַּל חָזוּ שָֽׁמֶשׁ׃
translation: Before your pots can feel the heat of the thorns, he will sweep away the green and the burning alike. (Psalms 58:9)

text: וַיַּכּוּ הַיְּהוּדִים בְּכָל אֹיְבֵיהֶם מַכַּת חֶרֶב וְהֶרֶג וְאַבְדָן וַיַּֽעֲשׂוּ בְשֹׂנְאֵיהֶם כִּרְצוֹנָֽם׃
translation: The Jews struck all their enemies with the stroke of the sword, and with slaughter and destruction, and did what they wanted to those who hated them. (Esther 9:5)

text: זֶה הָעָם אֲשֶׁר הֶגְלָה נְבֽוּכַדְרֶאצַּר בִּשְׁנַת שֶׁבַע יְהוּדִים שְׁלֹשֶׁת אֲלָפִים וְעֶשְׂרִים וּשְׁלֹשָֽׁה׃
translation: This is the number of the people whom Nebuchadnezzar carried away captive: in the seventh year, three thousand twenty-three Jews; (Jeremiah 52:28)

text: וַיָּסַר הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת טַבַּעְתּוֹ מֵעַל יָדוֹ וַֽיִּתְּנָהּ לְהָמָן בֶּֽן הַמְּדָתָא הָאֲגָגִי צֹרֵר הַיְּהוּדִֽים׃
translation: The king took his ring from his hand, and gave it to Haman the son of Hammedatha the Agagite, the Jews' enemy. (Esther 3:10)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר מָרְדֳּכַי לְהָשִׁיב אֶל אֶסְתֵּר אַל תְּדַמִּי בְנַפְשֵׁךְ לְהִמָּלֵט בֵּית הַמֶּלֶךְ מִכָּל הַיְּהוּדִֽים׃
translation: Then Mordecai asked them to return this answer to Esther: "Don't think to yourself that you will escape in the king's house any more than all the Jews. (Esther 4:13)

text: עֲשֶׂרֶת בְּנֵי הָמָן בֶּֽן הַמְּדָתָא צֹרֵר הַיְּהוּדִים הָרָגוּ וּבַבִּזָּה לֹא שָׁלְחוּ אֶת יָדָֽם׃
translation: the ten sons of Haman the son of Hammedatha, the Jews' enemy, but they didn't lay their hand on the plunder. (Esther 9:10)

text: וַֽיְהִי כַּאֲשֶׁר בָּאוּ הַיְּהוּדִים הַיֹּשְׁבִים אֶצְלָם וַיֹּאמְרוּ לָנוּ עֶשֶׂר פְּעָמִים מִכָּל הַמְּקֹמוֹת אֲשֶׁר תָּשׁוּבוּ עָלֵֽינוּ׃
translation: So we built the wall; and all the wall was joined together to half its height, for the people had a mind to work. (Nehemiah 4:6)

text: וְנָקַל זֹאת בְּעֵינֵי יְהוָה וְנָתַן אֶת מוֹאָב בְּיֶדְכֶֽם׃
translation: This is an easy thing in the LORD's sight. He will also deliver the Moabites into your hand. (2 Kings 3:18)

text: הֵן קַלֹּתִי מָה אֲשִׁיבֶךָּ יָדִי שַׂמְתִּי לְמוֹ פִֽי׃
translation: "Behold, I am of small account. What will I answer you? I lay my hand on my mouth. (Job 40:4)

text: יְקַֽלְלוּ הֵמָּה וְאַתָּה תְבָרֵךְ קָמוּ וַיֵּבֹשׁוּ וְֽעַבְדְּךָ יִשְׂמָֽח׃
translation: They may curse, but you bless. When they arise, they will be shamed, but your servant shall rejoice. (Psalms 109:28)

text: אַחֲרֵי כֵן פָּתַח אִיּוֹב אֶת פִּיהוּ וַיְקַלֵּל אֶת יוֹמֽוֹ׃
translation: After this Job opened his mouth, and cursed the day of his birth. (Job 3:1)

text: דּוֹר אָבִיו יְקַלֵּל וְאֶת אִמּוֹ לֹא יְבָרֵֽךְ׃
translation: There is a generation that curses their father, and doesn't bless their mother. (Proverbs 30:11)

text: וְכֹֽה אָמַר שִׁמְעִי בְּקַֽלְלוֹ צֵא צֵא אִישׁ הַדָּמִים וְאִישׁ הַבְּלִיָּֽעַל׃
translation: Shimei said when he cursed, "Be gone, be gone, you man of blood, and wicked fellow! (2 Samuel 16:7)

text: בָּרוּךְ יְהוָה אֱלֹהִים אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל עֹשֵׂה נִפְלָאוֹת לְבַדּֽוֹ׃
translation: Praise be to the LORD God, the God of Israel, who alone does marvelous deeds. (Psalms 72:18)

text: נֶגֶד אֲבוֹתָם עָשָׂה פֶלֶא בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם שְׂדֵה צֹֽעַן׃
translation: He did marvelous things in the sight of their fathers, in the land of Egypt, in the field of Zoan. (Psalms 78:12)

text: כִּֽי גָדוֹל אַתָּה וְעֹשֵׂה נִפְלָאוֹת אַתָּה אֱלֹהִים לְבַדֶּֽךָ׃
translation: For you are great, and do wondrous things. You are God alone. (Psalms 86:10)

text: הֲלַמֵּתִים תַּעֲשֶׂה פֶּלֶא אִם רְפָאִים יָקוּמוּ יוֹדוּךָ סֶּֽלָה׃
translation: Is your loving kindness declared in the grave? Or your faithfulness in Destruction? (Psalms 88:11)

text: שְׁלֹשָׁה הֵמָּה נִפְלְאוּ מִמֶּנִּי וארבע וְאַרְבָּעָה לֹא יְדַעְתִּֽים׃
translation: "There are three things which are too amazing for me, four which I don't understand: (Proverbs 30:18)

text: סַפְּרוּ בַגּוֹיִם אֶת כְּבוֹדוֹ בְּכָל הָעַמִּים נִפְלְאֹתָֽיו׃
translation: Declare his glory among the nations, and his marvelous works among all the peoples. (1 Chronicles 16:24)

text: וְהִקְטִיר אֹתָם הַכֹּהֵן הַמִּזְבֵּחָה אִשֶּׁה לַיהוָה אָשָׁם הֽוּא׃
translation: and the priest shall burn them on the altar for an offering made by fire to the LORD: it is a trespass offering. (Leviticus 7:5)

text: וְהָיָה כִֽי יֶאְשַׁם לְאַחַת מֵאֵלֶּה וְהִתְוַדָּה אֲשֶׁר חָטָא עָלֶֽיהָ׃
translation: It shall be, when he is guilty of one of these, he shall confess that in which he has sinned; (Leviticus 5:5)

text: זֹאת הַתּוֹרָה לָֽעֹלָה לַמִּנְחָה וְלַֽחַטָּאת וְלָאָשָׁם וְלַמִּלּוּאִים וּלְזֶבַח הַשְּׁלָמִֽים׃
translation: This is the law of the burnt offering, the meal offering, the sin offering, the trespass offering, the consecration, and the sacrifice of peace offerings (Leviticus 7:37)

text: כְּדַבֵּר אֶפְרַיִם רְתֵת נָשָׂא הוּא בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֶּאְשַׁם בַּבַּעַל וַיָּמֹֽת׃
translation: When Ephraim spoke, there was trembling. He exalted himself in Israel, but when he became guilty through Baal, he died. (Hosea 13:1)

text: וְזֹאת תּוֹרַת הָאָשָׁם קֹדֶשׁ קָֽדָשִׁים הֽוּא׃
translation: "'This is the law of the trespass offering: It is most holy. (Leviticus 7:1)

text: וְהֵבִיא אֶת אֲשָׁמוֹ לַֽיהוָה אֶל פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד אֵיל אָשָֽׁם׃
translation: He shall bring his trespass offering to the LORD, to the door of the Tent of Meeting, even a ram for a trespass offering. (Leviticus 19:21)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר חִזְקִיָּהוּ מָה אוֹת כִּי אֶעֱלֶה בֵּית יְהוָֽה׃
translation: Hezekiah also had said, "What is the sign that I will go up to the LORD's house?" (Isaiah 38:22)

text: וְאֶת הַמַּטֶּה הַזֶּה תִּקַּח בְּיָדֶךָ אֲשֶׁר תַּעֲשֶׂה בּוֹ אֶת הָאֹתֹֽת׃
translation: You shall take this rod in your hand, with which you shall do the signs." (Exodus 4:17)

text: אַךְ בְּזֹאת נֵאוֹת לָכֶם אִם תִּהְיוּ כָמֹנוּ לְהִמֹּל לָכֶם כָּל זָכָֽר׃
translation: Only on this condition will we consent to you. If you will be as we are, that every male of you be circumcised, (Genesis 34:15)

text: וַיִּתֵּן יְהוָה אוֹתֹת וּמֹפְתִים גְּדֹלִים וְרָעִים בְּמִצְרַיִם בְּפַרְעֹה וּבְכָל בֵּיתוֹ לְעֵינֵֽינוּ׃
translation: and the LORD showed great and awesome signs and wonders on Egypt, on Pharaoh, and on all his house, before our eyes; (Deuteronomy 6:22)

text: אֽוֹתֹתֵינוּ לֹא רָאִינוּ אֵֽין עוֹד נָבִיא וְלֹֽא אִתָּנוּ יֹדֵעַ עַד מָֽה׃
translation: We see no miraculous signs. There is no longer any prophet, neither is there among us anyone who knows how long. (Psalms 74:9)

text: שְׁאַל לְךָ אוֹת מֵעִם יְהוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ הַעְמֵק שְׁאָלָה אוֹ הַגְבֵּהַּ לְמָֽעְלָה׃
translation: "Ask a sign of the LORD your God; ask it either in the depth, or in the height above." (Isaiah 7:11)

text: אֵיךְ נָשִׁיר אֶת שִׁיר יְהוָה עַל אַדְמַת נֵכָֽר׃
translation: How can we sing the LORD's song in a foreign land? (Psalms 137:4)

text: אֵיךְ נָפְלוּ גִבֹּרִים בְּתוֹךְ הַמִּלְחָמָה יְהוֹנָתָן עַל בָּמוֹתֶיךָ חָלָֽל׃
translation: How the mighty have fallen in the middle of the battle! Jonathan was slain on your high places. (2 Samuel 1:25)

text: אֵיךְ תֹּֽאמְרוּ גִּבּוֹרִים אֲנָחְנוּ וְאַנְשֵׁי חַיִל לַמִּלְחָמָֽה׃
translation: "How do you say, 'We are mighty men, and valiant men for the war'? (Jeremiah 48:14)

text: אֵיכָה אֶשָּׂא לְבַדִּי טָרְחֲכֶם וּמַֽשַּׂאֲכֶם וְרִֽיבְכֶֽם׃
translation: How can I myself alone bear your problems, your burdens, and your strife? (Deuteronomy 1:12)

text: כִּי תֹאמַר בִּלְבָבְךָ רַבִּים הַגּוֹיִם הָאֵלֶּה מִמֶּנִּי אֵיכָה אוּכַל לְהוֹרִישָֽׁם׃
translation: If you shall say in your heart, "These nations are more than I; how can I dispossess them?" (Deuteronomy 7:17)

text: אֵיךְ נָפְלוּ גִבּוֹרִים וַיֹּאבְדוּ כְּלֵי מִלְחָמָֽה׃
translation: How the mighty have fallen, and the weapons of war have perished!" (2 Samuel 1:27)

text: כִּי אֶבֶן מִקִּיר תִּזְעָק וְכָפִיס מֵעֵץ יַעֲנֶֽנָּה׃
translation: For the stone will cry out of the wall, and the beam out of the woodwork will answer it. (Habakkuk 2:11)

text: וַיָּבֵא אֹתִי אֶל פֶּתַח הֶֽחָצֵר וָאֶרְאֶה וְהִנֵּה חֹר אֶחָד בַּקִּֽיר׃
translation: He brought me to the door of the court; and when I looked, behold, a hole in the wall. (Ezekiel 8:7)

text: וּמִגְרְשֵׁי הֶֽעָרִים אֲשֶׁר תִּתְּנוּ לַלְוִיִּם מִקִּיר הָעִיר וָחוּצָה אֶלֶף אַמָּה סָבִֽיב׃
translation: "The pasture lands of the cities, which you shall give to the Levites, shall be from the wall of the city and outward one thousand cubits around it. (Numbers 35:4)

text: עַל כֵּן עַל מוֹאָב אֲיֵלִיל וּלְמוֹאָב כֻּלֹּה אֶזְעָק אֶל אַנְשֵׁי קִֽיר חֶרֶשׂ יֶהְגֶּֽה׃
translation: Therefore I will wail for Moab. Yes, I will cry out for all Moab. They will mourn for the men of Kir Heres. (Jeremiah 48:31)

text: וְהִקְרִיבוֹ הַכֹּהֵן אֶל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וּמָלַק אֶת רֹאשׁוֹ וְהִקְטִיר הַמִּזְבֵּחָה וְנִמְצָה דָמוֹ עַל קִיר הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃
translation: The priest shall bring it to the altar, and wring off its head, and burn it on the altar; and its blood shall be drained out on the side of the altar; (Leviticus 1:15)

text: הִנְנִי מבי מֵבִיא אֵלֶיךָ רָעָה וּבִעַרְתִּי אַחֲרֶיךָ וְהִכְרַתִּי לְאַחְאָב מַשְׁתִּין בְּקִיר וְעָצוּר וְעָזוּב בְּיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
translation: Behold, I will bring evil on you, and will utterly sweep you away and will cut off from Ahab everyone who urinates against a wall, and him who is shut up and him who is left at large in Israel. (1 Kings 21:21)

text: וְאִם עֵז קָרְבָּנוֹ וְהִקְרִיבוֹ לִפְנֵי יְהוָֽה׃
translation: "'If his offering is a goat, then he shall offer it before the LORD. (Leviticus 3:12)

text: וַיְהִי הַמַּקְרִיב בַּיּוֹם הָרִאשׁוֹן אֶת קָרְבָּנוֹ נַחְשׁוֹן בֶּן עַמִּינָדָב לְמַטֵּה יְהוּדָֽה׃
translation: He who offered his offering the first day was Nahshon the son of Amminadab, of the tribe of Judah, (Numbers 7:12)

text: וַיַּקְרֵב אֵת קָרְבַּן הָעָם וַיִּקַּח אֶת שְׂעִיר הַֽחַטָּאת אֲשֶׁר לָעָם וַיִּשְׁחָטֵהוּ וַֽיְחַטְּאֵהוּ כָּרִאשֽׁוֹן׃
translation: He presented the people's offering, and took the goat of the sin offering which was for the people, and killed it, and offered it for sin, like the first. (Leviticus 9:15)

text: אֽוֹ הוֹדַע אֵלָיו חַטָּאתוֹ אֲשֶׁר חָטָא בָּהּ וְהֵבִיא אֶת קָרְבָּנוֹ שְׂעִיר עִזִּים זָכָר תָּמִֽים׃
translation: if his sin in which he has sinned is made known to him, he shall bring as his offering a goat, a male without defect. (Leviticus 4:23)

text: וְהִקְרִיב מִמֶּנּוּ אֶחָד מִכָּל קָרְבָּן תְּרוּמָה לַיהוָה לַכֹּהֵן הַזֹּרֵק אֶת דַּם הַשְּׁלָמִים לוֹ יִהְיֶֽה׃
translation: Of it he shall offer one out of each offering for a heave offering to the LORD. It shall be the priest's who sprinkles the blood of the peace offerings. (Leviticus 7:14)

text: וְאִם בְּהֵמָה אֲשֶׁר יַקְרִיבוּ מִמֶּנָּה קָרְבָּן לַֽיהוָה כֹּל אֲשֶׁר יִתֵּן מִמֶּנּוּ לַיהוָה יִֽהְיֶה קֹּֽדֶשׁ׃
translation: "'If it is an animal of which men offer an offering to the LORD, all that any man gives of such to the LORD becomes holy. (Leviticus 27:9)

text: וַיִּקְרָא יְהוָה אֱלֹהִים אֶל הָֽאָדָם וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ אַיֶּֽכָּה׃
translation: The LORD God called to the man, and said to him, "Where are you?" (Genesis 3:9)

text: אִֽי לָךְ אֶרֶץ שֶׁמַּלְכֵּךְ נָעַר וְשָׂרַיִךְ בַּבֹּקֶר יֹאכֵֽלוּ׃
translation: Woe to you, land, when your king is a child, and your princes eat in the morning! (Ecclesiastes 10:16)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵי זֶה הַדֶּרֶךְ נַעֲלֶה וַיֹּאמֶר דֶּרֶךְ מִדְבַּר אֱדֽוֹם׃
translation: Then he said, "Which way shall we go up?" Jehoram answered, "The way of the wilderness of Edom." (2 Kings 3:8)

text: אֵי זֶה הַדֶּרֶךְ יִשְׁכָּן אוֹר וְחֹשֶׁךְ אֵי זֶה מְקֹמֽוֹ׃
translation: "What is the way to the dwelling of light? As for darkness, where is its place, (Job 38:19)

text: יְהוָה מָלָךְ תָּגֵל הָאָרֶץ יִשְׂמְחוּ אִיִּים רַבִּֽים׃
translation: The LORD reigns! Let the earth rejoice! Let the multitude of islands be glad! (Psalms 97:1)

text: וְאָמַר אֵי אֱלֹהֵימוֹ צוּר חָסָיוּ בֽוֹ׃
translation: He will say, "Where are their gods, the rock in which they took refuge, (Deuteronomy 32:37)

text: וּלְדָן אָמַר דָּן גּוּר אַרְיֵה יְזַנֵּק מִן הַבָּשָֽׁן׃
translation: About Dan he said, "Dan is a lion's cub that leaps out of Bashan." (Deuteronomy 33:22)

text: הָיְתָה לִּי נַחֲלָתִי כְּאַרְיֵה בַיָּעַר נָתְנָה עָלַי בְּקוֹלָהּ עַל כֵּן שְׂנֵאתִֽיהָ׃
translation: My heritage has become to me as a lion in the forest. She has uttered her voice against me. Therefore I have hated her. (Jeremiah 12:8)

text: שִׁוִּיתִי עַד בֹּקֶר כָּֽאֲרִי כֵּן יְשַׁבֵּר כָּל עַצְמוֹתָי מִיּוֹם עַד לַיְלָה תַּשְׁלִימֵֽנִי׃
translation: I waited patiently until morning. He breaks all my bones like a lion. From day even to night you will make an end of me. (Isaiah 38:13)

text: לַשָּׁוְא הִכֵּיתִי אֶת בְּנֵיכֶם מוּסָר לֹא לָקָחוּ אָכְלָה חַרְבְּכֶם נְבִֽיאֵיכֶם כְּאַרְיֵה מַשְׁחִֽית׃
translation: "I have struck your children in vain. They received no correction. Your own sword has devoured your prophets, like a destroying lion. (Jeremiah 2:30)

text: לֹא יִהְיֶה שָׁם אַרְיֵה וּפְרִיץ חַיּוֹת בַּֽל יַעֲלֶנָּה לֹא תִמָּצֵא שָׁם וְהָלְכוּ גְּאוּלִֽים׃
translation: No lion will be there, nor will any ravenous animal go up on it. They will not be found there; but the redeemed will walk there. (Isaiah 35:9)

text: וַיְפַתַּח עַל הַלֻּחֹת יְדֹתֶיהָ וְעַל ומסגרתיה מִסְגְּרֹתֶיהָ כְּרוּבִים אֲרָיוֹת וְתִמֹרֹת כְּמַֽעַר אִישׁ וְלֹיוֹת סָבִֽיב׃
translation: On the plates of its supports and on its panels, he engraved cherubim, lions, and palm trees, each in its space, with wreaths all around. (1 Kings 7:36)

text: וְדֵי חֲלֵב עִזִּים לְֽלַחְמְךָ לְלֶחֶם בֵּיתֶךָ וְחַיִּים לְנַעֲרוֹתֶֽיךָ׃
translation: There will be plenty of goats' milk for your food, for your family's food, and for the nourishment of your servant girls. (Proverbs 27:27)

text: וַתָּרָץ הַֽנַּעֲרָ וַתַּגֵּד לְבֵית אִמָּהּ כַּדְּבָרִים הָאֵֽלֶּה׃
translation: The young lady ran, and told her mother's house about these words. (Genesis 24:28)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר בֹּעַז לְנַעֲרוֹ הַנִּצָּב עַל הַקּֽוֹצְרִים לְמִי הַנַּעֲרָה הַזֹּֽאת׃
translation: Then Boaz said to his servant who was set over the reapers, "Whose young lady is this?" (Ruth 2:5)

text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ נִקְרָא לַֽנַּעֲרָ וְנִשְׁאֲלָה אֶת פִּֽיהָ׃
translation: They said, "We will call the young lady, and ask her." (Genesis 24:57)

text: וַיָּבֹא וַיַּגֵּד לַאדֹנָיו לֵאמֹר כָּזֹאת וְכָזֹאת דִּבְּרָה הַֽנַּעֲרָה אֲשֶׁר מֵאֶרֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
translation: Someone went in and told his lord, saying, "The girl who is from the land of Israel said this." (2 Kings 5:4)

text: וַתִּדְבַּק נַפְשׁוֹ בְּדִינָה בַּֽת יַעֲקֹב וַיֶּֽאֱהַב אֶת הַֽנַּעֲרָ וַיְדַבֵּר עַל לֵב הַֽנַּעֲרָֽ׃
translation: His soul joined to Dinah, the daughter of Jacob, and he loved the young lady, and spoke kindly to the young lady. (Genesis 34:3)

text: וַיָּמָת נָדָב וַאֲבִיהוּא בְּהַקְרִיבָם אֵשׁ זָרָה לִפְנֵי יְהוָֽה׃
translation: Nadab and Abihu died when they offered strange fire before the LORD. (Numbers 26:61)

text: לָהֶם לְבַדָּם נִתְּנָה הָאָרֶץ וְלֹא עָבַר זָר בְּתוֹכָֽם׃
translation: to whom alone the land was given, and no stranger passed among them): (Job 15:19)

text: אִם שָׁכַחְנוּ שֵׁם אֱלֹהֵינוּ וַנִּפְרֹשׂ כַּפֵּינוּ לְאֵל זָֽר׃
translation: won't God search this out? For he knows the secrets of the heart. (Psalms 44:21)

text: אַחַי מֵעָלַי הִרְחִיק וְיֹדְעַי אַךְ זָרוּ מִמֶּֽנִּי׃
translation: "He has put my brothers far from me. My acquaintances are wholly estranged from me. (Job 19:13)

text: יְהַלֶּלְךָ זָר וְלֹא פִיךָ נָכְרִי וְאַל שְׂפָתֶֽיךָ׃
translation: Let another man praise you, and not your own mouth; a stranger, and not your own lips. (Proverbs 27:2)

text: רוּחִֽי זָרָה לְאִשְׁתִּי וְחַנֹּתִי לִבְנֵי בִטְנִֽי׃
translation: My breath is offensive to my wife. I am loathsome to the children of my own mother. (Job 19:17)

text: כַּעַס לְאָבִיו בֵּן כְּסִיל וּמֶמֶר לְיוֹלַדְתּֽוֹ׃
translation: A foolish son brings grief to his father, and bitterness to her who bore him. (Proverbs 17:25)

text: וְהָסֵר כַּעַס מִלִּבֶּךָ וְהַעֲבֵר רָעָה מִבְּשָׂרֶךָ כִּֽי הַיַּלְדוּת וְהַֽשַּׁחֲרוּת הָֽבֶל׃
translation: Therefore remove sorrow from your heart, and put away evil from your flesh; for youth and the dawn of life are vanity. (Ecclesiastes 11:10)

text: הָעָם הַמַּכְעִיסִים אוֹתִי עַל פָּנַי תָּמִיד זֹֽבְחִים בַּגַּנּוֹת וּֽמְקַטְּרִים עַל הַלְּבֵנִֽים׃
translation: a people who provoke me to my face continually, sacrificing in gardens, and burning incense on bricks; (Isaiah 65:3)

text: יַקְנִאֻהוּ בְּזָרִים בְּתוֹעֵבֹת יַכְעִיסֻֽהוּ׃
translation: They moved him to jealousy with strange gods. They provoked him to anger with abominations. (Deuteronomy 32:16)

text: וְלֹֽא שְׁמַעְתֶּם אֵלַי נְאֻם יְהוָה לְמַעַן הכעסוני הַכְעִיסֵנִי בְּמַעֲשֵׂה יְדֵיכֶם לְרַע לָכֶֽם׃
translation: "Yet you have not listened to me," says the LORD, "that you may provoke me to anger with the work of your hands to your own hurt." (Jeremiah 25:7)

text: וְהִכְעַסְתִּי לֵב עַמִּים רַבִּים בַּהֲבִיאִי שִׁבְרְךָ בַּגּוֹיִם עַל אֲרָצוֹת אֲשֶׁר לֹֽא יְדַעְתָּֽם׃
translation: "I will also trouble the hearts of many peoples, when I bring your destruction among the nations, into the countries which you have not known. (Ezekiel 32:9)

text: בָּרוּךְ אֱלֹהִים אֲשֶׁר לֹֽא הֵסִיר תְּפִלָּתִי וְחַסְדּוֹ מֵאִתִּֽי׃
translation: Blessed be God, who has not turned away my prayer, nor his loving kindness from me. (Psalms 66:20)

text: בְּכָל זֹאת לֹא חָטָא אִיּוֹב וְלֹא נָתַן תִּפְלָה לֵאלֹהִֽים׃
translation: In all this, Job didn't sin, nor charge God with wrongdoing. (Job 1:22)

text: יְהוָה אֱלֹהִים צְבָאוֹת שִׁמְעָה תְפִלָּתִי הַאֲזִינָה אֱלֹהֵי יַעֲקֹב סֶֽלָה׃
translation: Behold, God our shield, look at the face of your anointed. (Psalms 84:9)

text: וַאֲנִי אֵלֶיךָ יְהוָה שִׁוַּעְתִּי וּבַבֹּקֶר תְּֽפִלָּתִי תְקַדְּמֶֽךָּ׃
translation: LORD, why do you reject my soul? Why do you hide your face from me? (Psalms 88:14)

text: זֶבַח רְשָׁעִים תּוֹעֲבַת יְהוָה וּתְפִלַּת יְשָׁרִים רְצוֹנֽוֹ׃
translation: The sacrifice made by the wicked is an abomination to the LORD, but the prayer of the upright is his delight. (Proverbs 15:8)

text: מֵסִיר אָזְנוֹ מִשְּׁמֹעַ תּוֹרָה גַּֽם תְּפִלָּתוֹ תּוֹעֵבָֽה׃
translation: He who turns away his ear from hearing the law, even his prayer is an abomination. (Proverbs 28:9)

text: וַיֵּשְׁבוּ בָהּ וַיִּבְנוּ לְךָ בָּהּ מִקְדָּשׁ לְשִׁמְךָ לֵאמֹֽר׃
translation: They lived in it, and have built you a sanctuary in it for your name, saying, (2 Chronicles 20:8)

text: אֶת שַׁבְּתֹתַי תִּשְׁמֹרוּ וּמִקְדָּשִׁי תִּירָאוּ אֲנִי יְהוָֽה׃
translation: "'You shall keep my Sabbaths, and reverence my sanctuary; I am the LORD. (Leviticus 19:30)

text: אֶת שַׁבְּתֹתַי תִּשְׁמֹרוּ וּמִקְדָּשִׁי תִּירָאוּ אֲנִי יְהוָֽה׃
translation: "'You shall keep my Sabbaths, and have reverence for my sanctuary. I am the LORD. (Leviticus 26:2)

text: עַד אָבוֹא אֶל מִקְדְּשֵׁי אֵל אָבִינָה לְאַחֲרִיתָֽם׃
translation: until I entered God's sanctuary, and considered their latter end. (Psalms 73:17)

text: שִׁלְחוּ בָאֵשׁ מִקְדָּשֶׁךָ לָאָרֶץ חִלְּלוּ מִֽשְׁכַּן שְׁמֶֽךָ׃
translation: They have burned your sanctuary to the ground. They have profaned the dwelling place of your Name. (Psalms 74:7)

text: וְלָקַחְתָּ אֵת הַפָּר הַֽחַטָּאת וּשְׂרָפוֹ בְּמִפְקַד הַבַּיִת מִחוּץ לַמִּקְדָּֽשׁ׃
translation: You shall also take the bull of the sin offering, and it shall be burned in the appointed place of the house, outside of the sanctuary. (Ezekiel 43:21)

text: אַשְׂכִּֽילְךָ וְֽאוֹרְךָ בְּדֶֽרֶךְ זוּ תֵלֵךְ אִֽיעֲצָה עָלֶיךָ עֵינִֽי׃
translation: I will instruct you and teach you in the way which you shall go. I will counsel you with my eye on you. (Psalms 32:8)

text: כִּֽי אָמְרוּ אוֹיְבַי לִי וְשֹׁמְרֵי נַפְשִׁי נוֹעֲצוּ יַחְדָּֽו׃
translation: For my enemies talk about me. Those who watch for my soul conspire together, (Psalms 71:10)

text: וַאֲחִיתֹפֶל יוֹעֵץ לַמֶּלֶךְ וְחוּשַׁי הָאַרְכִּי רֵעַ הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
translation: Ahithophel was the king's counselor. Hushai the Archite was the king's friend. (1 Chronicles 27:33)

text: כִּי נוֹעֲצוּ לֵב יַחְדָּו עָלֶיךָ בְּרִית יִכְרֹֽתוּ׃
translation: The tents of Edom and the Ishmaelites; Moab, and the Hagrites; (Psalms 83:6)

text: וְאֵרֶא וְאֵין אִישׁ וּמֵאֵלֶּה וְאֵין יוֹעֵץ וְאֶשְׁאָלֵם וְיָשִׁיבוּ דָבָֽר׃
translation: When I look, there is no man, even among them there is no counselor who, when I ask, can answer a word. (Isaiah 41:28)

text: יַעַן כִּֽי יָעַץ עָלֶיךָ אֲרָם רָעָה אֶפְרַיִם וּבֶן רְמַלְיָהוּ לֵאמֹֽר׃
translation: Because Syria, Ephraim, and the son of Remaliah, have plotted evil against you, saying, (Isaiah 7:5)

text: וְֽהַלְוִיִּם אֲחִיָּה עַל אֽוֹצְרוֹת בֵּית הָאֱלֹהִים וּלְאֹֽצְרוֹת הַקֳּדָשִֽׁים׃
translation: Of the Levites, Ahijah was over the treasures of God's house and over the treasures of the dedicated things. (1 Chronicles 26:20)

text: בְּנֵי יְחִֽיאֵלִי זֵתָם וְיוֹאֵל אָחִיו עַל אֹצְרוֹת בֵּית יְהוָֽה׃
translation: The sons of Jehieli: Zetham, and Joel his brother, over the treasures of the LORD's house. (1 Chronicles 26:22)

text: בְּחָכְמָֽתְךָ וּבִתְבוּנָתְךָ עָשִׂיתָ לְּךָ חָיִל וַתַּעַשׂ זָהָב וָכֶסֶף בְּאוֹצְרוֹתֶֽיךָ׃
translation: By your wisdom and by your understanding you have gotten yourself riches, and have gotten gold and silver into your treasuries. (Ezekiel 28:4)

text: וְעַל הַכְּרָמִים שִׁמְעִי הָרָֽמָתִי וְעַל שֶׁבַּכְּרָמִים לְאֹצְרוֹת הַיַּיִן זַבְדִּי הַשִּׁפְמִֽי׃
translation: Over the vineyards was Shimei the Ramathite. Over the increase of the vineyards for the wine cellars was Zabdi the Shiphmite. (1 Chronicles 27:27)

text: וְלֹא סָרוּ מִצְוַת הַמֶּלֶךְ עַל הַכֹּהֲנִים וְהַלְוִיִּם לְכָל דָּבָר וְלָאֹצָרֽוֹת׃
translation: They didn't depart from the commandment of the king to the priests and Levites concerning any matter or concerning the treasures. (2 Chronicles 8:15)

text: וַיִּתֵּן חִזְקִיָּה אֶת כָּל הַכֶּסֶף הַנִּמְצָא בֵית יְהוָה וּבְאֹצְרוֹת בֵּית הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
translation: Hezekiah gave him all the silver that was found in the LORD's house and in the treasures of the king's house. (2 Kings 18:15)

text: כִּֽי קָרוֹב אֵלֶיךָ הַדָּבָר מְאֹד בְּפִיךָ וּבִֽלְבָבְךָ לַעֲשֹׂתֽוֹ׃
translation: But the word is very near to you, in your mouth and in your heart, that you may do it. (Deuteronomy 30:14)

text: אֹֽהֲבַי וְרֵעַי מִנֶּגֶד נִגְעִי יַעֲמֹדוּ וּקְרוֹבַי מֵרָחֹק עָמָֽדוּ׃
translation: They also who seek after my life lay snares. Those who seek my hurt speak mischievous things, and meditate deceits all day long. (Psalms 38:12)

text: הוֹדִינוּ לְּךָ אֱֽלֹהִים הוֹדִינוּ וְקָרוֹב שְׁמֶךָ סִפְּרוּ נִפְלְאוֹתֶֽיךָ׃
translation: When I choose the appointed time, I will judge blamelessly. (Psalms 75:2)

text: קָרוֹב יְהוָה לְכָל קֹרְאָיו לְכֹל אֲשֶׁר יִקְרָאֻהוּ בֶאֱמֶֽת׃
translation: The LORD is near to all those who call on him, to all who call on him in truth. (Psalms 145:18)

text: הַאֱלֹהֵי מִקָּרֹב אָנִי נְאֻם יְהוָה וְלֹא אֱלֹהֵי מֵרָחֹֽק׃
translation: "Am I a God at hand," says the LORD, "and not a God afar off? (Jeremiah 23:23)

text: לַיְלָה לְיוֹם יָשִׂימוּ אוֹר קָרוֹב מִפְּנֵי חֹֽשֶׁךְ׃
translation: They change the night into day, saying 'The light is near' in the presence of darkness. (Job 17:12)

text: וַיַּעֲמֵד הַכֹּהֲנִים עַל מִשְׁמְרוֹתָם וַֽיְחַזְּקֵם לַעֲבוֹדַת בֵּית יְהוָֽה׃
translation: He set the priests in their offices and encouraged them in the service of the LORD's house. (2 Chronicles 35:2)

text: וְהֵם וּבְנֵיהֶם עַל הַשְּׁעָרִים לְבֵית יְהוָה לְבֵית הָאֹהֶל לְמִשְׁמָרֽוֹת׃
translation: So they and their children had the oversight of the gates of the LORD's house, even the house of the tent, as guards. (1 Chronicles 9:23)

text: וְטִֽהַרְתִּים מִכָּל נֵכָר וָאַעֲמִידָה מִשְׁמָרוֹת לַכֹּהֲנִים וְלַלְוִיִּם אִישׁ בִּמְלַאכְתּֽוֹ׃
translation: Thus I cleansed them from all foreigners and appointed duties for the priests and for the Levites, everyone in his work; (Nehemiah 13:30)

text: וְלֹא שְׁמַרְתֶּם מִשְׁמֶרֶת קָדָשָׁי וַתְּשִׂימוּן לְשֹׁמְרֵי מִשְׁמַרְתִּי בְּמִקְדָּשִׁי לָכֶֽם׃
translation: You have not performed the duty of my holy things; but you have set performers of my duty in my sanctuary for yourselves." (Ezekiel 44:8)

text: וּבַקְבֻּֽקְיָה וענו וְעֻנִּי אֲחֵיהֶם לְנֶגְדָּם לְמִשְׁמָרֽוֹת׃
translation: Also Bakbukiah and Unno, their brothers, were close to them according to their offices. (Nehemiah 12:9)

text: וְאָהַבְתָּ אֵת יְהוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ וְשָׁמַרְתָּ מִשְׁמַרְתּוֹ וְחֻקֹּתָיו וּמִשְׁפָּטָיו וּמִצְוֺתָיו כָּל הַיָּמִֽים׃
translation: Therefore you shall love the LORD your God, and keep his instructions, his statutes, his ordinances, and his commandments, always. (Deuteronomy 11:1)

text: קוֹלִי אֶל יְהוָה אֶקְרָא וַיַּֽעֲנֵנִי מֵהַר קָדְשׁוֹ סֶֽלָה׃
translation: I laid myself down and slept. I awakened, for the LORD sustains me. (Psalms 3:5)

text: זֶה דּוֹר דרשו דֹּרְשָׁיו מְבַקְשֵׁי פָנֶיךָ יַעֲקֹב סֶֽלָה׃
translation: This is the generation of those who seek Him, who seek your face—even Jacob. Selah. (Psalms 24:6)

text: בֵּֽאלֹהִים הִלַּלְנוּ כָל הַיּוֹם וְשִׁמְךָ לְעוֹלָם נוֹדֶה סֶֽלָה׃
translation: But now you rejected us, and brought us to dishonor, and don't go out with our armies. (Psalms 44:9)

text: וַיַּגִּידוּ שָׁמַיִם צִדְקוֹ כִּֽי אֱלֹהִים שֹׁפֵט הוּא סֶֽלָה׃
translation: The heavens shall declare his righteousness, for God himself is judge. Selah. (Psalms 50:6)

text: יְֽהוָה יִסְפֹּר בִּכְתוֹב עַמִּים זֶה יֻלַּד שָׁם סֶֽלָה׃
translation: The LORD will count, when he writes up the peoples, "This one was born there." Selah. (Psalms 87:6)

text: אָהַבְתָּ רָּע מִטּוֹב שֶׁקֶר מִדַּבֵּר צֶדֶק סֶֽלָה׃
translation: God will likewise destroy you forever. He will take you up, and pluck you out of your tent, and root you out of the land of the living. Selah. (Psalms 52:5)

text: וְהָיָה בְּעַֽנְנִי עָנָן עַל הָאָרֶץ וְנִרְאֲתָה הַקֶּשֶׁת בֶּעָנָֽן׃
translation: When I bring a cloud over the earth, that the rainbow will be seen in the cloud, (Genesis 9:14)

text: אִם לֹא יָשׁוּב חַרְבּוֹ יִלְטוֹשׁ קַשְׁתּוֹ דָרַךְ וַֽיְכוֹנְנֶֽהָ׃
translation: He has also prepared for himself the instruments of death. He makes ready his flaming arrows. (Psalms 7:13)

text: כִּי לֹא בְקַשְׁתִּי אֶבְטָח וְחַרְבִּי לֹא תוֹשִׁיעֵֽנִי׃
translation: But you have saved us from our adversaries, and have shamed those who hate us. (Psalms 44:7)

text: אֶת קַשְׁתִּי נָתַתִּי בֶּֽעָנָן וְהָֽיְתָה לְאוֹת בְּרִית בֵּינִי וּבֵין הָאָֽרֶץ׃
translation: I set my rainbow in the cloud, and it will be a sign of a covenant between me and the earth. (Genesis 9:13)

text: וַיְהִי אֱלֹהִים אֶת הַנַּעַר וַיִּגְדָּל וַיֵּשֶׁב בַּמִּדְבָּר וַיְהִי רֹבֶה קַשָּֽׁת׃
translation: God was with the boy, and he grew. He lived in the wilderness, and as he grew up, he became an archer. (Genesis 21:20)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר לְלַמֵּד בְּנֵֽי יְהוּדָה קָשֶׁת הִנֵּה כְתוּבָה עַל סֵפֶר הַיָּשָֽׁר׃
translation: (and he commanded them to teach the children of Judah the song of the bow; behold, it is written in the book of Jashar): (2 Samuel 1:18)

text: רַבִּים אֹמְרִים לְנַפְשִׁי אֵין יְֽשׁוּעָתָה לּוֹ בֵֽאלֹהִים סֶֽלָה׃
translation: But you, LORD, are a shield around me, my glory, and the one who lifts up my head. (Psalms 3:3)

text: שִׁירוּ לַיהוָה בָּרֲכוּ שְׁמוֹ בַּשְּׂרוּ מִיּֽוֹם לְיוֹם יְשׁוּעָתֽוֹ׃
translation: Sing to the LORD! Bless his name! Proclaim his salvation from day to day! (Psalms 96:2)

text: שִׁירוּ לַֽיהוָה כָּל הָאָרֶץ בַּשְּׂרוּ מִיּֽוֹם אֶל יוֹם יְשׁוּעָתֽוֹ׃
translation: Sing to the LORD, all the earth! Display his salvation from day to day. (1 Chronicles 16:23)

text: אַתָּה הוּא מַלְכִּי אֱלֹהִים צַוֵּה יְשׁוּעוֹת יַעֲקֹֽב׃
translation: Through you, we will push down our adversaries. Through your name, we will tread down those who rise up against us. (Psalms 44:5)

text: אַךְ אֶל אֱלֹהִים דּֽוּמִיָּה נַפְשִׁי מִמֶּנּוּ יְשׁוּעָתִֽי׃
translation: He alone is my rock, my salvation, and my fortress. I will never be greatly shaken. (Psalms 62:2)

text: וֵאלֹהִים מַלְכִּי מִקֶּדֶם פֹּעֵל יְשׁוּעוֹת בְּקֶרֶב הָאָֽרֶץ׃
translation: Yet God is my King of old, working salvation throughout the earth. (Psalms 74:12)

text: עַל פִּי הַגּוֹרָל תֵּחָלֵק נַחֲלָתוֹ בֵּין רַב לִמְעָֽט׃
translation: According to the lot shall their inheritance be divided between the more and the fewer." (Numbers 26:56)

text: וְעַתָּה זֶה הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר נַעֲשֶׂה לַגִּבְעָה עָלֶיהָ בְּגוֹרָֽל׃
translation: But now this is the thing which we will do to Gibeah: we will go up against it by lot; (Judges 20:9)

text: וַיַּפִּילוּ גוֹרָלוֹת כַּקָּטֹן כַּגָּדוֹל לְבֵית אֲבוֹתָם לְשַׁעַר וָשָֽׁעַר׃
translation: They cast lots, the small as well as the great, according to their fathers' houses, for every gate. (1 Chronicles 26:13)

text: אַךְ בְּגוֹרָל יֵחָלֵק אֶת הָאָרֶץ לִשְׁמוֹת מַטּוֹת אֲבֹתָם יִנְחָֽלוּ׃
translation: Notwithstanding, the land shall be divided by lot. According to the names of the tribes of their fathers they shall inherit. (Numbers 26:55)

text: לְמַטֵּה בְנֵי דָן לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם יָצָא הַגּוֹרָל הַשְּׁבִיעִֽי׃
translation: The seventh lot came out for the tribe of the children of Dan according to their families. (Joshua 19:40)

text: לָכֵן לֹֽא יִֽהְיֶה לְךָ מַשְׁלִיךְ חֶבֶל בְּגוֹרָל בִּקְהַל יְהוָֽה׃
translation: Therefore you will have no one who divides the land by lot in the LORD's assembly. (Micah 2:5)

text: עִנּוּ בַכֶּבֶל רגליו רַגְלוֹ בַּרְזֶל בָּאָה נַפְשֽׁוֹ׃
translation: They bruised his feet with shackles. His neck was locked in irons, (Psalms 105:18)

text: וְהָיוּ שָׁמֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר עַל רֹאשְׁךָ נְחֹשֶׁת וְהָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר תַּחְתֶּיךָ בַּרְזֶֽל׃
translation: Your sky that is over your head will be bronze, and the earth that is under you will be iron. (Deuteronomy 28:23)

text: יֹשְׁבֵי חֹשֶׁךְ וְצַלְמָוֶת אֲסִירֵי עֳנִי וּבַרְזֶֽל׃
translation: Some sat in darkness and in the shadow of death, being bound in affliction and iron, (Psalms 107:10)

text: בַּרְזֶל וּנְחֹשֶׁת מִנְעָלֶיךָ וּכְיָמֶיךָ דָּבְאֶֽךָ׃
translation: Your bars will be iron and bronze. As your days, so your strength will be. (Deuteronomy 33:25)

text: לַזָּהָב לַכֶּסֶף וְלַנְּחֹשֶׁת וְלַבַּרְזֶל אֵין מִסְפָּר קוּם וַעֲשֵׂה וִיהִי יְהוָה עִמָּֽךְ׃
translation: of the gold, the silver, the bronze, and the iron, there is no number. Arise and be doing, and may the LORD be with you." (1 Chronicles 22:16)

text: הֲיָרֹעַ בַּרְזֶל בַּרְזֶל מִצָּפוֹן וּנְחֹֽשֶׁת׃
translation: Can one break iron, even iron from the north, and bronze? (Jeremiah 15:12)

text: וַיַּצֶּב שָׁם מִזְבֵּחַ וַיִּקְרָא לוֹ אֵל אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
translation: He erected an altar there, and called it El Elohe Israel. (Genesis 33:20)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה הִנֵּה מָקוֹם אִתִּי וְנִצַּבְתָּ עַל הַצּֽוּר׃
translation: The LORD also said, "Behold, there is a place by me, and you shall stand on the rock. (Exodus 33:21)

text: וַיָּשָׁב אֵלָיו וְהִנֵּה נִצָּב עַל עֹלָתוֹ הוּא וְכָל שָׂרֵי מוֹאָֽב׃
translation: He returned to him, and behold, he was standing by his burnt offering, he, and all the princes of Moab. (Numbers 23:6)

text: וְֽהָיְתָה הַפְּצִירָה פִים לַמַּֽחֲרֵשֹׁת וְלָאֵתִים וְלִשְׁלֹשׁ קִלְּשׁוֹן וּלְהַקַּרְדֻּמִּים וּלְהַצִּיב הַדָּרְבָֽן׃
translation: The price was one payim each to sharpen mattocks, plowshares, pitchforks, axes, and goads. (1 Samuel 13:21)

text: נִצָּב לָרִיב יְהוָה וְעֹמֵד לָדִין עַמִּֽים׃
translation: The LORD stands up to contend, and stands to judge the peoples. (Isaiah 3:13)

text: כֹּה הִרְאַנִי וְהִנֵּה אֲדֹנָי נִצָּב עַל חוֹמַת אֲנָךְ וּבְיָדוֹ אֲנָֽךְ׃
translation: Thus he showed me: behold, the Lord stood beside a wall made by a plumb line, with a plumb line in his hand. (Amos 7:7)

text: שָׁם פָּחֲדוּ פָחַד כִּֽי אֱלֹהִים בְּדוֹר צַדִּֽיק׃
translation: There they were in great fear, for God is in the generation of the righteous. (Psalms 14:5)

text: שָׂמַח מִצְרַיִם בְּצֵאתָם כִּֽי נָפַל פַּחְדָּם עֲלֵיהֶֽם׃
translation: Egypt was glad when they departed, for the fear of them had fallen on them. (Psalms 105:38)

text: וְשֹׁמֵעַֽ לִי יִשְׁכָּן בֶּטַח וְשַׁאֲנַן מִפַּחַד רָעָֽה׃
translation: But whoever listens to me will dwell securely, and will be at ease, without fear of harm." (Proverbs 1:33)

text: אִם תִּשְׁכַּב לֹֽא תִפְחָד וְשָׁכַבְתָּ וְֽעָרְבָה שְׁנָתֶֽךָ׃
translation: When you lie down, you will not be afraid. Yes, you will lie down, and your sleep will be sweet. (Proverbs 3:24)

text: נְאֻֽם פֶּשַׁע לָרָשָׁע בְּקֶרֶב לִבִּי אֵֽין פַּחַד אֱלֹהִים לְנֶגֶד עֵינָֽיו׃
translation: For he flatters himself in his own eyes, too much to detect and hate his sin. (Psalms 36:2)

text: סָמַר מִפַּחְדְּךָ בְשָׂרִי וּֽמִמִּשְׁפָּטֶיךָ יָרֵֽאתִי׃
translation: My flesh trembles for fear of you. I am afraid of your judgments. AYIN (Psalms 119:120)

text: כִּי לֹא סָגַר דַּלְתֵי בִטְנִי וַיַּסְתֵּר עָמָל מֵעֵינָֽי׃
translation: because it didn't shut up the doors of my mother's womb, nor did it hide trouble from my eyes. (Job 3:10)

text: נֶפֶשׁ עָמֵל עָמְלָה לּוֹ כִּֽי אָכַף עָלָיו פִּֽיהוּ׃
translation: The appetite of the laboring man labors for him, for his mouth urges him on. (Proverbs 16:26)

text: כָּל עֲמַל הָאָדָם לְפִיהוּ וְגַם הַנֶּפֶשׁ לֹא תִמָּלֵֽא׃
translation: All the labor of man is for his mouth, and yet the appetite is not filled. (Ecclesiastes 6:7)

text: כִּי אַתָּה עָמָל תִּשְׁכָּח כְּמַיִם עָבְרוּ תִזְכֹּֽר׃
translation: for you will forget your misery. You will remember it like waters that have passed away. (Job 11:16)

text: בַּעֲמַל אֱנוֹשׁ אֵינֵמוֹ וְעִם אָדָם לֹא יְנֻגָּֽעוּ׃
translation: They are free from burdens of men, neither are they plagued like other men. (Psalms 73:5)

text: וָֽאֲחַשְּׁבָה לָדַעַת זֹאת עָמָל היא הוּא בְעֵינָֽי׃
translation: When I tried to understand this, it was too painful for me— (Psalms 73:16)

text: וְזֹאת הַתְּרוּמָה אֲשֶׁר תִּקְחוּ מֵאִתָּם זָהָב וָכֶסֶף וּנְחֹֽשֶׁת׃
translation: This is the offering which you shall take from them: gold, silver, bronze, (Exodus 25:3)

text: וְהָיָה בַּאֲכָלְכֶם מִלֶּחֶם הָאָרֶץ תָּרִימוּ תְרוּמָה לַיהוָֽה׃
translation: then it shall be that when you eat of the bread of the land, you shall offer up a wave offering to the LORD. (Numbers 15:19)

text: כֹּל הָעָם הָאָרֶץ יִהְיוּ אֶל הַתְּרוּמָה הַזֹּאת לַנָּשִׂיא בְּיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
translation: "All the people of the land shall give to this offering for the prince in Israel. (Ezekiel 45:16)

text: מֵרֵאשִׁית עֲרִסֹתֵיכֶם תִּתְּנוּ לַיהוָה תְּרוּמָה לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶֽם׃
translation: Of the first of your dough, you shall give to the LORD a wave offering throughout your generations. (Numbers 15:21)

text: וְהָיְתָה לָהֶם תְּרוּמִיָּה מִתְּרוּמַת הָאָרֶץ קֹדֶשׁ קָדָשִׁים אֶל גְּבוּל הַלְוִיִּֽם׃
translation: It shall be to them an offering from the offering of the land, a most holy thing, by the border of the Levites. (Ezekiel 48:12)

text: כֹּל הָעֹבֵר עַל הַפְּקֻדִים מִבֶּן עֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה וָמָעְלָה יִתֵּן תְּרוּמַת יְהוָֽה׃
translation: Everyone who passes over to those who are counted, from twenty years old and upward, shall give the offering to the LORD. (Exodus 30:14)

text: כֶּסֶף נִמְאָס קָרְאוּ לָהֶם כִּֽי מָאַס יְהוָה בָּהֶֽם׃
translation: Men will call them rejected silver, because the LORD has rejected them." (Jeremiah 6:30)

text: גַּם עֲוִילִים מָאֲסוּ בִי אָקוּמָה וַיְדַבְּרוּ בִֽי׃
translation: Even young children despise me. If I arise, they speak against me. (Job 19:18)

text: אִם אֶמְאַס מִשְׁפַּט עַבְדִּי וַאֲמָתִי בְּרִבָם עִמָּדִֽי׃
translation: "If I have despised the cause of my male servant or of my female servant, when they contended with me, (Job 31:13)

text: וַיִּמְאַס בְּאֹהֶל יוֹסֵף וּֽבְשֵׁבֶט אֶפְרַיִם לֹא בָחָֽר׃
translation: Moreover he rejected the tent of Joseph, and didn't choose the tribe of Ephraim, (Psalms 78:67)

text: שָׁמַע אֱלֹהִים וַֽיִּתְעַבָּר וַיִּמְאַס מְאֹד בְּיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
translation: When God heard this, he was angry, and greatly abhorred Israel, (Psalms 78:59)

text: וְאַתָּה זָנַחְתָּ וַתִּמְאָס הִתְעַבַּרְתָּ עִם מְשִׁיחֶֽךָ׃
translation: You have renounced the covenant of your servant. You have defiled his crown in the dust. (Psalms 89:39)

text: שְׁבֹר זְרוֹעַ רָשָׁע וָרָע תִּֽדְרוֹשׁ רִשְׁעוֹ בַל תִּמְצָֽא׃
translation: Break the arm of the wicked. As for the evil man, seek out his wickedness until you find none. (Psalms 10:15)

text: גְּֽבוּל שַׂמְתָּ בַּל יַֽעֲבֹרוּן בַּל יְשׁוּבוּן לְכַסּוֹת הָאָֽרֶץ׃
translation: You have set a boundary that they may not pass over, that they don't turn again to cover the earth. (Psalms 104:9)

text: לֵךְ מִנֶּגֶד לְאִישׁ כְּסִיל וּבַל יָדַעְתָּ שִׂפְתֵי דָֽעַת׃
translation: Stay away from a foolish man, for you won't find knowledge on his lips. (Proverbs 14:7)

text: גַּם אֵלֶּה לַֽחֲכָמִים הַֽכֵּר פָּנִים בְּמִשְׁפָּט בַּל טֽוֹב׃
translation: These also are sayings of the wise: To show partiality in judgment is not good. (Proverbs 24:23)

text: אָמַר בְּלִבּוֹ בַּל אֶמּוֹט לְדֹר וָדֹר אֲשֶׁר לֹֽא בְרָֽע׃
translation: He says in his heart, "I shall not be shaken. For generations I shall have no trouble." (Psalms 10:6)

text: אָמַר בְּלִבּוֹ שָׁכַֽח אֵל הִסְתִּיר פָּנָיו בַּל רָאָה לָנֶֽצַח׃
translation: He says in his heart, "God has forgotten. He hides his face. He will never see it." (Psalms 10:11)

text: וְלָקַח הַכֹּהֵן הַטֶּנֶא מִיָּדֶךָ וְהִנִּיחוֹ לִפְנֵי מִזְבַּח יְהוָה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ׃
translation: The priest shall take the basket out of your hand, and set it down before the LORD your God's altar. (Deuteronomy 26:4)

text: וְעַתָּה הַנִּיחָה לִּי וְיִֽחַר אַפִּי בָהֶם וַאֲכַלֵּם וְאֶֽעֱשֶׂה אוֹתְךָ לְגוֹי גָּדֽוֹל׃
translation: Now therefore leave me alone, that my wrath may burn hot against them, and that I may consume them; and I will make of you a great nation." (Exodus 32:10)

text: כִּי תְשׁוּבֻן מֵֽאַחֲרָיו וְיָסַף עוֹד לְהַנִּיחוֹ בַּמִּדְבָּר וְשִֽׁחַתֶּם לְכָל הָעָם הַזֶּֽה׃
translation: For if you turn away from after him, he will yet again leave them in the wilderness; and you will destroy all these people." (Numbers 32:15)

text: וְהִנַּחְתֶּם שִׁמְכֶם לִשְׁבוּעָה לִבְחִירַי וֶהֱמִיתְךָ אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה וְלַעֲבָדָיו יִקְרָא שֵׁם אַחֵֽר׃
translation: You will leave your name for a curse to my chosen, and the Lord GOD will kill you. He will call his servants by another name, (Isaiah 65:15)

text: וּבְשַׂר זֶבַח תּוֹדַת שְׁלָמָיו בְּיוֹם קָרְבָּנוֹ יֵאָכֵל לֹֽא יַנִּיחַ מִמֶּנּוּ עַד בֹּֽקֶר׃
translation: The flesh of the sacrifice of his peace offerings for thanksgiving shall be eaten on the day of his offering. He shall not leave any of it until the morning. (Leviticus 7:15)

text: וַיַּנַּח יְהוָה אֶת הַגּוֹיִם הָאֵלֶּה לְבִלְתִּי הוֹרִישָׁם מַהֵר וְלֹא נְתָנָם בְּיַד יְהוֹשֻֽׁעַ׃
translation: So the LORD left those nations, without driving them out hastily. He didn't deliver them into Joshua's hand. (Judges 2:23)

text: וְרָחֲצוּ אַהֲרֹן וּבָנָיו מִמֶּנּוּ אֶת יְדֵיהֶם וְאֶת רַגְלֵיהֶֽם׃
translation: Aaron and his sons shall wash their hands and their feet in it. (Exodus 30:19)

text: וַיִּרְחַץ פָּנָיו וַיֵּצֵא וַיִּתְאַפַּק וַיֹּאמֶר שִׂימוּ לָֽחֶם׃
translation: He washed his face, and came out. He controlled himself, and said, "Serve the meal." (Genesis 43:31)

text: וְרָחֲצוּ מִמֶּנּוּ מֹשֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן וּבָנָיו אֶת יְדֵיהֶם וְאֶת רַגְלֵיהֶֽם׃
translation: Moses, Aaron, and his sons washed their hands and their feet there. (Exodus 40:31)

text: וַיַּקְרֵב מֹשֶׁה אֶֽת אַהֲרֹן וְאֶת בָּנָיו וַיִּרְחַץ אֹתָם בַּמָּֽיִם׃
translation: Moses brought Aaron and his sons, and washed them with water. (Leviticus 8:6)

text: אֶרְחַץ בְּנִקָּיוֹן כַּפָּי וַאֲסֹבְבָה אֶת מִזְבַּחֲךָ יְהוָֽה׃
translation: I will wash my hands in innocence, so I will go about your altar, LORD, (Psalms 26:6)

text: דּוֹר טָהוֹר בְּעֵינָיו וּמִצֹּאָתוֹ לֹא רֻחָֽץ׃
translation: There is a generation that is pure in their own eyes, yet are not washed from their filthiness. (Proverbs 30:12)

text: יֹלֵד כְּסִיל לְתוּגָה לוֹ וְלֹֽא יִשְׂמַח אֲבִי נָבָֽל׃
translation: He who becomes the father of a fool grieves. The father of a fool has no joy. (Proverbs 17:21)

text: אֶת פְּנֵי מֵבִין חָכְמָה וְעֵינֵי כְסִיל בִּקְצֵה אָֽרֶץ׃
translation: Wisdom is before the face of one who has understanding, but the eyes of a fool wander to the ends of the earth. (Proverbs 17:24)

text: אִֽישׁ בַּעַר לֹא יֵדָע וּכְסִיל לֹא יָבִין אֶת זֹֽאת׃
translation: though the wicked spring up as the grass, and all the evildoers flourish, they will be destroyed forever. (Psalms 92:7)

text: הלוך הוֹלֵךְ אֶת חֲכָמִים וחכם יֶחְכָּם וְרֹעֶה כְסִילִים יֵרֽוֹעַ׃
translation: One who walks with wise men grows wise, but a companion of fools suffers harm. (Proverbs 13:20)

text: חָכָם יָרֵא וְסָר מֵרָע וּכְסִיל מִתְעַבֵּר וּבוֹטֵֽחַ׃
translation: A wise man fears and shuns evil, but the fool is hot headed and reckless. (Proverbs 14:16)

text: שִׂפְתֵי כְסִיל יָבֹאֽוּ בְרִיב וּפִיו לְֽמַהֲלֻמוֹת יִקְרָֽא׃
translation: A fool's lips come into strife, and his mouth invites beatings. (Proverbs 18:6)

text: אָרוּר פְּרִֽי בִטְנְךָ וּפְרִי אַדְמָתֶךָ שְׁגַר אֲלָפֶיךָ וְעַשְׁתְּרוֹת צֹאנֶֽךָ׃
translation: The fruit of your body, the fruit of your ground, the increase of your livestock, and the young of your flock will be cursed. (Deuteronomy 28:18)

text: הֲֽלֹא בַבֶּטֶן עֹשֵׂנִי עָשָׂהוּ וַיְכֻנֶנּוּ בָּרֶחֶם אֶחָֽד׃
translation: Didn't he who made me in the womb make him? Didn't one fashion us in the womb? (Job 31:15)

text: עָלֶיךָ הָשְׁלַכְתִּי מֵרָחֶם מִבֶּטֶן אִמִּי אֵלִי אָֽתָּה׃
translation: Don't be far from me, for trouble is near. For there is no one to help. (Psalms 22:11)

text: הִנֵּה נַחֲלַת יְהוָה בָּנִים שָׂכָר פְּרִי הַבָּֽטֶן׃
translation: Behold, children are a heritage of the LORD. The fruit of the womb is his reward. (Psalms 127:3)

text: אֶפְרַיִם כָּעוֹף יִתְעוֹפֵף כְּבוֹדָם מִלֵּדָה וּמִבֶּטֶן וּמֵהֵרָיֽוֹן׃
translation: As for Ephraim, their glory will fly away like a bird. There will be no birth, no one with child, and no conception. (Hosea 9:11)

text: וַיִּמְלְאוּ יָמֶיהָ לָלֶדֶת וְהִנֵּה תוֹמִם בְּבִטְנָֽהּ׃
translation: When her days to be delivered were fulfilled, behold, there were twins in her womb. (Genesis 25:24)

text: וּבַחֹדֶשׁ הָרִאשׁוֹן בְּאַרְבָּעָה עָשָׂר יוֹם לַחֹדֶשׁ פֶּסַח לַיהוָֽה׃
translation: "'In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, is the LORD's Passover. (Numbers 28:16)

text: בִּשְׁמוֹנֶה עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה לְמַלְכוּת יֹאשִׁיָּהוּ נַעֲשָׂה הַפֶּסַח הַזֶּֽה׃
translation: This Passover was kept in the eighteenth year of the reign of Josiah. (2 Chronicles 35:19)

text: בַּחֹדֶשׁ הָרִאשׁוֹן בְּאַרְבָּעָה עָשָׂר לַחֹדֶשׁ בֵּין הָעַרְבָּיִם פֶּסַח לַיהוָֽה׃
translation: In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month in the evening, is the LORD's Passover. (Leviticus 23:5)

text: וַיְדַבֵּר מֹשֶׁה אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לַעֲשֹׂת הַפָּֽסַח׃
translation: Moses told the children of Israel that they should keep the Passover. (Numbers 9:4)

text: וְיַעֲשׂוּ בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת הַפָּסַח בְּמוֹעֲדֽוֹ׃
translation: "Let the children of Israel keep the Passover in its appointed season. (Numbers 9:2)

text: וַיִּוָּעַץ הַמֶּלֶךְ וְשָׂרָיו וְכָל הַקָּהָל בִּירוּשָׁלִָם לַעֲשׂוֹת הַפֶּסַח בַּחֹדֶשׁ הַשֵּׁנִֽי׃
translation: For the king had taken counsel with his princes and all the assembly in Jerusalem to keep the Passover in the second month. (2 Chronicles 30:2)

text: וַיָּבֵא אֶת הַכֹּהֲנִים וְאֶת הַלְוִיִּם וַיַּֽאַסְפֵם לִרְחוֹב הַמִּזְרָֽח׃
translation: He brought in the priests and the Levites and gathered them together into the wide place on the east, (2 Chronicles 29:4)

text: אֵלֶּה אֲשֶׁר נִחַל מֹשֶׁה בְּעַֽרְבוֹת מוֹאָב מֵעֵבֶר לְיַרְדֵּן יְרִיחוֹ מִזְרָֽחָה׃
translation: These are the inheritances which Moses distributed in the plains of Moab, beyond the Jordan at Jericho, eastward. (Joshua 13:32)

text: וְלִפְאַת קֵדְמָה מִזְרָחָה חֲמִשִּׁים אַמָּֽה׃
translation: For the east side eastward fifty cubits, (Exodus 38:13)

text: שְׁנֵי הַמַּטּוֹת וַחֲצִי הַמַּטֶּה לָקְחוּ נַחֲלָתָם מֵעֵבֶר לְיַרְדֵּן יְרֵחוֹ קֵדְמָה מִזְרָֽחָה׃
translation: The two tribes and the half-tribe have received their inheritance beyond the Jordan at Jericho eastward, toward the sunrise." (Numbers 34:15)

text: וַיִּסְעוּ מֵאֹבֹת וַֽיַּחֲנוּ בְּעִיֵּי הָֽעֲבָרִים בַּמִּדְבָּר אֲשֶׁר עַל פְּנֵי מוֹאָב מִמִּזְרַח הַשָּֽׁמֶשׁ׃
translation: They traveled from Oboth, and encamped at Iyeabarim, in the wilderness which is before Moab, toward the sunrise. (Numbers 21:11)

text: נֶגְבָּה לְאֶפְרַיִם וְצָפוֹנָה לִמְנַשֶּׁה וַיְהִי הַיָּם גְּבוּלוֹ וּבְאָשֵׁר יִפְגְּעוּן מִצָּפוֹן וּבְיִשָּׂשכָר מִמִּזְרָֽח׃
translation: Southward it was Ephraim's, and northward it was Manasseh's, and the sea was his border. They reached to Asher on the north, and to Issachar on the east. (Joshua 17:10)

text: קוֹל יְהוָה שֹׁבֵר אֲרָזִים וַיְשַׁבֵּר יְהוָה אֶת אַרְזֵי הַלְּבָנֽוֹן׃
translation: The LORD's voice breaks the cedars. Yes, the LORD breaks in pieces the cedars of Lebanon. (Psalms 29:5)

text: יִשְׂבְּעוּ עֲצֵי יְהוָה אַֽרְזֵי לְבָנוֹן אֲשֶׁר נָטָֽע׃
translation: The LORD's trees are well watered, the cedars of Lebanon, which he has planted, (Psalms 104:16)

text: הֶהָרִים וְכָל גְּבָעוֹת עֵץ פְּרִי וְכָל אֲרָזִֽים׃
translation: mountains and all hills, fruit trees and all cedars, (Psalms 148:9)

text: קֹרוֹת בָּתֵּינוּ אֲרָזִים רחיטנו רַהִיטֵנוּ בְּרוֹתִֽים׃
translation: The beams of our house are cedars. Our rafters are firs. (Song of Solomon 1:17)

text: פְּתַח לְבָנוֹן דְּלָתֶיךָ וְתֹאכַל אֵשׁ בַּאֲרָזֶֽיךָ׃
translation: Open your doors, Lebanon, that the fire may devour your cedars. (Zechariah 11:1)

text: ישבתי יֹשַׁבְתְּ בַּלְּבָנוֹן מקננתי מְקֻנַּנְתְּ בָּֽאֲרָזִים מַה נֵּחַנְתְּ בְּבֹא לָךְ חֲבָלִים חִיל כַּיֹּלֵדָֽה׃
translation: Inhabitant of Lebanon, who makes your nest in the cedars, how greatly to be pitied you will be when pangs come on you, the pain as of a woman in travail! (Jeremiah 22:23)

text: וַיֵּשֶׁב הָאָשֵׁרִי בְּקֶרֶב הַֽכְּנַעֲנִי יֹשְׁבֵי הָאָרֶץ כִּי לֹא הוֹרִישֽׁוֹ׃
translation: but the Asherites lived among the Canaanites, the inhabitants of the land, for they didn't drive them out. (Judges 1:32)

text: וְאֶת הָֽאַרְוָדִי וְאֶת הַצְּמָרִי וְאֶת הַֽחֲמָתִי וְאַחַר נָפֹצוּ מִשְׁפְּחוֹת הַֽכְּנַעֲנִֽי׃
translation: the Arvadites, the Zemarites, and the Hamathites. Afterward the families of the Canaanites were spread abroad. (Genesis 10:18)

text: וּבְנֵי שִׁמְעוֹן יְמוּאֵל וְיָמִין וְאֹהַד וְיָכִין וְצֹחַר וְשָׁאוּל בֶּן הַֽכְּנַעֲנִֽית׃
translation: The sons of Simeon: Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jachin, Zohar, and Shaul the son of a Canaanite woman. (Genesis 46:10)

text: וַיַּרְא שָׁם יְהוּדָה בַּת אִישׁ כְּנַעֲנִי וּשְׁמוֹ שׁוּעַ וַיִּקָּחֶהָ וַיָּבֹא אֵלֶֽיהָ׃
translation: There, Judah saw the daughter of a certain Canaanite man named Shua. He took her, and went in to her. (Genesis 38:2)

text: וְאֶפְרַיִם לֹא הוֹרִישׁ אֶת הַֽכְּנַעֲנִי הַיּוֹשֵׁב בְּגָזֶר וַיֵּשֶׁב הַֽכְּנַעֲנִי בְּקִרְבּוֹ בְּגָֽזֶר׃
translation: Ephraim didn't drive out the Canaanites who lived in Gezer, but the Canaanites lived in Gezer among them. (Judges 1:29)

text: וַיִּשְׁמַע הַֽכְּנַעֲנִי מֶלֶךְ עֲרָד וְהֽוּא יֹשֵׁב בַּנֶּגֶב בְּאֶרֶץ כְּנָעַן בְּבֹא בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
translation: The Canaanite king of Arad, who lived in the South in the land of Canaan, heard of the coming of the children of Israel. (Numbers 33:40)

text: וַתַּנַּח בִּגְדוֹ אֶצְלָהּ עַד בּוֹא אֲדֹנָיו אֶל בֵּיתֽוֹ׃
translation: She laid up his garment by her, until his master came home. (Genesis 39:16)

text: וָאֶשְׁמַע מִדַּבֵּר אֵלַי מֵהַבָּיִת וְאִישׁ הָיָה עֹמֵד אֶצְלִֽי׃
translation: I heard one speaking to me out of the house, and a man stood by me. (Ezekiel 43:6)

text: וַיְהִי כַּהֲרִימִי קוֹלִי וָאֶקְרָא וַיַּעֲזֹב בִּגְדוֹ אֶצְלִי וַיָּנָס הַחֽוּצָה׃
translation: and as I lifted up my voice and cried, he left his garment by me, and ran outside." (Genesis 39:18)

text: וַיַּעַבְרוּ וַיֵּלֵכוּ וַתָּבֹא לָהֶם הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ אֵצֶל הַגִּבְעָה אֲשֶׁר לְבִנְיָמִֽן׃
translation: So they passed on and went their way; and the sun went down on them near Gibeah, which belongs to Benjamin. (Judges 19:14)

text: וַיְהִי כְשָׁמְעוֹ כִּֽי הֲרִימֹתִי קוֹלִי וָאֶקְרָא וַיַּעֲזֹב בִּגְדוֹ אֶצְלִי וַיָּנָס וַיֵּצֵא הַחֽוּצָה׃
translation: When he heard that I lifted up my voice and cried, he left his garment by me, and ran outside." (Genesis 39:15)

text: בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא יִֽהְיֶה מִזְבֵּחַ לַֽיהוָה בְּתוֹךְ אֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם וּמַצֵּבָה אֵֽצֶל גְּבוּלָהּ לַֽיהוָֽה׃
translation: In that day, there will be an altar to the LORD in the middle of the land of Egypt, and a pillar to the LORD at its border. (Isaiah 19:19)

text: מִכָּל פְּשָׁעַי הַצִּילֵנִי חֶרְפַּת נָבָל אַל תְּשִׂימֵֽנִי׃
translation: I was mute. I didn't open my mouth, because you did it. (Psalms 39:9)

text: שַׁסֻּהוּ כָּל עֹבְרֵי דָרֶךְ הָיָה חֶרְפָּה לִשְׁכֵנָֽיו׃
translation: You have exalted the right hand of his adversaries. You have made all of his enemies rejoice. (Psalms 89:42)

text: וְנָתַתִּי עֲלֵיכֶם חֶרְפַּת עוֹלָם וּכְלִמּוּת עוֹלָם אֲשֶׁר לֹא תִשָּׁכֵֽחַ׃
translation: I will bring an everlasting reproach on you, and a perpetual shame, which will not be forgotten.'" (Jeremiah 23:40)

text: קוּמָה אֱלֹהִים רִיבָה רִיבֶךָ זְכֹר חֶרְפָּתְךָ מִנִּי נָבָל כָּל הַיּֽוֹם׃
translation: Arise, God! Plead your own cause. Remember how the foolish man mocks you all day. (Psalms 74:22)

text: שָׁמַעְתָּ חֶרְפָּתָם יְהוָה כָּל מַחְשְׁבֹתָם עָלָֽי׃
translation: You have heard their reproach, LORD, and all their plans against me, (Lamentations 3:61)

text: זְכֹר יְהוָה מֶֽה הָיָה לָנוּ הביט הַבִּיטָה וּרְאֵה אֶת חֶרְפָּתֵֽנוּ׃
translation: Remember, LORD, what has come on us. Look, and see our reproach. (Lamentations 5:1)

text: בְּשֵׁשׁ צָרוֹת יַצִּילֶךָּ וּבְשֶׁבַע לֹא יִגַּע בְּךָ רָֽע׃
translation: He will deliver you in six troubles; yes, in seven no evil will touch you. (Job 5:19)

text: זֶה עָנִי קָרָא וַיהוָה שָׁמֵעַ וּמִכָּל צָרוֹתָיו הוֹשִׁיעֽוֹ׃
translation: The LORD's angel encamps around those who fear him, and delivers them. (Psalms 34:7)

text: לְמַֽעַן שִׁמְךָ יְהוָה תְּחַיֵּנִי בְּצִדְקָתְךָ תוֹצִיא מִצָּרָה נַפְשִֽׁי׃
translation: Revive me, LORD, for your name's sake. In your righteousness, bring my soul out of trouble. (Psalms 143:11)

text: אַל תִּרְחַק מִמֶּנִּי כִּי צָרָה קְרוֹבָה כִּי אֵין עוֹזֵֽר׃
translation: Many bulls have surrounded me. Strong bulls of Bashan have encircled me. (Psalms 22:12)

text: בְּכָל עֵת אֹהֵב הָרֵעַ וְאָח לְצָרָה יִוָּלֵֽד׃
translation: A friend loves at all times; and a brother is born for adversity. (Proverbs 17:17)

text: שָׁמַעְנוּ אֶת שָׁמְעוֹ רָפוּ יָדֵינוּ צָרָה הֶחֱזִיקַתְנוּ חִיל כַּיּוֹלֵדָֽה׃
translation: We have heard its report. Our hands become feeble. Anguish has taken hold of us, and pains as of a woman in labor. (Jeremiah 6:24)

text: כִּי עֲוֺנֹתַי עָבְרוּ רֹאשִׁי כְּמַשָּׂא כָבֵד יִכְבְּדוּ מִמֶּֽנִּי׃
translation: My wounds are loathsome and corrupt because of my foolishness. (Psalms 38:5)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ דָּוִד אִם עָבַרְתָּ אִתִּי וְהָיִתָ עָלַי לְמַשָּֽׂא׃
translation: David said to him, "If you pass on with me, then you will be a burden to me; (2 Samuel 15:33)

text: דִּבְרֵי לְמוּאֵל מֶלֶךְ מַשָּׂא אֲֽשֶׁר יִסְּרַתּוּ אִמּֽוֹ׃
translation: The words of King Lemuel—the revelation which his mother taught him: (Proverbs 31:1)

text: מַשָּׂא בָּבֶל אֲשֶׁר חָזָה יְשַׁעְיָהוּ בֶּן אָמֽוֹץ׃
translation: The burden of Babylon, which Isaiah the son of Amoz saw. (Isaiah 13:1)

text: בִּשְׁנַת מוֹת הַמֶּלֶךְ אָחָז הָיָה הַמַּשָּׂא הַזֶּֽה׃
translation: This burden was in the year that King Ahaz died. (Isaiah 14:28)

text: מַשָּׂא דַּמָּשֶׂק הִנֵּה דַמֶּשֶׂק מוּסָר מֵעִיר וְהָיְתָה מְעִי מַפָּלָֽה׃
translation: The burden of Damascus. "Behold, Damascus is taken away from being a city, and it will be a ruinous heap. (Isaiah 17:1)

text: בְּעֶצֶם הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה נִמּוֹל אַבְרָהָם וְיִשְׁמָעֵאל בְּנֽוֹ׃
translation: In the same day both Abraham and Ishmael, his son, were circumcised. (Genesis 17:26)

text: וְאִם לֹא תִשְׁמְעוּ אֵלֵינוּ לְהִמּוֹל וְלָקַחְנוּ אֶת בִּתֵּנוּ וְהָלָֽכְנוּ׃
translation: But if you will not listen to us and be circumcised, then we will take our sister, and we will be gone." (Genesis 34:17)

text: וּמֵי הַיַּרְקוֹן וְהָֽרַקּוֹן עִֽם הַגְּבוּל מוּל יָפֽוֹ׃
translation: Me Jarkon, and Rakkon, with the border opposite Joppa. (Joshua 19:46)

text: כָּל גּוֹיִם סְבָבוּנִי בְּשֵׁם יְהוָה כִּי אֲמִילַֽם׃
translation: All the nations surrounded me, but in the LORD's name I cut them off. (Psalms 118:10)

text: סַבּוּנִי גַם סְבָבוּנִי בְּשֵׁם יְהוָה כִּי אֲמִילַֽם׃
translation: They surrounded me, yes, they surrounded me. In the LORD's name I indeed cut them off. (Psalms 118:11)

text: וְכָל עֶבֶד אִישׁ מִקְנַת כָּסֶף וּמַלְתָּה אֹתוֹ אָז יֹאכַל בּֽוֹ׃
translation: but every man's servant who is bought for money, when you have circumcised him, then shall he eat of it. (Exodus 12:44)

text: וַהֲקִמֹתִי עֲלֵיכֶם צֹפִים הַקְשִׁיבוּ לְקוֹל שׁוֹפָר וַיֹּאמְרוּ לֹא נַקְשִֽׁיב׃
translation: I set watchmen over you, saying, 'Listen to the sound of the trumpet!' But they said, 'We will not listen!' (Jeremiah 6:17)

text: וְרוּחַ יְהוָה לָבְשָׁה אֶת גִּדְעוֹן וַיִּתְקַע בַּשּׁוֹפָר וַיִזָּעֵק אֲבִיעֶזֶר אַחֲרָֽיו׃
translation: But the LORD's Spirit came on Gideon, and he blew a trumpet; and Abiezer was gathered together to follow him. (Judges 6:34)

text: תִּקְעוּ שׁוֹפָר בַּגִּבְעָה חֲצֹצְרָה בָּרָמָה הָרִיעוּ בֵּית אָוֶן אַחֲרֶיךָ בִּנְיָמִֽין׃
translation: "Blow the cornet in Gibeah, and the trumpet in Ramah! Sound a battle cry at Beth Aven, behind you, Benjamin! (Hosea 5:8)

text: וַיְהִי קוֹל הַשּׁוֹפָר הוֹלֵךְ וְחָזֵק מְאֹד מֹשֶׁה יְדַבֵּר וְהָאֱלֹהִים יַעֲנֶנּוּ בְקֽוֹל׃
translation: When the sound of the trumpet grew louder and louder, Moses spoke, and God answered him by a voice. (Exodus 19:19)

text: בִּמְקוֹם אֲשֶׁר תִּשְׁמְעוּ אֶת קוֹל הַשּׁוֹפָר שָׁמָּה תִּקָּבְצוּ אֵלֵינוּ אֱלֹהֵינוּ יִלָּחֶם לָֽנוּ׃
translation: I looked, and rose up, and said to the nobles, to the rulers, and to the rest of the people, "Don't be afraid of them! Remember the Lord, who is great and awesome, and fight for your brothers, your sons, your daughters, your wives, and your houses." (Nehemiah 4:14)

text: וַיִּתְקַע יוֹאָב בַּשֹּׁפָר וַיָּשָׁב הָעָם מִרְדֹף אַחֲרֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל כִּֽי חָשַׂךְ יוֹאָב אֶת הָעָֽם׃
translation: Joab blew the trumpet, and the people returned from pursuing after Israel; for Joab held the people back. (2 Samuel 18:16)

text: כִּֽי שְׁנוֹת מִסְפָּר יֶאֱתָיוּ וְאֹרַח לֹא אָשׁוּב אֶהֱלֹֽךְ׃
translation: For when a few years have come, I will go the way of no return. (Job 16:22)

text: כִּי פֹעַל אָדָם יְשַׁלֶּם לוֹ וּֽכְאֹרַח אִישׁ יַמְצִאֶֽנּוּ׃
translation: For the work of a man he will give to him, and cause every man to find according to his ways. (Job 34:11)

text: בְּאֹרַח רְשָׁעִים אַל תָּבֹא וְאַל תְּאַשֵּׁר בְּדֶרֶךְ רָעִֽים׃
translation: Don't enter into the path of the wicked. Don't walk in the way of evil men. (Proverbs 4:14)

text: אֹרַח חַיִּים לְמַעְלָה לְמַשְׂכִּיל לְמַעַן סוּר מִשְּׁאוֹל מָֽטָּה׃
translation: The path of life leads upward for the wise, to keep him from going downward to Sheol. (Proverbs 15:24)

text: וְאָרַח לְחֶבְרָה עִם פֹּעֲלֵי אָוֶן וְלָלֶכֶת עִם אַנְשֵׁי רֶֽשַׁע׃
translation: who goes in company with the workers of iniquity, and walks with wicked men? (Job 34:8)

text: לְמַעַן תֵּלֵךְ בְּדֶרֶךְ טוֹבִים וְאָרְחוֹת צַדִּיקִים תִּשְׁמֹֽר׃
translation: Therefore walk in the way of good men, and keep the paths of the righteous. (Proverbs 2:20)

text: וְאֶת אַהֲרֹן וְאֶת בָּנָיו תִּמְשָׁח וְקִדַּשְׁתָּ אֹתָם לְכַהֵן לִֽי׃
translation: You shall anoint Aaron and his sons, and sanctify them, that they may minister to me in the priest's office. (Exodus 30:30)

text: אֵלֶּה שְׁמוֹת בְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֲנִים הַמְּשֻׁחִים אֲשֶׁר מִלֵּא יָדָם לְכַהֵֽן׃
translation: These are the names of the sons of Aaron, the priests who were anointed, whom he consecrated to minister in the priest's office. (Numbers 3:3)

text: מָצָאתִי דָּוִד עַבְדִּי בְּשֶׁמֶן קָדְשִׁי מְשַׁחְתִּֽיו׃
translation: with whom my hand shall be established. My arm will also strengthen him. (Psalms 89:21)

text: עָרֹךְ הַשֻּׁלְחָן צָפֹה הַצָּפִית אָכוֹל שָׁתֹה קוּמוּ הַשָּׂרִים מִשְׁחוּ מָגֵֽן׃
translation: They prepare the table. They set the watch. They eat. They drink. Rise up, you princes, oil the shield! (Isaiah 21:5)

text: וְהִלְבַּשְׁתָּ אֶֽת אַהֲרֹן אֵת בִּגְדֵי הַקֹּדֶשׁ וּמָשַׁחְתָּ אֹתוֹ וְקִדַּשְׁתָּ אֹתוֹ וְכִהֵן לִֽי׃
translation: You shall put on Aaron the holy garments; and you shall anoint him, and sanctify him, that he may minister to me in the priest's office. (Exodus 40:13)

text: וְאַבְשָׁלוֹם אֲשֶׁר מָשַׁחְנוּ עָלֵינוּ מֵת בַּמִּלְחָמָה וְעַתָּה לָמָה אַתֶּם מַחֲרִשִׁים לְהָשִׁיב אֶת הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
translation: King David sent to Zadok and to Abiathar the priests, saying, "Speak to the elders of Judah, saying, 'Why are you the last to bring the king back to his house, since the speech of all Israel has come to the king, to return him to his house? (2 Samuel 19:11)

text: שִֽׂימָה נָּא עָרְבֵנִי עִמָּךְ מִֽי הוּא לְיָדִי יִתָּקֵֽעַ׃
translation: "Now give a pledge. Be collateral for me with yourself. Who is there who will strike hands with me? (Job 17:3)

text: רַע יֵרוֹעַ כִּי עָרַב זָר וְשֹׂנֵא תֹקְעִים בּוֹטֵֽחַ׃
translation: He who is collateral for a stranger will suffer for it, but he who refuses pledges of collateral is secure. (Proverbs 11:15)

text: בְּנִי אִם עָרַבְתָּ לְרֵעֶךָ תָּקַעְתָּ לַזָּר כַּפֶּֽיךָ׃
translation: My son, if you have become collateral for your neighbor, if you have struck your hands in pledge for a stranger, (Proverbs 6:1)

text: אַל תְּהִי בְתֹֽקְעֵי כָף בַּעֹרְבִים מַשָּׁאֽוֹת׃
translation: Don't you be one of those who strike hands, of those who are collateral for debts. (Proverbs 22:26)

text: תָּקְעוּ בַתָּקוֹעַ וְהָכִין הַכֹּל וְאֵין הֹלֵךְ לַמִּלְחָמָה כִּי חֲרוֹנִי אֶל כָּל הֲמוֹנָֽהּ׃
translation: They have blown the trumpet, and have made all ready; but no one goes to the battle, for my wrath is on all its multitude. (Ezekiel 7:14)

text: וַיִּשְׁלַח אֵהוּד אֶת יַד שְׂמֹאלוֹ וַיִּקַּח אֶת הַחֶרֶב מֵעַל יֶרֶךְ יְמִינוֹ וַיִּתְקָעֶהָ בְּבִטְנֽוֹ׃
translation: Ehud put out his left hand, and took the sword from his right thigh, and thrust it into his body. (Judges 3:21)

text: אֶת הַשֻּׁלְחָן אֶת כָּל כֵּלָיו וְאֵת לֶחֶם הַפָּנִֽים׃
translation: the table, all its vessels, the show bread, (Exodus 39:36)

text: וַֽיְדַבְּרוּ בֵּֽאלֹהִים אָמְרוּ הֲיוּכַל אֵל לַעֲרֹךְ שֻׁלְחָן בַּמִּדְבָּֽר׃
translation: Yes, they spoke against God. They said, "Can God prepare a table in the wilderness? (Psalms 78:19)

text: וְנָתַתָּ עַֽל הַשֻּׁלְחָן לֶחֶם פָּנִים לְפָנַי תָּמִֽיד׃
translation: You shall set bread of the presence on the table before me always. (Exodus 25:30)

text: אֶת הַשֻּׁלְחָן וְאֶת בַּדָּיו וְאֶת כָּל כֵּלָיו וְאֵת לֶחֶם הַפָּנִֽים׃
translation: the table with its poles and all its vessels, and the show bread; (Exodus 35:13)

text: וַיַּעַשׂ אֶת הַבַּדִּים עֲצֵי שִׁטִּים וַיְצַף אֹתָם זָהָב לָשֵׂאת אֶת הַשֻּׁלְחָֽן׃
translation: He made the poles of acacia wood, and overlaid them with gold, to carry the table. (Exodus 37:15)

text: וְיָשַׁבְתְּ עַל מִטָּה כְבוּדָּה וְשֻׁלְחָן עָרוּךְ לְפָנֶיהָ וּקְטָרְתִּי וְשַׁמְנִי שַׂמְתְּ עָלֶֽיהָ׃
translation: and sat on a stately bed, with a table prepared before it, whereupon you set my incense and my oil. (Ezekiel 23:41)

text: וְלִי מַה יָּקְרוּ רֵעֶיךָ אֵל מֶה עָצְמוּ רָאשֵׁיהֶֽם׃
translation: How precious to me are your thoughts, God! How vast is their sum! (Psalms 139:17)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר הָמָן אֶל הַמֶּלֶךְ אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר הַמֶּלֶךְ חָפֵץ בִּיקָרֽוֹ׃
translation: Haman said to the king, "For the man whom the king delights to honor, (Esther 6:7)

text: מִתּוֹךְ וּמֵחָמָס יִגְאַל נַפְשָׁם וְיֵיקַר דָּמָם בְּעֵינָֽיו׃
translation: He will redeem their soul from oppression and violence. Their blood will be precious in his sight. (Psalms 72:14)

text: חוֹשֵׂךְ אֲמָרָיו יוֹדֵעַ דָּעַת וקר יְקַר רוּחַ אִישׁ תְּבוּנָֽה׃
translation: He who spares his words has knowledge. He who is even tempered is a man of understanding. (Proverbs 17:27)

text: הֹקַר רַגְלְךָ מִבֵּית רֵעֶךָ פֶּן יִשְׂבָּעֲךָ וּשְׂנֵאֶֽךָ׃
translation: Let your foot be seldom in your neighbor's house, lest he be weary of you, and hate you. (Proverbs 25:17)

text: וְהָיָה בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא לֹֽא יִהְיֶה אוֹר יְקָרוֹת יקפאון וְקִפָּאֽוֹן׃
translation: It will happen in that day that there will not be light, cold, or frost. (Zechariah 14:6)

text: נִבְחָר שֵׁם מֵעֹשֶׁר רָב מִכֶּסֶף וּמִזָּהָב חֵן טֽוֹב׃
translation: A good name is more desirable than great riches, and loving favor is better than silver and gold. (Proverbs 22:1)

text: אֹהֵב טהור טְהָר לֵב חֵן שְׂפָתָיו רֵעֵהוּ מֶֽלֶךְ׃
translation: He who loves purity of heart and speaks gracefully is the king's friend. (Proverbs 22:11)

text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ הֶחֱיִתָנוּ נִמְצָא חֵן בְּעֵינֵי אֲדֹנִי וְהָיִינוּ עֲבָדִים לְפַרְעֹֽה׃
translation: They said, "You have saved our lives! Let us find favor in the sight of my lord, and we will be Pharaoh's servants." (Genesis 47:25)

text: כִּי לִוְיַת חֵן הֵם לְרֹאשֶׁךָ וַעֲנָקִים לְגַרְגְּרֹתֶֽיךָ׃
translation: for they will be a garland to grace your head, and chains around your neck. (Proverbs 1:9)

text: וּמְצָא חֵן וְשֵֽׂכֶל טוֹב בְּעֵינֵי אֱלֹהִים וְאָדָֽם׃
translation: So you will find favor, and good understanding in the sight of God and man. (Proverbs 3:4)

text: מוֹכִיחַ אָדָם אַחֲרַי חֵן יִמְצָא מִֽמַּחֲלִיק לָשֽׁוֹן׃
translation: One who rebukes a man will afterward find more favor than one who flatters with the tongue. (Proverbs 28:23)

text: אַךְ שָׁוְא לֹא יִשְׁמַע אֵל וְשַׁדַּי לֹא יְשׁוּרֶֽנָּה׃
translation: Surely God will not hear an empty cry, neither will the Almighty regard it. (Job 35:13)

text: שָׂנֵאתִי הַשֹּׁמְרִים הַבְלֵי שָׁוְא וַאֲנִי אֶל יְהוָה בָּטָֽחְתִּי׃
translation: I will be glad and rejoice in your loving kindness, for you have seen my affliction. You have known my soul in adversities. (Psalms 31:7)

text: אֲשֶׁר פִּיהֶם דִּבֶּר שָׁוְא וִֽימִינָם יְמִין שָֽׁקֶר׃
translation: whose mouths speak deceit, whose right hand is a right hand of falsehood. (Psalms 144:8)

text: ושיא וּשְׁוָא סֹפֵר וְצָדוֹק וְאֶבְיָתָר כֹּהֲנִֽים׃
translation: Sheva was scribe, Zadok and Abiathar were priests, (2 Samuel 20:25)

text: הַעֲבֵר עֵינַי מֵרְאוֹת שָׁוְא בִּדְרָכֶךָ חַיֵּֽנִי׃
translation: Turn my eyes away from looking at worthless things. Revive me in your ways. (Psalms 119:37)

text: אֲשֶׁר יֹאמְרֻךָ לִמְזִמָּה נָשֻׂא לַשָּׁוְא עָרֶֽיךָ׃
translation: For they speak against you wickedly. Your enemies take your name in vain. (Psalms 139:20)

text: בְּלֵב נָבוֹן תָּנוּחַ חָכְמָה וּבְקֶרֶב כְּסִילִים תִּוָּדֵֽעַ׃
translation: Wisdom rests in the heart of one who has understanding, and is even made known in the inward part of fools. (Proverbs 14:33)

text: יַסֵּר בִּנְךָ וִֽינִיחֶךָ וְיִתֵּן מַעֲדַנִּים לְנַפְשֶֽׁךָ׃
translation: Correct your son, and he will give you peace; yes, he will bring delight to your soul. (Proverbs 29:17)

text: וַיֹּאמַר פָּנַי יֵלֵכוּ וַהֲנִחֹתִי לָֽךְ׃
translation: He said, "My presence will go with you, and I will give you rest." (Exodus 33:14)

text: וַיְהִי כִּי יָשַׁב הַמֶּלֶךְ בְּבֵיתוֹ וַיהוָה הֵנִֽיחַ לוֹ מִסָּבִיב מִכָּל אֹיְבָֽיו׃
translation: When the king lived in his house, and the LORD had given him rest from all his enemies all around, (2 Samuel 7:1)

text: וְגַם אֲנִי אַכֶּה כַפִּי אֶל כַּפִּי וַהֲנִחֹתִי חֲמָתִי אֲנִי יְהוָה דִּבַּֽרְתִּי׃
translation: In his right hand was the lot for Jerusalem, to set battering rams, to open the mouth in the slaughter, to lift up the voice with shouting, to set battering rams against the gates, to cast up mounds, and to build forts. (Ezekiel 21:22)

text: וְהָיָה כַּאֲשֶׁר יָרִים מֹשֶׁה יָדוֹ וְגָבַר יִשְׂרָאֵל וְכַאֲשֶׁר יָנִיחַ יָדוֹ וְגָבַר עֲמָלֵֽק׃
translation: When Moses held up his hand, Israel prevailed. When he let down his hand, Amalek prevailed. (Exodus 17:11)

text: כִּכָּר זָהָב טָהוֹר עָשָׂה אֹתָהּ וְאֵת כָּל כֵּלֶֽיהָ׃
translation: He made it of a talent of pure gold, with all its vessels. (Exodus 37:24)

text: כִּכָּר זָהָב טָהוֹר יַעֲשֶׂה אֹתָהּ אֵת כָּל הַכֵּלִים הָאֵֽלֶּה׃
translation: It shall be made of a talent of pure gold, with all these accessories. (Exodus 25:39)

text: וַיִּשְׁלַח חִירָם לַמֶּלֶךְ מֵאָה וְעֶשְׂרִים כִּכַּר זָהָֽב׃
translation: Hiram sent to the king one hundred twenty talents of gold. (1 Kings 9:14)

text: וַיִּשְׂכֹּר מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל מֵאָה אֶלֶף גִּבּוֹר חָיִל בְּמֵאָה כִכַּר כָּֽסֶף׃
