translation: He also hired one hundred thousand mighty men of valor out of Israel for one hundred talents of silver. (2 Chronicles 25:6)

text: בְּכִכַּר הַיַּרְדֵּן יְצָקָם הַמֶּלֶךְ בְּמַעֲבֵה הָאֲדָמָה בֵּין סֻכּוֹת וּבֵין צָרְתָֽן׃
translation: The king cast them in the plain of the Jordan, in the clay ground between Succoth and Zarethan. (1 Kings 7:46)

text: בְּכִכַּר הַיַּרְדֵּן יְצָקָם הַמֶּלֶךְ בַּעֲבִי הָאֲדָמָה בֵּין סֻכּוֹת וּבֵין צְרֵדָֽתָה׃
translation: The king cast them in the plain of the Jordan, in the clay ground between Succoth and Zeredah. (2 Chronicles 4:17)

text: אֲנִי אֲנִי דִּבַּרְתִּי אַף קְרָאתִיו הֲבִיאֹתִיו וְהִצְלִיחַ דַּרְכּֽוֹ׃
translation: I, even I, have spoken. Yes, I have called him. I have brought him and he shall make his way prosperous. (Isaiah 48:15)

text: וְצָלְחָה עָלֶיךָ רוּחַ יְהוָה וְהִתְנַבִּיתָ עִמָּם וְנֶהְפַּכְתָּ לְאִישׁ אַחֵֽר׃
translation: Then the LORD's Spirit will come mightily on you, then you will prophesy with them and will be turned into another man. (1 Samuel 10:6)

text: מְכַסֶּה פְשָׁעָיו לֹא יַצְלִיחַ וּמוֹדֶה וְעֹזֵב יְרֻחָֽם׃
translation: He who conceals his sins doesn't prosper, but whoever confesses and renounces them finds mercy. (Proverbs 28:13)

text: וְצָבָא תִּנָּתֵן עַל הַתָּמִיד בְּפָשַׁע וְתַשְׁלֵךְ אֱמֶת אַרְצָה וְעָשְׂתָה וְהִצְלִֽיחָה׃
translation: The army was given over to it together with the continual burnt offering through disobedience. It cast down truth to the ground, and it did its pleasure and prospered. (Daniel 8:12)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם אַל תְּאַחֲרוּ אֹתִי וַֽיהוָה הִצְלִיחַ דַּרְכִּי שַׁלְּחוּנִי וְאֵלְכָה לַֽאדֹנִֽי׃
translation: He said to them, "Don't hinder me, since the LORD has prospered my way. Send me away that I may go to my master." (Genesis 24:56)

text: וַיְהִי יְהוָה אֶת יוֹסֵף וַיְהִי אִישׁ מַצְלִיחַ וַיְהִי בְּבֵית אֲדֹנָיו הַמִּצְרִֽי׃
translation: The LORD was with Joseph, and he was a prosperous man. He was in the house of his master the Egyptian. (Genesis 39:2)

text: מִֽי פָקַד עָלָיו דַּרְכּוֹ וּמִֽי אָמַר פָּעַלְתָּ עַוְלָֽה׃
translation: Who has prescribed his way for him? Or who can say, 'You have committed unrighteousness'? (Job 36:23)

text: מֵאַחַר עָלוֹת הֱבִיאוֹ לִרְעוֹת בְּיַעֲקֹב עַמּוֹ וּבְיִשְׂרָאֵל נַחֲלָתֽוֹ׃
translation: from following the ewes that have their young, he brought him to be the shepherd of Jacob, his people, and Israel, his inheritance. (Psalms 78:71)

text: לֹֽא יַשִּׁא אוֹיֵב בּוֹ וּבֶן עַוְלָה לֹא יְעַנֶּֽנּוּ׃
translation: I will beat down his adversaries before him, and strike those who hate him. (Psalms 89:23)

text: תּוֹעֲבַת צַדִּיקִים אִישׁ עָוֶל וְתוֹעֲבַת רָשָׁע יְשַׁר דָּֽרֶךְ׃
translation: A dishonest man detests the righteous, and the upright in their ways detest the wicked. (Proverbs 29:27)

text: אַךְ אֵלֶּה מִשְׁכְּנוֹת עַוָּל וְזֶה מְקוֹם לֹא יָדַֽע אֵֽל׃
translation: Surely such are the dwellings of the unrighteous. This is the place of him who doesn't know God." (Job 18:21)

text: בִּלְעֲדֵי אֶחֱזֶה אַתָּה הֹרֵנִי אִֽם עָוֶל פָּעַלְתִּי לֹא אֹסִֽיף׃
translation: Teach me that which I don't see. If I have done iniquity, I will do it no more'? (Job 34:32)

text: מְֽכַסֶּה פֶּשַׁע מְבַקֵּשׁ אַהֲבָה וְשֹׁנֶה בְדָבָר מַפְרִיד אַלּֽוּף׃
translation: He who covers an offense promotes love; but he who repeats a matter separates best friends. (Proverbs 17:9)

text: אֵלֶּה בְנֵי עֵשָׂו וְאֵלֶּה אַלּוּפֵיהֶם הוּא אֱדֽוֹם׃
translation: These are the sons of Esau (that is, Edom), and these are their chiefs. (Genesis 36:19)

text: הַעֹזֶבֶת אַלּוּף נְעוּרֶיהָ וְאֶת בְּרִית אֱלֹהֶיהָ שָׁכֵֽחָה׃
translation: who forsakes the friend of her youth, and forgets the covenant of her God; (Proverbs 2:17)

text: הֲלוֹא מֵעַתָּה קראתי קָרָאת לִי אָבִי אַלּוּף נְעֻרַי אָֽתָּה׃
translation: Will you not from this time cry to me, 'My Father, you are the guide of my youth!'? (Jeremiah 3:4)

text: אַלּוּף אָהֳלִיבָמָה אַלּוּף אֵלָה אַלּוּף פִּינֹֽן׃
translation: chief Oholibamah, chief Elah, chief Pinon, (Genesis 36:41)

text: אַלּוּף קְנַז אַלּוּף תֵּימָן אַלּוּף מִבְצָֽר׃
translation: chief Kenaz, chief Teman, chief Mibzar, (Genesis 36:42)

text: נֶחְשַׁבְתִּי עִם יוֹרְדֵי בוֹר הָיִיתִי כְּגֶבֶר אֵֽין אֱיָֽל׃
translation: set apart among the dead, like the slain who lie in the grave, whom you remember no more. They are cut off from your hand. (Psalms 88:5)

text: בַּעַל הַבּוֹר יְשַׁלֵּם כֶּסֶף יָשִׁיב לִבְעָלָיו וְהַמֵּת יִֽהְיֶה לּֽוֹ׃
translation: the owner of the pit shall make it good. He shall give money to its owner, and the dead animal shall be his. (Exodus 21:34)

text: יְֽהוָה הֶֽעֱלִיתָ מִן שְׁאוֹל נַפְשִׁי חִיִּיתַנִי מיורדי מִיָּֽרְדִי בֽוֹר׃
translation: Sing praise to the LORD, you saints of his. Give thanks to his holy name. (Psalms 30:4)

text: בּוֹר כָּרָֽה וַֽיַּחְפְּרֵהוּ וַיִּפֹּל בְּשַׁחַת יִפְעָֽל׃
translation: The trouble he causes shall return to his own head. His violence shall come down on the crown of his own head. (Psalms 7:16)

text: נִבְלָעֵם כִּשְׁאוֹל חַיִּים וּתְמִימִים כְּיוֹרְדֵי בֽוֹר׃
translation: Let's swallow them up alive like Sheol, and whole, like those who go down into the pit. (Proverbs 1:12)

text: שְׁתֵה מַיִם מִבּוֹרֶךָ וְנֹזְלִים מִתּוֹךְ בְּאֵרֶֽךָ׃
translation: Drink water out of your own cistern, running water out of your own well. (Proverbs 5:15)

text: וַיּוֹלִכֵנִי אֶל הַשָּׁעַר שַׁעַר אֲשֶׁר פֹּנֶה דֶּרֶךְ הַקָּדִֽים׃
translation: Afterward he brought me to the gate, even the gate that looks toward the east. (Ezekiel 43:1)

text: הֶֽחָכָם יַעֲנֶה דַֽעַת רוּחַ וִֽימַלֵּא קָדִים בִּטְנֽוֹ׃
translation: "Should a wise man answer with vain knowledge, and fill himself with the east wind? (Job 15:2)

text: אֵי זֶה הַדֶּרֶךְ יֵחָלֶק אוֹר יָפֵץ קָדִים עֲלֵי אָֽרֶץ׃
translation: By what way is the lightning distributed, or the east wind scattered on the earth? (Job 38:24)

text: וְיֶתֶר הַשְּׁבָטִים מִפְּאַת קָדִימָה עַד פְּאַת יָמָּה בִּנְיָמִן אֶחָֽד׃
translation: "As for the rest of the tribes: from the east side to the west side, Benjamin, one portion. (Ezekiel 48:23)

text: וְעַל גְּבוּל דָּן מִפְּאַת קָדִים עַד פְּאַת יָמָּה אָשֵׁר אֶחָֽד׃
translation: "By the border of Dan, from the east side to the west side, Asher, one portion. (Ezekiel 48:2)

text: וְעַל גְּבוּל אָשֵׁר מִפְּאַת קָדִימָה וְעַד פְּאַת יָמָּה נַפְתָּלִי אֶחָֽד׃
translation: "By the border of Asher, from the east side even to the west side, Naphtali, one portion. (Ezekiel 48:3)

text: מִפְּרִי פִי אִישׁ יֹאכַל טוֹב וְנֶפֶשׁ בֹּגְדִים חָמָֽס׃
translation: By the fruit of his lips, a man enjoys good things, but the unfaithful crave violence. (Proverbs 13:2)

text: מְקַצֶּה רַגְלַיִם חָמָס שֹׁתֶה שֹׁלֵחַ דְּבָרִים בְּיַד כְּסִֽיל׃
translation: One who sends a message by the hand of a fool is cutting off feet and drinking violence. (Proverbs 26:6)

text: וַתִּשָּׁחֵת הָאָרֶץ לִפְנֵי הָֽאֱלֹהִים וַתִּמָּלֵא הָאָרֶץ חָמָֽס׃
translation: The earth was corrupt before God, and the earth was filled with violence. (Genesis 6:11)

text: וּמוֹצִיאִי מֵאֹֽיְבָי וּמִקָּמַי תְּרוֹמְמֵנִי מֵאִישׁ חֲמָסִים תַּצִּילֵֽנִי׃
translation: who brings me away from my enemies. Yes, you lift me up above those who rise up against me. You deliver me from the violent man. (2 Samuel 22:49)

text: מְפַלְּטִי מֵאֹיְבָי אַף מִן קָמַי תְּרוֹמְמֵנִי מֵאִישׁ חָמָס תַּצִּילֵֽנִי׃
translation: Therefore I will give thanks to you, LORD, among the nations, and will sing praises to your name. (Psalms 18:49)

text: יְקוּמוּן עֵדֵי חָמָס אֲשֶׁר לֹא יָדַעְתִּי יִשְׁאָלֽוּנִי׃
translation: Unrighteous witnesses rise up. They ask me about things that I don't know about. (Psalms 35:11)

text: יָקוּם אֱלֹהִים יָפוּצוּ אוֹיְבָיו וְיָנוּסוּ מְשַׂנְאָיו מִפָּנָֽיו׃
translation: As smoke is driven away, so drive them away. As wax melts before the fire, so let the wicked perish at the presence of God. (Psalms 68:2)

text: וַיָּפֶץ יְהוָה אֹתָם מִשָּׁם עַל פְּנֵי כָל הָאָרֶץ וַֽיַּחְדְּלוּ לִבְנֹת הָעִֽיר׃
translation: So the LORD scattered them abroad from there on the surface of all the earth. They stopped building the city. (Genesis 11:8)

text: אָרוּר אַפָּם כִּי עָז וְעֶבְרָתָם כִּי קָשָׁתָה אֲחַלְּקֵם בְּיַעֲקֹב וַאֲפִיצֵם בְּיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
translation: Cursed be their anger, for it was fierce; and their wrath, for it was cruel. I will divide them in Jacob, and scatter them in Israel. (Genesis 49:7)

text: סָבִיב בִּֽעֲתֻהוּ בַלָּהוֹת וֶהֱפִיצֻהוּ לְרַגְלָֽיו׃
translation: Terrors will make him afraid on every side, and will chase him at his heels. (Job 18:11)

text: וַהֲפִצוֹתִי אֶת מִצְרַיִם בַּגּוֹיִם וְזֵרִיתִי אוֹתָם בָּאֲרָצוֹת וְיָדְעוּ כִּֽי אֲנִי יְהוָֽה׃
translation: I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations and disperse them through the countries. Then they will know that I am the LORD.'" (Ezekiel 30:26)

text: וַיְהִי בִּנְסֹעַ הָאָרֹן וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה קוּמָה יְהוָה וְיָפֻצוּ אֹֽיְבֶיךָ וְיָנֻסוּ מְשַׂנְאֶיךָ מִפָּנֶֽיךָ׃
translation: When the ark went forward, Moses said, "Rise up, LORD, and let your enemies be scattered! Let those who hate you flee before you!" (Numbers 10:35)

text: וַיָּרֵעוּ אֹתָנוּ הַמִּצְרִים וַיְעַנּוּנוּ וַיִּתְּנוּ עָלֵינוּ עֲבֹדָה קָשָֽׁה׃
translation: The Egyptians mistreated us, afflicted us, and imposed hard labor on us. (Deuteronomy 26:6)

text: חֲכַם לֵבָב וְאַמִּיץ כֹּחַ מִֽי הִקְשָׁה אֵלָיו וַיִּשְׁלָֽם׃
translation: God is wise in heart, and mighty in strength. Who has hardened himself against him and prospered? (Job 9:4)

text: אַשְׁרֵי אָדָם מְפַחֵד תָּמִיד וּמַקְשֶׁה לִבּוֹ יִפּוֹל בְּרָעָֽה׃
translation: Blessed is the man who always fears; but one who hardens his heart falls into trouble. (Proverbs 28:14)

text: וַיַּעֲנֵם הַמֶּלֶךְ קָשָׁה וַֽיַּעֲזֹב הַמֶּלֶךְ רְחַבְעָם אֵת עֲצַת הַזְּקֵנִֽים׃
translation: The king answered them roughly; and King Rehoboam abandoned the counsel of the old men, (2 Chronicles 10:13)

text: אַל תַּקְשׁוּ לְבַבְכֶם כִּמְרִיבָה כְּיוֹם מַסָּה בַּמִּדְבָּֽר׃
translation: Don't harden your heart, as at Meribah, as in the day of Massah in the wilderness, (Psalms 95:8)

text: דִּבֶּר הָאִישׁ אֲדֹנֵי הָאָרֶץ אִתָּנוּ קָשׁוֹת וַיִּתֵּן אֹתָנוּ כִּֽמְרַגְּלִים אֶת הָאָֽרֶץ׃
translation: "The man, the lord of the land, spoke roughly with us, and took us for spies of the country. (Genesis 42:30)

text: שִׁיר הַֽמַּעֲלוֹת אֶל יְהוָה בַּצָּרָתָה לִּי קָרָאתִי וַֽיַּעֲנֵֽנִי׃
translation: A Song of Ascents. In my distress, I cried to the LORD. He answered me. (Psalms 120:1)

text: שִׁיר הַֽמַּעֲלוֹת אֵלֶיךָ נָשָׂאתִי אֶת עֵינַי הַיֹּשְׁבִי בַּשָּׁמָֽיִם׃
translation: A Song of Ascents. I lift up my eyes to you, you who sit in the heavens. (Psalms 123:1)

text: שִׁיר הַֽמַּעֲלוֹת אַשְׁרֵי כָּל יְרֵא יְהוָה הַהֹלֵךְ בִּדְרָכָֽיו׃
translation: A Song of Ascents. Blessed is everyone who fears the LORD, who walks in his ways. (Psalms 128:1)

text: שִׁיר הַֽמַּעֲלוֹת זְכוֹר יְהוָה לְדָוִד אֵת כָּל עֻנּוֹתֽוֹ׃
translation: A Song of Ascents. LORD, remember David and all his affliction, (Psalms 132:1)

text: שִׁיר לַֽמַּעֲלוֹת אֶשָּׂא עֵינַי אֶל הֶהָרִים מֵאַיִן יָבֹא עֶזְרִֽי׃
translation: A Song of Ascents. I will lift up my eyes to the hills. Where does my help come from? (Psalms 121:1)

text: שִׁיר הַֽמַּעֲלוֹת לְדָוִד שָׂמַחְתִּי בְּאֹמְרִים לִי בֵּית יְהוָה נֵלֵֽךְ׃
translation: A Song of Ascents. By David. I was glad when they said to me, "Let's go to the LORD's house!" (Psalms 122:1)

text: הֲקֵץ לְדִבְרֵי רוּחַ אוֹ מַה יַּמְרִֽיצְךָ כִּי תַעֲנֶֽה׃
translation: Shall vain words have an end? Or what provokes you that you answer? (Job 16:3)

text: וְאַתָּה לֵךְ לַקֵּץ וְתָנוּחַ וְתַעֲמֹד לְגֹרָלְךָ לְקֵץ הַיָּמִֽין׃
translation: "But go your way until the end; for you will rest, and will stand in your inheritance at the end of the days." (Daniel 12:13)

text: וַֽיְהִי מִקֵּץ יָמִים וַיָּבֵא קַיִן מִפְּרִי הָֽאֲדָמָה מִנְחָה לַֽיהוָֽה׃
translation: As time passed, Cain brought an offering to the LORD from the fruit of the ground. (Genesis 4:3)

text: לְֽכָל תִּכְלָה רָאִיתִי קֵץ רְחָבָה מִצְוָתְךָ מְאֹֽד׃
translation: I have seen a limit to all perfection, but your commands are boundless. MEM (Psalms 119:96)

text: וַיְהִי מִקֵּץ עֲשֶׂרֶת יָמִים וַיְהִי דְבַר יְהוָה אֶֽל יִרְמְיָֽהוּ׃
translation: After ten days, the LORD's word came to Jeremiah. (Jeremiah 42:7)

text: הֲלֹא רָעָֽתְךָ רַבָּה וְאֵֽין קֵץ לַעֲוֺנֹתֶֽיךָ׃
translation: Isn't your wickedness great? Neither is there any end to your iniquities. (Job 22:5)

text: וַיְהִי לָהֶם בְּנַֽחֲלָתָם בְּאֵֽר שֶׁבַע וְשֶׁבַע וּמוֹלָדָֽה׃
translation: They had for their inheritance Beersheba (or Sheba), Moladah, (Joshua 19:2)

text: אָז יָשִׁיר יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת הַשִּׁירָה הַזֹּאת עֲלִי בְאֵר עֱנוּ לָֽהּ׃
translation: Then Israel sang this song: "Spring up, well! Sing to it, (Numbers 21:17)

text: וְכָתַבְתָּ עַל הָאֲבָנִים אֶֽת כָּל דִּבְרֵי הַתּוֹרָה הַזֹּאת בַּאֵר הֵיטֵֽב׃
translation: You shall write on the stones all the words of this law very plainly." (Deuteronomy 27:8)

text: וַיָּנָס יוֹתָם וַיִּבְרַח וַיֵּלֶךְ בְּאֵרָה וַיֵּשֶׁב שָׁם מִפְּנֵי אֲבִימֶלֶךְ אָחִֽיו׃
translation: Jotham ran away and fled, and went to Beer and lived there, for fear of Abimelech his brother. (Judges 9:21)

text: עַל כֵּן קָרָא לַמָּקוֹם הַהוּא בְּאֵר שָׁבַע כִּי שָׁם נִשְׁבְּעוּ שְׁנֵיהֶֽם׃
translation: Therefore he called that place Beersheba, because they both swore an oath there. (Genesis 21:31)

text: וַיַּעַל מִשָּׁם בְּאֵר שָֽׁבַע׃
translation: He went up from there to Beersheba. (Genesis 26:23)

text: וַיְהִי כִּשְׁמֹעַ הַמֶּלֶךְ אֵת דִּבְרֵי הַתּוֹרָה וַיִּקְרַע אֶת בְּגָדָֽיו׃
translation: When the king had heard the words of the law, he tore his clothes. (2 Chronicles 34:19)

text: וַיַּחֲזֵק דָּוִד בבגדו בִּבְגָדָיו וַיִּקְרָעֵם וְגַם כָּל הָאֲנָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר אִתּֽוֹ׃
translation: Then David took hold on his clothes and tore them; and all the men who were with him did likewise. (2 Samuel 1:11)

text: אַךְ בְּיָמֶיךָ לֹא אֶעֱשֶׂנָּה לְמַעַן דָּוִד אָבִיךָ מִיַּד בִּנְךָ אֶקְרָעֶֽנָּה׃
translation: Nevertheless, I will not do it in your days, for David your father's sake; but I will tear it out of your son's hand. (1 Kings 11:12)

text: וַיִּתְפֹּשׂ אֲחִיָּה בַּשַּׂלְמָה הַחֲדָשָׁה אֲשֶׁר עָלָיו וַיִּקְרָעֶהָ שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר קְרָעִֽים׃
translation: Ahijah took the new garment that was on him, and tore it in twelve pieces. (1 Kings 11:30)

text: וַֽיְהִי כִּשְׁמֹעַ הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת דִּבְרֵי סֵפֶר הַתּוֹרָה וַיִּקְרַע אֶת בְּגָדָֽיו׃
translation: When the king had heard the words of the book of the law, he tore his clothes. (2 Kings 22:11)

text: וַיָּשָׁב רְאוּבֵן אֶל הַבּוֹר וְהִנֵּה אֵין יוֹסֵף בַּבּוֹר וַיִּקְרַע אֶת בְּגָדָֽיו׃
translation: Reuben returned to the pit, and saw that Joseph wasn't in the pit; and he tore his clothes. (Genesis 37:29)

text: שְׁתֵּי כְתֵפֹת חֹֽבְרֹת יִֽהְיֶה לּוֹ אֶל שְׁנֵי קְצוֹתָיו וְחֻבָּֽר׃
translation: It shall have two shoulder straps joined to the two ends of it, that it may be joined together. (Exodus 28:7)

text: וְלִבְנֵי קְהָת לֹא נָתָן כִּֽי עֲבֹדַת הַקֹּדֶשׁ עֲלֵהֶם בַּכָּתֵף יִשָּֽׂאוּ׃
translation: But to the sons of Kohath he gave none, because the service of the sanctuary belonged to them; they carried it on their shoulders. (Numbers 7:9)

text: כְּתֵפִי מִשִּׁכְמָה תִפּוֹל וְאֶזְרֹעִי מִקָּנָה תִשָּׁבֵֽר׃
translation: then let my shoulder fall from the shoulder blade, and my arm be broken from the bone. (Job 31:22)

text: אַרְבָּעָה שֻׁלְחָנוֹת מִפֹּה וְאַרְבָּעָה שֻׁלְחָנוֹת מִפֹּה לְכֶתֶף הַשָּׁעַר שְׁמוֹנָה שֻׁלְחָנוֹת אֲלֵיהֶם יִשְׁחָֽטוּ׃
translation: Four tables were on this side, and four tables on that side, by the side of the gate: eight tables, on which they killed the sacrifices. (Ezekiel 40:41)

text: לְבִנְיָמִן אָמַר יְדִיד יְהֹוָה יִשְׁכֹּן לָבֶטַח עָלָיו חֹפֵף עָלָיו כָּל הַיּוֹם וּבֵין כְּתֵיפָיו שָׁכֵֽן׃
translation: About Benjamin he said, "The beloved of the LORD will dwell in safety by him. He covers him all day long. He dwells between his shoulders." (Deuteronomy 33:12)

text: בְּתָפְשָׂם בְּךָ בכפך בַכַּף תֵּרוֹץ וּבָקַעְתָּ לָהֶם כָּל כָּתֵף וּבְהִֽשָּׁעֲנָם עָלֶיךָ תִּשָּׁבֵר וְהַעֲמַדְתָּ לָהֶם כָּל מָתְנָֽיִם׃
translation: When they took hold of you by your hand, you broke and tore all their shoulders. When they leaned on you, you broke and paralyzed all of their thighs." (Ezekiel 29:7)

text: אַתָּֽה יְהוָה תִּשְׁמְרֵם תִּצְּרֶנּוּ מִן הַדּוֹר זוּ לְעוֹלָֽם׃
translation: The wicked walk on every side, when what is vile is exalted among the sons of men. (Psalms 12:8)

text: כָּל אָרְחוֹת יְהוָה חֶסֶד וֶאֱמֶת לְנֹצְרֵי בְרִיתוֹ וְעֵדֹתָֽיו׃
translation: All the paths of the LORD are loving kindness and truth to such as keep his covenant and his testimonies. (Psalms 25:10)

text: אַתָּה סֵתֶר לִי מִצַּר תִּצְּרֵנִי רָנֵּי פַלֵּט תְּסוֹבְבֵנִי סֶֽלָה׃
translation: You are my hiding place. You will preserve me from trouble. You will surround me with songs of deliverance. Selah. (Psalms 32:7)

text: קָרָאתִי בְכָל לֵב עֲנֵנִי יְהוָה חֻקֶּיךָ אֶצֹּֽרָה׃
translation: I have called with my whole heart. Answer me, LORD! I will keep your statutes. (Psalms 119:145)

text: חַלְּצֵנִי יְהוָה מֵאָדָם רָע מֵאִישׁ חֲמָסִים תִּנְצְרֵֽנִי׃
translation: those who devise mischief in their hearts. They continually gather themselves together for war. (Psalms 140:2)

text: בְּנִי תּוֹרָתִי אַל תִּשְׁכָּח וּמִצְוֺתַי יִצֹּר לִבֶּֽךָ׃
translation: My son, don't forget my teaching, but let your heart keep my commandments, (Proverbs 3:1)

text: וַיִּמְלֹךְ בֶּאֱדוֹם בֶּלַע בֶּן בְּעוֹר וְשֵׁם עִירוֹ דִּנְהָֽבָה׃
translation: Bela, the son of Beor, reigned in Edom. The name of his city was Dinhabah. (Genesis 36:32)

text: וַיָּמָת בָּלַע וַיִּמְלֹךְ תַּחְתָּיו יוֹבָב בֶּן זֶרַח מִבָּצְרָֽה׃
translation: Bela died, and Jobab, the son of Zerah of Bozrah, reigned in his place. (Genesis 36:33)

text: וַיָּמָת בָּלַע וַיִּמְלֹךְ תַּחְתָּיו יוֹבָב בֶּן זֶרַח מִבָּצְרָֽה׃
translation: Bela died, and Jobab the son of Zerah of Bozrah reigned in his place. (1 Chronicles 1:44)

text: אַל יֹאמְרוּ בְלִבָּם הֶאָח נַפְשֵׁנוּ אַל יֹאמְרוּ בִּֽלַּעֲנֽוּהוּ׃
translation: Don't let them say in their heart, "Aha! That's the way we want it!" Don't let them say, "We have swallowed him up!" (Psalms 35:25)

text: תִּפְתַּח אֶרֶץ וַתִּבְלַע דָּתָן וַתְּכַס עַל עֲדַת אֲבִירָֽם׃
translation: The earth opened and swallowed up Dathan, and covered the company of Abiram. (Psalms 106:17)

text: וְלֹא יָבֹאוּ לִרְאוֹת כְּבַלַּע אֶת הַקֹּדֶשׁ וָמֵֽתוּ׃
translation: but they shall not go in to see the sanctuary even for a moment, lest they die." (Numbers 4:20)

text: לִבְנֵי בְרִיעָה לְחֶבֶר מִשְׁפַּחַת הַֽחֶבְרִי לְמַלְכִּיאֵל מִשְׁפַּחַת הַמַּלְכִּיאֵלִֽי׃
translation: Of the sons of Beriah: of Heber, the family of the Heberites; of Malchiel, the family of the Malchielites. (Numbers 26:45)

text: וּבְנֵי בְרִיעָה חֶבֶר וּמַלְכִּיאֵל הוּא אֲבִי ברזות בִרְזָֽיִת׃
translation: The sons of Beriah: Heber and Malchiel, who was the father of Birzaith. (1 Chronicles 7:31)

text: וַיֵּֽאָסֵף כָּל אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל הָעִיר כְּאִישׁ אֶחָד חֲבֵרִֽים׃
translation: So all the men of Israel were gathered against the city, knit together as one man. (Judges 20:11)

text: וּמִן הִֽתְחַבְּרוּת אֵלָיו יַעֲשֶׂה מִרְמָה וְעָלָה וְעָצַם בִּמְעַט גּֽוֹי׃
translation: After the treaty made with him he will work deceitfully; for he will come up and will become strong with few people. (Daniel 11:23)

text: יְרוּשָׁלִַם הַבְּנוּיָה כְּעִיר שֶׁחֻבְּרָה לָּהּ יַחְדָּֽו׃
translation: Jerusalem is built as a city that is compact together, (Psalms 122:3)

text: חֲבוּר עֲצַבִּים אֶפְרָיִם הַֽנַּֽח לֽוֹ׃
translation: Ephraim is joined to idols. Leave him alone! (Hosea 4:17)

text: וְאַתָּה יְהוָה מָגֵן בַּעֲדִי כְּבוֹדִי וּמֵרִים רֹאשִֽׁי׃
translation: I cry to the LORD with my voice, and he answers me out of his holy hill. Selah. (Psalms 3:4)

text: בֵּית אַהֲרֹן בִּטְחוּ בַיהוָה עֶזְרָם וּמָגִנָּם הֽוּא׃
translation: House of Aaron, trust in the LORD! He is their help and their shield. (Psalms 115:10)

text: יִרְאֵי יְהוָה בִּטְחוּ בַיהוָה עֶזְרָם וּמָגִנָּם הֽוּא׃
translation: You who fear the LORD, trust in the LORD! He is their help and their shield. (Psalms 115:11)

text: פָּרַס כּוּשׁ וּפוּט אִתָּם כֻּלָּם מָגֵן וְכוֹבָֽע׃
translation: Persia, Cush, and Put with them, all of them with shield and helmet; (Ezekiel 38:5)

text: וַתִּתֶּן לִי מָגֵן יִשְׁעֶךָ וַעֲנֹתְךָ תַּרְבֵּֽנִי׃
translation: You have also given me the shield of your salvation. Your gentleness has made me great. (2 Samuel 22:36)

text: מָֽגִנִּי עַל אֱלֹהִים מוֹשִׁיעַ יִשְׁרֵי לֵֽב׃
translation: God is a righteous judge, yes, a God who has indignation every day. (Psalms 7:11)

text: וּֽשְׂדֵה מִגְרַשׁ עָרֵיהֶם לֹא יִמָּכֵר כִּֽי אֲחֻזַּת עוֹלָם הוּא לָהֶֽם׃
translation: But the field of the pasture lands of their cities may not be sold, for it is their perpetual possession. (Leviticus 25:34)

text: וְאִם אֶת שְׂדֵה מִקְנָתוֹ אֲשֶׁר לֹא מִשְּׂדֵה אֲחֻזָּתוֹ יַקְדִּישׁ לַֽיהוָֽה׃
translation: "'If he dedicates a field to the LORD which he has bought, which is not of the field of his possession, (Leviticus 27:22)

text: וְאֶת שְׂדֵה הָעִיר וְאֶת חֲצֵרֶיהָ נָֽתְנוּ לְכָלֵב בֶּן יְפֻנֶּה בַּאֲחֻזָּתֽוֹ׃
translation: But they gave the fields of the city and its villages to Caleb the son of Jephunneh for his possession. (Joshua 21:12)

text: בִּשְׁנַת הַיּוֹבֵל יָשׁוּב הַשָּׂדֶה לַאֲשֶׁר קָנָהוּ מֵאִתּוֹ לַאֲשֶׁר לוֹ אֲחֻזַּת הָאָֽרֶץ׃
translation: In the Year of Jubilee the field shall return to him from whom it was bought, even to him to whom the possession of the land belongs. (Leviticus 27:24)

text: כֹּל עָרֵי הַלְוִיִּם בְּתוֹךְ אֲחֻזַּת בְּנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵל עָרִים אַרְבָּעִים וּשְׁמֹנֶה וּמִגְרְשֵׁיהֶֽן׃
translation: All the cities of the Levites among the possessions of the children of Israel were forty-eight cities with their pasture lands. (Joshua 21:41)

text: וְיָצָא מֵֽעִמָּךְ הוּא וּבָנָיו עִמּוֹ וְשָׁב אֶל מִשְׁפַּחְתּוֹ וְאֶל אֲחֻזַּת אֲבֹתָיו יָשֽׁוּב׃
translation: Then he shall go out from you, he and his children with him, and shall return to his own family, and to the possession of his fathers. (Leviticus 25:41)

text: וְעַתָּה לֹא כַיָּמִים הָרִֽאשֹׁנִים אֲנִי לִשְׁאֵרִית הָעָם הַזֶּה נְאֻם יְהוָה צְבָאֽוֹת׃
translation: But now I will not be to the remnant of this people as in the former days," says the LORD of Armies. (Zechariah 8:11)

text: כִּי מִירוּשָׁלִַם תֵּצֵא שְׁאֵרִית וּפְלֵיטָה מֵהַר צִיּוֹן קִנְאַת יְהוָה צְבָאוֹת תַּֽעֲשֶׂה זֹּֽאת׃
translation: For out of Jerusalem a remnant will go out, and out of Mount Zion those who shall escape. The LORD's zeal will perform this. (2 Kings 19:31)

text: כִּי מִירֽוּשָׁלִַם תֵּצֵא שְׁאֵרִית וּפְלֵיטָה מֵהַר צִיּוֹן קִנְאַת יְהוָה צְבָאוֹת תַּֽעֲשֶׂה זֹּֽאת׃
translation: For out of Jerusalem a remnant will go out, and survivors will escape from Mount Zion. The zeal of the LORD of Armies will perform this.' (Isaiah 37:32)

text: וּשְׁאֵרִית לֹא תִֽהְיֶה לָהֶם כִּֽי אָבִיא רָעָה אֶל אַנְשֵׁי עֲנָתוֹת שְׁנַת פְּקֻדָּתָֽם׃
translation: There will be no remnant to them, for I will bring evil on the men of Anathoth, even the year of their visitation.'" (Jeremiah 11:23)

text: בֹּֽאוּ לָהּ מִקֵּץ פִּתְחוּ מַאֲבֻסֶיהָ סָלּוּהָ כְמוֹ עֲרֵמִים וְהַחֲרִימוּהָ אַל תְּהִי לָהּ שְׁאֵרִֽית׃
translation: Come against her from the farthest border. Open her storehouses. Cast her up as heaps. Destroy her utterly. Let nothing of her be left. (Jeremiah 50:26)

text: וַיֶּגֶל הַשְּׁאֵרִית מִן הַחֶרֶב אֶל בָּבֶל וַֽיִּהְיוּ לוֹ וּלְבָנָיו לַעֲבָדִים עַד מְלֹךְ מַלְכוּת פָּרָֽס׃
translation: He carried those who had escaped from the sword away to Babylon, and they were servants to him and his sons until the reign of the kingdom of Persia, (2 Chronicles 36:20)

text: וּבַשָּׁנָה הָרְבִיעִת יִהְיֶה כָּל פִּרְיוֹ קֹדֶשׁ הִלּוּלִים לַיהוָֽה׃
translation: But in the fourth year all its fruit shall be holy, for giving praise to the LORD. (Leviticus 19:24)

text: בַּיּוֹם הָרְבִיעִי נָשִׂיא לִבְנֵי רְאוּבֵן אֱלִיצוּר בֶּן שְׁדֵיאֽוּר׃
translation: On the fourth day Elizur the son of Shedeur, prince of the children of Reuben, (Numbers 7:30)

text: וּבְנָי יְרִיָּהוּ אֲמַרְיָהוּ הַשֵּׁנִי יַחֲזִיאֵל הַשְּׁלִישִׁי יְקַמְעָם הָרְבִיעִֽי׃
translation: The sons of Hebron: Jeriah, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth. (1 Chronicles 24:23)

text: לְיִשָּׂשכָר יָצָא הַגּוֹרָל הָֽרְבִיעִי לִבְנֵי יִשָּׂשכָר לְמִשְׁפְּחוֹתָֽם׃
translation: The fourth lot came out for Issachar, even for the children of Issachar according to their families. (Joshua 19:17)

text: וַֽיְהִי עֶרֶב וַֽיְהִי בֹקֶר יוֹם רְבִיעִֽי׃
translation: There was evening and there was morning, a fourth day. (Genesis 1:19)

text: וְנִסְכּוֹ רְבִיעִת הַהִין לַכֶּבֶשׂ הָאֶחָד בַּקֹּדֶשׁ הַסֵּךְ נֶסֶךְ שֵׁכָר לַיהוָֽה׃
translation: Its drink offering shall be the fourth part of a hin for each lamb. You shall pour out a drink offering of strong drink to the LORD in the holy place. (Numbers 28:7)

text: לֵאמֹר אֱלֹהִים עֲזָבוֹ רִֽדְפוּ וְתִפְשׂוּהוּ כִּי אֵין מַצִּֽיל׃
translation: saying, "God has forsaken him. Pursue and take him, for no one will rescue him." (Psalms 71:11)

text: וְאֶת מֶלֶךְ הָעַי תָּפְשׂוּ חָי וַיַּקְרִבוּ אֹתוֹ אֶל יְהוֹשֻֽׁעַ׃
translation: They captured the king of Ai alive, and brought him to Joshua. (Joshua 8:23)

text: שְׂמָמִית בְּיָדַיִם תְּתַפֵּשׂ וְהִיא בְּהֵיכְלֵי מֶֽלֶךְ׃
translation: You can catch a lizard with your hands, yet it is in kings' palaces. (Proverbs 30:28)

text: וַתִּתְפְּשֵׂהוּ בְּבִגְדוֹ לֵאמֹר שִׁכְבָה עִמִּי וַיַּעֲזֹב בִּגְדוֹ בְּיָדָהּ וַיָּנָס וַיֵּצֵא הַחֽוּצָה׃
translation: She caught him by his garment, saying, "Lie with me!" He left his garment in her hand, and ran outside. (Genesis 39:12)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר אִם לְשָׁלוֹם יָצָאוּ תִּפְשׂוּם חַיִּים וְאִם לְמִלְחָמָה יָצָאוּ חַיִּים תִּפְשֽׂוּם׃
translation: He said, "If they have come out for peace, take them alive; or if they have come out for war, take them alive." (1 Kings 20:18)

text: וְתָפְשׂוּ בוֹ אָבִיו וְאִמּוֹ וְהוֹצִיאוּ אֹתוֹ אֶל זִקְנֵי עִירוֹ וְאֶל שַׁעַר מְקֹמֽוֹ׃
translation: then his father and his mother shall take hold of him and bring him out to the elders of his city and to the gate of his place. (Deuteronomy 21:19)

text: וְאַבְשָׁלוֹם בָּרַח וַיֵּלֶךְ גְּשׁוּר וַיְהִי שָׁם שָׁלֹשׁ שָׁנִֽים׃
translation: So Absalom fled and went to Geshur, and was there three years. (2 Samuel 13:38)

text: וְיָמַי קַלּוּ מִנִּי רָץ בָּֽרְחוּ לֹא רָאוּ טוֹבָֽה׃
translation: "Now my days are swifter than a runner. They flee away. They see no good. (Job 9:25)

text: וַיֻּגַּד לְלָבָן בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי כִּי בָרַח יַעֲקֹֽב׃
translation: Laban was told on the third day that Jacob had fled. (Genesis 31:22)

text: וַיִּבְרְחוּ הַבְּאֵרֹתִים גִּתָּיְמָה וַֽיִּהְיוּ שָׁם גָּרִים עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּֽה׃
translation: and the Beerothites fled to Gittaim, and have lived as foreigners there until today). (2 Samuel 4:3)

text: וַיִּבְרַח יַעֲקֹב שְׂדֵה אֲרָם וַיַּעֲבֹד יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּאִשָּׁה וּבְאִשָּׁה שָׁמָֽר׃
translation: By a prophet the LORD brought Israel up out of Egypt, and by a prophet he was preserved. (Hosea 12:13)

text: וְעַתָּה בְנִי שְׁמַע בְּקֹלִי וְקוּם בְּרַח לְךָ אֶל לָבָן אָחִי חָרָֽנָה׃
translation: Now therefore, my son, obey my voice. Arise, flee to Laban, my brother, in Haran. (Genesis 27:43)

text: וַיִּשְׁמַע יְהוָה אֶת קוֹל דִּבְרֵיכֶם וַיִּקְצֹף וַיִּשָּׁבַע לֵאמֹֽר׃
translation: The LORD heard the voice of your words and was angry, and swore, saying, (Deuteronomy 1:34)

text: וּבְתַבְעֵרָה וּבְמַסָּה וּבְקִבְרֹת הַֽתַּאֲוָה מַקְצִפִים הֱיִיתֶם אֶת יְהוָֽה׃
translation: At Taberah, at Massah, and at Kibroth Hattaavah you provoked the LORD to wrath. (Deuteronomy 9:22)

text: כִּי אִם מָאֹס מְאַסְתָּנוּ קָצַפְתָּ עָלֵינוּ עַד מְאֹֽד׃
translation: But you have utterly rejected us. You are very angry against us. (Lamentations 5:22)

text: יְֽהוָה אַל בְּקֶצְפְּךָ תוֹכִיחֵנִי וּֽבַחֲמָתְךָ תְיַסְּרֵֽנִי׃
translation: For your arrows have pierced me, your hand presses hard on me. (Psalms 38:2)

text: מִפְּנֵֽי זַֽעַמְךָ וְקִצְפֶּךָ כִּי נְשָׂאתַנִי וַתַּשְׁלִיכֵֽנִי׃
translation: My days are like a long shadow. I have withered like grass. (Psalms 102:11)

text: וּבָנוּ בְנֵֽי נֵכָר חֹמֹתַיִךְ וּמַלְכֵיהֶם יְשָׁרְתוּנֶךְ כִּי בְקִצְפִּי הִכִּיתִיךְ וּבִרְצוֹנִי רִֽחַמְתִּֽיךְ׃
translation: "Foreigners will build up your walls, and their kings will serve you; for in my wrath I struck you, but in my favor I have had mercy on you. (Isaiah 60:10)

text: כִּי שֶׁבַע יִפּוֹל צַדִּיק וָקָם וּרְשָׁעִים יִכָּשְׁלוּ בְרָעָֽה׃
translation: for a righteous man falls seven times and rises up again, but the wicked are overthrown by calamity. (Proverbs 24:16)

text: שׁוּבָה יִשְׂרָאֵל עַד יְהוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ כִּי כָשַׁלְתָּ בַּעֲוֺנֶֽךָ׃
translation: Take words with you, and return to the LORD. Tell him, "Forgive all our sins, and accept that which is good; so we offer bulls as we vowed of our lips. (Hosea 14:2)

text: בִּנְפֹל אויביך אֽוֹיִבְךָ אַל תִּשְׂמָח וּבִכָּשְׁלוֹ אַל יָגֵל לִבֶּֽךָ׃
translation: Don't rejoice when your enemy falls. Don't let your heart be glad when he is overthrown, (Proverbs 24:17)

text: וַֽיּוֹצִיאֵם בְּכֶסֶף וְזָהָב וְאֵין בִּשְׁבָטָיו כּוֹשֵֽׁל׃
translation: He brought them out with silver and gold. There was not one feeble person among his tribes. (Psalms 105:37)

text: חַזְּקוּ יָדַיִם רָפוֹת וּבִרְכַּיִם כֹּשְׁלוֹת אַמֵּֽצוּ׃
translation: Strengthen the weak hands, and make the feeble knees firm. (Isaiah 35:3)

text: בִּקְרֹב עָלַי מְרֵעִים לֶאֱכֹל אֶת בְּשָׂרִי צָרַי וְאֹיְבַי לִי הֵמָּה כָשְׁלוּ וְנָפָֽלוּ׃
translation: When evildoers came at me to eat up my flesh, even my adversaries and my foes, they stumbled and fell. (Psalms 27:2)

text: שִׁבְעַת יָמִים תֹּאכַל מַצֹּת וּבַיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי חַג לַיהוָֽה׃
translation: Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread, and in the seventh day shall be a feast to the LORD. (Exodus 13:6)

text: אֹהֵֽב פֶּשַׁע אֹהֵב מַצָּה מַגְבִּיהַּ פִּתְחוֹ מְבַקֶּשׁ שָֽׁבֶר׃
translation: He who loves disobedience loves strife. One who builds a high gate seeks destruction. (Proverbs 17:19)

text: וּבַחֲמִשָּׁה עָשָׂר יוֹם לַחֹדֶשׁ הַזֶּה חָג שִׁבְעַת יָמִים מַצּוֹת יֵאָכֵֽל׃
translation: On the fifteenth day of this month shall be a feast. Unleavened bread shall be eaten for seven days. (Numbers 28:17)

text: וּבַחֲמִשָּׁה עָשָׂר יוֹם לַחֹדֶשׁ הַזֶּה חַג הַמַּצּוֹת לַיהוָה שִׁבְעַת יָמִים מַצּוֹת תֹּאכֵֽלוּ׃
translation: On the fifteenth day of the same month is the feast of unleavened bread to the LORD. Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread. (Leviticus 23:6)

text: וְהַנּוֹתֶרֶת מִמֶּנָּה יֹאכְלוּ אַהֲרֹן וּבָנָיו מַצּוֹת תֵּֽאָכֵל בְּמָקוֹם קָדֹשׁ בַּחֲצַר אֹֽהֶל מוֹעֵד יֹאכְלֽוּהָ׃
translation: "Command Aaron and his sons, saying, 'This is the law of the burnt offering: the burnt offering shall be on the hearth on the altar all night until the morning; and the fire of the altar shall be kept burning on it. (Leviticus 6:9)

text: וַיֵּֽאָסְפוּ יְרוּשָׁלִַם עַם רָב לַעֲשׂוֹת אֶת חַג הַמַּצּוֹת בַּחֹדֶשׁ הַשֵּׁנִי קָהָל לָרֹב מְאֹֽד׃
translation: Many people assembled at Jerusalem to keep the feast of unleavened bread in the second month, a very great assembly. (2 Chronicles 30:13)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלַי מַלְאַךְ הָאֱלֹהִים בַּחֲלוֹם יַֽעֲקֹב וָאֹמַר הִנֵּֽנִי׃
translation: The angel of God said to me in the dream, 'Jacob,' and I said, 'Here I am.' (Genesis 31:11)

text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אִישׁ אֶל אָחִיו הִנֵּה בַּעַל הַחֲלֹמוֹת הַלָּזֶה בָּֽא׃
translation: They said to one another, "Behold, this dreamer comes. (Genesis 37:19)

text: וַיְדַבֵּר פַּרְעֹה אֶל יוֹסֵף בַּחֲלֹמִי הִנְנִי עֹמֵד עַל שְׂפַת הַיְאֹֽר׃
translation: Pharaoh spoke to Joseph, "In my dream, behold, I stood on the brink of the river; (Genesis 41:17)

text: כִּי בְרֹב חֲלֹמוֹת וַהֲבָלִים וּדְבָרִים הַרְבֵּה כִּי אֶת הָאֱלֹהִים יְרָֽא׃
translation: Don't allow your mouth to lead you into sin. Don't protest before the messenger that this was a mistake. Why should God be angry at your voice, and destroy the work of your hands? (Ecclesiastes 5:6)

text: כִּֽי יָקוּם בְּקִרְבְּךָ נָבִיא אוֹ חֹלֵם חֲלוֹם וְנָתַן אֵלֶיךָ אוֹת אוֹ מוֹפֵֽת׃
translation: and the sign or the wonder comes to pass, of which he spoke to you, saying, "Let's go after other gods" (which you have not known) "and let's serve them," (Deuteronomy 13:2)

text: וּבִשְׁנַת שְׁתַּיִם לְמַלְכוּת נְבֻֽכַדְנֶצַּר חָלַם נְבֻֽכַדְנֶצַּר חֲלֹמוֹת וַתִּתְפָּעֶם רוּחוֹ וּשְׁנָתוֹ נִהְיְתָה עָלָֽיו׃
translation: In the second year of the reign of Nebuchadnezzar, Nebuchadnezzar dreamed dreams; and his spirit was troubled, and his sleep went from him. (Daniel 2:1)

text: וַיַּעַשׂ הַמֶּלֶךְ כִּסֵּא שֵׁן גָּדוֹל וַיְצַפֵּהוּ זָהָב מוּפָֽז׃
translation: Moreover the king made a great throne of ivory, and overlaid it with the finest gold. (1 Kings 10:18)

text: וַיַּעַשׂ הַמֶּלֶךְ כִּסֵּא שֵׁן גָּדוֹל וַיְצַפֵּהוּ זָהָב טָהֽוֹר׃
translation: Moreover the king made a great throne of ivory, and overlaid it with pure gold. (2 Chronicles 9:17)

text: עַל מָה אֶשָּׂא בְשָׂרִי בְשִׁנָּי וְנַפְשִׁי אָשִׂים בְּכַפִּֽי׃
translation: Why should I take my flesh in my teeth, and put my life in my hand? (Job 13:14)

text: בְּעוֹרִי וּבִבְשָׂרִי דָּבְקָה עַצְמִי וָאֶתְמַלְּטָה בְּעוֹר שִׁנָּֽי׃
translation: My bones stick to my skin and to my flesh. I have escaped by the skin of my teeth. (Job 19:20)

text: חַכְלִילִי עֵינַיִם מִיָּיִן וּלְבֶן שִׁנַּיִם מֵחָלָֽב׃
translation: His eyes will be red with wine, his teeth white with milk. (Genesis 49:12)

text: בְּחַנְפֵי לַעֲגֵי מָעוֹג חָרֹק עָלַי שִׁנֵּֽימוֹ׃
translation: Like the profane mockers in feasts, they gnashed their teeth at me. (Psalms 35:16)

text: לא לֽוֹ אַחֲרִישׁ בַּדָּיו וּדְבַר גְּבוּרוֹת וְחִין עֶרְכּֽוֹ׃
translation: Will he make a covenant with you, that you should take him for a servant forever? (Job 41:4)

text: מֵאֵין כָּמוֹךָ יְהוָה גָּדוֹל אַתָּה וְגָדוֹל שִׁמְךָ בִּגְבוּרָֽה׃
translation: There is no one like you, LORD. You are great, and your name is great in might. (Jeremiah 10:6)

text: אָבוֹא בִּגְבֻרוֹת אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה אַזְכִּיר צִדְקָתְךָ לְבַדֶּֽךָ׃
translation: I will come with the mighty acts of the Lord GOD. I will make mention of your righteousness, even of yours alone. (Psalms 71:16)

text: לִֽי עֵצָה וְתוּשִׁיָּה אֲנִי בִינָה לִי גְבוּרָֽה׃
translation: Counsel and sound knowledge are mine. I have understanding and power. (Proverbs 8:14)

text: וּלְרוּחַ מִשְׁפָּט לַיּוֹשֵׁב עַל הַמִּשְׁפָּט וְלִגְבוּרָה מְשִׁיבֵי מִלְחָמָה שָֽׁעְרָה׃
translation: and a spirit of justice to him who sits in judgment, and strength to those who turn back the battle at the gate. (Isaiah 28:6)

text: שִׁמְעוּ רְחוֹקִים אֲשֶׁר עָשִׂיתִי וּדְעוּ קְרוֹבִים גְּבֻרָתִֽי׃
translation: Hear, you who are far off, what I have done; and, you who are near, acknowledge my might." (Isaiah 33:13)

text: בֵּאדַיִן מַלְכָּא הַצְלַח לְשַׁדְרַךְ מֵישַׁךְ וַעֲבֵד נְגוֹ בִּמְדִינַת בָּבֶֽל׃
translation: Then the king promoted Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego in the province of Babylon. (Daniel 3:30)

text: וְאֵלֶּה יָצְאוּ מִן הָעִיר נַעֲרֵי שָׂרֵי הַמְּדִינוֹת וְהַחַיִל אֲשֶׁר אַחֲרֵיהֶֽם׃
translation: So these went out of the city, the young men of the princes of the provinces, and the army which followed them. (1 Kings 20:19)

text: וַיְהִי בִּימֵי אֲחַשְׁוֵרוֹשׁ הוּא אֲחַשְׁוֵרוֹשׁ הַמֹּלֵךְ מֵהֹדּוּ וְעַד כּוּשׁ שֶׁבַע וְעֶשְׂרִים וּמֵאָה מְדִינָֽה׃
translation: Now in the days of Ahasuerus (this is Ahasuerus who reigned from India even to Ethiopia, over one hundred twenty-seven provinces), (Esther 1:1)

text: וַיֵּצְאוּ נַעֲרֵי שָׂרֵי הַמְּדִינוֹת בָּרִֽאשֹׁנָה וַיִּשְׁלַח בֶּן הֲדַד וַיַּגִּידוּ לוֹ לֵאמֹר אֲנָשִׁים יָצְאוּ מִשֹּׁמְרֽוֹן׃
translation: The young men of the princes of the provinces went out first; and Ben Hadad sent out, and they told him, saying, "Men are coming out from Samaria." (1 Kings 20:17)

text: בְּיוֹם אֶחָד בְּכָל מְדִינוֹת הַמֶּלֶךְ אֲחַשְׁוֵרוֹשׁ בִּשְׁלוֹשָׁה עָשָׂר לְחֹדֶשׁ שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר הוּא חֹדֶשׁ אֲדָֽר׃
translation: on one day in all the provinces of King Ahasuerus, on the thirteenth day of the twelfth month, which is the month Adar. (Esther 8:12)

text: כִּֽי גָדוֹל מָרְדֳּכַי בְּבֵית הַמֶּלֶךְ וְשָׁמְעוֹ הוֹלֵךְ בְּכָל הַמְּדִינוֹת כִּֽי הָאִישׁ מָרְדֳּכַי הוֹלֵךְ וְגָדֽוֹל׃
translation: For Mordecai was great in the king's house, and his fame went out throughout all the provinces, for the man Mordecai grew greater and greater. (Esther 9:4)

text: הִגְדַּלְתִּי מַעֲשָׂי בָּנִיתִי לִי בָּתִּים נָטַעְתִּי לִי כְּרָמִֽים׃
translation: I made myself great works. I built myself houses. I planted myself vineyards. (Ecclesiastes 2:4)

text: עוֹד תִּטְּעִי כְרָמִים בְּהָרֵי שֹֽׁמְרוֹן נָטְעוּ נֹטְעִים וְחִלֵּֽלוּ׃
translation: Again you will plant vineyards on the mountains of Samaria. The planters will plant, and will enjoy its fruit. (Jeremiah 31:5)

text: הֲנֹטַֽע אֹזֶן הֲלֹא יִשְׁמָע אִֽם יֹצֵֽר עַיִן הֲלֹא יַבִּֽיט׃
translation: He who implanted the ear, won't he hear? He who formed the eye, won't he see? (Psalms 94:9)

text: וּבָנוּ בָתִּים וְיָשָׁבוּ וְנָטְעוּ כְרָמִים וְאָכְלוּ פִּרְיָֽם׃
translation: They will build houses and inhabit them. They will plant vineyards and eat their fruit. (Isaiah 65:21)

text: וַיָּחֶל נֹחַ אִישׁ הָֽאֲדָמָה וַיִּטַּע כָּֽרֶם׃
translation: Noah began to be a farmer, and planted a vineyard. (Genesis 9:20)

text: וַיִּטַּע אֶשֶׁל בִּבְאֵר שָׁבַע וַיִּקְרָא שָׁם בְּשֵׁם יְהוָה אֵל עוֹלָֽם׃
translation: Abraham planted a tamarisk tree in Beersheba, and there he called on the name of the LORD, the Everlasting God. (Genesis 21:33)

text: לֹא תֹאכְלוּ עַל הַדָּם לֹא תְנַחֲשׁוּ וְלֹא תְעוֹנֵֽנוּ׃
translation: "'You shall not eat any meat with the blood still in it. You shall not use enchantments, nor practice sorcery. (Leviticus 19:26)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר הַנָּחָשׁ אֶל הָֽאִשָּׁה לֹֽא מוֹת תְּמֻתֽוּן׃
translation: The serpent said to the woman, "You won't really die, (Genesis 3:4)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר הַשְׁלִיכֵהוּ אַרְצָה וַיַּשְׁלִיכֵהוּ אַרְצָה וַיְהִי לְנָחָשׁ וַיָּנָס מֹשֶׁה מִפָּנָֽיו׃
translation: He said, "Throw it on the ground." He threw it on the ground, and it became a snake; and Moses ran away from it. (Exodus 4:3)

text: וַיְהִי אַחֲרֵי כֵן וַיָּמָת נָחָשׁ מֶלֶךְ בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן וַיִּמְלֹךְ בְּנוֹ תַּחְתָּֽיו׃
translation: After this, Nahash the king of the children of Ammon died, and his son reigned in his place. (1 Chronicles 19:1)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֱלֹהִים לָאִשָּׁה מַה זֹּאת עָשִׂית וַתֹּאמֶר הָֽאִשָּׁה הַנָּחָשׁ הִשִּׁיאַנִי וָאֹכֵֽל׃
translation: The LORD God said to the woman, "What have you done?" The woman said, "The serpent deceived me, and I ate." (Genesis 3:13)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו לָבָן אִם נָא מָצָאתִי חֵן בְּעֵינֶיךָ נִחַשְׁתִּי וַיְבָרֲכֵנִי יְהוָה בִּגְלָלֶֽךָ׃
translation: Laban said to him, "If now I have found favor in your eyes, stay here, for I have divined that the LORD has blessed me for your sake." (Genesis 30:27)

text: אָרוּר מַכֵּה רֵעֵהוּ בַּסָּתֶר וְאָמַר כָּל הָעָם אָמֵֽן׃
translation: 'Cursed is he who secretly kills his neighbor.' All the people shall say, 'Amen.' (Deuteronomy 27:24)

text: בַּמְּאֵרָה אַתֶּם נֵֽאָרִים וְאֹתִי אַתֶּם קֹבְעִים הַגּוֹי כֻּלּֽוֹ׃
translation: You are cursed with the curse; for you rob me, even this whole nation. (Malachi 3:9)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר אָרוּר כְּנָעַן עֶבֶד עֲבָדִים יִֽהְיֶה לְאֶחָֽיו׃
translation: He said, "Canaan is cursed. He will be a servant of servants to his brothers." (Genesis 9:25)

text: וַאֲבָֽרֲכָה מְבָרְכֶיךָ וּמְקַלֶּלְךָ אָאֹר וְנִבְרְכוּ בְךָ כֹּל מִשְׁפְּחֹת הָאֲדָמָֽה׃
translation: I will bless those who bless you, and I will curse him who treats you with contempt. All the families of the earth will be blessed through you." (Genesis 12:3)

text: אֱלֹהִים לֹא תְקַלֵּל וְנָשִׂיא בְעַמְּךָ לֹא תָאֹֽר׃
translation: for that is his only covering, it is his garment for his skin. What would he sleep in? It will happen, when he cries to me, that I will hear, for I am gracious. (Exodus 22:27)

text: אָרוּר שֹׁכֵב עִם כָּל בְּהֵמָה וְאָמַר כָּל הָעָם אָמֵֽן׃
translation: 'Cursed is he who lies with any kind of animal.' All the people shall say, 'Amen.' (Deuteronomy 27:21)

text: בְּרֹב דְּבָרִים לֹא יֶחְדַּל פָּשַׁע וְחֹשֵׂךְ שְׂפָתָיו מַשְׂכִּֽיל׃
translation: In the multitude of words there is no lack of disobedience, but he who restrains his lips does wisely. (Proverbs 10:19)

text: וְכִי תֶחְדַּל לִנְדֹּר לֹֽא יִהְיֶה בְךָ חֵֽטְא׃
translation: You shall observe and do that which has gone out of your lips. Whatever you have vowed to the LORD your God as a free will offering, which you have promised with your mouth, you must do. (Deuteronomy 23:23)

text: וַֽיְהִי כִּשְׁמֹעַ בַּעְשָׁא וַיֶּחְדַּל מִבְּנוֹת אֶת הָֽרָמָה וַיֵּשֶׁב בְּתִרְצָֽה׃
translation: When Baasha heard of it, he stopped building Ramah, and lived in Tirzah. (1 Kings 15:21)

text: מָאַסְתִּי לֹא לְעֹלָם אֶֽחְיֶה חֲדַל מִמֶּנִּי כִּי הֶבֶל יָמָֽי׃
translation: I loathe my life. I don't want to live forever. Leave me alone, for my days are but a breath. (Job 7:16)

text: וְאַבְרָהָם וְשָׂרָה זְקֵנִים בָּאִים בַּיָּמִים חָדַל לִהְיוֹת לְשָׂרָה אֹרַח כַּנָּשִֽׁים׃
translation: Now Abraham and Sarah were old, well advanced in age. Sarah had passed the age of childbearing. (Genesis 18:11)

text: חָדְלוּ פְרָזוֹן בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל חָדֵלּוּ עַד שַׁקַּמְתִּי דְּבוֹרָה שַׁקַּמְתִּי אֵם בְּיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
translation: The rulers ceased in Israel. They ceased until I, Deborah, arose; Until I arose a mother in Israel. (Judges 5:7)

text: וַיִּתֵּן לָבָן לָהּ אֶת זִלְפָּה שִׁפְחָתוֹ לְלֵאָה בִתּוֹ שִׁפְחָֽה׃
translation: Laban gave Zilpah his servant to his daughter Leah for a servant. (Genesis 29:24)

text: וַיִּתֵּן לָבָן לְרָחֵל בִּתּוֹ אֶת בִּלְהָה שִׁפְחָתוֹ לָהּ לְשִׁפְחָֽה׃
translation: Laban gave Bilhah, his servant, to his daughter Rachel to be her servant. (Genesis 29:29)

text: וַתִּתֶּן לוֹ אֶת בִּלְהָה שִׁפְחָתָהּ לְאִשָּׁה וַיָּבֹא אֵלֶיהָ יַעֲקֹֽב׃
translation: She gave him Bilhah her servant as wife, and Jacob went in to her. (Genesis 30:4)

text: וַתַּהַר עוֹד וַתֵּלֶד בִּלְהָה שִׁפְחַת רָחֵל בֵּן שֵׁנִי לְיַעֲקֹֽב׃
translation: Bilhah, Rachel's servant, conceived again, and bore Jacob a second son. (Genesis 30:7)

text: וַתֵּלֶד זִלְפָּה שִׁפְחַת לֵאָה בֵּן שֵׁנִי לְיַעֲקֹֽב׃
translation: Zilpah, Leah's servant, bore Jacob a second son. (Genesis 30:12)

text: וַתֵּלֶד זִלְפָּה שִׁפְחַת לֵאָה לְיַעֲקֹב בֵּֽן׃
translation: Zilpah, Leah's servant, bore Jacob a son. (Genesis 30:10)

text: וְעַל רֹאשׁ הָעַמּוּדִים מַעֲשֵׂה שׁוֹשָׁן וַתִּתֹּם מְלֶאכֶת הָעַמּוּדִֽים׃
translation: On the tops of the pillars was lily work. So the work of the pillars was finished. (1 Kings 7:22)

text: וַיְהִי כַאֲשֶׁר תַּמּוּ כָּל אַנְשֵׁי הַמִּלְחָמָה לָמוּת מִקֶּרֶב הָעָֽם׃
translation: So, when all the men of war were consumed and dead from among the people, (Deuteronomy 2:16)

text: חַֽסְדֵי יְהוָה כִּי לֹא תָמְנוּ כִּי לֹא כָלוּ רַחֲמָֽיו׃
translation: It is because of the LORD's loving kindnesses that we are not consumed, because his mercies don't fail. (Lamentations 3:22)

text: וַיְהִי כַּאֲשֶׁר תַּמּוּ כָל הַגּוֹי לְהִמּוֹל וַיֵּשְׁבוּ תַחְתָּם בַּֽמַּחֲנֶה עַד חֲיוֹתָֽם׃
translation: When they were done circumcising the whole nation, they stayed in their places in the camp until they were healed. (Joshua 5:8)

text: וַתֹּאמֶר לֵאמֹר דַּבֵּר יְדַבְּרוּ בָרִֽאשֹׁנָה לֵאמֹר שָׁאֹל יְשָׁאֲלוּ בְּאָבֵל וְכֵן הֵתַֽמּוּ׃
translation: Then she spoke, saying, "They used to say in old times, 'They shall surely ask counsel at Abel,' and so they settled a matter. (2 Samuel 20:18)

text: וְאַתָּה הוּא וּשְׁנוֹתֶיךָ לֹא יִתָּֽמּוּ׃
translation: The children of your servants will continue. Their offspring will be established before you." (Psalms 102:28)

text: הֲלוֹא כֹה דְבָרִי כָּאֵשׁ נְאֻם יְהוָה וּכְפַטִּישׁ יְפֹצֵֽץ סָֽלַע׃
translation: "Isn't my word like fire?" says the LORD; "and like a hammer that breaks the rock in pieces? (Jeremiah 23:29)

text: וּגְבוּל הָאֱמֹרִי מִֽמַּעֲלֵה עַקְרַבִּים מֵהַסֶּלַע וָמָֽעְלָה׃
translation: The border of the Amorites was from the ascent of Akrabbim, from the rock, and upward. (Judges 1:36)

text: וּבָאוּ וְנָחוּ כֻלָּם בְּנַחֲלֵי הַבַּתּוֹת וּבִנְקִיקֵי הַסְּלָעִים וּבְכֹל הַנַּעֲצוּצִים וּבְכֹל הַנַּהֲלֹלִֽים׃
translation: They shall come, and shall all rest in the desolate valleys, in the clefts of the rocks, on all thorn hedges, and on all pastures. (Isaiah 7:19)

text: יְהוָה סַֽלְעִי וּמְצוּדָתִי וּמְפַלְטִי אֵלִי צוּרִי אֶֽחֱסֶה בּוֹ מָֽגִנִּי וְקֶֽרֶן יִשְׁעִי מִשְׂגַּבִּֽי׃
translation: I call on the LORD, who is worthy to be praised; and I am saved from my enemies. (Psalms 18:3)

text: יִשְׂאוּ מִדְבָּר וְעָרָיו חֲצֵרִים תֵּשֵׁב קֵדָר יָרֹנּוּ יֹשְׁבֵי סֶלַע מֵרֹאשׁ הָרִים יִצְוָֽחוּ׃
translation: Let the wilderness and its cities raise their voices, with the villages that Kedar inhabits. Let the inhabitants of Sela sing. Let them shout from the top of the mountains! (Isaiah 42:11)

text: עִזְבוּ עָרִים וְשִׁכְנוּ בַּסֶּלַע יֹשְׁבֵי מוֹאָב וִֽהְיוּ כְיוֹנָה תְּקַנֵּן בְּעֶבְרֵי פִי פָֽחַת׃
translation: You inhabitants of Moab, leave the cities, and dwell in the rock. Be like the dove that makes her nest over the mouth of the abyss. (Jeremiah 48:28)

text: וְעָבַר אֶל כֶּתֶף מוּל הָֽעֲרָבָה צָפוֹנָה וְיָרַד הָעֲרָבָֽתָה׃
translation: It passed along to the side opposite the Arabah northward, and went down to the Arabah. (Joshua 18:18)

text: וַיִּסְעוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַֽיַּחֲנוּ בְּעַֽרְבוֹת מוֹאָב מֵעֵבֶר לְיַרְדֵּן יְרֵחֽוֹ׃
translation: The children of Israel traveled, and encamped in the plains of Moab beyond the Jordan at Jericho. (Numbers 22:1)

text: וַיִּסְעוּ מֵהָרֵי הָעֲבָרִים וַֽיַּחֲנוּ בְּעַֽרְבֹת מוֹאָב עַל יַרְדֵּן יְרֵחֽוֹ׃
translation: They traveled from the mountains of Abarim, and encamped in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho. (Numbers 33:48)

text: וַיַּחֲנוּ עַל הַיַּרְדֵּן מִבֵּית הַיְשִׁמֹת עַד אָבֵל הַשִּׁטִּים בְּעַֽרְבֹת מוֹאָֽב׃
translation: They encamped by the Jordan, from Beth Jeshimoth even to Abel Shittim in the plains of Moab. (Numbers 33:49)

text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה בְּעַֽרְבֹת מוֹאָב עַל יַרְדֵּן יְרֵחוֹ לֵאמֹֽר׃
translation: The LORD spoke to Moses in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho, saying, (Numbers 33:50)

text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה בְּעַֽרְבֹת מוֹאָב עַל יַרְדֵּן יְרֵחוֹ לֵאמֹֽר׃
translation: The LORD spoke to Moses in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho, saying, (Numbers 35:1)

text: וְאֵד יַֽעֲלֶה מִן הָאָרֶץ וְהִשְׁקָה אֶֽת כָּל פְּנֵֽי הָֽאֲדָמָֽה׃
translation: but a mist went up from the earth, and watered the whole surface of the ground. (Genesis 2:6)

text: לְכָה נַשְׁקֶה אֶת אָבִינוּ יַיִן וְנִשְׁכְּבָה עִמּוֹ וּנְחַיֶּה מֵאָבִינוּ זָֽרַע׃
translation: Come, let's make our father drink wine, and we will lie with him, that we may preserve our father's family line." (Genesis 19:32)

text: עֲטִינָיו מָלְאוּ חָלָב וּמֹחַ עַצְמוֹתָיו יְשֻׁקֶּֽה׃
translation: His pails are full of milk. The marrow of his bones is moistened. (Job 21:24)

text: הִרְאִיתָה עַמְּךָ קָשָׁה הִשְׁקִיתָנוּ יַיִן תַּרְעֵלָֽה׃
translation: So that your beloved may be delivered, save with your right hand, and answer us. (Psalms 60:5)

text: וְהַשְׁקוֹת בִּכְלֵי זָהָב וְכֵלִים מִכֵּלִים שׁוֹנִים וְיֵין מַלְכוּת רָב כְּיַד הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
translation: They gave them drinks in golden vessels of various kinds, including royal wine in abundance, according to the bounty of the king. (Esther 1:7)

text: אֲנִי יְהוָה נֹֽצְרָהּ לִרְגָעִים אַשְׁקֶנָּה פֶּן יִפְקֹד עָלֶיהָ לַיְלָה וָיוֹם אֶצֳּרֶֽנָּה׃
translation: I, the LORD, am its keeper. I will water it every moment. Lest anyone damage it, I will keep it night and day. (Isaiah 27:3)

text: הָבוּ לַֽיהוָה מִשְׁפְּחוֹת עַמִּים הָבוּ לַיהוָה כָּבוֹד וָעֹֽז׃
translation: Ascribe to the LORD, you families of the peoples, ascribe to the LORD glory and strength! (1 Chronicles 16:28)

text: הָבוּ לַֽיהוָה כְּבוֹד שְׁמוֹ הִשְׁתַּחֲווּ לַיהוָה בְּהַדְרַת קֹֽדֶשׁ׃
translation: Ascribe to the LORD the glory due to his name. Worship the LORD in holy array. (Psalms 29:2)

text: הָבוּ לַיהוָה מִשְׁפְּחוֹת עַמִּים הָבוּ לַיהוָה כָּבוֹד וָעֹֽז׃
translation: Ascribe to the LORD, you families of nations, ascribe to the LORD glory and strength. (Psalms 96:7)

text: הָבוּ לַיהוָה כְּבוֹד שְׁמוֹ שְׂאֽוּ מִנְחָה וּבֹאוּ לְחַצְרוֹתָֽיו׃
translation: Ascribe to the LORD the glory due to his name. Bring an offering, and come into his courts. (Psalms 96:8)

text: הָבוּ לָכֶם אֲנָשִׁים חֲכָמִים וּנְבֹנִים וִידֻעִים לְשִׁבְטֵיכֶם וַאֲשִׂימֵם בְּרָאשֵׁיכֶֽם׃
translation: Take wise men of understanding who are respected among your tribes, and I will make them heads over you." (Deuteronomy 1:13)

text: כִּי שֵׁם יְהוָה אֶקְרָא הָבוּ גֹדֶל לֵאלֹהֵֽינוּ׃
translation: For I will proclaim the LORD's name. Ascribe greatness to our God! (Deuteronomy 32:3)

text: וַיִּקַּח יְהוּדָה אִשָּׁה לְעֵר בְּכוֹרוֹ וּשְׁמָהּ תָּמָֽר׃
translation: Judah took a wife for Er, his firstborn, and her name was Tamar. (Genesis 38:6)

text: וְאֶֽת בַּעֲלָת וְאֶת תמר תַּדְמֹר בַּמִּדְבָּר בָּאָֽרֶץ׃
translation: Baalath, Tamar in the wilderness, (1 Kings 9:18)

text: מֵהָאָרֶץ עַד מֵעַל הַפֶּתַח הַכְּרוּבִים וְהַתִּֽמֹרִים עֲשׂוּיִם וְקִיר הַׄהֵׄיׄכָֽׄלׄ׃
translation: Cherubim and palm trees were made from the ground to above the door. The wall of the temple was like this. (Ezekiel 41:20)

text: וְעָשׂוּי כְּרוּבִים וְתִֽמֹרִים וְתִֽמֹרָה בֵּין כְּרוּב לִכְרוּב וּשְׁנַיִם פָּנִים לַכְּרֽוּב׃
translation: It was made with cherubim and palm trees. A palm tree was between cherub and cherub, and every cherub had two faces, (Ezekiel 41:18)

text: וְתָמָר כַּלָּתוֹ יָלְדָה לּוֹ אֶת פֶּרֶץ וְאֶת זָרַח כָּל בְּנֵי יְהוּדָה חֲמִשָּֽׁה׃
translation: Tamar his daughter-in-law bore him Perez and Zerah. All the sons of Judah were five. (1 Chronicles 2:4)

text: וַיֶּאֱסֹף אֵלָיו אֶת בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן וַעֲמָלֵק וַיֵּלֶךְ וַיַּךְ אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּֽירְשׁוּ אֶת עִיר הַתְּמָרִֽים׃
translation: He gathered the children of Ammon and Amalek to himself; and he went and struck Israel, and they possessed the city of palm trees. (Judges 3:13)

text: וּקְשַׁרְתָּם לְאוֹת עַל יָדֶךָ וְהָיוּ לְטֹטָפֹת בֵּין עֵינֶֽיךָ׃
translation: You shall bind them for a sign on your hand, and they shall be for frontlets between your eyes. (Deuteronomy 6:8)

text: וַיִּקְשְׁרוּ עַבְדֵֽי אָמוֹן עָלָיו וַיָּמִיתוּ אֶת הַמֶּלֶךְ בְּבֵיתֽוֹ׃
translation: The servants of Amon conspired against him, and put the king to death in his own house. (2 Kings 21:23)

text: וַיִּקְשְׁרוּ כֻלָּם יַחְדָּו לָבוֹא לְהִלָּחֵם בִּירוּשָׁלִָם וְלַעֲשׂוֹת לוֹ תּוֹעָֽה׃
translation: He spoke before his brothers and the army of Samaria, and said, "What are these feeble Jews doing? Will they fortify themselves? Will they sacrifice? Will they finish in a day? Will they revive the stones out of the heaps of rubbish, since they are burned?" (Nehemiah 4:2)

text: הַֽתְקַשֵּׁר מַעֲדַנּוֹת כִּימָה אֽוֹ מֹשְׁכוֹת כְּסִיל תְּפַתֵּֽחַ׃
translation: "Can you bind the cluster of the Pleiades, or loosen the cords of Orion? (Job 38:31)

text: קָשְׁרֵם עַל לִבְּךָ תָמִיד עָנְדֵם עַל גַּרְגְּרֹתֶֽךָ׃
translation: Bind them continually on your heart. Tie them around your neck. (Proverbs 6:21)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֵלָי נִֽמְצָא קֶשֶׁר בְּאִישׁ יְהוּדָה וּבְיֹשְׁבֵי יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
translation: The LORD said to me, "A conspiracy is found among the men of Judah, and among the inhabitants of Jerusalem. (Jeremiah 11:9)

text: יֵשׁ דֶּרֶךְ יָשָׁר לִפְנֵי אִישׁ וְאַחֲרִיתָהּ דַּרְכֵי מָֽוֶת׃
translation: There is a way which seems right to a man, but in the end it leads to death. (Proverbs 14:12)

text: יֵשׁ דֶּרֶךְ יָשָׁר לִפְנֵי אִישׁ וְאַחֲרִיתָהּ דַּרְכֵי מָֽוֶת׃
translation: There is a way which seems right to a man, but in the end it leads to death. (Proverbs 16:25)

text: וַאֲנִי שָׁמַעְתִּי וְלֹא אָבִין וָאֹמְרָה אֲדֹנִי מָה אַחֲרִית אֵֽלֶּה׃
translation: I heard, but I didn't understand. Then I said, "My lord, what will be the outcome of these things?" (Daniel 12:8)

text: לוּ חָכְמוּ יַשְׂכִּילוּ זֹאת יָבִינוּ לְאַחֲרִיתָֽם׃
translation: Oh that they were wise, that they understood this, that they would consider their latter end! (Deuteronomy 32:29)

text: וּֽפֹשְׁעִים נִשְׁמְדוּ יַחְדָּו אַחֲרִית רְשָׁעִים נִכְרָֽתָה׃
translation: As for transgressors, they shall be destroyed together. The future of the wicked shall be cut off. (Psalms 37:38)

text: אֶשָּׂא כַנְפֵי שָׁחַר אֶשְׁכְּנָה בְּאַחֲרִית יָֽם׃
translation: If I take the wings of the dawn, and settle in the uttermost parts of the sea, (Psalms 139:9)

text: מַֽה תַּעֲשׂוּ לְיוֹם מוֹעֵד וּלְיוֹם חַג יְהוָֽה׃
translation: What will you do in the day of solemn assembly, and in the day of the feast of the LORD? (Hosea 9:5)

text: וַיִּקָּהֲלוּ אֶל הַמֶּלֶךְ כָּל אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל בֶּחָג הוּא הַחֹדֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִעִֽי׃
translation: So all the men of Israel assembled themselves to the king at the feast, which was in the seventh month. (2 Chronicles 5:3)

text: תִּקְעוּ בַחֹדֶשׁ שׁוֹפָר בַּכֵּסֶה לְיוֹם חַגֵּֽנוּ׃
translation: For it is a statute for Israel, an ordinance of the God of Jacob. (Psalms 81:4)

text: וַיַּרְא אַהֲרֹן וַיִּבֶן מִזְבֵּחַ לְפָנָיו וַיִּקְרָא אַֽהֲרֹן וַיֹּאמַר חַג לַיהוָה מָחָֽר׃
translation: When Aaron saw this, he built an altar before it; and Aaron made a proclamation, and said, "Tomorrow shall be a feast to the LORD." (Exodus 32:5)

text: לֹֽא תִשְׁחַט עַל חָמֵץ דַּם זִבְחִי וְלֹא יָלִין לַבֹּקֶר זֶבַח חַג הַפָּֽסַח׃
translation: "You shall not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leavened bread. The sacrifice of the feast of the Passover shall not be left to the morning. (Exodus 34:25)

text: וְשָׂמַחְתָּ בְּחַגֶּךָ אַתָּה וּבִנְךָ וּבִתֶּךָ וְעַבְדְּךָ וַאֲמָתֶךָ וְהַלֵּוִי וְהַגֵּר וְהַיָּתוֹם וְהָאַלְמָנָה אֲשֶׁר בִּשְׁעָרֶֽיךָ׃
translation: You shall rejoice in your feast, you, your son, your daughter, your male servant, your female servant, the Levite, the foreigner, the fatherless, and the widow who are within your gates. (Deuteronomy 16:14)

text: וְנָתַתִּי אֶת בְּשָׂרְךָ עַל הֶֽהָרִים וּמִלֵּאתִי הַגֵּאָיוֹת רָמוּתֶֽךָ׃
translation: I will lay your flesh on the mountains, and fill the valleys with your height. (Ezekiel 32:5)

text: וַנֵּשֶׁב בַּגָּיְא מוּל בֵּית פְּעֽוֹר׃
translation: So we stayed in the valley near Beth Peor. (Deuteronomy 3:29)

text: וּפְלִשְׁתִּים עֹמְדִים אֶל הָהָר מִזֶּה וְיִשְׂרָאֵל עֹמְדִים אֶל הָהָר מִזֶּה וְהַגַּיְא בֵּינֵיהֶֽם׃
translation: The Philistines stood on the mountain on the one side, and Israel stood on the mountain on the other side: and there was a valley between them. (1 Samuel 17:3)

text: וַיַּעַשׂ דָּוִד שֵׁם בְּשֻׁבוֹ מֵהַכּוֹתוֹ אֶת אֲרָם בְּגֵיא מֶלַח שְׁמוֹנָה עָשָׂר אָֽלֶף׃
translation: David earned a reputation when he returned from striking down eighteen thousand men of the Syrians in the Valley of Salt. (2 Samuel 8:13)

text: וָאֱהִי עֹלֶה בַנַּחַל לַיְלָה וָאֱהִי שֹׂבֵר בַּחוֹמָה וָאָשׁוּב וָאָבוֹא בְּשַׁעַר הַגַּיְא וָאָשֽׁוּב׃
translation: Then I went up in the night by the brook and inspected the wall; and I turned back, and entered by the valley gate, and so returned. (Nehemiah 2:15)

text: לֹד וְאוֹנוֹ גֵּי הַחֲרָשִֽׁים׃
translation: Lod, and Ono, the valley of craftsmen. (Nehemiah 11:35)

text: הֲלֹא הֵם יוֹרוּךָ יֹאמְרוּ לָךְ וּמִלִּבָּם יוֹצִאוּ מִלִּֽים׃
translation: Shall they not teach you, tell you, and utter words out of their heart? (Job 8:10)

text: כִּֽי תָשִׁיב אֶל אֵל רוּחֶךָ וְהֹצֵאתָ מִפִּיךָ מִלִּֽין׃
translation: that you turn your spirit against God, and let such words go out of your mouth? (Job 15:13)

text: אִם יֵשׁ מִלִּין הֲשִׁיבֵנִי דַּבֵּר כִּֽי חָפַצְתִּי צַדְּקֶֽךָּ׃
translation: If you have anything to say, answer me. Speak, for I desire to justify you. (Job 33:32)

text: כִּי אֵין מִלָּה בִּלְשׁוֹנִי הֵן יְהוָה יָדַעְתָּ כֻלָּֽהּ׃
translation: For there is not a word on my tongue, but behold, LORD, you know it altogether. (Psalms 139:4)

text: רוּחַ יְהוָה דִּבֶּר בִּי וּמִלָּתוֹ עַל לְשׁוֹנִֽי׃
translation: "The LORD's Spirit spoke by me. His word was on my tongue. (2 Samuel 23:2)

text: אֵדְעָה מִלִּים יַעֲנֵנִי וְאָבִינָה מַה יֹּאמַר לִֽי׃
translation: I would know the words which he would answer me, and understand what he would tell me. (Job 23:5)

text: וְאַתֶּם הַדְּבֵקִים בַּיהוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם חַיִּים כֻּלְּכֶם הַיּֽוֹם׃
translation: But you who were faithful to the LORD your God are all alive today. (Deuteronomy 4:4)

text: אִישׁ רֵעִים לְהִתְרֹעֵעַ וְיֵשׁ אֹהֵב דָּבֵק מֵאָֽח׃
translation: A man of many companions may be ruined, but there is a friend who sticks closer than a brother. (Proverbs 18:24)

text: אֶת יְהוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ תִּירָא אֹתוֹ תַעֲבֹד וּבוֹ תִדְבָּק וּבִשְׁמוֹ תִּשָּׁבֵֽעַ׃
translation: You shall fear the LORD your God. You shall serve him. You shall cling to him, and you shall swear by his name. (Deuteronomy 10:20)

text: כִּי אִם בַּיהוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם תִּדְבָּקוּ כַּאֲשֶׁר עֲשִׂיתֶם עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּֽה׃
translation: but hold fast to the LORD your God, as you have done to this day. (Joshua 23:8)

text: דָּבְקָה נַפְשִׁי אַחֲרֶיךָ בִּי תָּמְכָה יְמִינֶֽךָ׃
translation: But those who seek my soul to destroy it shall go into the lower parts of the earth. (Psalms 63:9)

text: דָּֽבְקָה לֶעָפָר נַפְשִׁי חַיֵּנִי כִּדְבָרֶֽךָ׃
translation: My soul is laid low in the dust. Revive me according to your word! (Psalms 119:25)

text: וּלְאֵלֶּה תִּטַּמָּאוּ כָּל הַנֹּגֵעַ בְּנִבְלָתָם יִטְמָא עַד הָעָֽרֶב׃
translation: "'By these you will become unclean: whoever touches their carcass shall be unclean until the evening. (Leviticus 11:24)

text: וְכָל הַנֹּשֵׂא מִנִּבְלָתָם יְכַבֵּס בְּגָדָיו וְטָמֵא עַד הָעָֽרֶב׃
translation: Whoever carries any part of their carcass shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the evening. (Leviticus 11:25)

text: מִבְּשָׂרָם לֹא תֹאכֵלוּ וּבְנִבְלָתָם לֹא תִגָּעוּ טְמֵאִים הֵם לָכֶֽם׃
translation: You shall not eat their meat. You shall not touch their carcasses. They are unclean to you. (Leviticus 11:8)

text: וְהַנֹּשֵׂא אֶת נִבְלָתָם יְכַבֵּס בְּגָדָיו וְטָמֵא עַד הָעָרֶב טְמֵאִים הֵמָּה לָכֶֽם׃
translation: He who carries their carcass shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the evening. They are unclean to you. (Leviticus 11:28)

text: וְכִי יִפֹּל מִנִּבְלָתָם עַל כָּל זֶרַע זֵרוּעַ אֲשֶׁר יִזָּרֵעַ טָהוֹר הֽוּא׃
translation: If part of their carcass falls on any sowing seed which is to be sown, it is clean. (Leviticus 11:37)

text: וְכִי יֻתַּן מַיִם עַל זֶרַע וְנָפַל מִנִּבְלָתָם עָלָיו טָמֵא הוּא לָכֶֽם׃
translation: But if water is put on the seed, and part of their carcass falls on it, it is unclean to you. (Leviticus 11:38)

text: בְּיָדְךָ אַפְקִיד רוּחִי פָּדִיתָה אוֹתִי יְהוָה אֵל אֱמֶֽת׃
translation: I hate those who regard lying vanities, but I trust in the LORD. (Psalms 31:6)

text: תְּרַנֵּנָּה שְׂפָתַי כִּי אֲזַמְּרָה לָּךְ וְנַפְשִׁי אֲשֶׁר פָּדִֽיתָ׃
translation: My lips shall shout for joy! My soul, which you have redeemed, sings praises to you! (Psalms 71:23)

text: וְהֵם עֲבָדֶיךָ וְעַמֶּךָ אֲשֶׁר פָּדִיתָ בְּכֹחֲךָ הַגָּדוֹל וּבְיָדְךָ הַחֲזָקָֽה׃
translation: "Now these are your servants and your people, whom you have redeemed by your great power and by your strong hand. (Nehemiah 1:10)

text: פָּדָה נפשי נַפְשׁוֹ מֵעֲבֹר בַּשָּׁחַת וחיתי וְחַיָּתוֹ בָּאוֹר תִּרְאֶֽה׃
translation: He has redeemed my soul from going into the pit. My life will see the light.' (Job 33:28)

text: אָח לֹא פָדֹה יִפְדֶּה אִישׁ לֹא יִתֵּן לֵאלֹהִים כָּפְרֽוֹ׃
translation: For the redemption of their life is costly, no payment is ever enough, (Psalms 49:8)

text: אַךְ אֱלֹהִים יִפְדֶּה נַפְשִׁי מִֽיַּד שְׁאוֹל כִּי יִקָּחֵנִי סֶֽלָה׃
translation: Don't be afraid when a man is made rich, when the glory of his house is increased; (Psalms 49:16)

text: וְנָתַתָּ אֶל הָאָרֹן אֵת הָעֵדֻת אֲשֶׁר אֶתֵּן אֵלֶֽיךָ׃
translation: You shall put the covenant which I shall give you into the ark. (Exodus 25:16)

text: וּמָשַׁחְתָּ בוֹ אֶת אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וְאֵת אֲרוֹן הָעֵדֻֽת׃
translation: You shall use it to anoint the Tent of Meeting, the ark of the covenant, (Exodus 30:26)

text: צַוֵּה אֶת הַכֹּהֲנִים נֹשְׂאֵי אֲרוֹן הָעֵדוּת וְיַעֲלוּ מִן הַיַּרְדֵּֽן׃
translation: "Command the priests who bear the ark of the covenant, that they come up out of the Jordan." (Joshua 4:16)

text: לַמְנַצֵּחַ עַל שׁוּשַׁן עֵדוּת מִכְתָּם לְדָוִד לְלַמֵּֽד׃
translation: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of "The Lily of the Covenant." A teaching poem by David, when he fought with Aram Naharaim and with Aram Zobah, and Joab returned, and killed twelve thousand of Edom in the Valley of Salt. God, you have rejected us. You have broken us down. You have been angry. Restore us, again. (Psalms 60:1)

text: מִכָּל מְלַמְּדַי הִשְׂכַּלְתִּי כִּי עֵדְוֺתֶיךָ שִׂיחָה לִֽֿי׃
translation: I have more understanding than all my teachers, for your testimonies are my meditation. (Psalms 119:99)

text: כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה וַיַּנִּיחֵהוּ אַהֲרֹן לִפְנֵי הָעֵדֻת לְמִשְׁמָֽרֶת׃
translation: As the LORD commanded Moses, so Aaron laid it up before the Testimony, to be kept. (Exodus 16:34)

text: אִם לֹא בָכִיתִי לִקְשֵׁה יוֹם עָֽגְמָה נַפְשִׁי לָאֶבְיֽוֹן׃
translation: Didn't I weep for him who was in trouble? Wasn't my soul grieved for the needy? (Job 30:25)

text: אָב אָנֹכִֽי לָֽאֶבְיוֹנִים וְרִב לֹא יָדַעְתִּי אֶחְקְרֵֽהוּ׃
translation: I was a father to the needy. I researched the cause of him whom I didn't know. (Job 29:16)

text: כִּֽי עָנִי וְאֶבְיוֹן אָנֹכִי וְלִבִּי חָלַל בְּקִרְבִּֽי׃
translation: for I am poor and needy. My heart is wounded within me. (Psalms 109:22)

text: כִּֽי יַעֲמֹד לִימִין אֶבְיוֹן לְהוֹשִׁיעַ מִשֹּׁפְטֵי נַפְשֽׁוֹ׃
translation: For he will stand at the right hand of the needy, to save him from those who judge his soul. (Psalms 109:31)

text: ידעת יָדַעְתִּי כִּֽי יַעֲשֶׂה יְהוָה דִּין עָנִי מִשְׁפַּט אֶבְיֹנִֽים׃
translation: Surely the righteous will give thanks to your name. The upright will dwell in your presence. (Psalms 140:13)

text: פְּתַח פִּיךָ שְׁפָט צֶדֶק וְדִין עָנִי וְאֶבְיֽוֹן׃
translation: Open your mouth, judge righteously, and serve justice to the poor and needy." (Proverbs 31:9)

text: אֶשְׂחַק אֲלֵהֶם לֹא יַאֲמִינוּ וְאוֹר פָּנַי לֹא יַפִּילֽוּן׃
translation: I smiled on them when they had no confidence. They didn't reject the light of my face. (Job 29:24)

text: מִֽי יְסַפֵּר שְׁחָקִים בְּחָכְמָה וְנִבְלֵי שָׁמַיִם מִי יַשְׁכִּֽיב׃
translation: Who can count the clouds by wisdom? Or who can pour out the containers of the sky, (Job 38:37)

text: אֲדֹנָי יִשְׂחַק לוֹ כִּֽי רָאָה כִּֽי יָבֹא יוֹמֽוֹ׃
translation: The Lord will laugh at him, for he sees that his day is coming. (Psalms 37:13)

text: כִּֽי גָדֹל עַד שָׁמַיִם חַסְדֶּךָ וְֽעַד שְׁחָקִים אֲמִתֶּֽךָ׃
translation: Be exalted, God, above the heavens. Let your glory be over all the earth. (Psalms 57:11)

text: כִּֽי גָדוֹל מֵֽעַל שָׁמַיִם חַסְדֶּךָ וְֽעַד שְׁחָקִים אֲמִתֶּֽךָ׃
translation: Be exalted, God, above the heavens! Let your glory be over all the earth. (Psalms 108:5)

text: הַבֵּט שָׁמַיִם וּרְאֵה וְשׁוּר שְׁחָקִים גָּבְהוּ מִמֶּֽךָּ׃
translation: Look to the skies, and see. See the skies, which are higher than you. (Job 35:5)

text: וַיִּגֶל אָזְנָם לַמּוּסָר וַיֹּאמֶר כִּֽי יְשֻׁבוּן מֵאָֽוֶן׃
translation: He also opens their ears to instruction, and commands that they return from iniquity. (Job 36:10)

text: מוּסָר רָע לְעֹזֵב אֹרַח שׂוֹנֵא תוֹכַחַת יָמֽוּת׃
translation: There is stern discipline for one who forsakes the way. Whoever hates reproof shall die. (Proverbs 15:10)

text: יִרְאַת יְהוָה מוּסַר חָכְמָה וְלִפְנֵי כָבוֹד עֲנָוָֽה׃
translation: The fear of the LORD teaches wisdom. Before honor is humility. (Proverbs 15:33)

text: אֱמֶת קְנֵה וְאַל תִּמְכֹּר חָכְמָה וּמוּסָר וּבִינָֽה׃
translation: Buy the truth, and don't sell it. Get wisdom, discipline, and understanding. (Proverbs 23:23)

text: וָֽאֶחֱזֶה אָנֹכִֽי אָשִׁית לִבִּי רָאִיתִי לָקַחְתִּי מוּסָֽר׃
translation: Then I saw, and considered well. I saw, and received instruction: (Proverbs 24:32)

text: וְאַתָּה שָׂנֵאתָ מוּסָר וַתַּשְׁלֵךְ דְּבָרַי אַחֲרֶֽיךָ׃
translation: since you hate instruction, and throw my words behind you? (Psalms 50:17)

text: הֲכֹל הַיּוֹם יַחֲרֹשׁ הַחֹרֵשׁ לִזְרֹעַ יְפַתַּח וִֽישַׂדֵּד אַדְמָתֽוֹ׃
translation: Does he who plows to sow plow continually? Does he keep turning the soil and breaking the clods? (Isaiah 28:24)

text: יִשְׁלָיוּ אֹֽהָלִים לְשֹׁדְדִים וּֽבַטֻּחוֹת לְמַרְגִּיזֵי אֵל לַאֲשֶׁר הֵבִיא אֱלוֹהַּ בְּיָדֽוֹ׃
translation: The tents of robbers prosper. Those who provoke God are secure, who carry their god in their hands. (Job 12:6)

text: קוֹל פְּחָדִים בְּאָזְנָיו בַּשָּׁלוֹם שׁוֹדֵד יְבוֹאֶֽנּוּ׃
translation: A sound of terrors is in his ears. In prosperity the destroyer will come on him. (Job 15:21)

text: שֶׁבֶר עַל שֶׁבֶר נִקְרָא כִּי שֻׁדְּדָה כָּל הָאָרֶץ פִּתְאֹם שֻׁדְּדוּ אֹהָלַי רֶגַע יְרִיעֹתָֽי׃
translation: Destruction on destruction is decreed, for the whole land is laid waste. Suddenly my tents are destroyed, and my curtains gone in a moment. (Jeremiah 4:20)

text: הֹבִישׁ מוֹאָב כִּֽי חַתָּה הילילי הֵילִילוּ וזעקי וּֽזְעָקוּ הַגִּידוּ בְאַרְנוֹן כִּי שֻׁדַּד מוֹאָֽב׃
translation: Moab is disappointed; for it is broken down. Wail and cry! Tell it by the Arnon, that Moab is laid waste. (Jeremiah 48:20)

text: בֵּין רַגְלֶיהָ כָּרַע נָפַל שָׁכָב בֵּין רַגְלֶיהָ כָּרַע נָפָל בַּאֲשֶׁר כָּרַע שָׁם נָפַל שָׁדֽוּד׃
translation: At her feet he bowed, he fell, he lay. At her feet he bowed, he fell. Where he bowed, there he fell down dead. (Judges 5:27)

text: וַעֲזַרְיָה הֹלִיד אֶת חָלֶץ וְחֶלֶץ הֹלִיד אֶת אֶלְעָשָֽׂה׃
translation: and Azariah became the father of Helez, and Helez became the father of Eleasah, (1 Chronicles 2:39)

text: וְאִם לֹא יַֽעַבְרוּ חֲלוּצִים אִתְּכֶם וְנֹֽאחֲזוּ בְתֹכְכֶם בְּאֶרֶץ כְּנָֽעַן׃
translation: but if they will not pass over with you armed, they shall have possessions among you in the land of Canaan." (Numbers 32:30)

text: וַיֹּצֵא לַמֶּרְחָב אֹתִי יְחַלְּצֵנִי כִּי חָפֵֽץ בִּֽי׃
translation: He also brought me out into a large place. He delivered me, because he delighted in me. (2 Samuel 22:20)

text: שׁוּבָה יְהוָה חַלְּצָה נַפְשִׁי הוֹשִׁיעֵנִי לְמַעַן חַסְדֶּֽךָ׃
translation: For in death there is no memory of you. In Sheol, who shall give you thanks? (Psalms 6:5)

text: יִקְרָאֵנִי וְֽאֶעֱנֵהוּ עִמּֽוֹ אָנֹכִי בְצָרָה אֲחַלְּצֵהוּ וַֽאֲכַבְּדֵֽהוּ׃
translation: He will call on me, and I will answer him. I will be with him in trouble. I will deliver him, and honor him. (Psalms 91:15)

text: רְאֵֽה עָנְיִי וְחַלְּצֵנִי כִּי תֽוֹרָתְךָ לֹא שָׁכָֽחְתִּי׃
translation: Consider my affliction, and deliver me, for I don't forget your law. (Psalms 119:153)

text: כַּף אַחַת עֲשָׂרָה זָהָב מְלֵאָה קְטֹֽרֶת׃
translation: one golden ladle of ten shekels, full of incense; (Numbers 7:14)

text: כַּף אַחַת עֲשָׂרָה זָהָב מְלֵאָה קְטֹֽרֶת׃
translation: one golden ladle of ten shekels, full of incense; (Numbers 7:20)

text: כַּף אַחַת עֲשָׂרָה זָהָב מְלֵאָה קְטֹֽרֶת׃
translation: one golden ladle of ten shekels, full of incense; (Numbers 7:26)

text: כַּף אַחַת עֲשָׂרָה זָהָב מְלֵאָה קְטֹֽרֶת׃
translation: one golden ladle of ten shekels, full of incense; (Numbers 7:32)

text: כַּף אַחַת עֲשָׂרָה זָהָב מְלֵאָה קְטֹֽרֶת׃
translation: one golden ladle of ten shekels, full of incense; (Numbers 7:38)

text: כַּף אַחַת עֲשָׂרָה זָהָב מְלֵאָה קְטֹֽרֶת׃
translation: one golden ladle of ten shekels, full of incense; (Numbers 7:44)

text: אֹמַר אֶל אֱלוֹהַּ אַל תַּרְשִׁיעֵנִי הֽוֹדִיעֵנִי עַל מַה תְּרִיבֵֽנִי׃
translation: I will tell God, 'Do not condemn me. Show me why you contend with me. (Job 10:2)

text: חָנֻּנִי חָנֻּנִי אַתֶּם רֵעָי כִּי יַד אֱלוֹהַּ נָגְעָה בִּֽי׃
translation: "Have pity on me. Have pity on me, you my friends, for the hand of God has touched me. (Job 19:21)

text: בָּתֵּיהֶם שָׁלוֹם מִפָּחַד וְלֹא שֵׁבֶט אֱלוֹהַּ עֲלֵיהֶֽם׃
translation: Their houses are safe from fear, neither is the rod of God upon them. (Job 21:9)

text: הֶן זֹאת לֹא צָדַקְתָּ אֶעֱנֶךָּ כִּֽי יִרְבֶּה אֱלוֹהַ מֵאֱנֽוֹשׁ׃
translation: "Behold, I will answer you. In this you are not just, for God is greater than man. (Job 33:12)

text: הֲרֹב עִם שַׁדַּי יִסּוֹר מוֹכִיחַ אֱלוֹהַּ יַעֲנֶֽנָּה׃
translation: "Shall he who argues contend with the Almighty? He who argues with God, let him answer it." (Job 40:2)

text: חַי יְהוָה וּבָרוּךְ צוּרִי וְיָרוּם אֱלוֹהֵי יִשְׁעִֽי׃
translation: even the God who executes vengeance for me, and subdues peoples under me. (Psalms 18:47)

text: וְהִפְרֵתִי אֹֽתְךָ בִּמְאֹד מְאֹד וּנְתַתִּיךָ לְגוֹיִם וּמְלָכִים מִמְּךָ יֵצֵֽאוּ׃
translation: I will make you exceedingly fruitful, and I will make nations of you. Kings will come out of you. (Genesis 17:6)

text: וְאֵל שַׁדַּי יְבָרֵךְ אֹֽתְךָ וְיַפְרְךָ וְיַרְבֶּךָ וְהָיִיתָ לִקְהַל עַמִּֽים׃
translation: May God Almighty bless you, and make you fruitful, and multiply you, that you may be a company of peoples, (Genesis 28:3)

text: וְיָצָא חֹטֶר מִגֵּזַע יִשָׁי וְנֵצֶר מִשָּׁרָשָׁיו יִפְרֶֽה׃
translation: A shoot will come out of the stock of Jesse, and a branch out of his roots will bear fruit. (Isaiah 11:1)

text: וְאֵת שֵׁם הַשֵּׁנִי קָרָא אֶפְרָיִם כִּֽי הִפְרַנִי אֱלֹהִים בְּאֶרֶץ עָנְיִֽי׃
translation: The name of the second, he called Ephraim: "For God has made me fruitful in the land of my affliction." (Genesis 41:52)

text: וּפָנִיתִי אֲלֵיכֶם וְהִפְרֵיתִי אֶתְכֶם וְהִרְבֵּיתִי אֶתְכֶם וַהֲקִימֹתִי אֶת בְּרִיתִי אִתְּכֶֽם׃
translation: "'I will have respect for you, make you fruitful, multiply you, and will establish my covenant with you. (Leviticus 26:9)

text: וְאִם יָרֵא אַתָּה לָרֶדֶת רֵד אַתָּה וּפֻרָה נַעַרְךָ אֶל הַֽמַּחֲנֶֽה׃
translation: But if you are afraid to go down, go with Purah your servant down to the camp. (Judges 7:10)

text: וַתַּהַר וַתֵּלֶד בֵּן וַתֹּאמֶר אָסַף אֱלֹהִים אֶת חֶרְפָּתִֽי׃
translation: She conceived, bore a son, and said, "God has taken away my reproach." (Genesis 30:23)

text: וַתַּהַר עוֹד וַתֵּלֶד בֵּן וַתִּקְרָא אֶת שְׁמוֹ אוֹנָֽן׃
translation: She conceived again, and bore a son; and she named him Onan. (Genesis 38:4)

text: וַתַּהַר הָֽאִשָּׁה וַתִּשְׁלַח וַתַּגֵּד לְדָוִד וַתֹּאמֶר הָרָה אָנֹֽכִי׃
translation: The woman conceived; and she sent and told David, and said, "I am with child." (2 Samuel 11:5)

text: יֹאבַד יוֹם אִוָּלֶד בּוֹ וְהַלַּיְלָה אָמַר הֹרָה גָֽבֶר׃
translation: "Let the day perish in which I was born, the night which said, 'There is a boy conceived.' (Job 3:3)

text: וַתַּהַר וַתֵּלֶד בֵּן וַיִּקְרָא אֶת שְׁמוֹ עֵֽר׃
translation: She conceived, and bore a son; and he named him Er. (Genesis 38:3)

text: הִנֵּה יְחַבֶּל אָוֶן וְהָרָה עָמָל וְיָלַד שָֽׁקֶר׃
translation: He has dug a hole, and has fallen into the pit which he made. (Psalms 7:15)

text: וַֽיְחִי חֲנוֹךְ חָמֵשׁ וְשִׁשִּׁים שָׁנָה וַיּוֹלֶד אֶת מְתוּשָֽׁלַח׃
translation: Enoch lived sixty-five years, then became the father of Methuselah. (Genesis 5:21)

text: פְּקֻדֵיהֶם לְמַטֵּה דָן שְׁנַיִם וְשִׁשִּׁים אֶלֶף וּשְׁבַע מֵאֽוֹת׃
translation: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Dan, were sixty-two thousand seven hundred. (Numbers 1:39)

text: אֵלֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹת הַזְּבוּלֹנִי לִפְקֻדֵיהֶם שִׁשִּׁים אֶלֶף וַחֲמֵשׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃
translation: These are the families of the Zebulunites according to those who were counted of them, sixty thousand five hundred. (Numbers 26:27)

text: וּמִבְּנֵי שְׁלוֹמִית בֶּן יוֹסִפְיָה וְעִמּוֹ מֵאָה וְשִׁשִּׁים הַזְּכָרִֽים׃
translation: Of the sons of Shelomith, the son of Josiphiah; and with him one hundred sixty males. (Ezra 8:10)

text: וַֽיְחִי מַֽהֲלַלְאֵל חָמֵשׁ שָׁנִים וְשִׁשִּׁים שָׁנָה וַיּוֹלֶד אֶת יָֽרֶד׃
translation: Mahalalel lived sixty-five years, then became the father of Jared. (Genesis 5:15)

text: וּצְבָאוֹ וּפְקֻדֵיהֶם שְׁנַיִם וְשִׁשִּׁים אֶלֶף וּשְׁבַע מֵאֽוֹת׃
translation: His division, and those who were counted of them, were sixty-two thousand seven hundred. (Numbers 2:26)

text: עַד שֶׁהַמֶּלֶךְ בִּמְסִבּוֹ נִרְדִּי נָתַן רֵיחֽוֹ׃
translation: While the king sat at his table, my perfume spread its fragrance. (Song of Solomon 1:12)

text: מִלְּבַד עֹלַת הַחֹדֶשׁ וּמִנְחָתָהּ וְעֹלַת הַתָּמִיד וּמִנְחָתָהּ וְנִסְכֵּיהֶם כְּמִשְׁפָּטָם לְרֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ אִשֶּׁה לַיהוָֽה׃
translation: in addition to the burnt offering of the new moon with its meal offering, and the continual burnt offering with its meal offering, and their drink offerings, according to their ordinance, for a pleasant aroma, an offering made by fire to the LORD. (Numbers 29:6)

text: וְלָקַחְתָּ אֹתָם מִיָּדָם וְהִקְטַרְתָּ הַמִּזְבֵּחָה עַל הָעֹלָה לְרֵיחַ נִיחוֹחַ לִפְנֵי יְהוָה אִשֶּׁה הוּא לַיהוָֽה׃
translation: You shall take them from their hands, and burn them on the altar on the burnt offering, for a pleasant aroma before the LORD: it is an offering made by fire to the LORD. (Exodus 29:25)

text: וְקִרְבּוֹ וּכְרָעָיו יִרְחַץ בַּמָּיִם וְהִקְטִיר הַכֹּהֵן אֶת הַכֹּל הַמִּזְבֵּחָה עֹלָה אִשֵּׁה רֵֽיחַ נִיחוֹחַ לַֽיהוָֽה׃
translation: but he shall wash its innards and its legs with water. The priest shall burn all of it on the altar, for a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to the LORD. (Leviticus 1:9)

text: וּמִנְחָתוֹ שְׁנֵי עֶשְׂרֹנִים סֹלֶת בְּלוּלָה בַשֶּׁמֶן אִשֶּׁה לַיהוָה רֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ וְנִסְכֹּה יַיִן רְבִיעִת הַהִֽין׃
translation: The meal offering with it shall be two tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil, an offering made by fire to the LORD for a pleasant aroma; and the drink offering with it shall be of wine, the fourth part of a hin. (Leviticus 23:13)

text: וְאֵת הַכֶּבֶשׂ הַשֵּׁנִי תַּעֲשֶׂה בֵּין הָֽעַרְבָּיִם כְּמִנְחַת הַבֹּקֶר וּכְנִסְכּוֹ תַּעֲשֶׂה אִשֵּׁה רֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ לַיהוָֽה׃
translation: The other lamb you shall offer at evening. As the meal offering of the morning, and as its drink offering, you shall offer it, an offering made by fire, for a pleasant aroma to the LORD. (Numbers 28:8)

text: מַה נִּמְרְצוּ אִמְרֵי יֹשֶׁר וּמַה יּוֹכִיחַ הוֹכֵחַ מִכֶּֽם׃
translation: How forcible are words of uprightness! But your reproof, what does it reprove? (Job 6:25)

text: לֹא יֵשׁ בֵּינֵינוּ מוֹכִיחַ יָשֵׁת יָדוֹ עַל שְׁנֵֽינוּ׃
translation: There is no umpire between us, that might lay his hand on us both. (Job 9:33)

text: הִנֵּה אַשְׁרֵי אֱנוֹשׁ יוֹכִחֶנּֽוּ אֱלוֹהַּ וּמוּסַר שַׁדַּי אַל תִּמְאָֽס׃
translation: "Behold, happy is the man whom God corrects. Therefore do not despise the chastening of the Almighty. (Job 5:17)

text: אוּלָם אֲנִי אֶל שַׁדַּי אֲדַבֵּר וְהוֹכֵחַ אֶל אֵל אֶחְפָּֽץ׃
translation: "Surely I would speak to the Almighty. I desire to reason with God. (Job 13:3)

text: הוֹכֵחַ יוֹכִיחַ אֶתְכֶם אִם בַּסֵּתֶר פָּנִים תִּשָּׂאֽוּן׃
translation: He will surely reprove you if you secretly show partiality. (Job 13:10)

text: וְיוֹכַח לְגֶבֶר עִם אֱלוֹהַּ וּֽבֶן אָדָם לְרֵעֵֽהוּ׃
translation: that he would maintain the right of a man with God, of a son of man with his neighbor! (Job 16:21)

text: אִם אָוֶן בְּיָדְךָ הַרְחִיקֵהוּ וְאַל תַּשְׁכֵּן בְּאֹהָלֶיךָ עַוְלָֽה׃
translation: If iniquity is in your hand, put it far away. Don't let unrighteousness dwell in your tents. (Job 11:14)

text: הֵן לֹא בְיָדָם טוּבָם עֲצַת רְשָׁעִים רָחֲקָה מֶֽנִּי׃
translation: Behold, their prosperity is not in their hand. The counsel of the wicked is far from me. (Job 21:16)

text: וְהוּא מִלֵּא בָתֵּיהֶם טוֹב וַעֲצַת רְשָׁעִים רָחֲקָה מֶֽנִּי׃
translation: Yet he filled their houses with good things, but the counsel of the wicked is far from me. (Job 22:18)

text: אִם תָּשׁוּב עַד שַׁדַּי תִּבָּנֶה תַּרְחִיק עַוְלָה מֵאָהֳלֶֽךָ׃
translation: If you return to the Almighty, you will be built up, if you put away unrighteousness far from your tents. (Job 22:23)

text: רָאִיתָה יְהוָה אַֽל תֶּחֱרַשׁ אֲדֹנָי אֲל תִּרְחַק מִמֶּֽנִּי׃
translation: You have seen it, LORD. Don't keep silent. Lord, don't be far from me. (Psalms 35:22)

text: הָסֵר מִמְּךָ עִקְּשׁוּת פֶּה וּלְזוּת שְׂפָתַיִם הַרְחֵק מִמֶּֽךָּ׃
translation: Put away from yourself a perverse mouth. Put corrupt lips far from you. (Proverbs 4:24)

text: כִּי כָּל שֻׁלְחָנוֹת מָלְאוּ קִיא צֹאָה בְּלִי מָקֽוֹם׃
translation: For all tables are completely full of filthy vomit and filthiness. (Isaiah 28:8)

text: בְּֽנֵי נָבָל גַּם בְּנֵי בְלִי שֵׁם נִכְּאוּ מִן הָאָֽרֶץ׃
translation: They are children of fools, yes, children of wicked men. They were flogged out of the land. (Job 30:8)

text: מִי זֶה מַחְשִׁיךְ עֵצָה בְמִלִּין בְּֽלִי דָֽעַת׃
translation: "Who is this who darkens counsel by words without knowledge? (Job 38:2)

text: אֵֽין עַל עָפָר מָשְׁלוֹ הֶעָשׂוּ לִבְלִי חָֽת׃
translation: When he raises himself up, the mighty are afraid. They retreat before his thrashing. (Job 41:25)

text: אֵֽין אֹמֶר וְאֵין דְּבָרִים בְּלִי נִשְׁמָע קוֹלָֽם׃
translation: Their voice has gone out through all the earth, their words to the end of the world. In them he has set a tent for the sun, (Psalms 19:4)

text: בְּֽלִי עָוֺן יְרוּצוּן וְיִכּוֹנָנוּ עוּרָה לִקְרָאתִי וּרְאֵה׃
translation: You, LORD God of Armies, the God of Israel, rouse yourself to punish the nations. Show no mercy to the wicked traitors. Selah. (Psalms 59:5)

text: אֲבָרֲכָה אֶת יְהוָה בְּכָל עֵת תָּמִיד תְּֽהִלָּתוֹ בְּפִֽי׃
translation: My soul shall boast in the LORD. The humble shall hear of it and be glad. (Psalms 34:2)

text: רְפָאֵנִי יְהוָה וְאֵרָפֵא הוֹשִׁיעֵנִי וְאִוָּשֵׁעָה כִּי תְהִלָּתִי אָֽתָּה׃
translation: Heal me, O LORD, and I will be healed. Save me, and I will be saved; for you are my praise. (Jeremiah 17:14)

text: הֵן בַּעֲבָדָיו לֹא יַאֲמִין וּבְמַלְאָכָיו יָשִׂים תָּהֳלָֽה׃
translation: Behold, he puts no trust in his servants. He charges his angels with error. (Job 4:18)

text: וַאֲנִי תָּמִיד אֲיַחֵל וְהוֹסַפְתִּי עַל כָּל תְּהִלָּתֶֽךָ׃
translation: But I will always hope, and will add to all of your praise. (Psalms 71:14)

text: תְּהִלָּה לְדָוִד אֲרוֹמִמְךָ אֱלוֹהַי הַמֶּלֶךְ וַאֲבָרֲכָה שִׁמְךָ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶֽד׃
translation: A praise psalm by David. I will exalt you, my God, the King. I will praise your name forever and ever. (Psalms 145:1)

text: לְמַעַן שְׁמִי אַאֲרִיךְ אַפִּי וּתְהִלָּתִי אֶחֱטָם לָךְ לְבִלְתִּי הַכְרִיתֶֽךָ׃
translation: For my name's sake, I will defer my anger, and for my praise, I hold it back for you so that I don't cut you off. (Isaiah 48:9)

text: וָאֶשָּׂא עֵינַי וָאֵרֶא וְהִנֵּה אִישׁ וּבְיָדוֹ חֶבֶל מִדָּֽה׃
translation: For I,' says the LORD, 'will be to her a wall of fire around it, and I will be the glory in the middle of her. (Zechariah 2:5)

text: וְעֶשֶׂר בָּֽאַמָּה הַכְּרוּב הַשֵּׁנִי מִדָּה אַחַת וְקֶצֶב אֶחָד לִשְׁנֵי הַכְּרֻבִֽים׃
translation: The other cherub was ten cubits. Both the cherubim were of one measure and one form. (1 Kings 6:25)

text: וְאֵלֶּה תּוֹצְאֹת הָעִיר מִפְּאַת צָפוֹן חֲמֵשׁ מֵאוֹת וְאַרְבַּעַת אֲלָפִים מִדָּֽה׃
translation: "These are the exits of the city: On the north side four thousand five hundred reeds by measure; (Ezekiel 48:30)

text: הוֹדִיעֵנִי יְהוָה קִצִּי וּמִדַּת יָמַי מַה הִיא אֵדְעָה מֶה חָדֵל אָֽנִי׃
translation: Behold, you have made my days hand widths. My lifetime is as nothing before you. Surely every man stands as a breath." Selah. (Psalms 39:5)

text: מָדַד רוּחַ הַקָּדִים בִּקְנֵה הַמִּדָּה חֲמֵשׁ אמות מֵאוֹת קָנִים בִּקְנֵה הַמִּדָּה סָבִֽיב׃
translation: He measured on the east side with the measuring reed five hundred reeds, with the measuring reed all around. (Ezekiel 42:16)

text: כַּשֶּׁמֶן הַטּוֹב עַל הָרֹאשׁ יֹרֵד עַֽל הַזָּקָן זְקַֽן אַהֲרֹן שֶׁיֹּרֵד עַל פִּי מִדּוֹתָֽיו׃
translation: It is like the precious oil on the head, that ran down on the beard, even Aaron's beard, that came down on the edge of his robes, (Psalms 133:2)

text: כֹּל חַיְתוֹ שָׂדָי אֵתָיוּ לֶאֱכֹל כָּל חַיְתוֹ בַּיָּֽעַר׃
translation: All you animals of the field, come to devour, all you animals in the forest. (Isaiah 56:9)
