text: וַיֵּצֵא הָעָם הַשָּׂדֶה לִקְרַאת יִשְׂרָאֵל וַתְּהִי הַמִּלְחָמָה בְּיַעַר אֶפְרָֽיִם׃
translation: So the people went out into the field against Israel; and the battle was in the forest of Ephraim. (2 Samuel 18:6)

text: וּשְׁאָר עֵץ יַעְרוֹ מִסְפָּר יִֽהְיוּ וְנַעַר יִכְתְּבֵֽם׃
translation: The remnant of the trees of his forest shall be few, so that a child could write their number. (Isaiah 10:19)

text: הִנֵּֽה שְׁמַֽעֲנוּהָ בְאֶפְרָתָה מְצָאנוּהָ בִּשְׂדֵי יָֽעַר׃
translation: Behold, we heard of it in Ephrathah. We found it in the field of Jaar. (Psalms 132:6)

text: הֲלוֹא עוֹד מְעַט מִזְעָר וְשָׁב לְבָנוֹן לַכַּרְמֶל וְהַכַּרְמֶל לַיַּעַר יֵחָשֵֽׁב׃
translation: Isn't it yet a very little while, and Lebanon will be turned into a fruitful field, and the fruitful field will be regarded as a forest? (Isaiah 29:17)

text: אָז יְרַנְּנוּ עֲצֵי הַיָּעַר מִלִּפְנֵי יְהוָה כִּי בָא לִשְׁפּוֹט אֶת הָאָֽרֶץ׃
translation: Then the trees of the forest will sing for joy before the LORD, for he comes to judge the earth. (1 Chronicles 16:33)

text: וַיְחִי נָחוֹר תֵּשַׁע וְעֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה וַיּוֹלֶד אֶת תָּֽרַח׃
translation: Nahor lived twenty-nine years, and became the father of Terah. (Genesis 11:24)

text: פְּקֻדֵיהֶם לְמַטֵּה שִׁמְעוֹן תִּשְׁעָה וַחֲמִשִּׁים אֶלֶף וּשְׁלֹשׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃
translation: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Simeon, were fifty-nine thousand three hundred. (Numbers 1:23)

text: וּצְבָאוֹ וּפְקֻדֵיהֶם תִּשְׁעָה וַחֲמִשִּׁים אֶלֶף וּשְׁלֹשׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃
translation: His division, and those who were counted of them, were fifty-nine thousand three hundred. (Numbers 2:13)

text: וְחֻמְטָה וְקִרְיַת אַרְבַּע הִיא חֶבְרוֹן וְצִיעֹר עָרִים תֵּשַׁע וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃
translation: Humtah, Kiriath Arba (also called Hebron), and Zior; nine cities with their villages. (Joshua 15:54)

text: לְתִשְׁעָה עָשָׂר לְמַלּוֹתִי בָּנָיו וְאֶחָיו שְׁנֵים עָשָֽׂר׃
translation: for the nineteenth to Mallothi, his sons and his brothers, twelve; (1 Chronicles 25:26)

text: הַֽכֹּהֲנִים בְּנֵי יְדַֽעְיָה לְבֵית יֵשׁוּעַ תְּשַׁע מֵאוֹת שִׁבְעִים וּשְׁלֹשָֽׁה׃
translation: The priests: the children of Jedaiah, of the house of Jeshua, nine hundred seventy-three. (Ezra 2:36)

text: עָרֵי קָדְשְׁךָ הָיוּ מִדְבָּר צִיּוֹן מִדְבָּר הָיָתָה יְרוּשָׁלִַם שְׁמָמָֽה׃
translation: Don't be furious, LORD. Don't remember iniquity forever. Look and see, we beg you, we are all your people. (Isaiah 64:9)

text: וְהֶעָרִים הַנּֽוֹשָׁבוֹת תֶּחֱרַבְנָה וְהָאָרֶץ שְׁמָמָה תִֽהְיֶה וִֽידַעְתֶּם כִּֽי אֲנִי יְהוָֽה׃
translation: The cities that are inhabited will be laid waste, and the land will be a desolation. Then you will know that I am the LORD."'" (Ezekiel 12:20)

text: וְנָתַתִּי אֶת הָאָרֶץ שְׁמָמָה יַעַן מָעֲלוּ מַעַל נְאֻם אֲדֹנָי יְהוִֽה׃
translation: I will make the land desolate, because they have acted unfaithfully," says the Lord GOD. (Ezekiel 15:8)

text: וְנָֽתַתִּי אֶת הַר שֵׂעִיר לְשִֽׁמְמָה וּשְׁמָמָה וְהִכְרַתִּי מִמֶּנּוּ עֹבֵר וָשָֽׁב׃
translation: Thus I will make Mount Seir an astonishment and a desolation. I will cut off from it him who passes through and him who returns. (Ezekiel 35:7)

text: כֹּה אָמַר אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה כִּשְׂמֹחַ כָּל הָאָרֶץ שְׁמָמָה אֶעֱשֶׂה לָּֽךְ׃
translation: The Lord GOD says: "When the whole earth rejoices, I will make you desolate. (Ezekiel 35:14)

text: וְהָאָרֶץ הַנְּשַׁמָּה תֵּֽעָבֵד תַּחַת אֲשֶׁר הָיְתָה שְׁמָמָה לְעֵינֵי כָּל עוֹבֵֽר׃
translation: The land that was desolate will be tilled instead of being a desolation in the sight of all who passed by. (Ezekiel 36:34)

text: וְזֹאת מִשְׁמֶרֶת מַשָּׂאָם לְכָל עֲבֹדָתָם בְּאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד קַרְשֵׁי הַמִּשְׁכָּן וּבְרִיחָיו וְעַמּוּדָיו וַאֲדָנָֽיו׃
translation: This is the duty of their burden, according to all their service in the Tent of Meeting: the tabernacle's boards, its bars, its pillars, its sockets, (Numbers 4:31)

text: וְאַרְבָּעִים אַדְנֵיהֶם כָּסֶף שְׁנֵי אֲדָנִים תַּחַת הַקֶּרֶשׁ הָֽאֶחָד וּשְׁנֵי אֲדָנִים תַּחַת הַקֶּרֶשׁ הָאֶחָֽד׃
translation: and their forty sockets of silver; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board. (Exodus 26:21)

text: וְאַרְבָּעִים אַדְנֵיהֶם כָּסֶף שְׁנֵי אֲדָנִים תַּחַת הַקֶּרֶשׁ הָאֶחָד וּשְׁנֵי אֲדָנִים תַּחַת הַקֶּרֶשׁ הָאֶחָֽד׃
translation: and their forty sockets of silver: two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board. (Exodus 36:26)

text: וּפְקֻדַּת מִשְׁמֶרֶת בְּנֵי מְרָרִי קַרְשֵׁי הַמִּשְׁכָּן וּבְרִיחָיו וְעַמֻּדָיו וַאֲדָנָיו וְכָל כֵּלָיו וְכֹל עֲבֹדָתֽוֹ׃
translation: The appointed duty of the sons of Merari shall be the tabernacle's boards, its bars, its pillars, its sockets, all its instruments, all its service, (Numbers 3:36)

text: וְנָתַתָּה אֹתָהּ עַל אַרְבָּעָה עַמּוּדֵי שִׁטִּים מְצֻפִּים זָהָב וָוֵיהֶם זָהָב עַל אַרְבָּעָה אַדְנֵי כָֽסֶף׃
translation: You shall hang it on four pillars of acacia overlaid with gold; their hooks shall be of gold, on four sockets of silver. (Exodus 26:32)

text: וַיַּעַשׂ לָהּ אַרְבָּעָה עַמּוּדֵי שִׁטִּים וַיְצַפֵּם זָהָב וָוֵיהֶם זָהָב וַיִּצֹק לָהֶם אַרְבָּעָה אַדְנֵי כָֽסֶף׃
translation: He made four pillars of acacia for it, and overlaid them with gold. Their hooks were of gold. He cast four sockets of silver for them. (Exodus 36:36)

text: וַיִּרְאוּ אֹתוֹ מֵרָחֹק וּבְטֶרֶם יִקְרַב אֲלֵיהֶם וַיִּֽתְנַכְּלוּ אֹתוֹ לַהֲמִיתֽוֹ׃
translation: They saw him afar off, and before he came near to them, they conspired against him to kill him. (Genesis 37:18)

text: וְאַתָּה וַעֲבָדֶיךָ יָדַעְתִּי כִּי טֶרֶם תִּֽירְאוּן מִפְּנֵי יְהוָה אֱלֹהִֽים׃
translation: But as for you and your servants, I know that you don't yet fear the LORD God." (Exodus 9:30)

text: לֹֽא יִתְיַצְּבוּ הֽוֹלְלִים לְנֶגֶד עֵינֶיךָ שָׂנֵאתָ כָּל פֹּעֲלֵי אָֽוֶן׃
translation: You will destroy those who speak lies. The LORD abhors the bloodthirsty and deceitful man. (Psalms 5:6)

text: בְּטֶרֶם תָּחִיל יָלָדָה בְּטֶרֶם יָבוֹא חֵבֶל לָהּ וְהִמְלִיטָה זָכָֽר׃
translation: "Before she travailed, she gave birth. Before her pain came, she delivered a son. (Isaiah 66:7)

text: וּשְׁמוּאֵל טֶרֶם יָדַע אֶת יְהוָה וְטֶרֶם יִגָּלֶה אֵלָיו דְּבַר יְהוָֽה׃
translation: Now Samuel didn't yet know the LORD, neither was the LORD's word yet revealed to him. (1 Samuel 3:7)

text: וְהָיָה טֶֽרֶם יִקְרָאוּ וַאֲנִי אֶעֱנֶה עוֹד הֵם מְדַבְּרִים וַאֲנִי אֶשְׁמָֽע׃
translation: It will happen that before they call, I will answer; and while they are yet speaking, I will hear. (Isaiah 65:24)

text: וַֽיְבָרְכֵהוּ וַיֹּאמַר בָּרוּךְ אַבְרָם לְאֵל עֶלְיוֹן קֹנֵה שָׁמַיִם וָאָֽרֶץ׃
translation: He blessed him, and said, "Blessed be Abram of God Most High, possessor of heaven and earth. (Genesis 14:19)

text: כִּֽי יְהוָה עֶלְיוֹן נוֹרָא מֶלֶךְ גָּדוֹל עַל כָּל הָאָֽרֶץ׃
translation: He subdues nations under us, and peoples under our feet. (Psalms 47:3)

text: וְֽאָמְרוּ אֵיכָה יָדַֽע אֵל וְיֵשׁ דֵּעָה בְעֶלְיֽוֹן׃
translation: They say, "How does God know? Is there knowledge in the Most High?" (Psalms 73:11)

text: וַֽיִּזְכְּרוּ כִּֽי אֱלֹהִים צוּרָם וְאֵל עֶלְיוֹן גֹּאֲלָֽם׃
translation: They remembered that God was their rock, the Most High God, their redeemer. (Psalms 78:35)

text: אֲֽנִי אָמַרְתִּי אֱלֹהִים אַתֶּם וּבְנֵי עֶלְיוֹן כֻּלְּכֶֽם׃
translation: I said, "You are gods, all of you are sons of the Most High. (Psalms 82:6)

text: וּֽלֲצִיּוֹן יֵאָמַר אִישׁ וְאִישׁ יֻלַּד בָּהּ וְהוּא יְכוֹנְנֶהָ עֶלְיֽוֹן׃
translation: Yes, of Zion it will be said, "This one and that one was born in her;" the Most High himself will establish her. (Psalms 87:5)

text: וַיִּקַּח אֹתָם נְבוּזַרְאֲדָן רַב טַבָּחִים וַיֹּלֶךְ אֹתָם עַל מֶלֶךְ בָּבֶל רִבְלָֽתָה׃
translation: Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard took them, and brought them to the king of Babylon to Riblah. (2 Kings 25:20)

text: חֶרֶב פָּֽתְחוּ רְשָׁעִים וְדָרְכוּ קַשְׁתָּם לְהַפִּיל עָנִי וְאֶבְיוֹן לִטְבוֹחַ יִשְׁרֵי דָֽרֶךְ׃
translation: The wicked have drawn out the sword, and have bent their bow, to cast down the poor and needy, to kill those who are upright on the path. (Psalms 37:14)

text: וַיְצַו נְבוּכַדְרֶאצַּר מֶֽלֶךְ בָּבֶל עַֽל יִרְמְיָהוּ בְּיַד נְבוּזַרְאֲדָן רַב טַבָּחִים לֵאמֹֽר׃
translation: Now Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon commanded Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard concerning Jeremiah, saying, (Jeremiah 39:11)

text: וַיִּקַּח אוֹתָם נְבוּזַרְאֲדָן רַב טַבָּחִים וַיֹּלֶךְ אוֹתָם אֶל מֶלֶךְ בָּבֶל רִבְלָֽתָה׃
translation: Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard took them, and brought them to the king of Babylon to Riblah. (Jeremiah 52:26)

text: חִרְבוּ כָּל פָּרֶיהָ יֵרְדוּ לַטָּבַח הוֹי עֲלֵיהֶם כִּֽי בָא יוֹמָם עֵת פְּקֻדָּתָֽם׃
translation: Kill all her bulls. Let them go down to the slaughter. Woe to them! For their day has come, the time of their visitation. (Jeremiah 50:27)

text: כִּי קֶצֶף לַֽיהוָה עַל כָּל הַגּוֹיִם וְחֵמָה עַל כָּל צְבָאָם הֶחֱרִימָם נְתָנָם לַטָּֽבַח׃
translation: For the LORD is enraged against all the nations, and angry with all their armies. He has utterly destroyed them. He has given them over for slaughter. (Isaiah 34:2)

text: וְֽאוּלָם מִֽי יִתֵּן אֱלוֹהַּ דַּבֵּר וְיִפְתַּח שְׂפָתָיו עִמָּֽךְ׃
translation: But oh that God would speak, and open his lips against you, (Job 11:5)

text: וְֽאוּלָם שְׁמַֽע נָא אִיּוֹב מִלָּי וְֽכָל דְּבָרַי הַאֲזִֽינָה׃
translation: "However, Job, please hear my speech, and listen to all my words. (Job 33:1)

text: וּבְבוֹא הַנָּשִׂיא דֶּרֶךְ אוּלָם הַשַּׁעַר יָבוֹא וּבְדַרְכּוֹ יֵצֵֽא׃
translation: When the prince enters, he shall go in by the way of the porch of the gate, and he shall go out by its way. (Ezekiel 46:8)

text: וְאוּלָם חַי אָנִי וְיִמָּלֵא כְבוֹד יְהוָה אֶת כָּל הָאָֽרֶץ׃
translation: but in very deed—as I live, and as all the earth shall be filled with the LORD's glory— (Numbers 14:21)

text: וּבְנֵי עֵשֶׁק אָחִיו אוּלָם בְּכֹרוֹ יְעוּשׁ הַשֵּׁנִי וֶֽאֱלִיפֶלֶט הַשְּׁלִשִֽׁי׃
translation: The sons of Eshek his brother: Ulam his firstborn, Jeush the second, and Eliphelet the third. (1 Chronicles 8:39)

text: וְֽאוּלָם שְׁאַל נָא בְהֵמוֹת וְתֹרֶךָּ וְעוֹף הַשָּׁמַיִם וְיַגֶּד לָֽךְ׃
translation: "But ask the animals now, and they will teach you; the birds of the sky, and they will tell you. (Job 12:7)

text: וְגֹנֵב אִישׁ וּמְכָרוֹ וְנִמְצָא בְיָדוֹ מוֹת יוּמָֽת׃
translation: "Anyone who kidnaps someone and sells him, or if he is found in his hand, he shall surely be put to death. (Exodus 21:16)

text: אִם בַּמַּחְתֶּרֶת יִמָּצֵא הַגַּנָּב וְהֻכָּה וָמֵת אֵין לוֹ דָּמִֽים׃
translation: "If a man steals an ox or a sheep, and kills it or sells it, he shall pay five oxen for an ox, and four sheep for a sheep. (Exodus 22:1)

text: וְאֵלַי דָּבָר יְגֻנָּב וַתִּקַּח אָזְנִי שֵׁמֶץ מֶֽנְהֽוּ׃
translation: "Now a thing was secretly brought to me. My ear received a whisper of it. (Job 4:12)

text: חוֹלֵק עִם גַּנָּב שׂוֹנֵא נַפְשׁוֹ אָלָה יִשְׁמַע וְלֹא יַגִּֽיד׃
translation: Whoever is an accomplice of a thief is an enemy of his own soul. He takes an oath, but dares not testify. (Proverbs 29:24)

text: וְאִם גָּנֹב יִגָּנֵב מֵעִמּוֹ יְשַׁלֵּם לִבְעָלָֽיו׃
translation: the oath of the LORD shall be between them both, he has not put his hand on his neighbor's goods; and its owner shall accept it, and he shall not make restitution. (Exodus 22:11)

text: לָכֵן הִנְנִי עַל הַנְּבִאִים נְאֻם יְהוָה מְגַנְּבֵי דְבָרַי אִישׁ מֵאֵת רֵעֵֽהוּ׃
translation: "Therefore behold, I am against the prophets," says the LORD, "who each steal my words from his neighbor. (Jeremiah 23:30)

text: כִּי לֹא תַחְפֹּץ זֶבַח וְאֶתֵּנָה עוֹלָה לֹא תִרְצֶֽה׃
translation: Do well in your good pleasure to Zion. Build the walls of Jerusalem. (Psalms 51:18)

text: כִּֽי רָצוּ עֲבָדֶיךָ אֶת אֲבָנֶיהָ וְֽאֶת עֲפָרָהּ יְחֹנֵֽנוּ׃
translation: So the nations will fear the LORD's name, all the kings of the earth your glory. (Psalms 102:15)

text: בִּרְצוֹת יְהוָה דַּרְכֵי אִישׁ גַּם אוֹיְבָיו יַשְׁלִם אִתּֽוֹ׃
translation: When a man's ways please the LORD, he makes even his enemies to be at peace with him. (Proverbs 16:7)

text: תְּנָֽה בְנִי לִבְּךָ לִי וְעֵינֶיךָ דְּרָכַי תרצנה תִּצֹּֽרְנָה׃
translation: My son, give me your heart; and let your eyes keep in my ways. (Proverbs 23:26)

text: וְאִם הֵאָכֹל יֵאָכֵל בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי פִּגּוּל הוּא לֹא יֵרָצֶֽה׃
translation: If it is eaten at all on the third day, it is an abomination. It will not be accepted; (Leviticus 19:7)

text: רוֹצֶה יְהוָה אֶת יְרֵאָיו אֶת הַֽמְיַחֲלִים לְחַסְדּֽוֹ׃
translation: The LORD takes pleasure in those who fear him, in those who hope in his loving kindness. (Psalms 147:11)

text: וַיִּגְדַּל הַיָּלֶד וַיְהִי הַיּוֹם וַיֵּצֵא אֶל אָבִיו אֶל הַקֹּצְרִֽים׃
translation: When the child was grown, one day he went out to his father to the reapers. (2 Kings 4:18)

text: כַּאֲשֶׁר רָאִיתִי חֹרְשֵׁי אָוֶן וְזֹרְעֵי עָמָל יִקְצְרֻֽהוּ׃
translation: According to what I have seen, those who plow iniquity and sow trouble, reap the same. (Job 4:8)

text: בַּשָּׂדֶה בְּלִילוֹ יקצירו יִקְצוֹרוּ וְכֶרֶם רָשָׁע יְלַקֵּֽשׁוּ׃
translation: They cut their food in the field. They glean the vineyard of the wicked. (Job 24:6)

text: עִנָּה בַדֶּרֶךְ כחו כֹּחִי קִצַּר יָמָֽי׃
translation: I said, "My God, don't take me away in the middle of my days. Your years are throughout all generations. (Psalms 102:24)

text: הֵן לֹֽא קָצְרָה יַד יְהוָה מֵֽהוֹשִׁיעַ וְלֹא כָבְדָה אָזְנוֹ מִשְּׁמֽוֹעַ׃
translation: Behold, the LORD's hand is not shortened, that it can't save; nor his ear dull, that it can't hear. (Isaiah 59:1)

text: וַיָּסִירוּ אֶת אֱלֹהֵי הַנֵּכָר מִקִּרְבָּם וַיַּעַבְדוּ אֶת יְהוָה וַתִּקְצַר נַפְשׁוֹ בַּעֲמַל יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
translation: They put away the foreign gods from among them and served the LORD; and his soul was grieved for the misery of Israel. (Judges 10:16)

text: לְדָוִד בְּשַׁנּוֹתוֹ אֶת טַעְמוֹ לִפְנֵי אֲבִימֶלֶךְ וַֽיְגָרֲשֵׁהוּ וַיֵּלַֽךְ׃
translation: By David; when he pretended to be insane before Abimelech, who drove him away, and he departed. I will bless the LORD at all times. His praise will always be in my mouth. (Psalms 34:1)

text: טַעֲמוּ וּרְאוּ כִּי טוֹב יְהוָה אַֽשְׁרֵי הַגֶּבֶר יֶחֱסֶה בּֽוֹ׃
translation: Oh fear the LORD, you his saints, for there is no lack with those who fear him. (Psalms 34:9)

text: טוּב טַעַם וָדַעַת לַמְּדֵנִי כִּי בְמִצְוֺתֶיךָ הֶאֱמָֽנְתִּי׃
translation: Teach me good judgment and knowledge, for I believe in your commandments. (Psalms 119:66)

text: מֵסִיר שָׂפָה לְנֶאֱמָנִים וְטַעַם זְקֵנִים יִקָּֽח׃
translation: He removes the speech of those who are trusted, and takes away the understanding of the elders. (Job 12:20)

text: חָכָם עָצֵל בְּעֵינָיו מִשִּׁבְעָה מְשִׁיבֵי טָֽעַם׃
translation: The sluggard is wiser in his own eyes than seven men who answer with discretion. (Proverbs 26:16)

text: וַיִּקְרְאוּ בֵֽית יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת שְׁמוֹ מָן וְהוּא כְּזֶרַע גַּד לָבָן וְטַעְמוֹ כְּצַפִּיחִת בִּדְבָֽשׁ׃
translation: The house of Israel called its name "Manna", and it was like coriander seed, white; and its taste was like wafers with honey. (Exodus 16:31)

text: יִשְׂמְחוּ הַשָּׁמַיִם וְתָגֵל הָאָרֶץ וְיֹאמְרוּ בַגּוֹיִם יְהוָה מָלָֽךְ׃
translation: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice! Let them say among the nations, "The LORD reigns!" (1 Chronicles 16:31)

text: שִׂמְחוּ בַֽיהוָה וְגִילוּ צַדִּיקִים וְהַרְנִינוּ כָּל יִשְׁרֵי לֵֽב׃
translation: Be glad in the LORD, and rejoice, you righteous! Shout for joy, all you who are upright in heart! (Psalms 32:11)

text: יִשְׂמַח הַר צִיּוֹן תָּגֵלְנָה בְּנוֹת יְהוּדָה לְמַעַן מִשְׁפָּטֶֽיךָ׃
translation: Walk about Zion, and go around her. Number its towers. (Psalms 48:12)

text: לְמַעַן אֲסַפְּרָה כָּֽל תְּהִלָּתֶיךָ בְּשַֽׁעֲרֵי בַת צִיּוֹן אָגִילָה בִּישׁוּעָתֶֽךָ׃
translation: The nations have sunk down in the pit that they made. In the net which they hid, their own foot is taken. (Psalms 9:15)

text: לָכֵן שָׂמַח לִבִּי וַיָּגֶל כְּבוֹדִי אַף בְּשָׂרִי יִשְׁכֹּן לָבֶֽטַח׃
translation: Therefore my heart is glad, and my tongue rejoices. My body shall also dwell in safety. (Psalms 16:9)

text: יְֽהוָה בְּעָזְּךָ יִשְׂמַח מֶלֶךְ וּבִישׁוּעָתְךָ מַה יגיל יָּגֶל מְאֹֽד׃
translation: You have given him his heart's desire, and have not withheld the request of his lips. Selah. (Psalms 21:2)

text: בֵּאדַיִן דָּרְיָוֶשׁ מַלְכָּא שָׂם טְעֵם וּבַקַּרוּ בְּבֵית סִפְרַיָּא דִּי גִנְזַיָּא מְהַחֲתִין תַּמָּה בְּבָבֶֽל׃
translation: Then Darius the king made a decree, and the house of the archives, where the treasures were laid up in Babylon, was searched. (Ezra 6:1)

text: וְדָרְיָוֶשׁ מָֽדָיָא קַבֵּל מַלְכוּתָא כְּבַר שְׁנִין שִׁתִּין וְתַרְתֵּֽין׃
translation: It pleased Darius to set over the kingdom one hundred twenty local governors, who should be throughout the whole kingdom; (Daniel 6:1)

text: פְּרֵס פְּרִיסַת מַלְכוּתָךְ וִיהִיבַת לְמָדַי וּפָרָֽס׃
translation: PERES: your kingdom is divided, and given to the Medes and Persians." (Daniel 5:28)

text: מִנִּי שִׂים טְעֵם דִּי כָל מִתְנַדַּב בְּמַלְכוּתִי מִן עַמָּה יִשְׂרָאֵל וְכָהֲנוֹהִי וְלֵוָיֵא לִמְהָךְ לִֽירוּשְׁלֶם עִמָּךְ יְהָֽךְ׃
translation: I make a decree that all those of the people of Israel and their priests and the Levites in my realm, who intend of their own free will to go to Jerusalem, go with you. (Ezra 7:13)

text: מִזְמוֹר לְאָסָף אֱֽלֹהִים נִצָּב בַּעֲדַת אֵל בְּקֶרֶב אֱלֹהִים יִשְׁפֹּֽט׃
translation: A Psalm by Asaph. God presides in the great assembly. He judges among the gods. (Psalms 82:1)

text: לַמְנַצֵּחַ לְדָוִד מִזְמוֹר אֱלֹהֵי תְהִלָּתִי אַֽל תֶּחֱרַֽשׁ׃
translation: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. God of my praise, don't remain silent, (Psalms 109:1)

text: מִזְמוֹר לְדָוִד בְּבָרְחוֹ מִפְּנֵי אַבְשָׁלוֹם בְּנֽוֹ׃
translation: A Psalm by David, when he fled from Absalom his son. LORD, how my adversaries have increased! Many are those who rise up against me. (Psalms 3:1)

text: מִזְמוֹר לְדָוִד יְהֹוָה מִי יָגוּר בְּאָהֳלֶךָ מִֽי יִשְׁכֹּן בְּהַר קָדְשֶֽׁךָ׃
translation: A Psalm by David. LORD, who shall dwell in your sanctuary? Who shall live on your holy hill? (Psalms 15:1)

text: לַמְנַצֵּחַ עַל אַיֶּלֶת הַשַּׁחַר מִזְמוֹר לְדָוִֽד׃
translation: For the Chief Musician; set to "The Doe of the Morning." A Psalm by David. My God, my God, why have you forsaken me? Why are you so far from helping me, and from the words of my groaning? (Psalms 22:1)

text: מִזְמוֹר לְדָוִד הָבוּ לַֽיהוָה בְּנֵי אֵלִים הָבוּ לַיהוָה כָּבוֹד וָעֹֽז׃
translation: A Psalm by David. Ascribe to the LORD, you sons of the mighty, ascribe to the LORD glory and strength. (Psalms 29:1)

text: עֲצַת יְהוָה לְעוֹלָם תַּעֲמֹד מַחְשְׁבוֹת לִבּוֹ לְדֹר וָדֹֽר׃
translation: The counsel of the LORD stands fast forever, the thoughts of his heart to all generations. (Psalms 33:11)

text: כָּל הַיּוֹם דְּבָרַי יְעַצֵּבוּ עָלַי כָּל מַחְשְׁבֹתָם לָרָֽע׃
translation: They conspire and lurk, watching my steps. They are eager to take my life. (Psalms 56:6)

text: לֵב חֹרֵשׁ מַחְשְׁבוֹת אָוֶן רַגְלַיִם מְמַהֲרוֹת לָרוּץ לָֽרָעָה׃
translation: a heart that devises wicked schemes, feet that are swift in running to mischief, (Proverbs 6:18)

text: רַבּוֹת מַחֲשָׁבוֹת בְּלֶב אִישׁ וַעֲצַת יְהוָה הִיא תָקֽוּם׃
translation: There are many plans in a man's heart, but the LORD's counsel will prevail. (Proverbs 19:21)

text: וּבַחֲרֹשֶׁת אֶבֶן לְמַלֹּאת וּבַחֲרֹשֶׁת עֵץ לַעֲשׂוֹת בְּכָל מְלֶאכֶת מַחֲשָֽׁבֶת׃
translation: in cutting of stones for setting, and in carving of wood, to work in all kinds of skillful workmanship. (Exodus 35:33)

text: מַה גָּדְלוּ מַעֲשֶׂיךָ יְהוָה מְאֹד עָמְקוּ מַחְשְׁבֹתֶֽיךָ׃
translation: A senseless man doesn't know, neither does a fool understand this: (Psalms 92:6)

text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֵׄלָׄיׄוׄ אַיֵּה שָׂרָה אִשְׁתֶּךָ וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֵּה בָאֹֽהֶל׃
translation: They asked him, "Where is Sarah, your wife?" He said, "There, in the tent." (Genesis 18:9)

text: אַיֵּה חֲסָדֶיךָ הָרִאשֹׁנִים אֲדֹנָי נִשְׁבַּעְתָּ לְדָוִד בֶּאֱמוּנָתֶֽךָ׃
translation: Remember, Lord, the reproach of your servants, how I bear in my heart the taunts of all the mighty peoples, (Psalms 89:50)

text: הִנֵּה הֵמָּה אֹמְרִים אֵלָי אַיֵּה דְבַר יְהוָה יָבוֹא נָֽא׃
translation: Behold, they ask me, "Where is the LORD's word? Let it be fulfilled now." (Jeremiah 17:15)

text: וְגֶבֶר יָמוּת וַֽיֶּחֱלָשׁ וַיִּגְוַע אָדָם וְאַיּֽוֹ׃
translation: But man dies, and is laid low. Yes, man gives up the spirit, and where is he? (Job 14:10)

text: לָמָּה יֹאמְרוּ הַגּוֹיִם אַיֵּה נָא אֱלֹהֵיהֶֽם׃
translation: Why should the nations say, "Where is their God, now?" (Psalms 115:2)

text: אֲבֽוֹתֵיכֶם אַיֵּה הֵם וְהַנְּבִאִים הַלְעוֹלָם יִֽחְיֽוּ׃
translation: Your fathers, where are they? And the prophets, do they live forever? (Zechariah 1:5)

text: וַיְחַזֵּק יְהוָה אֶת לֵב פַּרְעֹה וְלֹא אָבָה לְשַׁלְּחָֽם׃
translation: But the LORD hardened Pharaoh's heart, and he wouldn't let them go. (Exodus 10:27)

text: וְלֹא אֲבִיתֶם לַעֲלֹת וַתַּמְרוּ אֶת פִּי יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃
translation: Yet you wouldn't go up, but rebelled against the commandment of the LORD your God. (Deuteronomy 1:26)

text: וְלֹא שָׁמַע עַמִּי לְקוֹלִי וְיִשְׂרָאֵל לֹא אָבָה לִֽי׃
translation: So I let them go after the stubbornness of their hearts, that they might walk in their own counsels. (Psalms 81:12)

text: וְלֹא אָבָה לִשְׁמֹעַ בְּקוֹלָהּ וַיֶּחֱזַק מִמֶּנָּה וַיְעַנֶּהָ וַיִּשְׁכַּב אֹתָֽהּ׃
translation: However, he would not listen to her voice; but being stronger than she, he forced her and lay with her. (2 Samuel 13:14)

text: וְלֹא אָבִיתִי לִשְׁמֹעַ לְבִלְעָם וַיְבָרֶךְ בָּרוֹךְ אֶתְכֶם וָאַצִּל אֶתְכֶם מִיָּדֽוֹ׃
translation: but I would not listen to Balaam; therefore he blessed you still. So I delivered you out of his hand. (Joshua 24:10)

text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֵלָיו כָּל הַזְּקֵנִים וְכָל הָעָם אַל תִּשְׁמַע וְלוֹא תֹאבֶֽה׃
translation: All the elders and all the people said to him, "Don't listen, and don't consent." (1 Kings 20:8)

text: בִּרְכַּת אֹבֵד עָלַי תָּבֹא וְלֵב אַלְמָנָה אַרְנִֽן׃
translation: the blessing of him who was ready to perish came on me, and I caused the widow's heart to sing for joy. (Job 29:13)

text: כֹּהֲנָיו בַּחֶרֶב נָפָלוּ וְאַלְמְנֹתָיו לֹא תִבְכֶּֽינָה׃
translation: Their priests fell by the sword, and their widows couldn't weep. (Psalms 78:64)

text: לִמְדוּ הֵיטֵב דִּרְשׁוּ מִשְׁפָּט אַשְּׁרוּ חָמוֹץ שִׁפְטוּ יָתוֹם רִיבוּ אַלְמָנָֽה׃
translation: Learn to do well. Seek justice. Relieve the oppressed. Defend the fatherless. Plead for the widow." (Isaiah 1:17)

text: כָּל אַלְמָנָה וְיָתוֹם לֹא תְעַנּֽוּן׃
translation: "You shall not wrong an alien or oppress him, for you were aliens in the land of Egypt. (Exodus 22:21)

text: יִֽהְיוּ בָנָיו יְתוֹמִים וְאִשְׁתּוֹ אַלְמָנָֽה׃
translation: Let his children be fatherless, and his wife a widow. (Psalms 109:9)

text: וַיֹּֽאמֶר לָהּ הַמֶּלֶךְ מַה לָּךְ וַתֹּאמֶר אֲבָל אִשָּֽׁה אַלְמָנָה אָנִי וַיָּמָת אִישִֽׁי׃
translation: The king said to her, "What ails you?" She answered, "Truly I am a widow, and my husband is dead. (2 Samuel 14:5)

text: וְעָמַד מֶלֶךְ גִּבּוֹר וּמָשַׁל מִמְשָׁל רַב וְעָשָׂה כִּרְצוֹנֽוֹ׃
translation: A mighty king will stand up, who will rule with great dominion, and do according to his will. (Daniel 11:3)

text: וְכִי תִזְבְּחוּ זֶבַח שְׁלָמִים לַיהוָה לִֽרְצֹנְכֶם תִּזְבָּחֻֽהוּ׃
translation: "'When you offer a sacrifice of peace offerings to the LORD, you shall offer it so that you may be accepted. (Leviticus 19:5)

text: בָּרֲכוּ יְהוָה כָּל צְבָאָיו מְשָׁרְתָיו עֹשֵׂי רְצוֹנֽוֹ׃
translation: Praise the LORD, all you armies of his, you servants of his, who do his pleasure. (Psalms 103:21)

text: פּוֹתֵחַ אֶת יָדֶךָ וּמַשְׂבִּיעַ לְכָל חַי רָצֽוֹן׃
translation: You open your hand, and satisfy the desire of every living thing. (Psalms 145:16)

text: תּוֹעֲבַת יְהוָה עִקְּשֵׁי לֵב וּרְצוֹנוֹ תְּמִימֵי דָֽרֶךְ׃
translation: Those who are perverse in heart are an abomination to the LORD, but those whose ways are blameless are his delight. (Proverbs 11:20)

text: תּוֹעֲבַת יְהוָה שִׂפְתֵי שָׁקֶר וְעֹשֵׂי אֱמוּנָה רְצוֹנֽוֹ׃
translation: Lying lips are an abomination to the LORD, but those who do the truth are his delight. (Proverbs 12:22)

text: וַיְהִי כַּעֲשֶׂרֶת הַיָּמִים וַיִּגֹּף יְהוָה אֶת נָבָל וַיָּמֹֽת׃
translation: About ten days later, the LORD struck Nabal, so that he died. (1 Samuel 25:38)

text: וַיַּרְא אֲרָם כִּי נִגַּף לִפְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֵּאָסְפוּ יָֽחַד׃
translation: When the Syrians saw that they were defeated by Israel, they gathered themselves together. (2 Samuel 10:15)

text: וַיִּנָּגֶף יְהוּדָה לִפְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיָּנֻסוּ אִישׁ לאהלו לְאֹהָלָֽיו׃
translation: Judah was defeated by Israel; and each man fled to his tent. (2 Kings 14:12)

text: וַיִּנָּגֶף יְהוּדָה לִפְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיָּנֻסוּ אִישׁ לְאֹהָלָֽיו׃
translation: Judah was defeated by Israel; so every man fled to his tent. (2 Chronicles 25:22)

text: עַל כַּפַּיִם יִשָּׂאוּנְךָ פֶּן תִּגֹּף בָּאֶבֶן רַגְלֶֽךָ׃
translation: They will bear you up in their hands, so that you won't dash your foot against a stone. (Psalms 91:12)

text: אָז תֵּלֵךְ לָבֶטַח דַּרְכֶּךָ וְרַגְלְךָ לֹא תִגּֽוֹף׃
translation: Then you shall walk in your way securely. Your foot won't stumble. (Proverbs 3:23)

text: גַּם עַתָּה הִנֵּה בַשָּׁמַיִם עֵדִי וְשָׂהֲדִי בַּמְּרוֹמִֽים׃
translation: Even now, behold, my witness is in heaven. He who vouches for me is on high. (Job 16:19)

text: וּמֶה חֵלֶק אֱלוֹהַּ מִמָּעַל וְֽנַחֲלַת שַׁדַּי מִמְּרֹמִֽים׃
translation: For what is the portion from God above, and the heritage from the Almighty on high? (Job 31:2)

text: הַלְלוּ יָהּ הַֽלְלוּ אֶת יְהוָה מִן הַשָּׁמַיִם הַֽלְלוּהוּ בַּמְּרוֹמִֽים׃
translation: Praise the LORD! Praise the LORD from the heavens! Praise him in the heights! (Psalms 148:1)

text: וְֽיָשְׁבָה לְפֶתַח בֵּיתָהּ עַל כִּסֵּא מְרֹמֵי קָֽרֶת׃
translation: She sits at the door of her house, on a seat in the high places of the city, (Proverbs 9:14)

text: יִשְׁלַח מִמָּרוֹם יִקָּחֵנִי יַֽמְשֵׁנִי מִמַּיִם רַבִּֽים׃
translation: He sent from on high and he took me. He drew me out of many waters. (2 Samuel 22:17)

text: הַמְשֵׁל וָפַחַד עִמּוֹ עֹשֶׂה שָׁלוֹם בִּמְרוֹמָֽיו׃
translation: "Dominion and fear are with him. He makes peace in his high places. (Job 25:2)

text: וַיַּמְטֵר עֲלֵיהֶם כֶּעָפָר שְׁאֵר וּֽכְחוֹל יַמִּים עוֹף כָּנָֽף׃
translation: He also rained meat on them as the dust, winged birds as the sand of the seas. (Psalms 78:27)

text: לְהַמְטִיר עַל אֶרֶץ לֹא אִישׁ מִדְבָּר לֹא אָדָם בּֽוֹ׃
translation: to cause it to rain on a land where there is no man, on the wilderness, in which there is no man, (Job 38:26)

text: הַנֹּתֵן מָטָר עַל פְּנֵי אָרֶץ וְשֹׁלֵֽחַ מַיִם עַל פְּנֵי חוּצֽוֹת׃
translation: who gives rain on the earth, and sends waters on the fields; (Job 5:10)

text: בַּעֲשֹׂתוֹ לַמָּטָר חֹק וְדֶרֶךְ לַחֲזִיז קֹלֽוֹת׃
translation: When he made a decree for the rain, and a way for the lightning of the thunder, (Job 28:26)

text: וַאֲשִׁיתֵהוּ בָתָה לֹא יִזָּמֵר וְלֹא יֵעָדֵר וְעָלָה שָׁמִיר וָשָׁיִת וְעַל הֶעָבִים אֲצַוֶּה מֵהַמְטִיר עָלָיו מָטָֽר׃
translation: I will lay it a wasteland. It won't be pruned or hoed, but it will grow briers and thorns. I will also command the clouds that they rain no rain on it." (Isaiah 5:6)

text: לְקוֹל תִּתּוֹ הֲמוֹן מַיִם בַּשָּׁמַיִם וַיַּעַל נְשִׂאִים מִקְצֵה אָרֶץ בְּרָקִים לַמָּטָר עָשָׂה וַיֹּצֵא רוּחַ מֵאֹצְרֹתָֽיו׃
translation: When he utters his voice, there is a roar of waters in the heavens, and he causes the vapors to ascend from the ends of the earth. He makes lightning for the rain, and brings the wind out of his treasuries. (Jeremiah 51:16)

text: לֹא יִצְעַק וְלֹא יִשָּׂא וְלֹֽא יַשְׁמִיעַ בַּחוּץ קוֹלֽוֹ׃
translation: He will not shout, nor raise his voice, nor cause it to be heard in the street. (Isaiah 42:2)

text: וַיַּצְעֵק שְׁמוּאֵל אֶת הָעָם אֶל יְהוָה הַמִּצְפָּֽה׃
translation: Samuel called the people together to the LORD to Mizpah; (1 Samuel 10:17)

text: קוֹלִי אֶל אֱלֹהִים וְאֶצְעָקָה קוֹלִי אֶל אֱלֹהִים וְהַאֲזִין אֵלָֽי׃
translation: In the day of my trouble I sought the Lord. My hand was stretched out in the night, and didn't get tired. My soul refused to be comforted. (Psalms 77:2)

text: יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵי יְשׁוּעָתִי יוֹם צָעַקְתִּי בַלַּיְלָה נֶגְדֶּֽךָ׃
translation: Let my prayer enter into your presence. Turn your ear to my cry. (Psalms 88:2)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר מֶה עָשִׂיתָ קוֹל דְּמֵי אָחִיךָ צֹעֲקִים אֵלַי מִן הָֽאֲדָמָֽה׃
translation: The LORD said, "What have you done? The voice of your brother's blood cries to me from the ground. (Genesis 4:10)

text: וַיִּצְעַק מֹשֶׁה אֶל יְהוָה לֵאמֹר אֵל נָא רְפָא נָא לָֽהּ׃
translation: Moses cried to the LORD, saying, "Heal her, God, I beg you!" (Numbers 12:13)

text: כִּֽי עָשִׂיתָ מִשְׁפָּטִי וְדִינִי יָשַׁבְתָּ לְכִסֵּא שׁוֹפֵט צֶֽדֶק׃
translation: You have rebuked the nations. You have destroyed the wicked. You have blotted out their name forever and ever. (Psalms 9:5)

text: יִקְרָא אֶל הַשָּׁמַיִם מֵעָל וְאֶל הָאָרֶץ לָדִין עַמּֽוֹ׃
translation: He calls to the heavens above, to the earth, that he may judge his people: (Psalms 50:4)

text: יֹדֵעַ צַדִּיק דִּין דַּלִּים רָשָׁע לֹא יָבִין דָּֽעַת׃
translation: The righteous care about justice for the poor. The wicked aren't concerned about knowledge. (Proverbs 29:7)

text: אַף כִּֽי תֹאמַר לֹא תְשׁוּרֶנּוּ דִּין לְפָנָיו וּתְחוֹלֵֽל לֽוֹ׃
translation: How much less when you say you don't see him. The cause is before him, and you wait for him! (Job 35:14)

text: כִּי בָם יָדִין עַמִּים יִֽתֶּן אֹכֶל לְמַכְבִּֽיר׃
translation: For by these he judges the people. He gives food in abundance. (Job 36:31)

text: כִּֽי יָדִין יְהוָה עַמּוֹ וְעַל עֲבָדָיו יִתְנֶחָֽם׃
translation: For the LORD will judge his people and have compassion on his servants. (Psalms 135:14)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם לֹא כִּֽי עֶרְוַת הָאָרֶץ בָּאתֶם לִרְאֽוֹת׃
translation: He said to them, "No, but you have come to see the nakedness of the land!" (Genesis 42:12)

text: עֶרְוַת אֵֽשֶׁת אָבִיךָ לֹא תְגַלֵּה עֶרְוַת אָבִיךָ הִֽוא׃
translation: "'You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father's wife. It is your father's nakedness. (Leviticus 18:8)

text: עֶרְוַת אֲחוֹת אָבִיךָ לֹא תְגַלֵּה שְׁאֵר אָבִיךָ הִֽוא׃
translation: "'You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father's sister. She is your father's near kinswoman. (Leviticus 18:12)

text: עֶרְוַת אֵֽשֶׁת אָחִיךָ לֹא תְגַלֵּה עֶרְוַת אָחִיךָ הִֽוא׃
translation: "'You shall not uncover the nakedness of your brother's wife. It is your brother's nakedness. (Leviticus 18:16)

text: עֶרְוַת אֲחֽוֹת אִמְּךָ לֹא תְגַלֵּה כִּֽי שְׁאֵר אִמְּךָ הִֽוא׃
translation: "'You shall not uncover the nakedness of your mother's sister, for she is your mother's near kinswoman. (Leviticus 18:13)

text: וְלֹֽא תַעֲלֶה בְמַעֲלֹת עַֽל מִזְבְּחִי אֲשֶׁר לֹֽא תִגָּלֶה עֶרְוָתְךָ עָלָֽיו׃
translation: You shall not go up by steps to my altar, that your nakedness may not be exposed to it.' (Exodus 20:26)

text: הִנֵּה נָא כֹחוֹ בְמָתְנָיו וְאֹנוֹ בִּשְׁרִירֵי בִטְנֽוֹ׃
translation: Look now, his strength is in his thighs. His force is in the muscles of his belly. (Job 40:16)

text: מַתָּן אָדָם יַרְחִיב לוֹ וְלִפְנֵי גְדֹלִים יַנְחֶֽנּוּ׃
translation: A man's gift makes room for him, and brings him before great men. (Proverbs 18:16)

text: זַרְזִיר מָתְנַיִם אוֹ תָיִשׁ וּמֶלֶךְ אַלְקוּם עִמּֽוֹ׃
translation: the greyhound; the male goat; and the king against whom there is no rising up. (Proverbs 30:31)

text: וְהַבּוֹנִים אִישׁ חַרְבּוֹ אֲסוּרִים עַל מָתְנָיו וּבוֹנִים וְהַתּוֹקֵעַ בַּשּׁוֹפָר אֶצְלִֽי׃
translation: When the Jews who lived by them came, they said to us ten times from all places, "Wherever you turn, they will attack us." (Nehemiah 4:12)

text: תֶּחְשַׁכְנָה עֵינֵיהֶם מֵרְאוֹת וּמָתְנֵיהֶם תָּמִיד הַמְעַֽד׃
translation: Pour out your indignation on them. Let the fierceness of your anger overtake them. (Psalms 69:24)

text: וַיָּמָד אֶלֶף וַיַּעֲבִרֵנִי בַמַּיִם מַיִם בִּרְכָּיִם וַיָּמָד אֶלֶף וַיַּעֲבִרֵנִי מֵי מָתְנָֽיִם׃
translation: Again he measured one thousand, and caused me to pass through the waters, waters that were to the knees. Again he measured one thousand, and caused me to pass through waters that were to the waist. (Ezekiel 47:4)

text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ הָעֵצִים לַגָּפֶן לְכִי אַתְּ מלוכי מָלְכִי עָלֵֽינוּ׃
translation: "The trees said to the vine, 'Come and reign over us.' (Judges 9:12)

text: אֱלֹהִים צְבָאוֹת שֽׁוּב נָא הַבֵּט מִשָּׁמַיִם וּרְאֵה וּפְקֹד גֶּפֶן זֹֽאת׃
translation: the stock which your right hand planted, the branch that you made strong for yourself. (Psalms 80:15)

text: בֶּן אָדָם מַה יִּֽהְיֶה עֵץ הַגֶּפֶן מִכָּל עֵץ הַזְּמוֹרָה אֲשֶׁר הָיָה בַּעֲצֵי הַיָּֽעַר׃
translation: "Son of man, what is the vine tree more than any tree, the vine branch which is among the trees of the forest? (Ezekiel 15:2)

text: כֹּה אָמַר יְהֹוָה צְבָאוֹת עוֹלֵל יְעוֹלְלוּ כַגֶּפֶן שְׁאֵרִית יִשְׂרָאֵל הָשֵׁב יָדְךָ כְּבוֹצֵר עַל סַלְסִלּֽוֹת׃
translation: The LORD of Armies says, "They will thoroughly glean the remnant of Israel like a vine. Turn again your hand as a grape gatherer into the baskets." (Jeremiah 6:9)

text: בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא נְאֻם יְהוָה צְבָאוֹת תִּקְרְאוּ אִישׁ לְרֵעֵהוּ אֶל תַּחַת גֶּפֶן וְאֶל תַּחַת תְּאֵנָֽה׃
translation: In that day,' says the LORD of Armies, 'you will invite every man his neighbor under the vine and under the fig tree.'" (Zechariah 3:10)

text: הַעוֹד הַזֶּרַע בַּמְּגוּרָה וְעַד הַגֶּפֶן וְהַתְּאֵנָה וְהָרִמּוֹן וְעֵץ הַזַּיִת לֹא נָשָׂא מִן הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה אֲבָרֵֽךְ׃
translation: Is the seed yet in the barn? Yes, the vine, the fig tree, the pomegranate, and the olive tree haven't produced. From today I will bless you.'" (Haggai 2:19)

text: וְכָל הַמֶּרְכָּב אֲשֶׁר יִרְכַּב עָלָיו הַזָּב יִטְמָֽא׃
translation: "'Whatever saddle he who has the discharge rides on shall be unclean. (Leviticus 15:9)

text: וְאִֽם טָהֲרָה מִזּוֹבָהּ וְסָפְרָה לָּהּ שִׁבְעַת יָמִים וְאַחַר תִּטְהָֽר׃
translation: "'But if she is cleansed of her discharge, then she shall count to herself seven days, and after that she shall be clean. (Leviticus 15:28)

text: וְהַנֹּגֵעַ בִּבְשַׂר הַזָּב יְכַבֵּס בְּגָדָיו וְרָחַץ בַּמַּיִם וְטָמֵא עַד הָעָֽרֶב׃
translation: "'He who touches the body of him who has the discharge shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening. (Leviticus 15:7)

text: וְכִֽי יָרֹק הַזָּב בַּטָּהוֹר וְכִבֶּס בְּגָדָיו וְרָחַץ בַּמַּיִם וְטָמֵא עַד הָעָֽרֶב׃
translation: "'If he who has the discharge spits on him who is clean, then he shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening. (Leviticus 15:8)

text: וְלֹא צָמְאוּ בָּחֳרָבוֹת הֽוֹלִיכָם מַיִם מִצּוּר הִזִּיל לָמוֹ וַיִּבְקַע צוּר וַיָּזֻבוּ מָֽיִם׃
translation: They didn't thirst when he led them through the deserts. He caused the waters to flow out of the rock for them. He also split the rock and the waters gushed out. (Isaiah 48:21)

text: כָּל הַמִּשְׁכָּב אֲשֶׁר יִשְׁכַּב עָלָיו הַזָּב יִטְמָא וְכָֽל הַכְּלִי אֲשֶׁר יֵשֵׁב עָלָיו יִטְמָֽא׃
translation: "'Every bed on which he who has the discharge lies shall be unclean; and everything he sits on shall be unclean. (Leviticus 15:4)

text: שַׂבְּעֵנוּ בַבֹּקֶר חַסְדֶּךָ וּֽנְרַנְּנָה וְנִשְׂמְחָה בְּכָל יָמֵֽינוּ׃
translation: Satisfy us in the morning with your loving kindness, that we may rejoice and be glad all our days. (Psalms 90:14)

text: כִּי שִׂמַּחְתַּנִי יְהוָה בְּפָעֳלֶךָ בְּֽמַעֲשֵׂי יָדֶיךָ אֲרַנֵּֽן׃
translation: How great are your works, LORD! Your thoughts are very deep. (Psalms 92:5)

text: לְכוּ נְרַנְּנָה לַיהוָה נָרִיעָה לְצוּר יִשְׁעֵֽנוּ׃
translation: Oh come, let's sing to the LORD. Let's shout aloud to the rock of our salvation! (Psalms 95:1)

text: וְֽכֹהֲנֶיהָ אַלְבִּישׁ יֶשַׁע וַחֲסִידֶיהָ רַנֵּן יְרַנֵּֽנוּ׃
translation: I will also clothe her priests with salvation. Her saints will shout aloud for joy. (Psalms 132:16)

text: זֵכֶר רַב טוּבְךָ יַבִּיעוּ וְצִדְקָתְךָ יְרַנֵּֽנוּ׃
translation: They will utter the memory of your great goodness, and will sing of your righteousness. (Psalms 145:7)

text: חָכְמוֹת בַּחוּץ תָּרֹנָּה בָּרְחֹבוֹת תִּתֵּן קוֹלָֽהּ׃
translation: Wisdom calls aloud in the street. She utters her voice in the public squares. (Proverbs 1:20)

text: וְאֶת עַם עָנִי תּוֹשִׁיעַ וְעֵינֶיךָ עַל רָמִים תַּשְׁפִּֽיל׃
translation: You will save the afflicted people, but your eyes are on the arrogant, that you may bring them down. (2 Samuel 22:28)

text: כִּֽי אַתָּה עַם עָנִי תוֹשִׁיעַ וְעֵינַיִם רָמוֹת תַּשְׁפִּֽיל׃
translation: For you will light my lamp, LORD. My God will light up my darkness. (Psalms 18:28)

text: כִּֽי הִשְׁפִּילוּ וַתֹּאמֶר גֵּוָה וְשַׁח עֵינַיִם יוֹשִֽׁעַ׃
translation: When they cast down, you will say, 'be lifted up.' He will save the humble person. (Job 22:29)

text: כִּֽי אֱלֹהִים שֹׁפֵט זֶה יַשְׁפִּיל וְזֶה יָרִֽים׃
translation: For in the LORD's hand there is a cup, full of foaming wine mixed with spices. He pours it out. Indeed the wicked of the earth drink and drink it to its very dregs. (Psalms 75:8)

text: לִֽהְיוֹת מַמְלָכָה שְׁפָלָה לְבִלְתִּי הִתְנַשֵּׂא לִשְׁמֹר אֶת בְּרִיתוֹ לְעָמְדָֽהּ׃
translation: that the kingdom might be brought low, that it might not lift itself up, but that by keeping his covenant it might stand. (Ezekiel 17:14)

text: יְהוָה מוֹרִישׁ וּמַעֲשִׁיר מַשְׁפִּיל אַף מְרוֹמֵֽם׃
translation: The LORD makes poor and makes rich. He brings low, he also lifts up. (1 Samuel 2:7)

text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהוָה אֶל מְנַשֶּׁה וְאֶל עַמּוֹ וְלֹא הִקְשִֽׁיבוּ׃
translation: The LORD spoke to Manasseh and to his people, but they didn't listen. (2 Chronicles 33:10)

text: מֹשֵׁל מַקְשִׁיב עַל דְּבַר שָׁקֶר כָּֽל מְשָׁרְתָיו רְשָׁעִֽים׃
translation: If a ruler listens to lies, all of his officials are wicked. (Proverbs 29:12)

text: עַתָּה עֵינַי יִהְיוּ פְתֻחוֹת וְאָזְנַי קַשֻּׁבוֹת לִתְפִלַּת הַמָּקוֹם הַזֶּֽה׃
translation: Now my eyes will be open and my ears attentive to prayer that is made in this place. (2 Chronicles 7:15)

text: הַקְשֵׁב אִיּוֹב שְֽׁמַֽע לִי הַחֲרֵשׁ וְאָנֹכִי אֲדַבֵּֽר׃
translation: Mark well, Job, and listen to me. Hold your peace, and I will speak. (Job 33:31)

text: שִׁמְעוּ בָנִים מוּסַר אָב וְהַקְשִׁיבוּ לָדַעַת בִּינָֽה׃
translation: Listen, sons, to a father's instruction. Pay attention and know understanding; (Proverbs 4:1)

text: וְעַתָּה בָנִים שִׁמְעוּ לִי וְהַקְשִׁיבוּ לְאִמְרֵי פִֽי׃
translation: Now therefore, sons, listen to me. Pay attention to the words of my mouth. (Proverbs 7:24)

text: צָפוֹן וְיָמִין אַתָּה בְרָאתָם תָּבוֹר וְחֶרְמוֹן בְּשִׁמְךָ יְרַנֵּֽנוּ׃
translation: You have a mighty arm. Your hand is strong, and your right hand is exalted. (Psalms 89:13)

text: תִּכָּתֶב זֹאת לְדוֹר אַחֲרוֹן וְעַם נִבְרָא יְהַלֶּל יָֽהּ׃
translation: for he has looked down from the height of his sanctuary. From heaven, the LORD saw the earth, (Psalms 102:19)

text: יְֽהַֽלְלוּ אֶת שֵׁם יְהוָה כִּי הוּא צִוָּה וְנִבְרָֽאוּ׃
translation: Let them praise the LORD's name, for he commanded, and they were created. (Psalms 148:5)

text: כֹּל הַנִּקְרָא בִשְׁמִי וְלִכְבוֹדִי בְּרָאתִיו יְצַרְתִּיו אַף עֲשִׂיתִֽיו׃
translation: everyone who is called by my name, and whom I have created for my glory, whom I have formed, yes, whom I have made.'" (Isaiah 43:7)

text: בְּרֵאשִׁית בָּרָא אֱלֹהִים אֵת הַשָּׁמַיִם וְאֵת הָאָֽרֶץ׃
translation: In the beginning, God created the heavens and the earth. (Genesis 1:1)

text: לֵב טָהוֹר בְּרָא לִי אֱלֹהִים וְרוּחַ נָכוֹן חַדֵּשׁ בְּקִרְבִּֽי׃
translation: Restore to me the joy of your salvation. Uphold me with a willing spirit. (Psalms 51:12)

text: שֵׁשֶׁת יָמִים תַּעֲבֹד וּבַיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי תִּשְׁבֹּת בֶּחָרִישׁ וּבַקָּצִיר תִּשְׁבֹּֽת׃
translation: "Six days you shall work, but on the seventh day you shall rest: in plowing time and in harvest you shall rest. (Exodus 34:21)

text: תְּשַׁלַּח קְצִירֶהָ עַד יָם וְאֶל נָהָר יֽוֹנְקוֹתֶֽיהָ׃
translation: Why have you broken down its walls, so that all those who pass by the way pluck it? (Psalms 80:12)

text: מִתַּחַת שָֽׁרָשָׁיו יִבָשׁוּ וּמִמַּעַל יִמַּל קְצִירֽוֹ׃
translation: His roots will be dried up beneath. His branch will be cut off above. (Job 18:16)

text: כִּי זֶה שְׁנָתַיִם הָרָעָב בְּקֶרֶב הָאָרֶץ וְעוֹד חָמֵשׁ שָׁנִים אֲשֶׁר אֵין חָרִישׁ וְקָצִּֽיר׃
translation: For these two years the famine has been in the land, and there are yet five years, in which there will be no plowing and no harvest. (Genesis 45:6)

text: וּבֵית שֶׁמֶשׁ קֹצְרִים קְצִיר חִטִּים בָּעֵמֶק וַיִּשְׂאוּ אֶת עֵינֵיהֶם וַיִּרְאוּ אֶת הָאָרוֹן וַֽיִּשְׂמְחוּ לִרְאֽוֹת׃
translation: The people of Beth Shemesh were reaping their wheat harvest in the valley; and they lifted up their eyes and saw the ark, and rejoiced to see it. (1 Samuel 6:13)

text: הִרְבִּיתָ הַגּוֹי לא לוֹ הִגְדַּלְתָּ הַשִּׂמְחָה שָׂמְחוּ לְפָנֶיךָ כְּשִׂמְחַת בַּקָּצִיר כַּאֲשֶׁר יָגִילוּ בְּחַלְּקָם שָׁלָֽל׃
translation: The people who walked in darkness have seen a great light. The light has shined on those who lived in the land of the shadow of death. (Isaiah 9:2)

text: אֶעְבְּרָה בְאַרְצֶךָ בַּדֶּרֶךְ בַּדֶּרֶךְ אֵלֵךְ לֹא אָסוּר יָמִין וּשְׂמֹֽאול׃
translation: "Let me pass through your land. I will go along by the highway. I will turn neither to the right hand nor to the left. (Deuteronomy 2:27)

text: אַֽל תֵּט יָמִין וּשְׂמֹאול הָסֵר רַגְלְךָ מֵרָֽע׃
translation: Don't turn to the right hand nor to the left. Remove your foot from evil. (Proverbs 4:27)

text: אֹרֶךְ יָמִים בִּֽימִינָהּ בִּשְׂמֹאולָהּ עֹשֶׁר וְכָבֽוֹד׃
translation: Length of days is in her right hand. In her left hand are riches and honor. (Proverbs 3:16)

text: לֵב חָכָם לִֽימִינוֹ וְלֵב כְּסִיל לִשְׂמֹאלֽוֹ׃
translation: A wise man's heart is at his right hand, but a fool's heart at his left. (Ecclesiastes 10:2)

text: כִּי יָמִין וּשְׂמֹאול תִּפְרֹצִי וְזַרְעֵךְ גּוֹיִם יִירָשׁ וְעָרִים נְשַׁמּוֹת יוֹשִֽׁיבוּ׃
translation: For you will spread out on the right hand and on the left; and your offspring will possess the nations and settle in desolate cities. (Isaiah 54:3)

text: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם לַעֲשׂוֹת כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם אֶתְכֶם לֹא תָסֻרוּ יָמִין וּשְׂמֹֽאל׃
translation: You shall observe to do therefore as the LORD your God has commanded you. You shall not turn away to the right hand or to the left. (Deuteronomy 5:32)

text: וְאָנֹכִי תוֹלַעַת וְלֹא אִישׁ חֶרְפַּת אָדָם וּבְזוּי עָֽם׃
translation: All those who see me mock me. They insult me with their lips. They shake their heads, saying, (Psalms 22:7)

text: פָּנָה אֶל תְּפִלַּת הָעַרְעָר וְלֹֽא בָזָה אֶת תְּפִלָּתָֽם׃
translation: This will be written for the generation to come. A people which will be created will praise the LORD, (Psalms 102:18)

text: בֵּן חָכָם יְשַׂמַּח אָב וּכְסִיל אָדָם בּוֹזֶה אִמּֽוֹ׃
translation: A wise son makes a father glad, but a foolish man despises his mother. (Proverbs 15:20)

text: שֹׁמֵר מִצְוָה שֹׁמֵר נַפְשׁוֹ בּוֹזֵה דְרָכָיו יומת יָמֽוּת׃
translation: He who keeps the commandment keeps his soul, but he who is contemptuous in his ways shall die. (Proverbs 19:16)

text: הוֹלֵךְ בְּיָשְׁרוֹ יְרֵא יְהוָה וּנְלוֹז דְּרָכָיו בּוֹזֵֽהוּ׃
translation: He who walks in his uprightness fears the LORD, but he who is perverse in his ways despises him. (Proverbs 14:2)

text: כִּֽי הִנֵּה קָטֹן נְתַתִּיךָ בַּגּוֹיִם בָּזוּי בָּאָדָֽם׃
translation: "For, behold, I have made you small among the nations, and despised among men. (Jeremiah 49:15)

text: לֹא הִנִּיחַ לְאִישׁ לְעָשְׁקָם וַיּוֹכַח עֲלֵיהֶם מְלָכִֽים׃
translation: He allowed no man to do them wrong. Yes, he reproved kings for their sakes, (1 Chronicles 16:21)

text: לֹֽא הִנִּיחַ אָדָם לְעָשְׁקָם וַיּוֹכַח עֲלֵיהֶם מְלָכִֽים׃
translation: He allowed no one to do them wrong. Yes, he reproved kings for their sakes, (Psalms 105:14)

text: יָמִיקוּ וִידַבְּרוּ בְרָע עֹשֶׁק מִמָּרוֹם יְדַבֵּֽרוּ׃
translation: They scoff and speak with malice. In arrogance, they threaten oppression. (Psalms 73:8)

text: עֹשֵׂה צְדָקוֹת יְהוָה וּמִשְׁפָּטִים לְכָל עֲשׁוּקִֽים׃
translation: The LORD executes righteous acts, and justice for all who are oppressed. (Psalms 103:6)

text: עָשִׂיתִי מִשְׁפָּט וָצֶדֶק בַּל תַּנִּיחֵנִי לְעֹֽשְׁקָֽי׃
translation: I have done what is just and righteous. Don't leave me to my oppressors. (Psalms 119:121)

text: אָדָם עָשֻׁק בְּדַם נָפֶשׁ עַד בּוֹר יָנוּס אַל יִתְמְכוּ בֽוֹ׃
translation: A man who is tormented by blood guilt will be a fugitive until death. No one will support him. (Proverbs 28:17)

text: וְכָל הָאָרֶץ בָּאוּ בַיָּעַר וַיְהִי דְבַשׁ עַל פְּנֵי הַשָּׂדֶֽה׃
translation: All the people came into the forest; and there was honey on the ground. (1 Samuel 14:25)

text: מַה נִּמְלְצוּ לְחִכִּי אִמְרָתֶךָ מִדְּבַשׁ לְפִֽי׃
translation: How sweet are your promises to my taste, more than honey to my mouth! (Psalms 119:103)

text: וַיְבִאֵנוּ אֶל הַמָּקוֹם הַזֶּה וַיִּתֶּן לָנוּ אֶת הָאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת אֶרֶץ זָבַת חָלָב וּדְבָֽשׁ׃
translation: and he has brought us into this place, and has given us this land, a land flowing with milk and honey. (Deuteronomy 26:9)

text: הַמְעַט כִּי הֶֽעֱלִיתָנוּ מֵאֶרֶץ זָבַת חָלָב וּדְבַשׁ לַהֲמִיתֵנוּ בַּמִּדְבָּר כִּֽי תִשְׂתָּרֵר עָלֵינוּ גַּם הִשְׂתָּרֵֽר׃
translation: Is it a small thing that you have brought us up out of a land flowing with milk and honey, to kill us in the wilderness, but you must also make yourself a prince over us? (Numbers 16:13)

text: וַתִּתֵּן לָהֶם אֶת הָאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּעְתָּ לַאֲבוֹתָם לָתֵת לָהֶם אֶרֶץ זָבַת חָלָב וּדְבָֽשׁ׃
translation: and gave them this land, which you swore to their fathers to give them, a land flowing with milk and honey. (Jeremiah 32:22)

text: וַיְסַפְּרוּ לוֹ וַיֹּאמְרוּ בָּאנוּ אֶל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר שְׁלַחְתָּנוּ וְגַם זָבַת חָלָב וּדְבַשׁ הִוא וְזֶה פִּרְיָֽהּ׃
translation: They told him, and said, "We came to the land where you sent us. Surely it flows with milk and honey, and this is its fruit. (Numbers 13:27)

text: וַיַּעַל הַנֵּרֹת לִפְנֵי יְהוָה כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהוָה אֶת מֹשֶֽׁה׃
translation: He lit the lamps before the LORD, as the LORD commanded Moses. (Exodus 40:25)

text: בְּהִלּוֹ נֵרוֹ עֲלֵי רֹאשִׁי לְאוֹרוֹ אֵלֶךְ חֹֽשֶׁךְ׃
translation: when his lamp shone on my head, and by his light I walked through darkness, (Job 29:3)

text: רוּם עֵינַיִם וּרְחַב לֵב נִר רְשָׁעִים חַטָּֽאת׃
translation: A high look and a proud heart, the lamp of the wicked, is sin. (Proverbs 21:4)

text: אוֹר צַדִּיקִים יִשְׂמָח וְנֵר רְשָׁעִים יִדְעָֽךְ׃
translation: The light of the righteous shines brightly, but the lamp of the wicked is snuffed out. (Proverbs 13:9)

text: וְעָשִׂיתָ אֶת נֵרֹתֶיהָ שִׁבְעָה וְהֶֽעֱלָה אֶת נֵרֹתֶיהָ וְהֵאִיר עַל עֵבֶר פָּנֶֽיהָ׃
translation: You shall make its lamps seven, and they shall light its lamps to give light to the space in front of it. (Exodus 25:37)

text: נֵר לְרַגְלִי דְבָרֶךָ וְאוֹר לִנְתִיבָתִֽי׃
translation: Your word is a lamp to my feet, and a light for my path. (Psalms 119:105)

text: וַיְחַבֵּר אֶת חֲמֵשׁ הַיְרִיעֹת לְבָד וְאֶת שֵׁשׁ הַיְרִיעֹת לְבָֽד׃
translation: He coupled five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves. (Exodus 36:16)

text: תַּחַת אָוֶן רָאִיתִי אָהֳלֵי כוּשָׁן יִרְגְּזוּן יְרִיעוֹת אֶרֶץ מִדְיָֽן׃
translation: I saw the tents of Cushan in affliction. The dwellings of the land of Midian trembled. (Habakkuk 3:7)

text: וְעָשִׂיתָ יְרִיעֹת עִזִּים לְאֹהֶל עַל הַמִּשְׁכָּן עַשְׁתֵּי עֶשְׂרֵה יְרִיעֹת תַּעֲשֶׂה אֹתָֽם׃
translation: "You shall make curtains of goats' hair for a covering over the tabernacle. You shall make eleven curtains. (Exodus 26:7)

text: וַיַּעַשׂ יְרִיעֹת עִזִּים לְאֹהֶל עַל הַמִּשְׁכָּן עַשְׁתֵּֽי עֶשְׂרֵה יְרִיעֹת עָשָׂה אֹתָֽם׃
translation: He made curtains of goats' hair for a covering over the tabernacle. He made them eleven curtains. (Exodus 36:14)

text: חֲמֵשׁ הַיְרִיעֹת תִּֽהְיֶיןָ חֹֽבְרֹת אִשָּׁה אֶל אֲחֹתָהּ וְחָמֵשׁ יְרִיעֹת חֹֽבְרֹת אִשָּׁה אֶל אֲחֹתָֽהּ׃
translation: Five curtains shall be coupled together to one another, and the other five curtains shall be coupled to one another. (Exodus 26:3)

text: וַיְחַבֵּר אֶת חֲמֵשׁ הַיְרִיעֹת אַחַת אֶל אֶחָת וְחָמֵשׁ יְרִיעֹת חִבַּר אַחַת אֶל אֶחָֽת׃
translation: He coupled five curtains to one another, and the other five curtains he coupled to one another. (Exodus 36:10)

text: לְדָוִד מִזְמוֹר חֶֽסֶד וּמִשְׁפָּט אָשִׁירָה לְךָ יְהוָה אֲזַמֵּֽרָה׃
translation: A Psalm by David. I will sing of loving kindness and justice. To you, LORD, I will sing praises. (Psalms 101:1)

text: עַל כֵּן אוֹדְךָ יְהוָה בַּגּוֹיִם וּלְשִׁמְךָ אֲזַמֵּֽר׃
translation: Therefore I will give thanks to you, LORD, among the nations, and will sing praises to your name. (2 Samuel 22:50)

text: עַל כֵּן אוֹדְךָ בַגּוֹיִם יְהוָה וּלְשִׁמְךָ אֲזַמֵּֽרָה׃
translation: He gives great deliverance to his king, and shows loving kindness to his anointed, to David and to his offspring, forever more. (Psalms 18:50)

text: כִּי מֶלֶךְ כָּל הָאָרֶץ אֱלֹהִים זַמְּרוּ מַשְׂכִּֽיל׃
translation: God reigns over the nations. God sits on his holy throne. (Psalms 47:8)

text: נָכוֹן לִבִּי אֱלֹהִים נָכוֹן לִבִּי אָשִׁירָה וַאֲזַמֵּֽרָה׃
translation: Wake up, my glory! Wake up, lute and harp! I will wake up the dawn. (Psalms 57:8)

text: כָּל הָאָרֶץ יִשְׁתַּחֲווּ לְךָ וִֽיזַמְּרוּ לָךְ יְזַמְּרוּ שִׁמְךָ סֶֽלָה׃
translation: All the earth will worship you, and will sing to you; they will sing to your name." Selah. (Psalms 66:4)

text: כִּֽי מְרֵעִים יִכָּרֵתוּן וְקֹוֵי יְהוָה הֵמָּה יִֽירְשׁוּ אָֽרֶץ׃
translation: For evildoers shall be cut off, but those who wait for the LORD shall inherit the land. (Psalms 37:9)

text: אַל תֹּאמַר אֲשַׁלְּמָה רָע קַוֵּה לַֽיהוָה וְיֹשַֽׁע לָֽךְ׃
translation: Don't say, "I will pay back evil." Wait for the LORD, and he will save you. (Proverbs 20:22)

text: וְעַתָּה מַה קִּוִּיתִי אֲדֹנָי תּוֹחַלְתִּי לְךָ הִֽיא׃
translation: Deliver me from all my transgressions. Don't make me the reproach of the foolish. (Psalms 39:8)

text: אַף אֹרַח מִשְׁפָּטֶיךָ יְהוָה קִוִּינוּךָ לְשִׁמְךָ וּֽלְזִכְרְךָ תַּאֲוַת נָֽפֶשׁ׃
translation: Yes, in the way of your judgments, LORD, we have waited for you. Your name and your renown are the desire of our soul. (Isaiah 26:8)

text: לִי קִוּוּ רְשָׁעִים לְאַבְּדֵנִי עֵדֹתֶיךָ אֶתְבּוֹנָֽן׃
translation: The wicked have waited for me, to destroy me. I will consider your statutes. (Psalms 119:95)

text: קִוִּיתִי יְהוָה קִוְּתָה נַפְשִׁי וְֽלִדְבָרוֹ הוֹחָֽלְתִּי׃
translation: I wait for the LORD. My soul waits. I hope in his word. (Psalms 130:5)

text: בַּצּוּרוֹת יְאֹרִים בִּקֵּעַ וְכָל יְקָר רָאֲתָה עֵינֽוֹ׃
translation: He cuts out channels among the rocks. His eye sees every precious thing. (Job 28:10)

text: וַיְהִי כְּכַלֹּתוֹ לְדַבֵּר אֵת כָּל הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה וַתִּבָּקַע הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר תַּחְתֵּיהֶֽם׃
translation: As he finished speaking all these words, the ground that was under them split apart. (Numbers 16:31)

text: נַעֲלֶה בִֽיהוּדָה וּנְקִיצֶנָּה וְנַבְקִעֶנָּה אֵלֵינוּ וְנַמְלִיךְ מֶלֶךְ בְּתוֹכָהּ אֵת בֶּן טָֽבְאַֽל׃
translation: "Let's go up against Judah, and tear it apart, and let's divide it among ourselves, and set up a king within it, even the son of Tabeel." (Isaiah 7:6)

text: מוֹלִיךְ לִימִין מֹשֶׁה זְרוֹעַ תִּפְאַרְתּוֹ בּוֹקֵֽעַ מַיִם מִפְּנֵיהֶם לַעֲשׂוֹת לוֹ שֵׁם עוֹלָֽם׃
translation: Who caused his glorious arm to be at Moses' right hand? Who divided the waters before them, to make himself an everlasting name? (Isaiah 63:12)

text: וַיַּעֲלוּ כָל הָעָם אַֽחֲרָיו וְהָעָם מְחַלְּלִים בַּחֲלִלִים וּשְׂמֵחִים שִׂמְחָה גְדוֹלָה וַתִּבָּקַע הָאָרֶץ בְּקוֹלָֽם׃
translation: All the people came up after him, and the people piped with pipes, and rejoiced with great joy, so that the earth shook with their sound. (1 Kings 1:40)

text: וְנָתַתִּי אֵשׁ בְּמִצְרַיִם חוּל תחיל תָּחוּל סִין וְנֹא תִּהְיֶה לְהִבָּקֵעַ וְנֹף צָרֵי יוֹמָֽם׃
translation: I will set a fire in Egypt Sin will be in great anguish. No will be broken up. Memphis will have adversaries in the daytime. (Ezekiel 30:16)

text: וְאִם מִנְחַת מַרְחֶשֶׁת קָרְבָּנֶךָ סֹלֶת בַּשֶּׁמֶן תֵּעָשֶֽׂה׃
translation: If your offering is a meal offering of the pan, it shall be made of fine flour with oil. (Leviticus 2:7)

text: וּמִנְחָתָם סֹלֶת בְּלוּלָה בַשָּׁמֶן שְׁלֹשָׁה עֶשְׂרֹנִים לַפָּר וּשְׁנֵי עֶשְׂרֹנִים לָאַיִל תַּעֲשֽׂוּ׃
translation: with their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil. You shall offer three tenths for a bull, and two tenths for the ram. (Numbers 28:20)

text: וּמִנְחָתָם סֹלֶת בְּלוּלָה בַשָּׁמֶן שְׁלֹשָׁה עֶשְׂרֹנִים לַפָּר שְׁנֵי עֶשְׂרֹנִים לָאַיִל הָאֶחָֽד׃
translation: and their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil: three tenths for the bull, two tenths for the one ram, (Numbers 29:9)

text: וְהִקְרִיב עַל בֶּן הַבָּקָר מִנְחָה סֹלֶת שְׁלֹשָׁה עֶשְׂרֹנִים בָּלוּל בַּשֶּׁמֶן חֲצִי הַהִֽין׃
translation: then he shall offer with the bull a meal offering of three tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with half a hin of oil; (Numbers 15:9)

text: וּמִנְחָתָם סֹלֶת בְּלוּלָה בַשָּׁמֶן שְׁלֹשָׁה עֶשְׂרֹנִים לַפָּר הָֽאֶחָד שְׁנֵי עֶשְׂרֹנִים לָאַיִל הָאֶחָֽד׃
translation: and their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil, three tenths for each bull, two tenths for the one ram, (Numbers 28:28)

text: וְלָֽקְחוּ פַּר בֶּן בָּקָר וּמִנְחָתוֹ סֹלֶת בְּלוּלָה בַשָּׁמֶן וּפַר שֵׁנִי בֶן בָּקָר תִּקַּח לְחַטָּֽאת׃
translation: Then let them take a young bull and its meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil; and another young bull you shall take for a sin offering. (Numbers 8:8)

text: וַיִּשְׁמַע מֹשֶׁה לְקוֹל חֹתְנוֹ וַיַּעַשׂ כֹּל אֲשֶׁר אָמָֽר׃
translation: So Moses listened to the voice of his father-in-law, and did all that he had said. (Exodus 18:24)

text: וַיְשַׁלַּח מֹשֶׁה אֶת חֹתְנוֹ וַיֵּלֶךְ לוֹ אֶל אַרְצֽוֹ׃
translation: Moses let his father-in-law depart, and he went his way into his own land. (Exodus 18:27)

text: אָרוּר שֹׁכֵב עִם חֹֽתַנְתּוֹ וְאָמַר כָּל הָעָם אָמֵֽן׃
translation: 'Cursed is he who lies with his mother-in-law.' All the people shall say, 'Amen.' (Deuteronomy 27:23)

text: וְהִֽתְחַתְּנוּ אֹתָנוּ בְּנֹֽתֵיכֶם תִּתְּנוּ לָנוּ וְאֶת בְּנֹתֵינוּ תִּקְחוּ לָכֶֽם׃
translation: Make marriages with us. Give your daughters to us, and take our daughters for yourselves. (Genesis 34:9)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה לְחֹתְנוֹ כִּֽי יָבֹא אֵלַי הָעָם לִדְרֹשׁ אֱלֹהִֽים׃
translation: Moses said to his father-in-law, "Because the people come to me to inquire of God. (Exodus 18:15)

text: וַיְהִי לִֽיהוֹשָׁפָט עֹשֶׁר וְכָבוֹד לָרֹב וַיִּתְחַתֵּן לְאַחְאָֽב׃
translation: Now Jehoshaphat had riches and honor in abundance; and he allied himself with Ahab. (2 Chronicles 18:1)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם שִׁמְעוּ נָא הַחֲלוֹם הַזֶּה אֲשֶׁר חָלָֽמְתִּי׃
translation: He said to them, "Please hear this dream which I have dreamed: (Genesis 37:6)

text: יַחְלְמוּ בְנֵיהֶם יִרְבּוּ בַבָּר יָצְאוּ וְלֹא שָׁבוּ לָֽמוֹ׃
translation: Their young ones become strong. They grow up in the open field. They go out, and don't return again. (Job 39:4)

text: וַיַּחֲלֹם יוֹסֵף חֲלוֹם וַיַּגֵּד לְאֶחָיו וַיּוֹסִפוּ עוֹד שְׂנֹא אֹתֽוֹ׃
translation: Joseph dreamed a dream, and he told it to his brothers, and they hated him all the more. (Genesis 37:5)

text: וַיְהִי מִקֵּץ שְׁנָתַיִם יָמִים וּפַרְעֹה חֹלֵם וְהִנֵּה עֹמֵד עַל הַיְאֹֽר׃
translation: At the end of two full years, Pharaoh dreamed, and behold, he stood by the river. (Genesis 41:1)

text: וַנַּֽחַלְמָה חֲלוֹם בְּלַיְלָה אֶחָד אֲנִי וָהוּא אִישׁ כְּפִתְרוֹן חֲלֹמוֹ חָלָֽמְנוּ׃
translation: We dreamed a dream in one night, he and I. Each man dreamed according to the interpretation of his dream. (Genesis 41:11)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶם הַמֶּלֶךְ חֲלוֹם חָלָמְתִּי וַתִּפָּעֶם רוּחִי לָדַעַת אֶֽת הַחֲלֽוֹם׃
translation: The king said to them, "I have dreamed a dream, and my spirit is troubled to know the dream." (Daniel 2:3)

text: יָדֹעַ תֵּדַע פְּנֵי צֹאנֶךָ שִׁית לִבְּךָ לַעֲדָרִֽים׃
translation: Know well the state of your flocks, and pay attention to your herds, (Proverbs 27:23)

text: בְּנֵי מוּשִׁי מַחְלִי וְעֵדֶר וִירֵמוֹת שְׁלֹשָֽׁה׃
translation: The sons of Mushi: Mahli, Eder, and Jeremoth, three. (1 Chronicles 23:23)

text: וּבְנֵי מוּשִׁי מַחְלִי וְעֵדֶר וִירִימוֹת אֵלֶּה בְּנֵי הַלְוִיִּם לְבֵית אֲבֹתֵיהֶֽם׃
translation: The sons of Mushi: Mahli, Eder, and Jerimoth. These were the sons of the Levites after their fathers' houses. (1 Chronicles 24:30)

text: הָסֵבִּי עֵינַיִךְ מִנֶּגְדִּי שֶׁהֵם הִרְהִיבֻנִי שַׂעְרֵךְ כְּעֵדֶר הָֽעִזִּים שֶׁגָּלְשׁוּ מִן הַגִּלְעָֽד׃
translation: Turn away your eyes from me, for they have overcome me. Your hair is like a flock of goats, that lie along the side of Gilead. (Song of Solomon 6:5)

text: לָמָּה יָשַׁבְתָּ בֵּין הַֽמִּשְׁפְּתַיִם לִשְׁמֹעַ שְׁרִקוֹת עֲדָרִים לִפְלַגּוֹת רְאוּבֵן גְּדוֹלִים חִקְרֵי לֵֽב׃
translation: Why did you sit among the sheepfolds? To hear the whistling for the flocks? At the watercourses of Reuben, there were great searchings of heart. (Judges 5:16)

text: אֵלֶיהָ יָבֹאוּ רֹעִים וְעֶדְרֵיהֶם תָּקְעוּ עָלֶיהָ אֹהָלִים סָבִיב רָעוּ אִישׁ אֶת יָדֽוֹ׃
translation: Shepherds with their flocks will come to her. They will pitch their tents against her all around. They will feed everyone in his place." (Jeremiah 6:3)

text: וַיֹּֽאמֶר לוֹ יְהוֹנָתָן מָחָר חֹדֶשׁ וְנִפְקַדְתָּ כִּי יִפָּקֵד מוֹשָׁבֶֽךָ׃
translation: Then Jonathan said to him, "Tomorrow is the new moon, and you will be missed, because your seat will be empty. (1 Samuel 20:18)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר לְמָחָר וַיֹּאמֶר כִּדְבָרְךָ לְמַעַן תֵּדַע כִּי אֵין כַּיהוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃
translation: Aaron stretched out his hand over the waters of Egypt; and the frogs came up, and covered the land of Egypt. (Exodus 8:6)

text: וְשַׂמְתִּי פְדֻת בֵּין עַמִּי וּבֵין עַמֶּךָ לְמָחָר יִהְיֶה הָאֹת הַזֶּֽה׃
translation: Then the magicians said to Pharaoh, "This is God's finger;" but Pharaoh's heart was hardened, and he didn't listen to them, as the LORD had spoken. (Exodus 8:19)

text: וַיָּשֶׂם יְהוָה מוֹעֵד לֵאמֹר מָחָר יַעֲשֶׂה יְהוָה הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה בָּאָֽרֶץ׃
translation: The LORD appointed a set time, saying, "Tomorrow the LORD shall do this thing in the land." (Exodus 9:5)

text: אַל תֹּאמַר לרעיך לְרֵֽעֲךָ לֵךְ וָשׁוּב וּמָחָר אֶתֵּן וְיֵשׁ אִתָּֽךְ׃
translation: Don't say to your neighbor, "Go, and come again; tomorrow I will give it to you," when you have it by you. (Proverbs 3:28)

text: אַֽל תִּתְהַלֵּל בְּיוֹם מָחָר כִּי לֹא תֵדַע מַה יֵּלֶד יֽוֹם׃
translation: Don't boast about tomorrow; for you don't know what a day may bring. (Proverbs 27:1)

text: כִּי אִם מָאֵן אַתָּה לְשַׁלֵּחַ וְעוֹדְךָ מַחֲזִיק בָּֽם׃
translation: For if you refuse to let them go, and hold them still, (Exodus 9:2)

text: לֹא שָׁמְרוּ בְּרִית אֱלֹהִים וּבְתוֹרָתוֹ מֵאֲנוּ לָלֶֽכֶת׃
translation: They didn't keep God's covenant, and refused to walk in his law. (Psalms 78:10)

text: יַעַן קָרָאתִי וַתְּמָאֵנוּ נָטִיתִי יָדִי וְאֵין מַקְשִֽׁיב׃
translation: Because I have called, and you have refused; I have stretched out my hand, and no one has paid attention; (Proverbs 1:24)

text: שֹׁד רְשָׁעִים יְגוֹרֵם כִּי מֵאֲנוּ לַעֲשׂוֹת מִשְׁפָּֽט׃
translation: The violence of the wicked will drive them away, because they refuse to do what is right. (Proverbs 21:7)

text: תַּאֲוַת עָצֵל תְּמִיתֶנּוּ כִּֽי מֵאֲנוּ יָדָיו לַעֲשֽׂוֹת׃
translation: The desire of the sluggard kills him, for his hands refuse to labor. (Proverbs 21:25)

text: וְאִם תְּמָאֲנוּ וּמְרִיתֶם חֶרֶב תְּאֻכְּלוּ כִּי פִּי יְהוָה דִּבֵּֽר׃
translation: but if you refuse and rebel, you will be devoured with the sword; for the LORD's mouth has spoken it." (Isaiah 1:20)

text: מֵרֵיחַ מַיִם יַפְרִחַ וְעָשָׂה קָצִיר כְּמוֹ נָֽטַע׃
translation: yet through the scent of water it will bud, and sprout boughs like a plant. (Job 14:9)

text: בּוֹטֵחַ בְּעָשְׁרוֹ הוּא יִפֹּל וְכֶעָלֶה צַדִּיקִים יִפְרָֽחוּ׃
translation: He who trusts in his riches will fall, but the righteous shall flourish as the green leaf. (Proverbs 11:28)

text: צַדִּיק כַּתָּמָר יִפְרָח כְּאֶרֶז בַּלְּבָנוֹן יִשְׂגֶּֽה׃
translation: They are planted in the LORD's house. They will flourish in our God's courts. (Psalms 92:13)

text: בֵּית רְשָׁעִים יִשָּׁמֵד וְאֹהֶל יְשָׁרִים יַפְרִֽיחַ׃
translation: The house of the wicked will be overthrown, but the tent of the upright will flourish. (Proverbs 14:11)

text: דִּבְּרוּ דְבָרִים אָלוֹת שָׁוְא כָּרֹת בְּרִית וּפָרַח כָּרֹאשׁ מִשְׁפָּט עַל תַּלְמֵי שָׂדָֽי׃
translation: They make promises, swearing falsely in making covenants. Therefore judgment springs up like poisonous weeds in the furrows of the field. (Hosea 10:4)

text: נַשְׁכִּימָה לַכְּרָמִים נִרְאֶה אִם פָּֽרְחָה הַגֶּפֶן פִּתַּח הַסְּמָדַר הֵנֵצוּ הָרִמּוֹנִים שָׁם אֶתֵּן אֶת דֹּדַי לָֽךְ׃
translation: The mandrakes produce fragrance. At our doors are all kinds of precious fruits, new and old, which I have stored up for you, my beloved. (Song of Solomon 7:13)

text: וּבְעֵת הָצֵר לוֹ וַיּוֹסֶף לִמְעוֹל בַּיהוָה הוּא הַמֶּלֶךְ אָחָֽז׃
translation: In the time of his distress, he trespassed yet more against the LORD, this same King Ahaz. (2 Chronicles 28:22)

text: וְאַל תַּסְתֵּר פָּנֶיךָ מֵֽעַבְדֶּךָ כִּֽי צַר לִי מַהֵר עֲנֵֽנִי׃
translation: Draw near to my soul and redeem it. Ransom me because of my enemies. (Psalms 69:18)

text: כִּצְרוֹר אֶבֶן בְּמַרְגֵּמָה כֵּן נוֹתֵן לִכְסִיל כָּבֽוֹד׃
translation: As one who binds a stone in a sling, so is he who gives honor to a fool. (Proverbs 26:8)

text: וְאִשָּׁה אֶל אֲחֹתָהּ לֹא תִקָּח לִצְרֹר לְגַלּוֹת עֶרְוָתָהּ עָלֶיהָ בְּחַיֶּֽיהָ׃
translation: "'You shall not take a wife in addition to her sister, to be a rival, to uncover her nakedness, while her sister is still alive. (Leviticus 18:18)

text: עָֽשְׁשָׁה מִכַּעַס עֵינִי עָֽתְקָה בְּכָל צוֹרְרָֽי׃
translation: Depart from me, all you workers of iniquity, for the LORD has heard the voice of my weeping. (Psalms 6:8)

text: חָנֵּנִי יְהוָה כִּי צַר לִי עָשְׁשָׁה בְכַעַס עֵינִי נַפְשִׁי וּבִטְנִֽי׃
translation: For my life is spent with sorrow, my years with sighing. My strength fails because of my iniquity. My bones are wasted away. (Psalms 31:10)

text: כִּֽי עַתָּה הֱיִיתֶם לא לוֹ תִּֽרְאוּ חֲתַת וַתִּירָֽאוּ׃
translation: For now you are nothing. You see a terror, and are afraid. (Job 6:21)

text: יִשְׂחַק לְפַחַד וְלֹא יֵחָת וְלֹֽא יָשׁוּב מִפְּנֵי חָֽרֶב׃
translation: He mocks at fear, and is not dismayed, neither does he turn back from the sword. (Job 39:22)

text: וּבְנֵי קְנַז עָתְנִיאֵל וּשְׂרָיָה וּבְנֵי עָתְנִיאֵל חֲתַֽת׃
translation: The sons of Kenaz: Othniel and Seraiah. The sons of Othniel: Hathath. (1 Chronicles 4:13)

text: וְחַתּוּ וָבֹשׁוּ מִכּוּשׁ מַבָּטָם וּמִן מִצְרַיִם תִּפְאַרְתָּֽם׃
translation: They will be dismayed and confounded, because of Ethiopia their expectation, and of Egypt their glory. (Isaiah 20:5)

text: כִּֽי מִקּוֹל יְהוָה יֵחַת אַשּׁוּר בַּשֵּׁבֶט יַכֶּֽה׃
translation: For through the LORD's voice the Assyrian will be dismayed. He will strike him with his rod. (Isaiah 30:31)

text: וַיִּשְׁמַע שָׁאוּל וְכָל יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת דִּבְרֵי הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי הָאֵלֶּה וַיֵּחַתּוּ וַיִּֽרְאוּ מְאֹֽד׃
translation: When Saul and all Israel heard those words of the Philistine, they were dismayed and greatly afraid. (1 Samuel 17:11)

text: כִּי יוֹם נָקָם לַֽיהוָה שְׁנַת שִׁלּוּמִים לְרִיב צִיּֽוֹן׃
translation: For the LORD has a day of vengeance, a year of recompense for the cause of Zion. (Isaiah 34:8)

text: יִשְׂמַח צַדִּיק כִּי חָזָה נָקָם פְּעָמָיו יִרְחַץ בְּדַם הָרָשָֽׁע׃
translation: so that men shall say, "Most certainly there is a reward for the righteous. Most certainly there is a God who judges the earth." (Psalms 58:11)

text: כִּי יוֹם נָקָם בְּלִבִּי וּשְׁנַת גְּאוּלַי בָּֽאָה׃
translation: For the day of vengeance was in my heart, and the year of my redeemed has come. (Isaiah 63:4)

text: וְעָשִׂיתִי בְּאַף וּבְחֵמָה נָקָם אֶת הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר לֹא שָׁמֵֽעוּ׃
translation: I will uproot your Asherah poles from among you; and I will destroy your cities. (Micah 5:14)

text: תִּגָּל עֶרְוָתֵךְ גַּם תֵּרָאֶה חֶרְפָּתֵךְ נָקָם אֶקָּח וְלֹא אֶפְגַּע אָדָֽם׃
translation: Your nakedness will be uncovered. Yes, your shame will be seen. I will take vengeance, and will spare no one." (Isaiah 47:3)

text: לִקְרֹא שְׁנַת רָצוֹן לַֽיהוָה וְיוֹם נָקָם לֵאלֹהֵינוּ לְנַחֵם כָּל אֲבֵלִֽים׃
translation: to proclaim the year of the LORD's favor and the day of vengeance of our God, to comfort all who mourn, (Isaiah 61:2)

text: וָאֹמַר מִֽי יִתֶּן לִּי אֵבֶר כַּיּוֹנָה אָעוּפָה וְאֶשְׁכֹּֽנָה׃
translation: Behold, then I would wander far off. I would lodge in the wilderness." Selah. (Psalms 55:7)

text: וַֽיְהִי דְּבַר יְהוָה אֶל יוֹנָה בֶן אֲמִתַּי לֵאמֹֽר׃
translation: Now the LORD's word came to Jonah the son of Amittai, saying, (Jonah 1:1)

text: וַיְהִי דְבַר יְהוָה אֶל יוֹנָה שֵׁנִית לֵאמֹֽר׃
translation: The LORD's word came to Jonah the second time, saying, (Jonah 3:1)

text: וַיֵּרַע אֶל יוֹנָה רָעָה גְדוֹלָה וַיִּחַר לֽוֹ׃
translation: But it displeased Jonah exceedingly, and he was angry. (Jonah 4:1)

text: וַיְשַׁלַּח אֶת הַיּוֹנָה מֵאִתּוֹ לִרְאוֹת הֲקַלּוּ הַמַּיִם מֵעַל פְּנֵי הָֽאֲדָמָֽה׃
translation: He himself sent out a dove to see if the waters were abated from the surface of the ground, (Genesis 8:8)

text: עֵינָיו כְּיוֹנִים עַל אֲפִיקֵי מָיִם רֹֽחֲצוֹת בֶּֽחָלָב יֹשְׁבוֹת עַל מִלֵּֽאת׃
translation: His eyes are like doves beside the water brooks, washed with milk, mounted like jewels. (Song of Solomon 5:12)

text: שָׁלַֽח חֹשֶׁךְ וַיַּחְשִׁךְ וְלֹֽא מָרוּ אֶת דברוו דְּבָרֽוֹ׃
translation: He sent darkness, and made it dark. They didn't rebel against his words. (Psalms 105:28)

text: פְּעָמִים רַבּוֹת יַצִּילֵם וְהֵמָּה יַמְרוּ בַעֲצָתָם וַיָּמֹכּוּ בַּעֲוֺנָֽם׃
translation: He rescued them many times, but they were rebellious in their counsel, and were brought low in their iniquity. (Psalms 106:43)

text: לֵב יוֹדֵעַ מָרַּת נַפְשׁוֹ וּבְשִׂמְחָתוֹ לֹא יִתְעָרַב זָֽר׃
translation: The heart knows its own bitterness and joy; he will not share these with a stranger. (Proverbs 14:10)

text: מַמְרִים הֱיִיתֶם עִם יְהוָה מִיּוֹם דַּעְתִּי אֶתְכֶֽם׃
translation: You have been rebellious against the LORD from the day that I knew you. (Deuteronomy 9:24)

text: כִּֽי הִמְרוּ אֶת רוּחוֹ וַיְבַטֵּא בִּשְׂפָתָֽיו׃
translation: because they were rebellious against his spirit, he spoke rashly with his lips. (Psalms 106:33)

text: כְּשֹׁמְרֵי שָׂדַי הָיוּ עָלֶיהָ מִסָּבִיב כִּי אֹתִי מָרָתָה נְאֻם יְהוָֽה׃
translation: As keepers of a field, they are against her all around, because she has been rebellious against me,'" says the LORD. (Jeremiah 4:17)

text: וְהִיא מָרַת נָפֶשׁ וַתִּתְפַּלֵּל עַל יְהוָה וּבָכֹה תִבְכֶּֽה׃
translation: She was in bitterness of soul, and prayed to the LORD, weeping bitterly. (1 Samuel 1:10)

text: הֵן אֶרְאֶלָּם צָעֲקוּ חֻצָה מַלְאֲכֵי שָׁלוֹם מַר יִבְכָּיֽוּן׃
translation: Behold, their valiant ones cry outside; the ambassadors of peace weep bitterly. (Isaiah 33:7)

text: לָמָּה יִתֵּן לְעָמֵל אוֹר וְחַיִּים לְמָרֵי נָֽפֶשׁ׃
translation: "Why is light given to him who is in misery, life to the bitter in soul, (Job 3:20)

text: נָֽקְטָה נַפְשִׁי בְּחַיָּי אֶֽעֶזְבָה עָלַי שִׂיחִי אֲדַבְּרָה בְּמַר נַפְשִֽׁי׃
translation: "My soul is weary of my life. I will give free course to my complaint. I will speak in the bitterness of my soul. (Job 10:1)

text: וְזֶה יָמוּת בְּנֶפֶשׁ מָרָה וְלֹֽא אָכַל בַּטּוֹבָֽה׃
translation: Another dies in bitterness of soul, and never tastes of good. (Job 21:25)

text: וְכָתַב אֶת הָאָלֹת הָאֵלֶּה הַכֹּהֵן בַּסֵּפֶר וּמָחָה אֶל מֵי הַמָּרִֽים׃
translation: "'The priest shall write these curses in a book, and he shall wipe them into the water of bitterness. (Numbers 5:23)

text: בְּצֶקֶת עָפָר לַמּוּצָק וּרְגָבִים יְדֻבָּֽקוּ׃
translation: when the dust runs into a mass, and the clods of earth stick together? (Job 38:38)

text: וַיִּקָּחוּם מִתּוֹךְ הָאֹהֶל וַיְבִאוּם אֶל יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וְאֶל כָּל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיַּצִּקֻם לִפְנֵי יְהוָֽה׃
translation: They took them from the middle of the tent, and brought them to Joshua and to all the children of Israel. They laid them down before the LORD. (Joshua 7:23)

text: וּבָאת וְסָגַרְתְּ הַדֶּלֶת בַּעֲדֵךְ וּבְעַד בָּנַיִךְ וְיָצַקְתְּ עַל כָּל הַכֵּלִים הָאֵלֶּה וְהַמָּלֵא תַּסִּֽיעִי׃
translation: Go in and shut the door on you and on your sons, and pour oil into all those containers; and set aside those which are full." (2 Kings 4:4)

text: וַתֵּלֶךְ מֵֽאִתּוֹ וַתִּסְגֹּר הַדֶּלֶת בַּעֲדָהּ וּבְעַד בָּנֶיהָ הֵם מַגִּשִׁים אֵלֶיהָ וְהִיא מיצקת מוֹצָֽקֶת׃
translation: So she went from him, and shut the door on herself and on her sons. They brought the containers to her, and she poured oil. (2 Kings 4:5)

text: וַיִּצֹק לוֹ אַרְבַּע טַבְּעֹת זָהָב וַיִּתֵּן אֶת הַטַּבָּעֹת עַל אַרְבַּע הַפֵּאֹת אֲשֶׁר לְאַרְבַּע רַגְלָֽיו׃
translation: He cast four rings of gold for it, and put the rings in the four corners that were on its four feet. (Exodus 37:13)

text: וְעָשִׂיתָ לַמָּסָךְ חֲמִשָּׁה עַמּוּדֵי שִׁטִּים וְצִפִּיתָ אֹתָם זָהָב וָוֵיהֶם זָהָב וְיָצַקְתָּ לָהֶם חֲמִשָּׁה אַדְנֵי נְחֹֽשֶׁת׃
translation: You shall make for the screen five pillars of acacia, and overlay them with gold. Their hooks shall be of gold. You shall cast five sockets of bronze for them. (Exodus 26:37)

text: וְאֶת זָכָר לֹא תִשְׁכַּב מִשְׁכְּבֵי אִשָּׁה תּוֹעֵבָה הִֽוא׃
translation: "'You shall not lie with a man as with a woman. That is detestable. (Leviticus 18:22)

text: אִם אֵֽין לְךָ לְשַׁלֵּם לָמָּה יִקַּח מִשְׁכָּבְךָ מִתַּחְתֶּֽיךָ׃
translation: If you don't have means to pay, why should he take away your bed from under you? (Proverbs 22:27)

text: וְכָל הַנֹּגֵעַ בְּמִשְׁכָּבָהּ יְכַבֵּס בְּגָדָיו וְרָחַץ בַּמַּיִם וְטָמֵא עַד הָעָֽרֶב׃
translation: Whoever touches her bed shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening. (Leviticus 15:21)

text: עַל מִשְׁכָּבִי בַּלֵּילוֹת בִּקַּשְׁתִּי אֵת שֶׁאָהֲבָה נַפְשִׁי בִּקַּשְׁתִּיו וְלֹא מְצָאתִֽיו׃
translation: By night on my bed, I sought him whom my soul loves. I sought him, but I didn't find him. (Song of Solomon 3:1)

text: וְאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יִגַּע בְּמִשְׁכָּבוֹ יְכַבֵּס בְּגָדָיו וְרָחַץ בַּמַּיִם וְטָמֵא עַד הָעָֽרֶב׃
translation: Whoever touches his bed shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening. (Leviticus 15:5)

text: עַל הַר גָּבֹהַּ וְנִשָּׂא שַׂמְתְּ מִשְׁכָּבֵךְ גַּם שָׁם עָלִית לִזְבֹּחַ זָֽבַח׃
translation: On a high and lofty mountain you have set your bed. You also went up there to offer sacrifice. (Isaiah 57:7)

text: וְיָצְאוּ זְקֵנֶיךָ וְשֹׁפְטֶיךָ וּמָדְדוּ אֶל הֶעָרִים אֲשֶׁר סְבִיבֹת הֶחָלָֽל׃
translation: then your elders and your judges shall come out, and they shall measure to the cities which are around him who is slain. (Deuteronomy 21:2)

text: וַיָּמָד אֶת אֻלָם הַשַּׁעַר מֵהַבַּיִת קָנֶה אֶחָֽד׃
translation: He measured also the porch of the gate toward the house, one reed. (Ezekiel 40:8)

text: וַיְבִיאֵנִי אֶל שַׁעַר הַצָּפוֹן וּמָדַד כַּמִּדּוֹת הָאֵֽלֶּה׃
translation: He brought me to the north gate, and he measured it according to these measurements— (Ezekiel 40:35)

text: מָדַד רוּחַ הַצָּפוֹן חֲמֵשׁ מֵאוֹת קָנִים בִּקְנֵה הַמִּדָּה סָבִֽיב׃
translation: He measured on the north side five hundred reeds with the measuring reed all around. (Ezekiel 42:17)

text: סָבַב אֶל רוּחַ הַיָּם מָדַד חֲמֵשׁ מֵאוֹת קָנִים בִּקְנֵה הַמִּדָּֽה׃
translation: He turned about to the west side, and measured five hundred reeds with the measuring reed. (Ezekiel 42:19)

text: וַיָּמָד אֶת רֹחַב פֶּֽתַח הַשַּׁעַר עֶשֶׂר אַמּוֹת אֹרֶךְ הַשַּׁעַר שְׁלוֹשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה אַמּֽוֹת׃
translation: He measured the width of the opening of the gate, ten cubits; and the length of the gate, thirteen cubits; (Ezekiel 40:11)

text: וְאִם יִפְנֶה לְבָבְךָ וְלֹא תִשְׁמָע וְנִדַּחְתָּ וְהִֽשְׁתַּחֲוִיתָ לֵאלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים וַעֲבַדְתָּֽם׃
translation: But if your heart turns away, and you will not hear, but are drawn away and worship other gods, and serve them, (Deuteronomy 30:17)

text: הִטַּתּוּ בְּרֹב לִקְחָהּ בְּחֵלֶק שְׂפָתֶיהָ תַּדִּיחֶֽנּוּ׃
translation: With persuasive words, she led him astray. With the flattering of her lips, she seduced him. (Proverbs 7:21)

text: בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא נְאֻם יְהוָה אֹֽסְפָה הַצֹּלֵעָה וְהַנִּדָּחָה אֲקַבֵּצָה וַאֲשֶׁר הֲרֵעֹֽתִי׃
translation: "In that day," says the LORD, "I will assemble that which is lame, and I will gather that which is driven away, and that which I have afflicted; (Micah 4:6)

text: אִם יִהְיֶה נִֽדַּחֲךָ בִּקְצֵה הַשָּׁמָיִם מִשָּׁם יְקַבֶּצְךָ יְהוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ וּמִשָּׁם יִקָּחֶֽךָ׃
translation: If your outcasts are in the uttermost parts of the heavens, from there the LORD your God will gather you, and from there he will bring you back. (Deuteronomy 30:4)

text: גַּם הוּא עָשָֽׂה בָמוֹת בְּהָרֵי יְהוּדָה וַיֶּזֶן אֶת יֹשְׁבֵי יְרוּשָׁלִַם וַיַּדַּח אֶת יְהוּדָֽה׃
translation: Moreover he made high places in the mountains of Judah, and made the inhabitants of Jerusalem play the prostitute, and led Judah astray. (2 Chronicles 21:11)

text: כִּי שֶׁקֶר הֵם נִבְּאִים לָכֶם לְמַעַן הַרְחִיק אֶתְכֶם מֵעַל אַדְמַתְכֶם וְהִדַּחְתִּי אֶתְכֶם וַאֲבַדְתֶּֽם׃
translation: for they prophesy a lie to you, to remove you far from your land, so that I would drive you out, and you would perish. (Jeremiah 27:10)

text: וַתְּהִי רֵאשִׁית מַמְלַכְתּוֹ בָּבֶל וְאֶרֶךְ וְאַכַּד וְכַלְנֵה בְּאֶרֶץ שִׁנְעָֽר׃
translation: The beginning of his kingdom was Babel, Erech, Accad, and Calneh, in the land of Shinar. (Genesis 10:10)

text: הוּא רֵאשִׁית דַּרְכֵי אֵל הָעֹשׂוֹ יַגֵּשׁ חַרְבּֽוֹ׃
translation: He is the chief of the ways of God. He who made him gives him his sword. (Job 40:19)

text: וַיַּךְ כָּל בְּכוֹר בְּאַרְצָם רֵאשִׁית לְכָל אוֹנָֽם׃
translation: He struck also all the firstborn in their land, the first fruits of all their manhood. (Psalms 105:36)

text: יְֽהוָה קָנָנִי רֵאשִׁית דַּרְכּוֹ קֶדֶם מִפְעָלָיו מֵאָֽז׃
translation: "The LORD possessed me in the beginning of his work, before his deeds of old. (Proverbs 8:22)

text: טוֹב אַחֲרִית דָּבָר מֵֽרֵאשִׁיתוֹ טוֹב אֶֽרֶךְ רוּחַ מִגְּבַהּ רֽוּחַ׃
translation: Better is the end of a thing than its beginning. The patient in spirit is better than the proud in spirit. (Ecclesiastes 7:8)

text: וַיִּקַּח הָעָם מֵהַשָּׁלָל צֹאן וּבָקָר רֵאשִׁית הַחֵרֶם לִזְבֹּחַ לַֽיהוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בַּגִּלְגָּֽל׃
translation: But the people took of the plunder, sheep and cattle, the best of the devoted things, to sacrifice to the LORD your God in Gilgal." (1 Samuel 15:21)

text: וְהֵבֵאתָ לְאָבִיךָ וְאָכָל בַּעֲבֻר אֲשֶׁר יְבָרֶכְךָ לִפְנֵי מוֹתֽוֹ׃
translation: You shall bring it to your father, that he may eat, so that he may bless you before his death." (Genesis 27:10)

text: בַּעֲבוּר יִשְׁמְרוּ חֻקָּיו וְתוֹרֹתָיו יִנְצֹרוּ הַֽלְלוּ יָֽהּ׃
translation: that they might keep his statutes, and observe his laws. Praise the LORD! (Psalms 105:45)

text: וַיַּקְצִיפוּ עַל מֵי מְרִיבָה וַיֵּרַע לְמֹשֶׁה בַּעֲבוּרָֽם׃
translation: They angered him also at the waters of Meribah, so that Moses was troubled for their sakes; (Psalms 106:32)

text: וַיִּשְׁלַח בְּיַד נָתָן הַנָּבִיא וַיִּקְרָא אֶת שְׁמוֹ יְדִידְיָהּ בַּעֲבוּר יְהוָֽה׃
translation: and he sent by the hand of Nathan the prophet, and he named him Jedidiah, for the LORD's sake. (2 Samuel 12:25)

text: וְכִֽעֲסַתָּה צָֽרָתָהּ גַּם כַּעַס בַּעֲבוּר הַרְּעִמָהּ כִּֽי סָגַר יְהוָה בְּעַד רַחְמָֽהּ׃
translation: Her rival provoked her severely, to irritate her, because the LORD had shut up her womb. (1 Samuel 1:6)

text: וְהִגַּדְתָּ לְבִנְךָ בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא לֵאמֹר בַּעֲבוּר זֶה עָשָׂה יְהוָה לִי בְּצֵאתִי מִמִּצְרָֽיִם׃
translation: You shall tell your son in that day, saying, 'It is because of that which the LORD did for me when I came out of Egypt.' (Exodus 13:8)

text: קֵץ בָּא בָּא הַקֵּץ הֵקִיץ אֵלָיִךְ הִנֵּה בָּאָֽה׃
translation: An end has come. The end has come! It awakes against you. Behold, it comes. (Ezekiel 7:6)

text: בְּהִתְהַלֶּכְךָ תַּנְחֶה אֹתָךְ בְּֽשָׁכְבְּךָ תִּשְׁמֹר עָלֶיךָ וַהֲקִיצוֹתָ הִיא תְשִׂיחֶֽךָ׃
translation: When you walk, it will lead you. When you sleep, it will watch over you. When you awake, it will talk with you. (Proverbs 6:22)

text: עַל זֹאת הֱקִיצֹתִי וָאֶרְאֶה וּשְׁנָתִי עָרְבָה לִּֽי׃
translation: On this I awakened, and saw; and my sleep was sweet to me. (Jeremiah 31:26)

text: וְקוֹץ הוֹלִיד אֶת עָנוּב וְאֶת הַצֹּבֵבָה וּמִשְׁפְּחוֹת אֲחַרְחֵל בֶּן הָרֽוּם׃
translation: Hakkoz became the father of Anub, Zobebah, and the families of Aharhel the son of Harum. (1 Chronicles 4:8)

text: הָעִירָה וְהָקִיצָה לְמִשְׁפָּטִי אֱלֹהַי וַֽאדֹנָי לְרִיבִֽי׃
translation: Wake up! Rise up to defend me, my God! My Lord, contend for me! (Psalms 35:23)

text: אֶסְפְּרֵם מֵחוֹל יִרְבּוּן הֱקִיצֹתִי וְעוֹדִי עִמָּֽךְ׃
translation: If I would count them, they are more in number than the sand. When I wake up, I am still with you. (Psalms 139:18)

text: וְהַֽנַּעֲרָה יָפָה עַד מְאֹד וַתְּהִי לַמֶּלֶךְ סֹכֶנֶת וַתְּשָׁרְתֵהוּ וְהַמֶּלֶךְ לֹא יְדָעָֽהּ׃
translation: The young lady was very beautiful; and she cherished the king, and served him; but the king didn't know her intimately. (1 Kings 1:4)

text: יָפְיָפִיתָ מִבְּנֵי אָדָם הוּצַק חֵן בְּשְׂפְתוֹתֶיךָ עַל כֵּן בֵּֽרַכְךָ אֱלֹהִים לְעוֹלָֽם׃
translation: Strap your sword on your thigh, O mighty one, in your splendor and your majesty. (Psalms 45:3)

text: וַיְהִי כְּבוֹא אַבְרָם מִצְרָיְמָה וַיִּרְאוּ הַמִּצְרִים אֶת הָאִשָּׁה כִּֽי יָפָה הִוא מְאֹֽד׃
translation: When Abram had come into Egypt, some Egyptians saw that the woman was very beautiful. (Genesis 12:14)

text: וַיַּבֵּט הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי וַיִּרְאֶה אֶת דָּוִד וַיִּבְזֵהוּ כִּֽי הָיָה נַעַר וְאַדְמֹנִי עִם יְפֵה מַרְאֶֽה׃
translation: When the Philistine looked around and saw David, he disdained him; for he was but a youth, and ruddy, and had a good looking face. (1 Samuel 17:42)

text: וַיִּֽוָּלְדוּ לְאַבְשָׁלוֹם שְׁלוֹשָׁה בָנִים וּבַת אַחַת וּשְׁמָהּ תָּמָר הִיא הָיְתָה אִשָּׁה יְפַת מַרְאֶֽה׃
translation: Three sons were born to Absalom, and one daughter, whose name was Tamar. She was a woman with a beautiful face. (2 Samuel 14:27)

text: וַיְהִי אַֽחֲרֵי כֵן וּלְאַבְשָׁלוֹם בֶּן דָּוִד אָחוֹת יָפָה וּשְׁמָהּ תָּמָר וַיֶּאֱהָבֶהָ אַמְנוֹן בֶּן דָּוִֽד׃
translation: After this, Absalom the son of David had a beautiful sister, whose name was Tamar; and Amnon the son of David loved her. (2 Samuel 13:1)

text: הֲֽלוֹא יִתְעוּ חֹרְשֵׁי רָע וְחֶסֶד וֶאֱמֶת חֹרְשֵׁי טֽוֹב׃
translation: Don't they go astray who plot evil? But love and faithfulness belong to those who plan good. (Proverbs 14:22)

text: זֹרוּ רְשָׁעִים מֵרָחֶם תָּעוּ מִבֶּטֶן דֹּבְרֵי כָזָֽב׃
translation: Their poison is like the poison of a snake, like a deaf cobra that stops its ear, (Psalms 58:4)

text: אָדָם תּוֹעֶה מִדֶּרֶךְ הַשְׂכֵּל בִּקְהַל רְפָאִים יָנֽוּחַ׃
translation: The man who wanders out of the way of understanding shall rest in the assembly of the departed spirits. (Proverbs 21:16)

text: וַיִּֽהְיוּ מְאַשְּׁרֵי הָֽעָם הַזֶּה מַתְעִים וּמְאֻשָּׁרָיו מְבֻלָּעִֽים׃
translation: The elder and the honorable man is the head, and the prophet who teaches lies is the tail. (Isaiah 9:15)

text: וְיָדְעוּ תֹֽעֵי רוּחַ בִּינָה וְרוֹגְנִים יִלְמְדוּ לֶֽקַח׃
translation: They also who err in spirit will come to understanding, and those who grumble will receive instruction." (Isaiah 29:24)

text: וַיִּמְצָאֵהוּ אִישׁ וְהִנֵּה תֹעֶה בַּשָּׂדֶה וַיִּשְׁאָלֵהוּ הָאִישׁ לֵאמֹר מַה תְּבַקֵּֽשׁ׃
translation: A certain man found him, and behold, he was wandering in the field. The man asked him, "What are you looking for?" (Genesis 37:15)

text: וַאֲנִי יָדַעְתִּי גֹּאֲלִי חָי וְאַחֲרוֹן עַל עָפָר יָקֽוּם׃
translation: But as for me, I know that my Redeemer lives. In the end, he will stand upon the earth. (Job 19:25)

text: לַמּוֹעֵד יָשׁוּב וּבָא בַנֶּגֶב וְלֹֽא תִהְיֶה כָרִאשֹׁנָה וְכָאַחֲרֹנָֽה׃
