translation: "He will return at the appointed time and come into the south; but it won't be in the latter time as it was in the former. (Daniel 11:29)

text: לְמַעַן יֵדְעוּ דּוֹר אַחֲרוֹן בָּנִים יִוָּלֵדוּ יָקֻמוּ וִֽיסַפְּרוּ לִבְנֵיהֶֽם׃
translation: that the generation to come might know, even the children who should be born; who should arise and tell their children, (Psalms 78:6)

text: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי עֻזִּיָּהוּ הָרִאשֹׁנִים וְהָאֲחֲרֹנִים כָּתַב יְשַֽׁעְיָהוּ בֶן אָמוֹץ הַנָּבִֽיא׃
translation: Now the rest of the acts of Uzziah, first and last, Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz, wrote. (2 Chronicles 26:22)

text: וּדְבָרָיו הָרִאשֹׁנִים וְהָאַחֲרֹנִים הִנָּם כְּתוּבִים עַל סֵפֶר מַלְכֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵל וִיהוּדָֽה׃
translation: and his acts, first and last, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah. (2 Chronicles 35:27)

text: אַחַי אַתֶּם עַצְמִי וּבְשָׂרִי אַתֶּם וְלָמָּה תִהְיוּ אַחֲרֹנִים לְהָשִׁיב אֶת הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
translation: Say to Amasa, 'Aren't you my bone and my flesh? God do so to me, and more also, if you aren't captain of the army before me continually instead of Joab.'" (2 Samuel 19:13)

text: יְהוָה מָלָךְ יִרְגְּזוּ עַמִּים יֹשֵׁב כְּרוּבִים תָּנוּט הָאָֽרֶץ׃
translation: The LORD reigns! Let the peoples tremble. He sits enthroned among the cherubim. Let the earth be moved. (Psalms 99:1)

text: וַיְשַׁלַּח אֶת אֶחָיו וַיֵּלֵכוּ וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם אַֽל תִּרְגְּזוּ בַּדָּֽרֶךְ׃
translation: So he sent his brothers away, and they departed. He said to them, "See that you don't quarrel on the way." (Genesis 45:24)

text: שָֽׁמְעוּ עַמִּים יִרְגָּזוּן חִיל אָחַז יֹשְׁבֵי פְּלָֽשֶׁת׃
translation: The peoples have heard. They tremble. Pangs have taken hold of the inhabitants of Philistia. (Exodus 15:14)

text: וְשִׁבְתְּךָ וְצֵאתְךָ וּבֹאֲךָ יָדָעְתִּי וְאֵת הִֽתְרַגֶּזְךָ אֵלָֽי׃
translation: But I know your sitting down, your going out, your coming in, and your raging against me. (2 Kings 19:27)

text: אָדָם יְלוּד אִשָּׁה קְצַר יָמִים וּֽשְׂבַֽע רֹֽגֶז׃
translation: "Man, who is born of a woman, is of few days, and full of trouble. (Job 14:1)

text: תַּחַת שָׁלוֹשׁ רָגְזָה אֶרֶץ וְתַחַת אַרְבַּע לֹא תוּכַל שְׂאֵֽת׃
translation: "For three things the earth trembles, and under four, it can't bear up: (Proverbs 30:21)

text: וְאִם לֹא יְכַבֵּס וּבְשָׂרוֹ לֹא יִרְחָץ וְנָשָׂא עֲוֺנֽוֹ׃
translation: But if he doesn't wash them, or bathe his flesh, then he shall bear his iniquity.'" (Leviticus 17:16)

text: וְכִבַּסְתֶּם בִּגְדֵיכֶם בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי וּטְהַרְתֶּם וְאַחַר תָּבֹאוּ אֶל הַֽמַּחֲנֶֽה׃
translation: You shall wash your clothes on the seventh day, and you shall be clean. Afterward you shall come into the camp." (Numbers 31:24)

text: וְהַשֹּׁכֵב בַּבַּיִת יְכַבֵּס אֶת בְּגָדָיו וְהָאֹכֵל בַּבַּיִת יְכַבֵּס אֶת בְּגָדָֽיו׃
translation: He who lies down in the house shall wash his clothes; and he who eats in the house shall wash his clothes. (Leviticus 14:47)

text: הרבה הֶרֶב כַּבְּסֵנִי מֵעֲוֺנִי וּֽמֵחַטָּאתִי טַהֲרֵֽנִי׃
translation: Against you, and you only, I have sinned, and done that which is evil in your sight, so you may be proved right when you speak, and justified when you judge. (Psalms 51:4)

text: וַיֵּרֶד מֹשֶׁה מִן הָהָר אֶל הָעָם וַיְקַדֵּשׁ אֶת הָעָם וַֽיְכַבְּסוּ שִׂמְלֹתָֽם׃
translation: Moses went down from the mountain to the people, and sanctified the people; and they washed their clothes. (Exodus 19:14)

text: וְצִוָּה הַכֹּהֵן וְכִבְּסוּ אֵת אֲשֶׁר בּוֹ הַנָּגַע וְהִסְגִּירוֹ שִׁבְעַת יָמִים שֵׁנִֽית׃
translation: then the priest shall command that they wash the thing that the plague is in, and he shall isolate it seven more days. (Leviticus 13:54)

text: שְׁנֵי שָׁדַיִךְ כִּשְׁנֵי עֳפָרִים תְּאוֹמֵי צְבִיָּה הָרוֹעִים בַּשּׁוֹשַׁנִּֽים׃
translation: Your two breasts are like two fawns that are twins of a roe, which feed among the lilies. (Song of Solomon 4:5)

text: לְשֹׁד וּלְכָפָן תִּשְׂחָק וּֽמֵחַיַּת הָאָרֶץ אַל תִּירָֽא׃
translation: You will laugh at destruction and famine, neither will you be afraid of the animals of the earth. (Job 5:22)

text: כִּי שֹׁד יֶהְגֶּה לִבָּם וְעָמָל שִׂפְתֵיהֶם תְּדַבֵּֽרְנָה׃
translation: for their hearts plot violence and their lips talk about mischief. (Proverbs 24:2)

text: אֲהָהּ לַיּוֹם כִּי קָרוֹב יוֹם יְהוָה וּכְשֹׁד מִשַׁדַּי יָבֽוֹא׃
translation: Alas for the day! For the day of the LORD is at hand, and it will come as destruction from the Almighty. (Joel 1:15)

text: וַיִּזְבְּחוּ אֶת בְּנֵיהֶם וְאֶת בְּנֽוֹתֵיהֶם לַשֵּֽׁדִים׃
translation: Yes, they sacrificed their sons and their daughters to demons. (Psalms 106:37)

text: שְׁנֵי שָׁדַיִךְ כִּשְׁנֵי עֳפָרִים תָּאֳמֵי צְבִיָּֽה׃
translation: Your neck is like an ivory tower. Your eyes are like the pools in Heshbon by the gate of Bathrabbim. Your nose is like the tower of Lebanon which looks toward Damascus. (Song of Solomon 7:4)

text: בָּנִים וּבָנוֹת תּוֹלִיד וְלֹא יִהְיוּ לָךְ כִּי יֵלְכוּ בַּשֶּֽׁבִי׃
translation: You will father sons and daughters, but they will not be yours, for they will go into captivity. (Deuteronomy 28:41)

text: כֻּלֹּה לְחָמָס יָבוֹא מְגַמַּת פְּנֵיהֶם קָדִימָה וַיֶּאֱסֹף כַּחוֹל שֶֽׁבִי׃
translation: All of them come for violence. Their hordes face forward. They gather prisoners like sand. (Habakkuk 1:9)

text: וְהִנֵּה נָפְלוּ אֲבוֹתֵינוּ בֶּחָרֶב וּבָנֵינוּ וּבְנוֹתֵינוּ וְנָשֵׁינוּ בַּשְּׁבִי עַל זֹֽאת׃
translation: For behold, our fathers have fallen by the sword, and our sons and our daughters and our wives are in captivity for this. (2 Chronicles 29:9)

text: וַיִּתֵּן לַשְּׁבִי עֻזּוֹ וְֽתִפְאַרְתּוֹ בְיַד צָֽר׃
translation: and delivered his strength into captivity, his glory into the adversary's hand. (Psalms 78:61)

text: אֱמֹר אֲנִי מֽוֹפֶתְכֶם כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשִׂיתִי כֵּן יֵעָשֶׂה לָהֶם בַּגּוֹלָה בַשְּׁבִי יֵלֵֽכוּ׃
translation: "Say, 'I am your sign. As I have done, so will it be done to them. They will go into exile, into captivity. (Ezekiel 12:11)

text: עוּרִי עוּרִי דְּבוֹרָה עוּרִי עוּרִי דַּבְּרִי שִׁיר קוּם בָּרָק וּֽשֲׁבֵה שֶׁבְיְךָ בֶּן אֲבִינֹֽעַם׃
translation: 'Awake, awake, Deborah! Awake, awake, utter a song! Arise, Barak, and lead away your captives, you son of Abinoam.' (Judges 5:12)

text: יוֹמָם וָלַיְלָה יְסוֹבְבֻהָ עַל חוֹמֹתֶיהָ וְאָוֶן וְעָמָל בְּקִרְבָּֽהּ׃
translation: Destructive forces are within her. Threats and lies don't depart from her streets. (Psalms 55:11)

text: וַעֲנַן יְהוָה עֲלֵיהֶם יוֹמָם בְּנָסְעָם מִן הַֽמַּחֲנֶֽה׃
translation: The cloud of the LORD was over them by day, when they set forward from the camp. (Numbers 10:34)

text: אֱֽלֹהַי אֶקְרָא יוֹמָם וְלֹא תַעֲנֶה וְלַיְלָה וְֽלֹא דֽוּמִיָּה לִֽי׃
translation: But you are holy, you who inhabit the praises of Israel. (Psalms 22:3)

text: לֹא תִירָא מִפַּחַד לָיְלָה מֵחֵץ יָעוּף יוֹמָֽם׃
translation: You shall not be afraid of the terror by night, nor of the arrow that flies by day, (Psalms 91:5)

text: יוֹמָם הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ לֹֽא יַכֶּכָּה וְיָרֵחַ בַּלָּֽיְלָה׃
translation: The sun will not harm you by day, nor the moon by night. (Psalms 121:6)

text: וְהָיוּ חַיֶּיךָ תְּלֻאִים לְךָ מִנֶּגֶד וּפָֽחַדְתָּ לַיְלָה וְיוֹמָם וְלֹא תַאֲמִין בְּחַיֶּֽיךָ׃
translation: Your life will hang in doubt before you. You will be afraid night and day, and will have no assurance of your life. (Deuteronomy 28:66)

text: וּלְצֶלַע הַמִּשְׁכָּן הַשֵּׁנִית לִפְאַת צָפוֹן עָשָׂה עֶשְׂרִים קְרָשִֽׁים׃
translation: For the second side of the tabernacle, on the north side, he made twenty boards (Exodus 36:25)

text: וְעָשִׂיתָ אֶת הַקְּרָשִׁים לַמִּשְׁכָּן עֲצֵי שִׁטִּים עֹמְדִֽים׃
translation: "You shall make the boards for the tabernacle of acacia wood, standing upright. (Exodus 26:15)

text: וְעָשִׂיתָ אֶת הַקְּרָשִׁים לַמִּשְׁכָּן עֶשְׂרִים קֶרֶשׁ לִפְאַת נֶגְבָּה תֵימָֽנָה׃
translation: You shall make twenty boards for the tabernacle, for the south side southward. (Exodus 26:18)

text: וּלְצֶלַע הַמִּשְׁכָּן הַשֵּׁנִית לִפְאַת צָפוֹן עֶשְׂרִים קָֽרֶשׁ׃
translation: For the second side of the tabernacle, on the north side, twenty boards, (Exodus 26:20)

text: וְעָשִׂיתָ בְרִיחִם עֲצֵי שִׁטִּים חֲמִשָּׁה לְקַרְשֵׁי צֶֽלַע הַמִּשְׁכָּן הָאֶחָֽד׃
translation: "You shall make bars of acacia wood: five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle, (Exodus 26:26)

text: וַיַּעַשׂ אֶת הַקְּרָשִׁים לַמִּשְׁכָּן עֲצֵי שִׁטִּים עֹמְדִֽים׃
translation: He made the boards for the tabernacle of acacia wood, standing up. (Exodus 36:20)

text: וְעַתָּה אֱלֹהֵינוּ מוֹדִים אֲנַחְנוּ לָךְ וּֽמְהַֽלְלִים לְשֵׁם תִּפְאַרְתֶּֽךָ׃
translation: Now therefore, our God, we thank you and praise your glorious name. (1 Chronicles 29:13)

text: כִּֽי תִפְאֶרֶת עֻזָּמוֹ אָתָּה וּבִרְצֹנְךָ תרים תָּרוּם קַרְנֵֽנוּ׃
translation: For our shield belongs to the LORD, our king to the Holy One of Israel. (Psalms 89:18)

text: שֵׂכֶל אָדָם הֶאֱרִיךְ אַפּוֹ וְתִפאַרְתּוֹ עֲבֹר עַל פָּֽשַׁע׃
translation: The discretion of a man makes him slow to anger. It is his glory to overlook an offense. (Proverbs 19:11)

text: וְעָשִׂיתָ בִגְדֵי קֹדֶשׁ לְאַהֲרֹן אָחִיךָ לְכָבוֹד וּלְתִפְאָֽרֶת׃
translation: You shall make holy garments for Aaron your brother, for glory and for beauty. (Exodus 28:2)

text: וַיְצַף אֶת הַבַּיִת אֶבֶן יְקָרָה לְתִפְאָרֶת וְהַזָּהָב זְהַב פַּרְוָֽיִם׃
translation: He decorated the house with precious stones for beauty. The gold was gold from Parvaim. (2 Chronicles 3:6)

text: בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא יָסִיר אֲדֹנָי אֵת תִּפְאֶרֶת הָעֲכָסִים וְהַשְּׁבִיסִים וְהַשַּׂהֲרֹנִֽים׃
translation: In that day the Lord will take away the beauty of their anklets, the headbands, the crescent necklaces, (Isaiah 3:18)

text: יְהִי רָעֵב אֹנוֹ וְאֵיד נָכוֹן לְצַלְעֽוֹ׃
translation: His strength will be famished. Calamity will be ready at his side. (Job 18:12)

text: וַיִּבֶן יְהוָה אֱלֹהִים אֶֽת הַצֵּלָע אֲשֶׁר לָקַח מִן הָֽאָדָם לְאִשָּׁה וַיְבִאֶהָ אֶל הָֽאָדָֽם׃
translation: The LORD God made a woman from the rib which he had taken from the man, and brought her to the man. (Genesis 2:22)

text: וַחֲמִשָּׁה בְרִיחִם לְקַרְשֵׁי צֶֽלַע הַמִּשְׁכָּן הַשֵּׁנִית וַחֲמִשָּׁה בְרִיחִם לְקַרְשֵׁי צֶלַע הַמִּשְׁכָּן לַיַּרְכָתַיִם יָֽמָּה׃
translation: and five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the side of the tabernacle, for the far side westward. (Exodus 26:27)

text: וַיָּמָד קִֽיר הַבַּיִת שֵׁשׁ אַמּוֹת וְרֹחַב הַצֵּלָע אַרְבַּע אַמּוֹת סָבִיב סָבִיב לַבַּיִת סָבִֽיב׃
translation: Then he measured the wall of the house, six cubits; and the width of every side room, four cubits, all around the house on every side. (Ezekiel 41:5)

text: וַיָּבֵא אֶת הַבַּדִּים בַּטַּבָּעֹת עַל צַלְעֹת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ לָשֵׂאת אֹתוֹ בָּהֶם נְבוּב לֻחֹת עָשָׂה אֹתֽוֹ׃
translation: He put the poles into the rings on the sides of the altar, with which to carry it. He made it hollow with planks. (Exodus 38:7)

text: רֹחַב הַקִּיר אֲֽשֶׁר לַצֵּלָע אֶל הַחוּץ חָמֵשׁ אַמּוֹת וַאֲשֶׁר מֻנָּח בֵּית צְלָעוֹת אֲשֶׁר לַבָּֽיִת׃
translation: The thickness of the outer wall of the side rooms was five cubits. That which was left was the place of the side rooms that belonged to the house. (Ezekiel 41:9)

text: וַיָּבֹאוּ הָרֹעִים וַיְגָרְשׁוּם וַיָּקָם מֹשֶׁה וַיּוֹשִׁעָן וַיַּשְׁקְ אֶת צֹאנָֽם׃
translation: The shepherds came and drove them away; but Moses stood up and helped them, and watered their flock. (Exodus 2:17)

text: וְאֶתְּנֵהוּ בְּיַד אֵיל גּוֹיִם עָשׂוֹ יַֽעֲשֶׂה לוֹ כְּרִשְׁעוֹ גֵּרַשְׁתִּֽהוּ׃
translation: I will deliver him into the hand of the mighty one of the nations. He will surely deal with him. I have driven him out for his wickedness. (Ezekiel 31:11)

text: מְעַט מְעַט אֲגָרְשֶׁנּוּ מִפָּנֶיךָ עַד אֲשֶׁר תִּפְרֶה וְנָחַלְתָּ אֶת הָאָֽרֶץ׃
translation: Little by little I will drive them out from before you, until you have increased and inherit the land. (Exodus 23:30)

text: וְנֵדֶר אַלְמָנָה וּגְרוּשָׁה כֹּל אֲשֶׁר אָסְרָה עַל נַפְשָׁהּ יָקוּם עָלֶֽיהָ׃
translation: "If she vowed in her husband's house or bound her soul by a bond with an oath, (Numbers 30:10)

text: וַיְגָרֶשׁ מִפְּנֵיהֶם גּוֹיִם וַֽיַּפִּילֵם בְּחֶבֶל נַחֲלָה וַיַּשְׁכֵּן בְּאָהֳלֵיהֶם שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
translation: He also drove out the nations before them, allotted them for an inheritance by line, and made the tribes of Israel to dwell in their tents. (Psalms 78:55)

text: גֶּפֶן מִמִּצְרַיִם תַּסִּיעַ תְּגָרֵשׁ גּוֹיִם וַתִּטָּעֶֽהָ׃
translation: You cleared the ground for it. It took deep root, and filled the land. (Psalms 80:9)

text: עִם מְלָכִים וְיֹעֲצֵי אָרֶץ הַבֹּנִים חֳרָבוֹת לָֽמוֹ׃
translation: with kings and counselors of the earth, who built up waste places for themselves; (Job 3:14)

text: וְרָעוּ כְבָשִׂים כְּדָבְרָם וְחָרְבוֹת מֵחִים גָּרִים יֹאכֵֽלוּ׃
translation: Then the lambs will graze as in their pasture, and strangers will eat the ruins of the rich. (Isaiah 5:17)

text: וְאֶתְּנֵךְ לְחָרְבָּה וּלְחֶרְפָּה בַּגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר סְבִיבוֹתָיִךְ לְעֵינֵי כָּל עוֹבֵֽר׃
translation: "'Moreover I will make you a desolation and a reproach among the nations that are around you, in the sight of all that pass by. (Ezekiel 5:14)

text: וְנוֹעַ יָנוּעוּ בָנָיו וְשִׁאֵלוּ וְדָרְשׁוּ מֵחָרְבוֹתֵיהֶֽם׃
translation: Let his children be wandering beggars. Let them be sought from their ruins. (Psalms 109:10)

text: עָרֶיךָ חָרְבָּה אָשִׂים וְאַתָּה שְׁמָמָה תִֽהְיֶה וְיָדַעְתָּ כִּֽי אֲנִי יְהוָֽה׃
translation: I will lay your cities waste, and you will be desolate. Then you will know that I am the LORD. (Ezekiel 35:4)

text: וְנָתַתִּי אֶת עָֽרֵיכֶם חָרְבָּה וַהֲשִׁמּוֹתִי אֶת מִקְדְּשֵׁיכֶם וְלֹא אָרִיחַ בְּרֵיחַ נִיחֹֽחֲכֶֽם׃
translation: I will lay your cities waste, and will bring your sanctuaries to desolation. I will not take delight in the sweet fragrance of your offerings. (Leviticus 26:31)

text: הֵן יַעְצֹר בַּמַּיִם וְיִבָשׁוּ וִֽישַׁלְּחֵם וְיַהַפְכוּ אָֽרֶץ׃
translation: Behold, he withholds the waters, and they dry up. Again, he sends them out, and they overturn the earth. (Job 12:15)

text: וְלֹֽא עָצַר כֹּֽחַ יָרָבְעָם עוֹד בִּימֵי אֲבִיָּהוּ וַיִּגְּפֵהוּ יְהוָה וַיָּמֹֽת׃
translation: Jeroboam didn't recover strength again in the days of Abijah. The LORD struck him, and he died. (2 Chronicles 13:20)

text: שָׂרִים עָצְרוּ בְמִלִּים וְכַף יָשִׂימוּ לְפִיהֶֽם׃
translation: The princes refrained from talking, and laid their hand on their mouth. (Job 29:9)

text: וְאָבַד כָּל בֵּית אַחְאָב וְהִכְרַתִּי לְאַחְאָב מַשְׁתִּין בְּקִיר וְעָצוּר וְעָזוּב בְּיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
translation: For the whole house of Ahab will perish. I will cut off from Ahab everyone who urinates against a wall, both him who is shut up and him who is left at large in Israel. (2 Kings 9:8)

text: שְׁאוֹל וְעֹצֶר רָחַם אֶרֶץ לֹא שָׂבְעָה מַּיִם וְאֵשׁ לֹא אָמְרָה הֽוֹן׃
translation: Sheol, the barren womb, the earth that is not satisfied with water, and the fire that doesn't say, 'Enough!' (Proverbs 30:16)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר מָנוֹחַ אֶל מַלְאַךְ יְהוָה נַעְצְרָה נָּא אוֹתָךְ וְנַעֲשֶׂה לְפָנֶיךָ גְּדִי עִזִּֽים׃
translation: Manoah said to the LORD's angel, "Please stay with us, that we may make a young goat ready for you." (Judges 13:15)

text: וְאִם הָפֵר יָפֵר אֹתָם אַחֲרֵי שָׁמְעוֹ וְנָשָׂא אֶת עֲוֺנָֽהּ׃
translation: These are the statutes which the LORD commanded Moses, between a man and his wife, between a father and his daughter, being in her youth, in her father's house. (Numbers 30:16)

text: רֹעָה הִֽתְרֹעֲעָה הָאָרֶץ פּוֹר הִֽתְפּוֹרְרָה אֶרֶץ מוֹט הִֽתְמוֹטְטָה אָֽרֶץ׃
translation: The earth is utterly broken. The earth is torn apart. The earth is shaken violently. (Isaiah 24:19)

text: הַאַף תָּפֵר מִשְׁפָּטִי תַּרְשִׁיעֵנִי לְמַעַן תִּצְדָּֽק׃
translation: Will you even annul my judgment? Will you condemn me, that you may be justified? (Job 40:8)

text: שׁוּבֵנוּ אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׁעֵנוּ וְהָפֵר כַּֽעַסְךָ עִמָּֽנוּ׃
translation: Will you be angry with us forever? Will you draw out your anger to all generations? (Psalms 85:5)

text: עֻצוּ עֵצָה וְתֻפָר דַּבְּרוּ דָבָר וְלֹא יָקוּם כִּי עִמָּנוּ אֵֽל׃
translation: Take counsel together, and it will be brought to nothing; speak the word, and it will not stand, for God is with us." (Isaiah 8:10)

text: כִּֽי יְהוָה צְבָאוֹת יָעָץ וּמִי יָפֵר וְיָדוֹ הַנְּטוּיָה וּֽמִי יְשִׁיבֶֽנָּה׃
translation: For the LORD of Armies has planned, and who can stop it? His hand is stretched out, and who can turn it back?" (Isaiah 14:27)

text: וּבְהִקָּבֵץ בְּתוּלוֹת שֵׁנִית וּמָרְדֳּכַי יֹשֵׁב בְּשַֽׁעַר הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
translation: When the virgins were gathered together the second time, Mordecai was sitting in the king's gate. (Esther 2:19)

text: בְּרִית כָּרַתִּי לְעֵינָי וּמָה אֶתְבּוֹנֵן עַל בְּתוּלָֽה׃
translation: "I made a covenant with my eyes; how then should I look lustfully at a young woman? (Job 31:1)

text: אִם מָאֵן יְמָאֵן אָבִיהָ לְתִתָּהּ לוֹ כֶּסֶף יִשְׁקֹל כְּמֹהַר הַבְּתוּלֹֽת׃
translation: "If a man entices a virgin who isn't pledged to be married, and lies with her, he shall surely pay a dowry for her to be his wife. (Exodus 22:16)

text: וְלַאֲחֹתוֹ הַבְּתוּלָה הַקְּרוֹבָה אֵלָיו אֲשֶׁר לֹֽא הָיְתָה לְאִישׁ לָהּ יִטַּמָּֽא׃
translation: and for his virgin sister who is near to him, who has had no husband; for her he may defile himself. (Leviticus 21:3)

text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ נַעֲרֵֽי הַמֶּלֶךְ מְשָׁרְתָיו יְבַקְשׁוּ לַמֶּלֶךְ נְעָרוֹת בְּתוּלוֹת טוֹבוֹת מַרְאֶֽה׃
translation: Then the king's servants who served him said, "Let beautiful young virgins be sought for the king. (Esther 2:2)

text: נָשִׁים בְּצִיּוֹן עִנּוּ בְּתֻלֹת בְּעָרֵי יְהוּדָֽה׃
translation: They ravished the women in Zion, the virgins in the cities of Judah. (Lamentations 5:11)

text: כָּל בָּאֶיהָ לֹא יְשׁוּבוּן וְלֹֽא יַשִּׂיגוּ אָרְחוֹת חַיִּֽים׃
translation: None who go to her return again, neither do they attain to the paths of life. (Proverbs 2:19)

text: אֶרְדּוֹף אוֹיְבַי וְאַשִּׂיגֵם וְלֹֽא אָשׁוּב עַד כַּלּוֹתָֽם׃
translation: I will strike them through, so that they will not be able to rise. They shall fall under my feet. (Psalms 18:38)

text: וַֽיַּשִּׂגֵם וַיְדַבֵּר אֲלֵהֶם אֶת הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵֽלֶּה׃
translation: He overtook them, and he spoke these words to them. (Genesis 44:6)

text: וּבָאוּ עָלֶיךָ כָּל הַבְּרָכוֹת הָאֵלֶּה וְהִשִּׂיגֻךָ כִּי תִשְׁמַע בְּקוֹל יְהוָה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ׃
translation: All these blessings will come upon you, and overtake you, if you listen to the LORD your God's voice. (Deuteronomy 28:2)

text: וְעָשָׂה אֶת הָֽאֶחָד מִן הַתֹּרִים אוֹ מִן בְּנֵי הַיּוֹנָה מֵאֲשֶׁר תַּשִּׂיג יָדֽוֹ׃
translation: He shall offer one of the turtledoves, or of the young pigeons, which ever he is able to afford, (Leviticus 14:30)

text: וַיִּרְדְּפוּ חֵיל כַּשְׂדִּים אַחַר הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיַּשִּׂגוּ אֹתוֹ בְּעַרְבוֹת יְרֵחוֹ וְכָל חֵילוֹ נָפֹצוּ מֵעָלָֽיו׃
translation: But the Chaldean army pursued the king, and overtook him in the plains of Jericho; and all his army was scattered from him. (2 Kings 25:5)

text: לֹא יִהְיֶה לְךָ בְּבֵיתְךָ אֵיפָה וְאֵיפָה גְּדוֹלָה וּקְטַנָּֽה׃
translation: You shall not have in your house diverse measures, one large and one small. (Deuteronomy 25:14)

text: אֵיפֹה הָיִיתָ בְּיָסְדִי אָרֶץ הַגֵּד אִם יָדַעְתָּ בִינָֽה׃
translation: "Where were you when I laid the foundations of the earth? Declare, if you have understanding. (Job 38:4)

text: אֶבֶן וָאֶבֶן אֵיפָה וְאֵיפָה תּוֹעֲבַת יְהוָה גַּם שְׁנֵיהֶֽם׃
translation: Differing weights and differing measures, both of them alike are an abomination to the LORD. (Proverbs 20:10)

text: וּמִנְחָה אֵיפָה לָאַיִל וְלַכְּבָשִׂים מִנְחָה מַתַּת יָדוֹ וְשֶׁמֶן הִין לָאֵיפָֽה׃
translation: and the meal offering shall be an ephah for the ram, and the meal offering for the lambs as he is able to give, and a hin of oil to an ephah. (Ezekiel 46:5)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֶת אַחַי אָנֹכִי מְבַקֵּשׁ הַגִּֽידָה נָּא לִי אֵיפֹה הֵם רֹעִֽים׃
translation: He said, "I am looking for my brothers. Tell me, please, where they are feeding the flock." (Genesis 37:16)

text: וָאֹמַר מַה הִיא וַיֹּאמֶר זֹאת הָֽאֵיפָה הַיּוֹצֵאת וַיֹּאמֶר זֹאת עֵינָם בְּכָל הָאָֽרֶץ׃
translation: I said, "What is it?" He said, "This is the ephah basket that is appearing." He said moreover, "This is their appearance in all the land— (Zechariah 5:6)

text: בְּטַבְּעֹת הָאָרֹן יִהְיוּ הַבַּדִּים לֹא יָסֻרוּ מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃
translation: The poles shall be in the rings of the ark. They shall not be taken from it. (Exodus 25:15)

text: וַיָּבֵא אֶת הַבַּדִּים בַּטַּבָּעֹת עַל צַלְעֹת הָאָרֹן לָשֵׂאת אֶת הָאָרֹֽן׃
translation: He put the poles into the rings on the sides of the ark, to bear the ark. (Exodus 37:5)

text: וְהֵֽבֵאתָ אֶת הַבַּדִּים בַּטַּבָּעֹת עַל צַלְעֹת הָאָרֹן לָשֵׂאת אֶת הָאָרֹן בָּהֶֽם׃
translation: You shall put the poles into the rings on the sides of the ark to carry the ark. (Exodus 25:14)

text: וְהוּבָא אֶת בַּדָּיו בַּטַּבָּעֹת וְהָיוּ הַבַּדִּים עַל שְׁתֵּי צַלְעֹת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ בִּשְׂאֵת אֹתֽוֹ׃
translation: Its poles shall be put into the rings, and the poles shall be on the two sides of the altar when carrying it. (Exodus 27:7)

text: וְעָשִׂיתָ לּוֹ אַרְבַּע טַבְּעֹת זָהָב וְנָתַתָּ אֶת הַטַּבָּעֹת עַל אַרְבַּע הַפֵּאֹת אֲשֶׁר לְאַרְבַּע רַגְלָֽיו׃
translation: You shall make four rings of gold for it, and put the rings in the four corners that are on its four feet. (Exodus 25:26)

text: וְֽאֶת הַקְּרָשִׁים תְּצַפֶּה זָהָב וְאֶת טַבְּעֹֽתֵיהֶם תַּעֲשֶׂה זָהָב בָּתִּים לַבְּרִיחִם וְצִפִּיתָ אֶת הַבְּרִיחִם זָהָֽב׃
translation: You shall overlay the boards with gold, and make their rings of gold for places for the bars. You shall overlay the bars with gold. (Exodus 26:29)

text: כִּי עַתָּה תָּבוֹא אֵלֶיךָ וַתֵּלֶא תִּגַּע עָדֶיךָ וַתִּבָּהֵֽל׃
translation: But now it has come to you, and you faint. It touches you, and you are troubled. (Job 4:5)

text: עַל כֵּן מִפָּנָיו אֶבָּהֵל אֶתְבּוֹנֵן וְאֶפְחַד מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃
translation: Therefore I am terrified at his presence. When I consider, I am afraid of him. (Job 23:15)

text: נַחֲלָה מבחלת מְבֹהֶלֶת בָּרִאשֹׁנָה וְאַחֲרִיתָהּ לֹא תְבֹרָֽךְ׃
translation: An inheritance quickly gained at the beginning won't be blessed in the end. (Proverbs 20:21)

text: וְאִם זָכַרְתִּי וְנִבְהָלְתִּי וְאָחַז בְּשָׂרִי פַּלָּצֽוּת׃
translation: When I remember, I am troubled. Horror takes hold of my flesh. (Job 21:6)

text: חָנֵּנִי יְהוָה כִּי אֻמְלַל אָנִי רְפָאֵנִי יְהוָה כִּי נִבְהֲלוּ עֲצָמָֽי׃
translation: My soul is also in great anguish. But you, LORD—how long? (Psalms 6:3)

text: יֵבֹשׁוּ וְיִבָּהֲלוּ עֲדֵי עַד וְֽיַחְפְּרוּ וְיֹאבֵֽדוּ׃
translation: that they may know that you alone, whose name is the LORD, are the Most High over all the earth. (Psalms 83:18)

text: בְּצִדְקָתִי הֶחֱזַקְתִּי וְלֹא אַרְפֶּהָ לֹֽא יֶחֱרַף לְבָבִי מִיָּמָֽי׃
translation: I hold fast to my righteousness, and will not let it go. My heart will not reproach me so long as I live. (Job 27:6)

text: הֶרֶף מֵאַף וַעֲזֹב חֵמָה אַל תִּתְחַר אַךְ לְהָרֵֽעַ׃
translation: Cease from anger, and forsake wrath. Don't fret; it leads only to evildoing. (Psalms 37:8)

text: הַחֲזֵק בַּמּוּסָר אַל תֶּרֶף נִצְּרֶהָ כִּי הִיא חַיֶּֽיךָ׃
translation: Take firm hold of instruction. Don't let her go. Keep her, for she is your life. (Proverbs 4:13)

text: וַיִּרֶף מִמֶּנּוּ אָז אָֽמְרָה חֲתַן דָּמִים לַמּוּלֹֽת׃
translation: So he let him alone. Then she said, "You are a bridegroom of blood," because of the circumcision. (Exodus 4:26)

text: הַרְפּוּ וּדְעוּ כִּי אָנֹכִי אֱלֹהִים אָרוּם בַּגּוֹיִם אָרוּם בָּאָֽרֶץ׃
translation: The LORD of Armies is with us. The God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah. (Psalms 46:11)

text: גַּם מִתְרַפֶּה בִמְלַאכְתּוֹ אָח הוּא לְבַעַל מַשְׁחִֽית׃
translation: One who is slack in his work is brother to him who is a master of destruction. (Proverbs 18:9)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁאַל אַתָּה בֶּן מִי זֶה הָעָֽלֶם׃
translation: The king said, "Inquire whose son the young man is!" (1 Samuel 17:56)

text: וְֽנֶעֶלְמָה מֵעֵינֵי כָל חָי וּמֵעוֹף הַשָּׁמַיִם נִסְתָּֽרָה׃
translation: Seeing it is hidden from the eyes of all living, and kept close from the birds of the sky. (Job 28:21)

text: לָמָה יְהוָה תַּעֲמֹד בְּרָחוֹק תַּעְלִים לְעִתּוֹת בַּצָּרָֽה׃
translation: Why do you stand far off, LORD? Why do you hide yourself in times of trouble? (Psalms 10:1)

text: עֲנוֹ וְאָמְרִין לִנְבוּכַדְנֶצַּר מַלְכָּא מַלְכָּא לְעָלְמִין חֱיִֽי׃
translation: They answered Nebuchadnezzar the king, "O king, live for ever! (Daniel 3:9)

text: גַּם אַתְּ תִּשְׁכְּרִי תְּהִי נַֽעֲלָמָה גַּם אַתְּ תְּבַקְשִׁי מָעוֹז מֵאוֹיֵֽב׃
translation: You also will be drunken. You will be hidden. You also will seek a stronghold because of the enemy. (Nahum 3:11)

text: לֹֽא תִרְאֶה אֶת שׁוֹר אָחִיךָ אוֹ אֶת שֵׂיוֹ נִדָּחִים וְהִתְעַלַּמְתָּ מֵהֶם הָשֵׁב תְּשִׁיבֵם לְאָחִֽיךָ׃
translation: You shall not see your brother's ox or his sheep go astray and hide yourself from them. You shall surely bring them again to your brother. (Deuteronomy 22:1)

text: מָֽה אֱנוֹשׁ כִּי תְגַדְּלֶנּוּ וְכִי תָשִׁית אֵלָיו לִבֶּֽךָ׃
translation: What is man, that you should magnify him, that you should set your mind on him, (Job 7:17)

text: לֹא יָדַע אֱנוֹשׁ עֶרְכָּהּ וְלֹא תִמָּצֵא בְּאֶרֶץ הַֽחַיִּֽים׃
translation: Man doesn't know its price, and it isn't found in the land of the living. (Job 28:13)

text: מָֽה אֱנוֹשׁ כִּֽי תִזְכְּרֶנּוּ וּבֶן אָדָם כִּי תִפְקְדֶֽנּוּ׃
translation: For you have made him a little lower than the angels, and crowned him with glory and honor. (Psalms 8:5)

text: הִרְכַּבְתָּ אֱנוֹשׁ לְרֹאשֵׁנוּ בָּֽאנוּ בָאֵשׁ וּבַמַּיִם וַתּוֹצִיאֵנוּ לָֽרְוָיָֽה׃
translation: You allowed men to ride over our heads. We went through fire and through water, but you brought us to the place of abundance. (Psalms 66:12)

text: וַֽיְחִי שֵׁת חָמֵשׁ שָׁנִים וּמְאַת שָׁנָה וַיּוֹלֶד אֶת אֱנֽוֹשׁ׃
translation: Seth lived one hundred five years, then became the father of Enosh. (Genesis 5:6)

text: הַֽאֱנוֹשׁ מֵאֱלוֹהַ יִצְדָּק אִם מֵעֹשֵׂהוּ יִטְהַר גָּֽבֶר׃
translation: 'Shall mortal man be more just than God? Shall a man be more pure than his Maker? (Job 4:17)

text: וַתָּקָם בְּעוֹד לַיְלָה וַתִּתֵּן טֶרֶף לְבֵיתָהּ וְחֹק לְנַעֲרֹתֶֽיהָ׃
translation: She rises also while it is yet night, gives food to her household, and portions for her servant girls. (Proverbs 31:15)

text: בִּֽינוּ נָא זֹאת שֹׁכְחֵי אֱלוֹהַּ פֶּן אֶטְרֹף וְאֵין מַצִּֽיל׃
translation: "Now consider this, you who forget God, lest I tear you into pieces, and there be no one to deliver. (Psalms 50:22)

text: וָֽאֲשַׁבְּרָה מְתַלְּעוֹת עַוָּל וּמִשִּׁנָּיו אַשְׁלִיךְ טָֽרֶף׃
translation: I broke the jaws of the unrighteous and plucked the prey out of his teeth. (Job 29:17)

text: טֶרֶף נָתַן לִֽירֵאָיו יִזְכֹּר לְעוֹלָם בְּרִיתֽוֹ׃
translation: He has given food to those who fear him. He always remembers his covenant. (Psalms 111:5)

text: בָּרוּךְ יְהוָה שֶׁלֹּא נְתָנָנוּ טֶרֶף לְשִׁנֵּיהֶֽם׃
translation: Blessed be the LORD, who has not given us as a prey to their teeth. (Psalms 124:6)

text: וַיֵּצֵא הָֽאֶחָד מֵֽאִתִּי וָאֹמַר אַךְ טָרֹף טֹרָף וְלֹא רְאִיתִיו עַד הֵֽנָּה׃
translation: One went out from me, and I said, "Surely he is torn in pieces;" and I haven't seen him since. (Genesis 44:28)

text: שַׂלְמָא אֲבִי בֵֽית לָחֶם חָרֵף אֲבִי בֵית גָּדֵֽר׃
translation: Salma the father of Bethlehem, and Hareph the father of Beth Gader. (1 Chronicles 2:51)

text: זְבֻלוּן עַם חֵרֵף נַפְשׁוֹ לָמוּת וְנַפְתָּלִי עַל מְרוֹמֵי שָׂדֶֽה׃
translation: Zebulun was a people that jeopardized their lives to the death; Naphtali also, on the high places of the field. (Judges 5:18)

text: וַיְחָרֵף אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיַּכֵּהוּ יְהוֹנָתָן בֶּן שִׁמְעָא אֲחִי דָוִֽיד׃
translation: When he defied Israel, Jonathan the son of Shimea, David's brother, killed him. (1 Chronicles 20:7)

text: כָּל הַיּוֹם חֵרְפוּנִי אוֹיְבָי מְהוֹלָלַי בִּי נִשְׁבָּֽעוּ׃
translation: For I have eaten ashes like bread, and mixed my drink with tears, (Psalms 102:9)

text: עֹשֵֽׁק דָּל חֵרֵף עֹשֵׂהוּ וּמְכַבְּדוֹ חֹנֵן אֶבְיֽוֹן׃
translation: He who oppresses the poor shows contempt for his Maker, but he who is kind to the needy honors him. (Proverbs 14:31)

text: חֲכַם בְּנִי וְשַׂמַּח לִבִּי וְאָשִׁיבָה חֹרְפִי דָבָֽר׃
translation: Be wise, my son, and bring joy to my heart, then I can answer my tormentor. (Proverbs 27:11)

text: וַיֻּגַּד לַאֲבִימֶלֶךְ כִּי הִֽתְקַבְּצוּ כָּֽל בַּעֲלֵי מִֽגְדַּל שְׁכֶֽם׃
translation: Abimelech was told that all the men of the tower of Shechem were gathered together. (Judges 9:47)

text: וְעָרִים בָּנָה בְּהַר יְהוּדָה וּבֶחֳרָשִׁים בָּנָה בִּֽירָנִיּוֹת וּמִגְדָּלִֽים׃
translation: Moreover he built cities in the hill country of Judah, and in the forests he built fortresses and towers. (2 Chronicles 27:4)

text: וְעַל כָּל מִגְדָּל גָּבֹהַ וְעַל כָּל חוֹמָה בְצוּרָֽה׃
translation: for every lofty tower, for every fortified wall, (Isaiah 2:15)

text: אֲנִי חוֹמָה וְשָׁדַי כַּמִּגְדָּלוֹת אָז הָיִיתִי בְעֵינָיו כְּמוֹצְאֵת שָׁלֽוֹם׃
translation: I am a wall, and my breasts like towers, then I was in his eyes like one who found peace. (Song of Solomon 8:10)

text: וַיֵּרֶד יְהוָה לִרְאֹת אֶת הָעִיר וְאֶת הַמִּגְדָּל אֲשֶׁר בָּנוּ בְּנֵי הָאָדָֽם׃
translation: The LORD came down to see the city and the tower, which the children of men built. (Genesis 11:5)

text: וַֽיִּשְׁמְעוּ כָּֽל בַּעֲלֵי מִֽגְדַּל שְׁכֶם וַיָּבֹאוּ אֶל צְרִיחַ בֵּית אֵל בְּרִֽית׃
translation: When all the men of the tower of Shechem heard of it, they entered into the stronghold of the house of Elberith. (Judges 9:46)

text: יֵשֵׁב עוֹלָם לִפְנֵי אֱלֹהִים חֶסֶד וֶאֱמֶת מַן יִנְצְרֻֽהוּ׃
translation: So I will sing praise to your name forever, that I may fulfill my vows daily. (Psalms 61:8)

text: לִמְנוֹת יָמֵינוּ כֵּן הוֹדַע וְנָבִא לְבַב חָכְמָֽה׃
translation: So teach us to count our days, that we may gain a heart of wisdom. (Psalms 90:12)

text: וַיְהִי הַיּוֹם וַיִּזְבַּח אֶלְקָנָה וְנָתַן לִפְנִנָּה אִשְׁתּוֹ וּֽלְכָל בָּנֶיהָ וּבְנוֹתֶיהָ מָנֽוֹת׃
translation: When the day came that Elkanah sacrificed, he gave portions to Peninnah his wife and to all her sons and her daughters; (1 Samuel 1:4)

text: וּלְחַנָּה יִתֵּן מָנָה אַחַת אַפָּיִם כִּי אֶת חַנָּה אָהֵב וַֽיהוָה סָגַר רַחְמָֽהּ׃
translation: but he gave a double portion to Hannah, for he loved Hannah, but the LORD had shut up her womb. (1 Samuel 1:5)

text: הַמַּקְרִיב אֶת דַּם הַשְּׁלָמִים וְאֶת הַחֵלֶב מִבְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן לוֹ תִהְיֶה שׁוֹק הַיָּמִין לְמָנָֽה׃
translation: He among the sons of Aaron who offers the blood of the peace offerings, and the fat, shall have the right thigh for a portion. (Leviticus 7:33)

text: וְעַבְדְּךָ בְּתוֹךְ עַמְּךָ אֲשֶׁר בָּחָרְתָּ עַם רָב אֲשֶׁר לֹֽא יִמָּנֶה וְלֹא יִסָּפֵר מֵרֹֽב׃
translation: Your servant is among your people which you have chosen, a great people, that can't be numbered or counted for multitude. (1 Kings 3:8)

text: וַיָּתִירוּ בֵית יוֹסֵף בְּבֵֽית אֵל וְשֵׁם הָעִיר לְפָנִים לֽוּז׃
translation: The house of Joseph sent to spy out Bethel. (The name of the city before that was Luz.) (Judges 1:23)

text: תּוֹרֵי זָהָב נַעֲשֶׂה לָּךְ עִם נְקֻדּוֹת הַכָּֽסֶף׃
translation: We will make you earrings of gold, with studs of silver. (Song of Solomon 1:11)

text: וַֽיַּעֲלוּ וַיָּתֻרוּ אֶת הָאָרֶץ מִמִּדְבַּר צִן עַד רְחֹב לְבֹא חֲמָֽת׃
translation: So they went up, and spied out the land from the wilderness of Zin to Rehob, to the entrance of Hamath. (Numbers 13:21)

text: וַיָּשֻׁבוּ מִתּוּר הָאָרֶץ מִקֵּץ אַרְבָּעִים יֽוֹם׃
translation: They returned from spying out the land at the end of forty days. (Numbers 13:25)

text: אַל תִּתֵּן לְחַיַּת נֶפֶשׁ תּוֹרֶךָ חַיַּת עֲנִיֶּיךָ אַל תִּשְׁכַּח לָנֶֽצַח׃
translation: Don't deliver the soul of your dove to wild beasts. Don't forget the life of your poor forever. (Psalms 74:19)

text: יָתֵר מֵרֵעֵהוּ צַדִּיק וְדֶרֶךְ רְשָׁעִים תַּתְעֵֽם׃
translation: A righteous person is cautious in friendship, but the way of the wicked leads them astray. (Proverbs 12:26)

text: יְהוָה שֹׁמְרֶךָ יְהוָה צִלְּךָ עַל יַד יְמִינֶֽךָ׃
translation: The LORD is your keeper. The LORD is your shade on your right hand. (Psalms 121:5)

text: יֹשֵׁב בְּסֵתֶר עֶלְיוֹן בְּצֵל שַׁדַּי יִתְלוֹנָֽן׃
translation: He who dwells in the secret place of the Most High will rest in the shadow of the Almighty. (Psalms 91:1)

text: אָדָם לַהֶבֶל דָּמָה יָמָיו כְּצֵל עוֹבֵֽר׃
translation: Man is like a breath. His days are like a shadow that passes away. (Psalms 144:4)

text: רוּחַ אַפֵּינוּ מְשִׁיחַ יְהוָה נִלְכַּד בִּשְׁחִיתוֹתָם אֲשֶׁר אָמַרְנוּ בְּצִלּוֹ נִֽחְיֶה בַגּוֹיִֽם׃
translation: The breath of our nostrils, the anointed of the LORD, was taken in their pits; of whom we said, under his shadow we will live among the nations. (Lamentations 4:20)

text: הַהֹלְכִים לָרֶדֶת מִצְרַיִם וּפִי לֹא שָׁאָלוּ לָעוֹז בְּמָעוֹז פַּרְעֹה וְלַחְסוֹת בְּצֵל מִצְרָֽיִם׃
translation: who set out to go down into Egypt without asking for my advice, to strengthen themselves in the strength of Pharaoh, and to take refuge in the shadow of Egypt! (Isaiah 30:2)

text: חָנֵּנִי אֱלֹהִים חָנֵּנִי כִּי בְךָ חָסָיָה נַפְשִׁי וּבְצֵֽל כְּנָפֶיךָ אֶחְסֶה עַד יַעֲבֹר הַוּֽוֹת׃
translation: I cry out to God Most High, to God who accomplishes my requests for me. (Psalms 57:2)

text: בֶּן חֶסֶד בָּֽאֲרֻבּוֹת לוֹ שֹׂכֹה וְכָל אֶרֶץ חֵֽפֶר׃
translation: Ben Hesed, in Arubboth (Socoh and all the land of Hepher belonged to him); (1 Kings 4:10)

text: וַיַּחְפְּרוּ עַבְדֵֽי יִצְחָק בַּנָּחַל וַיִּמְצְאוּ שָׁם בְּאֵר מַיִם חַיִּֽים׃
translation: Isaac's servants dug in the valley, and found there a well of flowing water. (Genesis 26:19)

text: וַֽיַּחְפְּרוּ בְּאֵר אַחֶרֶת וַיָּרִיבוּ גַּם עָלֶיהָ וַיִּקְרָא שְׁמָהּ שִׂטְנָֽה׃
translation: They dug another well, and they argued over that, also. So he called its name Sitnah. (Genesis 26:21)

text: מְֽשַׁדֶּד אָב יַבְרִיחַ אֵם בֵּן מֵבִישׁ וּמַחְפִּֽיר׃
translation: He who robs his father and drives away his mother is a son who causes shame and brings reproach. (Proverbs 19:26)

text: וּשְׁמִידָע מִשְׁפַּחַת הַשְּׁמִידָעִי וְחֵפֶר מִשְׁפַּחַת הַֽחֶפְרִֽי׃
translation: and Shemida, the family of the Shemidaites; and Hepher, the family of the Hepherites. (Numbers 26:32)

text: מֶלֶךְ תַּפּוּחַ אֶחָד מֶלֶךְ חֵפֶר אֶחָֽד׃
translation: the king of Tappuah, one; the king of Hepher, one; (Joshua 12:17)

text: בְּמִסְפָּר בְּמִשְׁקָל לַכֹּל וַיִּכָּתֵב כָּֽל הַמִּשְׁקָל בָּעֵת הַהִֽיא׃
translation: Everything was counted and weighed; and all the weight was written at that time. (Ezra 8:34)

text: לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ עָוֶל בַּמִּשְׁפָּט בַּמִּדָּה בַּמִּשְׁקָל וּבַמְּשׂוּרָֽה׃
translation: "'You shall do no unrighteousness in judgment, in measures of length, of weight, or of quantity. (Leviticus 19:35)

text: וַיִּתֵּן דָּוִיד לְאָרְנָן בַּמָּקוֹם שִׁקְלֵי זָהָב מִשְׁקָל שֵׁשׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃
translation: So David gave to Ornan six hundred shekels of gold by weight for the place. (1 Chronicles 21:25)

text: וַיַּנַּח שְׁלֹמֹה אֶת כָּל הַכֵּלִים מֵרֹב מְאֹד מְאֹד לֹא נֶחְקַר מִשְׁקַל הַנְּחֹֽשֶׁת׃
translation: Solomon left all the vessels unweighed, because there were so many of them. The weight of the bronze could not be determined. (1 Kings 7:47)

text: וּבַרְזֶל לָרֹב לַֽמִּסְמְרִים לְדַלְתוֹת הַשְּׁעָרִים וְלַֽמְחַבְּרוֹת הֵכִין דָּוִיד וּנְחֹשֶׁת לָרֹב אֵין מִשְׁקָֽל׃
translation: David prepared iron in abundance for the nails for the doors of the gates and for the couplings, and bronze in abundance without weight, (1 Chronicles 22:3)

text: וַיַּעַשׂ שְׁלֹמֹה כָּל הַכֵּלִים הָאֵלֶּה לָרֹב מְאֹד כִּי לֹא נֶחְקַר מִשְׁקַל הַנְּחֹֽשֶׁת׃
translation: Thus Solomon made all these vessels in great abundance, so that the weight of the bronze could not be determined. (2 Chronicles 4:18)

text: וַיְהִי כִּשְׁמֹעַ הַמֶּלֶךְ חִזְקִיָּהוּ וַיִּקְרַע אֶת בְּגָדָיו וַיִּתְכַּס בַּשָּׂק וַיָּבֹא בֵּית יְהוָֽה׃
translation: When King Hezekiah heard it, he tore his clothes, covered himself with sackcloth, and went into the LORD's house. (2 Kings 19:1)

text: וּבְיוֹם עֶשְׂרִים וְאַרְבָּעָה לַחֹדֶשׁ הַזֶּה נֶאֶסְפוּ בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּצוֹם וּבְשַׂקִּים וַאֲדָמָה עֲלֵיהֶֽם׃
translation: Now in the twenty-fourth day of this month the children of Israel were assembled with fasting, with sackcloth, and dirt on them. (Nehemiah 9:1)

text: וַיְהִי כִּשְׁמֹעַ הַמֶּלֶךְ חִזְקִיָּהוּ וַיִּקְרַע אֶת בְּגָדָיו וַיִּתְכַּס בַּשָּׂק וַיָּבֹא בֵּית יְהוָֽה׃
translation: When King Hezekiah heard it, he tore his clothes, covered himself with sackcloth, and went into the LORD's house. (Isaiah 37:1)

text: וָאֶתְּנָה אֶת פָּנַי אֶל אֲדֹנָי הָֽאֱלֹהִים לְבַקֵּשׁ תְּפִלָּה וְתַחֲנוּנִים בְּצוֹם וְשַׂק וָאֵֽפֶר׃
translation: I set my face to the Lord God, to seek by prayer and petitions, with fasting and sackcloth and ashes. (Daniel 9:3)

text: וַיָּבוֹא עַד לִפְנֵי שַֽׁעַר הַמֶּלֶךְ כִּי אֵין לָבוֹא אֶל שַׁעַר הַמֶּלֶךְ בִּלְבוּשׁ שָֽׂק׃
translation: He came even before the king's gate, for no one is allowed inside the king's gate clothed with sackcloth. (Esther 4:2)

text: יֵשְׁבוּ לָאָרֶץ יִדְּמוּ זִקְנֵי בַת צִיּוֹן הֶֽעֱלוּ עָפָר עַל רֹאשָׁם חָגְרוּ שַׂקִּים הוֹרִידוּ לָאָרֶץ רֹאשָׁן בְּתוּלֹת יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
translation: The elders of the daughter of Zion sit on the ground. They keep silence. They have cast up dust on their heads. They have clothed themselves with sackcloth. The virgins of Jerusalem hang down their heads to the ground. (Lamentations 2:10)

text: וְלִבְנֵי יִשָׂשכָר תּוֹלָע וּפוּאָה ישיב יָשׁוּב וְשִׁמְרוֹן אַרְבָּעָֽה׃
translation: Of the sons of Issachar: Tola, Puah, Jashub, and Shimron, four. (1 Chronicles 7:1)

text: בְּנֵי יִשָּׂשכָר לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם תּוֹלָע מִשְׁפַּחַת הַתּוֹלָעִי לְפֻוָה מִשְׁפַּחַת הַפּוּנִֽי׃
translation: The sons of Issachar after their families: of Tola, the family of the Tolaites; of Puvah, the family of the Punites; (Numbers 26:23)

text: אַף כִּֽי אֱנוֹשׁ רִמָּה וּבֶן אָדָם תּוֹלֵעָֽה׃
translation: How much less man, who is a worm, and the son of man, who is a worm!" (Job 25:6)

text: וּבְנֵי יִשָׂשכָר תּוֹלָע וּפֻוָּה וְיוֹב וְשִׁמְרֽוֹן׃
translation: The sons of Issachar: Tola, Puvah, Iob, and Shimron. (Genesis 46:13)

text: כְּרָמִים תִּטַּע וְעָבָדְתָּ וְיַיִן לֹֽא תִשְׁתֶּה וְלֹא תֶאֱגֹר כִּי תֹאכְלֶנּוּ הַתֹּלָֽעַת׃
translation: You will plant vineyards and dress them, but you will neither drink of the wine, nor harvest, because worms will eat them. (Deuteronomy 28:39)

text: אַל תִּֽירְאִי תּוֹלַעַת יַֽעֲקֹב מְתֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲנִי עֲזַרְתִּיךְ נְאֻם יְהוָה וְגֹאֲלֵךְ קְדוֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
translation: Don't be afraid, you worm Jacob, and you men of Israel. I will help you," says the LORD. "Your Redeemer is the Holy One of Israel. (Isaiah 41:14)

text: שְׁאַל מִמֶּנִּי וְאֶתְּנָה גוֹיִם נַחֲלָתֶךָ וַאֲחֻזָּתְךָ אַפְסֵי אָֽרֶץ׃
translation: Ask of me, and I will give the nations for your inheritance, the uttermost parts of the earth for your possession. (Psalms 2:8)

text: הֶאָפֵס לָנֶצַח חַסְדּוֹ גָּמַר אֹמֶר לְדֹר וָדֹֽר׃
translation: Has God forgotten to be gracious? Has he, in anger, withheld his compassion?" Selah. (Psalms 77:9)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר יוֹסֵף הָבוּ מִקְנֵיכֶם וְאֶתְּנָה לָכֶם בְּמִקְנֵיכֶם אִם אָפֵס כָּֽסֶף׃
translation: Joseph said, "Give me your livestock; and I will give you food for your livestock, if your money is gone." (Genesis 47:16)

text: תְּבַקְשֵׁם וְלֹא תִמְצָאֵם אַנְשֵׁי מַצֻּתֶךָ יִהְיוּ כְאַיִן וּכְאֶפֶס אַנְשֵׁי מִלְחַמְתֶּֽךָ׃
translation: You will seek them, and won't find them, even those who contend with you. Those who war against you will be as nothing, as a nonexistent thing. (Isaiah 41:12)

text: הֵן גּוֹר יָגוּר אֶפֶס מֵֽאוֹתִי מִי גָר אִתָּךְ עָלַיִךְ יִפּֽוֹל׃
translation: Behold, they may gather together, but not by me. Whoever gathers together against you will fall because of you. (Isaiah 54:15)

text: פְּנוּ אֵלַי וְהִוָּשְׁעוּ כָּל אַפְסֵי אָרֶץ כִּי אֲנִי אֵל וְאֵין עֽוֹד׃
translation: "Look to me, and be saved, all the ends of the earth; for I am God, and there is no other. (Isaiah 45:22)

text: לֹֽא אַכְזָר כִּי יְעוּרֶנּוּ וּמִי הוּא לְפָנַי יִתְיַצָּֽב׃
translation: Can you put a rope into his nose, or pierce his jaw through with a hook? (Job 41:2)

text: וַתֵּתַצַּב אֲחֹתוֹ מֵרָחֹק לְדֵעָה מַה יֵּעָשֶׂה לֽוֹ׃
translation: His sister stood far off, to see what would be done to him. (Exodus 2:4)

text: וַיֵּרֶד יְהוָה בֶּֽעָנָן וַיִּתְיַצֵּב עִמּוֹ שָׁם וַיִּקְרָא בְשֵׁם יְהוָֽה׃
translation: The LORD descended in the cloud, and stood with him there, and proclaimed the LORD's name. (Exodus 34:5)

text: וַיִּגַּשׁ הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי הַשְׁכֵּם וְהַעֲרֵב וַיִּתְיַצֵּב אַרְבָּעִים יֽוֹם׃
translation: The Philistine came near morning and evening, and presented himself forty days. (1 Samuel 17:16)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ סֹב הִתְיַצֵּב כֹּה וַיִּסֹּב וַֽיַּעֲמֹֽד׃
translation: The king said, "Come and stand here." He came and stood still. (2 Samuel 18:30)

text: וְהַכֹּהֲנִים וְהַלְוִיִּם אֲשֶׁר בְּכָל יִשְׂרָאֵל הִֽתְיַצְּבוּ עָלָיו מִכָּל גְּבוּלָֽם׃
translation: The priests and the Levites who were in all Israel stood with him out of all their territory. (2 Chronicles 11:13)

text: שָׁם יִצְעֲקוּ וְלֹא יַעֲנֶה מִפְּנֵי גְּאוֹן רָעִֽים׃
translation: There they cry, but no one answers, because of the pride of evil men. (Job 35:12)

text: לִפְנֵי שֶׁבֶר גָּאוֹן וְלִפְנֵי כִשָּׁלוֹן גֹּבַהּ רֽוּחַ׃
translation: Pride goes before destruction, and an arrogant spirit before a fall. (Proverbs 16:18)

text: נִשְׁבַּע יְהוָה בִּגְאוֹן יַעֲקֹב אִם אֶשְׁכַּח לָנֶצַח כָּל מַעֲשֵׂיהֶֽם׃
translation: The LORD has sworn by the pride of Jacob, "Surely I will never forget any of their works. (Amos 8:7)

text: יִבְחַר לָנוּ אֶת נַחֲלָתֵנוּ אֶת גְּאוֹן יַעֲקֹב אֲשֶׁר אָהֵב סֶֽלָה׃
translation: God has gone up with a shout, the LORD with the sound of a trumpet. (Psalms 47:5)

text: וְיָשַׁב מַמְזֵר בְּאַשְׁדּוֹד וְהִכְרַתִּי גְּאוֹן פְּלִשְׁתִּֽים׃
translation: Foreigners will dwell in Ashdod, and I will cut off the pride of the Philistines. (Zechariah 9:6)

text: יִֽרְאַת יְהוָה שְֽׂנֹאת רָע גֵּאָה וְגָאוֹן וְדֶרֶךְ רָע וּפִי תַהְפֻּכוֹת שָׂנֵֽאתִי׃
translation: The fear of the LORD is to hate evil. I hate pride, arrogance, the evil way, and the perverse mouth. (Proverbs 8:13)

text: בְּטַח בַּֽיהוָה וַעֲשֵׂה טוֹב שְׁכָן אֶרֶץ וּרְעֵה אֱמוּנָֽה׃
translation: Trust in the LORD, and do good. Dwell in the land, and enjoy safe pasture. (Psalms 37:3)

text: וְיוֹדוּ שָׁמַיִם פִּלְאֲךָ יְהוָה אַף אֱמֽוּנָתְךָ בִּקְהַל קְדֹשִֽׁים׃
translation: For who in the skies can be compared to the LORD? Who among the sons of the heavenly beings is like the LORD, (Psalms 89:6)

text: כִּֽי יָשָׁר דְּבַר יְהוָה וְכָל מַעֲשֵׂהוּ בֶּאֱמוּנָֽה׃
translation: For the LORD's word is right. All his work is done in faithfulness. (Psalms 33:4)

text: חַֽסְדֵי יְהוָה עוֹלָם אָשִׁירָה לְדֹר וָדֹר אוֹדִיעַ אֱמוּנָתְךָ בְּפִֽי׃
translation: I indeed declare, "Love stands firm forever. You established the heavens. Your faithfulness is in them." (Psalms 89:2)

text: כִּֽי אָמַרְתִּי עוֹלָם חֶסֶד יִבָּנֶה שָׁמַיִם תָּכִן אֱמוּנָתְךָ בָהֶֽם׃
translation: "I have made a covenant with my chosen one, I have sworn to David, my servant, (Psalms 89:3)

text: יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵי צְבָאוֹת מִֽי כָֽמוֹךָ חֲסִין יָהּ וֶאֱמֽוּנָתְךָ סְבִיבוֹתֶֽיךָ׃
translation: You rule the pride of the sea. When its waves rise up, you calm them. (Psalms 89:9)

text: אָמַר עָצֵל אֲרִי בַחוּץ בְּתוֹךְ רְחֹבוֹת אֵֽרָצֵֽחַ׃
translation: The sluggard says, "There is a lion outside! I will be killed in the streets!" (Proverbs 22:13)

text: וְאִם בִּכְלִי בַרְזֶל הִכָּהוּ וַיָּמֹת רֹצֵחַֽ הוּא מוֹת יוּמַת הָרֹצֵֽחַ׃
translation: "'But if he struck him with an instrument of iron, so that he died, he is a murderer. The murderer shall surely be put to death. (Numbers 35:16)

text: גֹּאֵל הַדָּם הוּא יָמִית אֶת הָרֹצֵחַ בְּפִגְעוֹ בוֹ הוּא יְמִיתֶֽנּוּ׃
translation: The avenger of blood shall himself put the murderer to death. When he meets him, he shall put him to death. (Numbers 35:19)

text: בְּרֶצַח בְּֽעַצְמוֹתַי חֵרְפוּנִי צוֹרְרָי בְּאָמְרָם אֵלַי כָּל הַיּוֹם אַיֵּה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ׃
translation: Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him, the saving help of my countenance, and my God. (Psalms 42:11)

text: אַלְמָנָה וְגֵר יַהֲרֹגוּ וִֽיתוֹמִים יְרַצֵּֽחוּ׃
translation: They kill the widow and the alien, and murder the fatherless. (Psalms 94:6)

text: וּכְחַכֵּי אִישׁ גְּדוּדִים חֶבֶר כֹּֽהֲנִים דֶּרֶךְ יְרַצְּחוּ שֶׁכְמָה כִּי זִמָּה עָשֽׂוּ׃
translation: As gangs of robbers wait to ambush a man, so the company of priests murder on the path toward Shechem, committing shameful crimes. (Hosea 6:9)

text: וְעָשִׂיתָ חֹשֶׁן מִשְׁפָּט מַעֲשֵׂה חֹשֵׁב כְּמַעֲשֵׂה אֵפֹד תַּעֲשֶׂנּוּ זָהָב תְּכֵלֶת וְאַרְגָּמָן וְתוֹלַעַת שָׁנִי וְשֵׁשׁ מָשְׁזָר תַּעֲשֶׂה אֹתֽוֹ׃
translation: "You shall make a breastplate of judgment, the work of the skillful workman; like the work of the ephod you shall make it; of gold, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, you shall make it. (Exodus 28:15)

text: וְכָל אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר נִמְצָא אִתּוֹ תְּכֵלֶת וְאַרְגָּמָן וְתוֹלַעַת שָׁנִי וְשֵׁשׁ וְעִזִּים וְעֹרֹת אֵילִם מְאָדָּמִים וְעֹרֹת תְּחָשִׁים הֵבִֽיאוּ׃
translation: Everyone with whom was found blue, purple, scarlet, fine linen, goats' hair, rams' skins dyed red, and sea cow hides, brought them. (Exodus 35:23)

text: וְכָל אִשָּׁה חַכְמַת לֵב בְּיָדֶיהָ טָווּ וַיָּבִיאוּ מַטְוֶה אֶֽת הַתְּכֵלֶת וְאֶת הָֽאַרְגָּמָן אֶת תּוֹלַעַת הַשָּׁנִי וְאֶת הַשֵּֽׁשׁ׃
translation: All the women who were wise-hearted spun with their hands, and brought that which they had spun: the blue, the purple, the scarlet, and the fine linen. (Exodus 35:25)

text: וְחֵשֶׁב אֲפֻדָּתוֹ אֲשֶׁר עָלָיו מִמֶּנּוּ הוּא כְּמַעֲשֵׂהוּ זָהָב תְּכֵלֶת וְאַרְגָּמָן וְתוֹלַעַת שָׁנִי וְשֵׁשׁ מָשְׁזָר כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהוָה אֶת מֹשֶֽׁה׃
translation: The skillfully woven band that was on it, with which to fasten it on, was of the same piece, like its work: of gold, of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen, as the LORD commanded Moses. (Exodus 39:5)

text: וּשְׁמוּאֵל מְשָׁרֵת אֶת פְּנֵי יְהוָה נַעַר חָגוּר אֵפוֹד בָּֽד׃
translation: But Samuel ministered before the LORD, being a child, clothed with a linen ephod. (1 Samuel 2:18)

text: וְדָוִד מְכַרְכֵּר בְּכָל עֹז לִפְנֵי יְהוָה וְדָוִד חָגוּר אֵפוֹד בָּֽד׃
translation: David danced before the LORD with all his might; and David was clothed in a linen ephod. (2 Samuel 6:14)

text: וַיְהִי בִּבְרֹחַ אֶבְיָתָר בֶּן אֲחִימֶלֶךְ אֶל דָּוִד קְעִילָה אֵפוֹד יָרַד בְּיָדֽוֹ׃
translation: When Abiathar the son of Ahimelech fled to David to Keilah, he came down with an ephod in his hand. (1 Samuel 23:6)

text: וַיֵּדַע דָּוִד כִּי עָלָיו שָׁאוּל מַחֲרִישׁ הָרָעָה וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל אֶבְיָתָר הַכֹּהֵן הַגִּישָׁה הָאֵפֽוֹד׃
translation: David knew that Saul was devising mischief against him. He said to Abiathar the priest, "Bring the ephod here." (1 Samuel 23:9)

text: וַיַּעַשׂ אֶת הַחֹשֶׁן מַעֲשֵׂה חֹשֵׁב כְּמַעֲשֵׂה אֵפֹד זָהָב תְּכֵלֶת וְאַרְגָּמָן וְתוֹלַעַת שָׁנִי וְשֵׁשׁ מָשְׁזָֽר׃
translation: He made the breastplate, the work of a skillful workman, like the work of the ephod: of gold, of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen. (Exodus 39:8)

text: וַֽיַּעֲשׂוּ שְׁתֵּי טַבְּעֹת זָהָב וַיָּשִׂימוּ עַל שְׁנֵי קְצוֹת הַחֹשֶׁן עַל שְׂפָתוֹ אֲשֶׁר אֶל עֵבֶר הָאֵפֹד בָּֽיְתָה׃
translation: They made two rings of gold, and put them on the two ends of the breastplate, on its edge, which was toward the side of the ephod inward. (Exodus 39:19)

text: וּלְבָאוֹת וְשִׁלְחִים וְעַיִן וְרִמּוֹן כָּל עָרִים עֶשְׂרִים וָתֵשַׁע וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃
translation: Lebaoth, Shilhim, Ain, and Rimmon. All the cities are twenty-nine, with their villages. (Joshua 15:32)

text: וּבְעֵין רִמּוֹן וּבְצָרְעָה וּבְיַרְמֽוּת׃
translation: in En Rimmon, in Zorah, in Jarmuth, (Nehemiah 11:29)

text: אֶל גִּנַּת אֱגוֹז יָרַדְתִּי לִרְאוֹת בְּאִבֵּי הַנָּחַל לִרְאוֹת הֲפָֽרְחָה הַגֶּפֶן הֵנֵצוּ הָרִמֹּנִֽים׃
translation: I went down into the nut tree grove, to see the green plants of the valley, to see whether the vine budded, and the pomegranates were in flower. (Song of Solomon 6:11)

text: וַֽיִּשְׁלְחוּ כָּל הָעֵדָה וַֽיְדַבְּרוּ אֶל בְּנֵי בִנְיָמִן אֲשֶׁר בְּסֶלַע רִמּוֹן וַיִּקְרְאוּ לָהֶם שָׁלֽוֹם׃
translation: The whole congregation sent and spoke to the children of Benjamin who were in the rock of Rimmon, and proclaimed peace to them. (Judges 21:13)

text: לִבְנֵי מְרָרִי הַנּוֹתָרִים מִמַּטֵּה זְבוּלֻן אֶת רִמּוֹנוֹ וְאֶת מִגְרָשֶׁיהָ אֶת תָּבוֹר וְאֶת מִגְרָשֶֽׁיהָ׃
translation: To the sons of Gershom, according to their families, out of the tribe of Issachar, and out of the tribe of Asher, and out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen cities. (1 Chronicles 6:62)

text: וַיִּפְנוּ וַיָּנֻסוּ הַמִּדְבָּרָה אֶל סֶלַע הָֽרִמּוֹן שֵׁשׁ מֵאוֹת אִישׁ וַיֵּֽשְׁבוּ בְּסֶלַע רִמּוֹן אַרְבָּעָה חֳדָשִֽׁים׃
translation: But six hundred men turned and fled toward the wilderness to the rock of Rimmon, and stayed in the rock of Rimmon four months. (Judges 20:47)

text: לְמַֽעַן שִׁמְךָ יְהוָה וְֽסָלַחְתָּ לַעֲוֺנִי כִּי רַב הֽוּא׃
translation: For your name's sake, LORD, pardon my iniquity, for it is great. (Psalms 25:11)

text: כִּֽי אַתָּה אֲדֹנָי טוֹב וְסַלָּח וְרַב חֶסֶד לְכָל קֹרְאֶֽיךָ׃
translation: For you, Lord, are good, and ready to forgive, abundant in loving kindness to all those who call on you. (Psalms 86:5)

text: הַסֹּלֵחַ לְכָל עֲוֺנֵכִי הָרֹפֵא לְכָל תַּחֲלֻאָֽיְכִי׃
translation: who forgives all your sins, who heals all your diseases, (Psalms 103:3)

text: נַחְנוּ פָשַׁעְנוּ וּמָרִינוּ אַתָּה לֹא סָלָֽחְתָּ׃
translation: "We have transgressed and have rebelled. You have not pardoned. (Lamentations 3:42)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה סָלַחְתִּי כִּדְבָרֶֽךָ׃
translation: The LORD said, "I have pardoned according to your word; (Numbers 14:20)

text: וְאֶת הַשֵּׁנִי יַעֲשֶׂה עֹלָה כַּמִּשְׁפָּט וְכִפֶּר עָלָיו הַכֹּהֵן מֵחַטָּאתוֹ אֲשֶׁר חָטָא וְנִסְלַח לֽוֹ׃
translation: He shall offer the second for a burnt offering, according to the ordinance; and the priest shall make atonement for him concerning his sin which he has sinned, and he shall be forgiven. (Leviticus 5:10)

text: זְכָר נָא כִּי כַחֹמֶר עֲשִׂיתָנִי וְֽאֶל עָפָר תְּשִׁיבֵֽנִי׃
translation: Remember, I beg you, that you have fashioned me as clay. Will you bring me into dust again? (Job 10:9)

text: דָּרַכְתָּ בַיָּם סוּסֶיךָ חֹמֶר מַיִם רַבִּֽים׃
translation: You trampled the sea with your horses, churning mighty waters. (Habakkuk 3:15)

text: וְעַתָּה יְהוָה אָבִינוּ אָתָּה אֲנַחְנוּ הַחֹמֶר וְאַתָּה יֹצְרֵנוּ וּמַעֲשֵׂה יָדְךָ כֻּלָּֽנוּ׃
translation: There is no one who calls on your name, who stirs himself up to take hold of you; for you have hidden your face from us, and have consumed us by means of our iniquities. (Isaiah 64:7)

text: וְעֵמֶק הַשִׂדִּים בֶּֽאֱרֹת בֶּאֱרֹת חֵמָר וַיָּנֻסוּ מֶֽלֶךְ סְדֹם וַעֲמֹרָה וַיִּפְּלוּ שָׁמָּה וְהַנִּשְׁאָרִים הֶרָה נָּֽסוּ׃
translation: Now the valley of Siddim was full of tar pits; and the kings of Sodom and Gomorrah fled, and some fell there. Those who remained fled to the hills. (Genesis 14:10)

text: הַפְכְּכֶם אִם כְּחֹמֶר הַיֹּצֵר יֵֽחָשֵׁב כִּֽי יֹאמַר מַעֲשֶׂה לְעֹשֵׂהוּ לֹא עָשָׂנִי וְיֵצֶר אָמַר לְיוֹצְרוֹ לֹא הֵבִֽין׃
translation: You turn things upside down! Should the potter be thought to be like clay, that the thing made should say about him who made it, "He didn't make me;" or the thing formed say of him who formed it, "He has no understanding"? (Isaiah 29:16)

text: הָאֵיפָה וְהַבַּת תֹּכֶן אֶחָד יִֽהְיֶה לָשֵׂאת מַעְשַׂר הַחֹמֶר הַבָּת וַעֲשִׂירִת הַחֹמֶר הָֽאֵיפָה אֶל הַחֹמֶר יִהְיֶה מַתְכֻּנְתּֽוֹ׃
translation: The ephah and the bath shall be of one measure, that the bath may contain one tenth of a homer, and the ephah one tenth of a homer. Its measure shall be the same as the homer. (Ezekiel 45:11)

text: אֽוּרִיָּה הַֽחִתִּי כֹּל שְׁלֹשִׁים וְשִׁבְעָֽה׃
translation: and Uriah the Hittite: thirty-seven in all. (2 Samuel 23:39)

text: אֽוּרִיָּה הַחִתִּי זָבָד בֶּן אַחְלָֽי׃
translation: Uriah the Hittite, Zabad the son of Ahlai, (1 Chronicles 11:41)

text: וַיֵּלֶךְ הָאִישׁ אֶרֶץ הַחִתִּים וַיִּבֶן עִיר וַיִּקְרָא שְׁמָהּ לוּז הוּא שְׁמָהּ עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּֽה׃
translation: The man went into the land of the Hittites, built a city, and called its name Luz, which is its name to this day. (Judges 1:26)

text: וְאָמַרְתָּ כֹּה אָמַר אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה לִירוּשָׁלִַם מְכֹרֹתַיִךְ וּמֹלְדֹתַיִךְ מֵאֶרֶץ הַֽכְּנַעֲנִי אָבִיךְ הָאֱמֹרִי וְאִמֵּךְ חִתִּֽית׃
translation: and say, 'The Lord GOD says to Jerusalem: "Your origin and your birth is of the land of the Canaanite. An Amorite was your father, and your mother was a Hittite. (Ezekiel 16:3)

text: וַיִּשְׁלַח דָּוִד אֶל יוֹאָב שְׁלַח אֵלַי אֶת אֽוּרִיָּה הַחִתִּי וַיִּשְׁלַח יוֹאָב אֶת אֽוּרִיָּה אֶל דָּוִֽד׃
translation: David sent to Joab, "Send me Uriah the Hittite." Joab sent Uriah to David. (2 Samuel 11:6)

text: וַיֵּצְאוּ אַנְשֵׁי הָעִיר וַיִּלָּחֲמוּ אֶת יוֹאָב וַיִּפֹּל מִן הָעָם מֵעַבְדֵי דָוִד וַיָּמָת גַּם אוּרִיָּה הַחִתִּֽי׃
translation: The men of the city went out and fought with Joab. Some of the people fell, even of David's servants; and Uriah the Hittite died also. (2 Samuel 11:17)

text: וָאֹמַר אֶל אֲדֹנִי אֻלַי לֹא תֵלֵךְ הָאִשָּׁה אַחֲרָֽי׃
translation: I asked my master, 'What if the woman will not follow me?' (Genesis 24:39)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֵלָי עוֹד קַח לְךָ כְּלִי רֹעֶה אֱוִלִֽי׃
translation: The LORD said to me, "Take for yourself yet again the equipment of a foolish shepherd. (Zechariah 11:15)

text: יִתֵּן בֶּֽעָפָר פִּיהוּ אוּלַי יֵשׁ תִּקְוָֽה׃
translation: Let him put his mouth in the dust, if it is so that there may be hope. (Lamentations 3:29)

text: וָאֶשְׁמַע קוֹל אָדָם בֵּין אוּלָי וַיִּקְרָא וַיֹּאמַר גַּבְרִיאֵל הָבֵן לְהַלָּז אֶת הַמַּרְאֶֽה׃
translation: I heard a man's voice between the banks of the Ulai, which called and said, "Gabriel, make this man understand the vision." (Daniel 8:16)

text: אוּלַי יִרְאֶה יְהוָה בעוני בְּעֵינִי וְהֵשִׁיב יְהוָה לִי טוֹבָה תַּחַת קִלְלָתוֹ הַיּוֹם הַזֶּֽה׃
translation: It may be that the LORD will look on the wrong done to me, and that the LORD will repay me good for the cursing of me today." (2 Samuel 16:12)

text: וַיֹּסֶף עוֹד לְדַבֵּר אֵלָיו וַיֹּאמַר אוּלַי יִמָּצְאוּן שָׁם אַרְבָּעִים וַיֹּאמֶר לֹא אֶֽעֱשֶׂה בַּעֲבוּר הָאַרְבָּעִֽים׃
translation: He spoke to him yet again, and said, "What if there are forty found there?" He said, "I will not do it for the forty's sake." (Genesis 18:29)

text: וְיָרַד מִיָּנוֹחָה עֲטָרוֹת וְנַעֲרָתָה וּפָגַע בִּֽירִיחוֹ וְיָצָא הַיַּרְדֵּֽן׃
translation: It went down from Janoah to Ataroth, to Naarah, reached to Jericho, and went out at the Jordan. (Joshua 16:7)

text: וְאַֽלַמֶּלֶךְ וְעַמְעָד וּמִשְׁאָל וּפָגַע בְּכַרְמֶל הַיָּמָּה וּבְשִׁיחוֹר לִבְנָֽת׃
translation: Allammelech, Amad, Mishal. It reached to Carmel westward, and to Shihorlibnath. (Joshua 19:26)

text: וְיַעֲקֹב הָלַךְ לְדַרְכּוֹ וַיִּפְגְּעוּ בוֹ מַלְאֲכֵי אֱלֹהִֽים׃
translation: When he saw them, Jacob said, "This is God's army." He called the name of that place Mahanaim. (Genesis 32:2)

text: עַל כַּפַּיִם כִּסָּה אוֹר וַיְצַו עָלֶיהָ בְמַפְגִּֽיעַ׃
translation: He covers his hands with the lightning, and commands it to strike the mark. (Job 36:32)

text: וַֽיִּפְגְּעוּ אֶת מֹשֶׁה וְאֶֽת אַהֲרֹן נִצָּבִים לִקְרָאתָם בְּצֵאתָם מֵאֵת פַּרְעֹֽה׃
translation: They met Moses and Aaron, who stood along the way, as they came out from Pharaoh. (Exodus 5:20)

text: כִּי תִפְגַּע שׁוֹר אֹֽיִבְךָ אוֹ חֲמֹרוֹ תֹּעֶה הָשֵׁב תְּשִׁיבֶנּוּ לֽוֹ׃
translation: "If you meet your enemy's ox or his donkey going astray, you shall surely bring it back to him again. (Exodus 23:4)

text: בְּֽנֵי אֶפְרַיִם נוֹשְׁקֵי רוֹמֵי קָשֶׁת הָפְכוּ בְּיוֹם קְרָֽב׃
translation: The children of Ephraim, being armed and carrying bows, turned back in the day of battle. (Psalms 78:9)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו יִצְחָק אָבִיו גְּשָׁה נָּא וּשְׁקָה לִּי בְּנִֽי׃
translation: His father Isaac said to him, "Come near now, and kiss me, my son." (Genesis 27:26)

text: וַיִּשַּׁק יַעֲקֹב לְרָחֵל וַיִּשָּׂא אֶת קֹלוֹ וַיֵּֽבְךְּ׃
translation: Jacob kissed Rachel, and lifted up his voice, and wept. (Genesis 29:11)

text: וַיִּפֹּל יוֹסֵף עַל פְּנֵי אָבִיו וַיֵּבְךְּ עָלָיו וַיִּשַּׁק לֽוֹ׃
translation: Joseph fell on his father's face, wept on him, and kissed him. (Genesis 50:1)

text: יִשָּׁקֵנִי מִנְּשִׁיקוֹת פִּיהוּ כִּֽי טוֹבִים דֹּדֶיךָ מִיָּֽיִן׃
translation: Let him kiss me with the kisses of his mouth; for your love is better than wine. (Song of Solomon 1:2)

text: וַיְנַשֵּׁק לְכָל אֶחָיו וַיֵּבְךְּ עֲלֵיהֶם וְאַחֲרֵי כֵן דִּבְּרוּ אֶחָיו אִתּֽוֹ׃
translation: He kissed all his brothers, and wept on them. After that his brothers talked with him. (Genesis 45:15)

text: סָמוּךְ לִבּוֹ לֹא יִירָא עַד אֲשֶׁר יִרְאֶה בְצָרָֽיו׃
translation: His heart is established. He will not be afraid in the end when he sees his adversaries. (Psalms 112:8)

text: יֵצֶר סָמוּךְ תִּצֹּר שָׁלוֹם שָׁלוֹם כִּי בְךָ בָּטֽוּחַ׃
translation: You will keep whoever's mind is steadfast in perfect peace, because he trusts in you. (Isaiah 26:3)

text: וְסָמַךְ יָדוֹ עַל רֹאשׁ הָעֹלָה וְנִרְצָה לוֹ לְכַפֵּר עָלָֽיו׃
translation: He shall lay his hand on the head of the burnt offering, and it shall be accepted for him to make atonement for him. (Leviticus 1:4)

text: כִּי זְרוֹעוֹת רְשָׁעִים תִּשָּׁבַרְנָה וְסוֹמֵךְ צַדִּיקִים יְהוָֽה׃
translation: For the arms of the wicked shall be broken, but the LORD upholds the righteous. (Psalms 37:17)

text: הִנֵּה אֱלֹהִים עֹזֵר לִי אֲדֹנָי בְּֽסֹמְכֵי נַפְשִֽׁי׃
translation: With a free will offering, I will sacrifice to you. I will give thanks to your name, LORD, for it is good. (Psalms 54:6)

text: סוֹמֵךְ יְהוָה לְכָל הַנֹּפְלִים וְזוֹקֵף לְכָל הַכְּפוּפִֽים׃
translation: The LORD upholds all who fall, and raises up all those who are bowed down. (Psalms 145:14)

text: וַיָּֽשֶׁב יְהוָה לִי כְצִדְקִי כְּבֹר יָדַי לְנֶגֶד עֵינָֽיו׃
translation: With the merciful you will show yourself merciful. With the perfect man, you will show yourself perfect. (Psalms 18:25)

text: מִזְמוֹר לְאָסָף אַךְ טוֹב לְיִשְׂרָאֵל אֱלֹהִים לְבָרֵי לֵבָֽב׃
translation: A Psalm by Asaph. Surely God is good to Israel, to those who are pure in heart. (Psalms 73:1)

text: בְּאֵין אֲלָפִים אֵבוּס בָּר וְרָב תְּבוּאוֹת בְּכֹחַ שֽׁוֹר׃
translation: Where no oxen are, the crib is clean, but much increase is by the strength of the ox. (Proverbs 14:4)

text: מַה בְּרִי וּמַֽה בַּר בִּטְנִי וּמֶה בַּר נְדָרָֽי׃
translation: "Oh, my son! Oh, son of my womb! Oh, son of my vows! (Proverbs 31:2)

text: וַיֵּרְדוּ אֲחֵֽי יוֹסֵף עֲשָׂרָה לִשְׁבֹּר בָּר מִמִּצְרָֽיִם׃
translation: Joseph's ten brothers went down to buy grain from Egypt. (Genesis 42:3)

text: יִגְמְלֵנִי יְהוָה כְּצִדְקָתִי כְּבֹר יָדַי יָשִׁיב לִֽי׃
translation: The LORD rewarded me according to my righteousness. He rewarded me according to the cleanness of my hands. (2 Samuel 22:21)

text: שְׁמַע עֵצָה וְקַבֵּל מוּסָר לְמַעַן תֶּחְכַּם בְּאַחֲרִיתֶֽךָ׃
translation: Listen to counsel and receive instruction, that you may be wise in your latter end. (Proverbs 19:20)

text: וּמְחִי קָֽבָלּוֹ יִתֵּן בְּחֹֽמוֹתָיִךְ וּמִגְדְּלֹתַיִךְ יִתֹּץ בְּחַרְבוֹתָֽיו׃
translation: He will set his battering engines against your walls, and with his axes he will break down your towers. (Ezekiel 26:9)

text: וַיִּקְשֹׁר עָלָיו שַׁלֻּם בֶּן יָבֵשׁ וַיַּכֵּהוּ קָֽבָלְ עָם וַיְמִיתֵהוּ וַיִּמְלֹךְ תַּחְתָּֽיו׃
translation: Shallum the son of Jabesh conspired against him, and struck him before the people and killed him, and reigned in his place. (2 Kings 15:10)

text: וַיָּבֹא גָד אֶל דָּוִיד וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ כֹּֽה אָמַר יְהוָה קַבֶּל לָֽךְ׃
translation: So Gad came to David and said to him, "The LORD says, 'Take your choice: (1 Chronicles 21:11)

text: וְקִבְּלוּ הַכֹּהֲנִים וְהַלְוִיִּם מִשְׁקַל הַכֶּסֶף וְהַזָּהָב וְהַכֵּלִים לְהָבִיא לִירוּשָׁלִַם לְבֵית אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃
translation: So the priests and the Levites received the weight of the silver, the gold, and the vessels, to bring them to Jerusalem to the house of our God. (Ezra 8:30)

text: וְקִבֵּל הַיְּהוּדִים אֵת אֲשֶׁר הֵחֵלּוּ לַעֲשׂוֹת וְאֵת אֲשֶׁר כָּתַב מָרְדֳּכַי אֲלֵיהֶֽם׃
translation: The Jews accepted the custom that they had begun, as Mordecai had written to them, (Esther 9:23)

text: הַכְּמַכַּת מַכֵּהוּ הִכָּהוּ אִם כְּהֶרֶג הֲרֻגָיו הֹרָֽג׃
translation: Has he struck them as he struck those who struck them? Or are they killed like those who killed them were killed? (Isaiah 27:7)

text: וַיֵּצֵא מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיַּךְ אֶת הַסּוּס וְאֶת הָרָכֶב וְהִכָּה בַאֲרָם מַכָּה גְדוֹלָֽה׃
translation: The king of Israel went out and struck the horses and chariots, and killed the Syrians with a great slaughter. (1 Kings 20:21)

text: וְאָמַר אֵלָיו מָה הַמַּכּוֹת הָאֵלֶּה בֵּין יָדֶיךָ וְאָמַר אֲשֶׁר הֻכֵּיתִי בֵּית מְאַהֲבָֽי׃
translation: One will say to him, 'What are these wounds between your arms?' Then he will answer, 'Those with which I was wounded in the house of my friends.' (Zechariah 13:6)

text: וַתּוֹסֶף הַמִּלְחָמָה לִֽהְיוֹת וַיֵּצֵא דָוִד וַיִּלָּחֶם בַּפְּלִשְׁתִּים וַיַּךְ בָּהֶם מַכָּה גְדוֹלָה וַיָּנֻסוּ מִפָּנָֽיו׃
translation: There was war again. David went out and fought with the Philistines, and killed them with a great slaughter; and they fled before him. (1 Samuel 19:8)

text: וַתְּהִי הַמַּכָּה הָרִאשֹׁנָה אֲשֶׁר הִכָּה יוֹנָתָן וְנֹשֵׂא כֵלָיו כְּעֶשְׂרִים אִישׁ כְּבַחֲצִי מַעֲנָה צֶמֶד שָׂדֶֽה׃
translation: That first slaughter, which Jonathan and his armor bearer made, was about twenty men, within as it were half a furrow's length in an acre of land. (1 Samuel 14:14)

text: וַיַּכּוּ בָהֶם אֲבִיָּה וְעַמּוֹ מַכָּה רַבָּה וַיִּפְּלוּ חֲלָלִים מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל חֲמֵשׁ מֵאוֹת אֶלֶף אִישׁ בָּחֽוּר׃
translation: Abijah and his people killed them with a great slaughter, so five hundred thousand chosen men of Israel fell down slain. (2 Chronicles 13:17)

text: עָשֹׂה אֵלֶּה לָךְ בִּזְנוֹתֵךְ אַחֲרֵי גוֹיִם עַל אֲשֶׁר נִטְמֵאת בְּגִלּוּלֵיהֶֽם׃
translation: These things will be done to you because you have played the prostitute after the nations, and because you are polluted with their idols. (Ezekiel 23:30)

text: וַיַּעֲבֵר הַקְּדֵשִׁים מִן הָאָרֶץ וַיָּסַר אֶת כָּל הַגִּלֻּלִים אֲשֶׁר עָשׂוּ אֲבֹתָֽיו׃
translation: He put away the sodomites out of the land, and removed all the idols that his fathers had made. (1 Kings 15:12)

text: וַיַּֽעַבְדוּ הַגִּלֻּלִים אֲשֶׁר אָמַר יְהוָה לָהֶם לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ אֶת הַדָּבָר הַזֶּֽה׃
translation: and they served idols, of which the LORD had said to them, "You shall not do this thing." (2 Kings 17:12)

text: לְמַעַן תְּפֹשׂ אֶת בֵּֽית יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּלִבָּם אֲשֶׁר נָזֹרוּ מֵֽעָלַי בְּגִלּֽוּלֵיהֶם כֻּלָּֽם׃
translation: that I may take the house of Israel in their own heart, because they are all estranged from me through their idols."' (Ezekiel 14:5)

text: וְנָתְנוּ זִמַּתְכֶנָה עֲלֵיכֶן וַחֲטָאֵי גִלּוּלֵיכֶן תִּשֶּׂאינָה וִידַעְתֶּם כִּי אֲנִי אֲדֹנָי יְהוִֽה׃
translation: They will recompense your lewdness on you, and you will bear the sins of your idols. Then you will know that I am the Lord GOD.'" (Ezekiel 23:49)

text: וָאֶשְׁפֹּךְ חֲמָתִי עֲלֵיהֶם עַל הַדָּם אֲשֶׁר שָׁפְכוּ עַל הָאָרֶץ וּבְגִלּוּלֵיהֶם טִמְּאֽוּהָ׃
translation: Therefore I poured out my wrath on them for the blood which they had poured out on the land, and because they had defiled it with their idols. (Ezekiel 36:18)

text: וְהָיָה כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּמִּיתִי לַעֲשׂוֹת לָהֶם אֶֽעֱשֶׂה לָכֶֽם׃
translation: It shall happen that as I thought to do to them, so I will do to you." (Numbers 33:56)

text: וְאָדָם בִּיקָר בַּל יָלִין נִמְשַׁל כַּבְּהֵמוֹת נִדְמֽוּ׃
translation: This is the destiny of those who are foolish, and of those who approve their sayings. Selah. (Psalms 49:13)

text: כִּי מִי בַשַּׁחַק יַעֲרֹךְ לַיהוָה יִדְמֶה לַיהוָה בִּבְנֵי אֵלִים׃
translation: a very awesome God in the council of the holy ones, to be feared above all those who are around him? (Psalms 89:7)

text: וְכָשַׁלְתָּ הַיּוֹם וְכָשַׁל גַּם נָבִיא עִמְּךָ לָיְלָה וְדָמִיתִי אִמֶּֽךָ׃
translation: You will stumble in the day, and the prophet will also stumble with you in the night; and I will destroy your mother. (Hosea 4:5)

text: נִדְמֶה שֹׁמְרוֹן מַלְכָּהּ כְּקֶצֶף עַל פְּנֵי מָֽיִם׃
translation: Samaria and her king float away like a twig on the water. (Hosea 10:7)

text: אֵלֶּה עָשִׂיתָ וְֽהֶחֱרַשְׁתִּי דִּמִּיתָ הֱֽיוֹת אֶֽהְיֶה כָמוֹךָ אוֹכִיחֲךָ וְאֶֽעֶרְכָה לְעֵינֶֽיךָ׃
translation: You have done these things, and I kept silent. You thought that I was just like you. I will rebuke you, and accuse you in front of your eyes. (Psalms 50:21)

text: וְלִשְׁכָּה וּפִתְחָהּ בְּאֵילִים הַשְּׁעָרִים שָׁם יָדִיחוּ אֶת הָעֹלָֽה׃
translation: A room with its door was by the posts at the gates. They washed the burnt offering there. (Ezekiel 40:38)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְחִזְקִיָּהוּ לְהָכִין לְשָׁכוֹת בְּבֵית יְהוָה וַיָּכִֽינוּ׃
translation: Then Hezekiah commanded them to prepare rooms in the LORD's house, and they prepared them. (2 Chronicles 31:11)

text: וּבֵין הַלְּשָׁכוֹת רֹחַב עֶשְׂרִים אַמָּה סָבִיב לַבַּיִת סָבִיב סָבִֽיב׃
translation: Between the rooms was a width of twenty cubits around the house on every side. (Ezekiel 41:10)

text: וְלִפְנֵי מִזֶּה אֶלְיָשִׁיב הַכֹּהֵן נָתוּן בְּלִשְׁכַּת בֵּית אֱלֹהֵינוּ קָרוֹב לְטוֹבִיָּֽה׃
translation: Now before this, Eliashib the priest, who was appointed over the rooms of the house of our God, being allied to Tobiah, (Nehemiah 13:4)

text: וַיֵּרַֽע לִי מְאֹד וָֽאַשְׁלִיכָה אֶֽת כָּל כְּלֵי בֵית טוֹבִיָּה הַחוּץ מִן הַלִּשְׁכָּֽה׃
translation: It grieved me severely. Therefore I threw all Tobiah's household stuff out of the room. (Nehemiah 13:8)

text: וְלִפְנֵי הַלְּשָׁכוֹת מַהֲלַךְ עֶשֶׂר אַמּוֹת רֹחַב אֶל הַפְּנִימִית דֶּרֶךְ אַמָּה אֶחָת וּפִתְחֵיהֶם לַצָּפֽוֹן׃
translation: Before the rooms was a walk of ten cubits' width inward, a way of one cubit; and their doors were toward the north. (Ezekiel 42:4)

text: וַיַּעַן דָּוִד וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֵּה החנית חֲנִית הַמֶּלֶךְ וְיַעֲבֹר אֶחָד מֵֽהַנְּעָרִים וְיִקָּחֶֽהָ׃
translation: David answered, "Behold the spear, O king! Let one of the young men come over and get it. (1 Samuel 26:22)

text: וְאִישׁ יִגַּע בָּהֶם יִמָּלֵא בַרְזֶל וְעֵץ חֲנִית וּבָאֵשׁ שָׂרוֹף יִשָּׂרְפוּ בַּשָּֽׁבֶת׃
translation: The man who touches them must be armed with iron and the staff of a spear. They will be utterly burned with fire in their place." (2 Samuel 23:7)

text: וְחָרָשׁ לֹא יִמָּצֵא בְּכֹל אֶרֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵל כִּֽי אמר אָמְרוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים פֶּן יַעֲשׂוּ הָעִבְרִים חֶרֶב אוֹ חֲנִֽית׃
translation: Now there was no blacksmith found throughout all the land of Israel, for the Philistines said, "Lest the Hebrews make themselves swords or spears"; (1 Samuel 13:19)

text: וְיֵֽדְעוּ כָּל הַקָּהָל הַזֶּה כִּֽי לֹא בְּחֶרֶב וּבַחֲנִית יְהוֹשִׁיעַ יְהוָה כִּי לַֽיהוָה הַמִּלְחָמָה וְנָתַן אֶתְכֶם בְּיָדֵֽנוּ׃
translation: and that all this assembly may know that the LORD doesn't save with sword and spear; for the battle is the LORD's, and he will give you into our hand." (1 Samuel 17:47)

text: וַיָּטֶל שָׁאוּל אֶֽת הַחֲנִית עָלָיו לְהַכֹּתוֹ וַיֵּדַע יְהוֹנָתָן כִּֽי כָלָה הִיא מֵעִם אָבִיו לְהָמִית אֶת דָּוִֽד׃
translation: Saul cast his spear at him to strike him. By this Jonathan knew that his father was determined to put David to death. (1 Samuel 20:33)

text: וַיִּתֵּן יְהוֹיָדָע הַכֹּהֵן לְשָׂרֵי הַמֵּאוֹת אֶת הַֽחֲנִיתִים וְאֶת הַמָּגִנּוֹת וְאֶת הַשְּׁלָטִים אֲשֶׁר לַמֶּלֶךְ דָּוִיד אֲשֶׁר בֵּית הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃
translation: Jehoiada the priest delivered to the captains of hundreds the spears, bucklers, and shields that had been king David's, which were in God's house. (2 Chronicles 23:9)

text: בִּרְכַּת יְהוָה הִיא תַעֲשִׁיר וְלֹֽא יוֹסִף עֶצֶב עִמָּֽהּ׃
translation: The LORD's blessing brings wealth, and he adds no trouble to it. (Proverbs 10:22)

text: וַיַּעַזְבוּ שָׁם אֶת עֲצַבֵּיהֶם וַיִּשָּׂאֵם דָּוִד וַאֲנָשָֽׁיו׃
translation: They left their images there, and David and his men took them away. (2 Samuel 5:21)

text: עֲצַבֵּי הַגּוֹיִם כֶּסֶף וְזָהָב מַעֲשֵׂה יְדֵי אָדָֽם׃
translation: The idols of the nations are silver and gold, the work of men's hands. (Psalms 135:15)

text: וַיִּנָּחֶם יְהוָה כִּֽי עָשָׂה אֶת הָֽאָדָם בָּאָרֶץ וַיִּתְעַצֵּב אֶל לִבּֽוֹ׃
translation: The LORD was sorry that he had made man on the earth, and it grieved him in his heart. (Genesis 6:6)

text: יָדֶיךָ עִצְּבוּנִי וַֽיַּעֲשׂוּנִי יַחַד סָבִיב וַֽתְּבַלְּעֵֽנִי׃
translation: "'Your hands have framed me and fashioned me altogether, yet you destroy me. (Job 10:8)

text: וַיַּעַבְדוּ אֶת עֲצַבֵּיהֶם וַיִּהְיוּ לָהֶם לְמוֹקֵֽשׁ׃
translation: They served their idols, which became a snare to them. (Psalms 106:36)

text: וַֽיְהִי הַגֶּשֶׁם עַל הָאָרֶץ אַרְבָּעִים יוֹם וְאַרְבָּעִים לָֽיְלָה׃
translation: It rained on the earth forty days and forty nights. (Genesis 7:12)

text: נְשִׂיאִים וְרוּחַ וְגֶשֶׁם אָיִן אִישׁ מִתְהַלֵּל בְּמַתַּת שָֽׁקֶר׃
translation: As clouds and wind without rain, so is he who boasts of gifts deceptively. (Proverbs 25:14)

text: וַיְהִי מִקֵּץ יָמִים וַיִּיבַשׁ הַנָּחַל כִּי לֹֽא הָיָה גֶשֶׁם בָּאָֽרֶץ׃
translation: After a while, the brook dried up, because there was no rain in the land. (1 Kings 17:7)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלִיָּהוּ לְאַחְאָב עֲלֵה אֱכֹל וּשְׁתֵה כִּי קוֹל הֲמוֹן הַגָּֽשֶׁם׃
translation: Elijah said to Ahab, "Get up, eat and drink; for there is the sound of abundance of rain." (1 Kings 18:41)

text: וְנָתַתִּי אוֹתָם וּסְבִיבוֹת גִּבְעָתִי בְּרָכָה וְהוֹרַדְתִּי הַגֶּשֶׁם בְּעִתּוֹ גִּשְׁמֵי בְרָכָה יִֽהְיֽוּ׃
translation: I will make them and the places around my hill a blessing. I will cause the shower to come down in its season. There will be showers of blessing. (Ezekiel 34:26)

text: עַד אֲשֶׁר לֹֽא תֶחְשַׁךְ הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ וְהָאוֹר וְהַיָּרֵחַ וְהַכּוֹכָבִים וְשָׁבוּ הֶעָבִים אַחַר הַגָּֽשֶׁם׃
translation: Before the sun, the light, the moon, and the stars are darkened, and the clouds return after the rain; (Ecclesiastes 12:2)

text: וְשָׁחַט אֶת הַצִּפֹּר הָאֶחָת אֶל כְּלִי חֶרֶשׂ עַל מַיִם חַיִּֽים׃
translation: He shall kill one of the birds in an earthen vessel over running water. (Leviticus 14:50)

text: וַיַּרְא בָּלָק בֶּן צִפּוֹר אֵת כָּל אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה יִשְׂרָאֵל לָֽאֱמֹרִֽי׃
translation: Balak the son of Zippor saw all that Israel had done to the Amorites. (Numbers 22:2)

text: וַיִּשָּׂא מְשָׁלוֹ וַיֹּאמַר קוּם בָּלָק וּֽשֲׁמָע הַאֲזִינָה עָדַי בְּנוֹ צִפֹּֽר׃
translation: He took up his parable, and said, "Rise up, Balak, and hear! Listen to me, you son of Zippor. (Numbers 23:18)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר בִּלְעָם אֶל הָאֱלֹהִים בָּלָק בֶּן צִפֹּר מֶלֶךְ מוֹאָב שָׁלַח אֵלָֽי׃
translation: Balaam said to God, "Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, has said to me, (Numbers 22:10)

text: יֶחֶרְדוּ כְצִפּוֹר מִמִּצְרַיִם וּכְיוֹנָה מֵאֶרֶץ אַשּׁוּר וְהוֹשַׁבְתִּים עַל בָּתֵּיהֶם נְאֻם יְהוָֽה׃
translation: They will come trembling like a bird out of Egypt, and like a dove out of the land of Assyria; and I will settle them in their houses," says the LORD. (Hosea 11:11)

text: וְצִוָּה הַכֹּהֵן וְשָׁחַט אֶת הַצִּפּוֹר הָאֶחָת אֶל כְּלִי חֶרֶשׂ עַל מַיִם חַיִּֽים׃
translation: The priest shall command them to kill one of the birds in an earthen vessel over running water. (Leviticus 14:5)

text: שִׁיר הַֽמַּעֲלוֹת רַבַּת צְרָרוּנִי מִנְּעוּרַי יֹֽאמַר נָא יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
translation: A Song of Ascents. Many times they have afflicted me from my youth up. Let Israel now say: (Psalms 129:1)

text: כִּֽי תִכְתֹּב עָלַי מְרֹרוֹת וְתוֹרִישֵׁנִי עֲוֺנוֹת נְעוּרָֽי׃
translation: For you write bitter things against me, and make me inherit the iniquities of my youth. (Job 13:26)

text: אֱֽלֹהִים לִמַּדְתַּנִי מִנְּעוּרָי וְעַד הֵנָּה אַגִּיד נִפְלְאוֹתֶֽיךָ׃
translation: God, you have taught me from my youth. Until now, I have declared your wondrous works. (Psalms 71:17)

text: רַבַּת צְרָרוּנִי מִנְּעוּרָי גַּם לֹא יָכְלוּ לִֽי׃
translation: many times they have afflicted me from my youth up, yet they have not prevailed against me. (Psalms 129:2)

text: וְאִשָּׁה כִּֽי תִדֹּר נֶדֶר לַיהוָה וְאָסְרָה אִסָּר בְּבֵית אָבִיהָ בִּנְעֻרֶֽיהָ׃
translation: and her father hears her vow and her pledge with which she has bound her soul, and her father says nothing to her, then all her vows shall stand, and every pledge with which she has bound her soul shall stand. (Numbers 30:4)

text: כְּחִצִּים בְּיַד גִּבּוֹר כֵּן בְּנֵי הַנְּעוּרִֽים׃
translation: As arrows in the hand of a mighty man, so are the children of youth. (Psalms 127:4)

text: בְּנֵי יֶפֶת גֹּמֶר וּמָגוֹג וּמָדַי וְיָוָן וְתֻבָל וּמֶשֶׁךְ וְתִירָֽס׃
translation: The sons of Japheth were: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras. (Genesis 10:2)

text: בְּנֵי יֶפֶת גֹּמֶר וּמָגוֹג וּמָדַי וְיָוָן וְתֻבָל וּמֶשֶׁךְ וְתִירָֽס׃
translation: The sons of Japheth: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras. (1 Chronicles 1:5)

text: מְשֹׁךְ חַסְדְּךָ לְיֹדְעֶיךָ וְצִדְקָֽתְךָ לְיִשְׁרֵי לֵֽב׃
translation: Don't let the foot of pride come against me. Don't let the hand of the wicked drive me away. (Psalms 36:11)

text: בְּתוֹךְ חַלְלֵי חֶרֶב יִפֹּלוּ חֶרֶב נִתָּנָה מָשְׁכוּ אוֹתָהּ וְכָל הֲמוֹנֶֽיהָ׃
translation: They will fall among those who are slain by the sword. She is delivered to the sword. Draw her away with all her multitudes. (Ezekiel 32:20)

text: יוֹם מַלְכֵּנוּ הֶחֱלוּ שָׂרִים חֲמַת מִיָּיִן מָשַׁךְ יָדוֹ אֶת לֹצְצִֽים׃
translation: On the day of our king, the princes made themselves sick with the heat of wine. He joined his hand with mockers. (Hosea 7:5)

text: בְּנֵי שֵׁם עֵילָם וְאַשּׁוּר וְאַרְפַּכְשַׁד וְלוּד וַאֲרָם וְעוּץ וְחוּל וְגֶתֶר וָמֶֽשֶׁךְ׃
translation: The sons of Shem: Elam, Asshur, Arpachshad, Lud, Aram, Uz, Hul, Gether, and Meshech. (1 Chronicles 1:17)

text: כִּי אִם יִהְיֶה לְבָעֵֽר קָיִן עַד מָה אַשּׁוּר תִּשְׁבֶּֽךָּ׃
translation: Nevertheless Kain shall be wasted, until Asshur carries you away captive." (Numbers 24:22)

text: וּשְׁתֵּי נְשֵֽׁי דָוִד נִשְׁבּוּ אֲחִינֹעַם הַיִּזְרְעֵלִית וַאֲבִיגַיִל אֵשֶׁת נָבָל הַֽכַּרְמְלִֽי׃
translation: David's two wives were taken captive, Ahinoam the Jezreelitess, and Abigail the wife of Nabal the Carmelite. (1 Samuel 30:5)

text: וְגַם אָהֳלֵי מִקְנֶה הִכּוּ וַיִּשְׁבּוּ צֹאן לָרֹב וּגְמַלִּים וַיָּשֻׁבוּ יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
translation: They struck all the cities around Gerar, for the fear of the LORD came on them. They plundered all the cities, for there was much plunder in them. (2 Chronicles 14:14)

text: וַיִּתֵּן אוֹתָם לְרַחֲמִים לִפְנֵי כָּל שׁוֹבֵיהֶֽם׃
translation: He made them also to be pitied by all those who carried them captive. (Psalms 106:46)

text: כִּֽי תֵצֵא לַמִּלְחָמָה עַל אֹיְבֶיךָ וּנְתָנוֹ יְהוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בְּיָדֶךָ וְשָׁבִיתָ שִׁבְיֽוֹ׃
translation: When you go out to battle against your enemies, and the LORD your God delivers them into your hands and you carry them away captive, (Deuteronomy 21:10)

text: וַיָּבֹא דָוִד וַֽאֲנָשָׁיו אֶל הָעִיר וְהִנֵּה שְׂרוּפָה בָּאֵשׁ וּנְשֵׁיהֶם וּבְנֵיהֶם וּבְנֹתֵיהֶם נִשְׁבּֽוּ׃
translation: When David and his men came to the city, behold, it was burned with fire; and their wives, their sons, and their daughters were taken captive. (1 Samuel 30:3)

text: וַיֶּאֱסֹף לָבָן אֶת כָּל אַנְשֵׁי הַמָּקוֹם וַיַּעַשׂ מִשְׁתֶּֽה׃
translation: Laban gathered together all the men of the place, and made a feast. (Genesis 29:22)

text: כָּל יְמֵי עָנִי רָעִים וְטֽוֹב לֵב מִשְׁתֶּה תָמִֽיד׃
translation: All the days of the afflicted are wretched, but one who has a cheerful heart enjoys a continual feast. (Proverbs 15:15)

text: וּבֵית מִשְׁתֶּה לֹא תָבוֹא לָשֶׁבֶת אוֹתָם לֶאֱכֹל וְלִשְׁתּֽוֹת׃
translation: "You shall not go into the house of feasting to sit with them, to eat and to drink." (Jeremiah 16:8)

text: וַיְהִי הַמֶּלְצַר נֹשֵׂא אֶת פַּתְבָּגָם וְיֵין מִשְׁתֵּיהֶם וְנֹתֵן לָהֶם זֵרְעֹנִֽים׃
translation: So the steward took away their delicacies and the wine that they were given to drink, and gave them vegetables. (Daniel 1:16)

text: וַיִּגְדַּל הַיֶּלֶד וַיִּגָּמַל וַיַּעַשׂ אַבְרָהָם מִשְׁתֶּה גָדוֹל בְּיוֹם הִגָּמֵל אֶת יִצְחָֽק׃
translation: The child grew and was weaned. Abraham made a great feast on the day that Isaac was weaned. (Genesis 21:8)

text: וַיַּעַשׂ לָהֶם מִשְׁתֶּה וַיֹּאכְלוּ וַיִּשְׁתּֽוּ׃
translation: He made them a feast, and they ate and drank. (Genesis 26:30)

text: תָּעִיתִי כְּשֶׂה אֹבֵד בַּקֵּשׁ עַבְדֶּךָ כִּי מִצְוֺתֶיךָ לֹא שָׁכָֽחְתִּי׃
translation: I have gone astray like a lost sheep. Seek your servant, for I don't forget your commandments. (Psalms 119:176)

text: וְשׁוֹר אוֹ שֶׂה אֹתוֹ וְאֶת בְּנוֹ לֹא תִשְׁחֲטוּ בְּיוֹם אֶחָֽד׃
translation: Whether it is a cow or ewe, you shall not kill it and its young both in one day. (Leviticus 22:28)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר אַבְרָהָם אֱלֹהִים יִרְאֶה לּוֹ הַשֶּׂה לְעֹלָה בְּנִי וַיֵּלְכוּ שְׁנֵיהֶם יַחְדָּֽו׃
translation: Abraham said, "God will provide himself the lamb for a burnt offering, my son." So they both went together. (Genesis 22:8)

text: שֶׂה תָמִים זָכָר בֶּן שָׁנָה יִהְיֶה לָכֶם מִן הַכְּבָשִׂים וּמִן הָעִזִּים תִּקָּֽחוּ׃
translation: Your lamb shall be without defect, a male a year old. You shall take it from the sheep or from the goats. (Exodus 12:5)

text: אִֽם הִמָּצֵא תִמָּצֵא בְיָדוֹ הַגְּנֵבָה מִשּׁוֹר עַד חֲמוֹר עַד שֶׂה חַיִּים שְׁנַיִם יְשַׁלֵּֽם׃
translation: If the sun has risen on him, he is guilty of bloodshed. He shall make restitution. If he has nothing, then he shall be sold for his theft. (Exodus 22:3)

text: וְכָל פֶּטֶר חֲמֹר תִּפְדֶּה בְשֶׂה וְאִם לֹא תִפְדֶּה וַעֲרַפְתּוֹ וְכֹל בְּכוֹר אָדָם בְּבָנֶיךָ תִּפְדֶּֽה׃
translation: Every firstborn of a donkey you shall redeem with a lamb; and if you will not redeem it, then you shall break its neck; and you shall redeem all the firstborn of man among your sons. (Exodus 13:13)

text: לְֽכוּ חֲזוּ מִפְעֲלוֹת יְהוָה אֲשֶׁר שָׂם שַׁמּוֹת בָּאָֽרֶץ׃
translation: He makes wars cease to the end of the earth. He breaks the bow, and shatters the spear. He burns the chariots in the fire. (Psalms 46:9)

text: וַיַּעֲבֵר יִשַׁי שַׁמָּה וַיֹּאמֶר גַּם בָּזֶה לֹא בָחַר יְהוָֽה׃
translation: Then Jesse made Shammah to pass by. He said, "The LORD has not chosen this one, either." (1 Samuel 16:9)

text: אֶפְרַיִם לְשַׁמָּה תִֽהְיֶה בְּיוֹם תּֽוֹכֵחָה בְּשִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הוֹדַעְתִּי נֶאֱמָנָֽה׃
translation: Ephraim will become a desolation in the day of rebuke. Among the tribes of Israel, I have made known that which will surely be. (Hosea 5:9)

text: שַׁמָּה הַֽהֲרָרִי אֲחִיאָם בֶּן שָׁרָר הָארָרִֽי׃
translation: Shammah the Hararite, Ahiam the son of Sharar the Ararite, (2 Samuel 23:33)

text: שַׁמָּה הַֽחֲרֹדִי אֱלִיקָא הַחֲרֹדִֽי׃
translation: Shammah the Harodite, Elika the Harodite, (2 Samuel 23:25)

text: שַׁמָּה וְשַׁעֲרוּרָה נִהְיְתָה בָּאָֽרֶץ׃
translation: "An astonishing and horrible thing has happened in the land. (Jeremiah 5:30)

text: וְאַתֶּם פְּנוּ לָכֶם וּסְעוּ הַמִּדְבָּרָה דֶּרֶךְ יַם סֽוּף׃
translation: But as for you, turn, and take your journey into the wilderness by the way to the Red Sea." (Deuteronomy 1:40)

text: וְנִעֵר פַּרְעֹה וְחֵילוֹ בְיַם סוּף כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
translation: but overthrew Pharaoh and his army in the Red Sea, for his loving kindness endures forever; (Psalms 136:15)

text: אָסֹף אָסֵף כֹּל מֵעַל פְּנֵי הָאֲדָמָה נְאֻם יְהוָֽה׃
translation: I will utterly sweep away everything from the surface of the earth, says the LORD. (Zephaniah 1:2)

text: לְגֹזֵר יַם סוּף לִגְזָרִים כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
translation: to him who divided the Red Sea apart, for his loving kindness endures forever; (Psalms 136:13)

text: וַיִּסְעוּ מִיַּם סוּף וַֽיַּחֲנוּ בְּמִדְבַּר סִֽין׃
translation: They traveled from the Red Sea, and encamped in the wilderness of Sin. (Numbers 33:11)
