text: כִּי בַּעֲלוֹתָם מִמִּצְרָיִם וַיֵּלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל בַּמִּדְבָּר עַד יַם סוּף וַיָּבֹא קָדֵֽשָׁה׃
translation: but when they came up from Egypt, and Israel went through the wilderness to the Red Sea, and came to Kadesh, (Judges 11:16)

text: אַשְׁרֵי מַשְׂכִּיל אֶל דָּל בְּיוֹם רָעָה יְֽמַלְּטֵהוּ יְהוָֽה׃
translation: The LORD will preserve him, and keep him alive. He shall be blessed on the earth, and he will not surrender him to the will of his enemies. (Psalms 41:2)

text: טֽוֹב עַיִן הוּא יְבֹרָךְ כִּֽי נָתַן מִלַּחְמוֹ לַדָּֽל׃
translation: He who has a generous eye will be blessed, for he shares his food with the poor. (Proverbs 22:9)

text: מֶלֶךְ שׁוֹפֵט בֶּֽאֱמֶת דַּלִּים כִּסְאוֹ לָעַד יִכּֽוֹן׃
translation: The king who fairly judges the poor, his throne shall be established forever. (Proverbs 29:14)

text: בָּנָיו יְרַצּוּ דַלִּים וְיָדָיו תָּשֵׁבְנָה אוֹנֽוֹ׃
translation: His children will seek the favor of the poor. His hands will give back his wealth. (Job 20:10)

text: פַּלְּטוּ דַל וְאֶבְיוֹן מִיַּד רְשָׁעִים הַצִּֽילוּ׃
translation: Rescue the weak and needy. Deliver them out of the hand of the wicked." (Psalms 82:4)

text: וְדָל לֹא תֶהְדַּר בְּרִיבֽוֹ׃
translation: You shall not favor a poor man in his cause. (Exodus 23:3)

text: אַל תּוֹסְףְּ עַל דְּבָרָיו פֶּן יוֹכִיחַ בְּךָ וְנִכְזָֽבְתָּ׃
translation: Don't you add to his words, lest he reprove you, and you be found a liar. (Proverbs 30:6)

text: עֵד כְּזָבִים יֹאבֵד וְאִישׁ שׁוֹמֵעַ לָנֶצַח יְדַבֵּֽר׃
translation: A false witness will perish. A man who listens speaks to eternity. (Proverbs 21:28)

text: אַחַת נִשְׁבַּעְתִּי בְקָדְשִׁי אִֽם לְדָוִד אֲכַזֵּֽב׃
translation: His offspring will endure forever, his throne like the sun before me. (Psalms 89:36)

text: וַיְפַתּוּהוּ בְּפִיהֶם וּבִלְשׁוֹנָם יְכַזְּבוּ לֽוֹ׃
translation: But they flattered him with their mouth, and lied to him with their tongue. (Psalms 78:36)

text: אַךְ הֶבֶל בְּנֵֽי אָדָם כָּזָב בְּנֵי אִישׁ בְּמֹאזְנַיִם לַעֲלוֹת הֵמָּה מֵהֶבֶל יָֽחַד׃
translation: Don't trust in oppression. Don't become vain in robbery. If riches increase, don't set your heart on them. (Psalms 62:10)

text: שָׁוְא וּֽדְבַר כָּזָב הַרְחֵק מִמֶּנִּי רֵאשׁ וָעֹשֶׁר אַל תִּֽתֶּן לִי הַטְרִיפֵנִי לֶחֶם חֻקִּֽי׃
translation: Remove far from me falsehood and lies. Give me neither poverty nor riches. Feed me with the food that is needful for me, (Proverbs 30:8)

text: מִקּוֹל נִתְפְּשָׂה בָבֶל נִרְעֲשָׁה הָאָרֶץ וּזְעָקָה בַּגּוֹיִם נִשְׁמָֽע׃
translation: The earth trembles at the noise of the taking of Babylon. The cry is heard among the nations. (Jeremiah 50:46)

text: הִרְעַשְׁתָּה אֶרֶץ פְּצַמְתָּהּ רְפָה שְׁבָרֶיהָ כִי מָֽטָה׃
translation: You have given a banner to those who fear you, that it may be displayed because of the truth. Selah. (Psalms 60:4)

text: רָאִיתִי הֶֽהָרִים וְהִנֵּה רֹעֲשִׁים וְכָל הַגְּבָעוֹת הִתְקַלְקָֽלוּ׃
translation: I saw the mountains, and behold, they trembled, and all the hills moved back and forth. (Jeremiah 4:24)

text: בֶּן אָדָם לַחְמְךָ בְּרַעַשׁ תֹּאכֵל וּמֵימֶיךָ בְּרָגְזָה וּבִדְאָגָה תִּשְׁתֶּֽה׃
translation: "Son of man, eat your bread with quaking, and drink your water with trembling and with fearfulness. (Ezekiel 12:18)

text: רֹאֶיךָ אֵלֶיךָ יַשְׁגִּיחוּ אֵלֶיךָ יִתְבּוֹנָנוּ הֲזֶה הָאִישׁ מַרְגִּיז הָאָרֶץ מַרְעִישׁ מַמְלָכֽוֹת׃
translation: Those who see you will stare at you. They will ponder you, saying, "Is this the man who made the earth to tremble, who shook kingdoms, (Isaiah 14:16)

text: וַתִּשָּׂאֵנִי רוּחַ וָאֶשְׁמַע אַחֲרַי קוֹל רַעַשׁ גָּדוֹל בָּרוּךְ כְּבוֹד יְהוָה מִמְּקוֹמֽוֹ׃
translation: Then the Spirit lifted me up, and I heard behind me the voice of a great rushing, saying, "Blessed be the LORD's glory from his place." (Ezekiel 3:12)

text: קָרְאוּ צוֹם וְהֹשִׁיבוּ אֶת נָבוֹת בְּרֹאשׁ הָעָֽם׃
translation: They proclaimed a fast, and set Naboth on high among the people. (1 Kings 21:12)

text: וַיִּקְחוּ אֶת עַצְמֹתֵיהֶם וַיִּקְבְּרוּ תַֽחַת הָאֶשֶׁל בְּיָבֵשָׁה וַיָּצֻמוּ שִׁבְעַת יָמִֽים׃
translation: They took their bones and buried them under the tamarisk tree in Jabesh, and fasted seven days. (1 Samuel 31:13)

text: וַתִּכְתֹּב בַּסְּפָרִים לֵאמֹר קִֽרְאוּ צוֹם וְהוֹשִׁיבוּ אֶת נָבוֹת בְּרֹאשׁ הָעָֽם׃
translation: She wrote in the letters, saying, "Proclaim a fast, and set Naboth on high among the people. (1 Kings 21:9)

text: וָאֶבְכֶּה בַצּוֹם נַפְשִׁי וַתְּהִי לַחֲרָפוֹת לִֽי׃
translation: When I made sackcloth my clothing, I became a byword to them. (Psalms 69:11)

text: בִּרְכַּי כָּשְׁלוּ מִצּוֹם וּבְשָׂרִי כָּחַשׁ מִשָּֽׁמֶן׃
translation: My knees are weak through fasting. My body is thin and lacks fat. (Psalms 109:24)

text: וַֽיַּאֲמִינוּ אַנְשֵׁי נִֽינְוֵה בֵּֽאלֹהִים וַיִּקְרְאוּ צוֹם וַיִּלְבְּשׁוּ שַׂקִּים מִגְּדוֹלָם וְעַד קְטַנָּֽם׃
translation: The people of Nineveh believed God; and they proclaimed a fast and put on sackcloth, from their greatest even to their least. (Jonah 3:5)

text: קוֹמַת הַכְּרוּב הָֽאֶחָד עֶשֶׂר בָּֽאַמָּה וְכֵן הַכְּרוּב הַשֵּׁנִֽי׃
translation: One cherub was ten cubits high, and so was the other cherub. (1 Kings 6:26)

text: וְעָשִׂיתָ שֻׁלְחָן עֲצֵי שִׁטִּים אַמָּתַיִם אָרְכּוֹ וְאַמָּה רָחְבּוֹ וְאַמָּה וָחֵצִי קֹמָתֽוֹ׃
translation: "You shall make a table of acacia wood. Its length shall be two cubits, and its width a cubit, and its height one and a half cubits. (Exodus 25:23)

text: וַיַּעַשׂ אֶת הַשֻּׁלְחָן עֲצֵי שִׁטִּים אַמָּתַיִם אָרְכּוֹ וְאַמָּה רָחְבּוֹ וְאַמָּה וָחֵצִי קֹמָתֽוֹ׃
translation: He made the table of acacia wood. Its length was two cubits, and its width was a cubit, and its height was a cubit and a half. (Exodus 37:10)

text: וַיַּעַשׂ מִזְבַּח נְחֹשֶׁת עֶשְׂרִים אַמָּה אָרְכּוֹ וְעֶשְׂרִים אַמָּה רָחְבּוֹ וְעֶשֶׂר אַמּוֹת קוֹמָתֽוֹ׃
translation: Then he made an altar of bronze, twenty cubits long, twenty cubits wide, and ten cubits high. (2 Chronicles 4:1)

text: וְעָשׂוּ אֲרוֹן עֲצֵי שִׁטִּים אַמָּתַיִם וָחֵצִי אָרְכּוֹ וְאַמָּה וָחֵצִי רָחְבּוֹ וְאַמָּה וָחֵצִי קֹמָתֽוֹ׃
translation: "They shall make an ark of acacia wood. Its length shall be two and a half cubits, its width a cubit and a half, and a cubit and a half its height. (Exodus 25:10)

text: וְהַבַּיִת אֲשֶׁר בָּנָה הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה לַֽיהוָה שִׁשִּֽׁים אַמָּה אָרְכּוֹ וְעֶשְׂרִים רָחְבּוֹ וּשְׁלֹשִׁים אַמָּה קוֹמָתֽוֹ׃
translation: The house which King Solomon built for the LORD had a length of sixty cubits, and its width twenty, and its height thirty cubits. (1 Kings 6:2)

text: וַיַּעֲמֵד שֹֽׁפְטִים בָּאָרֶץ בְּכָל עָרֵי יְהוּדָה הַבְּצֻרוֹת לְעִיר וָעִֽיר׃
translation: He set judges in the land throughout all the fortified cities of Judah, city by city, (2 Chronicles 19:5)

text: וְשִׁית עַל עָפָר בָּצֶר וּבְצוּר נְחָלִים אוֹפִֽיר׃
translation: Lay your treasure in the dust, the gold of Ophir among the stones of the brooks. (Job 22:24)

text: קְרָא אֵלַי וְאֶעֱנֶךָּ וְאַגִּידָה לְּךָ גְּדֹלוֹת וּבְצֻרוֹת לֹא יְדַעְתָּֽם׃
translation: 'Call to me, and I will answer you, and will show you great and difficult things, which you don't know.' (Jeremiah 33:3)

text: וּמִמַּטֵּה רְאוּבֵן אֶת בֶּצֶר וְאֶת מִגְרָשֶׁהָ וְאֶת יַהְצָה וְאֶת מִגְרָשֶֽׁהָ׃
translation: Out of the tribe of Reuben, Bezer with its pasture lands, Jahaz with its pasture lands, (Joshua 21:36)

text: בֶּצֶר וָהוֹד וְשַׁמָּא וְשִׁלְשָׁה וְיִתְרָן וּבְאֵרָֽא׃
translation: Bezer, Hod, Shamma, Shilshah, Ithran, and Beera. (1 Chronicles 7:37)

text: וְהָיָה שַׁדַּי בְּצָרֶיךָ וְכֶסֶף תּוֹעָפוֹת לָֽךְ׃
translation: The Almighty will be your treasure, and precious silver to you. (Job 22:25)

text: וַתֵּרֶא מַֽלְכַּת שְׁבָא אֵת חָכְמַת שְׁלֹמֹה וְהַבַּיִת אֲשֶׁר בָּנָֽה׃
translation: When the queen of Sheba had seen the wisdom of Solomon, the house that he had built, (2 Chronicles 9:3)

text: וַיָּבֹא הַמֶּלֶךְ וְהָמָן לִשְׁתּוֹת עִם אֶסְתֵּר הַמַּלְכָּֽה׃
translation: So the king and Haman came to banquet with Esther the queen. (Esther 7:1)

text: וַתֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו בַּת בְּתוּאֵל אָנֹכִי בֶּן מִלְכָּה אֲשֶׁר יָלְדָה לְנָחֽוֹר׃
translation: She said to him, "I am the daughter of Bethuel the son of Milcah, whom she bore to Nahor." (Genesis 24:24)

text: וַתֵּרֶא מַֽלְכַּת שְׁבָא אֵת כָּל חָכְמַת שְׁלֹמֹה וְהַבַּיִת אֲשֶׁר בָּנָֽה׃
translation: When the queen of Sheba had seen all the wisdom of Solomon, the house that he had built, (1 Kings 10:4)

text: וּבְתוּאֵל יָלַד אֶת רִבְקָה שְׁמֹנָה אֵלֶּה יָלְדָה מִלְכָּה לְנָחוֹר אֲחִי אַבְרָהָֽם׃
translation: Bethuel became the father of Rebekah. These eight Milcah bore to Nahor, Abraham's brother. (Genesis 22:23)

text: גַּם וַשְׁתִּי הַמַּלְכָּה עָשְׂתָה מִשְׁתֵּה נָשִׁים בֵּית הַמַּלְכוּת אֲשֶׁר לַמֶּלֶךְ אֲחַשְׁוֵרֽוֹשׁ׃
translation: Also Vashti the queen made a feast for the women in the royal house which belonged to King Ahasuerus. (Esther 1:9)

text: כָּל אֵלֶּה חָֽבְרוּ אֶל עֵמֶק הַשִּׂדִּים הוּא יָם הַמֶּֽלַח׃
translation: All these joined together in the valley of Siddim (also called the Salt Sea). (Genesis 14:3)

text: בצאתו בִּצֹּאתָיו וּגְבָאָיו וְלֹא יֵרָפְאוּ לְמֶלַח נִתָּֽנוּ׃
translation: But its swamps and marshes will not be healed. They will be given up to salt. (Ezekiel 47:11)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר קְחוּ לִי צְלֹחִית חֲדָשָׁה וְשִׂימוּ שָׁם מֶלַח וַיִּקְחוּ אֵלָֽיו׃
translation: He said, "Bring me a new jar, and put salt in it." Then they brought it to him. (2 Kings 2:20)

text: וַיְהִי לָהֶם גְּבוּל נֶגֶב מִקְצֵה יָם הַמֶּלַח מִן הַלָּשֹׁן הַפֹּנֶה נֶֽגְבָּה׃
translation: Their south border was from the uttermost part of the Salt Sea, from the bay that looks southward; (Joshua 15:2)

text: וְאַבְשַׁי בֶּן צְרוּיָה הִכָּה אֶת אֱדוֹם בְּגֵיא הַמֶּלַח שְׁמוֹנָה עָשָׂר אָֽלֶף׃
translation: Moreover Abishai the son of Zeruiah struck eighteen thousand of the Edomites in the Valley of Salt. (1 Chronicles 18:12)

text: וְהִקְרַבְתָּם לִפְנֵי יְהוָה וְהִשְׁלִיכוּ הַכֹּהֲנִים עֲלֵיהֶם מֶלַח וְהֶעֱלוּ אוֹתָם עֹלָה לַֽיהוָֽה׃
translation: You shall bring them near to the LORD, and the priests shall cast salt on them, and they shall offer them up for a burnt offering to the LORD. (Ezekiel 43:24)

text: רָאוּ אִיִּים וְיִירָאוּ קְצוֹת הָאָרֶץ יֶחֱרָדוּ קָרְבוּ וַיֶּאֱתָיֽוּן׃
translation: The islands have seen, and fear. The ends of the earth tremble. They approach, and come. (Isaiah 41:5)

text: וַיַּרְא שָׁאוּל אֶת מַחֲנֵה פְלִשְׁתִּים וַיִּרָא וַיֶּחֱרַד לִבּוֹ מְאֹֽד׃
translation: When Saul saw the army of the Philistines, he was afraid, and his heart trembled greatly. (1 Samuel 28:5)

text: וַיֶּֽחֶרְדוּ וַיָּקֻמוּ כָּל הַקְּרֻאִים אֲשֶׁר לַאֲדֹנִיָּהוּ וַיֵּלְכוּ אִישׁ לְדַרְכּֽוֹ׃
translation: All the guests of Adonijah were afraid, and rose up, and each man went his way. (1 Kings 1:49)

text: וַיְהִי בַּחֲצִי הַלַּיְלָה וַיֶּחֱרַד הָאִישׁ וַיִּלָּפֵת וְהִנֵּה אִשָּׁה שֹׁכֶבֶת מַרְגְּלֹתָֽיו׃
translation: At midnight, the man was startled and turned himself; and behold, a woman lay at his feet. (Ruth 3:8)

text: אִם יִתָּקַע שׁוֹפָר בְּעִיר וְעָם לֹא יֶחֱרָדוּ אִם תִּהְיֶה רָעָה בְּעִיר וַיהוָה לֹא עָשָֽׂה׃
translation: Does the trumpet alarm sound in a city, without the people being afraid? Does evil happen to a city, and the LORD hasn't done it? (Amos 3:6)

text: וְנָתַתִּי שָׁלוֹם בָּאָרֶץ וּשְׁכַבְתֶּם וְאֵין מַחֲרִיד וְהִשְׁבַּתִּי חַיָּה רָעָה מִן הָאָרֶץ וְחֶרֶב לֹא תַעֲבֹר בְּאַרְצְכֶֽם׃
translation: "'I will give peace in the land, and you shall lie down, and no one will make you afraid. I will remove evil animals out of the land, neither shall the sword go through your land. (Leviticus 26:6)

text: וְכֵן עָשָׂה לְכָל נָשָׁיו הַנָּכְרִיּוֹת מַקְטִירוֹת וּֽמְזַבְּחוֹת לֵאלֹהֵיהֶֽן׃
translation: So he did for all his foreign wives, who burned incense and sacrificed to their gods. (1 Kings 11:8)

text: גָּרֵי בֵיתִי וְאַמְהֹתַי לְזָר תַּחְשְׁבֻנִי נָכְרִי הָיִיתִי בְעֵינֵיהֶֽם׃
translation: Those who dwell in my house and my maids consider me a stranger. I am an alien in their sight. (Job 19:15)

text: קַח בִּגְדוֹ כִּי עָרַב זָר וּבְעַד נָכְרִיָּה חַבְלֵֽהוּ׃
translation: Take his garment when he puts up collateral for a stranger. Hold it for a wayward woman! (Proverbs 27:13)

text: פֶּֽן יִשְׂבְּעוּ זָרִים כֹּחֶךָ וַעֲצָבֶיךָ בְּבֵית נָכְרִֽי׃
translation: lest strangers feast on your wealth, and your labors enrich another man's house. (Proverbs 5:10)

text: לְֽקַח בִּגְדוֹ כִּי עָרַב זָר וּבְעַד נכרים נָכְרִיָּה חַבְלֵֽהוּ׃
translation: Take the garment of one who puts up collateral for a stranger; and hold him in pledge for a wayward woman. (Proverbs 20:16)

text: כִּֽי שׁוּחָה עֲמֻקָּה זוֹנָה וּבְאֵר צָרָה נָכְרִיָּֽה׃
translation: For a prostitute is a deep pit; and a wayward wife is a narrow well. (Proverbs 23:27)

text: וַיַּעַשׂ בְּרִיחֵי עֲצֵי שִׁטִּים חֲמִשָּׁה לְקַרְשֵׁי צֶֽלַע הַמִּשְׁכָּן הָאֶחָֽת׃
translation: He made bars of acacia wood: five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle, (Exodus 36:31)

text: בְּרוּחוֹ שָׁמַיִם שִׁפְרָה חֹֽלֲלָה יָדוֹ נָחָשׁ בָּרִֽיחַ׃
translation: By his Spirit the heavens are garnished. His hand has pierced the swift serpent. (Job 26:13)

text: כִּֽי חִזַּק בְּרִיחֵי שְׁעָרָיִךְ בֵּרַךְ בָּנַיִךְ בְּקִרְבֵּֽךְ׃
translation: For he has strengthened the bars of your gates. He has blessed your children within you. (Psalms 147:13)

text: וָאֶשְׁבֹּר עָלָיו חֻקִּי וָֽאָשִׂים בְּרִיחַ וּדְלָתָֽיִם׃
translation: marked out for it my bound, set bars and doors, (Job 38:10)

text: וּבְנֵי שְׁכַנְיָה שְׁמַעְיָה וּבְנֵי שְׁמַעְיָה חַטּוּשׁ וְיִגְאָל וּבָרִיחַ וּנְעַרְיָה וְשָׁפָט שִׁשָּֽׁה׃
translation: The son of Shecaniah: Shemaiah. The sons of Shemaiah: Hattush, Igal, Bariah, Neariah, and Shaphat, six. (1 Chronicles 3:22)

text: וַחֲמִשָּׁה בְרִיחִם לְקַרְשֵׁי צֶֽלַע הַמִּשְׁכָּן הַשֵּׁנִית וַחֲמִשָּׁה בְרִיחִם לְקַרְשֵׁי הַמִּשְׁכָּן לַיַּרְכָתַיִם יָֽמָּה׃
translation: and five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the tabernacle for the hinder part westward. (Exodus 36:32)

text: בַּחוּרֵי אָוֶן וּפִי בֶסֶת בַּחֶרֶב יִפֹּלוּ וְהֵנָּה בַּשְּׁבִי תֵלַֽכְנָה׃
translation: The young men of Aven and of Pibeseth will fall by the sword. They will go into captivity. (Ezekiel 30:17)

text: בַּחוּרָיו אָֽכְלָה אֵשׁ וּבְתוּלֹתָיו לֹא הוּלָּֽלוּ׃
translation: Fire devoured their young men. Their virgins had no wedding song. (Psalms 78:63)

text: בַּחוּרִים וְגַם בְּתוּלוֹת זְקֵנִים עִם נְעָרִֽים׃
translation: both young men and maidens, old men and children. (Psalms 148:12)

text: תִּפְאֶרֶת בַּחוּרִים כֹּחָם וַהֲדַר זְקֵנִים שֵׂיבָֽה׃
translation: The glory of young men is their strength. The splendor of old men is their gray hair. (Proverbs 20:29)

text: בַּחוּרִים טְחוֹן נָשָׂאוּ וּנְעָרִים בָּעֵץ כָּשָֽׁלוּ׃
translation: The young men carry millstones. The children stumbled under loads of wood. (Lamentations 5:13)

text: וַיֵּרֶד אָבִיהוּ אֶל הָאִשָּׁה וַיַּעַשׂ שָׁם שִׁמְשׁוֹן מִשְׁתֶּה כִּי כֵּן יַעֲשׂוּ הַבַּחוּרִֽים׃
translation: His father went down to the woman; and Samson made a feast there, for the young men used to do so. (Judges 14:10)

text: בַּיּוֹם הַחֲמִישִׁי נָשִׂיא לִבְנֵי שִׁמְעוֹן שְׁלֻֽמִיאֵל בֶּן צוּרִֽישַׁדָּֽי׃
translation: On the fifth day Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai, prince of the children of Simeon, (Numbers 7:36)

text: וְהָרְבִיעִי אֲדֹנִיָּה בֶן חַגִּית וְהַחֲמִישִׁי שְׁפַטְיָה בֶן אֲבִיטָֽל׃
translation: and the fourth, Adonijah the son of Haggith; and the fifth, Shephatiah the son of Abital; (2 Samuel 3:4)

text: וַיָּבֹא יְרוּשָׁלִַם בַּחֹדֶשׁ הַחֲמִישִׁי הִיא שְׁנַת הַשְּׁבִיעִית לַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
translation: He came to Jerusalem in the fifth month, which was in the seventh year of the king. (Ezra 7:8)

text: וַיִּשְׁמַע אֱלֹהִים אֶל לֵאָה וַתַּהַר וַתֵּלֶד לְיַעֲקֹב בֵּן חֲמִישִֽׁי׃
translation: God listened to Leah, and she conceived, and bore Jacob a fifth son. (Genesis 30:17)

text: וְאִם גָּאֹל יִגְאָלֶנָּה וְיָסַף חֲמִישִׁתוֹ עַל עֶרְכֶּֽךָ׃
translation: But if he will indeed redeem it, then he shall add the fifth part of it to its valuation. (Leviticus 27:13)

text: וַיֵּצֵא הַגּוֹרָל הַֽחֲמִישִׁי לְמַטֵּה בְנֵֽי אָשֵׁר לְמִשְׁפְּחוֹתָֽם׃
translation: The fifth lot came out for the tribe of the children of Asher according to their families. (Joshua 19:24)

text: כִּי לֹא יֵצֵא מֵעָפָר אָוֶן וּמֵאֲדָמָה לֹא יִצְמַח עָמָֽל׃
translation: For affliction doesn't come out of the dust, neither does trouble spring out of the ground; (Job 5:6)

text: עָשִׂיתִי לִי בְּרֵכוֹת מָיִם לְהַשְׁקוֹת מֵהֶם יַעַר צוֹמֵחַ עֵצִֽים׃
translation: I made myself pools of water, to water the forest where trees were grown. (Ecclesiastes 2:6)

text: הָרִֽאשֹׁנוֹת הִנֵּה בָאוּ וַֽחֲדָשׁוֹת אֲנִי מַגִּיד בְּטֶרֶם תִּצְמַחְנָה אַשְׁמִיע אֶתְכֶֽם׃
translation: Behold, the former things have happened and I declare new things. I tell you about them before they come up." (Isaiah 42:9)

text: בַּיָּמִים הָהֵם וּבָעֵת הַהִיא אַצְמִיחַ לְדָוִד צֶמַח צְדָקָה וְעָשָׂה מִשְׁפָּט וּצְדָקָה בָּאָֽרֶץ׃
translation: "In those days and at that time, I will cause a Branch of righteousness to grow up to David. He will execute justice and righteousness in the land. (Jeremiah 33:15)

text: וַֽיַּהֲפֹךְ אֶת הֶעָרִים הָאֵל וְאֵת כָּל הַכִּכָּר וְאֵת כָּל יֹשְׁבֵי הֶעָרִים וְצֶמַח הָאֲדָמָֽה׃
translation: He overthrew those cities, all the plain, all the inhabitants of the cities, and that which grew on the ground. (Genesis 19:25)

text: בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא יִֽהְיֶה צֶמַח יְהוָה לִצְבִי וּלְכָבוֹד וּפְרִי הָאָרֶץ לְגָאוֹן וּלְתִפְאֶרֶת לִפְלֵיטַת יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
translation: In that day, the LORD's branch will be beautiful and glorious, and the fruit of the land will be the beauty and glory of the survivors of Israel. (Isaiah 4:2)

text: בָּז לְרֵעֵהוּ חֲסַר לֵב וְאִישׁ תְּבוּנוֹת יַחֲרִֽישׁ׃
translation: One who despises his neighbor is void of wisdom, but a man of understanding holds his peace. (Proverbs 11:12)

text: צַדִּיק אֹכֵל לְשֹׂבַע נַפְשׁוֹ וּבֶטֶן רְשָׁעִים תֶּחְסָֽר׃
translation: The righteous one eats to the satisfying of his soul, but the belly of the wicked goes hungry. (Proverbs 13:25)

text: אָדָם חֲסַר לֵב תּוֹקֵעַ כָּף עֹרֵב עֲרֻבָּה לִפְנֵי רֵעֵֽהוּ׃
translation: A man void of understanding strikes hands, and becomes collateral in the presence of his neighbor. (Proverbs 17:18)

text: בָּטַח בָּהּ לֵב בַּעְלָהּ וְשָׁלָל לֹא יֶחְסָֽר׃
translation: The heart of her husband trusts in her. He shall have no lack of gain. (Proverbs 31:11)

text: מִהַר צֹעֶה לְהִפָּתֵחַ וְלֹא יָמוּת לַשַּׁחַת וְלֹא יֶחְסַר לַחְמֽוֹ׃
translation: The captive exile will speedily be freed. He will not die and go down into the pit. His bread won't fail. (Isaiah 51:14)

text: מִזְמוֹר לְדָוִד יְהוָה רֹעִי לֹא אֶחְסָֽר׃
translation: A Psalm by David. The LORD is my shepherd; I shall lack nothing. (Psalms 23:1)

text: עֹלַת תָּמִיד הָעֲשֻׂיָה בְּהַר סִינַי לְרֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ אִשֶּׁה לַֽיהוָֽה׃
translation: It is a continual burnt offering which was ordained in Mount Sinai for a pleasant aroma, an offering made by fire to the LORD. (Numbers 28:6)

text: וְהִקְטִירָם הַכֹּהֵן הַמִּזְבֵּחָה לֶחֶם אִשֶּׁה לְרֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ כָּל חֵלֶב לַיהוָֽה׃
translation: The priest shall burn them on the altar: it is the food of the offering made by fire, for a pleasant aroma; all the fat is the LORD's. (Leviticus 3:16)

text: קָרְבַּן רֵאשִׁית תַּקְרִיבוּ אֹתָם לַיהוָה וְאֶל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ לֹא יַעֲלוּ לְרֵיחַ נִיחֹֽחַ׃
translation: As an offering of first fruits you shall offer them to the LORD, but they shall not rise up as a pleasant aroma on the altar. (Leviticus 2:12)

text: וְהִקְטַרְתָּ אֶת כָּל הָאַיִל הַמִּזְבֵּחָה עֹלָה הוּא לַֽיהוָה רֵיחַ נִיחוֹחַ אִשֶּׁה לַיהוָה הֽוּא׃
translation: You shall burn the whole ram on the altar: it is a burnt offering to the LORD; it is a pleasant aroma, an offering made by fire to the LORD. (Exodus 29:18)

text: עַֽל מַחֲבַת בַּשֶּׁמֶן תֵּעָשֶׂה מֻרְבֶּכֶת תְּבִיאֶנָּה תֻּפִינֵי מִנְחַת פִּתִּים תַּקְרִיב רֵֽיחַ נִיחֹחַ לַיהוָֽה׃
translation: "'This is the law of the meal offering: the sons of Aaron shall offer it before the LORD, before the altar. (Leviticus 6:14)

text: וְעִשָּׂרֹן עִשָּׂרוֹן סֹלֶת מִנְחָה בְּלוּלָה בַשֶּׁמֶן לַכֶּבֶשׂ הָאֶחָד עֹלָה רֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ אִשֶּׁה לַיהוָֽה׃
translation: and one tenth part of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering to every lamb, as a burnt offering of a pleasant aroma, an offering made by fire to the LORD. (Numbers 28:13)

text: אַל תָּרִימוּ לַמָּרוֹם קַרְנְכֶם תְּדַבְּרוּ בְצַוָּאר עָתָֽק׃
translation: For neither from the east, nor from the west, nor yet from the south, comes exaltation. (Psalms 75:6)

text: וַיִּפֹּל עַל צַוְּארֵי בִנְיָמִֽן אָחִיו וַיֵּבְךְּ וּבִנְיָמִן בָּכָה עַל צַוָּארָֽיו׃
translation: He fell on his brother Benjamin's neck and wept, and Benjamin wept on his neck. (Genesis 45:14)

text: הֲתִתֵּן לַסּוּס גְּבוּרָה הֲתַלְבִּישׁ צַוָּארוֹ רַעְמָֽה׃
translation: "Have you given the horse might? Have you clothed his neck with a quivering mane? (Job 39:19)

text: בְּֽצַוָּארוֹ יָלִין עֹז וּלְפָנָיו תָּדוּץ דְּאָבָֽה׃
translation: Who can open the doors of his face? Around his teeth is terror. (Job 41:14)

text: לִבַּבְתִּנִי אֲחֹתִי כַלָּה לִבַּבְתִּינִי באחד בְּאַחַת מֵעֵינַיִךְ בְּאַחַד עֲנָק מִצַּוְּרֹנָֽיִךְ׃
translation: You have ravished my heart, my sister, my bride. You have ravished my heart with one of your eyes, with one chain of your neck. (Song of Solomon 4:9)

text: הִתְנַעֲרִי מֵעָפָר קוּמִי שְּׁבִי יְרֽוּשָׁלִָם התפתחו הִֽתְפַּתְּחִי מוֹסְרֵי צַוָּארֵךְ שְׁבִיָּה בַּת צִיּֽוֹן׃
translation: Shake yourself from the dust! Arise, sit up, Jerusalem! Release yourself from the bonds of your neck, captive daughter of Zion! (Isaiah 52:2)

text: אַל תִּתְהַדַּר לִפְנֵי מֶלֶךְ וּבִמְקוֹם גְּדֹלִים אַֽל תַּעֲמֹֽד׃
translation: Don't exalt yourself in the presence of the king, or claim a place among great men; (Proverbs 25:6)

text: יֵרָאֶה אֶל עֲבָדֶיךָ פָעֳלֶךָ וַהֲדָרְךָ עַל בְּנֵיהֶֽם׃
translation: Let your work appear to your servants, your glory to their children. (Psalms 90:16)

text: לְהוֹדִיעַ לִבְנֵי הָאָדָם גְּבוּרֹתָיו וּכְבוֹד הֲדַר מַלְכוּתֽוֹ׃
translation: to make known to the sons of men his mighty acts, the glory of the majesty of his kingdom. (Psalms 145:12)

text: הוֹד וְהָדָר לְפָנָיו עֹז וְחֶדְוָה בִּמְקֹמֽוֹ׃
translation: Honor and majesty are before him. Strength and gladness are in his place. (1 Chronicles 16:27)

text: קוֹל יְהוָה בַּכֹּחַ קוֹל יְהוָה בֶּהָדָֽר׃
translation: The LORD's voice is powerful. The LORD's voice is full of majesty. (Psalms 29:4)

text: הוֹד וְהָדָר לְפָנָיו עֹז וְתִפְאֶרֶת בְּמִקְדָּשֽׁוֹ׃
translation: Honor and majesty are before him. Strength and beauty are in his sanctuary. (Psalms 96:6)

text: וּכְכַלּוֹת לְהַעֲלוֹת כָּרְעוּ הַמֶּלֶךְ וְכָֽל הַנִּמְצְאִים אִתּוֹ וַיִּֽשְׁתַּחֲוֽוּ׃
translation: When they had finished offering, the king and all who were present with him bowed themselves and worshiped. (2 Chronicles 29:29)

text: וַיִּרְחַץ אֶת הַקֶּרֶב וְאֶת הַכְּרָעָיִם וַיַּקְטֵר עַל הָעֹלָה הַמִּזְבֵּֽחָה׃
translation: He washed the innards and the legs, and burned them on the burnt offering on the altar. (Leviticus 9:14)

text: בֹּאוּ נִשְׁתַּחֲוֶה וְנִכְרָעָה נִבְרְכָה לִֽפְנֵי יְהוָה עֹשֵֽׂנוּ׃
translation: Oh come, let's worship and bow down. Let's kneel before the LORD, our Maker, (Psalms 95:6)

text: כּוֹשֵׁל יְקִימוּן מִלֶּיךָ וּבִרְכַּיִם כֹּרְעוֹת תְּאַמֵּֽץ׃
translation: Your words have supported him who was falling, you have made the feeble knees firm. (Job 4:4)

text: וַתְּאַזְּרֵנִי חַיִל לַמִּלְחָמָה תַּכְרִיעַ קָמַי תַּחְתָּֽי׃
translation: You have also made my enemies turn their backs to me, that I might cut off those who hate me. (Psalms 18:40)

text: הֵמָּה כָּרְעוּ וְנָפָלוּ וַאֲנַחְנוּ קַּמְנוּ וַנִּתְעוֹדָֽד׃
translation: Save, LORD! Let the King answer us when we call! (Psalms 20:9)

text: וְהִכֵּיתִי קַשְׁתְּךָ מִיַּד שְׂמֹאולֶךָ וְחִצֶּיךָ מִיַּד יְמִינְךָ אַפִּֽיל׃
translation: I will strike your bow out of your left hand, and will cause your arrows to fall out of your right hand. (Ezekiel 39:3)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ אֱלִישָׁע קַח קֶשֶׁת וְחִצִּים וַיִּקַּח אֵלָיו קֶשֶׁת וְחִצִּֽים׃
translation: Elisha said to him, "Take bow and arrows;" and he took bow and arrows for himself. (2 Kings 13:15)

text: נֹשְׁקֵי קֶשֶׁת מַיְמִינִים וּמַשְׂמִאלִים בָּֽאֲבָנִים וּבַחִצִּים בַּקָּשֶׁת מֵאֲחֵי שָׁאוּל מִבִּנְיָמִֽן׃
translation: They were armed with bows, and could use both the right hand and the left in slinging stones and in shooting arrows from the bow. They were of Saul's relatives of the tribe of Benjamin. (1 Chronicles 12:2)

text: יִמָּאֲסוּ כְמוֹ מַיִם יִתְהַלְּכוּ לָמוֹ יִדְרֹךְ חצו חִצָּיו כְּמוֹ יִתְמֹלָֽלוּ׃
translation: Let them be like a snail which melts and passes away, like the stillborn child, who has not seen the sun. (Psalms 58:8)

text: כִּי חִצֵּי שַׁדַּי עִמָּדִי אֲשֶׁר חֲמָתָם שֹׁתָה רוּחִי בִּעוּתֵי אֱלוֹהַּ יַֽעַרְכֽוּנִי׃
translation: For the arrows of the Almighty are within me. My spirit drinks up their poison. The terrors of God set themselves in array against me. (Job 6:4)

text: וַֽיהוָה עֲלֵיהֶם יֵֽרָאֶה וְיָצָא כַבָּרָק חִצּוֹ וַֽאדֹנָי יְהֹוִה בַּשּׁוֹפָר יִתְקָע וְהָלַךְ בְּסַעֲרוֹת תֵּימָֽן׃
translation: The LORD will be seen over them. His arrow will flash like lightning. The Lord GOD will blow the trumpet, and will go with whirlwinds of the south. (Zechariah 9:14)

text: פֶּן יֹאמַר אֹיְבִי יְכָלְתִּיו צָרַי יָגִילוּ כִּי אֶמּֽוֹט׃
translation: But I trust in your loving kindness. My heart rejoices in your salvation. (Psalms 13:5)

text: כִּֽי הַמֶּלֶךְ בֹּטֵחַ בַּיהוָה וּבְחֶסֶד עֶלְיוֹן בַּל יִמּֽוֹט׃
translation: Your hand will find out all of your enemies. Your right hand will find out those who hate you. (Psalms 21:8)

text: אֱלֹהִים בְּקִרְבָּהּ בַּל תִּמּוֹט יַעְזְרֶהָ אֱלֹהִים לִפְנוֹת בֹּֽקֶר׃
translation: The nations raged. The kingdoms were moved. He lifted his voice and the earth melted. (Psalms 46:6)

text: כִּֽי לְעוֹלָם לֹא יִמּוֹט לְזֵכֶר עוֹלָם יִהְיֶה צַדִּֽיק׃
translation: For he will never be shaken. The righteous will be remembered forever. (Psalms 112:6)

text: צַדִּיק לְעוֹלָם בַּל יִמּוֹט וּרְשָׁעִים לֹא יִשְׁכְּנוּ אָֽרֶץ׃
translation: The righteous will never be removed, but the wicked will not dwell in the land. (Proverbs 10:30)

text: מַפְּלֵי בְשָׂרוֹ דָבֵקוּ יָצוּק עָלָיו בַּל יִמּֽוֹט׃
translation: Strong scales are his pride, shut up together with a close seal. (Job 41:15)

text: פַּעַם בַּחוּץ פַּעַם בָּרְחֹבוֹת וְאֵצֶל כָּל פִּנָּה תֶאֱרֹֽב׃
translation: Now she is in the streets, now in the squares, and lurking at every corner. (Proverbs 7:12)

text: וְעַתָּה קוּם לַיְלָה אַתָּה וְהָעָם אֲשֶׁר אִתָּךְ וֶאֱרֹב בַּשָּׂדֶֽה׃
translation: Now therefore, go up by night, you and the people who are with you, and lie in wait in the field. (Judges 9:32)

text: ויצו וַיְצַוּוּ אֶת בְּנֵי בִנְיָמִן לֵאמֹר לְכוּ וַאֲרַבְתֶּם בַּכְּרָמִֽים׃
translation: They commanded the children of Benjamin, saying, "Go and lie in wait in the vineyards, (Judges 21:20)

text: דִּבְרֵי רְשָׁעִים אֱרָב דָּם וּפִי יְשָׁרִים יַצִּילֵֽם׃
translation: The words of the wicked are about lying in wait for blood, but the speech of the upright rescues them. (Proverbs 12:6)

text: אַף הִיא כְּחֶתֶף תֶּֽאֱרֹב וּבוֹגְדִים בְּאָדָם תּוֹסִֽף׃
translation: Yes, she lies in wait like a robber, and increases the unfaithful among men. (Proverbs 23:28)

text: וְאַתֶּם תָּקֻמוּ מֵהָאוֹרֵב וְהוֹרַשְׁתֶּם אֶת הָעִיר וּנְתָנָהּ יְהוָה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶם בְּיֶדְכֶֽם׃
translation: and you shall rise up from the ambush, and take possession of the city; for the LORD your God will deliver it into your hand. (Joshua 8:7)

text: לֹא יִכּוֹן אָדָם בְּרֶשַׁע וְשֹׁרֶשׁ צַדִּיקִים בַּל יִמּֽוֹט׃
translation: A man shall not be established by wickedness, but the root of the righteous shall not be moved. (Proverbs 12:3)

text: אִם יַזְקִין בָּאָרֶץ שָׁרְשׁוֹ וּבֶעָפָר יָמוּת גִּזְעֽוֹ׃
translation: Though its root grows old in the earth, and its stock dies in the ground, (Job 14:8)

text: כִּי תֹאמְרוּ מַה נִּרְדָּף לוֹ וְשֹׁרֶשׁ דָּבָר נִמְצָא בִֽי׃
translation: If you say, 'How we will persecute him!' because the root of the matter is found in me, (Job 19:28)

text: הַקֹּטְפִים מַלּוּחַ עֲלֵי שִׂיחַ וְשֹׁרֶשׁ רְתָמִים לַחְמָֽם׃
translation: They pluck salt herbs by the bushes. The roots of the broom tree are their food. (Job 30:4)

text: כִּי אֵשׁ הִיא עַד אֲבַדּוֹן תֹּאכֵל וּֽבְכָל תְּבוּאָתִי תְשָׁרֵֽשׁ׃
translation: for it is a fire that consumes to destruction, and would root out all my increase. (Job 31:12)

text: הֵן פָּרַשׂ עָלָיו אוֹרוֹ וְשָׁרְשֵׁי הַיָּם כִּסָּֽה׃
translation: Behold, he spreads his light around him. He covers the bottom of the sea. (Job 36:30)

text: וְכָל דָּם לֹא תֹאכְלוּ בְּכֹל מוֹשְׁבֹתֵיכֶם לָעוֹף וְלַבְּהֵמָֽה׃
translation: You shall not eat any blood, whether it is of bird or of animal, in any of your dwellings. (Leviticus 7:26)

text: וְהָיוּ אֵלֶּה לָכֶם לְחֻקַּת מִשְׁפָּט לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶם בְּכֹל מוֹשְׁבֹתֵיכֶֽם׃
translation: "'These things shall be for a statute and ordinance to you throughout your generations in all your dwellings. (Numbers 35:29)

text: וַֽיְהִי מוֹשָׁבָם מִמֵּשָׁא בֹּאֲכָה סְפָרָה הַר הַקֶּֽדֶם׃
translation: Their dwelling extended from Mesha, as you go toward Sephar, the mountain of the east. (Genesis 10:30)

text: לֹא תְבַעֲרוּ אֵשׁ בְּכֹל מֹשְׁבֹֽתֵיכֶם בְּיוֹם הַשַּׁבָּֽת׃
translation: You shall kindle no fire throughout your habitations on the Sabbath day.'" (Exodus 35:3)

text: כָּל מְלָאכָה לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ חֻקַּת עוֹלָם לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶם בְּכֹל מֹֽשְׁבֹֽתֵיכֶֽם׃
translation: You shall do no kind of work: it is a statute forever throughout your generations in all your dwellings. (Leviticus 23:31)

text: בְּצֵאתִי שַׁעַר עֲלֵי קָרֶת בָּרְחוֹב אָכִין מוֹשָׁבִֽי׃
translation: when I went out to the city gate, when I prepared my seat in the street. (Job 29:7)

text: וּלְאַבְרָם הֵיטִיב בַּעֲבוּרָהּ וַֽיְהִי לוֹ צֹאן וּבָקָר וַחֲמֹרִים וַעֲבָדִים וּשְׁפָחֹת וַאֲתֹנֹת וּגְמַלִּֽים׃
translation: He dealt well with Abram for her sake. He had sheep, cattle, male donkeys, male servants, female servants, female donkeys, and camels. (Genesis 12:16)

text: וּמַלְאָךְ בָּא אֶל אִיּוֹב וַיֹּאמַר הַבָּקָר הָיוּ חֹֽרְשׁוֹת וְהָאֲתֹנוֹת רֹעוֹת עַל יְדֵיהֶֽם׃
translation: that a messenger came to Job, and said, "The oxen were plowing, and the donkeys feeding beside them, (Job 1:14)

text: וַיִּפְתַּח יְהוָה אֶת פִּי הָאָתוֹן וַתֹּאמֶר לְבִלְעָם מֶה עָשִׂיתִֽי לְךָ כִּי הִכִּיתַנִי זֶה שָׁלֹשׁ רְגָלִֽים׃
translation: The LORD opened the mouth of the donkey, and she said to Balaam, "What have I done to you, that you have struck me these three times?" (Numbers 22:28)

text: וַֽתַּחֲבֹשׁ הָֽאָתוֹן וַתֹּאמֶר אֶֽל נַעֲרָהּ נְהַג וָלֵךְ אַל תַּעֲצָר לִי לִרְכֹּב כִּי אִם אָמַרְתִּי לָֽךְ׃
translation: Then she saddled a donkey, and said to her servant, "Drive, and go forward! Don't slow down for me, unless I ask you to." (2 Kings 4:24)

text: וּלְאָבִיו שָׁלַח כְּזֹאת עֲשָׂרָה חֲמֹרִים נֹשְׂאִים מִטּוּב מִצְרָיִם וְעֶשֶׂר אֲתֹנֹת נֹֽשְׂאֹת בָּר וָלֶחֶם וּמָזוֹן לְאָבִיו לַדָּֽרֶךְ׃
translation: He sent the following to his father: ten donkeys loaded with the good things of Egypt, and ten female donkeys loaded with grain and bread and provision for his father by the way. (Genesis 45:23)

text: וַתֵּרֶא הָאָתוֹן אֶת מַלְאַךְ יְהוָה וַתִּלָּחֵץ אֶל הַקִּיר וַתִּלְחַץ אֶת רֶגֶל בִּלְעָם אֶל הַקִּיר וַיֹּסֶף לְהַכֹּתָֽהּ׃
translation: The donkey saw the LORD's angel, and she thrust herself to the wall, and crushed Balaam's foot against the wall. He struck her again. (Numbers 22:25)

text: אִם אַתָּה תְּשַׁחֵר אֶל אֵל וְאֶל שַׁדַּי תִּתְחַנָּֽן׃
translation: If you want to seek God diligently, make your supplication to the Almighty. (Job 8:5)

text: הְֽמִיָּמֶיךָ צִוִּיתָ בֹּקֶר ידעתה שחר יִדַּעְתָּה הַשַּׁחַר מְקֹמֽוֹ׃
translation: "Have you commanded the morning in your days, and caused the dawn to know its place, (Job 38:12)

text: אָז יִקְרָאֻנְנִי וְלֹא אֶֽעֱנֶה יְשַׁחֲרֻנְנִי וְלֹא יִמְצָאֻֽנְנִי׃
translation: Then they will call on me, but I will not answer. They will seek me diligently, but they will not find me, (Proverbs 1:28)

text: עַל כֵּן יָצָאתִי לִקְרָאתֶךָ לְשַׁחֵר פָּנֶיךָ וָאֶמְצָאֶֽךָּ׃
translation: Therefore I came out to meet you, to diligently seek your face, and I have found you. (Proverbs 7:15)

text: שֹׁחֵֽר טוֹב יְבַקֵּשׁ רָצוֹן וְדֹרֵשׁ רָעָה תְבוֹאֶֽנּוּ׃
translation: He who diligently seeks good seeks favor, but he who searches after evil, it shall come to him. (Proverbs 11:27)

text: חוֹשֵׂךְ שִׁבְטוֹ שׂוֹנֵא בְנוֹ וְאֹהֲבוֹ שִֽׁחֲרוֹ מוּסָֽר׃
translation: One who spares the rod hates his son, but one who loves him is careful to discipline him. (Proverbs 13:24)

text: וְנִקָּה הָאִישׁ מֵעָוֺן וְהָאִשָּׁה הַהִוא תִּשָּׂא אֶת עֲוֺנָֽהּ׃
translation: The man shall be free from iniquity, and that woman shall bear her iniquity.'" (Numbers 5:31)

text: יָד לְיָד לֹא יִנָּקֶה רָּע וְזֶרַע צַדִּיקִים נִמְלָֽט׃
translation: Most certainly, the evil man will not be unpunished, but the offspring of the righteous will be delivered. (Proverbs 11:21)

text: וְאִם לֹא נִטְמְאָה הָֽאִשָּׁה וּטְהֹרָה הִוא וְנִקְּתָה וְנִזְרְעָה זָֽרַע׃
translation: If the woman isn't defiled, but is clean; then she shall be free, and shall conceive offspring. (Numbers 5:28)

text: תּוֹעֲבַת יְהוָה כָּל גְּבַהּ לֵב יָד לְיָד לֹא יִנָּקֶֽה׃
translation: Everyone who is proud in heart is an abomination to the LORD; they shall certainly not be unpunished. (Proverbs 16:5)

text: אִם חָטָאתִי וּשְׁמַרְתָּנִי וּמֵעֲוֺנִי לֹא תְנַקֵּֽנִי׃
translation: if I sin, then you mark me. You will not acquit me from my iniquity. (Job 10:14)

text: כֵּן הַבָּא אֶל אֵשֶׁת רֵעֵהוּ לֹא יִנָּקֶה כָּֽל הַנֹּגֵעַ בָּֽהּ׃
translation: So is he who goes in to his neighbor's wife. Whoever touches her will not be unpunished. (Proverbs 6:29)

text: וְכַנָּה אֲשֶׁר נָטְעָה יְמִינֶךָ וְעַל בֵּן אִמַּצְתָּה לָּֽךְ׃
translation: It's burned with fire. It's cut down. They perish at your rebuke. (Psalms 80:16)

text: וַתֵּרֶא כִּֽי מִתְאַמֶּצֶת הִיא לָלֶכֶת אִתָּהּ וַתֶּחְדַּל לְדַבֵּר אֵלֶֽיהָ׃
translation: When Naomi saw that she was determined to go with her, she stopped urging her. (Ruth 1:18)

text: יַצִּילֵנִי מֵאֹיְבִי עָז מִשֹּׂנְאַי כִּי אָמְצוּ מִמֶּֽנִּי׃
translation: He delivered me from my strong enemy, from those who hated me, for they were too mighty for me. (2 Samuel 22:18)

text: וְיֹאחֵז צַדִּיק דַּרְכּוֹ וּֽטֳהָר יָדַיִם יֹסִיף אֹֽמֶץ׃
translation: Yet the righteous will hold to his way. He who has clean hands will grow stronger and stronger. (Job 17:9)

text: יַצִּילֵנִי מֵאֹיְבִי עָז וּמִשֹּׂנְאַי כִּֽי אָמְצוּ מִמֶּֽנִּי׃
translation: They came on me in the day of my calamity, but the LORD was my support. (Psalms 18:18)

text: קַוֵּה אֶל יְהוָה חֲזַק וְיַאֲמֵץ לִבֶּךָ וְקַוֵּה אֶל יְהוָֽה׃
translation: Wait for the LORD. Be strong, and let your heart take courage. Yes, wait for the LORD. (Psalms 27:14)

text: בַּמֶּרְכָּבָה הָרִֽאשֹׁנָה סוּסִים אֲדֻמִּים וּבַמֶּרְכָּבָה הַשֵּׁנִית סוּסִים שְׁחֹרִֽים׃
translation: In the first chariot were red horses. In the second chariot were black horses. (Zechariah 6:2)

text: וְהָיָה בַיּוֹם הַהוּא נְאֻם יְהוָה וְהִכְרַתִּי סוּסֶיךָ מִקִּרְבֶּךָ וְהַאֲבַדְתִּי מַרְכְּבֹתֶֽיךָ׃
translation: Let your hand be lifted up above your adversaries, and let all of your enemies be cut off. (Micah 5:9)

text: וַֽיְהִי מֵאַחֲרֵי כֵן וַיַּעַשׂ לוֹ אַבְשָׁלוֹם מֶרְכָּבָה וְסֻסִים וַחֲמִשִּׁים אִישׁ רָצִים לְפָנָֽיו׃
translation: After this, Absalom prepared a chariot and horses for himself, and fifty men to run before him. (2 Samuel 15:1)

text: וַתִּמָּלֵא אַרְצוֹ כֶּסֶף וְזָהָב וְאֵין קֵצֶה לְאֹצְרֹתָיו וַתִּמָּלֵא אַרְצוֹ סוּסִים וְאֵין קֵצֶה לְמַרְכְּבֹתָֽיו׃
translation: Their land is full of silver and gold, neither is there any end of their treasures. Their land also is full of horses, neither is there any end of their chariots. (Isaiah 2:7)

text: וַיַּעַשׂ לָהֶם יְהוֹשֻׁעַ כַּאֲשֶׁר אָֽמַר לוֹ יְהוָה אֶת סוּסֵיהֶם עִקֵּר וְאֶת מַרְכְּבֹתֵיהֶם שָׂרַף בָּאֵֽשׁ׃
translation: Joshua did to them as the LORD told him. He hamstrung their horses and burned their chariots with fire. (Joshua 11:9)

text: וַיִּרְדֹּף גֵּיחֲזִי אַחֲרֵי נַֽעֲמָן וַיִּרְאֶה נַֽעֲמָן רָץ אַחֲרָיו וַיִּפֹּל מֵעַל הַמֶּרְכָּבָה לִקְרָאתוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר הֲשָׁלֽוֹם׃
translation: So Gehazi followed after Naaman. When Naaman saw one running after him, he came down from the chariot to meet him, and said, "Is all well?" (2 Kings 5:21)

text: וַיַּעַן מֶֽלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֹּאמֶר דַּבְּרוּ אַל יִתְהַלֵּל חֹגֵר כִּמְפַתֵּֽחַ׃
translation: The king of Israel answered, "Tell him, 'Don't let him who puts on his armor brag like he who takes it off.'" (1 Kings 20:11)

text: כִּֽי חֲמַת אָדָם תּוֹדֶךָּ שְׁאֵרִית חֵמֹת תַּחְגֹּֽר׃
translation: Make vows to the LORD your God, and fulfill them! Let all of his neighbors bring presents to him who is to be feared. (Psalms 76:11)

text: אֱלִי כִּבְתוּלָה חֲגֻֽרַת שַׂק עַל בַּעַל נְעוּרֶֽיהָ׃
translation: Mourn like a virgin dressed in sackcloth for the husband of her youth! (Joel 1:8)

text: חָֽגְרָה בְעוֹז מָתְנֶיהָ וַתְּאַמֵּץ זְרֹעוֹתֶֽיהָ׃
translation: She arms her waist with strength, and makes her arms strong. (Proverbs 31:17)

text: וַיִּסְעוּ מִשָּׁם מִמִּשְׁפַּחַת הַדָּנִי מִצָּרְעָה וּמֵאֶשְׁתָּאֹל שֵֽׁשׁ מֵאוֹת אִישׁ חָגוּר כְּלֵי מִלְחָמָֽה׃
translation: The family of the Danites set out from Zorah and Eshtaol with six hundred men armed with weapons of war. (Judges 18:11)

text: וְשֵׁשׁ מֵאוֹת אִישׁ חֲגוּרִים כְּלֵי מִלְחַמְתָּם נִצָּבִים פֶּתַח הַשָּׁעַר אֲשֶׁר מִבְּנֵי דָֽן׃
translation: The six hundred men armed with their weapons of war, who were of the children of Dan, stood by the entrance of the gate. (Judges 18:16)

text: הֵן יַהֲרוֹס וְלֹא יִבָּנֶה יִסְגֹּר עַל אִישׁ וְלֹא יִפָּתֵֽחַ׃
translation: Behold, he breaks down, and it can't be built again. He imprisons a man, and there can be no release. (Job 12:14)

text: בְּבִרְכַּת יְשָׁרִים תָּרוּם קָרֶת וּבְפִי רְשָׁעִים תֵּהָרֵֽס׃
translation: By the blessing of the upright, the city is exalted, but it is overthrown by the mouth of the wicked. (Proverbs 11:11)

text: מֶלֶךְ בְּמִשְׁפָּט יַעֲמִיד אָרֶץ וְאִישׁ תְּרוּמוֹת יֶֽהֶרְסֶֽנָּה׃
translation: The king by justice makes the land stable, but he who takes bribes tears it down. (Proverbs 29:4)

text: כִּי הַשָּׁתוֹת יֵֽהָרֵסוּן צַדִּיק מַה פָּעָֽל׃
translation: If the foundations are destroyed, what can the righteous do? (Psalms 11:3)

text: וְהִנֵּה עָלָה כֻלּוֹ קִמְּשֹׂנִים כָּסּוּ פָנָיו חֲרֻלִּים וְגֶדֶר אֲבָנָיו נֶהֱרָֽסָה׃
translation: Behold, it was all grown over with thorns. Its surface was covered with nettles, and its stone wall was broken down. (Proverbs 24:31)

text: מִֽהֲרוּ בָּנָיִךְ מְהָֽרְסַיִךְ וּמַחֲרִבַיִךְ מִמֵּךְ יֵצֵֽאוּ׃
translation: Your children hurry. Your destroyers and those who devastated you will leave you. (Isaiah 49:17)

text: יְהִי לְמַלֵּא בִטְנוֹ יְֽשַׁלַּח בּוֹ חֲרוֹן אַפּוֹ וְיַמְטֵר עָלֵימוֹ בִּלְחוּמֽוֹ׃
translation: When he is about to fill his belly, God will cast the fierceness of his wrath on him. It will rain on him while he is eating. (Job 20:23)

text: אָז יְדַבֵּר אֵלֵימוֹ בְאַפּוֹ וּֽבַחֲרוֹנוֹ יְבַהֲלֵֽמוֹ׃
translation: Then he will speak to them in his anger, and terrify them in his wrath: (Psalms 2:5)

text: שְׁפָךְ עֲלֵיהֶם זַעְמֶךָ וַחֲרוֹן אַפְּךָ יַשִּׂיגֵֽם׃
translation: Let their habitation be desolate. Let no one dwell in their tents. (Psalms 69:25)

text: צְאוּ מִתּוֹכָהּ עַמִּי וּמַלְּטוּ אִישׁ אֶת נַפְשׁוֹ מֵחֲרוֹן אַף יְהוָֽה׃
translation: "My people, go away from the middle of her, and each of you save yourselves from the LORD's fierce anger. (Jeremiah 51:45)

text: מִֽי יוֹדֵעַ יָשׁוּב וְנִחַם הָאֱלֹהִים וְשָׁב מֵחֲרוֹן אַפּוֹ וְלֹא נֹאבֵֽד׃
translation: Who knows whether God will not turn and relent, and turn away from his fierce anger, so that we might not perish?" (Jonah 3:9)

text: עָלַי עָבְרוּ חֲרוֹנֶיךָ בִּעוּתֶיךָ צִמְּתוּתֻֽנִי׃
translation: They came around me like water all day long. They completely engulfed me. (Psalms 88:17)

text: בְּרָן יַחַד כּוֹכְבֵי בֹקֶר וַיָּרִיעוּ כָּל בְּנֵי אֱלֹהִֽים׃
translation: when the morning stars sang together, and all the sons of God shouted for joy? (Job 38:7)

text: כָּֽל הָעַמִּים תִּקְעוּ כָף הָרִיעוּ לֵאלֹהִים בְּקוֹל רִנָּֽה׃
translation: For the LORD Most High is awesome. He is a great King over all the earth. (Psalms 47:2)

text: לַמְנַצֵּחַ שִׁיר מִזְמוֹר הָרִיעוּ לֵאלֹהִים כָּל הָאָֽרֶץ׃
translation: For the Chief Musician. A song. A Psalm. Make a joyful shout to God, all the earth! (Psalms 66:1)

text: וּבְהַקְהִיל אֶת הַקָּהָל תִּתְקְעוּ וְלֹא תָרִֽיעוּ׃
translation: But when the assembly is to be gathered together, you shall blow, but you shall not sound an alarm. (Numbers 10:7)

text: בְּזֹאת יָדַעְתִּי כִּֽי חָפַצְתָּ בִּי כִּי לֹֽא יָרִיעַ אֹיְבִי עָלָֽי׃
translation: As for me, you uphold me in my integrity, and set me in your presence forever. (Psalms 41:12)

text: הַרְנִינוּ לֵאלֹהִים עוּזֵּנוּ הָרִיעוּ לֵאלֹהֵי יַעֲקֹֽב׃
translation: Raise a song, and bring here the tambourine, the pleasant lyre with the harp. (Psalms 81:2)

text: וִיהוֹיָדָע הַנָּגִיד לְאַהֲרֹן וְעִמּוֹ שְׁלֹשֶׁת אֲלָפִים וּשְׁבַע מֵאֽוֹת׃
translation: and Zadok, a young man mighty of valor, and of his father's house twenty-two captains. (1 Chronicles 12:28)

text: וַיִּוָּעַץ דָּוִיד עִם שָׂרֵי הָאֲלָפִים וְהַמֵּאוֹת לְכָל נָגִֽיד׃
translation: David consulted with the captains of thousands and of hundreds, even with every leader. (1 Chronicles 13:1)

text: וּשְׁבֻאֵל בֶּן גֵּרְשׁוֹם בֶּן מֹשֶׁה נָגִיד עַל הָאֹצָרֽוֹת׃
translation: Shebuel the son of Gershom, the son of Moses, was ruler over the treasuries. (1 Chronicles 26:24)

text: וּזְרֹעוֹת הַשֶּׁטֶף יִשָּׁטְפוּ מִלְּפָנָיו וְיִשָּׁבֵרוּ וְגַם נְגִיד בְּרִֽית׃
translation: The overwhelming forces will be overwhelmed from before him, and will be broken. Yes, also the prince of the covenant. (Daniel 11:22)

text: וּפִֽינְחָס בֶּן אֶלְעָזָר נָגִיד הָיָה עֲלֵיהֶם לְפָנִים יְהוָה עִמּֽוֹ׃
translation: Phinehas the son of Eleazar was ruler over them in time past, and the LORD was with him. (1 Chronicles 9:20)

text: הֵן עֵד לְאוּמִּים נְתַתִּיו נָגִיד וּמְצַוֵּה לְאֻמִּֽים׃
translation: Behold, I have given him for a witness to the peoples, a leader and commander to the peoples. (Isaiah 55:4)

text: וַיְהִי כְּשָׁמְעָם אֶת הַתּוֹרָה וַיַּבְדִּילוּ כָל עֵרֶב מִיִּשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
translation: It came to pass, when they had heard the law, that they separated all the mixed multitude from Israel. (Nehemiah 13:3)

text: וְהִבְדַּלְתָּ אֶת הַלְוִיִּם מִתּוֹךְ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְהָיוּ לִי הַלְוִיִּֽם׃
translation: Thus you shall separate the Levites from among the children of Israel, and the Levites shall be mine. (Numbers 8:14)

text: אָז יַבְדִּיל מֹשֶׁה שָׁלֹשׁ עָרִים בְּעֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן מִזְרְחָה שָֽׁמֶשׁ׃
translation: Then Moses set apart three cities beyond the Jordan toward the sunrise, (Deuteronomy 4:41)

text: עַל כֵּן אָנֹכִי מְצַוְּךָ לֵאמֹר שָׁלֹשׁ עָרִים תַּבְדִּיל לָֽךְ׃
translation: Therefore I command you to set apart three cities for yourselves. (Deuteronomy 19:7)

text: וָאַבְדִּילָה מִשָּׂרֵי הַכֹּהֲנִים שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר לְשֵׁרֵֽבְיָה חֲשַׁבְיָה וְעִמָּהֶם מֵאֲחֵיהֶם עֲשָׂרָֽה׃
translation: Then I set apart twelve of the chiefs of the priests, even Sherebiah, Hashabiah, and ten of their brothers with them, (Ezra 8:24)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֱלֹהִים יְהִי רָקִיעַ בְּתוֹךְ הַמָּיִם וִיהִי מַבְדִּיל בֵּין מַיִם לָמָֽיִם׃
translation: God said, "Let there be an expanse in the middle of the waters, and let it divide the waters from the waters." (Genesis 1:6)

text: אִם אֶרְאֶה אוֹר כִּי יָהֵל וְיָרֵחַ יָקָר הֹלֵֽךְ׃
translation: if I have seen the sun when it shined, or the moon moving in splendor, (Job 31:26)

text: יִֽפְרַח בְּיָמָיו צַדִּיק וְרֹב שָׁלוֹם עַד בְּלִי יָרֵֽחַ׃
translation: In his days, the righteous shall flourish, and abundance of peace, until the moon is no more. (Psalms 72:7)

text: כֵּן הָנְחַלְתִּי לִי יַרְחֵי שָׁוְא וְלֵילוֹת עָמָל מִנּוּ לִֽי׃
translation: so I am made to possess months of misery, wearisome nights are appointed to me. (Job 7:3)

text: מִֽי יִתְּנֵנִי כְיַרְחֵי קֶדֶם כִּימֵי אֱלוֹהַּ יִשְׁמְרֵֽנִי׃
translation: "Oh that I were as in the months of old, as in the days when God watched over me; (Job 29:2)

text: יִֽירָאוּךָ עִם שָׁמֶשׁ וְלִפְנֵי יָרֵחַ דּוֹר דּוֹרִֽים׃
translation: They shall fear you while the sun endures; and as long as the moon, throughout all generations. (Psalms 72:5)

text: כְּיָרֵחַ יִכּוֹן עוֹלָם וְעֵד בַּשַּׁחַק נֶאֱמָן סֶֽלָה׃
translation: But you have rejected and spurned. You have been angry with your anointed. (Psalms 89:38)

text: וַיְבִיאֵהוּ לְבֵיתוֹ וַיָּבָול לַחֲמוֹרִים וַֽיִּרְחֲצוּ רַגְלֵיהֶם וַיֹּאכְלוּ וַיִּשְׁתּֽוּ׃
translation: So he brought him into his house, and gave the donkeys fodder. Then they washed their feet, and ate and drank. (Judges 19:21)

text: וְאִם מִנְחָה עַל הַֽמַּחֲבַת קָרְבָּנֶךָ סֹלֶת בְּלוּלָה בַשֶּׁמֶן מַצָּה תִהְיֶֽה׃
translation: If your offering is a meal offering made on a griddle, it shall be of unleavened fine flour, mixed with oil. (Leviticus 2:5)

text: הָבָה נֵֽרְדָה וְנָבְלָה שָׁם שְׂפָתָם אֲשֶׁר לֹא יִשְׁמְעוּ אִישׁ שְׂפַת רֵעֵֽהוּ׃
translation: Come, let's go down, and there confuse their language, that they may not understand one another's speech." (Genesis 11:7)

text: וְכָל מִנְחָה בְלוּלָֽה בַשֶּׁמֶן וַחֲרֵבָה לְכָל בְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן תִּהְיֶה אִישׁ כְּאָחִֽיו׃
translation: Every meal offering, mixed with oil or dry, belongs to all the sons of Aaron, one as well as another. (Leviticus 7:10)

text: וְהִקְרִיב הַמַּקְרִיב קָרְבָּנוֹ לַֽיהוָה מִנְחָה סֹלֶת עִשָּׂרוֹן בָּלוּל בִּרְבִעִית הַהִין שָֽׁמֶן׃
translation: then he who offers his offering shall offer to the LORD a meal offering of one tenth of an ephah of fine flour mixed with one fourth of a hin of oil. (Numbers 15:4)

text: אוֹ לָאַיִל תַּעֲשֶׂה מִנְחָה סֹלֶת שְׁנֵי עֶשְׂרֹנִים בְּלוּלָה בַשֶּׁמֶן שְׁלִשִׁית הַהִֽין׃
translation: "'For a ram, you shall prepare for a meal offering two tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with the third part of a hin of oil; (Numbers 15:6)

text: עַד אָנָה תְּשִׂימוּן קִנְצֵי לְמִלִּין תָּבִינוּ וְאַחַר נְדַבֵּֽר׃
translation: "How long will you hunt for words? Consider, and afterwards we will speak. (Job 18:2)

text: וַיָּשָׁב אֶל אֶחָיו וַיֹּאמַר הַיֶּלֶד אֵינֶנּוּ וַאֲנִי אָנָה אֲנִי בָֽא׃
translation: He returned to his brothers, and said, "The child is no more; and I, where will I go?" (Genesis 37:30)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה עַד אָנָה מֵֽאַנְתֶּם לִשְׁמֹר מִצְוֺתַי וְתוֹרֹתָֽי׃
translation: The LORD said to Moses, "How long do you refuse to keep my commandments and my laws? (Exodus 16:28)

text: אָנָה אֵלֵךְ מֵרוּחֶךָ וְאָנָה מִפָּנֶיךָ אֶבְרָֽח׃
translation: Where could I go from your Spirit? Or where could I flee from your presence? (Psalms 139:7)

text: אָנָה הָלַךְ דּוֹדֵךְ הַיָּפָה בַּנָּשִׁים אָנָה פָּנָה דוֹדֵךְ וּנְבַקְשֶׁנּוּ עִמָּֽךְ׃
translation: Where has your beloved gone, you fairest among women? Where has your beloved turned, that we may seek him with you? (Song of Solomon 6:1)

text: וָאֹמַר אֶל הַמַּלְאָךְ הַדֹּבֵר בִּי אָנָה הֵמָּה מֽוֹלִכוֹת אֶת הָאֵיפָֽה׃
translation: Then I said to the angel who talked with me, "Where are these carrying the ephah basket?" (Zechariah 5:10)

text: מִקְנֵה הַשָּׂדֶה וְהַמְּעָרָה אֲשֶׁר בּוֹ מֵאֵת בְּנֵי חֵֽת׃
translation: the field and the cave that is therein, which was purchased from the children of Heth." (Genesis 49:32)

text: לַמְנַצֵּחַ אַל תַּשְׁחֵת לְדָוִד מִכְתָּם בְּבָרְחוֹ מִפְּנֵי שָׁאוּל בַּמְּעָרָֽה׃
translation: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of "Do Not Destroy." A poem by David, when he fled from Saul, in the cave. Be merciful to me, God, be merciful to me, for my soul takes refuge in you. Yes, in the shadow of your wings, I will take refuge, until disaster has passed. (Psalms 57:1)

text: וַיָּקָם הַשָּׂדֶה וְהַמְּעָרָה אֲשֶׁר בּוֹ לְאַבְרָהָם לַאֲחֻזַּת קָבֶר מֵאֵת בְּנֵי חֵֽת׃
translation: The field, and the cave that is in it, were deeded to Abraham by the children of Heth as a possession for a burial place. (Genesis 23:20)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁעַ גֹּלּוּ אֲבָנִים גְּדֹלוֹת אֶל פִּי הַמְּעָרָה וְהַפְקִידוּ עָלֶיהָ אֲנָשִׁים לְשָׁמְרָֽם׃
translation: Joshua said, "Roll large stones to cover the cave's entrance, and set men by it to guard them; (Joshua 10:18)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁעַ פִּתְחוּ אֶת פִּי הַמְּעָרָה וְהוֹצִיאוּ אֵלַי אֶת חֲמֵשֶׁת הַמְּלָכִים הָאֵלֶּה מִן הַמְּעָרָֽה׃
translation: Then Joshua said, "Open the cave entrance, and bring those five kings out of the cave to me." (Joshua 10:22)

text: וַיֵּלֶךְ דָּוִד מִשָּׁם וַיִּמָּלֵט אֶל מְעָרַת עֲדֻלָּם וַיִּשְׁמְעוּ אֶחָיו וְכָל בֵּית אָבִיו וַיֵּרְדוּ אֵלָיו שָֽׁמָּה׃
translation: David therefore departed from there and escaped to Adullam's cave. When his brothers and all his father's house heard it, they went down there to him. (1 Samuel 22:1)

text: עֵינַיִם רָמוֹת לְשׁוֹן שָׁקֶר וְיָדַיִם שֹׁפְכוֹת דָּם נָקִֽי׃
translation: arrogant eyes, a lying tongue, hands that shed innocent blood, (Proverbs 6:17)

text: וְאַתָּה תְּבַעֵר הַדָּם הַנָּקִי מִקִּרְבֶּךָ כִּֽי תַעֲשֶׂה הַיָּשָׁר בְּעֵינֵי יְהוָֽה׃
translation: So you shall put away the innocent blood from among you, when you shall do that which is right in the LORD's eyes. (Deuteronomy 21:9)

text: יְֽמַלֵּט אִֽי נָקִי וְנִמְלַט בְּבֹר כַּפֶּֽיךָ׃
translation: He will even deliver him who is not innocent. Yes, he will be delivered through the cleanness of your hands." (Job 22:30)

text: יָכִין וְצַדִּיק יִלְבָּשׁ וְכֶסֶף נָקִי יַחֲלֹֽק׃
translation: he may prepare it, but the just will put it on, and the innocent will divide the silver. (Job 27:17)

text: מִדְּבַר שֶׁקֶר תִּרְחָק וְנָקִי וְצַדִּיק אַֽל תַּהֲרֹג כִּי לֹא אַצְדִּיק רָשָֽׁע׃
translation: "Keep far from a false charge, and don't kill the innocent and righteous; for I will not justify the wicked. (Exodus 23:7)

text: אָרוּר לֹקֵחַ שֹׁחַד לְהַכּוֹת נֶפֶשׁ דָּם נָקִי וְאָמַר כָּל הָעָם אָמֵֽן׃
translation: 'Cursed is he who takes a bribe to kill an innocent person.' All the people shall say, 'Amen.' (Deuteronomy 27:25)

text: וְנַפְשִׁי נִבְהֲלָה מְאֹד ואת וְאַתָּה יְהוָה עַד מָתָֽי׃
translation: Return, LORD. Deliver my soul, and save me for your loving kindness' sake. (Psalms 6:4)

text: אוֹיְבַי יֹאמְרוּ רַע לִי מָתַי יָמוּת וְאָבַד שְׁמֽוֹ׃
translation: If he comes to see me, he speaks falsehood. His heart gathers iniquity to itself. When he goes abroad, he tells it. (Psalms 41:6)

text: עַד מָתַי תִּשְׁפְּטוּ עָוֶל וּפְנֵי רְשָׁעִים תִּשְׂאוּ סֶֽלָה׃
translation: "How long will you judge unjustly, and show partiality to the wicked?" Selah. (Psalms 82:2)

text: שׁוּבָה יְהוָה עַד מָתָי וְהִנָּחֵם עַל עֲבָדֶֽיךָ׃
translation: Relent, LORD! How long? Have compassion on your servants! (Psalms 90:13)

text: כַּמָּה יְמֵֽי עַבְדֶּךָ מָתַי תַּעֲשֶׂה בְרֹדְפַי מִשְׁפָּֽט׃
translation: How many are the days of your servant? When will you execute judgment on those who persecute me? (Psalms 119:84)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלֶיהָ עֵלִי עַד מָתַי תִּשְׁתַּכָּרִין הָסִירִי אֶת יֵינֵךְ מֵעָלָֽיִךְ׃
translation: Eli said to her, "How long will you be drunk? Get rid of your wine!" (1 Samuel 1:14)

text: רַק הַבְּהֵמָה בָּזַזְנוּ לָנוּ וּשְׁלַל הֶעָרִים אֲשֶׁר לָכָֽדְנוּ׃
translation: Only the livestock we took for plunder for ourselves, with the plunder of the cities which we had taken. (Deuteronomy 2:35)

text: בְּנֵי יַעֲקֹב בָּאוּ עַל הַחֲלָלִים וַיָּבֹזּוּ הָעִיר אֲשֶׁר טִמְּאוּ אֲחוֹתָֽם׃
translation: Jacob's sons came on the dead, and plundered the city, because they had defiled their sister. (Genesis 34:27)

text: וְכָל הַבְּהֵמָה וּשְׁלַל הֶעָרִים בַּזּוֹנוּ לָֽנוּ׃
translation: But all the livestock, and the plunder of the cities, we took for plunder for ourselves. (Deuteronomy 3:7)

text: אַנְשֵׁי הַצָּבָא בָּזְזוּ אִישׁ לֽוֹ׃
translation: The men of war had taken booty, every man for himself. (Numbers 31:53)

text: לְהַטּוֹת מִדִּין דַּלִּים וְלִגְזֹל מִשְׁפַּט עֲנִיֵּי עַמִּי לִהְיוֹת אַלְמָנוֹת שְׁלָלָם וְאֶת יְתוֹמִים יָבֹֽזּוּ׃
translation: to deprive the needy of justice, and to rob the poor among my people of their rights, that widows may be their plunder, and that they may make the fatherless their prey! (Isaiah 10:2)

text: לָכֵן כֹּה אָמַר אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה צַר וּסְבִיב הָאָרֶץ וְהוֹרִד מִמֵּךְ עֻזֵּךְ וְנָבֹזּוּ אַרְמְנוֹתָֽיִךְ׃
translation: Therefore the Lord GOD says: "An adversary will overrun the land; and he will pull down your strongholds, and your fortresses will be plundered." (Amos 3:11)

text: וְהִפְשִׁיטוּךְ אֶת בְּגָדָיִךְ וְלָקְחוּ כְּלֵי תִפְאַרְתֵּֽךְ׃
translation: They will also strip you of your clothes and take away your beautiful jewels. (Ezekiel 23:26)

text: וּפְלִשְׁתִּים בָּאוּ וַֽיִּפְשְׁטוּ בְּעֵמֶק רְפָאִֽים׃
translation: Now the Philistines had come and made a raid in the valley of Rephaim. (1 Chronicles 14:9)

text: וַיֹּסִיפוּ עוֹד פְּלִשְׁתִּים וַֽיִּפְשְׁטוּ בָּעֵֽמֶק׃
translation: The Philistines made another raid in the valley. (1 Chronicles 14:13)

text: וּמַלְאָךְ בָּא אֶל שָׁאוּל לֵאמֹר מַהֲרָה וְלֵכָה כִּֽי פָשְׁטוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים עַל הָאָֽרֶץ׃
translation: But a messenger came to Saul, saying, "Hurry and come, for the Philistines have made a raid on the land!" (1 Samuel 23:27)

text: וְהַפְשֵׁט אֶֽת אַהֲרֹן אֶת בְּגָדָיו וְהִלְבַּשְׁתָּם אֶת אֶלְעָזָר בְּנוֹ וְאַהֲרֹן יֵאָסֵף וּמֵת שָֽׁם׃
translation: and strip Aaron of his garments, and put them on Eleazar his son. Aaron shall be gathered, and shall die there." (Numbers 20:26)

text: וְהָאֹרֵב הֵחִישׁוּ וַֽיִּפְשְׁטוּ אֶל הַגִּבְעָה וַיִּמְשֹׁךְ הָאֹרֵב וַיַּךְ אֶת כָּל הָעִיר לְפִי חָֽרֶב׃
translation: The ambushers hurried, and rushed on Gibeah; then the ambushers spread out, and struck all the city with the edge of the sword. (Judges 20:37)

text: וְשֵׁשׁ שָׁנִים תִּזְרַע אֶת אַרְצֶךָ וְאָסַפְתָּ אֶת תְּבוּאָתָֽהּ׃
translation: "For six years you shall sow your land, and shall gather in its increase, (Exodus 23:10)

text: וְלִבְהֶמְתְּךָ וְלַֽחַיָּה אֲשֶׁר בְּאַרְצֶךָ תִּהְיֶה כָל תְּבוּאָתָהּ לֶאֱכֹֽל׃
translation: For your livestock also, and for the animals that are in your land, shall all its increase be for food. (Leviticus 25:7)

text: מִפְּרִי פִי אִישׁ תִּשְׂבַּע בִּטְנוֹ תְּבוּאַת שְׂפָתָיו יִשְׂבָּֽע׃
translation: A man's stomach is filled with the fruit of his mouth. With the harvest of his lips he is satisfied. (Proverbs 18:20)

text: וַיִּזְרְעוּ שָׂדוֹת וַיִּטְּעוּ כְרָמִים וַיַּעֲשׂוּ פְּרִי תְבֽוּאָה׃
translation: sow fields, plant vineyards, and reap the fruits of increase. (Psalms 107:37)

text: טוֹב מְעַט בִּצְדָקָה מֵרֹב תְּבוּאוֹת בְּלֹא מִשְׁפָּֽט׃
translation: Better is a little with righteousness, than great revenues with injustice. (Proverbs 16:8)

text: עַשֵּׂר תְּעַשֵּׂר אֵת כָּל תְּבוּאַת זַרְעֶךָ הַיֹּצֵא הַשָּׂדֶה שָׁנָה שָׁנָֽה׃
translation: You shall surely tithe all the increase of your seed, that which comes out of the field year by year. (Deuteronomy 14:22)

text: כִּי הוּא עַל יַמִּים יְסָדָהּ וְעַל נְהָרוֹת יְכוֹנְנֶֽהָ׃
translation: For he has founded it on the seas, and established it on the floods. (Psalms 24:2)

text: בַּשָּׁנָה הָֽרְבִיעִית יֻסַּד בֵּית יְהוָה בְּיֶרַח זִֽו׃
translation: The foundation of the LORD's house was laid in the fourth year, in the month Ziv. (1 Kings 6:37)

text: וַיִּבֶן כְּמוֹ רָמִים מִקְדָּשׁוֹ כְּאֶרֶץ יְסָדָהּ לְעוֹלָֽם׃
translation: He built his sanctuary like the heights, like the earth which he has established forever. (Psalms 78:69)

text: לְךָ שָׁמַיִם אַף לְךָ אָרֶץ תֵּבֵל וּמְלֹאָהּ אַתָּה יְסַדְתָּֽם׃
translation: You have created the north and the south. Tabor and Hermon rejoice in your name. (Psalms 89:12)

text: יְֽהוָה בְּחָכְמָה יָֽסַד אָרֶץ כּוֹנֵן שָׁמַיִם בִּתְבוּנָֽה׃
translation: By wisdom the LORD founded the earth. By understanding, he established the heavens. (Proverbs 3:19)

text: יִתְיַצְּבוּ מַלְכֵי אֶרֶץ וְרוֹזְנִים נֽוֹסְדוּ יָחַד עַל יְהוָה וְעַל מְשִׁיחֽוֹ׃
translation: The kings of the earth take a stand, and the rulers take counsel together, against the LORD, and against his Anointed, saying, (Psalms 2:2)

text: וַתְּלַקֵּט בַּשָּׂדֶה עַד הָעָרֶב וַתַּחְבֹּט אֵת אֲשֶׁר לִקֵּטָה וַיְהִי כְּאֵיפָה שְׂעֹרִֽים׃
translation: So she gleaned in the field until evening; and she beat out that which she had gleaned, and it was about an ephah of barley. (Ruth 2:17)

text: רַבּוּ מִשַּׂעֲרוֹת רֹאשִׁי שֹׂנְאַי חִנָּם עָצְמוּ מַצְמִיתַי אֹיְבַי שֶׁקֶר אֲשֶׁר לֹא גָזַלְתִּי אָז אָשִֽׁיב׃
translation: God, you know my foolishness. My sins aren't hidden from you. (Psalms 69:5)

text: וְעַתָּה הֲלֹא בֹעַז מֹֽדַעְתָּנוּ אֲשֶׁר הָיִית אֶת נַעֲרוֹתָיו הִנֵּה הוּא זֹרֶה אֶת גֹּרֶן הַשְּׂעֹרִים הַלָּֽיְלָה׃
translation: Now isn't Boaz our kinsman, with whose maidens you were? Behold, he will be winnowing barley tonight on the threshing floor. (Ruth 3:2)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁלֹמֹה אִם יִהְיֶה לְבֶן חַיִל לֹֽא יִפֹּל מִשַּׂעֲרָתוֹ אָרְצָה וְאִם רָעָה תִמָּצֵא בוֹ וָמֵֽת׃
translation: Solomon said, "If he shows himself a worthy man, not a hair of his shall fall to the earth; but if wickedness is found in him, he shall die." (1 Kings 1:52)

text: וְאִם מִשְּׂדֵה אֲחֻזָּתוֹ יַקְדִּישׁ אִישׁ לַֽיהוָה וְהָיָה עֶרְכְּךָ לְפִי זַרְעוֹ זֶרַע חֹמֶר שְׂעֹרִים בַּחֲמִשִּׁים שֶׁקֶל כָּֽסֶף׃
translation: "'If a man dedicates to the LORD part of the field of his possession, then your valuation shall be according to the seed for it. The sowing of a homer of barley shall be valued at fifty shekels of silver. (Leviticus 27:16)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר הָבִי הַמִּטְפַּחַת אֲשֶׁר עָלַיִךְ וְאֶֽחֳזִי בָהּ וַתֹּאחֶז בָּהּ וַיָּמָד שֵׁשׁ שְׂעֹרִים וַיָּשֶׁת עָלֶיהָ וַיָּבֹא הָעִֽיר׃
translation: He said, "Bring the mantle that is on you, and hold it." She held it; and he measured six measures of barley, and laid it on her; then he went into the city. (Ruth 3:15)

text: וָאֶתְפֹּשׂ בִּשְׁנֵי הַלֻּחֹת וָֽאַשְׁלִכֵם מֵעַל שְׁתֵּי יָדָי וָאֲשַׁבְּרֵם לְעֵינֵיכֶֽם׃
translation: I took hold of the two tablets, and threw them out of my two hands, and broke them before your eyes. (Deuteronomy 9:17)

text: קָשְׁרֵם עַל אֶצְבְּעֹתֶיךָ כָּתְבֵם עַל לוּחַ לִבֶּֽךָ׃
translation: Bind them on your fingers. Write them on the tablet of your heart. (Proverbs 7:3)

text: נְבוּב לֻחֹת תַּעֲשֶׂה אֹתוֹ כַּאֲשֶׁר הֶרְאָה אֹתְךָ בָּהָר כֵּן יַעֲשֽׂוּ׃
translation: You shall make it hollow with planks. They shall make it as it has been shown you on the mountain. (Exodus 27:8)

text: חֶסֶד וֶאֱמֶת אַֽל יַעַזְבֻךָ קָשְׁרֵם עַל גַּרְגְּרוֹתֶיךָ כָּתְבֵם עַל לוּחַ לִבֶּֽךָ׃
translation: Don't let kindness and truth forsake you. Bind them around your neck. Write them on the tablet of your heart. (Proverbs 3:3)

text: וַיַּעֲנֵנִי יְהוָה וַיֹּאמֶר כְּתוֹב חָזוֹן וּבָאֵר עַל הַלֻּחוֹת לְמַעַן יָרוּץ קוֹרֵא בֽוֹ׃
translation: The LORD answered me, "Write the vision, and make it plain on tablets, that he who runs may read it. (Habakkuk 2:2)

text: וָאֵפֶן וָֽאֵרֵד מִן הָהָר וְהָהָר בֹּעֵר בָּאֵשׁ וּשְׁנֵי לֻחֹת הַבְּרִית עַל שְׁתֵּי יָדָֽי׃
translation: So I turned and came down from the mountain, and the mountain was burning with fire. The two tablets of the covenant were in my two hands. (Deuteronomy 9:15)

text: כִּי גוֹי אֹבַד עֵצוֹת הֵמָּה וְאֵין בָּהֶם תְּבוּנָֽה׃
translation: For they are a nation void of counsel. There is no understanding in them. (Deuteronomy 32:28)

text: לֹֽא יַחְפֹּץ כְּסִיל בִּתְבוּנָה כִּי אִֽם בְּהִתְגַּלּוֹת לִבּֽוֹ׃
translation: A fool has no delight in understanding, but only in revealing his own opinion. (Proverbs 18:2)

text: קֹֽנֶה לֵּב אֹהֵב נַפְשׁוֹ שֹׁמֵר תְּבוּנָה לִמְצֹא טֽוֹב׃
translation: He who gets wisdom loves his own soul. He who keeps understanding shall find good. (Proverbs 19:8)

text: אֵין חָכְמָה וְאֵין תְּבוּנָה וְאֵין עֵצָה לְנֶגֶד יְהוָֽה׃
translation: There is no wisdom nor understanding nor counsel against the LORD. (Proverbs 21:30)

text: וָאֲמַלֵּא אֹתוֹ רוּחַ אֱלֹהִים בְּחָכְמָה וּבִתְבוּנָה וּבְדַעַת וּבְכָל מְלָאכָֽה׃
translation: I have filled him with the Spirit of God, in wisdom, and in understanding, and in knowledge, and in all kinds of workmanship, (Exodus 31:3)

text: וַיְמַלֵּא אֹתוֹ רוּחַ אֱלֹהִים בְּחָכְמָה בִּתְבוּנָה וּבְדַעַת וּבְכָל מְלָאכָֽה׃
translation: He has filled him with the Spirit of God, in wisdom, in understanding, in knowledge, and in all kinds of workmanship; (Exodus 35:31)

text: וְלָֽקְחוּ זִקְנֵי הָֽעִיר הַהִוא אֶת הָאִישׁ וְיִסְּרוּ אֹתֽוֹ׃
translation: The elders of that city shall take the man and chastise him. (Deuteronomy 22:18)

text: יַסְּרֵנִי יְהוָה אַךְ בְּמִשְׁפָּט אַל בְּאַפְּךָ פֶּן תַּמְעִטֵֽנִי׃
translation: LORD, correct me, but gently; not in your anger, lest you reduce me to nothing. (Jeremiah 10:24)

text: וּכְנַנְיָהוּ שַֽׂר הַלְוִיִּם בְּמַשָּׂא יָסֹר בַּמַּשָּׂא כִּי מֵבִין הֽוּא׃
translation: Chenaniah, chief of the Levites, was over the singing. He taught the singers, because he was skillful. (1 Chronicles 15:22)

text: יְֽהוָה אַל בְּאַפְּךָ תוֹכִיחֵנִי וְֽאַל בַּחֲמָתְךָ תְיַסְּרֵֽנִי׃
translation: Have mercy on me, LORD, for I am faint. LORD, heal me, for my bones are troubled. (Psalms 6:2)

text: הֲיֹסֵר גּוֹיִם הֲלֹא יוֹכִיחַ הַֽמְלַמֵּד אָדָם דָּֽעַת׃
translation: He who disciplines the nations, won't he punish? He who teaches man knows. (Psalms 94:10)

text: אַשְׁרֵי הַגֶּבֶר אֲשֶׁר תְּיַסְּרֶנּוּ יָּהּ וּֽמִתּוֹרָתְךָ תְלַמְּדֶֽנּוּ׃
translation: Blessed is the man whom you discipline, LORD, and teach out of your law, (Psalms 94:12)

text: כִּֽי קִנְאַת בֵּיתְךָ אֲכָלָתְנִי וְחֶרְפּוֹת חוֹרְפֶיךָ נָפְלוּ עָלָֽי׃
translation: When I wept and I fasted, that was to my reproach. (Psalms 69:10)

text: כִּֽי קִנְאָה חֲמַת גָּבֶר וְלֹֽא יַחְמוֹל בְּיוֹם נָקָֽם׃
translation: For jealousy arouses the fury of the husband. He won't spare in the day of vengeance. (Proverbs 6:34)

text: אַכְזְרִיּוּת חֵמָה וְשֶׁטֶף אָף וּמִי יַעֲמֹד לִפְנֵי קִנְאָֽה׃
translation: Wrath is cruel, and anger is overwhelming; but who is able to stand before jealousy? (Proverbs 27:4)

text: זֹאת תּוֹרַת הַקְּנָאֹת אֲשֶׁר תִּשְׂטֶה אִשָּׁה תַּחַת אִישָׁהּ וְנִטְמָֽאָה׃
translation: "'This is the law of jealousy, when a wife, being under her husband, goes astray, and is defiled, (Numbers 5:29)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר לְכָה אִתִּי וּרְאֵה בְּקִנְאָתִי לַיהוָה וַיַּרְכִּבוּ אֹתוֹ בְּרִכְבּֽוֹ׃
translation: He said, "Come with me, and see my zeal for the LORD." So they made him ride in his chariot. (2 Kings 10:16)

text: וַהֲנִחֹתִי חֲמָתִי בָּךְ וְסָרָה קִנְאָתִי מִמֵּךְ וְשָׁקַטְתִּי וְלֹא אֶכְעַס עֽוֹד׃
translation: So I will cause my wrath toward you to rest, and my jealousy will depart from you. I will be quiet, and will not be angry any more. (Ezekiel 16:42)

text: אזכיר אֶזְכּוֹר מַֽעַלְלֵי יָהּ כִּֽי אֶזְכְּרָה מִקֶּדֶם פִּלְאֶֽךָ׃
translation: I will also meditate on all your work, and consider your doings. (Psalms 77:12)

text: אִמְרוּ צַדִּיק כִּי טוֹב כִּֽי פְרִי מַעַלְלֵיהֶם יֹאכֵֽלוּ׃
translation: Tell the righteous that it will be well with them, for they will eat the fruit of their deeds. (Isaiah 3:10)

text: וְהָיָה כָעָם כַּכֹּהֵן וּפָקַדְתִּי עָלָיו דְּרָכָיו וּמַעֲלָלָיו אָשִׁיב לֽוֹ׃
translation: It will be like people, like priest; and I will punish them for their ways, and will repay them for their deeds. (Hosea 4:9)

text: וְהָיְתָה הָאָרֶץ לִשְׁמָמָה עַל יֹֽשְׁבֶיהָ מִפְּרִי מַֽעַלְלֵיהֶֽם׃
translation: Yet the land will be desolate because of those who dwell therein, for the fruit of their doings. (Micah 7:13)

text: וַֽיהוָה הֽוֹדִיעַנִי וָֽאֵדָעָה אָז הִרְאִיתַנִי מַעַלְלֵיהֶֽם׃
translation: The LORD gave me knowledge of it, and I knew it. Then you showed me their doings. (Jeremiah 11:18)

text: וְרִיב לַֽיהוָה עִם יְהוּדָה וְלִפְקֹד עַֽל יַעֲקֹב כִּדְרָכָיו כְּמַעֲלָלָיו יָשִׁיב לֽוֹ׃
translation: In the womb he took his brother by the heel, and in his manhood he contended with God. (Hosea 12:3)

text: וַתִּשְׁקֹט הָאָרֶץ אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה וַיָּמָת עָתְנִיאֵל בֶּן קְנַֽז׃
translation: The land had rest forty years, then Othniel the son of Kenaz died. (Judges 3:11)

text: לֹא שָׁלַוְתִּי וְלֹא שָׁקַטְתִּי וְֽלֹא נָחְתִּי וַיָּבֹא רֹֽגֶז׃
translation: I am not at ease, neither am I quiet, neither do I have rest; but trouble comes." (Job 3:26)

text: וַתִּשְׁקֹט מַלְכוּת יְהוֹשָׁפָט וַיָּנַֽח לוֹ אֱלֹהָיו מִסָּבִֽיב׃
translation: So the realm of Jehoshaphat was quiet, for his God gave him rest all around. (2 Chronicles 20:30)

text: אֱלֹהִים אַל דֳּמִי לָךְ אַל תֶּחֱרַשׁ וְאַל תִּשְׁקֹט אֵֽל׃
translation: For, behold, your enemies are stirred up. Those who hate you have lifted up their heads. (Psalms 83:2)

text: וַיִּשְׂמְחוּ כָל עַם הָאָרֶץ וְהָעִיר שָׁקָטָה וְאֶת עֲתַלְיָהוּ הֵמִיתוּ בֶחָֽרֶב׃
translation: So all the people of the land rejoiced, and the city was quiet. They had slain Athaliah with the sword. (2 Chronicles 23:21)

text: מִשָּׁמַיִם הִשְׁמַעְתָּ דִּין אֶרֶץ יָֽרְאָה וְשָׁקָֽטָה׃
translation: when God arose to judgment, to save all the afflicted ones of the earth. Selah. (Psalms 76:9)

text: וְהָלַךְ מַלְכָּם בַּגּוֹלָה הוּא וְשָׂרָיו יַחְדָּו אָמַר יְהוָֽה׃
translation: and their king will go into captivity, he and his princes together," says the LORD. (Amos 1:15)

text: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ בְנֵי הַגּוֹלָה אֶת הַפָּסַח בְּאַרְבָּעָה עָשָׂר לַחֹדֶשׁ הָרִאשֽׁוֹן׃
translation: The children of the captivity kept the Passover on the fourteenth day of the first month. (Ezra 6:19)

text: וַיַּעֲבִירוּ קוֹל בִּיהוּדָה וִירֽוּשָׁלִַם לְכֹל בְּנֵי הַגּוֹלָה לְהִקָּבֵץ יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
translation: They made a proclamation throughout Judah and Jerusalem to all the children of the captivity, that they should gather themselves together to Jerusalem; (Ezra 10:7)

text: וָאֲדַבֵּר אֶל הַגּוֹלָה אֵת כָּל דִּבְרֵי יְהוָה אֲשֶׁר הֶרְאָֽנִי׃
translation: Then I spoke to the captives all the things that the LORD had shown me. (Ezekiel 11:25)

text: וְאַתֶּם שִׁמְעוּ דְבַר יְהוָה כָּל הַגּוֹלָה אֲשֶׁר שִׁלַּחְתִּי מִירוּשָׁלִַם בָּבֶֽלָה׃
translation: Hear therefore the LORD's word, all you captives whom I have sent away from Jerusalem to Babylon. (Jeremiah 29:20)

text: כִּֽי חֲלָלִים רַבִּים נָפָלוּ כִּי מֵהָאֱלֹהִים הַמִּלְחָמָה וַיֵּשְׁבוּ תַחְתֵּיהֶם עַד הַגֹּלָֽה׃
translation: For many fell slain, because the war was of God. They lived in their place until the captivity. (1 Chronicles 5:22)

text: וַתֹּאמֶר הָֽאִשָּׁה אֶל הַנָּחָשׁ מִפְּרִי עֵֽץ הַגָּן נֹאכֵֽל׃
translation: The woman said to the serpent, "We may eat fruit from the trees of the garden, (Genesis 3:2)

text: וַיִּקַּח יְהוָה אֱלֹהִים אֶת הָֽאָדָם וַיַּנִּחֵהוּ בְגַן עֵדֶן לְעָבְדָהּ וּלְשָׁמְרָֽהּ׃
translation: The LORD God took the man, and put him into the garden of Eden to cultivate and keep it. (Genesis 2:15)

text: הַיוֹשֶׁבֶת בַּגַּנִּים חֲבֵרִים מַקְשִׁיבִים לְקוֹלֵךְ הַשְׁמִיעִֽינִי׃
translation: You who dwell in the gardens, with friends in attendance, let me hear your voice! (Song of Solomon 8:13)

text: וְנָהָרּ יֹצֵא מֵעֵדֶן לְהַשְׁקוֹת אֶת הַגָּן וּמִשָּׁם יִפָּרֵד וְהָיָה לְאַרְבָּעָה רָאשִֽׁים׃
translation: A river went out of Eden to water the garden; and from there it was parted, and became the source of four rivers. (Genesis 2:10)

text: וַיְצַו יְהוָה אֱלֹהִים עַל הָֽאָדָם לֵאמֹר מִכֹּל עֵֽץ הַגָּן אָכֹל תֹּאכֵֽל׃
translation: The LORD God commanded the man, saying, "You may freely eat of every tree of the garden; (Genesis 2:16)

text: וַֽיְשַׁלְּחֵהוּ יְהוָה אֱלֹהִים מִגַּן עֵדֶן לַֽעֲבֹד אֶת הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר לֻקַּח מִשָּֽׁם׃
translation: Therefore the LORD God sent him out from the garden of Eden, to till the ground from which he was taken. (Genesis 3:23)

text: הֵמָּה ינועון יְנִיעוּן לֶאֱכֹל אִם לֹא יִשְׂבְּעוּ וַיָּלִֽינוּ׃
translation: But I will sing of your strength. Yes, I will sing aloud of your loving kindness in the morning. For you have been my high tower, a refuge in the day of my distress. (Psalms 59:16)

text: וַאֲנִי הָיִיתִי חֶרְפָּה לָהֶם יִרְאוּנִי יְנִיעוּן רֹאשָֽׁם׃
translation: I have also become a reproach to them. When they see me, they shake their head. (Psalms 109:25)

text: וְהִנֵּה יָד נָגְעָה בִּי וַתְּנִיעֵנִי עַל בִּרְכַּי וְכַפּוֹת יָדָֽי׃
translation: Behold, a hand touched me, which set me on my knees and on the palms of my hands. (Daniel 10:10)

text: אַל תַּהַרְגֵם פֶּֽן יִשְׁכְּחוּ עַמִּי הֲנִיעֵמוֹ בְחֵילְךָ וְהוֹרִידֵמוֹ מָֽגִנֵּנוּ אֲדֹנָֽי׃
translation: For the sin of their mouth, and the words of their lips, let them be caught in their pride, for the curses and lies which they utter. (Psalms 59:12)

text: וְנָעוּ מִיָּם עַד יָם וּמִצָּפוֹן וְעַד מִזְרָח יְשֽׁוֹטְטוּ לְבַקֵּשׁ אֶת דְּבַר יְהוָה וְלֹא יִמְצָֽאוּ׃
translation: They will wander from sea to sea, and from the north even to the east; they will run back and forth to seek the LORD's word, and will not find it. (Amos 8:12)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר הַנִּיחוּ לוֹ אִישׁ אַל יָנַע עַצְמֹתָיו וַֽיְמַלְּטוּ עַצְמֹתָיו אֵת עַצְמוֹת הַנָּבִיא אֲשֶׁר בָּא מִשֹּׁמְרֽוֹן׃
translation: He said, "Let him be! Let no one move his bones." So they let his bones alone, with the bones of the prophet who came out of Samaria. (2 Kings 23:18)

text: וְהִשְׁבַּתִּי הֲמוֹן שִׁירָיִךְ וְקוֹל כִּנּוֹרַיִךְ לֹא יִשָּׁמַע עֽוֹד׃
translation: I will cause the noise of your songs to cease. The sound of your harps won't be heard any more. (Ezekiel 26:13)

text: עוּרָה כְבוֹדִי עוּרָֽה הַנֵּבֶל וְכִנּוֹר אָעִירָה שָּֽׁחַר׃
translation: I will give thanks to you, Lord, among the peoples. I will sing praises to you among the nations. (Psalms 57:9)

text: וַיְהִי לְאֵבֶל כִּנֹּרִי וְעֻגָבִי לְקוֹל בֹּכִֽים׃
translation: Therefore my harp has turned to mourning, and my pipe into the voice of those who weep. (Job 30:31)

text: זַמְּרוּ לַיהוָה בְּכִנּוֹר בְּכִנּוֹר וְקוֹל זִמְרָֽה׃
translation: Sing praises to the LORD with the harp, with the harp and the voice of melody. (Psalms 98:5)

text: עֱנוּ לַיהוָה בְּתוֹדָה זַמְּרוּ לֵאלֹהֵינוּ בְכִנּֽוֹר׃
translation: Sing to the LORD with thanksgiving. Sing praises on the harp to our God, (Psalms 147:7)

text: הַֽלְלוּהוּ בְּתֵקַע שׁוֹפָר הַֽלְלוּהוּ בְּנֵבֶל וְכִנּֽוֹר׃
translation: Praise him with the sounding of the trumpet! Praise him with harp and lyre! (Psalms 150:3)

text: כִּֽי לְךָ יְהוָה הוֹחָלְתִּי אַתָּה תַעֲנֶה אֲדֹנָי אֱלֹהָֽי׃
translation: For I said, "Don't let them gloat over me, or exalt themselves over me when my foot slips." (Psalms 38:16)

text: חֶלְקִי יְהוָה אָמְרָה נַפְשִׁי עַל כֵּן אוֹחִיל לֽוֹ׃
translation: "The LORD is my portion," says my soul. "Therefore I will hope in him." (Lamentations 3:24)

text: וַאֲנִי בַּיהוָה אֲצַפֶּה אוֹחִילָה לֵאלֹהֵי יִשְׁעִי יִשְׁמָעֵנִי אֱלֹהָֽי׃
translation: But as for me, I will look to the LORD. I will wait for the God of my salvation. My God will hear me. (Micah 7:7)

text: מַה כֹּחִי כִֽי אֲיַחֵל וּמַה קִּצִּי כִּֽי אַאֲרִיךְ נַפְשִֽׁי׃
translation: What is my strength, that I should wait? What is my end, that I should be patient? (Job 6:11)

text: הֵן הוֹחַלְתִּי לְֽדִבְרֵיכֶם אָזִין עַד תְּבוּנֹֽתֵיכֶם עַֽד תַּחְקְרוּן מִלִּֽין׃
translation: "Behold, I waited for your words, and I listened for your reasoning, while you searched out what to say. (Job 32:11)

text: וְהוֹחַלְתִּי כִּי לֹא יְדַבֵּרוּ כִּי עָמְדוּ לֹא עָנוּ עֽוֹד׃
translation: Shall I wait, because they don't speak, because they stand still, and answer no more? (Job 32:16)

text: יְהוָה יָדִין עַמִּים שָׁפְטֵנִי יְהוָה כְּצִדְקִי וּכְתֻמִּי עָלָֽי׃
translation: Oh let the wickedness of the wicked come to an end, but establish the righteous; their minds and hearts are searched by the righteous God. (Psalms 7:9)

text: שְׁמָר תָּם וּרְאֵה יָשָׁר כִּֽי אַחֲרִית לְאִישׁ שָׁלֽוֹם׃
translation: Mark the perfect man, and see the upright, for there is a future for the man of peace. (Psalms 37:37)

text: הֶן אֵל לֹא יִמְאַס תָּם וְלֹֽא יַחֲזִיק בְּיַד מְרֵעִֽים׃
translation: "Behold, God will not cast away a blameless man, neither will he uphold the evildoers. (Job 8:20)

text: תָּֽם אָנִי לֹֽא אֵדַע נַפְשִׁי אֶמְאַס חַיָּֽי׃
translation: I am blameless. I don't respect myself. I despise my life. (Job 9:21)

text: אַחַת הִיא עַל כֵּן אָמַרְתִּי תָּם וְרָשָׁע הוּא מְכַלֶּֽה׃
translation: "It is all the same. Therefore I say he destroys the blameless and the wicked. (Job 9:22)

text: הוֹלֵךְ בַּתֹּם יֵלֶךְ בֶּטַח וּמְעַקֵּשׁ דְּרָכָיו יִוָּדֵֽעַ׃
translation: He who walks blamelessly walks surely, but he who perverts his ways will be found out. (Proverbs 10:9)

text: תַּחַת כִּי שָׂנְאוּ דָעַת וְיִרְאַת יְהֹוָה לֹא בָחָֽרוּ׃
translation: because they hated knowledge, and didn't choose the fear of the LORD. (Proverbs 1:29)

text: בְּחֶסֶד וֶאֱמֶת יְכֻפַּר עָוֺן וּבְיִרְאַת יְהוָה סוּר מֵרָֽע׃
translation: By mercy and truth iniquity is atoned for. By the fear of the LORD men depart from evil. (Proverbs 16:6)

text: יִרְאַת יְהוָה לְחַיִּים וְשָׂבֵעַ יָלִין בַּל יִפָּקֶד רָֽע׃
translation: The fear of the LORD leads to life, then contentment; he rests and will not be touched by trouble. (Proverbs 19:23)

text: לְֽכוּ בָנִים שִׁמְעוּ לִי יִֽרְאַת יְהוָה אֲלַמֶּדְכֶֽם׃
translation: Who is someone who desires life, and loves many days, that he may see good? (Psalms 34:12)

text: אָז תָּבִין יִרְאַת יְהוָה וְדַעַת אֱלֹהִים תִּמְצָֽא׃
translation: then you will understand the fear of the LORD, and find the knowledge of God. (Proverbs 2:5)

text: יִרְאַת יְהוָה תּוֹסִיף יָמִים וּשְׁנוֹת רְשָׁעִים תִּקְצֹֽרְנָה׃
translation: The fear of the LORD prolongs days, but the years of the wicked shall be shortened. (Proverbs 10:27)

text: טַפֵּנוּ נָשֵׁינוּ מִקְנֵנוּ וְכָל בְּהֶמְתֵּנוּ יִֽהְיוּ שָׁם בְּעָרֵי הַגִּלְעָֽד׃
translation: Our little ones, our wives, our flocks, and all our livestock shall be there in the cities of Gilead; (Numbers 32:26)

text: וְכָל יְהוּדָה עֹמְדִים לִפְנֵי יְהוָה גַּם טַפָּם נְשֵׁיהֶם וּבְנֵיהֶֽם׃
translation: All Judah stood before the LORD, with their little ones, their wives, and their children. (2 Chronicles 20:13)

text: וְכֹל הַטַּף בַּנָּשִׁים אֲשֶׁר לֹא יָדְעוּ מִשְׁכַּב זָכָר הַחֲיוּ לָכֶֽם׃
translation: But all the girls, who have not known man by lying with him, keep alive for yourselves. (Numbers 31:18)

text: וַיִּפְנוּ וַיֵּלֵכוּ וַיָּשִׂימוּ אֶת הַטַּף וְאֶת הַמִּקְנֶה וְאֶת הַכְּבוּדָּה לִפְנֵיהֶֽם׃
translation: So they turned and departed, and put the little ones, the livestock, and the goods before them. (Judges 18:21)

text: וְעַתָּה הִרְגוּ כָל זָכָר בַּטָּף וְכָל אִשָּׁה יֹדַעַת אִישׁ לְמִשְׁכַּב זָכָר הֲרֹֽגוּ׃
translation: Now therefore kill every male among the little ones, and kill every woman who has known man by lying with him. (Numbers 31:17)

text: וּלְהִתְיַחֵשׂ בְּכָל טַפָּם נְשֵׁיהֶם וּבְנֵיהֶם וּבְנוֹתֵיהֶם לְכָל קָהָל כִּי בֶאֱמוּנָתָם יִתְקַדְּשׁוּ קֹֽדֶשׁ׃
translation: and those who were listed by genealogy of all their little ones, their wives, their sons, and their daughters, through all the congregation; for in their office of trust they sanctified themselves in holiness. (2 Chronicles 31:18)

text: וַיִּתֵּן הָֽאֱלֹהִים אֶת דָּנִיֵּאל לְחֶסֶד וּֽלְרַחֲמִים לִפְנֵי שַׂר הַסָּרִיסִֽים׃
translation: Now God made Daniel find kindness and compassion in the sight of the prince of the eunuchs. (Daniel 1:9)

text: וְהַמְּדָנִים מָכְרוּ אֹתוֹ אֶל מִצְרָיִם לְפֽוֹטִיפַר סְרִיס פַּרְעֹה שַׂר הַטַּבָּחִֽים׃
translation: The Midianites sold him into Egypt to Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh's, the captain of the guard. (Genesis 37:36)

text: וְזַרְעֵיכֶם וְכַרְמֵיכֶם יַעְשֹׂר וְנָתַן לְסָרִיסָיו וְלַעֲבָדָֽיו׃
translation: He will take one tenth of your seed and of your vineyards, and give it to his officers and to his servants. (1 Samuel 8:15)

text: וַיִּקְרָא מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל סָרִיס אֶחָד וַיֹּאמֶר מַהֲרָה מִיכָיְהוּ בֶן יִמְלָֽה׃
translation: Then the king of Israel called an officer, and said, "Quickly get Micaiah the son of Imlah." (1 Kings 22:9)

text: וַיִּקְרָא מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל סָרִיס אֶחָד וַיֹּאמֶר מַהֵר מיכהו מִיכָיְהוּ בֶן יִמְלָֽא׃
translation: Then the king of Israel called an officer, and said, "Get Micaiah the son of Imla quickly." (2 Chronicles 18:8)

text: וּמִבָּנֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר יֵצְאוּ מִמְּךָ אֲשֶׁר תּוֹלִיד יִקָּחוּ וְהָיוּ סָרִיסִים בְּהֵיכַל מֶלֶךְ בָּבֶֽל׃
translation: 'They will take away your sons who will issue from you, whom you shall father, and they will be eunuchs in the king of Babylon's palace.'" (Isaiah 39:7)

text: לֹא תַטֶּה מִשְׁפַּט גֵּר יָתוֹם וְלֹא תַחֲבֹל בֶּגֶד אַלְמָנָֽה׃
translation: You shall not deprive the foreigner or the fatherless of justice, nor take a widow's clothing in pledge; (Deuteronomy 24:17)

text: אַל יְהִי לוֹ מֹשֵׁךְ חָסֶד וְֽאַל יְהִי חוֹנֵן לִיתוֹמָֽיו׃
translation: Let there be no one to extend kindness to him, neither let there be anyone to have pity on his fatherless children. (Psalms 109:12)

text: עָזְבָה יְתֹמֶיךָ אֲנִי אֲחַיֶּה וְאַלְמְנֹתֶיךָ עָלַי תִּבְטָֽחוּ׃
translation: Leave your fatherless children. I will preserve them alive. Let your widows trust in me." (Jeremiah 49:11)

text: יְתוֹמִים הָיִינוּ אין וְאֵין אָב אִמֹּתֵינוּ כְּאַלְמָנֽוֹת׃
translation: We are orphans and fatherless. Our mothers are as widows. (Lamentations 5:3)

text: וְחָרָה אַפִּי וְהָרַגְתִּי אֶתְכֶם בֶּחָרֶב וְהָיוּ נְשֵׁיכֶם אַלְמָנוֹת וּבְנֵיכֶם יְתֹמִֽים׃
translation: If you take advantage of them at all, and they cry at all to me, I will surely hear their cry; (Exodus 22:23)

text: אָרוּר מַטֶּה מִשְׁפַּט גֵּר יָתוֹם וְאַלְמָנָה וְאָמַר כָּל הָעָם אָמֵֽן׃
translation: 'Cursed is he who withholds justice from the foreigner, fatherless, and widow.' All the people shall say, 'Amen.' (Deuteronomy 27:19)

text: עַל הַמְּנֹרָה הַטְּהֹרָה יַעֲרֹךְ אֶת הַנֵּרוֹת לִפְנֵי יְהוָה תָּמִֽיד׃
translation: He shall keep in order the lamps on the pure gold lamp stand before the LORD continually. (Leviticus 24:4)

text: וְאֶת הַשֻּׁלְחָן וְאֶת כָּל כֵּלָיו וְאֶת הַמְּנֹרָה וְאֶת כֵּלֶיהָ וְאֵת מִזְבַּח הַקְּטֹֽרֶת׃
translation: the table and all its articles, the lamp stand and its accessories, the altar of incense, (Exodus 30:27)

text: וְהֵבֵאתָ אֶת הַשֻּׁלְחָן וְעָרַכְתָּ אֶת עֶרְכּוֹ וְהֵבֵאתָ אֶת הַמְּנֹרָה וְהַעֲלֵיתָ אֶת נֵרֹתֶֽיהָ׃
translation: You shall bring in the table, and set in order the things that are on it. You shall bring in the lamp stand, and light its lamps. (Exodus 40:4)

text: וַיַּעַשׂ אֶת מְנֹרוֹת הַזָּהָב עֶשֶׂר כְּמִשְׁפָּטָם וַיִּתֵּן בַּֽהֵיכָל חָמֵשׁ מִיָּמִין וְחָמֵשׁ מִשְּׂמֹֽאול׃
translation: He made the ten lamp stands of gold according to the ordinance concerning them; and he set them in the temple, five on the right hand and five on the left. (2 Chronicles 4:7)

text: וָאַעַן וָאֹמַר אֵלָיו מַה שְּׁנֵי הַזֵּיתִים הָאֵלֶה עַל יְמִין הַמְּנוֹרָה וְעַל שְׂמֹאולָֽהּ׃
translation: Then I asked him, "What are these two olive trees on the right side of the lamp stand and on the left side of it?" (Zechariah 4:11)

text: וְאֶת הַשֻּׁלְחָן וְאֶת כֵּלָיו וְאֶת הַמְּנֹרָה הַטְּהֹרָה וְאֶת כָּל כֵּלֶיהָ וְאֵת מִזְבַּח הַקְּטֹֽרֶת׃
translation: the table and its vessels, the pure lamp stand with all its vessels, the altar of incense, (Exodus 31:8)

text: וְאֶת מִגְדַּל פְּנוּאֵל נָתָץ וַֽיַּהֲרֹג אֶת אַנְשֵׁי הָעִֽיר׃
translation: He broke down the tower of Penuel, and killed the men of the city. (Judges 8:17)

text: וְאֶת בָּתֵּי יְרוּשָׁלִַם סְפַרְתֶּם וַתִּתְֿצוּ הַבָּתִּים לְבַצֵּר הַחוֹמָֽה׃
translation: You counted the houses of Jerusalem, and you broke down the houses to fortify the wall. (Isaiah 22:10)

text: יִתְּצֵנִי סָבִיב וָאֵלַךְ וַיַּסַּע כָּעֵץ תִּקְוָתִֽי׃
translation: He has broken me down on every side, and I am gone. He has plucked my hope up like a tree. (Job 19:10)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר גַּם לְאַנְשֵׁי פְנוּאֵל לֵאמֹר בְּשׁוּבִי בְשָׁלוֹם אֶתֹּץ אֶת הַמִּגְדָּל הַזֶּֽה׃
translation: He spoke also to the men of Penuel, saying, "When I come again in peace, I will break down this tower." (Judges 8:9)

text: וְאֶת חוֹמֹת יְרוּשָׁלִַם סָבִיב נָֽתְצוּ כָּל חֵיל כַּשְׂדִּים אֲשֶׁר רַב טַבָּחִֽים׃
