translation: All the army of the Chaldeans, who were with the captain of the guard, broke down the walls around Jerusalem. (2 Kings 25:10)

text: גַּם אֵל יִתָּצְךָ לָנֶצַח יַחְתְּךָ וְיִסָּחֲךָ מֵאֹהֶל וְשֵֽׁרֶשְׁךָ מֵאֶרֶץ חַיִּים סֶֽלָה׃
translation: "Behold, this is the man who didn't make God his strength, but trusted in the abundance of his riches, and strengthened himself in his wickedness." (Psalms 52:7)

text: יְהוָה אֱלֹהַי בְּךָ חָסִיתִי הוֹשִׁיעֵנִי מִכָּל רֹדְפַי וְהַצִּילֵֽנִי׃
translation: lest they tear apart my soul like a lion, ripping it in pieces, while there is no one to deliver. (Psalms 7:2)

text: שָׁמְרָה נַפְשִׁי וְהַצִּילֵנִי אַל אֵבוֹשׁ כִּֽי חָסִיתִי בָֽךְ׃
translation: Oh keep my soul, and deliver me. Let me not be disappointed, for I take refuge in you. (Psalms 25:20)

text: וְהִשְׁאַרְתִּי בְקִרְבֵּךְ עַם עָנִי וָדָל וְחָסוּ בְּשֵׁם יְהוָֽה׃
translation: But I will leave among you an afflicted and poor people, and they will take refuge in the LORD's name. (Zephaniah 3:12)

text: מִכְתָּם לְדָוִד שָֽׁמְרֵנִי אֵל כִּֽי חָסִיתִי בָֽךְ׃
translation: A Poem by David. Preserve me, God, for I take refuge in you. (Psalms 16:1)

text: מַה יָּקָר חַסְדְּךָ אֱלֹהִים וּבְנֵי אָדָם בְּצֵל כְּנָפֶיךָ יֶחֱסָיֽוּן׃
translation: They shall be abundantly satisfied with the abundance of your house. You will make them drink of the river of your pleasures. (Psalms 36:8)

text: וַֽיַּעְזְרֵם יְהוָה וַֽיְפַלְּטֵם יְפַלְּטֵם מֵרְשָׁעִים וְיוֹשִׁיעֵם כִּי חָסוּ בֽוֹ׃
translation: The LORD helps them and rescues them. He rescues them from the wicked and saves them, because they have taken refuge in him. (Psalms 37:40)

text: וַיֶּֽחָלְקֵם דָּוִיד מַחְלְקוֹת לִבְנֵי לֵוִי לְגֵרְשׁוֹן קְהָת וּמְרָרִֽי׃
translation: David divided them into divisions according to the sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari. (1 Chronicles 23:6)

text: וְלִבְנֵי אַהֲרֹן מַחְלְקוֹתָם בְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן נָדָב וַאֲבִיהוּא אֶלְעָזָר וְאִיתָמָֽר׃
translation: These were the divisions of the sons of Aaron. The sons of Aaron: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar. (1 Chronicles 24:1)

text: הוּא בְנָיָהוּ גִּבּוֹר הַשְּׁלֹשִׁים וְעַל הַשְּׁלֹשִׁים וּמַחֲלֻקְתּוֹ עַמִּיזָבָד בְּנֽוֹ׃
translation: This is that Benaiah who was the mighty man of the thirty and over the thirty. Of his division was Ammizabad his son. (1 Chronicles 27:6)

text: הַחַמִישִׁי לַחֹדֶשׁ הַחֲמִישִׁי הַשַּׂר שַׁמְהוּת הַיִּזְרָח וְעַל מַחֲלֻקְתּוֹ עֶשְׂרִים וְאַרְבָּעָה אָֽלֶף׃
translation: The fifth captain for the fifth month was Shamhuth the Izrahite. In his division were twenty-four thousand. (1 Chronicles 27:8)

text: וַתִּכּוֹן הָעֲבוֹדָה וַיַּֽעַמְדוּ הַכֹּהֲנִים עַל עָמְדָם וְהַלְוִיִּם עַל מַחְלְקוֹתָם כְּמִצְוַת הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
translation: So the service was prepared, and the priests stood in their place, and the Levites by their divisions, according to the king's commandment. (2 Chronicles 35:10)

text: וּמִן הַלְוִיִּם מַחְלְקוֹת יְהוּדָה לְבִנְיָמִֽין׃
translation: Of the Levites, certain divisions in Judah settled in Benjamin's territory. (Nehemiah 11:36)

text: וַיֵּלֶךְ דָּוִיד וְכָל יִשְׂרָאֵל יְרוּשָׁלִַם הִיא יְבוּס וְשָׁם הַיְבוּסִי יֹשְׁבֵי הָאָֽרֶץ׃
translation: David and all Israel went to Jerusalem (also called Jebus); and the Jebusites, the inhabitants of the land, were there. (1 Chronicles 11:4)

text: בָּעֵת הַהִיא בִּרְאוֹת דָּוִיד כִּי עָנָהוּ יְהוָה בְּגֹרֶן אָרְנָן הַיְבוּסִי וַיִּזְבַּח שָֽׁם׃
translation: At that time, when David saw that the LORD had answered him in the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite, then he sacrificed there. (1 Chronicles 21:28)

text: כָּל הָעָם הַנּוֹתָר מִן הַחִתִּי וְהָאֱמֹרִי וְהַפְּרִזִּי וְהַחִוִּי וְהַיְבוּסִי אֲשֶׁר לֹא מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל הֵֽמָּה׃
translation: As for all the people who were left of the Hittites, the Amorites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites, who were not of Israel— (2 Chronicles 8:7)

text: כָּל הָעָם הַנּוֹתָר מִן הָאֱמֹרִי הַחִתִּי הַפְּרִזִּי הַחִוִּי וְהַיְבוּסִי אֲשֶׁר לֹֽא מִבְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הֵֽמָּה׃
translation: As for all the people who were left of the Amorites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites, who were not of the children of Israel— (1 Kings 9:20)

text: וַהֲסִרֹתִי דָמָיו מִפִּיו וְשִׁקֻּצָיו מִבֵּין שִׁנָּיו וְנִשְׁאַר גַּם הוּא לֵֽאלֹהֵינוּ וְהָיָה כְּאַלֻּף בִּֽיהוּדָה וְעֶקְרוֹן כִּיבוּסִֽי׃
translation: I will take away his blood out of his mouth, and his abominations from between his teeth; and he also will be a remnant for our God; and he will be as a chieftain in Judah, and Ekron as a Jebusite. (Zechariah 9:7)

text: עֲמָלֵק יוֹשֵׁב בְּאֶרֶץ הַנֶּגֶב וְהַֽחִתִּי וְהַיְבוּסִי וְהָֽאֱמֹרִי יוֹשֵׁב בָּהָר וְהַֽכְּנַעֲנִי יֹשֵׁב עַל הַיָּם וְעַל יַד הַיַּרְדֵּֽן׃
translation: Amalek dwells in the land of the South. The Hittite, the Jebusite, and the Amorite dwell in the hill country. The Canaanite dwells by the sea, and along the side of the Jordan." (Numbers 13:29)

text: וְהָיָה בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא יְחַיֶּה אִישׁ עֶגְלַת בָּקָר וּשְׁתֵּי צֹֽאן׃
translation: It shall happen in that day that a man shall keep alive a young cow, and two sheep. (Isaiah 7:21)

text: וַיִּקַּח מֹשֶׁה אֶת הָעֲגָלֹת וְאֶת הַבָּקָר וַיִּתֵּן אוֹתָם אֶל הַלְוִיִּֽם׃
translation: Moses took the wagons and the oxen, and gave them to the Levites. (Numbers 7:6)

text: אֵת שְׁתֵּי הָעֲגָלֹת וְאֵת אַרְבַּעַת הַבָּקָר נָתַן לִבְנֵי גֵרְשׁוֹן כְּפִי עֲבֹדָתָֽם׃
translation: He gave two wagons and four oxen to the sons of Gershon, according to their service. (Numbers 7:7)

text: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ הָאֲנָשִׁים כֵּן וַיִּקְחוּ שְׁתֵּי פָרוֹת עָלוֹת וַיַּאַסְרוּם בָּעֲגָלָה וְאֶת בְּנֵיהֶם כָּלוּ בַבָּֽיִת׃
translation: The men did so, and took two milk cows and tied them to the cart, and shut up their calves at home. (1 Samuel 6:10)

text: וַיַּרְכִּיבוּ אֶת אֲרוֹן הָאֱלֹהִים עַל עֲגָלָה חֲדָשָׁה מִבֵּית אֲבִינָדָב וְעֻזָּא וְאַחְיוֹ נֹהֲגִים בָּעֲגָלָֽה׃
translation: They carried God's ark on a new cart, and brought it out of Abinadab's house; and Uzza and Ahio drove the cart. (1 Chronicles 13:7)

text: וְכֹל זִקְנֵי הָעִיר הַהִוא הַקְּרֹבִים אֶל הֶחָלָל יִרְחֲצוּ אֶת יְדֵיהֶם עַל הָעֶגְלָה הָעֲרוּפָה בַנָּֽחַל׃
translation: All the elders of that city which is nearest to the slain man shall wash their hands over the heifer whose neck was broken in the valley. (Deuteronomy 21:6)

text: וְהַנִּבְשָׁן וְעִיר הַמֶּלַח וְעֵין גֶּדִי עָרִים שֵׁשׁ וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃
translation: Nibshan, the City of Salt, and En Gedi; six cities with their villages. (Joshua 15:62)

text: לְמַטֵּה יוֹסֵף לְמַטֵּה מְנַשֶּׁה גַּדִּי בֶּן סוּסִֽי׃
translation: Of the tribe of Joseph, of the tribe of Manasseh, Gaddi the son of Susi. (Numbers 13:11)

text: יִגְאָל בֶּן נָתָן מִצֹּבָה בָּנִי הַגָּדִֽי׃
translation: Igal the son of Nathan of Zobah, Bani the Gadite, (2 Samuel 23:36)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר אָנֹכִי אֲשַׁלַּח גְּדִֽי עִזִּים מִן הַצֹּאן וַתֹּאמֶר אִם תִּתֵּן עֵרָבוֹן עַד שָׁלְחֶֽךָ׃
translation: He said, "I will send you a young goat from the flock." She said, "Will you give me a pledge, until you send it?" (Genesis 38:17)

text: וַיִּשְׁלַח יְהוּדָה אֶת גְּדִי הָֽעִזִּים בְּיַד רֵעֵהוּ הָֽעֲדֻלָּמִי לָקַחַת הָעֵרָבוֹן מִיַּד הָאִשָּׁה וְלֹא מְצָאָֽהּ׃
translation: Judah sent the young goat by the hand of his friend, the Adullamite, to receive the pledge from the woman's hand, but he didn't find her. (Genesis 38:20)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוּדָה תִּֽקַּֽח לָהּ פֶּן נִהְיֶה לָבוּז הִנֵּה שָׁלַחְתִּי הַגְּדִי הַזֶּה וְאַתָּה לֹא מְצָאתָֽהּ׃
translation: Judah said, "Let her keep it, lest we be shamed. Behold, I sent this young goat, and you haven't found her." (Genesis 38:23)

text: יְהוּדָה אַתָּה יוֹדוּךָ אַחֶיךָ יָדְךָ בְּעֹרֶף אֹיְבֶיךָ יִשְׁתַּחֲוּוּ לְךָ בְּנֵי אָבִֽיךָ׃
translation: "Judah, your brothers will praise you. Your hand will be on the neck of your enemies. Your father's sons will bow down before you. (Genesis 49:8)

text: בִּי אֲדֹנָי מָה אֹמַר אַחֲרֵי אֲשֶׁר הָפַךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל עֹרֶף לִפְנֵי אֹיְבָֽיו׃
translation: Oh, Lord, what shall I say, after Israel has turned their backs before their enemies? (Joshua 7:8)

text: כְּרֽוּחַ קָדִים אֲפִיצֵם לִפְנֵי אוֹיֵב עֹרֶף וְלֹֽא פָנִים אֶרְאֵם בְּיוֹם אֵידָֽם׃
translation: I will scatter them as with an east wind before the enemy. I will show them the back, and not the face, in the day of their calamity. (Jeremiah 18:17)

text: וְלֹא שָׁמֵעוּ וַיַּקְשׁוּ אֶת עָרְפָּם כְּעֹרֶף אֲבוֹתָם אֲשֶׁר לֹא הֶאֱמִינוּ בַּֽיהוָה אֱלֹהֵיהֶֽם׃
translation: Notwithstanding, they would not listen, but hardened their neck like the neck of their fathers who didn't believe in the LORD their God. (2 Kings 17:14)

text: וְלוֹא שָׁמְעוּ אֵלַי וְלֹא הִטּוּ אֶת אָזְנָם וַיַּקְשׁוּ אֶת עָרְפָּם הֵרֵעוּ מֵאֲבוֹתָֽם׃
translation: Yet they didn't listen to me or incline their ear, but made their neck stiff. They did worse than their fathers. (Jeremiah 7:26)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה רָאִיתִי אֶת הָעָם הַזֶּה וְהִנֵּה עַם קְשֵׁה עֹרֶף הֽוּא׃
translation: The LORD said to Moses, "I have seen these people, and behold, they are a stiff-necked people. (Exodus 32:9)

text: הֵן קֶדֶם אֶהֱלֹךְ וְאֵינֶנּוּ וְאָחוֹר וְֽלֹא אָבִין לֽוֹ׃
translation: "If I go east, he is not there. If I go west, I can't find him. (Job 23:8)

text: מַה לְּךָ הַיָּם כִּי תָנוּס הַיַּרְדֵּן תִּסֹּב לְאָחֽוֹר׃
translation: What was it, you sea, that you fled? You Jordan, that you turned back? (Psalms 114:5)

text: וַהֲסִרֹתִי אֶת כַּפִּי וְרָאִיתָ אֶת אֲחֹרָי וּפָנַי לֹא יֵרָאֽוּ׃
translation: then I will take away my hand, and you will see my back; but my face shall not be seen." (Exodus 33:23)

text: וַיַּךְ צָרָיו אָחוֹר חֶרְפַּת עוֹלָם נָתַן לָֽמוֹ׃
translation: He struck his adversaries backward. He put them to a perpetual reproach. (Psalms 78:66)

text: מִי בָכֶם יַאֲזִין זֹאת יַקְשִׁב וְיִשְׁמַע לְאָחֽוֹר׃
translation: Who is there among you who will give ear to this? Who will listen and hear for the time to come? (Isaiah 42:23)

text: בְּשׁוּב אוֹיְבַי אָחוֹר יִכָּשְׁלוּ וְיֹאבְדוּ מִפָּנֶֽיךָ׃
translation: For you have maintained my just cause. You sit on the throne judging righteously. (Psalms 9:4)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל בְּרוּכִים אַתֶּם לַֽיהוָה כִּי חֲמַלְתֶּם עָלָֽי׃
translation: Saul said, "You are blessed by the LORD, for you have had compassion on me. (1 Samuel 23:21)

text: וְיַשְׁלֵךְ עָלָיו וְלֹא יַחְמֹל מִיָּדוֹ בָּרוֹחַ יִבְרָֽח׃
translation: For it hurls at him, and does not spare, as he flees away from his hand. (Job 27:22)

text: וַיְקַנֵּא יְהוָה לְאַרְצוֹ וַיַּחְמֹל עַל עַמּֽוֹ׃
translation: Then the LORD was jealous for his land, and had pity on his people. (Joel 2:18)

text: וּתְהִי עוֹד נֶחָמָתִי וַאֲסַלְּדָה בְחִילָה לֹא יַחְמוֹל כִּי לֹא כִחַדְתִּי אִמְרֵי קָדֽוֹשׁ׃
translation: Let it still be my consolation, yes, let me exult in pain that doesn't spare, that I have not denied the words of the Holy One. (Job 6:10)

text: וָאֶחְמֹל עַל שֵׁם קָדְשִׁי אֲשֶׁר חִלְּלוּהוּ בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל בַּגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר בָּאוּ שָֽׁמָּה׃
translation: But I had respect for my holy name, which the house of Israel had profaned among the nations where they went. (Ezekiel 36:21)

text: וּלְאֵלֶּה אָמַר בְּאָזְנַי עִבְרוּ בָעִיר אַחֲרָיו וְהַכּוּ על אַל תָּחֹס עיניכם עֵינְכֶם וְאַל תַּחְמֹֽלוּ׃
translation: To the others he said in my hearing, "Go through the city after him, and strike. Don't let your eye spare, neither have pity. (Ezekiel 9:5)

text: וַיַּֽעֲמֶד לוֹ כֹּֽהֲנִים לַבָּמוֹת וְלַשְּׂעִירִים וְלָעֲגָלִים אֲשֶׁר עָשָֽׂה׃
translation: He himself appointed priests for the high places, for the male goat and calf idols which he had made. (2 Chronicles 11:15)

text: וַיִּקְרַב אַהֲרֹן אֶל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וַיִּשְׁחַט אֶת עֵגֶל הַחַטָּאת אֲשֶׁר לֽוֹ׃
translation: So Aaron came near to the altar, and killed the calf of the sin offering, which was for himself. (Leviticus 9:8)

text: זָנַח עֶגְלֵךְ שֹֽׁמְרוֹן חָרָה אַפִּי בָּם עַד מָתַי לֹא יוּכְלוּ נִקָּיֹֽן׃
translation: Let Samaria throw out his calf idol! My anger burns against them! How long will it be until they are capable of purity? (Hosea 8:5)

text: בַּמָּה אֲקַדֵּם יְהוָה אִכַּף לֵאלֹהֵי מָרוֹם הַאֲקַדְּמֶנּוּ בְעוֹלוֹת בַּעֲגָלִים בְּנֵי שָׁנָֽה׃
translation: How shall I come before the LORD, and bow myself before the exalted God? Shall I come before him with burnt offerings, with calves a year old? (Micah 6:6)

text: וַיִּגֹּף יְהוָה אֶת הָעָם עַל אֲשֶׁר עָשׂוּ אֶת הָעֵגֶל אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה אַהֲרֹֽן׃
translation: The LORD struck the people, because of what they did with the calf, which Aaron made. (Exodus 32:35)

text: וְרַגְלֵיהֶם רֶגֶל יְשָׁרָה וְכַף רַגְלֵיהֶם כְּכַף רֶגֶל עֵגֶל וְנֹצְצִים כְּעֵין נְחֹשֶׁת קָלָֽל׃
translation: Their feet were straight feet. The sole of their feet was like the sole of a calf's foot; and they sparkled like burnished bronze. (Ezekiel 1:7)

text: יָמַי עָבְרוּ זִמֹּתַי נִתְּקוּ מוֹרָשֵׁי לְבָבִֽי׃
translation: My days are past. My plans are broken off, as are the thoughts of my heart. (Job 17:11)

text: יִנָּתֵק מֵאָהֳלוֹ מִבְטַחוֹ וְתַצְעִדֵהוּ לְמֶלֶךְ בַּלָּהֽוֹת׃
translation: He will be rooted out of the security of his tent. He will be brought to the king of terrors. (Job 18:14)

text: וְעַתָּה אֶשְׁבֹּר מֹטֵהוּ מֵֽעָלָיִךְ וּמוֹסְרֹתַיִךְ אֲנַתֵּֽק׃
translation: Now I will break his yoke from off you, and will burst your bonds apart." (Nahum 1:13)

text: יֽוֹצִיאֵם מֵחֹשֶׁךְ וְצַלְמָוֶת וּמוֹסְרוֹתֵיהֶם יְנַתֵּֽק׃
translation: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death, and broke away their chains. (Psalms 107:14)

text: וְאַתָּה יְהוָה יְדַעְתָּנִי תִּרְאֵנִי וּבָחַנְתָּ לִבִּי אִתָּךְ הַתִּקֵם כְּצֹאן לְטִבְחָה וְהַקְדִּשֵׁם לְיוֹם הֲרֵגָֽה׃
translation: But you, LORD, know me. You see me, and test my heart toward you. Pull them out like sheep for the slaughter, and prepare them for the day of slaughter. (Jeremiah 12:3)

text: וְאִם בְּעֵינָיו עָמַד הַנֶּתֶק וְשֵׂעָר שָׁחֹר צָֽמַח בּוֹ נִרְפָּא הַנֶּתֶק טָהוֹר הוּא וְטִהֲרוֹ הַכֹּהֵֽן׃
translation: But if in his eyes the itch is arrested and black hair has grown in it, then the itch is healed. He is clean. The priest shall pronounce him clean. (Leviticus 13:37)

text: גַּם יְהוּדָה שָׁת קָצִיר לָךְ בְּשׁוּבִי שְׁבוּת עַמִּֽי׃
translation: "Also, Judah, there is a harvest appointed for you, when I restore the fortunes of my people. (Hosea 6:11)

text: רָצִיתָ יְהוָה אַרְצֶךָ שַׁבְתָּ שבות שְׁבִית יַעֲקֹֽב׃
translation: You have forgiven the iniquity of your people. You have covered all their sin. Selah. (Psalms 85:2)

text: וַהֲשִֽׁבֹתִי אֶת שְׁבוּת יְהוּדָה וְאֵת שְׁבוּת יִשְׂרָאֵל וּבְנִתִים כְּבָרִֽאשֹׁנָֽה׃
translation: I will restore the fortunes of Judah and Israel, and will build them as at the first. (Jeremiah 33:7)

text: וְאַחֲרֵי כֵן אָשִׁיב אֶת שְׁבוּת בְּנֵֽי עַמּוֹן נְאֻם יְהוָֽה׃
translation: "But afterward I will reverse the captivity of the children of Ammon," says the LORD. (Jeremiah 49:6)

text: וְשַׁבְתִּי שְׁבוּת מוֹאָב בְּאַחֲרִית הַיָּמִים נְאֻם יְהוָה עַד הֵנָּה מִשְׁפַּט מוֹאָֽב׃
translation: "Yet I will reverse the captivity of Moab in the latter days," says the LORD. Thus far is the judgment of Moab. (Jeremiah 48:47)

text: וְהָיָה בְּאַחֲרִית הַיָּמִים אשוב אָשִׁיב אֶת שבית שְׁבוּת עֵילָם נְאֻם יְהוָֽה׃
translation: 'But it will happen in the latter days that I will reverse the captivity of Elam,' says the LORD." (Jeremiah 49:39)

text: מֵאֵלֶּה נִפְרְדוּ אִיֵּי הַגּוֹיִם בְּאַרְצֹתָם אִישׁ לִלְשֹׁנוֹ לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם בְּגוֹיֵהֶֽם׃
translation: Of these were the islands of the nations divided in their lands, everyone after his language, after their families, in their nations. (Genesis 10:5)

text: סוּסֵיהֶם שְׁבַע מֵאוֹת שְׁלֹשִׁים וְשִׁשָּׁה פִּרְדֵיהֶם מָאתַיִם אַרְבָּעִים וַחֲמִשָּֽׁה׃
translation: Their horses were seven hundred thirty-six; their mules, two hundred forty-five; (Ezra 2:66)

text: אִישׁ בְּאָחִיהוּ יְדֻבָּקוּ יִתְלַכְּדוּ וְלֹא יִתְפָּרָֽדוּ׃
translation: Behold, the hope of him is in vain. Won't one be cast down even at the sight of him? (Job 41:9)

text: לְֽתַאֲוָה יְבַקֵּשׁ נִפְרָד בְּכָל תּוּשִׁיָּה יִתְגַּלָּֽע׃
translation: A man who isolates himself pursues selfishness, and defies all sound judgment. (Proverbs 18:1)

text: מִדְיָנִים יַשְׁבִּית הַגּוֹרָל וּבֵין עֲצוּמִים יַפְרִֽיד׃
translation: The lot settles disputes, and keeps strong ones apart. (Proverbs 18:18)

text: אֵלֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹת בְּנֵי נֹחַ לְתוֹלְדֹתָם בְּגוֹיֵהֶם וּמֵאֵלֶּה נִפְרְדוּ הַגּוֹיִם בָּאָרֶץ אַחַר הַמַּבּֽוּל׃
translation: These are the families of the sons of Noah, by their generations, according to their nations. The nations divided from these in the earth after the flood. (Genesis 10:32)

text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ הָעֵצִים לַתְּאֵנָה לְכִי אַתְּ מָלְכִי עָלֵֽינוּ׃
translation: "The trees said to the fig tree, 'Come and reign over us.' (Judges 9:10)

text: נֹצֵר תְּאֵנָה יֹאכַל פִּרְיָהּ וְשֹׁמֵר אֲדֹנָיו יְכֻבָּֽד׃
translation: Whoever tends the fig tree shall eat its fruit. He who looks after his master shall be honored. (Proverbs 27:18)

text: וַיַּךְ גַּפְנָם וּתְאֵנָתָם וַיְשַׁבֵּר עֵץ גְּבוּלָֽם׃
translation: He struck their vines and also their fig trees, and shattered the trees of their country. (Psalms 105:33)

text: כָּל מִבְצָרַיִךְ תְּאֵנִים עִם בִּכּוּרִים אִם יִנּוֹעוּ וְנָפְלוּ עַל פִּי אוֹכֵֽל׃
translation: All your fortresses will be like fig trees with the first-ripe figs. If they are shaken, they fall into the mouth of the eater. (Nahum 3:12)

text: וַתֹּאמֶר לָהֶם הַתְּאֵנָה הֶחֳדַלְתִּי אֶת מָתְקִי וְאֶת תְּנוּבָתִי הַטּוֹבָה וְהָלַכְתִּי לָנוּעַ עַל הָעֵצִֽים׃
translation: "But the fig tree said to them, 'Should I leave my sweetness, and my good fruit, and go to wave back and forth over the trees?' (Judges 9:11)

text: וְיָשְׁבוּ אִישׁ תַּחַת גַּפְנוֹ וְתַחַת תְּאֵנָתוֹ וְאֵין מַחֲרִיד כִּי פִי יְהוָה צְבָאוֹת דִּבֵּֽר׃
translation: But every man will sit under his vine and under his fig tree. No one will make them afraid, for the mouth of the LORD of Armies has spoken. (Micah 4:4)

text: כִּי יְהוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֵשׁ אֹכְלָה הוּא אֵל קַנָּֽא׃
translation: For the LORD your God is a devouring fire, a jealous God. (Deuteronomy 4:24)

text: לְדָוִד אַל תִּתְחַר בַּמְּרֵעִים אַל תְּקַנֵּא בְּעֹשֵׂי עַוְלָֽה׃
translation: By David. Don't fret because of evildoers, neither be envious against those who work unrighteousness. (Psalms 37:1)

text: אַל תְּקַנֵּא בְּאִישׁ חָמָס וְאַל תִּבְחַר בְּכָל דְּרָכָֽיו׃
translation: Don't envy the man of violence. Choose none of his ways. (Proverbs 3:31)

text: וַיְקַנְאוּ בוֹ אֶחָיו וְאָבִיו שָׁמַר אֶת הַדָּבָֽר׃
translation: His brothers envied him, but his father kept this saying in mind. (Genesis 37:11)

text: אַל תְּקַנֵּא בְּאַנְשֵׁי רָעָה וְאַל תתאו תִּתְאָיו לִהְיוֹת אִתָּֽם׃
translation: Don't be envious of evil men, neither desire to be with them; (Proverbs 24:1)

text: כִּֽי קִנֵּאתִי בַּֽהוֹלְלִים שְׁלוֹם רְשָׁעִים אֶרְאֶֽה׃
translation: For I was envious of the arrogant, when I saw the prosperity of the wicked. (Psalms 73:3)

text: וַיַּמְטֵר עֲלֵיהֶם מָן לֶאֱכֹל וּדְגַן שָׁמַיִם נָתַן לָֽמוֹ׃
translation: He rained down manna on them to eat, and gave them food from the sky. (Psalms 78:24)

text: יָשֻׁבוּ יֹשְׁבֵי בְצִלּוֹ יְחַיּוּ דָגָן וְיִפְרְחוּ כַגָּפֶן זִכְרוֹ כְּיֵין לְבָנֽוֹן׃
translation: Ephraim, what have I to do any more with idols? I answer, and will take care of him. I am like a green cypress tree; from me your fruit is found." (Hosea 14:8)

text: וְיֵשׁ אֲשֶׁר אֹמְרִים בָּנֵינוּ וּבְנֹתֵינוּ אֲנַחְנוּ רַבִּים וְנִקְחָה דָגָן וְנֹאכְלָה וְנִחְיֶֽה׃
translation: For there were some who said, "We, our sons and our daughters, are many. Let us get grain, that we may eat and live." (Nehemiah 5:2)

text: וְיֵשׁ אֲשֶׁר אֹמְרִים שְׂדֹתֵינוּ וּכְרָמֵינוּ וּבָתֵּינוּ אֲנַחְנוּ עֹרְבִים וְנִקְחָה דָגָן בָּרָעָֽב׃
translation: There were also some who said, "We are mortgaging our fields, our vineyards, and our houses. Let us get grain, because of the famine." (Nehemiah 5:3)

text: עָבְשׁוּ פְרֻדוֹת תַּחַת מֶגְרְפֹתֵיהֶם נָשַׁמּוּ אֹֽצָרוֹת נֶהֶרְסוּ מַמְּגֻרוֹת כִּי הֹבִישׁ דָּגָֽן׃
translation: The seeds rot under their clods. The granaries are laid desolate. The barns are broken down, for the grain has withered. (Joel 1:17)

text: פָּקַדְתָּ הָאָרֶץ וַתְּשֹׁקְקֶהָ רַבַּת תַּעְשְׁרֶנָּה פֶּלֶג אֱלֹהִים מָלֵא מָיִם תָּכִין דְּגָנָם כִּי כֵן תְּכִינֶֽהָ׃
translation: You drench its furrows. You level its ridges. You soften it with showers. You bless it with a crop. (Psalms 65:10)

text: וַיַּהֲפֹךְ יְהוֹרָם יָדָיו וַיָּנֹס וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל אֲחַזְיָהוּ מִרְמָה אֲחַזְיָֽה׃
translation: Joram turned his hands and fled, and said to Ahaziah, "This is treason, Ahaziah!" (2 Kings 9:23)

text: הָרֹה עָמָל וְיָלֹד אָוֶן וּבִטְנָם תָּכִין מִרְמָֽה׃
translation: They conceive mischief and produce iniquity. Their heart prepares deceit." (Job 15:35)

text: אָלָה פִּיהוּ מָלֵא וּמִרְמוֹת וָתֹךְ תַּחַת לְשׁוֹנוֹ עָמָל וָאָֽוֶן׃
translation: His mouth is full of cursing, deceit, and oppression. Under his tongue is mischief and iniquity. (Psalms 10:7)

text: דִּבְרֵי פִיו אָוֶן וּמִרְמָה חָדַל לְהַשְׂכִּיל לְהֵיטִֽיב׃
translation: He plots iniquity on his bed. He sets himself in a way that is not good. He doesn't abhor evil. (Psalms 36:4)

text: מִרְמָה בְּלֶב חֹרְשֵׁי רָע וּֽלְיֹעֲצֵי שָׁלוֹם שִׂמְחָֽה׃
translation: Deceit is in the heart of those who plot evil, but joy comes to the promoters of peace. (Proverbs 12:20)

text: בשפתו בִּשְׂפָתָיו יִנָּכֵר שׂוֹנֵא וּבְקִרְבּוֹ יָשִׁית מִרְמָֽה׃
translation: A malicious man disguises himself with his lips, but he harbors evil in his heart. (Proverbs 26:24)

text: כִּי לֹא יִטֹּשׁ יְהוָה עַמּוֹ וְנַחֲלָתוֹ לֹא יַעֲזֹֽב׃
translation: For the LORD won't reject his people, neither will he forsake his inheritance. (Psalms 94:14)

text: שְׁמַע בְּנִי מוּסַר אָבִיךָ וְאַל תִּטֹּשׁ תּוֹרַת אִמֶּֽךָ׃
translation: My son, listen to your father's instruction, and don't forsake your mother's teaching; (Proverbs 1:8)

text: נְצֹר בְּנִי מִצְוַת אָבִיךָ וְאַל תִּטֹּשׁ תּוֹרַת אִמֶּֽךָ׃
translation: My son, keep your father's commandment, and don't forsake your mother's teaching. (Proverbs 6:20)

text: וַיֹּסִפוּ עוֹד פְּלִשְׁתִּים לַֽעֲלוֹת וַיִּנָּֽטְשׁוּ בְּעֵמֶק רְפָאִֽים׃
translation: The Philistines came up yet again and spread themselves in the valley of Rephaim. (2 Samuel 5:22)

text: וַיִּטֹּשׁ מִשְׁכַּן שִׁלוֹ אֹהֶל שִׁכֵּן בָּאָדָֽם׃
translation: so that he abandoned the tent of Shiloh, the tent which he placed among men, (Psalms 78:60)

text: וּפְלִשְׁתִּים בָּאוּ וַיִּנָּטְשׁוּ בְּעֵמֶק רְפָאִֽים׃
translation: Now the Philistines had come and spread themselves in the valley of Rephaim. (2 Samuel 5:18)

text: סַמְּכוּנִי בָּֽאֲשִׁישׁוֹת רַפְּדוּנִי בַּתַּפּוּחִים כִּי חוֹלַת אַהֲבָה אָֽנִי׃
translation: Strengthen me with raisins, refresh me with apples; for I am faint with love. (Song of Solomon 2:5)

text: וַיִּכְרֹת יְהוֹנָתָן וְדָוִד בְּרִית בְּאַהֲבָתוֹ אֹתוֹ כְּנַפְשֽׁוֹ׃
translation: Then Jonathan and David made a covenant, because he loved him as his own soul. (1 Samuel 18:3)

text: וַיּוֹסֶף יְהֽוֹנָתָן לְהַשְׁבִּיעַ אֶת דָּוִד בְּאַהֲבָתוֹ אֹתוֹ כִּֽי אַהֲבַת נַפְשׁוֹ אֲהֵבֽוֹ׃
translation: Jonathan caused David to swear again, for the love that he had to him; for he loved him as he loved his own soul. (1 Samuel 20:17)

text: טוֹבָה תּוֹכַחַת מְגֻלָּה מֵֽאַהֲבָה מְסֻתָּֽרֶת׃
translation: Better is open rebuke than hidden love. (Proverbs 27:5)

text: מֵרָחוֹק יְהוָה נִרְאָה לִי וְאַהֲבַת עוֹלָם אֲהַבְתִּיךְ עַל כֵּן מְשַׁכְתִּיךְ חָֽסֶד׃
translation: The LORD appeared of old to me, saying, "Yes, I have loved you with an everlasting love. Therefore I have drawn you with loving kindness. (Jeremiah 31:3)

text: עַמּוּדָיו עָשָׂה כֶסֶף רְפִידָתוֹ זָהָב מֶרְכָּבוֹ אַרְגָּמָן תּוֹכוֹ רָצוּף אַהֲבָה מִבְּנוֹת יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
translation: He made its pillars of silver, its bottom of gold, its seat of purple, the middle of it being paved with love, from the daughters of Jerusalem. (Song of Solomon 3:10)

text: וּבְנֵי מְרָרִי מַחְלִי וּמוּשִׁי אֵלֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹת הַלֵּוִי לְתֹלְדֹתָֽם׃
translation: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. These are the families of the Levites according to their generations. (Exodus 6:19)

text: אֵלֶּה רָאשֵׁי אָבוֹת לְתֹלְדוֹתָם רָאשִׁים אֵלֶּה יָשְׁבוּ בִירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
translation: These were heads of fathers' households throughout their generations, chief men. These lived in Jerusalem. (1 Chronicles 8:28)

text: וְאֵלֶּה תּוֹלְדֹת יִצְחָק בֶּן אַבְרָהָם אַבְרָהָם הוֹלִיד אֶת יִצְחָֽק׃
translation: This is the history of the generations of Isaac, Abraham's son. Abraham became the father of Isaac. (Genesis 25:19)

text: וְאֵלֶּה תֹּלְדוֹת עֵשָׂו אֲבִי אֱדוֹם בְּהַר שֵׂעִֽיר׃
translation: This is the history of the generations of Esau the father of the Edomites in the hill country of Seir: (Genesis 36:9)

text: וְאֵלֶּה תּוֹלְדוֹת פָּרֶץ פֶּרֶץ הוֹלִיד אֶת חֶצְרֽוֹן׃
translation: Now this is the history of the generations of Perez: Perez became the father of Hezron, (Ruth 4:18)

text: אֵלֶּה רָאשֵׁי הָאָבוֹת לַלְוִיִּם לְתֹלְדוֹתָם רָאשִׁים אֵלֶּה יָשְׁבוּ בִירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
translation: These were heads of fathers' households of the Levites, throughout their generations, chief men. They lived at Jerusalem. (1 Chronicles 9:34)

text: וַיַּנְחֵם לָבֶטַח וְלֹא פָחָדוּ וְאֶת אוֹיְבֵיהֶם כִּסָּה הַיָּֽם׃
translation: He led them safely, so that they weren't afraid, but the sea overwhelmed their enemies. (Psalms 78:53)

text: וּרְאֵה אִם דֶּֽרֶךְ עֹצֶב בִּי וּנְחֵנִי בְּדֶרֶךְ עוֹלָֽם׃
translation: See if there is any wicked way in me, and lead me in the everlasting way. (Psalms 139:24)

text: דְּרָכָיו רָאִיתִי וְאֶרְפָּאֵהוּ וְאַנְחֵהוּ וַאֲשַׁלֵּם נִֽחֻמִים לוֹ וְלַאֲבֵלָֽיו׃
translation: I have seen his ways, and will heal him. I will lead him also, and restore comforts to him and to his mourners. (Isaiah 57:18)

text: כִּי מִנְּעוּרַי גְּדֵלַנִי כְאָב וּמִבֶּטֶן אִמִּי אַנְחֶֽנָּה׃
translation: (no, from my youth he grew up with me as with a father, I have guided her from my mother's womb); (Job 31:18)

text: הֲתֹצִיא מַזָּרוֹת בְּעִתּוֹ וְעַיִשׁ עַל בָּנֶיהָ תַנְחֵֽם׃
translation: Can you lead the constellations out in their season? Or can you guide the Bear with her cubs? (Job 38:32)

text: וַיַּנְחֵם בֶּעָנָן יוֹמָם וְכָל הַלַּיְלָה בְּאוֹר אֵֽשׁ׃
translation: In the daytime he also led them with a cloud, and all night with a light of fire. (Psalms 78:14)

text: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ כֵן בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַֽיִּלְקְטוּ הַמַּרְבֶּה וְהַמַּמְעִֽיט׃
translation: The children of Israel did so, and some gathered more, some less. (Exodus 16:17)

text: שֵׁשֶׁת יָמִים תִּלְקְטֻהוּ וּבַיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי שַׁבָּת לֹא יִֽהְיֶה בּֽוֹ׃
translation: Six days you shall gather it, but on the seventh day is the Sabbath. In it there shall be none." (Exodus 16:26)

text: וַֽיְהִי בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי יָצְאוּ מִן הָעָם לִלְקֹט וְלֹא מָצָֽאוּ׃
translation: On the seventh day, some of the people went out to gather, and they found none. (Exodus 16:27)

text: תִּתֵּן לָהֶם יִלְקֹטוּן תִּפְתַּח יָֽדְךָ יִשְׂבְּעוּן טֽוֹב׃
translation: You give to them; they gather. You open your hand; they are satisfied with good. (Psalms 104:28)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר יַעֲקֹב לְאֶחָיו לִקְטוּ אֲבָנִים וַיִּקְחוּ אֲבָנִים וַיַּֽעֲשׂוּ גָל וַיֹּאכְלוּ שָׁם עַל הַגָּֽל׃
translation: Jacob said to his relatives, "Gather stones." They took stones, and made a heap. They ate there by the heap. (Genesis 31:46)

text: וּֽבְקֻצְרְכֶם אֶת קְצִיר אַרְצְכֶם לֹא תְכַלֶּה פְּאַת שָׂדְךָ לִקְצֹר וְלֶקֶט קְצִֽירְךָ לֹא תְלַקֵּֽט׃
translation: "'When you reap the harvest of your land, you shall not wholly reap the corners of your field, neither shall you gather the gleanings of your harvest. (Leviticus 19:9)

text: הַמַּבְלִיג שֹׁד עַל עָז וְשֹׁד עַל מִבְצָר יָבֽוֹא׃
translation: who brings sudden destruction on the strong, so that destruction comes on the fortress. (Amos 5:9)

text: וְעָרֵי מִבְצָר הַצִּדִּים צֵר וְחַמַּת רַקַּת וְכִנָּֽרֶת׃
translation: The fortified cities were Ziddim, Zer, Hammath, Rakkath, Chinnereth, (Joshua 19:35)

text: פָּרַצְתָּ כָל גְּדֵרֹתָיו שַׂמְתָּ מִבְצָרָיו מְחִתָּה׃
translation: All who pass by the way rob him. He has become a reproach to his neighbors. (Psalms 89:41)

text: וְהִכְרַתִּי עָרֵי אַרְצֶךָ וְהָרַסְתִּי כָּל מִבְצָרֶֽיךָ׃
translation: "It will happen in that day", says the LORD, "that I will cut off your horses from among you and will destroy your chariots. (Micah 5:10)

text: אֵלֶּה הַמְשָׁרְתִים אֶת הַמֶּלֶךְ מִלְּבַד אֲשֶׁר נָתַן הַמֶּלֶךְ בְּעָרֵי הַמִּבְצָר בְּכָל יְהוּדָֽה׃
translation: These were those who waited on the king, in addition to those whom the king put in the fortified cities throughout all Judah. (2 Chronicles 17:19)

text: וַיָּבֹאוּ מִבְצַר צֹר וְכָל עָרֵי הַחִוִּי וְהַֽכְּנַעֲנִי וַיֵּֽצְאוּ אֶל נֶגֶב יְהוּדָה בְּאֵר שָֽׁבַע׃
translation: and came to the stronghold of Tyre, and to all the cities of the Hivites and of the Canaanites; and they went out to the south of Judah, at Beersheba. (2 Samuel 24:7)

text: הַחֵפֶץ לְשַׁדַּי כִּי תִצְדָּק וְאִם בֶּצַע כִּֽי תַתֵּם דְּרָכֶֽיךָ׃
translation: Is it any pleasure to the Almighty that you are righteous? Or does it benefit him that you make your ways perfect? (Job 22:3)

text: הַט לִבִּי אֶל עֵדְוֺתֶיךָ וְאַל אֶל בָּֽצַע׃
translation: Turn my heart toward your statutes, not toward selfish gain. (Psalms 119:36)

text: כֵּן אָרְחוֹת כָּל בֹּצֵֽעַ בָּצַע אֶת נֶפֶשׁ בְּעָלָיו יִקָּֽח׃
translation: So are the ways of everyone who is greedy for gain. It takes away the life of its owners. (Proverbs 1:19)

text: כִּי מַה תִּקְוַת חָנֵף כִּי יִבְצָע כִּי יֵשֶׁל אֱלוֹהַּ נַפְשֽׁוֹ׃
translation: For what is the hope of the godless, when he is cut off, when God takes away his life? (Job 27:8)

text: כִּֽי הִלֵּל רָשָׁע עַל תַּאֲוַת נַפְשׁוֹ וּבֹצֵעַ בֵּרֵךְ נִאֵץ יְהוָֽה׃
translation: For the wicked boasts of his heart's cravings. He blesses the greedy and condemns the LORD. (Psalms 10:3)

text: מַה בֶּצַע בְּדָמִי בְּרִדְתִּי אֶל שָׁחַת הֲיוֹדְךָ עָפָר הֲיַגִּיד אֲמִתֶּֽךָ׃
translation: Hear, LORD, and have mercy on me. LORD, be my helper." (Psalms 30:10)

text: דַּרְכֵי שְׁאוֹל בֵּיתָהּ יֹרְדוֹת אֶל חַדְרֵי מָֽוֶת׃
translation: Her house is the way to Sheol, going down to the rooms of death. (Proverbs 7:27)

text: דִּבְרֵי נִרְגָּן כְּמִֽתְלַהֲמִים וְהֵם יָרְדוּ חַדְרֵי בָֽטֶן׃
translation: The words of a gossip are like dainty morsels: they go down into a person's innermost parts. (Proverbs 18:8)

text: דִּבְרֵי נִרְגָּן כְּמִֽתְלַהֲמִים וְהֵם יָרְדוּ חַדְרֵי בָֽטֶן׃
translation: The words of a whisperer are as dainty morsels, they go down into the innermost parts. (Proverbs 26:22)

text: עֹֽשֶׂה עָשׁ כְּסִיל וְכִימָה וְחַדְרֵי תֵמָֽן׃
translation: He makes the Bear, Orion, and the Pleiades, and the rooms of the south. (Job 9:9)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר מִיכָיְהוּ הִנְּךָ רֹאֶה בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא אֲשֶׁר תָּבֹא חֶדֶר בְּחֶדֶר לְהֵחָבֵֽה׃
translation: Micaiah said, "Behold, you will see on that day when you go into an inner room to hide yourself." (1 Kings 22:25)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר מִיכָיְהוּ הִנְּךָ רֹאֶה בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא אֲשֶׁר תָּבוֹא חֶדֶר בְּחֶדֶר לְהֵחָבֵֽא׃
translation: Micaiah said, "Behold, you shall see on that day, when you go into an inner room to hide yourself." (2 Chronicles 18:24)

text: שִׂפְתֵי חֲכָמִים יְזָרוּ דָעַת וְלֵב כְּסִילִים לֹא כֵֽן׃
translation: The lips of the wise spread knowledge; not so with the heart of fools. (Proverbs 15:7)

text: מֶלֶךְ יוֹשֵׁב עַל כִּסֵּא דִין מְזָרֶה בְעֵינָיו כָּל רָֽע׃
translation: A king who sits on the throne of judgment scatters away all evil with his eyes. (Proverbs 20:8)

text: וְיָדְעוּ כִּֽי אֲנִי יְהוָה בַּהֲפִיצִי אוֹתָם בַּגּוֹיִם וְזֵרִיתִי אוֹתָם בָּאֲרָצֽוֹת׃
translation: "'They will know that I am the LORD when I disperse them among the nations and scatter them through the countries. (Ezekiel 12:15)

text: וַהֲפִצוֹתִי אֶת מִצְרַיִם בַּגּוֹיִם וְזֵרִיתִם בָּאֲרָצֽוֹת׃
translation: I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations, and will disperse them through the countries. (Ezekiel 30:23)

text: וּלְהַפִּיל זַרְעָם בַּגּוֹיִם וּלְזָרוֹתָם בָּאֲרָצֽוֹת׃
translation: that he would overthrow their offspring among the nations, and scatter them in the lands. (Psalms 106:27)

text: וְהָאֲלָפִים וְהָעֲיָרִים עֹֽבְדֵי הָֽאֲדָמָה בְּלִיל חָמִיץ יֹאכֵלוּ אֲשֶׁר זֹרֶה בָרַחַת וּבַמִּזְרֶֽה׃
translation: The oxen likewise and the young donkeys that till the ground will eat savory feed, which has been winnowed with the shovel and with the fork. (Isaiah 30:24)

text: וְהֵבִיא הַכֹּהֵן הַמָּשִׁיחַ מִדַּם הַפָּר אֶל אֹהֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃
translation: The anointed priest shall bring some of the blood of the bull to the Tent of Meeting. (Leviticus 4:16)

text: אֲשֶׁר חֵרְפוּ אוֹיְבֶיךָ יְהוָה אֲשֶׁר חֵרְפוּ עִקְּבוֹת מְשִׁיחֶֽךָ׃
translation: Blessed be the LORD forever more. Amen, and Amen. (Psalms 89:52)

text: יְהוָה עֹֽז לָמוֹ וּמָעוֹז יְשׁוּעוֹת מְשִׁיחוֹ הֽוּא׃
translation: The LORD is their strength. He is a stronghold of salvation to his anointed. (Psalms 28:8)

text: בַּעֲבוּר דָּוִד עַבְדֶּךָ אַל תָּשֵׁב פְּנֵי מְשִׁיחֶֽךָ׃
translation: For your servant David's sake, don't turn away the face of your anointed one. (Psalms 132:10)

text: שָׁם אַצְמִיחַ קֶרֶן לְדָוִד עָרַכְתִּי נֵר לִמְשִׁיחִֽי׃
translation: I will make the horn of David to bud there. I have ordained a lamp for my anointed. (Psalms 132:17)

text: וְלָקַח הַכֹּהֵן הַמָּשִׁיחַ מִדַּם הַפָּר וְהֵבִיא אֹתוֹ אֶל אֹהֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃
translation: The anointed priest shall take some of the blood of the bull, and bring it to the Tent of Meeting. (Leviticus 4:5)

text: וְעַתָּה שָׁלַחְתִּי אִישׁ חָכָם יוֹדֵעַ בִּינָה לְחוּרָם אָבִֽי׃
translation: Huram continued, "Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, who made heaven and earth, who has given to David the king a wise son, endowed with discretion and understanding, who would build a house for the LORD and a house for his kingdom. (2 Chronicles 2:12)

text: כִּי בַעַר אָנֹכִי מֵאִישׁ וְלֹֽא בִינַת אָדָם לִֽי׃
translation: "Surely I am the most ignorant man, and don't have a man's understanding. (Proverbs 30:2)

text: וְֽהַחָכְמָה מֵאַיִן תִּמָּצֵא וְאֵי זֶה מְקוֹם בִּינָֽה׃
translation: "But where will wisdom be found? Where is the place of understanding? (Job 28:12)

text: וְֽהַחָכְמָה מֵאַיִן תָּבוֹא וְאֵי זֶה מְקוֹם בִּינָֽה׃
translation: Where then does wisdom come from? Where is the place of understanding? (Job 28:20)

text: וְאִם בִּינָה שִׁמְעָה זֹּאת הַאֲזִינָה לְקוֹל מִלָּֽי׃
translation: "If now you have understanding, hear this. Listen to the voice of my words. (Job 34:16)

text: מִי שָׁת בַּטֻּחוֹת חָכְמָה אוֹ מִֽי נָתַן לַשֶּׂכְוִי בִינָֽה׃
translation: Who has put wisdom in the inward parts? Or who has given understanding to the mind? (Job 38:36)

text: עֹשֶׂה גְדֹלוֹת וְאֵין חֵקֶר נִפְלָאוֹת עַד אֵין מִסְפָּֽר׃
translation: who does great things that can't be fathomed, marvelous things without number; (Job 5:9)

text: כִּֽי שְׁאַל נָא לְדֹר רִישׁוֹן וְכוֹנֵן לְחֵקֶר אֲבוֹתָֽם׃
translation: "Please inquire of past generations. Find out about the learning of their fathers. (Job 8:8)

text: הַחֵקֶר אֱלוֹהַ תִּמְצָא אִם עַד תַּכְלִית שַׁדַּי תִּמְצָֽא׃
translation: "Can you fathom the mystery of God? Or can you probe the limits of the Almighty? (Job 11:7)

text: כְּבֹד אֱלֹהִים הַסְתֵּר דָּבָר וּכְבֹד מְלָכִים חֲקֹר דָּבָֽר׃
translation: It is the glory of God to conceal a thing, but the glory of kings is to search out a matter. (Proverbs 25:2)

text: שָׁמַיִם לָרוּם וָאָרֶץ לָעֹמֶק וְלֵב מְלָכִים אֵין חֵֽקֶר׃
translation: As the heavens for height, and the earth for depth, so the hearts of kings are unsearchable. (Proverbs 25:3)

text: אָכֹל דְּבַשׁ הַרְבּוֹת לֹא טוֹב וְחֵקֶר כְּבֹדָם כָּבֽוֹד׃
translation: It is not good to eat much honey, nor is it honorable to seek one's own honor. (Proverbs 25:27)

text: הֶאָנֹכִי לְאָדָם שִׂיחִי וְאִם מַדּוּעַ לֹא תִקְצַר רוּחִֽי׃
translation: As for me, is my complaint to man? Why shouldn't I be impatient? (Job 21:4)

text: שְׁמַע אֱלֹהִים קוֹלִי בְשִׂיחִי מִפַּחַד אוֹיֵב תִּצֹּר חַיָּֽי׃
translation: Hide me from the conspiracy of the wicked, from the noisy crowd of the ones doing evil; (Psalms 64:2)

text: גַּם יָֽשְׁבוּ שָׂרִים בִּי נִדְבָּרוּ עַבְדְּךָ יָשִׂיחַ בְּחֻקֶּֽיךָ׃
translation: Though princes sit and slander me, your servant will meditate on your statutes. (Psalms 119:23)

text: וְאֶשָּֽׂא כַפַּי אֶֽל מִצְוֺתֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר אָהָבְתִּי וְאָשִׂיחָה בְחֻקֶּֽיךָ׃
translation: I reach out my hands for your commandments, which I love. I will meditate on your statutes. ZAYIN (Psalms 119:48)

text: שִׁירוּ לוֹ זַמְּרוּ לוֹ שִׂיחוּ בְּכָל נִפְלְאֹתָֽיו׃
translation: Sing to him. Sing praises to him. Tell of all his marvelous works. (1 Chronicles 16:9)

text: אִם אָמְרִי אֶשְׁכְּחָה שִׂיחִי אֶעֶזְבָה פָנַי וְאַבְלִֽיגָה׃
translation: If I say, 'I will forget my complaint, I will put off my sad face, and cheer up,' (Job 9:27)

text: וְעַל יָדוֹ יְהוֹחָנָן הַשָּׂר וְעִמּוֹ מָאתַיִם וּשְׁמוֹנִים אָֽלֶף׃
translation: and next to him Jehohanan the captain, and with him two hundred eighty thousand; (2 Chronicles 17:15)

text: וּמִבְּנֵי שְׁפַטְיָה זְבַדְיָה בֶּן מִֽיכָאֵל וְעִמּוֹ שְׁמֹנִים הַזְּכָרִֽים׃
translation: Of the sons of Shephatiah, Zebadiah the son of Michael; and with him eighty males. (Ezra 8:8)

text: וַֽיְחִי לֶמֶךְ שְׁתַּיִם וּשְׁמֹנִים שָׁנָה וּמְאַת שָׁנָה וַיּוֹלֶד בֵּֽן׃
translation: Lamech lived one hundred eighty-two years, then became the father of a son. (Genesis 5:28)

text: וַיִּֽהְיוּ יְמֵי יִצְחָק מְאַת שָׁנָה וּשְׁמֹנִים שָׁנָֽה׃
translation: The days of Isaac were one hundred eighty years. (Genesis 35:28)

text: וַיִּהְיוּ פְּקֻדֵיהֶם שְׁמֹנַת אֲלָפִים וַחֲמֵשׁ מֵאוֹת וּשְׁמֹנִֽים׃
translation: even those who were counted of them, were eight thousand five hundred eighty. (Numbers 4:48)

text: וְעַל יָדוֹ יְהוֹזָבָד וְעִמּוֹ מֵאָֽה וּשְׁמוֹנִים אֶלֶף חֲלוּצֵי צָבָֽא׃
translation: and next to him Jehozabad, and with him one hundred eighty thousand ready and prepared for war. (2 Chronicles 17:18)

text: וְאֶת שְׂדֽוֹתֵיכֶם וְאֶת כַּרְמֵיכֶם וְזֵיתֵיכֶם הַטּוֹבִים יִקָּח וְנָתַן לַעֲבָדָֽיו׃
translation: He will take your fields, your vineyards, and your olive groves, even your best, and give them to his servants. (1 Samuel 8:14)

text: וּשְׁנַיִם זֵיתִים עָלֶיהָ אֶחָד מִימִין הַגֻּלָּה וְאֶחָד עַל שְׂמֹאלָֽהּ׃
translation: and two olive trees by it, one on the right side of the bowl, and the other on the left side of it." (Zechariah 4:3)

text: הָלוֹךְ הָֽלְכוּ הָעֵצִים לִמְשֹׁחַ עֲלֵיהֶם מֶלֶךְ וַיֹּאמְרוּ לַזַּיִת מלוכה מָלְכָה עָלֵֽינוּ׃
translation: The trees set out to anoint a king over themselves. They said to the olive tree, 'Reign over us.' (Judges 9:8)

text: צַו אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְיִקְחוּ אֵלֶיךָ שֶׁמֶן זַיִת זָךְ כָּתִית לַמָּאוֹר לְהַעֲלֹת נֵר תָּמִֽיד׃
translation: "Command the children of Israel, that they bring to you pure olive oil beaten for the light, to cause a lamp to burn continually. (Leviticus 24:2)

text: וְאַתָּה תְּצַוֶּה אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְיִקְחוּ אֵלֶיךָ שֶׁמֶן זַיִת זָךְ כָּתִית לַמָּאוֹר לְהַעֲלֹת נֵר תָּמִֽיד׃
translation: "You shall command the children of Israel, that they bring to you pure olive oil beaten for the light, to cause a lamp to burn continually. (Exodus 27:20)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶם הַזַּיִת הֶחֳדַלְתִּי אֶת דִּשְׁנִי אֲשֶׁר בִּי יְכַבְּדוּ אֱלֹהִים וַאֲנָשִׁים וְהָלַכְתִּי לָנוּעַ עַל הָעֵצִֽים׃
translation: "But the olive tree said to them, 'Should I stop producing my oil, with which they honor God and man by me, and go to wave back and forth over the trees?' (Judges 9:9)

text: גּוֹל עַל יְהוָה דַּרְכֶּךָ וּבְטַח עָלָיו וְהוּא יַעֲשֶֽׂה׃
translation: Commit your way to the LORD. Trust also in him, and he will do this: (Psalms 37:5)

text: וּבַקְבַּקַּר חֶרֶשׁ וְגָלָל וּמַתַּנְיָה בֶּן מִיכָא בֶּן זִכְרִי בֶּן אָסָֽף׃
translation: and Bakbakkar, Heresh, Galal, and Mattaniah the son of Mica, the son of Zichri, the son of Asaph, (1 Chronicles 9:15)

text: כְּֽגֶלֲלוֹ לָנֶצַח יֹאבֵד רֹאָיו יֹאמְרוּ אַיּֽוֹ׃
translation: yet he will perish forever like his own dung. Those who have seen him will say, 'Where is he?' (Job 20:7)

text: כְּפֶרֶץ רָחָב יֶאֱתָיוּ תַּחַת שֹׁאָה הִתְגַּלְגָּֽלוּ׃
translation: As through a wide breach they come. They roll themselves in amid the ruin. (Job 30:14)

text: גֹּל אֶל יְהוָה מַעֲשֶׂיךָ וְיִכֹּנוּ מַחְשְׁבֹתֶֽיךָ׃
translation: Commit your deeds to the LORD, and your plans shall succeed. (Proverbs 16:3)

text: אִמְרִי נָא אֲחֹתִי אָתְּ לְמַעַן יִֽיטַב לִי בַעֲבוּרֵךְ וְחָיְתָה נַפְשִׁי בִּגְלָלֵֽךְ׃
translation: Please say that you are my sister, that it may be well with me for your sake, and that my soul may live because of you." (Genesis 12:13)

text: יְהוָה אֱלֹהִים צְבָאוֹת עַד מָתַי עָשַׁנְתָּ בִּתְפִלַּת עַמֶּֽךָ׃
translation: You have fed them with the bread of tears, and given them tears to drink in large measure. (Psalms 80:5)

text: וְנָֽתַתִּי מֽוֹפְתִים בַּשָּׁמַיִם וּבָאָרֶץ דָּם וָאֵשׁ וְתִֽימֲרוֹת עָשָֽׁן׃
translation: and have cast lots for my people, and have given a boy for a prostitute, and sold a girl for wine, that they may drink. (Joel 3:3)

text: וְלַאֲשֶׁר בְּחָרְמָה וְלַאֲשֶׁר בְּבוֹר עָשָׁן וְלַאֲשֶׁר בַּעֲתָֽךְ׃
translation: to those who were in Hormah, to those who were in Borashan, to those who were in Athach, (1 Samuel 30:30)

text: וְאֶת עָשָׁן וְאֶת מִגְרָשֶׁיהָ וְאֶת בֵּית שֶׁמֶשׁ וְאֶת מִגְרָשֶֽׁיהָ׃
translation: On the left hand their brothers the sons of Merari: Ethan the son of Kishi, the son of Abdi, the son of Malluch, (1 Chronicles 6:44)

text: יְהוָה הַט שָׁמֶיךָ וְתֵרֵד גַּע בֶּהָרִים וְֽיֶעֱשָֽׁנוּ׃
translation: Part your heavens, LORD, and come down. Touch the mountains, and they will smoke. (Psalms 144:5)

text: הֵילִילִֽי שַׁעַר זַֽעֲקִי עִיר נָמוֹג פְּלֶשֶׁת כֻּלֵּךְ כִּי מִצָּפוֹן עָשָׁן בָּא וְאֵין בּוֹדֵד בְּמוֹעָדָֽיו׃
translation: Howl, gate! Cry, city! You are melted away, Philistia, all of you; for smoke comes out of the north, and there is no straggler in his ranks. (Isaiah 14:31)

text: לָמָּה תָשִׁיב יָדְךָ וִֽימִינֶךָ מִקֶּרֶב חוקך חֵֽיקְךָ כַלֵּֽה׃
translation: Why do you draw back your hand, even your right hand? Take it from your chest and consume them! (Psalms 74:11)

text: וַתִּקַּח נָעֳמִי אֶת הַיֶּלֶד וַתְּשִׁתֵהוּ בְחֵיקָהּ וַתְּהִי לוֹ לְאֹמֶֽנֶת׃
translation: Naomi took the child, laid him in her bosom, and became nurse to him. (Ruth 4:16)

text: זְכֹר אֲדֹנָי חֶרְפַּת עֲבָדֶיךָ שְׂאֵתִי בְחֵיקִי כָּל רַבִּים עַמִּֽים׃
translation: With which your enemies have mocked, LORD, with which they have mocked the footsteps of your anointed one. (Psalms 89:51)

text: הֲיַחְתֶּה אִישׁ אֵשׁ בְּחֵיקוֹ וּבְגָדָיו לֹא תִשָּׂרַֽפְנָה׃
translation: Can a man scoop fire into his lap, and his clothes not be burned? (Proverbs 6:27)

text: אַל תְּבַהֵל בְּרֽוּחֲךָ לִכְעוֹס כִּי כַעַס בְּחֵיק כְּסִילִים יָנֽוּחַ׃
translation: Don't be hasty in your spirit to be angry, for anger rests in the bosom of fools. (Ecclesiastes 7:9)

text: וַאֲנִי בַּחֲלוֹתָם לְבוּשִׁי שָׂק עִנֵּיתִי בַצּוֹם נַפְשִׁי וּתְפִלָּתִי עַל חֵיקִי תָשֽׁוּב׃
translation: But as for me, when they were sick, my clothing was sackcloth. I afflicted my soul with fasting. My prayer returned into my own bosom. (Psalms 35:13)

text: כֹּל חֵלֶב יִצְהָר וְכָל חֵלֶב תִּירוֹשׁ וְדָגָן רֵאשִׁיתָם אֲשֶׁר יִתְּנוּ לַֽיהוָה לְךָ נְתַתִּֽים׃
translation: "I have given to you all the best of the oil, all the best of the vintage, and of the grain, the first fruits of them which they give to the LORD. (Numbers 18:12)

text: וַתֹּאמֶר לָהֶם הַגֶּפֶן הֶחֳדַלְתִּי אֶת תִּירוֹשִׁי הַֽמְשַׂמֵּחַ אֱלֹהִים וַאֲנָשִׁים וְהָלַכְתִּי לָנוּעַ עַל הָעֵצִֽים׃
translation: "The vine said to them, 'Should I leave my new wine, which cheers God and man, and go to wave back and forth over the trees?' (Judges 9:13)

text: עַד בֹּאִי וְלָקַחְתִּי אֶתְכֶם אֶל אֶרֶץ כְּאַרְצְכֶם אֶרֶץ דָּגָן וְתִירוֹשׁ אֶרֶץ לֶחֶם וּכְרָמִֽים׃
translation: until I come and take you away to a land like your own land, a land of grain and new wine, a land of bread and vineyards. (Isaiah 36:17)

text: וְלֹֽא זָעֲקוּ אֵלַי בְּלִבָּם כִּי יְיֵלִילוּ עַל מִשְׁכְּבוֹתָם עַל דָּגָן וְתִירוֹשׁ יִתְגּוֹרָרוּ יָסוּרוּ בִֽי׃
translation: They haven't cried to me with their heart, but they howl on their beds. They assemble themselves for grain and new wine. They turn away from me. (Hosea 7:14)

text: וְהִיא לֹא יָֽדְעָה כִּי אָֽנֹכִי נָתַתִּי לָהּ הַדָּגָן וְהַתִּירוֹשׁ וְהַיִּצְהָר וְכֶסֶף הִרְבֵּיתִי לָהּ וְזָהָב עָשׂוּ לַבָּֽעַל׃
translation: Now I will uncover her lewdness in the sight of her lovers, and no one will deliver her out of my hand. (Hosea 2:10)

text: וְכִפְרֹץ הַדָּבָר הִרְבּוּ בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵל רֵאשִׁית דָּגָן תִּירוֹשׁ וְיִצְהָר וּדְבַשׁ וְכֹל תְּבוּאַת שָׂדֶה וּמַעְשַׂר הַכֹּל לָרֹב הֵבִֽיאוּ׃
translation: As soon as the commandment went out, the children of Israel gave in abundance the first fruits of grain, new wine, oil, honey, and of all the increase of the field; and they brought in the tithe of all things abundantly. (2 Chronicles 31:5)

text: וּבָנִיתָ שָּׁם מִזְבֵּחַ לַיהוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ מִזְבַּח אֲבָנִים לֹא תָנִיף עֲלֵיהֶם בַּרְזֶֽל׃
translation: There you shall build an altar to the LORD your God, an altar of stones. You shall not use any iron tool on them. (Deuteronomy 27:5)

text: נַפְתִּי מִשְׁכָּבִי מֹר אֲהָלִים וְקִנָּמֽוֹן׃
translation: I have perfumed my bed with myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon. (Proverbs 7:17)

text: עוֹד הַיּוֹם בְּנֹב לַֽעֲמֹד יְנֹפֵף יָדוֹ הַר בית בַּת צִיּוֹן גִּבְעַת יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
translation: This very day he will halt at Nob. He shakes his hand at the mountain of the daughter of Zion, the hill of Jerusalem. (Isaiah 10:32)

text: וְלָקַח הַכֹּהֵן אֶת כֶּבֶשׂ הָאָשָׁם וְאֶת לֹג הַשָּׁמֶן וְהֵנִיף אֹתָם הַכֹּהֵן תְּנוּפָה לִפְנֵי יְהוָֽה׃
translation: The priest shall take the lamb of the trespass offering, and the log of oil, and the priest shall wave them for a wave offering before the LORD. (Leviticus 14:24)

text: וַיִּֽתְחַטְּאוּ הַלְוִיִּם וַֽיְכַבְּסוּ בִּגְדֵיהֶם וַיָּנֶף אַהֲרֹן אֹתָם תְּנוּפָה לִפְנֵי יְהוָה וַיְכַפֵּר עֲלֵיהֶם אַהֲרֹן לְטַהֲרָֽם׃
translation: The Levites purified themselves from sin, and they washed their clothes; and Aaron offered them for a wave offering before the LORD and Aaron made atonement for them to cleanse them. (Numbers 8:21)

text: כִּי הִנְנִי מֵנִיף אֶת יָדִי עֲלֵיהֶם וְהָיוּ שָׁלָל לְעַבְדֵיהֶם וִֽידַעְתֶּם כִּֽי יְהוָה צְבָאוֹת שְׁלָחָֽנִי׃
translation: Be silent, all flesh, before the LORD; for he has roused himself from his holy habitation!" (Zechariah 2:13)

text: וּתְכֵלֶת וְאַרְגָּמָן וְתוֹלַעַת שָׁנִי וְשֵׁשׁ וְעִזִּֽים׃
translation: blue, purple, scarlet, fine linen, goats' hair, (Exodus 25:4)

text: וּתְכֵלֶת וְאַרְגָּמָן וְתוֹלַעַת שָׁנִי וְשֵׁשׁ וְעִזִּֽים׃
translation: blue, purple, scarlet, fine linen, goats' hair, (Exodus 35:6)

text: וְהֵם יִקְחוּ אֶת הַזָּהָב וְאֶת הַתְּכֵלֶת וְאֶת הָֽאַרְגָּמָן וְאֶת תּוֹלַעַת הַשָּׁנִי וְאֶת הַשֵּֽׁשׁ׃
translation: They shall use the gold, and the blue, and the purple, and the scarlet, and the fine linen. (Exodus 28:5)

text: וְחֵשֶׁב אֲפֻדָּתוֹ אֲשֶׁר עָלָיו כְּמַעֲשֵׂהוּ מִמֶּנּוּ יִהְיֶה זָהָב תְּכֵלֶת וְאַרְגָּמָן וְתוֹלַעַת שָׁנִי וְשֵׁשׁ מָשְׁזָֽר׃
translation: The skillfully woven band, which is on it, shall be like its work and of the same piece; of gold, blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen. (Exodus 28:8)

text: וְאֶת הַמִּשְׁכָּן תַּעֲשֶׂה עֶשֶׂר יְרִיעֹת שֵׁשׁ מָשְׁזָר וּתְכֵלֶת וְאַרְגָּמָן וְתֹלַעַת שָׁנִי כְּרֻבִים מַעֲשֵׂה חֹשֵׁב תַּעֲשֶׂה אֹתָֽם׃
translation: "Moreover you shall make the tabernacle with ten curtains of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet, with cherubim. You shall make them with the work of a skillful workman. (Exodus 26:1)

text: וּלְשַׁעַר הֶֽחָצֵר מָסָךְ עֶשְׂרִים אַמָּה תְּכֵלֶת וְאַרְגָּמָן וְתוֹלַעַת שָׁנִי וְשֵׁשׁ מָשְׁזָר מַעֲשֵׂה רֹקֵם עַמֻּֽדֵיהֶם אַרְבָּעָה וְאַדְנֵיהֶם אַרְבָּעָֽה׃
translation: For the gate of the court shall be a screen of twenty cubits, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, the work of the embroiderer; their pillars four, and their sockets four. (Exodus 27:16)

text: מִֽי פָקַד עָלָיו אָרְצָה וּמִי שָׂם תֵּבֵל כֻּלָּֽהּ׃
translation: Who put him in charge of the earth? Or who has appointed him over the whole world? (Job 34:13)

text: לְדָוִד מִזְמוֹר לַֽיהוָה הָאָרֶץ וּמְלוֹאָהּ תֵּבֵל וְיֹשְׁבֵי בָֽהּ׃
translation: A Psalm by David. The earth is the LORD's, with its fullness; the world, and those who dwell in it. (Psalms 24:1)

text: עַד לֹא עָשָׂה אֶרֶץ וְחוּצוֹת וְרֹאשׁ עָפְרוֹת תֵּבֵֽל׃
translation: while as yet he had not made the earth, nor the fields, nor the beginning of the dust of the world. (Proverbs 8:26)

text: חִילוּ מִלְּפָנָיו כָּל הָאָרֶץ אַף תִּכּוֹן תֵּבֵל בַּל תִּמּֽוֹט׃
translation: Tremble before him, all the earth. The world also is established that it can't be moved. (1 Chronicles 16:30)

text: יִֽירְאוּ מֵיְהוָה כָּל הָאָרֶץ מִמֶּנּוּ יָגוּרוּ כָּל יֹשְׁבֵי תֵבֵֽל׃
translation: Let all the earth fear the LORD. Let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of him. (Psalms 33:8)

text: אִם אֶרְעַב לֹא אֹמַר לָךְ כִּי לִי תֵבֵל וּמְלֹאָֽהּ׃
translation: If I were hungry, I would not tell you, for the world is mine, and all that is in it. (Psalms 50:12)

text: זֶה עֶשֶׂר פְּעָמִים תַּכְלִימוּנִי לֹֽא תֵבֹשׁוּ תַּהְכְּרוּ לִֽי׃
translation: You have reproached me ten times. You aren't ashamed that you attack me. (Job 19:3)

text: אַל תֵּצֵא לָרִב מַהֵר פֶּן מַה תַּעֲשֶׂה בְּאַחֲרִיתָהּ בְּהַכְלִים אֹתְךָ רֵעֶֽךָ׃
translation: Don't be hasty in bringing charges to court. What will you do in the end when your neighbor shames you? (Proverbs 25:8)

text: הֵן יֵבֹשׁוּ וְיִכָּלְמוּ כֹּל הַנֶּחֱרִים בָּךְ יִֽהְיוּ כְאַיִן וְיֹאבְדוּ אַנְשֵׁי רִיבֶֽךָ׃
translation: Behold, all those who are incensed against you will be disappointed and confounded. Those who strive with you will be like nothing, and shall perish. (Isaiah 41:11)

text: וַיִּתְגַּנֵּב הָעָם בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא לָבוֹא הָעִיר כַּאֲשֶׁר יִתְגַּנֵּב הָעָם הַנִּכְלָמִים בְּנוּסָם בַּמִּלְחָמָֽה׃
translation: The king covered his face, and the king cried with a loud voice, "My son Absalom, Absalom, my son, my son!" (2 Samuel 19:4)

text: יִשְׂרָאֵל נוֹשַׁע בַּיהוָה תְּשׁוּעַת עוֹלָמִים לֹא תֵבֹשׁוּ וְלֹא תִכָּלְמוּ עַד עוֹלְמֵי עַֽד׃
translation: Israel will be saved by the LORD with an everlasting salvation. You will not be disappointed nor confounded to ages everlasting. (Isaiah 45:17)

text: וַתָּקָם לְלַקֵּט וַיְצַו בֹּעַז אֶת נְעָרָיו לֵאמֹר גַּם בֵּין הָֽעֳמָרִים תְּלַקֵּט וְלֹא תַכְלִימֽוּהָ׃
translation: When she had risen up to glean, Boaz commanded his young men, saying, "Let her glean even among the sheaves, and don't reproach her. (Ruth 2:15)

text: וְאֶת הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה עֲשֵׂה הָסֵר הַמְּלָכִים אִישׁ מִמְּקֹמוֹ וְשִׂים פַּחוֹת תַּחְתֵּיהֶֽם׃
translation: Do this thing: take the kings away, every man out of his place, and put captains in their place. (1 Kings 20:24)

text: אֱמֹר אֶל זְרֻבָּבֶל פַּֽחַת יְהוּדָה לֵאמֹר אֲנִי מַרְעִישׁ אֶת הַשָּׁמַיִם וְאֶת הָאָֽרֶץ׃
translation: "Speak to Zerubbabel, governor of Judah, saying, 'I will shake the heavens and the earth. (Haggai 2:21)

text: אֵלֶּה בִּימֵי יוֹיָקִים בֶּן יֵשׁוּעַ בֶּן יוֹצָדָק וּבִימֵי נְחֶמְיָה הַפֶּחָה וְעֶזְרָא הַכֹּהֵן הַסּוֹפֵֽר׃
translation: These were in the days of Joiakim the son of Jeshua, the son of Jozadak, and in the days of Nehemiah the governor, and of Ezra the priest and scribe. (Nehemiah 12:26)

text: וְאֵיךְ תָּשִׁיב אֵת פְּנֵי פַחַת אַחַד עַבְדֵי אֲדֹנִי הַקְּטַנִּים וַתִּבְטַח לְךָ עַל מִצְרַיִם לְרֶכֶב וּלְפָרָשִֽׁים׃
translation: How then can you turn away the face of one captain of the least of my master's servants, and put your trust on Egypt for chariots and for horsemen? (2 Kings 18:24)

text: וְאֵיךְ תָּשִׁיב אֵת פְּנֵי פַחַת אַחַד עַבְדֵי אֲדֹנִי הַקְטַנִּים וַתִּבְטַח לְךָ עַל מִצְרַיִם לְרֶכֶב וּלְפָרָשִֽׁים׃
translation: How then can you turn away the face of one captain of the least of my master's servants, and put your trust in Egypt for chariots and for horsemen? (Isaiah 36:9)

text: וְהִשְׁכַּרְתִּי שָׂרֶיהָ וַחֲכָמֶיהָ פַּחוֹתֶיהָ וּסְגָנֶיהָ וְגִבּוֹרֶיהָ וְיָשְׁנוּ שְׁנַת עוֹלָם וְלֹא יָקִיצוּ נְאֻם הַמֶּלֶךְ יְהוָה צְבָאוֹת שְׁמֽוֹ׃
translation: I will make her princes, her wise men, her governors, her deputies, and her mighty men drunk. They will sleep a perpetual sleep, and not wake up," says the King, whose name is the LORD of Armies. (Jeremiah 51:57)

text: דִּֽי לֶהֱוֺן מְהַקְרְבִין נִיחוֹחִין לֶאֱלָהּ שְׁמַיָּא וּמְצַלַּיִן לְחַיֵּי מַלְכָּא וּבְנֽוֹהִי׃
translation: that they may offer sacrifices of pleasant aroma to the God of heaven, and pray for the life of the king and of his sons. (Ezra 6:10)

text: כָּל דִּי מִן טַעַם אֱלָהּ שְׁמַיָּא יִתְעֲבֵד אַדְרַזְדָּא לְבֵית אֱלָהּ שְׁמַיָּא דִּֽי לְמָה לֶֽהֱוֵא קְצַף עַל מַלְכוּת מַלְכָּא וּבְנֽוֹהִי׃
translation: Whatever is commanded by the God of heaven, let it be done exactly for the house of the God of heaven; for why should there be wrath against the realm of the king and his sons? (Ezra 7:23)

text: יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם הִרְבָּה אֶתְכֶם וְהִנְּכֶם הַיּוֹם כְּכוֹכְבֵי הַשָּׁמַיִם לָרֹֽב׃
translation: The LORD your God has multiplied you, and behold, you are today as the stars of the sky for multitude. (Deuteronomy 1:10)

text: הֲֽלֹא אֱלוֹהַּ גֹּבַהּ שָׁמָיִם וּרְאֵה רֹאשׁ כּוֹכָבִים כִּי רָֽמּוּ׃
translation: "Isn't God in the heights of heaven? See the height of the stars, how high they are! (Job 22:12)

text: הֵן עַד יָרֵחַ וְלֹא יַאֲהִיל וְכוֹכָבִים לֹא זַכּוּ בְעֵינָֽיו׃
translation: Behold, even the moon has no brightness, and the stars are not pure in his sight; (Job 25:5)

text: הַֽלְלוּהוּ שֶׁמֶשׁ וְיָרֵחַ הַלְלוּהוּ כָּל כּוֹכְבֵי אֽוֹר׃
translation: Praise him, sun and moon! Praise him, all you shining stars! (Psalms 148:3)

text: מוֹנֶה מִסְפָּר לַכּוֹכָבִים לְכֻלָּם שֵׁמוֹת יִקְרָֽא׃
translation: He counts the number of the stars. He calls them all by their names. (Psalms 147:4)

text: לְפָנָיו רָגְזָה אֶרֶץ רָעֲשׁוּ שָׁמָיִם שֶׁמֶשׁ וְיָרֵחַ קָדָרוּ וְכוֹכָבִים אָסְפוּ נָגְהָֽם׃
translation: The earth quakes before them. The heavens tremble. The sun and the moon are darkened, and the stars withdraw their shining. (Joel 2:10)

text: בַּבֶּטֶן עָקַב אֶת אָחִיו וּבְאוֹנוֹ שָׂרָה אֶת אֱלֹהִֽים׃
translation: Indeed, he struggled with the angel, and prevailed; he wept, and made supplication to him. He found him at Bethel, and there he spoke with us— (Hosea 12:4)

text: וְהִתְבָּרֲכוּ בְזַרְעֲךָ כֹּל גּוֹיֵי הָאָרֶץ עֵקֶב אֲשֶׁר שָׁמַעְתָּ בְּקֹלִֽי׃
translation: All the nations of the earth will be blessed by your offspring, because you have obeyed my voice.'" (Genesis 22:18)

text: לָמָּה אִירָא בִּימֵי רָע עֲוֺן עֲקֵבַי יְסוּבֵּֽנִי׃
translation: Those who trust in their wealth, and boast in the multitude of their riches— (Psalms 49:6)

text: בַּיָּם דַּרְכֶּךָ ושביליך וּֽשְׁבִֽילְךָ בְּמַיִם רַבִּים וְעִקְּבוֹתֶיךָ לֹא נֹדָֽעוּ׃
translation: You led your people like a flock, by the hand of Moses and Aaron. (Psalms 77:20)

text: עֵקֶב עֲנָוָה יִרְאַת יְהוָה עֹשֶׁר וְכָבוֹד וְחַיִּֽים׃
translation: The result of humility and the fear of the LORD is wealth, honor, and life. (Proverbs 22:4)

text: עֵקֶב אֲשֶׁר שָׁמַע אַבְרָהָם בְּקֹלִי וַיִּשְׁמֹר מִשְׁמַרְתִּי מִצְוֺתַי חֻקּוֹתַי וְתוֹרֹתָֽי׃
translation: because Abraham obeyed my voice, and kept my requirements, my commandments, my statutes, and my laws." (Genesis 26:5)

text: טֶרֶם אֶעֱנֶה אֲנִי שֹׁגֵג וְעַתָּה אִמְרָתְךָ שָׁמָֽרְתִּי׃
translation: Before I was afflicted, I went astray; but now I observe your word. (Psalms 119:67)

text: רָאִיתִי בֹגְדִים וָֽאֶתְקוֹטָטָה אֲשֶׁר אִמְרָתְךָ לֹא שָׁמָֽרוּ׃
translation: I look at the faithless with loathing, because they don't observe your word. (Psalms 119:158)

text: תַּעַן לְשׁוֹנִי אִמְרָתֶךָ כִּי כָל מִצְוֺתֶיךָ צֶּֽדֶק׃
translation: Let my tongue sing of your word, for all your commandments are righteousness. (Psalms 119:172)

text: אֲנִֽי קְרָאתִיךָ כִֽי תַעֲנֵנִי אֵל הַֽט אָזְנְךָ לִי שְׁמַע אִמְרָתִֽי׃
translation: I have called on you, for you will answer me, God. Turn your ear to me. Hear my speech. (Psalms 17:6)

text: זֹאת נֶחָמָתִי בְעָנְיִי כִּי אִמְרָתְךָ חִיָּֽתְנִי׃
translation: This is my comfort in my affliction, for your word has revived me. (Psalms 119:50)

text: חִלִּיתִי פָנֶיךָ בְכָל לֵב חָנֵּנִי כְּאִמְרָתֶֽךָ׃
translation: I sought your favor with my whole heart. Be merciful to me according to your word. (Psalms 119:58)

text: וַיַּךְ כָּל בְּכוֹר בְּמִצְרָיִם רֵאשִׁית אוֹנִים בְּאָהֳלֵי חָֽם׃
translation: and struck all the firstborn in Egypt, the chief of their strength in the tents of Ham. (Psalms 78:51)

text: אֵלֶּה בְנֵי חָם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם לִלְשֹֽׁנֹתָם בְּאַרְצֹתָם בְּגוֹיֵהֶֽם׃
translation: These are the sons of Ham, after their families, according to their languages, in their lands and their nations. (Genesis 10:20)

text: וַיָּבֹא יִשְׂרָאֵל מִצְרָיִם וְיַעֲקֹב גָּר בְּאֶֽרֶץ חָֽם׃
translation: Israel also came into Egypt. Jacob lived in the land of Ham. (Psalms 105:23)

text: שָֽׂמוּ בָם דִּבְרֵי אֹתוֹתָיו וּמֹפְתִים בְּאֶרֶץ חָֽם׃
translation: They performed miracles among them, and wonders in the land of Ham. (Psalms 105:27)

text: נִפְלָאוֹת בְּאֶרֶץ חָם נוֹרָאוֹת עַל יַם סֽוּף׃
translation: wondrous works in the land of Ham, and awesome things by the Red Sea. (Psalms 106:22)

text: וַיּוֹלֶד נֹחַ שְׁלֹשָׁה בָנִים אֶת שֵׁם אֶת חָם וְאֶת יָֽפֶת׃
translation: Noah became the father of three sons: Shem, Ham, and Japheth. (Genesis 6:10)

text: וְאַתָּה בְּתוֹךְ עֲרֵלִים תִּשָּׁבַר וְתִשְׁכַּב אֶת חַלְלֵי חָֽרֶב׃
translation: "But you will be broken among the uncircumcised, and will lie with those who are slain by the sword. (Ezekiel 32:28)

text: מִמִּי נָעָמְתָּ רְדָה וְהָשְׁכְּבָה אֶת עֲרֵלִֽים׃
translation: Whom do you pass in beauty? Go down, and be laid with the uncircumcised. (Ezekiel 32:19)

text: מוֹתֵי עֲרֵלִים תָּמוּת בְּיַד זָרִים כִּי אֲנִי דִבַּרְתִּי נְאֻם אֲדֹנָי יְהוִֽה׃
translation: You will die the death of the uncircumcised by the hand of strangers; for I have spoken it," says the Lord GOD.'" (Ezekiel 28:10)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה לִפְנֵי יְהוָה הֵן אֲנִי עֲרַל שְׂפָתַיִם וְאֵיךְ יִשְׁמַע אֵלַי פַּרְעֹֽה׃
translation: Moses said before the LORD, "Behold, I am of uncircumcised lips, and how shall Pharaoh listen to me?" (Exodus 6:30)

text: יְדַבְּרוּ לוֹ אֵלֵי גִבּוֹרִים מִתּוֹךְ שְׁאוֹל אֶת עֹֽזְרָיו יָֽרְדוּ שָׁכְבוּ הָעֲרֵלִים חַלְלֵי חָֽרֶב׃
translation: The strong among the mighty will speak to him out of the middle of Sheol with those who help him. They have gone down. The uncircumcised lie still, slain by the sword. (Ezekiel 32:21)

text: וְעָרֵל זָכָר אֲשֶׁר לֹֽא יִמּוֹל אֶת בְּשַׂר עָרְלָתוֹ וְנִכְרְתָה הַנֶּפֶשׁ הַהִוא מֵעַמֶּיהָ אֶת בְּרִיתִי הֵפַֽר׃
translation: The uncircumcised male who is not circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin, that soul shall be cut off from his people. He has broken my covenant." (Genesis 17:14)

text: כֹּל בְּנֵי דָוִיד מִלְּבַד בְּֽנֵי פִֽילַגְשִׁים וְתָמָר אֲחוֹתָֽם׃
translation: All these were the sons of David, in addition to the sons of the concubines; and Tamar was their sister. (1 Chronicles 3:9)

text: פִּלֶגֶשׁ כָּלֵב מַעֲכָה יָלַד שֶׁבֶר וְאֶֽת תִּרְחֲנָֽה׃
translation: Maacah, Caleb's concubine, bore Sheber and Tirhanah. (1 Chronicles 2:48)

text: וּפִֽילַגְשׁוֹ אֲשֶׁר בִּשְׁכֶם יָֽלְדָה לּוֹ גַם הִיא בֵּן וַיָּשֶׂם אֶת שְׁמוֹ אֲבִימֶֽלֶךְ׃
translation: His concubine who was in Shechem also bore him a son, and he named him Abimelech. (Judges 8:31)

text: וָֽאֹחֵז בְּפִֽילַגְשִׁי וָֽאֲנַתְּחֶהָ וָֽאֲשַׁלְּחֶהָ בְּכָל שְׂדֵה נַחֲלַת יִשְׂרָאֵל כִּי עָשׂוּ זִמָּה וּנְבָלָה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
translation: I took my concubine and cut her in pieces, and sent her throughout all the country of the inheritance of Israel; for they have committed lewdness and folly in Israel. (Judges 20:6)

text: וַיֵּצֵא הַמֶּלֶךְ וְכָל בֵּיתוֹ בְּרַגְלָיו וַיַּעֲזֹב הַמֶּלֶךְ אֵת עֶשֶׂר נָשִׁים פִּֽלַגְשִׁים לִשְׁמֹר הַבָּֽיִת׃
translation: The king went out, and all his household after him. The king left ten women, who were concubines, to keep the house. (2 Samuel 15:16)

text: וַיַּטּוּ לְאַבְשָׁלוֹם הָאֹהֶל עַל הַגָּג וַיָּבֹא אַבְשָׁלוֹם אֶל פִּֽלַגְשֵׁי אָבִיו לְעֵינֵי כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
translation: So they spread a tent for Absalom on the top of the house, and Absalom went in to his father's concubines in the sight of all Israel. (2 Samuel 16:22)

text: וְהָיָה מֵהַנַּחַל תִּשְׁתֶּה וְאֶת הָעֹרְבִים צִוִּיתִי לְכַלְכֶּלְךָ שָֽׁם׃
translation: You shall drink from the brook. I have commanded the ravens to feed you there." (1 Kings 17:4)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶל בַּרְזִלָּי אַתָּה עֲבֹר אִתִּי וְכִלְכַּלְתִּי אֹתְךָ עִמָּדִי בִּירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
translation: Barzillai said to the king, "How many are the days of the years of my life, that I should go up with the king to Jerusalem? (2 Samuel 19:34)

text: הַשְׁלֵךְ עַל יְהוָה יְהָבְךָ וְהוּא יְכַלְכְּלֶךָ לֹא יִתֵּן לְעוֹלָם מוֹט לַצַּדִּֽיק׃
translation: But you, God, will bring them down into the pit of destruction. Bloodthirsty and deceitful men shall not live out half their days, but I will trust in you. (Psalms 55:23)

text: וַיְכַלְכֵּל יוֹסֵף אֶת אָבִיו וְאֶת אֶחָיו וְאֵת כָּל בֵּית אָבִיו לֶחֶם לְפִי הַטָּֽף׃
translation: Joseph provided his father, his brothers, and all of his father's household with bread, according to the sizes of their families. (Genesis 47:12)

text: וְעַתָּה אַל תִּירָאוּ אָנֹכִי אֲכַלְכֵּל אֶתְכֶם וְאֶֽת טַפְּכֶם וַיְנַחֵם אוֹתָם וַיְדַבֵּר עַל לִבָּֽם׃
translation: Now therefore don't be afraid. I will provide for you and your little ones." He comforted them, and spoke kindly to them. (Genesis 50:21)

text: קוּם לֵךְ צָרְפַתָה אֲשֶׁר לְצִידוֹן וְיָשַׁבְתָּ שָׁם הִנֵּה צִוִּיתִי שָׁם אִשָּׁה אַלְמָנָה לְכַלְכְּלֶֽךָ׃
translation: "Arise, go to Zarephath, which belongs to Sidon, and stay there. Behold, I have commanded a widow there to sustain you." (1 Kings 17:9)

text: הֲתַאֲמִין בּוֹ כִּי ישוב יָשִׁיב זַרְעֶךָ וְֽגָרְנְךָ יֶאֱסֹֽף׃
translation: Will you confide in him, that he will bring home your seed, and gather the grain of your threshing floor? (Job 39:12)

text: רֵאשִׁית עֲרִסֹתֵכֶם חַלָּה תָּרִימוּ תְרוּמָה כִּתְרוּמַת גֹּרֶן כֵּן תָּרִימוּ אֹתָֽהּ׃
translation: Of the first of your dough you shall offer up a cake for a wave offering. As the wave offering of the threshing floor, so you shall heave it. (Numbers 15:20)

text: וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵהֶם בַּהֲרִֽימְכֶם אֶת חֶלְבּוֹ מִמֶּנּוּ וְנֶחְשַׁב לַלְוִיִּם כִּתְבוּאַת גֹּרֶן וְכִתְבוּאַת יָֽקֶב׃
translation: "Therefore you shall tell them, 'When you heave its best from it, then it shall be credited to the Levites as the increase of the threshing floor, and as the increase of the wine press. (Numbers 18:30)

text: הַעֲנֵיק תַּעֲנִיק לוֹ מִצֹּאנְךָ וּמִֽגָּרְנְךָ וּמִיִּקְבֶךָ אֲשֶׁר בֵּרַכְךָ יְהוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ תִּתֶּן לֽוֹ׃
translation: You shall furnish him liberally out of your flock, out of your threshing floor, and out of your wine press. As the LORD your God has blessed you, you shall give to him. (Deuteronomy 15:14)

text: מְדֻשָׁתִי וּבֶן גָּרְנִי אֲשֶׁר שָׁמַעְתִּי מֵאֵת יְהוָה צְבָאוֹת אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הִגַּדְתִּי לָכֶֽם׃
translation: You are my threshing, and the grain of my floor!" That which I have heard from the LORD of Armies, the God of Israel, I have declared to you. (Isaiah 21:10)

text: וְהֵמָּה לֹא יָֽדְעוּ מַחְשְׁבוֹת יְהוָה וְלֹא הֵבִינוּ עֲצָתוֹ כִּי קִבְּצָם כֶּעָמִיר גֹּֽרְנָה׃
translation: But they don't know the thoughts of the LORD, neither do they understand his counsel; for he has gathered them like the sheaves to the threshing floor. (Micah 4:12)

text: שַׂק תָּפַרְתִּי עֲלֵי גִלְדִּי וְעֹלַלְתִּי בֶעָפָר קַרְנִֽי׃
translation: I have sewed sackcloth on my skin, and have thrust my horn in the dust. (Job 16:15)

text: כִּי תִבְצֹר כַּרְמְךָ לֹא תְעוֹלֵל אַחֲרֶיךָ לַגֵּר לַיָּתוֹם וְלָאַלְמָנָה יִהְיֶֽה׃
translation: When you harvest your vineyard, you shall not glean it after yourselves. It shall be for the foreigner, for the fatherless, and for the widow. (Deuteronomy 24:21)

text: עֵינִי עֽוֹלְלָה לְנַפְשִׁי מִכֹּל בְּנוֹת עִירִֽי׃
translation: My eye affects my soul, because of all the daughters of my city. (Lamentations 3:51)

text: עַמִּי נֹגְשָׂיו מְעוֹלֵל וְנָשִׁים מָשְׁלוּ בוֹ עַמִּי מְאַשְּׁרֶיךָ מַתְעִים וְדֶרֶךְ אֹֽרְחֹתֶיךָ בִּלֵּֽעוּ׃
translation: As for my people, children are their oppressors, and women rule over them. My people, those who lead you cause you to err, and destroy the way of your paths. (Isaiah 3:12)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר בִּלְעָם לָֽאָתוֹן כִּי הִתְעַלַּלְתְּ בִּי לוּ יֶשׁ חֶרֶב בְּיָדִי כִּי עַתָּה הֲרַגְתִּֽיךְ׃
translation: Balaam said to the donkey, "Because you have mocked me, I wish there were a sword in my hand, for now I would have killed you." (Numbers 22:29)

text: וְכַרְמְךָ לֹא תְעוֹלֵל וּפֶרֶט כַּרְמְךָ לֹא תְלַקֵּט לֶֽעָנִי וְלַגֵּר תַּעֲזֹב אֹתָם אֲנִי יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃
translation: You shall not glean your vineyard, neither shall you gather the fallen grapes of your vineyard. You shall leave them for the poor and for the foreigner. I am the LORD your God. (Leviticus 19:10)

text: אַשְׁרֵי הָעָם שֶׁכָּכָה לּוֹ אַֽשְׁרֵי הָעָם שֶׁיֲהוָה אֱלֹהָֽיו׃
translation: Happy are the people who are in such a situation. Happy are the people whose God is the LORD. (Psalms 144:15)

text: כַּמִּסְפָּר אֲשֶׁר תַּעֲשׂוּ כָּכָה תַּעֲשׂוּ לָאֶחָד כְּמִסְפָּרָֽם׃
translation: According to the number that you shall prepare, so you shall do to everyone according to their number. (Numbers 15:12)

text: מַה דּוֹדֵךְ מִדּוֹד הַיָּפָה בַּנָּשִׁים מַה דּוֹדֵךְ מִדּוֹד שֶׁכָּכָה הִשְׁבַּעְתָּֽנוּ׃
translation: How is your beloved better than another beloved, you fairest among women? How is your beloved better than another beloved, that you do so adjure us? (Song of Solomon 5:9)

text: וְעָשִׂיתָ לְאַהֲרֹן וּלְבָנָיו כָּכָה כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר צִוִּיתִי אֹתָכָה שִׁבְעַת יָמִים תְּמַלֵּא יָדָֽם׃
translation: "You shall do so to Aaron and to his sons, according to all that I have commanded you. You shall consecrate them seven days. (Exodus 29:35)

text: כָּכָה יֵעָשֶׂה לַשּׁוֹר הָֽאֶחָד אוֹ לָאַיִל הָאֶחָד אֽוֹ לַשֶּׂה בַכְּבָשִׂים אוֹ בָעִזִּֽים׃
translation: Thus it shall be done for each bull, for each ram, for each of the male lambs, or of the young goats. (Numbers 15:11)

text: כֹּה אָמַר יְהוָה כָּכָה אַשְׁחִית אֶת גְּאוֹן יְהוּדָה וְאֶת גְּאוֹן יְרוּשָׁלִַם הָרָֽב׃
translation: "The LORD says, 'In this way I will ruin the pride of Judah, and the great pride of Jerusalem. (Jeremiah 13:9)

text: וְֽיָדַעְתָּ כִּי שָׁלוֹם אָהֳלֶךָ וּֽפָקַדְתָּ נָוְךָ וְלֹא תֶחֱטָֽא׃
translation: You will know that your tent is in peace. You will visit your fold, and will miss nothing. (Job 5:24)

text: מַלְכֵי צְבָאוֹת יִדֹּדוּן יִדֹּדוּן וּנְוַת בַּיִת תְּחַלֵּק שָׁלָֽל׃
translation: while you sleep among the camp fires, the wings of a dove sheathed with silver, her feathers with shining gold. (Psalms 68:13)

text: אוֹצָר נֶחְמָד וָשֶׁמֶן בִּנְוֵה חָכָם וּכְסִיל אָדָם יְבַלְּעֶֽנּוּ׃
translation: There is precious treasure and oil in the dwelling of the wise, but a foolish man swallows it up. (Proverbs 21:20)

text: אַל תֶּאֱרֹב רָשָׁע לִנְוֵה צַדִּיק אַֽל תְּשַׁדֵּד רִבְצוֹ׃
translation: Don't lay in wait, wicked man, against the habitation of the righteous. Don't destroy his resting place; (Proverbs 24:15)

text: כִּי אָכַל אֶֽת יַעֲקֹב וְֽאֶת נָוֵהוּ הֵשַֽׁמּוּ׃
translation: for they have devoured Jacob, and destroyed his homeland. (Psalms 79:7)

text: מְאֵרַת יְהוָה בְּבֵית רָשָׁע וּנְוֵה צַדִּיקִים יְבָרֵֽךְ׃
translation: The LORD's curse is in the house of the wicked, but he blesses the habitation of the righteous. (Proverbs 3:33)

text: וּבְשֶׁטֶף עֹבֵר כָּלָה יַעֲשֶׂה מְקוֹמָהּ וְאֹיְבָיו יְרַדֶּף חֹֽשֶׁךְ׃
translation: But with an overflowing flood, he will make a full end of her place, and will pursue his enemies into darkness. (Nahum 1:8)

text: אֲזַי הַמַּיִם שְׁטָפוּנוּ נַחְלָה עָבַר עַל נַפְשֵֽׁנוּ׃
translation: then the waters would have overwhelmed us, the stream would have gone over our soul. (Psalms 124:4)

text: אֲבָנִים שָׁחֲקוּ מַיִם תִּשְׁטֹֽף סְפִיחֶיהָ עֲפַר אָרֶץ וְתִקְוַת אֱנוֹשׁ הֶאֱבַֽדְתָּ׃
translation: The waters wear the stones. The torrents of it wash away the dust of the earth. So you destroy the hope of man. (Job 14:19)

text: וּכְלִי חֶרֶשׂ אֲשֶׁר יִגַּע בּוֹ הַזָּב יִשָּׁבֵר וְכָל כְּלִי עֵץ יִשָּׁטֵף בַּמָּֽיִם׃
translation: "'The earthen vessel, which he who has the discharge touches, shall be broken; and every vessel of wood shall be rinsed in water. (Leviticus 15:12)

text: עַל זֹאת יִתְפַּלֵּל כָּל חָסִיד אֵלֶיךָ לְעֵת מְצֹא רַק לְשֵׁטֶף מַיִם רַבִּים אֵלָיו לֹא יַגִּֽיעוּ׃
translation: For this, let everyone who is godly pray to you in a time when you may be found. Surely when the great waters overflow, they shall not reach to him. (Psalms 32:6)

text: הֵן הִכָּה צוּר וַיָּזוּבוּ מַיִם וּנְחָלִים יִשְׁטֹפוּ הֲגַם לֶחֶם יוּכַל תֵּת אִם יָכִין שְׁאֵר לְעַמּֽוֹ׃
translation: Behold, he struck the rock, so that waters gushed out, and streams overflowed. Can he give bread also? Will he provide meat for his people?" (Psalms 78:20)

text: וְיָשֵׁב פָּנָיו לְמָעוּזֵּי אַרְצוֹ וְנִכְשַׁל וְנָפַל וְלֹא יִמָּצֵֽא׃
translation: Then he will turn his face toward the fortresses of his own land; but he will stumble and fall, and won't be found. (Daniel 11:19)

text: טוֹב יְהוָה לְמָעוֹז בְּיוֹם צָרָה וְיֹדֵעַ חֹסֵי בֽוֹ׃
translation: The LORD is good, a stronghold in the day of trouble; and he knows those who take refuge in him. (Nahum 1:7)

text: אוֹ יַחֲזֵק בְּמָעוּזִּי יַעֲשֶׂה שָׁלוֹם לִי שָׁלוֹם יַֽעֲשֶׂה לִּֽי׃
translation: Or else let him take hold of my strength, that he may make peace with me. Let him make peace with me." (Isaiah 27:5)

text: וַאֲנִי בִּשְׁנַת אַחַת לְדָרְיָוֶשׁ הַמָּדִי עָמְדִי לְמַחֲזִיק וּלְמָעוֹז לֽוֹ׃
translation: "As for me, in the first year of Darius the Mede, I stood up to confirm and strengthen him. (Daniel 11:1)

text: וְשָׁפַכְתִּי חֲמָתִי עַל סִין מָעוֹז מִצְרָיִם וְהִכְרַתִּי אֶת הֲמוֹן נֹֽא׃
translation: I will pour my wrath on Sin, the stronghold of Egypt. I will cut off the multitude of No. (Ezekiel 30:15)

text: לְדָוִד יְהוָה אוֹרִי וְיִשְׁעִי מִמִּי אִירָא יְהוָה מָֽעוֹז חַיַּי מִמִּי אֶפְחָֽד׃
translation: By David. The LORD is my light and my salvation. Whom shall I fear? The LORD is the strength of my life. Of whom shall I be afraid? (Psalms 27:1)

text: וְהַשֹּׁעֲרִים שַׁלּוּם וְעַקּוּב וְטַלְמֹן וַאֲחִימָן וַאֲחִיהֶם שַׁלּוּם הָרֹֽאשׁ׃
translation: The gatekeepers: Shallum, Akkub, Talmon, Ahiman, and their brothers (Shallum was the chief), (1 Chronicles 9:17)

text: לְאַרְבַּע רוּחוֹת יִהְיוּ הַשֹּׁעֲרִים מִזְרָח יָמָּה צָפוֹנָה וָנֶֽגְבָּה׃
translation: On the four sides were the gatekeepers, toward the east, west, north, and south. (1 Chronicles 9:24)

text: וּמִן הַמְשֹׁרְרִים אֶלְיָשִׁיב וּמִן הַשֹּׁעֲרִים שַׁלֻּם וָטֶלֶם וְאוּרִֽי׃
translation: Of the singers: Eliashib. Of the gatekeepers: Shallum, Telem, and Uri. (Ezra 10:24)

text: זְכַרְיָה בֶּן מְשֶֽׁלֶמְיָה שֹׁעֵר פֶּתַח לְאֹהֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃
translation: Zechariah the son of Meshelemiah was gatekeeper of the door of the Tent of Meeting. (1 Chronicles 9:21)

text: וְהַשּֽׁוֹעֲרִים עַקּוּב טַלְמוֹן וַאֲחֵיהֶם הַשֹּׁמְרִים בַּשְּׁעָרִים מֵאָה שִׁבְעִים וּשְׁנָֽיִם׃
translation: Moreover the gatekeepers, Akkub, Talmon, and their brothers, who kept watch at the gates, were one hundred seventy-two. (Nehemiah 11:19)

text: וְֽעַד הֵנָּה בְּשַׁעַר הַמֶּלֶךְ מִזְרָחָה הֵמָּה הַשֹּׁעֲרִים לְמַחֲנוֹת בְּנֵי לֵוִֽי׃
translation: who previously served in the king's gate eastward. They were the gatekeepers for the camp of the children of Levi. (1 Chronicles 9:18)

text: תְּהוֹם אָמַר לֹא בִי הִיא וְיָם אָמַר אֵין עִמָּדִֽי׃
translation: The deep says, 'It isn't in me.' The sea says, 'It isn't with me.' (Job 28:14)

text: הֲבָאתָ עַד נִבְכֵי יָם וּבְחֵקֶר תְּהוֹם הִתְהַלָּֽכְתָּ׃
translation: "Have you entered into the springs of the sea? Or have you walked in the recesses of the deep? (Job 38:16)

text: רָאוּךָ מַּיִם אֱֽלֹהִים רָאוּךָ מַּיִם יָחִילוּ אַף יִרְגְּזוּ תְהֹמֽוֹת׃
translation: The clouds poured out water. The skies resounded with thunder. Your arrows also flashed around. (Psalms 77:17)

text: יְבַקַּע צֻרִים בַּמִּדְבָּר וַיַּשְׁקְ כִּתְהֹמוֹת רַבָּֽה׃
translation: He split rocks in the wilderness, and gave them drink abundantly as out of the depths. (Psalms 78:15)

text: כֹּל אֲשֶׁר חָפֵץ יְהוָה עָשָׂה בַּשָּׁמַיִם וּבָאָרֶץ בַּיַּמִּים וְכָל תְּהוֹמֽוֹת׃
translation: Whatever the LORD pleased, that he has done, in heaven and in earth, in the seas and in all deeps. (Psalms 135:6)

text: מוֹלִיכָם בַּתְּהֹמוֹת כַּסּוּס בַּמִּדְבָּר לֹא יִכָּשֵֽׁלוּ׃
translation: Who led them through the depths, like a horse in the wilderness, so that they didn't stumble? (Isaiah 63:13)

text: כִּֽי עַתָּה שָׁכַבְתִּי וְאֶשְׁקוֹט יָשַׁנְתִּי אָז יָנוּחַֽ לִֽי׃
translation: For now I should have lain down and been quiet. I should have slept, then I would have been at rest, (Job 3:13)

text: וַאֲכַלְתֶּם יָשָׁן נוֹשָׁן וְיָשָׁן מִפְּנֵי חָדָשׁ תּוֹצִֽיאוּ׃
translation: You shall eat old supplies long kept, and you shall move out the old because of the new. (Leviticus 26:10)

text: אֲנִי שָׁכַבְתִּי וָֽאִישָׁנָה הֱקִיצוֹתִי כִּי יְהוָה יִסְמְכֵֽנִי׃
translation: I will not be afraid of tens of thousands of people who have set themselves against me on every side. (Psalms 3:6)

text: הַבִּיטָֽה עֲנֵנִי יְהוָה אֱלֹהָי הָאִירָה עֵינַי פֶּן אִישַׁן הַמָּֽוֶת׃
translation: lest my enemy say, "I have prevailed against him;" lest my adversaries rejoice when I fall. (Psalms 13:4)

text: הִנֵּה לֹֽא יָנוּם וְלֹא יִישָׁן שׁוֹמֵר יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
translation: Behold, he who keeps Israel will neither slumber nor sleep. (Psalms 121:4)

text: אֶלְיַחְבָּא הַשַּׁעַלְבֹנִי בְּנֵי יָשֵׁן יְהוֹנָתָֽן׃
translation: Eliahba the Shaalbonite, the sons of Jashen, Jonathan, (2 Samuel 23:32)

text: חָנֵּנִי אֱלֹהִים כְּחַסְדֶּךָ כְּרֹב רַחֲמֶיךָ מְחֵה פְשָׁעָֽי׃
translation: For I know my transgressions. My sin is constantly before me. (Psalms 51:3)

text: יִמָּחֽוּ מִסֵּפֶר חַיִּים וְעִם צַדִּיקִים אַל יִכָּתֵֽבוּ׃
translation: But I am in pain and distress. Let your salvation, God, protect me. (Psalms 69:29)

text: יְהִֽי אַחֲרִיתוֹ לְהַכְרִית בְּדוֹר אַחֵר יִמַּח שְׁמָֽם׃
translation: Let his posterity be cut off. In the generation following let their name be blotted out. (Psalms 109:13)

text: יִזָּכֵר עֲוֺן אֲבֹתָיו אֶל יְהוָה וְחַטַּאת אִמּוֹ אַל תִּמָּֽח׃
translation: Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered by the LORD. Don't let the sin of his mother be blotted out. (Psalms 109:14)

text: אַל תִּתֵּן לַנָּשִׁים חֵילֶךָ וּדְרָכֶיךָ לַֽמְחוֹת מְלָכִֽין׃
translation: Don't give your strength to women, nor your ways to that which destroys kings. (Proverbs 31:3)

text: אָנֹכִי אָנֹכִי הוּא מֹחֶה פְשָׁעֶיךָ לְמַעֲנִי וְחַטֹּאתֶיךָ לֹא אֶזְכֹּֽר׃
translation: I, even I, am he who blots out your transgressions for my own sake; and I will not remember your sins. (Isaiah 43:25)

text: וּבַמֶּרְכָּבָה הַשְּׁלִשִׁית סוּסִים לְבָנִים וּבַמֶּרְכָּבָה הָרְבִעִית סוּסִים בְּרֻדִּים אֲמֻצִּֽים׃
translation: In the third chariot were white horses. In the fourth chariot were dappled horses, all of them powerful. (Zechariah 6:3)

text: רַק בְּאֶרֶץ גֹּשֶׁן אֲשֶׁר שָׁם בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֹא הָיָה בָּרָֽד׃
translation: Only in the land of Goshen, where the children of Israel were, there was no hail. (Exodus 9:26)

text: וּבְנֵי אֶפְרַיִם שׁוּתָלַח וּבֶרֶד בְּנוֹ וְתַחַת בְּנוֹ וְאֶלְעָדָה בְנוֹ וְתַחַת בְּנֽוֹ׃
translation: The sons of Ephraim: Shuthelah, Bered his son, Tahath his son, Eleadah his son, Tahath his son, (1 Chronicles 7:20)

text: הַעְתִּירוּ אֶל יְהוָה וְרַב מִֽהְיֹת קֹלֹת אֱלֹהִים וּבָרָד וַאֲשַׁלְּחָה אֶתְכֶם וְלֹא תֹסִפוּן לַעֲמֹֽד׃
translation: Pray to the LORD; for there has been enough of mighty thunderings and hail. I will let you go, and you shall stay no longer." (Exodus 9:28)

text: וַיַּרְא פַּרְעֹה כִּֽי חָדַל הַמָּטָר וְהַבָּרָד וְהַקֹּלֹת וַיֹּסֶף לַחֲטֹא וַיַּכְבֵּד לִבּוֹ הוּא וַעֲבָדָֽיו׃
translation: When Pharaoh saw that the rain and the hail and the thunders had ceased, he sinned yet more, and hardened his heart, he and his servants. (Exodus 9:34)

text: הִנְנִי מַמְטִיר כָּעֵת מָחָר בָּרָד כָּבֵד מְאֹד אֲשֶׁר לֹא הָיָה כָמֹהוּ בְּמִצְרַיִם לְמִן הַיּוֹם הִוָּסְדָה וְעַד עָֽתָּה׃
translation: Behold, tomorrow about this time I will cause it to rain a very grievous hail, such as has not been in Egypt since the day it was founded even until now. (Exodus 9:18)

text: יִגְזְלוּ מִשֹּׁד יָתוֹם וְֽעַל עָנִי יַחְבֹּֽלוּ׃
translation: There are those who pluck the fatherless from the breast, and take a pledge of the poor, (Job 24:9)

text: גּוֹזֵל אָבִיו וְאִמּוֹ וְאֹמֵר אֵֽין פָּשַׁע חָבֵר הוּא לְאִישׁ מַשְׁחִֽית׃
translation: Whoever robs his father or his mother and says, "It's not wrong," is a partner with a destroyer. (Proverbs 28:24)

text: שֹׂנְאֵי טוֹב וְאֹהֲבֵי רעה רָע גֹּזְלֵי עוֹרָם מֵֽעֲלֵיהֶם וּשְׁאֵרָם מֵעַל עַצְמוֹתָֽם׃
translation: You who hate the good, and love the evil; who tear off their skin, and their flesh from off their bones; (Micah 3:2)

text: כִּי לֹא יִֽשְׁנוּ אִם לֹא יָרֵעוּ וְֽנִגְזְלָה שְׁנָתָם אִם לֹא יכשולו יַכְשִֽׁילוּ׃
translation: For they don't sleep unless they do evil. Their sleep is taken away, unless they make someone fall. (Proverbs 4:16)

text: וַיַּעַן יַעֲקֹב וַיֹּאמֶר לְלָבָן כִּי יָרֵאתִי כִּי אָמַרְתִּי פֶּן תִּגְזֹל אֶת בְּנוֹתֶיךָ מֵעִמִּֽי׃
translation: Jacob answered Laban, "Because I was afraid, for I said, 'Lest you should take your daughters from me by force.' (Genesis 31:31)

text: כָּל עַצְמוֹתַי תֹּאמַרְנָה יְהוָה מִי כָמוֹךָ מַצִּיל עָנִי מֵחָזָק מִמֶּנּוּ וְעָנִי וְאֶבְיוֹן מִגֹּזְלֽוֹ׃
translation: All my bones shall say, "LORD, who is like you, who delivers the poor from him who is too strong for him; yes, the poor and the needy from him who robs him?" (Psalms 35:10)

text: לֹא תְנַסּוּ אֶת יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם כַּאֲשֶׁר נִסִּיתֶם בַּמַּסָּֽה׃
translation: You shall not tempt the LORD your God, as you tempted him in Massah. (Deuteronomy 6:16)

text: הֲנִסָּה דָבָר אֵלֶיךָ תִּלְאֶה וַעְצֹר בְּמִלִּין מִי יוּכָֽל׃
translation: "If someone ventures to talk with you, will you be grieved? But who can withhold himself from speaking? (Job 4:2)

text: וַיְנַסּוּ וַיַּמְרוּ אֶת אֱלֹהִים עֶלְיוֹן וְעֵדוֹתָיו לֹא שָׁמָֽרוּ׃
translation: Yet they tempted and rebelled against the Most High God, and didn't keep his testimonies, (Psalms 78:56)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר אָחָז לֹא אֶשְׁאַל וְלֹֽא אֲנַסֶּה אֶת יְהוָֽה׃
translation: But Ahaz said, "I won't ask. I won't tempt the LORD." (Isaiah 7:12)

text: אֲשֶׁר נִסּוּנִי אֲבוֹתֵיכֶם בְּחָנוּנִי גַּם רָאוּ פָעֳלִֽי׃
translation: when your fathers tempted me, tested me, and saw my work. (Psalms 95:9)

text: כָּל זֹה נִסִּיתִי בַֽחָכְמָה אָמַרְתִּי אֶחְכָּמָה וְהִיא רְחוֹקָה מִמֶּֽנִּי׃
translation: All this I have proved in wisdom. I said, "I will be wise;" but it was far from me. (Ecclesiastes 7:23)

text: אַתָּה יָדְךָ גּוֹיִם הוֹרַשְׁתָּ וַתִּטָּעֵם תָּרַע לְאֻמִּים וַֽתְּשַׁלְּחֵֽם׃
translation: For they didn't get the land in possession by their own sword, neither did their own arm save them; but your right hand, your arm, and the light of your face, because you were favorable to them. (Psalms 44:3)

text: מַלְכֵי אֶרֶץ וְכָל לְאֻמִּים שָׂרִים וְכָל שֹׁפְטֵי אָֽרֶץ׃
translation: kings of the earth and all peoples, princes and all judges of the earth, (Psalms 148:11)

text: תְּשִׂימֵנוּ מָשָׁל בַּגּוֹיִם מְנֽוֹד רֹאשׁ בַּל אֻמִּֽים׃
translation: All day long my dishonor is before me, and shame covers my face, (Psalms 44:15)

text: וַיִּתֵּן לָהֶם אַרְצוֹת גּוֹיִם וַעֲמַל לְאֻמִּים יִירָֽשׁוּ׃
translation: He gave them the lands of the nations. They took the labor of the peoples in possession, (Psalms 105:44)
