text: וַעֲדַת לְאֻמִּים תְּסוֹבְבֶךָּ וְעָלֶיהָ לַמָּרוֹם שֽׁוּבָה׃
translation: The LORD administers judgment to the peoples. Judge me, LORD, according to my righteousness, and to my integrity that is in me. (Psalms 7:8)

text: יַדְבֵּר עַמִּים תַּחְתֵּינוּ וּלְאֻמִּים תַּחַת רַגְלֵֽינוּ׃
translation: He chooses our inheritance for us, the glory of Jacob whom he loved. Selah. (Psalms 47:4)

text: וּבְרֶדֶת הַטַּל עַל הַֽמַּחֲנֶה לָיְלָה יֵרֵד הַמָּן עָלָֽיו׃
translation: When the dew fell on the camp in the night, the manna fell on it. (Numbers 11:9)

text: הֲיֵשׁ לַמָּטָר אָב אוֹ מִי הוֹלִיד אֶגְלֵי טָֽל׃
translation: Does the rain have a father? Or who fathers the drops of dew? (Job 38:28)

text: אֶהְיֶה כַטַּל לְיִשְׂרָאֵל יִפְרַח כַּשּֽׁוֹשַׁנָּה וְיַךְ שָׁרָשָׁיו כַּלְּבָנֽוֹן׃
translation: His branches will spread, and his beauty will be like the olive tree, and his fragrance like Lebanon. (Hosea 14:6)

text: שָׁרְשִׁי פָתוּחַ אֱלֵי מָיִם וְטַל יָלִין בִּקְצִירִֽי׃
translation: My root is spread out to the waters. The dew lies all night on my branch. (Job 29:19)

text: בְּדַעְתּוֹ תְּהוֹמוֹת נִבְקָעוּ וּשְׁחָקִים יִרְעֲפוּ טָֽל׃
translation: By his knowledge, the depths were broken up, and the skies drop down the dew. (Proverbs 3:20)

text: מָה אֶֽעֱשֶׂה לְּךָ אֶפְרַיִם מָה אֶעֱשֶׂה לְּךָ יְהוּדָה וְחַסְדְּכֶם כַּֽעֲנַן בֹּקֶר וְכַטַּל מַשְׁכִּים הֹלֵֽךְ׃
translation: "Ephraim, what shall I do to you? Judah, what shall I do to you? For your love is like a morning cloud, and like the dew that disappears early. (Hosea 6:4)

text: זוֹרֵעַ עַוְלָה יקצור יִקְצָר אָוֶן וְשֵׁבֶט עֶבְרָתוֹ יִכְלֶֽה׃
translation: He who sows wickedness reaps trouble, and the rod of his fury will be destroyed. (Proverbs 22:8)

text: תַּאֲוַת צַדִּיקִים אַךְ טוֹב תִּקְוַת רְשָׁעִים עֶבְרָֽה׃
translation: The desire of the righteous is only good. The expectation of the wicked is wrath. (Proverbs 11:23)

text: רְֽצוֹן מֶלֶךְ לְעֶבֶד מַשְׂכִּיל וְעֶבְרָתוֹ תִּהְיֶה מֵבִֽישׁ׃
translation: The king's favor is toward a servant who deals wisely, but his wrath is toward one who causes shame. (Proverbs 14:35)

text: קוּמָה יְהוָה בְּאַפֶּךָ הִנָּשֵׂא בְּעַבְרוֹת צוֹרְרָי וְעוּרָה אֵלַי מִשְׁפָּט צִוִּֽיתָ׃
translation: Let the congregation of the peoples surround you. Rule over them on high. (Psalms 7:7)

text: יְשַׁלַּח בָּם חֲרוֹן אַפּוֹ עֶבְרָה וָזַעַם וְצָרָה מִשְׁלַחַת מַלְאֲכֵי רָעִֽים׃
translation: He threw on them the fierceness of his anger, wrath, indignation, and trouble, and a band of angels of evil. (Psalms 78:49)

text: אָסַפְתָּ כָל עֶבְרָתֶךָ הֱשִׁיבוֹתָ מֵחֲרוֹן אַפֶּֽךָ׃
translation: Turn us, God of our salvation, and cause your indignation toward us to cease. (Psalms 85:4)

text: כִּֽי לִבָּם צָפַנְתָּ מִּשָּׂכֶל עַל כֵּן לֹא תְרֹמֵֽם׃
translation: For you have hidden their heart from understanding, therefore you will not exalt them. (Job 17:4)

text: טוֹב יַנְחִיל בְּנֵֽי בָנִים וְצָפוּן לַצַּדִּיק חֵיל חוֹטֵֽא׃
translation: A good man leaves an inheritance to his children's children, but the wealth of the sinner is stored for the righteous. (Proverbs 13:22)

text: וְאֵלֶּה צָפַנְתָּ בִלְבָבֶךָ יָדַעְתִּי כִּי זֹאת עִמָּֽךְ׃
translation: Yet you hid these things in your heart. I know that this is with you: (Job 10:13)

text: אֱלוֹהַּ יִצְפֹּן לְבָנָיו אוֹנוֹ יְשַׁלֵּם אֵלָיו וְיֵדָֽע׃
translation: You say, 'God lays up his iniquity for his children.' Let him recompense it to himself, that he may know it. (Job 21:19)

text: יָגוּרוּ יצפינו יִצְפּוֹנוּ הֵמָּה עֲקֵבַי יִשְׁמֹרוּ כַּאֲשֶׁר קִוּוּ נַפְשִֽׁי׃
translation: Shall they escape by iniquity? In anger cast down the peoples, God. (Psalms 56:7)

text: בְּלִבִּי צָפַנְתִּי אִמְרָתֶךָ לְמַעַן לֹא אֶֽחֱטָא לָֽךְ׃
translation: I have hidden your word in my heart, that I might not sin against you. (Psalms 119:11)

text: שָׁלַח אֹתוֹת וּמֹפְתִים בְּתוֹכֵכִי מִצְרָיִם בְּפַרְעֹה וּבְכָל עֲבָדָֽיו׃
translation: He sent signs and wonders into the middle of you, Egypt, on Pharaoh, and on all his servants. (Psalms 135:9)

text: וְהָיוּ בְךָ לְאוֹת וּלְמוֹפֵת וּֽבְזַרְעֲךָ עַד עוֹלָֽם׃
translation: They will be for a sign and for a wonder to you and to your offspring forever. (Deuteronomy 28:46)

text: הַמַּסּוֹת הַגְּדֹלֹת אֲשֶׁר רָאוּ עֵינֶיךָ הָאֹתֹת וְהַמֹּפְתִים הַגְּדֹלִים הָהֵֽם׃
translation: Moses called to all Israel, and said to them: Your eyes have seen all that the LORD did in the land of Egypt to Pharaoh, and to all his servants, and to all his land; (Deuteronomy 29:2)

text: זִכְרוּ נִפְלְאֹתָיו אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה מֹפְתָיו וּמִשְׁפְּטֵי פִֽיהוּ׃
translation: Remember his marvelous works that he has done, his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth, (1 Chronicles 16:12)

text: אֲשֶׁר שָׂם בְּמִצְרַיִם אֹֽתוֹתָיו וּמוֹפְתָיו בִּשְׂדֵה צֹֽעַן׃
translation: how he set his signs in Egypt, his wonders in the field of Zoan, (Psalms 78:43)

text: זִכְרוּ נִפְלְאוֹתָיו אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה מֹפְתָיו וּמִשְׁפְּטֵי פִֽיו׃
translation: Remember his marvelous works that he has done: his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth, (Psalms 105:5)

text: אִם רָעֵב שֹׂנַאֲךָ הַאֲכִלֵהוּ לָחֶם וְאִם צָמֵא הַשְׁקֵהוּ מָֽיִם׃
translation: If your enemy is hungry, give him food to eat. If he is thirsty, give him water to drink; (Proverbs 25:21)

text: בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא תִּתְעַלַּפְנָה הַבְּתוּלֹת הַיָּפוֹת וְהַבַּחוּרִים בַּצָּמָֽא׃
translation: In that day the beautiful virgins and the young men will faint for thirst. (Amos 8:13)

text: צָמְאָה נַפְשִׁי לֵאלֹהִים לְאֵל חָי מָתַי אָבוֹא וְאֵרָאֶה פְּנֵי אֱלֹהִֽים׃
translation: My tears have been my food day and night, while they continually ask me, "Where is your God?" (Psalms 42:3)

text: רְעֵבִים גַּם צְמֵאִים נַפְשָׁם בָּהֶם תִּתְעַטָּֽף׃
translation: Hungry and thirsty, their soul fainted in them. (Psalms 107:5)

text: לִקְרַאת צָמֵא הֵתָיוּ מָיִם יֹשְׁבֵי אֶרֶץ תֵּימָא בְּלַחְמוֹ קִדְּמוּ נֹדֵֽד׃
translation: They brought water to him who was thirsty. The inhabitants of the land of Tema met the fugitives with their bread. (Isaiah 21:14)

text: לָכֵן גָּלָה עַמִּי מִבְּלִי דָעַת וּכְבוֹדוֹ מְתֵי רָעָב וַהֲמוֹנוֹ צִחֵה צָמָֽא׃
translation: Therefore my people go into captivity for lack of knowledge. Their honorable men are famished, and their multitudes are parched with thirst. (Isaiah 5:13)

text: יֵבֹשׁוּ כָּל עֹבְדֵי פֶסֶל הַמִּֽתְהַלְלִים בָּאֱלִילִים הִשְׁתַּחֲווּ לוֹ כָּל אֱלֹהִֽים׃
translation: Let all them be shamed who serve engraved images, who boast in their idols. Worship him, all you gods! (Psalms 97:7)

text: וַיָּשִׂימוּ לָהֶם אֶת פֶּסֶל מִיכָה אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה כָּל יְמֵי הֱיוֹת בֵּית הָאֱלֹהִים בְּשִׁלֹֽה׃
translation: So they set up for themselves Micah's engraved image which he made, and it remained all the time that God's house was in Shiloh. (Judges 18:31)

text: וָאַגִּיד לְךָ מֵאָז בְּטֶרֶם תָּבוֹא הִשְׁמַעְתִּיךָ פֶּן תֹּאמַר עָצְבִּי עָשָׂם וּפִסְלִי וְנִסְכִּי צִוָּֽם׃
translation: therefore I have declared it to you from of old; before it came to pass I showed it to you; lest you should say, 'My idol has done them. My engraved image and my molten image has commanded them.' (Isaiah 48:5)

text: וָאַעַשׂ אֲרוֹן עֲצֵי שִׁטִּים וָאֶפְסֹל שְׁנֵי לֻחֹת אֲבָנִים כָּרִאשֹׁנִים וָאַעַל הָהָרָה וּשְׁנֵי הַלֻּחֹת בְּיָדִֽי׃
translation: So I made an ark of acacia wood, and cut two stone tablets like the first, and went up onto the mountain, having the two tablets in my hand. (Deuteronomy 10:3)

text: נִבְעַר כָּל אָדָם מִדַּעַת הֹבִישׁ כָּל צוֹרֵף מִפָּסֶל כִּי שֶׁקֶר נִסְכּוֹ וְלֹא רוּחַ בָּֽם׃
translation: Every man has become brutish and without knowledge. Every goldsmith is disappointed by his engraved image; for his molten image is falsehood, and there is no breath in them. (Jeremiah 10:14)

text: נִבְעַר כָּל אָדָם מִדַּעַת הֹבִישׁ כָּל צֹרֵף מִפָּסֶל כִּי שֶׁקֶר נִסְכּוֹ וְלֹא רוּחַ בָּֽם׃
translation: "Every man has become stupid and without knowledge. Every goldsmith is disappointed by his image, for his molten images are falsehood, and there is no breath in them. (Jeremiah 51:17)

text: אֵיךְ הָיוּ לְשַׁמָּה כְרָגַע סָפוּ תַמּוּ מִן בַּלָּהֽוֹת׃
translation: How they are suddenly destroyed! They are completely swept away with terrors. (Psalms 73:19)

text: שְֽׂפַת אֱמֶת תִּכּוֹן לָעַד וְעַד אַרְגִּיעָה לְשׁוֹן שָֽׁקֶר׃
translation: Truth's lips will be established forever, but a lying tongue is only momentary. (Proverbs 12:19)

text: וְרֶגַע אֲדַבֵּר עַל גּוֹי וְעַל מַמְלָכָה לִבְנֹת וְלִנְטֹֽעַ׃
translation: At the instant I speak concerning a nation, and concerning a kingdom, to build and to plant it, (Jeremiah 18:9)

text: הִבָּדְלוּ מִתּוֹךְ הָעֵדָה הַזֹּאת וַאַכַלֶּה אֹתָם כְּרָֽגַע׃
translation: "Separate yourselves from among this congregation, that I may consume them in a moment!" (Numbers 16:21)

text: לָבַשׁ בְּשָׂרִי רִמָּה וגיש וְגוּשׁ עָפָר עוֹרִי רָגַע וַיִּמָּאֵֽס׃
translation: My flesh is clothed with worms and clods of dust. My skin closes up, and breaks out afresh. (Job 7:5)

text: כִּי לֹא שָׁלוֹם יְדַבֵּרוּ וְעַל רִגְעֵי אֶרֶץ דִּבְרֵי מִרְמוֹת יַחֲשֹׁבֽוּן׃
translation: For they don't speak peace, but they devise deceitful words against those who are quiet in the land. (Psalms 35:20)

text: וַהֲפִיצוֹתִי אוֹתָךְ בַּגּוֹיִם וְזֵרִיתִיךְ בָּאֲרָצוֹת וַהֲתִמֹּתִי טֻמְאָתֵךְ מִמֵּֽךְ׃
translation: I will scatter you among the nations, and disperse you through the countries. I will purge your filthiness out of you. (Ezekiel 22:15)

text: כְּטֻמְאָתָם וּכְפִשְׁעֵיהֶם עָשִׂיתִי אֹתָם וָאַסְתִּר פָּנַי מֵהֶֽם׃
translation: I did to them according to their uncleanness and according to their transgressions. I hid my face from them. (Ezekiel 39:24)

text: וְזָרַקְתִּי עֲלֵיכֶם מַיִם טְהוֹרִים וּטְהַרְתֶּם מִכֹּל טֻמְאוֹתֵיכֶם וּמִכָּל גִּלּוּלֵיכֶם אֲטַהֵר אֶתְכֶֽם׃
translation: I will sprinkle clean water on you, and you will be clean. I will cleanse you from all your filthiness and from all your idols. (Ezekiel 36:25)

text: וְעָשָׂה הַכֹּהֵן אֶת הַחַטָּאת וְכִפֶּר עַל הַמִּטַּהֵר מִטֻּמְאָתוֹ וְאַחַר יִשְׁחַט אֶת הָעֹלָֽה׃
translation: "The priest shall offer the sin offering, and make atonement for him who is to be cleansed because of his uncleanness. Afterward he shall kill the burnt offering; (Leviticus 14:19)

text: וְהִזַּרְתֶּם אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִטֻּמְאָתָם וְלֹא יָמֻתוּ בְּטֻמְאָתָם בְּטַמְּאָם אֶת מִשְׁכָּנִי אֲשֶׁר בְּתוֹכָֽם׃
translation: "'Thus you shall separate the children of Israel from their uncleanness, so they will not die in their uncleanness when they defile my tabernacle that is among them.'" (Leviticus 15:31)

text: וְהוֹשַׁעְתִּי אֶתְכֶם מִכֹּל טֻמְאֽוֹתֵיכֶם וְקָרָאתִי אֶל הַדָּגָן וְהִרְבֵּיתִי אֹתוֹ וְלֹא אֶתֵּן עֲלֵיכֶם רָעָֽב׃
translation: I will save you from all your uncleanness. I will call for the grain and will multiply it, and lay no famine on you. (Ezekiel 36:29)

text: אַשְׁרֵי הָעָם יוֹדְעֵי תְרוּעָה יְהוָה בְּֽאוֹר פָּנֶיךָ יְהַלֵּכֽוּן׃
translation: In your name they rejoice all day. In your righteousness, they are exalted. (Psalms 89:16)

text: יוֹם שׁוֹפָר וּתְרוּעָה עַל הֶעָרִים הַבְּצֻרוֹת וְעַל הַפִּנּוֹת הַגְּבֹהֽוֹת׃
translation: a day of the trumpet and alarm against the fortified cities and against the high battlements. (Zephaniah 1:16)

text: וּתְקַעְתֶּם תְּרוּעָה וְנָֽסְעוּ הַֽמַּחֲנוֹת הַחֹנִים קֵֽדְמָה׃
translation: When you blow an alarm, the camps that lie on the east side shall go forward. (Numbers 10:5)

text: עָלָה אֱלֹהִים בִּתְרוּעָה יְהֹוָה בְּקוֹל שׁוֹפָֽר׃
translation: Sing praises to God! Sing praises! Sing praises to our King! Sing praises! (Psalms 47:6)

text: וְדָוִד וְכָל בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל מַעֲלִים אֶת אֲרוֹן יְהוָה בִּתְרוּעָה וּבְקוֹל שׁוֹפָֽר׃
translation: So David and all the house of Israel brought up the LORD's ark with shouting and with the sound of the trumpet. (2 Samuel 6:15)

text: וְהַֽעֲבַרְתָּ שׁוֹפַר תְּרוּעָה בַּחֹדֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִעִי בֶּעָשׂוֹר לַחֹדֶשׁ בְּיוֹם הַכִּפֻּרִים תַּעֲבִירוּ שׁוֹפָר בְּכָל אַרְצְכֶֽם׃
translation: Then you shall sound the loud trumpet on the tenth day of the seventh month. On the Day of Atonement you shall sound the trumpet throughout all your land. (Leviticus 25:9)

text: אַךְ אֲנָשִׁים מֵאָשֵׁר וּמְנַשֶּׁה וּמִזְּבֻלוּן נִֽכְנְעוּ וַיָּבֹאוּ לִירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
translation: Nevertheless some men of Asher, Manasseh, and Zebulun humbled themselves and came to Jerusalem. (2 Chronicles 30:11)

text: וַיִּכָּנְעוּ שָׂרֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְהַמֶּלֶךְ וַיֹּאמְרוּ צַדִּיק יְהוָֽה׃
translation: Then the princes of Israel and the king humbled themselves; and they said, "The LORD is righteous." (2 Chronicles 12:6)

text: כִּמְעַט אוֹיְבֵיהֶם אַכְנִיעַ וְעַל צָרֵיהֶם אָשִׁיב יָדִֽי׃
translation: The haters of the LORD would cringe before him, and their punishment would last forever. (Psalms 81:15)

text: וַיַּכְנַע בֶּעָמָל לִבָּם כָּשְׁלוּ וְאֵין עֹזֵֽר׃
translation: Therefore he brought down their heart with labor. They fell down, and there was no one to help. (Psalms 107:12)

text: וַתִּכָּנַע מוֹאָב בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא תַּחַת יַד יִשְׂרָאֵל וַתִּשְׁקֹט הָאָרֶץ שְׁמוֹנִים שָׁנָֽה׃
translation: So Moab was subdued that day under the hand of Israel. Then the land had rest eighty years. (Judges 3:30)

text: וַיַּכְנַע אֱלֹהִים בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא אֵת יָבִין מֶֽלֶךְ כְּנָעַן לִפְנֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
translation: So God subdued Jabin the king of Canaan before the children of Israel on that day. (Judges 4:23)

text: נֶפֶשׁ רָשָׁע אִוְּתָה רָע לֹא יֻחַן בְּעֵינָיו רֵעֵֽהוּ׃
translation: The soul of the wicked desires evil; his neighbor finds no mercy in his eyes. (Proverbs 21:10)

text: וְהוּא בְאֶחָד וּמִי יְשִׁיבֶנּוּ וְנַפְשׁוֹ אִוְּתָה וַיָּֽעַשׂ׃
translation: But he stands alone, and who can oppose him? What his soul desires, even that he does. (Job 23:13)

text: כִּֽי בָחַר יְהוָה בְּצִיּוֹן אִוָּהּ לְמוֹשָׁב לֽוֹ׃
translation: For the LORD has chosen Zion. He has desired it for his habitation. (Psalms 132:13)

text: בְּאַוָּתִי וְאֶסֳּרֵם וְאֻסְּפוּ עֲלֵיהֶם עַמִּים בְּאָסְרָם לִשְׁתֵּי עינתם עוֹנֹתָֽם׃
translation: When it is my desire, I will chastise them; and the nations will be gathered against them when they are bound to their two transgressions. (Hosea 10:10)

text: וְעַתָּה לְכָל אַוַּת נַפְשְׁךָ הַמֶּלֶךְ לָרֶדֶת רֵד וְלָנוּ הַסְגִּירוֹ בְּיַד הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
translation: Now therefore, O king, come down. According to all the desire of your soul to come down; and our part will be to deliver him up into the king's hand." (1 Samuel 23:20)

text: וַיִּתְאַוֶּה דָוִד וַיֹּאמַר מִי יַשְׁקֵנִי מַיִם מִבֹּאר בֵּֽית לֶחֶם אֲשֶׁר בַּשָּֽׁעַר׃
translation: David said longingly, "Oh that someone would give me water to drink from the well of Bethlehem, which is by the gate!" (2 Samuel 23:15)

text: אַרְתַּחְשַׁסְתְּא מֶלֶךְ מַלְכַיָּא לְעֶזְרָא כָהֲנָא סָפַר דָּתָא דִּֽי אֱלָהּ שְׁמַיָּא גְּמִיר וּכְעֶֽנֶת׃
translation: Artaxerxes, king of kings, To Ezra the priest, the scribe of the law of the perfect God of heaven. Now (Ezra 7:12)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ לְהֵֽעָשׂוֹת כֵּן וַתִּנָּתֵן דָּת בְּשׁוּשָׁן וְאֵת עֲשֶׂרֶת בְּנֵֽי הָמָן תָּלֽוּ׃
translation: The king commanded this to be done. A decree was given out in Susa; and they hanged Haman's ten sons. (Esther 9:14)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ לַחֲכָמִים יֹדְעֵי הָֽעִתִּים כִּי כֵן דְּבַר הַמֶּלֶךְ לִפְנֵי כָּל יֹדְעֵי דָּת וָדִֽין׃
translation: Then the king said to the wise men, who knew the times (for it was the king's custom to consult those who knew law and judgment; (Esther 1:13)

text: כְּדָת מַֽה לַּעֲשׂוֹת בַּמַּלְכָּה וַשְׁתִּי עַל אֲשֶׁר לֹֽא עָשְׂתָה אֶֽת מַאֲמַר הַמֶּלֶךְ אֲחַשְׁוֵרוֹשׁ בְּיַד הַסָּרִיסִֽים׃
translation: "What shall we do to Queen Vashti according to law, because she has not done the bidding of the King Ahasuerus by the eunuchs?" (Esther 1:15)

text: וְהַשְּׁתִיָּה כַדָּת אֵין אֹנֵס כִּי כֵן יִסַּד הַמֶּלֶךְ עַל כָּל רַב בֵּיתוֹ לַעֲשׂוֹת כִּרְצוֹן אִישׁ וָאִֽישׁ׃
translation: In accordance with the law, the drinking was not compulsory; for so the king had instructed all the officials of his house, that they should do according to every man's pleasure. (Esther 1:8)

text: וַיֹּאמַר יְהוָה מִסִּינַי בָּא וְזָרַח מִשֵּׂעִיר לָמוֹ הוֹפִיעַ מֵהַר פָּארָן וְאָתָה מֵרִבְבֹת קֹדֶשׁ מִֽימִינוֹ אשדת אֵשׁ דָּת לָֽמוֹ׃
translation: He said, "The LORD came from Sinai, and rose from Seir to them. He shone from Mount Paran. He came from the ten thousands of holy ones. At his right hand was a fiery law for them. (Deuteronomy 33:2)

text: בְּמוֹת אָדָם רָשָׁע תֹּאבַד תִּקְוָה וְתוֹחֶלֶת אוֹנִים אָבָֽדָה׃
translation: When a wicked man dies, hope perishes, and expectation of power comes to nothing. (Proverbs 11:7)

text: וְיֵשׁ תִּקְוָה לְאַחֲרִיתֵךְ נְאֻם יְהוָה וְשָׁבוּ בָנִים לִגְבוּלָֽם׃
translation: There is hope for your latter end," says the LORD. "Your children will come again to their own territory. (Jeremiah 31:17)

text: וּֽבָטַחְתָּ כִּי יֵשׁ תִּקְוָה וְחָפַרְתָּ לָבֶטַח תִּשְׁכָּֽב׃
translation: You will be secure, because there is hope. Yes, you will search, and will take your rest in safety. (Job 11:18)

text: כִּי אִם יֵשׁ אַחֲרִית וְתִקְוָתְךָ לֹא תִכָּרֵֽת׃
translation: Indeed surely there is a future hope, and your hope will not be cut off. (Proverbs 23:18)

text: רָאִיתָ אִישׁ חָכָם בְּעֵינָיו תִּקְוָה לִכְסִיל מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃
translation: Do you see a man wise in his own eyes? There is more hope for a fool than for him. (Proverbs 26:12)

text: הֲלֹא יִרְאָתְךָ כִּסְלָתֶךָ תִּקְוָתְךָ וְתֹם דְּרָכֶֽיךָ׃
translation: Isn't your piety your confidence? Isn't the integrity of your ways your hope? (Job 4:6)

text: לוּלֵי יְהוָה עֶזְרָתָה לִּי כִּמְעַט שָֽׁכְנָה דוּמָה נַפְשִֽׁי׃
translation: Unless the LORD had been my help, my soul would have soon lived in silence. (Psalms 94:17)

text: אִם הֲנִיפוֹתִי עַל יָתוֹם יָדִי כִּֽי אֶרְאֶה בַשַּׁעַר עֶזְרָתִֽי׃
translation: if I have lifted up my hand against the fatherless, because I saw my help in the gate; (Job 31:21)

text: כִּֽי הָיִיתָ עֶזְרָתָה לִּי וּבְצֵל כְּנָפֶיךָ אֲרַנֵּֽן׃
translation: My soul stays close to you. Your right hand holds me up. (Psalms 63:8)

text: הָֽבָה לָּנוּ עֶזְרָת מִצָּר וְשָׁוְא תְּשׁוּעַת אָדָֽם׃
translation: Through God, we will do valiantly, for it is he who will tread down our enemies. (Psalms 108:13)

text: כּוּשׁ עָצְמָה וּמִצְרַיִם וְאֵין קֵצֶה פּוּט וְלוּבִים הָיוּ בְּעֶזְרָתֵֽךְ׃
translation: Cush and Egypt were her boundless strength. Put and Libya were her helpers. (Nahum 3:9)

text: וַיַּעַשׂ חֲצַר הַכֹּהֲנִים וְהָעֲזָרָה הַגְּדוֹלָה וּדְלָתוֹת לָעֲזָרָה וְדַלְתוֹתֵיהֶם צִפָּה נְחֹֽשֶׁת׃
translation: Furthermore he made the court of the priests, the great court, and doors for the court, and overlaid their doors with bronze. (2 Chronicles 4:9)

text: כִּי כֹה אָמַר יְהוָה אָנוּשׁ לְשִׁבְרֵךְ נַחְלָה מַכָּתֵֽךְ׃
translation: For the LORD says, "Your hurt is incurable. Your wound is grievous. (Jeremiah 30:12)

text: עַל מִשְׁפָּטִי אֲכַזֵּב אָנוּשׁ חִצִּי בְלִי פָֽשַׁע׃
translation: Notwithstanding my right I am considered a liar. My wound is incurable, though I am without disobedience.' (Job 34:6)

text: עָקֹב הַלֵּב מִכֹּל וְאָנֻשׁ הוּא מִי יֵדָעֶֽנּוּ׃
translation: The heart is deceitful above all things and it is exceedingly corrupt. Who can know it? (Jeremiah 17:9)

text: כִּי אֲנוּשָׁה מַכּוֹתֶיהָ כִּי בָאָה עַד יְהוּדָה נָגַע עַד שַׁעַר עַמִּי עַד יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
translation: For her wounds are incurable; for it has come even to Judah. It reaches to the gate of my people, even to Jerusalem. (Micah 1:9)

text: וַיֵּלֶךְ נָתָן אֶל בֵּיתוֹ וַיִּגֹּף יְהוָה אֶת הַיֶּלֶד אֲשֶׁר יָלְדָה אֵֽשֶׁת אוּרִיָּה לְדָוִד וַיֵּאָנַֽשׁ׃
translation: Then Nathan departed to his house. The LORD struck the child that Uriah's wife bore to David, and he was very sick. (2 Samuel 12:15)

text: מַה תִּזְעַק עַל שִׁבְרֵךְ אָנוּשׁ מַכְאֹבֵךְ עַל רֹב עֲוֺנֵךְ עָֽצְמוּ חַטֹּאתַיִךְ עָשִׂיתִי אֵלֶּה לָֽךְ׃
translation: Why do you cry over your injury? Your pain is incurable. For the greatness of your iniquity, because your sins have increased, I have done these things to you. (Jeremiah 30:15)

text: אַף עַל זֶה פָּקַחְתָּ עֵינֶךָ וְאֹתִי תָבִיא בְמִשְׁפָּט עִמָּֽךְ׃
translation: Do you open your eyes on such a one, and bring me into judgment with you? (Job 14:3)

text: יְהוָה פֹּקֵחַ עִוְרִים יְהוָה זֹקֵף כְּפוּפִים יְהוָה אֹהֵב צַדִּיקִֽים׃
translation: The LORD opens the eyes of the blind. The LORD raises up those who are bowed down. The LORD loves the righteous. (Psalms 146:8)

text: אַל תֶּֽאֱהַב שֵׁנָה פֶּן תִּוָּרֵשׁ פְּקַח עֵינֶיךָ שְֽׂבַֽע לָֽחֶם׃
translation: Don't love sleep, lest you come to poverty. Open your eyes, and you shall be satisfied with bread. (Proverbs 20:13)

text: אָז תִּפָּקַחְנָה עֵינֵי עִוְרִים וְאָזְנֵי חֵרְשִׁים תִּפָּתַֽחְנָה׃
translation: Then the eyes of the blind will be opened, and the ears of the deaf will be unstopped. (Isaiah 35:5)

text: ראית רָאוֹת רַבּוֹת וְלֹא תִשְׁמֹר פָּקוֹחַ אָזְנַיִם וְלֹא יִשְׁמָֽע׃
translation: You see many things, but don't observe. His ears are open, but he doesn't listen. (Isaiah 42:20)

text: בִּשְׁנַת שְׁתַּיִם לְפֶקַח בֶּן רְמַלְיָהוּ מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל מָלַךְ יוֹתָם בֶּן עֻזִיָּהוּ מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָֽה׃
translation: In the second year of Pekah the son of Remaliah king of Israel, Jotham the son of Uzziah king of Judah began to reign. (2 Kings 15:32)

text: מֶלֶךְ יְרִיחוֹ אֶחָד מֶלֶךְ הָעַי אֲשֶׁר מִצַּד בֵּֽית אֵל אֶחָֽד׃
translation: the king of Jericho, one; the king of Ai, which is beside Bethel, one; (Joshua 12:9)

text: וְגַם אָמַרְתִּי לֹֽא אֲגָרֵשׁ אוֹתָם מִפְּנֵיכֶם וְהָיוּ לָכֶם לְצִדִּים וֵאלֹהֵיהֶם יִהְיוּ לָכֶם לְמוֹקֵֽשׁ׃
translation: Therefore I also said, 'I will not drive them out from before you; but they shall be in your sides, and their gods will be a snare to you.'" (Judges 2:3)

text: וְהִנֵּה נָתַתִּי עָלֶיךָ עֲבוֹתִים וְלֹֽא תֵהָפֵךְ מִֽצִּדְּךָ אֶל צִדֶּךָ עַד כַּלּוֹתְךָ יְמֵי מְצוּרֶֽךָ׃
translation: Behold, I put ropes on you, and you shall not turn yourself from one side to the other, until you have accomplished the days of your siege. (Ezekiel 4:8)

text: וְשִׁשָּׁה קָנִים יֹצְאִים מִצִּדֶּיהָ שְׁלֹשָׁה קְנֵי מְנֹרָה מִצִּדָּהּ הָאֶחָד וּשְׁלֹשָׁה קְנֵי מְנֹרָה מִצִּדָּהּ הַשֵּׁנִֽי׃
translation: There shall be six branches going out of its sides: three branches of the lamp stand out of its one side, and three branches of the lamp stand out of its other side; (Exodus 25:32)

text: וְשִׁשָּׁה קָנִים יֹצְאִים מִצִּדֶּיהָ שְׁלֹשָׁה קְנֵי מְנֹרָה מִצִּדָּהּ הָֽאֶחָד וּשְׁלֹשָׁה קְנֵי מְנֹרָה מִצִּדָּהּ הַשֵּׁנִֽי׃
translation: There were six branches going out of its sides: three branches of the lamp stand out of its one side, and three branches of the lamp stand out of its other side: (Exodus 37:18)

text: צֹהַר תַּֽעֲשֶׂה לַתֵּבָה וְאֶל אַמָּה תְּכַלֶנָּה מִלְמַעְלָה וּפֶתַח הַתֵּבָה בְּצִדָּהּ תָּשִׂים תַּחְתִּיִּם שְׁנִיִּם וּשְׁלִשִׁים תַּֽעֲשֶֽׂהָ׃
translation: You shall make a roof in the ship, and you shall finish it to a cubit upward. You shall set the door of the ship in its side. You shall make it with lower, second, and third levels. (Genesis 6:16)

text: וְאֶת חֹלֹן וְאֶת מִגְרָשֶׁהָ וְאֶת דְּבִר וְאֶת מִגְרָשֶֽׁהָ׃
translation: Holon with its pasture lands, Debir with its pasture lands, (Joshua 21:15)

text: וְגֹשֶׁן וְחֹלֹן וְגִלֹה עָרִים אַֽחַת עֶשְׂרֵה וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃
translation: Goshen, Holon, and Giloh; eleven cities with their villages. (Joshua 15:51)

text: וַתֹּרֶד מִיכַל אֶת דָּוִד בְּעַד הַחַלּוֹן וַיֵּלֶךְ וַיִּבְרַח וַיִּמָּלֵֽט׃
translation: So Michal let David down through the window. He went away, fled, and escaped. (1 Samuel 19:12)

text: בָּעִיר יָשֹׁקּוּ בַּֽחוֹמָה יְרֻצוּן בַּבָּתִּים יַעֲלוּ בְּעַד הַחַלּוֹנִים יָבֹאוּ כַּגַּנָּֽב׃
translation: They rush on the city. They run on the wall. They climb up into the houses. They enter in at the windows like thieves. (Joel 2:9)

text: וַתּוֹרִדֵם בַּחֶבֶל בְּעַד הַֽחַלּוֹן כִּי בֵיתָהּ בְּקִיר הַֽחוֹמָה וּבַֽחוֹמָה הִיא יוֹשָֽׁבֶת׃
translation: Then she let them down by a cord through the window; for her house was on the side of the wall, and she lived on the wall. (Joshua 2:15)

text: וַתֹּאמֶר כְּדִבְרֵיכֶם כֶּן הוּא וַֽתְּשַׁלְּחֵם וַיֵּלֵכוּ וַתִּקְשֹׁר אֶת תִּקְוַת הַשָּׁנִי בַּחַלּֽוֹן׃
translation: She said, "Let it be as you have said." She sent them away, and they departed. Then she tied the scarlet line in the window. (Joshua 2:21)

text: וַיָּמָת שַׂמְלָה וַיִּמְלֹךְ תַּחְתָּיו שָׁאוּל מֵרְחֹבוֹת הַנָּהָֽר׃
translation: Samlah died, and Shaul of Rehoboth by the river, reigned in his place. (Genesis 36:37)

text: וַיָּמָת שַׂמְלָה וַיִּמְלֹךְ תַּחְתָּיו שָׁאוּל מֵרְחֹבוֹת הַנָּהָֽר׃
translation: Samlah died, and Shaul of Rehoboth by the River reigned in his place. (1 Chronicles 1:48)

text: וַיָּמָת הֲדָד וַיִּמְלֹךְ תַּחְתָּיו שַׂמְלָה מִמַּשְׂרֵקָֽה׃
translation: Hadad died, and Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his place. (Genesis 36:36)

text: עֹשֶׂה מִשְׁפַּט יָתוֹם וְאַלְמָנָה וְאֹהֵב גֵּר לָתֶת לוֹ לֶחֶם וְשִׂמְלָֽה׃
translation: He executes justice for the fatherless and widow and loves the foreigner in giving him food and clothing. (Deuteronomy 10:18)

text: וַיָּמָת הֲדָד וַיִּמְלֹךְ תַּחְתָּיו שַׂמְלָה מִמַּשְׂרֵקָֽה׃
translation: Hadad died, and Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his place. (1 Chronicles 1:47)

text: וַיִּקְרַע יַעֲקֹב שִׂמְלֹתָיו וַיָּשֶׂם שַׂק בְּמָתְנָיו וַיִּתְאַבֵּל עַל בְּנוֹ יָמִים רַבִּֽים׃
translation: Jacob tore his clothes, and put sackcloth on his waist, and mourned for his son many days. (Genesis 37:34)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר מֶלֶךְ מִצְרַיִם לַֽמְיַלְּדֹת הָֽעִבְרִיֹּת אֲשֶׁר שֵׁם הָֽאַחַת שִׁפְרָה וְשֵׁם הַשֵּׁנִית פּוּעָֽה׃
translation: The king of Egypt spoke to the Hebrew midwives, of whom the name of the one was Shiphrah, and the name of the other Puah, (Exodus 1:15)

text: וַתִּפְתַּח וַתִּרְאֵהוּ אֶת הַיֶּלֶד וְהִנֵּה נַעַר בֹּכֶה וַתַּחְמֹל עָלָיו וַתֹּאמֶר מִיַּלְדֵי הָֽעִבְרִים זֶֽה׃
translation: She opened it, and saw the child, and behold, the baby cried. She had compassion on him, and said, "This is one of the Hebrews' children." (Exodus 2:6)

text: הִֽתְחַזְּקוּ וִֽהְיוּ לַֽאֲנָשִׁים פְּלִשְׁתִּים פֶּן תַּעַבְדוּ לָעִבְרִים כַּאֲשֶׁר עָבְדוּ לָכֶם וִהְיִיתֶם לַאֲנָשִׁים וְנִלְחַמְתֶּֽם׃
translation: Be strong and behave like men, O you Philistines, that you not be servants to the Hebrews, as they have been to you. Strengthen yourselves like men, and fight!" (1 Samuel 4:9)

text: וַתְּדַבֵּר אֵלָיו כַּדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה לֵאמֹר בָּֽא אֵלַי הָעֶבֶד הָֽעִבְרִי אֲשֶׁר הֵבֵאתָ לָּנוּ לְצַחֶק בִּֽי׃
translation: She spoke to him according to these words, saying, "The Hebrew servant, whom you have brought to us, came in to me to mock me, (Genesis 39:17)

text: וְעִבְרִים עָֽבְרוּ אֶת הַיַּרְדֵּן אֶרֶץ גָּד וְגִלְעָד וְשָׁאוּל עוֹדֶנּוּ בַגִּלְגָּל וְכָל הָעָם חָרְדוּ אַחֲרָֽיו׃
translation: Now some of the Hebrews had gone over the Jordan to the land of Gad and Gilead; but as for Saul, he was yet in Gilgal, and all the people followed him trembling. (1 Samuel 13:7)

text: כִּֽי יִמָּכֵר לְךָ אָחִיךָ הָֽעִבְרִי אוֹ הָֽעִבְרִיָּה וַעֲבָֽדְךָ שֵׁשׁ שָׁנִים וּבַשָּׁנָה הַשְּׁבִיעִת תְּשַׁלְּחֶנּוּ חָפְשִׁי מֵעִמָּֽךְ׃
translation: If your brother, a Hebrew man, or a Hebrew woman, is sold to you and serves you six years, then in the seventh year you shall let him go free from you. (Deuteronomy 15:12)

text: אָז חָלַף רוּחַ וַֽיַּעֲבֹר וְאָשֵׁם זוּ כֹחוֹ לֵאלֹהֽוֹ׃
translation: Then they sweep by like the wind and go on. They are indeed guilty, whose strength is their god." (Habakkuk 1:11)

text: וְרוּחַ עַל פָּנַי יַחֲלֹף תְּסַמֵּר שַֽׂעֲרַת בְּשָׂרִֽי׃
translation: Then a spirit passed before my face. The hair of my flesh stood up. (Job 4:15)

text: הֵן יַעֲבֹר עָלַי וְלֹא אֶרְאֶה וְיַחֲלֹף וְֽלֹא אָבִין לֽוֹ׃
translation: Behold, he goes by me, and I don't see him. He passes on also, but I don't perceive him. (Job 9:11)

text: כִּֽי הִנֵּה הסתו הַסְּתָיו עָבָר הַגֶּשֶׁם חָלַף הָלַךְ לֽוֹ׃
translation: For behold, the winter is past. The rain is over and gone. (Song of Solomon 2:11)

text: אִם יַחֲלֹף וְיַסְגִּיר וְיַקְהִיל וּמִי יְשִׁיבֶֽנּוּ׃
translation: If he passes by, or confines, or convenes a court, then who can oppose him? (Job 11:10)

text: כְּבוֹדִי חָדָשׁ עִמָּדִי וְקַשְׁתִּי בְּיָדִי תַחֲלִֽיף׃
translation: My glory is fresh in me. My bow is renewed in my hand.' (Job 29:20)

text: שׁוּבוּ לְבִצָּרוֹן אֲסִירֵי הַתִּקְוָה גַּם הַיּוֹם מַגִּיד מִשְׁנֶה אָשִׁיב לָֽךְ׃
translation: Turn to the stronghold, you prisoners of hope! Even today I declare that I will restore double to you. (Zechariah 9:12)

text: וַיְהִי שֶׁם בְּנוֹ הַבְּכוֹר יוֹאֵל וְשֵׁם מִשְׁנֵהוּ אֲבִיָּה שֹׁפְטִים בִּבְאֵר שָֽׁבַע׃
translation: Now the name of his firstborn was Joel, and the name of his second, Abijah. They were judges in Beersheba. (1 Samuel 8:2)

text: וַיִּכְתָּב שָׁם עַל הָאֲבָנִים אֵת מִשְׁנֵה תּוֹרַת מֹשֶׁה אֲשֶׁר כָּתַב לִפְנֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
translation: He wrote there on the stones a copy of Moses' law, which he wrote in the presence of the children of Israel. (Joshua 8:32)

text: וְהָיָה בַּיּוֹם הַשִּׁשִּׁי וְהֵכִינוּ אֵת אֲשֶׁר יָבִיאוּ וְהָיָה מִשְׁנֶה עַל אֲשֶֽׁר יִלְקְטוּ יוֹם יֽוֹם׃
translation: It shall come to pass on the sixth day, that they shall prepare that which they bring in, and it shall be twice as much as they gather daily." (Exodus 16:5)

text: וַיָּבִיאוּ אֶת הַתְּרוּמָה וְהַֽמַּעֲשֵׂר וְהַקֳּדָשִׁים בֶּאֱמוּנָה וַעֲלֵיהֶם נָגִיד כונניהו כָּֽנַנְיָהוּ הַלֵּוִי וְשִׁמְעִי אָחִיהוּ מִשְׁנֶֽה׃
translation: They brought in the offerings, the tithes, and the dedicated things faithfully. Conaniah the Levite was ruler over them, and Shimei his brother was second. (2 Chronicles 31:12)

text: תַּחַת בָּשְׁתְּכֶם מִשְׁנֶה וּכְלִמָּה יָרֹנּוּ חֶלְקָם לָכֵן בְּאַרְצָם מִשְׁנֶה יִירָשׁוּ שִׂמְחַת עוֹלָם תִּֽהְיֶה לָהֶֽם׃
translation: Instead of your shame you will have double. Instead of dishonor, they will rejoice in their portion. Therefore in their land they will possess double. Everlasting joy will be to them. (Isaiah 61:7)

text: יְחַלְּקוּ בְגָדַי לָהֶם וְעַל לְבוּשִׁי יַפִּילוּ גוֹרָֽל׃
translation: But don't be far off, LORD. You are my help. Hurry to help me! (Psalms 22:19)

text: תְּהוֹם כַּלְּבוּשׁ כִּסִּיתוֹ עַל הָרִים יַֽעַמְדוּ מָֽיִם׃
translation: You covered it with the deep as with a cloak. The waters stood above the mountains. (Psalms 104:6)

text: נָעוּ עִוְרִים בַּֽחוּצוֹת נְגֹֽאֲלוּ בַּדָּם בְּלֹא יֽוּכְלוּ יִגְּעוּ בִּלְבֻשֵׁיהֶֽם׃
translation: They wander as blind men in the streets. They are polluted with blood, So that men can't touch their garments. (Lamentations 4:14)

text: וָאֶתְּנָה לְבוּשִׁי שָׂק וָאֱהִי לָהֶם לְמָשָֽׁל׃
translation: Those who sit in the gate talk about me. I am the song of the drunkards. (Psalms 69:12)

text: מַרְבַדִּים עָֽשְׂתָה לָּהּ שֵׁשׁ וְאַרְגָּמָן לְבוּשָֽׁהּ׃
translation: She makes for herself carpets of tapestry. Her clothing is fine linen and purple. (Proverbs 31:22)

text: עֹז וְהָדָר לְבוּשָׁהּ וַתִּשְׂחַק לְיוֹם אַחֲרֽוֹן׃
translation: Strength and dignity are her clothing. She laughs at the time to come. (Proverbs 31:25)

text: וַיִּשְׁחָט וַיִּזְרֹק מֹשֶׁה אֶת הַדָּם עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ סָבִֽיב׃
translation: He killed it; and Moses sprinkled the blood around on the altar. (Leviticus 8:19)

text: וַֽיִּשְׁחֲטוּ הַפָּסַח וַיִּזְרְקוּ הַכֹּהֲנִים מִיָּדָם וְהַלְוִיִּם מַפְשִׁיטִֽים׃
translation: They killed the Passover lambs, and the priests sprinkled the blood which they received from their hands, and the Levites skinned them. (2 Chronicles 35:11)

text: וְשָׁחַטְתָּ אֶת הָאָיִל וְלָֽקַחְתָּ אֶת דָּמוֹ וְזָרַקְתָּ עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ סָבִֽיב׃
translation: You shall kill the ram, and you shall take its blood, and sprinkle it around on the altar. (Exodus 29:16)

text: וַיִּקַּח מֹשֶׁה חֲצִי הַדָּם וַיָּשֶׂם בָּאַגָּנֹת וַחֲצִי הַדָּם זָרַק עַל הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃
translation: Moses took half of the blood and put it in basins, and half of the blood he sprinkled on the altar. (Exodus 24:6)

text: וַיִּשְׁחַט אֶת הָעֹלָה וַיַּמְצִאוּ בְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן אֵלָיו אֶת הַדָּם וַיִּזְרְקֵהוּ עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ סָבִֽיב׃
translation: He killed the burnt offering; and Aaron's sons delivered the blood to him, and he sprinkled it around on the altar. (Leviticus 9:12)

text: אָכְלוּ זָרִים כֹּחוֹ וְהוּא לֹא יָדָע גַּם שֵׂיבָה זָרְקָה בּוֹ וְהוּא לֹא יָדָֽע׃
translation: Strangers have devoured his strength, and he doesn't realize it. Indeed, gray hairs are here and there on him, and he doesn't realize it. (Hosea 7:9)

text: מְזָרֶה רְשָׁעִים מֶלֶךְ חָכָם וַיָּשֶׁב עֲלֵיהֶם אוֹפָֽן׃
translation: A wise king winnows out the wicked, and drives the threshing wheel over them. (Proverbs 20:26)

text: וּמַרְאֵיהֶם דְּמוּת אֶחָד לְאַרְבַּעְתָּם כַּאֲשֶׁר יִהְיֶה הָאוֹפַן בְּתוֹךְ הָאוֹפָֽן׃
translation: As for their appearance, the four of them had one likeness, like a wheel within a wheel. (Ezekiel 10:10)

text: וָאֵרֶא הַחַיּוֹת וְהִנֵּה אוֹפַן אֶחָד בָּאָרֶץ אֵצֶל הַחַיּוֹת לְאַרְבַּעַת פָּנָֽיו׃
translation: Now as I saw the living creatures, behold, there was one wheel on the earth beside the living creatures, for each of the four faces of it. (Ezekiel 1:15)

text: וּבְלֶכֶת הַֽחַיּוֹת יֵלְכוּ הָאוֹפַנִּים אֶצְלָם וּבְהִנָּשֵׂא הַֽחַיּוֹת מֵעַל הָאָרֶץ יִנָּשְׂאוּ הָאוֹפַנִּֽים׃
translation: When the living creatures went, the wheels went beside them. When the living creatures were lifted up from the earth, the wheels were lifted up. (Ezekiel 1:19)

text: וְכָל בְּשָׂרָם וְגַבֵּהֶם וִֽידֵיהֶם וְכַנְפֵיהֶם וְהָאֽוֹפַנִּים מְלֵאִים עֵינַיִם סָבִיב לְאַרְבַּעְתָּם אוֹפַנֵּיהֶֽם׃
translation: Their whole body, including their backs, their hands, their wings, and the wheels, were full of eyes all around, even the wheels that the four of them had. (Ezekiel 10:12)

text: לָאוֹפַנִּים לָהֶם קוֹרָא הַגַּלְגַּל בְּאָזְנָֽי׃
translation: As for the wheels, they were called in my hearing, "the whirling wheels". (Ezekiel 10:13)

text: עָבִים סֵֽתֶר לוֹ וְלֹא יִרְאֶה וְחוּג שָׁמַיִם יִתְהַלָּֽךְ׃
translation: Thick clouds are a covering to him, so that he doesn't see. He walks on the vault of the sky.' (Job 22:14)

text: שֹׁמֵר רוּחַ לֹא יִזְרָע וְרֹאֶה בֶעָבִים לֹא יִקְצֽוֹר׃
translation: He who observes the wind won't sow; and he who regards the clouds won't reap. (Ecclesiastes 11:4)

text: אִם יַעֲלֶה לַשָּׁמַיִם שִׂיאוֹ וְרֹאשׁוֹ לָעָב יַגִּֽיעַ׃
translation: Though his height mount up to the heavens, and his head reach to the clouds, (Job 20:6)

text: צֹרֵֽר מַיִם בְּעָבָיו וְלֹא נִבְקַע עָנָן תַּחְתָּֽם׃
translation: He binds up the waters in his thick clouds, and the cloud is not burst under them. (Job 26:8)

text: הָהְפַּךְ עָלַי בַּלָּהוֹת תִּרְדֹּף כָּרוּחַ נְדִבָתִי וּכְעָב עָבְרָה יְשֻׁעָתִֽי׃
translation: Terrors have turned on me. They chase my honor as the wind. My welfare has passed away as a cloud. (Job 30:15)

text: אַף בְּרִי יַטְרִיחַ עָב יָפִיץ עֲנַן אוֹרֽוֹ׃
translation: Yes, he loads the thick cloud with moisture. He spreads abroad the cloud of his lightning. (Job 37:11)

text: וַתָּשַׁר דְּבוֹרָה וּבָרָק בֶּן אֲבִינֹעַם בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא לֵאמֹֽר׃
translation: Then Deborah and Barak the son of Abinoam sang on that day, saying, (Judges 5:1)

text: וַיַּגִּדוּ לְסִֽיסְרָא כִּי עָלָה בָּרָק בֶּן אֲבִינֹעַם הַר תָּבֽוֹר׃
translation: They told Sisera that Barak the son of Abinoam had gone up to Mount Tabor. (Judges 4:12)

text: הַֽתְשַׁלַּח בְּרָקִים וְיֵלֵכוּ וְיֹאמְרוּ לְךָ הִנֵּֽנוּ׃
translation: Can you send out lightnings, that they may go? Do they report to you, 'Here we are'? (Job 38:35)

text: הֵאִירוּ בְרָקָיו תֵּבֵל רָאֲתָה וַתָּחֵל הָאָֽרֶץ׃
translation: His lightning lights up the world. The earth sees, and trembles. (Psalms 97:4)

text: מַֽעֲלֶה נְשִׂאִים מִקְצֵה הָאָרֶץ בְּרָקִים לַמָּטָר עָשָׂה מֽוֹצֵא רוּחַ מֵאֽוֹצְרוֹתָֽיו׃
translation: He causes the clouds to rise from the ends of the earth. He makes lightnings with the rain. He brings the wind out of his treasuries. (Psalms 135:7)

text: שֶׁמֶשׁ יָרֵחַ עָמַד זְבֻלָה לְאוֹר חִצֶּיךָ יְהַלֵּכוּ לְנֹגַהּ בְּרַק חֲנִיתֶֽךָ׃
translation: The sun and moon stood still in the sky at the light of your arrows as they went, at the shining of your glittering spear. (Habakkuk 3:11)

text: כָּל יְמֵי הַזִּירוֹ לַיהוָה עַל נֶפֶשׁ מֵת לֹא יָבֹֽא׃
translation: "'All the days that he separates himself to the LORD he shall not go near a dead body. (Numbers 6:6)

text: כֹּל יְמֵי נִזְרוֹ קָדֹשׁ הוּא לַֽיהוָֽה׃
translation: All the days of his separation he is holy to the LORD. (Numbers 6:8)

text: נֵאַרְתָּה בְּרִית עַבְדֶּךָ חִלַּלְתָּ לָאָרֶץ נִזְרֽוֹ׃
translation: You have broken down all his hedges. You have brought his strongholds to ruin. (Psalms 89:40)

text: כֹּל יְמֵי נִזְרוֹ מִכֹּל אֲשֶׁר יֵעָשֶׂה מִגֶּפֶן הַיַּיִן מֵחַרְצַנִּים וְעַד זָג לֹא יֹאכֵֽל׃
translation: All the days of his separation he shall eat nothing that is made of the grapevine, from the seeds even to the skins. (Numbers 6:4)

text: לְאָבִיו וּלְאִמּוֹ לְאָחִיו וּלְאַחֹתוֹ לֹא יִטַּמָּא לָהֶם בְּמֹתָם כִּי נֵזֶר אֱלֹהָיו עַל רֹאשֽׁוֹ׃
translation: He shall not make himself unclean for his father, or for his mother, for his brother, or for his sister, when they die, because his separation to God is on his head. (Numbers 6:7)

text: וְֽהוֹשִׁיעָם יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵיהֶם בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא כְּצֹאן עַמּוֹ כִּי אַבְנֵי נֵזֶר מִֽתְנוֹסְסוֹת עַל אַדְמָתֽוֹ׃
translation: The LORD their God will save them in that day as the flock of his people; for they are like the jewels of a crown, lifted on high over his land. (Zechariah 9:16)

text: נֶגַע צָרַעַת כִּי תִהְיֶה בְּאָדָם וְהוּבָא אֶל הַכֹּהֵֽן׃
translation: "When the plague of leprosy is in a man, then he shall be brought to the priest; (Leviticus 13:9)

text: לְהוֹרֹת בְּיוֹם הַטָּמֵא וּבְיוֹם הַטָּהֹר זֹאת תּוֹרַת הַצָּרָֽעַת׃
translation: to teach when it is unclean, and when it is clean. This is the law of leprosy. (Leviticus 14:57)

text: זֹאת הַתּוֹרָה לְכָל נֶגַע הַצָּרַעַת וְלַנָּֽתֶק׃
translation: This is the law for any plague of leprosy, and for an itch, (Leviticus 14:54)

text: צָרַעַת נוֹשֶׁנֶת הִוא בְּעוֹר בְּשָׂרוֹ וְטִמְּאוֹ הַכֹּהֵן לֹא יַסְגִּרֶנּוּ כִּי טָמֵא הֽוּא׃
translation: it is a chronic leprosy in the skin of his body, and the priest shall pronounce him unclean. He shall not isolate him, for he is already unclean. (Leviticus 13:11)

text: וְרָאָה הַכֹּהֵן אֶת הַבָּשָׂר הַחַי וְטִמְּאוֹ הַבָּשָׂר הַחַי טָמֵא הוּא צָרַעַת הֽוּא׃
translation: The priest shall examine the raw flesh, and pronounce him unclean: the raw flesh is unclean. It is leprosy. (Leviticus 13:15)

text: וְרָאָהוּ הַכֹּהֵן בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי אִם פָּשֹׂה תִפְשֶׂה בָּעוֹר וְטִמֵּא הַכֹּהֵן אֹתוֹ נֶגַע צָרַעַת הִֽוא׃
translation: The priest shall examine him on the seventh day. If it has spread in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean. It is the plague of leprosy. (Leviticus 13:27)

text: וְדִבַּרְתִּי עַל הַנְּבִיאִים וְאָנֹכִי חָזוֹן הִרְבֵּיתִי וּבְיַד הַנְּבִיאִים אֲדַמֶּֽה׃
translation: If Gilead is wicked, surely they are worthless. In Gilgal they sacrifice bulls. Indeed, their altars are like heaps in the furrows of the field. (Hosea 12:11)

text: מַשָּׂא נִֽינְוֵה סֵפֶר חֲזוֹן נַחוּם הָאֶלְקֹשִֽׁי׃
translation: A revelation about Nineveh. The book of the vision of Nahum the Elkoshite. (Nahum 1:1)

text: כְּכֹל הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה וּכְכֹל הֶחָזוֹן הַזֶּה כֵּן דִּבֶּר נָתָן אֶל דָּוִֽיד׃
translation: According to all these words, and according to all this vision, so Nathan spoke to David. (1 Chronicles 17:15)

text: אָז דִּבַּרְתָּֽ בְחָזוֹן לַֽחֲסִידֶיךָ וַתֹּאמֶר שִׁוִּיתִי עֵזֶר עַל גִּבּוֹר הֲרִימוֹתִי בָחוּר מֵעָֽם׃
translation: I have found David, my servant. I have anointed him with my holy oil, (Psalms 89:20)

text: כִּי לֹא יִֽהְיֶה עוֹד כָּל חֲזוֹן שָׁוְא וּמִקְסַם חָלָק בְּתוֹךְ בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
translation: For there will be no more any false vision nor flattering divination within the house of Israel. (Ezekiel 12:24)

text: וַיְהִי בִּרְאֹתִי אֲנִי דָנִיֵּאל אֶת הֶחָזוֹן וָאֲבַקְשָׁה בִינָה וְהִנֵּה עֹמֵד לְנֶגְדִּי כְּמַרְאֵה גָֽבֶר׃
translation: When I, even I Daniel, had seen the vision, I sought to understand it. Then behold, there stood before me someone with the appearance of a man. (Daniel 8:15)

text: קוֹל רִנָּה וִֽישׁוּעָה בְּאָהֳלֵי צַדִּיקִים יְמִין יְהוָה עֹשָׂה חָֽיִל׃
translation: The voice of rejoicing and salvation is in the tents of the righteous. "The right hand of the LORD does valiantly. (Psalms 118:15)

text: תָּבוֹא לְפָנֶיךָ תְּפִלָּתִי הַטֵּֽה אָזְנְךָ לְרִנָּתִֽי׃
translation: For my soul is full of troubles. My life draws near to Sheol. (Psalms 88:3)

text: וַיַּרְא בַּצַּר לָהֶם בְּשָׁמְעוֹ אֶת רִנָּתָֽם׃
translation: Nevertheless he regarded their distress, when he heard their cry. (Psalms 106:44)

text: וְיִזְבְּחוּ זִבְחֵי תוֹדָה וִֽיסַפְּרוּ מַעֲשָׂיו בְּרִנָּֽה׃
translation: Let them offer the sacrifices of thanksgiving, and declare his deeds with singing. (Psalms 107:22)

text: תִּקְרַב רִנָּתִי לְפָנֶיךָ יְהוָה כִּדְבָרְךָ הֲבִינֵֽנִי׃
translation: Let my cry come before you, LORD. Give me understanding according to your word. (Psalms 119:169)

text: שִׁמְעָה אֱלֹהִים רִנָּתִי הַקְשִׁיבָה תְּפִלָּתִֽי׃
translation: From the end of the earth, I will call to you when my heart is overwhelmed. Lead me to the rock that is higher than I. (Psalms 61:2)

text: דְּנָה חֶלְמָא וּפִשְׁרֵהּ נֵאמַר קֳדָם מַלְכָּֽא׃
translation: "This is the dream; and we will tell its interpretation before the king. (Daniel 2:36)

text: מִי כְּהֶחָכָם וּמִי יוֹדֵעַ פֵּשֶׁר דָּבָר חָכְמַת אָדָם תָּאִיר פָּנָיו וְעֹז פָּנָיו יְשֻׁנֶּֽא׃
translation: Who is like the wise man? And who knows the interpretation of a thing? A man's wisdom makes his face shine, and the hardness of his face is changed. (Ecclesiastes 8:1)

text: בֵּאדַיִן עָנֵה דָנִיֵּאל וְאָמַר קֳדָם מַלְכָּא מַתְּנָתָךְ לָךְ לֶֽהֶוְיָן וּנְבָזְבְּיָתָךְ לְאָחֳרָן הַב בְּרַם כְּתָבָא אֶקְרֵא לְמַלְכָּא וּפִשְׁרָא אֲהוֹדְעִנֵּֽהּ׃
translation: Then Daniel answered before the king, "Let your gifts be to yourself, and give your rewards to another. Nevertheless, I will read the writing to the king, and make known to him the interpretation. (Daniel 5:17)

text: יְֽהַלְלוּהוּ שָׁמַיִם וָאָרֶץ יַמִּים וְֽכָל רֹמֵשׂ בָּֽם׃
translation: For God will save Zion, and build the cities of Judah. They shall settle there, and own it. (Psalms 69:35)

text: תָּֽשֶׁת חֹשֶׁךְ וִיהִי לָיְלָה בּֽוֹ תִרְמֹשׂ כָּל חַיְתוֹ יָֽעַר׃
translation: You make darkness, and it is night, in which all the animals of the forest prowl. (Psalms 104:20)

text: הַֽחַיָּה וְכָל בְּהֵמָה רֶמֶשׂ וְצִפּוֹר כָּנָֽף׃
translation: wild animals and all livestock, small creatures and flying birds, (Psalms 148:10)

text: זֶה הַיָּם גָּדוֹל וּרְחַב יָדָיִם שָֽׁם רֶמֶשׂ וְאֵין מִסְפָּר חַיּוֹת קְטַנּוֹת עִם גְּדֹלֽוֹת׃
translation: There is the sea, great and wide, in which are innumerable living things, both small and large animals. (Psalms 104:25)

text: כָּל הַֽחַיָּה כָּל הָרֶמֶשׂ וְכָל הָעוֹף כֹּל רוֹמֵשׂ עַל הָאָרֶץ לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתֵיהֶם יָצְאוּ מִן הַתֵּבָֽה׃
translation: Every animal, every creeping thing, and every bird, whatever moves on the earth, after their families, went out of the ship. (Genesis 8:19)

text: מִן הַבְּהֵמָה הַטְּהוֹרָה וּמִן הַבְּהֵמָה אֲשֶׁר אֵינֶנָּה טְהֹרָה וּמִן הָעוֹף וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר רֹמֵשׂ עַל הָֽאֲדָמָֽה׃
translation: Clean animals, unclean animals, birds, and everything that creeps on the ground (Genesis 7:8)

text: כַּחֲלוֹם מֵהָקִיץ אֲדֹנָי בָּעִיר צַלְמָם תִּבְזֶֽה׃
translation: As a dream when one wakes up, so, Lord, when you awake, you will despise their fantasies. (Psalms 73:20)

text: וַֽיְחִי אָדָם שְׁלֹשִׁים וּמְאַת שָׁנָה וַיּוֹלֶד בִּדְמוּתוֹ כְּצַלְמוֹ וַיִּקְרָא אֶת שְׁמוֹ שֵֽׁת׃
translation: Adam lived one hundred thirty years, and became the father of a son in his own likeness, after his image, and named him Seth. (Genesis 5:3)

text: שֹׁפֵךְ דַּם הָֽאָדָם בָּֽאָדָם דָּמוֹ יִשָּׁפֵךְ כִּי בְּצֶלֶם אֱלֹהִים עָשָׂה אֶת הָאָדָֽם׃
translation: Whoever sheds man's blood, his blood will be shed by man, for God made man in his own image. (Genesis 9:6)

text: וּנְשָׂאתֶם אֵת סִכּוּת מַלְכְּכֶם וְאֵת כִּיּוּן צַלְמֵיכֶם כּוֹכַב אֱלֹהֵיכֶם אֲשֶׁר עֲשִׂיתֶם לָכֶֽם׃
translation: You also carried the tent of your king and the shrine of your images, the star of your god, which you made for yourselves. (Amos 5:26)

text: וַיִּבְרָא אֱלֹהִים אֶת הָֽאָדָם בְּצַלְמוֹ בְּצֶלֶם אֱלֹהִים בָּרָא אֹתוֹ זָכָר וּנְקֵבָה בָּרָא אֹתָֽם׃
translation: God created man in his own image. In God's image he created him; male and female he created them. (Genesis 1:27)

text: וּצְבִי עֶדְיוֹ לְגָאוֹן שָׂמָהוּ וְצַלְמֵי תוֹעֲבֹתָם שִׁקּוּצֵיהֶם עָשׂוּ בוֹ עַל כֵּן נְתַתִּיו לָהֶם לְנִדָּֽה׃
translation: As for the beauty of his ornament, he set it in majesty; but they made the images of their abominations and their detestable things therein. Therefore I have made it to them as an unclean thing. (Ezekiel 7:20)

text: בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא כֶּרֶם חֶמֶד עַנּוּ לָֽהּ׃
translation: In that day, sing to her, "A pleasant vineyard! (Isaiah 27:2)

text: וְחָמְדוּ שָׂדוֹת וְגָזָלוּ וּבָתִּים וְנָשָׂאוּ וְעָֽשְׁקוּ גֶּבֶר וּבֵיתוֹ וְאִישׁ וְנַחֲלָתֽוֹ׃
translation: They covet fields and seize them, and houses, then take them away. They oppress a man and his house, even a man and his heritage. (Micah 2:2)

text: לָמָּה תְּֽרַצְּדוּן הָרִים גַּבְנֻנִּים הָהָר חָמַד אֱלֹהִים לְשִׁבְתּוֹ אַף יְהוָה יִשְׁכֹּן לָנֶֽצַח׃
translation: The chariots of God are tens of thousands and thousands of thousands. The Lord is among them, from Sinai, into the sanctuary. (Psalms 68:17)

text: עַד מָתַי פְּתָיִם תְּֽאֵהֲבוּ פֶתִי וְלֵצִים לָצוֹן חָמְדוּ לָהֶם וּכְסִילִים יִשְׂנְאוּ דָֽעַת׃
translation: "How long, you simple ones, will you love simplicity? How long will mockers delight themselves in mockery, and fools hate knowledge? (Proverbs 1:22)

text: לֹא תַחְמֹד בֵּית רֵעֶךָ לֹֽא תַחְמֹד אֵשֶׁת רֵעֶךָ וְעַבְדּוֹ וַאֲמָתוֹ וְשׁוֹרוֹ וַחֲמֹרוֹ וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר לְרֵעֶֽךָ׃
translation: "You shall not covet your neighbor's house. You shall not covet your neighbor's wife, nor his male servant, nor his female servant, nor his ox, nor his donkey, nor anything that is your neighbor's." (Exodus 20:17)

text: יֹֽצְרֵי פֶסֶל כֻּלָּם תֹּהוּ וַחֲמוּדֵיהֶם בַּל יוֹעִילוּ וְעֵדֵיהֶם הֵׄמָּׄהׄ בַּל יִרְאוּ וּבַל יֵדְעוּ לְמַעַן יֵבֹֽשׁוּ׃
translation: Everyone who makes a carved image is vain. The things that they delight in will not profit. Their own witnesses don't see, nor know, that they may be disappointed. (Isaiah 44:9)

text: עֲזֻבוֹת עָרֵי עֲרֹעֵר לַעֲדָרִים תִּֽהְיֶינָה וְרָבְצוּ וְאֵין מַחֲרִֽיד׃
translation: The cities of Aroer are forsaken. They will be for flocks, which shall lie down, and no one shall make them afraid. (Isaiah 17:2)

text: אֲנִי אֶרְעֶה צֹאנִי וַאֲנִי אַרְבִּיצֵם נְאֻם אֲדֹנָי יְהוִֽה׃
translation: I myself will be the shepherd of my sheep, and I will cause them to lie down," says the Lord GOD. (Ezekiel 34:15)

text: וְֽרָבַצְתָּ וְאֵין מַחֲרִיד וְחִלּוּ פָנֶיךָ רַבִּֽים׃
translation: Also you will lie down, and no one will make you afraid. Yes, many will court your favor. (Job 11:19)

text: וְרָעוּ בְּכוֹרֵי דַלִּים וְאֶבְיוֹנִים לָבֶטַח יִרְבָּצוּ וְהֵמַתִּי בָֽרָעָב שָׁרְשֵׁךְ וּשְׁאֵרִיתֵךְ יַהֲרֹֽג׃
translation: The firstborn of the poor will eat, and the needy will lie down in safety; and I will kill your root with famine, and your remnant will be killed. (Isaiah 14:30)

text: וְהָיָה הַשָּׁרוֹן לִנְוֵה צֹאן וְעֵמֶק עָכוֹר לְרֵבֶץ בָּקָר לְעַמִּי אֲשֶׁר דְּרָשֽׁוּנִי׃
translation: Sharon will be a fold of flocks, and the valley of Achor a place for herds to lie down in, for my people who have sought me. (Isaiah 65:10)

text: כִּֽי תִרְאֶה חֲמוֹר שֹׂנַאֲךָ רֹבֵץ תַּחַת מַשָּׂאוֹ וְחָדַלְתָּ מֵעֲזֹב לוֹ עָזֹב תַּעֲזֹב עִמּֽוֹ׃
translation: If you see the donkey of him who hates you fallen down under his burden, don't leave him. You shall surely help him with it. (Exodus 23:5)

text: זֶרַע רַב תּוֹצִיא הַשָּׂדֶה וּמְעַט תֶּאֱסֹף כִּי יַחְסְלֶנּוּ הָאַרְבֶּֽה׃
translation: You will carry much seed out into the field, and will gather little in, for the locust will consume it. (Deuteronomy 28:38)

text: מִי אֵלֶּה כָּעָב תְּעוּפֶינָה וְכַיּוֹנִים אֶל אֲרֻבֹּתֵיהֶֽם׃
translation: "Who are these who fly as a cloud, and as the doves to their windows? (Isaiah 60:8)

text: מֶלֶךְ אֵין לָאַרְבֶּה וַיֵּצֵא חֹצֵץ כֻּלּֽוֹ׃
translation: The locusts have no king, yet they advance in ranks. (Proverbs 30:27)

text: כְּצֵל כִּנְטוֹתוֹ נֶהֱלָכְתִּי נִנְעַרְתִּי כָּֽאַרְבֶּֽה׃
translation: I fade away like an evening shadow. I am shaken off like a locust. (Psalms 109:23)

text: כִּי אִם מָאֵן אַתָּה לְשַׁלֵּחַ אֶת עַמִּי הִנְנִי מֵבִיא מָחָר אַרְבֶּה בִּגְבֻלֶֽךָ׃
translation: Or else, if you refuse to let my people go, behold, tomorrow I will bring locusts into your country, (Exodus 10:4)

text: וּפֵרַשׂ יָדָיו בְּקִרְבּוֹ כַּאֲשֶׁר יְפָרֵשׂ הַשֹּׂחֶה לִשְׂחוֹת וְהִשְׁפִּיל גַּֽאֲוָתוֹ עִם אָרְבּוֹת יָדָֽיו׃
translation: He will spread out his hands in the middle of it, like one who swims spreads out hands to swim, but his pride will be humbled together with the craft of his hands. (Isaiah 25:11)

text: דּוֹדִי שָׁלַח יָדוֹ מִן הַחֹר וּמֵעַי הָמוּ עָלָֽיו׃
translation: My beloved thrust his hand in through the latch opening. My heart pounded for him. (Song of Solomon 5:4)

text: מֵעַי רֻתְּחוּ וְלֹא דָמּוּ קִדְּמֻנִי יְמֵי עֹֽנִי׃
translation: My heart is troubled, and doesn't rest. Days of affliction have come on me. (Job 30:27)

text: לַֽעֲשֽׂוֹת רְצוֹנְךָ אֱלֹהַי חָפָצְתִּי וְתוֹרָתְךָ בְּתוֹךְ מֵעָֽי׃
translation: I have proclaimed glad news of righteousness in the great assembly. Behold, I will not seal my lips, LORD, you know. (Psalms 40:9)

text: עַל כֵּן מֵעַי לְמוֹאָב כַּכִּנּוֹר יֶֽהֱמוּ וְקִרְבִּי לְקִיר חָֽרֶשׂ׃
translation: Therefore my heart sounds like a harp for Moab, and my inward parts for Kir Heres. (Isaiah 16:11)

text: וּבָאוּ הַמַּיִם הַמְאָרְרִים הָאֵלֶּה בְּֽמֵעַיִךְ לַצְבּוֹת בֶּטֶן וְלַנְפִּל יָרֵךְ וְאָמְרָה הָאִשָּׁה אָמֵן אָמֵֽן׃
translation: and this water that brings a curse will go into your bowels, and make your body swell, and your thigh fall away." The woman shall say, "Amen, Amen." (Numbers 5:22)

text: שִׁמְעוּ אִיִּים אֵלַי וְהַקְשִׁיבוּ לְאֻמִּים מֵרָחוֹק יְהוָה מִבֶּטֶן קְרָאָנִי מִמְּעֵי אִמִּי הִזְכִּיר שְׁמִֽי׃
translation: Listen, islands, to me. Listen, you peoples, from afar: the LORD has called me from the womb; from the inside of my mother, he has mentioned my name. (Isaiah 49:1)

text: מִשְׁפְּחֹת בְּנֵי קְהָת יַחֲנוּ עַל יֶרֶךְ הַמִּשְׁכָּן תֵּימָֽנָה׃
translation: The families of the sons of Kohath shall encamp on the south side of the tabernacle. (Numbers 3:29)

text: וַיִּֽזְרַֽח לוֹ הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ כַּאֲשֶׁר עָבַר אֶת פְּנוּאֵל וְהוּא צֹלֵעַ עַל יְרֵכֽוֹ׃
translation: Therefore the children of Israel don't eat the sinew of the hip, which is on the hollow of the thigh, to this day, because he touched the hollow of Jacob's thigh in the sinew of the hip. (Genesis 32:32)

text: וַֽיְהִי כָּל נֶפֶשׁ יֹצְאֵי יֶֽרֶךְ יַעֲקֹב שִׁבְעִים נָפֶשׁ וְיוֹסֵף הָיָה בְמִצְרָֽיִם׃
translation: All the souls who came out of Jacob's body were seventy souls, and Joseph was in Egypt already. (Exodus 1:5)

text: וַעֲשֵׂה לָהֶם מִכְנְסֵי בָד לְכַסּוֹת בְּשַׂר עֶרְוָה מִמָּתְנַיִם וְעַד יְרֵכַיִם יִהְיֽוּ׃
translation: You shall make them linen pants to cover their naked flesh. They shall reach from the waist even to the thighs. (Exodus 28:42)

text: וּלְגִדְעוֹן הָיוּ שִׁבְעִים בָּנִים יֹצְאֵי יְרֵכוֹ כִּֽי נָשִׁים רַבּוֹת הָיוּ לֽוֹ׃
translation: Gideon had seventy sons conceived from his body, for he had many wives. (Judges 8:30)

text: כֻּלָּם אֲחֻזֵי חֶרֶב מְלֻמְּדֵי מִלְחָמָה אִישׁ חַרְבּוֹ עַל יְרֵכוֹ מִפַּחַד בַּלֵּילּֽוֹת׃
translation: They all handle the sword, and are expert in war. Every man has his sword on his thigh, because of fear in the night. (Song of Solomon 3:8)

text: וְלֹֽא תָקִים לְךָ מַצֵּבָה אֲשֶׁר שָׂנֵא יְהוָה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ׃
translation: Neither shall you set yourself up a sacred stone which the LORD your God hates. (Deuteronomy 16:22)

text: חָלַק לִבָּם עַתָּה יֶאְשָׁמוּ הוּא יַעֲרֹף מִזְבְּחוֹתָם יְשֹׁדֵד מַצֵּבוֹתָֽם׃
translation: Their heart is divided. Now they will be found guilty. He will demolish their altars. He will destroy their sacred stones. (Hosea 10:2)

text: כִּי אֶת מִזְבְּחֹתָם תִּתֹּצוּן וְאֶת מַצֵּבֹתָם תְּשַׁבֵּרוּן וְאֶת אֲשֵׁרָיו תִּכְרֹתֽוּן׃
translation: but you shall break down their altars, and dash in pieces their pillars, and you shall cut down their Asherah poles; (Exodus 34:13)

text: וַיֹּצִאוּ אֶת מַצְּבוֹת בֵּית הַבַּעַל וַֽיִּשְׂרְפֽוּהָ׃
translation: They brought out the pillars that were in the house of Baal and burned them. (2 Kings 10:26)

text: וַיִּקַּח יַעֲקֹב אָבֶן וַיְרִימֶהָ מַצֵּבָֽה׃
translation: Jacob took a stone, and set it up for a pillar. (Genesis 31:45)

text: וְשִׁבַּר אֶת הַמַּצֵּבוֹת וַיִּכְרֹת אֶת הָאֲשֵׁרִים וַיְמַלֵּא אֶת מְקוֹמָם עַצְמוֹת אָדָֽם׃
translation: He broke in pieces the pillars, cut down the Asherah poles, and filled their places with men's bones. (2 Kings 23:14)

text: לוּא הִקְשַׁבְתָּ לְמִצְוֺתָי וַיְהִי כַנָּהָר שְׁלוֹמֶךָ וְצִדְקָתְךָ כְּגַלֵּי הַיָּֽם׃
translation: Oh that you had listened to my commandments! Then your peace would have been like a river and your righteousness like the waves of the sea. (Isaiah 48:18)

text: עָלָה עַל בָּבֶל הַיָּם בַּהֲמוֹן גַּלָּיו נִכְסָֽתָה׃
translation: The sea has come up on Babylon. She is covered with the multitude of its waves. (Jeremiah 51:42)

text: וָאֹמַר עַד פֹּה תָבוֹא וְלֹא תֹסִיף וּפֹא יָשִׁית בִּגְאוֹן גַּלֶּֽיךָ׃
translation: and said, 'You may come here, but no further. Your proud waves shall be stopped here'? (Job 38:11)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר וַֽיַּעֲמֵד רוּחַ סְעָרָה וַתְּרוֹמֵם גַּלָּֽיו׃
translation: For he commands, and raises the stormy wind, which lifts up its waves. (Psalms 107:25)

text: וְאָֽנֹכִי יְהוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ רֹגַע הַיָּם וַיֶּהֱמוּ גַּלָּיו יְהוָה צְבָאוֹת שְׁמֽוֹ׃
translation: For I am the LORD your God, who stirs up the sea so that its waves roar. the LORD of Armies is his name. (Isaiah 51:15)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר לָבָן לְיַעֲקֹב הִנֵּה הַגַּל הַזֶּה וְהִנֵּה הַמַצֵּבָה אֲשֶׁר יָרִיתִי בֵּינִי וּבֵינֶֽךָ׃
translation: Laban said to Jacob, "See this heap, and see the pillar, which I have set between me and you. (Genesis 31:51)

text: וַיִּהְיוּ בְּנֵי אֱלִיפָז תֵּימָן אוֹמָר צְפוֹ וְגַעְתָּם וּקְנַֽז׃
translation: The sons of Eliphaz were Teman, Omar, Zepho, and Gatam, and Kenaz. (Genesis 36:11)

text: וַיַּעַשׂ אֶת הַקְּרָשִׁים לַמִּשְׁכָּן עֶשְׂרִים קְרָשִׁים לִפְאַת נֶגֶב תֵּימָֽנָה׃
translation: He made the boards for the tabernacle, twenty boards for the south side southward. (Exodus 36:23)

text: בְּנֵי אֱלִיפָז תֵּימָן וְאוֹמָר צְפִי וְגַעְתָּם קְנַז וְתִמְנָע וַעֲמָלֵֽק׃
translation: The sons of Eliphaz: Teman, Omar, Zephi, Gatam, Kenaz, Timna, and Amalek. (1 Chronicles 1:36)

text: הֲֽמִבִּינָתְךָ יַֽאֲבֶר נֵץ יִפְרֹשׂ כנפו כְּנָפָיו לְתֵימָֽן׃
translation: "Is it by your wisdom that the hawk soars, and stretches her wings toward the south? (Job 39:26)

text: אַלּוּף קְנַז אַלּוּף תֵּימָן אַלּוּף מִבְצָֽר׃
translation: chief Kenaz, chief Teman, chief Mibzar, (1 Chronicles 1:53)

text: אֹמַר לַצָּפוֹן תֵּנִי וּלְתֵימָן אַל תִּכְלָאִי הָבִיאִי בָנַי מֵרָחוֹק וּבְנוֹתַי מִקְצֵה הָאָֽרֶץ׃
translation: I will tell the north, 'Give them up!' and tell the south, 'Don't hold them back! Bring my sons from far away, and my daughters from the ends of the earth— (Isaiah 43:6)

text: וְאֶת הַכּוֹס וְאֶת הַשָּׁלָךְ וְאֶת הַיַּנְשֽׁוּף׃
translation: the little owl, the cormorant, the great owl, (Leviticus 11:17)

text: דָּמִיתִי לִקְאַת מִדְבָּר הָיִיתִי כְּכוֹס חֳרָבֽוֹת׃
translation: I watch, and have become like a sparrow that is alone on the housetop. (Psalms 102:7)

text: כּוֹס יְשׁוּעוֹת אֶשָּׂא וּבְשֵׁם יְהוָה אֶקְרָֽא׃
translation: I will take the cup of salvation, and call on the LORD's name. (Psalms 116:13)

text: בְּדֶרֶךְ אֲחוֹתֵךְ הָלָכְתְּ וְנָתַתִּי כוֹסָהּ בְּיָדֵֽךְ׃
translation: You have walked in the way of your sister; therefore I will give her cup into your hand.' (Ezekiel 23:31)

text: אֶת הַכּוֹס וְאֶת הַיַּנְשׁוּף וְהַתִּנְשָֽׁמֶת׃
translation: the little owl, the great owl, the horned owl, (Deuteronomy 14:16)

text: וָאֶקַּח אֶת הַכּוֹס מִיַּד יְהוָה וָֽאַשְׁקֶה אֶת כָּל הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר שְׁלָחַנִי יְהוָה אֲלֵיהֶֽם׃
translation: Then I took the cup at the LORD's hand, and made all the nations to drink, to whom the LORD had sent me: (Jeremiah 25:17)

text: שָׁם אֳנִיּוֹת יְהַלֵּכוּן לִוְיָתָן זֶֽה יָצַרְתָּ לְשַֽׂחֶק בּֽוֹ׃
translation: There the ships go, and leviathan, whom you formed to play there. (Psalms 104:26)

text: יוֹרְדֵי הַיָּם בָּאֳנִיּוֹת עֹשֵׂי מְלָאכָה בְּמַיִם רַבִּֽים׃
translation: Those who go down to the sea in ships, who do business in great waters, (Psalms 107:23)

text: וַיְחַבְּרֵהוּ עִמּוֹ לַעֲשׂוֹת אֳנִיּוֹת לָלֶכֶת תַּרְשִׁישׁ וַיַּעֲשׂוּ אֳנִיּוֹת בְּעֶצְיוֹן גָּֽבֶר׃
translation: He joined himself with him to make ships to go to Tarshish. They made the ships in Ezion Geber. (2 Chronicles 20:36)

text: הֵילִילוּ אֳנִיּוֹת תַּרְשִׁישׁ כִּי שֻׁדַּד מָעֻזְּכֶֽן׃
translation: Howl, you ships of Tarshish, for your stronghold is laid waste! (Isaiah 23:14)

text: בְּרוּחַ קָדִים תְּשַׁבֵּר אֳנִיּוֹת תַּרְשִֽׁישׁ׃
translation: As we have heard, so we have seen, in the city of the LORD of Armies, in the city of our God. God will establish it forever. Selah. (Psalms 48:8)

text: וַיִּשְׁלַח חִירָם בָּֽאֳנִי אֶת עֲבָדָיו אַנְשֵׁי אֳנִיּוֹת יֹדְעֵי הַיָּם עִם עַבְדֵי שְׁלֹמֹֽה׃
translation: Hiram sent in the fleet his servants, sailors who had knowledge of the sea, with the servants of Solomon. (1 Kings 9:27)

text: הֲיֵשׁ מִסְפָּר לִגְדוּדָיו וְעַל מִי לֹא יָקוּם אוֹרֵֽהוּ׃
translation: Can his armies be counted? On whom does his light not arise? (Job 25:3)

text: כִּי בְכָה אָרוּץ גְּדוּד בֵּאלֹהַי אֲדַלֶּג שֽׁוּר׃
translation: For by you, I run against a troop. By my God, I leap over a wall. (2 Samuel 22:30)

text: וַיָּמָת אֱלִישָׁע וַֽיִּקְבְּרֻהוּ וּגְדוּדֵי מוֹאָב יָבֹאוּ בָאָרֶץ בָּא שָׁנָֽה׃
translation: Elisha died, and they buried him. Now the bands of the Moabites invaded the land at the coming in of the year. (2 Kings 13:20)

text: כִּֽי בְךָ אָרֻץ גְּדוּד וּבֵֽאלֹהַי אֲדַלֶּג שֽׁוּר׃
translation: As for God, his way is perfect. The LORD's word is tried. He is a shield to all those who take refuge in him. (Psalms 18:30)

text: גָּד גְּדוּד יְגוּדֶנּוּ וְהוּא יָגֻד עָקֵֽב׃
translation: "A troop will press on Gad, but he will press on their heel. (Genesis 49:19)

text: אֶֽבֲחַר דַּרְכָּם וְאֵשֵׁב רֹאשׁ וְאֶשְׁכּוֹן כְּמֶלֶךְ בַּגְּדוּד כַּאֲשֶׁר אֲבֵלִים יְנַחֵֽם׃
translation: I chose out their way, and sat as chief. I lived as a king in the army, as one who comforts the mourners. (Job 29:25)

text: כִּֽי אֶרְאֶה שָׁמֶיךָ מַעֲשֵׂי אֶצְבְּעֹתֶיךָ יָרֵחַ וְכוֹכָבִים אֲשֶׁר כּוֹנָֽנְתָּה׃
translation: what is man, that you think of him? What is the son of man, that you care for him? (Psalms 8:4)

text: לְדָוִד בָּרוּךְ יְהוָה צוּרִי הַֽמְלַמֵּד יָדַי לַקְרָב אֶצְבְּעוֹתַי לַמִּלְחָמָֽה׃
translation: By David. Blessed be the LORD, my rock, who trains my hands to war, and my fingers to battle— (Psalms 144:1)

text: כִּי כַפֵּיכֶם נְגֹאֲלוּ בַדָּם וְאֶצְבְּעוֹתֵיכֶם בֶּֽעָוֺן שִׂפְתֽוֹתֵיכֶם דִּבְּרוּ שֶׁקֶר לְשׁוֹנְכֶם עַוְלָה תֶהְגֶּֽה׃
translation: For your hands are defiled with blood, and your fingers with iniquity. Your lips have spoken lies. Your tongue mutters wickedness. (Isaiah 59:3)

text: וַיִּתֵּן אֶל מֹשֶׁה כְּכַלֹּתוֹ לְדַבֵּר אִתּוֹ בְּהַר סִינַי שְׁנֵי לֻחֹת הָעֵדֻת לֻחֹת אֶבֶן כְּתֻבִים בְּאֶצְבַּע אֱלֹהִֽים׃
translation: When he finished speaking with him on Mount Sinai, he gave Moses the two tablets of the covenant, stone tablets, written with God's finger. (Exodus 31:18)

text: וְלָקַח הַכֹּהֵן מִדָּמָהּ בְּאֶצְבָּעוֹ וְנָתַן עַל קַרְנֹת מִזְבַּח הָעֹלָה וְאֶת כָּל דָּמָהּ יִשְׁפֹּךְ אֶל יְסוֹד הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃
translation: The priest shall take some of its blood with his finger, and put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering; and the rest of its blood he shall pour out at the base of the altar. (Leviticus 4:30)

text: וַתְּהִי עוֹד מִלְחָמָה בְּגַת וַיְהִי אִישׁ מִדָּה וְאֶצְבְּעֹתָיו שֵׁשׁ וָשֵׁשׁ עֶשְׂרִים וְאַרְבַּע וְגַם הוּא נוֹלַד לְהָרָפָֽא׃
translation: There was again war at Gath, where there was a man of great stature, who had twenty-four fingers and toes, six on each hand and six on each foot; and he also was born to the giant. (1 Chronicles 20:6)

text: הָאֹמְרִים לֹא בְקָרוֹב בְּנוֹת בָּתִּים הִיא הַסִּיר וַאֲנַחְנוּ הַבָּשָֽׂר׃
translation: who say, 'The time is not near to build houses. This is the cauldron, and we are the meat.' (Ezekiel 11:3)

text: כִּי כְקוֹל הַסִּירִים תַּחַת הַסִּיר כֵּן שְׂחֹק הַכְּסִיל וְגַם זֶה הָֽבֶל׃
translation: For as the crackling of thorns under a pot, so is the laughter of the fool. This also is vanity. (Ecclesiastes 7:6)

text: לָכֵן הִנְנִי שָׂךְ אֶת דַּרְכֵּךְ בַּסִּירִים וְגָֽדַרְתִּי אֶת גְּדֵרָהּ וּנְתִיבוֹתֶיהָ לֹא תִמְצָֽא׃
translation: For she didn't know that I gave her the grain, the new wine, and the oil, and multiplied to her silver and gold, which they used for Baal. (Hosea 2:8)

text: הִיא לֹֽא תִהְיֶה לָכֶם לְסִיר וְאַתֶּם תִּהְיוּ בְתוֹכָהּ לְבָשָׂר אֶל גְּבוּל יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶשְׁפֹּט אֶתְכֶֽם׃
translation: This will not be your cauldron, neither will you be the meat in the middle of it. I will judge you in the border of Israel. (Ezekiel 11:11)

text: נִשְׁבַּע אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה בְּקָדְשׁוֹ כִּי הִנֵּה יָמִים בָּאִים עֲלֵיכֶם וְנִשָּׂא אֶתְכֶם בְּצִנּוֹת וְאַחֲרִיתְכֶן בְּסִירוֹת דּוּגָֽה׃
translation: The Lord GOD has sworn by his holiness, "Behold, the days shall come on you that they will take you away with hooks, and the last of you with fish hooks. (Amos 4:2)

text: בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא יִֽהְיֶה עַל מְצִלּוֹת הַסּוּס קֹדֶשׁ לַֽיהוָה וְהָיָה הַסִּירוֹת בְּבֵית יְהוָה כַּמִּזְרָקִים לִפְנֵי הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃
translation: In that day there will be inscribed on the bells of the horses, "HOLY TO THE LORD"; and the pots in the LORD's house will be like the bowls before the altar. (Zechariah 14:20)

text: וְעָשִׂיתָ מִזְבֵּחַ מִקְטַר קְטֹרֶת עֲצֵי שִׁטִּים תַּעֲשֶׂה אֹתֽוֹ׃
translation: "You shall make an altar to burn incense on. You shall make it of acacia wood. (Exodus 30:1)

text: וְעָשִׂיתָ אֶת הַבַּדִּים עֲצֵי שִׁטִּים וְצִפִּיתָ אֹתָם זָהָֽב׃
translation: You shall make the poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with gold. (Exodus 30:5)

text: וַיַּעַשׂ אֶת הַבַּדִּים עֲצֵי שִׁטִּים וַיְצַף אֹתָם זָהָֽב׃
translation: He made the poles of acacia wood, and overlaid them with gold. (Exodus 37:28)

text: וַיַּעַשׂ אֶת הַבַּדִּים עֲצֵי שִׁטִּים וַיְצַף אֹתָם נְחֹֽשֶׁת׃
translation: He made the poles of acacia wood, and overlaid them with bronze. (Exodus 38:6)

text: וְעָשִׂיתָ בַדֵּי עֲצֵי שִׁטִּים וְצִפִּיתָ אֹתָם זָהָֽב׃
translation: You shall make poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with gold. (Exodus 25:13)

text: וְעָשִׂיתָ בַדִּים לַמִּזְבֵּחַ בַּדֵּי עֲצֵי שִׁטִּים וְצִפִּיתָ אֹתָם נְחֹֽשֶׁת׃
translation: You shall make poles for the altar, poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with bronze. (Exodus 27:6)

text: קֶסֶם עַֽל שִׂפְתֵי מֶלֶךְ בְּמִשְׁפָּט לֹא יִמְעַל פִּֽיו׃
translation: Inspired judgments are on the lips of the king. He shall not betray his mouth. (Proverbs 16:10)

text: גִּבּוֹר וְאִישׁ מִלְחָמָה שׁוֹפֵט וְנָבִיא וְקֹסֵם וְזָקֵֽן׃
translation: the mighty man, the man of war, the judge, the prophet, the diviner, the elder, (Isaiah 3:2)

text: וְאֶת בִּלְעָם בֶּן בְּעוֹר הַקּוֹסֵם הָרְגוּ בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵל בַּחֶרֶב אֶל חַלְלֵיהֶֽם׃
translation: The children of Israel also killed Balaam the son of Beor, the soothsayer, with the sword, among the rest of their slain. (Joshua 13:22)

text: וַיִּקְרְאוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים לַכֹּהֲנִים וְלַקֹּֽסְמִים לֵאמֹר מַֽה נַּעֲשֶׂה לַאֲרוֹן יְהוָה הוֹדִעֻנוּ בַּמֶּה נְשַׁלְּחֶנּוּ לִמְקוֹמֽוֹ׃
translation: The Philistines called for the priests and the diviners, saying, "What shall we do with the LORD's ark? Show us how we should send it to its place." (1 Samuel 6:2)

text: חָזוּ שָׁוְא וְקֶסֶם כָּזָב הָאֹֽמְרִים נְאֻם יְהוָה וַֽיהוָה לֹא שְׁלָחָם וְיִֽחֲלוּ לְקַיֵּם דָּבָֽר׃
translation: They have seen falsehood and lying divination, who say, 'The LORD says;' but the LORD has not sent them. They have made men to hope that the word would be confirmed. (Ezekiel 13:6)

text: וְהָיָה לָהֶם כקסום כִּקְסָם שָׁוְא בְּעֵינֵיהֶם שְׁבֻעֵי שְׁבֻעוֹת לָהֶם וְהֽוּא מַזְכִּיר עָוֺן לְהִתָּפֵֽשׂ׃
translation: "You, son of man, prophesy and say, 'The Lord GOD says this concerning the children of Ammon, and concerning their reproach: "A sword! A sword is drawn! It is polished for the slaughter, to cause it to devour, that it may be as lightning; (Ezekiel 21:28)

text: רוּחַ צָפוֹן תְּחוֹלֵֽל גָּשֶׁם וּפָנִים נִזְעָמִים לְשׁוֹן סָֽתֶר׃
translation: The north wind produces rain; so a backbiting tongue brings an angry face. (Proverbs 25:23)

text: הוֹי אַשּׁוּר שֵׁבֶט אַפִּי וּמַטֶּה הוּא בְיָדָם זַעְמִֽי׃
translation: Alas Assyrian, the rod of my anger, the staff in whose hand is my indignation! (Isaiah 10:5)

text: אֱלֹהִים שׁוֹפֵט צַדִּיק וְאֵל זֹעֵם בְּכָל יֽוֹם׃
translation: If a man doesn't repent, he will sharpen his sword; he has bent and strung his bow. (Psalms 7:12)

text: שׁוּחָה עֲמֻקָּה פִּי זָרוֹת זְעוּם יְהוָה יפול יִפָּל שָֽׁם׃
translation: The mouth of an adulteress is a deep pit. He who is under the LORD's wrath will fall into it. (Proverbs 22:14)

text: כִּי עוֹד מְעַט מִזְעָר וְכָלָה זַעַם וְאַפִּי עַל תַּבְלִיתָֽם׃
translation: For yet a very little while, and the indignation against you will be accomplished, and my anger will be directed to his destruction." (Isaiah 10:25)

text: עוֹד הַאִשׁ בֵּית רָשָׁע אֹצְרוֹת רֶשַׁע וְאֵיפַת רָזוֹן זְעוּמָֽה׃
translation: Are there yet treasures of wickedness in the house of the wicked, and a short ephah that is accursed? (Micah 6:10)

text: עִם חָסִיד תִּתְחַסָּד עִם גִּבּוֹר תָּמִים תִּתַּמָּֽם׃
translation: With the merciful you will show yourself merciful. With the perfect man you will show yourself perfect. (2 Samuel 22:26)

text: עִם חָסִיד תִּתְחַסָּד עִם גְּבַר תָּמִים תִּתַּמָּֽם׃
translation: With the pure, you will show yourself pure. With the crooked you will show yourself shrewd. (Psalms 18:26)

text: אִסְפוּ לִי חֲסִידָי כֹּרְתֵי בְרִיתִי עֲלֵי זָֽבַח׃
translation: "Gather my saints together to me, those who have made a covenant with me by sacrifice." (Psalms 50:5)

text: צַדִּיק יְהוָה בְּכָל דְּרָכָיו וְחָסִיד בְּכָל מַעֲשָֽׂיו׃
translation: The LORD is righteous in all his ways, and gracious in all his works. (Psalms 145:17)

text: הַלְלוּ יָהּ שִׁירוּ לַֽיהוָה שִׁיר חָדָשׁ תְּהִלָּתוֹ בִּקְהַל חֲסִידִֽים׃
translation: Praise the LORD! Sing to the LORD a new song, his praise in the assembly of the saints. (Psalms 149:1)

text: לִנְצֹר אָרְחוֹת מִשְׁפָּט וְדֶרֶךְ חסידו חֲסִידָיו יִשְׁמֹֽר׃
translation: that he may guard the paths of justice, and preserve the way of his saints. (Proverbs 2:8)

text: כָּל אִמְרַת אֱלוֹהַּ צְרוּפָה מָגֵן הוּא לַֽחֹסִים בּֽוֹ׃
translation: "Every word of God is flawless. He is a shield to those who take refuge in him. (Proverbs 30:5)

text: עַד עֵת בֹּֽא דְבָרוֹ אִמְרַת יְהוָה צְרָפָֽתְהוּ׃
translation: until the time that his word happened, and the LORD's word proved him true. (Psalms 105:19)

text: כִּֽי בְחַנְתָּנוּ אֱלֹהִים צְרַפְתָּנוּ כִּצְרָף כָּֽסֶף׃
translation: For you, God, have tested us. You have refined us, as silver is refined. (Psalms 66:10)

text: הָאֵל תָּמִים דַּרְכּוֹ אִמְרַת יְהוָה צְרוּפָה מָגֵן הוּא לְכֹל הַחֹסִים בּֽוֹ׃
translation: As for God, his way is perfect. The LORD's word is tested. He is a shield to all those who take refuge in him. (2 Samuel 22:31)

text: הָאֵל תָּמִים דַּרְכּוֹ אִמְרַֽת יְהוָה צְרוּפָה מָגֵן הוּא לְכֹל הַחֹסִים בּֽוֹ׃
translation: For who is God, except the LORD? Who is a rock, besides our God, (Psalms 18:31)

text: צְרוּפָה אִמְרָתְךָ מְאֹד וְֽעַבְדְּךָ אֲהֵבָֽהּ׃
translation: Your promises have been thoroughly tested, and your servant loves them. (Psalms 119:140)

text: הַצִּילֵנִי מִדָּמִים אֱֽלֹהִים אֱלֹהֵי תְּשׁוּעָתִי תְּרַנֵּן לְשׁוֹנִי צִדְקָתֶֽךָ׃
translation: For you don't delight in sacrifice, or else I would give it. You have no pleasure in burnt offering. (Psalms 51:16)

text: שֶׁקֶר הַסּוּס לִתְשׁוּעָה וּבְרֹב חֵילוֹ לֹא יְמַלֵּֽט׃
translation: A horse is a vain thing for safety, neither does he deliver any by his great power. (Psalms 33:17)

text: וּתְשׁוּעַת צַדִּיקִים מֵיְהוָה מָֽעוּזָּם בְּעֵת צָרָֽה׃
translation: But the salvation of the righteous is from the LORD. He is their stronghold in the time of trouble. (Psalms 37:39)

text: פִּי יְסַפֵּר צִדְקָתֶךָ כָּל הַיּוֹם תְּשׁוּעָתֶךָ כִּי לֹא יָדַעְתִּי סְפֹרֽוֹת׃
translation: My mouth will tell about your righteousness, and of your salvation all day, though I don't know its full measure. (Psalms 71:15)

text: סוּס מוּכָן לְיוֹם מִלְחָמָה וְלַֽיהוָה הַתְּשׁוּעָֽה׃
translation: The horse is prepared for the day of battle; but victory is with the LORD. (Proverbs 21:31)

text: וַיִּתְיַצֵּב בְּתוֹךְ הַֽחֶלְקָה וַיַּצִּילֶהָ וַיַּךְ אֶת פְּלִשְׁתִּים וַיַּעַשׂ יְהוָה תְּשׁוּעָה גְדוֹלָֽה׃
translation: But he stood in the middle of the plot and defended it, and killed the Philistines; and the LORD worked a great victory. (2 Samuel 23:12)

text: בְּרֹאשׁ הֹמִיּוֹת תִּקְרָא בְּפִתְחֵי שְׁעָרִים בָּעִיר אֲמָרֶיהָ תֹאמֵֽר׃
translation: She calls at the head of noisy places. At the entrance of the city gates, she utters her words: (Proverbs 1:21)

text: כִּֽי הִנֵּה אוֹיְבֶיךָ יֶהֱמָיוּן וּמְשַׂנְאֶיךָ נָשְׂאוּ רֹֽאשׁ׃
translation: They conspire with cunning against your people. They plot against your cherished ones. (Psalms 83:3)

text: אֵשֶׁת כְּסִילוּת הֹֽמִיָּה פְּתַיּוּת וּבַל יָדְעָה מָּֽה׃
translation: The foolish woman is loud, undisciplined, and knows nothing. (Proverbs 9:13)

text: יָשׁוּבוּ לָעֶרֶב יֶהֱמוּ כַכָּלֶב וִיסוֹבְבוּ עִֽיר׃
translation: Behold, they spew with their mouth. Swords are in their lips, "For", they say, "who hears us?" (Psalms 59:7)

text: וְיָשׁוּבוּ לָעֶרֶב יֶהֱמוּ כַכָּלֶב וִיסוֹבְבוּ עִֽיר׃
translation: They shall wander up and down for food, and wait all night if they aren't satisfied. (Psalms 59:15)

text: מַה תִּשְׁתּוֹחֲחִי נַפְשִׁי וַתֶּהֱמִי עָלָי הוֹחִילִי לֵֽאלֹהִים כִּי עוֹד אוֹדֶנּוּ יְשׁוּעוֹת פָּנָֽיו׃
translation: My God, my soul is in despair within me. Therefore I remember you from the land of the Jordan, the heights of Hermon, from the hill Mizar. (Psalms 42:6)

text: וְקוֹץ וְדַרְדַּר תַּצְמִיחַֽ לָךְ וְאָכַלְתָּ אֶת עֵשֶׂב הַשָּׂדֶֽה׃
translation: It will yield thorns and thistles to you; and you will eat the herb of the field. (Genesis 3:18)

text: הוּכָּֽה כָעֵשֶׂב וַיִּבַשׁ לִבִּי כִּֽי שָׁכַחְתִּי מֵאֲכֹל לַחְמִֽי׃
translation: By reason of the voice of my groaning, my bones stick to my skin. (Psalms 102:5)

text: וַיֹּאכַל כָּל עֵשֶׂב בְּאַרְצָם וַיֹּאכַל פְּרִי אַדְמָתָֽם׃
translation: They ate up every plant in their land, and ate up the fruit of their ground. (Psalms 105:35)

text: וְנָתַתִּי עֵשֶׂב בְּשָׂדְךָ לִבְהֶמְתֶּךָ וְאָכַלְתָּ וְשָׂבָֽעְתָּ׃
translation: I will give grass in your fields for your livestock, and you shall eat and be full. (Deuteronomy 11:15)

text: יָמַי כְּצֵל נָטוּי וַאֲנִי כָּעֵשֶׂב אִיבָֽשׁ׃
translation: But you, LORD, will remain forever; your renown endures to all generations. (Psalms 102:12)

text: וַתּוֹצֵא הָאָרֶץ דֶּשֶׁא עֵשֶׂב מַזְרִיעַ זֶרַע לְמִינֵהוּ וְעֵץ עֹֽשֶׂה פְּרִי אֲשֶׁר זַרְעוֹ בוֹ לְמִינֵהוּ וַיַּרְא אֱלֹהִים כִּי טֽוֹב׃
translation: The earth yielded grass, herbs yielding seed after their kind, and trees bearing fruit, with their seeds in it, after their kind; and God saw that it was good. (Genesis 1:12)

text: וַיָּנֻסוּ חֲמֵשֶׁת הַמְּלָכִים הָאֵלֶּה וַיֵּחָבְאוּ בַמְּעָרָה בְּמַקֵּדָֽה׃
translation: These five kings fled, and hid themselves in the cave at Makkedah. (Joshua 10:16)

text: וַיֻּגַּד לִיהוֹשֻׁעַ לֵאמֹר נִמְצְאוּ חֲמֵשֶׁת הַמְּלָכִים נֶחְבְּאִים בַּמְּעָרָה בְּמַקֵּדָֽה׃
translation: Joshua was told, saying, "The five kings have been found, hidden in the cave at Makkedah." (Joshua 10:17)

text: יַטּוּ אֶבְיוֹנִים מִדָּרֶךְ יַחַד חֻבְּאוּ עֲנִיֵּי אָֽרֶץ׃
translation: They turn the needy out of the way. The poor of the earth all hide themselves. (Job 24:4)

text: רָאוּנִי נְעָרִים וְנֶחְבָּאוּ וִֽישִׁישִׁים קָמוּ עָמָֽדוּ׃
translation: The young men saw me and hid themselves. The aged rose up and stood. (Job 29:8)

text: קוֹל נְגִידִים נֶחְבָּאוּ וּלְשׁוֹנָם לְחִכָּם דָּבֵֽקָה׃
translation: The voice of the nobles was hushed, and their tongue stuck to the roof of their mouth. (Job 29:10)

text: כָּאֶבֶן מַיִם יִתְחַבָּאוּ וּפְנֵי תְהוֹם יִתְלַכָּֽדוּ׃
translation: The waters become hard like stone, when the surface of the deep is frozen. (Job 38:30)

text: וַיְדַבֵּר אֶל בָּנָיו לֵאמֹר חִבְשׁוּ לִי אֶֽת הַחֲמוֹר וַֽיַּחֲבֹֽשׁוּ׃
translation: He said to his sons, saying, "Saddle the donkey for me," and they saddled it. (1 Kings 13:27)

text: אֲפָפוּנִי מַיִם עַד נֶפֶשׁ תְּהוֹם יְסֹבְבֵנִי סוּף חָבוּשׁ לְרֹאשִֽׁי׃
translation: I went down to the bottoms of the mountains. The earth barred me in forever; yet you have brought my life up from the pit, LORD my God. (Jonah 2:6)

text: וַיָּקָם בִּלְעָם בַּבֹּקֶר וַֽיַּחֲבֹשׁ אֶת אֲתֹנוֹ וַיֵּלֶךְ עִם שָׂרֵי מוֹאָֽב׃
translation: Balaam rose up in the morning, and saddled his donkey, and went with the princes of Moab. (Numbers 22:21)

text: מִבְּכִי נְהָרוֹת חִבֵּשׁ וְתַעֲלֻמָהּ יֹצִא אֽוֹר׃
translation: He binds the streams that they don't trickle. The thing that is hidden he brings out to light. (Job 28:11)

text: טָמְנֵם בֶּעָפָר יָחַד פְּנֵיהֶם חֲבֹשׁ בַּטָּמֽוּן׃
translation: Hide them in the dust together. Bind their faces in the hidden place. (Job 40:13)

text: לְכוּ וְנָשׁוּבָה אֶל יְהוָה כִּי הוּא טָרָף וְיִרְפָּאֵנוּ יַךְ וְיַחְבְּשֵֽׁנוּ׃
translation: "Come! Let's return to the LORD; for he has torn us to pieces, and he will heal us; he has injured us, and he will bind up our wounds. (Hosea 6:1)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל בָּלָק הִתְיַצֵּב כֹּה עַל עֹלָתֶךָ וְאָנֹכִי אִקָּרֶה כֹּֽה׃
translation: He said to Balak, "Stand here by your burnt offering, while I meet God over there." (Numbers 23:15)

text: וַיִּשָּׁבַֽע לָהּ שָׁאוּל בַּֽיהוָה לֵאמֹר חַי יְהוָה אִֽם יִקְּרֵךְ עָוֺן בַּדָּבָר הַזֶּֽה׃
translation: Saul swore to her by the LORD, saying, "As the LORD lives, no punishment will happen to you for this thing." (1 Samuel 28:10)

text: וּבָאתִי לַהֲבִינְךָ אֵת אֲשֶׁר יִקְרָה לְעַמְּךָ בְּאַחֲרִית הַיָּמִים כִּי עוֹד חָזוֹן לַיָּמִֽים׃
translation: Now I have come to make you understand what will happen to your people in the latter days, for the vision is yet for many days." (Daniel 10:14)

text: וַיָּבֹאוּ אֶל יַעֲקֹב אֲבִיהֶם אַרְצָה כְּנָעַן וַיַּגִּידוּ לוֹ אֵת כָּל הַקֹּרֹת אֹתָם לֵאמֹֽר׃
translation: They came to Jacob their father, to the land of Canaan, and told him all that had happened to them, saying, (Genesis 42:29)

text: וּלְקַחְתֶּם גַּם אֶת זֶה מֵעִם פָּנַי וְקָרָהוּ אָסוֹן וְהֽוֹרַדְתֶּם אֶת שֵׂיבָתִי בְּרָעָה שְׁאֹֽלָה׃
translation: If you take this one also from me, and harm happens to him, you will bring down my gray hairs with sorrow to Sheol.' (Genesis 44:29)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה הֲיַד יְהוָה תִּקְצָר עַתָּה תִרְאֶה הֲיִקְרְךָ דְבָרִי אִם לֹֽא׃
translation: The LORD said to Moses, "Has the LORD's hand grown short? Now you will see whether my word will happen to you or not." (Numbers 11:23)

text: וַיֶּאֱהַב קְלָלָה וַתְּבוֹאֵהוּ וְֽלֹא חָפֵץ בִּבְרָכָה וַתִּרְחַק מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃
translation: Yes, he loved cursing, and it came to him. He didn't delight in blessing, and it was far from him. (Psalms 109:17)

text: רְאֵה אָנֹכִי נֹתֵן לִפְנֵיכֶם הַיּוֹם בְּרָכָה וּקְלָלָֽה׃
translation: Behold, I set before you today a blessing and a curse: (Deuteronomy 11:26)

text: מְבָרֵךְ רֵעֵהוּ בְּקוֹל גָּדוֹל בַּבֹּקֶר הַשְׁכֵּים קְלָלָה תֵּחָשֶׁב לֽוֹ׃
translation: He who blesses his neighbor with a loud voice early in the morning, it will be taken as a curse by him. (Proverbs 27:14)

text: וַתֹּאמֶר לוֹ אִמּוֹ עָלַי קִלְלָתְךָ בְּנִי אַךְ שְׁמַע בְּקֹלִי וְלֵךְ קַֽח לִֽי׃
translation: His mother said to him, "Let your curse be on me, my son. Only obey my voice, and go get them for me." (Genesis 27:13)

text: וְאֵלֶּה יַֽעַמְדוּ עַל הַקְּלָלָה בְּהַר עֵיבָל רְאוּבֵן גָּד וְאָשֵׁר וּזְבוּלֻן דָּן וְנַפְתָּלִֽי׃
translation: These shall stand on Mount Ebal for the curse: Reuben, Gad, Asher, Zebulun, Dan, and Naphtali. (Deuteronomy 27:13)

text: וַיִּֽחַר אַף יְהוָה בָּאָרֶץ הַהִוא לְהָבִיא עָלֶיהָ אֶת כָּל הַקְּלָלָה הַכְּתוּבָה בַּסֵּפֶר הַזֶּֽה׃
translation: and went and served other gods and worshiped them, gods that they didn't know and that he had not given to them. (Deuteronomy 29:26)

text: וַיָּנֻעוּ אַמּוֹת הַסִּפִּים מִקּוֹל הַקּוֹרֵא וְהַבַּיִת יִמָּלֵא עָשָֽׁן׃
translation: The foundations of the thresholds shook at the voice of him who called, and the house was filled with smoke. (Isaiah 6:4)

text: וַתָּקָם אֵשֶׁת יָרָבְעָם וַתֵּלֶךְ וַתָּבֹא תִרְצָתָה הִיא בָּאָה בְסַף הַבַּיִת וְהַנַּעַר מֵֽת׃
translation: Jeroboam's wife arose and departed, and came to Tirzah. As she came to the threshold of the house, the child died. (1 Kings 14:17)

text: זֶה הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר תַּעֲשׂוּ הַשְּׁלִשִׁית מִכֶּם בָּאֵי הַשַּׁבָּת לַכֹּֽהֲנִים וְלַלְוִיִּם לְשֹֽׁעֲרֵי הַסִּפִּֽים׃
translation: This is the thing that you must do: a third part of you, who come in on the Sabbath, of the priests and of the Levites, shall be gatekeepers of the thresholds. (2 Chronicles 23:4)

text: וַיִּקַּח רַב טַבָּחִים אֶת שְׂרָיָה כֹּהֵן הָרֹאשׁ וְאֶת צְפַנְיָהוּ כֹּהֵן מִשְׁנֶה וְאֶת שְׁלֹשֶׁת שֹׁמְרֵי הַסַּֽף׃
translation: The captain of the guard took Seraiah the chief priest, Zephaniah the second priest, and the three keepers of the threshold; (2 Kings 25:18)

text: וַיִּקַּח רַב טַבָּחִים אֶת שְׂרָיָה כֹּהֵן הָרֹאשׁ וְאֶת צְפַנְיָה כֹּהֵן הַמִּשְׁנֶה וְאֶת שְׁלֹשֶׁת שֹׁמְרֵי הַסַּֽף׃
translation: The captain of the guard took Seraiah the chief priest, and Zephaniah the second priest, and the three keepers of the threshold, (Jeremiah 52:24)

text: כֻּלָּם הַבְּרוּרִים לְשֹׁעֲרִים בַּסִּפִּים מָאתַיִם וּשְׁנֵים עָשָׂר הֵמָּה בְחַצְרֵיהֶם הִתְיַחְשָׂם הֵמָּה יִסַּד דָּוִיד וּשְׁמוּאֵל הָרֹאֶה בֶּאֱמוּנָתָֽם׃
translation: All these who were chosen to be gatekeepers in the thresholds were two hundred twelve. These were listed by genealogy in their villages, whom David and Samuel the seer ordained in their office of trust. (1 Chronicles 9:22)

text: וַיִּסְעוּ מֵאֵילִם וַֽיַּחֲנוּ עַל יַם סֽוּף׃
translation: They traveled from Elim, and encamped by the Red Sea. (Numbers 33:10)

text: וְאֵֽלַמּוֹת סָבִיב סָבִיב אֹרֶךְ חָמֵשׁ וְעֶשְׂרִים אַמָּה וְרֹחַב חָמֵשׁ אַמּֽוֹת׃
translation: There were arches all around, twenty-five cubits long and five cubits wide. (Ezekiel 40:30)

text: וְאֵלַמָּו אֶל חָצֵר הַחִצוֹנָה וְתִמֹרִים אֶל אילו אֵילָיו וּמַעֲלוֹת שְׁמוֹנֶה מעלו מַעֲלָֽיו׃
translation: Its arches were toward the outer court. Palm trees were on its posts. The ascent to it had eight steps. (Ezekiel 40:31)

text: וַיָּבֹאוּ אֵילִמָה וְשָׁם שְׁתֵּים עֶשְׂרֵה עֵינֹת מַיִם וְשִׁבְעִים תְּמָרִים וַיַּחֲנוּ שָׁם עַל הַמָּֽיִם׃
translation: They came to Elim, where there were twelve springs of water and seventy palm trees. They encamped there by the waters. (Exodus 15:27)

text: וַיִּסְעוּ מִמָּרָה וַיָּבֹאוּ אֵילִמָה וּבְאֵילִם שְׁתֵּים עֶשְׂרֵה עֵינֹת מַיִם וְשִׁבְעִים תְּמָרִים וַיַּחֲנוּ שָֽׁם׃
translation: They traveled from Marah, and came to Elim. In Elim, there were twelve springs of water and seventy palm trees, and they encamped there. (Numbers 33:9)

text: וַיּוֹלִכֵנִי דֶּרֶךְ הַדָּרוֹם וְהִנֵּה שַׁעַר דֶּרֶךְ הַדָּרוֹם וּמָדַד אילו אֵילָיו ואילמו וְאֵילַמָּיו כַּמִּדּוֹת הָאֵֽלֶּה׃
