translation: He led me toward the south; and behold, there was a gate toward the south. He measured its posts and its arches according to these measurements. (Ezekiel 40:24)

text: אִם רָאִיתָ גַנָּב וַתִּרֶץ עִמּוֹ וְעִם מְנָאֲפִים חֶלְקֶֽךָ׃
translation: When you saw a thief, you consented with him, and have participated with adulterers. (Psalms 50:18)

text: נֹאֵף אִשָּׁה חֲסַר לֵב מַֽשְׁחִית נַפְשׁוֹ הוּא יַעֲשֶֽׂנָּה׃
translation: He who commits adultery with a woman is void of understanding. He who does it destroys his own soul. (Proverbs 6:32)

text: וְאַתֶּם קִרְבוּ הֵנָּה בְּנֵי עֹנְנָה זֶרַע מְנָאֵף וַתִּזְנֶֽה׃
translation: "But draw near here, you sons of a sorceress, you offspring of adulterers and prostitutes. (Isaiah 57:3)

text: הָאִשָּׁה הַמְּנָאָפֶת תַּחַת אִישָׁהּ תִּקַּח אֶת זָרִֽים׃
translation: "'"Adulterous wife, who takes strangers instead of her husband! (Ezekiel 16:32)

text: וּשְׁפַטְתִּיךְ מִשְׁפְּטֵי נֹאֲפוֹת וְשֹׁפְכֹת דָּם וּנְתַתִּיךְ דַּם חֵמָה וְקִנְאָֽה׃
translation: I will judge you as women who break wedlock and shed blood are judged; and I will bring on you the blood of wrath and jealousy. (Ezekiel 16:38)

text: אָלֹה וְכַחֵשׁ וְרָצֹחַ וְגָנֹב וְנָאֹף פָּרָצוּ וְדָמִים בְּדָמִים נָגָֽעוּ׃
translation: There is cursing, lying, murder, stealing, and committing adultery; they break boundaries, and bloodshed causes bloodshed. (Hosea 4:2)

text: וְעֻמָה וַאֲפֵק וּרְחֹב עָרִים עֶשְׂרִים וּשְׁתַּיִם וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃
translation: Ummah also, and Aphek, and Rehob: twenty-two cities with their villages. (Joshua 19:30)

text: וַיַּפִּילוּ גּוֹרָלוֹת מִשְׁמֶרֶת לְעֻמַּת כַּקָּטֹן כַּגָּדוֹל מֵבִין עִם תַּלְמִֽיד׃
translation: They cast lots for their offices, all alike, the small as well as the great, the teacher as well as the student. (1 Chronicles 25:8)

text: לְאֵלֶּה מַחְלְקוֹת הַשֹּֽׁעֲרִים לְרָאשֵׁי הַגְּבָרִים מִשְׁמָרוֹת לְעֻמַּת אֲחֵיהֶם לְשָׁרֵת בְּבֵית יְהוָֽה׃
translation: Of these were the divisions of the doorkeepers, even of the chief men, having offices like their brothers, to minister in the LORD's house. (1 Chronicles 26:12)

text: לְשֻׁפִּים וּלְחֹסָה לַֽמַּעֲרָב עִם שַׁעַר שַׁלֶּכֶת בַּֽמְסִלָּה הָעוֹלָה מִשְׁמָר לְעֻמַּת מִשְׁמָֽר׃
translation: To Shuppim and Hosah westward, by the gate of Shallecheth, at the causeway that goes up, watchman opposite watchman. (1 Chronicles 26:16)

text: וַיִּשְׂאוּ הַכְּרוּבִים אֶת כַּנְפֵיהֶם וְהָאֽוֹפַנִּים לְעֻמָּתָם וּכְבוֹד אֱלֹהֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵל עֲלֵיהֶם מִלְמָֽעְלָה׃
translation: Then the cherubim lifted up their wings, and the wheels were beside them. The glory of the God of Israel was over them above. (Ezekiel 11:22)

text: וְקוֹל כַּנְפֵי הַחַיּוֹת מַשִּׁיקוֹת אִשָּׁה אֶל אֲחוֹתָהּ וְקוֹל הָאוֹפַנִּים לְעֻמָּתָם וְקוֹל רַעַשׁ גָּדֽוֹל׃
translation: I heard the noise of the wings of the living creatures as they touched one another, and the noise of the wheels beside them, even the noise of a great rushing. (Ezekiel 3:13)

text: זֹאת עֲשׂוּ קְחוּ לָכֶם מַחְתּוֹת קֹרַח וְכָל עֲדָתֽוֹ׃
translation: Do this: have Korah and all his company take censers, (Numbers 16:6)

text: נֹצֵר פִּיו שֹׁמֵר נַפְשׁוֹ פֹּשֵׂק שְׂפָתָיו מְחִתָּה לֽוֹ׃
translation: He who guards his mouth guards his soul. One who opens wide his lips comes to ruin. (Proverbs 13:3)

text: בְּרָב עָם הַדְרַת מֶלֶךְ וּבְאֶפֶס לְאֹם מְחִתַּת רָזֽוֹן׃
translation: In the multitude of people is the king's glory, but in the lack of people is the destruction of the prince. (Proverbs 14:28)

text: חֲכָמִים יִצְפְּנוּ דָעַת וּפִֽי אֱוִיל מְחִתָּה קְרֹבָֽה׃
translation: Wise men lay up knowledge, but the mouth of the foolish is near ruin. (Proverbs 10:14)

text: מָעוֹז לַתֹּם דֶּרֶךְ יְהוָה וּמְחִתָּה לְפֹעֲלֵי אָֽוֶן׃
translation: The way of the LORD is a stronghold to the upright, but it is a destruction to the workers of iniquity. (Proverbs 10:29)

text: שִׂמְחָה לַצַּדִּיק עֲשׂוֹת מִשְׁפָּט וּמְחִתָּה לְפֹעֲלֵי אָֽוֶן׃
translation: It is joy to the righteous to do justice; but it is a destruction to the workers of iniquity. (Proverbs 21:15)

text: וְאֶת הַיָּם נָתַן מִכֶּתֶף הַיְמָנִית קֵדְמָה מִמּוּל נֶֽגְבָּה׃
translation: He set the sea on the right side of the house eastward, toward the south. (2 Chronicles 4:10)

text: וַיּוֹצִאֵנִי דֶּֽרֶךְ שַׁעַר צָפוֹנָה וַיְסִבֵּנִי דֶּרֶךְ חוּץ אֶל שַׁעַר הַחוּץ דֶּרֶךְ הַפּוֹנֶה קָדִים וְהִנֵּה מַיִם מְפַכִּים מִן הַכָּתֵף הַיְמָנִֽית׃
translation: Then he brought me out by the way of the gate northward, and led me around by the way outside to the outer gate, by the way of the gate that looks toward the east. Behold, waters ran out on the right side. (Ezekiel 47:2)

text: עִשָּׂרוֹן עִשָּׂרוֹן תַּעֲשֶׂה לַכֶּבֶשׂ הָאֶחָד לְשִׁבְעַת הַכְּבָשִֽׂים׃
translation: You shall offer one tenth for every lamb of the seven lambs; (Numbers 28:21)

text: וְעִשָּׂרׄוֹן עִשָּׂרוֹן לַכֶּבֶשׂ הָאֶחָד לְאַרְבָּעָה עָשָׂר כְּבָשִֽׂים׃
translation: and one tenth for every lamb of the fourteen lambs; (Numbers 29:15)

text: עִשָּׂרוֹן עִשָּׂרוֹן לַכֶּבֶשׂ הָאֶחָד לְשִׁבְעַת הַכְּבָשִֽׂים׃
translation: one tenth for every lamb of the seven lambs; (Numbers 28:29)

text: וּמִנְחָתָם סֹלֶת בְּלוּלָה בַשָּׁמֶן שְׁלֹשָׁה עֶשְׂרֹנִים לַפָּר שְׁנֵי עֶשְׂרֹנִים לָאָֽיִל׃
translation: and their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil: three tenths for the bull, two tenths for the ram, (Numbers 29:3)

text: וְעִשָּׂרוֹן אֶחָד לַכֶּבֶשׂ הָאֶחָד לְשִׁבְעַת הַכְּבָשִֽׂים׃
translation: and one tenth for every lamb of the seven lambs; (Numbers 29:4)

text: עִשָּׂרוֹן עִשָּׂרוֹן לַכֶּבֶשׂ הָאֶחָד לְשִׁבְעַת הַכְּבָשִֽׂים׃
translation: one tenth for every lamb of the seven lambs; (Numbers 29:10)

text: וְאֶל אִשָּׁה בְּנִדַּת טֻמְאָתָהּ לֹא תִקְרַב לְגַלּוֹת עֶרְוָתָֽהּ׃
translation: "'You shall not approach a woman to uncover her nakedness, as long as she is impure by her uncleanness. (Leviticus 18:19)

text: עֶרְוַת אָב גִּלָּה בָךְ טְמֵאַת הַנִּדָּה עִנּוּ בָֽךְ׃
translation: In you have they uncovered their fathers' nakedness. In you have they humbled her who was unclean in her impurity. (Ezekiel 22:10)

text: הַֽמְנַדִּים לְיוֹם רָע וַתַּגִּישׁוּן שֶׁבֶת חָמָֽס׃
translation: Alas for you who put far away the evil day, and cause the seat of violence to come near, (Amos 6:3)

text: וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר תִּשְׁכַּב עָלָיו בְּנִדָּתָהּ יִטְמָא וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר תֵּשֵׁב עָלָיו יִטְמָֽא׃
translation: "'Everything that she lies on in her impurity shall be unclean. Everything also that she sits on shall be unclean. (Leviticus 15:20)

text: בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא יִֽהְיֶה מָקוֹר נִפְתָּח לְבֵית דָּוִיד וּלְיֹשְׁבֵי יְרֽוּשָׁלִָם לְחַטַּאת וּלְנִדָּֽה׃
translation: "In that day there will be a fountain opened to David's house and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, for sin and for uncleanness. (Zechariah 13:1)

text: וְאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יִקַּח אֶת אֵשֶׁת אָחִיו נִדָּה הִוא עֶרְוַת אָחִיו גִּלָּה עֲרִירִים יִהְיֽוּ׃
translation: "'If a man takes his brother's wife, it is an impurity. He has uncovered his brother's nakedness. They shall be childless. (Leviticus 20:21)

text: וַיַּעַן הַשָּׂטָן אֶת יְהוָה וַיֹּאמַר הַֽחִנָּם יָרֵא אִיּוֹב אֱלֹהִֽים׃
translation: Then Satan answered the LORD, and said, "Does Job fear God for nothing? (Job 1:9)

text: וּמְשַׁלְּמֵי רָעָה תַּחַת טוֹבָה יִשְׂטְנוּנִי תַּחַת רדופי רָֽדְפִי טֽוֹב׃
translation: Don't forsake me, LORD. My God, don't be far from me. (Psalms 38:21)

text: הַפְקֵד עָלָיו רָשָׁע וְשָׂטָן יַעֲמֹד עַל יְמִינֽוֹ׃
translation: Set a wicked man over him. Let an adversary stand at his right hand. (Psalms 109:6)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֶל הַשָּׂטָן הִנּוֹ בְיָדֶךָ אַךְ אֶת נַפְשׁוֹ שְׁמֹֽר׃
translation: The LORD said to Satan, "Behold, he is in your hand. Only spare his life." (Job 2:6)

text: וְעַתָּה הֵנִיחַ יְהוָה אֱלֹהַי לִי מִסָּבִיב אֵין שָׂטָן וְאֵין פֶּגַע רָֽע׃
translation: Solomon's builders and Hiram's builders and the Gebalites cut them, and prepared the timber and the stones to build the house. (1 Kings 5:18)

text: תַּֽחַת אַהֲבָתִי יִשְׂטְנוּנִי וַאֲנִי תְפִלָּֽה׃
translation: In return for my love, they are my adversaries; but I am in prayer. (Psalms 109:4)

text: וַיַּֽעַן יְהוָה אֶת אִיּוֹב מנ הסערה מִן הַסְּעָרָה וַיֹּאמַֽר׃
translation: Then the LORD answered Job out of the whirlwind, (Job 38:1)

text: וַיַּֽעַן יְהוָה אֶת אִיּוֹב מנ סערה מִן סְעָרָה וַיֹּאמַֽר׃
translation: Then the LORD answered Job out of the whirlwind: (Job 40:6)

text: אָחִישָׁה מִפְלָט לִי מֵרוּחַ סֹעָה מִסָּֽעַר׃
translation: Confuse them, Lord, and confound their language, for I have seen violence and strife in the city. (Psalms 55:9)

text: הִנֵּה סַעֲרַת יְהוָה חֵמָה יָֽצְאָה וְסַעַר מִתְחוֹלֵל עַל רֹאשׁ רְשָׁעִים יָחֽוּל׃
translation: Behold, the LORD's storm, his wrath, has gone out. Yes, a whirling storm! It will burst on the head of the wicked. (Jeremiah 23:19)

text: הִנֵּה סַעֲרַת יְהוָה חֵמָה יָֽצְאָה סַעַר מִתְגּוֹרֵר עַל רֹאשׁ רְשָׁעִים יָחֽוּל׃
translation: Behold, the LORD's storm, his wrath, has gone out, a sweeping storm; it will burst on the head of the wicked. (Jeremiah 30:23)

text: וַיְהִי בְּהַעֲלוֹת יְהוָה אֶת אֵלִיָּהוּ בַּֽסְעָרָה הַשָּׁמָיִם וַיֵּלֶךְ אֵלִיָּהוּ וֶאֱלִישָׁע מִן הַגִּלְגָּֽל׃
translation: When the LORD was about to take Elijah up by a whirlwind into heaven, Elijah went with Elisha from Gilgal. (2 Kings 2:1)

text: בַּיּוֹם הַשִּׁשִּׁי נָשִׂיא לִבְנֵי גָד אֶלְיָסָף בֶּן דְּעוּאֵֽל׃
translation: On the sixth day, Eliasaph the son of Deuel, prince of the children of Gad, (Numbers 7:42)

text: לִבְנֵי נַפְתָּלִי יָצָא הַגּוֹרָל הַשִּׁשִּׁי לִבְנֵי נַפְתָּלִי לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָֽם׃
translation: The sixth lot came out for the children of Naphtali, even for the children of Naphtali according to their families. (Joshua 19:32)

text: וַתַּהַר עוֹד לֵאָה וַתֵּלֶד בֵּן שִׁשִּׁי לְּיַעֲקֹֽב׃
translation: Leah conceived again, and bore a sixth son to Jacob. (Genesis 30:19)

text: וְהַשִּׁשִּׁי יִתְרְעָם לְעֶגְלָה אֵשֶׁת דָּוִד אֵלֶּה יֻלְּדוּ לְדָוִד בְּחֶבְרֽוֹן׃
translation: and the sixth, Ithream, of Eglah, David's wife. These were born to David in Hebron. (2 Samuel 3:5)

text: הַחֲמִישִׁי שְׁפַטְיָה לַאֲבִיטָל הַשִּׁשִּׁי יִתְרְעָם לְעֶגְלָה אִשְׁתּֽוֹ׃
translation: the fifth, Shephatiah of Abital; the sixth, Ithream by Eglah his wife: (1 Chronicles 3:3)

text: בְּיוֹם עֶשְׂרִים וְאַרְבָּעָה לַחֹדֶשׁ בַּשִּׁשִּׁי בִּשְׁנַת שְׁתַּיִם לְדָרְיָוֶשׁ הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
translation: in the twenty-fourth day of the month, in the sixth month, in the second year of Darius the king. (Haggai 1:15)

text: וְאִם גָּאֹל יִגְאַל אִישׁ מִמַּֽעַשְׂרוֹ חֲמִשִׁיתוֹ יֹסֵף עָלָֽיו׃
translation: If a man redeems anything of his tithe, he shall add a fifth part to it. (Leviticus 27:31)

text: וְכָל יְהוּדָה הֵבִיאוּ מַעְשַׂר הַדָּגָן וְהַתִּירוֹשׁ וְהַיִּצְהָר לָאוֹצָרֽוֹת׃
translation: Then all Judah brought the tithe of the grain, the new wine, and the oil to the treasuries. (Nehemiah 13:12)

text: וּבָרוּךְ אֵל עֶלְיוֹן אֲשֶׁר מִגֵּן צָרֶיךָ בְּיָדֶךָ וַיִּתֶּן לוֹ מַעֲשֵׂר מִכֹּֽל׃
translation: Blessed be God Most High, who has delivered your enemies into your hand." Abram gave him a tenth of all. (Genesis 14:20)

text: וְכָל מַעְשַׂר הָאָרֶץ מִזֶּרַע הָאָרֶץ מִפְּרִי הָעֵץ לַיהוָה הוּא קֹדֶשׁ לַֽיהוָֽה׃
translation: "'All the tithe of the land, whether of the seed of the land or of the fruit of the trees, is the LORD's. It is holy to the LORD. (Leviticus 27:30)

text: מִקְצֵה שָׁלֹשׁ שָׁנִים תּוֹצִיא אֶת כָּל מַעְשַׂר תְּבוּאָתְךָ בַּשָּׁנָה הַהִוא וְהִנַּחְתָּ בִּשְׁעָרֶֽיךָ׃
translation: At the end of every three years you shall bring all the tithe of your increase in the same year, and shall store it within your gates. (Deuteronomy 14:28)

text: הֲיִקְבַּע אָדָם אֱלֹהִים כִּי אַתֶּם קֹבְעִים אֹתִי וַאֲמַרְתֶּם בַּמֶּה קְבַעֲנוּךָ הַֽמַּעֲשֵׂר וְהַתְּרוּמָֽה׃
translation: Will a man rob God? Yet you rob me! But you say, 'How have we robbed you?' In tithes and offerings. (Malachi 3:8)

text: וַֽיְהִי מִֽמָּחֳרָת וַיֵּצֵא הָעָם הַשָּׂדֶה וַיַּגִּדוּ לַאֲבִימֶֽלֶךְ׃
translation: On the next day, the people went out into the field; and they told Abimelech. (Judges 9:42)

text: בְּיוֹם זִבְחֲכֶם יֵאָכֵל וּמִֽמָּחֳרָת וְהַנּוֹתָר עַד יוֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי בָּאֵשׁ יִשָּׂרֵֽף׃
translation: It shall be eaten the same day you offer it, and on the next day. If anything remains until the third day, it shall be burned with fire. (Leviticus 19:6)

text: וַֽיְהִי מִֽמָּחֳרָת וַיַּשְׁכִּימוּ הָעָם וַיִּבְנוּ שָׁם מִזְבֵּחַ וַיַּעֲלוּ עֹלוֹת וּשְׁלָמִֽים׃
translation: On the next day, the people rose early and built an altar there, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings. (Judges 21:4)

text: וַיְמַן הָֽאֱלֹהִים תּוֹלַעַת בַּעֲלוֹת הַשַּׁחַר לַֽמָּחֳרָת וַתַּךְ אֶת הַקִּֽיקָיוֹן וַיִּיבָֽשׁ׃
translation: But God prepared a worm at dawn the next day, and it chewed on the vine so that it withered. (Jonah 4:7)

text: עַד מִֽמָּחֳרַת הַשַּׁבָּת הַשְּׁבִיעִת תִּסְפְּרוּ חֲמִשִּׁים יוֹם וְהִקְרַבְתֶּם מִנְחָה חֲדָשָׁה לַיהוָֽה׃
translation: The next day after the seventh Sabbath you shall count fifty days; and you shall offer a new meal offering to the LORD. (Leviticus 23:16)

text: וַיְהִי מִֽמָּחֳרָת וַיֵּשֶׁב מֹשֶׁה לִשְׁפֹּט אֶת הָעָם וַיַּעֲמֹד הָעָם עַל מֹשֶׁה מִן הַבֹּקֶר עַד הָעָֽרֶב׃
translation: On the next day, Moses sat to judge the people, and the people stood around Moses from the morning to the evening. (Exodus 18:13)

text: מַדּוּעַ קִדְּמוּנִי בִרְכָּיִם וּמַה שָּׁדַיִם כִּי אִינָֽק׃
translation: Why did the knees receive me? Or why the breast, that I should nurse? (Job 3:12)

text: וַֽיְשַׁלְּחוּ אֶת רִבְקָה אֲחֹתָם וְאֶת מֵנִקְתָּהּ וְאֶת עֶבֶד אַבְרָהָם וְאֶת אֲנָשָֽׁיו׃
translation: They sent away Rebekah, their sister, with her nurse, Abraham's servant, and his men. (Genesis 24:59)

text: גְּמַלִּים מֵינִיקוֹת וּבְנֵיהֶם שְׁלֹשִׁים פָּרוֹת אַרְבָּעִים וּפָרִים עֲשָׂרָה אֲתֹנֹת עֶשְׂרִים וַעְיָרִם עֲשָׂרָֽה׃
translation: He delivered them into the hands of his servants, every herd by itself, and said to his servants, "Pass over before me, and put a space between herd and herd." (Genesis 32:16)

text: מִחוּץ תְּשַׁכֶּל חֶרֶב וּמֵחֲדָרִים אֵימָה גַּם בָּחוּר גַּם בְּתוּלָה יוֹנֵק עִם אִישׁ שֵׂיבָֽה׃
translation: Outside the sword will bereave, and in the rooms, terror on both young man and virgin, the nursing infant with the gray-haired man. (Deuteronomy 32:25)

text: יַרְכִּבֵהוּ עַל במותי בָּמֳתֵי אָרֶץ וַיֹּאכַל תְּנוּבֹת שָׂדָי וַיֵּנִקֵהֽוּ דְבַשׁ מִסֶּלַע וְשֶׁמֶן מֵחַלְמִישׁ צֽוּר׃
translation: He made him ride on the high places of the earth. He ate the increase of the field. He caused him to suck honey out of the rock, oil out of the flinty rock; (Deuteronomy 32:13)

text: עַמִּים הַר יִקְרָאוּ שָׁם יִזְבְּחוּ זִבְחֵי צֶדֶק כִּי שֶׁפַע יַמִּים יִינָקוּ וּשְׂפוּנֵי טְמוּנֵי חֽוֹל׃
translation: They will call the peoples to the mountain. There they will offer sacrifices of righteousness, for they will draw out the abundance of the seas, the hidden treasures of the sand." (Deuteronomy 33:19)

text: וְהַנַּעַר לֹֽא יָדַע מְאוּמָה אַךְ יְהֽוֹנָתָן וְדָוִד יָדְעוּ אֶת הַדָּבָֽר׃
translation: But the boy didn't know anything. Only Jonathan and David knew the matter. (1 Samuel 20:39)

text: כִּֽי גֻנֹּב גֻּנַּבְתִּי מֵאֶרֶץ הָעִבְרִים וְגַם פֹּה לֹא עָשִׂיתִֽי מְאוּמָה כִּֽי שָׂמוּ אֹתִי בַּבּֽוֹר׃
translation: For indeed, I was stolen away out of the land of the Hebrews, and here also I have done nothing that they should put me into the dungeon." (Genesis 40:15)

text: כַּאֲשֶׁר יָצָא מִבֶּטֶן אִמּוֹ עָרוֹם יָשׁוּב לָלֶכֶת כְּשֶׁבָּא וּמְאוּמָה לֹא יִשָּׂא בַעֲמָלוֹ שֶׁיֹּלֵךְ בְּיָדֽוֹ׃
translation: Those riches perish by misfortune, and if he has fathered a son, there is nothing in his hand. (Ecclesiastes 5:14)

text: וְהָאֲנָשִׁים טֹבִים לָנוּ מְאֹד וְלֹא הָכְלַמְנוּ וְלֹֽא פָקַדְנוּ מְאוּמָה כָּל יְמֵי הִתְהַלַּכְנוּ אִתָּם בִּֽהְיוֹתֵנוּ בַּשָּׂדֶֽה׃
translation: But the men were very good to us, and we were not harmed, and we didn't miss anything as long as we went with them, when we were in the fields. (1 Samuel 25:15)

text: וַיֵּצֶר לְאַמְנוֹן לְהִתְחַלּוֹת בַּֽעֲבוּר תָּמָר אֲחֹתוֹ כִּי בְתוּלָה הִיא וַיִּפָּלֵא בְּעֵינֵי אַמְנוֹן לַעֲשׂוֹת לָהּ מְאֽוּמָה׃
translation: Amnon was so troubled that he became sick because of his sister Tamar, for she was a virgin, and it seemed hard to Amnon to do anything to her. (2 Samuel 13:2)

text: כִּי הַֽחַיִּים יוֹדְעִים שֶׁיָּמֻתוּ וְהַמֵּתִים אֵינָם יוֹדְעִים מְאוּמָה וְאֵֽין עוֹד לָהֶם שָׂכָר כִּי נִשְׁכַּח זִכְרָֽם׃
translation: For the living know that they will die, but the dead don't know anything, neither do they have any more a reward; for their memory is forgotten. (Ecclesiastes 9:5)

text: וַיַּנַּח אֶת נִבְלָתוֹ בְּקִבְרוֹ וַיִּסְפְּדוּ עָלָיו הוֹי אָחִֽי׃
translation: He laid his body in his own grave; and they mourned over him, saying, "Alas, my brother!" (1 Kings 13:30)

text: עַל שָׁדַיִם סֹֽפְדִים עַל שְׂדֵי חֶמֶד עַל גֶּפֶן פֹּרִיָּֽה׃
translation: Beat your breasts for the pleasant fields, for the fruitful vine. (Isaiah 32:12)

text: וַתִּשְׁמַע אֵשֶׁת אֽוּרִיָּה כִּי מֵת אוּרִיָּה אִישָׁהּ וַתִּסְפֹּד עַל בַּעְלָֽהּ׃
translation: When Uriah's wife heard that Uriah her husband was dead, she mourned for her husband. (2 Samuel 11:26)

text: וַתָּמָת שָׂרָה בְּקִרְיַת אַרְבַּע הִוא חֶבְרוֹן בְּאֶרֶץ כְּנָעַן וַיָּבֹא אַבְרָהָם לִסְפֹּד לְשָׂרָה וְלִבְכֹּתָֽהּ׃
translation: Sarah died in Kiriath Arba (also called Hebron), in the land of Canaan. Abraham came to mourn for Sarah, and to weep for her. (Genesis 23:2)

text: עַל זֹאת חִגְרוּ שַׂקִּים סִפְדוּ וְהֵילִילוּ כִּי לֹא שָׁב חֲרוֹן אַף יְהֹוָה מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃
translation: For this, clothe yourself with sackcloth, lament and wail; for the fierce anger of the LORD hasn't turned back from us. (Jeremiah 4:8)

text: וַיִּקְבְּרוּ אֹתוֹ וַיִּסְפְּדוּ לוֹ כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵל כִּדְבַר יְהוָה אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר בְּיַד עַבְדּוֹ אֲחִיָּהוּ הַנָּבִֽיא׃
translation: All Israel buried him and mourned for him, according to the LORD's word, which he spoke by his servant Ahijah the prophet. (1 Kings 14:18)

text: שָׂרִים רְדָפוּנִי חִנָּם ומדבריך וּמִדְּבָרְךָ פָּחַד לִבִּֽי׃
translation: Princes have persecuted me without a cause, but my heart stands in awe of your words. (Psalms 119:161)

text: אִם יֹאמְרוּ לְכָה אִתָּנוּ נֶאֶרְבָה לְדָם נִצְפְּנָה לְנָקִי חִנָּֽם׃
translation: If they say, "Come with us. Let's lie in wait for blood. Let's lurk secretly for the innocent without cause. (Proverbs 1:11)

text: כִּֽי כֹה אָמַר יְהוָה חִנָּם נִמְכַּרְתֶּם וְלֹא בְכֶסֶף תִּגָּאֵֽלוּ׃
translation: For the LORD says, "You were sold for nothing; and you will be redeemed without money." (Isaiah 52:3)

text: וְאִם שְׁלָשׁ אֵלֶּה לֹא יַעֲשֶׂה לָהּ וְיָצְאָה חִנָּם אֵין כָּֽסֶף׃
translation: If he doesn't do these three things for her, she may go free without paying any money. (Exodus 21:11)

text: אַל תרוב תָּרִיב עִם אָדָם חִנָּם אִם לֹא גְמָלְךָ רָעָֽה׃
translation: Don't strive with a man without cause, if he has done you no harm. (Proverbs 3:30)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר לָבָן לְיַעֲקֹב הֲכִי אָחִי אַתָּה וַעֲבַדְתַּנִי חִנָּם הַגִּידָה לִּי מַה מַּשְׂכֻּרְתֶּֽךָ׃
translation: Laban said to Jacob, "Because you are my relative, should you therefore serve me for nothing? Tell me, what will your wages be?" (Genesis 29:15)

text: זְכָר נָא מִי הוּא נָקִי אָבָד וְאֵיפֹה יְשָׁרִים נִכְחָֽדוּ׃
translation: "Remember, now, who ever perished, being innocent? Or where were the upright cut off? (Job 4:7)

text: אִם לֹא נִכְחַד קִימָנוּ וְיִתְרָם אָכְלָה אֵֽשׁ׃
translation: saying, 'Surely those who rose up against us are cut off. The fire has consumed their remnant.' (Job 22:20)

text: אוֹרֶה אֶתְכֶם בְּיַד אֵל אֲשֶׁר עִם שַׁדַּי לֹא אֲכַחֵֽד׃
translation: I will teach you about the hand of God. I will not conceal that which is with the Almighty. (Job 27:11)

text: אָמְרוּ לְכוּ וְנַכְחִידֵם מִגּוֹי וְלֹֽא יִזָּכֵר שֵֽׁם יִשְׂרָאֵל עֽוֹד׃
translation: For they have conspired together with one mind. They form an alliance against you. (Psalms 83:5)

text: אֲשֶׁר חֲכָמִים יַגִּידוּ וְלֹא כִֽחֲדוּ מֵאֲבוֹתָֽם׃
translation: (which wise men have told by their fathers, and have not hidden it; (Job 15:18)

text: וַיִּשְׁכּוֹן עָרִים נִכְחָדוֹת בָּתִּים לֹא יֵשְׁבוּ לָמוֹ אֲשֶׁר הִתְעַתְּדוּ לְגַלִּֽים׃
translation: He has lived in desolate cities, in houses which no one inhabited, which were ready to become heaps. (Job 15:28)

text: בֶּן יִצְהָר בֶּן קְהָת בֶּן לֵוִי בֶּן יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
translation: Elkanah his son, Ebiasaph his son, Assir his son, (1 Chronicles 6:23)

text: וּבְנֵי קְהָת לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם עַמְרָם וְיִצְהָר חֶבְרוֹן וְעֻזִּיאֵֽל׃
translation: The sons of Kohath by their families: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel. (Numbers 3:19)

text: רֵאשִׁית דְּגָֽנְךָ תִּֽירֹשְׁךָ וְיִצְהָרֶךָ וְרֵאשִׁית גֵּז צֹאנְךָ תִּתֶּן לּֽוֹ׃
translation: You shall give him the first fruits of your grain, of your new wine, and of your oil, and the first of the fleece of your sheep. (Deuteronomy 18:4)

text: בְּנֵי קְהָת עַמְרָם יִצְהָר חֶבְרוֹן וְעֻזִּיאֵל אַרְבָּעָֽה׃
translation: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel, four. (1 Chronicles 23:12)

text: וּבְנֵי קְהָת עַמְרָם וְיִצְהָר וְחֶבְרוֹן וְעֻזִּיאֵֽל׃
translation: The children of Amram: Aaron, Moses, and Miriam. The sons of Aaron: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar. (1 Chronicles 6:3)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלֶּה שְׁנֵי בְנֵֽי הַיִּצְהָר הָעֹמְדִים עַל אֲדוֹן כָּל הָאָֽרֶץ׃
translation: Then he said, "These are the two anointed ones who stand by the Lord of the whole earth." (Zechariah 4:14)

text: עַל אַרְבַּעַת רִבְעֵיהֶן בְּלֶכְתָּם יֵלֵכוּ לֹא יִסַּבּוּ בְּלֶכְתָּֽן׃
translation: When they went, they went in their four directions. They didn't turn when they went. (Ezekiel 1:17)

text: אַמָּה אָרְכּוֹ וְאַמָּה רָחְבּוֹ רָבוּעַ יִהְיֶה וְאַמָּתַיִם קֹמָתוֹ מִמֶּנּוּ קַרְנֹתָֽיו׃
translation: Its length shall be a cubit, and its width a cubit. It shall be square, and its height shall be two cubits. Its horns shall be of one piece with it. (Exodus 30:2)

text: אָרְחִי וְרִבְעִי זֵרִיתָ וְֽכָל דְּרָכַי הִסְכַּֽנְתָּה׃
translation: You search out my path and my lying down, and are acquainted with all my ways. (Psalms 139:3)

text: וידו וִידֵי אָדָם מִתַּחַת כַּנְפֵיהֶם עַל אַרְבַּעַת רִבְעֵיהֶם וּפְנֵיהֶם וְכַנְפֵיהֶם לְאַרְבַּעְתָּֽם׃
translation: They had the hands of a man under their wings on their four sides. The four of them had their faces and their wings like this: (Ezekiel 1:8)

text: והאראיל וְהָאֲרִיאֵל שְׁתֵּים עֶשְׂרֵה אֹרֶךְ בִּשְׁתֵּים עֶשְׂרֵה רֹחַב רָבוּעַ אֶל אַרְבַּעַת רְבָעָֽיו׃
translation: The altar hearth shall be twelve cubits long by twelve wide, square in its four sides. (Ezekiel 43:16)

text: וְעִשָּׂרֹן סֹלֶת בָּלוּל בְּשֶׁמֶן כָּתִית רֶבַע הַהִין וְנֵסֶךְ רְבִעִית הַהִין יָיִן לַכֶּבֶשׂ הָאֶחָֽד׃
translation: and with the one lamb a tenth part of an ephah of fine flour mixed with the fourth part of a hin of beaten oil, and the fourth part of a hin of wine for a drink offering. (Exodus 29:40)

text: הַשֹּׁתִים בְּמִזְרְקֵי יַיִן וְרֵאשִׁית שְׁמָנִים יִמְשָׁחוּ וְלֹא נֶחְלוּ עַל שֵׁבֶר יוֹסֵֽף׃
translation: who drink wine in bowls, and anoint themselves with the best oils, but they are not grieved for the affliction of Joseph. (Amos 6:6)

text: וְאֶת הַמַּחְתּוֹת וְאֶת הַמִּזְרָקוֹת אֲשֶׁר זָהָב זָהָב וַאֲשֶׁר כֶּסֶף כָּסֶף לָקַח רַב טַבָּחִֽים׃
translation: The captain of the guard took away the fire pans, the basins, that which was of gold, for gold, and that which was of silver, for silver. (2 Kings 25:15)

text: וַיַּעַשׂ שֻׁלְחָנוֹת עֲשָׂרָה וַיַּנַּח בַּֽהֵיכָל חֲמִשָּׁה מִיָּמִין וַחֲמִשָּׁה מִשְּׂמֹאול וַיַּעַשׂ מִזְרְקֵי זָהָב מֵאָֽה׃
translation: He made also ten tables, and placed them in the temple, five on the right side and five on the left. He made one hundred basins of gold. (2 Chronicles 4:8)

text: קָרְבָּנוֹ קַֽעֲרַת כֶּסֶף אַחַת שְׁלֹשִׁים וּמֵאָה מִשְׁקָלָהּ מִזְרָק אֶחָד כֶּסֶף שִׁבְעִים שֶׁקֶל בְּשֶׁקֶל הַקֹּדֶשׁ שְׁנֵיהֶם מְלֵאִים סֹלֶת בְּלוּלָה בַשֶּׁמֶן לְמִנְחָֽה׃
translation: gave his offering: one silver platter, the weight of which was one hundred thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering; (Numbers 7:37)

text: קָרְבָּנוֹ קַֽעֲרַת כֶּסֶף אַחַת שְׁלֹשִׁים וּמֵאָה מִשְׁקָלָהּ מִזְרָק אֶחָד כֶּסֶף שִׁבְעִים שֶׁקֶל בְּשֶׁקֶל הַקֹּדֶשׁ שְׁנֵיהֶם מְלֵאִים סֹלֶת בְּלוּלָה בַשֶּׁמֶן לְמִנְחָֽה׃
translation: gave his offering: one silver platter, the weight of which was one hundred thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering; (Numbers 7:43)

text: קָרְבָּנוֹ קַֽעֲרַת כֶּסֶף אַחַת שְׁלֹשִׁים וּמֵאָה מִשְׁקָלָהּ מִזְרָק אֶחָד כֶּסֶף שִׁבְעִים שֶׁקֶל בְּשֶׁקֶל הַקֹּדֶשׁ שְׁנֵיהֶם מְלֵאִים סֹלֶת בְּלוּלָה בַשֶּׁמֶן לְמִנְחָֽה׃
translation: gave his offering: one silver platter, the weight of which was one hundred thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering; (Numbers 7:49)

text: זֹבֵחַ תּוֹדָה יְֽכַבְּדָנְנִי וְשָׂם דֶּרֶךְ אַרְאֶנּוּ בְּיֵשַׁע אֱלֹהִֽים׃
translation: Whoever offers the sacrifice of thanksgiving glorifies me, and prepares his way so that I will show God's salvation to him." (Psalms 50:23)

text: וְכִֽי תִזְבְּחוּ זֶֽבַח תּוֹדָה לַיהוָה לִֽרְצֹנְכֶם תִּזְבָּֽחוּ׃
translation: "When you sacrifice a sacrifice of thanksgiving to the LORD, you shall sacrifice it so that you may be accepted. (Leviticus 22:29)

text: בֹּאוּ שְׁעָרָיו בְּתוֹדָה חֲצֵרֹתָיו בִּתְהִלָּה הֽוֹדוּ לוֹ בָּרֲכוּ שְׁמֽוֹ׃
translation: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with praise. Give thanks to him, and bless his name. (Psalms 100:4)

text: לְֽךָ אֶזְבַּח זֶבַח תּוֹדָה וּבְשֵׁם יְהוָה אֶקְרָֽא׃
translation: I will offer to you the sacrifice of thanksgiving, and will call on the LORD's name. (Psalms 116:17)

text: לַשְׁמִעַ בְּקוֹל תּוֹדָה וּלְסַפֵּר כָּל נִפְלְאוֹתֶֽיךָ׃
translation: that I may make the voice of thanksgiving to be heard and tell of all your wondrous deeds. (Psalms 26:7)

text: זְבַח לֵאלֹהִים תּוֹדָה וְשַׁלֵּם לְעֶלְיוֹן נְדָרֶֽיךָ׃
translation: Offer to God the sacrifice of thanksgiving. Pay your vows to the Most High. (Psalms 50:14)

text: וְאֻסַּף שְׁלַלְכֶם אֹסֶף הֶֽחָסִיל כְּמַשַּׁק גֵּבִים שׁוֹקֵק בּֽוֹ׃
translation: Your plunder will be gathered as the caterpillar gathers. Men will leap on it as locusts leap. (Isaiah 33:4)

text: וַתִּבְנִי לָךְ גֶּב וַתַּעֲשִׂי לָךְ רָמָה בְּכָל רְחֽוֹב׃
translation: "that you have built for yourselves a vaulted place, and have made yourselves a lofty place in every street. (Ezekiel 16:24)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר כֹּה אָמַר יְהוָה עָשֹׂה הַנַּחַל הַזֶּה גֵּבִים גֵּבִֽים׃
translation: He said, "The LORD says, 'Make this valley full of trenches.' (2 Kings 3:16)

text: יָרוּץ אֵלָיו בְּצַוָּאר בַּעֲבִי גַּבֵּי מָֽגִנָּֽיו׃
translation: he runs at him with a stiff neck, with the thick shields of his bucklers, (Job 15:26)

text: וְגַבֵּיהֶן וְגֹבַהּ לָהֶם וְיִרְאָה לָהֶם וְגַבֹּתָם מְלֵאֹת עֵינַיִם סָבִיב לְאַרְבַּעְתָּֽן׃
translation: As for their rims, they were high and dreadful; and the four of them had their rims full of eyes all around. (Ezekiel 1:18)

text: וּמַֽעֲשֵׂה הָאוֹפַנִּים כְּמַעֲשֵׂה אוֹפַן הַמֶּרְכָּבָה יְדוֹתָם וְגַבֵּיהֶם וְחִשֻּׁקֵיהֶם וְחִשֻּׁרֵיהֶם הַכֹּל מוּצָֽק׃
translation: The work of the wheels was like the work of a chariot wheel. Their axles, their rims, their spokes, and their hubs were all of cast metal. (1 Kings 7:33)

text: כִּי הוא הִיא זִמָּה והיא וְהוּא עָוֺן פְּלִילִֽים׃
translation: For that would be a heinous crime. Yes, it would be an iniquity to be punished by the judges, (Job 31:11)

text: אֶת זִמָּתֵךְ וְאֶת תּוֹעֲבוֹתַיִךְ אַתְּ נְשָׂאתִים נְאֻם יְהוָֽה׃
translation: You have borne your lewdness and your abominations," says the LORD. (Ezekiel 16:58)

text: לְֽגֵרְשׁוֹם לִבְנִי בְנוֹ יַחַת בְּנוֹ זִמָּה בְנֽוֹ׃
translation: Abishua became the father of Bukki. Bukki became the father of Uzzi. (1 Chronicles 6:5)

text: זֶבַח רְשָׁעִים תּוֹעֵבָה אַף כִּֽי בְזִמָּה יְבִיאֶֽנּוּ׃
translation: The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination— how much more, when he brings it with a wicked mind! (Proverbs 21:27)

text: זִמַּת אִוֶּלֶת חַטָּאת וְתוֹעֲבַת לְאָדָם לֵֽץ׃
translation: The schemes of folly are sin. The mocker is detested by men. (Proverbs 24:9)

text: וַֽתִּפְקְדִי אֵת זִמַּת נְעוּרָיִךְ בַּעְשׂוֹת מִמִּצְרַיִם דַּדַּיִךְ לְמַעַן שְׁדֵי נְעוּרָֽיִךְ׃
translation: Thus you called to memory the lewdness of your youth, in the caressing of your nipples by the Egyptians because of your youthful breasts. (Ezekiel 23:21)

text: חַיִּים וָחֶסֶד עָשִׂיתָ עִמָּדִי וּפְקֻדָּתְךָ שָֽׁמְרָה רוּחִֽי׃
translation: You have granted me life and loving kindness. Your visitation has preserved my spirit. (Job 10:12)

text: עַל כֵּן יִתְרָה עָשָׂה וּפְקֻדָּתָם עַל נַחַל הָעֲרָבִים יִשָּׂאֽוּם׃
translation: Therefore they will carry away the abundance they have gotten, and that which they have stored up, over the brook of the willows. (Isaiah 15:7)

text: הֶבֶל הֵמָּה מַעֲשֵׂה תַּעְתֻּעִים בְּעֵת פְּקֻדָּתָם יֹאבֵֽדוּ׃
translation: They are vanity, a work of delusion. In the time of their visitation they will perish. (Jeremiah 10:15)

text: הֶבֶל הֵמָּה מַעֲשֵׂה תַּעְתֻּעִים בְּעֵת פְּקֻדָּתָם יֹאבֵֽדוּ׃
translation: They are vanity, a work of delusion. In the time of their visitation, they will perish. (Jeremiah 51:18)

text: יִֽהְיֽוּ יָמָיו מְעַטִּים פְּקֻדָּתוֹ יִקַּח אַחֵֽר׃
translation: Let his days be few. Let another take his office. (Psalms 109:8)

text: וּנְשִׂיא נְשִׂיאֵי הַלֵּוִי אֶלְעָזָר בֶּן אַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֵן פְּקֻדַּת שֹׁמְרֵי מִשְׁמֶרֶת הַקֹּֽדֶשׁ׃
translation: Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest shall be prince of the princes of the Levites, with the oversight of those who keep the requirements of the sanctuary. (Numbers 3:32)

text: וַיִּירְאוּ יֹשְׁבֵי קְצָוֺת מֵאוֹתֹתֶיךָ מוֹצָֽאֵי בֹקֶר וָעֶרֶב תַּרְנִֽין׃
translation: You visit the earth, and water it. You greatly enrich it. The river of God is full of water. You provide them grain, for so you have ordained it. (Psalms 65:9)

text: מִקְצֵה הַשָּׁמַיִם מֽוֹצָאוֹ וּתְקוּפָתוֹ עַל קְצוֹתָם וְאֵין נִסְתָּר מֵֽחַמָּתוֹ׃
translation: The LORD's law is perfect, restoring the soul. The LORD's covenant is sure, making wise the simple. (Psalms 19:7)

text: לֹא אֲחַלֵּל בְּרִיתִי וּמוֹצָא שְׂפָתַי לֹא אֲשַׁנֶּֽה׃
translation: Once I have sworn by my holiness, I will not lie to David. (Psalms 89:35)

text: וּמוֹצָא הוֹלִיד אֶת בִּנְעָא רָפָה בְנוֹ אֶלְעָשָׂה בְנוֹ אָצֵל בְּנֽוֹ׃
translation: Moza became the father of Binea. Raphah was his son, Eleasah his son, and Azel his son. (1 Chronicles 8:37)

text: וּמוֹצָא הוֹלִיד אֶת בִּנְעָא וּרְפָיָה בְנוֹ אֶלְעָשָׂה בְנוֹ אָצֵל בְּנֽוֹ׃
translation: Moza became the father of Binea, Rephaiah his son, Eleasah his son, and Azel his son. (1 Chronicles 9:43)

text: יָשֵׂם נְהָרוֹת לְמִדְבָּר וּמֹצָאֵי מַיִם לְצִמָּאֽוֹן׃
translation: He turns rivers into a desert, water springs into a thirsty ground, (Psalms 107:33)

text: הַצְּבִי יִשְׂרָאֵל עַל בָּמוֹתֶיךָ חָלָל אֵיךְ נָפְלוּ גִבּוֹרִֽים׃
translation: "Your glory, Israel, was slain on your high places! How the mighty have fallen! (2 Samuel 1:19)

text: אַיָּל וּצְבִי וְיַחְמוּר וְאַקּוֹ וְדִישֹׁן וּתְאוֹ וָזָֽמֶר׃
translation: the deer, the gazelle, the roebuck, the wild goat, the ibex, the antelope, and the chamois. (Deuteronomy 14:5)

text: בִּשְׁעָרֶיךָ תֹּאכֲלֶנּוּ הַטָּמֵא וְהַטָּהוֹר יַחְדָּו כַּצְּבִי וְכָאַיָּֽל׃
translation: You shall eat it within your gates. The unclean and the clean shall eat it alike, as the gazelle and as the deer. (Deuteronomy 15:22)

text: הִנָּצֵל כִּצְבִי מִיָּד וּכְצִפּוֹר מִיַּד יָקֽוּשׁ׃
translation: Free yourself, like a gazelle from the hand of the hunter, like a bird from the snare of the fowler. (Proverbs 6:5)

text: יְהוָה צְבָאוֹת יְעָצָהּ לְחַלֵּל גְּאוֹן כָּל צְבִי לְהָקֵל כָּל נִכְבַּדֵּי אָֽרֶץ׃
translation: The LORD of Armies has planned it, to stain the pride of all glory, to bring into contempt all the honorable of the earth. (Isaiah 23:9)

text: בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא יִֽהְיֶה יְהוָה צְבָאוֹת לַעֲטֶרֶת צְבִי וְלִצְפִירַת תִּפְאָרָה לִשְׁאָר עַמּֽוֹ׃
translation: In that day, the LORD of Armies will become a crown of glory and a diadem of beauty to the residue of his people, (Isaiah 28:5)

text: הֵילִילוּ כִּי קָרוֹב יוֹם יְהוָה כְּשֹׁד מִשַּׁדַּי יָבֽוֹא׃
translation: Wail, for the LORD's day is at hand! It will come as destruction from the Almighty. (Isaiah 13:6)

text: עִבְרוּ תַּרְשִׁישָׁה הֵילִילוּ יֹשְׁבֵי אִֽי׃
translation: Pass over to Tarshish! Wail, you inhabitants of the coast! (Isaiah 23:6)

text: בֶּן אָדָם הִנָּבֵא וְאָמַרְתָּ כֹּה אָמַר אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה הֵילִילוּ הָהּ לַיּֽוֹם׃
translation: "Son of man, prophesy, and say, 'The Lord GOD says: "Wail, 'Alas for the day!' (Ezekiel 30:2)

text: לָכֵן יְיֵלִיל מוֹאָב לְמוֹאָב כֻּלֹּה יְיֵלִיל לַאֲשִׁישֵׁי קִיר חֲרֶשֶׂת תֶּהְגּוּ אַךְ נְכָאִֽים׃
translation: Therefore Moab will wail for Moab. Everyone will wail. You will mourn for the raisin cakes of Kir Hareseth, utterly stricken. (Isaiah 16:7)

text: הֵילִילוּ יֹשְׁבֵי הַמַּכְתֵּשׁ כִּי נִדְמָה כָּל עַם כְּנַעַן נִכְרְתוּ כָּל נְטִילֵי כָֽסֶף׃
translation: Wail, you inhabitants of Maktesh, for all the people of Canaan are undone! All those who were loaded with silver are cut off. (Zephaniah 1:11)

text: מַשָּׂא צֹר הֵילִילוּ אֳנִיּוֹת תַּרְשִׁישׁ כִּֽי שֻׁדַּד מִבַּיִת מִבּוֹא מֵאֶרֶץ כִּתִּים נִגְלָה לָֽמוֹ׃
translation: The burden of Tyre. Howl, you ships of Tarshish! For it is laid waste, so that there is no house, no entering in. From the land of Kittim it is revealed to them. (Isaiah 23:1)

text: מַה שַׁדַּי כִּֽי נַֽעַבְדֶנּוּ וּמַה נּוֹעִיל כִּי נִפְגַּע בּֽוֹ׃
translation: What is the Almighty, that we should serve him? What profit should we have, if we pray to him?' (Job 21:15)

text: לֹא יוֹעִילוּ אוֹצְרוֹת רֶשַׁע וּצְדָקָה תַּצִּיל מִמָּֽוֶת׃
translation: Treasures of wickedness profit nothing, but righteousness delivers from death. (Proverbs 10:2)

text: מִֽי יָצַר אֵל וּפֶסֶל נָסָךְ לְבִלְתִּי הוֹעִֽיל׃
translation: Who has fashioned a god, or molds an image that is profitable for nothing? (Isaiah 44:10)

text: אֲנִי אַגִּיד צִדְקָתֵךְ וְאֶֽת מַעֲשַׂיִךְ וְלֹא יוֹעִילֽוּךְ׃
translation: I will declare your righteousness; and as for your works, they will not benefit you. (Isaiah 57:12)

text: הִנֵּה אַתֶּם בֹּטְחִים לָכֶם עַל דִּבְרֵי הַשָּׁקֶר לְבִלְתִּי הוֹעִֽיל׃
translation: Behold, you trust in lying words that can't profit. (Jeremiah 7:8)

text: הָרִים הַגְּבֹהִים לַיְּעֵלִים סְלָעִים מַחְסֶה לַֽשְׁפַנִּֽים׃
translation: The high mountains are for the wild goats. The rocks are a refuge for the rock badgers. (Psalms 104:18)

text: אֱֽלֹהִים הֲרָס שִׁנֵּימוֹ בְּפִימוֹ מַלְתְּעוֹת כְּפִירִים נְתֹץ יְהוָֽה׃
translation: Let them vanish like water that flows away. When they draw the bow, let their arrows be made blunt. (Psalms 58:7)

text: נָסוּ וְאֵין רֹדֵף רָשָׁע וְצַדִּיקִים כִּכְפִיר יִבְטָֽח׃
translation: The wicked flee when no one pursues; but the righteous are as bold as a lion. (Proverbs 28:1)

text: וַתַּעַל אֶחָד מִגֻּרֶיהָ כְּפִיר הָיָה וַיִּלְמַד לִטְרָף טֶרֶף אָדָם אָכָֽל׃
translation: She brought up one of her cubs. He became a young lion. He learned to catch the prey. He devoured men. (Ezekiel 19:3)

text: וַתֵּרֶא כִּי נֽוֹחֲלָה אָבְדָה תִּקְוָתָהּ וַתִּקַּח אֶחָד מִגֻּרֶיהָ כְּפִיר שָׂמָֽתְהוּ׃
translation: "'Now when she saw that she had waited, and her hope was lost, then she took another of her cubs, and made him a young lion. (Ezekiel 19:5)

text: וַיִּתְהַלֵּךְ בְּתוֹךְ אֲרָיוֹת כְּפִיר הָיָה וַיִּלְמַד לִטְרָף טֶרֶף אָדָם אָכָֽל׃
translation: He went up and down among the lions. He became a young lion. He learned to catch the prey. He devoured men. (Ezekiel 19:6)

text: וַיֵּרֶד שִׁמְשׁוֹן וְאָבִיו וְאִמּוֹ תִּמְנָתָה וַיָּבֹאוּ עַד כַּרְמֵי תִמְנָתָה וְהִנֵּה כְּפִיר אֲרָיוֹת שֹׁאֵג לִקְרָאתֽוֹ׃
translation: Then Samson went down to Timnah with his father and his mother, and came to the vineyards of Timnah; and behold, a young lion roared at him. (Judges 14:5)

text: וְיַיִן לֹֽא יִשְׁתּוּ כָּל כֹּהֵן בְּבוֹאָם אֶל הֶחָצֵר הַפְּנִימִֽית׃
translation: None of the priests shall drink wine when they enter into the inner court. (Ezekiel 44:21)

text: וְהַכְּרֻבִים עֹֽמְדִים מִימִין לַבַּיִת בְּבֹאוֹ הָאִישׁ וְהֶעָנָן מָלֵא אֶת הֶחָצֵר הַפְּנִימִֽית׃
translation: Now the cherubim stood on the right side of the house when the man went in; and the cloud filled the inner court. (Ezekiel 10:3)

text: וַיְבִיאֵנִי אֶל הֶחָצֵר הַפְּנִימִי דֶּרֶךְ הַקָּדִים וַיָּמָד אֶת הַשַּׁעַר כַּמִּדּוֹת הָאֵֽלֶּה׃
translation: He brought me into the inner court toward the east. He measured the gate according to these measurements; (Ezekiel 40:32)

text: וַתִּשָּׂאֵנִי רוּחַ וַתְּבִיאֵנִי אֶל הֶֽחָצֵר הַפְּנִימִי וְהִנֵּה מָלֵא כְבוֹד יְהוָה הַבָּֽיִת׃
translation: The Spirit took me up and brought me into the inner court; and behold, the LORD's glory filled the house. (Ezekiel 43:5)

text: וְעַל פְּנֵי הַשַּׁעַר היאתון הָֽאִיתוֹן עַל לִפְנֵי אֻלָם הַשַּׁעַר הַפְּנִימִי חֲמִשִּׁים אַמָּֽה׃
translation: From the forefront of the gate at the entrance to the forefront of the inner porch of the gate were fifty cubits. (Ezekiel 40:15)

text: וְשַׁעַר לֶחָצֵר הַפְּנִימִי נֶגֶד הַשַּׁעַר לַצָּפוֹן וְלַקָּדִים וַיָּמָד מִשַּׁעַר אֶל שַׁעַר מֵאָה אַמָּֽה׃
translation: There was a gate to the inner court facing the other gate, on the north and on the east. He measured one hundred cubits from gate to gate. (Ezekiel 40:23)

text: וְשִׁלַּחְתִּי אֵשׁ בְּבֵית חֲזָאֵל וְאָכְלָה אַרְמְנוֹת בֶּן הֲדָֽד׃
translation: but I will send a fire into the house of Hazael, and it will devour the palaces of Ben Hadad. (Amos 1:4)

text: שִׁיתוּ לִבְּכֶם לְֽחֵילָה פַּסְּגוּ אַרְמְנוֹתֶיהָ לְמַעַן תְּסַפְּרוּ לְדוֹר אַחֲרֽוֹן׃
translation: For this God is our God forever and ever. He will be our guide even to death. (Psalms 48:14)

text: וְשִׁלַּחְתִּי אֵשׁ בְּחוֹמַת עַזָּה וְאָכְלָה אַרְמְנֹתֶֽיהָ׃
translation: but I will send a fire on the wall of Gaza, and it will devour its palaces. (Amos 1:7)

text: וְשִׁלַּחְתִּי אֵשׁ בְּחוֹמַת צֹר וְאָכְלָה אַרְמְנֹתֶֽיהָ׃
translation: but I will send a fire on the wall of Tyre, and it will devour its palaces." (Amos 1:10)

text: וְשִׁלַּחְתִּי אֵשׁ בְּתֵימָן וְאָכְלָה אַרְמְנוֹת בָּצְרָֽה׃
translation: but I will send a fire on Teman, and it will devour the palaces of Bozrah." (Amos 1:12)

text: וְשִׁלַּחְתִּי אֵשׁ בִּֽיהוּדָה וְאָכְלָה אַרְמְנוֹת יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
translation: but I will send a fire on Judah, and it will devour the palaces of Jerusalem." (Amos 2:5)

text: וְאֶת הַדָּאָה וְאֶת הָאַיָּה לְמִינָֽהּ׃
translation: the red kite, any kind of black kite, (Leviticus 11:14)

text: וְהָרָאָה וְאֶת הָאַיָּה וְהַדַּיָּה לְמִינָֽהּ׃
translation: the red kite, the falcon, the kite of any kind, (Deuteronomy 14:13)

text: אֵת כָּל עֹרֵב לְמִינֽוֹ׃
translation: any kind of raven, (Leviticus 11:15)

text: וְאֵת כָּל עֹרֵב לְמִינֽוֹ׃
translation: every raven of any kind, (Deuteronomy 14:14)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֱלֹהִים תּוֹצֵא הָאָרֶץ נֶפֶשׁ חַיָּה לְמִינָהּ בְּהֵמָה וָרֶמֶשׂ וְחַֽיְתוֹ אֶרֶץ לְמִינָהּ וַֽיְהִי כֵֽן׃
translation: God said, "Let the earth produce living creatures after their kind, livestock, creeping things, and animals of the earth after their kind;" and it was so. (Genesis 1:24)

text: מֵהָעוֹף לְמִינֵהוּ וּמִן הַבְּהֵמָה לְמִינָהּ מִכֹּל רֶמֶשׂ הָֽאֲדָמָה לְמִינֵהוּ שְׁנַיִם מִכֹּל יָבֹאוּ אֵלֶיךָ לְהַֽחֲיֽוֹת׃
translation: Of the birds after their kind, of the livestock after their kind, of every creeping thing of the ground after its kind, two of every sort will come to you, to keep them alive. (Genesis 6:20)

text: לַֽאדֹנָי אֱלֹהֵינוּ הָרַחֲמִים וְהַסְּלִחוֹת כִּי מָרַדְנוּ בּֽוֹ׃
translation: To the Lord our God belong mercies and forgiveness, for we have rebelled against him. (Daniel 9:9)

text: שְׁתֵּים עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה עָבְדוּ אֶת כְּדָרְלָעֹמֶר וּשְׁלֹשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה מָרָֽדוּ׃
translation: They served Chedorlaomer for twelve years, and in the thirteenth year they rebelled. (Genesis 14:4)

text: הֵמָּה הָיוּ בְּֽמֹרְדֵי אוֹר לֹֽא הִכִּירוּ דְרָכָיו וְלֹא יָשְׁבוּ בִּנְתִיבֹתָֽיו׃
translation: "These are of those who rebel against the light. They don't know its ways, nor stay in its paths. (Job 24:13)

text: וַיָּקָם יָרָבְעָם בֶּן נְבָט עֶבֶד שְׁלֹמֹה בֶן דָּוִיד וַיִּמְרֹד עַל אֲדֹנָֽיו׃
translation: Yet Jeroboam the son of Nebat, the servant of Solomon the son of David, rose up, and rebelled against his lord. (2 Chronicles 13:6)

text: וְהָיָה יְהוָה עִמּוֹ בְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר יֵצֵא יַשְׂכִּיל וַיִּמְרֹד בְּמֶֽלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר וְלֹא עֲבָדֽוֹ׃
translation: The LORD was with him. Wherever he went, he prospered. He rebelled against the king of Assyria, and didn't serve him. (2 Kings 18:7)

text: אָמַרְתָּ אַךְ דְּבַר שְׂפָתַיִם עֵצָה וּגְבוּרָה לַמִּלְחָמָה עַתָּה עַל מִי בָטַחְתָּ כִּי מָרַדְתָּ בִּֽי׃
translation: You say (but they are but vain words), 'There is counsel and strength for war.' Now on whom do you trust, that you have rebelled against me? (2 Kings 18:20)

text: אַכֶּנּוּ בַדֶּבֶר וְאוֹרִשֶׁנּוּ וְאֶֽעֱשֶׂה אֹֽתְךָ לְגוֹי גָּדוֹל וְעָצוּם מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃
translation: I will strike them with the pestilence, and disinherit them, and will make of you a nation greater and mightier than they." (Numbers 14:12)

text: כִּֽי רַבִּים חֲלָלִים הִפִּילָה וַעֲצֻמִים כָּל הֲרֻגֶֽיהָ׃
translation: for she has thrown down many wounded. Yes, all her slain are a mighty army. (Proverbs 7:26)

text: שְׁפַנִּים עַם לֹא עָצוּם וַיָּשִׂימוּ בַסֶּלַע בֵּיתָֽם׃
translation: The hyraxes are but a feeble folk, yet make they their houses in the rocks. (Proverbs 30:26)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל עַמּוֹ הִנֵּה עַם בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל רַב וְעָצוּם מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃
translation: He said to his people, "Behold, the people of the children of Israel are more and mightier than we. (Exodus 1:9)

text: אוֹדְךָ בְּקָהָל רָב בְּעַם עָצוּם אֲהַֽלְלֶֽךָּ׃
translation: I will give you thanks in the great assembly. I will praise you among many people. (Psalms 35:18)

text: שֶֽׁהִכָּה גּוֹיִם רַבִּים וְהָרַג מְלָכִים עֲצוּמִֽים׃
translation: He struck many nations, and killed mighty kings— (Psalms 135:10)

text: יַכְרֵת יְהוָה כָּל שִׂפְתֵי חֲלָקוֹת לָשׁוֹן מְדַבֶּרֶת גְּדֹלֽוֹת׃
translation: who have said, "With our tongue we will prevail. Our lips are our own. Who is lord over us?" (Psalms 12:4)

text: וּמַרְשִׁיעֵי בְרִית יַחֲנִיף בַּחֲלַקּוֹת וְעַם יֹדְעֵי אֱלֹהָיו יַחֲזִקוּ וְעָשֽׂוּ׃
translation: He will corrupt those who do wickedly against the covenant by flatteries; but the people who know their God will be strong and take action. (Daniel 11:32)

text: וְאֵת עֹרֹת גְּדָיֵי הָֽעִזִּים הִלְבִּישָׁה עַל יָדָיו וְעַל חֶלְקַת צַוָּארָֽיו׃
translation: She put the skins of the young goats on his hands, and on the smooth of his neck. (Genesis 27:16)

text: שָׁוְא יְֽדַבְּרוּ אִישׁ אֶת רֵעֵהוּ שְׂפַת חֲלָקוֹת בְּלֵב וָלֵב יְדַבֵּֽרוּ׃
translation: May the LORD cut off all flattering lips, and the tongue that boasts, (Psalms 12:3)

text: אַךְ בַּחֲלָקוֹת תָּשִׁית לָמוֹ הִפַּלְתָּם לְמַשּׁוּאֽוֹת׃
translation: Surely you set them in slippery places. You throw them down to destruction. (Psalms 73:18)

text: לִשְׁמָרְךָ מֵאֵשֶׁת רָע מֵֽחֶלְקַת לָשׁוֹן נָכְרִיָּֽה׃
translation: to keep you from the immoral woman, from the flattery of the wayward wife's tongue. (Proverbs 6:24)

text: וְהָיִיתָ לְשַׁמָּה לְמָשָׁל וְלִשְׁנִינָה בְּכֹל הָֽעַמִּים אֲשֶׁר יְנַהֶגְךָ יְהוָה שָֽׁמָּה׃
translation: You will become an astonishment, a proverb, and a byword among all the peoples where the LORD will lead you away. (Deuteronomy 28:37)

text: חֲמוֹר יְתוֹמִים יִנְהָגוּ יַחְבְּלוּ שׁוֹר אַלְמָנָֽה׃
translation: They drive away the donkey of the fatherless, and they take the widow's ox for a pledge. (Job 24:3)

text: יַסַּע קָדִים בַּשָּׁמָיִם וַיְנַהֵג בְּעֻזּוֹ תֵימָֽן׃
translation: He caused the east wind to blow in the sky. By his power he guided the south wind. (Psalms 78:26)

text: וַיַּסַּע כַּצֹּאן עַמּוֹ וַֽיְנַהֲגֵם כַּעֵדֶר בַּמִּדְבָּֽר׃
translation: But he led out his own people like sheep, and guided them in the wilderness like a flock. (Psalms 78:52)

text: אוֹתִי נָהַג וַיֹּלַךְ חֹשֶׁךְ וְלֹא אֽוֹר׃
translation: He has led me and caused me to walk in darkness, and not in light. (Lamentations 3:2)

text: וְהֻצַּב גֻּלְּתָה הֹֽעֲלָתָה וְאַמְהֹתֶיהָ מְנַֽהֲגוֹת כְּקוֹל יוֹנִים מְתֹפְפֹת עַל לִבְבֵהֶֽן׃
translation: But Nineveh has been from of old like a pool of water, yet they flee away. "Stop! Stop!" they cry, but no one looks back. (Nahum 2:8)

text: וַיָּשֶׁת חֹשֶׁךְ סְבִיבֹתָיו סֻכּוֹת חַֽשְׁרַת מַיִם עָבֵי שְׁחָקִֽים׃
translation: He made darkness a shelter around himself, gathering of waters, and thick clouds of the skies. (2 Samuel 22:12)

text: אַף אִם יָבִין מִפְרְשֵׂי עָב תְּשֻׁאוֹת סֻכָּתֽוֹ׃
translation: Indeed, can anyone understand the spreading of the clouds and the thunderings of his pavilion? (Job 36:29)

text: תַּסְתִּירֵם בְּסֵתֶר פָּנֶיךָ מֵֽרֻכְסֵי אִישׁ תִּצְפְּנֵם בְּסֻכָּה מֵרִיב לְשֹׁנֽוֹת׃
translation: Praise be to the LORD, for he has shown me his marvelous loving kindness in a strong city. (Psalms 31:21)

text: וַיְצַו מֹשֶׁה אוֹתָם לֵאמֹר מִקֵּץ שֶׁבַע שָׁנִים בְּמֹעֵד שְׁנַת הַשְּׁמִטָּה בְּחַג הַסֻּכּֽוֹת׃
translation: Moses commanded them, saying, "At the end of every seven years, in the set time of the year of release, in the feast of booths, (Deuteronomy 31:10)

text: וַֽיַּעֲשׂוּ אֶת חַג הַסֻּכּוֹת כַּכָּתוּב וְעֹלַת יוֹם בְּיוֹם בְּמִסְפָּר כְּמִשְׁפַּט דְּבַר יוֹם בְּיוֹמֽוֹ׃
translation: They kept the feast of booths, as it is written, and offered the daily burnt offerings by number, according to the ordinance, as the duty of every day required; (Ezra 3:4)

text: וְיַעֲקֹב נָסַע סֻכֹּתָה וַיִּבֶן לוֹ בָּיִת וּלְמִקְנֵהוּ עָשָׂה סֻכֹּת עַל כֵּן קָרָא שֵׁם הַמָּקוֹם סֻכּֽוֹת׃
translation: Jacob traveled to Succoth, built himself a house, and made shelters for his livestock. Therefore the name of the place is called Succoth. (Genesis 33:17)

text: אִם כִּסִּיתִי כְאָדָם פְּשָׁעָי לִטְמוֹן בְּחֻבִּי עֲוֺֽנִי׃
translation: if like Adam I have covered my transgressions, by hiding my iniquity in my heart, (Job 31:33)

text: טָמַן עָצֵל יָדוֹ בַּצַּלָּחַת גַּם אֶל פִּיהוּ לֹא יְשִׁיבֶֽנָּה׃
translation: The sluggard buries his hand in the dish; he will not so much as bring it to his mouth again. (Proverbs 19:24)

text: בּוֹא בַצּוּר וְהִטָּמֵן בֶּֽעָפָר מִפְּנֵי פַּחַד יְהוָה וּמֵהֲדַר גְּאֹנֽוֹ׃
translation: Enter into the rock, and hide in the dust, from before the terror of the LORD, and from the glory of his majesty. (Isaiah 2:10)

text: וָאֵלֵךְ וָאֶטְמְנֵהוּ בִּפְרָת כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהוָה אוֹתִֽי׃
translation: So I went and hid it by the Euphrates, as the LORD commanded me. (Jeremiah 13:5)

text: וַיִּשְׁלַח יְהוֹשֻׁעַ מַלְאָכִים וַיָּרֻצוּ הָאֹהֱלָה וְהִנֵּה טְמוּנָה בְּאָהֳלוֹ וְהַכֶּסֶף תַּחְתֶּֽיהָ׃
translation: So Joshua sent messengers, and they ran to the tent. Behold, it was hidden in his tent, with the silver under it. (Joshua 7:22)

text: טָמוּן בָּאָרֶץ חַבְלוֹ וּמַלְכֻּדְתּוֹ עֲלֵי נָתִֽיב׃
translation: A noose is hidden for him in the ground, a trap for him on the path. (Job 18:10)

text: יְהוָה צַדִּיק יִבְחָן וְרָשָׁע וְאֹהֵב חָמָס שָֽׂנְאָה נַפְשֽׁוֹ׃
translation: The LORD examines the righteous, but his soul hates the wicked and him who loves violence. (Psalms 11:5)

text: בָּחוֹן נְתַתִּיךָ בְעַמִּי מִבְצָר וְתֵדַע וּבָחַנְתָּ אֶת דַּרְכָּֽם׃
translation: "I have made you a tester of metals and a fortress among my people, that you may know and try their way. (Jeremiah 6:27)

text: כִּֽי יָדַע דֶּרֶךְ עִמָּדִי בְּחָנַנִי כַּזָּהָב אֵצֵֽא׃
translation: But he knows the way that I take. When he has tried me, I will come out like gold. (Job 23:10)

text: חָקְרֵנִי אֵל וְדַע לְבָבִי בְּחָנֵנִי וְדַע שַׂרְעַפָּֽי׃
translation: Search me, God, and know my heart. Try me, and know my thoughts. (Psalms 139:23)

text: בַּצָּרָה קָרָאתָ וָאֲחַלְּצֶךָּ אֶעֶנְךָ בְּסֵתֶר רַעַם אֶבְחָֽנְךָ עַל מֵי מְרִיבָה סֶֽלָה׃
translation: "Hear, my people, and I will testify to you, Israel, if you would listen to me! (Psalms 81:8)

text: וַתִּפְקְדֶנּוּ לִבְקָרִים לִרְגָעִים תִּבְחָנֶֽנּוּ׃
translation: that you should visit him every morning, and test him every moment? (Job 7:18)

text: וַֽחֲזָאֵל מֶלֶךְ אֲרָם לָחַץ אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל כֹּל יְמֵי יְהוֹאָחָֽז׃
translation: Hazael king of Syria oppressed Israel all the days of Jehoahaz. (2 Kings 13:22)

text: יְחַלֵּץ עָנִי בְעָנְיוֹ וְיִגֶל בַּלַּחַץ אָזְנָֽם׃
translation: He delivers the afflicted by their affliction, and opens their ear in oppression. (Job 36:15)

text: אוֹמְרָה לְאֵל סַלְעִי לָמָה שְׁכַחְתָּנִי לָֽמָּה קֹדֵר אֵלֵךְ בְּלַחַץ אוֹיֵֽב׃
translation: As with a sword in my bones, my adversaries reproach me, while they continually ask me, "Where is your God?" (Psalms 42:10)

text: לָֽמָּה פָנֶיךָ תַסְתִּיר תִּשְׁכַּח עָנְיֵנוּ וְֽלַחֲצֵֽנוּ׃
translation: For our soul is bowed down to the dust. Our body clings to the earth. (Psalms 44:25)

text: וְהָיוּ בָנָיו כְּקֶדֶם וַעֲדָתוֹ לְפָנַי תִּכּוֹן וּפָקַדְתִּי עַל כָּל לֹחֲצָֽיו׃
translation: Their children also will be as before, and their congregation will be established before me. I will punish all who oppress them. (Jeremiah 30:20)

text: וַיִּלְחֲצוּ הָאֱמֹרִי אֶת בְּנֵי דָן הָהָרָה כִּי לֹא נְתָנוֹ לָרֶדֶת לָעֵֽמֶק׃
translation: The Amorites forced the children of Dan into the hill country, for they would not allow them to come down to the valley; (Judges 1:34)

text: הוֹי גִּבּוֹרִים לִשְׁתּוֹת יָיִן וְאַנְשֵׁי חַיִל לִמְסֹךְ שֵׁכָֽר׃
translation: Woe to those who are mighty to drink wine, and champions at mixing strong drink; (Isaiah 5:22)

text: וְשַׂמְתָּ אֶת הֶחָצֵר סָבִיב וְנָתַתָּ אֶת מָסַךְ שַׁעַר הֶחָצֵֽר׃
translation: You shall set up the court around it, and hang up the screen of the gate of the court. (Exodus 40:8)

text: טָבְחָה טִבְחָהּ מָסְכָה יֵינָהּ אַף עָֽרְכָה שֻׁלְחָנָֽהּ׃
translation: She has prepared her meat. She has mixed her wine. She has also set her table. (Proverbs 9:2)

text: פָּרַשׂ עָנָן לְמָסָךְ וְאֵשׁ לְהָאִיר לָֽיְלָה׃
translation: He spread a cloud for a covering, fire to give light in the night. (Psalms 105:39)

text: לְכוּ לַחֲמוּ בְֽלַחֲמִי וּשְׁתוּ בְּיַיִן מָסָֽכְתִּי׃
translation: "Come, eat some of my bread, Drink some of the wine which I have mixed! (Proverbs 9:5)

text: וַיָּשֶׂם אֶת מָסַךְ הַפֶּתַח לַמִּשְׁכָּֽן׃
translation: He put up the screen of the door to the tabernacle. (Exodus 40:28)

text: אֲבָרֵךְ אֶת יְהוָה אֲשֶׁר יְעָצָנִי אַף לֵילוֹת יִסְּרוּנִי כִלְיוֹתָֽי׃
translation: I will bless the LORD, who has given me counsel. Yes, my heart instructs me in the night seasons. (Psalms 16:7)

text: בְּחָנֵנִי יְהוָה וְנַסֵּנִי צרופה צָרְפָה כִלְיוֹתַי וְלִבִּֽי׃
translation: Examine me, LORD, and prove me. Try my heart and my mind. (Psalms 26:2)

text: כִּֽי אַתָּה קָנִיתָ כִלְיֹתָי תְּסֻכֵּנִי בְּבֶטֶן אִמִּֽי׃
translation: For you formed my inmost being. You knit me together in my mother's womb. (Psalms 139:13)

text: אֲשֶׁר אֲנִי אֶֽחֱזֶה לִּי וְעֵינַי רָאוּ וְלֹא זָר כָּלוּ כִלְיֹתַי בְּחֵקִֽי׃
translation: whom I, even I, will see on my side. My eyes will see, and not as a stranger. "My heart is consumed within me. (Job 19:27)

text: וְתַעְלֹזְנָה כִלְיוֹתָי בְּדַבֵּר שְׂפָתֶיךָ מֵישָׁרִֽים׃
translation: Yes, my heart will rejoice when your lips speak what is right. (Proverbs 23:16)

text: נְטַעְתָּם גַּם שֹׁרָשׁוּ יֵלְכוּ גַּם עָשׂוּ פֶרִי קָרוֹב אַתָּה בְּפִיהֶם וְרָחוֹק מִכִּלְיוֹתֵיהֶֽם׃
translation: You have planted them. Yes, they have taken root. They grow. Yes, they produce fruit. You are near in their mouth, and far from their heart. (Jeremiah 12:2)

text: וְהֵמָּה טֶרֶם יִשְׁכָּבוּן וְהִיא עָלְתָה עֲלֵיהֶם עַל הַגָּֽג׃
translation: Before they had lain down, she came up to them on the roof. (Joshua 2:8)

text: וַיֵּרְדוּ מֵהַבָּמָה הָעִיר וַיְדַבֵּר עִם שָׁאוּל עַל הַגָּֽג׃
translation: When they had come down from the high place into the city, he talked with Saul on the housetop. (1 Samuel 9:25)

text: טוֹב לָשֶׁבֶת עַל פִּנַּת גָּג מֵאֵשֶׁת מִדְיָנִים וּבֵית חָֽבֶר׃
translation: It is better to dwell in the corner of the housetop than to share a house with a contentious woman. (Proverbs 21:9)

text: טוֹב שֶׁבֶת עַל פִּנַּת גָּג מֵאֵשֶׁת מדונים מִדְיָנִים וּבֵית חָֽבֶר׃
translation: It is better to dwell in the corner of the housetop than to share a house with a contentious woman. (Proverbs 25:24)

text: בְּחוּצֹתָיו חָגְרוּ שָׂק עַל גַּגּוֹתֶיהָ וּבִרְחֹבֹתֶיהָ כֻּלֹּה יְיֵלִיל יֹרֵד בַּבֶּֽכִי׃
translation: In their streets, they clothe themselves in sackcloth. In their streets and on their housetops, everyone wails, weeping abundantly. (Isaiah 15:3)

text: וְאֶת הַמִּשְׁתַּחֲוִים עַל הַגַּגּוֹת לִצְבָא הַשָּׁמָיִם וְאֶת הַמִּֽשְׁתַּחֲוִים הַנִּשְׁבָּעִים לַֽיהוָה וְהַנִּשְׁבָּעִים בְּמַלְכָּֽם׃
translation: those who worship the army of the sky on the housetops, those who worship and swear by the LORD and also swear by Malcam, (Zephaniah 1:5)

text: עֹזְבֵי תוֹרָה יְהַֽלְלוּ רָשָׁע וְשֹׁמְרֵי תוֹרָה יִתְגָּרוּ בָֽם׃
translation: Those who forsake the law praise the wicked; but those who keep the law contend with them. (Proverbs 28:4)

text: וְכָל עֶרְכְּךָ יִהְיֶה בְּשֶׁקֶל הַקֹּדֶשׁ עֶשְׂרִים גֵּרָה יִהְיֶה הַשָּֽׁקֶל׃
translation: All your valuations shall be according to the shekel of the sanctuary: twenty gerahs to the shekel. (Leviticus 27:25)

text: וּפְדוּיָו מִבֶּן חֹדֶשׁ תִּפְדֶּה בְּעֶרְכְּךָ כֶּסֶף חֲמֵשֶׁת שְׁקָלִים בְּשֶׁקֶל הַקֹּדֶשׁ עֶשְׂרִים גֵּרָה הֽוּא׃
translation: You shall redeem those who are to be redeemed of them from a month old, according to your estimation, for five shekels of money, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, which weighs twenty gerahs. (Numbers 18:16)

text: וְהַשֶּׁקֶל עֶשְׂרִים גֵּרָה עֶשְׂרִים שְׁקָלִים חֲמִשָּׁה וְעֶשְׂרִים שְׁקָלִים עֲשָׂרָה וַחֲמִשָּׁה שֶׁקֶל הַמָּנֶה יִֽהְיֶה לָכֶֽם׃
translation: The shekel shall be twenty gerahs. Twenty shekels plus twenty-five shekels plus fifteen shekels shall be your mina. (Ezekiel 45:12)

text: הַכֵּה הִכִּיתָ אֶת אֱדוֹם וּֽנְשָׂאֲךָ לִבֶּךָ הִכָּבֵד וְשֵׁב בְּבֵיתֶךָ וְלָמָּה תִתְגָּרֶה בְּרָעָה וְנָפַלְתָּה אַתָּה וִיהוּדָה עִמָּֽךְ׃
translation: You have indeed struck Edom, and your heart has lifted you up. Enjoy the glory of it, and stay at home; for why should you meddle to your harm, that you fall, even you, and Judah with you?" (2 Kings 14:10)

text: ובנו וּבָנָיו יִתְגָּרוּ וְאָסְפוּ הֲמוֹן חֲיָלִים רַבִּים וּבָא בוֹא וְשָׁטַף וְעָבָר וְיָשֹׁב ויתגרו וְיִתְגָּרֶה עַד מעזה מָעֻזּֽוֹ׃
translation: His sons will wage war, and will assemble a multitude of great forces which will come on, and overflow, and pass through. They will return and wage war, even to his fortress. (Daniel 11:10)

text: אֵין שָׂרִיד לְאָכְלוֹ עַל כֵּן לֹא יָחִיל טוּבֽוֹ׃
translation: There was nothing left that he didn't devour, therefore his prosperity will not endure. (Job 20:21)

text: אָז יְרַד שָׂרִיד לְאַדִּירִים עָם יְהוָה יְרַד לִי בַּגִּבּוֹרִֽים׃
translation: "Then a remnant of the nobles and the people came down. The LORD came down for me against the mighty. (Judges 5:13)

text: שרידו שְׂרִידָיו בַּמָּוֶת יִקָּבֵרוּ וְאַלְמְנֹתָיו לֹא תִבְכֶּֽינָה׃
translation: Those who remain of him will be buried in death. His widows will make no lamentation. (Job 27:15)

text: וְיֵרְדְּ מִֽיַּעֲקֹב וְהֶֽאֱבִיד שָׂרִיד מֵעִֽיר׃
translation: Out of Jacob shall one have dominion, and shall destroy the remnant from the city." (Numbers 24:19)

text: וַיַּעַל הַגּוֹרָל הַשְּׁלִישִׁי לִבְנֵי זְבוּלֻן לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם וַיְהִי גְּבוּל נַחֲלָתָם עַד שָׂרִֽיד׃
translation: The third lot came up for the children of Zebulun according to their families. The border of their inheritance was to Sarid. (Joshua 19:10)

text: לוּלֵי יְהוָה צְבָאוֹת הוֹתִיר לָנוּ שָׂרִיד כִּמְעָט כִּסְדֹם הָיִינוּ לַעֲמֹרָה דָּמִֽינוּ׃
translation: Unless the LORD of Armies had left to us a very small remnant, we would have been as Sodom. We would have been like Gomorrah. (Isaiah 1:9)

text: אָרְחִי גָדַר וְלֹא אֶעֱבוֹר וְעַל נְתִיבוֹתַי חֹשֶׁךְ יָשִֽׂים׃
translation: He has walled up my way so that I can't pass, and has set darkness in my paths. (Job 19:8)

text: וַֽיַּעֲמֹד מַלְאַךְ יְהוָה בְּמִשְׁעוֹל הַכְּרָמִים גָּדֵר מִזֶּה וְגָדֵר מִזֶּֽה׃
translation: Then the LORD's angel stood in a narrow path between the vineyards, a wall being on this side, and a wall on that side. (Numbers 22:24)

text: לָמָּה פָּרַצְתָּ גְדֵרֶיהָ וְאָרוּהָ כָּל עֹבְרֵי דָֽרֶךְ׃
translation: The boar out of the wood ravages it. The wild animals of the field feed on it. (Psalms 80:13)

text: יוֹם לִבְנוֹת גְּדֵרָיִךְ יוֹם הַהוּא יִרְחַק חֹֽק׃
translation: A day to build your walls! In that day, he will extend your boundary. (Micah 7:11)

text: לֶחָרָשִׁים וְלַבֹּנִים וְלַגֹּֽדְרִים וְלִקְנוֹת עֵצִים וְאַבְנֵי מַחְצֵב לְחַזֵּק אֶת הַבָּֽיִת׃
translation: to the carpenters, and to the builders, and to the masons, and for buying timber and cut stone to repair the house. (2 Kings 22:6)

text: וְיוֹעֵאלָה וּזְבַדְיָה בְּנֵי יְרֹחָם מִן הַגְּדֽוֹר׃
translation: Some Gadites joined David in the stronghold in the wilderness, mighty men of valor, men trained for war, who could handle shield and spear; whose faces were like the faces of lions, and they were as swift as the gazelles on the mountains: (1 Chronicles 12:8)

text: בְּסַּאסְּאָה בְּשַׁלְחָהּ תְּרִיבֶנָּה הָגָה בְּרוּחוֹ הַקָּשָׁה בְּיוֹם קָדִֽים׃
translation: In measure, when you send them away, you contend with them. He has removed them with his rough blast in the day of the east wind. (Isaiah 27:8)

text: שִׁמְעוּ שָׁמוֹעַ בְּרֹגֶז קֹלוֹ וְהֶגֶה מִפִּיו יֵצֵֽא׃
translation: Hear, oh, hear the noise of his voice, the sound that goes out of his mouth. (Job 37:2)

text: כִּי אִם בְּתוֹרַת יְהוָה חֶפְצוֹ וּֽבְתוֹרָתוֹ יֶהְגֶּה יוֹמָם וָלָֽיְלָה׃
translation: but his delight is in the LORD's law. On his law he meditates day and night. (Psalms 1:2)

text: פִּֽי צַדִּיק יֶהְגֶּה חָכְמָה וּלְשׁוֹנוֹ תְּדַבֵּר מִשְׁפָּֽט׃
translation: The mouth of the righteous talks of wisdom. His tongue speaks justice. (Psalms 37:30)

text: כִּי כָל יָמֵינוּ פָּנוּ בְעֶבְרָתֶךָ כִּלִּינוּ שָׁנֵינוּ כְמוֹ הֶֽגֶה׃
translation: For all our days have passed away in your wrath. We bring our years to an end as a sigh. (Psalms 90:9)

text: זָכַרְתִּי יָמִים מִקֶּדֶם הָגִיתִי בְכָל פָּעֳלֶךָ בְּֽמַעֲשֵׂה יָדֶיךָ אֲשׂוֹחֵֽחַ׃
translation: I remember the days of old. I meditate on all your doings. I contemplate the work of your hands. (Psalms 143:5)

text: וְהִצַּתִּי אֵשׁ בְּחוֹמַת דַּמָּשֶׂק וְאָכְלָה אַרְמְנוֹת בֶּן הֲדָֽד׃
translation: "I will kindle a fire in the wall of Damascus, and it will devour the palaces of Ben Hadad." (Jeremiah 49:27)

text: וּפָקַדְתִּי עֲלֵיכֶם כִּפְרִי מַעַלְלֵיכֶם נְאֻם יְהוָה וְהִצַּתִּי אֵשׁ בְּיַעְרָהּ וְאָכְלָה כָּל סְבִיבֶֽיהָ׃
translation: I will punish you according to the fruit of your doings,' says the LORD; 'and I will kindle a fire in her forest, and it will devour all that is around her.'" (Jeremiah 21:14)

text: וְהִצַּתִּי אֵשׁ בְּחוֹמַת רַבָּה וְאָכְלָה אַרְמְנוֹתֶיהָ בִּתְרוּעָה בְּיוֹם מִלְחָמָה בְּסַעַר בְּיוֹם סוּפָֽה׃
translation: But I will kindle a fire in the wall of Rabbah, and it will devour its palaces, with shouting in the day of battle, with a storm in the day of the whirlwind; (Amos 1:14)

text: עָלָיו יִשְׁאֲגוּ כְפִרִים נָתְנוּ קוֹלָם וַיָּשִׁיתוּ אַרְצוֹ לְשַׁמָּה עָרָיו נצתה נִצְּתוּ מִבְּלִי יֹשֵֽׁב׃
translation: The young lions have roared at him and raised their voices. They have made his land waste. His cities are burned up, without inhabitant. (Jeremiah 2:15)

text: וְהָיָה כְּתָפְשְׂכֶם אֶת הָעִיר תַּצִּיתוּ אֶת הָעִיר בָּאֵשׁ כִּדְבַר יְהוָה תַּעֲשׂוּ רְאוּ צִוִּיתִי אֶתְכֶֽם׃
translation: It shall be, when you have seized the city, that you shall set the city on fire. You shall do this according to the LORD's word. Behold, I have commanded you." (Joshua 8:8)

text: כְּלֵי גוֹלָה עֲשִׂי לָךְ יוֹשֶׁבֶת בַּת מִצְרָיִם כִּֽי נֹף לְשַׁמָּה תִֽהְיֶה וְנִצְּתָה מֵאֵין יוֹשֵֽׁב׃
translation: You daughter who dwells in Egypt, furnish yourself to go into captivity; for Memphis will become a desolation, and will be burned up, without inhabitant. (Jeremiah 46:19)

text: שׁוֹרוֹ עִבַּר וְלֹא יַגְעִל תְּפַלֵּט פָּרָתוֹ וְלֹא תְשַׁכֵּֽל׃
translation: Their bulls breed without fail. Their cows calve, and don't miscarry. (Job 21:10)

text: גֹּל אֶל יְהוָה יְפַלְּטֵהוּ יַצִּילֵהוּ כִּי חָפֵֽץ בּֽוֹ׃
translation: But you brought me out of the womb. You made me trust while at my mother's breasts. (Psalms 22:9)

text: בְּךָ יְהוָה חָסִיתִי אַל אֵבוֹשָׁה לְעוֹלָם בְּצִדְקָתְךָ פַלְּטֵֽנִי׃
translation: Bow down your ear to me. Deliver me speedily. Be to me a strong rock, a house of defense to save me. (Psalms 31:2)

text: עַל אָוֶן פַּלֶּט לָמוֹ בְּאַף עַמִּים הוֹרֵד אֱלֹהִֽים׃
translation: You count my wanderings. You put my tears into your container. Aren't they in your book? (Psalms 56:8)

text: שָׁם יָשָׁר נוֹכָח עִמּוֹ וַאֲפַלְּטָה לָנֶצַח מִשֹּׁפְטִֽי׃
translation: There the upright might reason with him, so I should be delivered forever from my judge. (Job 23:7)

text: קוּמָה יְהוָה קַדְּמָה פָנָיו הַכְרִיעֵהוּ פַּלְּטָה נַפְשִׁי מֵרָשָׁע חַרְבֶּֽךָ׃
translation: Arise, LORD, confront him. Cast him down. Deliver my soul from the wicked by your sword, (Psalms 17:13)

text: יָשֹׁמּוּ עַל עֵקֶב בָּשְׁתָּם הָאֹמְרִים לִי הֶאָח הֶאָֽח׃
translation: Let all those who seek you rejoice and be glad in you. Let such as love your salvation say continually, "Let the LORD be exalted!" (Psalms 40:16)

text: יָעַצְתָּ בֹּשֶׁת לְבֵיתֶךָ קְצוֹת עַמִּים רַבִּים וְחוֹטֵא נַפְשֶֽׁךָ׃
translation: You have devised shame to your house by cutting off many peoples, and have sinned against your soul. (Habakkuk 2:10)

text: יָשׁוּבוּ עַל עֵקֶב בָּשְׁתָּם הָאֹמְרִים הֶאָח הֶאָֽח׃
translation: Let all those who seek you rejoice and be glad in you. Let those who love your salvation continually say, "Let God be exalted!" (Psalms 70:4)

text: שֹׂנְאֶיךָ יִלְבְּשׁוּ בֹשֶׁת וְאֹהֶל רְשָׁעִים אֵינֶֽנּוּ׃
translation: Those who hate you will be clothed with shame. The tent of the wicked will be no more." (Job 8:22)

text: יֵבֹשׁוּ וְיַחְפְּרוּ יַחְדָּו שְׂמֵחֵי רָעָתִי יִֽלְבְּשׁוּ בֹשֶׁת וּכְלִמָּה הַֽמַּגְדִּילִים עָלָֽי׃
translation: Let them be disappointed and confounded together who rejoice at my calamity. Let them be clothed with shame and dishonor who magnify themselves against me. (Psalms 35:26)

text: הַאֹתִי הֵם מַכְעִסִים נְאֻם יְהוָה הֲלוֹא אֹתָם לְמַעַן בֹּשֶׁת פְּנֵיהֶֽם׃
translation: Do they provoke me to anger?" says the LORD. "Don't they provoke themselves, to the confusion of their own faces?" (Jeremiah 7:19)

text: עָנֵה מַלְכָּא וְאָמַר מִן יַצִּיב יָדַע אֲנָה דִּי עִדָּנָא אַנְתּוּן זָבְנִין כָּל קֳבֵל דִּי חֲזֵיתוֹן דִּי אַזְדָּא מִנִּי מִלְּתָֽא׃
translation: The king answered, "I know of a certainty that you are trying to gain time, because you see the thing has gone from me. (Daniel 2:8)

text: וְהָיְתָה נִבְלָֽתְךָ לְמַאֲכָל לְכָל עוֹף הַשָּׁמַיִם וּלְבֶהֱמַת הָאָרֶץ וְאֵין מַחֲרִֽיד׃
translation: Your dead bodies will be food to all birds of the sky, and to the animals of the earth; and there will be no one to frighten them away. (Deuteronomy 28:26)

text: וְזִֽהֲמַתּוּ חַיָּתוֹ לָחֶם וְנַפְשׁוֹ מַאֲכַל תַּאֲוָֽה׃
translation: so that his life abhors bread, and his soul dainty food. (Job 33:20)

text: תִּתְּנֵנוּ כְּצֹאן מַאֲכָל וּבַגּוֹיִם זֵרִיתָֽנוּ׃
translation: You sell your people for nothing, and have gained nothing from their sale. (Psalms 44:12)

text: נָֽתְנוּ אֶת נִבְלַת עֲבָדֶיךָ מַאֲכָל לְעוֹף הַשָּׁמָיִם בְּשַׂר חֲסִידֶיךָ לְחַיְתוֹ אָֽרֶץ׃
translation: They have given the dead bodies of your servants to be food for the birds of the sky, the flesh of your saints to the animals of the earth. (Psalms 79:2)

text: וְֽהָיְתָה נִבְלַת הָעָם הַזֶּה לְמַֽאֲכָל לְעוֹף הַשָּׁמַיִם וּלְבֶהֱמַת הָאָרֶץ וְאֵין מַחֲרִֽיד׃
translation: The dead bodies of this people will be food for the birds of the sky, and for the animals of the earth. No one will frighten them away. (Jeremiah 7:33)

text: וּמַאֲכָֽלְךָ אֲשֶׁר תֹּאכֲלֶנּוּ בְּמִשְׁקוֹל עֶשְׂרִים שֶׁקֶל לַיּוֹם מֵעֵת עַד עֵת תֹּאכֲלֶֽנּוּ׃
translation: Your food which you shall eat shall be by weight, twenty shekels a day. From time to time you shall eat it. (Ezekiel 4:10)

text: לִקְנוֹת בַּכֶּסֶף דַּלִּים וְאֶבְיוֹן בַּעֲבוּר נַעֲלָיִם וּמַפַּל בַּר נַשְׁבִּֽיר׃
translation: that we may buy the poor for silver, and the needy for a pair of sandals, and sell the sweepings with the wheat?'" (Amos 8:6)

text: וְנִקְרָא שְׁמוֹ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל בֵּית חֲלוּץ הַנָּֽעַל׃
translation: His name shall be called in Israel, "The house of him who had his sandal removed." (Deuteronomy 25:10)

text: מוֹאָב סִיר רַחְצִי עַל אֱדוֹם אַשְׁלִיךְ נַעֲלִי עָלַי פְּלֶשֶׁת הִתְרֹעָֽעִֽי׃
translation: Haven't you, God, rejected us? You don't go out with our armies, God. (Psalms 60:10)

text: מוֹאָב סִיר רַחְצִי עַל אֱדוֹם אַשְׁלִיךְ נַעֲלִי עֲלֵֽי פְלֶשֶׁת אֶתְרוֹעָֽע׃
translation: Who will bring me into the fortified city? Who will lead me to Edom? (Psalms 108:10)

text: וַיִּקְרָא אֶֽת נַעֲרוֹ מְשָׁרְתוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר שִׁלְחוּ נָא אֶת זֹאת מֵעָלַי הַחוּצָה וּנְעֹל הַדֶּלֶת אַחֲרֶֽיהָ׃
translation: Then he called his servant who ministered to him, and said, "Now put this woman out from me, and bolt the door after her." (2 Samuel 13:17)

text: וְהֶחֱרִים יְהוָה אֵת לְשׁוֹן יָם מִצְרַיִם וְהֵנִיף יָדוֹ עַל הַנָּהָר בַּעְיָם רוּחוֹ וְהִכָּהוּ לְשִׁבְעָה נְחָלִים וְהִדְרִיךְ בַּנְּעָלִֽים׃
translation: The LORD will utterly destroy the tongue of the Egyptian sea; and with his scorching wind he will wave his hand over the River, and will split it into seven streams, and cause men to march over in sandals. (Isaiah 11:15)

text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֵלֶיהָ הָאֲנָשִׁים נְקִיִּם אֲנַחְנוּ מִשְּׁבֻעָתֵךְ הַזֶּה אֲשֶׁר הִשְׁבַּעְתָּֽנוּ׃
translation: The men said to her, "We will be guiltless of this your oath which you've made us to swear. (Joshua 2:17)

text: וְאִם בֵּית אִישָׁהּ נָדָרָה אֽוֹ אָסְרָה אִסָּר עַל נַפְשָׁהּ בִּשְׁבֻעָֽה׃
translation: and her husband heard it, and held his peace at her and didn't disallow her, then all her vows shall stand, and every pledge with which she bound her soul shall stand. (Numbers 30:11)

text: וְאִם תַּגִּידִי אֶת דְּבָרֵנוּ זֶה וְהָיִינוּ נְקִיִּם מִשְּׁבֻעָתֵךְ אֲשֶׁר הִשְׁבַּעְתָּֽנוּ׃
translation: But if you talk about this business of ours, then we shall be guiltless of your oath which you've made us to swear." (Joshua 2:20)

text: אֲשֶׁר כָּרַת אֶת אַבְרָהָם וּשְׁבוּעָתוֹ לְיִצְחָֽק׃
translation: the covenant which he made with Abraham, his oath to Isaac. (1 Chronicles 16:16)

text: אֲשֶׁר כָּרַת אֶת אַבְרָהָם וּשְׁבוּעָתוֹ לְיִשְׂחָֽק׃
translation: the covenant which he made with Abraham, his oath to Isaac, (Psalms 105:9)

text: עֶרְיָה תֵעוֹר קַשְׁתֶּךָ שְׁבֻעוֹת מַטּוֹת אֹמֶר סֶלָה נְהָרוֹת תְּבַקַּע אָֽרֶץ׃
translation: You uncovered your bow. You called for your sworn arrows. Selah. You split the earth with rivers. (Habakkuk 3:9)

text: וְהַחִטָּה וְהַכֻּסֶּמֶת לֹא נֻכּוּ כִּי אֲפִילֹת הֵֽנָּה׃
translation: But the wheat and the spelt were not struck, for they had not grown up. (Exodus 9:32)

text: אֶרֶץ חִטָּה וּשְׂעֹרָה וְגֶפֶן וּתְאֵנָה וְרִמּוֹן אֶֽרֶץ זֵית שֶׁמֶן וּדְבָֽשׁ׃
translation: a land of wheat, barley, vines, fig trees, and pomegranates; a land of olive trees and honey; (Deuteronomy 8:8)

text: וְעַתָּה הַחִטִּים וְהַשְּׂעֹרִים הַשֶּׁמֶן וְהַיַּיִן אֲשֶׁר אָמַר אֲדֹנִי יִשְׁלַח לַעֲבָדָֽיו׃
translation: the son of a woman of the daughters of Dan; and his father was a man of Tyre. He is skillful to work in gold, in silver, in bronze, in iron, in stone, in timber, in purple, in blue, in fine linen, and in crimson, also to engrave any kind of engraving and to devise any device, that there may be a place appointed to him with your skillful men, and with the skillful men of my lord David your father. (2 Chronicles 2:14)

text: הַשָּׂם גְּבוּלֵךְ שָׁלוֹם חֵלֶב חִטִּים יַשְׂבִּיעֵֽךְ׃
translation: He makes peace in your borders. He fills you with the finest of the wheat. (Psalms 147:14)

text: זָרְעוּ חִטִּים וְקֹצִים קָצָרוּ נֶחְלוּ לֹא יוֹעִלוּ וּבֹשׁוּ מִתְּבוּאֹתֵיכֶם מֵחֲרוֹן אַף יְהוָֽה׃
translation: They have sown wheat, and have reaped thorns. They have exhausted themselves, and profit nothing. You will be ashamed of your fruits, because of the LORD's fierce anger." (Jeremiah 12:13)

text: זֹאת הַתְּרוּמָה אֲשֶׁר תָּרִימוּ שִׁשִּׁית הָֽאֵיפָה מֵחֹמֶר הַֽחִטִּים וְשִׁשִּׁיתֶם הָֽאֵיפָה מֵחֹמֶר הַשְּׂעֹרִֽים׃
translation: "'"This is the offering that you shall offer: the sixth part of an ephah from a homer of wheat, and you shall give the sixth part of an ephah from a homer of barley, (Ezekiel 45:13)

text: לֹא אֶקַּח מִבֵּיתְךָ פָר מִמִּכְלְאֹתֶיךָ עַתּוּדִֽים׃
translation: I have no need for a bull from your stall, nor male goats from your pens. (Psalms 50:9)

text: כְּבָשִׂים לִלְבוּשֶׁךָ וּמְחִיר שָׂדֶה עַתּוּדִֽים׃
translation: The lambs are for your clothing, and the goats are the price of a field. (Proverbs 27:26)

text: עֹלוֹת מֵחִים אַעֲלֶה לָּךְ עִם קְטֹרֶת אֵילִים אֶעֱשֶֽׂה בָקָר עִם עַתּוּדִים סֶֽלָה׃
translation: I will offer to you burnt offerings of fat animals, with the offering of rams, I will offer bulls with goats. Selah. (Psalms 66:15)

text: וְאַתֵּנָה צֹאנִי כֹּה אָמַר אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה הִנְנִי שֹׁפֵט בֵּֽין שֶׂה לָשֶׂה לָאֵילִים וְלָעַתּוּדִֽים׃
translation: "As for you, O my flock, the Lord GOD says: 'Behold, I judge between sheep and sheep, the rams and the male goats. (Ezekiel 34:17)

text: וּלְזֶבַח הַשְּׁלָמִים בָּקָר שְׁנַיִם אֵילִם חֲמִשָּׁה עַתּוּדִים חֲמִשָּׁה כְּבָשִׂים בְּנֵֽי שָׁנָה חֲמִשָּׁה זֶה קָרְבַּן נַחְשׁוֹן בֶּן עַמִּינָדָֽב׃
translation: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Nahshon the son of Amminadab. (Numbers 7:17)

text: וּלְזֶבַח הַשְּׁלָמִים בָּקָר שְׁנַיִם אֵילִם חֲמִשָּׁה עַתּוּדִים חֲמִשָּׁה כְּבָשִׂים בְּנֵי שָׁנָה חֲמִשָּׁה זֶה קָרְבַּן נְתַנְאֵל בֶּן צוּעָֽר׃
translation: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Nethanel the son of Zuar. (Numbers 7:23)

text: רָאִיתִי וְהִנֵּה אֵין הָאָדָם וְכָל עוֹף הַשָּׁמַיִם נָדָֽדוּ׃
translation: I saw, and behold, there was no man, and all the birds of the sky had fled. (Jeremiah 4:25)

text: הָיִיתִי בַיּוֹם אֲכָלַנִי חֹרֶב וְקֶרַח בַּלָּיְלָה וַתִּדַּד שְׁנָתִי מֵֽעֵינָֽי׃
translation: This was my situation: in the day the drought consumed me, and the frost by night; and my sleep fled from my eyes. (Genesis 31:40)

text: וַיַּכְשִׁילוּהוּ עָלֵימוֹ לְשׁוֹנָם יִתְנֹדֲדוּ כָּל רֹאֵה בָֽם׃
translation: All mankind shall be afraid. They shall declare the work of God, and shall wisely ponder what he has done. (Psalms 64:9)

text: יִמְאָסֵם אֱלֹהַי כִּי לֹא שָׁמְעוּ לוֹ וְיִהְיוּ נֹדְדִים בַּגּוֹיִֽם׃
translation: My God will cast them away, because they didn't listen to him; and they will be wanderers among the nations. (Hosea 9:17)

text: נֹדֵד הוּא לַלֶּחֶם אַיֵּה יָדַע כִּֽי נָכוֹן בְּיָדוֹ יֽוֹם חֹֽשֶׁךְ׃
translation: He wanders abroad for bread, saying, 'Where is it?' He knows that the day of darkness is ready at his hand. (Job 15:23)

text: הִנֵּה אַרְחִיק נְדֹד אָלִין בַּמִּדְבָּר סֶֽלָה׃
translation: "I would hurry to a shelter from the stormy wind and storm." (Psalms 55:8)

text: אֶלְקָנָה בנו בְּנֵי אֶלְקָנָה צוֹפַי בְּנוֹ וְנַחַת בְּנֽוֹ׃
translation: Azariah became the father of Amariah. Amariah became the father of Ahitub. (1 Chronicles 6:11)

text: בַּדֵּי שְׁאֹל תֵּרַדְנָה אִם יַחַד עַל עָפָר נָֽחַת׃
translation: Shall it go down with me to the gates of Sheol, or descend together into the dust?" (Job 17:16)

text: כִּֽי חִצֶּיךָ נִחֲתוּ בִי וַתִּנְחַת עָלַי יָדֶֽךָ׃
translation: There is no soundness in my flesh because of your indignation, neither is there any health in my bones because of my sin. (Psalms 38:3)

text: גַּם שֶׁמֶשׁ לֹא רָאָה וְלֹא יָדָע נַחַת לָזֶה מִזֶּֽה׃
translation: Moreover it has not seen the sun nor known it. This has rest rather than the other. (Ecclesiastes 6:5)

text: דִּבְרֵי חֲכָמִים בְּנַחַת נִשְׁמָעִים מִזַּעֲקַת מוֹשֵׁל בַּכְּסִילִֽים׃
translation: The words of the wise heard in quiet are better than the cry of him who rules among fools. (Ecclesiastes 9:17)

text: בְּנֵי רְעוּאֵל נַחַת זֶרַח שַׁמָּה וּמִזָּֽה׃
translation: The sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah. (1 Chronicles 1:37)

text: הֵן אֶצְעַק חָמָס וְלֹא אֵעָנֶה אֲשַׁוַּע וְאֵין מִשְׁפָּֽט׃
translation: "Behold, I cry out of wrong, but I am not heard. I cry for help, but there is no justice. (Job 19:7)

text: כִּֽי אֲמַלֵּט עָנִי מְשַׁוֵּעַ וְיָתוֹם וְֽלֹא עֹזֵר לֽוֹ׃
translation: because I delivered the poor who cried, and the fatherless also, who had no one to help him, (Job 29:12)

text: הַקְשִׁיבָה לְקוֹל שַׁוְעִי מַלְכִּי וֵאלֹהָי כִּֽי אֵלֶיךָ אֶתְפַּלָּֽל׃
translation: LORD, in the morning you will hear my voice. In the morning I will lay my requests before you, and will watch expectantly. (Psalms 5:3)

text: כִּֽי יַצִּיל אֶבְיוֹן מְשַׁוֵּעַ וְעָנִי וְֽאֵין עֹזֵר לֽוֹ׃
translation: For he will deliver the needy when he cries; the poor, who has no helper. (Psalms 72:12)

text: אֲשַׁוַּע אֵלֶיךָ וְלֹא תַעֲנֵנִי עָמַדְתִּי וַתִּתְבֹּנֶן בִּֽי׃
translation: I cry to you, and you do not answer me. I stand up, and you gaze at me. (Job 30:20)

text: הֲיַעֲרֹךְ שׁוּעֲךָ לֹא בְצָר וְכֹל מַאֲמַצֵּי כֹֽחַ׃
translation: Would your wealth sustain you in distress, or all the might of your strength? (Job 36:19)

text: וְאֵת אֵיל הַמִּלֻּאִים תִּקָּח וּבִשַּׁלְתָּ אֶת בְּשָׂרוֹ בְּמָקֹם קָדֹֽשׁ׃
translation: "You shall take the ram of consecration and boil its meat in a holy place. (Exodus 29:31)

text: רֵאשִׁית בִּכּוּרֵי אַדְמָתְךָ תָּבִיא בֵּית יְהוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לֹֽא תְבַשֵּׁל גְּדִי בַּחֲלֵב אִמּֽוֹ׃
translation: You shall bring the first of the first fruits of your ground into the house of the LORD your God. "You shall not boil a young goat in its mother's milk. (Exodus 23:19)

text: רֵאשִׁית בִּכּוּרֵי אַדְמָתְךָ תָּבִיא בֵּית יְהוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לֹא תְבַשֵּׁל גְּדִי בַּחֲלֵב אִמּֽוֹ׃
translation: "You shall bring the first of the first fruits of your ground to the house of the LORD your God. "You shall not boil a young goat in its mother's milk." (Exodus 34:26)

text: וּבִשַּׁלְתָּ וְאָכַלְתָּ בַּמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר יִבְחַר יְהוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בּוֹ וּפָנִיתָ בַבֹּקֶר וְהָלַכְתָּ לְאֹהָלֶֽיךָ׃
translation: You shall roast and eat it in the place which the LORD your God chooses. In the morning you shall return to your tents. (Deuteronomy 16:7)

text: וַֽיְבַשְּׁלוּ הַפֶּסַח בָּאֵשׁ כַּמִּשְׁפָּט וְהַקֳּדָשִׁים בִּשְּׁלוּ בַּסִּירוֹת וּבַדְּוָדִים וּבַצֵּלָחוֹת וַיָּרִיצוּ לְכָל בְּנֵי הָעָֽם׃
translation: They roasted the Passover with fire according to the ordinance. They boiled the holy offerings in pots, in cauldrons, and in pans, and carried them quickly to all the children of the people. (2 Chronicles 35:13)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָי אֵלֶּה בֵּית הַֽמְבַשְּׁלִים אֲשֶׁר יְבַשְּׁלוּ שָׁם מְשָׁרְתֵי הַבַּיִת אֶת זֶבַח הָעָֽם׃
translation: Then he said to me, "These are the boiling houses, where the ministers of the house shall boil the sacrifice of the people." (Ezekiel 46:24)

text: אַךְ אֶל שְׁאוֹל תּוּרָד אֶל יַרְכְּתֵי בֽוֹר׃
translation: Yet you shall be brought down to Sheol, to the depths of the pit. (Isaiah 14:15)

text: וְשֹׁבַבְתִּיךָ וְשִׁשֵּׁאתִיךָ וְהַעֲלִיתִיךָ מִיַּרְכְּתֵי צָפוֹן וַהֲבִאוֹתִךָ עַל הָרֵי יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
translation: I will turn you around, will lead you on, and will cause you to come up from the uttermost parts of the north; and I will bring you onto the mountains of Israel. (Ezekiel 39:2)

text: וּֽלְיַרְכְּתֵי הַמִּשְׁכָּן יָמָּה תַּעֲשֶׂה שִׁשָּׁה קְרָשִֽׁים׃
translation: For the far side of the tabernacle westward you shall make six boards. (Exodus 26:22)

text: וּשְׁנֵי קְרָשִׁים תַּעֲשֶׂה לִמְקֻצְעֹת הַמִּשְׁכָּן בַּיַּרְכָתָֽיִם׃
translation: You shall make two boards for the corners of the tabernacle in the far side. (Exodus 26:23)

text: וּֽלְיַרְכְּתֵי הַמִּשְׁכָּן יָמָּה עָשָׂה שִׁשָּׁה קְרָשִֽׁים׃
translation: For the far part of the tabernacle westward he made six boards. (Exodus 36:27)

text: וּשְׁנֵי קְרָשִׁים עָשָׂה לִמְקֻצְעֹת הַמִּשְׁכָּן בַּיַּרְכָתָֽיִם׃
translation: He made two boards for the corners of the tabernacle in the far part. (Exodus 36:28)

text: רִגְזוּ וְֽאַל תֶּחֱטָאוּ אִמְרוּ בִלְבַבְכֶם עַֽל מִשְׁכַּבְכֶם וְדֹמּוּ סֶֽלָה׃
translation: Offer the sacrifices of righteousness. Put your trust in the LORD. (Psalms 4:5)

text: יְֽהוָה אַל אֵבוֹשָׁה כִּי קְרָאתִיךָ יֵבֹשׁוּ רְשָׁעִים יִדְּמוּ לִשְׁאֽוֹל׃
translation: Let the lying lips be mute, which speak against the righteous insolently, with pride and contempt. (Psalms 31:18)

text: אַךְ לֵאלֹהִים דּוֹמִּי נַפְשִׁי כִּי מִמֶּנּוּ תִּקְוָתִֽי׃
translation: He alone is my rock and my salvation, my fortress. I will not be shaken. (Psalms 62:6)

text: לָכֵן הַמַּשְׂכִּיל בָּעֵת הַהִיא יִדֹּם כִּי עֵת רָעָה הִֽיא׃
translation: Therefore a prudent person keeps silent in such a time, for it is an evil time. (Amos 5:13)

text: לִֽי שָׁמְעוּ וְיִחֵלּוּ וְיִדְּמוּ לְמוֹ עֲצָתִֽי׃
translation: "Men listened to me, waited, and kept silence for my counsel. (Job 29:21)

text: וּבְצַלְעִי שָׂמְחוּ וְֽנֶאֱסָפוּ נֶאֶסְפוּ עָלַי נֵכִים וְלֹא יָדַעְתִּי קָֽרְעוּ וְלֹא דָֽמּוּ׃
translation: But in my adversity, they rejoiced, and gathered themselves together. The attackers gathered themselves together against me, and I didn't know it. They tore at me, and didn't cease. (Psalms 35:15)

text: דּוֹדִי יָרַד לְגַנּוֹ לַעֲרוּגוֹת הַבֹּשֶׂם לִרְעוֹת בַּגַּנִּים וְלִלְקֹט שֽׁוֹשַׁנִּֽים׃
translation: My beloved has gone down to his garden, to the beds of spices, to pasture his flock in the gardens, and to gather lilies. (Song of Solomon 6:2)

text: בְּרַח דּוֹדִי וּֽדְמֵה לְךָ לִצְבִי אוֹ לְעֹפֶר הָֽאַיָּלִים עַל הָרֵי בְשָׂמִֽים׃
translation: Come away, my beloved! Be like a gazelle or a young stag on the mountains of spices! (Song of Solomon 8:14)

text: מַה יָּפוּ דֹדַיִךְ אֲחֹתִי כַלָּה מַה טֹּבוּ דֹדַיִךְ מִיַּיִן וְרֵיחַ שְׁמָנַיִךְ מִכָּל בְּשָׂמִֽים׃
translation: How beautiful is your love, my sister, my bride! How much better is your love than wine, the fragrance of your perfumes than all kinds of spices! (Song of Solomon 4:10)

text: וְהֵמָּה מְבִאִים אִישׁ מִנְחָתוֹ כְּלֵי כֶסֶף וּכְלֵי זָהָב וּשְׂלָמוֹת וְנֵשֶׁק וּבְשָׂמִים סוּסִים וּפְרָדִים דְּבַר שָׁנָה בְּשָׁנָֽה׃
translation: Year after year, every man brought his tribute, vessels of silver, vessels of gold, clothing, armor, spices, horses, and mules. (1 Kings 10:25)

text: וְהֵם מְבִיאִים אִישׁ מִנְחָתוֹ כְּלֵי כֶסֶף וּכְלֵי זָהָב וּשְׂלָמוֹת נֵשֶׁק וּבְשָׂמִים סוּסִים וּפְרָדִים דְּבַר שָׁנָה בְּשָׁנָֽה׃
translation: They each brought tribute: vessels of silver, vessels of gold, clothing, armor, spices, horses, and mules every year. (2 Chronicles 9:24)

text: וַיְהִי לִֽיחִזְקִיָּהוּ עֹשֶׁר וְכָבוֹד הַרְבֵּה מְאֹד וְאֹֽצָרוֹת עָֽשָׂה לוֹ לְכֶסֶף וּלְזָהָב וּלְאֶבֶן יְקָרָה וְלִבְשָׂמִים וּלְמָגִנִּים וּלְכֹל כְּלֵי חֶמְדָּֽה׃
translation: Hezekiah had exceedingly great riches and honor. He provided himself with treasuries for silver, for gold, for precious stones, for spices, for shields, and for all kinds of valuable vessels; (2 Chronicles 32:27)

text: וַחֲמֵשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה אַמָּה קְלָעִים לַכָּתֵף עַמֻּדֵיהֶם שְׁלֹשָׁה וְאַדְנֵיהֶם שְׁלֹשָֽׁה׃
translation: The hangings for the one side of the gate shall be fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three. (Exodus 27:14)
