text: וְלַכָּתֵף הַשֵּׁנִית חְמֵשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה קְלָעִים עַמֻּדֵיהֶם שְׁלֹשָׁה וְאַדְנֵיהֶם שְׁלֹשָֽׁה׃
translation: For the other side shall be hangings of fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three. (Exodus 27:15)

text: קְלָעִים חֲמֵשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה אַמָּה אֶל הַכָּתֵף עַמּוּדֵיהֶם שְׁלֹשָׁה וְאַדְנֵיהֶם שְׁלֹשָֽׁה׃
translation: the hangings for the one side were fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three; (Exodus 38:14)

text: וְרֹחַב הֶֽחָצֵר לִפְאַת יָם קְלָעִים חֲמִשִּׁים אַמָּה עַמֻּדֵיהֶם עֲשָׂרָה וְאַדְנֵיהֶם עֲשָׂרָֽה׃
translation: For the width of the court on the west side shall be hangings of fifty cubits; their pillars ten, and their sockets ten. (Exodus 27:12)

text: אֵת קַלְעֵי הֶחָצֵר אֶת עַמֻּדָיו וְאֶת אֲדָנֶיהָ וְאֵת מָסַךְ שַׁעַר הֶחָצֵֽר׃
translation: the hangings of the court, its pillars, their sockets, and the screen for the gate of the court; (Exodus 35:17)

text: וְלַכָּתֵף הַשֵּׁנִית מִזֶּה וּמִזֶּה לְשַׁעַר הֶֽחָצֵר קְלָעִים חֲמֵשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה אַמָּה עַמֻּדֵיהֶם שְׁלֹשָׁה וְאַדְנֵיהֶם שְׁלֹשָֽׁה׃
translation: and so for the other side: on this hand and that hand by the gate of the court were hangings of fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three. (Exodus 38:15)

text: וּנְחֹשֶׁת הַתְּנוּפָה שִׁבְעִים כִּכָּר וְאַלְפַּיִם וְאַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת שָֽׁקֶל׃
translation: The bronze of the offering was seventy talents and two thousand four hundred shekels. (Exodus 38:29)

text: וְהַֽעֲמַדְתָּ אֶת הַלְוִיִּם לִפְנֵי אַהֲרֹן וְלִפְנֵי בָנָיו וְהֵנַפְתָּ אֹתָם תְּנוּפָה לַֽיהוָֽה׃
translation: You shall set the Levites before Aaron and before his sons, and offer them as a wave offering to the LORD. (Numbers 8:13)

text: וְשַׂמְתָּ הַכֹּל עַל כַּפֵּי אַהֲרֹן וְעַל כַּפֵּי בָנָיו וְהֵנַפְתָּ אֹתָם תְּנוּפָה לִפְנֵי יְהוָֽה׃
translation: You shall put all of this in Aaron's hands, and in his sons' hands, and shall wave them for a wave offering before the LORD. (Exodus 29:24)

text: וְאֵת הֶחָזוֹת וְאֵת שׁוֹק הַיָּמִין הֵנִיף אַהֲרֹן תְּנוּפָה לִפְנֵי יְהוָה כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה מֹשֶֽׁה׃
translation: Aaron waved the breasts and the right thigh for a wave offering before the LORD, as Moses commanded. (Leviticus 9:21)

text: וְאַֽחֲרֵי כֵן יָבֹאוּ הַלְוִיִּם לַעֲבֹד אֶת אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וְטִֽהַרְתָּ אֹתָם וְהֵנַפְתָּ אֹתָם תְּנוּפָֽה׃
translation: "After that, the Levites shall go in to do the service of the Tent of Meeting. You shall cleanse them, and offer them as a wave offering. (Numbers 8:15)

text: וַיִּתֵּן אֶת הַכֹּל עַל כַּפֵּי אַהֲרֹן וְעַל כַּפֵּי בָנָיו וַיָּנֶף אֹתָם תְּנוּפָה לִפְנֵי יְהוָֽה׃
translation: He put all these in Aaron's hands and in his sons' hands, and waved them for a wave offering before the LORD. (Leviticus 8:27)

text: וּבֶן שַׁמַּי מָעוֹן וּמָעוֹן אֲבִי בֵֽית צֽוּר׃
translation: The son of Shammai was Maon; and Maon was the father of Beth Zur. (1 Chronicles 2:45)

text: יְֽהוָה אָהַבְתִּי מְעוֹן בֵּיתֶךָ וּמְקוֹם מִשְׁכַּן כְּבוֹדֶֽךָ׃
translation: LORD, I love the habitation of your house, the place where your glory dwells. (Psalms 26:8)

text: אֲבִי יְתוֹמִים וְדַיַּן אַלְמָנוֹת אֱלֹהִים בִּמְעוֹן קָדְשֽׁוֹ׃
translation: God sets the lonely in families. He brings out the prisoners with singing, but the rebellious dwell in a sun-scorched land. (Psalms 68:6)

text: תְּפִלָּה לְמֹשֶׁה אִֽישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים אֲֽדֹנָי מָעוֹן אַתָּה הָיִיתָ לָּנוּ בְּדֹר וָדֹֽר׃
translation: A Prayer by Moses, the man of God. Lord, you have been our dwelling place for all generations. (Psalms 90:1)

text: מָעוֹן כַּרְמֶל וָזִיף וְיוּטָּֽה׃
translation: Maon, Carmel, Ziph, Jutah, (Joshua 15:55)

text: הֱיֵה לִי לְצוּר מָעוֹן לָבוֹא תָּמִיד צִוִּיתָ לְהוֹשִׁיעֵנִי כִּֽי סַלְעִי וּמְצוּדָתִי אָֽתָּה׃
translation: Be to me a rock of refuge to which I may always go. Give the command to save me, for you are my rock and my fortress. (Psalms 71:3)

text: בָּרוּךְ יְהוָה כִּי הִפְלִיא חַסְדּוֹ לִי בְּעִיר מָצֽוֹר׃
translation: As for me, I said in my haste, "I am cut off from before your eyes." Nevertheless you heard the voice of my petitions when I cried to you. (Psalms 31:22)

text: וַיֵּשֶׁב רְחַבְעָם בִּירוּשָׁלִָם וַיִּבֶן עָרִים לְמָצוֹר בִּיהוּדָֽה׃
translation: Rehoboam lived in Jerusalem, and built cities for defense in Judah. (2 Chronicles 11:5)

text: אִסְפִּי מֵאֶרֶץ כִּנְעָתֵךְ ישבתי יֹשֶׁבֶת בַּמָּצֽוֹר׃
translation: Gather up your wares out of the land, you who live under siege. (Jeremiah 10:17)

text: בָּעֵת הַהִיא עלה עָלוּ עַבְדֵי נְבֻכַדְנֶאצַּר מֶֽלֶךְ בָּבֶל יְרוּשָׁלִָם וַתָּבֹא הָעִיר בַּמָּצֽוֹר׃
translation: At that time the servants of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up to Jerusalem, and the city was besieged. (2 Kings 24:10)

text: כֹּה אָמַר סַנְחֵרִיב מֶלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר עַל מָה אַתֶּם בֹּטְחִים וְיֹשְׁבִים בְּמָצוֹר בִּירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
translation: Sennacherib king of Assyria says, "In whom do you trust, that you remain under siege in Jerusalem? (2 Chronicles 32:10)

text: עַל מִשְׁמַרְתִּי אֶעֱמֹדָה וְאֶֽתְיַצְּבָה עַל מָצוֹר וַאֲצַפֶּה לִרְאוֹת מַה יְדַבֶּר בִּי וּמָה אָשִׁיב עַל תּוֹכַחְתִּֽי׃
translation: I will stand at my watch and set myself on the ramparts, and will look out to see what he will say to me, and what I will answer concerning my complaint. (Habakkuk 2:1)

text: וְלֹא אֹתִי קָרָאתָ יַֽעֲקֹב כִּֽי יָגַעְתָּ בִּי יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
translation: Yet you have not called on me, Jacob; but you have been weary of me, Israel. (Isaiah 43:22)

text: עַל צַוָּארֵנוּ נִרְדָּפְנוּ יָגַעְנוּ לא וְלֹא הֽוּנַח לָֽנוּ׃
translation: Our pursuers are on our necks. We are weary, and have no rest. (Lamentations 5:5)

text: עֲמַל הַכְּסִילִים תְּיַגְּעֶנּוּ אֲשֶׁר לֹֽא יָדַע לָלֶכֶת אֶל עִֽיר׃
translation: The labor of fools wearies every one of them; for he doesn't know how to go to the city. (Ecclesiastes 10:15)

text: אָנֹכִי אֶרְשָׁע לָמָּה זֶּה הֶבֶל אִיגָֽע׃
translation: I will be condemned. Why then do I labor in vain? (Job 9:29)

text: אַל תִּיגַע לְֽהַעֲשִׁיר מִֽבִּינָתְךָ חֲדָֽל׃
translation: Don't weary yourself to be rich. In your wisdom, show restraint. (Proverbs 23:4)

text: בְּרֹב דַּרְכֵּךְ יָגַעַתְּ לֹא אָמַרְתְּ נוֹאָשׁ חַיַּת יָדֵךְ מָצָאת עַל כֵּן לֹא חָלִֽית׃
translation: You were wearied with the length of your ways; yet you didn't say, 'It is in vain.' You found a reviving of your strength; therefore you weren't faint. (Isaiah 57:10)

text: וַיָּשָׁב יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וְכָל יִשְׂרָאֵל עִמּוֹ דְּבִרָה וַיִּלָּחֶם עָלֶֽיהָ׃
translation: Joshua returned, and all Israel with him, to Debir, and fought against it. (Joshua 10:38)

text: וְאֶת חִילֵז וְאֶת מִגְרָשֶׁיהָ אֶת דְּבִיר וְאֶת מִגְרָשֶֽׁיהָ׃
translation: the son of Jahath, the son of Gershom, the son of Levi. (1 Chronicles 6:43)

text: וּמֵחֶשְׁבּוֹן עַד רָמַת הַמִּצְפֶּה וּבְטֹנִים וּמִֽמַּחֲנַיִם עַד גְּבוּל לִדְבִֽר׃
translation: and from Heshbon to Ramath Mizpeh, and Betonim; and from Mahanaim to the border of Debir; (Joshua 13:26)

text: וַיַּעַשׂ בַּדְּבִיר שְׁנֵי כְרוּבִים עֲצֵי שָׁמֶן עֶשֶׂר אַמּוֹת קוֹמָתֽוֹ׃
translation: In the inner sanctuary he made two cherubim of olive wood, each ten cubits high. (1 Kings 6:23)

text: וְאֶת הַמְּנֹרוֹת וְנֵרֹתֵיהֶם לְבַעֲרָם כַּמִּשְׁפָּט לִפְנֵי הַדְּבִיר זָהָב סָגֽוּר׃
translation: and the lamp stands with their lamps to burn according to the ordinance before the inner sanctuary, of pure gold; (2 Chronicles 4:20)

text: מֶלֶךְ דְּבִר אֶחָד מֶלֶךְ גֶּדֶר אֶחָֽד׃
translation: the king of Debir, one; the king of Geder, one; (Joshua 12:13)

text: אַתָּה יָדַעְתָּ חֶרְפָּתִי וּבָשְׁתִּי וּכְלִמָּתִי נֶגְדְּךָ כָּל צוֹרְרָֽי׃
translation: Reproach has broken my heart, and I am full of heaviness. I looked for some to take pity, but there was none; for comforters, but I found none. (Psalms 69:20)

text: כָּל הַיּוֹם כְּלִמָּתִי נֶגְדִּי וּבֹשֶׁת פָּנַי כִּסָּֽתְנִי׃
translation: at the taunt of one who reproaches and verbally abuses, because of the enemy and the avenger. (Psalms 44:16)

text: כִּֽי עָלֶיךָ נָשָׂאתִי חֶרְפָּה כִּסְּתָה כְלִמָּה פָנָֽי׃
translation: I have become a stranger to my brothers, an alien to my mother's children. (Psalms 69:8)

text: וְהָיָה לָכֶם מָעוֹז פַּרְעֹה לְבֹשֶׁת וְהֶחָסוּת בְּצֵל מִצְרַיִם לִכְלִמָּֽה׃
translation: Therefore the strength of Pharaoh will be your shame, and the refuge in the shadow of Egypt your confusion. (Isaiah 30:3)

text: לְמַעַן תִּשְׂאִי כְלִמָּתֵךְ וְנִכְלַמְתְּ מִכֹּל אֲשֶׁר עָשִׂית בְּנַחֲמֵךְ אֹתָֽן׃
translation: that you may bear your own shame, and may be ashamed because of all that you have done, in that you are a comfort to them. (Ezekiel 16:54)

text: מוּסַר כְּלִמָּתִי אֶשְׁמָע וְרוּחַ מִֽבִּינָתִי יַעֲנֵֽנִי׃
translation: I have heard the reproof which puts me to shame. The spirit of my understanding answers me. (Job 20:3)

text: וְכֹל שֶׁרֶץ הָעוֹף טָמֵא הוּא לָכֶם לֹא יֵאָכֵֽלוּ׃
translation: All winged creeping things are unclean to you. They shall not be eaten. (Deuteronomy 14:19)

text: וְאַתֶּם פְּרוּ וּרְבוּ שִׁרְצוּ בָאָרֶץ וּרְבוּ בָֽהּ׃
translation: Be fruitful and multiply. Increase abundantly in the earth, and multiply in it." (Genesis 9:7)

text: וּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל פָּרוּ וַֽיִּשְׁרְצוּ וַיִּרְבּוּ וַיַּֽעַצְמוּ בִּמְאֹד מְאֹד וַתִּמָּלֵא הָאָרֶץ אֹתָֽם׃
translation: The children of Israel were fruitful, and increased abundantly, and multiplied, and grew exceedingly mighty; and the land was filled with them. (Exodus 1:7)

text: אֵלֶּה הַטְּמֵאִים לָכֶם בְּכָל הַשָּׁרֶץ כָּל הַנֹּגֵעַ בָּהֶם בְּמֹתָם יִטְמָא עַד הָעָֽרֶב׃
translation: These are they which are unclean to you among all that creep. Whoever touches them when they are dead shall be unclean until the evening. (Leviticus 11:31)

text: זֹאת תּוֹרַת הַבְּהֵמָה וְהָעוֹף וְכֹל נֶפֶשׁ הַֽחַיָּה הָרֹמֶשֶׂת בַּמָּיִם וּלְכָל נֶפֶשׁ הַשֹּׁרֶצֶת עַל הָאָֽרֶץ׃
translation: "'This is the law of the animal, and of the bird, and of every living creature that moves in the waters, and of every creature that creeps on the earth, (Leviticus 11:46)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֱלֹהִים יִשְׁרְצוּ הַמַּיִם שֶׁרֶץ נֶפֶשׁ חַיָּה וְעוֹף יְעוֹפֵף עַל הָאָרֶץ עַל פְּנֵי רְקִיעַ הַשָּׁמָֽיִם׃
translation: God said, "Let the waters abound with living creatures, and let birds fly above the earth in the open expanse of the sky." (Genesis 1:20)

text: וַיַּעַשׂ יְהוָה אֱלֹהִים לְאָדָם וּלְאִשְׁתּוֹ כָּתְנוֹת עוֹר וַיַּלְבִּשֵֽׁם׃
translation: The LORD God made garments of animal skins for Adam and for his wife, and clothed them. (Genesis 3:21)

text: וַֽיִּקְרְבוּ וַיִּשָּׂאֻם בְּכֻתֳּנֹתָם אֶל מִחוּץ לַֽמַּחֲנֶה כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר מֹשֶֽׁה׃
translation: So they came near, and carried them in their tunics out of the camp, as Moses had said. (Leviticus 10:5)

text: וַיַּכִּירָהּ וַיֹּאמֶר כְּתֹנֶת בְּנִי חַיָּה רָעָה אֲכָלָתְהוּ טָרֹף טֹרַף יוֹסֵֽף׃
translation: He recognized it, and said, "It is my son's tunic. An evil animal has devoured him. Joseph is without doubt torn in pieces." (Genesis 37:33)

text: וְאֶת בָּנָיו תַּקְרִיב וְהִלְבַּשְׁתָּ אֹתָם כֻּתֳּנֹֽת׃
translation: You shall bring his sons, and put tunics on them. (Exodus 40:14)

text: פָּשַׁטְתִּי אֶת כֻּתָּנְתִּי אֵיכָכָה אֶלְבָּשֶׁנָּה רָחַצְתִּי אֶת רַגְלַי אֵיכָכָה אֲטַנְּפֵֽם׃
translation: I have taken off my robe. Indeed, must I put it on? I have washed my feet. Indeed, must I soil them? (Song of Solomon 5:3)

text: וְאֶת בָּנָיו תַּקְרִיב וְהִלְבַּשְׁתָּם כֻּתֳּנֹֽת׃
translation: You shall bring his sons, and put tunics on them. (Exodus 29:8)

text: בִּשְׁנַת הַיּוֹבֵל הַזֹּאת תָּשֻׁבוּ אִישׁ אֶל אֲחֻזָּתֽוֹ׃
translation: "'In this Year of Jubilee each of you shall return to his property. (Leviticus 25:13)

text: אִם מִשְּׁנַת הַיֹּבֵל יַקְדִּישׁ שָׂדֵהוּ כְּעֶרְכְּךָ יָקֽוּם׃
translation: If he dedicates his field from the Year of Jubilee, according to your valuation it shall stand. (Leviticus 27:17)

text: וְשֵׁם אָחִיו יוּבָל הוּא הָיָה אֲבִי כָּל תֹּפֵשׂ כִּנּוֹר וְעוּגָֽב׃
translation: His brother's name was Jubal, who was the father of all who handle the harp and pipe. (Genesis 4:21)

text: וְאִם לֹא יִגָּאֵל בְּאֵלֶּה וְיָצָא בִּשְׁנַת הַיֹּבֵל הוּא וּבָנָיו עִמּֽוֹ׃
translation: If he isn't redeemed by these means, then he shall be released in the Year of Jubilee: he and his children with him. (Leviticus 25:54)

text: כִּי יוֹבֵל הִוא קֹדֶשׁ תִּהְיֶה לָכֶם מִן הַשָּׂדֶה תֹּאכְלוּ אֶת תְּבוּאָתָֽהּ׃
translation: For it is a jubilee; it shall be holy to you. You shall eat of its increase out of the field. (Leviticus 25:12)

text: וְהָיָה הַשָּׂדֶה בְּצֵאתוֹ בַיֹּבֵל קֹדֶשׁ לַֽיהוָה כִּשְׂדֵה הַחֵרֶם לַכֹּהֵן תִּהְיֶה אֲחֻזָּתֽוֹ׃
translation: but the field, when it goes out in the Jubilee, shall be holy to the LORD, as a devoted field. It shall be owned by the priests. (Leviticus 27:21)

text: בַּיּוֹם הָעֲשִׂירִי נָשִׂיא לִבְנֵי דָן אֲחִיעֶזֶר בֶּן עַמִּישַׁדָּֽי׃
translation: On the tenth day Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai, prince of the children of Dan, (Numbers 7:66)

text: הָעֲשִׂירִי שִׁמְעִי בָּנָיו וְאֶחָיו שְׁנֵים עָשָֽׂר׃
translation: the tenth to Shimei, his sons and his brothers, twelve; (1 Chronicles 25:17)

text: יִרְמְיָהוּ הָעֲשִׂירִי מַכְבַּנַּי עַשְׁתֵּי עָשָֽׂר׃
translation: These of the sons of Gad were captains of the army. He who was least was equal to one hundred, and the greatest to one thousand. (1 Chronicles 12:14)

text: בַּשָּׁנָה הָעֲשִׂירִית בָּעֲשִׂרִי בִּשְׁנֵים עָשָׂר לַחֹדֶשׁ הָיָה דְבַר יְהוָה אֵלַי לֵאמֹֽר׃
translation: In the tenth year, in the tenth month, on the twelfth day of the month, the LORD's word came to me, saying, (Ezekiel 29:1)

text: וְהַמַּיִם הָיוּ הָלוֹךְ וְחָסוֹר עַד הַחֹדֶשׁ הָֽעֲשִׂירִי בָּֽעֲשִׂירִי בְּאֶחָד לַחֹדֶשׁ נִרְאוּ רָאשֵׁי הֶֽהָרִֽים׃
translation: The waters receded continually until the tenth month. In the tenth month, on the first day of the month, the tops of the mountains were visible. (Genesis 8:5)

text: וְכָל מַעְשַׂר בָּקָר וָצֹאן כֹּל אֲשֶׁר יַעֲבֹר תַּחַת הַשָּׁבֶט הָֽעֲשִׂירִי יִֽהְיֶה קֹּדֶשׁ לַֽיהוָֽה׃
translation: All the tithe of the herds or the flocks, whatever passes under the rod, the tenth shall be holy to the LORD. (Leviticus 27:32)

text: בְּנֵי נֵכָר יִתְכַּֽחֲשׁוּ לִי לִשְׁמוֹעַ אֹזֶן יִשָּׁמְעוּ לִֽי׃
translation: The foreigners will submit themselves to me. As soon as they hear of me, they will obey me. (2 Samuel 22:45)

text: וַֽתִּקְמְטֵנִי לְעֵד הָיָה וַיָּקָם בִּי כַחֲשִׁי בְּפָנַי יַעֲנֶֽה׃
translation: You have shriveled me up. This is a witness against me. My leanness rises up against me. It testifies to my face. (Job 16:8)

text: גַּם הוּא עָוֺן פְּלִילִי כִּֽי כִחַשְׁתִּי לָאֵל מִמָּֽעַל׃
translation: this also would be an iniquity to be punished by the judges, for I would have denied the God who is above. (Job 31:28)

text: לְשֵׁמַֽע אֹזֶן יִשָּׁמְעוּ לִי בְּנֵֽי נֵכָר יְכַחֲשׁוּ לִֽי׃
translation: The foreigners shall fade away, and shall come trembling out of their strongholds. (Psalms 18:45)

text: אִם יְבַלְּעֶנּוּ מִמְּקוֹמוֹ וְכִחֶשׁ בּוֹ לֹא רְאִיתִֽיךָ׃
translation: If he is destroyed from his place, then it will deny him, saying, 'I have not seen you.' (Job 8:18)

text: חַטַּאת פִּימוֹ דְּֽבַר שְׂפָתֵימוֹ וְיִלָּכְדוּ בִגְאוֹנָם וּמֵאָלָה וּמִכַּחַשׁ יְסַפֵּֽרוּ׃
translation: Consume them in wrath. Consume them, and they will be no more. Let them know that God rules in Jacob, to the ends of the earth. Selah. (Psalms 59:13)

text: אֵלֶּה תֹּלְדוֹתָם בְּכוֹר יִשְׁמָעֵאל נְבָיוֹת וְקֵדָר וְאַדְבְּאֵל וּמִבְשָֽׂם׃
translation: These are their generations: the firstborn of Ishmael, Nebaioth; then Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam, (1 Chronicles 1:29)

text: עַל שֶׁבֶר בַּת עַמִּי הָשְׁבָּרְתִּי קָדַרְתִּי שַׁמָּה הֶחֱזִקָֽתְנִי׃
translation: For the hurt of the daughter of my people, I am hurt. I mourn. Dismay has taken hold of me. (Jeremiah 8:21)

text: קֹדֵר הִלַּכְתִּי בְּלֹא חַמָּה קַמְתִּי בַקָּהָל אֲשַׁוֵּֽעַ׃
translation: I go mourning without the sun. I stand up in the assembly, and cry for help. (Job 30:28)

text: אֽוֹיָה לִי כִּי גַרְתִּי מֶשֶׁךְ שָׁכַנְתִּי עִֽם אָהֳלֵי קֵדָֽר׃
translation: Woe is me, that I live in Meshech, that I dwell among the tents of Kedar! (Psalms 120:5)

text: לָשׂוּם שְׁפָלִים לְמָרוֹם וְקֹדְרִים שָׂגְבוּ יֶֽשַׁע׃
translation: so that he sets up on high those who are low, those who mourn are exalted to safety. (Job 5:11)

text: כִּֽי אַתָּה אֱלֹהֵי מָֽעוּזִּי לָמָה זְנַחְתָּנִי לָֽמָּה קֹדֵר אֶתְהַלֵּךְ בְּלַחַץ אוֹיֵֽב׃
translation: For you are the God of my strength. Why have you rejected me? Why do I go mourning because of the oppression of the enemy? (Psalms 43:2)

text: יָבוֹא שָׁלוֹם יָנוּחוּ עַל מִשְׁכְּבוֹתָם הֹלֵךְ נְכֹחֽוֹ׃
translation: He enters into peace. They rest in their beds, each one who walks in his uprightness. (Isaiah 57:2)

text: כֻּלָּם נְכֹחִים לַמֵּבִין וִֽישָׁרִים לְמֹצְאֵי דָֽעַת׃
translation: They are all plain to him who understands, right to those who find knowledge. (Proverbs 8:9)

text: וַיָּשֶׂם אֶת הַמְּנֹרָה בְּאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד נֹכַח הַשֻּׁלְחָן עַל יֶרֶךְ הַמִּשְׁכָּן נֶֽגְבָּה׃
translation: He put the lamp stand in the Tent of Meeting, opposite the table, on the south side of the tabernacle. (Exodus 40:24)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶם הַכֹּהֵן לְכוּ לְשָׁלוֹם נֹכַח יְהוָה דַּרְכְּכֶם אֲשֶׁר תֵּֽלְכוּ בָֽהּ׃
translation: The priest said to them, "Go in peace. Your way in which you go is before the LORD." (Judges 18:6)

text: שְׂפָתַיִם יִשָּׁק מֵשִׁיב דְּבָרִים נְכֹחִֽים׃
translation: An honest answer is like a kiss on the lips. (Proverbs 24:26)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו אַבְשָׁלוֹם רְאֵה דְבָרֶךָ טוֹבִים וּנְכֹחִים וְשֹׁמֵעַ אֵין לְךָ מֵאֵת הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
translation: Absalom said to him, "Behold, your matters are good and right; but there is no man deputized by the king to hear you." (2 Samuel 15:3)

text: בְּנִי אַל תֵּלֵךְ בְּדֶרֶךְ אִתָּם מְנַע רַגְלְךָ מִנְּתִיבָתָֽם׃
translation: my son, don't walk on the path with them. Keep your foot from their path, (Proverbs 1:15)

text: שְׁתַּיִם שָׁאַלְתִּי מֵאִתָּךְ אַל תִּמְנַע מִמֶּנִּי בְּטֶרֶם אָמֽוּת׃
translation: "Two things I have asked of you. Don't deny me before I die. (Proverbs 30:7)

text: אִם אֶמְנַע מֵחֵפֶץ דַּלִּים וְעֵינֵי אַלְמָנָה אֲכַלֶּֽה׃
translation: "If I have withheld the poor from their desire, or have caused the eyes of the widow to fail, (Job 31:16)

text: אַל תִּמְנַע טוֹב מִבְּעָלָיו בִּהְיוֹת לְאֵל ידיך יָדְךָ לַעֲשֽׂוֹת׃
translation: Don't withhold good from those to whom it is due, when it is in the power of your hand to do it. (Proverbs 3:27)

text: אַל תִּמְנַע מִנַּעַר מוּסָר כִּֽי תַכֶּנּוּ בַשֵּׁבֶט לֹא יָמֽוּת׃
translation: Don't withhold correction from a child. If you punish him with the rod, he will not die. (Proverbs 23:13)

text: עֲוֺנוֹתֵיכֶם הִטּוּ אֵלֶּה וְחַטֹּאותֵיכֶם מָנְעוּ הַטּוֹב מִכֶּֽם׃
translation: "Your iniquities have turned away these things, and your sins have withheld good from you. (Jeremiah 5:25)

text: נֹטֶה צָפוֹן עַל תֹּהוּ תֹּלֶה אֶרֶץ עַל בְּלִי מָֽה׃
translation: He stretches out the north over empty space, and hangs the earth on nothing. (Job 26:7)

text: שָׂרִים בְּיָדָם נִתְלוּ פְּנֵי זְקֵנִים לֹא נֶהְדָּֽרוּ׃
translation: Princes were hanged up by their hands. The faces of elders were not honored. (Lamentations 5:12)

text: וְכִֽי יִהְיֶה בְאִישׁ חֵטְא מִשְׁפַּט מָוֶת וְהוּמָת וְתָלִיתָ אֹתוֹ עַל עֵֽץ׃
translation: If a man has committed a sin worthy of death, and he is put to death, and you hang him on a tree, (Deuteronomy 21:22)

text: וַיִּתְלוּ אֶת הָמָן עַל הָעֵץ אֲשֶׁר הֵכִין לְמָרְדֳּכָי וַחֲמַת הַמֶּלֶךְ שָׁכָֽכָה׃
translation: So they hanged Haman on the gallows that he had prepared for Mordecai. Then the king's wrath was pacified. (Esther 7:10)

text: עַֽל עֲרָבִים בְּתוֹכָהּ תָּלִינוּ כִּנֹּרוֹתֵֽינוּ׃
translation: On the willows in that land, we hung up our harps. (Psalms 137:2)

text: וַיַּרְא אִישׁ אֶחָד וַיַּגֵּד לְיוֹאָב וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֵּה רָאִיתִי אֶת אַבְשָׁלֹם תָּלוּי בָּאֵלָֽה׃
translation: A certain man saw it, and told Joab, and said, "Behold, I saw Absalom hanging in an oak." (2 Samuel 18:10)

text: אָנָּא יְהוָה הוֹשִׁיעָה נָּא אָֽנָּא יְהוָה הַצְלִיחָה נָּֽא׃
translation: Save us now, we beg you, LORD! LORD, we beg you, send prosperity now. (Psalms 118:25)

text: וּבְשֵֽׁם יְהוָה אֶקְרָא אָנָּה יְהוָה מַלְּטָה נַפְשִֽׁי׃
translation: Then I called on the LORD's name: "LORD, I beg you, deliver my soul." (Psalms 116:4)

text: אָֽנָּה יְהוָה כִּֽי אֲנִי עַבְדֶּךָ אֲֽנִי עַבְדְּךָ בֶּן אֲמָתֶךָ פִּתַּחְתָּ לְמוֹסֵרָֽי׃
translation: LORD, truly I am your servant. I am your servant, the son of your servant girl. You have freed me from my chains. (Psalms 116:16)

text: וָאֹמַר אָֽנָּא יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵי הַשָּׁמַיִם הָאֵל הַגָּדוֹל וְהַנּוֹרָא שֹׁמֵר הַבְּרִית וָחֶסֶד לְאֹהֲבָיו וּלְשֹׁמְרֵי מִצְוֺתָֽיו׃
translation: and said, "I beg you, LORD, the God of heaven, the great and awesome God who keeps covenant and loving kindness with those who love him and keep his commandments, (Nehemiah 1:5)

text: וַיָּשָׁב מֹשֶׁה אֶל יְהוָה וַיֹּאמַר אָנָּא חָטָא הָעָם הַזֶּה חֲטָאָה גְדֹלָה וַיַּֽעֲשׂוּ לָהֶם אֱלֹהֵי זָהָֽב׃
translation: Moses returned to the LORD, and said, "Oh, this people have sinned a great sin, and have made themselves gods of gold. (Exodus 32:31)

text: וָֽאֶתְפַּֽלְלָה לַיהוָה אֱלֹהַי וָאֶתְוַדֶּה וָאֹֽמְרָה אָנָּא אֲדֹנָי הָאֵל הַגָּדוֹל וְהַנּוֹרָא שֹׁמֵר הַבְּרִית וְֽהַחֶסֶד לְאֹהֲבָיו וּלְשֹׁמְרֵי מִצְוֺתָֽיו׃
translation: I prayed to the LORD my God, and made confession, and said, "Oh, Lord, the great and dreadful God, who keeps covenant and loving kindness with those who love him and keep his commandments, (Daniel 9:4)

text: אִם לְכֹחַ אַמִּיץ הִנֵּה וְאִם לְמִשְׁפָּט מִי יוֹעִידֵֽנִי׃
translation: If it is a matter of strength, behold, he is mighty! If of justice, 'Who,' says he, 'will summon me?' (Job 9:19)

text: וְאִם לִבְנוֹ יִֽיעָדֶנָּה כְּמִשְׁפַּט הַבָּנוֹת יַעֲשֶׂה לָּֽהּ׃
translation: If he marries her to his son, he shall deal with her as a daughter. (Exodus 21:9)

text: וְאִם בְּאַחַת יִתְקָעוּ וְנוֹעֲדוּ אֵלֶיךָ הַנְּשִׂיאִים רָאשֵׁי אַלְפֵי יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
translation: If they blow just one, then the princes, the heads of the thousands of Israel, shall gather themselves to you. (Numbers 10:4)

text: הִתְאַחֲדִי הֵימִנִי הָשִׂימִי הַשְׂמִילִי אָנָה פָּנַיִךְ מֻעָדֽוֹת׃
translation: For the king of Babylon stood at the parting of the way, at the head of the two ways, to use divination. He shook the arrows back and forth. He consulted the teraphim. He looked in the liver. (Ezekiel 21:21)

text: וְנֹעַדְתִּי שָׁמָּה לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְנִקְדַּשׁ בִּכְבֹדִֽי׃
translation: There I will meet with the children of Israel; and the place shall be sanctified by my glory. (Exodus 29:43)

text: כִּֽי הִנֵּה הַמְּלָכִים נֽוֹעֲדוּ עָבְרוּ יַחְדָּֽו׃
translation: They saw it, then they were amazed. They were dismayed. They hurried away. (Psalms 48:5)

text: וְדִשְּׁנוּ אֶת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וּפָרְשׂוּ עָלָיו בֶּגֶד אַרְגָּמָֽן׃
translation: "They shall take away the ashes from the altar, and spread a purple cloth on it. (Numbers 4:13)

text: כְּמוֹ חֵלֶב וָדֶשֶׁן תִּשְׂבַּע נַפְשִׁי וְשִׂפְתֵי רְנָנוֹת יְהַלֶּל פִּֽי׃
translation: when I remember you on my bed, and think about you in the night watches. (Psalms 63:6)

text: יִזְכֹּר כָּל מִנְחֹתֶךָ וְעוֹלָתְךָ יְדַשְּׁנֶה סֶֽלָה׃
translation: May he grant you your heart's desire, and fulfill all your counsel. (Psalms 20:4)

text: תַּעֲרֹךְ לְפָנַי שֻׁלְחָן נֶגֶד צֹרְרָי דִּשַּׁנְתָּ בַשֶּׁמֶן רֹאשִׁי כּוֹסִי רְוָיָֽה׃
translation: You prepare a table before me in the presence of my enemies. You anoint my head with oil. My cup runs over. (Psalms 23:5)

text: וְהֵסִיר אֶת מֻרְאָתוֹ בְּנֹצָתָהּ וְהִשְׁלִיךְ אֹתָהּ אֵצֶל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ קֵדְמָה אֶל מְקוֹם הַדָּֽשֶׁן׃
translation: and he shall take away its crop and its feathers, and cast it beside the altar on the east part, in the place of the ashes. (Leviticus 1:16)

text: וְהַמִּזְבֵּחַ נִקְרָע וַיִּשָּׁפֵךְ הַדֶּשֶׁן מִן הַמִּזְבֵּחַ כַּמּוֹפֵת אֲשֶׁר נָתַן אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים בִּדְבַר יְהוָֽה׃
translation: The altar was also split apart, and the ashes poured out from the altar, according to the sign which the man of God had given by the LORD's word. (1 Kings 13:5)

text: הוֹי מֹשְׁכֵי הֶֽעָוֺן בְּחַבְלֵי הַשָּׁוְא וְכַעֲבוֹת הָעֲגָלָה חַטָּאָֽה׃
translation: Woe to those who draw iniquity with cords of falsehood, and wickedness as with cart rope, (Isaiah 5:18)

text: נְֽנַתְּקָה אֶת מֽוֹסְרוֹתֵימוֹ וְנַשְׁלִיכָה מִמֶּנּוּ עֲבֹתֵֽימוֹ׃
translation: "Let's break their bonds apart, and cast their cords from us." (Psalms 2:3)

text: אֵל יְהוָה וַיָּאֶר לָנוּ אִסְרוּ חַג בַּעֲבֹתִים עַד קַרְנוֹת הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃
translation: The LORD is God, and he has given us light. Bind the sacrifice with cords, even to the horns of the altar. (Psalms 118:27)

text: וְאַתָּה בֶן אָדָם הִנֵּה נָתְנוּ עָלֶיךָ עֲבוֹתִים וַאֲסָרוּךָ בָּהֶם וְלֹא תֵצֵא בְּתוֹכָֽם׃
translation: But you, son of man, behold, they will put ropes on you, and will bind you with them, and you will not go out among them. (Ezekiel 3:25)

text: בְּחַבְלֵי אָדָם אֶמְשְׁכֵם בַּעֲבֹתוֹת אַהֲבָה וָאֶהְיֶה לָהֶם כִּמְרִימֵי עֹל עַל לְחֵיהֶם וְאַט אֵלָיו אוֹכִֽיל׃
translation: I drew them with cords of a man, with ties of love; and I was to them like those who lift up the yoke on their necks; and I bent down to him and I fed him. (Hosea 11:4)

text: עַל הָרַע כַּפַּיִם לְהֵיטִיב הַשַּׂר שֹׁאֵל וְהַשֹּׁפֵט בַּשִׁלּוּם וְהַגָּדוֹל דֹּבֵר הַוַּת נַפְשׁוֹ הוּא וַֽיְעַבְּתֽוּהָ׃
translation: Their hands are on that which is evil to do it diligently. The ruler and judge ask for a bribe. The powerful man dictates the evil desire of his soul. Thus they conspire together. (Micah 7:3)

text: וַיֵּלֶךְ בְּדַרְכֵי מַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְגַם מַסֵּכוֹת עָשָׂה לַבְּעָלִֽים׃
translation: but he walked in the ways of the kings of Israel, and also made molten images for the Baals. (2 Chronicles 28:2)

text: נָסֹגוּ אָחוֹר יֵבֹשׁוּ בֹשֶׁת הַבֹּטְחִים בַּפָּסֶל הָאֹמְרִים לְמַסֵּכָה אַתֶּם אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃
translation: "Those who trust in engraved images, who tell molten images, 'You are our gods,' will be turned back. They will be utterly disappointed. (Isaiah 42:17)

text: אֱלֹהֵי מַסֵּכָה לֹא תַעֲשֶׂה לָּֽךְ׃
translation: "You shall make no cast idols for yourselves. (Exodus 34:17)

text: יַעֲשׂוּ עֵגֶל בְּחֹרֵב וַיִּשְׁתַּחֲווּ לְמַסֵּכָֽה׃
translation: They made a calf in Horeb, and worshiped a molten image. (Psalms 106:19)

text: אַל תִּפְנוּ אֶל הָאֱלִילִים וֵֽאלֹהֵי מַסֵּכָה לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ לָכֶם אֲנִי יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃
translation: "'Don't turn to idols, nor make molten gods for yourselves. I am the LORD your God. (Leviticus 19:4)

text: וּבִלַּע בָּהָר הַזֶּה פְּנֵֽי הַלּוֹט הַלּוֹט עַל כָּל הָֽעַמִּים וְהַמַּסֵּכָה הַנְּסוּכָה עַל כָּל הַגּוֹיִֽם׃
translation: He will destroy in this mountain the surface of the covering that covers all peoples, and the veil that is spread over all nations. (Isaiah 25:7)

text: אַל תִּבְטְחוּ בִנְדִיבִים בְּבֶן אָדָם שֶׁאֵֽין לוֹ תְשׁוּעָֽה׃
translation: Don't put your trust in princes, in a son of man in whom there is no help. (Psalms 146:3)

text: רַבִּים יְחַלּוּ פְנֵֽי נָדִיב וְכָל הָרֵעַ לְאִישׁ מַתָּֽן׃
translation: Many will entreat the favor of a ruler, and everyone is a friend to a man who gives gifts. (Proverbs 19:6)

text: כִּי תֹֽאמְרוּ אַיֵּה בֵית נָדִיב וְאַיֵּה אֹהֶל מִשְׁכְּנוֹת רְשָׁעִֽים׃
translation: For you say, 'Where is the house of the prince? Where is the tent in which the wicked lived?' (Job 21:28)

text: לֹא יָדַעְתִּי נַפְשִׁי שָׂמַתְנִי מַרְכְּבוֹת עַמִּי נָדִֽיב׃
translation: Without realizing it, my desire set me with my royal people's chariots. (Song of Solomon 6:12)

text: לֹֽא יִקָּרֵא עוֹד לְנָבָל נָדִיב וּלְכִילַי לֹא יֵֽאָמֵר שֽׁוֹעַ׃
translation: The fool will no longer be called noble, nor the scoundrel be highly respected. (Isaiah 32:5)

text: וְנָדִיב נְדִיבוֹת יָעָץ וְהוּא עַל נְדִיבוֹת יָקֽוּם׃
translation: But the noble devises noble things, and he will continue in noble things. (Isaiah 32:8)

text: וַיָּבֹאוּ יְרוּשָׁלִַם בִּנְבָלִים וּבְכִנֹּרוֹת וּבַחֲצֹצְרוֹת אֶל בֵּית יְהוָֽה׃
translation: They came to Jerusalem with stringed instruments, harps, and trumpets to the LORD's house. (2 Chronicles 20:28)

text: וּבְנָיָהוּ וְיַחֲזִיאֵל הַכֹּהֲנִים בַּחֲצֹצְרוֹת תָּמִיד לִפְנֵי אֲרוֹן בְּרִית הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃
translation: with Benaiah and Jahaziel the priests with trumpets continually, before the ark of the covenant of God. (1 Chronicles 16:6)

text: וַיִּשָּֽׁבְעוּ לַיהוָה בְּקוֹל גָּדוֹל וּבִתְרוּעָה וּבַחֲצֹצְרוֹת וּבְשׁוֹפָרֽוֹת׃
translation: They swore to the LORD with a loud voice, with shouting, with trumpets, and with cornets. (2 Chronicles 15:14)

text: וְהַכֹּהֲנִים אֶלְיָקִים מַעֲשֵׂיָה מִנְיָמִין מִיכָיָה אֶלְיוֹעֵינַי זְכַרְיָה חֲנַנְיָה בַּחֲצֹצְרֽוֹת׃
translation: and the priests, Eliakim, Maaseiah, Miniamin, Micaiah, Elioenai, Zechariah, and Hananiah, with trumpets; (Nehemiah 12:41)

text: בַּחֲצֹצְרוֹת וְקוֹל שׁוֹפָר הָרִיעוּ לִפְנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ יְהוָֽה׃
translation: With trumpets and sound of the ram's horn, make a joyful noise before the King, the LORD. (Psalms 98:6)

text: וּבְנֵי אַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֲנִים יִתְקְעוּ בַּֽחֲצֹצְרוֹת וְהָיוּ לָכֶם לְחֻקַּת עוֹלָם לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶֽם׃
translation: "The sons of Aaron, the priests, shall blow the trumpets. This shall be to you for a statute forever throughout your generations. (Numbers 10:8)

text: יִשְׂחַק לַהֲמוֹן קִרְיָה תְּשֻׁאוֹת נוֹגֵשׂ לֹא יִשְׁמָֽע׃
translation: He scorns the tumult of the city, neither does he hear the shouting of the driver. (Job 39:7)

text: אַנְשֵׁי לָצוֹן יָפִיחוּ קִרְיָה וַחֲכָמִים יָשִׁיבוּ אָֽף׃
translation: Mockers stir up a city, but wise men turn away anger. (Proverbs 29:8)

text: הוֹי בֹּנֶה עִיר בְּדָמִים וְכוֹנֵן קִרְיָה בְּעַוְלָֽה׃
translation: Woe to him who builds a town with blood, and establishes a city by iniquity! (Habakkuk 2:12)

text: גִּלְעָד קִרְיַת פֹּעֲלֵי אָוֶן עֲקֻבָּה מִדָּֽם׃
translation: Gilead is a city of those who work iniquity; it is stained with blood. (Hosea 6:8)

text: כִּי שַׂמְתָּ מֵעִיר לַגָּל קִרְיָה בְצוּרָה לְמַפֵּלָה אַרְמוֹן זָרִים מֵעִיר לְעוֹלָם לֹא יִבָּנֶֽה׃
translation: For you have made a city into a heap, a fortified city into a ruin, a palace of strangers to be no city. It will never be built. (Isaiah 25:2)

text: כִּי הֵשַׁח יֹשְׁבֵי מָרוֹם קִרְיָה נִשְׂגָּבָה יַשְׁפִּילֶנָּה יַשְׁפִּילָהּ עַד אֶרֶץ יַגִּיעֶנָּה עַד עָפָֽר׃
translation: For he has brought down those who dwell on high, the lofty city. He lays it low. He lays it low even to the ground. He brings it even to the dust. (Isaiah 26:5)

text: וַיִּלְכֹּד דָּוִד אֵת מְצֻדַת צִיּוֹן הִיא עִיר דָּוִֽד׃
translation: Nevertheless David took the stronghold of Zion. This is David's city. (2 Samuel 5:7)

text: סֶלַע יִשְׁכֹּן וְיִתְלֹנָן עַֽל שֶׁן סֶלַע וּמְצוּדָֽה׃
translation: On the cliff he dwells and makes his home, on the point of the cliff and the stronghold. (Job 39:28)

text: חָמַד רָשָׁע מְצוֹד רָעִים וְשֹׁרֶשׁ צַדִּיקִים יִתֵּֽן׃
translation: The wicked desires the plunder of evil men, but the root of the righteous flourishes. (Proverbs 12:12)

text: וַיֹּאמַר יְהוָה סַֽלְעִי וּמְצֻדָתִי וּמְפַלְטִי לִֽי׃
translation: and he said: "The LORD is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer, even mine; (2 Samuel 22:2)

text: הֲבֵאתָנוּ בַמְּצוּדָה שַׂמְתָּ מוּעָקָה בְמָתְנֵֽינוּ׃
translation: You brought us into prison. You laid a burden on our backs. (Psalms 66:11)

text: חַסְדִּי וּמְצוּדָתִי מִשְׂגַּבִּי וּֽמְפַלְטִי לִי מָגִנִּי וּבוֹ חָסִיתִי הָרוֹדֵד עַמִּי תַחְתָּֽי׃
translation: my loving kindness, my fortress, my high tower, my deliverer, my shield, and he in whom I take refuge, who subdues my people under me. (Psalms 144:2)

text: חֶרְפָּה שָֽׁבְרָה לִבִּי וָֽאָנוּשָׁה וָאֲקַוֶּה לָנוּד וָאַיִן וְלַמְנַחֲמִים וְלֹא מָצָֽאתִי׃
translation: They also gave me poison for my food. In my thirst, they gave me vinegar to drink. (Psalms 69:21)

text: לַמְנַצֵּחַ לְדָוִד בַּֽיהוָה חָסִיתִי אֵיךְ תֹּאמְרוּ לְנַפְשִׁי נודו נוּדִי הַרְכֶם צִפּֽוֹר׃
translation: For the Chief Musician. By David. In the LORD, I take refuge. How can you say to my soul, "Flee as a bird to your mountain"? (Psalms 11:1)

text: נֻדוּ מִתּוֹךְ בָּבֶל וּמֵאֶרֶץ כַּשְׂדִּים יצאו צֵאוּ וִהְיוּ כְּעַתּוּדִים לִפְנֵי צֹֽאן׃
translation: "Flee out of the middle of Babylon! Go out of the land of the Chaldeans, and be as the male goats before the flocks. (Jeremiah 50:8)

text: שְׁתַּיִם הֵנָּה קֹֽרְאֹתַיִךְ מִי יָנוּד לָךְ הַשֹּׁד וְהַשֶּׁבֶר וְהָרָעָב וְהַחֶרֶב מִי אֲנַחֲמֵֽךְ׃
translation: These two things have happened to you— who will grieve with you?— desolation and destruction, and famine and the sword. How can I comfort you? (Isaiah 51:19)

text: כִּי תַֽעֲבֹד אֶת הָאֲדָמָה לֹֽא תֹסֵף תֵּת כֹּחָהּ לָךְ נָע וָנָד תִּֽהְיֶה בָאָֽרֶץ׃
translation: From now on, when you till the ground, it won't yield its strength to you. You will be a fugitive and a wanderer in the earth." (Genesis 4:12)

text: כִּי מִֽי יַחְמֹל עָלַיִךְ יְרוּשָׁלִַם וּמִי יָנוּד לָךְ וּמִי יָסוּר לִשְׁאֹל לְשָׁלֹם לָֽךְ׃
translation: For who will have pity on you, Jerusalem? Who will mourn you? Who will come to ask of your welfare? (Jeremiah 15:5)

text: צֵא מִן הַתֵּבָה אַתָּה וְאִשְׁתְּךָ וּבָנֶיךָ וּנְשֵֽׁי בָנֶיךָ אִתָּֽךְ׃
translation: "Go out of the ship, you, your wife, your sons, and your sons' wives with you. (Genesis 8:16)

text: וַיִּגְבְּרוּ הַמַּיִם וַיִּרְבּוּ מְאֹד עַל הָאָרֶץ וַתֵּלֶךְ הַתֵּבָה עַל פְּנֵי הַמָּֽיִם׃
translation: The waters rose, and increased greatly on the earth; and the ship floated on the surface of the waters. (Genesis 7:18)

text: וַתָּנַח הַתֵּבָה בַּחֹדֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִי בְּשִׁבְעָה עָשָׂר יוֹם לַחֹדֶשׁ עַל הָרֵי אֲרָרָֽט׃
translation: The ship rested in the seventh month, on the seventeenth day of the month, on Ararat's mountains. (Genesis 8:4)

text: וַֽיְהִי מִקֵּץ אַרְבָּעִים יוֹם וַיִּפְתַּח נֹחַ אֶת חַלּוֹן הַתֵּבָה אֲשֶׁר עָשָֽׂה׃
translation: At the end of forty days, Noah opened the window of the ship which he had made, (Genesis 8:6)

text: וַיָּחֶל עוֹד שִׁבְעַת יָמִים אֲחֵרִים וַיֹּסֶף שַׁלַּח אֶת הַיּוֹנָה מִן הַתֵּבָֽה׃
translation: He waited yet another seven days; and again he sent the dove out of the ship. (Genesis 8:10)

text: וַהֲקִמֹתִי אֶת בְּרִיתִי אִתָּךְ וּבָאתָ אֶל הַתֵּבָה אַתָּה וּבָנֶיךָ וְאִשְׁתְּךָ וּנְשֵֽׁי בָנֶיךָ אִתָּֽךְ׃
translation: But I will establish my covenant with you. You shall come into the ship, you, your sons, your wife, and your sons' wives with you. (Genesis 6:18)

text: מִכָּל אֹרַח רָע כָּלִאתִי רַגְלָי לְמַעַן אֶשְׁמֹר דְּבָרֶֽךָ׃
translation: I have kept my feet from every evil way, that I might observe your word. (Psalms 119:101)

text: הִרְחַקְתָּ מְיֻדָּעַי מִמֶּנִּי שַׁתַּנִי תוֹעֵבוֹת לָמוֹ כָּלֻא וְלֹא אֵצֵֽא׃
translation: My eyes are dim from grief. I have called on you daily, LORD. I have spread out my hands to you. (Psalms 88:9)

text: אַתָּה יְהוָה לֹא תִכְלָא רַחֲמֶיךָ מִמֶּנִּי חַסְדְּךָ וַאֲמִתְּךָ תָּמִיד יִצְּרֽוּנִי׃
translation: For innumerable evils have surrounded me. My iniquities have overtaken me, so that I am not able to look up. They are more than the hairs of my head. My heart has failed me. (Psalms 40:12)

text: וַיַּעַן יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בִּן נוּן מְשָׁרֵת מֹשֶׁה מִבְּחֻרָיו וַיֹּאמַר אֲדֹנִי מֹשֶׁה כְּלָאֵֽם׃
translation: Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of Moses, one of his chosen men, answered, "My lord Moses, forbid them!" (Numbers 11:28)

text: וְשִׁנָּא אֵת בִּגְדֵי כִלְאוֹ וְאָכַל לֶחֶם תָּמִיד לְפָנָיו כָּל יְמֵי חַיָּֽיו׃
translation: and changed his prison garments. Jehoiachin ate bread before him continually all the days of his life; (2 Kings 25:29)

text: בִּשַּׂרְתִּי צֶדֶק בְּקָהָל רָב הִנֵּה שְׂפָתַי לֹא אֶכְלָא יְהוָה אַתָּה יָדָֽעְתָּ׃
translation: I have not hidden your righteousness within my heart. I have declared your faithfulness and your salvation. I have not concealed your loving kindness and your truth from the great assembly. (Psalms 40:10)

text: אִישׁ חָמָס יְפַתֶּה רֵעֵהוּ וְהוֹלִיכוֹ בְּדֶרֶךְ לֹא טֽוֹב׃
translation: A man of violence entices his neighbor, and leads him in a way that is not good. (Proverbs 16:29)

text: כִּֽי לֶֽאֱוִיל יַהֲרָג כָּעַשׂ וּפֹתֶה תָּמִית קִנְאָֽה׃
translation: For resentment kills the foolish man, and jealousy kills the simple. (Job 5:2)

text: אִם נִפְתָּה לִבִּי עַל אִשָּׁה וְעַל פֶּתַח רֵעִי אָרָֽבְתִּי׃
translation: "If my heart has been enticed to a woman, and I have laid wait at my neighbor's door, (Job 31:9)

text: אַל תְּהִי עֵד חִנָּם בְּרֵעֶךָ וַהֲפִתִּיתָ בִּשְׂפָתֶֽיךָ׃
translation: Don't be a witness against your neighbor without cause. Don't deceive with your lips. (Proverbs 24:28)

text: לָכֵן הִנֵּה אָֽנֹכִי מְפַתֶּיהָ וְהֹֽלַכְתִּיהָ הַמִּדְבָּר וְדִבַּרְתִּי עַל לִבָּֽהּ׃
translation: It will be in that day," says the LORD, "that you will call me 'my husband,' and no longer call me 'my master.' (Hosea 2:16)

text: יַפְתְּ אֱלֹהִים לְיֶפֶת וְיִשְׁכֹּן בְּאָֽהֳלֵי שֵׁם וִיהִי כְנַעַן עֶבֶד לָֽמוֹ׃
translation: May God enlarge Japheth. Let him dwell in the tents of Shem. Let Canaan be his servant." (Genesis 9:27)

text: וַיִּקְחוּ אֶת כָּל רְכֻשׁ סְדֹם וַעֲמֹרָה וְאֶת כָּל אָכְלָם וַיֵּלֵֽכוּ׃
translation: They took all the goods of Sodom and Gomorrah, and all their food, and went their way. (Genesis 14:11)

text: וְהָיוּ הֶֽעָרִים לָהֶם לָשָׁבֶת וּמִגְרְשֵׁיהֶם יִהְיוּ לִבְהֶמְתָּם וְלִרְכֻשָׁם וּלְכֹל חַיָּתָֽם׃
translation: They shall have the cities to dwell in. Their pasture lands shall be for their livestock, and for their possessions, and for all their animals. (Numbers 35:3)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר מֶֽלֶךְ סְדֹם אֶל אַבְרָם תֶּן לִי הַנֶּפֶשׁ וְהָרְכֻשׁ קַֽח לָֽךְ׃
translation: The king of Sodom said to Abram, "Give me the people, and take the goods for yourself." (Genesis 14:21)

text: וְעַל הַצֹּאן יָזִיז הַֽהַגְרִי כָּל אֵלֶּה שָׂרֵי הָרְכוּשׁ אֲשֶׁר לַמֶּלֶךְ דָּוִֽיד׃
translation: All these were the rulers of the property which was King David's. (1 Chronicles 27:31)

text: וְיָשֹׁב אַרְצוֹ בִּרְכוּשׁ גָּדוֹל וּלְבָבוֹ עַל בְּרִית קֹדֶשׁ וְעָשָׂה וְשָׁב לְאַרְצֽוֹ׃
translation: Then he will return into his land with great wealth. His heart will be against the holy covenant. He will take action, and return to his own land. (Daniel 11:28)

text: וַיִּקְחוּ אֶת לוֹט וְאֶת רְכֻשׁוֹ בֶּן אֲחִי אַבְרָם וַיֵּלֵכוּ וְהוּא יֹשֵׁב בִּסְדֹֽם׃
translation: They took Lot, Abram's brother's son, who lived in Sodom, and his goods, and departed. (Genesis 14:12)

text: פָּעֲרוּ עָלַי בְּפִיהֶם בְּחֶרְפָּה הִכּוּ לְחָיָי יַחַד עָלַי יִתְמַלָּאֽוּן׃
translation: They have gaped on me with their mouth. They have struck me on the cheek reproachfully. They gather themselves together against me. (Job 16:10)

text: וַיַּעֲלוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים וַֽיַּחֲנוּ בִּיהוּדָה וַיִּנָּטְשׁוּ בַּלֶּֽחִי׃
translation: Then the Philistines went up, encamped in Judah, and spread themselves in Lehi. (Judges 15:9)

text: וַיִּמְצָא לְחִֽי חֲמוֹר טְרִיָּה וַיִּשְׁלַח יָדוֹ וַיִּקָּחֶהָ וַיַּךְ בָּהּ אֶלֶף אִֽישׁ׃
translation: He found a fresh jawbone of a donkey, put out his hand, took it, and struck a thousand men with it. (Judges 15:15)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר שִׁמְשׁוֹן בִּלְחִי הַחֲמוֹר חֲמוֹר חֲמֹרָתָיִם בִּלְחִי הַחֲמוֹר הִכֵּיתִי אֶלֶף אִֽישׁ׃
translation: Samson said, "With the jawbone of a donkey, heaps on heaps; with the jawbone of a donkey I have struck a thousand men." (Judges 15:16)

text: וַֽיְהִי כְּכַלֹּתוֹ לְדַבֵּר וַיַּשְׁלֵךְ הַלְּחִי מִיָּדוֹ וַיִּקְרָא לַמָּקוֹם הַהוּא רָמַת לֶֽחִי׃
translation: When he had finished speaking, he threw the jawbone out of his hand; and that place was called Ramath Lehi. (Judges 15:17)

text: יִתֵּן לְמַכֵּהוּ לֶחִי יִשְׂבַּע בְּחֶרְפָּֽה׃
translation: Let him give his cheek to him who strikes him. Let him be filled full of reproach. (Lamentations 3:30)

text: דֹּמּוּ יֹשְׁבֵי אִי סֹחֵר צִידוֹן עֹבֵר יָם מִלְאֽוּךְ׃
translation: Be still, you inhabitants of the coast, you whom the merchants of Sidon that pass over the sea have replenished. (Isaiah 23:2)

text: וְאִתָּנוּ תֵּשֵׁבוּ וְהָאָרֶץ תִּהְיֶה לִפְנֵיכֶם שְׁבוּ וּסְחָרוּהָ וְהֵֽאָחֲזוּ בָּֽהּ׃
translation: You shall dwell with us, and the land will be before you. Live and trade in it, and get possessions in it." (Genesis 34:10)

text: לִבִּי סְחַרְחַר עֲזָבַנִי כֹחִי וְֽאוֹר עֵינַי גַּם הֵם אֵין אִתִּֽי׃
translation: My lovers and my friends stand aloof from my plague. My kinsmen stand far away. (Psalms 38:11)

text: וּבְמַיִם רַבִּים זֶרַע שִׁחֹר קְצִיר יְאוֹר תְּבֽוּאָתָהּ וַתְּהִי סְחַר גּוֹיִֽם׃
translation: On great waters, the seed of the Shihor, the harvest of the Nile, was her revenue. She was the market of nations. (Isaiah 23:3)

text: כֵּן הָיוּ לָךְ אֲשֶׁר יָגָעַתְּ סֹחֲרַיִךְ מִנְּעוּרַיִךְ אִישׁ לְעֶבְרוֹ תָּעוּ אֵין מוֹשִׁיעֵֽךְ׃
translation: The things that you labored in will be like this: those who have trafficked with you from your youth will each wander in his own way. There will be no one to save you. (Isaiah 47:15)

text: לְבַד מֵאַנְשֵׁי הַתָּרִים וְהַסֹּחֲרִים מְבִיאִים וְכָל מַלְכֵי עֲרַב וּפַחוֹת הָאָרֶץ מְבִיאִים זָהָב וָכֶסֶף לִשְׁלֹמֹֽה׃
translation: in addition to that which the traders and merchants brought. All the kings of Arabia and the governors of the country brought gold and silver to Solomon. (2 Chronicles 9:14)

text: וְיִשְׁלַח יָדוֹ בַּאֲרָצוֹת וְאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם לֹא תִהְיֶה לִפְלֵיטָֽה׃
translation: He will also stretch out his hand on the countries. The land of Egypt won't escape. (Daniel 11:42)

text: וְיָסְפָה פְּלֵיטַת בֵּית יְהוּדָה הַנִּשְׁאָרָה שֹׁרֶשׁ לְמָטָּה וְעָשָׂה פְרִי לְמָֽעְלָה׃
translation: The remnant that has escaped of the house of Judah will again take root downward, and bear fruit upward. (2 Kings 19:30)

text: וַיַּכּוּ אֶת שְׁאֵרִית הַפְּלֵטָה לַעֲמָלֵק וַיֵּשְׁבוּ שָׁם עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּֽה׃
translation: They struck the remnant of the Amalekites who escaped, and have lived there to this day. (1 Chronicles 4:43)

text: וְיָסְפָה פְּלֵיטַת בֵּית יְהוּדָה הַנִּשְׁאָרָה שֹׁרֶשׁ לְמָטָּה וְעָשָׂה פְרִי לְמָֽעְלָה׃
translation: The remnant that is escaped of the house of Judah will again take root downward, and bear fruit upward. (Isaiah 37:31)

text: וַיִּשְׁלָחֵנִי אֱלֹהִים לִפְנֵיכֶם לָשׂוּם לָכֶם שְׁאֵרִית בָּאָרֶץ וּלְהַחֲיוֹת לָכֶם לִפְלֵיטָה גְּדֹלָֽה׃
translation: God sent me before you to preserve for you a remnant in the earth, and to save you alive by a great deliverance. (Genesis 45:7)

text: וּבְהַר צִיּוֹן תִּהְיֶה פְלֵיטָה וְהָיָה קֹדֶשׁ וְיָֽרְשׁוּ בֵּית יַֽעֲקֹב אֵת מוֹרָֽשֵׁיהֶם׃
translation: But in Mount Zion, there will be those who escape, and it will be holy. The house of Jacob will possess their possessions. (Obadiah 1:17)

text: וַיִּתֵּן אֶת קֹלוֹ בִּבְכִי וַיִּשְׁמְעוּ מִצְרַיִם וַיִּשְׁמַע בֵּית פַּרְעֹֽה׃
translation: He wept aloud. The Egyptians heard, and the house of Pharaoh heard. (Genesis 45:2)

text: סוּרוּ מִמֶּנִּי כָּל פֹּעֲלֵי אָוֶן כִּֽי שָׁמַע יְהוָה קוֹל בִּכְיִֽי׃
translation: The LORD has heard my supplication. The LORD accepts my prayer. (Psalms 6:9)

text: כִּי רֶגַע בְּאַפּוֹ חַיִּים בִּרְצוֹנוֹ בָּעֶרֶב יָלִין בֶּכִי וְלַבֹּקֶר רִנָּֽה׃
translation: As for me, I said in my prosperity, "I shall never be moved." (Psalms 30:6)

text: וְגַלְתִּי בִירוּשָׁלִַם וְשַׂשְׂתִּי בְעַמִּי וְלֹֽא יִשָּׁמַע בָּהּ עוֹד קוֹל בְּכִי וְקוֹל זְעָקָֽה׃
translation: I will rejoice in Jerusalem, and delight in my people; and the voice of weeping and the voice of crying will be heard in her no more. (Isaiah 65:19)

text: וַיִּבְכּוּ בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת מֹשֶׁה בְּעַֽרְבֹת מוֹאָב שְׁלֹשִׁים יוֹם וַֽיִּתְּמוּ יְמֵי בְכִי אֵבֶל מֹשֶֽׁה׃
translation: The children of Israel wept for Moses in the plains of Moab thirty days, until the days of weeping in the mourning for Moses were ended. (Deuteronomy 34:8)

text: כִּי מַעֲלֵה הלחות הַלּוּחִית בִּבְכִי יַֽעֲלֶה בֶּכִי כִּי בְּמוֹרַד חוֹרֹנַיִם צָרֵי צַֽעֲקַת שֶׁבֶר שָׁמֵֽעוּ׃
translation: For they will go up by the ascent of Luhith with continual weeping. For at the descent of Horonaim they have heard the distress of the cry of destruction. (Jeremiah 48:5)

text: חֹפֵר גּוּמָּץ בּוֹ יִפּוֹל וּפֹרֵץ גָּדֵר יִשְּׁכֶנּוּ נָחָֽשׁ׃
translation: He who digs a pit may fall into it; and whoever breaks through a wall may be bitten by a snake. (Ecclesiastes 10:8)

text: אֶת כַּסְפְּךָ לֹֽא תִתֵּן לוֹ בְּנֶשֶׁךְ וּבְמַרְבִּית לֹא תִתֵּן אָכְלֶֽךָ׃
translation: You shall not lend him your money at interest, nor give him your food for profit. (Leviticus 25:37)

text: אַחֲרִיתוֹ כְּנָחָשׁ יִשָּׁךְ וּֽכְצִפְעֹנִי יַפְרִֽשׁ׃
translation: In the end, it bites like a snake, and poisons like a viper. (Proverbs 23:32)

text: לֹא תַשִּׁיךְ לְאָחִיךָ נֶשֶׁךְ כֶּסֶף נֶשֶׁךְ אֹכֶל נֶשֶׁךְ כָּל דָּבָר אֲשֶׁר יִשָּֽׁךְ׃
translation: You may charge a foreigner interest; but you shall not charge your brother interest, that the LORD your God may bless you in all that you put your hand to, in the land where you go in to possess it. (Deuteronomy 23:20)

text: וַיְשַׁלַּח יְהוָה בָּעָם אֵת הַנְּחָשִׁים הַשְּׂרָפִים וַֽיְנַשְּׁכוּ אֶת הָעָם וַיָּמָת עַם רָב מִיִּשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
translation: The LORD sent venomous snakes among the people, and they bit the people. Many people of Israel died. (Numbers 21:6)

text: יְהִי דָן נָחָשׁ עֲלֵי דֶרֶךְ שְׁפִיפֹן עֲלֵי אֹרַח הַנֹּשֵׁךְ עִקְּבֵי סוּס וַיִּפֹּל רֹכְבוֹ אָחֽוֹר׃
translation: Dan will be a serpent on the trail, an adder in the path, that bites the horse's heels, so that his rider falls backward. (Genesis 49:17)

text: וְזֶה אֲשֶׁר לֹֽא תֹאכְלוּ מֵהֶם הַנֶּשֶׁר וְהַפֶּרֶס וְהָֽעָזְנִיָּֽה׃
translation: But these are they of which you shall not eat: the eagle, the vulture, the osprey, (Deuteronomy 14:12)

text: חָלְפוּ עִם אֳנִיּוֹת אֵבֶה כְּנֶשֶׁר יָטוּשׂ עֲלֵי אֹֽכֶל׃
translation: They have passed away as the swift ships, as the eagle that swoops on the prey. (Job 9:26)

text: כִּי כֹה אָמַר יְהוָה הִנֵּה כַנֶּשֶׁר יִדְאֶה וּפָרַשׂ כְּנָפָיו אֶל מוֹאָֽב׃
translation: For the LORD says: "Behold, he will fly as an eagle, and will spread out his wings against Moab. (Jeremiah 48:40)

text: הִנֵּה כַּעֲנָנִים יַעֲלֶה וְכַסּוּפָה מַרְכְּבוֹתָיו קַלּוּ מִנְּשָׁרִים סוּסָיו אוֹי לָנוּ כִּי שֻׁדָּֽדְנוּ׃
translation: Behold, he will come up as clouds, and his chariots will be as the whirlwind. His horses are swifter than eagles. Woe to us! For we are ruined. (Jeremiah 4:13)

text: אַתֶּם רְאִיתֶם אֲשֶׁר עָשִׂיתִי לְמִצְרָיִם וָאֶשָּׂא אֶתְכֶם עַל כַּנְפֵי נְשָׁרִים וָאָבִא אֶתְכֶם אֵלָֽי׃
translation: 'You have seen what I did to the Egyptians, and how I bore you on eagles' wings, and brought you to myself. (Exodus 19:4)

text: אֶל חִכְּךָ שֹׁפָר כַּנֶּשֶׁר עַל בֵּית יְהוָה יַעַן עָבְרוּ בְרִיתִי וְעַל תּוֹרָתִי פָּשָֽׁעוּ׃
translation: "Put the trumpet to your lips! Something like an eagle is over the LORD's house, because they have broken my covenant and rebelled against my law. (Hosea 8:1)

text: וַיְהִי בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁמִינִי קָרָא מֹשֶׁה לְאַהֲרֹן וּלְבָנָיו וּלְזִקְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
translation: On the eighth day, Moses called Aaron and his sons, and the elders of Israel; (Leviticus 9:1)

text: בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁמִינִי נָשִׂיא לִבְנֵי מְנַשֶּׁה גַּמְלִיאֵל בֶּן פְּדָה צֽוּר׃
translation: On the eighth day Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur, prince of the children of Manasseh, (Numbers 7:54)

text: עַמִּיאֵל הַשִּׁשִּׁי יִשָׂשכָר הַשְּׁבִיעִי פְּעֻלְּתַי הַשְּׁמִינִי כִּי בֵרֲכוֹ אֱלֹהִֽים׃
translation: Ammiel the sixth, Issachar the seventh, and Peullethai the eighth; for God blessed him. (1 Chronicles 26:5)

text: הַשְּׁמִינִי יְשַֽׁעְיָהוּ בָּנָיו וְאֶחָיו שְׁנֵים עָשָֽׂר׃
translation: the eighth to Jeshaiah, his sons and his brothers, twelve; (1 Chronicles 25:15)

text: לְהַקּוֹץ הַשְּׁבִעִי לַאֲבִיָּה הַשְּׁמִינִֽי׃
translation: the seventh to Hakkoz, the eighth to Abijah, (1 Chronicles 24:10)

text: כֵּֽן תַּעֲשֶׂה לְשֹׁרְךָ לְצֹאנֶךָ שִׁבְעַת יָמִים יִהְיֶה עִם אִמּוֹ בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁמִינִי תִּתְּנוֹ לִֽי׃
translation: "You shall not delay to offer from your harvest and from the outflow of your presses. "You shall give the firstborn of your sons to me. (Exodus 22:29)

text: וַיִּסֹּב שְׁמוּאֵל לָלֶכֶת וַיַּחֲזֵק בִּכְנַף מְעִילוֹ וַיִּקָּרַֽע׃
translation: As Samuel turned around to go away, Saul grabbed the skirt of his robe, and it tore. (1 Samuel 15:27)

text: וּפִֽי הַמְּעִיל בְּתוֹכוֹ כְּפִי תַחְרָא שָׂפָה לְפִיו סָבִיב לֹא יִקָּרֵֽעַ׃
translation: The opening of the robe in the middle of it was like the opening of a coat of mail, with a binding around its opening, that it should not be torn. (Exodus 39:23)

text: צֶדֶק לָבַשְׁתִּי וַיִּלְבָּשֵׁנִי כִּֽמְעִיל וְצָנִיף מִשְׁפָּטִֽי׃
translation: I put on righteousness, and it clothed me. My justice was as a robe and a diadem. (Job 29:14)

text: וּבְמִנְחַת הָעֶרֶב קַמְתִּי מִתַּֽעֲנִיתִי וּבְקָרְעִי בִגְדִי וּמְעִילִי וָֽאֶכְרְעָה עַל בִּרְכַּי וָאֶפְרְשָׂה כַפַּי אֶל יְהוָה אֱלֹהָֽי׃
translation: At the evening offering I rose up from my humiliation, even with my garment and my robe torn; and I fell on my knees, and spread out my hands to the LORD my God; (Ezra 9:5)

text: וּמְעִיל קָטֹן תַּעֲשֶׂה לּוֹ אִמּוֹ וְהַעַלְתָה לוֹ מִיָּמִים יָמִימָה בַּֽעֲלוֹתָהּ אֶת אִישָׁהּ לִזְבֹּחַ אֶת זֶבַח הַיָּמִֽים׃
translation: Moreover his mother made him a little robe, and brought it to him from year to year when she came up with her husband to offer the yearly sacrifice. (1 Samuel 2:19)

text: וַיִּשְׂאוּ אֶת עֵינֵיהֶם מֵרָחוֹק וְלֹא הִכִּירֻהוּ וַיִּשְׂאוּ קוֹלָם וַיִּבְכּוּ וַֽיִּקְרְעוּ אִישׁ מְעִלוֹ וַיִּזְרְקוּ עָפָר עַל רָאשֵׁיהֶם הַשָּׁמָֽיְמָה׃
translation: When they lifted up their eyes from a distance, and didn't recognize him, they raised their voices, and wept; and they each tore his robe, and sprinkled dust on their heads toward the sky. (Job 2:12)

text: וְהַטּוּר הַשְּׁלִישִׁי לֶשֶׁם שְׁבוֹ וְאַחְלָֽמָה׃
translation: and the third row a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst; (Exodus 28:19)

text: וַיְמַלְאוּ בוֹ אַרְבָּעָה טוּרֵי אָבֶן טוּר אֹדֶם פִּטְדָה וּבָרֶקֶת הַטּוּר הָאֶחָֽד׃
translation: They set in it four rows of stones. A row of ruby, topaz, and beryl was the first row; (Exodus 39:10)

text: וְהַטּוּר הַשְּׁלִישִׁי לֶשֶׁם שְׁבוֹ וְאַחְלָֽמָה׃
translation: and the third row, a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst; (Exodus 39:12)

text: וּמִלֵּאתָ בוֹ מִלֻּאַת אֶבֶן אַרְבָּעָה טוּרִים אָבֶן טוּר אֹדֶם פִּטְדָה וּבָרֶקֶת הַטּוּר הָאֶחָֽד׃
translation: You shall set in it settings of stones, four rows of stones: a row of ruby, topaz, and beryl shall be the first row; (Exodus 28:17)

text: וּפְקָעִים מִתַּחַת לִשְׂפָתוֹ סָבִיב סֹבְבִים אֹתוֹ עֶשֶׂר בָּֽאַמָּה מַקִּפִים אֶת הַיָּם סָבִיב שְׁנֵי טוּרִים הַפְּקָעִים יְצֻקִים בִּיצֻקָתֽוֹ׃
translation: Under its brim around there were buds which encircled it for ten cubits, encircling the sea. The buds were in two rows, cast when it was cast. (1 Kings 7:24)

text: וּדְמוּת בְּקָרִים תַּחַת לוֹ סָבִיב סָבִיב סוֹבְבִים אֹתוֹ עֶשֶׂר בָּֽאַמָּה מַקִּיפִים אֶת הַיָּם סָבִיב שְׁנַיִם טוּרִים הַבָּקָר יְצוּקִים בְּמֻֽצַקְתּֽוֹ׃
translation: Under it was the likeness of oxen, which encircled it, for ten cubits, encircling the sea. The oxen were in two rows, cast when it was cast. (2 Chronicles 4:3)

text: בְּיַד כָּל אָדָם יַחְתּוֹם לָדַעַת כָּל אַנְשֵׁי מַעֲשֵֽׂהוּ׃
translation: He seals up the hand of every man, that all men whom he has made may know it. (Job 37:7)

text: וְעַל הַחֲתוּמִים נְחֶמְיָה הַתִּרְשָׁתָא בֶּן חֲכַלְיָה וְצִדְקִיָּֽה׃
translation: Seraiah, Azariah, Jeremiah, (Nehemiah 10:2)

text: הֲלֹא הוּא כָּמֻס עִמָּדִי חָתֻם בְּאוֹצְרֹתָֽי׃
translation: "Isn't this laid up in store with me, sealed up among my treasures? (Deuteronomy 32:34)

text: אָז יִגְלֶה אֹזֶן אֲנָשִׁים וּבְמֹסָרָם יַחְתֹּֽם׃
translation: then he opens the ears of men, and seals their instruction, (Job 33:16)

text: וָאֶקַּח אֶת סֵפֶר הַמִּקְנָה אֶת הֶֽחָתוּם הַמִּצְוָה וְהַחֻקִּים וְאֶת הַגָּלֽוּי׃
translation: So I took the deed of the purchase, both that which was sealed, containing the terms and conditions, and that which was open; (Jeremiah 32:11)

text: צוֹר תְּעוּדָה חֲתוֹם תּוֹרָה בְּלִמֻּדָֽי׃
translation: Wrap up the covenant. Seal the law among my disciples. (Isaiah 8:16)

text: וַיָּשִׂימוּ שִׁקּֽוּצֵיהֶם בַּבַּיִת אֲשֶׁר נִקְרָֽא שְׁמִי עָלָיו לְטַמְּאֽוֹ׃
translation: But they set their abominations in the house which is called by my name, to defile it. (Jeremiah 32:34)

text: וּבָאוּ שָׁמָּה וְהֵסִירוּ אֶת כָּל שִׁקּוּצֶיהָ וְאֶת כָּל תּוֹעֲבוֹתֶיהָ מִמֶּֽנָּה׃
translation: "'They will come there, and they will take away all its detestable things and all its abominations from there. (Ezekiel 11:18)

text: וַתִּרְאוּ אֶת שִׁקּוּצֵיהֶם וְאֵת גִּלֻּלֵיהֶם עֵץ וָאֶבֶן כֶּסֶף וְזָהָב אֲשֶׁר עִמָּהֶֽם׃
translation: (for you know how we lived in the land of Egypt, and how we came through the middle of the nations through which you passed; (Deuteronomy 29:16)

text: וּזְרֹעִים מִמֶּנּוּ יַעֲמֹדוּ וְחִלְּלוּ הַמִּקְדָּשׁ הַמָּעוֹז וְהֵסִירוּ הַתָּמִיד וְנָתְנוּ הַשִּׁקּוּץ מְשׁוֹמֵֽם׃
translation: "Forces from him will profane the sanctuary, even the fortress, and will take away the continual burnt offering. Then they will set up the abomination that makes desolate. (Daniel 11:31)

text: וְאֶל לֵב שִׁקּוּצֵיהֶם וְתוֹעֲבוֹתֵיהֶם לִבָּם הֹלֵךְ דַּרְכָּם בְּרֹאשָׁם נָתַתִּי נְאֻם אֲדֹנָי יְהוִֽה׃
translation: But as for them whose heart walks after the heart of their detestable things and their abominations, I will bring their way on their own heads,' says the Lord GOD." (Ezekiel 11:21)

text: אִם תָּשׁוּב יִשְׂרָאֵל נְאֻם יְהוָה אֵלַי תָּשׁוּב וְאִם תָּסִיר שִׁקּוּצֶיךָ מִפָּנַי וְלֹא תָנֽוּד׃
translation: "If you will return, Israel," says the LORD, "if you will return to me, and if you will put away your abominations out of my sight; then you will not be removed; (Jeremiah 4:1)

text: וְֽתִגְזַר אוֹמֶר וְיָקָם לָךְ וְעַל דְּרָכֶיךָ נָגַֽהּ אֽוֹר׃
translation: You will also decree a thing, and it will be established to you. Light will shine on your ways. (Job 22:28)

text: כִּֽי אַתָּה תָּאִיר נֵרִי יְהוָה אֱלֹהַי יַגִּיהַּ חָשְׁכִּֽי׃
translation: For by you, I advance through a troop. By my God, I leap over a wall. (Psalms 18:29)

text: כִּֽי אַתָּה נֵירִי יְהוָה וַיהוָה יַגִּיהַּ חָשְׁכִּֽי׃
translation: For you are my lamp, LORD. The LORD will light up my darkness. (2 Samuel 22:29)

text: וְאֹרַח צַדִּיקִים כְּאוֹר נֹגַהּ הוֹלֵךְ וָאוֹר עַד נְכוֹן הַיּֽוֹם׃
translation: But the path of the righteous is like the dawning light that shines more and more until the perfect day. (Proverbs 4:18)

text: וְנֹגַהּ כָּאוֹר תִּֽהְיֶה קַרְנַיִם מִיָּדוֹ לוֹ וְשָׁם חֶבְיוֹן עֻזֹּֽה׃
translation: His splendor is like the sunrise. Rays shine from his hand, where his power is hidden. (Habakkuk 3:4)

text: וְהָלְכוּ גוֹיִם לְאוֹרֵךְ וּמְלָכִים לְנֹגַהּ זַרְחֵֽךְ׃
translation: Nations will come to your light, and kings to the brightness of your rising. (Isaiah 60:3)

text: וָאֱהִי כְּאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר לֹא שֹׁמֵעַ וְאֵין בְּפִיו תּוֹכָחֽוֹת׃
translation: For I hope in you, LORD. You will answer, Lord my God. (Psalms 38:15)

text: מוּסַר יְהוָה בְּנִי אַל תִּמְאָס וְאַל תָּקֹץ בְּתוֹכַחְתּֽוֹ׃
translation: My son, don't despise the LORD's discipline, neither be weary of his correction; (Proverbs 3:11)

text: שֵׁבֶט וְתוֹכַחַת יִתֵּן חָכְמָה וְנַעַר מְשֻׁלָּח מֵבִישׁ אִמּֽוֹ׃
translation: The rod of correction gives wisdom, but a child left to himself causes shame to his mother. (Proverbs 29:15)

text: כִּי נֵר מִצְוָה וְתוֹרָה אוֹר וְדֶרֶךְ חַיִּים תּוֹכְחוֹת מוּסָֽר׃
translation: For the commandment is a lamp, and the law is light. Reproofs of instruction are the way of life, (Proverbs 6:23)

text: אֹרַח לְחַיִּים שׁוֹמֵר מוּסָר וְעוֹזֵב תּוֹכַחַת מַתְעֶֽה׃
translation: He is in the way of life who heeds correction, but he who forsakes reproof leads others astray. (Proverbs 10:17)

text: אֹהֵב מוּסָר אֹהֵֽב דָּעַת וְשֹׂנֵא תוֹכַחַת בָּֽעַר׃
translation: Whoever loves correction loves knowledge, but he who hates reproof is stupid. (Proverbs 12:1)

text: שִׂפְתֵי צַדִּיק יִרְעוּ רַבִּים וֶֽאֱוִילִים בַּחֲסַר לֵב יָמֽוּתוּ׃
translation: The lips of the righteous feed many, but the foolish die for lack of understanding. (Proverbs 10:21)

text: חֲכַם לֵב יִקַּח מִצְוֺת וֶאֱוִיל שְׂפָתַיִם יִלָּבֵֽט׃
translation: The wise in heart accept commandments, but a chattering fool will fall. (Proverbs 10:8)

text: דֶּרֶךְ אֱוִיל יָשָׁר בְּעֵינָיו וְשֹׁמֵעַ לְעֵצָה חָכָֽם׃
translation: The way of a fool is right in his own eyes, but he who is wise listens to counsel. (Proverbs 12:15)

text: כָּבוֹד לָאִישׁ שֶׁבֶת מֵרִיב וְכָל אֱוִיל יִתְגַּלָּֽע׃
translation: It is an honor for a man to keep aloof from strife, but every fool will be quarreling. (Proverbs 20:3)

text: רָאמוֹת לֶֽאֱוִיל חָכְמוֹת בַּשַּׁעַר לֹא יִפְתַּח פִּֽיהוּ׃
translation: Wisdom is too high for a fool. He doesn't open his mouth in the gate. (Proverbs 24:7)

text: אֱוִלִים יָלִיץ אָשָׁם וּבֵין יְשָׁרִים רָצֽוֹן׃
translation: Fools mock at making atonement for sins, but among the upright there is good will. (Proverbs 14:9)

text: הַֽלְלוּ אֶת יְהוָה מִן הָאָרֶץ תַּנִּינִים וְכָל תְּהֹמֽוֹת׃
translation: Praise the LORD from the earth, you great sea creatures, and all depths, (Psalms 148:7)

text: אַתָּה פוֹרַרְתָּ בְעָזְּךָ יָם שִׁבַּרְתָּ רָאשֵׁי תַנִּינִים עַל הַמָּֽיִם׃
translation: You divided the sea by your strength. You broke the heads of the sea monsters in the waters. (Psalms 74:13)

text: וַיַּשְׁלִיכוּ אִישׁ מַטֵּהוּ וַיִּהְיוּ לְתַנִּינִם וַיִּבְלַע מַטֵּֽה אַהֲרֹן אֶת מַטֹּתָֽם׃
translation: For they each cast down their rods, and they became serpents; but Aaron's rod swallowed up their rods. (Exodus 7:12)

text: וְעָנָה אִיִּים בְּאַלְמנוֹתָיו וְתַנִּים בְּהֵיכְלֵי עֹנֶג וְקָרוֹב לָבוֹא עִתָּהּ וְיָמֶיהָ לֹא יִמָּשֵֽׁכוּ׃
translation: Hyenas will cry in their fortresses, and jackals in the pleasant palaces. Her time is near to come, and her days will not be prolonged. (Isaiah 13:22)

text: וְנָתַתִּי אֶת יְרוּשָׁלִַם לְגַלִּים מְעוֹן תַּנִּים וְאֶת עָרֵי יְהוּדָה אֶתֵּן שְׁמָמָה מִבְּלִי יוֹשֵֽׁב׃
translation: I will weep and wail for the mountains, and lament for the pastures of the wilderness, because they are burned up, so that no one passes through; Men can't hear the voice of the livestock. Both the birds of the sky and the animals have fled. They are gone. (Jeremiah 9:10)

text: קוֹל שְׁמוּעָה הִנֵּה בָאָה וְרַעַשׁ גָּדוֹל מֵאֶרֶץ צָפוֹן לָשׂוּם אֶת עָרֵי יְהוּדָה שְׁמָמָה מְעוֹן תַּנִּֽים׃
translation: The voice of news, behold, it comes, and a great commotion out of the north country, to make the cities of Judah a desolation, a dwelling place of jackals. (Jeremiah 10:22)

text: וְיֵרְדְּ מִיָּם עַד יָם וּמִנָּהָר עַד אַפְסֵי אָֽרֶץ׃
translation: He shall have dominion also from sea to sea, from the River to the ends of the earth. (Psalms 72:8)

text: מַטֵּֽה עֻזְּךָ יִשְׁלַח יְהוָה מִצִּיּוֹן רְדֵה בְּקֶרֶב אֹיְבֶֽיךָ׃
translation: The LORD will send out the rod of your strength out of Zion. Rule among your enemies. (Psalms 110:2)

text: וְנָתַתִּי פָנַי בָּכֶם וְנִגַּפְתֶּם לִפְנֵי אֹיְבֵיכֶם וְרָדוּ בָכֶם שֹֽׂנְאֵיכֶם וְנַסְתֶּם וְאֵין רֹדֵף אֶתְכֶֽם׃
translation: I will set my face against you, and you will be struck before your enemies. Those who hate you will rule over you; and you will flee when no one pursues you. (Leviticus 26:17)

text: הַנְּבִיאִים נִבְּאוּ בַשֶּׁקֶר וְהַכֹּהֲנִים יִרְדּוּ עַל יְדֵיהֶם וְעַמִּי אָהֲבוּ כֵן וּמַֽה תַּעֲשׂוּ לְאַחֲרִיתָֽהּ׃
translation: The prophets prophesy falsely, and the priests rule by their own authority; and my people love to have it so. What will you do in the end of it? (Jeremiah 5:31)

text: מִן הַמַּמְלָכוֹת תִּהְיֶה שְׁפָלָה וְלֹֽא תִתְנַשֵּׂא עוֹד עַל הַגּוֹיִם וְהִמְעַטְתִּים לְבִלְתִּי רְדוֹת בַּגּוֹיִֽם׃
translation: It will be the lowest of the kingdoms. It won't lift itself up above the nations any more. I will diminish them so that they will no longer rule over the nations. (Ezekiel 29:15)

text: אֵלֶּה שָׂרֵי הַנִּצָּבִים אֲשֶׁר עַל הַמְּלָאכָה לִשְׁלֹמֹה חֲמִשִּׁים וַחֲמֵשׁ מֵאוֹת הָרֹדִים בָּעָם הָעֹשִׂים בַּמְּלָאכָֽה׃
translation: These were the five hundred fifty chief officers who were over Solomon's work, who ruled over the people who labored in the work. (1 Kings 9:23)

text: אָדָם עָרוּם כֹּסֶה דָּעַת וְלֵב כְּסִילִים יִקְרָא אִוֶּֽלֶת׃
translation: A prudent man keeps his knowledge, but the hearts of fools proclaim foolishness. (Proverbs 12:23)

text: וַיִּֽהְיוּ שְׁנֵיהֶם עֲרוּמִּים הָֽאָדָם וְאִשְׁתּוֹ וְלֹא יִתְבֹּשָֽׁשׁוּ׃
translation: The man and his wife were both naked, and they were not ashamed. (Genesis 2:25)

text: כִּי יְאַלֵּף עֲוֺנְךָ פִיךָ וְתִבְחַר לְשׁוֹן עֲרוּמִֽים׃
translation: For your iniquity teaches your mouth, and you choose the language of the crafty. (Job 15:5)

text: כִּֽי תַחְבֹּל אַחֶיךָ חִנָּם וּבִגְדֵי עֲרוּמִּים תַּפְשִֽׁיט׃
translation: For you have taken pledges from your brother for nothing, and stripped the naked of their clothing. (Job 22:6)

text: כָּל עָרוּם יַעֲשֶׂה בְדָעַת וּכְסִיל יִפְרֹשׂ אִוֶּֽלֶת׃
translation: Every prudent man acts from knowledge, but a fool exposes folly. (Proverbs 13:16)

text: חָכְמַת עָרוּם הָבִין דַּרְכּוֹ וְאִוֶּלֶת כְּסִילִים מִרְמָֽה׃
translation: The wisdom of the prudent is to think about his way, but the folly of fools is deceit. (Proverbs 14:8)

text: שָׁלַף וַיֵּצֵא מִגֵּוָה וּבָרָק מִֽמְּרֹרָתוֹ יַהֲלֹךְ עָלָיו אֵמִֽים׃
translation: He draws it out, and it comes out of his body. Yes, the glittering point comes out of his liver. Terrors are on him. (Job 20:25)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר הַגֹּאֵל לְבֹעַז קְנֵה לָךְ וַיִּשְׁלֹף נַעֲלֽוֹ׃
translation: So the near kinsman said to Boaz, "Buy it for yourself," then he took off his sandal. (Ruth 4:8)

text: וְיָקְטָן יָלַד אֶת אַלְמוֹדָד וְאֶת שָׁלֶף וְאֶת חֲצַרְמָוֶת וְאֶת יָֽרַח׃
translation: Joktan became the father of Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah, (Genesis 10:26)

text: וְיָקְטָן יָלַד אֶת אַלְמוֹדָד וְאֶת שָׁלֶף וְאֶת חֲצַרְמָוֶת וְאֶת יָֽרַח׃
translation: Joktan became the father of Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah, (1 Chronicles 1:20)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר לְיֶתֶר בְּכוֹרוֹ קוּם הֲרֹג אוֹתָם וְלֹא שָׁלַף הַנַּעַר חַרְבּוֹ כִּי יָרֵא כִּי עוֹדֶנּוּ נָֽעַר׃
translation: He said to Jether his firstborn, "Get up and kill them!" But the youth didn't draw his sword; for he was afraid, because he was yet a youth. (Judges 8:20)

text: וְאִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל הִתְפָּֽקְדוּ לְבַד מִבִּנְיָמִן אַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת אֶלֶף אִישׁ שֹׁלֵֽף חָרֶב כָּל זֶה אִישׁ מִלְחָמָֽה׃
translation: The men of Israel, besides Benjamin, were counted four hundred thousand men who drew sword. All these were men of war. (Judges 20:17)

text: וְאֶת הַחִתִּי וְאֶת הַפְּרִזִּי וְאֶת הָרְפָאִֽים׃
translation: the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Rephaim, (Genesis 15:20)

text: וּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל יָשְׁבוּ בְּקֶרֶב הַֽכְּנַעֲנִי הַחִתִּי וְהָֽאֱמֹרִי וְהַפְּרִזִּי וְהַחִוִּי וְהַיְבוּסִֽי׃
translation: The children of Israel lived among the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Amorites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites. (Judges 3:5)

text: וְשָׁלַחְתִּי לְפָנֶיךָ מַלְאָךְ וְגֵֽרַשְׁתִּי אֶת הַֽכְּנַעֲנִי הָֽאֱמֹרִי וְהַֽחִתִּי וְהַפְּרִזִּי הַחִוִּי וְהַיְבוּסִֽי׃
translation: I will send an angel before you; and I will drive out the Canaanite, the Amorite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite. (Exodus 33:2)

text: וַֽיִּמְצְאוּ אֶת אֲדֹנִי בֶזֶק בְּבֶזֶק וַיִּֽלָּחֲמוּ בּוֹ וַיַּכּוּ אֶת הַֽכְּנַעֲנִי וְאֶת הַפְּרִזִּֽי׃
translation: They found Adoni-Bezek in Bezek, and they fought against him. They struck the Canaanites and the Perizzites. (Judges 1:5)

text: כִּֽי יֵלֵךְ מַלְאָכִי לְפָנֶיךָ וֶהֱבִֽיאֲךָ אֶל הָֽאֱמֹרִי וְהַחִתִּי וְהַפְּרִזִּי וְהַֽכְּנַעֲנִי הַחִוִּי וְהַיְבוּסִי וְהִכְחַדְתִּֽיו׃
translation: For my angel shall go before you, and bring you in to the Amorite, the Hittite, the Perizzite, the Canaanite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite; and I will cut them off. (Exodus 23:23)

text: כָּל אֵלֶּה עָרִים בְּצֻרוֹת חוֹמָה גְבֹהָה דְּלָתַיִם וּבְרִיחַ לְבַד מֵעָרֵי הַפְּרָזִי הַרְבֵּה מְאֹֽד׃
translation: All these were cities fortified with high walls, gates, and bars, in addition to a great many villages without walls. (Deuteronomy 3:5)

text: שִׁוִּיתִי יְהוָה לְנֶגְדִּי תָמִיד כִּי מִֽימִינִי בַּל אֶמּֽוֹט׃
translation: I have set the LORD always before me. Because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved. (Psalms 16:8)

text: אַל תַּעַן כְּסִיל כְּאִוַּלְתּוֹ פֶּֽן תִּשְׁוֶה לּוֹ גַם אָֽתָּה׃
translation: Don't answer a fool according to his folly, lest you also be like him. (Proverbs 26:4)

text: וְאֶל מִי תְדַמְּיוּנִי וְאֶשְׁוֶה יֹאמַר קָדֽוֹשׁ׃
translation: "To whom then will you liken me? Who is my equal?" says the Holy One. (Isaiah 40:25)

text: דֶּֽרֶךְ אֱמוּנָה בָחָרְתִּי מִשְׁפָּטֶיךָ שִׁוִּֽיתִי׃
translation: I have chosen the way of truth. I have set your ordinances before me. (Psalms 119:30)

text: אִם לֹא שִׁוִּיתִי וְדוֹמַמְתִּי נַפְשִׁי כְּגָמֻל עֲלֵי אִמּוֹ כַּגָּמֻל עָלַי נַפְשִֽׁי׃
translation: Surely I have stilled and quieted my soul, like a weaned child with his mother, like a weaned child is my soul within me. (Psalms 131:2)

text: לְמִי תְדַמְיוּנִי וְתַשְׁווּ וְתַמְשִׁלוּנִי וְנִדְמֶֽה׃
translation: "To whom will you compare me, and consider my equal, and compare me, as if we were the same? (Isaiah 46:5)

text: אַל תּוֹכַח לֵץ פֶּן יִשְׂנָאֶךָּ הוֹכַח לְחָכָם וְיֶאֱהָבֶֽךָּ׃
translation: Don't reprove a scoffer, lest he hate you. Reprove a wise person, and he will love you. (Proverbs 9:8)

text: וְהֵם לֹא יָֽדְעוּ כִּי שֹׁמֵעַ יוֹסֵף כִּי הַמֵּלִיץ בֵּינֹתָֽם׃
translation: They didn't know that Joseph understood them; for there was an interpreter between them. (Genesis 42:23)

text: אִם חָכַמְתָּ חָכַמְתָּ לָּךְ וְלַצְתָּ לְֽבַדְּךָ תִשָּֽׂא׃
translation: If you are wise, you are wise for yourself. If you mock, you alone will bear it. (Proverbs 9:12)

text: בִּקֶּשׁ לֵץ חָכְמָה וָאָיִן וְדַעַת לְנָבוֹן נָקָֽל׃
translation: A scoffer seeks wisdom, and doesn't find it, but knowledge comes easily to a discerning person. (Proverbs 14:6)

text: לֹא יֶאֱהַב לֵץ הוֹכֵחַֽ לוֹ אֶל חֲכָמִים לֹא יֵלֵֽךְ׃
translation: A scoffer doesn't love to be reproved; he will not go to the wise. (Proverbs 15:12)

text: מְלִיצַי רֵעָי אֶל אֱלוֹהַ דָּלְפָה עֵינִֽי׃
translation: My friends scoff at me. My eyes pour out tears to God, (Job 16:20)

text: בְּפֶשַׁע שְׂפָתַיִם מוֹקֵשׁ רָע וַיֵּצֵא מִצָּרָה צַדִּֽיק׃
translation: An evil man is trapped by sinfulness of lips, but the righteous shall come out of trouble. (Proverbs 12:13)

text: פִּֽי כְסִיל מְחִתָּה לוֹ וּשְׂפָתָיו מוֹקֵשׁ נַפְשֽׁוֹ׃
translation: A fool's mouth is his destruction, and his lips are a snare to his soul. (Proverbs 18:7)

text: מוֹקֵשׁ אָדָם יָלַע קֹדֶשׁ וְאַחַר נְדָרִים לְבַקֵּֽר׃
translation: It is a snare to a man to make a rash dedication, then later to consider his vows. (Proverbs 20:25)

text: פֶּן תֶּאֱלַף ארחתו אֹֽרְחֹתָיו וְלָקַחְתָּ מוֹקֵשׁ לְנַפְשֶֽׁךָ׃
translation: lest you learn his ways and ensnare your soul. (Proverbs 22:25)

text: בְּפֶשַֽׁע אִישׁ רָע מוֹקֵשׁ וְצַדִּיק יָרוּן וְשָׂמֵֽחַ׃
translation: An evil man is snared by his sin, but the righteous can sing and be glad. (Proverbs 29:6)

text: חֶבְלֵי שְׁאוֹל סַבֻּנִי קִדְּמֻנִי מֹֽקְשֵׁי מָֽוֶת׃
translation: The cords of Sheol were around me. The snares of death caught me. (2 Samuel 22:6)

text: לִקְדוֹשִׁים אֲשֶׁר בָּאָרֶץ הֵמָּה וְאַדִּירֵי כָּל חֶפְצִי בָֽם׃
translation: As for the saints who are in the earth, they are the excellent ones in whom is all my delight. (Psalms 16:3)

text: וַֽיַּהֲרֹג מְלָכִים אַדִּירִים כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
translation: and killed mighty kings, for his loving kindness endures forever; (Psalms 136:18)

text: יְהוָה אֲדֹנֵינוּ מָֽה אַדִּיר שִׁמְךָ בְּכָל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר תְּנָה הוֹדְךָ עַל הַשָּׁמָֽיִם׃
translation: From the lips of babes and infants you have established strength, because of your adversaries, that you might silence the enemy and the avenger. (Psalms 8:2)

text: נָמוּ רֹעֶיךָ מֶלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר יִשְׁכְּנוּ אַדִּירֶיךָ נָפֹשׁוּ עַמְּךָ עַל הֶהָרִים וְאֵין מְקַבֵּֽץ׃
translation: Your shepherds slumber, king of Assyria. Your nobles lie down. Your people are scattered on the mountains, and there is no one to gather them. (Nahum 3:18)

text: הֵילֵל בְּרוֹשׁ כִּֽי נָפַל אֶרֶז אֲשֶׁר אַדִּרִים שֻׁדָּדוּ הֵילִילוּ אַלּוֹנֵי בָשָׁן כִּי יָרַד יַעַר הבצור הַבָּצִֽיר׃
translation: Wail, cypress tree, for the cedar has fallen, because the stately ones are destroyed. Wail, you oaks of Bashan, for the strong forest has come down. (Zechariah 11:2)

text: אוֹי לָנוּ מִי יַצִּילֵנוּ מִיַּד הָאֱלֹהִים הָאַדִּירִים הָאֵלֶּה אֵלֶּה הֵם הָאֱלֹהִים הַמַּכִּים אֶת מִצְרַיִם בְּכָל מַכָּה בַּמִּדְבָּֽר׃
translation: Woe to us! Who shall deliver us out of the hand of these mighty gods? These are the gods that struck the Egyptians with all kinds of plagues in the wilderness. (1 Samuel 4:8)

text: וְנָתַתָּ אֶת הַכַּפֹּרֶת עַל אֲרוֹן הָעֵדֻת בְּקֹדֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִֽׁים׃
translation: You shall put the mercy seat on the ark of the covenant in the most holy place. (Exodus 26:34)

text: אֶת הָאָרֹן וְאֶת בַּדָּיו אֶת הַכַּפֹּרֶת וְאֵת פָּרֹכֶת הַמָּסָֽךְ׃
translation: the ark, and its poles, the mercy seat, the veil of the screen; (Exodus 35:12)

text: אֶת אֲרֹן הָעֵדֻת וְאֶת בַּדָּיו וְאֵת הַכַּפֹּֽרֶת׃
translation: the ark of the covenant with its poles, the mercy seat, (Exodus 39:35)

text: וְעָשִׂיתָ כַפֹּרֶת זָהָב טָהוֹר אַמָּתַיִם וָחֵצִי אָרְכָּהּ וְאַמָּה וָחֵצִי רָחְבָּֽהּ׃
translation: You shall make a mercy seat of pure gold. Two and a half cubits shall be its length, and a cubit and a half its width. (Exodus 25:17)

text: וַיַּעַשׂ כַּפֹּרֶת זָהָב טָהוֹר אַמָּתַיִם וָחֵצִי אָרְכָּהּ וְאַמָּה וָחֵצִי רָחְבָּֽהּ׃
translation: He made a mercy seat of pure gold. Its length was two and a half cubits, and a cubit and a half its width. (Exodus 37:6)

text: וְנָתַתָּ אֶת הַכַּפֹּרֶת עַל הָאָרֹן מִלְמָעְלָה וְאֶל הָאָרֹן תִּתֵּן אֶת הָעֵדֻת אֲשֶׁר אֶתֵּן אֵלֶֽיךָ׃
translation: You shall put the mercy seat on top of the ark, and in the ark you shall put the covenant that I will give you. (Exodus 25:21)

text: עַל כֵּן סְבִיבוֹתֶיךָ פַחִים וִֽיבַהֶלְךָ פַּחַד פִּתְאֹֽם׃
translation: Therefore snares are around you. Sudden fear troubles you, (Job 22:10)

text: נָתְנוּ רְשָׁעִים פַּח לִי וּמִפִּקּוּדֶיךָ לֹא תָעִֽיתִי׃
translation: The wicked have laid a snare for me, yet I haven't gone astray from your precepts. (Psalms 119:110)

text: יֹאחֵז בְּעָקֵב פָּח יַחֲזֵק עָלָיו צַמִּֽים׃
translation: A snare will take him by the heel. A trap will catch him. (Job 18:9)

text: יְהִֽי שֻׁלְחָנָם לִפְנֵיהֶם לְפָח וְלִשְׁלוֹמִים לְמוֹקֵֽשׁ׃
translation: Let their eyes be darkened, so that they can't see. Let their backs be continually bent. (Psalms 69:23)

text: בְּהִתְעַטֵּף עָלַי רוּחִי וְאַתָּה יָדַעְתָּ נְֽתִיבָתִי בְּאֹֽרַח זוּ אֲהַלֵּךְ טָמְנוּ פַח לִֽי׃
translation: Look on my right, and see; for there is no one who is concerned for me. Refuge has fled from me. No one cares for my soul. (Psalms 142:4)

text: צֹפֶה אֶפְרַיִם עִם אֱלֹהָי נָבִיא פַּח יָקוֹשׁ עַל כָּל דְּרָכָיו מַשְׂטֵמָה בְּבֵית אֱלֹהָֽיו׃
translation: A prophet watches over Ephraim with my God. A fowler's snare is on all of his paths, and hostility in the house of his God. (Hosea 9:8)

text: וּנְתַתִּיו בְּיַֽד הַזָּרִים לָבַז וּלְרִשְׁעֵי הָאָרֶץ לְשָׁלָל וחללה וְחִלְּלֽוּהוּ׃
translation: I will give it into the hands of the strangers for a prey, and to the wicked of the earth for a plunder; and they will profane it. (Ezekiel 7:21)

text: וְהוֹשַׁעְתִּי לְצֹאנִי וְלֹֽא תִהְיֶינָה עוֹד לָבַז וְשָׁפַטְתִּי בֵּין שֶׂה לָשֶֽׂה׃
translation: therefore I will save my flock, and they will no more be a prey. I will judge between sheep and sheep. (Ezekiel 34:22)

text: וְנָטַשְׁתִּי אֵת שְׁאֵרִית נַחֲלָתִי וּנְתַתִּים בְּיַד אֹֽיְבֵיהֶם וְהָיוּ לְבַז וְלִמְשִׁסָּה לְכָל אֹיְבֵיהֶֽם׃
translation: I will cast off the remnant of my inheritance and deliver them into the hands of their enemies. They will become a prey and a plunder to all their enemies, (2 Kings 21:14)

text: וְטַפְּכֶם אֲשֶׁר אֲמַרְתֶּם לָבַז יִהְיֶה וְהֵבֵיאתִי אֹתָם וְיָֽדְעוּ אֶת הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר מְאַסְתֶּם בָּֽהּ׃
translation: But I will bring in your little ones that you said should be captured or killed, and they shall know the land which you have rejected. (Numbers 14:31)

text: וְלֹא יִהְיוּ עוֹד בַּז לַגּוֹיִם וְחַיַּת הָאָרֶץ לֹא תֹאכְלֵם וְיָשְׁבוּ לָבֶטַח וְאֵין מַחֲרִֽיד׃
translation: They will no more be a prey to the nations, neither will the animals of the earth devour them; but they will dwell securely, and no one will make them afraid. (Ezekiel 34:28)

text: מִשְׁטַח חֲרָמִים תִּֽהְיֶה בְּתוֹךְ הַיָּם כִּי אֲנִי דִבַּרְתִּי נְאֻם אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה וְהָיְתָה לְבַז לַגּוֹיִֽם׃
translation: She will be a place for the spreading of nets in the middle of the sea; for I have spoken it,' says the Lord GOD. 'She will become plunder for the nations. (Ezekiel 26:5)

text: מִן שָׁמַיִם נִלְחָמוּ הַכּֽוֹכָבִים מִמְּסִלּוֹתָם נִלְחֲמוּ עִם סִיסְרָֽא׃
translation: From the sky the stars fought. From their courses, they fought against Sisera. (Judges 5:20)

text: מְסִלַּת יְשָׁרִים סוּר מֵרָע שֹׁמֵר נַפְשׁוֹ נֹצֵר דַּרְכּֽוֹ׃
translation: The highway of the upright is to depart from evil. He who keeps his way preserves his soul. (Proverbs 16:17)

text: אַשְׁרֵי אָדָם עֽוֹז לוֹ בָךְ מְסִלּוֹת בִּלְבָבָֽם׃
translation: Passing through the valley of Weeping, they make it a place of springs. Yes, the autumn rain covers it with blessings. (Psalms 84:6)

text: קוֹל קוֹרֵא בַּמִּדְבָּר פַּנּוּ דֶּרֶךְ יְהוָה יַשְּׁרוּ בָּעֲרָבָה מְסִלָּה לֵאלֹהֵֽינוּ׃
translation: The voice of one who calls out, "Prepare the way of the LORD in the wilderness! Make a level highway in the desert for our God. (Isaiah 40:3)

text: וְשַׂמְתִּי כָל הָרַי לַדָּרֶךְ וּמְסִלֹּתַי יְרֻמֽוּן׃
translation: I will make all my mountains a road, and my highways shall be exalted. (Isaiah 49:11)

text: נָשַׁמּוּ מְסִלּוֹת שָׁבַת עֹבֵר אֹרַח הֵפֵר בְּרִית מָאַס עָרִים לֹא חָשַׁב אֱנֽוֹשׁ׃
translation: The highways are desolate. The traveling man ceases. The covenant is broken. He has despised the cities. He doesn't respect man. (Isaiah 33:8)

text: הָאֵל הַנֹּתֵן נְקָמֹת לִי וּמוֹרִיד עַמִּים תַּחְתֵּֽנִי׃
translation: even the God who executes vengeance for me, who brings down peoples under me, (2 Samuel 22:48)

text: הָאֵל הַנּוֹתֵן נְקָמוֹת לִי וַיַּדְבֵּר עַמִּים תַּחְתָּֽי׃
translation: He rescues me from my enemies. Yes, you lift me up above those who rise up against me. You deliver me from the violent man. (Psalms 18:48)

text: לַעֲשׂוֹת נְקָמָה בַּגּוֹיִם תּֽוֹכֵחֹת בַּל אֻמִּֽים׃
translation: to execute vengeance on the nations, and punishments on the peoples; (Psalms 149:7)

text: רָאִיתָה כָּל נִקְמָתָם כָּל מַחְשְׁבֹתָם לִֽי׃
translation: You have seen all their vengeance and all their plans against me. (Lamentations 3:60)

text: לָמָּה יֹאמְרוּ הַגּוֹיִם אַיֵּה אֱֽלֹהֵיהֶם יִוָּדַע בגיים בַּגּוֹיִם לְעֵינֵינוּ נִקְמַת דַּֽם עֲבָדֶיךָ הַשָּׁפֽוּךְ׃
translation: Why should the nations say, "Where is their God?" Let it be known among the nations, before our eyes, that vengeance for your servants' blood is being poured out. (Psalms 79:10)

text: וְעָשִׂיתִי בָם נְקָמוֹת גְּדֹלוֹת בְּתוֹכְחוֹת חֵמָה וְיָֽדְעוּ כִּֽי אֲנִי יְהוָה בְּתִתִּי אֶת נִקְמָתִי בָּֽם׃
translation: I will execute great vengeance on them with wrathful rebukes. Then they will know that I am the LORD, when I lay my vengeance on them."'" (Ezekiel 25:17)

text: לֹא יוֹעִיל הוֹן בְּיוֹם עֶבְרָה וּצְדָקָה תַּצִּיל מִמָּֽוֶת׃
translation: Riches don't profit in the day of wrath, but righteousness delivers from death. (Proverbs 11:4)

text: כָּל הוֹן יָקָר נִמְצָא נְמַלֵּא בָתֵּינוּ שָׁלָֽל׃
translation: We'll find all valuable wealth. We'll fill our houses with plunder. (Proverbs 1:13)

text: כַּבֵּד אֶת יְהוָה מֵהוֹנֶךָ וּמֵרֵאשִׁית כָּל תְּבוּאָתֶֽךָ׃
translation: Honor the LORD with your substance, with the first fruits of all your increase; (Proverbs 3:9)

text: הוֹן מֵהֶבֶל יִמְעָט וְקֹבֵץ עַל יָד יַרְבֶּֽה׃
translation: Wealth gained dishonestly dwindles away, but he who gathers by hand makes it grow. (Proverbs 13:11)

text: הוֹן יֹסִיף רֵעִים רַבִּים וְדָל מֵרֵעהוּ יִפָּרֵֽד׃
translation: Wealth adds many friends, but the poor is separated from his friend. (Proverbs 19:4)

text: בַּיִת וָהוֹן נַחֲלַת אָבוֹת וּמֵיְהוָה אִשָּׁה מַשְׂכָּֽלֶת׃
translation: House and riches are an inheritance from fathers, but a prudent wife is from the LORD. (Proverbs 19:14)

text: גַּם כָּל יָמָיו בַּחֹשֶׁךְ יֹאכֵל וְכָעַס הַרְבֵּה וְחָלְיוֹ וָקָֽצֶף׃
translation: This also is a grievous evil, that in all points as he came, so shall he go. And what profit does he have who labors for the wind? (Ecclesiastes 5:16)

text: וַיְהִי גְּבוּלָם חֶלְקַת וַחֲלִי וָבֶטֶן וְאַכְשָֽׁף׃
translation: Their border was Helkath, Hali, Beten, Achshaph, (Joshua 19:25)

text: אוֹי לִי עַל שִׁבְרִי נַחְלָה מַכָּתִי וַאֲנִי אָמַרְתִּי אַךְ זֶה חֳלִי וְאֶשָּׂאֶֽנּוּ׃
translation: Woe is me because of my injury! My wound is serious; but I said, "Truly this is my grief, and I must bear it." (Jeremiah 10:19)

text: וְהִפְלָא יְהוָה אֶת מַכֹּתְךָ וְאֵת מַכּוֹת זַרְעֶךָ מַכּוֹת גְּדֹלוֹת וְנֶאֱמָנוֹת וָחֳלָיִם רָעִים וְנֶאֱמָנִֽים׃
translation: then the LORD will make your plagues and the plagues of your offspring fearful, even great plagues, and of long duration, and severe sicknesses, and of long duration. (Deuteronomy 28:59)

text: מַה יָּפוּ פְעָמַיִךְ בַּנְּעָלִים בַּת נָדִיב חַמּוּקֵי יְרֵכַיִךְ כְּמוֹ חֲלָאִים מַעֲשֵׂה יְדֵי אָמָּֽן׃
translation: Your body is like a round goblet, no mixed wine is wanting. Your waist is like a heap of wheat, set about with lilies. (Song of Solomon 7:2)

text: גַּם כָּל חֳלִי וְכָל מַכָּה אֲשֶׁר לֹא כָתוּב בְּסֵפֶר הַתּוֹרָה הַזֹּאת יַעְלֵם יְהוָה עָלֶיךָ עַד הִשָּׁמְדָֽךְ׃
translation: Also every sickness and every plague which is not written in the book of this law, the LORD will bring them on you until you are destroyed. (Deuteronomy 28:61)

text: וּבְנֵי עֵלִי בְּנֵי בְלִיָּעַל לֹא יָדְעוּ אֶת יְהוָֽה׃
translation: Now the sons of Eli were wicked men. They didn't know the LORD. (1 Samuel 2:12)

text: וּבְלִיַּעַל כְּקוֹץ מֻנָד כֻּלָּהַם כִּֽי לֹא בְיָד יִקָּֽחוּ׃
translation: But all the ungodly will be as thorns to be thrust away, because they can't be taken with the hand. (2 Samuel 23:6)

text: עֵד בְּלִיַּעַל יָלִיץ מִשְׁפָּט וּפִי רְשָׁעִים יְבַלַּע אָֽוֶן׃
translation: A corrupt witness mocks justice, and the mouth of the wicked gulps down iniquity. (Proverbs 19:28)

text: מִמֵּךְ יָצָא חֹשֵׁב עַל יְהוָה רָעָה יֹעֵץ בְּלִיָּֽעַל׃
translation: One has gone out of you who devises evil against the LORD, who counsels wickedness. (Nahum 1:11)

text: דְּֽבַר בְּלִיַּעַל יָצוּק בּוֹ וַאֲשֶׁר שָׁכַב לֹא יוֹסִיף לָקֽוּם׃
translation: Yes, my own familiar friend, in whom I trusted, who ate bread with me, has lifted up his heel against me. (Psalms 41:9)

text: אָדָם בְּלִיַּעַל אִישׁ אָוֶן הוֹלֵךְ עִקְּשׁוּת פֶּֽה׃
translation: A worthless person, a man of iniquity, is he who walks with a perverse mouth, (Proverbs 6:12)

text: הַשְּׂמֵחִים אֱלֵי גִיל יָשִׂישׂוּ כִּי יִמְצְאוּ קָֽבֶר׃
translation: who rejoice exceedingly, and are glad, when they can find the grave? (Job 3:22)

text: יַחְפְּרוּ בָעֵמֶק וְיָשִׂישׂ בְּכֹחַ יֵצֵא לִקְרַאת נָֽשֶׁק׃
translation: He paws in the valley, and rejoices in his strength. He goes out to meet the armed men. (Job 39:21)

text: שָׂשׂ אָנֹכִֽי עַל אִמְרָתֶךָ כְּמוֹצֵא שָׁלָל רָֽב׃
translation: I rejoice at your word, as one who finds great plunder. (Psalms 119:162)

text: בְּדֶרֶךְ עֵדְוֺתֶיךָ שַׂשְׂתִּי כְּעַל כָּל הֽוֹן׃
translation: I have rejoiced in the way of your testimonies, as much as in all riches. (Psalms 119:14)

text: וְנַפְשִׁי תָּגִיל בַּיהוָה תָּשִׂישׂ בִּישׁוּעָתֽוֹ׃
translation: My soul shall be joyful in the LORD. It shall rejoice in his salvation. (Psalms 35:9)

text: יָשִׂישׂוּ וְיִשְׂמְחוּ בְּךָ כָּֽל מְבַקְשֶׁיךָ יֹאמְרוּ תָמִיד יִגְדַּל יְהוָה אֹֽהֲבֵי תְּשׁוּעָתֶֽךָ׃
