translation: But I am poor and needy. May the Lord think about me. You are my help and my deliverer. Don't delay, my God. (Psalms 40:17)

text: וְשָׁמַעְתָּ הַשָּׁמַיִם אֶת תְּפִלָּתָם וְאֶת תְּחִנָּתָם וְעָשִׂיתָ מִשְׁפָּטָֽם׃
translation: then hear in heaven their prayer and their supplication, and maintain their cause. (1 Kings 8:45)

text: וְשָׁמַעְתָּ מִן הַשָּׁמַיִם אֶת תְּפִלָּתָם וְאֶת תְּחִנָּתָם וְעָשִׂיתָ מִשְׁפָּטָֽם׃
translation: then hear from heaven their prayer and their supplication, and maintain their cause. (2 Chronicles 6:35)

text: וְשָׁמַעְתָּ הַשָּׁמַיִם מְכוֹן שִׁבְתְּךָ אֶת תְּפִלָּתָם וְאֶת תְּחִנָּתָם וְעָשִׂיתָ מִשְׁפָּטָֽם׃
translation: then hear their prayer and their supplication in heaven, your dwelling place, and maintain their cause; (1 Kings 8:49)

text: שָׁמַע יְהוָה תְּחִנָּתִי יְהוָה תְּֽפִלָּתִי יִקָּֽח׃
translation: May all my enemies be ashamed and dismayed. They shall turn back, they shall be disgraced suddenly. (Psalms 6:10)

text: הַאֲזִינָה אֱלֹהִים תְּפִלָּתִי וְאַל תִּתְעַלַּם מִתְּחִנָּתִֽי׃
translation: Attend to me, and answer me. I am restless in my complaint, and moan (Psalms 55:2)

text: תָּבוֹא תְּחִנָּתִי לְפָנֶיךָ כְּאִמְרָתְךָ הַצִּילֵֽנִי׃
translation: Let my supplication come before you. Deliver me according to your word. (Psalms 119:170)

text: מִשְּׁמוּעָה רָעָה לֹא יִירָא נָכוֹן לִבּוֹ בָּטֻחַ בַּיהוָֽה׃
translation: He will not be afraid of evil news. His heart is steadfast, trusting in the LORD. (Psalms 112:7)

text: מִי הֶאֱמִין לִשְׁמֻעָתֵנוּ וּזְרוֹעַ יְהוָה עַל מִי נִגְלָֽתָה׃
translation: Who has believed our message? To whom has the LORD's arm been revealed? (Isaiah 53:1)

text: וְלוֹא הָֽיְתָה סְדֹם אֲחוֹתֵךְ לִשְׁמוּעָה בְּפִיךְ בְּיוֹם גְּאוֹנָֽיִךְ׃
translation: For your sister Sodom was not mentioned by your mouth in the day of your pride, (Ezekiel 16:56)

text: וּשְׁמֻעוֹת יְבַהֲלֻהוּ מִמִּזְרָח וּמִצָּפוֹן וְיָצָא בְּחֵמָא גְדֹלָה לְהַשְׁמִיד וּֽלְהַחֲרִים רַבִּֽים׃
translation: But news out of the east and out of the north will trouble him; and he will go out with great fury to destroy and utterly to sweep away many. (Daniel 11:44)

text: הִנְנִי נֹתֵן בּוֹ רוּחַ וְשָׁמַע שְׁמוּעָה וְשָׁב לְאַרְצוֹ וְהִפַּלְתִּיו בַּחֶרֶב בְּאַרְצֽוֹ׃
translation: Behold, I will put a spirit in him, and he will hear news, and will return to his own land. I will cause him to fall by the sword in his own land."'" (2 Kings 19:7)

text: אַל בָּנָי כִּי לֽוֹא טוֹבָה הַשְּׁמֻעָה אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי שֹׁמֵעַ מַעֲבִרִים עַם יְהוָֽה׃
translation: No, my sons; for it is not a good report that I hear! You make the LORD's people disobey. (1 Samuel 2:24)

text: וְאַתָּה יְהוָה תִּשְׂחַק לָמוֹ תִּלְעַג לְכָל גּוֹיִֽם׃
translation: Oh, my Strength, I watch for you, for God is my high tower. (Psalms 59:9)

text: כִּי בְּלַעֲגֵי שָׂפָה וּבְלָשׁוֹן אַחֶרֶת יְדַבֵּר אֶל הָעָם הַזֶּֽה׃
translation: But he will speak to this nation with stammering lips and in another language, (Isaiah 28:11)

text: בַּדֶּיךָ מְתִים יַחֲרִישׁו וַתִּלְעַג וְאֵין מַכְלִֽם׃
translation: Should your boastings make men hold their peace? When you mock, will no man make you ashamed? (Job 11:3)

text: שָׂאוּנִי וְאָנֹכִי אֲדַבֵּר וְאַחַר דַּבְּרִי תַלְעִֽיג׃
translation: Allow me, and I also will speak. After I have spoken, mock on. (Job 21:3)

text: יִרְאוּ צַדִּיקִים וְיִשְׂמָחוּ וְנָקִי יִלְעַג לָֽמוֹ׃
translation: The righteous see it, and are glad. The innocent ridicule them, (Job 22:19)

text: מִי גֶבֶר כְּאִיּוֹב יִֽשְׁתֶּה לַּעַג כַּמָּֽיִם׃
translation: What man is like Job, who drinks scorn like water, (Job 34:7)

text: וַיִּהְיוּ בְנֵי רָם בְּכוֹר יְרַחְמְאֵל מַעַץ וְיָמִין וָעֵֽקֶר׃
translation: The sons of Ram the firstborn of Jerahmeel were Maaz, Jamin, and Eker. (1 Chronicles 2:27)

text: מֽוֹשִׁיבִי עֲקֶרֶת הַבַּיִת אֵֽם הַבָּנִים שְׂמֵחָה הַֽלְלוּ יָֽהּ׃
translation: He settles the barren woman in her home as a joyful mother of children. Praise the LORD! (Psalms 113:9)

text: לֹא תִהְיֶה מְשַׁכֵּלָה וַעֲקָרָה בְּאַרְצֶךָ אֶת מִסְפַּר יָמֶיךָ אֲמַלֵּֽא׃
translation: No one will miscarry or be barren in your land. I will fulfill the number of your days. (Exodus 23:26)

text: רֹעֶה עֲקָרָה לֹא תֵלֵד וְאַלְמָנָה לֹא יְיֵטִֽיב׃
translation: He devours the barren who don't bear. He shows no kindness to the widow. (Job 24:21)

text: עֵת לָלֶדֶת וְעֵת לָמוּת עֵת לָטַעַת וְעֵת לַעֲקוֹר נָטֽוּעַ׃
translation: a time to be born, and a time to die; a time to plant, and a time to pluck up that which is planted; (Ecclesiastes 3:2)

text: וַתְּהִי שָׂרַי עֲקָרָה אֵין לָהּ וָלָֽד׃
translation: Sarai was barren. She had no child. (Genesis 11:30)

text: יִרְאַת יְהוָה רֵאשִׁית דָּעַת חָכְמָה וּמוּסָר אֱוִילִים בָּֽזוּ׃
translation: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of knowledge, but the foolish despise wisdom and instruction. (Proverbs 1:7)

text: בָּז לְדָבָר יֵחָבֶל לוֹ וִירֵא מִצְוָה הוּא יְשֻׁלָּֽם׃
translation: Whoever despises instruction will pay for it, but he who respects a command will be rewarded. (Proverbs 13:13)

text: בְּאָזְנֵי כְסִיל אַל תְּדַבֵּר כִּֽי יָבוּז לְשֵׂכֶל מִלֶּֽיךָ׃
translation: Don't speak in the ears of a fool, for he will despise the wisdom of your words. (Proverbs 23:9)

text: גַּל מֵֽעָלַי חֶרְפָּה וָבוּז כִּי עֵדֹתֶיךָ נָצָֽרְתִּי׃
translation: Take reproach and contempt away from me, for I have kept your statutes. (Psalms 119:22)

text: חָנֵּנוּ יְהוָה חָנֵּנוּ כִּֽי רַב שָׂבַעְנוּ בֽוּז׃
translation: Have mercy on us, LORD, have mercy on us, for we have endured much contempt. (Psalms 123:3)

text: לֹא יָבוּזוּ לַגַּנָּב כִּי יִגְנוֹב לְמַלֵּא נַפְשׁוֹ כִּי יִרְעָֽב׃
translation: Men don't despise a thief if he steals to satisfy himself when he is hungry, (Proverbs 6:30)

text: וַתַּגְדִּילוּ עָלַי בְּפִיכֶם וְהַעְתַּרְתֶּם עָלַי דִּבְרֵיכֶם אֲנִי שָׁמָֽעְתִּי׃
translation: You have magnified yourselves against me with your mouth, and have multiplied your words against me. I have heard it." (Ezekiel 35:13)

text: וַיֵּצֵא מֹשֶׁה מֵעִם פַּרְעֹה וַיֶּעְתַּר אֶל יְהוָֽה׃
translation: Moses said, "It isn't appropriate to do so; for we shall sacrifice the abomination of the Egyptians to the LORD our God. Behold, if we sacrifice the abomination of the Egyptians before their eyes, won't they stone us? (Exodus 8:26)

text: עַיִן רִמּוֹן וָעֶתֶר וְעָשָׁן עָרִים אַרְבַּע וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃
translation: Ain, Rimmon, Ether, and Ashan; four cities with their villages; (Joshua 19:7)

text: וַנָּצוּמָה וַנְּבַקְשָׁה מֵאֱלֹהֵינוּ עַל זֹאת וַיֵּעָתֵר לָֽנוּ׃
translation: So we fasted and begged our God for this, and he granted our request. (Ezra 8:23)

text: וַיֵּצֵא מֵעִם פַּרְעֹה וַיֶּעְתַּר אֶל יְהוָֽה׃
translation: Moses went out from Pharaoh, and prayed to the LORD. (Exodus 10:18)

text: יֶעְתַּר אֶל אֱלוֹהַּ וַיִּרְצֵהוּ וַיַּרְא פָּנָיו בִּתְרוּעָה וַיָּשֶׁב לֶאֱנוֹשׁ צִדְקָתֽוֹ׃
translation: He prays to God, and he is favorable to him, so that he sees his face with joy. He restores to man his righteousness. (Job 33:26)

text: וּבְהִכָּשְׁלָם יֵעָזְרוּ עֵזֶר מְעָט וְנִלְווּ עֲלֵיהֶם רַבִּים בַּחֲלַקְלַקּֽוֹת׃
translation: Now when they fall, they will be helped with a little help; but many will join themselves to them with flatteries. (Daniel 11:34)

text: וְיֵשׁ אֲשֶׁר אֹמְרִים לָוִינוּ כֶסֶף לְמִדַּת הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׂדֹתֵינוּ וּכְרָמֵֽינוּ׃
translation: There were also some who said, "We have borrowed money for the king's tribute using our fields and our vineyards as collateral. (Nehemiah 5:4)

text: לֹוֶה רָשָׁע וְלֹא יְשַׁלֵּם וְצַדִּיק חוֹנֵן וְנוֹתֵֽן׃
translation: The wicked borrow, and don't pay back, but the righteous give generously. (Psalms 37:21)

text: גַּם אַשּׁוּר נִלְוָה עִמָּם הָיוּ זְרוֹעַ לִבְנֵי לוֹט סֶֽלָה׃
translation: Do to them as you did to Midian, as to Sisera, as to Jabin, at the river Kishon; (Psalms 83:9)

text: טֽוֹב אִישׁ חוֹנֵן וּמַלְוֶה יְכַלְכֵּל דְּבָרָיו בְּמִשְׁפָּֽט׃
translation: It is well with the man who deals graciously and lends. He will maintain his cause in judgment. (Psalms 112:5)

text: עָשִׁיר בְּרָשִׁים יִמְשׁוֹל וְעֶבֶד לֹוֶה לְאִישׁ מַלְוֶֽה׃
translation: The rich rule over the poor. The borrower is servant to the lender. (Proverbs 22:7)

text: אֹמֵר לְרָשָׁע צַדִּיק אָתָּה יִקְּבֻהוּ עַמִּים יִזְעָמוּהוּ לְאֻמִּֽים׃
translation: He who says to the wicked, "You are righteous," peoples will curse him, and nations will abhor him— (Proverbs 24:24)

text: וַיִּקַּח מֹשֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן אֵת הָאֲנָשִׁים הָאֵלֶּה אֲשֶׁר נִקְּבוּ בְּשֵׁמֽוֹת׃
translation: Moses and Aaron took these men who are mentioned by name. (Numbers 1:17)

text: מֹנֵֽעַ בָּר יִקְּבֻהוּ לְאוֹם וּבְרָכָה לְרֹאשׁ מַשְׁבִּֽיר׃
translation: People curse someone who withholds grain, but blessing will be on the head of him who sells it. (Proverbs 11:26)

text: וַיֹּאמַר נָקְבָה שְׂכָרְךָ עָלַי וְאֶתֵּֽנָה׃
translation: He said, "Appoint me your wages, and I will give it." (Genesis 30:28)

text: בְּעֵינָיו יִקָּחֶנּוּ בְּמֽוֹקְשִׁים יִנְקָב אָֽף׃
translation: Shall any take him when he is on the watch, or pierce through his nose with a snare? (Job 40:24)

text: וּמֵחֲצִי מַטֵּה מְנַשֶּׁה שְׁמוֹנָה עָשָׂר אָלֶף אֲשֶׁר נִקְּבוּ בְּשֵׁמוֹת לָבוֹא לְהַמְלִיךְ אֶת דָּוִֽיד׃
translation: Of the children of Issachar, men who had understanding of the times, to know what Israel ought to do, their heads were two hundred; and all their brothers were at their command. (1 Chronicles 12:32)

text: אֲדֹנָי עֲלֵיהֶם יִֽחְיוּ וּלְכָל בָּהֶן חַיֵּי רוּחִי וְתַחֲלִימֵנִי וְהַחֲיֵֽנִי׃
translation: Lord, men live by these things; and my spirit finds life in all of them. You restore me, and cause me to live. (Isaiah 38:16)

text: וְתָקְעוּ בָּהֵן וְנֽוֹעֲדוּ אֵלֶיךָ כָּל הָעֵדָה אֶל פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃
translation: When they blow them, all the congregation shall gather themselves to you at the door of the Tent of Meeting. (Numbers 10:3)

text: וְעָלָה הַגְּבוּל בֵּית חָגְלָה וְעָבַר מִצְּפוֹן לְבֵית הָעֲרָבָה וְעָלָה הַגְּבוּל אֶבֶן בֹּהַן בֶּן רְאוּבֵֽן׃
translation: The border went up to Beth Hoglah, and passed along by the north of Beth Arabah; and the border went up to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben. (Joshua 15:6)

text: וְצִוָּה הַכֹּהֵן וְחִלְּצוּ אֶת הָאֲבָנִים אֲשֶׁר בָּהֵן הַנָּגַע וְהִשְׁלִיכוּ אֶתְהֶן אֶל מִחוּץ לָעִיר אֶל מָקוֹם טָמֵֽא׃
translation: then the priest shall command that they take out the stones in which is the plague, and cast them into an unclean place outside of the city. (Leviticus 14:40)

text: וְתָאַר מִצָּפוֹן וְיָצָא עֵין שֶׁמֶשׁ וְיָצָא אֶל גְּלִילוֹת אֲשֶׁר נֹכַח מַעֲלֵה אֲדֻמִּים וְיָרַד אֶבֶן בֹּהַן בֶּן רְאוּבֵֽן׃
translation: It extended northward, went out at En Shemesh, and went out to Geliloth, which is opposite the ascent of Adummim. It went down to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben. (Joshua 18:17)

text: הָיוּ עָרֶיהָ לְשַׁמָּה אֶרֶץ צִיָּה וַעֲרָבָה אֶרֶץ לֹֽא יֵשֵׁב בָּהֵן כָּל אִישׁ וְלֹֽא יַעֲבֹר בָּהֵן בֶּן אָדָֽם׃
translation: Her cities have become a desolation, a dry land, and a desert, a land in which no man dwells. No son of man passes by it. (Jeremiah 51:43)

text: כִּי רְשָׁעִים יֹאבֵדוּ וְאֹיְבֵי יְהוָה כִּיקַר כָּרִים כָּלוּ בֶעָשָׁן כָּֽלוּ׃
translation: But the wicked shall perish. The enemies of the LORD shall be like the beauty of the fields. They will vanish— vanish like smoke. (Psalms 37:20)

text: שִׁלְחוּ כַר מֹשֵֽׁל אֶרֶץ מִסֶּלַע מִדְבָּרָה אֶל הַר בַּת צִיּֽוֹן׃
translation: Send the lambs for the ruler of the land from Selah to the wilderness, to the mountain of the daughter of Zion. (Isaiah 16:1)

text: אֽוֹרִידֵם כְּכָרִים לִטְבוֹחַ כְּאֵילִים עִם עַתּוּדִֽים׃
translation: "I will bring them down like lambs to the slaughter, like rams with male goats. (Jeremiah 51:40)

text: עֲרַב וְכָל נְשִׂיאֵי קֵדָר הֵמָּה סֹחֲרֵי יָדֵךְ בְּכָרִים וְאֵילִים וְעַתּוּדִים בָּם סֹחֲרָֽיִךְ׃
translation: "'"Arabia and all the princes of Kedar were your favorite dealers in lambs, rams, and goats. In these, they were your merchants. (Ezekiel 27:21)

text: וַיֵּצְאוּ אַנְשֵׁי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִן הַמִּצְפָּה וַֽיִּרְדְּפוּ אֶת פְּלִשְׁתִּים וַיַּכּוּם עַד מִתַּחַת לְבֵית כָּֽר׃
translation: The men of Israel went out of Mizpah and pursued the Philistines, and struck them until they came under Beth Kar. (1 Samuel 7:11)

text: וְחֹק הַשֶּׁמֶן הַבַּת הַשֶּׁמֶן מַעְשַׂר הַבַּת מִן הַכֹּר עֲשֶׂרֶת הַבַּתִּים חֹמֶר כִּֽי עֲשֶׂרֶת הַבַּתִּים חֹֽמֶר׃
translation: and the set portion of oil, of the bath of oil, one tenth of a bath out of the cor, which is ten baths, even a homer (for ten baths are a homer), (Ezekiel 45:14)

text: נֵר יְהוָה נִשְׁמַת אָדָם חֹפֵשׂ כָּל חַדְרֵי בָֽטֶן׃
translation: The spirit of man is the LORD's lamp, searching all his innermost parts. (Proverbs 20:27)

text: יַֽחְפְּֽשׂוּ עוֹלֹת תַּמְנוּ חֵפֶשׂ מְחֻפָּשׂ וְקֶרֶב אִישׁ וְלֵב עָמֹֽק׃
translation: But God will shoot at them. They will be suddenly struck down with an arrow. (Psalms 64:7)

text: וַיֵּלֶךְ הַנָּבִיא וַיַּעֲמֹד לַמֶּלֶךְ עַל הַדָּרֶךְ וַיִּתְחַפֵּשׂ בָּאֲפֵר עַל עֵינָֽיו׃
translation: So the prophet departed and waited for the king by the way, and disguised himself with his headband over his eyes. (1 Kings 20:38)

text: נַחְפְּשָׂה דְרָכֵינוּ וְֽנַחְקֹרָה וְנָשׁוּבָה עַד יְהוָֽה׃
translation: Let us search and try our ways, and turn again to the LORD. (Lamentations 3:40)

text: אִם תְּבַקְשֶׁנָּה כַכָּסֶף וְֽכַמַּטְמוֹנִים תַּחְפְּשֶֽׂנָּה׃
translation: if you seek her as silver, and search for her as for hidden treasures; (Proverbs 2:4)

text: אֵיךְ נֶחְפְּשׂוּ עֵשָׂו נִבְעוּ מַצְפֻּנָֽיו׃
translation: How Esau will be ransacked! How his hidden treasures are sought out! (Obadiah 1:6)

text: עֹבֵד אַדְמָתוֹ יִֽשְׂבַּֽע לָחֶם וּמְרַדֵּף רֵיקִים חֲסַר לֵֽב׃
translation: He who tills his land shall have plenty of bread, but he who chases fantasies is void of understanding. (Proverbs 12:11)

text: וַיִּקָּחֻהוּ וַיַּשְׁלִכוּ אֹתוֹ הַבֹּרָה וְהַבּוֹר רֵק אֵין בּוֹ מָֽיִם׃
translation: and they took him, and threw him into the pit. The pit was empty. There was no water in it. (Genesis 37:24)

text: לָמָּה רָגְשׁוּ גוֹיִם וּלְאֻמִּים יֶהְגּוּ רִֽיק׃
translation: Why do the nations rage, and the peoples plot a vain thing? (Psalms 2:1)

text: וּמִצְרַיִם הֶבֶל וָרִיק יַעְזֹרוּ לָכֵן קָרָאתִי לָזֹאת רַהַב הֵם שָֽׁבֶת׃
translation: For Egypt helps in vain, and to no purpose; therefore I have called her Rahab who sits still. (Isaiah 30:7)

text: בְּנֵי אִישׁ עַד מֶה כְבוֹדִי לִכְלִמָּה תֶּאֱהָבוּן רִיק תְּבַקְשׁוּ כָזָב סֶֽלָה׃
translation: But know that the LORD has set apart for himself him who is godly; The LORD will hear when I call to him. (Psalms 4:3)

text: לֹא יִֽיגְעוּ לָרִיק וְלֹא יֵלְדוּ לַבֶּהָלָה כִּי זֶרַע בְּרוּכֵי יְהוָה הֵמָּה וְצֶאֱצָאֵיהֶם אִתָּֽם׃
translation: They will not labor in vain nor give birth for calamity; for they are the offspring of the LORD's blessed and their descendants with them. (Isaiah 65:23)

text: וַיְהִי מִקְצֵה שְׁלֹשֶׁת יָמִים וַיַּעַבְרוּ הַשֹּׁטְרִים בְּקֶרֶב הַֽמַּחֲנֶֽה׃
translation: After three days, the officers went through the middle of the camp; (Joshua 3:2)

text: לַיִּצְהָרִי כְּנַנְיָהוּ וּבָנָיו לַמְּלָאכָה הַחִֽיצוֹנָה עַל יִשְׂרָאֵל לְשֹׁטְרִים וּלְשֹׁפְטִֽים׃
translation: Of the Izharites, Chenaniah and his sons were appointed to the outward business over Israel, for officers and judges. (1 Chronicles 26:29)

text: וַיְצַו פַּרְעֹה בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא אֶת הַנֹּגְשִׂים בָּעָם וְאֶת שֹׁטְרָיו לֵאמֹֽר׃
translation: The same day Pharaoh commanded the taskmasters of the people and their officers, saying, (Exodus 5:6)

text: וַיְצַו יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶת שֹׁטְרֵי הָעָם לֵאמֹֽר׃
translation: Then Joshua commanded the officers of the people, saying, (Joshua 1:10)

text: וְהָיָה כְּכַלֹּת הַשֹּׁטְרִים לְדַבֵּר אֶל הָעָם וּפָֽקְדוּ שָׂרֵי צְבָאוֹת בְּרֹאשׁ הָעָֽם׃
translation: It shall be, when the officers have finished speaking to the people, that they shall appoint captains of armies at the head of the people. (Deuteronomy 20:9)

text: וַיָּבֹאוּ שֹֽׁטְרֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּצְעֲקוּ אֶל פַּרְעֹה לֵאמֹר לָמָּה תַעֲשֶׂה כֹה לַעֲבָדֶֽיךָ׃
translation: Then the officers of the children of Israel came and cried to Pharaoh, saying, "Why do you deal this way with your servants? (Exodus 5:15)

text: וַיַּעֲמֹד בֵּֽין הַמֵּתִים וּבֵין הַֽחַיִּים וַתֵּעָצַר הַמַּגֵּפָֽה׃
translation: Everyone who keeps approaching the LORD's tabernacle, dies! Will we all perish?" (Numbers 17:13)

text: וַיִּהְיוּ הַמֵּתִים בַּמַּגֵּפָה אַרְבָּעָה וְעֶשְׂרִים אָֽלֶף׃
translation: Those who died by the plague were twenty-four thousand. (Numbers 25:9)

text: הִנֵּה יְהוָה נֹגֵף מַגֵּפָה גְדוֹלָה בְּעַמֶּךָ וּבְבָנֶיךָ וּבְנָשֶׁיךָ וּבְכָל רְכוּשֶֽׁךָ׃
translation: behold, the LORD will strike your people with a great plague, including your children, your wives, and all your possessions; (2 Chronicles 21:14)

text: וַיַּכְעִיסוּ בְּמַֽעַלְלֵיהֶם וַתִּפְרָץ בָּם מַגֵּפָֽה׃
translation: Thus they provoked him to anger with their deeds. The plague broke in on them. (Psalms 106:29)

text: וַיַּעֲמֹד פִּֽינְחָס וַיְפַלֵּל וַתֵּעָצַר הַמַּגֵּפָֽה׃
translation: Then Phinehas stood up and executed judgment, so the plague was stopped. (Psalms 106:30)

text: וַיִּנָּגְפוּ שָׁם עַם יִשְׂרָאֵל לִפְנֵי עַבְדֵי דָוִד וַתְּהִי שָׁם הַמַּגֵּפָה גְדוֹלָה בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא עֶשְׂרִים אָֽלֶף׃
translation: The people of Israel were struck there before David's servants, and there was a great slaughter there that day of twenty thousand men. (2 Samuel 18:7)

text: גַּֽם עַבְדְּךָ נִזְהָר בָּהֶם בְּשָׁמְרָם עֵקֶב רָֽב׃
translation: Who can discern his errors? Forgive me from hidden errors. (Psalms 19:12)

text: וְרָאָה אֶת הַחֶרֶב בָּאָה עַל הָאָרֶץ וְתָקַע בַּשּׁוֹפָר וְהִזְהִיר אֶת הָעָֽם׃
translation: if, when he sees the sword come on the land, he blows the trumpet and warns the people, (Ezekiel 33:3)

text: טוֹב יֶלֶד מִסְכֵּן וְחָכָם מִמֶּלֶךְ זָקֵן וּכְסִיל אֲשֶׁר לֹא יָדַע לְהִזָּהֵר עֽוֹד׃
translation: Better is a poor and wise youth than an old and foolish king who doesn't know how to receive admonition any more. (Ecclesiastes 4:13)

text: בֶּן אָדָם צֹפֶה נְתַתִּיךָ לְבֵית יִשְׂרָאֵל וְשָׁמַעְתָּ מִפִּי דָּבָר וְהִזְהַרְתָּ אוֹתָם מִמֶּֽנִּי׃
translation: "Son of man, I have made you a watchman to the house of Israel. Therefore hear the word from my mouth, and warn them from me. (Ezekiel 3:17)

text: וְשָׁמַע הַשֹּׁמֵעַ אֶת קוֹל הַשּׁוֹפָר וְלֹא נִזְהָר וַתָּבוֹא חֶרֶב וַתִּקָּחֵהוּ דָּמוֹ בְרֹאשׁוֹ יִֽהְיֶֽה׃
translation: then whoever hears the sound of the trumpet and doesn't heed the warning, if the sword comes and takes him away, his blood will be on his own head. (Ezekiel 33:4)

text: אֵת קוֹל הַשּׁוֹפָר שָׁמַע וְלֹא נִזְהָר דָּמוֹ בּוֹ יִֽהְיֶה וְהוּא נִזְהָר נַפְשׁוֹ מִלֵּֽט׃
translation: He heard the sound of the trumpet and didn't take warning. His blood will be on him; whereas if he had heeded the warning, he would have delivered his soul. (Ezekiel 33:5)

text: וְלָֽקַחְתָּ אֶת שֶׁמֶן הַמִּשְׁחָה וְיָצַקְתָּ עַל רֹאשׁוֹ וּמָשַׁחְתָּ אֹתֽוֹ׃
translation: Then you shall take the anointing oil, and pour it on his head, and anoint him. (Exodus 29:7)

text: וַיִּצֹק מִשֶּׁמֶן הַמִּשְׁחָה עַל רֹאשׁ אַהֲרֹן וַיִּמְשַׁח אֹתוֹ לְקַדְּשֽׁוֹ׃
translation: He poured some of the anointing oil on Aaron's head, and anointed him, to sanctify him. (Leviticus 8:12)

text: וְאֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל תְּדַבֵּר לֵאמֹר שֶׁמֶן מִשְׁחַת קֹדֶשׁ יִהְיֶה זֶה לִי לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶֽם׃
translation: You shall speak to the children of Israel, saying, 'This shall be a holy anointing oil to me throughout your generations. (Exodus 30:31)

text: זֹאת מִשְׁחַת אַהֲרֹן וּמִשְׁחַת בָּנָיו מֵאִשֵּׁי יְהוָה בְּיוֹם הִקְרִיב אֹתָם לְכַהֵן לַיהוָֽה׃
translation: This is the consecrated portion of Aaron, and the consecrated portion of his sons, out of the offerings of the LORD made by fire, in the day when he presented them to minister to the LORD in the priest's office; (Leviticus 7:35)

text: וּבִגְדֵי הַקֹּדֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר לְאַהֲרֹן יִהְיוּ לְבָנָיו אַחֲרָיו לְמָשְׁחָה בָהֶם וּלְמַלֵּא בָם אֶת יָדָֽם׃
translation: "The holy garments of Aaron shall be for his sons after him, to be anointed in them, and to be consecrated in them. (Exodus 29:29)

text: וְעָשִׂיתָ אֹתוֹ שֶׁמֶן מִשְׁחַת קֹדֶשׁ רֹקַח מִרְקַחַת מַעֲשֵׂה רֹקֵחַ שֶׁמֶן מִשְׁחַת קֹדֶשׁ יִהְיֶֽה׃
translation: You shall make it into a holy anointing oil, a perfume compounded after the art of the perfumer: it shall be a holy anointing oil. (Exodus 30:25)

text: וְאֵת שׁוֹק הַיָּמִין תִּתְּנוּ תְרוּמָה לַכֹּהֵן מִזִּבְחֵי שַׁלְמֵיכֶֽם׃
translation: The right thigh you shall give to the priest for a heave offering out of the sacrifices of your peace offerings. (Leviticus 7:32)

text: לֹא בִגְבוּרַת הַסּוּס יֶחְפָּץ לֹֽא בְשׁוֹקֵי הָאִישׁ יִרְצֶֽה׃
translation: He doesn't delight in the strength of the horse. He takes no pleasure in the legs of a man. (Psalms 147:10)

text: וּבְשָׂרָם יִהְיֶה לָּךְ כַּחֲזֵה הַתְּנוּפָה וּכְשׁוֹק הַיָּמִין לְךָ יִהְיֶֽה׃
translation: Their meat shall be yours, as the wave offering breast and as the right thigh, it shall be yours. (Numbers 18:18)

text: עֹבֵר בַּשּׁוּק אֵצֶל פִּנָּהּ וְדֶרֶךְ בֵּיתָהּ יִצְעָֽד׃
translation: passing through the street near her corner, he went the way to her house, (Proverbs 7:8)

text: שׁוֹקָיו עַמּוּדֵי שֵׁשׁ מְיֻסָּדִים עַל אַדְנֵי פָז מַרְאֵהוּ כַּלְּבָנוֹן בָּחוּר כָּאֲרָזִֽים׃
translation: His legs are like pillars of marble set on sockets of fine gold. His appearance is like Lebanon, excellent as the cedars. (Song of Solomon 5:15)

text: וַיַּךְ אוֹתָם שׁוֹק עַל יָרֵךְ מַכָּה גְדוֹלָה וַיֵּרֶד וַיֵּשֶׁב בִּסְעִיף סֶלַע עֵיטָֽם׃
translation: He struck them hip and thigh with a great slaughter; and he went down and lived in the cave in Etam's rock. (Judges 15:8)

text: גֶּשֶׁם נְדָבוֹת תָּנִיף אֱלֹהִים נַחֲלָתְךָ וְנִלְאָה אַתָּה כֽוֹנַנְתָּֽהּ׃
translation: Your congregation lived therein. You, God, prepared your goodness for the poor. (Psalms 68:10)

text: נִדְבוֹת פִּי רְצֵה נָא יְהוָה וּֽמִשְׁפָּטֶיךָ לַמְּדֵֽנִי׃
translation: Accept, I beg you, the willing offerings of my mouth. LORD, teach me your ordinances. (Psalms 119:108)

text: וְשׁוֹר וָשֶׂה שָׂרוּעַ וְקָלוּט נְדָבָה תַּעֲשֶׂה אֹתוֹ וּלְנֵדֶר לֹא יֵרָצֶֽה׃
translation: Either a bull or a lamb that has any deformity or lacking in his parts, that you may offer for a free will offering; but for a vow it shall not be accepted. (Leviticus 22:23)

text: אֵלֶּה תַּעֲשׂוּ לַיהוָה בְּמוֹעֲדֵיכֶם לְבַד מִנִּדְרֵיכֶם וְנִדְבֹתֵיכֶם לְעֹלֹֽתֵיכֶם וּלְמִנְחֹתֵיכֶם וּלְנִסְכֵּיכֶם וּלְשַׁלְמֵיכֶֽם׃
translation: "'You shall offer these to the LORD in your set feasts—in addition to your vows and your free will offerings—for your burnt offerings, your meal offerings, your drink offerings, and your peace offerings.'" (Numbers 29:39)

text: עַמְּךָ נְדָבֹת בְּיוֹם חֵילֶךָ בְּֽהַדְרֵי קֹדֶשׁ מֵרֶחֶם מִשְׁחָר לְךָ טַל יַלְדֻתֶֽיךָ׃
translation: Your people offer themselves willingly in the day of your power, in holy array. Out of the womb of the morning, you have the dew of your youth. (Psalms 110:3)

text: מוֹצָא שְׂפָתֶיךָ תִּשְׁמֹר וְעָשִׂיתָ כַּאֲשֶׁר נָדַרְתָּ לַיהוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ נְדָבָה אֲשֶׁר דִּבַּרְתָּ בְּפִֽיךָ׃
translation: When you come into your neighbor's vineyard, then you may eat your fill of grapes at your own pleasure; but you shall not put any in your container. (Deuteronomy 23:24)

text: בְּשׁוֹט לָשׁוֹן תֵּחָבֵא וְֽלֹא תִירָא מִשֹּׁד כִּי יָבֽוֹא׃
translation: You will be hidden from the scourge of the tongue, neither will you be afraid of destruction when it comes. (Job 5:21)

text: אִם שׁוֹט יָמִית פִּתְאֹם לְמַסַּת נְקִיִּם יִלְעָֽג׃
translation: If the scourge kills suddenly, he will mock at the trial of the innocent. (Job 9:23)

text: וַיָּשֻׁטוּ בְּכָל הָאָרֶץ וַיָּבֹאוּ מִקְצֵה תִשְׁעָה חֳדָשִׁים וְעֶשְׂרִים יוֹם יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
translation: So when they had gone back and forth through all the land, they came to Jerusalem at the end of nine months and twenty days. (2 Samuel 24:8)

text: בְּמַיִם רַבִּים הֱבִיאוּךְ הַשָּׁטִים אֹתָךְ רוּחַ הַקָּדִים שְׁבָרֵךְ בְּלֵב יַמִּֽים׃
translation: Your rowers have brought you into great waters. The east wind has broken you in the heart of the seas. (Ezekiel 27:26)

text: אַשְֽׁרֵי הַגֶּבֶר אֲשֶׁר שָׂם יְהֹוָה מִבְטַחוֹ וְֽלֹא פָנָה אֶל רְהָבִים וְשָׂטֵי כָזָֽב׃
translation: Many, LORD, my God, are the wonderful works which you have done, and your thoughts which are toward us. They can't be declared back to you. If I would declare and speak of them, they are more than can be counted. (Psalms 40:5)

text: לֹֽא אָשִׁית לְנֶגֶד עֵינַי דְּֽבַר בְּלִיָּעַל עֲשֹֽׂה סֵטִים שָׂנֵאתִי לֹא יִדְבַּק בִּֽי׃
translation: I will set no vile thing before my eyes. I hate the deeds of faithless men. They will not cling to me. (Psalms 101:3)

text: בְּקוּם לַמִּשְׁפָּט אֱלֹהִים לְהוֹשִׁיעַ כָּל עַנְוֵי אֶרֶץ סֶֽלָה׃
translation: Surely the wrath of man praises you. The survivors of your wrath are restrained. (Psalms 76:10)

text: אִם לַלֵּצִים הֽוּא יָלִיץ ולעניים וְלַעֲנָוִים יִתֶּן חֵֽן׃
translation: Surely he mocks the mockers, but he gives grace to the humble. (Proverbs 3:34)

text: קוּמָה יְהוָה אֵל נְשָׂא יָדֶךָ אַל תִּשְׁכַּח עניים עֲנָוִֽים׃
translation: Arise, LORD! God, lift up your hand! Don't forget the helpless. (Psalms 10:12)

text: יֹאכְלוּ עֲנָוִים וְיִשְׂבָּעוּ יְהַֽלְלוּ יְהוָה דֹּרְשָׁיו יְחִי לְבַבְכֶם לָעַֽד׃
translation: All the ends of the earth shall remember and turn to the LORD. All the relatives of the nations shall worship before you. (Psalms 22:27)

text: רָאוּ עֲנָוִים יִשְׂמָחוּ דֹּרְשֵׁי אֱלֹהִים וִיחִי לְבַבְכֶֽם׃
translation: For the LORD hears the needy, and doesn't despise his captive people. (Psalms 69:33)

text: מְעוֹדֵד עֲנָוִים יְהוָה מַשְׁפִּיל רְשָׁעִים עֲדֵי אָֽרֶץ׃
translation: The LORD upholds the humble. He brings the wicked down to the ground. (Psalms 147:6)

text: כִּי תִקָּחֶנּוּ אֶל גְּבוּלוֹ וְכִֽי תָבִין נְתִיבוֹת בֵּיתֽוֹ׃
translation: that you should take it to its bound, that you should discern the paths to its house? (Job 38:20)

text: אַל יֵשְׂטְ אֶל דְּרָכֶיהָ לִבֶּךָ אַל תֵּתַע בִּנְתִיבוֹתֶֽיהָ׃
translation: Don't let your heart turn to her ways. Don't go astray in her paths, (Proverbs 7:25)

text: בְּרֹאשׁ מְרוֹמִים עֲלֵי דָרֶךְ בֵּית נְתִיבוֹת נִצָּֽבָה׃
translation: On the top of high places by the way, where the paths meet, she stands. (Proverbs 8:2)

text: בְּאֹֽרַח צְדָקָה חַיִּים וְדֶרֶךְ נְתִיבָה אַל מָֽוֶת׃
translation: In the way of righteousness is life; in its path there is no death. (Proverbs 12:28)

text: כֹּה אָמַר יְהוָה הַנּוֹתֵן בַּיָּם דָּרֶךְ וּבְמַיִם עַזִּים נְתִיבָֽה׃
translation: The LORD, who makes a way in the sea, and a path in the mighty waters, (Isaiah 43:16)

text: הַדְרִיכֵנִי בִּנְתִיב מִצְוֺתֶיךָ כִּי בוֹ חָפָֽצְתִּי׃
translation: Direct me in the path of your commandments, for I delight in them. (Psalms 119:35)

text: מִפִּקּוּדֶיךָ אֶתְבּוֹנָן עַל כֵּן שָׂנֵאתִי כָּל אֹרַח שָֽׁקֶר׃
translation: Through your precepts, I get understanding; therefore I hate every false way. NUN (Psalms 119:104)

text: מַעֲשֵׂי יָדָיו אֱמֶת וּמִשְׁפָּט נֶאֱמָנִים כָּל פִּקּוּדָֽיו׃
translation: The works of his hands are truth and justice. All his precepts are sure. (Psalms 111:7)

text: חָבֵר אָנִי לְכָל אֲשֶׁר יְרֵאוּךָ וּלְשֹׁמְרֵי פִּקּוּדֶֽיךָ׃
translation: I am a friend of all those who fear you, of those who observe your precepts. (Psalms 119:63)

text: כִּמְעַט כִּלּוּנִי בָאָרֶץ וַאֲנִי לֹא עָזַבְתִּי פִקֻּודֶֽיךָ׃
translation: They had almost wiped me from the earth, but I didn't forsake your precepts. (Psalms 119:87)

text: לְעוֹלָם לֹא אֶשְׁכַּח פִּקּוּדֶיךָ כִּי בָם חִיִּיתָֽנִי׃
translation: I will never forget your precepts, for with them, you have revived me. (Psalms 119:93)

text: רְאֵה כִּי פִקּוּדֶיךָ אָהָבְתִּי יְהוָה כְּֽחַסְדְּךָ חַיֵּֽנִי׃
translation: Consider how I love your precepts. Revive me, LORD, according to your loving kindness. (Psalms 119:159)

text: וְאֶל מִי תְּדַמְּיוּן אֵל וּמַה דְּמוּת תַּעַרְכוּ לֽוֹ׃
translation: To whom then will you liken God? Or what likeness will you compare to him? (Isaiah 40:18)

text: וּמִתּוֹכָהּ דְּמוּת אַרְבַּע חַיּוֹת וְזֶה מַרְאֵֽיהֶן דְּמוּת אָדָם לָהֵֽנָּה׃
translation: Out of its center came the likeness of four living creatures. This was their appearance: They had the likeness of a man. (Ezekiel 1:5)

text: זֶה סֵפֶר תּוֹלְדֹת אָדָם בְּיוֹם בְּרֹא אֱלֹהִים אָדָם בִּדְמוּת אֱלֹהִים עָשָׂה אֹתֽוֹ׃
translation: This is the book of the generations of Adam. In the day that God created man, he made him in God's likeness. (Genesis 5:1)

text: וּדְמוּת עַל רָאשֵׁי הַחַיָּה רָקִיעַ כְּעֵין הַקֶּרַח הַנּוֹרָא נָטוּי עַל רָאשֵׁיהֶם מִלְמָֽעְלָה׃
translation: Over the head of the living creature there was the likeness of an expanse, like an awesome crystal to look at, stretched out over their heads above. (Ezekiel 1:22)

text: אַרְבָּעָה אַרְבָּעָה פָנִים לְאֶחָד וְאַרְבַּע כְּנָפַיִם לְאֶחָד וּדְמוּת יְדֵי אָדָם תַּחַת כַּנְפֵיהֶֽם׃
translation: Every one had four faces, and every one four wings. The likeness of the hands of a man was under their wings. (Ezekiel 10:21)

text: מַרְאֵה הָאוֹפַנִּים וּמַעֲשֵׂיהֶם כְּעֵין תַּרְשִׁישׁ וּדְמוּת אֶחָד לְאַרְבַּעְתָּן וּמַרְאֵיהֶם וּמַעֲשֵׂיהֶם כַּאֲשֶׁר יִהְיֶה הָאוֹפַן בְּתוֹךְ הָאוֹפָֽן׃
translation: The appearance of the wheels and their work was like a beryl. The four of them had one likeness. Their appearance and their work was as it were a wheel within a wheel. (Ezekiel 1:16)

text: כִּי לְיוֹם אֵיד יֵחָשֶׂךְ רָע לְיוֹם עֲבָרוֹת יוּבָֽלוּ׃
translation: that the evil man is reserved to the day of calamity, that they are led out to the day of wrath? (Job 21:30)

text: מִי יֹבִלֵנִי עִיר מָצוֹר מִי נָחַנִי עַד אֱדֽוֹם׃
translation: Give us help against the adversary, for the help of man is vain. (Psalms 60:11)

text: מִי יֹבִלֵנִי עִיר מִבְצָר מִי נָחַנִי עַד אֱדֽוֹם׃
translation: Haven't you rejected us, God? You don't go out, God, with our armies. (Psalms 108:11)

text: מֵעֵבֶר לְנַֽהֲרֵי כוּשׁ עֲתָרַי בַּת פוּצַי יוֹבִלוּן מִנְחָתִֽי׃
translation: From beyond the rivers of Cush, my worshipers, even the daughter of my dispersed people, will bring my offering. (Zephaniah 3:10)

text: כַּאֲשֶׁר לֹא הָיִיתִי אֶהְיֶה מִבֶּטֶן לַקֶּבֶר אוּבָֽל׃
translation: I should have been as though I had not been. I should have been carried from the womb to the grave. (Job 10:19)

text: מֵֽהֵיכָלֶךָ עַל יְרוּשָׁלִָם לְךָ יוֹבִילוּ מְלָכִים שָֽׁי׃
translation: Rebuke the wild animal of the reeds, the multitude of the bulls with the calves of the peoples. Trample under foot the bars of silver. Scatter the nations who delight in war. (Psalms 68:30)

text: עֶרֶב וָבֹקֶר וְצָהֳרַיִם אָשִׂיחָה וְאֶהֱמֶה וַיִּשְׁמַע קוֹלִֽי׃
translation: He has redeemed my soul in peace from the battle that was against me, although there are many who oppose me. (Psalms 55:18)

text: וַיִּשָּׂאֵהוּ וַיְבִיאֵהוּ אֶל אִמּוֹ וַיֵּשֶׁב עַל בִּרְכֶּיהָ עַד הַֽצָּהֳרַיִם וַיָּמֹֽת׃
translation: When he had taken him and brought him to his mother, he sat on her knees until noon, and then died. (2 Kings 4:20)

text: וְהוֹצִיא כָאוֹר צִדְקֶךָ וּמִשְׁפָּטֶךָ כַּֽצָּהֳרָֽיִם׃
translation: he will make your righteousness shine out like light, and your justice as the noon day sun. (Psalms 37:6)

text: כִּי עַזָּה עֲזוּבָה תִֽהְיֶה וְאַשְׁקְלוֹן לִשְׁמָמָה אַשְׁדּוֹד בַּֽצָּהֳרַיִם יְגָרְשׁוּהָ וְעֶקְרוֹן תֵּעָקֵֽר׃
translation: For Gaza will be forsaken, and Ashkelon a desolation. They will drive out Ashdod at noonday, and Ekron will be rooted up. (Zephaniah 2:4)

text: וַיָּכִינוּ אֶת הַמִּנְחָה עַד בּוֹא יוֹסֵף בַּֽצָּהֳרָיִם כִּי שָֽׁמְעוּ כִּי שָׁם יֹאכְלוּ לָֽחֶם׃
translation: They prepared the present for Joseph's coming at noon, for they heard that they should eat bread there. (Genesis 43:25)

text: וַֽיְהִי כַּעֲבֹר הַֽצָּהֳרַיִם וַיִּֽתְנַבְּאוּ עַד לַעֲלוֹת הַמִּנְחָה וְאֵֽין קוֹל וְאֵין עֹנֶה וְאֵין קָֽשֶׁב׃
translation: When midday was past, they prophesied until the time of the evening offering; but there was no voice, no answer, and nobody paid attention. (1 Kings 18:29)

text: וְאֶת הַֽחִוִּי וְאֶת הַֽעַרְקִי וְאֶת הַסִּינִֽי׃
translation: the Hivites, the Arkites, the Sinites, (Genesis 10:17)

text: וְאֶת הַחִוִּי וְאֶת הַֽעַרְקִי וְאֶת הַסִּינִֽי׃
translation: the Hivite, the Arkite, the Sinite, (1 Chronicles 1:15)

text: וְשָׁלַחְתִּי אֶת הַצִּרְעָה לְפָנֶיךָ וְגֵרְשָׁה אֶת הַחִוִּי אֶת הַֽכְּנַעֲנִי וְאֶת הַחִתִּי מִלְּפָנֶֽיךָ׃
translation: I will send the hornet before you, which will drive out the Hivite, the Canaanite, and the Hittite, from before you. (Exodus 23:28)

text: וַיַּרְא אֹתָהּ שְׁכֶם בֶּן חֲמוֹר הַֽחִוִּי נְשִׂיא הָאָרֶץ וַיִּקַּח אֹתָהּ וַיִּשְׁכַּב אֹתָהּ וַיְעַנֶּֽהָ׃
translation: Shechem the son of Hamor the Hivite, the prince of the land, saw her. He took her, lay with her, and humbled her. (Genesis 34:2)

text: כִּֽי הַחֲרֵם תַּחֲרִימֵם הַחִתִּי וְהָאֱמֹרִי הַכְּנַעֲנִי וְהַפְּרִזִּי הַחִוִּי וְהַיְבוּסִי כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוְּךָ יְהוָה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ׃
translation: but you shall utterly destroy them: the Hittite, the Amorite, the Canaanite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite, as the LORD your God has commanded you; (Deuteronomy 20:17)

text: הַֽכְּנַעֲנִי מִמִּזְרָח וּמִיָּם וְהָאֱמֹרִי וְהַחִתִּי וְהַפְּרִזִּי וְהַיְבוּסִי בָּהָר וְהַֽחִוִּי תַּחַת חֶרְמוֹן בְּאֶרֶץ הַמִּצְפָּֽה׃
translation: to the Canaanite on the east and on the west, the Amorite, the Hittite, the Perizzite, the Jebusite in the hill country, and the Hivite under Hermon in the land of Mizpah. (Joshua 11:3)

text: כִּֽי הִשְׁקִיף מִמְּרוֹם קָדְשׁוֹ יְהוָה מִשָּׁמַיִם אֶל אֶרֶץ הִבִּֽיט׃
translation: to hear the groans of the prisoner, to free those who are condemned to death, (Psalms 102:20)

text: אֱמֶת מֵאֶרֶץ תִּצְמָח וְצֶדֶק מִשָּׁמַיִם נִשְׁקָֽף׃
translation: Yes, the LORD will give that which is good. Our land will yield its increase. (Psalms 85:12)

text: כִּי בְּחַלּוֹן בֵּיתִי בְּעַד אֶשְׁנַבִּי נִשְׁקָֽפְתִּי׃
translation: For at the window of my house, I looked out through my lattice. (Proverbs 7:6)

text: וַיָּקֻמוּ מִשָּׁם הָֽאֲנָשִׁים וַיַּשְׁקִפוּ עַל פְּנֵי סְדֹם וְאַבְרָהָם הֹלֵךְ עִמָּם לְשַׁלְּחָֽם׃
translation: The men rose up from there, and looked toward Sodom. Abraham went with them to see them on their way. (Genesis 18:16)

text: מִי זֹאת הַנִּשְׁקָפָה כְּמוֹ שָׁחַר יָפָה כַלְּבָנָה בָּרָה כַּֽחַמָּה אֲיֻמָּה כַּנִּדְגָּלֽוֹת׃
translation: Who is she who looks out as the morning, beautiful as the moon, clear as the sun, and awesome as an army with banners? (Song of Solomon 6:10)

text: עַד יַשְׁקִיף וְיֵרֶא יְהוָה מִשָּׁמָֽיִם׃
translation: until the LORD looks down, and sees from heaven. (Lamentations 3:50)

text: וְאֶת בְּנוֹתֵיכֶם יִקָּח לְרַקָּחוֹת וּלְטַבָּחוֹת וּלְאֹפֽוֹת׃
translation: He will take your daughters to be perfumers, to be cooks, and to be bakers. (1 Samuel 8:13)

text: לֹא תֵאָפֶה חָמֵץ חֶלְקָם נָתַתִּי אֹתָהּ מֵאִשָּׁי קֹדֶשׁ קָֽדָשִׁים הִוא כַּחַטָּאת וְכָאָשָֽׁם׃
translation: The priest shall put on his linen garment, and he shall put on his linen trousers upon his body; and he shall remove the ashes from where the fire has consumed the burnt offering on the altar, and he shall put them beside the altar. (Leviticus 6:10)

text: וְלָקַחְתָּ סֹלֶת וְאָפִיתָ אֹתָהּ שְׁתֵּים עֶשְׂרֵה חַלּוֹת שְׁנֵי עֶשְׂרֹנִים יִהְיֶה הַֽחַלָּה הָאֶחָֽת׃
translation: "You shall take fine flour, and bake twelve cakes of it: two tenths of an ephah shall be in one cake. (Leviticus 24:5)

text: מִמּוֹשְׁבֹתֵיכֶם תָּבִיאּוּ לֶחֶם תְּנוּפָה שְׁתַּיִם שְׁנֵי עֶשְׂרֹנִים סֹלֶת תִּהְיֶינָה חָמֵץ תֵּאָפֶינָה בִּכּוּרִים לַֽיהוָֽה׃
translation: You shall bring out of your habitations two loaves of bread for a wave offering made of two tenths of an ephah of fine flour. They shall be baked with yeast, for first fruits to the LORD. (Leviticus 23:17)

text: פַּרְעֹה קָצַף עַל עֲבָדָיו וַיִּתֵּן אֹתִי בְּמִשְׁמַר בֵּית שַׂר הַטַּבָּחִים אֹתִי וְאֵת שַׂר הָאֹפִֽים׃
translation: Pharaoh was angry with his servants, and put me in custody in the house of the captain of the guard, with the chief baker. (Genesis 41:10)

text: בְּשִׁבְרִי לָכֶם מַטֵּה לֶחֶם וְאָפוּ עֶשֶׂר נָשִׁים לַחְמְכֶם בְּתַנּוּר אֶחָד וְהֵשִׁיבוּ לַחְמְכֶם בַּמִּשְׁקָל וַאֲכַלְתֶּם וְלֹא תִשְׂבָּֽעוּ׃
translation: When I break your staff of bread, ten women shall bake your bread in one oven, and they shall deliver your bread again by weight. You shall eat, and not be satisfied. (Leviticus 26:26)

text: צָעִיר אָנֹכִי וְנִבְזֶה פִּקֻּדֶיךָ לֹא שָׁכָֽחְתִּי׃
translation: I am small and despised. I don't forget your precepts. (Psalms 119:141)

text: הַקָּטֹן יִֽהְיֶה לָאֶלֶף וְהַצָּעִיר לְגוֹי עָצוּם אֲנִי יְהוָה בְּעִתָּהּ אֲחִישֶֽׁנָּה׃
translation: The little one will become a thousand, and the small one a strong nation. I, the LORD, will do this quickly in its time." (Isaiah 60:22)

text: נִשְׁבְּרָה מוֹאָב הִשְׁמִיעוּ זְּעָקָה צעוריה צְעִירֶֽיהָ׃
translation: Moab is destroyed. Her little ones have caused a cry to be heard. (Jeremiah 48:4)

text: שָׁם בִּנְיָמִן צָעִיר רֹדֵם שָׂרֵי יְהוּדָה רִגְמָתָם שָׂרֵי זְבֻלוּן שָׂרֵי נַפְתָּלִֽי׃
translation: Your God has commanded your strength. Strengthen, God, that which you have done for us. (Psalms 68:28)

text: וְעַתָּה שָֽׂחֲקוּ עָלַי צְעִירִים מִמֶּנִּי לְיָמִים אֲשֶׁר מָאַסְתִּי אֲבוֹתָם לָשִׁית עִם כַּלְבֵי צֹאנִֽי׃
translation: "But now those who are younger than I have me in derision, whose fathers I considered unworthy to put with my sheep dogs. (Job 30:1)

text: וַתַּשְׁקֶיןָ גַּם בַּלַּיְלָה הַהוּא אֶת אֲבִיהֶן יָיִן וַתָּקָם הַצְּעִירָה וַתִּשְׁכַּב עִמּוֹ וְלֹֽא יָדַע בְּשִׁכְבָהּ וּבְקֻמָֽהּ׃
translation: They made their father drink wine that night also. The younger went and lay with him. He didn't know when she lay down, nor when she got up. (Genesis 19:35)

text: אוֹ נוֹדַע כִּי שׁוֹר נַגָּח הוּא מִתְּמוֹל שִׁלְשֹׁם וְלֹא יִשְׁמְרֶנּוּ בְּעָלָיו שַׁלֵּם יְשַׁלֵּם שׁוֹר תַּחַת הַשּׁוֹר וְהַמֵּת יִֽהְיֶה לּֽוֹ׃
translation: Or if it is known that the bull was in the habit of goring in the past, and its owner has not kept it in, he shall surely pay bull for bull, and the dead animal shall be his own. (Exodus 21:36)

text: וְזֶה דְּבַר הָרֹצֵחַ אֲשֶׁר יָנוּס שָׁמָּה וָחָי אֲשֶׁר יַכֶּה אֶת רֵעֵהוּ בִּבְלִי דַעַת וְהוּא לֹא שֹׂנֵא לוֹ מִתְּמֹל שִׁלְשֹֽׁם׃
translation: This is the case of the man slayer who shall flee there and live: Whoever kills his neighbor unintentionally, and didn't hate him in time past— (Deuteronomy 19:4)

text: כָּל מַחְמֶצֶת לֹא תֹאכֵלוּ בְּכֹל מוֹשְׁבֹתֵיכֶם תֹּאכְלוּ מַצּֽוֹת׃
translation: You shall eat nothing leavened. In all your habitations you shall eat unleavened bread.'" (Exodus 12:20)

text: אֱֽלֹהַי פַּלְּטֵנִי מִיַּד רָשָׁע מִכַּף מְעַוֵּל וְחוֹמֵץ׃
translation: Rescue me, my God, from the hand of the wicked, from the hand of the unrighteous and cruel man. (Psalms 71:4)

text: עַל חַלֹּת לֶחֶם חָמֵץ יַקְרִיב קָרְבָּנוֹ עַל זֶבַח תּוֹדַת שְׁלָמָֽיו׃
translation: He shall offer his offering with the sacrifice of his peace offerings for thanksgiving with cakes of leavened bread. (Leviticus 7:13)

text: וַיִּתְּנוּ בְּבָרוּתִי רֹאשׁ וְלִצְמָאִי יַשְׁקוּנִי חֹֽמֶץ׃
translation: Let their table before them become a snare. May it become a retribution and a trap. (Psalms 69:22)

text: כִּי יִתְחַמֵּץ לְבָבִי וְכִלְיוֹתַי אֶשְׁתּוֹנָֽן׃
translation: For my soul was grieved. I was embittered in my heart. (Psalms 73:21)

text: לֹֽא תִזְבַּח עַל חָמֵץ דַּם זִבְחִי וְלֹֽא יָלִין חֵֽלֶב חַגִּי עַד בֹּֽקֶר׃
translation: "You shall not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leavened bread. The fat of my feast shall not remain all night until the morning. (Exodus 23:18)

text: מַתָּן בַּסֵּתֶר יִכְפֶּה אָף וְשֹׁחַד בַּחֵק חֵמָה עַזָּֽה׃
translation: A gift in secret pacifies anger, and a bribe in the cloak, strong wrath. (Proverbs 21:14)

text: מַצְדִּיקֵי רָשָׁע עֵקֶב שֹׁחַד וְצִדְקַת צַדִּיקִים יָסִירוּ מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃
translation: who acquit the guilty for a bribe, but deny justice for the innocent! (Isaiah 5:23)

text: הֲֽכִי אָמַרְתִּי הָבוּ לִי וּמִכֹּחֲכֶם שִׁחֲדוּ בַעֲדִֽי׃
translation: Did I ever say, 'Give to me'? or, 'Offer a present for me from your substance'? (Job 6:22)

text: שֹׁחַד מֵחֵיק רָשָׁע יִקָּח לְהַטּוֹת אָרְחוֹת מִשְׁפָּֽט׃
translation: A wicked man receives a bribe in secret, to pervert the ways of justice. (Proverbs 17:23)

text: אֲשֶׁר בִּידֵיהֶם זִמָּה וִֽימִינָם מָלְאָה שֹּֽׁחַד׃
translation: in whose hands is wickedness; their right hand is full of bribes. (Psalms 26:10)

text: לֹא יִשָּׂא פְּנֵי כָל כֹּפֶר וְלֹֽא יֹאבֶה כִּי תַרְבֶּה שֹֽׁחַד׃
translation: He won't regard any ransom, neither will he rest content, though you give many gifts. (Proverbs 6:35)

text: וְעָשִׂיתָ עַל הַחֹשֶׁן שַֽׁרְשֹׁת גַּבְלֻת מַעֲשֵׂה עֲבֹת זָהָב טָהֽוֹר׃
translation: You shall make on the breastplate chains like cords, of braided work of pure gold. (Exodus 28:22)

text: וְאַבְנֵי שֹׁהַם וְאַבְנֵי מִלֻּאִים לָאֵפוֹד וְלַחֹֽשֶׁן׃
translation: onyx stones, and stones to be set for the ephod and for the breastplate. (Exodus 35:9)

text: וְהַנְּשִׂאִם הֵבִיאוּ אֵת אַבְנֵי הַשֹּׁהַם וְאֵת אַבְנֵי הַמִּלֻּאִים לָאֵפוֹד וְלַחֹֽשֶׁן׃
translation: The rulers brought the onyx stones and the stones to be set for the ephod and for the breastplate; (Exodus 35:27)

text: וַֽיִּתְּנוּ שְׁתֵּי הָעֲבֹתֹת הַזָּהָב עַל שְׁתֵּי הַטַּבָּעֹת עַל קְצוֹת הַחֹֽשֶׁן׃
translation: They put the two braided chains of gold in the two rings at the ends of the breastplate. (Exodus 39:17)

text: וְנָתַתָּה אֶת שְׁתֵּי עֲבֹתֹת הַזָּהָב עַל שְׁתֵּי הַטַּבָּעֹת אֶל קְצוֹת הַחֹֽשֶׁן׃
translation: You shall put the two braided chains of gold in the two rings at the ends of the breastplate. (Exodus 28:24)

text: וְעָשִׂיתָ עַל הַחֹשֶׁן שְׁתֵּי טַבְּעוֹת זָהָב וְנָתַתָּ אֶת שְׁתֵּי הַטַּבָּעוֹת עַל שְׁנֵי קְצוֹת הַחֹֽשֶׁן׃
translation: You shall make on the breastplate two rings of gold, and shall put the two rings on the two ends of the breastplate. (Exodus 28:23)

text: וַיָּשֶׂם אֶת מִזְבַּח הַזָּהָב בְּאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד לִפְנֵי הַפָּרֹֽכֶת׃
translation: He put the golden altar in the Tent of Meeting before the veil; (Exodus 40:26)

text: וְשַׂמְתָּ שָׁם אֵת אֲרוֹן הָעֵדוּת וְסַכֹּתָ עַל הָאָרֹן אֶת הַפָּרֹֽכֶת׃
translation: You shall put the ark of the covenant in it, and you shall screen the ark with the veil. (Exodus 40:3)

text: וַיִּתֵּן אֶת הַשֻּׁלְחָן בְּאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד עַל יֶרֶךְ הַמִּשְׁכָּן צָפֹנָה מִחוּץ לַפָּרֹֽכֶת׃
translation: He put the table in the Tent of Meeting, on the north side of the tabernacle, outside of the veil. (Exodus 40:22)

text: וַיַּעַשׂ אֶת הַפָּרֹכֶת תְּכֵלֶת וְאַרְגָּמָן וְתוֹלַעַת שָׁנִי וְשֵׁשׁ מָשְׁזָר מַעֲשֵׂה חֹשֵׁב עָשָׂה אֹתָהּ כְּרֻבִֽים׃
translation: He made the veil of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen, with cherubim. He made it the work of a skillful workman. (Exodus 36:35)

text: וּבָא אַהֲרֹן וּבָנָיו בִּנְסֹעַ הַֽמַּחֲנֶה וְהוֹרִדוּ אֵת פָּרֹכֶת הַמָּסָךְ וְכִסּוּ בָהּ אֵת אֲרֹן הָעֵדֻֽת׃
translation: When the camp moves forward, Aaron shall go in with his sons; and they shall take down the veil of the screen, cover the ark of the Testimony with it, (Numbers 4:5)

text: וְנָתַתָּה אֹתוֹ לִפְנֵי הַפָּרֹכֶת אֲשֶׁר עַל אֲרֹן הָעֵדֻת לִפְנֵי הַכַּפֹּרֶת אֲשֶׁר עַל הָעֵדֻת אֲשֶׁר אִוָּעֵד לְךָ שָֽׁמָּה׃
translation: You shall put it before the veil that is by the ark of the covenant, before the mercy seat that is over the covenant, where I will meet with you. (Exodus 30:6)

text: אָרוּר מַשְׁגֶּה עִוֵּר בַּדָּרֶךְ וְאָמַר כָּל הָעָם אָמֵֽן׃
translation: 'Cursed is he who leads the blind astray on the road.' All the people shall say, 'Amen.' (Deuteronomy 27:18)

text: הוֹרוּנִי וַאֲנִי אַחֲרִישׁ וּמַה שָּׁגִיתִי הָבִינוּ לִֽי׃
translation: "Teach me, and I will hold my peace. Cause me to understand my error. (Job 6:24)

text: הוּא יָמוּת בְּאֵין מוּסָר וּבְרֹב אִוַּלְתּוֹ יִשְׁגֶּֽה׃
translation: He will die for lack of instruction. In the greatness of his folly, he will go astray. (Proverbs 5:23)

text: חַֽדַל בְּנִי לִשְׁמֹעַ מוּסָר לִשְׁגוֹת מֵֽאִמְרֵי דָֽעַת׃
translation: If you stop listening to instruction, my son, you will stray from the words of knowledge. (Proverbs 19:27)

text: לֵץ הַיַּין הֹמֶה שֵׁכָר וְכָל שֹׁגֶה בּוֹ לֹא יֶחְכָּֽם׃
translation: Wine is a mocker and beer is a brawler. Whoever is led astray by them is not wise. (Proverbs 20:1)

text: עִמּוֹ עֹז וְתֽוּשִׁיָּה לוֹ שֹׁגֵג וּמַשְׁגֶּֽה׃
translation: With him is strength and wisdom. The deceived and the deceiver are his. (Job 12:16)

text: אַל תִּירָא מִפַּחַד פִּתְאֹם וּמִשֹּׁאַת רְשָׁעִים כִּי תָבֹֽא׃
translation: Don't be afraid of sudden fear, neither of the desolation of the wicked, when it comes; (Proverbs 3:25)

text: וַיָּבֹא אֲלֵיהֶם יְהוֹשֻׁעַ פִּתְאֹם כָּל הַלַּיְלָה עָלָה מִן הַגִּלְגָּֽל׃
translation: Joshua therefore came to them suddenly. He marched from Gilgal all night. (Joshua 10:9)

text: הָרִֽאשֹׁנוֹת מֵאָז הִגַּדְתִּי וּמִפִּי יָצְאוּ וְאַשְׁמִיעֵם פִּתְאֹם עָשִׂיתִי וַתָּבֹֽאנָה׃
translation: I have declared the former things from of old. Yes, they went out of my mouth, and I revealed them. I did them suddenly, and they happened. (Isaiah 48:3)

text: וַיֹּרֵם אֱלֹהִים חֵץ פִּתְאוֹם הָיוּ מַכּוֹתָֽם׃
translation: Their own tongues shall ruin them. All who see them will shake their heads. (Psalms 64:8)

text: הוֹלֵךְ אַחֲרֶיהָ פִּתְאֹם כְּשׁוֹר אֶל טָבַח יָבוֹא וּכְעֶכֶס אֶל מוּסַר אֱוִֽיל׃
translation: He followed her immediately, as an ox goes to the slaughter, as a fool stepping into a noose. (Proverbs 7:22)

text: וַיִּשְׂמַח יְחִזְקִיָּהוּ וְכָל הָעָם עַל הַהֵכִין הָאֱלֹהִים לָעָם כִּי בְּפִתְאֹם הָיָה הַדָּבָֽר׃
translation: Hezekiah and all the people rejoiced because of that which God had prepared for the people; for the thing was done suddenly. (2 Chronicles 29:36)

text: עַל מֶה נִאֵץ רָשָׁע אֱלֹהִים אָמַר בְּלִבּוֹ לֹא תִּדְרֹֽשׁ׃
translation: Why does the wicked person condemn God, and say in his heart, "God won't call me into account"? (Psalms 10:13)

text: עַד מָתַי אֱלֹהִים יְחָרֶף צָר יְנָאֵץ אוֹיֵב שִׁמְךָ לָנֶֽצַח׃
translation: How long, God, shall the adversary reproach? Shall the enemy blaspheme your name forever? (Psalms 74:10)

text: זְכָר זֹאת אוֹיֵב חֵרֵף יְהוָה וְעַם נָבָל נִֽאֲצוּ שְׁמֶֽךָ׃
translation: Remember this, that the enemy has mocked you, LORD. Foolish people have blasphemed your name. (Psalms 74:18)

text: כִּֽי הִמְרוּ אִמְרֵי אֵל וַעֲצַת עֶלְיוֹן נָאָֽצוּ׃
translation: because they rebelled against the words of God, and condemned the counsel of the Most High. (Psalms 107:11)

text: וְֽאָמַרְתָּ אֵיךְ שָׂנֵאתִי מוּסָר וְתוֹכַחַת נָאַץ לִבִּֽי׃
translation: and say, "How I have hated instruction, and my heart despised reproof. (Proverbs 5:12)

text: וַיַּרְא יְהוָה וַיִּנְאָץ מִכַּעַס בָּנָיו וּבְנֹתָֽיו׃
translation: The LORD saw and abhorred, because of the provocation of his sons and his daughters. (Deuteronomy 32:19)

text: יֵֽלְכוּ יֹֽנְקוֹתָיו וִיהִי כַזַּיִת הוֹדוֹ וְרֵיחַֽ לוֹ כַּלְּבָנֽוֹן׃
translation: Men will dwell in his shade. They will revive like the grain, and blossom like the vine. Their fragrance will be like the wine of Lebanon. (Hosea 14:7)

text: וְנָתַתָּה מֵהֽוֹדְךָ עָלָיו לְמַעַן יִשְׁמְעוּ כָּל עֲדַת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
translation: You shall give authority to him, that all the congregation of the children of Israel may obey. (Numbers 27:20)

text: מִצָּפוֹן זָהָב יֶֽאֱתֶה עַל אֱלוֹהַּ נוֹרָא הֽוֹד׃
translation: Out of the north comes golden splendor. With God is awesome majesty. (Job 37:22)

text: עֲדֵה נָא גָֽאוֹן וָגֹבַהּ וְהוֹד וְהָדָר תִּלְבָּֽשׁ׃
translation: "Now deck yourself with excellency and dignity. Array yourself with honor and majesty. (Job 40:10)

text: גָּדוֹל כְּבוֹדוֹ בִּישׁוּעָתֶךָ הוֹד וְהָדָר תְּשַׁוֶּה עָלָֽיו׃
translation: For you make him most blessed forever. You make him glad with joy in your presence. (Psalms 21:6)

text: חֲגֽוֹר חַרְבְּךָ עַל יָרֵךְ גִּבּוֹר הוֹדְךָ וַהֲדָרֶֽךָ׃
translation: In your majesty ride on victoriously on behalf of truth, humility, and righteousness. Let your right hand display awesome deeds. (Psalms 45:4)

text: וְנָסַב הַגְּבוּל מֵעַצְמוֹן נַחְלָה מִצְרָיִם וְהָיוּ תוֹצְאֹתָיו הַיָּֽמָּה׃
translation: The border shall turn about from Azmon to the brook of Egypt, and it shall end at the sea. (Numbers 34:5)

text: הָאֵל לָנוּ אֵל לְֽמוֹשָׁעוֹת וְלֵיהוִה אֲדֹנָי לַמָּוֶת תּוֹצָאֽוֹת׃
translation: But God will strike through the head of his enemies, the hairy scalp of such a one as still continues in his guiltiness. (Psalms 68:21)

text: מִֽכָּל מִשְׁמָר נְצֹר לִבֶּךָ כִּֽי מִמֶּנּוּ תּוֹצְאוֹת חַיִּֽים׃
translation: Keep your heart with all diligence, for out of it is the wellspring of life. (Proverbs 4:23)

text: מֵהֹר הָהָר תְּתָאוּ לְבֹא חֲמָת וְהָיוּ תּוֹצְאֹת הַגְּבֻל צְדָֽדָה׃
translation: From Mount Hor you shall mark out to the entrance of Hamath; and the border shall pass by Zedad. (Numbers 34:8)

text: וַיֵּֽשְׁבוּ בַּגִּלְעָד בַּבָּשָׁן וּבִבְנֹתֶיהָ וּבְכָֽל מִגְרְשֵׁי שָׁרוֹן עַל תּוֹצְאוֹתָֽם׃
translation: They lived in Gilead in Bashan and in its towns, and in all the pasture lands of Sharon as far as their borders. (1 Chronicles 5:16)

text: וְנָסַב אֹתוֹ הַגְּבוּל מִצְּפוֹן חַנָּתֹן וְהָיוּ תֹּֽצְאֹתָיו גֵּי יִפְתַּח אֵֽל׃
translation: The border turned around it on the north to Hannathon; and it ended at the valley of Iphtah El; (Joshua 19:14)

text: כֵּן אָרְחוֹת כָּל שֹׁכְחֵי אֵל וְתִקְוַת חָנֵף תֹּאבֵֽד׃
translation: So are the paths of all who forget God. The hope of the godless man will perish, (Job 8:13)

text: כִּֽי עֲדַת חָנֵף גַּלְמוּד וְאֵשׁ אָכְלָה אָֽהֳלֵי שֹֽׁחַד׃
translation: For the company of the godless will be barren, and fire will consume the tents of bribery. (Job 15:34)

text: יָשֹׁמּוּ יְשָׁרִים עַל זֹאת וְנָקִי עַל חָנֵף יִתְעֹרָֽר׃
translation: Upright men will be astonished at this. The innocent will stir himself up against the godless. (Job 17:8)

text: כִּי רִנְנַת רְשָׁעִים מִקָּרוֹב וְשִׂמְחַת חָנֵף עֲדֵי רָֽגַע׃
translation: that the triumphing of the wicked is short, the joy of the godless but for a moment? (Job 20:5)

text: וְֽחַנְפֵי לֵב יָשִׂימוּ אָף לֹא יְשַׁוְּעוּ כִּי אֲסָרָֽם׃
translation: "But those who are godless in heart lay up anger. They don't cry for help when he binds them. (Job 36:13)

text: גַּם הוּא לִי לִֽישׁוּעָה כִּי לֹא לְפָנָיו חָנֵף יָבֽוֹא׃
translation: This also will be my salvation, that a godless man will not come before him. (Job 13:16)

text: חָכְמוֹת בָּנְתָה בֵיתָהּ חָצְבָה עַמּוּדֶיהָ שִׁבְעָֽה׃
translation: Wisdom has built her house. She has carved out her seven pillars. (Proverbs 9:1)

text: עַל כֵּן חָצַבְתִּי בַּנְּבִיאִים הֲרַגְתִּים בְּאִמְרֵי פִי וּמִשְׁפָּטֶיךָ אוֹר יֵצֵֽא׃
translation: Therefore I have cut them to pieces with the prophets; I killed them with the words of my mouth. Your judgments are like a flash of lightning. (Hosea 6:5)

text: וְעִמְּךָ לָרֹב עֹשֵׂי מְלָאכָה חֹצְבִים וְחָרָשֵׁי אֶבֶן וָעֵץ וְכָל חָכָם בְּכָל מְלָאכָֽה׃
translation: There are also workmen with you in abundance—cutters and workers of stone and timber, and all kinds of men who are skillful in every kind of work; (1 Chronicles 22:15)

text: וַיִּסְפֹּר שְׁלֹמֹה שִׁבְעִים אֶלֶף אִישׁ סַבָּל וּשְׁמוֹנִים אֶלֶף אִישׁ חֹצֵב בָּהָר וּמְנַצְּחִים עֲלֵיהֶם שְׁלֹשֶׁת אֲלָפִים וְשֵׁשׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃
translation: Now Solomon decided to build a house for the LORD's name, and a house for his kingdom. (2 Chronicles 2:1)

text: וַיַּעַשׂ מֵהֶם שִׁבְעִים אֶלֶף סַבָּל וּשְׁמֹנִים אֶלֶף חֹצֵב בָּהָר וּשְׁלֹשֶׁת אֲלָפִים וְשֵׁשׁ מֵאוֹת מְנַצְּחִים לְהַעֲבִיד אֶת הָעָֽם׃
translation: Solomon counted all the foreigners who were in the land of Israel, after the census with which David his father had counted them; and they found one hundred fifty-three thousand six hundred. (2 Chronicles 2:17)

text: אֶרֶץ אֲשֶׁר לֹא בְמִסְכֵּנֻת תֹּֽאכַל בָּהּ לֶחֶם לֹֽא תֶחְסַר כֹּל בָּהּ אֶרֶץ אֲשֶׁר אֲבָנֶיהָ בַרְזֶל וּמֵהֲרָרֶיהָ תַּחְצֹב נְחֹֽשֶׁת׃
translation: a land in which you shall eat bread without scarcity, you shall not lack anything in it; a land whose stones are iron, and out of whose hills you may dig copper. (Deuteronomy 8:9)

text: וַיִּגֹּף יְהוָה אֶת הַכּוּשִׁים לִפְנֵי אָסָא וְלִפְנֵי יְהוּדָה וַיָּנֻסוּ הַכּוּשִֽׁים׃
translation: Asa cried to the LORD his God, and said, "LORD, there is no one besides you to help, between the mighty and him who has no strength. Help us, LORD our God; for we rely on you, and in your name are we come against this multitude. LORD, you are our God. Don't let man prevail against you." (2 Chronicles 14:11)

text: וּמָשַׁל בְּמִכְמַנֵּי הַזָּהָב וְהַכֶּסֶף וּבְכֹל חֲמֻדוֹת מִצְרָיִם וְלֻבִים וְכֻשִׁים בְּמִצְעָדָֽיו׃
translation: But he will have power over the treasures of gold and of silver, and over all the precious things of Egypt. The Libyans and the Ethiopians will follow his steps. (Daniel 11:43)

text: גַּם אַתֶּם כּוּשִׁים חַֽלְלֵי חַרְבִּי הֵֽמָּה׃
translation: You Cushites also, you will be killed by my sword. (Zephaniah 2:12)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר יוֹאָב לַכּוּשִׁי לֵךְ הַגֵּד לַמֶּלֶךְ אֲשֶׁר רָאִיתָה וַיִּשְׁתַּחוּ כוּשִׁי לְיוֹאָב וַיָּרֹֽץ׃
translation: Then Joab said to the Cushite, "Go, tell the king what you have seen!" The Cushite bowed himself to Joab, and ran. (2 Samuel 18:21)

text: וִיהִי מָה אָרוּץ וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ רוּץ וַיָּרָץ אֲחִימַעַץ דֶּרֶךְ הַכִּכָּר וַֽיַּעֲבֹר אֶת הַכּוּשִֽׁי׃
translation: "But come what may," he said, "I will run." He said to him, "Run!" Then Ahimaaz ran by the way of the Plain, and outran the Cushite. (2 Samuel 18:23)

text: וַיֵּצֵא אֲלֵיהֶם זֶרַח הַכּוּשִׁי בְּחַיִל אֶלֶף אֲלָפִים וּמַרְכָּבוֹת שְׁלֹשׁ מֵאוֹת וַיָּבֹא עַד מָרֵשָֽׁה׃
translation: Asa had an army of three hundred thousand out of Judah who bore bucklers and spears, and two hundred eighty thousand out of Benjamin who bore shields and drew bows. All these were mighty men of valor. (2 Chronicles 14:8)

text: וְשַׁבְּתַי וְיוֹזָבָד עַל הַמְּלָאכָה הַחִֽיצֹנָה לְבֵית הָאֱלֹהִים מֵרָאשֵׁי הַלְוִיִּֽם׃
translation: and Shabbethai and Jozabad, of the chiefs of the Levites, who had the oversight of the outward business of God's house; (Nehemiah 11:16)

text: וְהַשַּׁעַר אֲשֶׁר פָּנָיו דֶּרֶךְ הַצָּפוֹן לֶחָצֵר הַחִֽיצוֹנָה מָדַד אָרְכּוֹ וְרָחְבּֽוֹ׃
translation: He measured the length and width of the gate of the outer court which faces toward the north. (Ezekiel 40:20)

text: וַיָּשֶׁב אֹתִי דֶּרֶךְ שַׁעַר הַמִּקְדָּשׁ הַֽחִיצוֹן הַפֹּנֶה קָדִים וְהוּא סָגֽוּר׃
translation: Then he brought me back by the way of the outer gate of the sanctuary, which looks toward the east; and it was shut. (Ezekiel 44:1)

text: וְקוֹל כַּנְפֵי הַכְּרוּבִים נִשְׁמַע עַד הֶחָצֵר הַחִיצֹנָה כְּקוֹל אֵל שַׁדַּי בְּדַבְּרֽוֹ׃
translation: The sound of the wings of the cherubim was heard even to the outer court, as the voice of God Almighty when he speaks. (Ezekiel 10:5)

text: ומתחתה לשכות וּמִתַּחַת הַלְּשָׁכוֹת הָאֵלֶּה המבוא הַמֵּבִיא מֵֽהַקָּדִים בְּבֹאוֹ לָהֵנָּה מֵֽהֶחָצֵר הַחִצֹנָֽה׃
translation: From under these rooms was the entry on the east side, as one goes into them from the outer court. (Ezekiel 42:9)

text: ואלמו וְאֵלַמָּיו לֶֽחָצֵר הַחִיצוֹנָה וְתִמֹרִים אֶל אלו אֵלָיו מִפּוֹ וּמִפּוֹ וּשְׁמֹנֶה מַעֲלוֹת מעלו מַעֲלָֽיו׃
translation: Its arches were toward the outer court. Palm trees were on its posts on this side and on that side. The ascent to it had eight steps. (Ezekiel 40:34)

text: אַנְתְּה מַלְכָּא מֶלֶךְ מַלְכַיָּא דִּי אֱלָהּ שְׁמַיָּא מַלְכוּתָא חִסְנָא וְתָקְפָּא וִֽיקָרָא יְהַב לָֽךְ׃
translation: You, O king, are king of kings, to whom the God of heaven has given the kingdom, the power, the strength, and the glory. (Daniel 2:37)

text: אנתה אַנְתְּ מַלְכָּא אֱלָהָא עליא עִלָּאָה מַלְכוּתָא וּרְבוּתָא וִיקָרָא וְהַדְרָה יְהַב לִנְבֻכַדְנֶצַּר אֲבֽוּךְ׃
translation: "To you, king, the Most High God gave Nebuchadnezzar your father the kingdom, and greatness, and glory, and majesty. (Daniel 5:18)

text: ואנתה וְאַנְתְּ בְּרֵהּ בֵּלְשַׁאצַּר לָא הַשְׁפֵּלְתְּ לִבְבָךְ כָּל קֳבֵל דִּי כָל דְּנָה יְדַֽעְתָּ׃
translation: "You, his son, Belshazzar, have not humbled your heart, though you knew all this, (Daniel 5:22)

text: אַנְתְּה מַלְכָּא חָזֵה הֲוַיְתָ וַאֲלוּ צְלֵם חַד שַׂגִּיא צַלְמָא דִּכֵּן רַב וְזִיוֵהּ יַתִּיר קָאֵם לְקָבְלָךְ וְרֵוֵהּ דְּחִֽיל׃
translation: "You, O king, saw, and behold, a great image. This image, which was mighty, and whose brightness was excellent, stood before you; and its appearance was terrifying. (Daniel 2:31)

text: וּבְכָל דִּי דארין דָֽיְרִין בְּֽנֵי אֲנָשָׁא חֵיוַת בָּרָא וְעוֹף שְׁמַיָּא יְהַב בִּידָךְ וְהַשְׁלְטָךְ בְּכָלְּהוֹן אַנְתְּה הוּא רֵאשָׁה דִּי דַהֲבָֽא׃
translation: Wherever the children of men dwell, he has given the animals of the field and the birds of the sky into your hand, and has made you rule over them all. You are the head of gold. (Daniel 2:38)

text: אֶרֶךְ אַפַּיִם רַב תְּבוּנָה וּקְצַר רוּחַ מֵרִים אִוֶּֽלֶת׃
translation: He who is slow to anger has great understanding, but he who has a quick temper displays folly. (Proverbs 14:29)

text: אִוֶּלֶת שִׂמְחָה לַחֲסַר לֵב וְאִישׁ תְּבוּנָה יְיַשֶׁר לָֽכֶת׃
translation: Folly is joy to one who is void of wisdom, but a man of understanding keeps his way straight. (Proverbs 15:21)

text: מֵשִׁיב דָּבָר בְּטֶרֶם יִשְׁמָע אִוֶּלֶת הִיא לוֹ וּכְלִמָּֽה׃
translation: He who answers before he hears, that is folly and shame to him. (Proverbs 18:13)

text: אִוֶּלֶת קְשׁוּרָה בְלֶב נָעַר שֵׁבֶט מוּסָר יַרְחִיקֶנָּה מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃
translation: Folly is bound up in the heart of a child; the rod of discipline drives it far from him. (Proverbs 22:15)

text: חַכְמוֹת נָשִׁים בָּנְתָה בֵיתָהּ וְאִוֶּלֶת בְּיָדֶיהָ תֶהֶרְסֶֽנּוּ׃
translation: Every wise woman builds her house, but the foolish one tears it down with her own hands. (Proverbs 14:1)

text: לֵב נָבוֹן יְבַקֶּשׁ דָּעַת ופני וּפִי כְסִילִים יִרְעֶה אִוֶּֽלֶת׃
translation: The heart of one who has understanding seeks knowledge, but the mouths of fools feed on folly. (Proverbs 15:14)

text: אֶת מִי הִגַּדְתָּ מִלִּין וְנִשְׁמַת מִי יָצְאָה מִמֶּֽךָּ׃
translation: To whom have you uttered words? Whose spirit came out of you? (Job 26:4)

text: כִּֽי כָל עוֹד נִשְׁמָתִי בִי וְרוּחַ אֱלוֹהַּ בְּאַפִּֽי׃
translation: (for the length of my life is still in me, and the spirit of God is in my nostrils); (Job 27:3)

text: אִם יָשִׂים אֵלָיו לִבּוֹ רוּחוֹ וְנִשְׁמָתוֹ אֵלָיו יֶאֱסֹֽף׃
translation: If he set his heart on himself, if he gathered to himself his spirit and his breath, (Job 34:14)

text: מִנִּשְׁמַת אֵל יִתֶּן קָרַח וְרֹחַב מַיִם בְּמוּצָֽק׃
translation: By the breath of God, ice is given, and the width of the waters is frozen. (Job 37:10)

text: כֹּל אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁמַת רוּחַ חַיִּים בְּאַפָּיו מִכֹּל אֲשֶׁר בֶּחָֽרָבָה מֵֽתוּ׃
translation: All on the dry land, in whose nostrils was the breath of the spirit of life, died. (Genesis 7:22)

text: מִנִּשְׁמַת אֱלוֹהַ יֹאבֵדוּ וּמֵרוּחַ אַפּוֹ יִכְלֽוּ׃
translation: By the breath of God they perish. By the blast of his anger are they consumed. (Job 4:9)

text: מִי הוּא יָרִיב עִמָּדִי כִּֽי עַתָּה אַחֲרִישׁ וְאֶגְוָֽע׃
translation: Who is he who will contend with me? For then I would hold my peace and give up the spirit. (Job 13:19)

text: יִגְוַע כָּל בָּשָׂר יָחַד וְאָדָם עַל עָפָר יָשֽׁוּב׃
translation: all flesh would perish together, and man would turn again to dust. (Job 34:15)

text: וְאִם לֹא יִשְׁמְעוּ בְּשֶׁלַח יַעֲבֹרוּ וְיִגְוְעוּ כִּבְלִי דָֽעַת׃
translation: But if they don't listen, they will perish by the sword; they will die without knowledge. (Job 36:12)

text: לָמָּה לֹּא מֵרֶחֶם אָמוּת מִבֶּטֶן יָצָאתִי וְאֶגְוָֽע׃
translation: "Why didn't I die from the womb? Why didn't I give up the spirit when my mother bore me? (Job 3:11)

text: וְלָמָּה מֵרֶחֶם הֹצֵאתָנִי אֶגְוַע וְעַיִן לֹא תִרְאֵֽנִי׃
translation: "'Why, then, have you brought me out of the womb? I wish I had given up the spirit, and no eye had seen me. (Job 10:18)

text: תַּסְתִּיר פָּנֶיךָ יִֽבָּהֵלוּן תֹּסֵף רוּחָם יִגְוָעוּן וְֽאֶל עֲפָרָם יְשׁוּבֽוּן׃
translation: You hide your face; they are troubled. You take away their breath; they die and return to the dust. (Psalms 104:29)

text: גַּן נָעוּל אֲחֹתִי כַלָּה גַּל נָעוּל מַעְיָן חָתֽוּם׃
translation: My sister, my bride, is a locked up garden; a locked up spring, a sealed fountain. (Song of Solomon 4:12)

text: וַיִּסָּֽכְרוּ מַעְיְנֹת תְּהוֹם וַֽאֲרֻבֹּת הַשָּׁמָיִם וַיִּכָּלֵא הַגֶּשֶׁם מִן הַשָּׁמָֽיִם׃
translation: The deep's fountains and the sky's windows were also stopped, and the rain from the sky was restrained. (Genesis 8:2)

text: בְּאֵין תְּהֹמוֹת חוֹלָלְתִּי בְּאֵין מַעְיָנוֹת נִכְבַּדֵּי מָֽיִם׃
translation: When there were no depths, I was born, when there were no springs abounding with water. (Proverbs 8:24)

text: הַֽמְשַׁלֵּחַ מַעְיָנִים בַּנְּחָלִים בֵּין הָרִים יְהַלֵּכֽוּן׃
translation: He sends springs into the valleys. They run among the mountains. (Psalms 104:10)

text: יָפוּצוּ מַעְיְנֹתֶיךָ חוּצָה בָּרְחֹבוֹת פַּלְגֵי מָֽיִם׃
translation: Should your springs overflow in the streets, streams of water in the public squares? (Proverbs 5:16)

text: וְשָׁרִים כְּחֹלְלִים כָּֽל מַעְיָנַי בָּֽךְ׃
translation: Those who sing as well as those who dance say, "All my springs are in you." (Psalms 87:7)

text: וְהוֹתַרְתִּי בִּהְיוֹת לָכֶם פְּלִיטֵי חֶרֶב בַּגּוֹיִם בְּהִזָּרֽוֹתֵיכֶם בָּאֲרָצֽוֹת׃
translation: "'"Yet I will leave a remnant, in that you will have some that escape the sword among the nations, when you are scattered through the countries. (Ezekiel 6:8)

text: בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא יָבוֹא הַפָּלִיט אֵלֶיךָ לְהַשְׁמָעוּת אָזְנָֽיִם׃
translation: that in that day he who escapes will come to you, to cause you to hear it with your ears? (Ezekiel 24:26)

text: וּפָֽלְטוּ פְּלִיטֵיהֶם וְהָיוּ אֶל הֶהָרִים כְּיוֹנֵי הַגֵּאָיוֹת כֻּלָּם הֹמוֹת אִישׁ בַּעֲוֺנֽוֹ׃
translation: But of those who escape, they will escape and will be on the mountains like doves of the valleys, all of them moaning, everyone in his iniquity. (Ezekiel 7:16)

text: קוֹל נָסִים וּפְלֵטִים מֵאֶרֶץ בָּבֶל לְהַגִּיד בְּצִיּוֹן אֶת נִקְמַת יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ נִקְמַת הֵיכָלֽוֹ׃
translation: Listen to those who flee and escape out of the land of Babylon, to declare in Zion the vengeance of the LORD our God, the vengeance of his temple. (Jeremiah 50:28)

text: פְּלֵטִים מֵחֶרֶב הִלְכוּ אַֽל תַּעֲמֹדוּ זִכְרוּ מֵֽרָחוֹק אֶת יְהוָה וִירֽוּשָׁלִַם תַּעֲלֶה עַל לְבַבְכֶֽם׃
translation: You who have escaped the sword, go! Don't stand still! Remember the LORD from afar, and let Jerusalem come into your mind." (Jeremiah 51:50)

text: אוֹי לְךָ מוֹאָב אָבַדְתָּ עַם כְּמוֹשׁ נָתַן בָּנָיו פְּלֵיטִם וּבְנֹתָיו בַּשְּׁבִית לְמֶלֶךְ אֱמֹרִי סִיחֽוֹן׃
translation: Woe to you, Moab! You are undone, people of Chemosh! He has given his sons as fugitives, and his daughters into captivity, to Sihon king of the Amorites. (Numbers 21:29)

text: וּפִגְרֵיכֶם אַתֶּם יִפְּלוּ בַּמִּדְבָּר הַזֶּֽה׃
translation: But as for you, your dead bodies shall fall in this wilderness. (Numbers 14:32)

text: וְנָתַתִּי אֶת פִּגְרֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לִפְנֵי גִּלּֽוּלֵיהֶם וְזֵרִיתִי אֶת עַצְמוֹתֵיכֶם סְבִיבוֹת מִזְבְּחוֹתֵיכֶֽם׃
translation: I will lay the dead bodies of the children of Israel before their idols. I will scatter your bones around your altars. (Ezekiel 6:5)

text: וִֽיהוּדָה בָּא עַל הַמִּצְפֶּה לַמִּדְבָּר וַיִּפְנוּ אֶל הֶהָמוֹן וְהִנָּם פְּגָרִים נֹפְלִים אַרְצָה וְאֵין פְּלֵיטָֽה׃
translation: When Judah came to the place overlooking the wilderness, they looked at the multitude; and behold, they were dead bodies fallen to the earth, and there were none who escaped. (2 Chronicles 20:24)

text: בַּמִּדְבָּר הַזֶּה יִפְּלוּ פִגְרֵיכֶם וְכָל פְּקֻדֵיכֶם לְכָל מִסְפַּרְכֶם מִבֶּן עֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה וָמָעְלָה אֲשֶׁר הֲלִֽינֹתֶם עָלָֽי׃
translation: Your dead bodies shall fall in this wilderness; and all who were counted of you, according to your whole number, from twenty years old and upward, who have complained against me, (Numbers 14:29)

text: וַיִּרְדֹּף דָּוִד הוּא וְאַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת אִישׁ וַיַּֽעַמְדוּ מָאתַיִם אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר פִּגְּרוּ מֵעֲבֹר אֶת נַחַל הַבְּשֽׂוֹר׃
translation: But David pursued, he and four hundred men; for two hundred stayed behind, who were so faint that they couldn't go over the brook Besor. (1 Samuel 30:10)

text: וְאַתָּה הָשְׁלַכְתָּ מִֽקִּבְרְךָ כְּנֵצֶר נִתְעָב לְבוּשׁ הֲרֻגִים מְטֹעֲנֵי חָרֶב יוֹרְדֵי אֶל אַבְנֵי בוֹר כְּפֶגֶר מוּבָֽס׃
translation: But you are cast away from your tomb like an abominable branch, clothed with the slain who are thrust through with the sword, who go down to the stones of the pit; like a dead body trodden under foot. (Isaiah 14:19)

text: וַיִּֽקַּֽח לוֹ חֶרֶשׂ לְהִתְגָּרֵד בּוֹ וְהוּא יֹשֵׁב בְּתוֹךְ הָאֵֽפֶר׃
translation: He took for himself a potsherd to scrape himself with, and he sat among the ashes. (Job 2:8)

text: עַל כֵּן אֶמְאַס וְנִחַמְתִּי עַל עָפָר וָאֵֽפֶר׃
translation: Therefore I abhor myself, and repent in dust and ashes." (Job 42:6)

text: כִּי אֵפֶר כַּלֶּחֶם אָכָלְתִּי וְשִׁקֻּוַי בִּבְכִי מָסָֽכְתִּי׃
translation: because of your indignation and your wrath; for you have taken me up and thrown me away. (Psalms 102:10)

text: הֹרָנִי לַחֹמֶר וָאֶתְמַשֵּׁל כֶּעָפָר וָאֵֽפֶר׃
translation: He has cast me into the mire. I have become like dust and ashes. (Job 30:19)

text: וַיַּגְרֵס בֶּֽחָצָץ שִׁנָּי הִכְפִּישַׁנִי בָּאֵֽפֶר׃
translation: He has also broken my teeth with gravel. He has covered me with ashes. (Lamentations 3:16)

text: וְהִשְׁמִיעוּ עָלַיִךְ בְּקוֹלָם וְיִזְעֲקוּ מָרָה וְיַעֲלוּ עָֽפָר עַל רָאשֵׁיהֶם בָּאֵפֶר יִתְפַּלָּֽשׁוּ׃
translation: and will cause their voice to be heard over you, and will cry bitterly. They will cast up dust on their heads. They will wallow in the ashes. (Ezekiel 27:30)

text: אַךְ לֹא בְעִי יִשְׁלַח יָד אִם בְּפִידוֹ לָהֶן שֽׁוּעַ׃
translation: "However doesn't one stretch out a hand in his fall? Or in his calamity therefore cry for help? (Job 30:24)

text: וַיִּקְרָא מֶֽלֶךְ מִצְרַיִם לַֽמְיַלְּדֹת וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶן מַדּוּעַ עֲשִׂיתֶן הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה וַתְּחַיֶּיןָ אֶת הַיְלָדִֽים׃
translation: The king of Egypt called for the midwives, and said to them, "Why have you done this thing and saved the boys alive?" (Exodus 1:18)

text: יִתֵּן יְהוָה לָכֶם וּמְצֶאןָ מְנוּחָה אִשָּׁה בֵּית אִישָׁהּ וַתִּשַּׁק לָהֶן וַתִּשֶּׂאנָה קוֹלָן וַתִּבְכֶּֽינָה׃
translation: May the LORD grant you that you may find rest, each of you in the house of her husband." Then she kissed them, and they lifted up their voices, and wept. (Ruth 1:9)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֵלַי בֶּן אָדָם הֲתִשְׁפּוֹט אֶֽת אָהֳלָה וְאֶת אָהֳלִיבָה וְהַגֵּד לָהֶן אֵת תוֹעֲבוֹתֵיהֶֽן׃
translation: The LORD said moreover to me: "Son of man, will you judge Oholah and Oholibah? Then declare to them their abominations. (Ezekiel 23:36)

text: הֵמָּה עֹלִים בְּמַעֲלֵה הָעִיר וְהֵמָּה מָצְאוּ נְעָרוֹת יֹצְאוֹת לִשְׁאֹב מָיִם וַיֹּאמְרוּ לָהֶן הֲיֵשׁ בָּזֶה הָרֹאֶֽה׃
translation: As they went up the ascent to the city, they found young maidens going out to draw water, and said to them, "Is the seer here?" (1 Samuel 9:11)

text: וַהֲקִמֹתִי עֲלֵיהֶם רֹעֶה אֶחָד וְרָעָה אֶתְהֶן אֵת עַבְדִּי דָוִיד הוּא יִרְעֶה אֹתָם וְהֽוּא יִהְיֶה לָהֶן לְרֹעֶֽה׃
translation: I will set up one shepherd over them, and he will feed them, even my servant David. He will feed them, and he will be their shepherd. (Ezekiel 34:23)

text: מִצְוַת שְׂפָתָיו וְלֹא אָמִישׁ מֵחֻקִּי צָפַנְתִּי אִמְרֵי פִֽיו׃
translation: I haven't gone back from the commandment of his lips. I have treasured up the words of his mouth more than my necessary food. (Job 23:12)

text: הַוּוֹת בְּקִרְבָּהּ וְֽלֹא יָמִישׁ מֵרְחֹבָהּ תֹּךְ וּמִרְמָֽה׃
translation: For it was not an enemy who insulted me, then I could have endured it. Neither was it he who hated me who raised himself up against me, then I would have hidden myself from him. (Psalms 55:12)

text: מֵשִׁיב רָעָה תַּחַת טוֹבָה לֹא תמיש תָמוּשׁ רָעָה מִבֵּיתֽוֹ׃
translation: Whoever rewards evil for good, evil shall not depart from his house. (Proverbs 17:13)

text: לֹֽא יָמִישׁ עַמּוּד הֶֽעָנָן יוֹמָם וְעַמּוּד הָאֵשׁ לָיְלָה לִפְנֵי הָעָֽם׃
translation: the pillar of cloud by day, and the pillar of fire by night, didn't depart from before the people. (Exodus 13:22)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר יִצְחָק אֶֽל יַעֲקֹב גְּשָׁה נָּא וַאֲמֻֽשְׁךָ בְּנִי הַֽאַתָּה זֶה בְּנִי עֵשָׂו אִם לֹֽא׃
translation: Isaac said to Jacob, "Please come near, that I may feel you, my son, whether you are really my son Esau or not." (Genesis 27:21)

text: כִּי הֶֽהָרִים יָמוּשׁוּ וְהַגְּבָעוֹת תְּמוּטֶנָה וְחַסְדִּי מֵאִתֵּךְ לֹֽא יָמוּשׁ וּבְרִית שְׁלוֹמִי לֹא תָמוּט אָמַר מְרַחֲמֵךְ יְהוָֽה׃
translation: For the mountains may depart, and the hills be removed, but my loving kindness will not depart from you, and my covenant of peace will not be removed," says the LORD who has mercy on you. (Isaiah 54:10)

text: כִּי בִי חָשַׁק וַאֲפַלְּטֵהוּ אֲשַׂגְּבֵהוּ כִּֽי יָדַע שְׁמִֽי׃
translation: "Because he has set his love on me, therefore I will deliver him. I will set him on high, because he has known my name. (Psalms 91:14)

text: וְלִפְאַת יָם קְלָעִים חֲמִשִּׁים בָּֽאַמָּה עַמּוּדֵיהֶם עֲשָׂרָה וְאַדְנֵיהֶם עֲשָׂרָה וָוֵי הָעַמֻּדִים וַחֲשׁוּקֵיהֶם כָּֽסֶף׃
translation: For the west side were hangings of fifty cubits, their pillars ten, and their sockets ten; the hooks of the pillars, and their fillets, of silver. (Exodus 38:12)

text: וְאֶת הָאֶלֶף וּשְׁבַע הַמֵּאוֹת וַחֲמִשָּׁה וְשִׁבְעִים עָשָׂה וָוִים לָעַמּוּדִים וְצִפָּה רָאשֵׁיהֶם וְחִשַּׁק אֹתָֽם׃
translation: From the one thousand seven hundred seventy-five shekels he made hooks for the pillars, overlaid their capitals, and made fillets for them. (Exodus 38:28)

text: וַיְדַבֵּר חֲמוֹר אִתָּם לֵאמֹר שְׁכֶם בְּנִי חָֽשְׁקָה נַפְשׁוֹ בְּבִתְּכֶם תְּנוּ נָא אֹתָהּ לוֹ לְאִשָּֽׁה׃
translation: Hamor talked with them, saying, "The soul of my son, Shechem, longs for your daughter. Please give her to him as a wife. (Genesis 34:8)

text: לֹא מֵֽרֻבְּכֶם מִכָּל הָֽעַמִּים חָשַׁק יְהוָה בָּכֶם וַיִּבְחַר בָּכֶם כִּֽי אַתֶּם הַמְעַט מִכָּל הָעַמִּֽים׃
translation: The LORD didn't set his love on you nor choose you, because you were more in number than any people; for you were the fewest of all peoples; (Deuteronomy 7:7)

text: רַק בַּאֲבֹתֶיךָ חָשַׁק יְהוָה לְאַהֲבָה אוֹתָם וַיִּבְחַר בְּזַרְעָם אַחֲרֵיהֶם בָּכֶם מִכָּל הָעַמִּים כַּיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃
translation: Only the LORD had a delight in your fathers to love them, and he chose their offspring after them, even you above all peoples, as it is today. (Deuteronomy 10:15)

text: יָחֹס עַל דַּל וְאֶבְיוֹן וְנַפְשׁוֹת אֶבְיוֹנִים יוֹשִֽׁיעַ׃
translation: He will have pity on the poor and needy. He will save the souls of the needy. (Psalms 72:13)

text: וַתָּחָס עֵינִי עֲלֵיהֶם מִֽשַּׁחֲתָם וְלֹֽא עָשִׂיתִי אוֹתָם כָּלָה בַּמִּדְבָּֽר׃
translation: Nevertheless my eye spared them, and I didn't destroy them. I didn't make a full end of them in the wilderness. (Ezekiel 20:17)

text: לֹא תָחוֹס עֵֽינְךָ עָלָיו וּבִֽעַרְתָּ דַֽם הַנָּקִי מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל וְטוֹב לָֽךְ׃
translation: Your eye shall not pity him, but you shall purge the innocent blood from Israel that it may go well with you. (Deuteronomy 19:13)

text: וְגַם אֲנִי לֹא תָחוֹס עֵינִי וְלֹא אֶחְמֹל דַּרְכָּם בְּרֹאשָׁם נָתָֽתִּי׃
translation: As for me also, my eye won't spare, neither will I have pity, but I will bring their way on their head." (Ezekiel 9:10)

text: וְעֵינְכֶם אַל תָּחֹס עַל כְּלֵיכֶם כִּי טוּב כָּל אֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם לָכֶם הֽוּא׃
translation: Also, don't concern yourselves about your belongings, for the good of all the land of Egypt is yours." (Genesis 45:20)

text: וּקְשָׁתוֹת נְעָרִים תְּרַטַּשְׁנָה וּפְרִי בֶטֶן לֹא יְרַחֵמוּ עַל בָּנִים לֹֽא תָחוּס עֵינָֽם׃
translation: Their bows will dash the young men in pieces; and they shall have no pity on the fruit of the womb. Their eyes will not spare children. (Isaiah 13:18)

text: וַאֲחִישָׁר עַל הַבָּיִת וַאֲדֹנִירָם בֶּן עַבְדָּא עַל הַמַּֽס׃
translation: Ahishar was over the household; and Adoniram the son of Abda was over the men subject to forced labor. (1 Kings 4:6)

text: וַאֲדֹרָם עַל הַמַּס וִיהוֹשָׁפָט בֶּן אֲחִילוּד הַמַּזְכִּֽיר׃
translation: Adoram was over the men subject to forced labor, Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was the recorder, (2 Samuel 20:24)

text: וַיָּשֶׂם הַמֶּלֶךְ אחשרש אֲחַשְׁוֵרוֹשׁ מַס עַל הָאָרֶץ וְאִיֵּי הַיָּֽם׃
translation: King Ahasuerus laid a tribute on the land and on the islands of the sea. (Esther 10:1)

text: לַמָּס מֵרֵעֵהוּ חָסֶד וְיִרְאַת שַׁדַּי יַעֲזֽוֹב׃
translation: "To him who is ready to faint, kindness should be shown from his friend; even to him who forsakes the fear of the Almighty. (Job 6:14)

text: וַֽיְהִי כִּֽי חָזַק יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיָּשֶׂם אֶת הַֽכְּנַעֲנִי לָמַס וְהוֹרֵישׁ לֹא הוֹרִישֽׁוֹ׃
translation: When Israel had grown strong, they put the Canaanites to forced labor, and didn't utterly drive them out. (Judges 1:28)

text: וַֽיְהִי כִּי חָֽזְקוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּתְּנוּ אֶת הַֽכְּנַעֲנִי לָמַס וְהוֹרֵשׁ לֹא הוֹרִישֽׁוֹ׃
translation: When the children of Israel had grown strong, they put the Canaanites to forced labor, and didn't utterly drive them out. (Joshua 17:13)

text: זִֽכְרֹנֵיכֶם מִשְׁלֵי אֵפֶר לְגַבֵּי חֹמֶר גַּבֵּיכֶֽם׃
translation: Your memorable sayings are proverbs of ashes. Your defenses are defenses of clay. (Job 13:12)

text: וְהָעֲטָרֹת תִּֽהְיֶה לְחֵלֶם וּלְטוֹבִיָּה וְלִידַֽעְיָה וּלְחֵן בֶּן צְפַנְיָה לְזִכָּרוֹן בְּהֵיכַל יְהוָֽה׃
translation: The crowns shall be to Helem, to Tobijah, to Jedaiah, and to Hen the son of Zephaniah, for a memorial in the LORD's temple. (Zechariah 6:14)

text: אֵין זִכְרוֹן לָרִאשֹׁנִים וְגַם לָאַחֲרֹנִים שֶׁיִּהְיוּ לֹֽא יִהְיֶה לָהֶם זִכָּרוֹן עִם שֶׁיִּהְיוּ לָאַחֲרֹנָֽה׃
translation: There is no memory of the former; neither shall there be any memory of the latter that are to come, among those that shall come after. (Ecclesiastes 1:11)

text: וַיָּשֶׂם אֹתָם עַל כִּתְפֹת הָאֵפֹד אַבְנֵי זִכָּרוֹן לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהוָה אֶת מֹשֶֽׁה׃
translation: He put them on the shoulder straps of the ephod, to be stones of memorial for the children of Israel, as the LORD commanded Moses. (Exodus 39:7)

text: בַּלַּיְלָה הַהוּא נָדְדָה שְׁנַת הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיֹּאמֶר לְהָבִיא אֶת סֵפֶר הַזִּכְרֹנוֹת דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים וַיִּהְיוּ נִקְרָאִים לִפְנֵי הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
translation: On that night, the king couldn't sleep. He commanded the book of records of the chronicles to be brought, and they were read to the king. (Esther 6:1)

text: וְנָשָׂא אַהֲרֹן אֶת שְׁמוֹת בְּנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּחֹשֶׁן הַמִּשְׁפָּט עַל לִבּוֹ בְּבֹאוֹ אֶל הַקֹּדֶשׁ לְזִכָּרֹן לִפְנֵֽי יְהוָה תָּמִֽיד׃
translation: Aaron shall bear the names of the children of Israel in the breastplate of judgment on his heart, when he goes in to the holy place, for a memorial before the LORD continually. (Exodus 28:29)

text: רַחוּם וְחַנּוּן יְהוָה אֶרֶךְ אַפַּיִם וְרַב חָֽסֶד׃
translation: The LORD is merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness. (Psalms 103:8)

text: זָרַח בַּחֹשֶׁךְ אוֹר לַיְשָׁרִים חַנּוּן וְרַחוּם וְצַדִּֽיק׃
translation: Light dawns in the darkness for the upright, gracious, merciful, and righteous. (Psalms 112:4)

text: חַנּוּן וְרַחוּם יְהוָה אֶרֶךְ אַפַּיִם וּגְדָל חָֽסֶד׃
translation: The LORD is gracious, merciful, slow to anger, and of great loving kindness. (Psalms 145:8)

text: וְאַתָּה אֲדֹנָי אֵל רַחוּם וְחַנּוּן אֶרֶךְ אַפַּיִם וְרַב חֶסֶד וֶאֱמֶֽת׃
translation: But you, Lord, are a merciful and gracious God, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness and truth. (Psalms 86:15)

text: זֵכֶר עָשָׂה לְנִפְלְאֹתָיו חַנּוּן וְרַחוּם יְהוָֽה׃
translation: He has caused his wonderful works to be remembered. The LORD is gracious and merciful. (Psalms 111:4)

text: וַֽיְהִי אַֽחֲרֵי כֵן וַיָּמָת מֶלֶךְ בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן וַיִּמְלֹךְ חָנוּן בְּנוֹ תַּחְתָּֽיו׃
translation: After this, the king of the children of Ammon died, and Hanun his son reigned in his place. (2 Samuel 10:1)

text: יְהֹוִה אֲדֹנָי עֹז יְשׁוּעָתִי סַכֹּתָה לְרֹאשִׁי בְּיוֹם נָֽשֶׁק׃
translation: LORD, don't grant the desires of the wicked. Don't let their evil plans succeed, or they will become proud. Selah. (Psalms 140:8)

text: לְגֶבֶר אֲשֶׁר דַּרְכּוֹ נִסְתָּרָה וַיָּסֶךְ אֱלוֹהַּ בַּעֲדֽוֹ׃
translation: Why is light given to a man whose way is hidden, whom God has hedged in? (Job 3:23)

text: סַכֹּתָה בָאַף וַֽתִּרְדְּפֵנוּ הָרַגְתָּ לֹא חָמָֽלְתָּ׃
translation: "You have covered us with anger and pursued us. You have killed. You have not pitied. (Lamentations 3:43)

text: וְהָיָה בַּעֲבֹר כְּבֹדִי וְשַׂמְתִּיךָ בְּנִקְרַת הַצּוּר וְשַׂכֹּתִי כַפִּי עָלֶיךָ עַד עָבְרִֽי׃
translation: It will happen, while my glory passes by, that I will put you in a cleft of the rock, and will cover you with my hand until I have passed by; (Exodus 33:22)

text: סַכּוֹתָה בֶֽעָנָן לָךְ מֵעֲבוֹר תְּפִלָּֽה׃
translation: You have covered yourself with a cloud, so that no prayer can pass through. (Lamentations 3:44)

text: וְיִשְׂמְחוּ כָל חוֹסֵי בָךְ לְעוֹלָם יְרַנֵּנוּ וְתָסֵךְ עָלֵימוֹ וְֽיַעְלְצוּ בְךָ אֹהֲבֵי שְׁמֶֽךָ׃
translation: For you will bless the righteous. LORD, you will surround him with favor as with a shield. (Psalms 5:12)

text: וּתְקַעְתִּיו יָתֵד בְּמָקוֹם נֶאֱמָן וְהָיָה לְכִסֵּא כָבוֹד לְבֵית אָבִֽיו׃
translation: I will fasten him like a nail in a sure place. He will be for a throne of glory to his father's house. (Isaiah 22:23)

text: וְֽכָל הַיְתֵדֹת לַמִּשְׁכָּן וְלֶחָצֵר סָבִיב נְחֹֽשֶׁת׃
translation: All the pins of the tabernacle, and around the court, were of bronze. (Exodus 38:20)

text: לְכֹל כְּלֵי הַמִּשְׁכָּן בְּכֹל עֲבֹדָתוֹ וְכָל יְתֵדֹתָיו וְכָל יִתְדֹת הֶחָצֵר נְחֹֽשֶׁת׃
translation: All the instruments of the tabernacle in all its service, and all its pins, and all the pins of the court, shall be of bronze. (Exodus 27:19)

text: מִמֶּנּוּ פִנָּה מִמֶּנּוּ יָתֵד מִמֶּנּוּ קֶשֶׁת מִלְחָמָה מִמֶּנּוּ יֵצֵא כָל נוֹגֵשׂ יַחְדָּֽו׃
translation: From him will come the cornerstone, from him the tent peg, from him the battle bow, from him every ruler together. (Zechariah 10:4)

text: יָדָהּ לַיָּתֵד תִּשְׁלַחְנָה וִֽימִינָהּ לְהַלְמוּת עֲמֵלִים וְהָלְמָה סִֽיסְרָא מָחֲקָה רֹאשׁוֹ וּמָחֲצָה וְחָלְפָה רַקָּתֽוֹ׃
translation: She put her hand to the tent peg, and her right hand to the workmen's hammer. With the hammer she struck Sisera. She struck through his head. Yes, she pierced and struck through his temples. (Judges 5:26)

text: הֲיֻקַּח מִמֶּנּוּ עֵץ לַעֲשׂוֹת לִמְלָאכָה אִם יִקְחוּ מִמֶּנּוּ יָתֵד לִתְלוֹת עָלָיו כָּל כֶּֽלִי׃
translation: Will wood be taken of it to make anything? Will men take a pin of it to hang any vessel on it? (Ezekiel 15:3)

text: וְהִזָּה עָלָיו מִן הַדָּם בְּאֶצְבָּעוֹ שֶׁבַע פְּעָמִים וְטִהֲרוֹ וְקִדְּשׁוֹ מִטֻּמְאֹת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
translation: He shall sprinkle some of the blood on it with his finger seven times, and cleanse it, and make it holy from the uncleanness of the children of Israel. (Leviticus 16:19)

text: וְהִזָּה מִדַּם הַחַטָּאת עַל קִיר הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וְהַנִּשְׁאָר בַּדָּם יִמָּצֵה אֶל יְסוֹד הַמִּזְבֵּחַ חַטָּאת הֽוּא׃
translation: He shall sprinkle some of the blood of the sin offering on the side of the altar; and the rest of the blood shall be drained out at the base of the altar. It is a sin offering. (Leviticus 5:9)

text: וְלָקַח אֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן מִדָּמָהּ בְּאֶצְבָּעוֹ וְהִזָּה אֶל נֹכַח פְּנֵי אֹֽהֶל מוֹעֵד מִדָּמָהּ שֶׁבַע פְּעָמִֽים׃
translation: Eleazar the priest shall take some of her blood with his finger, and sprinkle her blood toward the front of the Tent of Meeting seven times. (Numbers 19:4)

text: וְהִזָּה עַל הַמִּטַּהֵר מִן הַצָּרַעַת שֶׁבַע פְּעָמִים וְטִהֲרוֹ וְשִׁלַּח אֶת הַצִּפֹּר הַֽחַיָּה עַל פְּנֵי הַשָּׂדֶֽה׃
translation: He shall sprinkle on him who is to be cleansed from the leprosy seven times, and shall pronounce him clean, and shall let the living bird go into the open field. (Leviticus 14:7)
