text: וְהָיְתָה לָּהֶם לְחֻקַּת עוֹלָם וּמַזֵּה מֵֽי הַנִּדָּה יְכַבֵּס בְּגָדָיו וְהַנֹּגֵעַ בְּמֵי הַנִּדָּה יִטְמָא עַד הָעָֽרֶב׃
translation: It shall be a perpetual statute to them. He who sprinkles the water for impurity shall wash his clothes, and he who touches the water for impurity shall be unclean until evening. (Numbers 19:21)

text: כֹּל אֲשֶׁר יִגַּע בִּבְשָׂרָהּ יִקְדָּשׁ וַאֲשֶׁר יִזֶּה מִדָּמָהּ עַל הַבֶּגֶד אֲשֶׁר יִזֶּה עָלֶיהָ תְּכַבֵּס בְּמָקוֹם קָדֹֽשׁ׃
translation: "This is the offering of Aaron and of his sons, which they shall offer to the LORD in the day when he is anointed: one tenth of an ephah of fine flour for a meal offering perpetually, half of it in the morning, and half of it in the evening. (Leviticus 6:20)

text: בְּאֶפֶס עֵצִים תִּכְבֶּה אֵשׁ וּבְאֵין נִרְגָּן יִשְׁתֹּק מָדֽוֹן׃
translation: For lack of wood a fire goes out. Without gossip, a quarrel dies down. (Proverbs 26:20)

text: טָעֲמָה כִּי טוֹב סַחְרָהּ לֹֽא יִכְבֶּה בליל בַלַּיְלָה נֵרָֽהּ׃
translation: She perceives that her merchandise is profitable. Her lamp doesn't go out by night. (Proverbs 31:18)

text: וְרָאוּ כָּל בָּשָׂר כִּי אֲנִי יְהוָה בִּֽעַרְתִּיהָ לֹא תִּכְבֶּֽה׃
translation: Seeing then that I will cut off from you the righteous and the wicked, therefore my sword will go out of its sheath against all flesh from the south to the north. (Ezekiel 21:4)

text: וְנֵר אֱלֹהִים טֶרֶם יִכְבֶּה וּשְׁמוּאֵל שֹׁכֵב בְּהֵיכַל יְהוָה אֲשֶׁר שָׁם אֲרוֹן אֱלֹהִֽים׃
translation: and God's lamp hadn't yet gone out, and Samuel had laid down in the LORD's temple where God's ark was, (1 Samuel 3:3)

text: וְכִסֵּיתִי בְכַבּֽוֹתְךָ שָׁמַיִם וְהִקְדַּרְתִּי אֶת כֹּֽכְבֵיהֶם שֶׁמֶשׁ בֶּעָנָן אֲכַסֶּנּוּ וְיָרֵחַ לֹא יָאִיר אוֹרֽוֹ׃
translation: When I extinguish you, I will cover the heavens and make its stars dark. I will cover the sun with a cloud, and the moon won't give its light. (Ezekiel 32:7)

text: דִּרְשׁוּ אֶת יְהוָה וִֽחְיוּ פֶּן יִצְלַח כָּאֵשׁ בֵּית יוֹסֵף וְאָכְלָה וְאֵין מְכַבֶּה לְבֵֽית אֵֽל׃
translation: Seek the LORD, and you will live, lest he break out like fire in the house of Joseph, and it devour, and there be no one to quench it in Bethel. (Amos 5:6)

text: קָרְאוּ לָהֶם כֵּן הָלְכוּ מִפְּנֵיהֶם לַבְּעָלִים יְזַבֵּחוּ וְלַפְּסִלִים יְקַטֵּרֽוּן׃
translation: They called to them, so they went from them. They sacrificed to the Baals, and burned incense to engraved images. (Hosea 11:2)

text: וְהִכְרַתִּי פְסִילֶיךָ וּמַצֵּבוֹתֶיךָ מִקִּרְבֶּךָ וְלֹֽא תִשְׁתַּחֲוֶה עוֹד לְמַעֲשֵׂה יָדֶֽיךָ׃
translation: I will destroy witchcraft from your hand. You shall have no soothsayers. (Micah 5:12)

text: אֲנִי יְהוָה הוּא שְׁמִי וּכְבוֹדִי לְאַחֵר לֹֽא אֶתֵּן וּתְהִלָּתִי לַפְּסִילִֽים׃
translation: "I am the LORD. That is my name. I will not give my glory to another, nor my praise to engraved images. (Isaiah 42:8)

text: וַיַּכְעִיסוּהוּ בְּבָמוֹתָם וּבִפְסִילֵיהֶם יַקְנִיאֽוּהוּ׃
translation: For they provoked him to anger with their high places, and moved him to jealousy with their engraved images. (Psalms 78:58)

text: לָכֵן הִנֵּֽה יָמִים בָּאִים נְאֻם יְהוָה וּפָקַדְתִּי עַל פְּסִילֶיהָ וּבְכָל אַרְצָהּ יֶאֱנֹק חָלָֽל׃
translation: "Therefore behold, the days come," says the LORD, "that I will execute judgment on her engraved images; and through all her land the wounded will groan. (Jeremiah 51:52)

text: כִּֽי אִם כֹּה תַעֲשׂוּ לָהֶם מִזְבְּחֹתֵיהֶם תִּתֹּצוּ וּמַצֵּבֹתָם תְּשַׁבֵּרוּ וַאֲשֵֽׁירֵהֶם תְּגַדֵּעוּן וּפְסִילֵיהֶם תִּשְׂרְפוּן בָּאֵֽשׁ׃
translation: But you shall deal with them like this: you shall break down their altars, dash their pillars in pieces, cut down their Asherah poles, and burn their engraved images with fire. (Deuteronomy 7:5)

text: וָאָפִיץ אֹתָם בַּגּוֹיִם וַיִּזָּרוּ בָּאֲרָצוֹת כְּדַרְכָּם וְכַעֲלִילוֹתָם שְׁפַטְתִּֽים׃
translation: I scattered them among the nations, and they were dispersed through the countries. I judged them according to their way and according to their deeds. (Ezekiel 36:19)

text: הוֹדוּ לַֽיהוָה קִרְאוּ בִשְׁמוֹ הוֹדִיעוּ בָעַמִּים עֲלִילֹתָֽיו׃
translation: Oh give thanks to the LORD. Call on his name. Make what he has done known among the peoples. (1 Chronicles 16:8)

text: זַמְּרוּ לַיהוָה יֹשֵׁב צִיּוֹן הַגִּידוּ בָעַמִּים עֲלִֽילוֹתָֽיו׃
translation: For he who avenges blood remembers them. He doesn't forget the cry of the afflicted. (Psalms 9:12)

text: לְכוּ וּרְאוּ מִפְעֲלוֹת אֱלֹהִים נוֹרָא עֲלִילָה עַל בְּנֵי אָדָֽם׃
translation: Come, and see God's deeds— awesome work on behalf of the children of men. (Psalms 66:5)

text: הוֹדוּ לַיהוָה קִרְאוּ בִּשְׁמוֹ הוֹדִיעוּ בָעַמִּים עֲלִילוֹתָֽיו׃
translation: Give thanks to the LORD! Call on his name! Make his doings known among the peoples. (Psalms 105:1)

text: יוֹדִיעַ דְּרָכָיו לְמֹשֶׁה לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל עֲלִילֽוֹתָיו׃
translation: He made known his ways to Moses, his deeds to the children of Israel. (Psalms 103:7)

text: לֹעֵג לָרָשׁ חֵרֵף עֹשֵׂהוּ שָׂמֵחַ לְאֵיד לֹא יִנָּקֶֽה׃
translation: Whoever mocks the poor reproaches his Maker. He who is glad at calamity shall not be unpunished. (Proverbs 17:5)

text: כִּֽי פִתְאֹם יָקוּם אֵידָם וּפִיד שְׁנֵיהֶם מִי יוֹדֵֽעַ׃
translation: for their calamity will rise suddenly. Who knows what destruction may come from them both? (Proverbs 24:22)

text: יְקַדְּמֻנִי בְּיוֹם אֵידִי וַיְהִי יְהוָה מִשְׁעָן לִֽי׃
translation: They came on me in the day of my calamity, but the LORD was my support. (2 Samuel 22:19)

text: יְקַדְּמוּנִי בְיוֹם אֵידִי וַֽיְהִי יְהוָה לְמִשְׁעָן לִֽי׃
translation: He brought me out also into a large place. He delivered me, because he delighted in me. (Psalms 18:19)

text: גַּם אֲנִי בְּאֵידְכֶם אֶשְׂחָק אֶלְעַג בְּבֹא פַחְדְּכֶֽם׃
translation: I also will laugh at your disaster. I will mock when calamity overtakes you, (Proverbs 1:26)

text: קָרוֹב אֵיד מוֹאָב לָבוֹא וְרָעָתוֹ מִהֲרָה מְאֹֽד׃
translation: "The calamity of Moab is near to come, and his affliction hurries fast. (Jeremiah 48:16)

text: וַיִּלָּחֶם יוֹאָב בְּרַבַּת בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן וַיִּלְכֹּד אֶת עִיר הַמְּלוּכָֽה׃
translation: Now Joab fought against Rabbah of the children of Ammon, and took the royal city. (2 Samuel 12:26)

text: וְלָקַחְתִּי הַמְּלוּכָה מִיַּד בְּנוֹ וּנְתַתִּיהָ לְּךָ אֵת עֲשֶׂרֶת הַשְּׁבָטִֽים׃
translation: but I will take the kingdom out of his son's hand and will give it to you, even ten tribes. (1 Kings 11:35)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל אֶל הָעָם לְכוּ וְנֵלְכָה הַגִּלְגָּל וּנְחַדֵּשׁ שָׁם הַמְּלוּכָֽה׃
translation: Then Samuel said to the people, "Come! Let's go to Gilgal, and renew the kingdom there." (1 Samuel 11:14)

text: וְגַם יָשַׁב שְׁלֹמֹה עַל כִּסֵּא הַמְּלוּכָֽה׃
translation: Also, Solomon sits on the throne of the kingdom. (1 Kings 1:46)

text: וְלֹֽא דָרַשׁ בַּֽיהוָה וַיְמִיתֵהוּ וַיַּסֵּב אֶת הַמְּלוּכָה לְדָוִיד בֶּן יִשָֽׁי׃
translation: and didn't inquire of the LORD. Therefore he killed him, and turned the kingdom over to David the son of Jesse. (1 Chronicles 10:14)

text: וְהָיִיתְ עֲטֶרֶת תִּפְאֶרֶת בְּיַד יְהוָה וצנוף וּצְנִיף מְלוּכָה בְּכַף אֱלֹהָֽיִךְ׃
translation: You will also be a crown of beauty in the LORD's hand, and a royal diadem in your God's hand. (Isaiah 62:3)

text: גֶּבֶר רָשׁ וְעֹשֵׁק דַּלִּים מָטָר סֹחֵף וְאֵין לָֽחֶם׃
translation: A needy man who oppresses the poor is like a driving rain which leaves no crops. (Proverbs 28:3)

text: כְּפִירִים רָשׁוּ וְרָעֵבוּ וְדֹרְשֵׁי יְהוָה לֹא יַחְסְרוּ כָל טֽוֹב׃
translation: Come, you children, listen to me. I will teach you the fear of the LORD. (Psalms 34:11)

text: יֵשׁ מִתְעַשֵּׁר וְאֵין כֹּל מִתְרוֹשֵׁשׁ וְהוֹן רָֽב׃
translation: There are some who pretend to be rich, yet have nothing. There are some who pretend to be poor, yet have great wealth. (Proverbs 13:7)

text: תַּאֲוַת אָדָם חַסְדּוֹ וְטֽוֹב רָשׁ מֵאִישׁ כָּזָֽב׃
translation: That which makes a man to be desired is his kindness. A poor man is better than a liar. (Proverbs 19:22)

text: שִׁפְטוּ דַל וְיָתוֹם עָנִי וָרָשׁ הַצְדִּֽיקוּ׃
translation: "Defend the weak, the poor, and the fatherless. Maintain the rights of the poor and oppressed. (Psalms 82:3)

text: תַּחֲנוּנִים יְדַבֶּר רָשׁ וְעָשִׁיר יַעֲנֶה עַזּֽוֹת׃
translation: The poor plead for mercy, but the rich answer harshly. (Proverbs 18:23)

text: נַעֲוֵיתִי שַׁחֹתִי עַד מְאֹד כָּל הַיּוֹם קֹדֵר הִלָּֽכְתִּי׃
translation: For my waist is filled with burning. There is no soundness in my flesh. (Psalms 38:7)

text: לְֽפִי שִׂכְלוֹ יְהֻלַּל אִישׁ וְנַעֲוֵה לֵב יִהְיֶה לָבֽוּז׃
translation: A man shall be commended according to his wisdom, but he who has a warped mind shall be despised. (Proverbs 12:8)

text: חָטָאנוּ וְעָוִינוּ והרשענו הִרְשַׁעְנוּ וּמָרָדְנוּ וְסוֹר מִמִּצְוֺתֶךָ וּמִמִּשְׁפָּטֶֽיךָ׃
translation: we have sinned, and have dealt perversely, and have done wickedly, and have rebelled, even turning aside from your precepts and from your ordinances. (Daniel 9:5)

text: אַיּוֹ מֶֽלֶךְ חֲמָת וּמֶלֶךְ אַרְפָּד וּמֶלֶךְ לָעִיר סְפַרְוָיִם הֵנַע וְעִוָּֽה׃
translation: Where is the king of Hamath, the king of Arpad, and the king of the city of Sepharvaim, of Hena, and Ivvah?'" (2 Kings 19:13)

text: יָשֹׁר עַל אֲנָשִׁים וַיֹּאמֶר חָטָאתִי וְיָשָׁר הֶעֱוֵיתִי וְלֹא שָׁוָה לִֽי׃
translation: He sings before men, and says, 'I have sinned, and perverted that which was right, and it didn't profit me. (Job 33:27)

text: אַיֵּה מֶֽלֶךְ חֲמָת וּמֶלֶךְ אַרְפָּד וּמֶלֶךְ לָעִיר סְפַרְוָיִם הֵנַע וְעִוָּֽה׃
translation: Where is the king of Hamath, and the king of Arpad, and the king of the city of Sepharvaim, of Hena, and Ivvah?'" (Isaiah 37:13)

text: אִם לֹא עַל שִׁכְמִי אֶשָּׂאֶנּוּ אֶֽעֶנְדֶנּוּ עֲטָרוֹת לִֽי׃
translation: Surely I would carry it on my shoulder, and I would bind it to me as a crown. (Job 31:36)

text: נָֽפְלָה עֲטֶרֶת רֹאשֵׁנוּ אֽוֹי נָא לָנוּ כִּי חָטָֽאנוּ׃
translation: The crown has fallen from our head. Woe to us, for we have sinned! (Lamentations 5:16)

text: וַתְּהִי אִשָּׁה אַחֶרֶת לִֽירַחְמְאֵל וּשְׁמָהּ עֲטָרָה הִיא אֵם אוֹנָֽם׃
translation: Jerahmeel had another wife, whose name was Atarah. She was the mother of Onam. (1 Chronicles 2:26)

text: תִּתֵּן לְרֹאשְׁךָ לִוְיַת חֵן עֲטֶרֶת תִּפְאֶרֶת תְּמַגְּנֶֽךָּ׃
translation: She will give to your head a garland of grace. She will deliver a crown of splendor to you." (Proverbs 4:9)

text: עֲטֶרֶת זְקֵנִים בְּנֵי בָנִים וְתִפְאֶרֶת בָּנִים אֲבוֹתָֽם׃
translation: Children's children are the crown of old men; the glory of children is their parents. (Proverbs 17:6)

text: כְּבוֹדִי מֵעָלַי הִפְשִׁיט וַיָּסַר עֲטֶרֶת רֹאשִֽׁי׃
translation: He has stripped me of my glory, and taken the crown from my head. (Job 19:9)

text: וְכֹֽתָרֹת אֲשֶׁר עַל רֹאשׁ הָעַמּוּדִים מַעֲשֵׂה שׁוּשַׁן בָּֽאוּלָם אַרְבַּע אַמּֽוֹת׃
translation: The capitals that were on the top of the pillars in the porch were of lily work, four cubits. (1 Kings 7:19)

text: וּשְׁתֵּי כֹתָרֹת עָשָׂה לָתֵת עַל רָאשֵׁי הָֽעַמּוּדִים מֻצַק נְחֹשֶׁת חָמֵשׁ אַמּוֹת קוֹמַת הַכֹּתֶרֶת הָאֶחָת וְחָמֵשׁ אַמּוֹת קוֹמַת הַכֹּתֶרֶת הַשֵּׁנִֽית׃
translation: He made two capitals of molten bronze to set on the tops of the pillars. The height of the one capital was five cubits, and the height of the other capital was five cubits. (1 Kings 7:16)

text: וּפִיהוּ מִבֵּית לַכֹּתֶרֶת וָמַעְלָה בָּֽאַמָּה וּפִיהָ עָגֹל מַעֲשֵׂה כֵן אַמָּה וַחֲצִי הָֽאַמָּה וְגַם עַל פִּיהָ מִקְלָעוֹת וּמִסְגְּרֹתֵיהֶם מְרֻבָּעוֹת לֹא עֲגֻלּֽוֹת׃
translation: Its opening within the capital and above was a cubit. Its opening was round like the work of a pedestal, a cubit and a half; and also on its opening were engravings, and their panels were square, not round. (1 Kings 7:31)

text: עַמֻּדִים שְׁנַיִם וְגֻלֹּת הַכֹּתָרֹת אֲשֶׁר עַל רֹאשׁ הָֽעַמֻּדִים שְׁתָּיִם וְהַשְּׂבָכוֹת שְׁתַּיִם לְכַסּוֹת אֶת שְׁתֵּי גֻּלֹּת הַכֹּֽתָרֹת אֲשֶׁר עַל רֹאשׁ הָעַמּוּדִֽים׃
translation: the two pillars; the two bowls of the capitals that were on the top of the pillars; the two networks to cover the two bowls of the capitals that were on the top of the pillars; (1 Kings 7:41)

text: וְאֶת הָרִמֹּנִים אַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת לִשְׁתֵּי הַשְּׂבָכוֹת שְׁנֵֽי טוּרִים רִמֹּנִים לַשְּׂבָכָה הָֽאֶחָת לְכַסּוֹת אֶת שְׁתֵּי גֻּלֹּת הַכֹּֽתָרֹת אֲשֶׁר עַל פְּנֵי הָעַמּוּדִֽים׃
translation: the four hundred pomegranates for the two networks; two rows of pomegranates for each network, to cover the two bowls of the capitals that were on the pillars; (1 Kings 7:42)

text: וְאֶת הָֽרִמּוֹנִים אַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת לִשְׁתֵּי הַשְּׂבָכוֹת שְׁנַיִם טוּרִים רִמּוֹנִים לַשְּׂבָכָה הָאֶחָת לְכַסּוֹת אֶת שְׁתֵּי גֻּלּוֹת הַכֹּֽתָרוֹת אֲשֶׁר עַל פְּנֵי הָעַמּוּדִֽים׃
translation: and the four hundred pomegranates for the two networks—two rows of pomegranates for each network, to cover the two bowls of the capitals that were on the pillars. (2 Chronicles 4:13)

text: וְאֶת הַמְּכֹנוֹת עָשֶׂר וְאֶת הַכִּיֹּרֹת עֲשָׂרָה עַל הַמְּכֹנֽוֹת׃
translation: the ten bases; the ten basins on the bases; (1 Kings 7:43)

text: וְאֶת הַמְּכֹנוֹת עָשָׂה וְאֶת הַכִּיֹּרוֹת עָשָׂה עַל הַמְּכֹנֽוֹת׃
translation: He also made the bases, and he made the basins on the bases— (2 Chronicles 4:14)

text: וְאַרְבַּע כְּתֵפוֹת אֶל אַרְבַּע פִּנּוֹת הַמְּכֹנָה הָֽאֶחָת מִן הַמְּכֹנָה כְּתֵפֶֽיהָ׃
translation: There were four supports at the four corners of each base. Its supports were of the base itself. (1 Kings 7:34)

text: כָּזֹאת עָשָׂה אֵת עֶשֶׂר הַמְּכֹנוֹת מוּצָק אֶחָד מִדָּה אַחַת קֶצֶב אֶחָד לְכֻלָּֽהְנָה׃
translation: He made the ten bases in this way: all of them had one casting, one measure, and one form. (1 Kings 7:37)

text: וּבְרֹאשׁ הַמְּכוֹנָה חֲצִי הָאַמָּה קוֹמָה עָגֹל סָבִיב וְעַל רֹאשׁ הַמְּכֹנָה יְדֹתֶיהָ וּמִסְגְּרֹתֶיהָ מִמֶּֽנָּה׃
translation: In the top of the base there was a round band half a cubit high; and on the top of the base its supports and its panels were the same. (1 Kings 7:35)

text: וַיַּעַשׂ אֶת הַמְּכֹנוֹת עֶשֶׂר נְחֹשֶׁת אַרְבַּע בָּאַמָּה אֹרֶךְ הַמְּכוֹנָה הָֽאֶחָת וְאַרְבַּע בָּֽאַמָּה רָחְבָּהּ וְשָׁלֹשׁ בָּאַמָּה קוֹמָתָֽהּ׃
translation: He made the ten bases of bronze. The length of one base was four cubits, four cubits its width, and three cubits its height. (1 Kings 7:27)

text: שְׁלֹשָׁה אֵלֶּה בְּנֵי נֹחַ וּמֵאֵלֶּה נָֽפְצָה כָל הָאָֽרֶץ׃
translation: These three were the sons of Noah, and from these the whole earth was populated. (Genesis 9:19)

text: וְנִפַּצְתִּי בְךָ סוּס וְרֹֽכְבוֹ וְנִפַּצְתִּי בְךָ רֶכֶב וְרֹכְבֽוֹ׃
translation: With you I will break in pieces the horse and his rider. (Jeremiah 51:21)

text: אַשְׁרֵי שֶׁיֹּאחֵז וְנִפֵּץ אֶֽת עֹלָלַיִךְ אֶל הַסָּֽלַע׃
translation: Happy shall he be, who takes and dashes your little ones against the rock. (Psalms 137:9)

text: מִקּוֹל הָמוֹן נָדְדוּ עַמִּים מֵרוֹמְמֻתֶךָ נָפְצוּ גּוֹיִֽם׃
translation: At the noise of the thunder, the peoples have fled. When you lift yourself up, the nations are scattered. (Isaiah 33:3)

text: תְּרֹעֵם בְּשֵׁבֶט בַּרְזֶל כִּכְלִי יוֹצֵר תְּנַפְּצֵֽם׃
translation: You shall break them with a rod of iron. You shall dash them in pieces like a potter's vessel." (Psalms 2:9)

text: מַפֵּץ אַתָּה לִי כְּלֵי מִלְחָמָה וְנִפַּצְתִּי בְךָ גּוֹיִם וְהִשְׁחַתִּי בְךָ מַמְלָכֽוֹת׃
translation: "You are my battle ax and weapons of war. With you I will break the nations into pieces. With you I will destroy kingdoms. (Jeremiah 51:20)

text: וַֽיְחִי עֵבֶר אַרְבַּע וּשְׁלֹשִׁים שָׁנָה וַיּוֹלֶד אֶת פָּֽלֶג׃
translation: Eber lived thirty-four years, and became the father of Peleg. (Genesis 11:16)

text: נָהָר פְּלָגָיו יְשַׂמְּחוּ עִיר אֱלֹהִים קְדֹשׁ מִשְׁכְּנֵי עֶלְיֽוֹן׃
translation: God is within her. She shall not be moved. God will help her at dawn. (Psalms 46:5)

text: פַּלְגֵי מַיִם יָרְדוּ עֵינָי עַל לֹא שָׁמְרוּ תוֹרָתֶֽךָ׃
translation: Streams of tears run down my eyes, because they don't observe your law. TZADHE (Psalms 119:136)

text: פַּלְגֵי מַיִם תֵּרַד עֵינִי עַל שֶׁבֶר בַּת עַמִּֽי׃
translation: My eye runs down with streams of water, for the destruction of the daughter of my people. (Lamentations 3:48)

text: וַֽיְחִי פֶלֶג שְׁלֹשִׁים שָׁנָה וַיּוֹלֶד אֶת רְעֽוּ׃
translation: Peleg lived thirty years, and became the father of Reu. (Genesis 11:18)

text: בַּלַּע אֲדֹנָי פַּלַּג לְשׁוֹנָם כִּֽי רָאִיתִי חָמָס וְרִיב בָּעִֽיר׃
translation: Day and night they prowl around on its walls. Malice and abuse are also within her. (Psalms 55:10)

text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ בִּי אֲדֹנִי יָרֹד יָרַדְנוּ בַּתְּחִלָּה לִשְׁבָּר אֹֽכֶל׃
translation: and said, "Oh, my lord, we indeed came down the first time to buy food. (Genesis 43:20)

text: תְּחִלַּת חָכְמָה יִרְאַת יְהוָה וְדַעַת קְדֹשִׁים בִּינָֽה׃
translation: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom. The knowledge of the Holy One is understanding. (Proverbs 9:10)

text: וּבְמַלְכוּת אֲחַשְׁוֵרוֹשׁ בִּתְחִלַּת מַלְכוּתוֹ כָּתְבוּ שִׂטְנָה עַל יֹשְׁבֵי יְהוּדָה וִירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
translation: In the reign of Ahasuerus, in the beginning of his reign, they wrote an accusation against the inhabitants of Judah and Jerusalem. (Ezra 4:6)

text: וְאָשִׁיבָה שֹׁפְטַיִךְ כְּבָרִאשֹׁנָה וְיֹעֲצַיִךְ כְּבַתְּחִלָּה אַחֲרֵי כֵן יִקָּרֵא לָךְ עִיר הַצֶּדֶק קִרְיָה נֶאֱמָנָֽה׃
translation: I will restore your judges as at the first, and your counselors as at the beginning. Afterward you shall be called 'The city of righteousness, a faithful town.' (Isaiah 1:26)

text: בִּשְׁנַת שָׁלוֹשׁ לְמַלְכוּת בֵּלְאשַׁצַּר הַמֶּלֶךְ חָזוֹן נִרְאָה אֵלַי אֲנִי דָנִיֵּאל אַחֲרֵי הַנִּרְאָה אֵלַי בַּתְּחִלָּֽה׃
translation: In the third year of the reign of King Belshazzar, a vision appeared to me, even to me, Daniel, after that which appeared to me at the first. (Daniel 8:1)

text: בִּתְחִלַּת תַּחֲנוּנֶיךָ יָצָא דָבָר וַאֲנִי בָּאתִי לְהַגִּיד כִּי חֲמוּדוֹת אָתָּה וּבִין בַּדָּבָר וְהָבֵן בַּמַּרְאֶֽה׃
translation: At the beginning of your petitions the commandment went out, and I have come to tell you, for you are greatly beloved. Therefore consider the matter and understand the vision. (Daniel 9:23)

text: יבלו יְכַלּוּ בַטּוֹב יְמֵיהֶם וּבְרֶגַע שְׁאוֹל יֵחָֽתּוּ׃
translation: They spend their days in prosperity. In an instant they go down to Sheol. (Job 21:13)

text: הֵמָּה יֹאבֵדוּ וְאַתָּה תַעֲמֹד וְכֻלָּם כַּבֶּגֶד יִבְלוּ כַּלְּבוּשׁ תַּחֲלִיפֵם וְֽיַחֲלֹֽפוּ׃
translation: But you are the same. Your years will have no end. (Psalms 102:27)

text: וַיְהִי עַם הָאָרֶץ מְרַפִּים יְדֵי עַם יְהוּדָה ומבלהים וּֽמְבַהֲלִים אוֹתָם לִבְנֽוֹת׃
translation: Then the people of the land weakened the hands of the people of Judah, and troubled them in building. (Ezra 4:4)

text: בִּלָּה בְשָׂרִי וְעוֹרִי שִׁבַּר עַצְמוֹתָֽי׃
translation: He has made my flesh and my skin old. He has broken my bones. (Lamentations 3:4)

text: וַחֲצַר שׁוּעָל וּבָלָה וָעָֽצֶם׃
translation: Hazar Shual, Balah, Ezem, (Joshua 19:3)

text: וָאוֹלֵךְ אֶתְכֶם אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה בַּמִּדְבָּר לֹֽא בָלוּ שַׂלְמֹֽתֵיכֶם מֵעֲלֵיכֶם וְנַֽעַלְךָ לֹֽא בָלְתָה מֵעַל רַגְלֶֽךָ׃
translation: But the LORD has not given you a heart to know, eyes to see, and ears to hear, to this day. (Deuteronomy 29:4)

text: וְעַתָּה הוֹאִילוּ פְנוּ בִי וְעַל פְּנֵיכֶם אִם אֲכַזֵּֽב׃
translation: Now therefore be pleased to look at me, for surely I will not lie to your face. (Job 6:28)

text: חֶרֶב אֶל הַבַּדִּים וְנֹאָלוּ חֶרֶב אֶל גִּבּוֹרֶיהָ וָחָֽתּוּ׃
translation: A sword is on the boasters, and they will become fools. A sword is on her mighty men, and they will be dismayed. (Jeremiah 50:36)

text: וַיּוֹאֶל מֹשֶׁה לָשֶׁבֶת אֶת הָאִישׁ וַיִּתֵּן אֶת צִפֹּרָה בִתּוֹ לְמֹשֶֽׁה׃
translation: Moses was content to dwell with the man. He gave Moses Zipporah, his daughter. (Exodus 2:21)

text: וַיּוֹאֶל הַלֵּוִי לָשֶׁבֶת אֶת הָאִישׁ וַיְהִי הַנַּעַר לוֹ כְּאַחַד מִבָּנָֽיו׃
translation: The Levite was content to dwell with the man; and the young man was to him as one of his sons. (Judges 17:11)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר הָֽאֶחָד הוֹאֶל נָא וְלֵךְ אֶת עֲבָדֶיךָ וַיֹּאמֶר אֲנִי אֵלֵֽךְ׃
translation: One said, "Please be pleased to go with your servants." He answered, "I will go." (2 Kings 6:3)

text: בְּעֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן בְּאֶרֶץ מוֹאָב הוֹאִיל מֹשֶׁה בֵּאֵר אֶת הַתּוֹרָה הַזֹּאת לֵאמֹֽר׃
translation: Beyond the Jordan, in the land of Moab, Moses began to declare this law, saying, (Deuteronomy 1:5)

text: כַּאֲשֶׁר שָׁמְמוּ עָלֶיךָ רַבִּים כֵּן מִשְׁחַת מֵאִישׁ מַרְאֵהוּ וְתֹאֲרוֹ מִבְּנֵי אָדָֽם׃
translation: Just as many were astonished at you— his appearance was marred more than any man, and his form more than the sons of men— (Isaiah 52:14)

text: וְהִנֵּה מִן הַיְאֹר עֹלֹת שֶׁבַע פָּרוֹת בְּרִיאוֹת בָּשָׂר וִיפֹת תֹּאַר וַתִּרְעֶינָה בָּאָֽחוּ׃
translation: and behold, seven fat and sleek cattle came up out of the river. They fed in the marsh grass; (Genesis 41:18)

text: חָשַׁךְ מִשְּׁחוֹר תָּֽאֳרָם לֹא נִכְּרוּ בַּחוּצוֹת צָפַד עוֹרָם עַל עַצְמָם יָבֵשׁ הָיָה כָעֵֽץ׃
translation: Their appearance is blacker than a coal. They are not known in the streets. Their skin clings to their bones. It is withered. It has become like wood. (Lamentations 4:8)

text: וַיַּעַל כַּיּוֹנֵק לְפָנָיו וְכַשֹּׁרֶשׁ מֵאֶרֶץ צִיָּה לֹא תֹאַר לוֹ וְלֹא הָדָר וְנִרְאֵהוּ וְלֹֽא מַרְאֶה וְנֶחְמְדֵֽהוּ׃
translation: For he grew up before him as a tender plant, and as a root out of dry ground. He has no good looks or majesty. When we see him, there is no beauty that we should desire him. (Isaiah 53:2)

text: זַיִת רַֽעֲנָן יְפֵה פְרִי תֹאַר קָרָא יְהוָה שְׁמֵךְ לְקוֹל הֲמוּלָּה גְדֹלָה הִצִּית אֵשׁ עָלֶיהָ וְרָעוּ דָּלִיּוֹתָֽיו׃
translation: The LORD called your name, "A green olive tree, beautiful with goodly fruit." With the noise of a great roar he has kindled fire on it, and its branches are broken. (Jeremiah 11:16)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל זֶבַח וְאֶל צַלְמֻנָּע אֵיפֹה הָאֲנָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר הֲרַגְתֶּם בְּתָבוֹר וַֽיֹּאמרוּ כָּמוֹךָ כְמוֹהֶם אֶחָד כְּתֹאַר בְּנֵי הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
translation: Then he said to Zebah and Zalmunna, "What kind of men were they whom you killed at Tabor?" They answered, "They were like you. They all resembled the children of a king." (Judges 8:18)

text: וַיַּרְא יַעֲקֹב אֶת פְּנֵי לָבָן וְהִנֵּה אֵינֶנּוּ עִמּוֹ כִּתְמוֹל שִׁלְשֽׁוֹם׃
translation: Jacob saw the expression on Laban's face, and, behold, it was not toward him as before. (Genesis 31:2)

text: כִּֽי תְמוֹל אֲנַחְנוּ וְלֹא נֵדָע כִּי צֵל יָמֵינוּ עֲלֵי אָֽרֶץ׃
translation: (For we are but of yesterday, and know nothing, because our days on earth are a shadow.) (Job 8:9)

text: וַיִּתֵּן יְהוָה לְיִשְׂרָאֵל מוֹשִׁיעַ וַיֵּצְאוּ מִתַּחַת יַד אֲרָם וַיֵּשְׁבוּ בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּאָהֳלֵיהֶם כִּתְמוֹל שִׁלְשֽׁוֹם׃
translation: (The LORD gave Israel a savior, so that they went out from under the hand of the Syrians; and the children of Israel lived in their tents as before. (2 Kings 13:5)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶן רֹאֶה אָנֹכִי אֶת פְּנֵי אֲבִיכֶן כִּֽי אֵינֶנּוּ אֵלַי כִּתְמֹל שִׁלְשֹׁם וֵֽאלֹהֵי אָבִי הָיָה עִמָּדִֽי׃
translation: and said to them, "I see the expression on your father's face, that it is not toward me as before; but the God of my father has been with me. (Genesis 31:5)

text: וּדְבַר אַבְנֵר הָיָה עִם זִקְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר גַּם תְּמוֹל גַּם שִׁלְשֹׁם הֱיִיתֶם מְבַקְשִׁים אֶת דָּוִד לְמֶלֶךְ עֲלֵיכֶֽם׃
translation: Abner had communication with the elders of Israel, saying, "In times past, you sought for David to be king over you. (2 Samuel 3:17)

text: וְאִם שׁוֹר נַגָּח הוּא מִתְּמֹל שִׁלְשֹׁם וְהוּעַד בִּבְעָלָיו וְלֹא יִשְׁמְרֶנּוּ וְהֵמִית אִישׁ אוֹ אִשָּׁה הַשּׁוֹר יִסָּקֵל וְגַם בְּעָלָיו יוּמָֽת׃
translation: But if the bull had a habit of goring in the past, and this has been testified to its owner, and he has not kept it in, but it has killed a man or a woman, the bull shall be stoned, and its owner shall also be put to death. (Exodus 21:29)

text: וַהֲבֵאתָהּ אֶל תּוֹךְ בֵּיתֶךָ וְגִלְּחָה אֶת רֹאשָׁהּ וְעָשְׂתָה אֶת צִפָּרְנֶֽיהָ׃
translation: then you shall bring her home to your house. She shall shave her head and trim her nails. (Deuteronomy 21:12)

text: וַיָּחֶל שְׂעַר רֹאשׁוֹ לְצַמֵּחַ כַּאֲשֶׁר גֻּלָּֽח׃
translation: However, the hair of his head began to grow again after he was shaved. (Judges 16:22)

text: וְרֹאשָׁם לֹא יְגַלֵּחוּ וּפֶרַע לֹא יְשַׁלֵּחוּ כָּסוֹם יִכְסְמוּ אֶת רָאשֵׁיהֶֽם׃
translation: "'"They shall not shave their heads, or allow their locks to grow long. They shall only cut off the hair of their heads. (Ezekiel 44:20)

text: וְהִתְגַּלָּח וְאֶת הַנֶּתֶק לֹא יְגַלֵּחַ וְהִסְגִּיר הַכֹּהֵן אֶת הַנֶּתֶק שִׁבְעַת יָמִים שֵׁנִֽית׃
translation: then he shall be shaved, but he shall not shave the itch. Then the priest shall isolate the one who has the itch seven more days. (Leviticus 13:33)

text: וַיִּקַּח חָנוּן אֶת עַבְדֵי דָוִיד וַֽיְגַלְּחֵם וַיִּכְרֹת אֶת מַדְוֵיהֶם בַּחֵצִי עַד הַמִּפְשָׂעָה וַֽיְשַׁלְּחֵֽם׃
translation: So Hanun took David's servants, shaved them, and cut off their garments in the middle at their buttocks, and sent them away. (1 Chronicles 19:4)

text: וַיִּשְׁלַח פַּרְעֹה וַיִּקְרָא אֶת יוֹסֵף וַיְרִיצֻהוּ מִן הַבּוֹר וַיְגַלַּח וַיְחַלֵּף שִׂמְלֹתָיו וַיָּבֹא אֶל פַּרְעֹֽה׃
translation: Then Pharaoh sent and called Joseph, and they brought him hastily out of the dungeon. He shaved himself, changed his clothing, and came in to Pharaoh. (Genesis 41:14)

text: כִּֽי אָפֵס עָרִיץ וְכָלָה לֵץ וְנִכְרְתוּ כָּל שֹׁקְדֵי אָֽוֶן׃
translation: For the ruthless is brought to nothing, and the scoffer ceases, and all those who are alert to do evil are cut off— (Isaiah 29:20)

text: וְהוּא לִקְבָרוֹת יוּבָל וְֽעַל גָּדִישׁ יִשְׁקֽוֹד׃
translation: Yet he will be borne to the grave. Men will keep watch over the tomb. (Job 21:32)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֵלַי הֵיטַבְתָּ לִרְאוֹת כִּֽי שֹׁקֵד אֲנִי עַל דְּבָרִי לַעֲשֹׂתֽוֹ׃
translation: Then the LORD said to me, "You have seen well; for I watch over my word to perform it." (Jeremiah 1:12)

text: שִׁקְדוּ וְשִׁמְרוּ עַֽד תִּשְׁקְלוּ לִפְנֵי שָׂרֵי הַכֹּהֲנִים וְהַלְוִיִּם וְשָׂרֵֽי הָאָבוֹת לְיִשְׂרָאֵל בִּירוּשָׁלִָם הַלִּשְׁכוֹת בֵּית יְהוָֽה׃
translation: Watch and keep them until you weigh them before the chiefs of the priests, the Levites, and the princes of the fathers' households of Israel at Jerusalem, in the rooms of the LORD's house." (Ezra 8:29)

text: וְהָיָה כַּאֲשֶׁר שָׁקַדְתִּי עֲלֵיהֶם לִנְתוֹשׁ וְלִנְתוֹץ וְלַהֲרֹס וּלְהַאֲבִיד וּלְהָרֵעַ כֵּן אֶשְׁקֹד עֲלֵיהֶם לִבְנוֹת וְלִנְטוֹעַ נְאֻם יְהוָֽה׃
translation: It will happen that, like as I have watched over them to pluck up and to break down and to overthrow and to destroy and to afflict, so I will watch over them to build and to plant," says the LORD. (Jeremiah 31:28)

text: נִשְׂקַד עֹל פְּשָׁעַי בְּיָדוֹ יִשְׂתָּֽרְגוּ עָלוּ עַל צַוָּארִי הִכְשִׁיל כֹּחִי נְתָנַנִי אֲדֹנָי בִּידֵי לֹא אוּכַל קֽוּם׃
translation: "The yoke of my transgressions is bound by his hand. They are knit together. They have come up on my neck. He made my strength fail. The Lord has delivered me into their hands, against whom I am not able to stand. (Lamentations 1:14)

text: וְאֶת חוּקֹק וְאֶת מִגְרָשֶׁיהָ וְאֶת רְחֹב וְאֶת מִגְרָשֶֽׁיהָ׃
translation: and out of the tribe of Benjamin, Geba with its pasture lands, Allemeth with its pasture lands, and Anathoth with its pasture lands. All their cities throughout their families were thirteen cities. (1 Chronicles 6:60)

text: לִבִּי לְחוֹקְקֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הַמִּֽתְנַדְּבִים בָּעָם בָּרֲכוּ יְהוָֽה׃
translation: My heart is toward the governors of Israel, who offered themselves willingly among the people. Bless the LORD! (Judges 5:9)

text: לִי גִלְעָד וְלִי מְנַשֶּׁה וְאֶפְרַיִם מָעוֹז רֹאשִׁי יְהוּדָה מְחֹֽקְקִי׃
translation: Who will bring me into the strong city? Who has led me to Edom? (Psalms 60:9)

text: לִי גִלְעָד לִי מְנַשֶּׁה וְאֶפְרַיִם מָעוֹז רֹאשִׁי יְהוּדָה מְחֹקְקִֽי׃
translation: Moab is my wash pot. I will toss my sandal on Edom. I will shout over Philistia." (Psalms 108:9)

text: בַּהֲכִינוֹ שָׁמַיִם שָׁם אָנִי בְּחוּקוֹ חוּג עַל פְּנֵי תְהֽוֹם׃
translation: When he established the heavens, I was there. When he set a circle on the surface of the deep, (Proverbs 8:27)

text: פֶּן יִשְׁתֶּה וְיִשְׁכַּח מְחֻקָּק וִֽישַׁנֶּה דִּין כָּל בְּנֵי עֹֽנִי׃
translation: lest they drink, and forget the law, and pervert the justice due to anyone who is afflicted. (Proverbs 31:5)

text: וּמָשַׁךְ אַבִּירִים בְּכֹחוֹ יָקוּם וְֽלֹא יַאֲמִין בַּֽחַיִּֽין׃
translation: Yet God preserves the mighty by his power. He rises up who has no assurance of life. (Job 24:22)

text: עַד אֶמְצָא מָקוֹם לַיהוָה מִשְׁכָּנוֹת לַאֲבִיר יַעֲקֹֽב׃
translation: until I find out a place for the LORD, a dwelling for the Mighty One of Jacob." (Psalms 132:5)

text: הַֽאוֹכַל בְּשַׂר אַבִּירִים וְדַם עַתּוּדִים אֶשְׁתֶּֽה׃
translation: Will I eat the meat of bulls, or drink the blood of goats? (Psalms 50:13)

text: אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע לַיהוָה נָדַר לַאֲבִיר יַעֲקֹֽב׃
translation: how he swore to the LORD, and vowed to the Mighty One of Jacob: (Psalms 132:2)

text: שִׁמְעוּ אֵלַי אַבִּירֵי לֵב הָרְחוֹקִים מִצְּדָקָֽה׃
translation: Listen to me, you stubborn-hearted, who are far from righteousness! (Isaiah 46:12)

text: רֶגַע יָמֻתוּ וַחֲצוֹת לָיְלָה יְגֹעֲשׁוּ עָם וְיַעֲבֹרוּ וְיָסִירוּ אַבִּיר לֹא בְיָֽד׃
translation: In a moment they die, even at midnight. The people are shaken and pass away. The mighty are taken away without a hand. (Job 34:20)

text: אֵלֶּה מוֹעֲדֵי יְהוָה מִקְרָאֵי קֹדֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר תִּקְרְאוּ אֹתָם בְּמוֹעֲדָֽם׃
translation: "'These are the set feasts of the LORD, even holy convocations, which you shall proclaim in their appointed season. (Leviticus 23:4)

text: בַּיּוֹם הָרִאשׁוֹן מִקְרָא קֹדֶשׁ כָּל מְלֶאכֶת עֲבֹדָה לֹא תַעֲשֽׂוּ׃
translation: On the first day shall be a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work. (Leviticus 23:35)

text: בַּיּוֹם הָרִאשׁוֹן מִקְרָא קֹדֶשׁ כָּל מְלֶאכֶת עֲבֹדָה לֹא תַעֲשֽׂוּ׃
translation: In the first day shall be a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work, (Numbers 28:18)

text: וַֽיִּקְרְאוּ בַסֵּפֶר בְּתוֹרַת הָאֱלֹהִים מְפֹרָשׁ וְשׂוֹם שֶׂכֶל וַיָּבִינוּ בַּמִּקְרָֽא׃
translation: They read in the book, in the law of God, distinctly; and they gave the sense, so that they understood the reading. (Nehemiah 8:8)

text: בַּיּוֹם הָֽרִאשׁוֹן מִקְרָא קֹדֶשׁ יִהְיֶה לָכֶם כָּל מְלֶאכֶת עֲבֹדָה לֹא תַעֲשֽׂוּ׃
translation: In the first day you shall have a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work. (Leviticus 23:7)

text: וּבַיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי מִקְרָא קֹדֶשׁ יִהְיֶה לָכֶם כָּל מְלֶאכֶת עֲבֹדָה לֹא תַעֲשֽׂוּ׃
translation: On the seventh day you shall have a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work. (Numbers 28:25)

text: עָשִׁיר יִשְׁכַּב וְלֹא יֵאָסֵף עֵינָיו פָּקַח וְאֵינֶֽנּוּ׃
translation: He lies down rich, but he will not do so again. He opens his eyes, and he is not. (Job 27:19)

text: וּבַֽת צֹר בְּמִנְחָה פָּנַיִךְ יְחַלּוּ עֲשִׁירֵי עָֽם׃
translation: The princess inside is all glorious. Her clothing is interwoven with gold. (Psalms 45:13)

text: גַּם בְּנֵי אָדָם גַּם בְּנֵי אִישׁ יַחַד עָשִׁיר וְאֶבְיֽוֹן׃
translation: My mouth will speak words of wisdom. My heart will utter understanding. (Psalms 49:3)

text: גַּם לְרֵעֵהוּ יִשָּׂנֵא רָשׁ וְאֹהֲבֵי עָשִׁיר רַבִּֽים׃
translation: The poor person is shunned even by his own neighbor, but the rich person has many friends. (Proverbs 14:20)

text: חָכָם בְּעֵינָיו אִישׁ עָשִׁיר וְדַל מֵבִין יַחְקְרֶֽנּוּ׃
translation: The rich man is wise in his own eyes; but the poor who has understanding sees through him. (Proverbs 28:11)

text: לְעָשִׁיר הָיָה צֹאן וּבָקָר הַרְבֵּה מְאֹֽד׃
translation: The rich man had very many flocks and herds, (2 Samuel 12:2)

text: וּמָשַׁחְתָּ אֶת הַכִּיֹּר וְאֶת כַּנּוֹ וְקִדַּשְׁתָּ אֹתֽוֹ׃
translation: You shall anoint the basin and its base, and sanctify it. (Exodus 40:11)

text: וְאֶת מִזְבַּח הָעֹלָה וְאֶת כָּל כֵּלָיו וְאֶת הַכִּיֹּר וְאֶת כַּנּֽוֹ׃
translation: the altar of burnt offering with all its utensils, and the basin with its base. (Exodus 30:28)

text: וְאֶת מִזְבַּח הָעֹלָה וְאֶת כָּל כֵּלָיו וְאֶת הַכִּיּוֹר וְאֶת כַּנּֽוֹ׃
translation: the altar of burnt offering with all its vessels, the basin and its base, (Exodus 31:9)

text: וְנָֽתַתָּ אֶת הַכִּיֹּר בֵּֽין אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וּבֵין הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וְנָתַתָּ שָׁם מָֽיִם׃
translation: You shall set the basin between the Tent of Meeting and the altar, and shall put water therein. (Exodus 40:7)

text: וַיָּשֶׂם אֶת הַכִּיֹּר בֵּֽין אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וּבֵין הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וַיִּתֵּן שָׁמָּה מַיִם לְרָחְצָֽה׃
translation: He set the basin between the Tent of Meeting and the altar, and put water therein, with which to wash. (Exodus 40:30)

text: וַיַּעַשׂ אֵת הַכִּיּוֹר נְחֹשֶׁת וְאֵת כַּנּוֹ נְחֹשֶׁת בְּמַרְאֹת הַצֹּבְאֹת אֲשֶׁר צָֽבְאוּ פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃
translation: He made the basin of bronze, and its base of bronze, out of the mirrors of the ministering women who ministered at the door of the Tent of Meeting. (Exodus 38:8)

text: וְאֶשְׁחָקֵם כַּעֲפַר אָרֶץ כְּטִיט חוּצוֹת אֲדִקֵּם אֶרְקָעֵֽם׃
translation: Then I beat them as small as the dust of the earth. I crushed them as the mire of the streets, and spread them abroad. (2 Samuel 22:43)

text: לֶחֶם יוּדָק כִּי לֹא לָנֶצַח אָדוֹשׁ יְדוּשֶׁנּוּ וְהָמַם גִּלְגַּל עֶגְלָתוֹ וּפָרָשָׁיו לֹֽא יְדֻקֶּֽנּוּ׃
translation: Bread flour must be ground; so he will not always be threshing it. Although he drives the wheel of his threshing cart over it, his horses don't grind it. (Isaiah 28:28)

text: וְשָֽׁחַקְתָּ מִמֶּנָּה הָדֵק וְנָתַתָּה מִמֶּנָּה לִפְנֵי הָעֵדֻת בְּאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד אֲשֶׁר אִוָּעֵד לְךָ שָׁמָּה קֹדֶשׁ קָֽדָשִׁים תִּהְיֶה לָכֶֽם׃
translation: You shall beat some of it very small, and put some of it before the covenant in the Tent of Meeting, where I will meet with you. It shall be to you most holy. (Exodus 30:36)

text: וְגַֽם מַעֲכָה אֵם אָסָא הַמֶּלֶךְ הֱסִירָהּ מִגְּבִירָה אֲשֶׁר עָשְׂתָה לַאֲשֵׁרָה מִפְלָצֶת וַיִּכְרֹת אָסָא אֶת מִפְלַצְתָּהּ וַיָּדֶק וַיִּשְׂרֹף בְּנַחַל קִדְרֽוֹן׃
translation: Also Maacah, the mother of Asa the king, he removed from being queen mother, because she had made an abominable image for an Asherah; so Asa cut down her image, ground it into dust, and burned it at the brook Kidron. (2 Chronicles 15:16)

text: כֵּן אֲמַר חֵֽיוְתָא רְבִיעָיְתָא מַלְכוּ רביעיא רְבִיעָאָה תֶּהֱוֵא בְאַרְעָא דִּי תִשְׁנֵא מִן כָּל מַלְכְוָתָא וְתֵאכֻל כָּל אַרְעָא וּתְדוּשִׁנַּהּ וְתַדְּקִנַּֽהּ׃
translation: "So he said, 'The fourth animal will be a fourth kingdom on earth, which will be different from all the kingdoms, and will devour the whole earth, and will tread it down and break it in pieces. (Daniel 7:23)

text: וְדִבַּרְתָּ אֶת דְּבָרַי אֲלֵיהֶם אִֽם יִשְׁמְעוּ וְאִם יֶחְדָּלוּ כִּי מְרִי הֵֽמָּה׃
translation: You shall speak my words to them, whether they will hear or whether they will refuse; for they are most rebellious. (Ezekiel 2:7)

text: כִּי עַם מְרִי הוּא בָּנִים כֶּחָשִׁים בָּנִים לֹֽא אָבוּ שְׁמוֹעַ תּוֹרַת יְהוָֽה׃
translation: For it is a rebellious people, lying children, children who will not hear the LORD's law; (Isaiah 30:9)

text: בֶּן אָדָם הֲלֹא אָמְרוּ אֵלֶיךָ בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל בֵּית הַמֶּרִי מָה אַתָּה עֹשֶֽׂה׃
translation: "Son of man, hasn't the house of Israel, the rebellious house, said to you, 'What are you doing?' (Ezekiel 12:9)

text: וְהֵמָּה אִם יִשְׁמְעוּ וְאִם יֶחְדָּלוּ כִּי בֵּית מְרִי הֵמָּה וְיָדְעוּ כִּי נָבִיא הָיָה בְתוֹכָֽם׃
translation: They, whether they will hear, or whether they will refuse—for they are a rebellious house—yet they will know that there has been a prophet among them. (Ezekiel 2:5)

text: וּלְשֽׁוֹנְךָ אַדְבִּיק אֶל חִכֶּךָ וְנֶֽאֱלַמְתָּ וְלֹא תִֽהְיֶה לָהֶם לְאִישׁ מוֹכִיחַ כִּי בֵּית מְרִי הֵֽמָּה׃
translation: I will make your tongue stick to the roof of your mouth so that you will be mute and will not be able to correct them, for they are a rebellious house. (Ezekiel 3:26)

text: וְאָמַרְתָּ אֶל מֶרִי אֶל בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל כֹּה אָמַר אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה רַב לָכֶם מִֽכָּל תּוֹעֲבֽוֹתֵיכֶם בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
translation: You shall tell the rebellious, even the house of Israel, 'The Lord GOD says: "You house of Israel, let that be enough of all your abominations, (Ezekiel 44:6)

text: כִּסְאֲךָ אֱלֹהִים עוֹלָם וָעֶד שֵׁבֶט מִישֹׁר שֵׁבֶט מַלְכוּתֶֽךָ׃
translation: You have loved righteousness, and hated wickedness. Therefore God, your God, has anointed you with the oil of gladness above your fellows. (Psalms 45:7)

text: רַגְלִי עָֽמְדָה בְמִישׁוֹר בְּמַקְהֵלִים אֲבָרֵךְ יְהוָֽה׃
translation: My foot stands in an even place. In the congregations I will bless the LORD. (Psalms 26:12)

text: חֶשְׁבּוֹן וְכָל עָרֶיהָ אֲשֶׁר בַּמִּישֹׁר דִּיבוֹן וּבָמוֹת בַּעַל וּבֵית בַּעַל מְעֽוֹן׃
translation: Heshbon, and all its cities that are in the plain; Dibon, Bamoth Baal, Beth Baal Meon, (Joshua 13:17)

text: יִֽשְׂמְחוּ וִֽירַנְּנוּ לְאֻמִּים כִּֽי תִשְׁפֹּט עַמִּים מִישׁוֹר וּלְאֻמִּים בָּאָרֶץ תַּנְחֵם סֶֽלָה׃
translation: Let the peoples praise you, God. Let all the peoples praise you. (Psalms 67:5)

text: לַמְּדֵנִי לַֽעֲשׂוֹת רְצוֹנֶךָ כִּֽי אַתָּה אֱלוֹהָי רוּחֲךָ טוֹבָה תַּנְחֵנִי בְּאֶרֶץ מִישֽׁוֹר׃
translation: Teach me to do your will, for you are my God. Your Spirit is good. Lead me in the land of uprightness. (Psalms 143:10)

text: וּמִשְׁפָּט בָּא אֶל אֶרֶץ הַמִּישֹׁר אֶל חֹלוֹן וְאֶל יַהְצָה וְעַל מופעת מֵיפָֽעַת׃
translation: Judgment has come on the plain country— on Holon, on Jahzah, on Mephaath, (Jeremiah 48:21)

text: מִמִּזְרַח שֶׁמֶשׁ עַד מְבוֹאוֹ מְהֻלָּל שֵׁם יְהוָֽה׃
translation: From the rising of the sun to its going down, the LORD's name is to be praised. (Psalms 113:3)

text: לְיַד שְׁעָרִים לְפִי קָרֶת מְבוֹא פְתָחִים תָּרֹֽנָּה׃
translation: Beside the gates, at the entry of the city, at the entry doors, she cries aloud: (Proverbs 8:3)

text: עָשָׂה יָרֵחַ לְמוֹעֲדִים שֶׁמֶשׁ יָדַע מְבוֹאֽוֹ׃
translation: He appointed the moon for seasons. The sun knows when to set. (Psalms 104:19)

text: וַיָּשִׂמוּ לָהּ יָדַיִם וַתָּבוֹא דֶּֽרֶךְ מְבוֹא הַסּוּסִים בֵּית הַמֶּלֶךְ וַתּוּמַת שָֽׁם׃
translation: So they seized her; and she went by the way of the horses' entry to the king's house, and she was slain there. (2 Kings 11:16)

text: וַיָּשִׂימוּ לָהּ יָדַיִם וַתָּבוֹא אֶל מְבוֹא שַֽׁעַר הַסּוּסִים בֵּית הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיְמִיתוּהָ שָֽׁם׃
translation: So they made way for her. She went to the entrance of the horse gate to the king's house; and they killed her there. (2 Chronicles 23:15)

text: מִזְמוֹר לְאָסָף אֵל אֱֽלֹהִים יְֽהוָה דִּבֶּר וַיִּקְרָא אָרֶץ מִמִּזְרַח שֶׁמֶשׁ עַד מְבֹאֽוֹ׃
translation: A Psalm by Asaph. The Mighty One, God, the LORD, speaks, and calls the earth from sunrise to sunset. (Psalms 50:1)

text: בְּשִׂפְתֵי נָבוֹן תִּמָּצֵא חָכְמָה וְשֵׁבֶט לְגֵו חֲסַר לֵֽב׃
translation: Wisdom is found on the lips of him who has discernment, but a rod is for the back of him who is void of understanding. (Proverbs 10:13)

text: שׁוֹט לַסּוּס מֶתֶג לַחֲמוֹר וְשֵׁבֶט לְגֵו כְּסִילִֽים׃
translation: A whip is for the horse, a bridle for the donkey, and a rod for the back of fools! (Proverbs 26:3)

text: מִן גֵּו יְגֹרָשׁוּ יָרִיעוּ עָלֵימוֹ כַּגַּנָּֽב׃
translation: They are driven out from among men. They cry after them as after a thief, (Job 30:5)

text: נָכוֹנוּ לַלֵּצִים שְׁפָטִים וּמַהֲלֻמוֹת לְגֵו כְּסִילִֽים׃
translation: Penalties are prepared for scoffers, and beatings for the backs of fools. (Proverbs 19:29)

text: הִנֵּה לְשָׁלוֹם מַר לִי מָר וְאַתָּה חָשַׁקְתָּ נַפְשִׁי מִשַּׁחַת בְּלִי כִּי הִשְׁלַכְתָּ אַחֲרֵי גֵוְךָ כָּל חֲטָאָֽי׃
translation: Behold, for peace I had great anguish, but you have in love for my soul delivered it from the pit of corruption; for you have cast all my sins behind your back. (Isaiah 38:17)

text: וַתָּרַע לַעֲשׂוֹת מִכֹּל אֲשֶׁר הָיוּ לְפָנֶיךָ וַתֵּלֶךְ וַתַּעֲשֶׂה לְּךָ אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים וּמַסֵּכוֹת לְהַכְעִיסֵנִי וְאֹתִי הִשְׁלַכְתָּ אַחֲרֵי גַוֶּֽךָ׃
translation: but have done evil above all who were before you, and have gone and made for yourself other gods, molten images, to provoke me to anger, and have cast me behind your back, (1 Kings 14:9)

text: כִּי חִלַּצְתָּ נַפְשִׁי מִמָּוֶת אֶת עֵינִי מִן דִּמְעָה אֶת רַגְלִי מִדֶּֽחִי׃
translation: For you have delivered my soul from death, my eyes from tears, and my feet from falling. (Psalms 116:8)

text: הָֽיְתָה לִּי דִמְעָתִי לֶחֶם יוֹמָם וָלָיְלָה בֶּאֱמֹר אֵלַי כָּל הַיּוֹם אַיֵּה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ׃
translation: These things I remember, and pour out my soul within me, how I used to go with the crowd, and led them to God's house, with the voice of joy and praise, a multitude keeping a holy day. (Psalms 42:4)

text: הַזֹּרְעִים בְּדִמְעָה בְּרִנָּה יִקְצֹֽרוּ׃
translation: Those who sow in tears will reap in joy. (Psalms 126:5)

text: שִֽׁמְעָה תְפִלָּתִי יְהוָה וְשַׁוְעָתִי הַאֲזִינָה אֶֽל דִּמְעָתִי אַֽל תֶּחֱרַשׁ כִּי גֵר אָנֹכִי עִמָּךְ תּוֹשָׁב כְּכָל אֲבוֹתָֽי׃
translation: Oh spare me, that I may recover strength, before I go away and exist no more." (Psalms 39:13)

text: וְאִם לֹא תִשְׁמָעוּהָ בְּמִסְתָּרִים תִּבְכֶּֽה נַפְשִׁי מִפְּנֵי גֵוָה וְדָמֹעַ תִּדְמַע וְתֵרַד עֵינִי דִּמְעָה כִּי נִשְׁבָּה עֵדֶר יְהוָֽה׃
translation: But if you will not hear it, my soul will weep in secret for your pride. My eye will weep bitterly, and run down with tears, because the LORD's flock has been taken captive. (Jeremiah 13:17)

text: כֹּה אָמַר יְהוָה מִנְעִי קוֹלֵךְ מִבֶּכִי וְעֵינַיִךְ מִדִּמְעָה כִּי יֵשׁ שָׂכָר לִפְעֻלָּתֵךְ נְאֻם יְהוָה וְשָׁבוּ מֵאֶרֶץ אוֹיֵֽב׃
translation: The LORD says: "Refrain your voice from weeping, and your eyes from tears, for your work will be rewarded," says the LORD. "They will come again from the land of the enemy. (Jeremiah 31:16)

text: כִּי לֹא מִמּוֹצָא וּמִֽמַּעֲרָב וְלֹא מִמִּדְבַּר הָרִֽים׃
translation: But God is the judge. He puts down one, and lifts up another. (Psalms 75:7)

text: כִּרְחֹק מִזְרָח מִֽמַּֽעֲרָב הִֽרְחִיק מִמֶּנּוּ אֶת פְּשָׁעֵֽינוּ׃
translation: As far as the east is from the west, so far has he removed our transgressions from us. (Psalms 103:12)

text: אֳנִיּוֹת תַּרְשִׁישׁ שָׁרוֹתַיִךְ מַעֲרָבֵךְ וַתִּמָּלְאִי וַֽתִּכְבְּדִי מְאֹד בְּלֵב יַמִּֽים׃
translation: "'"The ships of Tarshish were your caravans for your merchandise. You were replenished and made very glorious in the heart of the seas. (Ezekiel 27:25)

text: לַפַּרְבָּר לַֽמַּעֲרָב אַרְבָּעָה לַֽמְסִלָּה שְׁנַיִם לַפַּרְבָּֽר׃
translation: For Parbar westward, four at the causeway, and two at Parbar. (1 Chronicles 26:18)

text: וּֽמֵאֲרָצוֹת קִבְּצָם מִמִּזְרָח וּמִֽמַּעֲרָב מִצָּפוֹן וּמִיָּֽם׃
translation: and gathered out of the lands, from the east and from the west, from the north and from the south. (Psalms 107:3)

text: אַל תִּירָא כִּי אִתְּךָ אָנִי מִמִּזְרָח אָבִיא זַרְעֶךָ וּמִֽמַּעֲרָב אֲקַבְּצֶֽךָּ׃
translation: Don't be afraid, for I am with you. I will bring your offspring from the east, and gather you from the west. (Isaiah 43:5)

text: וּלְהֵיבָלָה כְּסַף וּדְהַב דִּֽי מַלְכָּא וְיָעֲטוֹהִי הִתְנַדַּבוּ לֶאֱלָהּ יִשְׂרָאֵל דִּי בִֽירוּשְׁלֶם מִשְׁכְּנֵֽהּ׃
translation: and to carry the silver and gold, which the king and his counselors have freely offered to the God of Israel, whose habitation is in Jerusalem, (Ezra 7:15)

text: הוּא צַלְמָא רֵאשֵׁהּ דִּֽי דְהַב טָב חֲדוֹהִי וּדְרָעוֹהִי דִּי כְסַף מְעוֹהִי וְיַרְכָתֵהּ דִּי נְחָֽשׁ׃
translation: As for this image, its head was of fine gold, its chest and its arms of silver, its belly and its thighs of bronze, (Daniel 2:32)

text: וּמָה דִי עליך עֲלָךְ וְעַל אחיך אֶחָךְ יֵיטַב בִּשְׁאָר כַּסְפָּא וְדַהֲבָה לְמֶעְבַּד כִּרְעוּת אֱלָהֲכֹם תַּעַבְדֽוּן׃
translation: Whatever seems good to you and to your brothers to do with the rest of the silver and the gold, do that according to the will of your God. (Ezra 7:18)

text: וְכֹל כְּסַף וּדְהַב דִּי תְהַשְׁכַּח בְּכֹל מְדִינַת בָּבֶל עִם הִתְנַדָּבוּת עַמָּא וְכָֽהֲנַיָּא מִֽתְנַדְּבִין לְבֵית אֱלָהֲהֹם דִּי בִירוּשְׁלֶֽם׃
translation: and all the silver and gold that you will find in all the province of Babylon, with the free will offering of the people and of the priests, offering willingly for the house of their God which is in Jerusalem. (Ezra 7:16)

text: נְבוּכַדְנֶצַּר מַלְכָּא עֲבַד צְלֵם דִּֽי דְהַב רוּמֵהּ אַמִּין שִׁתִּין פְּתָיֵהּ אַמִּין שִׁת אֲקִימֵהּ בְּבִקְעַת דּוּרָא בִּמְדִינַת בָּבֶֽל׃
translation: Nebuchadnezzar the king made an image of gold, whose height was sixty cubits and its width six cubits. He set it up in the plain of Dura, in the province of Babylon. (Daniel 3:1)

text: וְאִם כֶּבֶשׂ יָבִיא קָרְבָּנוֹ לְחַטָּאת נְקֵבָה תְמִימָה יְבִיאֶֽנָּה׃
translation: "'If he brings a lamb as his offering for a sin offering, he shall bring a female without defect. (Leviticus 4:32)

text: וְאִם נְקֵבָה הִוא וְהָיָה עֶרְכְּךָ שְׁלֹשִׁים שָֽׁקֶל׃
translation: If she is a female, then your valuation shall be thirty shekels. (Leviticus 27:4)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם מֹשֶׁה הַֽחִיִּיתֶם כָּל נְקֵבָֽה׃
translation: Moses said to them, "Have you saved all the women alive? (Numbers 31:15)

text: זָכָר וּנְקֵבָה בְּרָאָם וַיְבָרֶךְ אֹתָם וַיִּקְרָא אֶת שְׁמָם אָדָם בְּיוֹם הִבָּֽרְאָֽם׃
translation: He created them male and female, and blessed them. On the day they were created, he named them Adam. (Genesis 5:2)

text: וְאִם מִן הַצֹּאן קָרְבָּנוֹ לְזֶבַח שְׁלָמִים לַיהוָה זָכָר אוֹ נְקֵבָה תָּמִים יַקְרִיבֶֽנּוּ׃
translation: "'If his offering for a sacrifice of peace offerings to the LORD is from the flock, either male or female, he shall offer it without defect. (Leviticus 3:6)

text: גַּם מֵעוֹף הַשָּׁמַיִם שִׁבְעָה שִׁבְעָה זָכָר וּנְקֵבָה לְחַיּוֹת זֶרַע עַל פְּנֵי כָל הָאָֽרֶץ׃
translation: Also of the birds of the sky, seven and seven, male and female, to keep seed alive on the surface of all the earth. (Genesis 7:3)

text: תַּאֲוַת עֲנָוִים שָׁמַעְתָּ יְהוָה תָּכִין לִבָּם תַּקְשִׁיב אָזְנֶֽךָ׃
translation: LORD, you have heard the desire of the humble. You will prepare their heart. You will cause your ear to hear, (Psalms 10:17)

text: תּוֹחֶלֶת מְמֻשָּׁכָה מַחֲלָה לֵב וְעֵץ חַיִּים תַּאֲוָה בָאָֽה׃
translation: Hope deferred makes the heart sick, but when longing is fulfilled, it is a tree of life. (Proverbs 13:12)

text: תַּאֲוָה נִהְיָה תֶּעֱרַב לְנָפֶשׁ וְתוֹעֲבַת כְּסִילִים סוּר מֵרָֽע׃
translation: Longing fulfilled is sweet to the soul, but fools detest turning from evil. (Proverbs 13:19)

text: כָּל הַיּוֹם הִתְאַוָּה תַאֲוָה וְצַדִּיק יִתֵּן וְלֹא יַחְשֹֽׂךְ׃
translation: There are those who covet greedily all day long; but the righteous give and don't withhold. (Proverbs 21:26)

text: תַּאֲוַת לִבּוֹ נָתַתָּה לּוֹ וַאֲרֶשֶׁת שְׂפָתָיו בַּל מָנַעְתָּ סֶּֽלָה׃
translation: For you meet him with the blessings of goodness. You set a crown of fine gold on his head. (Psalms 21:3)

text: מְגוֹרַת רָשָׁע הִיא תְבוֹאֶנּוּ וְתַאֲוַת צַדִּיקִים יִתֵּֽן׃
translation: What the wicked fear will overtake them, but the desire of the righteous will be granted. (Proverbs 10:24)

text: הוּרַד שְׁאוֹל גְּאוֹנֶךָ הֶמְיַת נְבָלֶיךָ תַּחְתֶּיךָ יֻצַּע רִמָּה וּמְכַסֶּיךָ תּוֹלֵעָֽה׃
translation: Your pomp is brought down to Sheol, with the sound of your stringed instruments. Maggots are spread out under you, and worms cover you. (Isaiah 14:11)

text: וּמִשְׁמֶרֶת בְּנֵֽי גֵרְשׁוֹן בְּאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד הַמִּשְׁכָּן וְהָאֹהֶל מִכְסֵהוּ וּמָסַךְ פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃
translation: The duty of the sons of Gershon in the Tent of Meeting shall be the tabernacle, the tent, its covering, the screen for the door of the Tent of Meeting, (Numbers 3:25)

text: וּפָרְשׂוּ עֲלֵיהֶם בֶּגֶד תּוֹלַעַת שָׁנִי וְכִסּוּ אֹתוֹ בְּמִכְסֵה עוֹר תָּחַשׁ וְשָׂמוּ אֶת בַּדָּֽיו׃
translation: They shall spread on them a scarlet cloth, and cover it with a covering of sealskin, and shall put in its poles. (Numbers 4:8)

text: וְעַל מִזְבַּח הַזָּהָב יִפְרְשׂוּ בֶּגֶד תְּכֵלֶת וְכִסּוּ אֹתוֹ בְּמִכְסֵה עוֹר תָּחַשׁ וְשָׂמוּ אֶת בַּדָּֽיו׃
translation: "On the golden altar they shall spread a blue cloth, and cover it with a covering of sealskin, and shall put in its poles. (Numbers 4:11)

text: וַיִּפְרֹשׂ אֶת הָאֹהֶל עַל הַמִּשְׁכָּן וַיָּשֶׂם אֶת מִכְסֵה הָאֹהֶל עָלָיו מִלְמָעְלָה כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהוָה אֶת מֹשֶֽׁה׃
translation: He spread the covering over the tent, and put the roof of the tabernacle above on it, as the LORD commanded Moses. (Exodus 40:19)

text: וְחִשַּׁב לוֹ הַכֹּהֵן אֵת מִכְסַת הָֽעֶרְכְּךָ עַד שְׁנַת הַיֹּבֵל וְנָתַן אֶת הָעֶרְכְּךָ בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא קֹדֶשׁ לַיהוָֽה׃
translation: then the priest shall reckon to him the worth of your valuation up to the Year of Jubilee; and he shall give your valuation on that day, as a holy thing to the LORD. (Leviticus 27:23)

text: וַיָּמָת הָרָן עַל פְּנֵי תֶּרַח אָבִיו בְּאֶרֶץ מוֹלַדְתּוֹ בְּאוּר כַּשְׂדִּֽים׃
translation: Haran died in the land of his birth, in Ur of the Chaldees, while his father Terah was still alive. (Genesis 11:28)

text: כִּי אֶל אַרְצִי וְאֶל מוֹלַדְתִּי תֵּלֵךְ וְלָקַחְתָּ אִשָּׁה לִבְנִי לְיִצְחָֽק׃
translation: But you shall go to my country, and to my relatives, and take a wife for my son Isaac." (Genesis 24:4)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֶֽל יַעֲקֹב שׁוּב אֶל אֶרֶץ אֲבוֹתֶיךָ וּלְמוֹלַדְתֶּךָ וְאֶֽהְיֶה עִמָּֽךְ׃
translation: The LORD said to Jacob, "Return to the land of your fathers, and to your relatives, and I will be with you." (Genesis 31:3)

text: וּמוֹלַדְתְּךָ אֲשֶׁר הוֹלַדְתָּ אַחֲרֵיהֶם לְךָ יִהְיוּ עַל שֵׁם אֲחֵיהֶם יִקָּרְאוּ בְּנַחֲלָתָֽם׃
translation: Your offspring, whom you become the father of after them, will be yours. They will be called after the name of their brothers in their inheritance. (Genesis 48:6)

text: עֶרְוַת בַּת אֵשֶׁת אָבִיךָ מוֹלֶדֶת אָבִיךָ אֲחוֹתְךָ הִוא לֹא תְגַלֶּה עֶרְוָתָֽהּ׃
translation: "'You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father's wife's daughter, conceived by your father, since she is your sister. (Leviticus 18:11)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו לֹא אֵלֵךְ כִּי אִם אֶל אַרְצִי וְאֶל מוֹלַדְתִּי אֵלֵֽךְ׃
translation: He said to him, "I will not go; but I will depart to my own land, and to my relatives." (Numbers 10:30)

text: יֻקַּֽח נָא מְעַט מַיִם וְרַחֲצוּ רַגְלֵיכֶם וְהִֽשָּׁעֲנוּ תַּחַת הָעֵֽץ׃
translation: Now let a little water be fetched, wash your feet, and rest yourselves under the tree. (Genesis 18:4)

text: וְאֶשֶׁד הַנְּחָלִים אֲשֶׁר נָטָה לְשֶׁבֶת עָר וְנִשְׁעַן לִגְבוּל מוֹאָֽב׃
translation: the slope of the valleys that incline toward the dwelling of Ar, leans on the border of Moab." (Numbers 21:15)

text: יִשָּׁעֵן עַל בֵּיתוֹ וְלֹא יַעֲמֹד יַחֲזִיק בּוֹ וְלֹא יָקֽוּם׃
translation: He will lean on his house, but it will not stand. He will cling to it, but it will not endure. (Job 8:15)

text: יִתֶּן לוֹ לָבֶטַח וְיִשָּׁעֵן וְעֵינֵיהוּ עַל דַּרְכֵיהֶֽם׃
translation: God gives them security, and they rest in it. His eyes are on their ways. (Job 24:23)

text: בְּטַח אֶל יְהוָה בְּכָל לִבֶּךָ וְאֶל בִּֽינָתְךָ אַל תִּשָּׁעֵֽן׃
translation: Trust in the LORD with all your heart, and don't lean on your own understanding. (Proverbs 3:5)

text: וַיִּכָּנְעוּ בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בָּעֵת הַהִיא וַיֶּֽאֶמְצוּ בְּנֵי יְהוּדָה כִּי נִשְׁעֲנוּ עַל יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵיהֶֽם׃
translation: Thus the children of Israel were brought under at that time, and the children of Judah prevailed, because they relied on the LORD, the God of their fathers. (2 Chronicles 13:18)

text: לְהַשְׁקִיט לוֹ מִימֵי רָע עַד יִכָּרֶה לָרָשָׁע שָֽׁחַת׃
translation: that you may give him rest from the days of adversity, until the pit is dug for the wicked. (Psalms 94:13)

text: כֹּֽרֶה שַּׁחַת בָּהּ יִפֹּל וְגֹלֵל אֶבֶן אֵלָיו תָּשֽׁוּב׃
translation: Whoever digs a pit shall fall into it. Whoever rolls a stone, it will come back on him. (Proverbs 26:27)

text: אַף עַל יָתוֹם תַּפִּילוּ וְתִכְרוּ עַל רֵֽיעֲכֶֽם׃
translation: Yes, you would even cast lots for the fatherless, and make merchandise of your friend. (Job 6:27)

text: כִּי סְבָבוּנִי כְּלָבִים עֲדַת מְרֵעִים הִקִּיפוּנִי כָּאֲרִי יָדַי וְרַגְלָֽי׃
translation: I can count all of my bones. They look and stare at me. (Psalms 22:17)

text: אִישׁ בְּלִיַּעַל כֹּרֶה רָעָה וְעַל שפתיו שְׂפָתוֹ כְּאֵשׁ צָרָֽבֶת׃
translation: A worthless man devises mischief. His speech is like a scorching fire. (Proverbs 16:27)

text: וָאֶכְּרֶהָ לִּי בַּחֲמִשָּׁה עָשָׂר כָּסֶף וְחֹמֶר שְׂעֹרִים וְלֵתֶךְ שְׂעֹרִֽים׃
translation: So I bought her for myself for fifteen pieces of silver and a homer and a half of barley. (Hosea 3:2)

text: כִּֽי הִשָּׁהּ אֱלוֹהַּ חָכְמָה וְלֹא חָלַק לָהּ בַּבִּינָֽה׃
translation: because God has deprived her of wisdom, neither has he imparted to her understanding. (Job 39:17)

text: וַתִּזְנַח מִשָּׁלוֹם נַפְשִׁי נָשִׁיתִי טוֹבָֽה׃
translation: You have removed my soul far away from peace. I forgot prosperity. (Lamentations 3:17)

text: בַּחוּץ תַּעֲמֹד וְהָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה נֹשֶׁה בוֹ יוֹצִיא אֵלֶיךָ אֶֽת הַעֲבוֹט הַחֽוּצָה׃
translation: You shall stand outside, and the man to whom you lend shall bring the pledge outside to you. (Deuteronomy 24:11)

text: וְגַם אֲנִי אַחַי וּנְעָרַי נֹשִׁים בָּהֶם כֶּסֶף וְדָגָן נַֽעַזְבָה נָּא אֶת הַמַּשָּׁא הַזֶּֽה׃
translation: I likewise, my brothers and my servants, lend them money and grain. Please let us stop this usury. (Nehemiah 5:10)

text: זְכָר אֵלֶּה יַעֲקֹב וְיִשְׂרָאֵל כִּי עַבְדִּי אָתָּה יְצַרְתִּיךָ עֶֽבֶד לִי אַתָּה יִשְׂרָאֵל לֹא תִנָּשֵֽׁנִי׃
translation: Remember these things, Jacob and Israel, for you are my servant. I have formed you. You are my servant. Israel, you will not be forgotten by me. (Isaiah 44:21)

text: וְהָיָה כָעָם כַּכֹּהֵן כַּעֶבֶד כַּֽאדֹנָיו כַּשִּׁפְחָה כַּגְּבִרְתָּהּ כַּקּוֹנֶה כַּמּוֹכֵר כַּמַּלְוֶה כַּלֹּוֶה כַּנֹּשֶׁה כַּאֲשֶׁר נֹשֶׁא בֽוֹ׃
translation: It will be as with the people, so with the priest; as with the servant, so with his master; as with the maid, so with her mistress; as with the buyer, so with the seller; as with the creditor, so with the debtor; as with the taker of interest, so with the giver of interest. (Isaiah 24:2)

text: דְּבַר שֶׁקֶר יִשְׂנָא צַדִּיק וְרָשָׁע יַבְאִישׁ וְיַחְפִּֽיר׃
translation: A righteous man hates lies, but a wicked man brings shame and disgrace. (Proverbs 13:5)

text: וַיַּאֲמֵן אָכִישׁ בְּדָוִד לֵאמֹר הַבְאֵשׁ הִבְאִישׁ בְּעַמּוֹ בְיִשְׂרָאֵל וְהָיָה לִי לְעֶבֶד עוֹלָֽם׃
translation: Achish believed David, saying, "He has made his people Israel utterly to abhor him. Therefore he will be my servant forever." (1 Samuel 27:12)

text: וַיַּנִּיחוּ אֹתוֹ עַד הַבֹּקֶר כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה מֹשֶׁה וְלֹא הִבְאִישׁ וְרִמָּה לֹא הָיְתָה בּֽוֹ׃
translation: They laid it up until the morning, as Moses ordered, and it didn't become foul, and there were no worms in it. (Exodus 16:24)

text: וְלֹא שָׁמְעוּ אֶל מֹשֶׁה וַיּוֹתִרוּ אֲנָשִׁים מִמֶּנּוּ עַד בֹּקֶר וַיָּרֻם תּוֹלָעִים וַיִּבְאַשׁ וַיִּקְצֹף עֲלֵהֶם מֹשֶֽׁה׃
translation: Notwithstanding they didn't listen to Moses, but some of them left of it until the morning, so it bred worms and became foul; and Moses was angry with them. (Exodus 16:20)

text: כֹּל הבאיש הֹבִישׁ עַל עַם לֹא יוֹעִילוּ לָמוֹ לֹא לְעֵזֶר וְלֹא לְהוֹעִיל כִּי לְבֹשֶׁת וְגַם לְחֶרְפָּֽה׃
translation: They shall all be ashamed because of a people that can't profit them, that are not a help nor profit, but a shame, and also a reproach." (Isaiah 30:5)

text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֲלֵהֶם יֵרֶא יְהוָה עֲלֵיכֶם וְיִשְׁפֹּט אֲשֶׁר הִבְאַשְׁתֶּם אֶת רֵיחֵנוּ בְּעֵינֵי פַרְעֹה וּבְעֵינֵי עֲבָדָיו לָֽתֶת חֶרֶב בְּיָדָם לְהָרְגֵֽנוּ׃
translation: They said to them, "May the LORD look at you and judge, because you have made us a stench to be abhorred in the eyes of Pharaoh, and in the eyes of his servants, to put a sword in their hand to kill us!" (Exodus 5:21)

text: תִּֽעֲבוּנִי כָּל מְתֵי סוֹדִי וְזֶֽה אָהַבְתִּי נֶהְפְּכוּ בִֽי׃
translation: All my familiar friends abhor me. They whom I loved have turned against me. (Job 19:19)

text: יְחִי רְאוּבֵן וְאַל יָמֹת וִיהִי מְתָיו מִסְפָּֽר׃
translation: "Let Reuben live, and not die; Nor let his men be few." (Deuteronomy 33:6)

text: כִּי הוּא יָדַע מְתֵי שָׁוְא וַיַּרְא אָוֶן וְלֹא יִתְבּוֹנָֽן׃
translation: For he knows false men. He sees iniquity also, even though he doesn't consider it. (Job 11:11)

text: הַאֹרַח עוֹלָם תִּשְׁמֹר אֲשֶׁר דָּרְכוּ מְתֵי אָֽוֶן׃
translation: Will you keep the old way, which wicked men have trodden, (Job 22:15)

text: לֹא יָשַׁבְתִּי עִם מְתֵי שָׁוְא וְעִם נַעֲלָמִים לֹא אָבֽוֹא׃
translation: I have not sat with deceitful men, neither will I go in with hypocrites. (Psalms 26:4)

text: בִּֽהְיֽוֹתְכֶם מְתֵי מִסְפָּר כִּמְעַט וְגָרִים בָּֽהּ׃
translation: when you were but a few men in number, yes, very few, and foreigners in it. (1 Chronicles 16:19)

text: בְּנֵי קְהָת עַמִּינָדָב בְּנוֹ קֹרַח בְּנוֹ אַסִּיר בְּנֽוֹ׃
translation: Meraioth became the father of Amariah. Amariah became the father of Ahitub. (1 Chronicles 6:7)

text: בֶּן תַּחַת בֶּן אַסִּיר בֶּן אֶבְיָסָף בֶּן קֹֽרַח׃
translation: The sons of Kohath: Amminadab his son, Korah his son, Assir his son, (1 Chronicles 6:22)

text: יַחַד אֲסִירִים שַׁאֲנָנוּ לֹא שָׁמְעוּ קוֹל נֹגֵֽשׂ׃
translation: There the prisoners are at ease together. They don't hear the voice of the taskmaster. (Job 3:18)

text: כִּֽי שֹׁמֵעַ אֶל אֶבְיוֹנִים יְהוָה וְאֶת אֲסִירָיו לֹא בָזָֽה׃
translation: Let heaven and earth praise him; the seas, and everything that moves therein! (Psalms 69:34)

text: תָּבוֹא לְפָנֶיךָ אֶנְקַת אָסִיר כְּגֹדֶל זְרוֹעֲךָ הוֹתֵר בְּנֵי תְמוּתָֽה׃
translation: Let the sighing of the prisoner come before you. According to the greatness of your power, preserve those who are sentenced to death. (Psalms 79:11)

text: שָׂם תֵּבֵל כַּמִּדְבָּר וְעָרָיו הָרָס אֲסִירָיו לֹא פָתַח בָּֽיְתָה׃
translation: who made the world like a wilderness, and overthrew its cities, who didn't release his prisoners to their home?" (Isaiah 14:17)

text: הֲֽיָם אָנִי אִם תַּנִּין כִּֽי תָשִׂים עָלַי מִשְׁמָֽר׃
translation: Am I a sea, or a sea monster, that you put a guard over me? (Job 7:12)

text: וַיַּנִּיחֻהוּ בַּמִּשְׁמָר לִפְרֹשׁ לָהֶם עַל פִּי יְהוָֽה׃
translation: They put him in custody until the LORD's will should be declared to them. (Leviticus 24:12)

text: וַיַּנִּיחוּ אֹתוֹ בַּמִּשְׁמָר כִּי לֹא פֹרַשׁ מַה יֵּעָשֶׂה לֽוֹ׃
translation: They put him in custody, because it had not been declared what should be done to him. (Numbers 15:34)

text: וַנִּתְפַּלֵּל אֶל אֱלֹהֵינוּ וַנַּעֲמִיד מִשְׁמָר עֲלֵיהֶם יוֹמָם וָלַיְלָה מִפְּנֵיהֶֽם׃
translation: Now Tobiah the Ammonite was by him, and he said, "What they are building, if a fox climbed up it, he would break down their stone wall." (Nehemiah 4:3)

text: וַיֶּאֱסֹף אֹתָם אֶל מִשְׁמָר שְׁלֹשֶׁת יָמִֽים׃
translation: He put them all together into custody for three days. (Genesis 42:17)

text: וַיִּפְקֹד שַׂר הַטַּבָּחִים אֶת יוֹסֵף אִתָּם וַיְשָׁרֶת אֹתָם וַיִּהְיוּ יָמִים בְּמִשְׁמָֽר׃
translation: The captain of the guard assigned them to Joseph, and he took care of them. They stayed in prison many days. (Genesis 40:4)

text: זֹאת מְנוּחָתִי עֲדֵי עַד פֹּֽה אֵשֵׁב כִּי אִוִּתִֽיהָ׃
translation: "This is my resting place forever. I will live here, for I have desired it. (Psalms 132:14)

text: אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּעְתִּי בְאַפִּי אִם יְבֹאוּן אֶל מְנוּחָתִֽי׃
translation: Therefore I swore in my wrath, "They won't enter into my rest." (Psalms 95:11)

text: שׁוּבִי נַפְשִׁי לִמְנוּחָיְכִי כִּֽי יְהוָה גָּמַל עָלָֽיְכִי׃
translation: Return to your rest, my soul, for the LORD has dealt bountifully with you. (Psalms 116:7)

text: קוּמָה יְהוָה לִמְנוּחָתֶךָ אַתָּה וַאֲרוֹן עֻזֶּֽךָ׃
translation: Arise, LORD, into your resting place, you, and the ark of your strength. (Psalms 132:8)

text: קוּמוּ וּלְכוּ כִּי לֹא זֹאת הַמְּנוּחָה בַּעֲבוּר טָמְאָה תְּחַבֵּל וְחֶבֶל נִמְרָֽץ׃
translation: Arise, and depart! For this is not your resting place, because of uncleanness that destroys, even with a grievous destruction. (Micah 2:10)

text: אֲשֶׁר אָמַר אֲלֵיהֶם זֹאת הַמְּנוּחָה הָנִיחוּ לֶֽעָיֵף וְזֹאת הַמַּרְגֵּעָה וְלֹא אָבוּא שְׁמֽוֹעַ׃
translation: to whom he said, "This is the resting place. Give rest to the weary," and "This is the refreshing;" yet they would not hear. (Isaiah 28:12)

text: כִּֽי עַתָּה צְעָדַי תִּסְפּוֹר לֹֽא תִשְׁמוֹר עַל חַטָּאתִֽי׃
translation: But now you count my steps. Don't you watch over my sin? (Job 14:16)

text: כִּי עֵינָיו עַל דַּרְכֵי אִישׁ וְֽכָל צְעָדָיו יִרְאֶֽה׃
translation: "For his eyes are on the ways of a man. He sees all his goings. (Job 34:21)

text: בְּֽלֶכְתְּךָ לֹא יֵצַר צַעֲדֶךָ וְאִם תָּרוּץ לֹא תִכָּשֵֽׁל׃
translation: When you go, your steps will not be hampered. When you run, you will not stumble. (Proverbs 4:12)

text: הֲלֹא הוּא יִרְאֶה דְרָכָי וְֽכָל צְעָדַי יִסְפּֽוֹר׃
translation: Doesn't he see my ways, and count all my steps? (Job 31:4)

text: לֵב אָדָם יְחַשֵּׁב דַּרְכּוֹ וַֽיהוָה יָכִין צַעֲדֽוֹ׃
translation: A man's heart plans his course, but the LORD directs his steps. (Proverbs 16:9)

text: שְׁלֹשָׁה הֵמָּה מֵיטִיבֵי צָעַד וְאַרְבָּעָה מֵיטִבֵי לָֽכֶת׃
translation: "There are three things which are stately in their march, four which are stately in going: (Proverbs 30:29)

text: אַף אַתָּה תָּפֵר יִרְאָה וְתִגְרַע שִׂיחָה לִפְנֵי אֵֽל׃
translation: Yes, you do away with fear, and hinder devotion before God. (Job 15:4)

text: הַבְסוֹד אֱלוֹהַ תִּשְׁמָע וְתִגְרַע אֵלֶיךָ חָכְמָֽה׃
translation: Have you heard the secret counsel of God? Do you limit wisdom to yourself? (Job 15:8)

text: לֹֽא יִגְרַע מִצַּדִּיק עֵינָיו וְאֶת מְלָכִים לַכִּסֵּא וַיֹּשִׁיבֵם לָנֶצַח וַיִּגְבָּֽהוּ׃
translation: He doesn't withdraw his eyes from the righteous, but with kings on the throne, he sets them forever, and they are exalted. (Job 36:7)

text: וַיִּרְאוּ שֹֽׁטְרֵי בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֹתָם בְּרָע לֵאמֹר לֹא תִגְרְעוּ מִלִּבְנֵיכֶם דְּבַר יוֹם בְּיוֹמֽוֹ׃
translation: The officers of the children of Israel saw that they were in trouble when it was said, "You shall not diminish anything from your daily quota of bricks!" (Exodus 5:19)

text: וְהִנֵּה נָטִיתִי יָדִי עָלַיִךְ וָאֶגְרַע חֻקֵּךְ וָאֶתְּנֵךְ בְּנֶפֶשׁ שֹׂנְאוֹתַיִךְ בְּנוֹת פְּלִשְׁתִּים הַנִּכְלָמוֹת מִדַּרְכֵּךְ זִמָּֽה׃
translation: See therefore, I have stretched out my hand over you, and have diminished your portion, and delivered you to the will of those who hate you, the daughters of the Philistines, who are ashamed of your lewd way. (Ezekiel 16:27)

text: לָמָּה יִגָּרַע שֵׁם אָבִינוּ מִתּוֹךְ מִשְׁפַּחְתּוֹ כִּי אֵין לוֹ בֵּן תְּנָה לָּנוּ אֲחֻזָּה בְּתוֹךְ אֲחֵי אָבִֽינוּ׃
translation: Why should the name of our father be taken away from among his family, because he had no son? Give to us a possession among the brothers of our father." (Numbers 27:4)

text: וַֽיִּשְׁלְחוּ אֶל אִיזֶבֶל לֵאמֹר סֻקַּל נָבוֹת וַיָּמֹֽת׃
translation: Then they sent to Jezebel, saying, "Naboth has been stoned and is dead." (1 Kings 21:14)

text: וַיִּצְעַק מֹשֶׁה אֶל יְהוָה לֵאמֹר מָה אֶעֱשֶׂה לָעָם הַזֶּה עוֹד מְעַט וּסְקָלֻֽנִי׃
translation: Moses cried to the LORD, saying, "What shall I do with these people? They are almost ready to stone me." (Exodus 17:4)

text: וּסְקַלְתּוֹ בָאֲבָנִים וָמֵת כִּי בִקֵּשׁ לְהַדִּֽיחֲךָ מֵעַל יְהוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ הַמּוֹצִיאֲךָ מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם מִבֵּית עֲבָדִֽים׃
translation: All Israel shall hear, and fear, and shall not do any more wickedness like this among you. (Deuteronomy 13:11)

text: וְהוֹשִׁיבוּ שְׁנַיִם אֲנָשִׁים בְּנֵֽי בְלִיַּעַל נֶגְדּוֹ וִיעִדֻהוּ לֵאמֹר בֵּרַכְתָּ אֱלֹהִים וָמֶלֶךְ וְהוֹצִיאֻהוּ וְסִקְלֻהוּ וְיָמֹֽת׃
translation: Set two men, wicked fellows, before him, and let them testify against him, saying, 'You cursed God and the king!' Then carry him out, and stone him to death." (1 Kings 21:10)

text: וַיְסַקֵּל בָּֽאֲבָנִים אֶת דָּוִד וְאֶת כָּל עַבְדֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ דָּוִד וְכָל הָעָם וְכָל הַגִּבֹּרִים מִימִינוֹ וּמִשְּׂמֹאלֽוֹ׃
translation: He cast stones at David and at all the servants of King David, and all the people and all the mighty men were on his right hand and on his left. (2 Samuel 16:6)

text: עִבְרוּ עִבְרוּ בַּשְּׁעָרִים פַּנּוּ דֶּרֶךְ הָעָם סֹלּוּ סֹלּוּ הַֽמְסִלָּה סַקְּלוּ מֵאֶבֶן הָרִימוּ נֵס עַל הָעַמִּֽים׃
translation: Go through, go through the gates! Prepare the way of the people! Build up, build up the highway! Gather out the stones! Lift up a banner for the peoples. (Isaiah 62:10)

text: תּוֹצִיאֵנִי מֵרֶשֶׁת זוּ טָמְנוּ לִי כִּֽי אַתָּה מָֽעוּזִּֽי׃
translation: Into your hand I commend my spirit. You redeem me, LORD, God of truth. (Psalms 31:5)

text: כִּֽי חִנָּם מְזֹרָה הָרָשֶׁת בְּעֵינֵי כָל בַּעַל כָּנָֽף׃
translation: For the net is spread in vain in the sight of any bird; (Proverbs 1:17)

text: גֶּבֶר מַחֲלִיק עַל רֵעֵהוּ רֶשֶׁת פּוֹרֵשׂ עַל פְּעָמָֽיו׃
translation: A man who flatters his neighbor spreads a net for his feet. (Proverbs 29:5)

text: עֵינַי תָּמִיד אֶל יְהוָה כִּי הֽוּא יוֹצִיא מֵרֶשֶׁת רַגְלָֽי׃
translation: My eyes are ever on the LORD, for he will pluck my feet out of the net. (Psalms 25:15)

text: כִּֽי חִנָּם טָֽמְנוּ לִי שַׁחַת רִשְׁתָּם חִנָּם חָפְרוּ לְנַפְשִֽׁי׃
translation: For without cause they have hidden their net in a pit for me. Without cause they have dug a pit for my soul. (Psalms 35:7)

text: וַיִּתְּנוּ עָלָיו גּוֹיִם סָבִיב מִמְּדִינוֹת וַֽיִּפְרְשׂוּ עָלָיו רִשְׁתָּם בְּשַׁחְתָּם נִתְפָּֽשׂ׃
translation: Then the nations attacked him on every side from the provinces. They spread their net over him. He was taken in their pit. (Ezekiel 19:8)

text: וַֽיַּעֲרֹךְ אֶת הָֽעֵצִים וַיְנַתַּח אֶת הַפָּר וַיָּשֶׂם עַל הָעֵצִֽים׃
translation: He put the wood in order, and cut the bull in pieces and laid it on the wood. He said, "Fill four jars with water, and pour it on the burnt offering and on the wood." (1 Kings 18:33)

text: וְהִפְשִׁיט אֶת הָעֹלָה וְנִתַּח אֹתָהּ לִנְתָחֶֽיהָ׃
translation: He shall skin the burnt offering and cut it into pieces. (Leviticus 1:6)

text: וְאֶת הָעֹלָה הִמְצִיאוּ אֵלָיו לִנְתָחֶיהָ וְאֶת הָרֹאשׁ וַיַּקְטֵר עַל הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃
translation: They delivered the burnt offering to him, piece by piece, and the head. He burned them upon the altar. (Leviticus 9:13)

text: אֱסֹף נְתָחֶיהָ אֵלֶיהָ כָּל נֵתַח טוֹב יָרֵךְ וְכָתֵף מִבְחַר עֲצָמִים מַלֵּֽא׃
translation: Gather its pieces into it, even every good piece: the thigh and the shoulder. Fill it with the choice bones. (Ezekiel 24:4)

text: וְאֶת הָאַיִל תְּנַתֵּחַ לִנְתָחָיו וְרָחַצְתָּ קִרְבּוֹ וּכְרָעָיו וְנָתַתָּ עַל נְתָחָיו וְעַל רֹאשֽׁוֹ׃
translation: You shall cut the ram into its pieces, and wash its innards, and its legs, and put them with its pieces, and with its head. (Exodus 29:17)

text: וְאֶת הָאַיִל נִתַּח לִנְתָחָיו וַיַּקְטֵר מֹשֶׁה אֶת הָרֹאשׁ וְאֶת הַנְּתָחִים וְאֶת הַפָּֽדֶר׃
translation: He cut the ram into its pieces; and Moses burned the head, and the pieces, and the fat. (Leviticus 8:20)

text: וְקִדָּה חֲמֵשׁ מֵאוֹת בְּשֶׁקֶל הַקֹּדֶשׁ וְשֶׁמֶן זַיִת הִֽין׃
translation: and of cassia five hundred, according to the shekel of the sanctuary; and a hin of olive oil. (Exodus 30:24)

text: וְיַיִן לַנֶּסֶךְ שְׁלִשִׁית הַהִין תַּקְרִיב רֵֽיחַ נִיחֹחַ לַיהוָֽה׃
translation: and for the drink offering you shall offer the third part of a hin of wine, of a pleasant aroma to the LORD. (Numbers 15:7)

text: וְיַיִן תַּקְרִיב לַנֶּסֶךְ חֲצִי הַהִין אִשֵּׁה רֵֽיחַ נִיחֹחַ לַיהוָֽה׃
translation: and you shall offer for the drink offering half a hin of wine, for an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to the LORD. (Numbers 15:10)

text: וַעֲשִׂירִית הָאֵיפָה סֹלֶת לְמִנְחָה בְּלוּלָה בְּשֶׁמֶן כָּתִית רְבִיעִת הַהִֽין׃
translation: with one tenth of an ephah of fine flour for a meal offering, mixed with the fourth part of a hin of beaten oil. (Numbers 28:5)

text: וּמַיִם בִּמְשׂוּרָה תִשְׁתֶּה שִׁשִּׁית הַהִין מֵעֵת עַד עֵת תִּשְׁתֶּֽה׃
translation: You shall drink water by measure, the sixth part of a hin. From time to time you shall drink. (Ezekiel 4:11)

text: וּמִנְחָה אֵיפָה לַפָּר וְאֵיפָה לָאַיִל יַֽעֲשֶׂה וְשֶׁמֶן הִין לָאֵיפָֽה׃
translation: He shall prepare a meal offering, an ephah for a bull, an ephah for a ram, and a hin of oil to an ephah. (Ezekiel 45:24)

text: וְנָתַתָּ עָלֶיהָ שֶׁמֶן וְשַׂמְתָּ עָלֶיהָ לְבֹנָה מִנְחָה הִֽוא׃
translation: You shall put oil on it and lay frankincense on it. It is a meal offering. (Leviticus 2:15)

text: וָאֹמְרָה וַֽיְטַהֲרוּ הַלְּשָׁכוֹת וָאָשִׁיבָה שָּׁם כְּלֵי בֵּית הָאֱלֹהִים אֶת הַמִּנְחָה וְהַלְּבוֹנָֽה׃
translation: Then I commanded, and they cleansed the rooms. I brought into them the vessels of God's house, with the meal offerings and the frankincense again. (Nehemiah 13:9)

text: מִי זֹאת עֹלָה מִן הַמִּדְבָּר כְּתִֽימֲרוֹת עָשָׁן מְקֻטֶּרֶת מוֹר וּלְבוֹנָה מִכֹּל אַבְקַת רוֹכֵֽל׃
translation: Who is this who comes up from the wilderness like pillars of smoke, perfumed with myrrh and frankincense, with all spices of the merchant? (Song of Solomon 3:6)

text: וּמֵהֶם מְמֻנִּים עַל הַכֵּלִים וְעַל כָּל כְּלֵי הַקֹּדֶשׁ וְעַל הַסֹּלֶת וְהַיַּיִן וְהַשֶּׁמֶן וְהַלְּבוֹנָה וְהַבְּשָׂמִֽים׃
translation: Some of them also were appointed over the furniture, and over all the vessels of the sanctuary, over the fine flour, the wine, the oil, the frankincense, and the spices. (1 Chronicles 9:29)

text: נֵרְדְּ וְכַרְכֹּם קָנֶה וְקִנָּמוֹן עִם כָּל עֲצֵי לְבוֹנָה מֹר וַאֲהָלוֹת עִם כָּל רָאשֵׁי בְשָׂמִֽים׃
translation: spikenard and saffron, calamus and cinnamon, with every kind of incense tree; myrrh and aloes, with all the best spices, (Song of Solomon 4:14)

text: לֹֽא הֵבֵיאתָ לִּי שֵׂה עֹלֹתֶיךָ וּזְבָחֶיךָ לֹא כִבַּדְתָּנִי לֹא הֶעֱבַדְתִּיךָ בְּמִנְחָה וְלֹא הוֹגַעְתִּיךָ בִּלְבוֹנָֽה׃
translation: You have not brought me any of your sheep for burnt offerings, neither have you honored me with your sacrifices. I have not burdened you with offerings, nor wearied you with frankincense. (Isaiah 43:23)

text: וְאִם פָּשֹׂה תִפְשֶׂה בָּעוֹר וְטִמֵּא הַכֹּהֵן אֹתוֹ נֶגַע הִֽוא׃
translation: If it spreads in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean. It is a plague. (Leviticus 13:22)

text: וְאִם פָּשֹׂה יִפְשֶׂה הַנֶּתֶק בָּעוֹר אַחֲרֵי טָהֳרָתֽוֹ׃
translation: But if the itch spreads in the skin after his cleansing, (Leviticus 13:35)

text: וְרָאָה הַכֹּהֵן וְהִנֵּה פָּשְׂתָה הַמִּסְפַּחַת בָּעוֹר וְטִמְּאוֹ הַכֹּהֵן צָרַעַת הִֽוא׃
translation: The priest shall examine him; and behold, if the scab has spread on the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean. It is leprosy. (Leviticus 13:8)

text: וְשָׁב הַכֹּהֵן בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי וְרָאָה וְהִנֵּה פָּשָׂה הַנֶּגַע בְּקִירֹת הַבָּֽיִת׃
translation: The priest shall come again on the seventh day, and look. If the plague has spread in the walls of the house, (Leviticus 14:39)

text: וְרָאָהוּ הַכֹּהֵן וְהִנֵּה פָּשָׂה הַנֶּתֶק בָּעוֹר לֹֽא יְבַקֵּר הַכֹּהֵן לַשֵּׂעָר הַצָּהֹב טָמֵא הֽוּא׃
translation: then the priest shall examine him; and behold, if the itch has spread in the skin, the priest shall not look for the yellow hair; he is unclean. (Leviticus 13:36)

text: וּבָא הַכֹּהֵן וְרָאָה וְהִנֵּה פָּשָׂה הַנֶּגַע בַּבָּיִת צָרַעַת מַמְאֶרֶת הִוא בַּבַּיִת טָמֵא הֽוּא׃
translation: then the priest shall come in and look; and behold, if the plague has spread in the house, it is a destructive mildew in the house. It is unclean. (Leviticus 14:44)

text: שִׁחֵת לוֹ לֹא בָּנָיו מוּמָם דּוֹר עִקֵּשׁ וּפְתַלְתֹּֽל׃
translation: They have dealt corruptly with him. They are not his children, because of their defect. They are a perverse and crooked generation. (Deuteronomy 32:5)

text: יֹסֵר לֵץ לֹקֵחַֽ לוֹ קָלוֹן וּמוֹכִיחַ לְרָשָׁע מוּמֽוֹ׃
translation: One who corrects a mocker invites insult. One who reproves a wicked man invites abuse. (Proverbs 9:7)

text: כִּי אָז תִּשָּׂא פָנֶיךָ מִמּוּם וְהָיִיתָ מֻצָק וְלֹא תִירָֽא׃
translation: Surely then you will lift up your face without spot. Yes, you will be steadfast, and will not fear, (Job 11:15)

text: כֹּל אֲשֶׁר בּוֹ מוּם לֹא תַקְרִיבוּ כִּי לֹא לְרָצוֹן יִהְיֶה לָכֶֽם׃
translation: But you shall not offer whatever has a defect, for it shall not be acceptable for you. (Leviticus 22:20)

text: אִם תִּטֶּה אַשֻּׁרִי מִנִּי הַדָּרֶךְ וְאַחַר עֵינַי הָלַךְ לִבִּי וּבְכַפַּי דָּבַק מֻאֽוּם׃
translation: if my step has turned out of the way, if my heart walked after my eyes, if any defilement has stuck to my hands, (Job 31:7)

text: וְכִֽי יִהְיֶה בוֹ מוּם פִּסֵּחַ אוֹ עִוֵּר כֹּל מוּם רָע לֹא תִזְבָּחֶנּוּ לַיהוָה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ׃
translation: If it has any defect—is lame or blind, or has any defect whatever, you shall not sacrifice it to the LORD your God. (Deuteronomy 15:21)

text: עֹדֶנּוּ בְאִבּוֹ לֹא יִקָּטֵף וְלִפְנֵי כָל חָצִיר יִיבָֽשׁ׃
translation: While it is yet in its greenness, not cut down, it withers before any other reed. (Job 8:12)

text: הִנֵּה נָא בְהֵמוֹת אֲשֶׁר עָשִׂיתִי עִמָּךְ חָצִיר כַּבָּקָר יֹאכֵֽל׃
translation: "See now behemoth, which I made as well as you. He eats grass as an ox. (Job 40:15)

text: הַֽמְכַסֶּה שָׁמַיִם בְּעָבִים הַמֵּכִין לָאָרֶץ מָטָר הַמַּצְמִיחַ הָרִים חָצִֽיר׃
translation: who covers the sky with clouds, who prepares rain for the earth, who makes grass grow on the mountains. (Psalms 147:8)

text: וְצָמְחוּ בְּבֵין חָצִיר כַּעֲרָבִים עַל יִבְלֵי מָֽיִם׃
translation: and they will spring up among the grass, as willows by the watercourses. (Isaiah 44:4)

text: מַצְמִיחַ חָצִיר לַבְּהֵמָה וְעֵשֶׂב לַעֲבֹדַת הָאָדָם לְהוֹצִיא לֶחֶם מִן הָאָֽרֶץ׃
translation: He causes the grass to grow for the livestock, and plants for man to cultivate, that he may produce food out of the earth: (Psalms 104:14)

text: אָנֹכִי אָנֹכִי הוּא מְנַחֶמְכֶם מִֽי אַתְּ וַתִּֽירְאִי מֵאֱנוֹשׁ יָמוּת וּמִבֶּן אָדָם חָצִיר יִנָּתֵֽן׃
translation: "I, even I, am he who comforts you. Who are you, that you are afraid of man who shall die, and of the son of man who will be made as grass? (Isaiah 51:12)

text: כִּֽי שִׁבַּר דַּלְתוֹת נְחֹשֶׁת וּבְרִיחֵי בַרְזֶל גִּדֵּֽעַ׃
translation: For he has broken the gates of bronze, and cut through bars of iron. (Psalms 107:16)

text: נִגְדְּעָה קֶרֶן מוֹאָב וּזְרֹעוֹ נִשְׁבָּרָה נְאֻם יְהוָֽה׃
translation: The horn of Moab is cut off, and his arm is broken," says the LORD. (Jeremiah 48:25)

text: וַיָּסַר אֶת מִזְבְּחוֹת הַנֵּכָר וְהַבָּמוֹת וַיְשַׁבֵּר אֶת הַמַּצֵּבוֹת וַיְגַדַּע אֶת הָאֲשֵׁרִֽים׃
translation: Asa did that which was good and right in the LORD his God's eyes, (2 Chronicles 14:2)

text: אֵיךְ נָפַלְתָּ מִשָּׁמַיִם הֵילֵל בֶּן שָׁחַר נִגְדַּעְתָּ לָאָרֶץ חוֹלֵשׁ עַל גּוֹיִֽם׃
translation: How you have fallen from heaven, shining one, son of the dawn! How you are cut down to the ground, who laid the nations low! (Isaiah 14:12)

text: אֵיךְ נִגְדַּע וַיִּשָּׁבֵר פַּטִּישׁ כָּל הָאָרֶץ אֵיךְ הָיְתָה לְשַׁמָּה בָּבֶל בַּגּוֹיִֽם׃
translation: How the hammer of the whole earth is cut apart and broken! How Babylon has become a desolation among the nations! (Jeremiah 50:23)

text: וַיִּנָּֽחֲמוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל בִּנְיָמִן אָחִיו וַיֹּאמְרוּ נִגְדַּע הַיּוֹם שֵׁבֶט אֶחָד מִיִּשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
translation: The children of Israel grieved for Benjamin their brother, and said, "There is one tribe cut off from Israel today. (Judges 21:6)

text: אַף כִּֽי נִתְעָב וְֽנֶאֱלָח אִישׁ שֹׁתֶה כַמַּיִם עַוְלָֽה׃
translation: how much less one who is abominable and corrupt, a man who drinks iniquity like water! (Job 15:16)

text: תְּאַבֵּד דֹּבְרֵי כָזָב אִישׁ דָּמִים וּמִרְמָה יְתָעֵב יְהוָֽה׃
translation: But as for me, in the abundance of your loving kindness I will come into your house. I will bow toward your holy temple in reverence of you. (Psalms 5:7)

text: כָּל אֹכֶל תְּתַעֵב נַפְשָׁם וַיַּגִּיעוּ עַד שַׁעֲרֵי מָֽוֶת׃
translation: Their soul abhors all kinds of food. They draw near to the gates of death. (Psalms 107:18)

text: תִּֽעֲבוּנִי רָחֲקוּ מֶנִּי וּמִפָּנַי לֹא חָשְׂכוּ רֹֽק׃
translation: They abhor me, they stand aloof from me, and don't hesitate to spit in my face. (Job 30:10)

text: וַיִּֽחַר אַף יְהוָה בְּעַמּוֹ וַיְתָעֵב אֶת נַחֲלָתֽוֹ׃
translation: Therefore the LORD burned with anger against his people. He abhorred his inheritance. (Psalms 106:40)

text: שָׂנְאוּ בַשַּׁעַר מוֹכִיחַ וְדֹבֵר תָּמִים יְתָעֵֽבוּ׃
translation: They hate him who reproves in the gate, and they abhor him who speaks blamelessly. (Amos 5:10)

text: וַחֲמִשָּׁה סַרְנֵֽי פְלִשְׁתִּים רָאוּ וַיָּשֻׁבוּ עֶקְרוֹן בַּיּוֹם הַהֽוּא׃
translation: When the five lords of the Philistines had seen it, they returned to Ekron the same day. (1 Samuel 6:16)

text: וְעַתָּה שׁוּב וְלֵךְ בְּשָׁלוֹם וְלֹֽא תַעֲשֶׂה רָע בְּעֵינֵי סַרְנֵי פְלִשְׁתִּֽים׃
translation: Therefore now return, and go in peace, that you not displease the lords of the Philistines." (1 Samuel 29:7)

text: וְסַרְנֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים עֹֽבְרִים לְמֵאוֹת וְלַאֲלָפִים וְדָוִד וַאֲנָשָׁיו עֹֽבְרִים בָּאַחֲרֹנָה עִם אָכִֽישׁ׃
translation: The lords of the Philistines passed on by hundreds and by thousands; and David and his men passed on in the rear with Achish. (1 Samuel 29:2)

text: חֲמֵשֶׁת סַרְנֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים וְכָל הַֽכְּנַעֲנִי וְהַצִּידֹנִי וְהַחִוִּי יֹשֵׁב הַר הַלְּבָנוֹן מֵהַר בַּעַל חֶרְמוֹן עַד לְבוֹא חֲמָֽת׃
translation: the five lords of the Philistines, all the Canaanites, the Sidonians, and the Hivites who lived on Mount Lebanon, from Mount Baal Hermon to the entrance of Hamath. (Judges 3:3)

text: וְסַרְנֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים נֶֽאֱסְפוּ לִזְבֹּחַ זֶֽבַח גָּדוֹל לְדָגוֹן אֱלֹהֵיהֶם וּלְשִׂמְחָה וַיֹּאמְרוּ נָתַן אֱלֹהֵינוּ בְּיָדֵנוּ אֵת שִׁמְשׁוֹן אוֹיְבֵֽינוּ׃
translation: The lords of the Philistines gathered together to offer a great sacrifice to Dagon their god, and to rejoice; for they said, "Our god has delivered Samson our enemy into our hand." (Judges 16:23)

text: וְהַבַּיִת מָלֵא הָֽאֲנָשִׁים וְהַנָּשִׁים וְשָׁמָּה כֹּל סַרְנֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים וְעַל הַגָּג כִּשְׁלֹשֶׁת אֲלָפִים אִישׁ וְאִשָּׁה הָרֹאִים בִּשְׂחוֹק שִׁמְשֽׁוֹן׃
translation: Now the house was full of men and women; and all the lords of the Philistines were there; and there were on the roof about three thousand men and women, who saw while Samson performed. (Judges 16:27)

text: וּמִנַּפְתָּלִי שָׂרִים אָלֶף וְעִמָּהֶם בְּצִנָּה וַחֲנִית שְׁלֹשִׁים וְשִׁבְעָה אָֽלֶף׃
translation: Of the Danites who could set the battle in array: twenty-eight thousand six hundred. (1 Chronicles 12:35)

text: בְּאֶבְרָתוֹ יָסֶךְ לָךְ וְתַֽחַת כְּנָפָיו תֶּחְסֶה צִנָּה וְֽסֹחֵרָה אֲמִתּֽוֹ׃
translation: He will cover you with his feathers. Under his wings you will take refuge. His faithfulness is your shield and rampart. (Psalms 91:4)

text: וַיֵּלֶךְ הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי הֹלֵךְ וְקָרֵב אֶל דָּוִד וְהָאִישׁ נֹשֵׂא הַצִּנָּה לְפָנָֽיו׃
translation: The Philistine walked and came near to David; and the man who bore the shield went before him. (1 Samuel 17:41)

text: הַחֲזֵק מָגֵן וְצִנָּה וְקוּמָה בְּעֶזְרָתִֽי׃
translation: Take hold of shield and buckler, and stand up for my help. (Psalms 35:2)

text: עִרְכוּ מָגֵן וְצִנָּה וּגְשׁוּ לַמִּלְחָמָֽה׃
translation: "Prepare the buckler and shield, and draw near to battle! (Jeremiah 46:3)

text: וַיַּעַשׂ הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה מָאתַיִם צִנָּה זָהָב שָׁחוּט שֵׁשׁ מֵאוֹת זָהָב יַעֲלֶה עַל הַצִּנָּה הָאֶחָֽת׃
translation: King Solomon made two hundred bucklers of beaten gold; six hundred shekels of gold went to one buckler. (1 Kings 10:16)

text: פְּעָמַי הָכֵן בְּאִמְרָתֶךָ וְֽאַל תַּשְׁלֶט בִּי כָל אָֽוֶן׃
translation: Establish my footsteps in your word. Don't let any iniquity have dominion over me. (Psalms 119:133)

text: וַיִּקַּח דָּוִד אֵת שִׁלְטֵי הַזָּהָב אֲשֶׁר הָיוּ אֶל עַבְדֵי הֲדַדְעָזֶר וַיְבִיאֵם יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
translation: David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadadezer, and brought them to Jerusalem. (2 Samuel 8:7)

text: וַיִּקַּח דָּוִיד אֵת שִׁלְטֵי הַזָּהָב אֲשֶׁר הָיוּ עַל עַבְדֵי הֲדַדְעָזֶר וַיְבִיאֵם יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
translation: David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadadezer, and brought them to Jerusalem. (1 Chronicles 18:7)

text: כְּמִגְדַּל דָּוִיד צַוָּארֵךְ בָּנוּי לְתַלְפִּיּוֹת אֶלֶף הַמָּגֵן תָּלוּי עָלָיו כֹּל שִׁלְטֵי הַגִּבּוֹרִֽים׃
translation: Your neck is like David's tower built for an armory, on which a thousand shields hang, all the shields of the mighty men. (Song of Solomon 4:4)
