text: וַיִּתֵּן הַכֹּהֵן לְשָׂרֵי המאיות הַמֵּאוֹת אֶֽת הַחֲנִית וְאֶת הַשְּׁלָטִים אֲשֶׁר לַמֶּלֶךְ דָּוִד אֲשֶׁר בְּבֵית יְהוָֽה׃
translation: The priest delivered to the captains over hundreds the spears and shields that had been King David's, which were in the LORD's house. (2 Kings 11:10)

text: וּמִי יוֹדֵעַ הֶֽחָכָם יִהְיֶה אוֹ סָכָל וְיִשְׁלַט בְּכָל עֲמָלִי שֶֽׁעָמַלְתִּי וְשֶׁחָכַמְתִּי תַּחַת הַשָּׁמֶשׁ גַּם זֶה הָֽבֶל׃
translation: Who knows whether he will be a wise man or a fool? Yet he will have rule over all of my labor in which I have labored, and in which I have shown myself wise under the sun. This also is vanity. (Ecclesiastes 2:19)

text: מִי שָׂם מְמַדֶּיהָ כִּי תֵדָע אוֹ מִֽי נָטָה עָלֶיהָ קָּֽו׃
translation: Who determined its measures, if you know? Or who stretched the line on it? (Job 38:5)

text: בְּכָל הָאָרֶץ יָצָא קַוָּם וּבִקְצֵה תֵבֵל מִלֵּיהֶם לַשֶּׁמֶשׁ שָֽׂם אֹהֶל בָּהֶֽם׃
translation: which is as a bridegroom coming out of his room, like a strong man rejoicing to run his course. (Psalms 19:5)

text: וְשַׂמְתִּי מִשְׁפָּט לְקָו וּצְדָקָה לְמִשְׁקָלֶת וְיָעָה בָרָד מַחְסֵה כָזָב וְסֵתֶר מַיִם יִשְׁטֹֽפוּ׃
translation: I will make justice the measuring line, and righteousness the plumb line. The hail will sweep away the refuge of lies, and the waters will overflow the hiding place. (Isaiah 28:17)

text: בְּצֵאת הָאִישׁ קָדִים וְקָו בְּיָדוֹ וַיָּמָד אֶלֶף בָּֽאַמָּה וַיַּעֲבִרֵנִי בַמַּיִם מֵי אָפְסָֽיִם׃
translation: When the man went out eastward with the line in his hand, he measured one thousand cubits, and he caused me to pass through the waters, waters that were to the ankles. (Ezekiel 47:3)

text: וִירֵשׁוּהָ קָאַת וְקִפּוֹד וְיַנְשׁוֹף וְעֹרֵב יִשְׁכְּנוּ בָהּ וְנָטָה עָלֶיהָ קַֽו תֹהוּ וְאַבְנֵי בֹֽהוּ׃
translation: But the pelican and the porcupine will possess it. The owl and the raven will dwell in it. He will stretch the line of confusion over it, and the plumb line of emptiness. (Isaiah 34:11)

text: וְהֽוּא הִפִּיל לָהֶן גּוֹרָל וְיָדוֹ חִלְּקַתָּה לָהֶם בַּקָּו עַד עוֹלָם יִֽירָשׁוּהָ לְדוֹר וָדוֹר יִשְׁכְּנוּ בָֽהּ׃
translation: He has cast the lot for them, and his hand has divided it to them with a measuring line. They shall possess it forever. From generation to generation they will dwell in it. (Isaiah 34:17)

text: בְּרַם בִּשְׁנַת חֲדָה לְכוֹרֶשׁ מַלְכָּא דִּי בָבֶל כּוֹרֶשׁ מַלְכָּא שָׂם טְעֵם בֵּית אֱלָהָא דְנָה לִבְּנֵֽא׃
translation: But in the first year of Cyrus king of Babylon, Cyrus the king made a decree to build this house of God. (Ezra 5:13)

text: עָנֵה מַלְכָּא וְאָמַר הֲלָא דָא הִיא בָּבֶל רַבְּתָא דִּֽי אֲנָה בֱנַיְתַהּ לְבֵית מַלְכוּ בִּתְקַף חִסְנִי וְלִיקָר הַדְרִֽי׃
translation: Therefore, O king, let my counsel be acceptable to you, and break off your sins by righteousness, and your iniquities by showing mercy to the poor. Perhaps there may be a lengthening of your tranquility." (Daniel 4:27)

text: כִּדְנָה תֵּאמְרוּן לְהוֹם אֱלָהַיָּא דִּֽי שְׁמַיָּא וְאַרְקָא לָא עֲבַדוּ יֵאבַדוּ מֵֽאַרְעָא וּמִן תְּחוֹת שְׁמַיָּא אֵֽלֶּה׃
translation: "You shall say this to them: 'The gods that have not made the heavens and the earth will perish from the earth, and from under the heavens.'" (Jeremiah 10:11)

text: אָז אָמַרְתִּי הִנֵּה בָאתִי בִּמְגִלַּת סֵפֶר כָּתוּב עָלָֽי׃
translation: I delight to do your will, my God. Yes, your law is within my heart." (Psalms 40:8)

text: וָאֶרְאֶה וְהִנֵּה יָד שְׁלוּחָה אֵלָי וְהִנֵּה בוֹ מְגִלַּת סֵֽפֶר׃
translation: When I looked, behold, a hand was stretched out to me; and behold, a scroll of a book was in it. (Ezekiel 2:9)

text: וָאֶפְתַּח אֶת פִּי וַיַּאֲכִלֵנִי אֵת הַמְּגִלָּה הַזֹּֽאת׃
translation: So I opened my mouth, and he caused me to eat the scroll. (Ezekiel 3:2)

text: וָאָשׁוּב וָאֶשָּׂא עֵינַי וָֽאֶרְאֶה וְהִנֵּה מְגִלָּה עָפָֽה׃
translation: Then again I lifted up my eyes and saw, and behold, a flying scroll. (Zechariah 5:1)

text: וְגַם אֶלְנָתָן וּדְלָיָהוּ וּגְמַרְיָהוּ הִפְגִּעוּ בַמֶּלֶךְ לְבִלְתִּי שְׂרֹף אֶת הַמְּגִלָּה וְלֹא שָׁמַע אֲלֵיהֶֽם׃
translation: Moreover Elnathan and Delaiah and Gemariah had made intercession to the king that he would not burn the scroll; but he would not listen to them. (Jeremiah 36:25)

text: וַיָּבֹאוּ אֶל הַמֶּלֶךְ חָצֵרָה וְאֶת הַמְּגִלָּה הִפְקִדוּ בְּלִשְׁכַּת אֱלִישָׁמָע הַסֹּפֵר וַיַּגִּידוּ בְּאָזְנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ אֵת כָּל הַדְּבָרִֽים׃
translation: They went in to the king into the court, but they had laid up the scroll in the room of Elishama the scribe. Then they told all the words in the hearing of the king. (Jeremiah 36:20)

text: וַֽתַּעֲמֹדְנָה שְׁתֵּי הַתּוֹדֹת בְּבֵית הָאֱלֹהִים וַאֲנִי וַחֲצִי הַסְּגָנִים עִמִּֽי׃
translation: So the two companies of those who gave thanks in God's house stood, and I and the half of the rulers with me; (Nehemiah 12:40)

text: לְבֻשֵׁי תְכֵלֶת פַּחוֹת וּסְגָנִים בַּחוּרֵי חֶמֶד כֻּלָּם פָּרָשִׁים רֹכְבֵי סוּסִֽים׃
translation: who were clothed with blue—governors and rulers, all of them desirable young men, horsemen riding on horses. (Ezekiel 23:6)

text: וָאָרִיבָה אֶת הַסְּגָנִים וָאֹמְרָה מַדּוּעַ נֶעֱזַב בֵּית הָאֱלֹהִים וָֽאֶקְבְּצֵם וָֽאַעֲמִדֵם עַל עָמְדָֽם׃
translation: Then I contended with the rulers, and said, "Why is God's house forsaken?" I gathered them together, and set them in their place. (Nehemiah 13:11)

text: וְהַיְּהוּדִים וְהַסְּגָנִים מֵאָה וַחֲמִשִּׁים אִישׁ וְהַבָּאִים אֵלֵינוּ מִן הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר סְבִיבֹתֵינוּ עַל שֻׁלְחָנִֽי׃
translation: Moreover there were at my table, of the Jews and the rulers, one hundred fifty men, in addition to those who came to us from among the nations that were around us. (Nehemiah 5:17)

text: קַדְּשׁוּ עָלֶיהָ גוֹיִם אֶת מַלְכֵי מָדַי אֶת פַּחוֹתֶיהָ וְאֶת כָּל סְגָנֶיהָ וְאֵת כָּל אֶרֶץ מֶמְשַׁלְתּֽוֹ׃
translation: Prepare against her the nations, the kings of the Medes, its governors, and all its deputies, and all the land of their dominion! (Jeremiah 51:28)

text: אֶל בְּנֵי אַשּׁוּר עָגָבָה פַּחוֹת וּסְגָנִים קְרֹבִים לְבֻשֵׁי מִכְלוֹל פָּרָשִׁים רֹכְבֵי סוּסִים בַּחוּרֵי חֶמֶד כֻּלָּֽם׃
translation: She lusted after the Assyrians, governors and rulers—her neighbors, clothed most gorgeously, horsemen riding on horses, all of them desirable young men. (Ezekiel 23:12)

text: הָשִׁיבָה לִּי שְׂשׂוֹן יִשְׁעֶךָ וְרוּחַ נְדִיבָה תִסְמְכֵֽנִי׃
translation: Deliver me from the guilt of bloodshed, O God, the God of my salvation. My tongue will sing aloud of your righteousness. (Psalms 51:14)

text: נָחַלְתִּי עֵדְוֺתֶיךָ לְעוֹלָם כִּֽי שְׂשׂוֹן לִבִּי הֵֽמָּה׃
translation: I have taken your testimonies as a heritage forever, for they are the joy of my heart. (Psalms 119:111)

text: לַיְּהוּדִים הָֽיְתָה אוֹרָה וְשִׂמְחָה וְשָׂשֹׂן וִיקָֽר׃
translation: The Jews had light, gladness, joy, and honor. (Esther 8:16)

text: וּשְׁאַבְתֶּם מַיִם בְּשָׂשׂוֹן מִמַּעַיְנֵי הַיְשׁוּעָֽה׃
translation: Therefore with joy you will draw water out of the wells of salvation. (Isaiah 12:3)

text: אָהַבְתָּ צֶּדֶק וַתִּשְׂנָא רֶשַׁע עַל כֵּן מְשָׁחֲךָ אֱלֹהִים אֱלֹהֶיךָ שֶׁמֶן שָׂשׂוֹן מֵֽחֲבֵרֶֽיךָ׃
translation: All your garments smell like myrrh, aloes, and cassia. Out of ivory palaces stringed instruments have made you glad. (Psalms 45:8)

text: וְהַאֲבַדְתִּי מֵהֶם קוֹל שָׂשׂוֹן וְקוֹל שִׂמְחָה קוֹל חָתָן וְקוֹל כַּלָּה קוֹל רֵחַיִם וְאוֹר נֵֽר׃
translation: Moreover I will take from them the voice of mirth and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom and the voice of the bride, the sound of the millstones, and the light of the lamp. (Jeremiah 25:10)

text: וָאֹמַר לַבָּלָה נִֽאוּפִים עת עַתָּה יזנה יִזְנוּ תַזְנוּתֶהָ וָהִֽיא׃
translation: Then I said of her who was old in adulteries, 'Now they will play the prostitute with her, and she with them.' (Ezekiel 23:43)

text: וַתִּזְנִי אֶל בְּנֵֽי מִצְרַיִם שְׁכֵנַיִךְ גִּדְלֵי בָשָׂר וַתַּרְבִּי אֶת תַּזְנֻתֵךְ לְהַכְעִיסֵֽנִי׃
translation: You have also committed sexual immorality with the Egyptians, your neighbors, great of flesh; and have multiplied your prostitution, to provoke me to anger. (Ezekiel 16:26)

text: וַתַּרְבִּי אֶת תַּזְנוּתֵךְ אֶל אֶרֶץ כְּנַעַן כַּשְׂדִּימָה וְגַם בְּזֹאת לֹא שָׂבָֽעַתְּ׃
translation: You have moreover multiplied your prostitution to the land of merchants, to Chaldea; and yet you weren't satisfied with this. (Ezekiel 16:29)

text: וַתַּרְבֶּה אֶת תַּזְנוּתֶיהָ לִזְכֹּר אֶת יְמֵי נְעוּרֶיהָ אֲשֶׁר זָנְתָה בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
translation: Yet she multiplied her prostitution, remembering the days of her youth, in which she had played the prostitute in the land of Egypt. (Ezekiel 23:19)

text: וַתּוֹסֶף אֶל תַּזְנוּתֶיהָ וַתֵּרֶא אַנְשֵׁי מְחֻקֶּה עַל הַקִּיר צַלְמֵי כשדיים כַשְׂדִּים חֲקֻקִים בַּשָּׁשַֽׁר׃
translation: "She increased her prostitution; for she saw men portrayed on the wall, the images of the Chaldeans portrayed with red, (Ezekiel 23:14)

text: וַתִּקְחִי אֶת בָּנַיִךְ וְאֶת בְּנוֹתַיִךְ אֲשֶׁר יָלַדְתְּ לִי וַתִּזְבָּחִים לָהֶם לֶאֱכוֹל הַמְעַט מתזנתך מִתַּזְנוּתָֽיִךְ׃
translation: "'"Moreover you have taken your sons and your daughters, whom you have borne to me, and you have sacrificed these to them to be devoured. Was your prostitution a small matter, (Ezekiel 16:20)

text: וְאַתָּה תָּבוֹא אֶל אֲבֹתֶיךָ בְּשָׁלוֹם תִּקָּבֵר בְּשֵׂיבָה טוֹבָֽה׃
translation: but you will go to your fathers in peace. You will be buried at a good old age. (Genesis 15:15)

text: וְעָשִׂיתָ כְּחָכְמָתֶךָ וְלֹֽא תוֹרֵד שֵׂיבָתוֹ בְּשָׁלֹם שְׁאֹֽל׃
translation: Do therefore according to your wisdom, and don't let his gray head go down to Sheol in peace. (1 Kings 2:6)

text: שִׁיר הַֽמַּעֲלוֹת בְּשׁוּב יְהוָה אֶת שִׁיבַת צִיּוֹן הָיִינוּ כְּחֹלְמִֽים׃
translation: A Song of Ascents. When the LORD brought back those who returned to Zion, we were like those who dream. (Psalms 126:1)

text: וַיִּגְוַע וַיָּמָת אַבְרָהָם בְּשֵׂיבָה טוֹבָה זָקֵן וְשָׂבֵעַ וַיֵּאָסֶף אֶל עַמָּֽיו׃
translation: Abraham gave up his spirit, and died at a good old age, an old man, and full of years, and was gathered to his people. (Genesis 25:8)

text: מִפְּנֵי שֵׂיבָה תָּקוּם וְהָדַרְתָּ פְּנֵי זָקֵן וְיָרֵאתָ מֵּאֱלֹהֶיךָ אֲנִי יְהוָֽה׃
translation: "'You shall rise up before the gray head and honor the face of the elderly; and you shall fear your God. I am the LORD. (Leviticus 19:32)

text: אַחֲרָיו יָאִיר נָתִיב יַחְשֹׁב תְּהוֹם לְשֵׂיבָֽה׃
translation: His heart is as firm as a stone, yes, firm as the lower millstone. (Job 41:24)

text: אָז הָלְמוּ עִקְּבֵי סוּס מִֽדַּהֲרוֹת דַּהֲרוֹת אַבִּירָֽיו׃
translation: Then the horse hoofs stamped because of the prancing, the prancing of their strong ones. (Judges 5:22)

text: הִנֵּה כֻלְּכֶם בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הָבוּ לָכֶם דָּבָר וְעֵצָה הֲלֹֽם׃
translation: Behold, you children of Israel, all of you, give here your advice and counsel." (Judges 20:7)

text: לָכֵן ישיב יָשׁוּב עַמּוֹ הֲלֹם וּמֵי מָלֵא יִמָּצוּ לָֽמוֹ׃
translation: Therefore their people return to them, and they drink up waters of abundance. (Psalms 73:10)

text: הִכּוּנִי בַל חָלִיתִי הֲלָמוּנִי בַּל יָדָעְתִּי מָתַי אָקִיץ אוֹסִיף אֲבַקְשֶׁנּוּ עֽוֹד׃
translation: "They hit me, and I was not hurt! They beat me, and I don't feel it! When will I wake up? I can do it again. I will look for more." (Proverbs 23:35)

text: וַיִּשְׁאֲלוּ עוֹד בַּֽיהוָה הֲבָא עוֹד הֲלֹם אִישׁ וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה הִנֵּה הוּא נֶחְבָּא אֶל הַכֵּלִֽים׃
translation: Therefore they asked of the LORD further, "Is there yet a man to come here?" The LORD answered, "Behold, he has hidden himself among the baggage." (1 Samuel 10:22)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל גֹּשֽׁוּ הֲלֹם כֹּל פִּנּוֹת הָעָם וּדְעוּ וּרְאוּ בַּמָּה הָֽיְתָה הַחַטָּאת הַזֹּאת הַיּֽוֹם׃
translation: Saul said, "Draw near here, all you chiefs of the people, and know and see in whom this sin has been today. (1 Samuel 14:38)

text: וַתְּהִי צַעֲקַת הָעָם וּנְשֵׁיהֶם גְּדוֹלָה אֶל אֲחֵיהֶם הַיְּהוּדִֽים׃
translation: Then there arose a great cry of the people and of their wives against their brothers the Jews. (Nehemiah 5:1)

text: הַֽצַעֲקָתוֹ יִשְׁמַע אֵל כִּֽי תָבוֹא עָלָיו צָרָֽה׃
translation: Will God hear his cry when trouble comes on him? (Job 27:9)

text: לְהָבִיא עָלָיו צַֽעֲקַת דָּל וְצַעֲקַת עֲנִיִּים יִשְׁמָֽע׃
translation: so that they caused the cry of the poor to come to him. He heard the cry of the afflicted. (Job 34:28)

text: מִקּוֹל נִפְלָם רָעֲשָׁה הָאָרֶץ צְעָקָה בְּיַם סוּף נִשְׁמַע קוֹלָֽהּ׃
translation: The earth trembles at the noise of their fall; there is a cry, the noise which is heard in the Red Sea. (Jeremiah 49:21)

text: כִּֽי דֹרֵשׁ דָּמִים אוֹתָם זָכָר לֹֽא שָׁכַח צַעֲקַת עניים עֲנָוִֽים׃
translation: Have mercy on me, LORD. See my affliction by those who hate me, and lift me up from the gates of death, (Psalms 9:13)

text: קוֹל צְעָקָה מֵחֹֽרוֹנָיִם שֹׁד וָשֶׁבֶר גָּדֽוֹל׃
translation: The sound of a cry from Horonaim, desolation and great destruction! (Jeremiah 48:3)

text: כִּי תָבֹא בְּכֶרֶם רֵעֶךָ וְאָכַלְתָּ עֲנָבִים כְּנַפְשְׁךָ שָׂבְעֶךָ וְאֶֽל כֶּלְיְךָ לֹא תִתֵּֽן׃
translation: When you come into your neighbor's standing grain, then you may pluck the ears with your hand; but you shall not use a sickle on your neighbor's standing grain. (Deuteronomy 23:25)

text: מַה לַּעֲשׂוֹת עוֹד לְכַרְמִי וְלֹא עָשִׂיתִי בּוֹ מַדּוּעַ קִוֵּיתִי לַעֲשׂוֹת עֲנָבִים וַיַּעַשׂ בְּאֻשִֽׁים׃
translation: What could have been done more to my vineyard, that I have not done in it? Why, when I looked for it to yield grapes, did it yield wild grapes? (Isaiah 5:4)

text: אָסֹף אֲסִיפֵם נְאֻם יְהֹוָה אֵין עֲנָבִים בַּגֶּפֶן וְאֵין תְּאֵנִים בַּתְּאֵנָה וְהֶֽעָלֶה נָבֵל וָאֶתֵּן לָהֶם יַעַבְרֽוּם׃
translation: "'I will utterly consume them, says the LORD. No grapes will be on the vine, no figs on the fig tree, and the leaf will fade. The things that I have given them will pass away from them.'" (Jeremiah 8:13)

text: וַֽיְעַזְּקֵהוּ וַֽיְסַקְּלֵהוּ וַיִּטָּעֵהוּ שֹׂרֵק וַיִּבֶן מִגְדָּל בְּתוֹכוֹ וְגַם יֶקֶב חָצֵב בּוֹ וַיְקַו לַעֲשׂוֹת עֲנָבִים וַיַּעַשׂ בְּאֻשִֽׁים׃
translation: He dug it up, gathered out its stones, planted it with the choicest vine, built a tower in the middle of it, and also cut out a wine press in it. He looked for it to yield grapes, but it yielded wild grapes. (Isaiah 5:2)

text: וְכוֹס פַּרְעֹה בְּיָדִי וָאֶקַּח אֶת הָֽעֲנָבִים וָֽאֶשְׂחַט אֹתָם אֶל כּוֹס פַּרְעֹה וָאֶתֵּן אֶת הַכּוֹס עַל כַּף פַּרְעֹֽה׃
translation: Pharaoh's cup was in my hand; and I took the grapes, and pressed them into Pharaoh's cup, and I gave the cup into Pharaoh's hand." (Genesis 40:11)

text: כַּעֲנָבִים בַּמִּדְבָּר מָצָאתִי יִשְׂרָאֵל כְּבִכּוּרָה בִתְאֵנָה בְּרֵאשִׁיתָהּ רָאִיתִי אֲבֽוֹתֵיכֶם הֵמָּה בָּאוּ בַֽעַל פְּעוֹר וַיִּנָּֽזְרוּ לַבֹּשֶׁת וַיִּהְיוּ שִׁקּוּצִים כְּאָהֳבָֽם׃
translation: I found Israel like grapes in the wilderness. I saw your fathers as the first ripe in the fig tree at its first season; but they came to Baal Peor, and consecrated themselves to the shameful thing, and became abominable like that which they loved. (Hosea 9:10)

text: פּוֹרֵעַ מוּסָר מוֹאֵס נַפְשׁוֹ וְשׁוֹמֵעַ תּוֹכַחַת קוֹנֶה לֵּֽב׃
translation: He who refuses correction despises his own soul, but he who listens to reproof gets understanding. (Proverbs 15:32)

text: בִּפְרֹעַ פְּרָעוֹת בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל בְּהִתְנַדֵּב עָם בָּרֲכוּ יְהוָֽה׃
translation: "Because the leaders took the lead in Israel, because the people offered themselves willingly, be blessed, LORD! (Judges 5:2)

text: פְּרָעֵהוּ אַל תַּעֲבָר בּוֹ שְׂטֵה מֵעָלָיו וַעֲבֽוֹר׃
translation: Avoid it, and don't pass by it. Turn from it, and pass on. (Proverbs 4:15)

text: בְּאֵין חָזוֹן יִפָּרַֽע עָם וְשֹׁמֵר תּוֹרָה אַשְׁרֵֽהוּ׃
translation: Where there is no revelation, the people cast off restraint; but one who keeps the law is blessed. (Proverbs 29:18)

text: וַתִּפְרְעוּ כָל עֲצָתִי וְתוֹכַחְתִּי לֹא אֲבִיתֶֽם׃
translation: but you have ignored all my counsel, and wanted none of my reproof; (Proverbs 1:25)

text: שִׁמְעוּ מוּסָר וַחֲכָמוּ וְאַל תִּפְרָֽעוּ׃
translation: Hear instruction, and be wise. Don't refuse it. (Proverbs 8:33)

text: יְֽהוָה מְנָת חֶלְקִי וְכוֹסִי אַתָּה תּוֹמִיךְ גּוֹרָלִֽי׃
translation: The LORD assigned my portion and my cup. You made my lot secure. (Psalms 16:5)

text: וַאֲנִי בְּתֻמִּי תָּמַכְתָּ בִּי וַתַּצִּיבֵנִי לְפָנֶיךָ לְעוֹלָֽם׃
translation: Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting and to everlasting! Amen and amen. (Psalms 41:13)

text: עֵץ חַיִּים הִיא לַמַּחֲזִיקִים בָּהּ וְֽתֹמְכֶיהָ מְאֻשָּֽׁר׃
translation: She is a tree of life to those who lay hold of her. Happy is everyone who retains her. (Proverbs 3:18)

text: וַיֹּרֵנִי וַיֹּאמֶר לִי יִֽתְמָךְ דְּבָרַי לִבֶּךָ שְׁמֹר מִצְוֺתַי וֶֽחְיֵֽה׃
translation: He taught me, and said to me: "Let your heart retain my words. Keep my commandments, and live. (Proverbs 4:4)

text: עַֽווֹנוֹתָיו יִלְכְּדֻנוֹ אֶת הָרָשָׁע וּבְחַבְלֵי חַטָּאתוֹ יִתָּמֵֽךְ׃
translation: The evil deeds of the wicked ensnare him. The cords of his sin hold him firmly. (Proverbs 5:22)

text: אֵֽשֶׁת חֵן תִּתְמֹךְ כָּבוֹד וְעָרִיצִים יִתְמְכוּ עֹֽשֶׁר׃
translation: A gracious woman obtains honor, but violent men obtain riches. (Proverbs 11:16)

text: כַּאֲשֶׁר הָיִיתִי בִּימֵי חָרְפִּי בְּסוֹד אֱלוֹהַּ עֲלֵי אָהֳלִֽי׃
translation: as I was in my prime, when the friendship of God was in my tent, (Job 29:4)

text: רִֽיבְךָ רִיב אֶת רֵעֶךָ וְסוֹד אַחֵר אַל תְּגָֽל׃
translation: Debate your case with your neighbor, and don't betray the confidence of another, (Proverbs 25:9)

text: הַלְלוּ יָהּ אוֹדֶה יְהוָה בְּכָל לֵבָב בְּסוֹד יְשָׁרִים וְעֵדָֽה׃
translation: Praise the LORD! I will give thanks to the LORD with my whole heart, in the council of the upright, and in the congregation. (Psalms 111:1)

text: כִּי תוֹעֲבַת יְהוָה נָלוֹז וְֽאֶת יְשָׁרִים סוֹדֽוֹ׃
translation: For the perverse is an abomination to the LORD, but his friendship is with the upright. (Proverbs 3:32)

text: הָפֵר מַחֲשָׁבוֹת בְּאֵין סוֹד וּבְרֹב יוֹעֲצִים תָּקֽוּם׃
translation: Where there is no counsel, plans fail; but in a multitude of counselors they are established. (Proverbs 15:22)

text: תַּסְתִּירֵנִי מִסּוֹד מְרֵעִים מֵרִגְשַׁת פֹּעֲלֵי אָֽוֶן׃
translation: who sharpen their tongue like a sword, and aim their arrows, deadly words, (Psalms 64:3)

text: אֲבֹתֵינוּ חָֽטְאוּ אינם וְאֵינָם אנחנו וַאֲנַחְנוּ עֲוֺנֹתֵיהֶם סָבָֽלְנוּ׃
translation: Our fathers sinned, and are no more. We have borne their iniquities. (Lamentations 5:7)

text: אַלּוּפֵינוּ מְֽסֻבָּלִים אֵֽין פֶּרֶץ וְאֵין יוֹצֵאת וְאֵין צְוָחָה בִּרְחֹבֹתֵֽינוּ׃
translation: Our oxen will pull heavy loads. There is no breaking in, and no going away, and no outcry in our streets. (Psalms 144:14)

text: הֲסִירוֹתִי מִסֵּבֶל שִׁכְמוֹ כַּפָּיו מִדּוּד תַּעֲבֹֽרְנָה׃
translation: You called in trouble, and I delivered you. I answered you in the secret place of thunder. I tested you at the waters of Meribah." Selah. (Psalms 81:7)

text: וְעַל הַסַּבָּלִים וּֽמְנַצְּחִים לְכֹל עֹשֵׂה מְלָאכָה לַעֲבוֹדָה וַעֲבוֹדָה וּמֵֽהַלְוִיִּם סוֹפְרִים וְשֹׁטְרִים וְשׁוֹעֲרִֽים׃
translation: Also they were over the bearers of burdens, and directed all who did the work in every kind of service. Of the Levites, there were scribes, officials, and gatekeepers. (2 Chronicles 34:13)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוּדָה כָּשַׁל כֹּחַ הַסַּבָּל וְהֶעָפָר הַרְבֵּה וַאֲנַחְנוּ לֹא נוּכַל לִבְנוֹת בַּחוֹמָֽה׃
translation: "Hear, our God, for we are despised. Turn back their reproach on their own head. Give them up for a plunder in a land of captivity. (Nehemiah 4:4)

text: מֵעֲמַל נַפְשׁוֹ יִרְאֶה יִשְׂבָּע בְּדַעְתּוֹ יַצְדִּיק צַדִּיק עַבְדִּי לָֽרַבִּים וַעֲוֺנֹתָם הוּא יִסְבֹּֽל׃
translation: After the suffering of his soul, he will see the light and be satisfied. My righteous servant will justify many by the knowledge of himself; and he will bear their iniquities. (Isaiah 53:11)

text: אַתָּה בָקַעְתָּ מַעְיָן וָנָחַל אַתָּה הוֹבַשְׁתָּ נַהֲרוֹת אֵיתָֽן׃
translation: You opened up spring and stream. You dried up mighty rivers. (Psalms 74:15)

text: וּבְנֵי זֶרַח זִמְרִי וְאֵיתָן וְהֵימָן וְכַלְכֹּל וָדָרַע כֻּלָּם חֲמִשָּֽׁה׃
translation: The sons of Zerah: Zimri, Ethan, Heman, Calcol, and Dara—five of them in all. (1 Chronicles 2:6)

text: שֵֽׂכֶל טוֹב יִתֶּן חֵן וְדֶרֶךְ בֹּגְדִים אֵיתָֽן׃
translation: Good understanding wins favor, but the way of the unfaithful is hard. (Proverbs 13:15)

text: בֶּן אֵיתָן בֶּן זִמָּה בֶּן שִׁמְעִֽי׃
translation: Eliab his son, Jeroham his son, and Elkanah his son. (1 Chronicles 6:27)

text: וְיִגַּל כַּמַּיִם מִשְׁפָּט וּצְדָקָה כְּנַחַל אֵיתָֽן׃
translation: But let justice roll on like rivers, and righteousness like a mighty stream. (Amos 5:24)

text: וּבְנֵי מְרָרִי אֲחֵיהֶם עַֽל הַשְּׂמֹאול אֵיתָן בֶּן קִישִׁי בֶּן עַבְדִּי בֶּן מַלּֽוּךְ׃
translation: The sons of Merari: Mahli, Libni his son, Shimei his son, Uzzah his son, (1 Chronicles 6:29)

text: אִם הִתְרָחַצְתִּי במו בְמֵי שָׁלֶג וַהֲזִכּוֹתִי בְּבֹר כַּפָּֽי׃
translation: If I wash myself with snow, and cleanse my hands with lye, (Job 9:30)

text: אֵשׁ וּבָרָד שֶׁלֶג וְקִיטוֹר רוּחַ סְעָרָה עֹשָׂה דְבָרֽוֹ׃
translation: lightning and hail, snow and clouds, stormy wind, fulfilling his word, (Psalms 148:8)

text: הֲבָאתָ אֶל אֹצְרוֹת שָׁלֶג וְאֹצְרוֹת בָּרָד תִּרְאֶֽה׃
translation: Have you entered the storehouses of the snow, or have you seen the storehouses of the hail, (Job 38:22)

text: לֹא תִירָא לְבֵיתָהּ מִשָּׁלֶג כִּי כָל בֵּיתָהּ לָבֻשׁ שָׁנִֽים׃
translation: She is not afraid of the snow for her household, for all her household are clothed with scarlet. (Proverbs 31:21)

text: הַקֹּדְרִים מִנִּי קָרַח עָלֵימוֹ יִתְעַלֶּם שָֽׁלֶג׃
translation: which are black by reason of the ice, in which the snow hides itself. (Job 6:16)

text: כִּי לַשֶּׁלַג יֹאמַר הֱוֵא אָרֶץ וְגֶשֶׁם מָטָר וְגֶשֶׁם מִטְרוֹת עֻזּֽוֹ׃
translation: For he says to the snow, 'Fall on the earth,' likewise to the shower of rain, and to the showers of his mighty rain. (Job 37:6)

text: וְחַצְרֵיהֶם עֵיטָם וָעַיִן רִמּוֹן וְתֹכֶן וְעָשָׁן עָרִים חָמֵֽשׁ׃
translation: Their villages were Etam, Ain, Rimmon, Tochen, and Ashan, five cities; (1 Chronicles 4:32)

text: נְֽמֹגִים אֶרֶץ וְכָל יֹשְׁבֶיהָ אָנֹכִי תִכַּנְתִּי עַמּוּדֶיהָ סֶּֽלָה׃
translation: I said to the arrogant, "Don't boast!" I said to the wicked, "Don't lift up the horn. (Psalms 75:4)

text: מִֽי תִכֵּן אֶת רוּחַ יְהוָה וְאִישׁ עֲצָתוֹ יוֹדִיעֶֽנּוּ׃
translation: Who has directed the LORD's Spirit, or has taught him as his counselor? (Isaiah 40:13)

text: וְעַתָּה לְכוּ עִבְדוּ וְתֶבֶן לֹא יִנָּתֵן לָכֶם וְתֹכֶן לְבֵנִים תִּתֵּֽנּוּ׃
translation: Go therefore now, and work; for no straw shall be given to you; yet you shall deliver the same number of bricks!" (Exodus 5:18)

text: לַעֲשׂוֹת לָרוּחַ מִשְׁקָל וּמַיִם תִּכֵּן בְּמִדָּֽה׃
translation: He establishes the force of the wind. Yes, he measures out the waters by measure. (Job 28:25)

text: וְאָמְרוּ בְּנֵי עַמְּךָ לֹא יִתָּכֵן דֶּרֶךְ אֲדֹנָי וְהֵמָּה דַּרְכָּם לֹֽא יִתָּכֵֽן׃
translation: "'Yet the children of your people say, "The way of the Lord is not fair;" but as for them, their way is not fair. (Ezekiel 33:17)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר לִי עַבְדִּי אָתָּה יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר בְּךָ אֶתְפָּאָֽר׃
translation: He said to me, "You are my servant, Israel, in whom I will be glorified." (Isaiah 49:3)

text: כִּֽי רוֹצֶה יְהוָה בְּעַמּוֹ יְפָאֵר עֲנָוִים בִּישׁוּעָֽה׃
translation: For the LORD takes pleasure in his people. He crowns the humble with salvation. (Psalms 149:4)

text: כִּי תַחְבֹּט זֵֽיתְךָ לֹא תְפָאֵר אַחֲרֶיךָ לַגֵּר לַיָּתוֹם וְלָאַלְמָנָה יִהְיֶֽה׃
translation: When you beat your olive tree, you shall not go over the boughs again. It shall be for the foreigner, for the fatherless, and for the widow. (Deuteronomy 24:20)

text: בָּרוּךְ יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ אֲשֶׁר נָתַן כָּזֹאת בְּלֵב הַמֶּלֶךְ לְפָאֵר אֶת בֵּית יְהוָה אֲשֶׁר בִּירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
translation: Blessed be the LORD, the God of our fathers, who has put such a thing as this in the king's heart, to beautify the LORD's house which is in Jerusalem; (Ezra 7:27)

text: כָּל צֹאן קֵדָר יִקָּבְצוּ לָךְ אֵילֵי נְבָיוֹת יְשָׁרְתוּנֶךְ יַעֲלוּ עַל רָצוֹן מִזְבְּחִי וּבֵית תִּפְאַרְתִּי אֲפָאֵֽר׃
translation: All the flocks of Kedar will be gathered together to you. The rams of Nebaioth will serve you. They will be accepted as offerings on my altar; and I will beautify my glorious house. (Isaiah 60:7)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה לְפַרְעֹה הִתְפָּאֵר עָלַי לְמָתַי אַעְתִּיר לְךָ וְלַעֲבָדֶיךָ וּֽלְעַמְּךָ לְהַכְרִית הַֽצֲפַרְדְּעִים מִמְּךָ וּמִבָּתֶּיךָ רַק בַּיְאֹר תִּשָּׁאַֽרְנָה׃
translation: The LORD said to Moses, "Tell Aaron, 'Stretch out your hand with your rod over the rivers, over the streams, and over the pools, and cause frogs to come up on the land of Egypt.'" (Exodus 8:5)

text: הֲלֹא כֶחָלָב תַּתִּיכֵנִי וְכַגְּבִנָּה תַּקְפִּיאֵֽנִי׃
translation: Haven't you poured me out like milk, and curdled me like cheese? (Job 10:10)

text: וַתִּתַּךְ חֲמָתִי וְאַפִּי וַתִּבְעַר בְּעָרֵי יְהוּדָה וּבְחֻצוֹת יְרֽוּשָׁלִָם וַתִּהְיֶינָה לְחָרְבָּה לִשְׁמָמָה כַּיּוֹם הַזֶּֽה׃
translation: Therefore my wrath and my anger was poured out, and was kindled in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem; and they are wasted and desolate, as it is today.' (Jeremiah 44:6)

text: וַיַּתִּיכוּ אֶת הַכֶּסֶף הַנִּמְצָא בְּבֵית יְהוָה וַֽיִּתְּנוּהוּ עַל יַד הַמֻּפְקָדִים וְעַל יַד עוֹשֵׂי הַמְּלָאכָֽה׃
translation: They have emptied out the money that was found in the LORD's house, and have delivered it into the hand of the overseers and into the hand of the workmen." (2 Chronicles 34:17)

text: לִפְנֵי זַעְמוֹ מִי יַֽעֲמוֹד וּמִי יָקוּם בַּחֲרוֹן אַפּוֹ חֲמָתוֹ נִתְּכָה כָאֵשׁ וְהַצֻּרִים נִתְּצוּ מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃
translation: Who can stand before his indignation? Who can endure the fierceness of his anger? His wrath is poured out like fire, and the rocks are broken apart by him. (Nahum 1:6)

text: וַיֵּצֵא מֹשֶׁה מֵעִם פַּרְעֹה אֶת הָעִיר וַיִּפְרֹשׂ כַּפָּיו אֶל יְהוָה וַֽיַּחְדְּלוּ הַקֹּלוֹת וְהַבָּרָד וּמָטָר לֹא נִתַּךְ אָֽרְצָה׃
translation: Moses went out of the city from Pharaoh, and spread out his hands to the LORD; and the thunders and hail ceased, and the rain was not poured on the earth. (Exodus 9:33)

text: תַּחַת אֲשֶׁר עֲזָבוּנִי ויקטירו וַֽיְקַטְּרוּ לֵֽאלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים לְמַעַן הַכְעִיסֵנִי בְּכֹל מַעֲשֵׂי יְדֵיהֶם וְתִתַּךְ חֲמָתִי בַּמָּקוֹם הַזֶּה וְלֹא תִכְבֶּֽה׃
translation: Because they have forsaken me, and have burned incense to other gods, that they might provoke me to anger with all the works of their hands, therefore my wrath is poured out on this place, and it will not be quenched.'"' (2 Chronicles 34:25)

text: וְאֶת הַשָּׁפָן כִּֽי מַעֲלֵה גֵרָה הוּא וּפַרְסָה לֹא יַפְרִיס טָמֵא הוּא לָכֶֽם׃
translation: The hyrax, because it chews the cud but doesn't have a parted hoof, is unclean to you. (Leviticus 11:5)

text: וְאֶת הָאַרְנֶבֶת כִּֽי מַעֲלַת גֵּרָה הִוא וּפַרְסָה לֹא הִפְרִיסָה טְמֵאָה הִוא לָכֶֽם׃
translation: The hare, because it chews the cud but doesn't have a parted hoof, is unclean to you. (Leviticus 11:6)

text: אֲשֶׁר חִצָּיו שְׁנוּנִים וְכָל קַשְּׁתֹתָיו דְּרֻכוֹת פַּרְסוֹת סוּסָיו כַּצַּר נֶחְשָׁבוּ וְגַלְגִּלָּיו כַּסּוּפָֽה׃
translation: whose arrows are sharp, and all their bows bent. Their horses' hoofs will be like flint, and their wheels like a whirlwind. (Isaiah 5:28)

text: בְּפַרְסוֹת סוּסָיו יִרְמֹס אֶת כָּל חֽוּצוֹתָיִךְ עַמֵּךְ בַּחֶרֶב יַהֲרֹג וּמַצְּבוֹת עֻזֵּךְ לָאָרֶץ תֵּרֵֽד׃
translation: He will tread down all your streets with the hoofs of his horses. He will kill your people with the sword. The pillars of your strength will go down to the ground. (Ezekiel 26:11)

text: מִקּוֹל שַֽׁעֲטַת פַּרְסוֹת אַבִּירָיו מֵרַעַשׁ לְרִכְבּוֹ הֲמוֹן גַּלְגִּלָּיו לֹֽא הִפְנוּ אָבוֹת אֶל בָּנִים מֵֽרִפְיוֹן יָדָֽיִם׃
translation: At the noise of the stamping of the hoofs of his strong ones, at the rushing of his chariots, at the rumbling of his wheels, the fathers don't look back for their children because their hands are so feeble, (Jeremiah 47:3)

text: וְהַֽאֲבַדְתִּי אֶת כָּל בְּהֶמְתָּהּ מֵעַל מַיִם רַבִּים וְלֹא תִדְלָחֵם רֶֽגֶל אָדָם עוֹד וּפַרְסוֹת בְּהֵמָה לֹא תִדְלָחֵֽם׃
translation: I will destroy also all its animals from beside many waters. The foot of man won't trouble them any more, nor will the hoofs of animals trouble them. (Ezekiel 32:13)

text: וְחַלְלֵיהֶם יֻשְׁלָכוּ וּפִגְרֵיהֶם יַעֲלֶה בָאְשָׁם וְנָמַסּוּ הָרִים מִדָּמָֽם׃
translation: Their slain will also be cast out, and the stench of their dead bodies will come up. The mountains will melt in their blood. (Isaiah 34:3)

text: הָרִים כַּדּוֹנַג נָמַסּוּ מִלִּפְנֵי יְהוָה מִלִּפְנֵי אֲדוֹן כָּל הָאָֽרֶץ׃
translation: The mountains melt like wax at the presence of the LORD, at the presence of the Lord of the whole earth. (Psalms 97:5)

text: רָשָׁע יִרְאֶה וְכָעָס שִׁנָּיו יַחֲרֹק וְנָמָס תַּאֲוַת רְשָׁעִים תֹּאבֵֽד׃
translation: The wicked will see it, and be grieved. He shall gnash with his teeth, and melt away. The desire of the wicked will perish. (Psalms 112:10)

text: עַל כֵּן כָּל יָדַיִם תִּרְפֶּינָה וְכָל לְבַב אֱנוֹשׁ יִמָּס׃
translation: Therefore all hands will be feeble, and everyone's heart will melt. (Isaiah 13:7)

text: וּכְבוֹד יַעְרוֹ וְכַרְמִלּוֹ מִנֶּפֶשׁ וְעַד בָּשָׂר יְכַלֶּה וְהָיָה כִּמְסֹס נֹסֵֽס׃
translation: He will consume the glory of his forest and of his fruitful field, both soul and body. It will be as when a standard bearer faints. (Isaiah 10:18)

text: כַּמַּיִם נִשְׁפַּכְתִּי וְהִתְפָּֽרְדוּ כָּֽל עַצְמוֹתָי הָיָה לִבִּי כַּדּוֹנָג נָמֵס בְּתוֹךְ מֵעָֽי׃
translation: My strength is dried up like a potsherd. My tongue sticks to the roof of my mouth. You have brought me into the dust of death. (Psalms 22:15)

text: וְהָֽעַוִּים הַיֹּשְׁבִים בַּחֲצֵרִים עַד עַזָּה כַּפְתֹּרִים הַיֹּצְאִים מִכַּפְתּוֹר הִשְׁמִידֻם וַיֵּשְׁבוּ תַחְתָּֽם׃
translation: Then the Avvim, who lived in villages as far as Gaza: the Caphtorim, who came out of Caphtor, destroyed them and lived in their place.) (Deuteronomy 2:23)

text: וַיַּעַשׂ אֶת הַמְּנֹרָה זָהָב טָהוֹר מִקְשָׁה עָשָׂה אֶת הַמְּנֹרָה יְרֵכָהּ וְקָנָהּ גְּבִיעֶיהָ כַּפְתֹּרֶיהָ וּפְרָחֶיהָ מִמֶּנָּה הָיֽוּ׃
translation: He made the lamp stand of pure gold. He made the lamp stand of beaten work. Its base, its shaft, its cups, its buds, and its flowers were of one piece with it. (Exodus 37:17)

text: וְכַפְתֹּר תַּחַת שְׁנֵי הַקָּנִים מִמֶּנָּה וְכַפְתֹּר תַּחַת שְׁנֵי הַקָּנִים מִמֶּנָּה וְכַפְתֹּר תַּֽחַת שְׁנֵי הַקָּנִים מִמֶּנָּה לְשֵׁשֶׁת הַקָּנִים הַיֹּצְאִים מִמֶּֽנָּה׃
translation: and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, for the six branches going out of it. (Exodus 37:21)

text: הֲלוֹא כִבְנֵי כֻשִׁיִּים אַתֶּם לִי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל נְאֻם יְהוָה הֲלוֹא אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל הֶעֱלֵיתִי מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם וּפְלִשְׁתִּיִּים מִכַּפְתּוֹר וַאֲרָם מִקִּֽיר׃
translation: Are you not like the children of the Ethiopians to me, children of Israel?" says the LORD. "Haven't I brought up Israel out of the land of Egypt, and the Philistines from Caphtor, and the Syrians from Kir? (Amos 9:7)

text: שְׁלֹשָׁה גְבִעִים מְֽשֻׁקָּדִים בַּקָּנֶה הָאֶחָד כַּפְתֹּר וָפֶרַח וּשְׁלֹשָׁה גְבִעִים מְשֻׁקָּדִים בַּקָּנֶה הָאֶחָד כַּפְתֹּר וָפָרַח כֵּן לְשֵׁשֶׁת הַקָּנִים הַיֹּצְאִים מִן הַמְּנֹרָֽה׃
translation: three cups made like almond blossoms in one branch, a bud and a flower; and three cups made like almond blossoms in the other branch, a bud and a flower, so for the six branches going out of the lamp stand; (Exodus 25:33)

text: וְכַפְתֹּר תַּחַת שְׁנֵי הַקָּנִים מִמֶּנָּה וְכַפְתֹּר תַּחַת שְׁנֵי הַקָּנִים מִמֶּנָּה וְכַפְתֹּר תַּחַת שְׁנֵי הַקָּנִים מִמֶּנָּה לְשֵׁשֶׁת הַקָּנִים הַיֹּצְאִים מִן הַמְּנֹרָֽה׃
translation: and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, for the six branches going out of the lamp stand. (Exodus 25:35)

text: כָּל קַלְעֵי הֶחָצֵר סָבִיב שֵׁשׁ מָשְׁזָֽר׃
translation: All the hangings around the court were of fine twined linen. (Exodus 38:16)

text: וַיַּעַשׂ אֶת הָאֵפֹד זָהָב תְּכֵלֶת וְאַרְגָּמָן וְתוֹלַעַת שָׁנִי וְשֵׁשׁ מָשְׁזָֽר׃
translation: He made the ephod of gold, blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen. (Exodus 39:2)

text: וְעָשׂוּ אֶת הָאֵפֹד זָהָב תְּכֵלֶת וְאַרְגָּמָן תּוֹלַעַת שָׁנִי וְשֵׁשׁ מָשְׁזָר מַעֲשֵׂה חֹשֵֽׁב׃
translation: "They shall make the ephod of gold, blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen, the work of the skillful workman. (Exodus 28:6)

text: וַיַּעַשׂ אֶת הֶחָצֵר לִפְאַת נֶגֶב תֵּימָנָה קַלְעֵי הֶֽחָצֵר שֵׁשׁ מָשְׁזָר מֵאָה בָּאַמָּֽה׃
translation: He made the court: for the south side southward the hangings of the court were of fine twined linen, one hundred cubits; (Exodus 38:9)

text: וְעָשִׂיתָ פָרֹכֶת תְּכֵלֶת וְאַרְגָּמָן וְתוֹלַעַת שָׁנִי וְשֵׁשׁ מָשְׁזָר מַעֲשֵׂה חֹשֵׁב יַעֲשֶׂה אֹתָהּ כְּרֻבִֽים׃
translation: "You shall make a veil of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, with cherubim. It shall be the work of a skillful workman. (Exodus 26:31)

text: אֹרֶךְ הֶֽחָצֵר מֵאָה בָֽאַמָּה וְרֹחַב חֲמִשִּׁים בַּחֲמִשִּׁים וְקֹמָה חָמֵשׁ אַמּוֹת שֵׁשׁ מָשְׁזָר וְאַדְנֵיהֶם נְחֹֽשֶׁת׃
translation: The length of the court shall be one hundred cubits, and the width fifty throughout, and the height five cubits, of fine twined linen, and their sockets of bronze. (Exodus 27:18)

text: וּֽבְרַחֲמֶיךָ הָרַבִּים לֹֽא עֲשִׂיתָם כָּלָה וְלֹא עֲזַבְתָּם כִּי אֵֽל חַנּוּן וְרַחוּם אָֽתָּה׃
translation: "Nevertheless in your manifold mercies you didn't make a full end of them, nor forsake them; for you are a gracious and merciful God. (Nehemiah 9:31)

text: וְהוּא רַחוּם יְכַפֵּר עָוֺן וְֽלֹא יַשְׁחִית וְהִרְבָּה לְהָשִׁיב אַפּוֹ וְלֹֽא יָעִיר כָּל חֲמָתֽוֹ׃
translation: But he, being merciful, forgave iniquity, and didn't destroy them. Yes, many times he turned his anger away, and didn't stir up all his wrath. (Psalms 78:38)

text: וַיַּעֲבֹר יְהוָה עַל פָּנָיו וַיִּקְרָא יְהוָה יְהוָה אֵל רַחוּם וְחַנּוּן אֶרֶךְ אַפַּיִם וְרַב חֶסֶד וֶאֱמֶֽת׃
translation: The LORD passed by before him, and proclaimed, "The LORD! The LORD, a merciful and gracious God, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness and truth, (Exodus 34:6)

text: כִּי אֵל רַחוּם יְהוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לֹא יַרְפְּךָ וְלֹא יַשְׁחִיתֶךָ וְלֹא יִשְׁכַּח אֶת בְּרִית אֲבֹתֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע לָהֶֽם׃
translation: For the LORD your God is a merciful God. He will not fail you nor destroy you, nor forget the covenant of your fathers which he swore to them. (Deuteronomy 4:31)

text: אֲשֶׁר בָּאוּ עִם זְרֻבָּבֶל יֵשׁוּעַ נְחֶמְיָה שְׂרָיָה רְֽעֵלָיָה מָרְדֳּכַי בִּלְשָׁן מִסְפָּר בִּגְוַי רְחוּם בַּעֲנָה מִסְפַּר אַנְשֵׁי עַם יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
translation: who came with Zerubbabel, Jeshua, Nehemiah, Seraiah, Reelaiah, Mordecai, Bilshan, Mispar, Bigvai, Rehum, and Baanah. The number of the men of the people of Israel: (Ezra 2:2)

text: וְקִרְעוּ לְבַבְכֶם וְאַל בִּגְדֵיכֶם וְשׁוּבוּ אֶל יְהוָה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶם כִּֽי חַנּוּן וְרַחוּם הוּא אֶרֶךְ אַפַּיִם וְרַב חֶסֶד וְנִחָם עַל הָרָעָֽה׃
translation: Tear your heart and not your garments, and turn to the LORD, your God; for he is gracious and merciful, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness, and relents from sending calamity. (Joel 2:13)

text: מִפְּנֵי רְשָׁעִים זוּ שַׁדּוּנִי אֹיְבַי בְּנֶפֶשׁ יַקִּיפוּ עָלָֽי׃
translation: from the wicked who oppress me, my deadly enemies, who surround me. (Psalms 17:9)

text: לֹא תַקִּפוּ פְּאַת רֹאשְׁכֶם וְלֹא תַשְׁחִית אֵת פְּאַת זְקָנֶֽךָ׃
translation: "'You shall not cut the hair on the sides of your head or clip off the edge of your beard. (Leviticus 19:27)

text: וְאַחַר עוֹרִֽי נִקְּפוּ זֹאת וּמִבְּשָׂרִי אֶֽחֱזֶה אֱלֽוֹהַּ׃
translation: After my skin is destroyed, then I will see God in my flesh, (Job 19:26)

text: סַבּוּנִי כַמַּיִם כָּל הַיּוֹם הִקִּיפוּ עָלַי יָֽחַד׃
translation: You have put lover and friend far from me, and my friends into darkness. (Psalms 88:18)

text: וַיִּשְׁלַח שָׁמָּה סוּסִים וְרֶכֶב וְחַיִל כָּבֵד וַיָּבֹאוּ לַיְלָה וַיַּקִּפוּ עַל הָעִֽיר׃
translation: Therefore he sent horses, chariots, and a great army there. They came by night and surrounded the city. (2 Kings 6:14)

text: סֹבּוּ צִיּוֹן וְהַקִּיפוּהָ סִפְרוּ מִגְדָּלֶֽיהָ׃
translation: Notice her bulwarks. Consider her palaces, that you may tell it to the next generation. (Psalms 48:13)

text: וְאַחַר יָֽרְדוּ בְּנֵי יְהוּדָה לְהִלָּחֵם בַּֽכְּנַעֲנִי יוֹשֵׁב הָהָר וְהַנֶּגֶב וְהַשְּׁפֵלָֽה׃
translation: After that, the children of Judah went down to fight against the Canaanites who lived in the hill country, and in the South, and in the lowland. (Judges 1:9)

text: וּבָרַד בְּרֶדֶת הַיָּעַר וּבַשִּׁפְלָה תִּשְׁפַּל הָעִֽיר׃
translation: though hail flattens the forest, and the city is leveled completely. (Isaiah 32:19)

text: וְֽאֶל הַמְּלָכִים אֲשֶׁר מִצְּפוֹן בָּהָר וּבָעֲרָבָה נֶגֶב כִּֽנֲרוֹת וּבַשְּׁפֵלָה וּבְנָפוֹת דּוֹר מִיָּֽם׃
translation: and to the kings who were on the north, in the hill country, in the Arabah south of Chinneroth, in the lowland, and in the heights of Dor on the west, (Joshua 11:2)

text: בַּשְּׁפֵלָה אֶשְׁתָּאוֹל וְצָרְעָה וְאַשְׁנָֽה׃
translation: In the lowland, Eshtaol, Zorah, Ashnah, (Joshua 15:33)

text: וְיָרְשׁוּ הַנֶּגֶב אֶת הַר עֵשָׂו וְהַשְּׁפֵלָה אֶת פְּלִשְׁתִּים וְיָרְשׁוּ אֶת שְׂדֵה אֶפְרַיִם וְאֵת שְׂדֵה שֹׁמְרוֹן וּבִנְיָמִן אֶת הַגִּלְעָֽד׃
translation: Those of the South will possess the mountain of Esau, and those of the lowland, the Philistines. They will possess the field of Ephraim, and the field of Samaria. Benjamin will possess Gilead. (Obadiah 1:19)

text: הֲלוֹא אֶת הַדְּבָרִים אֲשֶׁר קָרָא יְהוָה בְּיַד הַנְּבִיאִים הָרִֽאשֹׁנִים בִּהְיוֹת יְרוּשָׁלִַם יֹשֶׁבֶת וּשְׁלֵוָה וְעָרֶיהָ סְבִיבֹתֶיהָ וְהַנֶּגֶב וְהַשְּׁפֵלָה יֹשֵֽׁב׃
translation: Aren't these the words which the LORD proclaimed by the former prophets when Jerusalem was inhabited and in prosperity, and its cities around her, and the South and the lowland were inhabited?'" (Zechariah 7:7)

text: וַיְזַבֵּחַ וַיְקַטֵּר בַּבָּמוֹת וְעַל הַגְּבָעוֹת וְתַחַת כָּל עֵץ רַעֲנָֽן׃
translation: He sacrificed and burned incense in the high places, on the hills, and under every green tree. (2 Kings 16:4)

text: וַיְזַבֵּחַ וַיְקַטֵּר בַּבָּמוֹת וְעַל הַגְּבָעוֹת וְתַחַת כָּל עֵץ רַעֲנָֽן׃
translation: He sacrificed and burned incense in the high places, and on the hills, and under every green tree. (2 Chronicles 28:4)

text: אֲנָה נְבוּכַדְנֶצַּר שְׁלֵה הֲוֵית בְּבֵיתִי וְרַעְנַן בְּהֵיכְלִֽי׃
translation: Nebuchadnezzar the king, to all the peoples, nations, and languages, who dwell in all the earth: Peace be multiplied to you. (Daniel 4:1)

text: בְּֽלֹא יוֹמוֹ תִּמָּלֵא וְכִפָּתוֹ לֹא רַעֲנָֽנָה׃
translation: It will be accomplished before his time. His branch will not be green. (Job 15:32)

text: כִּזְכֹּר בְּנֵיהֶם מִזְבְּחוֹתָם וַאֲשֵׁרֵיהֶם עַל עֵץ רַֽעֲנָן עַל גְּבָעוֹת הַגְּבֹהֽוֹת׃
translation: Even their children remember their altars and their Asherah poles by the green trees on the high hills. (Jeremiah 17:2)

text: וַיַּצִּבוּ לָהֶם מַצֵּבוֹת וַאֲשֵׁרִים עַל כָּל גִּבְעָה גְבֹהָה וְתַחַת כָּל עֵץ רַעֲנָֽן׃
translation: and they set up for themselves pillars and Asherah poles on every high hill and under every green tree; (2 Kings 17:10)

text: הָֽאוֹיֵב תַּמּוּ חֳרָבוֹת לָנֶצַח וְעָרִים נָתַשְׁתָּ אָבַד זִכְרָם הֵֽמָּה׃
translation: But the LORD reigns forever. He has prepared his throne for judgment. (Psalms 9:7)

text: רֶגַע אֲדַבֵּר עַל גּוֹי וְעַל מַמְלָכָה לִנְתוֹשׁ וְלִנְתוֹץ וּֽלְהַאֲבִֽיד׃
translation: At the instant I speak concerning a nation, and concerning a kingdom, to pluck up and to break down and to destroy it, (Jeremiah 18:7)

text: וְהָיָה אַֽחֲרֵי נָתְשִׁי אוֹתָם אָשׁוּב וְרִֽחַמְתִּים וַהֲשִׁבֹתִים אִישׁ לְנַחֲלָתוֹ וְאִישׁ לְאַרְצֽוֹ׃
translation: It will happen that after I have plucked them up, I will return and have compassion on them. I will bring them again, every man to his heritage, and every man to his land. (Jeremiah 12:15)

text: וְאִם לֹא יִשְׁמָעוּ וְנָתַשְׁתִּי אֶת הַגּוֹי הַהוּא נָתוֹשׁ וְאַבֵּד נְאֻם יְהוָֽה׃
translation: But if they will not hear, then I will pluck up that nation, plucking up and destroying it," says the LORD. (Jeremiah 12:17)

text: הֲיַעֲזֹב מִצּוּר שָׂדַי שֶׁלֶג לְבָנוֹן אִם יִנָּתְשׁוּ מַיִם זָרִים קָרִים נוֹזְלִֽים׃
translation: Will the snow of Lebanon fail from the rock of the field? Will the cold waters that flow down from afar be dried up? (Jeremiah 18:14)

text: וְנָתַשְׁתִּי אֲשֵׁירֶיךָ מִקִּרְבֶּךָ וְהִשְׁמַדְתִּי עָרֶֽיךָ׃
translation: I will cut off your engraved images and your pillars from among you; and you shall no more worship the work of your hands. (Micah 5:13)

text: אִישׁ חֵמָה יְגָרֶה מָדוֹן וְאֶרֶך אַפַּיִם יַשְׁקִיט רִֽיב׃
translation: A wrathful man stirs up contention, but one who is slow to anger appeases strife. (Proverbs 15:18)

text: אָח נִפְשָׁע מִקִּרְיַת עֹז ומדונים וּמִדְיָנִים כִּבְרִיחַ אַרְמֽוֹן׃
translation: A brother offended is more difficult than a fortified city. Disputes are like the bars of a fortress. (Proverbs 18:19)

text: טוֹב שֶׁבֶת בְּאֶֽרֶץ מִדְבָּר מֵאֵשֶׁת מדונים מִדְיָנִים וָכָֽעַס׃
translation: It is better to dwell in a desert land, than with a contentious and fretful woman. (Proverbs 21:19)

text: דֶּלֶף טוֹרֵד בְּיוֹם סַגְרִיר וְאֵשֶׁת מדונים מִדְיָנִים נִשְׁתָּוָֽה׃
translation: A continual dropping on a rainy day and a contentious wife are alike: (Proverbs 27:15)

text: רְחַב נֶפֶשׁ יְגָרֶה מָדוֹן וּבוֹטֵחַ עַל יְהוָה יְדֻשָּֽׁן׃
translation: One who is greedy stirs up strife; but one who trusts in the LORD will prosper. (Proverbs 28:25)

text: אִֽישׁ אַף יְגָרֶה מָדוֹן וּבַעַל חֵמָה רַב פָּֽשַׁע׃
translation: An angry man stirs up strife, and a wrathful man abounds in sin. (Proverbs 29:22)

text: בָּרֲכִי נַפְשִׁי אֶת יְהוָה וְאַל תִּשְׁכְּחִי כָּל גְּמוּלָֽיו׃
translation: Praise the LORD, my soul, and don't forget all his benefits, (Psalms 103:2)

text: אוֹי לְרָשָׁע רָע כִּֽי גְמוּל יָדָיו יֵעָשֶׂה לּֽוֹ׃
translation: Woe to the wicked! Disaster is upon them, for the deeds of their hands will be paid back to them. (Isaiah 3:11)

text: וְעַל קִרְיָתַיִם וְעַל בֵּית גָּמוּל וְעַל בֵּית מְעֽוֹן׃
translation: on Kiriathaim, on Beth Gamul, on Beth Meon, (Jeremiah 48:23)

text: מַלְוֵה יְהוָה חוֹנֵֽן דָּל וּגְמֻלוֹ יְשַׁלֶּם לֽוֹ׃
translation: He who has pity on the poor lends to the LORD; he will reward him. (Proverbs 19:17)

text: לְיָכִין אֶחָד וְעֶשְׂרִים לְגָמוּל שְׁנַיִם וְעֶשְׂרִֽים׃
translation: the twenty-first to Jachin, the twenty-second to Gamul, (1 Chronicles 24:17)

text: בַּת בָּבֶל הַשְּׁדוּדָה אַשְׁרֵי שֶׁיְשַׁלֶּם לָךְ אֶת גְּמוּלֵךְ שֶׁגָּמַלְתְּ לָֽנוּ׃
translation: Daughter of Babylon, doomed to destruction, he will be happy who repays you, as you have done to us. (Psalms 137:8)

text: יָסֹבּוּ עָלַי רַבָּיו יְפַלַּח כִּלְיוֹתַי וְלֹא יַחְמוֹל יִשְׁפֹּךְ לָאָרֶץ מְרֵרָֽתִי׃
translation: His archers surround me. He splits my kidneys apart, and does not spare. He pours out my bile on the ground. (Job 16:13)

text: תִּכְרַעְנָה יַלְדֵיהֶן תְּפַלַּחְנָה חֶבְלֵיהֶם תְּשַׁלַּֽחְנָה׃
translation: They bow themselves. They bear their young. They end their labor pains. (Job 39:3)

text: כְּפֶלַח הָרִמּוֹן רַקָּתֵךְ מִבַּעַד לְצַמָּתֵֽךְ׃
translation: Your temples are like a piece of a pomegranate behind your veil. (Song of Solomon 6:7)

text: עַד יְפַלַּח חֵץ כְּֽבֵדוֹ כְּמַהֵר צִפּוֹר אֶל פָּח וְלֹֽא יָדַע כִּֽי בְנַפְשׁוֹ הֽוּא׃
translation: Until an arrow strikes through his liver, as a bird hurries to the snare, and doesn't know that it will cost his life. (Proverbs 7:23)

text: וּלְכֹם מְהוֹדְעִין דִּי כָל כָּהֲנַיָּא וְלֵוָיֵא זַמָּרַיָּא תָרָֽעַיָּא נְתִינַיָּא וּפָלְחֵי בֵּית אֱלָהָא דְנָה מִנְדָּה בְלוֹ וַהֲלָךְ לָא שַׁלִּיט לְמִרְמֵא עֲלֵיהֹֽם׃
translation: Also we inform you that it shall not be lawful to impose tribute, custom, or toll on any of the priests, Levites, singers, gatekeepers, temple servants, or laborers of this house of God. (Ezra 7:24)

text: שָׁאֲגוּ צֹרְרֶיךָ בְּקֶרֶב מוֹעֲדֶךָ שָׂמוּ אוֹתֹתָם אֹתֽוֹת׃
translation: Your adversaries have roared in the middle of your assembly. They have set up their standards as signs. (Psalms 74:4)

text: הַכְּפִירִים שֹׁאֲגִים לַטָּרֶף וּלְבַקֵּשׁ מֵאֵל אָכְלָֽם׃
translation: The young lions roar after their prey, and seek their food from God. (Psalms 104:21)

text: יַחְדָּו כַּכְּפִרִים יִשְׁאָגוּ נָעֲרוּ כְּגוֹרֵי אֲרָיֽוֹת׃
translation: They will roar together like young lions. They will growl as lions' cubs. (Jeremiah 51:38)

text: אַחֲרָיו יִשְׁאַג קוֹל יַרְעֵם בְּקוֹל גְּאוֹנוֹ וְלֹא יְעַקְּבֵם כִּֽי יִשָּׁמַע קוֹלֽוֹ׃
translation: After it a voice roars. He thunders with the voice of his majesty. He doesn't hold back anything when his voice is heard. (Job 37:4)

text: אַחֲרֵי יְהוָה יֵלְכוּ כְּאַרְיֵה יִשְׁאָג כִּֽי הוּא יִשְׁאַג וְיֶחֶרְדוּ בָנִים מִיָּֽם׃
translation: They will walk after the LORD, who will roar like a lion; for he will roar, and the children will come trembling from the west. (Hosea 11:10)

text: אַרְיֵה שָׁאָג מִי לֹא יִירָא אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה דִּבֶּר מִי לֹא יִנָּבֵֽא׃
translation: The lion has roared. Who will not fear? The Lord GOD has spoken. Who can but prophesy? (Amos 3:8)

text: וְאֶחָיו לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָיו בְּהִתְיַחֵשׂ לְתֹלְדוֹתָם הָרֹאשׁ יְעִיאֵל וּזְכַרְיָֽהוּ׃
translation: His brothers by their families, when the genealogy of their generations was listed: the chief, Jeiel, and Zechariah, (1 Chronicles 5:7)

text: כֻּלָּם הִתְיַחְשׂוּ בִּימֵי יוֹתָם מֶֽלֶךְ יְהוּדָה וּבִימֵי יָרָבְעָם מֶֽלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
translation: All these were listed by genealogies in the days of Jotham king of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam king of Israel. (1 Chronicles 5:17)

text: וְהִתְיַחְשָׂם לְתֹלְדוֹתָם רָאשֵׁי בֵּית אֲבוֹתָם גִּבּוֹרֵי חָיִל עֶשְׂרִים אֶלֶף וּמָאתָֽיִם׃
translation: They were listed by genealogy, after their generations, heads of their fathers' houses, mighty men of valor, twenty thousand two hundred. (1 Chronicles 7:9)

text: וְאֵלֶּה רָאשֵׁי אֲבֹתֵיהֶם וְהִתְיַחְשָׂם הָעֹלִים עִמִּי בְּמַלְכוּת אַרְתַּחְשַׁסְתְּא הַמֶּלֶךְ מִבָּבֶֽל׃
translation: Now these are the heads of their fathers' households, and this is the genealogy of those who went up with me from Babylon, in the reign of Artaxerxes the king: (Ezra 8:1)

text: מִבְּנֵי שְׁכַנְיָה מִבְּנֵי פַרְעֹשׁ זְכַרְיָה וְעִמּוֹ הִתְיַחֵשׂ לִזְכָרִים מֵאָה וַחֲמִשִּֽׁים׃
translation: Of the sons of Shecaniah, of the sons of Parosh, Zechariah; and with him were listed by genealogy of the males one hundred fifty. (Ezra 8:3)

text: וַאֲחֵיהֶם לְכֹל מִשְׁפְּחוֹת יִשָׂשכָר גִּבּוֹרֵי חֲיָלִים שְׁמוֹנִים וְשִׁבְעָה אֶלֶף הִתְיַחְשָׂם לַכֹּֽל׃
translation: Their brothers among all the families of Issachar, mighty men of valor, listed in all by genealogy, were eighty-seven thousand. (1 Chronicles 7:5)

text: מִי פֶתִי יָסֻר הֵנָּה חֲסַר לֵב אָמְרָה לּֽוֹ׃
translation: "Whoever is simple, let him turn in here!" As for him who is void of understanding, she says to him, (Proverbs 9:4)

text: מִי פֶתִי יָסֻר הֵנָּה וַחֲסַר לֵב וְאָמְרָה לּֽוֹ׃
translation: "Whoever is simple, let him turn in here." As for him who is void of understanding, she says to him, (Proverbs 9:16)

text: וָאֵרֶא בַפְּתָאיִם אָבִינָה בַבָּנִים נַעַר חֲסַר לֵֽב׃
translation: I saw among the simple ones. I discerned among the youths a young man void of understanding, (Proverbs 7:7)

text: פֶּתִי יַאֲמִין לְכָל דָּבָר וְעָרוּם יָבִין לַאֲשֻׁרֽוֹ׃
translation: A simple man believes everything, but the prudent man carefully considers his ways. (Proverbs 14:15)

text: תּוֹרַת יְהוָה תְּמִימָה מְשִׁיבַת נָפֶשׁ עֵדוּת יְהוָה נֶאֱמָנָה מַחְכִּימַת פֶּֽתִי׃
translation: The LORD's precepts are right, rejoicing the heart. The LORD's commandment is pure, enlightening the eyes. (Psalms 19:8)

text: לָתֵת לִפְתָאיִם עָרְמָה לְנַעַר דַּעַת וּמְזִמָּֽה׃
translation: to give prudence to the simple, knowledge and discretion to the young man— (Proverbs 1:4)

text: קָרוֹב יְהוָה לְנִשְׁבְּרֵי לֵב וְֽאֶת דַּכְּאֵי רוּחַ יוֹשִֽׁיעַ׃
translation: Many are the afflictions of the righteous, but the LORD delivers him out of them all. (Psalms 34:19)

text: יִשְׁפֹּט עֲֽנִיֵּי עָם יוֹשִׁיעַ לִבְנֵי אֶבְיוֹן וִֽידַכֵּא עוֹשֵֽׁק׃
translation: He will judge the poor of the people. He will save the children of the needy, and will break the oppressor in pieces. (Psalms 72:4)

text: תָּשֵׁב אֱנוֹשׁ עַד דַּכָּא וַתֹּאמֶר שׁוּבוּ בְנֵי אָדָֽם׃
translation: You turn man to destruction, saying, "Return, you children of men." (Psalms 90:3)

text: יִרְחֲקוּ בָנָיו מִיֶּשַׁע וְיִֽדַּכְּאוּ בַשַּׁעַר וְאֵין מַצִּֽיל׃
translation: His children are far from safety. They are crushed in the gate. Neither is there any to deliver them, (Job 5:4)

text: לָכֵן יַכִּיר מַעְבָּֽדֵיהֶם וְהָפַךְ לַיְלָה וְיִדַּכָּֽאוּ׃
translation: Therefore he takes knowledge of their works. He overturns them in the night, so that they are destroyed. (Job 34:25)

text: אַֽל תִּגְזָל דָּל כִּי דַל הוּא וְאַל תְּדַכֵּא עָנִי בַשָּֽׁעַר׃
translation: Don't exploit the poor because he is poor; and don't crush the needy in court; (Proverbs 22:22)

text: כְּרֵֽעַ כְּאָח לִי הִתְהַלָּכְתִּי כַּאֲבֶל אֵם קֹדֵר שַׁחֽוֹתִי׃
translation: I behaved myself as though it had been my friend or my brother. I bowed down mourning, as one who mourns his mother. (Psalms 35:14)

text: שַׁחוּ רָעִים לִפְנֵי טוֹבִים וּרְשָׁעִים עַֽל שַׁעֲרֵי צַדִּֽיק׃
translation: The evil bow down before the good, and the wicked at the gates of the righteous. (Proverbs 14:19)

text: אֱלוֹהַּ לֹא יָשִׁיב אַפּוֹ תחתו תַּחְתָּיו שָׁחֲחוּ עֹזְרֵי רָֽהַב׃
translation: "God will not withdraw his anger. The helpers of Rahab stoop under him. (Job 9:13)

text: וַיִּשַּׁח אָדָם וַיִּשְׁפַּל אִישׁ וְאַל תִּשָּׂא לָהֶֽם׃
translation: Man is brought low, and mankind is humbled; therefore don't forgive them. (Isaiah 2:9)

text: וַיִּשַּׁח אָדָם וַיִּשְׁפַּל אִישׁ וְעֵינֵי גְבֹהִים תִּשְׁפַּֽלְנָה׃
translation: So man is brought low, mankind is humbled, and the eyes of the arrogant ones are humbled; (Isaiah 5:15)

text: וְשַׁח גַּבְהוּת הָאָדָם וְשָׁפֵל רוּם אֲנָשִׁים וְנִשְׂגַּב יְהוָה לְבַדּוֹ בַּיּוֹם הַהֽוּא׃
translation: The loftiness of man shall be bowed down, and the arrogance of men shall be brought low; and the LORD alone shall be exalted in that day. (Isaiah 2:17)

text: שֹׁפֵךְ בּוּז עַל נְדִיבִים וַיַּתְעֵם בְּתֹהוּ לֹא דָֽרֶךְ׃
translation: He pours contempt on princes, and causes them to wander in a trackless waste. (Psalms 107:40)

text: כָּל הַגּוֹיִם כְּאַיִן נֶגְדּוֹ מֵאֶפֶס וָתֹהוּ נֶחְשְׁבוּ לֽוֹ׃
translation: All the nations are like nothing before him. They are regarded by him as less than nothing, and vanity. (Isaiah 40:17)

text: הֵן כֻּלָּם אָוֶן אֶפֶס מַעֲשֵׂיהֶם רוּחַ וָתֹהוּ נִסְכֵּיהֶֽם׃
translation: Behold, all of their deeds are vanity and nothing. Their molten images are wind and confusion. (Isaiah 41:29)

text: מֵסִיר לֵב רָאשֵׁי עַם הָאָרֶץ וַיַּתְעֵם בְּתֹהוּ לֹא דָֽרֶךְ׃
translation: He takes away understanding from the chiefs of the people of the earth, and causes them to wander in a wilderness where there is no way. (Job 12:24)

text: נִשְׁבְּרָה קִרְיַת תֹּהוּ סֻגַּר כָּל בַּיִת מִבּֽוֹא׃
translation: The confused city is broken down. Every house is shut up, that no man may come in. (Isaiah 24:10)

text: מַחֲטִיאֵי אָדָם בְּדָבָר וְלַמּוֹכִיחַ בַּשַּׁעַר יְקֹשׁוּן וַיַּטּוּ בַתֹּהוּ צַדִּֽיק׃
translation: who cause a person to be indicted by a word, and lay a snare for one who reproves in the gate, and who deprive the innocent of justice with false testimony. (Isaiah 29:21)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר לֹא תוּכַל לִרְאֹת אֶת פָּנָי כִּי לֹֽא יִרְאַנִי הָאָדָם וָחָֽי׃
translation: He said, "You cannot see my face, for man may not see me and live." (Exodus 33:20)

text: וַיִּֽהְיוּ כָּל יְמֵי אָדָם אֲשֶׁר חַי תְּשַׁע מֵאוֹת שָׁנָה וּשְׁלֹשִׁים שָׁנָה וַיָּמֹֽת׃
translation: All the days that Adam lived were nine hundred thirty years, then he died. (Genesis 5:5)

text: וְאֵלֶּה יְמֵי שְׁנֵֽי חַיֵּי אַבְרָהָם אֲשֶׁר חָי מְאַת שָׁנָה וְשִׁבְעִים שָׁנָה וְחָמֵשׁ שָׁנִֽים׃
translation: These are the days of the years of Abraham's life which he lived: one hundred seventy-five years. (Genesis 25:7)

text: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם אֶת חֻקֹּתַי וְאֶת מִשְׁפָּטַי אֲשֶׁר יַעֲשֶׂה אֹתָם הָאָדָם וָחַי בָּהֶם אֲנִי יְהוָֽה׃
translation: You shall therefore keep my statutes and my ordinances, which if a man does, he shall live in them. I am the LORD. (Leviticus 18:5)

text: וָאֹמְרָה הַאִישׁ כָּמוֹנִי יִבְרָח וּמִי כָמוֹנִי אֲשֶׁר יָבוֹא אֶל הַהֵיכָל וָחָי לֹא אָבֽוֹא׃
translation: I said, "Should a man like me flee? Who is there that, being such as I, would go into the temple to save his life? I will not go in." (Nehemiah 6:11)

text: וָאֶתֵּן לָהֶם אֶת חֻקּוֹתַי וְאֶת מִשְׁפָּטַי הוֹדַעְתִּי אוֹתָם אֲשֶׁר יַעֲשֶׂה אוֹתָם הָאָדָם וָחַי בָּהֶֽם׃
translation: I gave them my statutes and showed them my ordinances, which if a man does, he will live in them. (Ezekiel 20:11)

text: יִשְׁעוּ וְאֵין מֹשִׁיעַ אֶל יְהוָה וְלֹא עָנָֽם׃
translation: They looked, but there was no one to save; even to the LORD, but he didn't answer them. (2 Samuel 22:42)

text: כַּמָּה לֹא תִשְׁעֶה מִמֶּנִּי לֹֽא תַרְפֵּנִי עַד בִּלְעִי רֻקִּֽי׃
translation: How long will you not look away from me, nor leave me alone until I swallow down my spittle? (Job 7:19)

text: שְׁעֵה מֵעָלָיו וְיֶחְדָּל עַד יִרְצֶה כְּשָׂכִיר יוֹמֽוֹ׃
translation: Look away from him, that he may rest, until he accomplishes, as a hireling, his day. (Job 14:6)

text: וְלֹא תִשְׁעֶינָה עֵינֵי רֹאִים וְאָזְנֵי שֹׁמְעִים תִּקְשַֽׁבְנָה׃
translation: The eyes of those who see will not be dim, and the ears of those who hear will listen. (Isaiah 32:3)

text: תִּכְבַּד הָעֲבֹדָה עַל הָאֲנָשִׁים וְיַעֲשׂוּ בָהּ וְאַל יִשְׁעוּ בְּדִבְרֵי שָֽׁקֶר׃
translation: Let heavier work be laid on the men, that they may labor in it. Don't let them pay any attention to lying words." (Exodus 5:9)

text: וְאֶל קַיִן וְאֶל מִנְחָתוֹ לֹא שָׁעָה וַיִּחַר לְקַיִן מְאֹד וַֽיִּפְּלוּ פָּנָֽיו׃
translation: but he didn't respect Cain and his offering. Cain was very angry, and the expression on his face fell. (Genesis 4:5)

text: וּמִן בְּנֵי זֶרַח יְעוּאֵל וַאֲחֵיהֶם שֵׁשׁ מֵאוֹת וְתִשְׁעִֽים׃
translation: Of the sons of Zerah: Jeuel and their brothers, six hundred ninety. (1 Chronicles 9:6)

text: וַֽיְחִי אֱנוֹשׁ תִּשְׁעִים שָׁנָה וַיּוֹלֶד אֶת קֵינָֽן׃
translation: Enosh lived ninety years, and became the father of Kenan. (Genesis 5:9)

text: וְעֵלִי בֶּן תִּשְׁעִים וּשְׁמֹנֶה שָׁנָה וְעֵינָיו קָמָה וְלֹא יָכוֹל לִרְאֽוֹת׃
translation: Now Eli was ninety-eight years old. His eyes were set, so that he could not see. (1 Samuel 4:15)

text: וּמֵעֵת הוּסַר הַתָּמִיד וְלָתֵת שִׁקּוּץ שֹׁמֵם יָמִים אֶלֶף מָאתַיִם וְתִשְׁעִֽים׃
translation: "From the time that the continual burnt offering is taken away and the abomination that makes desolate set up, there will be one thousand two hundred ninety days. (Daniel 12:11)

text: וַיִּהְיוּ כָּל יְמֵי מַהֲלַלְאֵל חָמֵשׁ וְתִשְׁעִים שָׁנָה וּשְׁמֹנֶה מֵאוֹת שָׁנָה וַיָּמֹֽת׃
translation: All of the days of Mahalalel were eight hundred ninety-five years, then he died. (Genesis 5:17)

text: בְּנֵֽי אָטֵר לִֽיחִזְקִיָּה תִּשְׁעִים וּשְׁמֹנָֽה׃
translation: The children of Ater, of Hezekiah, ninety-eight. (Ezra 2:16)

text: הַנְּמָלִים עַם לֹא עָז וַיָּכִינוּ בַקַּיִץ לַחְמָֽם׃
translation: The ants are not a strong people, yet they provide their food in the summer. (Proverbs 30:25)

text: עָבַר קָצִיר כָּלָה קָיִץ וַאֲנַחְנוּ לוֹא נוֹשָֽׁעְנוּ׃
translation: "The harvest is past. The summer has ended, and we are not saved." (Jeremiah 8:20)

text: כֹּה הִרְאַנִי אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה וְהִנֵּה כְּלוּב קָֽיִץ׃
translation: Thus the Lord GOD showed me: behold, a basket of summer fruit. (Amos 8:1)

text: תָּכִין בַּקַּיִץ לַחְמָהּ אָגְרָה בַקָּצִיר מַאֲכָלָֽהּ׃
translation: provides her bread in the summer, and gathers her food in the harvest. (Proverbs 6:8)

text: כִּי יוֹמָם וָלַיְלָה תִּכְבַּד עָלַי יָדֶךָ נֶהְפַּךְ לְשַׁדִּי בְּחַרְבֹנֵי קַיִץ סֶֽלָה׃
translation: For day and night your hand was heavy on me. My strength was sapped in the heat of summer. Selah. (Psalms 32:4)

text: עֹד כָּל יְמֵי הָאָרֶץ זֶרַע וְקָצִיר וְקֹר וָחֹם וְקַיִץ וָחֹרֶף וְיוֹם וָלַיְלָה לֹא יִשְׁבֹּֽתוּ׃
translation: While the earth remains, seed time and harvest, and cold and heat, and summer and winter, and day and night will not cease." (Genesis 8:22)

text: וַֽיְהִי בְּנָסְעָם מִקֶּדֶם וַֽיִּמְצְאוּ בִקְעָה בְּאֶרֶץ שִׁנְעָר וַיֵּשְׁבוּ שָֽׁם׃
translation: As they traveled east, they found a plain in the land of Shinar, and they lived there. (Genesis 11:2)

text: יַעֲלוּ הָרִים יֵרְדוּ בְקָעוֹת אֶל מְקוֹם זֶה יָסַדְתָּ לָהֶֽם׃
translation: The mountains rose, the valleys sank down, to the place which you had assigned to them. (Psalms 104:8)

text: וְהִנֵּה שָׁם כְּבוֹד אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל כַּמַּרְאֶה אֲשֶׁר רָאִיתִי בַּבִּקְעָֽה׃
translation: Behold, the glory of the God of Israel was there, according to the appearance that I saw in the plain. (Ezekiel 8:4)

text: וְאֶת הַנֶּגֶב וְֽאֶת הַכִּכָּר בִּקְעַת יְרֵחוֹ עִיר הַתְּמָרִים עַד צֹֽעַר׃
translation: and the south, and the Plain of the valley of Jericho the city of palm trees, to Zoar. (Deuteronomy 34:3)

text: כָּל גֶּיא יִנָּשֵׂא וְכָל הַר וְגִבְעָה יִשְׁפָּלוּ וְהָיָה הֶֽעָקֹב לְמִישׁוֹר וְהָרְכָסִים לְבִקְעָֽה׃
translation: Every valley shall be exalted, and every mountain and hill shall be made low. The uneven shall be made level, and the rough places a plain. (Isaiah 40:4)

text: וְהָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר אַתֶּם עֹבְרִים שָׁמָּה לְרִשְׁתָּהּ אֶרֶץ הָרִים וּבְקָעֹת לִמְטַר הַשָּׁמַיִם תִּשְׁתֶּה מָּֽיִם׃
translation: but the land that you go over to possess is a land of hills and valleys which drinks water from the rain of the sky, (Deuteronomy 11:11)

text: וְעַל כָּל אַרְזֵי הַלְּבָנוֹן הָרָמִים וְהַנִּשָּׂאִים וְעַל כָּל אַלּוֹנֵי הַבָּשָֽׁן׃
translation: for all the cedars of Lebanon, that are high and lifted up, for all the oaks of Bashan, (Isaiah 2:13)

text: וַיֵּרָא אֵלָיו יְהוָה בְּאֵלֹנֵי מַמְרֵא וְהוּא יֹשֵׁב פֶּֽתַח הָאֹהֶל כְּחֹם הַיּֽוֹם׃
translation: The LORD appeared to him by the oaks of Mamre, as he sat in the tent door in the heat of the day. (Genesis 18:1)

text: וְזִיזָא בֶן שִׁפְעִי בֶן אַלּוֹן בֶּן יְדָיָה בֶן שִׁמְרִי בֶּן שְׁמַֽעְיָֽה׃
translation: and Ziza the son of Shiphi, the son of Allon, the son of Jedaiah, the son of Shimri, the son of Shemaiah— (1 Chronicles 4:37)

text: וַיֶּאֱהַל אַבְרָם וַיָּבֹא וַיֵּשֶׁב בְּאֵלֹנֵי מַמְרֵא אֲשֶׁר בְּחֶבְרוֹן וַיִּֽבֶן שָׁם מִזְבֵּחַ לַֽיהוָֽה׃
translation: Abram moved his tent, and came and lived by the oaks of Mamre, which are in Hebron, and built an altar there to the LORD. (Genesis 13:18)

text: אַלּוֹנִים מִבָּשָׁן עָשׂוּ מִשּׁוֹטָיִךְ קַרְשֵׁךְ עָֽשׂוּ שֵׁן בַּת אֲשֻׁרִים מֵאִיֵּי כתים כִּתִּיִּֽים׃
translation: They have made your oars of the oaks of Bashan. They have made your benches of ivory inlaid in cypress wood from the islands of Kittim. (Ezekiel 27:6)

text: וַתָּמָת דְּבֹרָה מֵינֶקֶת רִבְקָה וַתִּקָּבֵר מִתַּחַת לְבֵֽית אֵל תַּחַת הָֽאַלּוֹן וַיִּקְרָא שְׁמוֹ אַלּוֹן בָּכֽוּת׃
translation: Deborah, Rebekah's nurse, died, and she was buried below Bethel under the oak; and its name was called Allon Bacuth. (Genesis 35:8)

text: וַיֵּשֶׁב יַעֲקֹב בְּאֶרֶץ מְגוּרֵי אָבִיו בְּאֶרֶץ כְּנָֽעַן׃
translation: Jacob lived in the land of his father's travels, in the land of Canaan. (Genesis 37:1)

text: לֹא נִין לוֹ וְלֹא נֶכֶד בְּעַמּוֹ וְאֵין שָׂרִיד בִּמְגוּרָֽיו׃
translation: He will have neither son nor grandson among his people, nor any remaining where he lived. (Job 18:19)

text: ישימות יַשִּׁי מָוֶת עָלֵימוֹ יֵרְדוּ שְׁאוֹל חַיִּים כִּֽי רָעוֹת בִּמְגוּרָם בְּקִרְבָּֽם׃
translation: As for me, I will call on God. The LORD will save me. (Psalms 55:16)

text: אַל תצאי תֵּֽצְאוּ הַשָּׂדֶה וּבַדֶּרֶךְ אַל תלכי תֵּלֵכוּ כִּי חֶרֶב לְאֹיֵב מָגוֹר מִסָּבִֽיב׃
translation: Don't go out into the field or walk by the way; for the sword of the enemy and terror are on every side. (Jeremiah 6:25)

text: אָהֳלֵיהֶם וְצֹאנָם יִקָּחוּ יְרִיעוֹתֵיהֶם וְכָל כְּלֵיהֶם וּגְמַלֵּיהֶם יִשְׂאוּ לָהֶם וְקָרְאוּ עֲלֵיהֶם מָגוֹר מִסָּבִֽיב׃
translation: They will take their tents and their flocks. they will carry away for themselves their curtains, all their vessels, and their camels; and they will cry to them, 'Terror on every side!' (Jeremiah 49:29)

text: כִּֽי הָיָה רְכוּשָׁם רָב מִשֶּׁבֶת יַחְדָּו וְלֹא יָֽכְלָה אֶרֶץ מְגֽוּרֵיהֶם לָשֵׂאת אֹתָם מִפְּנֵי מִקְנֵיהֶֽם׃
translation: For their substance was too great for them to dwell together, and the land of their travels couldn't bear them because of their livestock. (Genesis 36:7)

text: וַיִּגַּשׁ אַבְרָהָם וַיֹּאמַר הַאַף תִּסְפֶּה צַדִּיק עִם רָשָֽׁע׃
translation: Abraham came near, and said, "Will you consume the righteous with the wicked? (Genesis 18:23)

text: וְאִם הָרֵעַ תָּרֵעוּ גַּם אַתֶּם גַּֽם מַלְכְּכֶם תִּסָּפֽוּ׃
translation: But if you keep doing evil, you will be consumed, both you and your king." (1 Samuel 12:25)

text: רָב אֹכֶל נִיר רָאשִׁים וְיֵשׁ נִסְפֶּה בְּלֹא מִשְׁפָּֽט׃
translation: An abundance of food is in poor people's fields, but injustice sweeps it away. (Proverbs 13:23)

text: אַסְפֶּה עָלֵימוֹ רָעוֹת חִצַּי אֲכַלֶּה בָּֽם׃
translation: "I will heap evils on them. I will spend my arrows on them. (Deuteronomy 32:23)

text: יֵבֹשׁוּ וְיַחְפְּרוּ יַחַד מְבַקְשֵׁי נַפְשִׁי לִסְפּוֹתָהּ יִסֹּגוּ אָחוֹר וְיִכָּלְמוּ חֲפֵצֵי רָעָתִֽי׃
translation: Let them be desolate by reason of their shame that tell me, "Aha! Aha!" (Psalms 40:15)

text: הוֹי אֲרִיאֵל אֲרִיאֵל קִרְיַת חָנָה דָוִד סְפוּ שָׁנָה עַל שָׁנָה חַגִּים יִנְקֹֽפוּ׃
translation: Woe to Ariel! Ariel, the city where David encamped! Add year to year; let the feasts come around; (Isaiah 29:1)

text: וַיֵּצֵא אָסָא לְפָנָיו וַיַּֽעַרְכוּ מִלְחָמָה בְּגֵיא צְפַתָה לְמָרֵשָֽׁה׃
translation: Zerah the Ethiopian came out against them with an army of a million troops and three hundred chariots, and he came to Mareshah. (2 Chronicles 14:9)

text: וּקְעִילָה וְאַכְזִיב וּמָֽרֵאשָׁה עָרִים תֵּשַׁע וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃
translation: Keilah, Achzib, and Mareshah; nine cities with their villages. (Joshua 15:44)

text: וְאֶת גַּת וְאֶת מָרֵשָׁה וְאֶת זִֽיף׃
translation: Gath, Mareshah, Ziph, (2 Chronicles 11:8)

text: אֱמֹר לַמֶּלֶךְ וְלַגְּבִירָה הַשְׁפִּילוּ שֵׁבוּ כִּי יָרַד מַרְאֲשׁוֹתֵיכֶם עֲטֶרֶת תִּֽפְאַרְתְּכֶֽם׃
translation: Say to the king and to the queen mother, "Humble yourselves. Sit down, for your crowns have come down, even the crown of your glory. (Jeremiah 13:18)

text: עֹד הַיֹּרֵשׁ אָבִי לָךְ יוֹשֶׁבֶת מָֽרֵשָׁה עַד עֲדֻּלָּם יָבוֹא כְּבוֹד יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
translation: I will yet bring a conqueror to you, inhabitants of Mareshah. The glory of Israel will come to Adullam. (Micah 1:15)

text: וּבְנֵי כָלֵב אֲחִי יְרַחְמְאֵל מֵישָׁע בְּכֹרוֹ הוּא אֲבִי זִיף וּבְנֵי מָרֵשָׁה אֲבִי חֶבְרֽוֹן׃
translation: The sons of Caleb the brother of Jerahmeel were Mesha his firstborn, who was the father of Ziph, and the sons of Mareshah the father of Hebron. (1 Chronicles 2:42)

text: בַּיָּמִים הָהֵם אֲנִי דָֽנִיֵּאל הָיִיתִי מִתְאַבֵּל שְׁלֹשָׁה שָׁבֻעִים יָמִֽים׃
translation: In those days I, Daniel, was mourning three whole weeks. (Daniel 10:2)

text: וְחַג שָׁבֻעֹת תַּעֲשֶׂה לְךָ בִּכּוּרֵי קְצִיר חִטִּים וְחַג הָֽאָסִיף תְּקוּפַת הַשָּׁנָֽה׃
translation: "You shall observe the feast of weeks with the first fruits of wheat harvest, and the feast of harvest at the year's end. (Exodus 34:22)

text: וַיַּעַשׂ יַעֲקֹב כֵּן וַיְמַלֵּא שְׁבֻעַ זֹאת וַיִּתֶּן לוֹ אֶת רָחֵל בִּתּוֹ לוֹ לְאִשָּֽׁה׃
translation: Jacob did so, and fulfilled her week. He gave him Rachel his daughter as wife. (Genesis 29:28)

text: בָּרִאשׁוֹן בְּאַרְבָּעָה עָשָׂר יוֹם לַחֹדֶשׁ יִהְיֶה לָכֶם הַפָּסַח חָג שְׁבֻעוֹת יָמִים מַצּוֹת יֵאָכֵֽל׃
translation: "'"In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, you shall have the Passover, a feast of seven days; unleavened bread shall be eaten. (Ezekiel 45:21)

text: וְאִם נְקֵבָה תֵלֵד וְטָמְאָה שְׁבֻעַיִם כְּנִדָּתָהּ וְשִׁשִּׁים יוֹם וְשֵׁשֶׁת יָמִים תֵּשֵׁב עַל דְּמֵי טָהֳרָֽה׃
translation: But if she bears a female child, then she shall be unclean two weeks, as in her period; and she shall continue in the blood of purification sixty-six days. (Leviticus 12:5)

text: וְעָשִׂיתָ חַג שָׁבֻעוֹת לַיהוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ מִסַּת נִדְבַת יָדְךָ אֲשֶׁר תִּתֵּן כַּאֲשֶׁר יְבָרֶכְךָ יְהוָה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ׃
translation: You shall keep the feast of weeks to the LORD your God with a tribute of a free will offering of your hand, which you shall give according to how the LORD your God blesses you. (Deuteronomy 16:10)

text: וָאֵרֶא בַּחֲלֹמִי וְהִנֵּה שֶׁבַע שִׁבֳּלִים עֹלֹת בְּקָנֶה אֶחָד מְלֵאֹת וְטֹבֽוֹת׃
translation: I saw in my dream, and behold, seven heads of grain came up on one stalk, full and good; (Genesis 41:22)

text: שֶׁבַע פָּרֹת הַטֹּבֹת שֶׁבַע שָׁנִים הֵנָּה וְשֶׁבַע הַֽשִּׁבֳּלִים הַטֹּבֹת שֶׁבַע שָׁנִים הֵנָּה חֲלוֹם אֶחָד הֽוּא׃
translation: The seven good cattle are seven years; and the seven good heads of grain are seven years. The dream is one. (Genesis 41:26)

text: וְהָיָה בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא יַחְבֹּט יְהוָה מִשִּׁבֹּלֶת הַנָּהָר עַד נַחַל מִצְרָיִם וְאַתֶּם תְּלֻקְּטוּ לְאַחַד אֶחָד בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
translation: It will happen in that day that the LORD will thresh from the flowing stream of the Euphrates to the brook of Egypt; and you will be gathered one by one, children of Israel. (Isaiah 27:12)

text: וָאַעַן שֵׁנִית וָאֹמַר אֵלָיו מַה שְׁתֵּי שִׁבֲּלֵי הַזֵּיתִים אֲשֶׁר בְּיַד שְׁנֵי צַנְתְּרוֹת הַזָּהָב הַֽמְרִיקִים מֵעֲלֵיהֶם הַזָּהָֽב׃
translation: I asked him the second time, "What are these two olive branches, which are beside the two golden spouts that pour the golden oil out of themselves?" (Zechariah 4:12)

text: וְשֶׁבַע הַפָּרוֹת הָֽרַקּוֹת וְהָרָעֹת הָעֹלֹת אַחֲרֵיהֶן שֶׁבַע שָׁנִים הֵנָּה וְשֶׁבַע הַֽשִׁבֳּלִים הָרֵקוֹת שְׁדֻפוֹת הַקָּדִים יִהְיוּ שֶׁבַע שְׁנֵי רָעָֽב׃
translation: The seven thin and ugly cattle that came up after them are seven years, and also the seven empty heads of grain blasted with the east wind; they will be seven years of famine. (Genesis 41:27)

text: וַתֹּאמֶר רוּת הַמּוֹאֲבִיָּה אֶֽל נָעֳמִי אֵֽלְכָה נָּא הַשָּׂדֶה וַאֲלַקֳטָּה בַשִׁבֳּלִים אַחַר אֲשֶׁר אֶמְצָא חֵן בְּעֵינָיו וַתֹּאמֶר לָהּ לְכִי בִתִּֽי׃
translation: Ruth the Moabitess said to Naomi, "Let me now go to the field, and glean among the ears of grain after him in whose sight I find favor." She said to her, "Go, my daughter." (Ruth 2:2)

text: וַיַּֽעֲמֹד שָׂטָן עַל יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיָּסֶת אֶת דָּוִיד לִמְנוֹת אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
translation: Satan stood up against Israel, and moved David to take a census of Israel. (1 Chronicles 21:1)

text: וְאַף הֲסִיתְךָ מִפִּי צָר רַחַב לֹא מוּצָק תַּחְתֶּיהָ וְנַחַת שֻׁלְחָנְךָ מָלֵא דָֽשֶׁן׃
translation: Yes, he would have allured you out of distress, into a wide place, where there is no restriction. That which is set on your table would be full of fatness. (Job 36:16)

text: אֹסְרִי לַגֶּפֶן עירה עִירוֹ וְלַשֹּׂרֵקָה בְּנִי אֲתֹנוֹ כִּבֵּס בַּיַּיִן לְבֻשׁוֹ וּבְדַם עֲנָבִים סותה סוּתֽוֹ׃
translation: Binding his foal to the vine, his donkey's colt to the choice vine, he has washed his garments in wine, his robes in the blood of grapes. (Genesis 49:11)

text: וַיְהִי בְּבוֹאָהּ וַתְּסִיתֵהוּ לִשְׁאוֹל מֵֽאֵת אָבִיהָ שָׂדֶה וַתִּצְנַח מֵעַל הַחֲמוֹר וַיֹּֽאמֶר לָהּ כָּלֵב מַה לָּֽךְ׃
translation: When she came, she had him ask her father for a field. She got off her donkey, and Caleb said, "What do you want?" (Joshua 15:18)

text: וַיְהִי בְּבוֹאָהּ וַתְּסִיתֵהוּ לִשְׁאוֹל מֵֽאֵת אָבִיהָ הַשָּׂדֶה וַתִּצְנַח מֵעַל הַחֲמוֹר וַיֹּֽאמֶר לָהּ כָּלֵב מַה לָּֽךְ׃
translation: When she came, she got him to ask her father for a field. She got off her donkey; and Caleb said to her, "What would you like?" (Judges 1:14)

text: רַק לֹֽא הָיָה כְאַחְאָב אֲשֶׁר הִתְמַכֵּר לַעֲשׂוֹת הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהוָה אֲשֶׁר הֵסַתָּה אֹתוֹ אִיזֶבֶל אִשְׁתּֽוֹ׃
translation: But there was no one like Ahab, who sold himself to do that which was evil in the LORD's sight, whom Jezebel his wife stirred up. (1 Kings 21:25)

text: זֹאת תִּֽהְיֶה תּוֹרַת הַמְּצֹרָע בְּיוֹם טָהֳרָתוֹ וְהוּבָא אֶל הַכֹּהֵֽן׃
translation: "This shall be the law of the leper in the day of his cleansing: He shall be brought to the priest, (Leviticus 14:2)

text: אִישׁ צָרוּעַ הוּא טָמֵא הוּא טַמֵּא יְטַמְּאֶנּוּ הַכֹּהֵן בְּרֹאשׁוֹ נִגְעֽוֹ׃
translation: he is a leprous man. He is unclean. The priest shall surely pronounce him unclean. His plague is on his head. (Leviticus 13:44)

text: וְצָרַעַת נַֽעֲמָן תִּֽדְבַּק בְּךָ וּֽבְזַרְעֲךָ לְעוֹלָם וַיֵּצֵא מִלְּפָנָיו מְצֹרָע כַּשָּֽׁלֶג׃
translation: Therefore the leprosy of Naaman will cling to you and to your offspring forever." He went out from his presence a leper, as white as snow. (2 Kings 5:27)

text: וְיָצָא הַכֹּהֵן אֶל מִחוּץ לַֽמַּחֲנֶה וְרָאָה הַכֹּהֵן וְהִנֵּה נִרְפָּא נֶֽגַע הַצָּרַעַת מִן הַצָּרֽוּעַ׃
translation: and the priest shall go out of the camp. The priest shall examine him. Behold, if the plague of leprosy is healed in the leper, (Leviticus 14:3)

text: צַו אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וִֽישַׁלְּחוּ מִן הַֽמַּחֲנֶה כָּל צָרוּעַ וְכָל זָב וְכֹל טָמֵא לָנָֽפֶשׁ׃
translation: "Command the children of Israel that they put out of the camp every leper, everyone who has a discharge, and whoever is unclean by a corpse. (Numbers 5:2)

text: וְהֶעָנָן סָר מֵעַל הָאֹהֶל וְהִנֵּה מִרְיָם מְצֹרַעַת כַּשָּׁלֶג וַיִּפֶן אַהֲרֹן אֶל מִרְיָם וְהִנֵּה מְצֹרָֽעַת׃
translation: The cloud departed from over the Tent; and behold, Miriam was leprous, as white as snow. Aaron looked at Miriam, and behold, she was leprous. (Numbers 12:10)

text: וְהִיא הֶעֱלָתַם הַגָּגָה וַֽתִּטְמְנֵם בְּפִשְׁתֵּי הָעֵץ הָעֲרֻכוֹת לָהּ עַל הַגָּֽג׃
translation: But she had brought them up to the roof, and hidden them under the stalks of flax which she had laid in order on the roof. (Joshua 2:6)

text: הַמּוֹצִיא רֶֽכֶב וָסוּס חַיִל וְעִזּוּז יַחְדָּו יִשְׁכְּבוּ בַּל יָקוּמוּ דָּעֲכוּ כַּפִּשְׁתָּה כָבֽוּ׃
translation: who brings out the chariot and horse, the army and the mighty man (they lie down together, they shall not rise; they are extinct, they are quenched like a wick) says: (Isaiah 43:17)

text: פַּאֲרֵי פִשְׁתִּים יִהְיוּ עַל רֹאשָׁם וּמִכְנְסֵי פִשְׁתִּים יִהְיוּ עַל מָתְנֵיהֶם לֹא יַחְגְּרוּ בַּיָּֽזַע׃
translation: They shall have linen turbans on their heads, and shall have linen trousers on their waists. They shall not clothe themselves with anything that makes them sweat. (Ezekiel 44:18)

text: כִּי זָֽנְתָה אִמָּם הֹבִישָׁה הֽוֹרָתָם כִּי אָמְרָה אֵלְכָה אַחֲרֵי מְאַהֲבַי נֹתְנֵי לַחְמִי וּמֵימַי צַמְרִי וּפִשְׁתִּי שַׁמְנִי וְשִׁקּוּיָֽי׃
translation: She will follow after her lovers, but she won't overtake them; and she will seek them, but won't find them. Then she will say, 'I will go and return to my first husband, for then it was better with me than now.' (Hosea 2:7)

text: וְהָיָה בְּבוֹאָם אֶֽל שַׁעֲרֵי הֶחָצֵר הַפְּנִימִית בִּגְדֵי פִשְׁתִּים יִלְבָּשׁוּ וְלֹֽא יַעֲלֶה עֲלֵיהֶם צֶמֶר בְּשָֽׁרְתָם בְּשַׁעֲרֵי הֶחָצֵר הַפְּנִימִית וָבָֽיְתָה׃
translation: "'"It will be that when they enter in at the gates of the inner court, they shall be clothed with linen garments. No wool shall come on them while they minister in the gates of the inner court, and within. (Ezekiel 44:17)

text: הֶאֱכַלְתָּם לֶחֶם דִּמְעָה וַתַּשְׁקֵמוֹ בִּדְמָעוֹת שָׁלִֽישׁ׃
translation: You make us a source of contention to our neighbors. Our enemies laugh among themselves. (Psalms 80:6)

text: וַיִּקַּח שֵׁשׁ מֵאוֹת רֶכֶב בָּחוּר וְכֹל רֶכֶב מִצְרָיִם וְשָׁלִשִׁם עַל כֻּלּֽוֹ׃
translation: and he took six hundred chosen chariots, and all the chariots of Egypt, with captains over all of them. (Exodus 14:7)

text: וּמִבְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֹֽא נָתַן שְׁלֹמֹה עָבֶד כִּי הֵם אַנְשֵׁי הַמִּלְחָמָה וַעֲבָדָיו וְשָׂרָיו וְשָׁלִשָׁיו וְשָׂרֵי רִכְבּוֹ וּפָרָשָֽׁיו׃
translation: But of the children of Israel Solomon made no bondservants; but they were the men of war, his servants, his princes, his captains, and rulers of his chariots and of his horsemen. (1 Kings 9:22)

text: וּמִן בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר לֹא נָתַן שְׁלֹמֹה לַעֲבָדִים לִמְלַאכְתּוֹ כִּי הֵמָּה אַנְשֵׁי מִלְחָמָה וְשָׂרֵי שָׁלִישָׁיו וְשָׂרֵי רִכְבּוֹ וּפָרָשָֽׁיו׃
translation: But of the children of Israel, Solomon made no servants for his work, but they were men of war, chief of his captains, and rulers of his chariots and of his horsemen. (2 Chronicles 8:9)

text: רֽוּחַ אִישׁ יְכַלְכֵּל מַחֲלֵהוּ וְרוּחַ נְכֵאָה מִי יִשָּׂאֶֽנָּה׃
translation: A man's spirit will sustain him in sickness, but a crushed spirit, who can bear? (Proverbs 18:14)

text: וַאֲחֹתוֹ הַמֹּלֶכֶת יָלְדָה אֶת אִישְׁהוֹד וְאֶת אֲבִיעֶזֶר וְאֶת מַחְלָֽה׃
translation: His sister Hammolecheth bore Ishhod, Abiezer, and Mahlah. (1 Chronicles 7:18)

text: וַתִּהְיֶינָה מַחְלָה תִרְצָה וְחָגְלָה וּמִלְכָּה וְנֹעָה בְּנוֹת צְלָפְחָד לִבְנֵי דֹדֵיהֶן לְנָשִֽׁים׃
translation: for Mahlah, Tirzah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Noah, the daughters of Zelophehad, were married to their father's brothers' sons. (Numbers 36:11)

text: וַעֲבַדְתֶּם אֵת יְהוָה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶם וּבֵרַךְ אֶֽת לַחְמְךָ וְאֶת מֵימֶיךָ וַהֲסִרֹתִי מַחֲלָה מִקִּרְבֶּֽךָ׃
translation: You shall serve the LORD your God, and he will bless your bread and your water, and I will take sickness away from among you. (Exodus 23:25)

text: שׁוּבִי שׁוּבִי הַשּׁוּלַמִּית שׁוּבִי שׁוּבִי וְנֶחֱזֶה בָּךְ מַֽה תֶּחֱזוּ בַּשּׁוּלַמִּית כִּמְחֹלַת הַֽמַּחֲנָֽיִם׃
translation: How beautiful are your feet in sandals, prince's daughter! Your rounded thighs are like jewels, the work of the hands of a skillful workman. (Song of Solomon 7:1)

text: וְאַתָּה בָּחֳלָיִים רַבִּים בְּמַחֲלֵה מֵעֶיךָ עַד יֵצְאוּ מֵעֶיךָ מִן הַחֹלִי יָמִים עַל יָמִֽים׃
translation: and you will have great sickness with a disease of your bowels, until your bowels fall out by reason of the sickness, day by day.'" (2 Chronicles 21:15)

text: וּרְאֵה וַעֲשֵׂה בְּתַבְנִיתָם אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה מָרְאֶה בָּהָֽר׃
translation: See that you make them after their pattern, which has been shown to you on the mountain. (Exodus 25:40)

text: הַכֹּל בִּכְתָב מִיַּד יְהוָה עָלַי הִשְׂכִּיל כֹּל מַלְאֲכוֹת הַתַּבְנִֽית׃
translation: "All this", David said, "I have been made to understand in writing from the LORD's hand, even all the works of this pattern." (1 Chronicles 28:19)

text: וַיֵּרָא לַכְּרֻבִים תַּבְנִית יַד אָדָם תַּחַת כַּנְפֵיהֶֽם׃
translation: The form of a man's hand appeared here in the cherubim under their wings. (Ezekiel 10:8)

text: תַּבְנִית כָּל בְּהֵמָה אֲשֶׁר בָּאָרֶץ תַּבְנִית כָּל צִפּוֹר כָּנָף אֲשֶׁר תָּעוּף בַּשָּׁמָֽיִם׃
translation: the likeness of any animal that is on the earth, the likeness of any winged bird that flies in the sky, (Deuteronomy 4:17)

text: כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר אֲנִי מַרְאֶה אוֹתְךָ אֵת תַּבְנִית הַמִּשְׁכָּן וְאֵת תַּבְנִית כָּל כֵּלָיו וְכֵן תַּעֲשֽׂוּ׃
translation: According to all that I show you, the pattern of the tabernacle, and the pattern of all of its furniture, even so you shall make it. (Exodus 25:9)

text: וַיִּתֵּן דָּוִיד לִשְׁלֹמֹה בְנוֹ אֶת תַּבְנִית הָאוּלָם וְֽאֶת בָּתָּיו וְגַנְזַכָּיו וַעֲלִיֹּתָיו וַחֲדָרָיו הַפְּנִימִים וּבֵית הַכַּפֹּֽרֶת׃
translation: Then David gave to Solomon his son the plans for the porch of the temple, for its houses, for its treasuries, for its upper rooms, for its inner rooms, for the place of the mercy seat; (1 Chronicles 28:11)

text: אֲשֶֽׁר קֻמְּטוּ וְלֹא עֵת נָהָר יוּצַק יְסוֹדָֽם׃
translation: who were snatched away before their time, whose foundation was poured out as a stream, (Job 22:16)

text: וְהַשְּׁלִשִׁית בְּבֵית הַמֶּלֶךְ וְהַשְּׁלִשִׁית בְּשַׁעַר הַיְסוֹד וְכָל הָעָם בְּחַצְרוֹת בֵּית יְהוָֽה׃
translation: A third part shall be at the king's house; and a third part at the gate of the foundation. All the people will be in the courts of the LORD's house. (2 Chronicles 23:5)

text: כִּלָּה יְהוָה אֶת חֲמָתוֹ שָׁפַךְ חֲרוֹן אַפּוֹ וַיַּצֶּת אֵשׁ בְּצִיּוֹן וַתֹּאכַל יְסוֹדֹתֶֽיהָ׃
translation: The LORD has accomplished his wrath. He has poured out his fierce anger. He has kindled a fire in Zion, which has devoured its foundations. (Lamentations 4:11)

text: זְכֹר יְהוָה לִבְנֵי אֱדוֹם אֵת יוֹם יְֽרוּשָׁלִָם הָאֹמְרִים עָרוּ עָרוּ עַד הַיְסוֹד בָּֽהּ׃
translation: Remember, LORD, against the children of Edom in the day of Jerusalem, who said, "Raze it! Raze it even to its foundation!" (Psalms 137:7)

text: וּבָאָה חֶרֶב בְּמִצְרַיִם וְהָיְתָה חַלְחָלָה בְּכוּשׁ בִּנְפֹל חָלָל בְּמִצְרָיִם וְלָקְחוּ הֲמוֹנָהּ וְנֶהֶרְסוּ יְסוֹדֹתֶֽיהָ׃
translation: A sword will come on Egypt, and anguish will be in Ethiopia, when the slain fall in Egypt. They take away her multitude, and her foundations are broken down. (Ezekiel 30:4)

text: וְלָֽקַחְתָּ מִדַּם הַפָּר וְנָתַתָּה עַל קַרְנֹת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ בְּאֶצְבָּעֶךָ וְאֶת כָּל הַדָּם תִּשְׁפֹּךְ אֶל יְסוֹד הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃
translation: You shall take of the blood of the bull, and put it on the horns of the altar with your finger; and you shall pour out all the blood at the base of the altar. (Exodus 29:12)

text: כִּי נֹפֶת תִּטֹּפְנָה שִׂפְתֵי זָרָה וְחָלָק מִשֶּׁמֶן חִכָּֽהּ׃
translation: For the lips of an adulteress drip honey. Her mouth is smoother than oil, (Proverbs 5:3)

text: אַחֲרֵי דְבָרִי לֹא יִשְׁנוּ וְעָלֵימוֹ תִּטֹּף מִלָּתִֽי׃
translation: After my words they didn't speak again. My speech fell on them. (Job 29:22)

text: לְחָיָו כַּעֲרוּגַת הַבֹּשֶׂם מִגְדְּלוֹת מֶרְקָחִים שִׂפְתוֹתָיו שֽׁוֹשַׁנִּים נֹטְפוֹת מוֹר עֹבֵֽר׃
translation: His cheeks are like a bed of spices with towers of perfumes. His lips are like lilies, dropping liquid myrrh. (Song of Solomon 5:13)

text: נֹפֶת תִּטֹּפְנָה שִׂפְתוֹתַיִךְ כַּלָּה דְּבַשׁ וְחָלָב תַּחַת לְשׁוֹנֵךְ וְרֵיחַ שַׂלְמֹתַיִךְ כְּרֵיחַ לְבָנֽוֹן׃
translation: Your lips, my bride, drip like the honeycomb. Honey and milk are under your tongue. The smell of your garments is like the smell of Lebanon. (Song of Solomon 4:11)

text: אֶרֶץ רָעָשָׁה אַף שָׁמַיִם נָטְפוּ מִפְּנֵי אֱלֹהִים זֶה סִינַי מִפְּנֵי אֱלֹהִים אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
translation: You, God, sent a plentiful rain. You confirmed your inheritance when it was weary. (Psalms 68:9)

text: קַמְתִּֽי אֲנִי לִפְתֹּחַ לְדוֹדִי וְיָדַי נָֽטְפוּ מוֹר וְאֶצְבְּעֹתַי מוֹר עֹבֵר עַל כַּפּוֹת הַמַּנְעֽוּל׃
translation: I rose up to open for my beloved. My hands dripped with myrrh, my fingers with liquid myrrh, on the handles of the lock. (Song of Solomon 5:5)

text: וַתַּעֲרֹךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל וּפְלִשְׁתִּים מַעֲרָכָה לִקְרַאת מַעֲרָכָֽה׃
translation: Israel and the Philistines put the battle in array, army against army. (1 Samuel 17:21)

text: אֶת הַמְּנֹרָה הַטְּהֹרָה אֶת נֵרֹתֶיהָ נֵרֹת הַמַּֽעֲרָכָה וְאֶת כָּל כֵּלֶיהָ וְאֵת שֶׁמֶן הַמָּאֽוֹר׃
translation: the pure lamp stand, its lamps, even the lamps to be set in order, all its vessels, the oil for the light, (Exodus 39:37)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי אֲנִי חֵרַפְתִּי אֶת מַעַרְכוֹת יִשְׂרָאֵל הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה תְּנוּ לִי אִישׁ וְנִֽלָּחֲמָה יָֽחַד׃
translation: The Philistine said, "I defy the armies of Israel today! Give me a man, that we may fight together!" (1 Samuel 17:10)

text: וְהָיָה כִּֽי קָם הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי וַיֵּלֶךְ וַיִּקְרַב לִקְרַאת דָּוִד וַיְמַהֵר דָּוִד וַיָּרָץ הַמַּעֲרָכָה לִקְרַאת הַפְּלִשְׁתִּֽי׃
translation: When the Philistine arose, and walked and came near to meet David, David hurried and ran toward the army to meet the Philistine. (1 Samuel 17:48)

text: וַיִּטֹּשׁ דָּוִד אֶת הַכֵּלִים מֵעָלָיו עַל יַד שׁוֹמֵר הַכֵּלִים וַיָּרָץ הַמַּעֲרָכָה וַיָּבֹא וַיִּשְׁאַל לְאֶחָיו לְשָׁלֽוֹם׃
translation: David left his baggage in the hand of the keeper of the baggage and ran to the army, and came and greeted his brothers. (1 Samuel 17:22)
