text: וַיַּעַרְכוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים לִקְרַאת יִשְׂרָאֵל וַתִּטֹּשׁ הַמִּלְחָמָה וַיִּנָּגֶף יִשְׂרָאֵל לִפְנֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים וַיַּכּוּ בַמַּֽעֲרָכָה בַּשָּׂדֶה כְּאַרְבַּעַת אֲלָפִים אִֽישׁ׃
translation: The Philistines put themselves in array against Israel. When they joined battle, Israel was defeated by the Philistines, who killed about four thousand men of the army in the field. (1 Samuel 4:2)

text: כִּי כָּל אֱלֹהֵי הָעַמִּים אֱלִילִים וַיהוָה שָׁמַיִם עָשָֽׂה׃
translation: For all the gods of the peoples are idols, but the LORD made the heavens. (1 Chronicles 16:26)

text: כִּי כָּל אֱלֹהֵי הָעַמִּים אֱלִילִים וַֽיהוָה שָׁמַיִם עָשָֽׂה׃
translation: For all the gods of the peoples are idols, but the LORD made the heavens. (Psalms 96:5)

text: כַּאֲשֶׁר מָצְאָה יָדִי לְמַמְלְכֹת הָאֱלִיל וּפְסִילֵיהֶם מִירֽוּשָׁלִַם וּמִשֹּׁמְרֽוֹן׃
translation: As my hand has found the kingdoms of the idols, whose engraved images exceeded those of Jerusalem and of Samaria, (Isaiah 10:10)

text: וְֽאוּלָם אַתֶּם טֹֽפְלֵי שָׁקֶר רֹפְאֵי אֱלִל כֻּלְּכֶֽם׃
translation: But you are forgers of lies. You are all physicians of no value. (Job 13:4)

text: וַתִּמָּלֵא אַרְצוֹ אֱלִילִים לְמַעֲשֵׂה יָדָיו יִֽשְׁתַּחֲווּ לַאֲשֶׁר עָשׂוּ אֶצְבְּעֹתָֽיו׃
translation: Their land also is full of idols. They worship the work of their own hands, that which their own fingers have made. (Isaiah 2:8)

text: הֲלֹא כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשִׂיתִי לְשֹׁמְרוֹן וְלֶאֱלִילֶיהָ כֵּן אֶעֱשֶׂה לִירוּשָׁלִַם וְלַעֲצַבֶּֽיהָ׃
translation: shall I not, as I have done to Samaria and her idols, so do to Jerusalem and her idols? (Isaiah 10:11)

text: הַשֹּׁלֵחַ אִמְרָתוֹ אָרֶץ עַד מְהֵרָה יָרוּץ דְּבָרֽוֹ׃
translation: He sends out his commandment to the earth. His word runs very swiftly. (Psalms 147:15)

text: הַטֵּה אֵלַי אָזְנְךָ מְהֵרָה הַצִּילֵנִי הֱיֵה לִי לְֽצוּר מָעוֹז לְבֵית מְצוּדוֹת לְהוֹשִׁיעֵֽנִי׃
translation: For you are my rock and my fortress, therefore for your name's sake lead me and guide me. (Psalms 31:3)

text: אָז יִבָּקַע כַּשַּׁחַר אוֹרֶךָ וַאֲרֻכָתְךָ מְהֵרָה תִצְמָח וְהָלַךְ לְפָנֶיךָ צִדְקֶךָ כְּבוֹד יְהוָה יַאַסְפֶֽךָ׃
translation: Then your light will break out as the morning, and your healing will appear quickly; then your righteousness shall go before you, and the LORD's glory will be your rear guard. (Isaiah 58:8)

text: וְהָאוֹרֵב קָם מְהֵרָה מִמְּקוֹמוֹ וַיָּרוּצוּ כִּנְטוֹת יָדוֹ וַיָּבֹאוּ הָעִיר וַֽיִּלְכְּדוּהָ וַֽיְמַהֲרוּ וַיַּצִּיתוּ אֶת הָעִיר בָּאֵֽשׁ׃
translation: The ambush arose quickly out of their place, and they ran as soon as he had stretched out his hand and entered into the city and took it. They hurried and set the city on fire. (Joshua 8:19)

text: וַיִּקְרָא יְהֽוֹנָתָן אַחֲרֵי הַנַּעַר מְהֵרָה חוּשָׁה אַֽל תַּעֲמֹד וַיְלַקֵּט נַעַר יְהֽוֹנָתָן אֶת החצי הַחִצִּים וַיָּבֹא אֶל אֲדֹנָֽיו׃
translation: Jonathan cried after the boy, "Go fast! Hurry! Don't delay!" Jonathan's boy gathered up the arrows, and came to his master. (1 Samuel 20:38)

text: וַיָּשָׁב וַיִּשְׁלַח אֵלָיו שַׂר חֲמִשִּׁים אַחֵר וַחֲמִשָּׁיו וַיַּעַן וַיְדַבֵּר אֵלָיו אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים כֹּֽה אָמַר הַמֶּלֶךְ מְהֵרָה רֵֽדָה׃
translation: Again he sent to him another captain of fifty with his fifty. He answered him, "Man of God, the king has said, 'Come down quickly!'" (2 Kings 1:11)

text: נָתַתָּה לִּירֵאֶיךָ נֵּס לְהִתְנוֹסֵס מִפְּנֵי קֹשֶׁט סֶֽלָה׃
translation: God has spoken from his sanctuary: "I will triumph. I will divide Shechem, and measure out the valley of Succoth. (Psalms 60:6)

text: עַד מָתַי אֶרְאֶה נֵּס אֶשְׁמְעָה קוֹל שׁוֹפָֽר׃
translation: How long will I see the standard and hear the sound of the trumpet? (Jeremiah 4:21)

text: כָּל יֹשְׁבֵי תֵבֵל וְשֹׁכְנֵי אָרֶץ כִּנְשֹׂא נֵס הָרִים תִּרְאוּ וְכִתְקֹעַ שׁוֹפָר תִּשְׁמָֽעוּ׃
translation: All you inhabitants of the world, and you dwellers on the earth, when a banner is lifted up on the mountains, look! When the trumpet is blown, listen! (Isaiah 18:3)

text: עַל הַר נִשְׁפֶּה שְֽׂאוּ נֵס הָרִימוּ קוֹל לָהֶם הָנִיפוּ יָד וְיָבֹאוּ פִּתְחֵי נְדִיבִֽים׃
translation: Set up a banner on the bare mountain! Lift up your voice to them! Wave your hand, that they may go into the gates of the nobles. (Isaiah 13:2)

text: שְׂאוּ נֵס צִיּוֹנָה הָעִיזוּ אַֽל תַּעֲמֹדוּ כִּי רָעָה אָנֹכִי מֵבִיא מִצָּפוֹן וְשֶׁבֶר גָּדֽוֹל׃
translation: Set up a standard toward Zion. Flee for safety! Don't wait; for I will bring evil from the north, and a great destruction." (Jeremiah 4:6)

text: וְהָיָה בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא שֹׁרֶשׁ יִשַׁי אֲשֶׁר עֹמֵד לְנֵס עַמִּים אֵלָיו גּוֹיִם יִדְרֹשׁוּ וְהָיְתָה מְנֻחָתוֹ כָּבֽוֹד׃
translation: It will happen in that day that the nations will seek the root of Jesse, who stands as a banner of the peoples; and his resting place will be glorious. (Isaiah 11:10)

text: וַיִּצָּמֶד יִשְׂרָאֵל לְבַעַל פְּעוֹר וַיִּֽחַר אַף יְהוָה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
translation: Israel joined himself to Baal Peor, and the LORD's anger burned against Israel. (Numbers 25:3)

text: פִּיךָ שָׁלַחְתָּ בְרָעָה וּלְשׁוֹנְךָ תַּצְמִיד מִרְמָֽה׃
translation: "You give your mouth to evil. Your tongue frames deceit. (Psalms 50:19)

text: וַיִּצָּמְדוּ לְבַעַל פְּעוֹר וַיֹּאכְלוּ זִבְחֵי מֵתִֽים׃
translation: They joined themselves also to Baal Peor, and ate the sacrifices of the dead. (Psalms 106:28)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה אֶל שֹׁפְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הִרְגוּ אִישׁ אֲנָשָׁיו הַנִּצְמָדִים לְבַעַל פְּעֽוֹר׃
translation: Moses said to the judges of Israel, "Everyone kill his men who have joined themselves to Baal Peor." (Numbers 25:5)

text: כִּי עֲשֶׂרֶת צִמְדֵּי כֶרֶם יַעֲשׂוּ בַּת אֶחָת וְזֶרַע חֹמֶר יַעֲשֶׂה אֵיפָֽה׃
translation: For ten acres of vineyard shall yield one bath, and a homer of seed shall yield an ephah." (Isaiah 5:10)

text: וְרָאָה רֶכֶב צֶמֶד פָּֽרָשִׁים רֶכֶב חֲמוֹר רֶכֶב גָּמָל וְהִקְשִׁיב קֶשֶׁב רַב קָֽשֶׁב׃
translation: When he sees a troop, horsemen in pairs, a troop of donkeys, a troop of camels, he shall listen diligently with great attentiveness." (Isaiah 21:7)

text: אִם הָלַכְתִּי עִם שָׁוְא וַתַּחַשׁ עַל מִרְמָה רַגְלִֽי׃
translation: "If I have walked with falsehood, and my foot has hurried to deceit (Job 31:5)

text: אֱלֹהִים אַל תִּרְחַק מִמֶּנִּי אֱלֹהַי לְעֶזְרָתִי חישה חֽוּשָׁה׃
translation: God, don't be far from me. My God, hurry to help me. (Psalms 71:12)

text: וְאַתָּה יְהוָה אַל תִּרְחָק אֱיָלוּתִי לְעֶזְרָתִי חֽוּשָׁה׃
translation: Deliver my soul from the sword, my precious life from the power of the dog. (Psalms 22:20)

text: כִּי מִי יֹאכַל וּמִי יָחוּשׁ חוּץ מִמֶּֽנִּי׃
translation: For who can eat, or who can have enjoyment, more than I? (Ecclesiastes 2:25)

text: לָכֵן שְׂעִפַּי יְשִׁיבוּנִי וּבַעֲבוּר חוּשִׁי בִֽי׃
translation: "Therefore my thoughts answer me, even by reason of my haste that is in me. (Job 20:2)

text: רְצֵה יְהוָה לְהַצִּילֵנִי יְהוָה לְעֶזְרָתִי חֽוּשָׁה׃
translation: Let them be disappointed and confounded together who seek after my soul to destroy it. Let them be turned backward and brought to dishonor who delight in my hurt. (Psalms 40:14)

text: וְהֶעָרִים אֲשֶׁר תִּתֵּנוּ שֵׁשׁ עָרֵי מִקְלָט תִּהְיֶינָה לָכֶֽם׃
translation: The cities which you shall give shall be for you six cities of refuge. (Numbers 35:13)

text: וְאִם יָצֹא יֵצֵא הָרֹצֵחַ אֶת גְּבוּל עִיר מִקְלָטוֹ אֲשֶׁר יָנוּס שָֽׁמָּה׃
translation: "'But if the man slayer shall at any time go beyond the border of his city of refuge where he flees, (Numbers 35:26)

text: וְהָיוּ לָכֶם הֶעָרִים לְמִקְלָט מִגֹּאֵל וְלֹא יָמוּת הָרֹצֵחַ עַד עָמְדוֹ לִפְנֵי הָעֵדָה לַמִּשְׁפָּֽט׃
translation: The cities shall be for your refuge from the avenger, that the man slayer not die until he stands before the congregation for judgment. (Numbers 35:12)

text: וְלֹא תִקְחוּ כֹפֶר לָנוּס אֶל עִיר מִקְלָטוֹ לָשׁוּב לָשֶׁבֶת בָּאָרֶץ עַד מוֹת הַכֹּהֵֽן׃
translation: "'You shall take no ransom for him who has fled to his city of refuge, that he may come again to dwell in the land before the death of the priest. (Numbers 35:32)

text: לָנוּס שָׁמָּה רוֹצֵחַ מַכֵּה נֶפֶשׁ בִּשְׁגָגָה בִּבְלִי דָעַת וְהָיוּ לָכֶם לְמִקְלָט מִגֹּאֵל הַדָּֽם׃
translation: that the man slayer who kills any person accidentally or unintentionally may flee there. They shall be to you for a refuge from the avenger of blood. (Joshua 20:3)

text: אֵת שְׁלֹשׁ הֶעָרִים תִּתְּנוּ מֵעֵבֶר לַיַּרְדֵּן וְאֵת שְׁלֹשׁ הֶֽעָרִים תִּתְּנוּ בְּאֶרֶץ כְּנָעַן עָרֵי מִקְלָט תִּהְיֶֽינָה׃
translation: You shall give three cities beyond the Jordan, and you shall give three cities in the land of Canaan. They shall be cities of refuge. (Numbers 35:14)

text: יַֽעַנְךָ יְהוָה בְּיוֹם צָרָה יְשַׂגֶּבְךָ שֵׁם אֱלֹהֵי יַעֲקֹֽב׃
translation: send you help from the sanctuary, grant you support from Zion, (Psalms 20:2)

text: פלאיה פְּלִיאָֽה דַעַת מִמֶּנִּי נִשְׂגְּבָה לֹא אוּכַֽל לָֽהּ׃
translation: This knowledge is beyond me. It's lofty. I can't attain it. (Psalms 139:6)

text: מִגְדַּל עֹז שֵׁם יְהוָה בּֽוֹ יָרוּץ צַדִּיק וְנִשְׂגָּֽב׃
translation: The LORD's name is a strong tower: the righteous run to him, and are safe. (Proverbs 18:10)

text: הֶן אֵל יַשְׂגִּיב בְּכֹחוֹ מִי כָמֹהוּ מוֹרֶֽה׃
translation: Behold, God is exalted in his power. Who is a teacher like him? (Job 36:22)

text: וַיְשַׂגֵּב יְהוָה אֶת צָרֵי רְצִין עָלָיו וְאֶת אֹיְבָיו יְסַכְסֵֽךְ׃
translation: "The bricks have fallen, but we will build with cut stone. The sycamore fig trees have been cut down, but we will put cedars in their place." (Isaiah 9:10)

text: נִשְׂגָּב יְהוָה כִּי שֹׁכֵן מָרוֹם מִלֵּא צִיּוֹן מִשְׁפָּט וּצְדָקָֽה׃
translation: The LORD is exalted, for he dwells on high. He has filled Zion with justice and righteousness. (Isaiah 33:5)

text: וַיֵּצֵא אֵהוּד הַֽמִּסְדְּרוֹנָה וַיִּסְגֹּר דַּלְתוֹת הָעַלִיָּה בַּעֲדוֹ וְנָעָֽל׃
translation: Then Ehud went out onto the porch, and shut the doors of the upper room on him, and locked them. (Judges 3:23)

text: וַיְהִי הַיּוֹם וַיָּבֹא שָׁמָּה וַיָּסַר אֶל הָעֲלִיָּה וַיִּשְׁכַּב שָֽׁמָּה׃
translation: One day he came there, and he went to the room and lay there. (2 Kings 4:11)

text: מַשְׁקֶה הָרִים מֵעֲלִיּוֹתָיו מִפְּרִי מַעֲשֶׂיךָ תִּשְׂבַּע הָאָֽרֶץ׃
translation: He waters the mountains from his rooms. The earth is filled with the fruit of your works. (Psalms 104:13)

text: הַמְקָרֶֽה בַמַּיִם עֲֽלִיּוֹתָיו הַשָּׂם עָבִים רְכוּבוֹ הַֽמְהַלֵּךְ עַל כַּנְפֵי רֽוּחַ׃
translation: He lays the beams of his rooms in the waters. He makes the clouds his chariot. He walks on the wings of the wind. (Psalms 104:3)

text: וַיִּקַּח אֵלִיָּהוּ אֶת הַיֶּלֶד וַיֹּרִדֵהוּ מִן הָעֲלִיָּה הַבַּיְתָה וַֽיִּתְּנֵהוּ לְאִמּוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלִיָּהוּ רְאִי חַי בְּנֵֽךְ׃
translation: Elijah took the child and brought him down out of the room into the house, and delivered him to his mother; and Elijah said, "Behold, your son lives." (1 Kings 17:23)

text: הוֹי בֹּנֶה בֵיתוֹ בְּֽלֹא צֶדֶק וַעֲלִיּוֹתָיו בְּלֹא מִשְׁפָּט בְּרֵעֵהוּ יַעֲבֹד חִנָּם וּפֹעֲלוֹ לֹא יִתֶּן לֽוֹ׃
translation: "Woe to him who builds his house by unrighteousness, and his rooms by injustice; who uses his neighbor's service without wages, and doesn't give him his hire; (Jeremiah 22:13)

text: אוֹ כְנֵפֶל טָמוּן לֹא אֶהְיֶה כְּעֹלְלִים לֹא רָאוּ אֽוֹר׃
translation: or as a hidden untimely birth I had not been, as infants who never saw light. (Job 3:16)

text: מִפִּי עֽוֹלְלִים וְֽיֹנְקִים יִסַּדְתָּ עֹז לְמַעַן צוֹרְרֶיךָ לְהַשְׁבִּית אוֹיֵב וּמִתְנַקֵּֽם׃
translation: When I consider your heavens, the work of your fingers, the moon and the stars, which you have ordained, (Psalms 8:3)

text: נְשֵׁי עַמִּי תְּגָרְשׁוּן מִבֵּית תַּֽעֲנֻגֶיהָ מֵעַל עֹֽלָלֶיהָ תִּקְחוּ הֲדָרִי לְעוֹלָֽם׃
translation: You drive the women of my people out from their pleasant houses; from their young children you take away my blessing forever. (Micah 2:9)

text: כִּֽי עָלָה מָוֶת בְּחַלּוֹנֵינוּ בָּא בְּאַרְמְנוֹתֵינוּ לְהַכְרִית עוֹלָל מִחוּץ בַּחוּרִים מֵרְחֹבֽוֹת׃
translation: Yet hear the LORD's word, you women. Let your ear receive the word of his mouth. Teach your daughters wailing. Everyone teach her neighbor a lamentation. (Jeremiah 9:20)

text: תֶּאְשַׁם שֹֽׁמְרוֹן כִּי מָרְתָה בֵּֽאלֹהֶיהָ בַּחֶרֶב יִפֹּלוּ עֹלְלֵיהֶם יְרֻטָּשׁוּ וְהָרִיּוֹתָיו יְבֻקָּֽעוּ׃
translation: Israel, return to the LORD your God; for you have fallen because of your sin. (Hosea 14:1)

text: דָּבַק לְשׁוֹן יוֹנֵק אֶל חכּוֹ בַּצָּמָא עֽוֹלָלִים שָׁאֲלוּ לֶחֶם פֹּרֵשׂ אֵין לָהֶֽם׃
translation: The tongue of the nursing child clings to the roof of his mouth for thirst. The young children ask for bread, and no one breaks it for them. (Lamentations 4:4)

text: קַֽל הוּא עַל פְּנֵי מַיִם תְּקֻלַּל חֶלְקָתָם בָּאָרֶץ לֹֽא יִפְנֶה דֶּרֶךְ כְּרָמִֽים׃
translation: "They are foam on the surface of the waters. Their portion is cursed in the earth. They don't turn into the way of the vineyards. (Job 24:18)

text: וְנָֽשָׂא נֵס לַגּוֹיִם מֵרָחוֹק וְשָׁרַק לוֹ מִקְצֵה הָאָרֶץ וְהִנֵּה מְהֵרָה קַל יָבֽוֹא׃
translation: He will lift up a banner to the nations from far away, and he will whistle for them from the end of the earth. Behold, they will come speedily and swiftly. (Isaiah 5:26)

text: אַל יָנוּס הַקַּל וְאַל יִמָּלֵט הַגִּבּוֹר צָפוֹנָה עַל יַד נְהַר פְּרָת כָּשְׁלוּ וְנָפָֽלוּ׃
translation: "Don't let the swift flee away, nor the mighty man escape. In the north by the river Euphrates they have stumbled and fallen. (Jeremiah 46:6)

text: וְתֹפֵשׂ הַקֶּשֶׁת לֹא יַעֲמֹד וְקַל בְּרַגְלָיו לֹא יְמַלֵּט וְרֹכֵב הַסּוּס לֹא יְמַלֵּט נַפְשֽׁוֹ׃
translation: He who handles the bow won't stand. He who is swift of foot won't escape. He who rides the horse won't deliver himself. (Amos 2:15)

text: וַיִּֽהְיוּ שָׁם שְׁלֹשָׁה בְּנֵי צְרוּיָה יוֹאָב וַאֲבִישַׁי וַעֲשָׂהאֵל וַעֲשָׂהאֵל קַל בְּרַגְלָיו כְּאַחַד הַצְּבָיִם אֲשֶׁר בַּשָּׂדֶֽה׃
translation: The three sons of Zeruiah were there: Joab, Abishai, and Asahel. Asahel was as light of foot as a wild gazelle. (2 Samuel 2:18)

text: וַתֹּאמְרוּ לֹא כִי עַל סוּס נָנוּס עַל כֵּן תְּנוּסוּן וְעַל קַל נִרְכָּב עַל כֵּן יִקַּלּוּ רֹדְפֵיכֶֽם׃
translation: but you said, "No, for we will flee on horses;" therefore you will flee; and, "We will ride on the swift;" therefore those who pursue you will be swift. (Isaiah 30:16)

text: גַּם בְּרוֹשִׁים שָׂמְחוּ לְךָ אַרְזֵי לְבָנוֹן מֵאָז שָׁכַבְתָּ לֹֽא יַעֲלֶה הַכֹּרֵת עָלֵֽינוּ׃
translation: Yes, the cypress trees rejoice with you, with the cedars of Lebanon, saying, "Since you are humbled, no lumberjack has come up against us." (Isaiah 14:8)

text: אֶתֵּן בַּמִּדְבָּר אֶרֶז שִׁטָּה וַהֲדַס וְעֵץ שָׁמֶן אָשִׂים בָּעֲרָבָה בְּרוֹשׁ תִּדְהָר וּתְאַשּׁוּר יַחְדָּֽו׃
translation: I will put cedar, acacia, myrtle, and oil trees in the wilderness. I will set cypress trees, pine, and box trees together in the desert; (Isaiah 41:19)

text: בְּרוֹשִׁים מִשְּׂנִיר בָּנוּ לָךְ אֵת כָּל לֻֽחֹתָיִם אֶרֶז מִלְּבָנוֹן לָקָחוּ לַעֲשׂוֹת תֹּרֶן עָלָֽיִךְ׃
translation: They have made all your planks of cypress trees from Senir. They have taken a cedar from Lebanon to make a mast for you. (Ezekiel 27:5)

text: מָגֵן גִּבֹּרֵיהוּ מְאָדָּם אַנְשֵׁי חַיִל מְתֻלָּעִים בְּאֵשׁ פְּלָדוֹת הָרֶכֶב בְּיוֹם הֲכִינוֹ וְהַבְּרֹשִׁים הָרְעָֽלוּ׃
translation: The chariots rage in the streets. They rush back and forth in the wide ways. Their appearance is like torches. They run like the lightnings. (Nahum 2:4)

text: וּשְׁתֵּי דַלְתוֹת עֲצֵי בְרוֹשִׁים שְׁנֵי צְלָעִים הַדֶּלֶת הָֽאַחַת גְּלִילִים וּשְׁנֵי קְלָעִים הַדֶּלֶת הַשֵּׁנִית גְּלִילִֽים׃
translation: and two doors of cypress wood. The two leaves of the one door were folding, and the two leaves of the other door were folding. (1 Kings 6:34)

text: כְּבוֹד הַלְּבָנוֹן אֵלַיִךְ יָבוֹא בְּרוֹשׁ תִּדְהָר וּתְאַשּׁוּר יַחְדָּו לְפָאֵר מְקוֹם מִקְדָּשִׁי וּמְקוֹם רַגְלַי אֲכַבֵּֽד׃
translation: "The glory of Lebanon shall come to you, the cypress tree, the pine, and the box tree together, to beautify the place of my sanctuary; and I will make the place of my feet glorious. (Isaiah 60:13)

text: עוּרָה לָמָּה תִישַׁן אֲדֹנָי הָקִיצָה אַל תִּזְנַח לָנֶֽצַח׃
translation: Why do you hide your face, and forget our affliction and our oppression? (Psalms 44:24)

text: הֲלֹֽא אַתָּה אֱלֹהִים זְנַחְתָּנוּ וְֽלֹא תֵצֵא אֱלֹהִים בְּצִבְאוֹתֵֽינוּ׃
translation: Through God we will do valiantly, for it is he who will tread down our adversaries. (Psalms 60:12)

text: הַֽלְעוֹלָמִים יִזְנַח אֲדֹנָי וְלֹֽא יֹסִיף לִרְצוֹת עֽוֹד׃
translation: Has his loving kindness vanished forever? Does his promise fail for generations? (Psalms 77:8)

text: לָמָה יְהוָה תִּזְנַח נַפְשִׁי תַּסְתִּיר פָּנֶיךָ מִמֶּֽנִּי׃
translation: I am afflicted and ready to die from my youth up. While I suffer your terrors, I am distracted. (Psalms 88:15)

text: הֲלֹֽא אֱלֹהִים זְנַחְתָּנוּ וְֽלֹא תֵצֵא אֱלֹהִים בְּצִבְאֹתֵֽינוּ׃
translation: Give us help against the enemy, for the help of man is vain. (Psalms 108:12)

text: אַף זָנַחְתָּ וַתַּכְלִימֵנוּ וְלֹא תֵצֵא בְּצִבְאוֹתֵֽינוּ׃
translation: You make us turn back from the adversary. Those who hate us take plunder for themselves. (Psalms 44:10)

text: וּלְקֻרְבַּן הָעֵצִים בְּעִתִּים מְזֻמָּנוֹת וְלַבִּכּוּרִים זָכְרָה לִּי אֱלֹהַי לְטוֹבָֽה׃
translation: and for the wood offering, at appointed times, and for the first fruits. Remember me, my God, for good. (Nehemiah 13:31)

text: לַכֹּל זְמָן וְעֵת לְכָל חֵפֶץ תַּחַת הַשָּׁמָֽיִם׃
translation: For everything there is a season, and a time for every purpose under heaven: (Ecclesiastes 3:1)

text: כָּל יְמֵי רָשָׁע הוּא מִתְחוֹלֵל וּמִסְפַּר שָׁנִים נִצְפְּנוּ לֶעָרִֽיץ׃
translation: the wicked man writhes in pain all his days, even the number of years that are laid up for the oppressor. (Job 15:20)

text: עַל כֵּן יְכַבְּדוּךָ עַם עָז קִרְיַת גּוֹיִם עָרִיצִים יִירָאֽוּךָ׃
translation: Therefore a strong people will glorify you. A city of awesome nations will fear you. (Isaiah 25:3)

text: וּמַלְּטוּנִי מִיַּד צָר וּמִיַּד עָרִיצִים תִּפְדּֽוּנִי׃
translation: or, 'Deliver me from the adversary's hand'? or, 'Redeem me from the hand of the oppressors'? (Job 6:23)

text: זֶה חֵֽלֶק אָדָם רָשָׁע עִם אֵל וְֽנַחֲלַת עָרִיצִים מִשַּׁדַּי יִקָּֽחוּ׃
translation: "This is the portion of a wicked man with God, the heritage of oppressors, which they receive from the Almighty. (Job 27:13)

text: וְהִצַּלְתִּיךָ מִיַּד רָעִים וּפְדִתִיךָ מִכַּף עָרִצִֽים׃
translation: "I will deliver you out of the hand of the wicked, and I will redeem you out of the hand of the terrible." (Jeremiah 15:21)

text: כִּי זָרִים קָמוּ עָלַי וְֽעָרִיצִים בִּקְשׁוּ נַפְשִׁי לֹא שָׂמוּ אֱלֹהִים לְנֶגְדָּם סֶֽלָה׃
translation: He will repay the evil to my enemies. Destroy them in your truth. (Psalms 54:5)

text: אֱלֹהִים לָנוּ מַחֲסֶה וָעֹז עֶזְרָה בְצָרוֹת נִמְצָא מְאֹֽד׃
translation: Therefore we won't be afraid, though the earth changes, though the mountains are shaken into the heart of the seas; (Psalms 46:2)

text: כִּֽי הָיִיתָ מַחְסֶה לִי מִגְדַּל עֹז מִפְּנֵי אוֹיֵֽב׃
translation: I will dwell in your tent forever. I will take refuge in the shelter of your wings. Selah. (Psalms 61:4)

text: עַל אֱלֹהִים יִשְׁעִי וּכְבוֹדִי צוּר עֻזִּי מַחְסִי בֵּֽאלֹהִֽים׃
translation: Trust in him at all times, you people. Pour out your heart before him. God is a refuge for us. Selah. (Psalms 62:8)

text: אַל תִּֽהְיֵה לִי לִמְחִתָּה מַֽחֲסִי אַתָּה בְּיוֹם רָעָֽה׃
translation: Don't be a terror to me. You are my refuge in the day of evil. (Jeremiah 17:17)

text: אֹמַר לַֽיהוָה מַחְסִי וּמְצוּדָתִי אֱלֹהַי אֶבְטַח בּֽוֹ׃
translation: I will say of the LORD, "He is my refuge and my fortress; my God, in whom I trust." (Psalms 91:2)

text: כִּֽי אַתָּה יְהוָה מַחְסִי עֶלְיוֹן שַׂמְתָּ מְעוֹנֶֽךָ׃
translation: Because you have made the LORD your refuge, and the Most High your dwelling place, (Psalms 91:9)

text: אִשְׁתִּיו חַמְרָא וְשַׁבַּחוּ לֵֽאלָהֵי דַּהֲבָא וְכַסְפָּא נְחָשָׁא פַרְזְלָא אָעָא וְאַבְנָֽא׃
translation: They drank wine, and praised the gods of gold, and of silver, of bronze, of iron, of wood, and of stone. (Daniel 5:4)

text: וּמַלְכוּ רביעיה רְבִיעָאָה תֶּהֱוֵא תַקִּיפָה כְּפַרְזְלָא כָּל קֳבֵל דִּי פַרְזְלָא מְהַדֵּק וְחָשֵׁל כֹּלָּא וּֽכְפַרְזְלָא דִּֽי מְרָעַע כָּל אִלֵּין תַּדִּק וְתֵרֹֽעַ׃
translation: The fourth kingdom will be strong as iron, because iron breaks in pieces and subdues all things; and as iron that crushes all these, it will break in pieces and crush. (Daniel 2:40)

text: לִבְבֵהּ מִן אנושא אֲנָשָׁא יְשַׁנּוֹן וּלְבַב חֵיוָה יִתְיְהִב לֵהּ וְשִׁבְעָה עִדָּנִין יַחְלְפוּן עֲלֽוֹהִי׃
translation: "I saw in the visions of my head on my bed, and behold, a holy watcher came down from the sky. (Daniel 4:13)

text: וְעָפְיֵהּ שַׁפִּיר וְאִנְבֵּהּ שַׂגִּיא וּמָזוֹן לְכֹלָּא בֵהּ תְּחֹתוֹהִי תְּדוּר חֵיוַת בָּרָא וּבְעַנְפוֹהִי יִשְׁכְּנָן צִפֲּרֵי שְׁמַיָּֽא׃
translation: "This dream I, King Nebuchadnezzar, have seen; and you, Belteshazzar, declare the interpretation, because all the wise men of my kingdom are not able to make known to me the interpretation; but you are able, for the spirit of the holy gods is in you." (Daniel 4:18)

text: קָרֵא בְחַיִל וְכֵן אָמַר גֹּדּוּ אִֽילָנָא וְקַצִּצוּ עַנְפוֹהִי אַתַּרוּ עָפְיֵהּ וּבַדַּרוּ אִנְבֵּהּ תְּנֻד חֵֽיוְתָא מִן תַּחְתּוֹהִי וְצִפְּרַיָּא מִן עַנְפֽוֹהִי׃
translation: The tree grew and was strong. Its height reached to the sky and its sight to the end of all the earth. (Daniel 4:11)

text: עָפְיֵהּ שַׁפִּיר וְאִנְבֵּהּ שַׂגִּיא וּמָזוֹן לְכֹלָּא בֵהּ תְּחֹתוֹהִי תַּטְלֵל חֵיוַת בָּרָא וּבְעַנְפוֹהִי ידרון יְדוּרָן צִפֲּרֵי שְׁמַיָּא וּמִנֵּהּ יִתְּזִין כָּל בִּשְׂרָֽא׃
translation: "Belteshazzar, master of the magicians, because I know that the spirit of the holy gods is in you and no secret troubles you, tell me the visions of my dream that I have seen, and its interpretation. (Daniel 4:9)

text: מְֽאוֹר עֵינַיִם יְשַׂמַּֽח לֵב שְׁמוּעָה טוֹבָה תְּדַשֶּׁן עָֽצֶם׃
translation: The light of the eyes rejoices the heart. Good news gives health to the bones. (Proverbs 15:30)

text: וְהָיוּ לִמְאוֹרֹת בִּרְקִיעַ הַשָּׁמַיִם לְהָאִיר עַל הָאָרֶץ וַֽיְהִי כֵֽן׃
translation: and let them be for lights in the expanse of the sky to give light on the earth;" and it was so. (Genesis 1:15)

text: לְךָ יוֹם אַף לְךָ לָיְלָה אַתָּה הֲכִינוֹתָ מָאוֹר וָשָֽׁמֶשׁ׃
translation: The day is yours, the night is also yours. You have prepared the light and the sun. (Psalms 74:16)

text: שת שַׁתָּה עֲוֺנֹתֵינוּ לְנֶגְדֶּךָ עֲלֻמֵנוּ לִמְאוֹר פָּנֶֽיךָ׃
translation: You have set our iniquities before you, our secret sins in the light of your presence. (Psalms 90:8)

text: וְאֶת מְנֹרַת הַמָּאוֹר וְאֶת כֵּלֶיהָ וְאֶת נֵרֹתֶיהָ וְאֵת שֶׁמֶן הַמָּאֽוֹר׃
translation: the lamp stand also for the light, with its vessels, its lamps, and the oil for the light; (Exodus 35:14)

text: כָּל מְאוֹרֵי אוֹר בַּשָּׁמַיִם אַקְדִּירֵם עָלֶיךָ וְנָתַתִּי חֹשֶׁךְ עַֽל אַרְצְךָ נְאֻם אֲדֹנָי יְהוִֽה׃
translation: I will make all the bright lights of the sky dark over you, and set darkness on your land," says the Lord GOD. (Ezekiel 32:8)

text: כִּֽי חַסְדְּךָ גָּדוֹל עָלָי וְהִצַּלְתָּ נַפְשִׁי מִשְּׁאוֹל תַּחְתִּיָּֽה׃
translation: For your loving kindness is great toward me. You have delivered my soul from the lowest Sheol. (Psalms 86:13)

text: לִבּוֹ יָצוּק כְּמוֹ אָבֶן וְיָצוּק כְּפֶלַח תַּחְתִּֽית׃
translation: One is so near to another, that no air can come between them. (Job 41:16)

text: וְהֵמָּה לְשׁוֹאָה יְבַקְשׁוּ נַפְשִׁי יָבֹאוּ בְּֽתַחְתִּיּוֹת הָאָֽרֶץ׃
translation: They shall be given over to the power of the sword. They shall be jackal food. (Psalms 63:10)

text: וַיּוֹצֵא מֹשֶׁה אֶת הָעָם לִקְרַאת הָֽאֱלֹהִים מִן הַֽמַּחֲנֶה וַיִּֽתְיַצְּבוּ בְּתַחְתִּית הָהָֽר׃
translation: Moses led the people out of the camp to meet God; and they stood at the lower part of the mountain. (Exodus 19:17)

text: קָרָאתִי שִׁמְךָ יְהוָה מִבּוֹר תַּחְתִּיּֽוֹת׃
translation: I called on your name, LORD, out of the lowest dungeon. (Lamentations 3:55)

text: כִּי אֵשׁ קָדְחָה בְאַפִּי וַתִּיקַד עַד שְׁאוֹל תַּחְתִּית וַתֹּאכַל אֶרֶץ וִֽיבֻלָהּ וַתְּלַהֵט מוֹסְדֵי הָרִֽים׃
translation: For a fire is kindled in my anger, that burns to the lowest Sheol, devours the earth with its increase, and sets the foundations of the mountains on fire. (Deuteronomy 32:22)

text: אוֹ שִׂיחַ לָאָרֶץ וְתֹרֶךָּ וִֽיסַפְּרוּ לְךָ דְּגֵי הַיָּֽם׃
translation: Or speak to the earth, and it will teach you. The fish of the sea will declare to you. (Job 12:8)

text: וַתַּעֲשֶׂה אָדָם כִּדְגֵי הַיָּם כְּרֶמֶשׂ לֹא מֹשֵׁל בּֽוֹ׃
translation: and make men like the fish of the sea, like the creeping things that have no ruler over them? (Habakkuk 1:14)

text: צִפּוֹר שָׁמַיִם וּדְגֵי הַיָּם עֹבֵר אָרְחוֹת יַמִּֽים׃
translation: LORD, our Lord, how majestic is your name in all the earth! (Psalms 8:9)

text: וְאֵת שַׁעַר הַדָּגִים בָּנוּ בְּנֵי הַסְּנָאָה הֵמָּה קֵרוּהוּ וַֽיַּעֲמִידוּ דַּלְתֹתָיו מַנְעוּלָיו וּבְרִיחָֽיו׃
translation: The sons of Hassenaah built the fish gate. They laid its beams, and set up its doors, its bolts, and its bars. (Nehemiah 3:3)

text: הֲצֹאן וּבָקָר יִשָּׁחֵט לָהֶם וּמָצָא לָהֶם אִם אֶֽת כָּל דְּגֵי הַיָּם יֵאָסֵף לָהֶם וּמָצָא לָהֶֽם׃
translation: Shall flocks and herds be slaughtered for them, to be sufficient for them? Shall all the fish of the sea be gathered together for them, to be sufficient for them?" (Numbers 11:22)

text: וַיְמַן יְהוָה דָּג גָּדוֹל לִבְלֹעַ אֶת יוֹנָה וַיְהִי יוֹנָה בִּמְעֵי הַדָּג שְׁלֹשָׁה יָמִים וּשְׁלֹשָׁה לֵילֽוֹת׃
translation: Then Jonah prayed to the LORD, his God, out of the fish's belly. (Jonah 2:1)

text: וְלֹֽא זָכַר שַֽׂר הַמַּשְׁקִים אֶת יוֹסֵף וַיִּשְׁכָּחֵֽהוּ׃
translation: Yet the chief cup bearer didn't remember Joseph, but forgot him. (Genesis 40:23)

text: וַיִּקְצֹף פַּרְעֹה עַל שְׁנֵי סָרִיסָיו עַל שַׂר הַמַּשְׁקִים וְעַל שַׂר הָאוֹפִֽים׃
translation: Pharaoh was angry with his two officers, the chief cup bearer and the chief baker. (Genesis 40:2)

text: וַיָּשֶׁב אֶת שַׂר הַמַּשְׁקִים עַל מַשְׁקֵהוּ וַיִּתֵּן הַכּוֹס עַל כַּף פַּרְעֹֽה׃
translation: He restored the chief cup bearer to his position again, and he gave the cup into Pharaoh's hand; (Genesis 40:21)

text: וַיְדַבֵּר שַׂר הַמַּשְׁקִים אֶת פַּרְעֹה לֵאמֹר אֶת חֲטָאַי אֲנִי מַזְכִּיר הַיּֽוֹם׃
translation: Then the chief cup bearer spoke to Pharaoh, saying, "I remember my faults today. (Genesis 41:9)

text: וַיְהִי אַחַר הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה חָֽטְאוּ מַשְׁקֵה מֶֽלֶךְ מִצְרַיִם וְהָאֹפֶה לַאֲדֹנֵיהֶם לְמֶלֶךְ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
translation: After these things, the butler of the king of Egypt and his baker offended their lord, the king of Egypt. (Genesis 40:1)

text: וַיְסַפֵּר שַֽׂר הַמַּשְׁקִים אֶת חֲלֹמוֹ לְיוֹסֵף וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ בַּחֲלוֹמִי וְהִנֵּה גֶפֶן לְפָנָֽי׃
translation: The chief cup bearer told his dream to Joseph, and said to him, "In my dream, behold, a vine was in front of me, (Genesis 40:9)

text: וְהָרֵק חֲנִית וּסְגֹר לִקְרַאת רֹדְפָי אֱמֹר לְנַפְשִׁי יְֽשֻׁעָתֵךְ אָֽנִי׃
translation: Brandish the spear and block those who pursue me. Tell my soul, "I am your salvation." (Psalms 35:3)

text: הַעַל כֵּן יָרִיק חֶרְמוֹ וְתָמִיד לַהֲרֹג גּוֹיִם לֹא יַחְמֽוֹל׃
translation: Will he therefore continually empty his net, and kill the nations without mercy? (Habakkuk 1:17)

text: אָמַר אוֹיֵב אֶרְדֹּף אַשִּׂיג אֲחַלֵּק שָׁלָל תִּמְלָאֵמוֹ נַפְשִׁי אָרִיק חַרְבִּי תּוֹרִישֵׁמוֹ יָדִֽי׃
translation: The enemy said, 'I will pursue. I will overtake. I will divide the plunder. My desire will be satisfied on them. I will draw my sword. My hand will destroy them.' (Exodus 15:9)

text: וְאֶתְכֶם אֱזָרֶה בַגּוֹיִם וַהֲרִיקֹתִי אַחֲרֵיכֶם חָרֶב וְהָיְתָה אַרְצְכֶם שְׁמָמָה וְעָרֵיכֶם יִהְיוּ חָרְבָּֽה׃
translation: I will scatter you among the nations, and I will draw out the sword after you. Your land will be a desolation, and your cities shall be a waste. (Leviticus 26:33)

text: לָכֵן הִנֵּה יָמִים בָּאִים נְאֻם יְהוָה וְשִׁלַּחְתִּי לוֹ צֹעִים וְצֵעֻהוּ וְכֵלָיו יָרִיקוּ וְנִבְלֵיהֶם יְנַפֵּֽצוּ׃
translation: Therefore behold, the days come," says the LORD, "that I will send to him those who pour off, and they will pour him off; and they will empty his vessels, and break their containers in pieces. (Jeremiah 48:12)

text: לָכֵן הִנְנִי מֵבִיא עָלֶיךָ זָרִים עָרִיצֵי גּוֹיִם וְהֵרִיקוּ חַרְבוֹתָם עַל יְפִי חָכְמָתֶךָ וְחִלְּלוּ יִפְעָתֶֽךָ׃
translation: therefore, behold, I will bring strangers on you, the terrible of the nations. They will draw their swords against the beauty of your wisdom. They will defile your brightness. (Ezekiel 28:7)

text: וַתְּכַל לְהַשְׁקֹתוֹ וַתֹּאמֶר גַּם לִגְמַלֶּיךָ אֶשְׁאָב עַד אִם כִּלּוּ לִשְׁתֹּֽת׃
translation: When she had finished giving him a drink, she said, "I will also draw for your camels, until they have finished drinking." (Genesis 24:19)

text: וַיַּבְרֵךְ הַגְּמַלִּים מִחוּץ לָעִיר אֶל בְּאֵר הַמָּיִם לְעֵת עֶרֶב לְעֵת צֵאת הַשֹּׁאֲבֹֽת׃
translation: He made the camels kneel down outside the city by the well of water at the time of evening, the time that women go out to draw water. (Genesis 24:11)

text: הִנֵּה אָנֹכִי נִצָּב עַל עֵין הַמָּיִם וּבְנוֹת אַנְשֵׁי הָעִיר יֹצְאֹת לִשְׁאֹב מָֽיִם׃
translation: Behold, I am standing by the spring of water. The daughters of the men of the city are coming out to draw water. (Genesis 24:13)

text: וְאָמְרָה אֵלַי גַּם אַתָּה שְׁתֵה וְגַם לִגְמַלֶּיךָ אֶשְׁאָב הִוא הָֽאִשָּׁה אֲשֶׁר הֹכִיחַ יְהוָה לְבֶן אֲדֹנִֽי׃
translation: then she tells me, "Drink, and I will also draw for your camels,"—let her be the woman whom the LORD has appointed for my master's son.' (Genesis 24:44)

text: אֲנִי טֶרֶם אֲכַלֶּה לְדַבֵּר אֶל לִבִּי וְהִנֵּה רִבְקָה יֹצֵאת וְכַדָּהּ עַל שִׁכְמָהּ וַתֵּרֶד הָעַיְנָה וַתִּשְׁאָב וָאֹמַר אֵלֶיהָ הַשְׁקִינִי נָֽא׃
translation: Before I had finished speaking in my heart, behold, Rebekah came out with her pitcher on her shoulder. She went down to the spring, and drew. I said to her, 'Please let me drink.' (Genesis 24:45)

text: עֵינַיִךְ בַּשָּׂדֶה אֲשֶׁר יִקְצֹרוּן וְהָלַכְתִּ אַחֲרֵיהֶן הֲלוֹא צִוִּיתִי אֶת הַנְּעָרִים לְבִלְתִּי נָגְעֵךְ וְצָמִת וְהָלַכְתְּ אֶל הַכֵּלִים וְשָׁתִית מֵאֲשֶׁר יִשְׁאֲבוּן הַנְּעָרִֽים׃
translation: Let your eyes be on the field that they reap, and go after them. Haven't I commanded the young men not to touch you? When you are thirsty, go to the vessels, and drink from that which the young men have drawn." (Ruth 2:9)

text: כִּי הָעֹשֶׁק יְהוֹלֵל חָכָם וִֽיאַבֵּד אֶת לֵב מַתָּנָֽה׃
translation: Surely extortion makes the wise man foolish; and a bribe destroys the understanding. (Ecclesiastes 7:7)

text: אִישׁ כְּמַתְּנַת יָדוֹ כְּבִרְכַּת יְהוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר נָֽתַן לָֽךְ׃
translation: Every man shall give as he is able, according to the LORD your God's blessing which he has given you. (Deuteronomy 16:17)

text: מִכֹּל מַתְּנֹתֵיכֶם תָּרִימוּ אֵת כָּל תְּרוּמַת יְהוָה מִכָּל חֶלְבּוֹ אֶֽת מִקְדְּשׁוֹ מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃
translation: Out of all your gifts, you shall offer every wave offering to the LORD, of all its best parts, even the holy part of it.' (Numbers 18:29)

text: וּמִמַּתָּנָה נַחֲלִיאֵל וּמִנַּחֲלִיאֵל בָּמֽוֹת׃
translation: and from Mattanah to Nahaliel; and from Nahaliel to Bamoth; (Numbers 21:19)

text: עָלִיתָ לַמָּרוֹם שָׁבִיתָ שֶּׁבִי לָקַחְתָּ מַתָּנוֹת בָּאָדָם וְאַף סוֹרְרִים לִשְׁכֹּן יָהּ אֱלֹהִֽים׃
translation: Blessed be the Lord, who daily bears our burdens, even the God who is our salvation. Selah. (Psalms 68:19)

text: מִלְּבַד שַׁבְּתֹת יְּהוָה וּמִלְּבַד מַתְּנֽוֹתֵיכֶם וּמִלְּבַד כָּל נִדְרֵיכֶם וּמִלְּבַד כָּל נִדְבוֹתֵיכֶם אֲשֶׁר תִּתְּנוּ לַיהוָֽה׃
translation: in addition to the Sabbaths of the LORD, and in addition to your gifts, and in addition to all your vows, and in addition to all your free will offerings, which you give to the LORD. (Leviticus 23:38)

text: כִּֽי רִצַּץ עָזַב דַּלִּים בַּיִת גָּזַל וְלֹא יִבֶנֵֽהוּ׃
translation: For he has oppressed and forsaken the poor. He has violently taken away a house, and he will not build it up. (Job 20:19)

text: אַתָּה רִצַּצְתָּ רָאשֵׁי לִוְיָתָן תִּתְּנֶנּוּ מַאֲכָל לְעָם לְצִיִּֽים׃
translation: You broke the heads of Leviathan in pieces. You gave him as food to people and desert creatures. (Psalms 74:14)

text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ לֹא עֲשַׁקְתָּנוּ וְלֹא רַצּוֹתָנוּ וְלֹֽא לָקַחְתָּ מִיַּד אִישׁ מְאֽוּמָה׃
translation: They said, "You have not defrauded us, nor oppressed us, neither have you taken anything from anyone's hand." (1 Samuel 12:4)

text: קָנֶה רָצוּץ לֹא יִשְׁבּוֹר וּפִשְׁתָּה כֵהָה לֹא יְכַבֶּנָּה לֶאֱמֶת יוֹצִיא מִשְׁפָּֽט׃
translation: He won't break a bruised reed. He won't quench a dimly burning wick. He will faithfully bring justice. (Isaiah 42:3)

text: לֹא יִכְהֶה וְלֹא יָרוּץ עַד יָשִׂים בָּאָרֶץ מִשְׁפָּט וּלְתוֹרָתוֹ אִיִּים יְיַחֵֽילוּ׃
translation: He will not fail nor be discouraged, until he has set justice in the earth, and the islands wait for his law." (Isaiah 42:4)

text: וַיִּתְרֹֽצֲצוּ הַבָּנִים בְּקִרְבָּהּ וַתֹּאמֶר אִם כֵּן לָמָּה זֶּה אָנֹכִי וַתֵּלֶךְ לִדְרֹשׁ אֶת יְהוָֽה׃
translation: The children struggled together within her. She said, "If it is like this, why do I live?" She went to inquire of the LORD. (Genesis 25:22)

text: וְכֵן עָשָׂה לְפֶתַח הַֽהֵיכָל מְזוּזוֹת עֲצֵי שָׁמֶן מֵאֵת רְבִעִֽית׃
translation: He also made the entrance of the temple door posts of olive wood, out of a fourth part of the wall, (1 Kings 6:33)

text: הַֽהֵיכָל מְזוּזַת רְבֻעָה וּפְנֵי הַקֹּדֶשׁ הַמַּרְאֶה כַּמַּרְאֶֽה׃
translation: The door posts of the nave were squared. As for the face of the nave, its appearance was as the appearance of the temple. (Ezekiel 41:21)

text: וְאֵת פֶּתַח הַדְּבִיר עָשָׂה דַּלְתוֹת עֲצֵי שָׁמֶן הָאַיִל מְזוּזוֹת חֲמִשִֽׁית׃
translation: For the entrance of the inner sanctuary, he made doors of olive wood. The lintel and door posts were a fifth part of the wall. (1 Kings 6:31)

text: וּכְתַבְתָּם עַל מְזוּזֹת בֵּיתֶךָ וּבִשְׁעָרֶֽיךָ׃
translation: You shall write them on the door posts of your house and on your gates. (Deuteronomy 6:9)

text: וּכְתַבְתָּם עַל מְזוּזוֹת בֵּיתֶךָ וּבִשְׁעָרֶֽיךָ׃
translation: You shall write them on the door posts of your house and on your gates; (Deuteronomy 11:20)

text: אַשְֽׁרֵי אָדָם שֹׁמֵעַֽ לִי לִשְׁקֹד עַל דַּלְתֹתַי יוֹם יוֹם לִשְׁמֹר מְזוּזֹת פְּתָחָֽי׃
translation: Blessed is the man who hears me, watching daily at my gates, waiting at my door posts. (Proverbs 8:34)

text: וְכִֽי יָגוּר אִתְּךָ גֵּר בְּאַרְצְכֶם לֹא תוֹנוּ אֹתֽוֹ׃
translation: "'If a stranger lives as a foreigner with you in your land, you shall not do him wrong. (Leviticus 19:33)

text: אָמְרוּ בְלִבָּם נִינָם יָחַד שָׂרְפוּ כָל מוֹעֲדֵי אֵל בָּאָֽרֶץ׃
translation: They said in their heart, "We will crush them completely." They have burned up all the places in the land where God was worshiped. (Psalms 74:8)

text: וְגֵר לֹא תוֹנֶה וְלֹא תִלְחָצֶנּוּ כִּֽי גֵרִים הֱיִיתֶם בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
translation: "He who sacrifices to any god, except to the LORD only, shall be utterly destroyed. (Exodus 22:20)

text: עִמְּךָ יֵשֵׁב בְּקִרְבְּךָ בַּמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר יִבְחַר בְּאַחַד שְׁעָרֶיךָ בַּטּוֹב לוֹ לֹא תּוֹנֶֽנּוּ׃
translation: There shall be no prostitute of the daughters of Israel, neither shall there be a sodomite of the sons of Israel. (Deuteronomy 23:17)

text: אָב וָאֵם הֵקַלּוּ בָךְ לַגֵּר עָשׂוּ בַעֹשֶׁק בְּתוֹכֵךְ יָתוֹם וְאַלְמָנָה הוֹנוּ בָֽךְ׃
translation: In you have they treated father and mother with contempt. Among you they have oppressed the foreigner. In you they have wronged the fatherless and the widow. (Ezekiel 22:7)

text: עָזַב כַּכְּפִיר סֻכּוֹ כִּֽי הָיְתָה אַרְצָם לְשַׁמָּה מִפְּנֵי חֲרוֹן הַיּוֹנָה וּמִפְּנֵי חֲרוֹן אַפּֽוֹ׃
translation: He has left his covert, as the lion; for their land has become an astonishment because of the fierceness of the oppression, and because of his fierce anger. (Jeremiah 25:38)

text: וַתָּבֹא הָעִיר בַּמָּצוֹר עַד עַשְׁתֵּי עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה לַמֶּלֶךְ צִדְקִיָּֽהוּ׃
translation: So the city was besieged until the eleventh year of King Zedekiah. (2 Kings 25:2)

text: עַשְׁתֵּֽי עָשָׂר עֲזַרְאֵל בָּנָיו וְאֶחָיו שְׁנֵים עָשָֽׂר׃
translation: the eleventh to Azarel, his sons and his brothers, twelve; (1 Chronicles 25:18)

text: וַתָּבֹא הָעִיר בַּמָּצוֹר עַד עַשְׁתֵּי עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה לַמֶּלֶךְ צִדְקִיָּֽהוּ׃
translation: So the city was besieged to the eleventh year of King Zedekiah. (Jeremiah 52:5)

text: בְּיוֹם עַשְׁתֵּי עָשָׂר יוֹם נָשִׂיא לִבְנֵי אָשֵׁר פַּגְעִיאֵל בֶּן עָכְרָֽן׃
translation: On the eleventh day Pagiel the son of Ochran, prince of the children of Asher, (Numbers 7:72)

text: לְאֶלְיָשִׁיב עַשְׁתֵּי עָשָׂר לְיָקִים שְׁנֵים עָשָֽׂר׃
translation: the eleventh to Eliashib, the twelfth to Jakim, (1 Chronicles 24:12)

text: בְּעַשְׁתֵּֽי עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה לְצִדְקִיָּהוּ בַּחֹדֶשׁ הָרְבִיעִי בְּתִשְׁעָה לַחֹדֶשׁ הָבְקְעָה הָעִֽיר׃
translation: In the eleventh year of Zedekiah, in the fourth month, the ninth day of the month, a breach was made in the city. (Jeremiah 39:2)

text: וְאִם נֶפֶשׁ אַחַת תֶּחֱטָא בִשְׁגָגָה וְהִקְרִיבָה עֵז בַּת שְׁנָתָהּ לְחַטָּֽאת׃
translation: "'If a person sins unwittingly, then he shall offer a female goat a year old for a sin offering. (Numbers 15:27)

text: וְאִישׁ כִּֽי יֹאכַל קֹדֶשׁ בִּשְׁגָגָה וְיָסַף חֲמִֽשִׁיתוֹ עָלָיו וְנָתַן לַכֹּהֵן אֶת הַקֹּֽדֶשׁ׃
translation: "'If a man eats something holy unwittingly, then he shall add the fifth part of its value to it, and shall give the holy thing to the priest. (Leviticus 22:14)

text: וְנִסְלַח לְכָל עֲדַת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְלַגֵּר הַגָּר בְּתוֹכָם כִּי לְכָל הָעָם בִּשְׁגָגָֽה׃
translation: All the congregation of the children of Israel shall be forgiven, as well as the stranger who lives as a foreigner among them; for with regard to all the people, it was done unwittingly. (Numbers 15:26)

text: הָֽאֶזְרָח בִּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְלַגֵּר הַגָּר בְּתוֹכָם תּוֹרָה אַחַת יִהְיֶה לָכֶם לָעֹשֶׂה בִּשְׁגָגָֽה׃
translation: You shall have one law for him who does anything unwittingly, for him who is native-born among the children of Israel, and for the stranger who lives as a foreigner among them. (Numbers 15:29)

text: וְכִפֶּר הַכֹּהֵן עַל הַנֶּפֶשׁ הַשֹּׁגֶגֶת בְּחֶטְאָה בִשְׁגָגָה לִפְנֵי יְהוָה לְכַפֵּר עָלָיו וְנִסְלַח לֽוֹ׃
translation: The priest shall make atonement for the soul who errs when he sins unwittingly before the LORD. He shall make atonement for him; and he shall be forgiven. (Numbers 15:28)

text: וְהִקְרִיתֶם לָכֶם עָרִים עָרֵי מִקְלָט תִּהְיֶינָה לָכֶם וְנָס שָׁמָּה רֹצֵחַ מַכֵּה נֶפֶשׁ בִּשְׁגָגָֽה׃
translation: then you shall appoint for yourselves cities to be cities of refuge for you, that the man slayer who kills any person unwittingly may flee there. (Numbers 35:11)

text: אֱֽלֹהִים אַתָּה יָדַעְתָּ לְאִוַּלְתִּי וְאַשְׁמוֹתַי מִמְּךָ לֹא נִכְחָֽדוּ׃
translation: Don't let those who wait for you be shamed through me, Lord GOD of Armies. Don't let those who seek you be brought to dishonor through me, God of Israel. (Psalms 69:6)

text: וַיִּתְּנוּ יָדָם לְהוֹצִיא נְשֵׁיהֶם וַאֲשֵׁמִים אֵֽיל צֹאן עַל אַשְׁמָתָֽם׃
translation: They gave their hand that they would put away their wives; and being guilty, they offered a ram of the flock for their guilt. (Ezra 10:19)

text: וְהִשִּׂיאוּ אוֹתָם עֲוֺן אַשְׁמָה בְּאָכְלָם אֶת קָדְשֵׁיהֶם כִּי אֲנִי יְהוָה מְקַדְּשָֽׁם׃
translation: and so cause them to bear the iniquity that brings guilt when they eat their holy things; for I am the LORD who sanctifies them.'" (Leviticus 22:16)

text: וְלֹא נִכְנַע מִלִּפְנֵי יְהוָה כְּהִכָּנַע מְנַשֶּׁה אָבִיו כִּי הוּא אָמוֹן הִרְבָּה אַשְׁמָֽה׃
translation: He didn't humble himself before the LORD, as Manasseh his father had humbled himself; but this same Amon trespassed more and more. (2 Chronicles 33:23)

text: וַיָּקָם עֶזְרָא הַכֹּהֵן וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם אַתֶּם מְעַלְתֶּם וַתֹּשִׁיבוּ נָשִׁים נָכְרִיּוֹת לְהוֹסִיף עַל אַשְׁמַת יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
translation: Ezra the priest stood up and said to them, "You have trespassed, and have married foreign women, increasing the guilt of Israel. (Ezra 10:10)

text: הַנִּשְׁבָּעִים בְּאַשְׁמַת שֹֽׁמְרוֹן וְאָמְרוּ חֵי אֱלֹהֶיךָ דָּן וְחֵי דֶּרֶךְ בְּאֵֽר שָׁבַע וְנָפְלוּ וְלֹא יָקוּמוּ עֽוֹד׃
translation: Those who swear by the sin of Samaria, and say, 'As your god, Dan, lives,' and, 'As the way of Beersheba lives,' they will fall, and never rise up again." (Amos 8:14)

text: נָתַן גִּשְׁמֵיהֶם בָּרָד אֵשׁ לֶהָבוֹת בְּאַרְצָֽם׃
translation: He gave them hail for rain, with lightning in their land. (Psalms 105:32)

text: וּמַשְׂכִּילֵי עָם יָבִינוּ לָֽרַבִּים וְנִכְשְׁלוּ בְּחֶרֶב וּבְלֶהָבָה בִּשְׁבִי וּבְבִזָּה יָמִֽים׃
translation: "Those who are wise among the people will instruct many; yet they will fall by the sword and by flame, by captivity and by plunder, many days. (Daniel 11:33)

text: קוֹל יְהוָה חֹצֵב לַהֲבוֹת אֵֽשׁ׃
translation: The LORD's voice strikes with flashes of lightning. (Psalms 29:7)

text: כִּי אֵשׁ יָֽצְאָה מֵֽחֶשְׁבּוֹן לֶהָבָה מִקִּרְיַת סִיחֹן אָֽכְלָה עָר מוֹאָב בַּעֲלֵי בָּמוֹת אַרְנֹֽן׃
translation: for a fire has gone out of Heshbon, a flame from the city of Sihon. It has devoured Ar of Moab, The lords of the high places of the Arnon. (Numbers 21:28)

text: גָּדַע בָּֽחֳרִי אַף כֹּל קֶרֶן יִשְׂרָאֵל הֵשִׁיב אָחוֹר יְמִינוֹ מִפְּנֵי אוֹיֵב וַיִּבְעַר בְּיַעֲקֹב כְּאֵשׁ לֶֽהָבָה אָכְלָה סָבִֽיב׃
translation: He has cut off all the horn of Israel in fierce anger. He has drawn back his right hand from before the enemy. He has burned up Jacob like a flaming fire, which devours all around. (Lamentations 2:3)

text: כִּֽי תַעֲבֹר בַּמַּיִם אִתְּךָ אָנִי וּבַנְּהָרוֹת לֹא יִשְׁטְפוּךָ כִּֽי תֵלֵךְ בְּמוֹ אֵשׁ לֹא תִכָּוֶה וְלֶהָבָה לֹא תִבְעַר בָּֽךְ׃
translation: When you pass through the waters, I will be with you, and through the rivers, they will not overflow you. When you walk through the fire, you will not be burned, and flame will not scorch you. (Isaiah 43:2)

text: בְּצֶדֶק כָּל אִמְרֵי פִי אֵין בָּהֶם נִפְתָּל וְעִקֵּֽשׁ׃
translation: All the words of my mouth are in righteousness. There is nothing crooked or perverse in them. (Proverbs 8:8)

text: טֽוֹב רָשׁ הוֹלֵךְ בְּתֻמּוֹ מֵעִקֵּשׁ שְׂפָתָיו וְהוּא כְסִֽיל׃
translation: Better is the poor who walks in his integrity than he who is perverse in his lips and is a fool. (Proverbs 19:1)

text: צִנִּים פַּחִים בְּדֶרֶךְ עִקֵּשׁ שׁוֹמֵר נַפְשׁוֹ יִרְחַק מֵהֶֽם׃
translation: Thorns and snares are in the path of the wicked; whoever guards his soul stays far from them. (Proverbs 22:5)

text: טֽוֹב רָשׁ הוֹלֵךְ בְּתֻמּוֹ מֵעִקֵּשׁ דְּרָכַיִם וְהוּא עָשִֽׁיר׃
translation: Better is the poor who walks in his integrity than he who is perverse in his ways, and he is rich. (Proverbs 28:6)

text: אִם אֶצְדָּק פִּי יַרְשִׁיעֵנִי תָּֽם אָנִי וַֽיַּעְקְשֵֽׁנִי׃
translation: Though I am righteous, my own mouth will condemn me. Though I am blameless, it will prove me perverse. (Job 9:20)

text: לֵבָב עִקֵּשׁ יָסוּר מִמֶּנִּי רָע לֹא אֵדָֽע׃
translation: A perverse heart will be far from me. I will have nothing to do with evil. (Psalms 101:4)

text: אֵין כָּאֵל יְשֻׁרוּן רֹכֵב שָׁמַיִם בְעֶזְרֶךָ וּבְגַאֲוָתוֹ שְׁחָקִֽים׃
translation: "There is no one like God, Jeshurun, who rides on the heavens for your help, in his excellency on the skies. (Deuteronomy 33:26)

text: אַל תְּבוֹאֵנִי רֶגֶל גַּאֲוָה וְיַד רְשָׁעִים אַל תְּנִדֵֽנִי׃
translation: There the workers of iniquity are fallen. They are thrust down, and shall not be able to rise. (Psalms 36:12)

text: תְּנוּ עֹז לֵֽאלֹהִים עַֽל יִשְׂרָאֵל גַּאֲוָתוֹ וְעֻזּוֹ בַּשְּׁחָקִֽים׃
translation: You are awesome, God, in your sanctuaries. The God of Israel gives strength and power to his people. Praise be to God! (Psalms 68:35)

text: יֶהֱמוּ יֶחְמְרוּ מֵימָיו יִֽרְעֲשֽׁוּ הָרִים בְּגַאֲוָתוֹ סֶֽלָה׃
translation: There is a river, the streams of which make the city of God glad, the holy place of the tents of the Most High. (Psalms 46:4)

text: בְּֽפִי אֱוִיל חֹטֶר גַּאֲוָה וְשִׂפְתֵי חֲכָמִים תִּשְׁמוּרֵֽם׃
translation: The fool's talk brings a rod to his back, but the lips of the wise protect them. (Proverbs 14:3)

text: גַּאֲוַת אָדָם תַּשְׁפִּילֶנּוּ וּשְׁפַל רוּחַ יִתְמֹךְ כָּבֽוֹד׃
translation: A man's pride brings him low, but one of lowly spirit gains honor. (Proverbs 29:23)

text: וְאַתָּה בֶן אָדָם שָׂא עַל צֹר קִינָֽה׃
translation: "You, son of man, take up a lamentation over Tyre; (Ezekiel 27:2)

text: וְאַתָּה שָׂא קִינָה אֶל נְשִׂיאֵי יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
translation: "Moreover, take up a lamentation for the princes of Israel, (Ezekiel 19:1)

text: שִׁמְעוּ אֶת הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי נֹשֵׂא עֲלֵיכֶם קִינָה בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
translation: Listen to this word which I take up for a lamentation over you, O house of Israel: (Amos 5:1)

text: וַיִּפְרֹשׂ אוֹתָהּ לְפָנַי וְהִיא כְתוּבָה פָּנִים וְאָחוֹר וְכָתוּב אֵלֶיהָ קִנִים וָהֶגֶה וָהִֽי׃
translation: He spread it before me. It was written within and without; and lamentations, mourning, and woe were written in it. (Ezekiel 2:10)

text: וַתֵּצֵא אֵשׁ מִמַּטֵּה בַדֶּיהָ פִּרְיָהּ אָכָלָה וְלֹא הָיָה בָהּ מַטֵּה עֹז שֵׁבֶט לִמְשׁוֹל קִינָה הִיא וַתְּהִי לְקִינָֽה׃
translation: Fire has gone out of its branches. It has devoured its fruit, so that there is in it no strong branch to be a scepter to rule.' This is a lamentation, and shall be for a lamentation." (Ezekiel 19:14)

text: בֶּן אָדָם שָׂא קִינָה עַל מֶלֶךְ צוֹר וְאָמַרְתָּ לּוֹ כֹּה אָמַר אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה אַתָּה חוֹתֵם תָּכְנִית מָלֵא חָכְמָה וּכְלִיל יֹֽפִי׃
translation: "Son of man, take up a lamentation over the king of Tyre, and tell him, 'The Lord GOD says: "You were the seal of full measure, full of wisdom, and perfect in beauty. (Ezekiel 28:12)

text: יַרְעֵם אֵל בְּקוֹלוֹ נִפְלָאוֹת עֹשֶׂה גְדֹלוֹת וְלֹא נֵדָֽע׃
translation: God thunders marvelously with his voice. He does great things, which we can't comprehend. (Job 37:5)

text: יַרְעֵם מִן שָׁמַיִם יְהוָה וְעֶלְיוֹן יִתֵּן קוֹלֽוֹ׃
translation: The LORD thundered from heaven. The Most High uttered his voice. (2 Samuel 22:14)

text: וְאִם זְרוֹעַ כָּאֵל לָךְ וּבְקוֹל כָּמֹהוּ תַרְעֵֽם׃
translation: Or do you have an arm like God? Can you thunder with a voice like him? (Job 40:9)

text: קוֹל רַעַמְךָ בַּגַּלְגַּל הֵאִירוּ בְרָקִים תֵּבֵל רָגְזָה וַתִּרְעַשׁ הָאָֽרֶץ׃
translation: Your way was through the sea, your paths through the great waters. Your footsteps were not known. (Psalms 77:19)

text: יִשְׂמְחוּ הַשָּׁמַיִם וְתָגֵל הָאָרֶץ יִֽרְעַם הַיָּם וּמְלֹאֽוֹ׃
translation: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice. Let the sea roar, and its fullness! (Psalms 96:11)

text: בְּדֵי שֹׁפָר יֹאמַר הֶאָח וּֽמֵרָחוֹק יָרִיחַ מִלְחָמָה רַעַם שָׂרִים וּתְרוּעָֽה׃
translation: As often as the trumpet sounds he snorts, 'Aha!' He smells the battle afar off, the thunder of the captains, and the shouting. (Job 39:25)

text: אַחַי בָּגְדוּ כְמוֹ נָחַל כַּאֲפִיק נְחָלִים יַעֲבֹֽרוּ׃
translation: My brothers have dealt deceitfully as a brook, as the channel of brooks that pass away; (Job 6:15)

text: שׁוֹפֵךְ בּוּז עַל נְדִיבִים וּמְזִיחַ אֲפִיקִים רִפָּֽה׃
translation: He pours contempt on princes, and loosens the belt of the strong. (Job 12:21)

text: שׁוּבָה יְהוָה אֶת שבותנו שְׁבִיתֵנוּ כַּאֲפִיקִים בַּנֶּֽגֶב׃
translation: Restore our fortunes again, LORD, like the streams in the Negev. (Psalms 126:4)

text: וְהִשְׁקֵיתִי אֶרֶץ צָפָתְךָ מִדָּמְךָ אֶל הֶֽהָרִים וַאֲפִקִים יִמָּלְאוּן מִמֶּֽךָּ׃
translation: I will also water the land in which you swim with your blood, even to the mountains. The watercourses will be full of you. (Ezekiel 32:6)

text: גַּאֲוָה אֲפִיקֵי מָֽגִנִּים סָגוּר חוֹתָם צָֽר׃
translation: Can you fill his skin with barbed irons, or his head with fish spears? (Job 41:7)

text: כְּאַיָּל תַּעֲרֹג עַל אֲפִֽיקֵי מָיִם כֵּן נַפְשִׁי תַעֲרֹג אֵלֶיךָ אֱלֹהִֽים׃
translation: My soul thirsts for God, for the living God. When shall I come and appear before God? (Psalms 42:2)

text: וַיְהִי לוֹ כֵּן וַיִּרְמְסוּ אֹתוֹ הָעָם בַּשַּׁעַר וַיָּמֹֽת׃
translation: It happened like that to him, for the people trampled over him in the gate, and he died. (2 Kings 7:20)

text: כִּי תָבֹאוּ לֵרָאוֹת פָּנָי מִי בִקֵּשׁ זֹאת מִיֶּדְכֶם רְמֹס חֲצֵרָֽי׃
translation: When you come to appear before me, who has required this at your hand, to trample my courts? (Isaiah 1:12)

text: תִּרְמְסֶנָּה רָגֶל רַגְלֵי עָנִי פַּעֲמֵי דַלִּֽים׃
translation: The foot shall tread it down, even the feet of the poor and the steps of the needy." (Isaiah 26:6)

text: יִֽרַדֹּף אוֹיֵב נַפְשִׁי וְיַשֵּׂג וְיִרְמֹס לָאָרֶץ חַיָּי וּכְבוֹדִי לֶעָפָר יַשְׁכֵּן סֶֽלָה׃
translation: Arise, LORD, in your anger. Lift up yourself against the rage of my adversaries. Awake for me. You have commanded judgment. (Psalms 7:6)

text: וַתִּגְדַּל עַד צְבָא הַשָּׁמָיִם וַתַּפֵּל אַרְצָה מִן הַצָּבָא וּמִן הַכּוֹכָבִים וַֽתִּרְמְסֵֽם׃
translation: It grew great, even to the army of the sky; and it cast down some of the army and of the stars to the ground and trampled on them. (Daniel 8:10)

text: יָגוּרוּ בָךְ נִדָּחַי מוֹאָב הֱוִי סֵתֶר לָמוֹ מִפְּנֵי שׁוֹדֵד כִּֽי אָפֵס הַמֵּץ כָּלָה שֹׁד תַּמּוּ רֹמֵס מִן הָאָֽרֶץ׃
translation: Let my outcasts dwell with you! As for Moab, be a hiding place for him from the face of the destroyer. For the extortionist is brought to nothing. Destruction ceases. The oppressors are consumed out of the land. (Isaiah 16:4)

text: כִּי טוֹב סַחְרָהּ מִסְּחַר כָּסֶף וּמֵחָרוּץ תְּבוּאָתָֽהּ׃
translation: For her good profit is better than getting silver, and her return is better than fine gold. (Proverbs 3:14)

text: קְחֽוּ מוּסָרִי וְאַל כָּסֶף וְדַעַת מֵחָרוּץ נִבְחָֽר׃
translation: Receive my instruction rather than silver, knowledge rather than choice gold. (Proverbs 8:10)

text: רָאשׁ עֹשֶׂה כַף רְמִיָּה וְיַד חָרוּצִים תַּעֲשִֽׁיר׃
translation: He becomes poor who works with a lazy hand, but the hand of the diligent brings wealth. (Proverbs 10:4)

text: קְֽנֹה חָכְמָה מַה טּוֹב מֵחָרוּץ וּקְנוֹת בִּינָה נִבְחָר מִכָּֽסֶף׃
translation: How much better it is to get wisdom than gold! Yes, to get understanding is to be chosen rather than silver. (Proverbs 16:16)

text: יַד חָרוּצִים תִּמְשׁוֹל ורְמִיָּה תִּהְיֶה לָמַֽס׃
translation: The hands of the diligent ones shall rule, but laziness ends in slave labor. (Proverbs 12:24)

text: בֶּן עֶשְׂרִים וּשְׁתַּיִם שָׁנָה אָמוֹן בְּמָלְכוֹ וּשְׁתַּיִם שָׁנִים מָלַךְ בִּירוּשָׁלִָם וְשֵׁם אִמּוֹ מְשֻׁלֶּמֶת בַּת חָרוּץ מִן יָטְבָֽה׃
translation: Amon was twenty-two years old when he began to reign; and he reigned two years in Jerusalem. His mother's name was Meshullemeth the daughter of Haruz of Jotbah. (2 Kings 21:19)

text: בַּחֲמִשָּׁה לַחֹדֶשׁ הִיא הַשָּׁנָה הַחֲמִישִׁית לְגָלוּת הַמֶּלֶךְ יוֹיָכִֽין׃
translation: In the fifth of the month, which was the fifth year of King Jehoiachin's captivity, (Ezekiel 1:2)

text: וַעֲבַדוּ בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵל כָּהֲנַיָּא וְלֵוָיֵא וּשְׁאָר בְּנֵי גָלוּתָא חֲנֻכַּת בֵּית אֱלָהָא דְנָה בְּחֶדְוָֽה׃
translation: The children of Israel, the priests, the Levites, and the rest of the children of the captivity, kept the dedication of this house of God with joy. (Ezra 6:16)

text: וַיְהִי בִּשְׁתֵּי עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה בָּעֲשִׂרִי בַּחֲמִשָּׁה לַחֹדֶשׁ לְגָלוּתֵנוּ בָּא אֵלַי הַפָּלִיט מִירוּשָׁלִַם לֵאמֹר הֻכְּתָה הָעִֽיר׃
translation: In the twelfth year of our captivity, in the tenth month, in the fifth day of the month, one who had escaped out of Jerusalem came to me, saying, "The city has been defeated!" (Ezekiel 33:21)

text: כֹּה אָמַר יְהוָה עַל שְׁלֹשָׁה פִּשְׁעֵי עַזָּה וְעַל אַרְבָּעָה לֹא אֲשִׁיבֶנּוּ עַל הַגְלוֹתָם גָּלוּת שְׁלֵמָה לְהַסְגִּיר לֶאֱדֽוֹם׃
translation: The LORD says: "For three transgressions of Gaza, yes, for four, I will not turn away its punishment, because they carried away captive the whole community, to deliver them up to Edom; (Amos 1:6)

text: וְגָלֻת הַֽחֵל הַזֶּה לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶֽׁר כְּנַעֲנִים עַד צָרְפַת וְגָלֻת יְרוּשָׁלִַם אֲשֶׁר בִּסְפָרַד יִֽרְשׁוּ אֵת עָרֵי הַנֶּֽגֶב׃
translation: The captives of this army of the children of Israel, who are among the Canaanites, will possess even to Zarephath; and the captives of Jerusalem, who are in Sepharad, will possess the cities of the Negev. (Obadiah 1:20)

text: כֵּן יִנְהַג מֶֽלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר אֶת שְׁבִי מִצְרַיִם וְאֶת גָּלוּת כּוּשׁ נְעָרִים וּזְקֵנִים עָרוֹם וְיָחֵף וַחֲשׂוּפַי שֵׁת עֶרְוַת מִצְרָֽיִם׃
translation: so the king of Assyria will lead away the captives of Egypt and the exiles of Ethiopia, young and old, naked and barefoot, and with buttocks uncovered, to the shame of Egypt. (Isaiah 20:4)

text: וְהַיּוֹשְׁבִים הָרִאשֹׁנִים אֲשֶׁר בַּאֲחֻזָּתָם בְּעָרֵיהֶם יִשְׂרָאֵל הַכֹּהֲנִים הַלְוִיִּם וְהַנְּתִינִֽים׃
translation: Now the first inhabitants who lived in their possessions in their cities were Israel, the priests, the Levites, and the temple servants. (1 Chronicles 9:2)

text: הַנְּתִינִים בְּנֵי צִיחָא בְנֵי חֲשׂוּפָא בְּנֵי טַבָּעֽוֹת׃
translation: The temple servants: the children of Ziha, the children of Hasupha, the children of Tabbaoth, (Ezra 2:43)

text: כָּל הַנְּתִינִים וּבְנֵי עַבְדֵי שְׁלֹמֹה שְׁלֹשׁ מֵאוֹת תִּשְׁעִים וּשְׁנָֽיִם׃
translation: All the temple servants, and the children of Solomon's servants, were three hundred ninety-two. (Ezra 2:58)

text: הַנְּתִינִים בְּנֵי צִחָא בְנֵי חֲשֻׂפָא בְּנֵי טַבָּעֽוֹת׃
translation: The temple servants: the children of Ziha, the children of Hasupha, the children of Tabbaoth, (Nehemiah 7:46)

text: כָּל הַנְּתִינִים וּבְנֵי עַבְדֵי שְׁלֹמֹה שְׁלֹשׁ מֵאוֹת תִּשְׁעִים וּשְׁנָֽיִם׃
translation: All the temple servants and the children of Solomon's servants were three hundred ninety-two. (Nehemiah 7:60)

text: וַיֵּשְׁבוּ הַכֹּהֲנִים וְהַלְוִיִּם וּֽמִן הָעָם וְהַמְשֹׁרְרִים וְהַשּׁוֹעֲרִים וְהַנְּתִינִים בְּעָרֵיהֶם וְכָל יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּעָרֵיהֶֽם׃
translation: So the priests and the Levites, with some of the people, the singers, the gatekeepers, and the temple servants, lived in their cities, and all Israel in their cities. (Ezra 2:70)

text: כָּל הַקָּהָל כְּאֶחָד אַרְבַּע רִבּוֹא אַלְפַּיִם שְׁלֹשׁ מֵאוֹת שִׁשִּֽׁים׃
translation: The whole assembly together was forty-two thousand three hundred sixty, (Ezra 2:64)

text: כָּל הַקָּהָל כְּאֶחָד אַרְבַּע רִבּוֹא אַלְפַּיִם שְׁלֹשׁ מֵאוֹת וְשִׁשִּֽׁים׃
translation: The whole assembly together was forty-two thousand three hundred sixty, (Nehemiah 7:66)

text: רֶכֶב אֱלֹהִים רִבֹּתַיִם אַלְפֵי שִׁנְאָן אֲדֹנָי בָם סִינַי בַּקֹּֽדֶשׁ׃
translation: You have ascended on high. You have led away captives. You have received gifts among people, yes, among the rebellious also, that the LORD God might dwell there. (Psalms 68:18)

text: וְנִשָּׂא הֶהָמוֹן ירום וְרָם לְבָבוֹ וְהִפִּיל רִבֹּאוֹת וְלֹא יָעֽוֹז׃
translation: The multitude will be carried off, and his heart will be exalted. He will cast down tens of thousands, but he won't prevail. (Daniel 11:12)

text: אכתוב אֶכְתָּב לוֹ רבו רֻבֵּי תּֽוֹרָתִי כְּמוֹ זָר נֶחְשָֽׁבוּ׃
translation: I wrote for him the many things of my law, but they were regarded as a strange thing. (Hosea 8:12)

text: וּמֵֽרָאשֵׁי הָֽאָבוֹת נָֽתְנוּ לְאוֹצַר הַמְּלָאכָה זָהָב דַּרְכְּמוֹנִים שְׁתֵּי רִבּוֹת וְכֶסֶף מָנִים אַלְפַּיִם וּמָאתָֽיִם׃
translation: Some from among the heads of fathers' households gave to the work. The governor gave to the treasury one thousand darics of gold, fifty basins, and five hundred thirty priests' garments. (Nehemiah 7:70)

text: וְהוּא יִשְׁפֹּֽט תֵּבֵל בְּצֶדֶק יָדִין לְאֻמִּים בְּמֵישָׁרִֽים׃
translation: The LORD will also be a high tower for the oppressed; a high tower in times of trouble. (Psalms 9:9)

text: שִׁמְעוּ כִּֽי נְגִידִים אֲדַבֵּר וּמִפְתַּח שְׂפָתַי מֵישָׁרִֽים׃
translation: Hear, for I will speak excellent things. The opening of my lips is for right things. (Proverbs 8:6)

text: וְחִכֵּךְ כְּיֵין הַטּוֹב הוֹלֵךְ לְדוֹדִי לְמֵישָׁרִים דּוֹבֵב שִׂפְתֵי יְשֵׁנִֽים׃
translation: I am my beloved's. His desire is toward me. (Song of Solomon 7:10)

text: מִלְּפָנֶיךָ מִשְׁפָּטִי יֵצֵא עֵינֶיךָ תֶּחֱזֶינָה מֵישָׁרִֽים׃
translation: Let my sentence come out of your presence. Let your eyes look on equity. (Psalms 17:2)

text: כִּי אֶקַּח מוֹעֵד אֲנִי מֵישָׁרִים אֶשְׁפֹּֽט׃
translation: The earth and all its inhabitants quake. I firmly hold its pillars. Selah. (Psalms 75:3)

text: לָקַחַת מוּסַר הַשְׂכֵּל צֶדֶק וּמִשְׁפָּט וּמֵישָׁרִֽים׃
translation: to receive instruction in wise dealing, in righteousness, justice, and equity; (Proverbs 1:3)

text: וְהִשְׁתְּכַח בְּאַחְמְתָא בְּבִֽירְתָא דִּי בְּמָדַי מְדִינְתָּה מְגִלָּה חֲדָה וְכֵן כְּתִיב בְּגַוַּהּ דִּכְרוֹנָֽה׃
translation: A scroll was found at Achmetha, in the palace that is in the province of Media, and in it this was written for a record: (Ezra 6:2)

text: וַיָּשֶׂם פִּי כְּחֶרֶב חַדָּה בְּצֵל יָדוֹ הֶחְבִּיאָנִי וַיְשִׂימֵנִי לְחֵץ בָּרוּר בְּאַשְׁפָּתוֹ הִסְתִּירָֽנִי׃
translation: He has made my mouth like a sharp sword. He has hidden me in the shadow of his hand. He has made me a polished shaft. He has kept me close in his quiver. (Isaiah 49:2)

text: רְחוּם בְּעֵל טְעֵם וְשִׁמְשַׁי סָֽפְרָא כְּתַבוּ אִגְּרָה חֲדָה עַל יְרוּשְׁלֶם לְאַרְתַּחְשַׁשְׂתְּא מַלְכָּא כְּנֵֽמָא׃
translation: Rehum the chancellor and Shimshai the scribe wrote a letter against Jerusalem to Artaxerxes the king as follows. (Ezra 4:8)

text: נַפְשִׁי בְּתוֹךְ לְבָאִם אֶשְׁכְּבָה לֹהֲטִים בְּֽנֵי אָדָם שִׁנֵּיהֶם חֲנִית וְחִצִּים וּלְשׁוֹנָם חֶרֶב חַדָּֽה׃
translation: Be exalted, God, above the heavens! Let your glory be above all the earth! (Psalms 57:5)

text: עָנֵה מַלְכָּא וְאָמַר לְדָנִיֵּאל דִּי שְׁמֵהּ בֵּלְטְשַׁאצַּר האיתיך הַֽאִיתָךְ כָּהֵל לְהוֹדָעֻתַנִי חֶלְמָא דִֽי חֲזֵית וּפִשְׁרֵֽהּ׃
translation: The king answered Daniel, whose name was Belteshazzar, "Are you able to make known to me the dream which I have seen, and its interpretation?" (Daniel 2:26)

text: מְהוֹדְעִין אֲנַחְנָה לְמַלְכָּא דִּי הֵן קִרְיְתָא דָךְ תִּתְבְּנֵא וְשׁוּרַיָּה יִֽשְׁתַּכְלְלוּן לָקֳבֵל דְּנָה חֲלָק בַּעֲבַר נַהֲרָא לָא אִיתַי לָֽךְ׃
translation: We inform the king that if this city is built and the walls finished, then you will have no possession beyond the River. (Ezra 4:16)

text: עָנֵה נְבֻֽכַדְנֶצַּר וְאָמַר לְהוֹן הַצְדָּא שַׁדְרַךְ מֵישַׁךְ וַעֲבֵד נְגוֹ לֵֽאלָהַי לָא אִֽיתֵיכוֹן פָּֽלְחִין וּלְצֶלֶם דַּהֲבָא דִּי הֲקֵימֶת לָא סָֽגְדִֽין׃
translation: Nebuchadnezzar answered them, "Is it true, Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, that you don't serve my gods and you don't worship the golden image which I have set up? (Daniel 3:14)

text: וְהֵן לָא יְדִיעַ לֶהֱוֵא לָךְ מַלְכָּא דִּי לאלהיך לֵֽאלָהָךְ לָא איתינא אִיתַנָא פָֽלְחִין וּלְצֶלֶם דַּהֲבָא דִּי הֲקֵימְתָּ לָא נִסְגֻּֽד׃
translation: But if not, let it be known to you, O king, that we will not serve your gods or worship the golden image which you have set up." (Daniel 3:18)

text: וּמִלְּתָא דִֽי מַלְכָּה שָׁאֵל יַקִּירָה וְאָחֳרָן לָא אִיתַי דִּי יְחַוִּנַּהּ קֳדָם מַלְכָּא לָהֵן אֱלָהִין דִּי מְדָרְהוֹן עִם בִּשְׂרָא לָא אִיתֽוֹהִי׃
translation: It is a rare thing that the king requires, and there is no other who can show it before the king except the gods, whose dwelling is not with flesh." (Daniel 2:11)

text: וְיִתְאָו הַמֶּלֶךְ יָפְיֵךְ כִּי הוּא אֲדֹנַיִךְ וְהִשְׁתַּֽחֲוִי לֽוֹ׃
translation: The daughter of Tyre comes with a gift. The rich among the people entreat your favor. (Psalms 45:12)

text: שֶׁקֶר הַחֵן וְהֶבֶל הַיֹּפִי אִשָּׁה יִרְאַת יְהוָה הִיא תִתְהַלָּֽל׃
translation: Charm is deceitful, and beauty is vain; but a woman who fears the LORD, she shall be praised. (Proverbs 31:30)

text: וַתִּבְטְחִי בְיָפְיֵךְ וַתִּזְנִי עַל שְׁמֵךְ וַתִּשְׁפְּכִי אֶת תַּזְנוּתַיִךְ עַל כָּל עוֹבֵר לוֹ יֶֽהִי׃
translation: "'"But you trusted in your beauty, and played the prostitute because of your renown, and poured out your prostitution on everyone who passed by. It was his. (Ezekiel 16:15)

text: וַיֵּצֵא לָךְ שֵׁם בַּגּוֹיִם בְּיָפְיֵךְ כִּי כָּלִיל הוּא בַּֽהֲדָרִי אֲשֶׁר שַׂמְתִּי עָלַיִךְ נְאֻם אֲדֹנָי יְהוִֽה׃
translation: Your renown went out among the nations for your beauty; for it was perfect, through my majesty which I had put on you," says the Lord GOD. (Ezekiel 16:14)

text: גָּבַהּ לִבְּךָ בְּיָפְיֶךָ שִׁחַתָּ חָכְמָתְךָ עַל יִפְעָתֶךָ עַל אֶרֶץ הִשְׁלַכְתִּיךָ לִפְנֵי מְלָכִים נְתַתִּיךָ לְרַאֲוָה בָֽךְ׃
translation: Your heart was lifted up because of your beauty. You have corrupted your wisdom by reason of your splendor. I have cast you to the ground. I have laid you before kings, that they may see you. (Ezekiel 28:17)

text: אֶל כָּל רֹאשׁ דֶּרֶךְ בָּנִית רָֽמָתֵךְ וַתְּתַֽעֲבִי אֶת יָפְיֵךְ וַתְּפַשְּׂקִי אֶת רַגְלַיִךְ לְכָל עוֹבֵר וַתַּרְבִּי אֶת תזנתך תַּזְנוּתָֽיִךְ׃
translation: You have built your lofty place at the head of every way, and have made your beauty an abomination, and have opened your feet to everyone who passed by, and multiplied your prostitution. (Ezekiel 16:25)

text: הֲיֵשׁ בִּלְשׁוֹנִי עַוְלָה אִם חִכִּי לֹא יָבִין הַוּֽוֹת׃
translation: Is there injustice on my tongue? Can't my taste discern mischievous things? (Job 6:30)

text: הַוֺּת לְאָבִיו בֵּן כְּסִיל וְדֶלֶף טֹרֵד מִדְיְנֵי אִשָּֽׁה׃
translation: A foolish son is the calamity of his father. A wife's quarrels are a continual dripping. (Proverbs 19:13)

text: נָתְסוּ נְֽתִיבָתִי לְהַוָּתִי יֹעִילוּ לֹא עֹזֵר לָֽמוֹ׃
translation: They mar my path. They promote my destruction without anyone's help. (Job 30:13)

text: כִּי הוּא יַצִּֽילְךָ מִפַּח יָקוּשׁ מִדֶּבֶר הַוּֽוֹת׃
translation: For he will deliver you from the snare of the fowler, and from the deadly pestilence. (Psalms 91:3)

text: הַֽיְחָבְרְךָ כִּסֵּא הַוּוֹת יֹצֵר עָמָל עֲלֵי חֹֽק׃
translation: Shall the throne of wickedness have fellowship with you, which brings about mischief by statute? (Psalms 94:20)

text: צִדְקַת יְשָׁרִים תַּצִּילֵם וּבְהַוַּת בֹּגְדִים יִלָּכֵֽדוּ׃
translation: The righteousness of the upright shall deliver them, but the unfaithful will be trapped by evil desires. (Proverbs 11:6)

text: כִּי נָטוּ עָלֶיךָ רָעָה חָֽשְׁבוּ מְזִמָּה בַּל יוּכָֽלוּ׃
translation: For you will make them turn their back, when you aim drawn bows at their face. (Psalms 21:12)

text: ידעת יָדַעְתִּי כִּי כֹל תּוּכָל וְלֹא יִבָּצֵר מִמְּךָ מְזִמָּֽה׃
translation: "I know that you can do all things, and that no purpose of yours can be restrained. (Job 42:2)

text: רָשָׁע כְּגֹבַהּ אַפּוֹ בַּל יִדְרֹשׁ אֵין אֱלֹהִים כָּל מְזִמּוֹתָֽיו׃
translation: The wicked, in the pride of his face, has no room in his thoughts for God. (Psalms 10:4)

text: אֲֽנִי חָכְמָה שָׁכַנְתִּי עָרְמָה וְדַעַת מְזִמּוֹת אֶמְצָֽא׃
translation: "I, wisdom, have made prudence my dwelling. Find out knowledge and discretion. (Proverbs 8:12)

text: קְֽצַר אַפַּיִם יַעֲשֶׂה אִוֶּלֶת וְאִישׁ מְזִמּוֹת יִשָּׂנֵֽא׃
translation: He who is quick to become angry will commit folly, and a crafty man is hated. (Proverbs 14:17)

text: הֵן יָדַעְתִּי מַחְשְׁבֽוֹתֵיכֶם וּמְזִמּוֹת עָלַי תַּחְמֹֽסוּ׃
translation: "Behold, I know your thoughts, the plans with which you would wrong me. (Job 21:27)

text: וַתְּפוּצֶינָה מִבְּלִי רֹעֶה וַתִּהְיֶינָה לְאָכְלָה לְכָל חַיַּת הַשָּׂדֶה וַתְּפוּצֶֽינָה׃
translation: They were scattered, because there was no shepherd. They became food to all the animals of the field, and were scattered. (Ezekiel 34:5)

text: וְהָיְתָה שַׁבַּת הָאָרֶץ לָכֶם לְאָכְלָה לְךָ וּלְעַבְדְּךָ וְלַאֲמָתֶךָ וְלִשְׂכִֽירְךָ וּלְתוֹשָׁבְךָ הַגָּרִים עִמָּֽךְ׃
translation: The Sabbath of the land shall be for food for you; for yourself, for your servant, for your maid, for your hired servant, and for your stranger, who lives as a foreigner with you. (Leviticus 25:6)

text: וְאַתָּה קַח לְךָ מִכָּל מַֽאֲכָל אֲשֶׁר יֵֽאָכֵל וְאָסַפְתָּ אֵלֶיךָ וְהָיָה לְךָ וְלָהֶם לְאָכְלָֽה׃
translation: Take with you some of all food that is eaten, and gather it to yourself; and it will be for food for you, and for them." (Genesis 6:21)

text: וְכִי יָמוּת מִן הַבְּהֵמָה אֲשֶׁר הִיא לָכֶם לְאָכְלָה הַנֹּגֵעַ בְּנִבְלָתָהּ יִטְמָא עַד הָעָֽרֶב׃
translation: "'If any animal of which you may eat dies, he who touches its carcass shall be unclean until the evening. (Leviticus 11:39)

text: הִנֵּה לָאֵשׁ נִתַּן לְאָכְלָה אֵת שְׁנֵי קְצוֹתָיו אָכְלָה הָאֵשׁ וְתוֹכוֹ נָחָר הֲיִצְלַח לִמְלָאכָֽה׃
translation: Behold, it is cast into the fire for fuel; the fire has devoured both its ends, and the middle of it is burned. Is it profitable for any work? (Ezekiel 15:4)

text: כִּי נִאֵפוּ וְדָם בִּֽידֵיהֶן וְאֶת גִּלּֽוּלֵיהֶן נִאֵפוּ וְגַם אֶת בְּנֵיהֶן אֲשֶׁר יָֽלְדוּ לִי הֶעֱבִירוּ לָהֶם לְאָכְלָֽה׃
translation: For they have committed adultery, and blood is in their hands. They have committed adultery with their idols. They have also caused their sons, whom they bore to me, to pass through the fire to them to be devoured. (Ezekiel 23:37)

text: וַיִּקְחוּ הָֽאֲנָשִׁים מִצֵּידָם וְאֶת פִּי יְהוָה לֹא שָׁאָֽלוּ׃
translation: The men sampled their provisions, and didn't ask counsel from the LORD's mouth. (Joshua 9:14)

text: לֹא יַחֲרֹךְ רְמִיָּה צֵידוֹ וְהוֹן אָדָם יָקָר חָרֽוּץ׃
translation: The slothful man doesn't roast his game, but the possessions of diligent men are prized. (Proverbs 12:27)

text: צֵידָהּ בָּרֵךְ אֲבָרֵךְ אֶבְיוֹנֶיהָ אַשְׂבִּיעַֽ לָֽחֶם׃
translation: I will abundantly bless her provision. I will satisfy her poor with bread. (Psalms 132:15)

text: וַיֶּאֱהַב יִצְחָק אֶת עֵשָׂו כִּי צַיִד בְּפִיו וְרִבְקָה אֹהֶבֶת אֶֽת יַעֲקֹֽב׃
translation: Now Isaac loved Esau, because he ate his venison. Rebekah loved Jacob. (Genesis 25:28)

text: מִי יָכִין לָעֹרֵב צֵידוֹ כִּֽי ילדו יְלָדָיו אֶל אֵל יְשַׁוֵּעוּ יִתְעוּ לִבְלִי אֹֽכֶל׃
translation: Who provides for the raven his prey, when his young ones cry to God, and wander for lack of food? (Job 38:41)

text: הֽוּא הָיָה גִבֹּֽר צַיִד לִפְנֵי יְהוָה עַל כֵּן יֵֽאָמַר כְּנִמְרֹד גִּבּוֹר צַיִד לִפְנֵי יְהוָֽה׃
translation: He was a mighty hunter before the LORD. Therefore it is said, "like Nimrod, a mighty hunter before the LORD". (Genesis 10:9)

text: פָּתוֹת אֹתָהּ פִּתִּים וְיָצַקְתָּ עָלֶיהָ שָׁמֶן מִנְחָה הִֽוא׃
translation: You shall cut it in pieces, and pour oil on it. It is a meal offering. (Leviticus 2:6)

text: וְאֹכַל פִּתִּי לְבַדִּי וְלֹא אָכַל יָתוֹם מִמֶּֽנָּה׃
translation: or have eaten my morsel alone, and the fatherless has not eaten of it (Job 31:17)

text: מַשְׁלִיךְ קַֽרְחוֹ כְפִתִּים לִפְנֵי קָרָתוֹ מִי יַעֲמֹֽד׃
translation: He hurls down his hail like pebbles. Who can stand before his cold? (Psalms 147:17)

text: הַֽכֵּר פָּנִים לֹא טוֹב וְעַל פַּת לֶחֶם יִפְשַׁע גָּֽבֶר׃
translation: To show partiality is not good, yet a man will do wrong for a piece of bread. (Proverbs 28:21)

text: וְאֹכְלֵי פַת בָּגוֹ יִשְׁבְּרוּהוּ וְחֵילוֹ יִשְׁטוֹף וְנָפְלוּ חֲלָלִים רַבִּֽים׃
translation: Yes, those who eat of his delicacies will destroy him, and his army will be swept away. Many will fall down slain. (Daniel 11:26)

text: וַתֵּלֶךְ לָקַחַת וַיִּקְרָא אֵלֶיהָ וַיֹּאמַר לִֽקְחִי נָא לִי פַּת לֶחֶם בְּיָדֵֽךְ׃
translation: As she was going to get it, he called to her and said, "Please bring me a morsel of bread in your hand." (1 Kings 17:11)

text: וַתֹּאמֶר שְׁתֵה אֲדֹנִי וַתְּמַהֵר וַתֹּרֶד כַּדָּהּ עַל יָדָהּ וַתַּשְׁקֵֽהוּ׃
translation: She said, "Drink, my lord." She hurried, and let down her pitcher on her hand, and gave him a drink. (Genesis 24:18)

text: וְהַֽנַּעֲרָ טֹבַת מַרְאֶה מְאֹד בְּתוּלָה וְאִישׁ לֹא יְדָעָהּ וַתֵּרֶד הָעַיְנָה וַתְּמַלֵּא כַדָּהּ וַתָּֽעַל׃
translation: The young lady was very beautiful to look at, a virgin. No man had known her. She went down to the spring, filled her pitcher, and came up. (Genesis 24:16)

text: וַתְּמַהֵר וַתּוֹרֶד כַּדָּהּ מֵֽעָלֶיהָ וַתֹּאמֶר שְׁתֵה וְגַם גְּמַלֶּיךָ אַשְׁקֶה וָאֵשְׁתְּ וְגַם הַגְּמַלִּים הִשְׁקָֽתָה׃
translation: She hurried and let down her pitcher from her shoulder, and said, 'Drink, and I will also give your camels a drink.' So I drank, and she also gave the camels a drink. (Genesis 24:46)

text: הִנֵּה אָנֹכִי נִצָּב עַל עֵין הַמָּיִם וְהָיָה הָֽעַלְמָה הַיֹּצֵאת לִשְׁאֹב וְאָמַרְתִּי אֵלֶיהָ הַשְׁקִֽינִי נָא מְעַט מַיִם מִכַּדֵּֽךְ׃
translation: behold, I am standing by this spring of water. Let it happen, that the maiden who comes out to draw, to whom I will say, "Please give me a little water from your pitcher to drink," (Genesis 24:43)

text: וַֽיִּתְקְעוּ שְׁלֹשֶׁת הָרָאשִׁים בַּשּֽׁוֹפָרוֹת וַיִּשְׁבְּרוּ הַכַּדִּים וַיַּחֲזִיקוּ בְיַד שְׂמאוֹלָם בַּלַּפִּדִים וּבְיַד יְמִינָם הַשּׁוֹפָרוֹת לִתְקוֹעַ וַֽיִּקְרְאוּ חֶרֶב לַֽיהוָה וּלְגִדְעֽוֹן׃
translation: The three companies blew the trumpets, broke the pitchers, and held the torches in their left hands and the trumpets in their right hands with which to blow; and they shouted, "The sword of the LORD and of Gideon!" (Judges 7:20)

text: עַד אֲשֶׁר לֹֽא ירחק יֵרָתֵק חֶבֶל הַכֶּסֶף וְתָרֻץ גֻּלַּת הַזָּהָב וְתִשָּׁבֶר כַּד עַל הַמַּבּוּעַ וְנָרֹץ הַגַּלְגַּל אֶל הַבּֽוֹר׃
translation: before the silver cord is severed, or the golden bowl is broken, or the pitcher is broken at the spring, or the wheel broken at the cistern, (Ecclesiastes 12:6)

text: לֹֽא אִירָא מֵרִבְבוֹת עָם אֲשֶׁר סָבִיב שָׁתוּ עָלָֽי׃
translation: Arise, LORD! Save me, my God! For you have struck all of my enemies on the cheek bone. You have broken the teeth of the wicked. (Psalms 3:7)

text: יִפֹּל מִצִּדְּךָ אֶלֶף וּרְבָבָה מִימִינֶךָ אֵלֶיךָ לֹא יִגָּֽשׁ׃
translation: A thousand may fall at your side, and ten thousand at your right hand; but it will not come near you. (Psalms 91:7)

text: וּבְנֻחֹה יֹאמַר שׁוּבָה יְהוָה רִֽבְבוֹת אַלְפֵי יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
translation: When it rested, he said, "Return, LORD, to the ten thousands of the thousands of Israel." (Numbers 10:36)

text: וַֽתַּעֲנֶינָה הַנָּשִׁים הַֽמְשַׂחֲקוֹת וַתֹּאמַרְןָ הִכָּה שָׁאוּל באלפו בַּאֲלָפָיו וְדָוִד בְּרִבְבֹתָֽיו׃
translation: The women sang to one another as they played, and said, "Saul has slain his thousands, and David his ten thousands." (1 Samuel 18:7)

text: דּוֹדִי צַח וְאָדוֹם דָּגוּל מֵרְבָבָֽה׃
translation: My beloved is white and ruddy. The best among ten thousand. (Song of Solomon 5:10)

text: וְרָדְפוּ מִכֶּם חֲמִשָּׁה מֵאָה וּמֵאָה מִכֶּם רְבָבָה יִרְדֹּפוּ וְנָפְלוּ אֹיְבֵיכֶם לִפְנֵיכֶם לֶחָֽרֶב׃
translation: Five of you shall chase a hundred, and a hundred of you shall chase ten thousand; and your enemies shall fall before you by the sword. (Leviticus 26:8)

text: פֵּרַשְׂתִּי יָדַי אֵלֶיךָ נַפְשִׁי כְּאֶֽרֶץ עֲיֵפָה לְךָ סֶֽלָה׃
translation: I spread out my hands to you. My soul thirsts for you, like a parched land. Selah. (Psalms 143:6)

text: וַיָּבֹא הַמֶּלֶךְ וְכָל הָעָם אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ עֲיֵפִים וַיִּנָּפֵשׁ שָֽׁם׃
translation: The king and all the people who were with him arrived weary; and he refreshed himself there. (2 Samuel 16:14)

text: לֹא מַיִם עָיֵף תַּשְׁקֶה וּמֵרָעֵב תִּֽמְנַֽע לָֽחֶם׃
translation: You haven't given water to the weary to drink, and you have withheld bread from the hungry. (Job 22:7)

text: וַיָּבֹא גִדְעוֹן הַיַּרְדֵּנָה עֹבֵר הוּא וּשְׁלֹשׁ מֵאוֹת הָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ עֲיֵפִים וְרֹדְפִֽים׃
translation: Gideon came to the Jordan and passed over, he and the three hundred men who were with him, faint, yet pursuing. (Judges 8:4)

text: אֱלֹהִים אֵלִי אַתָּה אֲֽשַׁחֲרֶךָּ צָמְאָה לְךָ נַפְשִׁי כָּמַהּ לְךָ בְשָׂרִי בְּאֶֽרֶץ צִיָּה וְעָיֵף בְּלִי מָֽיִם׃
translation: So I have seen you in the sanctuary, watching your power and your glory. (Psalms 63:2)

text: אֵין עָיֵף וְאֵין כּוֹשֵׁל בּוֹ לֹא יָנוּם וְלֹא יִישָׁן וְלֹא נִפְתַּח אֵזוֹר חֲלָצָיו וְלֹא נִתַּק שְׂרוֹךְ נְעָלָֽיו׃
translation: No one shall be weary nor stumble among them; no one shall slumber nor sleep, neither shall the belt of their waist be untied, nor the strap of their sandals be broken, (Isaiah 5:27)

text: וַתֵּכַהּ מִכַּעַשׂ עֵינִי וִֽיצֻרַי כַּצֵּל כֻּלָּֽם׃
translation: My eye also is dim by reason of sorrow. All my members are as a shadow. (Job 17:7)

text: וַֽיְהִי בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא וְעֵלִי שֹׁכֵב בִּמְקֹמוֹ ועינו וְעֵינָיו הֵחֵלּוּ כֵהוֹת לֹא יוּכַל לִרְאֽוֹת׃
translation: At that time, when Eli was laid down in his place (now his eyes had begun to grow dim, so that he could not see), (1 Samuel 3:2)

text: וַיְהִי כִּֽי זָקֵן יִצְחָק וַתִּכְהֶיןָ עֵינָיו מֵרְאֹת וַיִּקְרָא אֶת עֵשָׂו בְּנוֹ הַגָּדֹל וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו בְּנִי וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו הִנֵּֽנִי׃
translation: When Isaac was old, and his eyes were dim, so that he could not see, he called Esau his elder son, and said to him, "My son?" He said to him, "Here I am." (Genesis 27:1)

text: וְאִם יִרְאֶנָּה הַכֹּהֵן וְהִנֵּה אֵֽין בָּהּ שֵׂעָר לָבָן וּשְׁפָלָה אֵינֶנָּה מִן הָעוֹר וְהִיא כֵהָה וְהִסְגִּירוֹ הַכֹּהֵן שִׁבְעַת יָמִֽים׃
translation: But if the priest examines it, and behold, there are no white hairs in it, and it isn't deeper than the skin, but is dim, then the priest shall isolate him seven days. (Leviticus 13:21)

text: אֵין כֵּהָה לְשִׁבְרֶךָ נַחְלָה מַכָּתֶךָ כֹּל שֹׁמְעֵי שִׁמְעֲךָ תָּקְעוּ כַף עָלֶיךָ כִּי עַל מִי לֹֽא עָבְרָה רָעָתְךָ תָּמִֽיד׃
translation: There is no healing your wound, for your injury is fatal. All who hear the report of you clap their hands over you, for who hasn't felt your endless cruelty? (Nahum 3:19)

text: הוֹי רֹעִי הָֽאֱלִיל עֹזְבִי הַצֹּאן חֶרֶב עַל זְרוֹעוֹ וְעַל עֵין יְמִינוֹ זְרֹעוֹ יָבוֹשׁ תִּיבָשׁ וְעֵין יְמִינוֹ כָּהֹה תִכְהֶֽה׃
translation: Woe to the worthless shepherd who leaves the flock! The sword will strike his arm and his right eye. His arm will be completely withered, and his right eye will be totally blinded!" (Zechariah 11:17)

text: הֲתָצוּד לְלָבִיא טָרֶף וְחַיַּת כְּפִירִים תְּמַלֵּֽא׃
translation: "Can you hunt the prey for the lioness, or satisfy the appetite of the young lions, (Job 38:39)

text: אִישׁ לָשׁוֹן בַּל יִכּוֹן בָּאָרֶץ אִישׁ חָמָס רָע יְצוּדֶנּוּ לְמַדְחֵפֹֽת׃
translation: I know that the LORD will maintain the cause of the afflicted, and justice for the needy. (Psalms 140:12)

text: צוֹד צָדוּנִי כַּצִּפּוֹר אֹיְבַי חִנָּֽם׃
translation: They have chased me relentlessly like a bird, those who are my enemies without cause. (Lamentations 3:52)

text: צָדוּ צְעָדֵינוּ מִלֶּכֶת בִּרְחֹבֹתֵינוּ קָרַב קִצֵּינוּ מָלְאוּ יָמֵינוּ כִּי בָא קִצֵּֽינוּ׃
translation: They hunt our steps, so that we can't go in our streets. Our end is near. Our days are fulfilled, for our end has come. (Lamentations 4:18)

text: כִּי בְעַד אִשָּׁה זוֹנָה עַֽד כִּכַּר לָחֶם וְאֵשֶׁת אִישׁ נֶפֶשׁ יְקָרָה תָצֽוּד׃
translation: For a prostitute reduces you to a piece of bread. The adulteress hunts for your precious life. (Proverbs 6:26)

text: וְרִבְקָה שֹׁמַעַת בְּדַבֵּר יִצְחָק אֶל עֵשָׂו בְּנוֹ וַיֵּלֶךְ עֵשָׂו הַשָּׂדֶה לָצוּד צַיִד לְהָבִֽיא׃
translation: Rebekah heard when Isaac spoke to Esau his son. Esau went to the field to hunt for venison, and to bring it. (Genesis 27:5)

text: וְעַל כָּל אֳנִיּוֹת תַּרְשִׁישׁ וְעַל כָּל שְׂכִיּוֹת הַחֶמְדָּֽה׃
translation: for all the ships of Tarshish, and for all pleasant imagery. (Isaiah 2:16)

text: וַֽיִּמְאֲסוּ בְּאֶרֶץ חֶמְדָּה לֹֽא הֶאֱמִינוּ לִדְבָרֽוֹ׃
translation: Yes, they despised the pleasant land. They didn't believe his word, (Psalms 106:24)

text: בֹּזּוּ כֶסֶף בֹּזּוּ זָהָב וְאֵין קֵצֶה לַתְּכוּנָה כָּבֹד מִכֹּל כְּלִי חֶמְדָּֽה׃
translation: She is empty, void, and waste. The heart melts, the knees knock together, their bodies and faces have grown pale. (Nahum 2:10)

text: הֵילִילוּ הָרֹעִים וְזַעֲקוּ וְהִֽתְפַּלְּשׁוּ אַדִּירֵי הַצֹּאן כִּֽי מָלְאוּ יְמֵיכֶם לִטְבוֹחַ וּתְפוֹצוֹתִיכֶם וּנְפַלְתֶּם כִּכְלִי חֶמְדָּֽה׃
translation: Wail, you shepherds, and cry. Wallow in dust, you leader of the flock; for the days of your slaughter and of your dispersions have fully come, and you will fall like fine pottery. (Jeremiah 25:34)

text: וְשָׁלְלוּ חֵילֵךְ וּבָֽזְזוּ רְכֻלָּתֵךְ וְהָֽרְסוּ חוֹמוֹתַיִךְ וּבָתֵּי חֶמְדָּתֵךְ יִתֹּצוּ וַאֲבָנַיִךְ וְעֵצַיִךְ וַֽעֲפָרֵךְ בְּתוֹךְ מַיִם יָשִֽׂימוּ׃
translation: They will make a plunder of your riches and make a prey of your merchandise. They will break down your walls and destroy your pleasant houses. They will lay your stones, your timber, and your dust in the middle of the waters. (Ezekiel 26:12)

text: וַתִּקַּח רִבְקָה אֶת בִּגְדֵי עֵשָׂו בְּנָהּ הַגָּדֹל הַחֲמֻדֹת אֲשֶׁר אִתָּהּ בַּבָּיִת וַתַּלְבֵּשׁ אֶֽת יַעֲקֹב בְּנָהּ הַקָּטָֽן׃
translation: Rebekah took the good clothes of Esau, her elder son, which were with her in the house, and put them on Jacob, her younger son. (Genesis 27:15)

text: אָכֵן רֽוּחַ הִיא בֶאֱנוֹשׁ וְנִשְׁמַת שַׁדַּי תְּבִינֵֽם׃
translation: But there is a spirit in man, and the Spirit of the Almighty gives them understanding. (Job 32:8)

text: אָכֵן אַתָּה אֵל מִסְתַּתֵּר אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מוֹשִֽׁיעַ׃
translation: Most certainly you are a God who has hidden yourself, God of Israel, the Savior.'" (Isaiah 45:15)

text: אָכֵן שָׁמַע אֱלֹהִים הִקְשִׁיב בְּקוֹל תְּפִלָּתִֽי׃
translation: But most certainly, God has listened. He has heard the voice of my prayer. (Psalms 66:19)

text: אָכֵן כְּאָדָם תְּמוּתוּן וּכְאַחַד הַשָּׂרִים תִּפֹּֽלוּ׃
translation: Nevertheless you shall die like men, and fall like one of the rulers." (Psalms 82:7)

text: אָכֵן לַשֶּׁקֶר מִגְּבָעוֹת הָמוֹן הָרִים אָכֵן בַּיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ תְּשׁוּעַת יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
translation: Truly help from the hills, the tumult on the mountains, is in vain. Truly the salvation of Israel is in the LORD our God. (Jeremiah 3:23)

text: אָכֵן בָּגְדָה אִשָּׁה מֵרֵעָהּ כֵּן בְּגַדְתֶּם בִּי בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל נְאֻם יְהוָֽה׃
translation: "Surely as a wife treacherously departs from her husband, so you have dealt treacherously with me, house of Israel," says the LORD. (Jeremiah 3:20)

text: וָֽאֶגְדַּע אֶת מַקְלִי הַשֵּׁנִי אֵת הַחֹֽבְלִים לְהָפֵר אֶת הָֽאַחֲוָה בֵּין יְהוּדָה וּבֵין יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
translation: Then I cut apart my other staff, Union, that I might break the brotherhood between Judah and Israel. (Zechariah 11:14)

text: וַיְהִי דְבַר יְהוָה אֵלַי לֵאמֹר מָה אַתָּה רֹאֶה יִרְמְיָהוּ וָאֹמַר מַקֵּל שָׁקֵד אֲנִי רֹאֶֽה׃
translation: Moreover the LORD's word came to me, saying, "Jeremiah, what do you see?" I said, "I see a branch of an almond tree." (Jeremiah 1:11)

text: נֻדוּ לוֹ כָּל סְבִיבָיו וְכֹל יֹדְעֵי שְׁמוֹ אִמְרוּ אֵיכָה נִשְׁבַּר מַטֵּה עֹז מַקֵּל תִּפְאָרָֽה׃
translation: All you who are around him, bemoan him; and all you who know his name, say, 'How the strong staff is broken, the beautiful rod!' (Jeremiah 48:17)

text: וְכָכָה תֹּאכְלוּ אֹתוֹ מָתְנֵיכֶם חֲגֻרִים נַֽעֲלֵיכֶם בְּרַגְלֵיכֶם וּמַקֶּלְכֶם בְּיֶדְכֶם וַאֲכַלְתֶּם אֹתוֹ בְּחִפָּזוֹן פֶּסַח הוּא לַיהוָֽה׃
translation: This is how you shall eat it: with your belt on your waist, your sandals on your feet, and your staff in your hand; and you shall eat it in haste: it is the LORD's Passover. (Exodus 12:11)

text: וַתֵּרֶא הָֽאָתוֹן אֶת מַלְאַךְ יְהוָה וַתִּרְבַּץ תַּחַת בִּלְעָם וַיִּֽחַר אַף בִּלְעָם וַיַּךְ אֶת הָאָתוֹן בַּמַּקֵּֽל׃
translation: The donkey saw the LORD's angel, and she lay down under Balaam. Balaam's anger burned, and he struck the donkey with his staff. (Numbers 22:27)

text: וָאֶקַּח אֶת מַקְלִי אֶת נֹעַם וָאֶגְדַּע אֹתוֹ לְהָפֵיר אֶת בְּרִיתִי אֲשֶׁר כָּרַתִּי אֶת כָּל הָעַמִּֽים׃
translation: I took my staff Favor and cut it apart, that I might break my covenant that I had made with all the peoples. (Zechariah 11:10)

text: בַּחֹדֶשׁ הַשְּׁלִשִׁי הֵחֵלּוּ הָעֲרֵמוֹת לְיִסּוֹד וּבַחֹדֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִי כִּלּֽוּ׃
translation: In the third month, they began to lay the foundation of the heaps, and finished them in the seventh month. (2 Chronicles 31:7)

text: לֵץ תַּכֶּה וּפֶתִי יַעְרִם וְהוֹכִיחַ לְנָבוֹן יָבִין דָּֽעַת׃
translation: Flog a scoffer, and the simple will learn prudence; rebuke one who has understanding, and he will gain knowledge. (Proverbs 19:25)

text: וַיִּדְרֹשׁ יְחִזְקִיָּהוּ עַל הַכֹּֽהֲנִים וְהַלְוִיִּם עַל הָעֲרֵמֽוֹת׃
translation: Then Hezekiah questioned the priests and the Levites about the heaps. (2 Chronicles 31:9)

text: עַֽל עַמְּךָ יַעֲרִימוּ סוֹד וְיִתְיָעֲצוּ עַל צְפוּנֶֽיךָ׃
