translation: "Come," they say, "let's destroy them as a nation, that the name of Israel may be remembered no more." (Psalms 83:4)

text: אֱוִיל יִנְאַץ מוּסַר אָבִיו וְשֹׁמֵר תּוֹכַחַת יַעְרִֽם׃
translation: A fool despises his father's correction, but he who heeds reproof shows prudence. (Proverbs 15:5)

text: לֹכֵד חֲכָמִים בְּעָרְמָם וַעֲצַת נִפְתָּלִים נִמְהָֽרָה׃
translation: He takes the wise in their own craftiness; the counsel of the cunning is carried headlong. (Job 5:13)

text: עָרוֹם הִלְּכוּ בְּלִי לְבוּשׁ וּרְעֵבִים נָשְׂאוּ עֹֽמֶר׃
translation: so that they go around naked without clothing. Being hungry, they carry the sheaves. (Job 24:10)

text: וְהֵנִיף אֶת הָעֹמֶר לִפְנֵי יְהוָה לִֽרְצֹנְכֶם מִֽמָּחֳרַת הַשַּׁבָּת יְנִיפֶנּוּ הַכֹּהֵֽן׃
translation: He shall wave the sheaf before the LORD, to be accepted for you. On the next day after the Sabbath the priest shall wave it. (Leviticus 23:11)

text: שֶׁלֹּא מִלֵּא כַפּוֹ קוֹצֵר וְחִצְנוֹ מְעַמֵּֽר׃
translation: with which the reaper doesn't fill his hand, nor he who binds sheaves, his bosom. (Psalms 129:7)

text: וַעֲשִׂיתֶם בְּיוֹם הֲנִֽיפְכֶם אֶת הָעֹמֶר כֶּבֶשׂ תָּמִים בֶּן שְׁנָתוֹ לְעֹלָה לַיהוָֽה׃
translation: On the day when you wave the sheaf, you shall offer a male lamb without defect a year old for a burnt offering to the LORD. (Leviticus 23:12)

text: וְהָעֹמֶר עֲשִׂרִית הָאֵיפָה הֽוּא׃
translation: Now an omer is one tenth of an ephah. (Exodus 16:36)

text: וּסְפַרְתֶּם לָכֶם מִמָּחֳרַת הַשַּׁבָּת מִיּוֹם הֲבִיאֲכֶם אֶת עֹמֶר הַתְּנוּפָה שֶׁבַע שַׁבָּתוֹת תְּמִימֹת תִּהְיֶֽינָה׃
translation: "'You shall count from the next day after the Sabbath, from the day that you brought the sheaf of the wave offering: seven Sabbaths shall be completed. (Leviticus 23:15)

text: וְזֶה מַעֲשֵׂה הַמְּכוֹנָה מִסְגְּרֹת לָהֶם וּמִסְגְּרֹת בֵּין הַשְׁלַבִּֽים׃
translation: The work of the bases was like this: they had panels; and there were panels between the ledges; (1 Kings 7:28)

text: לְעֻמַּת הַמִּסְגֶּרֶת תִּהְיֶיןָ הַטַּבָּעֹת לְבָתִּים לְבַדִּים לָשֵׂאת אֶת הַשֻּׁלְחָֽן׃
translation: The rings shall be close to the rim, for places for the poles to carry the table. (Exodus 25:27)

text: לְעֻמַּת הַמִּסְגֶּרֶת הָיוּ הַטַּבָּעֹת בָּתִּים לַבַּדִּים לָשֵׂאת אֶת הַשֻּׁלְחָֽן׃
translation: The rings were close by the border, the places for the poles to carry the table. (Exodus 37:14)

text: בְּנֵי נֵכָר יִבֹּלוּ וְיַחְגְּרוּ מִמִּסְגְּרוֹתָֽם׃
translation: The foreigners will fade away, and will come trembling out of their close places. (2 Samuel 22:46)

text: בְּנֵי נֵכָר יִבֹּלוּ וְיַחְרְגוּ מִֽמִּסְגְּרֽוֹתֵיהֶֽם׃
translation: The LORD lives! Blessed be my rock. Exalted be the God of my salvation, (Psalms 18:46)

text: וְאַרְבַּעַת הָאֽוֹפַנִּים לְמִתַּחַת לַֽמִּסְגְּרוֹת וִידוֹת הָאֽוֹפַנִּים בַּמְּכוֹנָה וְקוֹמַת הָאוֹפַן הָאֶחָד אַמָּה וַחֲצִי הָאַמָּֽה׃
translation: The four wheels were underneath the panels; and the axles of the wheels were in the base. The height of a wheel was a cubit and half a cubit. (1 Kings 7:32)

text: וְשֶׁקֶץ יִהְיוּ לָכֶם מִבְּשָׂרָם לֹא תֹאכֵלוּ וְאֶת נִבְלָתָם תְּשַׁקֵּֽצוּ׃
translation: and you shall detest them. You shall not eat of their meat, and you shall detest their carcasses. (Leviticus 11:11)

text: כֹּל שֶׁרֶץ הָעוֹף הַהֹלֵךְ עַל אַרְבַּע שֶׁקֶץ הוּא לָכֶֽם׃
translation: "'All flying insects that walk on all fours are an abomination to you. (Leviticus 11:20)

text: וְכָל הַשֶּׁרֶץ הַשֹּׁרֵץ עַל הָאָרֶץ שֶׁקֶץ הוּא לֹא יֵאָכֵֽל׃
translation: "'Every creeping thing that creeps on the earth is an abomination. It shall not be eaten. (Leviticus 11:41)

text: וְכֹל שֶׁרֶץ הָעוֹף אֲשֶׁר לוֹ אַרְבַּע רַגְלָיִם שֶׁקֶץ הוּא לָכֶֽם׃
translation: But all winged creeping things which have four feet are an abomination to you. (Leviticus 11:23)

text: אַל תְּשַׁקְּצוּ אֶת נַפְשֹׁתֵיכֶם בְּכָל הַשֶּׁרֶץ הַשֹּׁרֵץ וְלֹא תִֽטַּמְּאוּ בָּהֶם וְנִטְמֵתֶם בָּֽם׃
translation: You shall not make yourselves abominable with any creeping thing that creeps. You shall not make yourselves unclean with them, that you should be defiled by them. (Leviticus 11:43)

text: כִּי לֹֽא בָזָה וְלֹא שִׁקַּץ עֱנוּת עָנִי וְלֹא הִסְתִּיר פָּנָיו מִמֶּנּוּ וּֽבְשַׁוְּעוֹ אֵלָיו שָׁמֵֽעַ׃
translation: My praise of you comes in the great assembly. I will pay my vows before those who fear him. (Psalms 22:25)

text: מְקוֹר חַיִּים פִּי צַדִּיק וּפִי רְשָׁעִים יְכַסֶּה חָמָֽס׃
translation: The mouth of the righteous is a spring of life, but violence covers the mouth of the wicked. (Proverbs 10:11)

text: מַעְיָן נִרְפָּשׂ וּמָקוֹר מָשְׁחָת צַדִּיק מָט לִפְנֵֽי רָשָֽׁע׃
translation: Like a muddied spring and a polluted well, so is a righteous man who gives way before the wicked. (Proverbs 25:26)

text: כִּֽי עִמְּךָ מְקוֹר חַיִּים בְּאוֹרְךָ נִרְאֶה אֽוֹר׃
translation: Oh continue your loving kindness to those who know you, your righteousness to the upright in heart. (Psalms 36:10)

text: תּוֹרַת חָכָם מְקוֹר חַיִּים לָסוּר מִמֹּקְשֵׁי מָֽוֶת׃
translation: The teaching of the wise is a spring of life, to turn from the snares of death. (Proverbs 13:14)

text: יִרְאַת יְהוָה מְקוֹר חַיִּים לָסוּר מִמֹּקְשֵׁי מָֽוֶת׃
translation: The fear of the LORD is a fountain of life, turning people from the snares of death. (Proverbs 14:27)

text: מְקוֹר חַיִּים שֵׂכֶל בְּעָלָיו וּמוּסַר אֱוִלִים אִוֶּֽלֶת׃
translation: Understanding is a fountain of life to one who has it, but the punishment of fools is their folly. (Proverbs 16:22)

text: אִם יְהַלֵּךְ אִישׁ עַל הַגֶּחָלִים וְרַגְלָיו לֹא תִכָּוֶֽינָה׃
translation: Or can one walk on hot coals, and his feet not be scorched? (Proverbs 6:28)

text: עָלָה עָשָׁן בְּאַפּוֹ וְאֵשׁ מִפִּיו תֹּאכֵל גֶּחָלִים בָּעֲרוּ מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃
translation: Smoke went up out of his nostrils. Consuming fire came out of his mouth. Coals were kindled by it. (2 Samuel 22:9)

text: עָלָה עָשָׁן בְּאַפּוֹ וְאֵשׁ מִפִּיו תֹּאכֵל גֶּחָלִים בָּעֲרוּ מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃
translation: He bowed the heavens also, and came down. Thick darkness was under his feet. (Psalms 18:9)

text: מִנֹּגַהּ נֶגְדּוֹ עָבָיו עָבְרוּ בָּרָד וְגַֽחֲלֵי אֵֽשׁ׃
translation: The LORD also thundered in the sky. The Most High uttered his voice: hailstones and coals of fire. (Psalms 18:13)

text: וַיַּרְעֵם בַּשָּׁמַיִם יְֽהוָה וְעֶלְיוֹן יִתֵּן קֹלוֹ בָּרָד וְגַֽחֲלֵי אֵֽשׁ׃
translation: He sent out his arrows, and scattered them. He routed them with great lightning bolts. (Psalms 18:14)

text: ימיטו יִמּוֹטוּ עֲלֵיהֶם גֶּֽחָלִים בָּאֵשׁ יַפִּלֵם בְּמַהֲמֹרוֹת בַּֽל יָקֽוּמוּ׃
translation: An evil speaker won't be established in the earth. Evil will hunt the violent man to overthrow him. (Psalms 140:11)

text: בַּיּוֹם הַתְּשִׁיעִי נָשִׂיא לִבְנֵי בִנְיָמִן אֲבִידָן בֶּן גִּדְעֹנִֽי׃
translation: On the ninth day Abidan the son of Gideoni, prince of the children of Benjamin, (Numbers 7:60)

text: הַתְּשִׁיעִי מַתַּנְיָהוּ בָּנָיו וְאֶחָיו שְׁנֵים עָשָֽׂר׃
translation: the ninth to Mattaniah, his sons and his brothers, twelve; (1 Chronicles 25:16)

text: וְהַמֶּלֶךְ יוֹשֵׁב בֵּית הַחֹרֶף בַּחֹדֶשׁ הַתְּשִׁיעִי וְאֶת הָאָח לְפָנָיו מְבֹעָֽרֶת׃
translation: Now the king was sitting in the winter house in the ninth month, and there was a fire in the brazier burning before him. (Jeremiah 36:22)

text: יֽוֹחָנָן הַשְּׁמִינִי אֶלְזָבָד הַתְּשִׁיעִֽי׃
translation: Jeremiah the tenth, and Machbannai the eleventh. (1 Chronicles 12:13)

text: לְיֵשׁוּעַ הַתְּשִׁעִי לִשְׁכַנְיָהוּ הָעֲשִׂרִֽי׃
translation: the ninth to Jeshua, the tenth to Shecaniah, (1 Chronicles 24:11)

text: בְּעֶשְׂרִים וְאַרְבָּעָה לַתְּשִׁיעִי בִּשְׁנַת שְׁתַּיִם לְדָרְיָוֶשׁ הָיָה דְּבַר יְהוָה אֶל חַגַּי הַנָּבִיא לֵאמֹֽר׃
translation: In the twenty-fourth day of the ninth month, in the second year of Darius, the LORD's word came by Haggai the prophet, saying, (Haggai 2:10)

text: נְרַנְּנָה בִּישׁוּעָתֶךָ וּבְשֵֽׁם אֱלֹהֵינוּ נִדְגֹּל יְמַלֵּא יְהוָה כָּל מִשְׁאֲלוֹתֶֽיךָ׃
translation: Now I know that the LORD saves his anointed. He will answer him from his holy heaven, with the saving strength of his right hand. (Psalms 20:6)

text: הֱבִיאַנִי אֶל בֵּית הַיָּיִן וְדִגְלוֹ עָלַי אַהֲבָֽה׃
translation: He brought me to the banquet hall. His banner over me is love. (Song of Solomon 2:4)

text: וְחָנוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אִישׁ עַֽל מַחֲנֵהוּ וְאִישׁ עַל דִּגְלוֹ לְצִבְאֹתָֽם׃
translation: The children of Israel shall pitch their tents, every man by his own camp, and every man by his own standard, according to their divisions. (Numbers 1:52)

text: וְנָסַע דֶּגֶל מַחֲנֵה רְאוּבֵן לְצִבְאֹתָם וְעַל צְבָאוֹ אֱלִיצוּר בֶּן שְׁדֵיאֽוּר׃
translation: The standard of the camp of Reuben went forward according to their armies. Elizur the son of Shedeur was over his army. (Numbers 10:18)

text: דֶּגֶל מַחֲנֵה רְאוּבֵן תֵּימָנָה לְצִבְאֹתָם וְנָשִׂיא לִבְנֵי רְאוּבֵן אֱלִיצוּר בֶּן שְׁדֵיאֽוּר׃
translation: "On the south side shall be the standard of the camp of Reuben according to their divisions. The prince of the children of Reuben shall be Elizur the son of Shedeur. (Numbers 2:10)

text: דֶּגֶל מַחֲנֵה אֶפְרַיִם לְצִבְאֹתָם יָמָּה וְנָשִׂיא לִבְנֵי אֶפְרַיִם אֱלִישָׁמָע בֶּן עַמִּיהֽוּד׃
translation: "On the west side shall be the standard of the camp of Ephraim according to their divisions. The prince of the children of Ephraim shall be Elishama the son of Ammihud. (Numbers 2:18)

text: וְלָרֽאוּבֵנִי וְלַגָּדִי וְלַחֲצִי שֵׁבֶט הַֽמְנַשֶּׁה אָמַר יְהוֹשֻׁעַ לֵאמֹֽר׃
translation: Joshua spoke to the Reubenites, and to the Gadites, and to the half-tribe of Manasseh, saying, (Joshua 1:12)

text: אָז יִקְרָא יְהוֹשֻׁעַ לָרֽאוּבֵנִי וְלַגָּדִי וְלַחֲצִי מַטֵּה מְנַשֶּֽׁה׃
translation: Then Joshua called the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh, (Joshua 22:1)

text: עֲדִינָא בֶן שִׁיזָא הָרֽאוּבֵנִי רֹאשׁ לָרֽאוּבֵנִי וְעָלָיו שְׁלוֹשִֽׁים׃
translation: Adina the son of Shiza the Reubenite (a chief of the Reubenites), and thirty with him, (1 Chronicles 11:42)

text: וַנִּקַּח אֶת אַרְצָם וַנִּתְּנָהּ לְנַחֲלָה לָרֽאוּבֵנִי וְלַגָּדִי וְלַחֲצִי שֵׁבֶט הַֽמְנַשִּֽׁי׃
translation: When you came to this place, Sihon the king of Heshbon and Og the king of Bashan came out against us to battle, and we struck them. (Deuteronomy 29:7)

text: אֵלֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹת הָרֻֽאוּבֵנִי וַיִּהְיוּ פְקֻדֵיהֶם שְׁלֹשָׁה וְאַרְבָּעִים אֶלֶף וּשְׁבַע מֵאוֹת וּשְׁלֹשִֽׁים׃
translation: These are the families of the Reubenites; and those who were counted of them were forty-three thousand seven hundred thirty. (Numbers 26:7)

text: בְּאֵרָה בְנוֹ אֲשֶׁר הֶגְלָה תִּלְּגַת פִּלְנְאֶסֶר מֶלֶךְ אַשֻּׁר הוּא נָשִׂיא לָרֽאוּבֵנִֽי׃
translation: and Beerah his son, whom Tilgath Pilneser king of Assyria carried away captive. He was prince of the Reubenites. (1 Chronicles 5:6)

text: צֶלֶק הָעַמּוֹנִי נַחְרַי הַבֵּרֹתִי נֹשֵׂא כְּלֵי יוֹאָב בֶּן צְרוּיָֽה׃
translation: Zelek the Ammonite, Naharai the Berothite (the armor bearer of Joab the son of Zeruiah), (1 Chronicles 11:39)

text: צֶלֶק הָעַמֹּנִי נַחְרַי הַבְּאֵרֹתִי נשאי נֹשֵׂא כְּלֵי יוֹאָב בֶּן צְרֻיָֽה׃
translation: Zelek the Ammonite, Naharai the Beerothite, armor bearers to Joab the son of Zeruiah, (2 Samuel 23:37)

text: אֶֽרֶץ רְפָאִים תֵּחָשֵׁב אַף הִוא רְפָאִים יָֽשְׁבוּ בָהּ לְפָנִים וְהָֽעַמֹּנִים יִקְרְאוּ לָהֶם זַמְזֻמִּֽים׃
translation: (That also is considered a land of Rephaim. Rephaim lived there in the past, but the Ammonites call them Zamzummim, (Deuteronomy 2:20)

text: וַיְהִי אַֽחֲרֵי כֵן בָּאוּ בְנֵי מוֹאָב וּבְנֵי עַמּוֹן וְעִמָּהֶם מֵֽהָעַמּוֹנִים עַל יְהוֹשָׁפָט לַמִּלְחָמָֽה׃
translation: After this, the children of Moab, the children of Ammon, and with them some of the Ammonites, came against Jehoshaphat to battle. (2 Chronicles 20:1)

text: וַיִּתְּנוּ הָֽעַמּוֹנִים מִנְחָה לְעֻזִּיָּהוּ וַיֵּלֶךְ שְׁמוֹ עַד לְבוֹא מִצְרַיִם כִּי הֶחֱזִיק עַד לְמָֽעְלָה׃
translation: The Ammonites gave tribute to Uzziah. His name spread abroad even to the entrance of Egypt, for he grew exceedingly strong. (2 Chronicles 26:8)

text: וַיַּעַל נָחָשׁ הָֽעַמּוֹנִי וַיִּחַן עַל יָבֵשׁ גִּלְעָד וַיֹּאמְרוּ כָּל אַנְשֵׁי יָבֵישׁ אֶל נָחָשׁ כְּרָת לָנוּ בְרִית וְנַעַבְדֶֽךָּ׃
translation: Then Nahash the Ammonite came up and encamped against Jabesh Gilead; and all the men of Jabesh said to Nahash, "Make a covenant with us, and we will serve you." (1 Samuel 11:1)

text: וַהֲצִיקוֹתִי לַֽאֲרִיאֵל וְהָיְתָה תַֽאֲנִיָּה וַֽאֲנִיָּה וְהָיְתָה לִּי כַּאֲרִיאֵֽל׃
translation: then I will distress Ariel, and there will be mourning and lamentation. She shall be to me as an altar hearth. (Isaiah 29:2)

text: כִּי מָלֵתִי מִלִּים הֱצִיקַתְנִי רוּחַ בִּטְנִֽי׃
translation: For I am full of words. The spirit within me constrains me. (Job 32:18)

text: וַיְהִי כִּֽי הֵצִיקָה לּוֹ בִדְבָרֶיהָ כָּל הַיָּמִים וַתְּאַֽלֲצֵהוּ וַתִּקְצַר נַפְשׁוֹ לָמֽוּת׃
translation: When she pressed him daily with her words and urged him, his soul was troubled to death. (Judges 16:16)

text: בְּבֹא כשאוה כְשׁוֹאָה פַּחְדְּכֶם וְֽאֵידְכֶם כְּסוּפָה יֶאֱתֶה בְּבֹא עֲלֵיכֶם צָרָה וְצוּקָֽה׃
translation: when calamity overtakes you like a storm, when your disaster comes on like a whirlwind, when distress and anguish come on you. (Proverbs 1:27)

text: וְהָיָה כַּֽחֲלוֹם חֲזוֹן לַיְלָה הֲמוֹן כָּל הַגּוֹיִם הַצֹּבְאִים עַל אֲרִיאֵל וְכָל צֹבֶיהָ וּמְצֹדָתָהּ וְהַמְּצִיקִים לָֽהּ׃
translation: The multitude of all the nations that fight against Ariel, even all who fight against her and her stronghold, and who distress her, will be like a dream, a vision of the night. (Isaiah 29:7)

text: וַתֵּבְךְּ עָלָיו שִׁבְעַת הַיָּמִים אֲשֶׁר הָיָה לָהֶם הַמִּשְׁתֶּה וַיְהִי בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי וַיַּגֶּד לָהּ כִּי הֱצִיקַתְהוּ וַתַּגֵּד הַחִידָה לִבְנֵי עַמָּֽהּ׃
translation: She wept before him the seven days, while their feast lasted; and on the seventh day, he told her, because she pressed him severely; and she told the riddle to the children of her people. (Judges 14:17)

text: וּבֵין עֲלִיַּת הַפִּנָּה לְשַׁעַר הַצֹּאן הֶחֱזִיקוּ הַצֹּרְפִים וְהָרֹכְלִֽים׃
translation: Between the ascent of the corner and the sheep gate, the goldsmiths and the merchants made repairs. (Nehemiah 3:32)

text: חָרָן וְכַנֵּה וָעֶדֶן רֹכְלֵי שְׁבָא אַשּׁוּר כִּלְמַד רֹכַלְתֵּֽךְ׃
translation: "'"Haran, Canneh, Eden, the traders of Sheba, Asshur and Chilmad, were your traders. (Ezekiel 27:23)

text: לְבַד מֵאַנְשֵׁי הַתָּרִים וּמִסְחַר הָרֹכְלִים וְכָל מַלְכֵי הָעֶרֶב וּפַחוֹת הָאָֽרֶץ׃
translation: in addition to that which the traders brought, and the traffic of the merchants, and of all the kings of the mixed people, and of the governors of the country. (1 Kings 10:15)

text: אֵת רֹאשׁ יְנִֽיקוֹתָיו קָטָף וַיְבִיאֵהוּ אֶל אֶרֶץ כְּנַעַן בְּעִיר רֹכְלִים שָׂמֽוֹ׃
translation: He cropped off the topmost of its young twigs, and carried it to a land of traffic. He planted it in a city of merchants. (Ezekiel 17:4)

text: יָוָן תֻּבַל וָמֶשֶׁךְ הֵמָּה רֹֽכְלָיִךְ בְּנֶפֶשׁ אָדָם וּכְלֵי נְחֹשֶׁת נָתְנוּ מַעֲרָבֵֽךְ׃
translation: "'"Javan, Tubal, and Meshech were your traders. They traded the persons of men and vessels of bronze for your merchandise. (Ezekiel 27:13)

text: דְּדָן רֹֽכַלְתֵּךְ בְבִגְדֵי חֹפֶשׁ לְרִכְבָּֽה׃
translation: "'"Dedan was your merchant in precious saddle blankets for riding. (Ezekiel 27:20)

text: עַד מָתַי רְשָׁעִים יְהוָה עַד מָתַי רְשָׁעִים יַעֲלֹֽזוּ׃
translation: LORD, how long will the wicked, how long will the wicked triumph? (Psalms 94:3)

text: אֱלֹהִים דִּבֶּר בְּקָדְשׁוֹ אֶעְלֹזָה אֲחַלְּקָה שְׁכֶם וְעֵמֶק סֻכּוֹת אֲמַדֵּֽד׃
translation: Moab is my wash basin. I will throw my sandal on Edom. I shout in triumph over Philistia." (Psalms 60:8)

text: אֱלֹהִים דִּבֶּר בְּקָדְשׁוֹ אֶעְלֹזָה אֲחַלְּקָה שְׁכֶם וְעֵמֶק סֻכּוֹת אֲמַדֵּֽד׃
translation: Gilead is mine. Manasseh is mine. Ephraim also is my helmet. Judah is my scepter. (Psalms 108:8)

text: יַעֲלֹז שָׂדַי וְכָל אֲשֶׁר בּוֹ אָז יְרַנְּנוּ כָּל עֲצֵי יָֽעַר׃
translation: Let the field and all that is in it exult! Then all the trees of the woods shall sing for joy (Psalms 96:12)

text: יַעְלְזוּ חֲסִידִים בְּכָבוֹד יְרַנְּנוּ עַל מִשְׁכְּבוֹתָֽם׃
translation: Let the saints rejoice in honor. Let them sing for joy on their beds. (Psalms 149:5)

text: וַאֲנִי בַּיהוָה אֶעְלוֹזָה אָגִילָה בֵּאלֹהֵי יִשְׁעִֽי׃
translation: yet I will rejoice in the LORD. I will be joyful in the God of my salvation! (Habakkuk 3:18)

text: עִם נָבָר תִּתָּבָר וְעִם עִקֵּשׁ תִּתַּפָּֽל׃
translation: With the pure you will show yourself pure. With the crooked you will show yourself shrewd. (2 Samuel 22:27)

text: עִם נָבָר תִּתְבָּרָר וְעִם עִקֵּשׁ תִּתְפַּתָּֽל׃
translation: For you will save the afflicted people, but the arrogant eyes you will bring down. (Psalms 18:27)

text: יִתְבָּֽרֲרוּ וְיִֽתְלַבְּנוּ וְיִצָּֽרְפוּ רַבִּים וְהִרְשִׁיעוּ רְשָׁעִים וְלֹא יָבִינוּ כָּל רְשָׁעִים וְהַמַּשְׂכִּלִים יָבִֽינוּ׃
translation: Many will purify themselves, and make themselves white, and be refined, but the wicked will do wickedly; and none of the wicked will understand, but those who are wise will understand. (Daniel 12:10)

text: וְעִמָּהֶם הֵימָן וִֽידוּתוּן וּשְׁאָר הַבְּרוּרִים אֲשֶׁר נִקְּבוּ בְּשֵׁמוֹת לְהֹדוֹת לַֽיהוָה כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
translation: and with them Heman and Jeduthun and the rest who were chosen, who were mentioned by name, to give thanks to the LORD, because his loving kindness endures forever; (1 Chronicles 16:41)

text: סוּרוּ סוּרוּ צְאוּ מִשָּׁם טָמֵא אַל תִּגָּעוּ צְאוּ מִתּוֹכָהּ הִבָּרוּ נֹשְׂאֵי כְּלֵי יְהוָֽה׃
translation: Depart! Depart! Go out from there! Touch no unclean thing! Go out from among her! Cleanse yourselves, you who carry the LORD's vessels. (Isaiah 52:11)

text: וּמִן הַמַּשְׂכִּילִים יִכָּֽשְׁלוּ לִצְרוֹף בָּהֶם וּלְבָרֵר וְלַלְבֵּן עַד עֵת קֵץ כִּי עוֹד לַמּוֹעֵֽד׃
translation: Some of those who are wise will fall—to refine them, and to purify, and to make them white, even to the time of the end, because it is yet for the time appointed. (Daniel 11:35)

text: אֲדֹנָי שִׁמְעָה בְקוֹלִי תִּהְיֶינָה אָזְנֶיךָ קַשֻּׁבוֹת לְקוֹל תַּחֲנוּנָֽי׃
translation: Lord, hear my voice. Let your ears be attentive to the voice of my petitions. (Psalms 130:2)

text: אָמַרְתִּי לַיהוָה אֵלִי אָתָּה הַאֲזִינָה יְהוָה קוֹל תַּחֲנוּנָֽי׃
translation: LORD, the Lord, the strength of my salvation, you have covered my head in the day of battle. (Psalms 140:7)

text: אָהַבְתִּי כִּֽי יִשְׁמַע יְהוָה אֶת קוֹלִי תַּחֲנוּנָֽי׃
translation: I love the LORD, because he listens to my voice, and my cries for mercy. (Psalms 116:1)

text: שְׁמַע קוֹל תַּחֲנוּנַי בְּשַׁוְּעִי אֵלֶיךָ בְּנָשְׂאִי יָדַי אֶל דְּבִיר קָדְשֶֽׁךָ׃
translation: Hear the voice of my petitions, when I cry to you, when I lift up my hands toward your Most Holy Place. (Psalms 28:2)

text: בָּרוּךְ יְהוָה כִּי שָׁמַע קוֹל תַּחֲנוּנָֽי׃
translation: Blessed be the LORD, because he has heard the voice of my petitions. (Psalms 28:6)

text: הַאֲזִינָה יְהוָה תְּפִלָּתִי וְהַקְשִׁיבָה בְּקוֹל תַּחֲנוּנוֹתָֽי׃
translation: Hear, LORD, my prayer. Listen to the voice of my petitions. (Psalms 86:6)

text: בְּטֶרֶם אֵלֵךְ וְלֹא אָשׁוּב אֶל אֶרֶץ חֹשֶׁךְ וְצַלְמָֽוֶת׃
translation: before I go where I will not return from, to the land of darkness and of the shadow of death; (Job 10:21)

text: אֵֽין חֹשֶׁךְ וְאֵין צַלְמָוֶת לְהִסָּתֶר שָׁם פֹּעֲלֵי אָֽוֶן׃
translation: There is no darkness, nor thick gloom, where the workers of iniquity may hide themselves. (Job 34:22)

text: יִגְאָלֻהוּ חֹשֶׁךְ וְצַלְמָוֶת תִּשְׁכָּן עָלָיו עֲנָנָה יְבַעֲתֻהוּ כִּֽמְרִירֵי יֽוֹם׃
translation: Let darkness and the shadow of death claim it for their own. Let a cloud dwell on it. Let all that makes the day black terrify it. (Job 3:5)

text: מְגַלֶּה עֲמֻקוֹת מִנִּי חֹשֶׁךְ וַיֹּצֵא לָאוֹר צַלְמָֽוֶת׃
translation: He uncovers deep things out of darkness, and brings out to light the shadow of death. (Job 12:22)

text: כִּי יַחְדָּו בֹּקֶר לָמוֹ צַלְמָוֶת כִּֽי יַכִּיר בַּלְהוֹת צַלְמָֽוֶת׃
translation: For the morning is to all of them like thick darkness, for they know the terrors of the thick darkness. (Job 24:17)

text: הֲנִגְלוּ לְךָ שַׁעֲרֵי מָוֶת וְשַׁעֲרֵי צַלְמָוֶת תִּרְאֶֽה׃
translation: Have the gates of death been revealed to you? Or have you seen the gates of the shadow of death? (Job 38:17)

text: הֲלֹא אֹזֶן מִלִּין תִּבְחָן וְחֵךְ אֹכֶל יִטְעַם לֽוֹ׃
translation: Doesn't the ear try words, even as the palate tastes its food? (Job 12:11)

text: יַחְמֹל עָלֶיהָ וְלֹא יַֽעַזְבֶנָּה וְיִמְנָעֶנָּה בְּתוֹךְ חִכּֽוֹ׃
translation: though he spare it, and will not let it go, but keep it still within his mouth, (Job 20:13)

text: וְלֹא נָתַתִּי לַחֲטֹא חִכִּי לִשְׁאֹל בְּאָלָה נַפְשֽׁוֹ׃
translation: (I have certainly not allowed my mouth to sin by asking his life with a curse); (Job 31:30)

text: הִנֵּה נָא פָּתַחְתִּי פִי דִּבְּרָה לְשׁוֹנִי בְחִכִּֽי׃
translation: See now, I have opened my mouth. My tongue has spoken in my mouth. (Job 33:2)

text: כִּי אֹזֶן מִלִּין תִּבְחָן וְחֵךְ יִטְעַם לֶאֱכֹֽל׃
translation: For the ear tries words, as the palate tastes food. (Job 34:3)

text: כִּֽי אֱמֶת יֶהְגֶּה חִכִּי וְתוֹעֲבַת שְׂפָתַי רֶֽשַׁע׃
translation: For my mouth speaks truth. Wickedness is an abomination to my lips. (Proverbs 8:7)

text: מַה שֶּֽׁהָיָה כְּבָר הוּא וַאֲשֶׁר לִהְיוֹת כְּבָר הָיָה וְהָאֱלֹהִים יְבַקֵּשׁ אֶת נִרְדָּֽף׃
translation: That which is has been long ago, and that which is to be has been long ago. God seeks again that which is passed away. (Ecclesiastes 3:15)

text: וְשַׁבֵּחַ אֲנִי אֶת הַמֵּתִים שֶׁכְּבָר מֵתוּ מִן הַחַיִּים אֲשֶׁר הֵמָּה חַיִּים עֲדֶֽנָה׃
translation: Therefore I praised the dead who have been long dead more than the living who are yet alive. (Ecclesiastes 4:2)

text: יֵשׁ דָּבָר שֶׁיֹּאמַר רְאֵה זֶה חָדָשׁ הוּא כְּבָר הָיָה לְעֹֽלָמִים אֲשֶׁר הָיָה מִלְּפָנֵֽנוּ׃
translation: Is there a thing of which it may be said, "Behold, this is new"? It has been long ago, in the ages which were before us. (Ecclesiastes 1:10)

text: הִיא הַחַיָּה אֲשֶׁר רָאִיתִי תַּחַת אֱלֹהֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵל בִּֽנְהַר כְּבָר וָאֵדַע כִּי כְרוּבִים הֵֽמָּה׃
translation: This is the living creature that I saw under the God of Israel by the river Chebar; and I knew that they were cherubim. (Ezekiel 10:20)

text: לֵךְ אֱכֹל בְּשִׂמְחָה לַחְמֶךָ וּֽשֲׁתֵה בְלֶב טוֹב יֵינֶךָ כִּי כְבָר רָצָה הָאֱלֹהִים אֶֽת מַעֲשֶֽׂיךָ׃
translation: Go your way—eat your bread with joy, and drink your wine with a merry heart; for God has already accepted your works. (Ecclesiastes 9:7)

text: וּדְמוּת פְּנֵיהֶם הֵמָּה הַפָּנִים אֲשֶׁר רָאִיתִי עַל נְהַר כְּבָר מַרְאֵיהֶם וְאוֹתָם אִישׁ אֶל עֵבֶר פָּנָיו יֵלֵֽכוּ׃
translation: As for the likeness of their faces, they were the faces which I saw by the river Chebar, their appearances and themselves. They each went straight forward. (Ezekiel 10:22)

text: אַל תִּשְׁכַּח קוֹל צֹרְרֶיךָ שְׁאוֹן קָמֶיךָ עֹלֶה תָמִֽיד׃
translation: Don't forget the voice of your adversaries. The tumult of those who rise up against you ascends continually. (Psalms 74:23)

text: קָרְאוּ שָׁם פַּרְעֹה מֶֽלֶךְ מִצְרַיִם שָׁאוֹן הֶעֱבִיר הַמּוֹעֵֽד׃
translation: They cried there, 'Pharaoh king of Egypt is but a noise; he has let the appointed time pass by.' (Jeremiah 46:17)

text: קוֹל שָׁאוֹן מֵעִיר קוֹל מֵֽהֵיכָל קוֹל יְהוָה מְשַׁלֵּם גְּמוּל לְאֹיְבָֽיו׃
translation: A voice of tumult from the city, a voice from the temple, a voice of the LORD that repays his enemies what they deserve. (Isaiah 66:6)

text: וְשִׁלַּחְתִּי אֵשׁ בְּמוֹאָב וְאָכְלָה אַרְמְנוֹת הַקְּרִיּוֹת וּמֵת בְּשָׁאוֹן מוֹאָב בִּתְרוּעָה בְּקוֹל שׁוֹפָֽר׃
translation: but I will send a fire on Moab, and it will devour the palaces of Kerioth; and Moab will die with tumult, with shouting, and with the sound of the trumpet; (Amos 2:2)

text: לָכֵן הִרְחִיבָה שְּׁאוֹל נַפְשָׁהּ וּפָעֲרָה פִיהָ לִבְלִי חֹק וְיָרַד הֲדָרָהּ וַהֲמוֹנָהּ וּשְׁאוֹנָהּ וְעָלֵז בָּֽהּ׃
translation: Therefore Sheol has enlarged its desire, and opened its mouth without measure; and their glory, their multitude, their pomp, and he who rejoices among them, descend into it. (Isaiah 5:14)

text: קוֹל הָמוֹן בֶּֽהָרִים דְּמוּת עַם רָב קוֹל שְׁאוֹן מַמְלְכוֹת גּוֹיִם נֶֽאֱסָפִים יְהוָה צְבָאוֹת מְפַקֵּד צְבָא מִלְחָמָֽה׃
translation: The noise of a multitude is in the mountains, as of a great people; the noise of an uproar of the kingdoms of the nations gathered together! The LORD of Armies is mustering the army for the battle. (Isaiah 13:4)

text: בֵּאדַיִן מַלְכָּא נְבֽוּכַדְנֶצַּר נְפַל עַל אַנְפּוֹהִי וּלְדָנִיֵּאל סְגִד וּמִנְחָה וְנִיחֹחִין אֲמַר לְנַסָּכָה לֵֽהּ׃
translation: Then King Nebuchadnezzar fell on his face, worshiped Daniel, and commanded that they should offer an offering and sweet odors to him. (Daniel 2:46)

text: וּשְׁאֵרִיתוֹ לְאֵל עָשָׂה לְפִסְלוֹ יסגוד יִסְגָּד לוֹ וְיִשְׁתַּחוּ וְיִתְפַּלֵּל אֵלָיו וְיֹאמַר הַצִּילֵנִי כִּי אֵלִי אָֽתָּה׃
translation: The rest of it he makes into a god, even his engraved image. He bows down to it and worships, and prays to it, and says, "Deliver me, for you are my god!" (Isaiah 44:17)

text: וְהָיָה לְאָדָם לְבָעֵר וַיִּקַּח מֵהֶם וַיָּחָם אַף יַשִּׂיק וְאָפָה לָחֶם אַף יִפְעַל אֵל וַיִּשְׁתָּחוּ עָשָׂהוּ פֶסֶל וַיִּסְגָּד לָֽמוֹ׃
translation: Then it will be for a man to burn; and he takes some of it and warms himself. Yes, he burns it and bakes bread. Yes, he makes a god and worships it; he makes it a carved image, and falls down to it. (Isaiah 44:15)

text: וַיִּתֵּן אֹתָם אֱלֹהִים בִּרְקִיעַ הַשָּׁמָיִם לְהָאִיר עַל הָאָֽרֶץ׃
translation: God set them in the expanse of the sky to give light to the earth, (Genesis 1:17)

text: הַשָּׁמַיִם מְֽסַפְּרִים כְּבֽוֹד אֵל וּֽמַעֲשֵׂה יָדָיו מַגִּיד הָרָקִֽיעַ׃
translation: Day after day they pour out speech, and night after night they display knowledge. (Psalms 19:2)

text: הַלְלוּ יָהּ הַֽלְלוּ אֵל בְּקָדְשׁוֹ הַֽלְלוּהוּ בִּרְקִיעַ עֻזּֽוֹ׃
translation: Praise the LORD! Praise God in his sanctuary! Praise him in his heavens for his acts of power! (Psalms 150:1)

text: וְהַמַּשְׂכִּלִים יַזְהִרוּ כְּזֹהַר הָרָקִיעַ וּמַצְדִּיקֵי הָֽרַבִּים כַּכּוֹכָבִים לְעוֹלָם וָעֶֽד׃
translation: Those who are wise will shine as the brightness of the expanse. Those who turn many to righteousness will shine as the stars forever and ever. (Daniel 12:3)

text: וַיִּקְרָא אֱלֹהִים לָֽרָקִיעַ שָׁמָיִם וַֽיְהִי עֶרֶב וַֽיְהִי בֹקֶר יוֹם שֵׁנִֽי׃
translation: God called the expanse "sky". There was evening and there was morning, a second day. (Genesis 1:8)

text: וַיְהִי קוֹל מֵעַל לָרָקִיעַ אֲשֶׁר עַל רֹאשָׁם בְּעָמְדָם תְּרַפֶּינָה כַנְפֵיהֶֽן׃
translation: There was a voice above the expanse that was over their heads. When they stood, they let down their wings. (Ezekiel 1:25)

text: גָּלָה חָצִיר וְנִרְאָה דֶשֶׁא וְנֶאֶסְפוּ עִשְּׂבוֹת הָרִֽים׃
translation: The hay is removed, and the new growth appears, the grasses of the hills are gathered in. (Proverbs 27:25)

text: לְהַשְׂבִּיעַ שֹׁאָה וּמְשֹׁאָה וּלְהַצְמִיחַ מֹצָא דֶֽשֶׁא׃
translation: to satisfy the waste and desolate ground, to cause the tender grass to grow? (Job 38:27)

text: כִּי גַם אַיֶּלֶת בַּשָּׂדֶה יָלְדָה וְעָזוֹב כִּי לֹֽא הָיָה דֶּֽשֶׁא׃
translation: Yes, the doe in the field also calves and forsakes her young, because there is no grass. (Jeremiah 14:5)

text: וּכְאוֹר בֹּקֶר יִזְרַח שָׁמֶשׁ בֹּקֶר לֹא עָבוֹת מִנֹּגַהּ מִמָּטָר דֶּשֶׁא מֵאָֽרֶץ׃
translation: shall be as the light of the morning when the sun rises, a morning without clouds, when the tender grass springs out of the earth, through clear shining after rain.' (2 Samuel 23:4)

text: וּרְאִיתֶם וְשָׂשׂ לִבְּכֶם וְעַצְמוֹתֵיכֶם כַּדֶּשֶׁא תִפְרַחְנָה וְנוֹדְעָה יַד יְהוָה אֶת עֲבָדָיו וְזָעַם אֶת אֹיְבָֽיו׃
translation: You will see it, and your heart shall rejoice, and your bones will flourish like the tender grass. The LORD's hand will be known among his servants; and he will have indignation against his enemies. (Isaiah 66:14)

text: אַל תִּֽירְאוּ בַּהֲמוֹת שָׂדַי כִּי דָשְׁאוּ נְאוֹת מִדְבָּר כִּֽי עֵץ נָשָׂא פִרְיוֹ תְּאֵנָה וָגֶפֶן נָתְנוּ חֵילָֽם׃
translation: Don't be afraid, you animals of the field; for the pastures of the wilderness spring up, for the tree bears its fruit. The fig tree and the vine yield their strength. (Joel 2:22)

text: וַיִּהְיוּ בְנֵי לוֹטָן חֹרִי וְהֵימָם וַאֲחוֹת לוֹטָן תִּמְנָֽע׃
translation: The children of Lotan were Hori and Heman. Lotan's sister was Timna. (Genesis 36:22)

text: וּבְנֵי לוֹטָן חֹרִי וְהוֹמָם וַאֲחוֹת לוֹטָן תִּמְנָֽע׃
translation: The sons of Lotan: Hori and Homam; and Timna was Lotan's sister. (1 Chronicles 1:39)

text: וְאֶת הַחֹרִי בְּהַרְרָם שֵׂעִיר עַד אֵיל פָּארָן אֲשֶׁר עַל הַמִּדְבָּֽר׃
translation: and the Horites in their Mount Seir, to El Paran, which is by the wilderness. (Genesis 14:6)

text: אֵלֶּה בְנֵֽי שֵׂעִיר הַחֹרִי יֹשְׁבֵי הָאָרֶץ לוֹטָן וְשׁוֹבָל וְצִבְעוֹן וַעֲנָֽה׃
translation: These are the sons of Seir the Horite, the inhabitants of the land: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah, (Genesis 36:20)

text: וְדִשׁוֹן וְאֵצֶר וְדִישָׁן אֵלֶּה אַלּוּפֵי הַחֹרִי בְּנֵי שֵׂעִיר בְּאֶרֶץ אֱדֽוֹם׃
translation: Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan. These are the chiefs who came of the Horites, the children of Seir in the land of Edom. (Genesis 36:21)

text: אֵלֶּה אַלּוּפֵי הַחֹרִי אַלּוּף לוֹטָן אַלּוּף שׁוֹבָל אַלּוּף צִבְעוֹן אַלּוּף עֲנָֽה׃
translation: These are the chiefs who came of the Horites: chief Lotan, chief Shobal, chief Zibeon, chief Anah, (Genesis 36:29)

text: דַּלְתֵי פָנָיו מִי פִתֵּחַ סְבִיבוֹת שִׁנָּיו אֵימָֽה׃
translation: Will traders barter for him? Will they part him among the merchants? (Job 41:6)

text: לִבִּי יָחִיל בְּקִרְבִּי וְאֵימוֹת מָוֶת נָפְלוּ עָלָֽי׃
translation: Fearfulness and trembling have come on me. Horror has overwhelmed me. (Psalms 55:5)

text: עָנִי אֲנִי וְגֹוֵעַ מִנֹּעַר נָשָׂאתִי אֵמֶיךָ אָפֽוּנָה׃
translation: Your fierce wrath has gone over me. Your terrors have cut me off. (Psalms 88:16)

text: חֹרֶב אֶל מֵימֶיהָ וְיָבֵשׁוּ כִּי אֶרֶץ פְּסִלִים הִיא וּבָאֵימִים יִתְהֹלָֽלוּ׃
translation: A drought is on her waters, and they will be dried up; for it is a land of engraved images, and they are mad over idols. (Jeremiah 50:38)

text: הְֽתַרְעִישֶׁנּוּ כָּאַרְבֶּה הוֹד נַחְרוֹ אֵימָֽה׃
translation: Have you made him to leap as a locust? The glory of his snorting is awesome. (Job 39:20)

text: לִבְּךָ יֶהְגֶּה אֵימָה אַיֵּה סֹפֵר אַיֵּה שֹׁקֵל אַיֵּה סֹפֵר אֶת הַמִּגְדָּלִֽים׃
translation: Your heart will meditate on the terror. Where is he who counted? Where is he who weighed? Where is he who counted the towers? (Isaiah 33:18)

text: וְעֵינֵי לֵאָה רַכּוֹת וְרָחֵל הָֽיְתָה יְפַת תֹּאַר וִיפַת מַרְאֶֽה׃
translation: Leah's eyes were weak, but Rachel was beautiful in form and attractive. (Genesis 29:17)

text: הָאִישׁ הָרַךְ בְּךָ וְהֶעָנֹג מְאֹד תֵּרַע עֵינוֹ בְאָחִיו וּבְאֵשֶׁת חֵיקוֹ וּבְיֶתֶר בָּנָיו אֲשֶׁר יוֹתִֽיר׃
translation: The man who is tender among you, and very delicate, his eye will be evil toward his brother, toward the wife whom he loves, and toward the remnant of his children whom he has remaining, (Deuteronomy 28:54)

text: וְאֶל הַבָּקָר רָץ אַבְרָהָם וַיִּקַּח בֶּן בָּקָר רַךְ וָטוֹב וַיִּתֵּן אֶל הַנַּעַר וַיְמַהֵר לַעֲשׂוֹת אֹתֽוֹ׃
translation: Abraham ran to the herd, and fetched a tender and good calf, and gave it to the servant. He hurried to dress it. (Genesis 18:7)

text: וְאָנֹכִי הַיּוֹם רַךְ וּמָשׁוּחַ מֶלֶךְ וְהָאֲנָשִׁים הָאֵלֶּה בְּנֵי צְרוּיָה קָשִׁים מִמֶּנִּי יְשַׁלֵּם יְהוָה לְעֹשֵׂה הָרָעָה כְּרָעָתֽוֹ׃
translation: I am weak today, though anointed king. These men, the sons of Zeruiah are too hard for me. May the LORD reward the evildoer according to his wickedness." (2 Samuel 3:39)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו אֲדֹנִי יֹדֵעַ כִּֽי הַיְלָדִים רַכִּים וְהַצֹּאן וְהַבָּקָר עָלוֹת עָלָי וּדְפָקוּם יוֹם אֶחָד וָמֵתוּ כָּל הַצֹּֽאן׃
translation: Jacob said to him, "My lord knows that the children are tender, and that the flocks and herds with me have their young, and if they overdrive them one day, all the flocks will die. (Genesis 33:13)

text: הָרַכָּה בְךָ וְהָעֲנֻגָּה אֲשֶׁר לֹא נִסְּתָה כַף רַגְלָהּ הַצֵּג עַל הָאָרֶץ מֵהִתְעַנֵּג וּמֵרֹךְ תֵּרַע עֵינָהּ בְּאִישׁ חֵיקָהּ וּבִבְנָהּ וּבְבִתָּֽהּ׃
translation: The tender and delicate woman among you, who would not venture to set the sole of her foot on the ground for delicateness and tenderness, her eye will be evil toward the husband that she loves, toward her son, toward her daughter, (Deuteronomy 28:56)

text: נֶזֶם זָהָב וַחֲלִי כָתֶם מוֹכִיחַ חָכָם עַל אֹזֶן שֹׁמָֽעַת׃
translation: As an earring of gold, and an ornament of fine gold, so is a wise reprover to an obedient ear. (Proverbs 25:12)

text: וָאֶתֵּן נֶזֶם עַל אַפֵּךְ וַעֲגִילִים עַל אָזְנָיִךְ וַעֲטֶרֶת תִּפְאֶרֶת בְּרֹאשֵֽׁךְ׃
translation: I put a ring on your nose, earrings in your ears, and a beautiful crown on your head. (Ezekiel 16:12)

text: וַיִּתְפָּֽרְקוּ כָּל הָעָם אֶת נִזְמֵי הַזָּהָב אֲשֶׁר בְּאָזְנֵיהֶם וַיָּבִיאוּ אֶֽל אַהֲרֹֽן׃
translation: All the people took off the golden rings which were in their ears, and brought them to Aaron. (Exodus 32:3)

text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ נָתוֹן נִתֵּן וַֽיִּפְרְשׂוּ אֶת הַשִּׂמְלָה וַיַּשְׁלִיכוּ שָׁמָּה אִישׁ נֶזֶם שְׁלָלֽוֹ׃
translation: They answered, "We will willingly give them." They spread a garment, and every man threw the earrings of his plunder into it. (Judges 8:25)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם אַהֲרֹן פָּֽרְקוּ נִזְמֵי הַזָּהָב אֲשֶׁר בְּאָזְנֵי נְשֵׁיכֶם בְּנֵיכֶם וּבְנֹתֵיכֶם וְהָבִיאוּ אֵלָֽי׃
translation: Aaron said to them, "Take off the golden rings, which are in the ears of your wives, of your sons, and of your daughters, and bring them to me." (Exodus 32:2)

text: וּפָקַדְתִּי עָלֶיהָ אֶת יְמֵי הַבְּעָלִים אֲשֶׁר תַּקְטִיר לָהֶם וַתַּעַד נִזְמָהּ וְחֶלְיָתָהּ וַתֵּלֶךְ אַחֲרֵי מְאַהֲבֶיהָ וְאֹתִי שָׁכְחָה נְאֻם יְהוָֽה׃
translation: I will give her vineyards from there, and the valley of Achor for a door of hope; and she will respond there as in the days of her youth, and as in the day when she came up out of the land of Egypt. (Hosea 2:15)

text: וַתֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו גַּם תֶּבֶן גַּם מִסְפּוֹא רַב עִמָּנוּ גַּם מָקוֹם לָלֽוּן׃
translation: She said moreover to him, "We have both straw and feed enough, and room to lodge in." (Genesis 24:25)

text: אַתֶּם לְכוּ קְחוּ לָכֶם תֶּבֶן מֵאֲשֶׁר תִּמְצָאוּ כִּי אֵין נִגְרָע מֵעֲבֹדַתְכֶם דָּבָֽר׃
translation: Go yourselves, get straw where you can find it, for nothing of your work shall be diminished.'" (Exodus 5:11)

text: תֶּבֶן אֵין נִתָּן לַעֲבָדֶיךָ וּלְבֵנִים אֹמְרִים לָנוּ עֲשׂוּ וְהִנֵּה עֲבָדֶיךָ מֻכִּים וְחָטָאת עַמֶּֽךָ׃
translation: No straw is given to your servants, and they tell us, 'Make brick!' and behold, your servants are beaten; but the fault is in your own people." (Exodus 5:16)

text: וַיֵּצְאוּ נֹגְשֵׂי הָעָם וְשֹׁטְרָיו וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֶל הָעָם לֵאמֹר כֹּה אָמַר פַּרְעֹה אֵינֶנִּי נֹתֵן לָכֶם תֶּֽבֶן׃
translation: The taskmasters of the people went out with their officers, and they spoke to the people, saying, "This is what Pharaoh says: 'I will not give you straw. (Exodus 5:10)

text: וַיָּבֹא הָאִישׁ הַבַּיְתָה וַיְפַתַּח הַגְּמַלִּים וַיִּתֵּן תֶּבֶן וּמִסְפּוֹא לַגְּמַלִּים וּמַיִם לִרְחֹץ רַגְלָיו וְרַגְלֵי הָאֲנָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר אִתּֽוֹ׃
translation: The man came into the house, and he unloaded the camels. He gave straw and feed for the camels, and water to wash his feet and the feet of the men who were with him. (Genesis 24:32)

text: הַנָּבִיא אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ חֲלוֹם יְסַפֵּר חֲלוֹם וַאֲשֶׁר דְּבָרִי אִתּוֹ יְדַבֵּר דְּבָרִי אֱמֶת מַה לַתֶּבֶן אֶת הַבָּר נְאֻם יְהוָֽה׃
translation: The prophet who has a dream, let him tell a dream; and he who has my word, let him speak my word faithfully. What is the straw to the wheat?" says the LORD. (Jeremiah 23:28)

text: וּמִקְצֵה אֶחָיו לָקַח חֲמִשָּׁה אֲנָשִׁים וַיַּצִּגֵם לִפְנֵי פַרְעֹֽה׃
translation: From among his brothers he took five men, and presented them to Pharaoh. (Genesis 47:2)

text: וְֽהִצִּגַנִי לִמְשֹׁל עַמִּים וְתֹפֶת לְפָנִים אֶֽהְיֶֽה׃
translation: "But he has made me a byword of the people. They spit in my face. (Job 17:6)

text: וַיִּקְחוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים אֶת אֲרוֹן הָאֱלֹהִים וַיָּבִיאוּ אֹתוֹ בֵּית דָּגוֹן וַיַּצִּיגוּ אֹתוֹ אֵצֶל דָּגֽוֹן׃
translation: The Philistines took God's ark, and brought it into the house of Dagon and set it by Dagon. (1 Samuel 5:2)

text: פֶּן אַפְשִׁיטֶנָּה עֲרֻמָּה וְהִצַּגְתִּיהָ כְּיוֹם הִוָּֽלְדָהּ וְשַׂמְתִּיהָ כַמִּדְבָּר וְשַׁתִּהָ כְּאֶרֶץ צִיָּה וַהֲמִתִּיהָ בַּצָּמָֽא׃
translation: For their mother has played the prostitute. She who conceived them has done shamefully; for she said, 'I will go after my lovers, who give me my bread and my water, my wool and my flax, my oil and my drink.' (Hosea 2:5)

text: אָֽנֹכִי אֶֽעֶרְבֶנּוּ מִיָּדִי תְּבַקְשֶׁנּוּ אִם לֹא הֲבִיאֹתִיו אֵלֶיךָ וְהִצַּגְתִּיו לְפָנֶיךָ וְחָטָאתִֽי לְךָ כָּל הַיָּמִֽים׃
translation: I'll be collateral for him. From my hand will you require him. If I don't bring him to you, and set him before you, then let me bear the blame forever; (Genesis 43:9)

text: שִׂנְאוּ רָע וְאֶהֱבוּ טוֹב וְהַצִּיגוּ בַשַּׁעַר מִשְׁפָּט אוּלַי יֶֽחֱנַן יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵֽי צְבָאוֹת שְׁאֵרִית יוֹסֵֽף׃
translation: Hate evil, love good, and establish justice in the courts. It may be that the LORD, the God of Armies, will be gracious to the remnant of Joseph." (Amos 5:15)

text: וַיִּשְׁמַע דָּוִד בַּמִּדְבָּר כִּֽי גֹזֵז נָבָל אֶת צֹאנֽוֹ׃
translation: David heard in the wilderness that Nabal was shearing his sheep. (1 Samuel 25:4)

text: וַיֻּגַּד לְתָמָר לֵאמֹר הִנֵּה חָמִיךְ עֹלֶה תִמְנָתָה לָגֹז צֹאנֽוֹ׃
translation: Tamar was told, "Behold, your father-in-law is going up to Timnah to shear his sheep." (Genesis 38:13)

text: וַיָּקָם אִיּוֹב וַיִּקְרַע אֶת מְעִלוֹ וַיָּגָז אֶת רֹאשׁוֹ וַיִּפֹּל אַרְצָה וַיִּשְׁתָּֽחוּ׃
translation: Then Job arose, and tore his robe, and shaved his head, and fell down on the ground, and worshiped. (Job 1:20)

text: וְעֵיפָה פִּילֶגֶשׁ כָּלֵב יָֽלְדָה אֶת חָרָן וְאֶת מוֹצָא וְאֶת גָּזֵז וְחָרָן הֹלִיד אֶת גָּזֵֽז׃
translation: Ephah, Caleb's concubine, bore Haran, Moza, and Gazez; and Haran became the father of Gazez. (1 Chronicles 2:46)

text: כֹּה אָמַר יְהוָה אִם שְׁלֵמִים וְכֵן רַבִּים וְכֵן נָגֹזּוּ וְעָבָר וְעִנִּתִךְ לֹא אֲעַנֵּךְ עֽוֹד׃
translation: The LORD says: "Though they are in full strength and likewise many, even so they will be cut down and pass away. Though I have afflicted you, I will afflict you no more. (Nahum 1:12)

text: וַיָּבֹא אַבְשָׁלוֹם אֶל הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֵּה נָא גֹזְזִים לְעַבְדֶּךָ יֵֽלֶךְ נָא הַמֶּלֶךְ וַעֲבָדָיו עִם עַבְדֶּֽךָ׃
translation: Absalom came to the king and said, "See now, your servant has sheep shearers. Please let the king and his servants go with your servant." (2 Samuel 13:24)

text: שְֽׂאוּ זִמְרָה וּתְנוּ תֹף כִּנּוֹר נָעִים עִם נָֽבֶל׃
translation: Blow the trumpet at the New Moon, at the full moon, on our feast day. (Psalms 81:3)

text: יִשְׂאוּ כְּתֹף וְכִנּוֹר וְיִשְׂמְחוּ לְקוֹל עוּגָֽב׃
translation: They sing to the tambourine and harp, and rejoice at the sound of the pipe. (Job 21:12)

text: לָמָּה נַחְבֵּאתָ לִבְרֹחַ וַתִּגְנֹב אֹתִי וְלֹא הִגַּדְתָּ לִּי וָֽאֲשַׁלֵּחֲךָ בְּשִׂמְחָה וּבְשִׁרִים בְּתֹף וּבְכִנּֽוֹר׃
translation: Why did you flee secretly, and deceive me, and didn't tell me, that I might have sent you away with mirth and with songs, with tambourine and with harp; (Genesis 31:27)

text: וְהָיָה כִנּוֹר וָנֶבֶל תֹּף וְחָלִיל וָיַיִן מִשְׁתֵּיהֶם וְאֵת פֹּעַל יְהוָה לֹא יַבִּיטוּ וּמַעֲשֵׂה יָדָיו לֹא רָאֽוּ׃
translation: The harp, lyre, tambourine, and flute, with wine, are at their feasts; but they don't respect the work of the LORD, neither have they considered the operation of his hands. (Isaiah 5:12)

text: וַיָּבֹא יִפְתָּח הַמִּצְפָּה אֶל בֵּיתוֹ וְהִנֵּה בִתּוֹ יֹצֵאת לִקְרָאתוֹ בְתֻפִּים וּבִמְחֹלוֹת וְרַק הִיא יְחִידָה אֵֽין לוֹ מִמֶּנּוּ בֵּן אוֹ בַֽת׃
translation: Jephthah came to Mizpah to his house; and behold, his daughter came out to meet him with tambourines and with dances. She was his only child. Besides her he had neither son nor daughter. (Judges 11:34)

text: וְלֹא נְטַשְׁתַּנִי לְנַשֵּׁק לְבָנַי וְלִבְנֹתָי עַתָּה הִסְכַּלְתָּֽ עֲשֽׂוֹ׃
translation: and didn't allow me to kiss my sons and my daughters? Now you have done foolishly. (Genesis 31:28)

text: נִתַּן הַסֶּכֶל בַּמְּרוֹמִים רַבִּים וַעֲשִׁירִים בַּשֵּׁפֶל יֵשֵֽׁבוּ׃
translation: Folly is set in great dignity, and the rich sit in a low place. (Ecclesiastes 10:6)

text: אַל תִּרְשַׁע הַרְבֵּה וְאַל תְּהִי סָכָל לָמָּה תָמוּת בְּלֹא עִתֶּֽךָ׃
translation: Don't be too wicked, neither be foolish. Why should you die before your time? (Ecclesiastes 7:17)

text: מֵפֵר אֹתוֹת בַּדִּים וְקֹסְמִים יְהוֹלֵל מֵשִׁיב חֲכָמִים אָחוֹר וְדַעְתָּם יְשַׂכֵּֽל׃
translation: who frustrates the signs of the liars, and makes diviners mad; who turns wise men backward, and makes their knowledge foolish; (Isaiah 44:25)

text: וְגַם בַּדֶּרֶךְ כשהסכל כְּשֶׁסָּכָל הֹלֵךְ לִבּוֹ חָסֵר וְאָמַר לַכֹּל סָכָל הֽוּא׃
translation: Yes also when the fool walks by the way, his understanding fails him, and he says to everyone that he is a fool. (Ecclesiastes 10:3)

text: וְהַסָּכָל יַרְבֶּה דְבָרִים לֹא יֵדַע הָאָדָם מַה שֶׁיִּֽהְיֶה וַאֲשֶׁר יִֽהְיֶה מֵֽאַחֲרָיו מִי יַגִּיד לֽוֹ׃
translation: A fool also multiplies words. Man doesn't know what will be; and that which will be after him, who can tell him? (Ecclesiastes 10:14)

text: שָׁם רְשָׁעִים חָדְלוּ רֹגֶז וְשָׁם יָנוּחוּ יְגִיעֵי כֹֽחַ׃
translation: There the wicked cease from troubling. There the weary are at rest. (Job 3:17)

text: הֲֽתִבְטַח בּוֹ כִּי רַב כֹּחוֹ וְתַעֲזֹב אֵלָיו יְגִיעֶֽךָ׃
translation: Will you trust him, because his strength is great? Or will you leave to him your labor? (Job 39:11)

text: הִקְשִׁיחַ בָּנֶיהָ לְּלֹא לָהּ לְרִיק יְגִיעָהּ בְּלִי פָֽחַד׃
translation: She deals harshly with her young ones, as if they were not hers. Though her labor is in vain, she is without fear, (Job 39:16)

text: יְגִיעַ כַּפֶּיךָ כִּי תֹאכֵל אַשְׁרֶיךָ וְטוֹב לָֽךְ׃
translation: For you will eat the labor of your hands. You will be happy, and it will be well with you. (Psalms 128:2)

text: הֲטוֹב לְךָ כִּֽי תַעֲשֹׁק כִּֽי תִמְאַס יְגִיעַ כַּפֶּיךָ וְעַל עֲצַת רְשָׁעִים הוֹפָֽעְתָּ׃
translation: Is it good to you that you should oppress, that you should despise the work of your hands, and smile on the counsel of the wicked? (Job 10:3)

text: וְהַבֹּשֶׁת אָֽכְלָה אֶת יְגִיעַ אֲבוֹתֵינוּ מִנְּעוּרֵינוּ אֶת צֹאנָם וְאֶת בְּקָרָם אֶת בְּנֵיהֶם וְאֶת בְּנוֹתֵיהֶֽם׃
translation: But the shameful thing has devoured the labor of our fathers from our youth, their flocks and their herds, their sons and their daughters. (Jeremiah 3:24)

text: וַאֲנִי כְחֵרֵשׁ לֹא אֶשְׁמָע וּכְאִלֵּם לֹא יִפְתַּח פִּֽיו׃
translation: Yes, I am as a man who doesn't hear, in whose mouth are no reproofs. (Psalms 38:14)

text: פְּתַח פִּיךָ לְאִלֵּם אֶל דִּין כָּל בְּנֵי חֲלֽוֹף׃
translation: Open your mouth for the mute, in the cause of all who are left desolate. (Proverbs 31:8)

text: וּבְדַבְּרוֹ עִמִּי כַּדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה נָתַתִּי פָנַי אַרְצָה וְנֶאֱלָֽמְתִּי׃
translation: When he had spoken these words to me, I set my face toward the ground and was mute. (Daniel 10:15)

text: נֶאֱלַמְתִּי לֹא אֶפְתַּח פִּי כִּי אַתָּה עָשִֽׂיתָ׃
translation: Remove your scourge away from me. I am overcome by the blow of your hand. (Psalms 39:10)

text: לַמְנַצֵּחַ עַל יוֹנַת אֵלֶם רְחֹקִים לְדָוִד מִכְתָּם בֶּֽאֱחֹז אֹתוֹ פְלִשְׁתִּים בְּגַֽת׃
translation: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of "Silent Dove in Distant Lands." A poem by David, when the Philistines seized him in Gath. Be merciful to me, God, for man wants to swallow me up. All day long, he attacks and oppresses me. (Psalms 56:1)

text: אָז יְדַלֵּג כָּֽאַיָּל פִּסֵּחַ וְתָרֹן לְשׁוֹן אִלֵּם כִּֽי נִבְקְעוּ בַמִּדְבָּר מַיִם וּנְחָלִים בָּעֲרָבָֽה׃
translation: Then the lame man will leap like a deer, and the tongue of the mute will sing; for waters will break out in the wilderness, and streams in the desert. (Isaiah 35:6)

text: וַתֹּאמֶר לוֹ אִשְׁתּוֹ עֹדְךָ מַחֲזִיק בְּתֻמָּתֶךָ בָּרֵךְ אֱלֹהִים וָמֻֽת׃
translation: Then his wife said to him, "Do you still maintain your integrity? Renounce God, and die." (Job 2:9)

text: יִשְׁקְלֵנִי בְמֹאזְנֵי צֶדֶק וְיֵדַע אֱלוֹהַּ תֻּמָּתִֽי׃
translation: (let me be weighed in an even balance, that God may know my integrity); (Job 31:6)

text: וַיֵּשְׁבוּ לְפָנָיו הַבְּכֹר כִּבְכֹרָתוֹ וְהַצָּעִיר כִּצְעִרָתוֹ וַיִּתְמְהוּ הָאֲנָשִׁים אִישׁ אֶל רֵעֵֽהוּ׃
translation: They sat before him, the firstborn according to his birthright, and the youngest according to his youth, and the men marveled with one another. (Genesis 43:33)

text: עַמּוּדֵי שָׁמַיִם יְרוֹפָפוּ וְיִתְמְהוּ מִגַּעֲרָתֽוֹ׃
translation: The pillars of heaven tremble and are astonished at his rebuke. (Job 26:11)

text: חָלִילָה לִּי אִם אַצְדִּיק אֶתְכֶם עַד אֶגְוָע לֹא אָסִיר תֻּמָּתִי מִמֶּֽנִּי׃
translation: Far be it from me that I should justify you. Until I die I will not put away my integrity from me. (Job 27:5)

text: רְאוּ בַגּוֹיִם וְֽהַבִּיטוּ וְהִֽתַּמְּהוּ תְּמָהוּ כִּי פֹעַל פֹּעֵל בִּֽימֵיכֶם לֹא תַאֲמִינוּ כִּי יְסֻפָּֽר׃
translation: "Look among the nations, watch, and wonder marvelously; for I am working a work in your days which you will not believe though it is told you. (Habakkuk 1:5)

text: חַי אֵל הֵסִיר מִשְׁפָּטִי וְשַׁדַּי הֵמַר נַפְשִֽׁי׃
translation: "As God lives, who has taken away my right, the Almighty, who has made my soul bitter (Job 27:2)

text: בַּשִּׁיר לֹא יִשְׁתּוּ יָיִן יֵמַר שֵׁכָר לְשֹׁתָֽיו׃
translation: They will not drink wine with a song. Strong drink will be bitter to those who drink it. (Isaiah 24:9)

text: וְאָכְלוּ אֶת הַבָּשָׂר בַּלַּיְלָה הַזֶּה צְלִי אֵשׁ וּמַצּוֹת עַל מְרֹרִים יֹאכְלֻֽהוּ׃
translation: They shall eat the meat in that night, roasted with fire, with unleavened bread. They shall eat it with bitter herbs. (Exodus 12:8)

text: בַּחֹדֶשׁ הַשֵּׁנִי בְּאַרְבָּעָה עָשָׂר יוֹם בֵּין הָעַרְבַּיִם יַעֲשׂוּ אֹתוֹ עַל מַצּוֹת וּמְרֹרִים יֹאכְלֻֽהוּ׃
translation: In the second month, on the fourteenth day at evening they shall keep it; they shall eat it with unleavened bread and bitter herbs. (Numbers 9:11)

text: הִשָּׁמֶר מִפָּנָיו וּשְׁמַע בְּקֹלוֹ אַל תַּמֵּר בּוֹ כִּי לֹא יִשָּׂא לְפִשְׁעֲכֶם כִּי שְׁמִי בְּקִרְבּֽוֹ׃
translation: Pay attention to him, and listen to his voice. Don't provoke him, for he will not pardon your disobedience, for my name is in him. (Exodus 23:21)

text: וְיִתְמַרְמַר מֶלֶךְ הַנֶּגֶב וְיָצָא וְנִלְחַם עִמּוֹ עִם מֶלֶךְ הַצָּפוֹן וְהֶעֱמִיד הָמוֹן רָב וְנִתַּן הֶהָמוֹן בְּיָדֽוֹ׃
translation: "The king of the south will be moved with anger and will come out and fight with him, even with the king of the north. He will send out a great multitude, and the multitude will be given into his hand. (Daniel 11:11)

text: תּוֹרָה אַחַת יִהְיֶה לָֽאֶזְרָח וְלַגֵּר הַגָּר בְּתוֹכְכֶֽם׃
translation: One law shall be to him who is born at home, and to the stranger who lives as a foreigner among you." (Exodus 12:49)

text: בַּסֻּכֹּת תֵּשְׁבוּ שִׁבְעַת יָמִים כָּל הָֽאֶזְרָח בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל יֵשְׁבוּ בַּסֻּכֹּֽת׃
translation: You shall dwell in temporary shelters for seven days. All who are native-born in Israel shall dwell in temporary shelters, (Leviticus 23:42)

text: מִשְׁפַּט אֶחָד יִהְיֶה לָכֶם כַּגֵּר כָּאֶזְרָח יִהְיֶה כִּי אֲנִי יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃
translation: You shall have one kind of law for the foreigner as well as the native-born; for I am the LORD your God.'" (Leviticus 24:22)

text: כָּל הָאֶזְרָח יַעֲשֶׂה כָּכָה אֶת אֵלֶּה לְהַקְרִיב אִשֵּׁה רֵֽיחַ נִיחֹחַ לַֽיהוָֽה׃
translation: "'All who are native-born shall do these things in this way, in offering an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to the LORD. (Numbers 15:13)

text: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם אַתֶּם אֶת חֻקֹּתַי וְאֶת מִשְׁפָּטַי וְלֹא תַעֲשׂוּ מִכֹּל הַתּוֹעֵבֹת הָאֵלֶּה הָֽאֶזְרָח וְהַגֵּר הַגָּר בְּתוֹכְכֶֽם׃
translation: You therefore shall keep my statutes and my ordinances, and shall not do any of these abominations; neither the native-born, nor the stranger who lives as a foreigner among you (Leviticus 18:26)

text: וְנֹקֵב שֵׁם יְהוָה מוֹת יוּמָת רָגוֹם יִרְגְּמוּ בוֹ כָּל הָעֵדָה כַּגֵּר כָּֽאֶזְרָח בְּנָקְבוֹ שֵׁם יוּמָֽת׃
translation: He who blasphemes the LORD's name, he shall surely be put to death. All the congregation shall certainly stone him. The foreigner as well as the native-born shall be put to death when he blasphemes the Name. (Leviticus 24:16)

text: הֲלֹא צָבָא לֶאֱנוֹשׁ על עֲלֵי אָרֶץ וְכִימֵי שָׂכִיר יָמָֽיו׃
translation: "Isn't a man forced to labor on earth? Aren't his days like the days of a hired hand? (Job 7:1)

text: אִם בְּעָלָיו עִמּוֹ לֹא יְשַׁלֵּם אִם שָׂכִיר הוּא בָּא בִּשְׂכָרֽוֹ׃
translation: "If a man borrows anything of his neighbor's, and it is injured, or dies, its owner not being with it, he shall surely make restitution. (Exodus 22:14)

text: לֹא תַעֲשֹׁק שָׂכִיר עָנִי וְאֶבְיוֹן מֵאַחֶיךָ אוֹ מִגֵּרְךָ אֲשֶׁר בְּאַרְצְךָ בִּשְׁעָרֶֽיךָ׃
translation: You shall not oppress a hired servant who is poor and needy, whether he is one of your brothers or one of the foreigners who are in your land within your gates. (Deuteronomy 24:14)

text: לֹֽא תַעֲשֹׁק אֶת רֵֽעֲךָ וְלֹא תִגְזֹל לֹֽא תָלִין פְּעֻלַּת שָׂכִיר אִתְּךָ עַד בֹּֽקֶר׃
translation: "'You shall not oppress your neighbor, nor rob him. "'The wages of a hired servant shall not remain with you all night until the morning. (Leviticus 19:13)

text: כִּי כֹה אָמַר אֲדֹנָי אֵלָי בְּעוֹד שָׁנָה כִּשְׁנֵי שָׂכִיר וְכָלָה כָּל כְּבוֹד קֵדָֽר׃
translation: For the Lord said to me, "Within a year, as a worker bound by contract would count it, all the glory of Kedar will fail, (Isaiah 21:16)

text: לֹא יִקְשֶׁה בְעֵינֶךָ בְּשַׁלֵּֽחֲךָ אֹתוֹ חָפְשִׁי מֵֽעִמָּךְ כִּי מִשְׁנֶה שְׂכַר שָׂכִיר עֲבָֽדְךָ שֵׁשׁ שָׁנִים וּבֵֽרַכְךָ יְהוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר תַּעֲשֶֽׂה׃
translation: It shall not seem hard to you when you let him go free from you, for he has been double the value of a hired hand as he served you six years. The LORD your God will bless you in all that you do. (Deuteronomy 15:18)

text: כָּל רֹאַי יַלְעִגוּ לִי יַפְטִירוּ בְשָׂפָה יָנִיעוּ רֹֽאשׁ׃
translation: "He trusts in the LORD. Let him deliver him. Let him rescue him, since he delights in him." (Psalms 22:8)

text: פּוֹטֵֽר מַיִם רֵאשִׁית מָדוֹן וְלִפְנֵי הִתְגַּלַּע הָרִיב נְטֽוֹשׁ׃
translation: The beginning of strife is like breaching a dam, therefore stop contention before quarreling breaks out. (Proverbs 17:14)

text: כָּל פֶּטֶר רֶחֶם לִי וְכָֽל מִקְנְךָ תִּזָּכָר פֶּטֶר שׁוֹר וָשֶֽׂה׃
translation: "All that opens the womb is mine; and all your livestock that is male, the firstborn of cow and sheep. (Exodus 34:19)

text: קַדֶּשׁ לִי כָל בְּכוֹר פֶּטֶר כָּל רֶחֶם בִּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בָּאָדָם וּבַבְּהֵמָה לִי הֽוּא׃
translation: "Sanctify to me all the firstborn, whatever opens the womb among the children of Israel, both of man and of animal. It is mine." (Exodus 13:2)

text: וְאֵלֶּה הַמְשֹׁרְרִים רָאשֵׁי אָבוֹת לַלְוִיִּם בַּלְּשָׁכֹת פטירים פְּטוּרִים כִּֽי יוֹמָם וָלַיְלָה עֲלֵיהֶם בַּמְּלָאכָֽה׃
translation: These are the singers, heads of fathers' households of the Levites, who lived in the rooms and were free from other service, for they were employed in their work day and night. (1 Chronicles 9:33)

text: וְהַעֲבַרְתָּ כָל פֶּֽטֶר רֶחֶם לַֽיהֹוָה וְכָל פֶּטֶר שֶׁגֶר בְּהֵמָה אֲשֶׁר יִהְיֶה לְךָ הַזְּכָרִים לַיהוָֽה׃
translation: that you shall set apart to the LORD all that opens the womb, and every firstborn that comes from an animal which you have. The males shall be the LORD's. (Exodus 13:12)

text: הָמוּ גוֹיִם מָטוּ מַמְלָכוֹת נָתַן בְּקוֹלוֹ תָּמוּג אָֽרֶץ׃
translation: The LORD of Armies is with us. The God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah. (Psalms 46:7)

text: יַעֲלוּ שָׁמַיִם יֵרְדוּ תְהוֹמוֹת נַפְשָׁם בְּרָעָה תִתְמוֹגָֽג׃
translation: They mount up to the sky; they go down again to the depths. Their soul melts away because of trouble. (Psalms 107:26)

text: וַיִּרְאוּ הַצֹּפִים לְשָׁאוּל בְּגִבְעַת בִּנְיָמִן וְהִנֵּה הֶהָמוֹן נָמוֹג וַיֵּלֶךְ וַהֲלֹֽם׃
translation: The watchmen of Saul in Gibeah of Benjamin looked; and behold, the multitude melted away and scattered. (1 Samuel 14:16)

text: שַׁעֲרֵי הַנְּהָרוֹת נִפְתָּחוּ וְהַֽהֵיכָל נָמֽוֹג׃
translation: It is decreed: she is uncovered, she is carried away; and her servants moan as with the voice of doves, beating on their breasts. (Nahum 2:7)

text: הָרִים רָעֲשׁוּ מִמֶּנּוּ וְהַגְּבָעוֹת הִתְמֹגָגוּ וַתִּשָּׂא הָאָרֶץ מִפָּנָיו וְתֵבֵל וְכָל יֹשְׁבֵי בָֽהּ׃
translation: The mountains quake before him, and the hills melt away. The earth trembles at his presence, yes, the world, and all who dwell in it. (Nahum 1:5)

text: וְאֵין קוֹרֵא בְשִׁמְךָ מִתְעוֹרֵר לְהַחֲזִיק בָּךְ כִּֽי הִסְתַּרְתָּ פָנֶיךָ מִמֶּנּוּ וַתְּמוּגֵנוּ בְּיַד עֲוֺנֵֽנוּ׃
translation: For we have all become like one who is unclean, and all our righteousness is like a polluted garment. We all fade like a leaf; and our iniquities, like the wind, take us away. (Isaiah 64:6)

text: בָּנֹה בָנִיתִי בֵּית זְבֻל לָךְ מָכוֹן לְשִׁבְתְּךָ עוֹלָמִֽים׃
translation: I have surely built you a house of habitation, a place for you to dwell in forever." (1 Kings 8:13)

text: וַֽאֲנִי בָּנִיתִי בֵית זְבֻל לָךְ וּמָכוֹן לְשִׁבְתְּךָ עוֹלָמִֽים׃
translation: But I have built you a house and home, a place for you to dwell in forever." (2 Chronicles 6:2)

text: צֶדֶק וּמִשְׁפָּט מְכוֹן כִּסְאֶךָ חֶסֶד וֶאֱמֶת יְֽקַדְּמוּ פָנֶֽיךָ׃
translation: Blessed are the people who learn to acclaim you. They walk in the light of your presence, LORD. (Psalms 89:15)

text: יָֽסַד אֶרֶץ עַל מְכוֹנֶיהָ בַּל תִּמּוֹט עוֹלָם וָעֶֽד׃
translation: He laid the foundations of the earth, that it should not be moved forever. (Psalms 104:5)

text: מִֽמְּכוֹן שִׁבְתּוֹ הִשְׁגִּיחַ אֶל כָּל יֹשְׁבֵי הָאָֽרֶץ׃
translation: From the place of his habitation he looks out on all the inhabitants of the earth, (Psalms 33:14)

text: עָנָן וַעֲרָפֶל סְבִיבָיו צֶדֶק וּמִשְׁפָּט מְכוֹן כִּסְאֽוֹ׃
translation: Clouds and darkness are around him. Righteousness and justice are the foundation of his throne. (Psalms 97:2)

text: כִּי לֹא יָדַע שָׁלֵו בְּבִטְנוֹ בַּחֲמוּדוֹ לֹא יְמַלֵּֽט׃
translation: "Because he knew no quietness within him, he will not save anything of that in which he delights. (Job 20:20)

text: זֶה יָמוּת בְּעֶצֶם תֻּמּוֹ כֻּלּוֹ שַׁלְאֲנַן וְשָׁלֵֽיו׃
translation: One dies in his full strength, being wholly at ease and quiet. (Job 21:23)

text: הִנֵּה אֵלֶּה רְשָׁעִים וְשַׁלְוֵי עוֹלָם הִשְׂגּוּ חָֽיִל׃
translation: Behold, these are the wicked. Being always at ease, they increase in riches. (Psalms 73:12)

text: וַאֲנִי אָמַרְתִּי בְשַׁלְוִי בַּל אֶמּוֹט לְעוֹלָֽם׃
translation: You, LORD, when you favored me, made my mountain stand strong; but when you hid your face, I was troubled. (Psalms 30:7)

text: שָׁאַל וַיָּבֵא שְׂלָו וְלֶחֶם שָׁמַיִם יַשְׂבִּיעֵֽם׃
translation: They asked, and he brought quails, and satisfied them with the bread of the sky. (Psalms 105:40)

text: וּזְהִירִין הֱווֹ שָׁלוּ לְמֶעְבַּד עַל דְּנָה לְמָה יִשְׂגֵּא חֲבָלָא לְהַנְזָקַת מַלְכִֽין׃
translation: Be careful that you not be slack doing so. Why should damage grow to the hurt of the kings? (Ezra 4:22)

text: קָטֹן וְגָדוֹל שָׁם הוּא וְעֶבֶד חָפְשִׁי מֵאֲדֹנָֽיו׃
translation: The small and the great are there. The servant is free from his master. (Job 3:19)

text: כִּי תִקְנֶה עֶבֶד עִבְרִי שֵׁשׁ שָׁנִים יַעֲבֹד וּבַשְּׁבִעִת יֵצֵא לַֽחָפְשִׁי חִנָּֽם׃
translation: "If you buy a Hebrew servant, he shall serve six years, and in the seventh he shall go out free without paying anything. (Exodus 21:2)

text: וְאִם שֵׁן עַבְדּוֹ אֽוֹ שֵׁן אֲמָתוֹ יַפִּיל לַֽחָפְשִׁי יְשַׁלְּחֶנּוּ תַּחַת שִׁנּֽוֹ׃
translation: If he strikes out his male servant's tooth, or his female servant's tooth, he shall let the servant go free for his tooth's sake. (Exodus 21:27)

text: בַּמֵּתִים חָפְשִׁי כְּמוֹ חֲלָלִים שֹׁכְבֵי קֶבֶר אֲשֶׁר לֹא זְכַרְתָּם עוֹד וְהֵמָּה מִיָּדְךָ נִגְזָֽרוּ׃
translation: You have laid me in the lowest pit, in the darkest depths. (Psalms 88:6)

text: וְאִם אָמֹר יֹאמַר הָעֶבֶד אָהַבְתִּי אֶת אֲדֹנִי אֶת אִשְׁתִּי וְאֶת בָּנָי לֹא אֵצֵא חָפְשִֽׁי׃
translation: But if the servant shall plainly say, 'I love my master, my wife, and my children. I will not go out free;' (Exodus 21:5)

text: וְכִֽי יַכֶּה אִישׁ אֶת עֵין עַבְדּוֹ אֽוֹ אֶת עֵין אֲמָתוֹ וְשִֽׁחֲתָהּ לַֽחָפְשִׁי יְשַׁלְּחֶנּוּ תַּחַת עֵינֽוֹ׃
translation: "If a man strikes his servant's eye, or his maid's eye, and destroys it, he shall let him go free for his eye's sake. (Exodus 21:26)

text: וְעָשִׂיתָ קְּעָרֹתָיו וְכַפֹּתָיו וּקְשׂוֹתָיו וּמְנַקִּיֹּתָיו אֲשֶׁר יֻסַּךְ בָּהֵן זָהָב טָהוֹר תַּעֲשֶׂה אֹתָֽם׃
translation: You shall make its dishes, its spoons, its ladles, and its bowls with which to pour out offerings. You shall make them of pure gold. (Exodus 25:29)

text: שְׁלֹשִׁים וּמֵאָה הַקְּעָרָה הָֽאַחַת כֶּסֶף וְשִׁבְעִים הַמִּזְרָק הָאֶחָד כֹּל כֶּסֶף הַכֵּלִים אַלְפַּיִם וְאַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת בְּשֶׁקֶל הַקֹּֽדֶשׁ׃
translation: each silver platter weighing one hundred thirty shekels, and each bowl seventy; all the silver of the vessels two thousand four hundred shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary; (Numbers 7:85)

text: וַיַּעַשׂ אֶֽת הַכֵּלִים אֲשֶׁר עַל הַשֻּׁלְחָן אֶת קְעָרֹתָיו וְאֶת כַּפֹּתָיו וְאֵת מְנַקִּיֹּתָיו וְאֶת הַקְּשָׂוֺת אֲשֶׁר יֻסַּךְ בָּהֵן זָהָב טָהֽוֹר׃
translation: He made the vessels which were on the table, its dishes, its spoons, its bowls, and its pitchers with which to pour out, of pure gold. (Exodus 37:16)

text: וְקָרְבָּנוֹ קַֽעֲרַת כֶּסֶף אַחַת שְׁלֹשִׁים וּמֵאָה מִשְׁקָלָהּ מִזְרָק אֶחָד כֶּסֶף שִׁבְעִים שֶׁקֶל בְּשֶׁקֶל הַקֹּדֶשׁ שְׁנֵיהֶם מְלֵאִים סֹלֶת בְּלוּלָה בַשֶּׁמֶן לְמִנְחָֽה׃
translation: and his offering was: one silver platter, the weight of which was one hundred thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering; (Numbers 7:13)

text: קָרְבָּנוֹ קַֽעֲרַת כֶּסֶף אַחַת שְׁלֹשִׁים וּמֵאָה מִשְׁקָלָהּ מִזְרָק אֶחָד כֶּסֶף שִׁבְעִים שֶׁקֶל בְּשֶׁקֶל הַקֹּדֶשׁ שְׁנֵיהֶם מְלֵאִים סֹלֶת בְּלוּלָה בַשֶּׁמֶן לְמִנְחָֽה׃
translation: gave his offering: one silver platter, the weight of which was a hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering; (Numbers 7:25)

text: קָרְבָּנוֹ קַֽעֲרַת כֶּסֶף אַחַת שְׁלֹשִׁים וּמֵאָה מִשְׁקָלָהּ מִזְרָק אֶחָד כֶּסֶף שִׁבְעִים שֶׁקֶל בְּשֶׁקֶל הַקֹּדֶשׁ שְׁנֵיהֶם מְלֵאִים סֹלֶת בְּלוּלָה בַשֶּׁמֶן לְמִנְחָֽה׃
translation: gave his offering: one silver platter, the weight of which was one hundred thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering; (Numbers 7:31)

text: אֵשׁ תָּמִיד תּוּקַד עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ לֹא תִכְבֶֽה׃
translation: He shall bring his trespass offering to the LORD: a ram without defect from the flock, according to your estimation, for a trespass offering, to the priest. (Leviticus 6:6)

text: וְהַֽעֲבַרְתִּי אֶת אֹיְבֶיךָ בְּאֶרֶץ לֹא יָדָעְתָּ כִּֽי אֵשׁ קָדְחָה בְאַפִּי עֲלֵיכֶם תּוּקָֽד׃
translation: I will make them to pass with your enemies into a land which you don't know; for a fire is kindled in my anger, which will burn on you." (Jeremiah 15:14)

text: הָאֹֽמְרִים קְרַב אֵלֶיךָ אַל תִּגַּשׁ בִּי כִּי קְדַשְׁתִּיךָ אֵלֶּה עָשָׁן בְּאַפִּי אֵשׁ יֹקֶדֶת כָּל הַיּֽוֹם׃
translation: who say, 'Stay by yourself, don't come near to me, for I am holier than you.' These are smoke in my nose, a fire that burns all day. (Isaiah 65:5)

text: וּשְׁבָרָהּ כְּשֵׁבֶר נֵבֶל יוֹצְרִים כָּתוּת לֹא יַחְמֹל וְלֹֽא יִמָּצֵא בִמְכִתָּתוֹ חֶרֶשׂ לַחְתּוֹת אֵשׁ מִיָּקוּד וְלַחְשֹׂף מַיִם מִגֶּֽבֶא׃
translation: He will break it as a potter's vessel is broken, breaking it in pieces without sparing, so that there won't be found among the broken pieces a piece good enough to take fire from the hearth, or to dip up water out of the cistern." (Isaiah 30:14)

text: וְהָאֵשׁ עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ תּֽוּקַד בּוֹ לֹא תִכְבֶּה וּבִעֵר עָלֶיהָ הַכֹּהֵן עֵצִים בַּבֹּקֶר בַּבֹּקֶר וְעָרַךְ עָלֶיהָ הָֽעֹלָה וְהִקְטִיר עָלֶיהָ חֶלְבֵי הַשְּׁלָמִֽים׃
translation: or any thing about which he has sworn falsely: he shall restore it in full, and shall add a fifth part more to it. He shall return it to him to whom it belongs in the day of his being found guilty. (Leviticus 6:5)

text: וְשָׁמַטְתָּה וּבְךָ מִנַּחֲלָֽתְךָ אֲשֶׁר נָתַתִּי לָךְ וְהַעֲבַדְתִּיךָ אֶת אֹיְבֶיךָ בָּאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר לֹֽא יָדָעְתָּ כִּֽי אֵשׁ קְדַחְתֶּם בְּאַפִּי עַד עוֹלָם תּוּקָֽד׃
translation: You, even of yourself, will discontinue from your heritage that I gave you. I will cause you to serve your enemies in the land which you don't know, for you have kindled a fire in my anger which will burn forever." (Jeremiah 17:4)

text: יֵבֹשׁוּ יִכְלוּ שֹׂטְנֵי נַפְשִׁי יַֽעֲטוּ חֶרְפָּה וּכְלִמָּה מְבַקְשֵׁי רָעָתִֽי׃
translation: Let my accusers be disappointed and consumed. Let them be covered with disgrace and scorn who want to harm me. (Psalms 71:13)

text: הִקְצַרְתָּ יְמֵי עֲלוּמָיו הֶֽעֱטִיתָ עָלָיו בּוּשָׁה סֶֽלָה׃
translation: How long, LORD? Will you hide yourself forever? Will your wrath burn like fire? (Psalms 89:46)

text: תְּהִי לוֹ כְּבֶגֶד יַעְטֶה וּלְמֵזַח תָּמִיד יַחְגְּרֶֽהָ׃
translation: Let it be to him as the clothing with which he covers himself, for the belt that is always around him. (Psalms 109:19)

text: עֹֽטֶה אוֹר כַּשַּׂלְמָה נוֹטֶה שָׁמַיִם כַּיְרִיעָֽה׃
translation: He covers himself with light as with a garment. He stretches out the heavens like a curtain. (Psalms 104:2)

text: יִלְבְּשׁוּ שׂוֹטְנַי כְּלִמָּה וְיַעֲטוּ כַמְעִיל בָּשְׁתָּֽם׃
translation: Let my adversaries be clothed with dishonor. Let them cover themselves with their own shame as with a robe. (Psalms 109:29)

text: הַגִּידָה לִּי שֶׁאָהֲבָה נַפְשִׁי אֵיכָה תִרְעֶה אֵיכָה תַּרְבִּיץ בַּֽצָּהֳרָיִם שַׁלָּמָה אֶֽהְיֶה כְּעֹטְיָה עַל עֶדְרֵי חֲבֵרֶֽיךָ׃
translation: Tell me, you whom my soul loves, where you graze your flock, where you rest them at noon; for why should I be as one who is veiled beside the flocks of your companions? (Song of Solomon 1:7)

text: הִנֵּֽה בִטְנִי כְּיַיִן לֹא יִפָּתֵחַ כְּאֹבוֹת חֲדָשִׁים יִבָּקֵֽעַ׃
translation: Behold, my breast is as wine which has no vent; like new wineskins it is ready to burst. (Job 32:19)

text: וְשָׁפַלְתְּ מֵאֶרֶץ תְּדַבֵּרִי וּמֵֽעָפָר תִּשַּׁח אִמְרָתֵךְ וְֽהָיָה כְּאוֹב מֵאֶרֶץ קוֹלֵךְ וּמֵעָפָר אִמְרָתֵךְ תְּצַפְצֵֽף׃
translation: You will be brought down, and will speak out of the ground. Your speech will mumble out of the dust. Your voice will be as of one who has a familiar spirit, out of the ground, and your speech will whisper out of the dust. (Isaiah 29:4)

text: וַיָּמָת שָׁאוּל בְּמַֽעֲלוֹ אֲשֶׁר מָעַל בַּֽיהוָה עַל דְּבַר יְהוָה אֲשֶׁר לֹא שָׁמָר וְגַם לִשְׁאוֹל בָּאוֹב לִדְרֽוֹשׁ׃
translation: So Saul died for his trespass which he committed against the LORD, because of the LORD's word, which he didn't keep, and also because he asked counsel of one who had a familiar spirit, to inquire, (1 Chronicles 10:13)

text: וְכִֽי יֹאמְרוּ אֲלֵיכֶם דִּרְשׁוּ אֶל הָאֹבוֹת וְאֶל הַיִּדְּעֹנִים הַֽמְצַפְצְפִים וְהַמַּהְגִּים הֲלוֹא עַם אֶל אֱלֹהָיו יִדְרֹשׁ בְּעַד הַחַיִּים אֶל הַמֵּתִֽים׃
translation: When they tell you, "Consult with those who have familiar spirits and with the wizards, who chirp and who mutter," shouldn't a people consult with their God? Should they consult the dead on behalf of the living? (Isaiah 8:19)

text: וְהוּא הֶעֱבִיר אֶת בָּנָיו בָּאֵשׁ בְּגֵי בֶן הִנֹּם וְעוֹנֵן וְנִחֵשׁ וְֽכִשֵּׁף וְעָשָׂה אוֹב וְיִדְּעוֹנִי הִרְבָּה לַעֲשׂוֹת הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהוָה לְהַכְעִיסֽוֹ׃
translation: He also made his children to pass through the fire in the valley of the son of Hinnom. He practiced sorcery, divination, and witchcraft, and dealt with those who had familiar spirits and with wizards. He did much evil in the LORD's sight, to provoke him to anger. (2 Chronicles 33:6)

text: וּבְנֵי יָהְדָּי רֶגֶם וְיוֹתָם וְגֵישָׁן וָפֶלֶט וְעֵיפָה וָשָֽׁעַף׃
translation: The sons of Jahdai: Regem, Jothan, Geshan, Pelet, Ephah, and Shaaph. (1 Chronicles 2:47)

text: וְהֶעֱלוּ עָלַיִךְ קָהָל וְרָגְמוּ אוֹתָךְ בָּאָבֶן וּבִתְּקוּךְ בְּחַרְבוֹתָֽם׃
translation: They will also bring up a company against you, and they will stone you with stones, and thrust you through with their swords. (Ezekiel 16:40)

text: וַיִּקְשְׁרוּ עָלָיו וַיִּרְגְּמֻהוּ אֶבֶן בְּמִצְוַת הַמֶּלֶךְ בַּחֲצַר בֵּית יְהוָֽה׃
translation: They conspired against him, and stoned him with stones at the commandment of the king in the court of the LORD's house. (2 Chronicles 24:21)

text: וּרְגָמֻהוּ כָּל אַנְשֵׁי עִירוֹ בָֽאֲבָנִים וָמֵת וּבִֽעַרְתָּ הָרָע מִקִּרְבֶּךָ וְכָל יִשְׂרָאֵל יִשְׁמְעוּ וְיִרָֽאוּ׃
translation: All the men of his city shall stone him to death with stones. So you shall remove the evil from among you. All Israel shall hear, and fear. (Deuteronomy 21:21)

text: וְרָגְמוּ עֲלֵיהֶן אֶבֶן קָהָל וּבָרֵא אוֹתְהֶן בְּחַרְבוֹתָם בְּנֵיהֶם וּבְנֽוֹתֵיהֶם יַהֲרֹגוּ וּבָתֵּיהֶן בָּאֵשׁ יִשְׂרֹֽפוּ׃
translation: The company will stone them with stones and dispatch them with their swords. They will kill their sons and their daughters, and burn up their houses with fire. (Ezekiel 23:47)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה מוֹת יוּמַת הָאִישׁ רָגוֹם אֹתוֹ בָֽאֲבָנִים כָּל הָעֵדָה מִחוּץ לַֽמַּחֲנֶֽה׃
translation: The LORD said to Moses, "The man shall surely be put to death. All the congregation shall stone him with stones outside of the camp." (Numbers 15:35)

text: מִבֹּקֶר לָעֶרֶב יֻכַּתּוּ מִבְּלִי מֵשִׂים לָנֶצַח יֹאבֵֽדוּ׃
translation: Between morning and evening they are destroyed. They perish forever without any regarding it. (Job 4:20)

text: וּמָעוּךְ וְכָתוּת וְנָתוּק וְכָרוּת לֹא תַקְרִיבוּ לַֽיהוָה וּֽבְאַרְצְכֶם לֹא תַעֲשֽׂוּ׃
translation: You must not offer to the LORD that which has its testicles bruised, crushed, broken, or cut. You must not do this in your land. (Leviticus 22:24)

text: וְכֻתְּתוּ גוֹי בְּגוֹי וְעִיר בְּעִיר כִּֽי אֱלֹהִים הֲמָמָם בְּכָל צָרָֽה׃
translation: They were broken in pieces, nation against nation, and city against city; for God troubled them with all adversity. (2 Chronicles 15:6)

text: נִשְׁאַר בָּעִיר שַׁמָּה וּשְׁאִיָּה יֻכַּת שָֽׁעַר׃
translation: The city is left in desolation, and the gate is struck with destruction. (Isaiah 24:12)

text: וְכַתּוֹתִי מִפָּנָיו צָרָיו וּמְשַׂנְאָיו אֶגּֽוֹף׃
translation: But my faithfulness and my loving kindness will be with him. In my name, his horn will be exalted. (Psalms 89:24)

text: וַיֵּצֵא הָאֱמֹרִי הַיֹּשֵׁב בָּהָר הַהוּא לִקְרַאתְכֶם וַיִּרְדְּפוּ אֶתְכֶם כַּאֲשֶׁר תַּעֲשֶׂינָה הַדְּבֹרִים וַֽיַּכְּתוּ אֶתְכֶם בְּשֵׂעִיר עַד חָרְמָֽה׃
translation: The Amorites, who lived in that hill country, came out against you and chased you as bees do, and beat you down in Seir, even to Hormah. (Deuteronomy 1:44)

text: אֶפְתְּחָה בְמָשָׁל פִּי אַבִּיעָה חִידוֹת מִנִּי קֶֽדֶם׃
translation: I will open my mouth in a parable. I will utter dark sayings of old, (Psalms 78:2)

text: בֶּן אָדָם חוּד חִידָה וּמְשֹׁל מָשָׁל אֶל בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
translation: "Son of man, tell a riddle, and speak a parable to the house of Israel; (Ezekiel 17:2)

text: אַטֶּה לְמָשָׁל אָזְנִי אֶפְתַּח בְּכִנּוֹר חִידָתִֽי׃
translation: Why should I fear in the days of evil, when iniquity at my heels surrounds me? (Psalms 49:5)

text: לְהָבִין מָשָׁל וּמְלִיצָה דִּבְרֵי חֲכָמִים וְחִידֹתָֽם׃
translation: to understand a proverb and parables, the words and riddles of the wise. (Proverbs 1:6)

text: וּֽבְאַחֲרִית מַלְכוּתָם כְּהָתֵם הַפֹּשְׁעִים יַעֲמֹד מֶלֶךְ עַז פָּנִים וּמֵבִין חִידֽוֹת׃
translation: "In the latter time of their kingdom, when the transgressors have come to the full, a king of fierce face, and understanding riddles, will stand up. (Daniel 8:23)

text: וּמַֽלְכַּת שְׁבָא שֹׁמַעַת אֶת שֵׁמַע שְׁלֹמֹה לְשֵׁם יְהוָה וַתָּבֹא לְנַסֹּתוֹ בְּחִידֽוֹת׃
translation: When the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon concerning the LORD's name, she came to test him with hard questions. (1 Kings 10:1)

text: וַיָּשִׂימוּ עָלַי רָעָה תַּחַת טוֹבָה וְשִׂנְאָה תַּחַת אַהֲבָתִֽי׃
translation: They have rewarded me evil for good, and hatred for my love. (Psalms 109:5)

text: שִׂנְאָה תְּעוֹרֵר מְדָנִים וְעַל כָּל פְּשָׁעִים תְּכַסֶּה אַהֲבָֽה׃
translation: Hatred stirs up strife, but love covers all wrongs. (Proverbs 10:12)

text: תַּכְלִית שִׂנְאָה שְׂנֵאתִים לְאוֹיְבִים הָיוּ לִֽי׃
translation: I hate them with perfect hatred. They have become my enemies. (Psalms 139:22)

text: תִּכַּסֶּה שִׂנְאָה בְּמַשָּׁאוֹן תִּגָּלֶה רָעָתוֹ בְקָהָֽל׃
translation: His malice may be concealed by deception, but his wickedness will be exposed in the assembly. (Proverbs 26:26)

text: וְדִבְרֵי שִׂנְאָה סְבָבוּנִי וַיִּֽלָּחֲמוּנִי חִנָּֽם׃
translation: They have also surrounded me with words of hatred, and fought against me without a cause. (Psalms 109:3)

text: וַתֵּרָגְנוּ בְאָהֳלֵיכֶם וַתֹּאמְרוּ בְּשִׂנְאַת יְהוָה אֹתָנוּ הוֹצִיאָנוּ מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם לָתֵת אֹתָנוּ בְּיַד הָאֱמֹרִי לְהַשְׁמִידֵֽנוּ׃
translation: You murmured in your tents, and said, "Because the LORD hated us, he has brought us out of the land of Egypt, to deliver us into the hand of the Amorites to destroy us. (Deuteronomy 1:27)

text: וְלָעָם הַזֶּה הָיָה לֵב סוֹרֵר וּמוֹרֶה סָרוּ וַיֵּלֵֽכוּ׃
translation: "But this people has a revolting and a rebellious heart. They have revolted and gone. (Jeremiah 5:23)

text: וַיְמָאֲנוּ לְהַקְשִׁיב וַיִּתְּנוּ כָתֵף סֹרָרֶת וְאָזְנֵיהֶם הִכְבִּידוּ מִשְּׁמֽוֹעַ׃
translation: But they refused to listen, and turned their backs, and stopped their ears, that they might not hear. (Zechariah 7:11)

text: הֹמִיָּה הִיא וְסֹרָרֶת בְּבֵיתָהּ לֹא יִשְׁכְּנוּ רַגְלֶֽיהָ׃
translation: She is loud and defiant. Her feet don't stay in her house. (Proverbs 7:11)

text: כִּי כְּפָרָה סֹֽרֵרָה סָרַר יִשְׂרָאֵל עַתָּה יִרְעֵם יְהוָה כְּכֶבֶשׂ בַּמֶּרְחָֽב׃
translation: For Israel has behaved extremely stubbornly, like a stubborn heifer. Then how will the LORD feed them like a lamb in a meadow? (Hosea 4:16)

text: מֹשֵׁל בִּגְבוּרָתוֹ עוֹלָם עֵינָיו בַּגּוֹיִם תִּצְפֶּינָה הַסּוֹרְרִים אַל ירימו יָרוּמוּ לָמוֹ סֶֽלָה׃
translation: He rules by his might forever. His eyes watch the nations. Don't let the rebellious rise up against him. Selah. (Psalms 66:7)

text: פֵּרַשְׂתִּי יָדַי כָּל הַיּוֹם אֶל עַם סוֹרֵר הַהֹלְכִים הַדֶּרֶךְ לֹא טוֹב אַחַר מַחְשְׁבֹתֵיהֶֽם׃
translation: I have spread out my hands all day to a rebellious people, who walk in a way that is not good, after their own thoughts; (Isaiah 65:2)

text: כִּי הִרְוֵיתִי נֶפֶשׁ עֲיֵפָה וְכָל נֶפֶשׁ דָּאֲבָה מִלֵּֽאתִי׃
translation: For I have satiated the weary soul, and I have replenished every sorrowful soul." (Jeremiah 31:25)

text: לְכָה נִרְוֶה דֹדִים עַד הַבֹּקֶר נִתְעַלְּסָה בָּאֳהָבִֽים׃
translation: Come, let's take our fill of loving until the morning. Let's solace ourselves with loving. (Proverbs 7:18)

text: נֶֽפֶשׁ בְּרָכָה תְדֻשָּׁן וּמַרְוֶה גַּם הוּא יוֹרֶֽא׃
translation: The liberal soul shall be made fat. He who waters shall be watered also himself. (Proverbs 11:25)

text: יִרְוְיֻן מִדֶּשֶׁן בֵּיתֶךָ וְנַחַל עֲדָנֶיךָ תַשְׁקֵֽם׃
translation: For with you is the spring of life. In your light we will see light. (Psalms 36:9)

text: וְרִוֵּיתִי נֶפֶשׁ הַכֹּהֲנִים דָּשֶׁן וְעַמִּי אֶת טוּבִי יִשְׂבָּעוּ נְאֻם יְהוָֽה׃
translation: I will satiate the soul of the priests with fatness, and my people will be satisfied with my goodness," says the LORD. (Jeremiah 31:14)

text: אַיֶּלֶת אֲהָבִים וְֽיַעֲלַת חֵן דַּדֶּיהָ יְרַוֻּךָ בְכָל עֵת בְּאַהֲבָתָהּ תִּשְׁגֶּה תָמִֽיד׃
translation: A loving doe and a graceful deer— let her breasts satisfy you at all times. Be captivated always with her love. (Proverbs 5:19)

text: אֵת רוּחַ הַדָּרוֹם מָדָד חֲמֵשׁ מֵאוֹת קָנִים בִּקְנֵה הַמִּדָּֽה׃
translation: He measured on the south side five hundred reeds with the measuring reed. (Ezekiel 42:18)

text: אֲשֶׁר בְּגָדֶיךָ חַמִּים בְּהַשְׁקִט אֶרֶץ מִדָּרֽוֹם׃
translation: You whose clothing is warm when the earth is still by reason of the south wind? (Job 37:17)

text: וּלְנַפְתָּלִי אָמַר נַפְתָּלִי שְׂבַע רָצוֹן וּמָלֵא בִּרְכַּת יְהוָה יָם וְדָרוֹם יְרָֽשָׁה׃
translation: About Naphtali he said, "Naphtali, satisfied with favor, full of the LORD's blessing, Possess the west and the south." (Deuteronomy 33:23)

text: וַיְבִיאֵנִי אֶל חָצֵר הַפְּנִימִי בְּשַׁעַר הַדָּרוֹם וַיָּמָד אֶת הַשַּׁעַר הַדָּרוֹם כַּמִּדּוֹת הָאֵֽלֶּה׃
translation: Then he brought me to the inner court by the south gate. He measured the south gate according to these measurements; (Ezekiel 40:28)

text: וַיְדַבֵּר אֵלָי זֹה הַלִּשְׁכָּה אֲשֶׁר פָּנֶיהָ דֶּרֶךְ הַדָּרוֹם לַכֹּהֲנִים שֹׁמְרֵי מִשְׁמֶרֶת הַבָּֽיִת׃
translation: He said to me, "This room, which faces toward the south, is for the priests who perform the duty of the house. (Ezekiel 40:45)

text: וְשַׁעַר לֶחָצֵר הַפְּנִימִי דֶּרֶךְ הַדָּרוֹם וַיָּמָד מִשַּׁעַר אֶל הַשַּׁעַר דֶּרֶךְ הַדָּרוֹם מֵאָה אַמּֽוֹת׃
translation: There was a gate to the inner court toward the south. He measured one hundred cubits from gate to gate toward the south. (Ezekiel 40:27)

text: יְהוָה צְבָאוֹת עִמָּנוּ מִשְׂגָּֽב לָנוּ אֱלֹהֵי יַעֲקֹב סֶֽלָה׃
translation: Come, see the LORD's works, what desolations he has made in the earth. (Psalms 46:8)

text: אַךְ הוּא צוּרִי וִֽישׁוּעָתִי מִשְׂגַּבִּי לֹא אֶמּוֹט רַבָּֽה׃
translation: How long will you assault a man? Would all of you throw him down, like a leaning wall, like a tottering fence? (Psalms 62:3)

text: אַךְ הוּא צוּרִי וִֽישׁוּעָתִי מִשְׂגַּבִּי לֹא אֶמּֽוֹט׃
translation: My salvation and my honor is with God. The rock of my strength, and my refuge, is in God. (Psalms 62:7)

text: וַיְהִי יְהוָה לִי לְמִשְׂגָּב וֵאלֹהַי לְצוּר מַחְסִֽי׃
translation: But the LORD has been my high tower, my God, the rock of my refuge. (Psalms 94:22)

text: וּמִבְצַר מִשְׂגַּב חוֹמֹתֶיךָ הֵשַׁח הִשְׁפִּיל הִגִּיעַ לָאָרֶץ עַד עָפָֽר׃
translation: He has brought the high fortress of your walls down, laid low, and brought to the ground, even to the dust. (Isaiah 25:12)

text: עֻזּוֹ אֵלֶיךָ אֶשְׁמֹרָה כִּֽי אֱלֹהִים מִשְׂגַּבִּֽי׃
translation: My God will go before me with his loving kindness. God will let me look at my enemies in triumph. (Psalms 59:10)

text: וַיְהִי מִדֵּי בֹא הַמֶּלֶךְ בֵּית יְהוָה יִשָּׂאוּם הָֽרָצִים וֶהֱשִׁיבוּם אֶל תָּא הָרָצִֽים׃
translation: It was so, that as often as the king went into the LORD's house, the guard bore them, and brought them back into the guard room. (1 Kings 14:28)

text: וַיְהִי מִדֵּי בוֹא הַמֶּלֶךְ בֵּית יְהוָה בָּאוּ הָרָצִים וּנְשָׂאוּם וֶהֱשִׁבוּם אֶל תָּא הָרָצִֽים׃
translation: As often as the king entered into the LORD's house, the guard came and bore them, then brought them back into the guard room. (2 Chronicles 12:11)

text: וַיָּמָד אֶת הַשַּׁעַר מִגַּג הַתָּא לְגַגּוֹ רֹחַב עֶשְׂרִים וְחָמֵשׁ אַמּוֹת פֶּתַח נֶגֶד פָּֽתַח׃
translation: He measured the gate from the roof of the one side room to the roof of the other, a width of twenty-five cubits, door against door. (Ezekiel 40:13)

text: וְתָאֵי הַשַּׁעַר דֶּרֶךְ הַקָּדִים שְׁלֹשָׁה מִפֹּה וּשְׁלֹשָׁה מִפֹּה מִדָּה אַחַת לִשְׁלָשְׁתָּם וּמִדָּה אַחַת לָאֵילִם מִפֹּה וּמִפּֽוֹ׃
translation: The side rooms of the gate eastward were three on this side, and three on that side. The three of them were of one measure. The posts had one measure on this side and on that side. (Ezekiel 40:10)

text: וּגְבוּל לִפְנֵי הַתָּאוֹת אַמָּה אֶחָת וְאַמָּה אַחַת גְּבוּל מִפֹּה וְהַתָּא שֵׁשׁ אַמּוֹת מִפּוֹ וְשֵׁשׁ אַמּוֹת מִפּֽוֹ׃
translation: and a border before the lodges, one cubit on this side, and a border, one cubit on that side; and the side rooms, six cubits on this side, and six cubits on that side. (Ezekiel 40:12)

text: תאו תָּאָיו אלו אֵלָיו ואלמו וְאֵֽלַמָּיו וְחַלּוֹנוֹת לוֹ סָבִיב סָבִיב אֹרֶךְ חֲמִשִּׁים אַמָּה וְרֹחַב חָמֵשׁ וְעֶשְׂרִים אַמָּֽה׃
translation: its lodges, its posts, and its arches. There were windows in it all around. The length was fifty cubits and the width twenty-five cubits. (Ezekiel 40:36)

text: וְחִכִּיתִי לַיהוָה הַמַּסְתִּיר פָּנָיו מִבֵּית יַעֲקֹב וְקִוֵּיתִֽי לֽוֹ׃
translation: I will wait for the LORD, who hides his face from the house of Jacob, and I will look for him. (Isaiah 8:17)

text: אַשְׁרֵי הַֽמְחַכֶּה וְיַגִּיעַ לְיָמִים אֶלֶף שְׁלֹשׁ מֵאוֹת שְׁלֹשִׁים וַחֲמִשָּֽׁה׃
translation: Blessed is he who waits, and comes to the one thousand three hundred thirty-five days. (Daniel 12:12)

text: וֶֽאֱלִיהוּ חִכָּה אֶת אִיּוֹב בִּדְבָרִים כִּי זְֽקֵנִים הֵמָּה מִמֶּנּוּ לְיָמִֽים׃
translation: Now Elihu had waited to speak to Job, because they were older than he. (Job 32:4)

text: נַפְשֵׁנוּ חִכְּתָה לַֽיהוָה עֶזְרֵנוּ וּמָגִנֵּנוּ הֽוּא׃
translation: Our soul has waited for the LORD. He is our help and our shield. (Psalms 33:20)

text: מִֽהֲרוּ שָׁכְחוּ מַעֲשָׂיו לֹֽא חִכּוּ לַעֲצָתֽוֹ׃
translation: They soon forgot his works. They didn't wait for his counsel, (Psalms 106:13)

text: הַֽמְחַכִּים לַמָּוֶת וְאֵינֶנּוּ וַֽיַּחְפְּרֻהוּ מִמַּטְמוֹנִֽים׃
translation: who long for death, but it doesn't come; and dig for it more than for hidden treasures, (Job 3:21)

text: אַל יָשֹׁב דַּךְ נִכְלָם עָנִי וְאֶבְיוֹן יְֽהַלְלוּ שְׁמֶֽךָ׃
translation: Don't let the oppressed return ashamed. Let the poor and needy praise your name. (Psalms 74:21)

text: לְֽשׁוֹן שֶׁקֶר יִשְׂנָא דַכָּיו וּפֶה חָלָק יַעֲשֶׂה מִדְחֶֽה׃
translation: A lying tongue hates those it hurts; and a flattering mouth works ruin. (Proverbs 26:28)

text: וִיהִי יְהוָה מִשְׂגָּב לַדָּךְ מִשְׂגָּב לְעִתּוֹת בַּצָּרָֽה׃
translation: Those who know your name will put their trust in you, for you, LORD, have not forsaken those who seek you. (Psalms 9:10)

text: לִשְׁפֹּט יָתוֹם וָדָךְ בַּל יוֹסִיף עוֹד לַעֲרֹץ אֱנוֹשׁ מִן הָאָֽרֶץ׃
translation: to judge the fatherless and the oppressed, that man who is of the earth may terrify no more. (Psalms 10:18)

text: אֵיךְ לֹֽא עֻזְּבָה עִיר תהלה תְּהִלָּת קִרְיַת מְשׂוֹשִֽׂי׃
translation: How is the city of praise not forsaken, the city of my joy? (Jeremiah 49:25)

text: וְהִשְׁבַּתִּי כָּל מְשׂוֹשָׂהּ חַגָּהּ חָדְשָׁהּ וְשַׁבַּתָּהּ וְכֹל מוֹעֲדָֽהּ׃
translation: I will visit on her the days of the Baals, to which she burned incense when she decked herself with her earrings and her jewels, and went after her lovers and forgot me," says the LORD. (Hosea 2:13)

text: הֶן הוּא מְשׂוֹשׂ דַּרְכּוֹ וּמֵעָפָר אַחֵר יִצְמָֽחוּ׃
translation: Behold, this is the joy of his way. Out of the earth, others will spring. (Job 8:19)

text: צְוָחָה עַל הַיַּיִן בַּֽחוּצוֹת עָֽרְבָה כָּל שִׂמְחָה גָּלָה מְשׂוֹשׂ הָאָֽרֶץ׃
translation: There is a crying in the streets because of the wine. All joy is darkened. The mirth of the land is gone. (Isaiah 24:11)

text: יְפֵה נוֹף מְשׂוֹשׂ כָּל הָאָרֶץ הַר צִיּוֹן יַרְכְּתֵי צָפוֹן קִרְיַת מֶלֶךְ רָֽב׃
translation: God has shown himself in her citadels as a refuge. (Psalms 48:3)

text: תַּחַת הֱיוֹתֵךְ עֲזוּבָה וּשְׂנוּאָה וְאֵין עוֹבֵר וְשַׂמְתִּיךְ לִגְאוֹן עוֹלָם מְשׂוֹשׂ דּוֹר וָדֽוֹר׃
translation: "Whereas you have been forsaken and hated, so that no one passed through you, I will make you an eternal excellency, a joy of many generations. (Isaiah 60:15)

text: בְּֽבוֹא רָשָׁע בָּא גַם בּוּז וְֽעִם קָלוֹן חֶרְפָּֽה׃
translation: When wickedness comes, contempt also comes, and with shame comes disgrace. (Proverbs 18:3)

text: אֱוִיל בַּיּוֹם יִוָּדַע כַּעְסוֹ וְכֹסֶה קָלוֹן עָרֽוּם׃
translation: A fool shows his annoyance the same day, but one who overlooks an insult is prudent. (Proverbs 12:16)

text: גָּרֵֽשׁ לֵץ וְיֵצֵא מָדוֹן וְיִשְׁבֹּת דִּין וְקָלֽוֹן׃
