translation: Drive out the mocker, and strife will go out; yes, quarrels and insults will stop. (Proverbs 22:10)

text: מַלֵּא פְנֵיהֶם קָלוֹן וִֽיבַקְשׁוּ שִׁמְךָ יְהוָֽה׃
translation: Let them be disappointed and dismayed forever. Yes, let them be confounded and perish; (Psalms 83:17)

text: כָּבוֹד חֲכָמִים יִנְחָלוּ וּכְסִילִים מֵרִים קָלֽוֹן׃
translation: The wise will inherit glory, but shame will be the promotion of fools. (Proverbs 3:35)

text: נֶֽגַע וְקָלוֹן יִמְצָא וְחֶרְפָּתוֹ לֹא תִמָּחֶֽה׃
translation: He will get wounds and dishonor. His reproach will not be wiped away. (Proverbs 6:33)

text: כִּי רָם יְהוָה וְשָׁפָל יִרְאֶה וְגָבֹהַּ מִמֶּרְחָק יְיֵדָֽע׃
translation: For though the LORD is high, yet he looks after the lowly; but he knows the proud from afar. (Psalms 138:6)

text: וְאֶזְרָעֵם בָּֽעַמִּים וּבַמֶּרְחַקִּים יִזְכְּרוּנִי וְחָיוּ אֶת בְּנֵיהֶם וָשָֽׁבוּ׃
translation: I will sow them among the peoples. They will remember me in far countries. They will live with their children and will return. (Zechariah 10:9)

text: מַיִם קָרִים עַל נֶפֶשׁ עֲיֵפָה וּשְׁמוּעָה טוֹבָה מֵאֶרֶץ מֶרְחָֽק׃
translation: Like cold water to a thirsty soul, so is good news from a far country. (Proverbs 25:25)

text: מֶלֶךְ בְּיָפְיוֹ תֶּחֱזֶינָה עֵינֶיךָ תִּרְאֶינָה אֶרֶץ מַרְחַקִּֽים׃
translation: Your eyes will see the king in his beauty. They will see a distant land. (Isaiah 33:17)

text: הָיְתָה כָּאֳנִיּוֹת סוֹחֵר מִמֶּרְחָק תָּבִיא לַחְמָֽהּ׃
translation: She is like the merchant ships. She brings her bread from afar. (Proverbs 31:14)

text: רֹעוּ עַמִּים וָחֹתּוּ וְהַֽאֲזִינוּ כֹּל מֶרְחַקֵּי אָרֶץ הִתְאַזְּרוּ וָחֹתּוּ הִֽתְאַזְּרוּ וָחֹֽתּוּ׃
translation: Make an uproar, you peoples, and be broken in pieces! Listen, all you from far countries: dress for battle, and be shattered! Dress for battle, and be shattered! (Isaiah 8:9)

text: וּמַן דִּי לָא יִפֵּל וְיִסְגֻּד יִתְרְמֵא לְגֽוֹא אַתּוּן נוּרָא יָקִֽדְתָּֽא׃
translation: and whoever doesn't fall down and worship shall be cast into the middle of a burning fiery furnace. (Daniel 3:11)

text: וּמַן דִּי לָא יִפֵּל וְיִסְגֻּד בַּהּ שַׁעֲתָא יִתְרְמֵא לְגֽוֹא אַתּוּן נוּרָא יָקִֽדְתָּֽא׃
translation: Whoever doesn't fall down and worship shall be cast into the middle of a burning fiery furnace the same hour." (Daniel 3:6)

text: בֵּאדַיִן גֻּבְרַיָּא אִלֵּךְ כְּפִתוּ בְּסַרְבָּלֵיהוֹן פטישיהון פַּטְּשֵׁיהוֹן וְכַרְבְּלָתְהוֹן וּלְבֻשֵׁיהוֹן וּרְמִיו לְגֽוֹא אַתּוּן נוּרָא יָקִֽדְתָּֽא׃
translation: Then these men were bound in their pants, their tunics, and their mantles, and their other clothes, and were cast into the middle of the burning fiery furnace. (Daniel 3:21)

text: וּלְגֻבְרִין גִּבָּֽרֵי חַיִל דִּי בְחַיְלֵהּ אֲמַר לְכַפָּתָה לְשַׁדְרַךְ מֵישַׁךְ וַעֲבֵד נְגוֹ לְמִרְמֵא לְאַתּוּן נוּרָא יָקִֽדְתָּֽא׃
translation: He commanded certain mighty men who were in his army to bind Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, and to cast them into the burning fiery furnace. (Daniel 3:20)

text: הָפַךְ אֶת מֵימֵיהֶם לְדָם וַיָּמֶת אֶת דְּגָתָֽם׃
translation: He turned their waters into blood, and killed their fish. (Psalms 105:29)

text: וַיִּתְפַּלֵּל יוֹנָה אֶל יְהוָה אֱלֹהָיו מִמְּעֵי הַדָּגָֽה׃
translation: He said, "I called because of my affliction to the LORD. He answered me. Out of the belly of Sheol I cried. You heard my voice. (Jonah 2:2)

text: תַּבְנִית כָּל רֹמֵשׂ בָּאֲדָמָה תַּבְנִית כָּל דָּגָה אֲשֶׁר בַּמַּיִם מִתַּחַת לָאָֽרֶץ׃
translation: the likeness of anything that creeps on the ground, the likeness of any fish that is in the water under the earth; (Deuteronomy 4:18)

text: וְהַדָּגָה אֲשֶׁר בַּיְאֹר תָּמוּת וּבָאַשׁ הַיְאֹר וְנִלְאוּ מִצְרַיִם לִשְׁתּוֹת מַיִם מִן הַיְאֹֽר׃
translation: The fish that are in the river will die and the river will become foul. The Egyptians will loathe to drink water from the river."'" (Exodus 7:18)

text: זָכַרְנוּ אֶת הַדָּגָה אֲשֶׁר נֹאכַל בְּמִצְרַיִם חִנָּם אֵת הַקִּשֻּׁאִים וְאֵת הָֽאֲבַטִּחִים וְאֶת הֶחָצִיר וְאֶת הַבְּצָלִים וְאֶת הַשּׁוּמִֽים׃
translation: We remember the fish, which we ate in Egypt for nothing; the cucumbers, and the melons, and the leeks, and the onions, and the garlic; (Numbers 11:5)

text: וְהַדָּגָה אֲשֶׁר בַּיְאֹר מֵתָה וַיִּבְאַשׁ הַיְאֹר וְלֹא יָכְלוּ מִצְרַיִם לִשְׁתּוֹת מַיִם מִן הַיְאֹר וַיְהִי הַדָּם בְּכָל אֶרֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
translation: The fish that were in the river died. The river became foul. The Egyptians couldn't drink water from the river. The blood was throughout all the land of Egypt. (Exodus 7:21)

text: כִּי יְהוּדָה גָּבַר בְּאֶחָיו וּלְנָגִיד מִמֶּנּוּ וְהַבְּכֹרָה לְיוֹסֵֽף׃
translation: For Judah prevailed above his brothers, and from him came the prince; but the birthright was Joseph's)— (1 Chronicles 5:2)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר יַעֲקֹב מִכְרָה כַיּוֹם אֶת בְּכֹֽרָתְךָ לִֽי׃
translation: Jacob said, "First, sell me your birthright." (Genesis 25:31)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר עֵשָׂו הִנֵּה אָנֹכִי הוֹלֵךְ לָמוּת וְלָמָּה זֶּה לִי בְּכֹרָֽה׃
translation: Esau said, "Behold, I am about to die. What good is the birthright to me?" (Genesis 25:32)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר יַעֲקֹב הִשָּׁבְעָה לִּי כַּיּוֹם וַיִּשָּׁבַע לוֹ וַיִּמְכֹּר אֶת בְּכֹרָתוֹ לְיַעֲקֹֽב׃
translation: Jacob said, "Swear to me first." He swore to him. He sold his birthright to Jacob. (Genesis 25:33)

text: וְהֶבֶל הֵבִיא גַם הוּא מִבְּכֹרוֹת צֹאנוֹ וּמֵֽחֶלְבֵהֶן וַיִּשַׁע יְהוָה אֶל הֶבֶל וְאֶל מִנְחָתֽוֹ׃
translation: Abel also brought some of the firstborn of his flock and of its fat. The LORD respected Abel and his offering, (Genesis 4:4)

text: וַהֲבֵאתֶם שָׁמָּה עֹלֹֽתֵיכֶם וְזִבְחֵיכֶם וְאֵת מַעְשְׂרֹתֵיכֶם וְאֵת תְּרוּמַת יֶדְכֶם וְנִדְרֵיכֶם וְנִדְבֹתֵיכֶם וּבְכֹרֹת בְּקַרְכֶם וְצֹאנְכֶֽם׃
translation: You shall bring your burnt offerings, your sacrifices, your tithes, the wave offering of your hand, your vows, your free will offerings, and the firstborn of your herd and of your flock there. (Deuteronomy 12:6)

text: וְאַבְרָהָם בֶּן תִּשְׁעִים וָתֵשַׁע שָׁנָה בְּהִמֹּלוֹ בְּשַׂר עָרְלָתֽוֹ׃
translation: Abraham was ninety-nine years old when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin. (Genesis 17:24)

text: וּמַלְתֶּם אֵת עָרְלַת לְבַבְכֶם וְעָרְפְּכֶם לֹא תַקְשׁוּ עֽוֹד׃
translation: Circumcise therefore the foreskin of your heart, and be no more stiff-necked. (Deuteronomy 10:16)

text: וּנְמַלְתֶּם אֵת בְּשַׂר עָרְלַתְכֶם וְהָיָה לְאוֹת בְּרִית בֵּינִי וּבֵינֵיכֶֽם׃
translation: You shall be circumcised in the flesh of your foreskin. It will be a token of the covenant between me and you. (Genesis 17:11)

text: וְיִשְׁמָעֵאל בְּנוֹ בֶּן שְׁלֹשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה בְּהִמֹּלוֹ אֵת בְּשַׂר עָרְלָתֽוֹ׃
translation: Ishmael, his son, was thirteen years old when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin. (Genesis 17:25)

text: הִנֵּה יָמִים בָּאִים נְאֻם יְהוָה וּפָקַדְתִּי עַל כָּל מוּל בְּעָרְלָֽה׃
translation: But let him who glories glory in this, that he has understanding, and knows me, that I am the LORD who exercises loving kindness, justice, and righteousness in the earth, for I delight in these things," says the LORD. (Jeremiah 9:24)

text: וּבַיּוֹם הַשְּׁמִינִי יִמּוֹל בְּשַׂר עָרְלָתֽוֹ׃
translation: In the eighth day the flesh of his foreskin shall be circumcised. (Leviticus 12:3)

text: וַיִּסַּע יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֵּט אָֽהֳלֹה מֵהָלְאָה לְמִגְדַּל עֵֽדֶר׃
translation: Israel traveled, and spread his tent beyond the tower of Eder. (Genesis 35:21)

text: וַיְהִי שָׁאוּל עון עוֹיֵן אֶת דָּוִד מֵהַיּוֹם הַהוּא וָהָֽלְאָה׃
translation: Saul watched David from that day and forward. (1 Samuel 18:9)

text: וְהִגְלֵיתִי אֶתְכֶם מֵהָלְאָה לְדַמָּשֶׂק אָמַר יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵֽי צְבָאוֹת שְׁמֽוֹ׃
translation: Therefore I will cause you to go into captivity beyond Damascus," says the LORD, whose name is the God of Armies. (Amos 5:27)

text: וְיָֽדְעוּ בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל כִּי אֲנִי יְהוָה אֱלֹֽהֵיהֶם מִן הַיּוֹם הַהוּא וָהָֽלְאָה׃
translation: So the house of Israel will know that I am the LORD their God, from that day and forward. (Ezekiel 39:22)

text: וְאִם כֹּה אֹמַר לָעֶלֶם הִנֵּה הַחִצִּים מִמְּךָ וָהָלְאָה לֵךְ כִּי שִֽׁלַּחֲךָ יְהוָֽה׃
translation: But if I say this to the boy, 'Behold, the arrows are beyond you,' then go your way, for the LORD has sent you away. (1 Samuel 20:22)

text: כִּי לֹא נִנְחַל אִתָּם מֵעֵבֶר לַיַּרְדֵּן וָהָלְאָה כִּי בָאָה נַחֲלָתֵנוּ אֵלֵינוּ מֵעֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן מִזְרָֽחָה׃
translation: For we will not inherit with them on the other side of the Jordan and beyond, because our inheritance has come to us on this side of the Jordan eastward." (Numbers 32:19)

text: וְעֵילָם נָשָׂא אַשְׁפָּה בְּרֶכֶב אָדָם פָּֽרָשִׁים וְקִיר עֵרָה מָגֵֽן׃
translation: Elam carried his quiver, with chariots of men and horsemen; and Kir uncovered the shield. (Isaiah 22:6)

text: רָאִיתִי רָשָׁע עָרִיץ וּמִתְעָרֶה כְּאֶזְרָח רַעֲנָֽן׃
translation: I have seen the wicked in great power, spreading himself like a green tree in its native soil. (Psalms 37:35)

text: כִּי אֵלֶיךָ יְהֹוִה אֲדֹנָי עֵינָי בְּכָה חָסִיתִי אַל תְּעַר נַפְשִֽׁי׃
translation: For my eyes are on you, LORD, the Lord. I take refuge in you. Don't leave my soul destitute. (Psalms 141:8)

text: עַד יֵעָרֶה עָלֵינוּ רוּחַ מִמָּרוֹם וְהָיָה מִדְבָּר לַכַּרְמֶל וכרמל וְהַכַּרְמֶל לַיַּעַר יֵחָשֵֽׁב׃
translation: until the Spirit is poured on us from on high, and the wilderness becomes a fruitful field, and the fruitful field is considered a forest. (Isaiah 32:15)

text: וַתְּמַהֵר וַתְּעַר כַּדָּהּ אֶל הַשֹּׁקֶת וַתָּרָץ עוֹד אֶֽל הַבְּאֵר לִשְׁאֹב וַתִּשְׁאַב לְכָל גְּמַלָּֽיו׃
translation: She hurried, and emptied her pitcher into the trough, and ran again to the well to draw, and drew for all his camels. (Genesis 24:20)

text: וְעֶרְוַת אֲחוֹת אִמְּךָ וַאֲחוֹת אָבִיךָ לֹא תְגַלֵּה כִּי אֶת שְׁאֵרוֹ הֶעֱרָה עֲוֺנָם יִשָּֽׂאוּ׃
translation: "'You shall not uncover the nakedness of your mother's sister, nor of your father's sister, for he has made his close relative naked. They shall bear their iniquity. (Leviticus 20:19)

text: הוֹדוּ לַיהוָה בְּכִנּוֹר בְּנֵבֶל עָשׂוֹר זַמְּרוּ לֽוֹ׃
translation: Give thanks to the LORD with the lyre. Sing praises to him with the harp of ten strings. (Psalms 33:2)

text: עֲֽלֵי עָשׂוֹר וַעֲלֵי נָבֶל עֲלֵי הִגָּיוֹן בְּכִנּֽוֹר׃
translation: For you, LORD, have made me glad through your work. I will triumph in the works of your hands. (Psalms 92:4)

text: אֱֽלֹהִים שִׁיר חָדָשׁ אָשִׁירָה לָּךְ בְּנֵבֶל עָשׂוֹר אֲזַמְּרָה לָּֽךְ׃
translation: I will sing a new song to you, God. On a ten-stringed lyre, I will sing praises to you. (Psalms 144:9)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר אָחִיהָ וְאִמָּהּ תֵּשֵׁב הַנַּעֲרָ אִתָּנוּ יָמִים אוֹ עָשׂוֹר אַחַר תֵּלֵֽךְ׃
translation: Her brother and her mother said, "Let the young lady stay with us a few days, at least ten. After that she will go." (Genesis 24:55)

text: וַיְהִי דְבַר יְהוָה אֵלַי בַּשָּׁנָה הַתְּשִׁיעִית בַּחֹדֶשׁ הָעֲשִׂירִי בֶּעָשׂוֹר לַחֹדֶשׁ לֵאמֹֽר׃
translation: Again, in the ninth year, in the tenth month, in the tenth day of the month, the LORD's word came to me, saying, (Ezekiel 24:1)

text: וְהָעָם עָלוּ מִן הַיַּרְדֵּן בֶּעָשׂוֹר לַחֹדֶשׁ הָרִאשׁוֹן וַֽיַּחֲנוּ בַּגִּלְגָּל בִּקְצֵה מִזְרַח יְרִיחֽוֹ׃
translation: The people came up out of the Jordan on the tenth day of the first month, and encamped in Gilgal, on the east border of Jericho. (Joshua 4:19)

text: שְׂמֹאול בַּעֲשֹׂתוֹ וְלֹא אָחַז יַעְטֹף יָמִין וְלֹא אֶרְאֶֽה׃
translation: He works to the north, but I can't see him. He turns south, but I can't catch a glimpse of him. (Job 23:9)

text: תְּפִלָּה לְעָנִי כִֽי יַעֲטֹף וְלִפְנֵי יְהוָה יִשְׁפֹּךְ שִׂיחֽוֹ׃
translation: A Prayer of the afflicted, when he is overwhelmed and pours out his complaint before the LORD. Hear my prayer, LORD! Let my cry come to you. (Psalms 102:1)

text: וּבְהַעֲטִיף הַצֹּאן לֹא יָשִׂים וְהָיָה הָעֲטֻפִים לְלָבָן וְהַקְּשֻׁרִים לְיַעֲקֹֽב׃
translation: but when the flock were feeble, he didn't put them in. So the feebler were Laban's, and the stronger Jacob's. (Genesis 30:42)

text: לָכֵן עֲנָקַתְמוֹ גַאֲוָה יַעֲטָף שִׁית חָמָס לָֽמוֹ׃
translation: Therefore pride is like a chain around their neck. Violence covers them like a garment. (Psalms 73:6)

text: אֶזְכְּרָה אֱלֹהִים וְאֶֽהֱמָיָה אָשִׂיחָה וְתִתְעַטֵּף רוּחִי סֶֽלָה׃
translation: You hold my eyelids open. I am so troubled that I can't speak. (Psalms 77:4)

text: מִקְצֵה הָאָרֶץ אֵלֶיךָ אֶקְרָא בַּעֲטֹף לִבִּי בְּצוּר יָרוּם מִמֶּנִּי תַנְחֵֽנִי׃
translation: For you have been a refuge for me, a strong tower from the enemy. (Psalms 61:3)

text: גַּם כָּל קֹוֶיךָ לֹא יֵבֹשׁוּ יֵבֹשׁוּ הַבּוֹגְדִים רֵיקָֽם׃
translation: Yes, no one who waits for you will be shamed. They will be shamed who deal treacherously without cause. (Psalms 25:3)

text: וְכִֽי תְשַׁלְּחֶנּוּ חָפְשִׁי מֵֽעִמָּךְ לֹא תְשַׁלְּחֶנּוּ רֵיקָֽם׃
translation: When you let him go free from you, you shall not let him go empty. (Deuteronomy 15:13)

text: אִם גָּמַלְתִּי שֽׁוֹלְמִי רָע וָאֲחַלְּצָה צוֹרְרִי רֵיקָֽם׃
translation: let the enemy pursue my soul, and overtake it; yes, let him tread my life down to the earth, and lay my glory in the dust. Selah. (Psalms 7:5)

text: אַלְמָנוֹת שִׁלַּחְתָּ רֵיקָם וּזְרֹעוֹת יְתֹמִים יְדֻכָּֽא׃
translation: You have sent widows away empty, and the arms of the fatherless have been broken. (Job 22:9)

text: וְנָתַתִּי אֶת חֵן הָֽעָם הַזֶּה בְּעֵינֵי מִצְרָיִם וְהָיָה כִּי תֵֽלֵכוּן לֹא תֵלְכוּ רֵיקָֽם׃
translation: I will give this people favor in the sight of the Egyptians, and it will happen that when you go, you shall not go empty-handed. (Exodus 3:21)

text: מִדַּם חֲלָלִים מֵחֵלֶב גִּבּוֹרִים קֶשֶׁת יְהוֹנָתָן לֹא נָשׂוֹג אָחוֹר וְחֶרֶב שָׁאוּל לֹא תָשׁוּב רֵיקָֽם׃
translation: From the blood of the slain, from the fat of the mighty, Jonathan's bow didn't turn back. Saul's sword didn't return empty. (2 Samuel 1:22)

text: יְהוָה בָּדָד יַנְחֶנּוּ וְאֵין עִמּוֹ אֵל נֵכָֽר׃
translation: The LORD alone led him. There was no foreign god with him. (Deuteronomy 32:12)

text: שָׁקַדְתִּי וָאֶֽהְיֶה כְּצִפּוֹר בּוֹדֵד עַל גָּֽג׃
translation: My enemies reproach me all day. Those who are mad at me use my name as a curse. (Psalms 102:8)

text: לֹֽא יָשַׁבְתִּי בְסוֹד מְשַׂחֲקִים וָֽאֶעְלֹז מִפְּנֵי יָֽדְךָ בָּדָד יָשַׁבְתִּי כִּֽי זַעַם מִלֵּאתָֽנִי׃
translation: I didn't sit in the assembly of those who make merry and rejoice. I sat alone because of your hand, for you have filled me with indignation. (Jeremiah 15:17)

text: כָּל יְמֵי אֲשֶׁר הַנֶּגַע בּוֹ יִטְמָא טָמֵא הוּא בָּדָד יֵשֵׁב מִחוּץ לַֽמַּחֲנֶה מוֹשָׁבֽוֹ׃
translation: All the days in which the plague is in him he shall be unclean. He is unclean. He shall dwell alone. His dwelling shall be outside of the camp. (Leviticus 13:46)

text: כִּֽי מֵרֹאשׁ צֻרִים אֶרְאֶנּוּ וּמִגְּבָעוֹת אֲשׁוּרֶנּוּ הֶן עָם לְבָדָד יִשְׁכֹּן וּבַגּוֹיִם לֹא יִתְחַשָּֽׁב׃
translation: For from the top of the rocks I see him. From the hills I see him. Behold, it is a people that dwells alone, and shall not be listed among the nations. (Numbers 23:9)

text: וַיִּשְׁכֹּן יִשְׂרָאֵל בֶּטַח בָּדָד עֵין יַעֲקֹב אֶל אֶרֶץ דָּגָן וְתִירוֹשׁ אַף שָׁמָיו יַֽעַרְפוּ טָֽל׃
translation: Israel dwells in safety, the fountain of Jacob alone, In a land of grain and new wine. Yes, his heavens drop down dew. (Deuteronomy 33:28)

text: וַיִּקְחוּ אֶת כְּתֹנֶת יוֹסֵף וַֽיִּשְׁחֲטוּ שְׂעִיר עִזִּים וַיִּטְבְּלוּ אֶת הַכֻּתֹּנֶת בַּדָּֽם׃
translation: They took Joseph's tunic, and killed a male goat, and dipped the tunic in the blood. (Genesis 37:31)

text: וּלְאָשֵׁר אָמַר בָּרוּךְ מִבָּנִים אָשֵׁר יְהִי רְצוּי אֶחָיו וְטֹבֵל בַּשֶּׁמֶן רַגְלֽוֹ׃
translation: About Asher he said, "Asher is blessed with children. Let him be acceptable to his brothers. Let him dip his foot in oil. (Deuteronomy 33:24)

text: אָז בַּשַּׁחַת תִּטְבְּלֵנִי וְתִֽעֲבוּנִי שַׂלְמוֹתָֽי׃
translation: yet you will plunge me in the ditch. My own clothes will abhor me. (Job 9:31)

text: וְטָבַל הַכֹּהֵן אֶצְבָּעוֹ מִן הַדָּם וְהִזָּה שֶׁבַע פְּעָמִים לִפְנֵי יְהוָה אֵת פְּנֵי הַפָּרֹֽכֶת׃
translation: The priest shall dip his finger in the blood and sprinkle it seven times before the LORD, before the veil. (Leviticus 4:17)

text: וַיֵּרֶד וַיִּטְבֹּל בַּיַּרְדֵּן שֶׁבַע פְּעָמִים כִּדְבַר אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים וַיָּשָׁב בְּשָׂרוֹ כִּבְשַׂר נַעַר קָטֹן וַיִּטְהָֽר׃
translation: Then went he down and dipped himself seven times in the Jordan, according to the saying of the man of God; and his flesh was restored like the flesh of a little child, and he was clean. (2 Kings 5:14)

text: וְטָבַל הַכֹּהֵן אֶת אֶצְבָּעוֹ בַּדָּם וְהִזָּה מִן הַדָּם שֶׁבַע פְּעָמִים לִפְנֵי יְהוָה אֶת פְּנֵי פָּרֹכֶת הַקֹּֽדֶשׁ׃
translation: The priest shall dip his finger in the blood, and sprinkle some of the blood seven times before the LORD, before the veil of the sanctuary. (Leviticus 4:6)

text: עֻזִיָּא הָעֲשְׁתְּרָתִי שָׁמָע ויעואל וִֽיעִיאֵל בְּנֵי חוֹתָם הָעֲרֹעֵרִֽי׃
translation: Uzzia the Ashterathite, Shama and Jeiel the sons of Hotham the Aroerite, (1 Chronicles 11:44)

text: תִּתְהַפֵּךְ כְּחֹמֶר חוֹתָם וְיִֽתְיַצְּבוּ כְּמוֹ לְבֽוּשׁ׃
translation: It is changed as clay under the seal, and presented as a garment. (Job 38:14)

text: וְחֶבֶר הוֹלִיד אֶת יַפְלֵט וְאֶת שׁוֹמֵר וְאֶת חוֹתָם וְאֵת שׁוּעָא אֲחוֹתָֽם׃
translation: Heber became the father of Japhlet, Shomer, Hotham, and Shua their sister. (1 Chronicles 7:32)

text: וְהָאֲבָנִים תִּֽהְיֶיןָ עַל שְׁמֹת בְּנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵל שְׁתֵּים עֶשְׂרֵה עַל שְׁמֹתָם פִּתּוּחֵי חוֹתָם אִישׁ עַל שְׁמוֹ תִּֽהְיֶיןָ לִשְׁנֵי עָשָׂר שָֽׁבֶט׃
translation: The stones shall be according to the names of the children of Israel, twelve, according to their names; like the engravings of a signet, everyone according to his name, they shall be for the twelve tribes. (Exodus 28:21)

text: חַי אָנִי נְאֻם יְהוָה כִּי אִם יִהְיֶה כָּנְיָהוּ בֶן יְהֽוֹיָקִים מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה חוֹתָם עַל יַד יְמִינִי כִּי מִשָּׁם אֶתְּקֶֽנְךָּ׃
translation: "As I live," says the LORD, "though Coniah the son of Jehoiakim king of Judah were the signet on my right hand, I would still pluck you from there. (Jeremiah 22:24)

text: בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא נְאֻם יְהוָה צְבָאוֹת אֶקָּחֲךָ זְרֻבָּבֶל בֶּן שְׁאַלְתִּיאֵל עַבְדִּי נְאֻם יְהוָה וְשַׂמְתִּיךָ כַּֽחוֹתָם כִּֽי בְךָ בָחַרְתִּי נְאֻם יְהוָה צְבָאֽוֹת׃
translation: In that day, says the LORD of Armies, I will take you, Zerubbabel my servant, the son of Shealtiel,' says the LORD, 'and will make you like a signet ring, for I have chosen you,' says the LORD of Armies." (Haggai 2:23)

text: וַתִּבְלַעְןָ הָשִׁבֳּלִים הַדַּקֹּת אֵת שֶׁבַע הַֽשִׁבֳּלִים הַטֹּבוֹת וָֽאֹמַר אֶל הַֽחַרְטֻמִּים וְאֵין מַגִּיד לִֽי׃
translation: The thin heads of grain swallowed up the seven good heads of grain. I told it to the magicians, but there was no one who could explain it to me." (Genesis 41:24)

text: וְלֹֽא יָכְלוּ הַֽחַרְטֻמִּים לַעֲמֹד לִפְנֵי מֹשֶׁה מִפְּנֵי הַשְּׁחִין כִּֽי הָיָה הַשְּׁחִין בַּֽחֲרְטֻמִּם וּבְכָל מִצְרָֽיִם׃
translation: The magicians couldn't stand before Moses because of the boils; for the boils were on the magicians and on all the Egyptians. (Exodus 9:11)

text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ הַֽחַרְטֻמִּים אֶל פַּרְעֹה אֶצְבַּע אֱלֹהִים הִוא וַיֶּחֱזַק לֵב פַּרְעֹה וְלֹֽא שָׁמַע אֲלֵהֶם כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהוָֽה׃
translation: But when Pharaoh saw that there was a respite, he hardened his heart, and didn't listen to them, as the LORD had spoken. (Exodus 8:15)

text: תִּכּוֹן תְּפִלָּתִי קְטֹרֶת לְפָנֶיךָ מַֽשְׂאַת כַּפַּי מִנְחַת עָֽרֶב׃
translation: Let my prayer be set before you like incense; the lifting up of my hands like the evening sacrifice. (Psalms 141:2)

text: וְהַמּוֹעֵד הָיָה לְאִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל עִם הָאֹרֵב הֶרֶב לְהַעֲלוֹתָם מַשְׂאַת הֶעָשָׁן מִן הָעִֽיר׃
translation: Now the appointed sign between the men of Israel and the ambushers was that they should make a great cloud of smoke rise up out of the city. (Judges 20:38)

text: וַיִּתְּנוּ קוֹל בִּֽיהוּדָה וּבִֽירוּשָׁלִַם לְהָבִיא לַֽיהוָה מַשְׂאַת מֹשֶׁה עֶֽבֶד הָאֱלֹהִים עַל יִשְׂרָאֵל בַּמִּדְבָּֽר׃
translation: They made a proclamation through Judah and Jerusalem, to bring in for the LORD the tax that Moses the servant of God laid on Israel in the wilderness. (2 Chronicles 24:9)

text: וַיִּשָּׂא מַשְׂאֹת מֵאֵת פָּנָיו אֲלֵהֶם וַתֵּרֶב מַשְׂאַת בִּנְיָמִן מִמַּשְׂאֹת כֻּלָּם חָמֵשׁ יָדוֹת וַיִּשְׁתּוּ וַֽיִּשְׁכְּרוּ עִמּֽוֹ׃
translation: He sent portions to them from before him, but Benjamin's portion was five times as much as any of theirs. They drank, and were merry with him. (Genesis 43:34)

text: וְהַמַּשְׂאֵת הֵחֵלָּה לַעֲלוֹת מִן הָעִיר עַמּוּד עָשָׁן וַיִּפֶן בִּנְיָמִן אַחֲרָיו וְהִנֵּה עָלָה כְלִיל הָעִיר הַשָּׁמָֽיְמָה׃
translation: But when the cloud began to arise up out of the city in a pillar of smoke, the Benjamites looked behind them; and behold, the whole city went up in smoke to the sky. (Judges 20:40)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד לְאוּרִיָּה רֵד לְבֵיתְךָ וּרְחַץ רַגְלֶיךָ וַיֵּצֵא אֽוּרִיָּה מִבֵּית הַמֶּלֶךְ וַתֵּצֵא אַחֲרָיו מַשְׂאַת הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
translation: David said to Uriah, "Go down to your house and wash your feet." Uriah departed out of the king's house, and a gift from the king was sent after him. (2 Samuel 11:8)

text: אֶשְׁרְקָה לָהֶם וַאֲקַבְּצֵם כִּי פְדִיתִים וְרָבוּ כְּמוֹ רָבֽוּ׃
translation: I will signal for them and gather them, for I have redeemed them. They will increase as they were before. (Zechariah 10:8)

text: סֹֽחֲרִים בָּעַמִּים שָׁרְקוּ עָלָיִךְ בַּלָּהוֹת הָיִית וְאֵינֵךְ עַד עוֹלָֽם׃
translation: The merchants among the peoples hiss at you. You have come to a terrible end, and you will be no more."'" (Ezekiel 27:36)

text: וְהָיְתָה אֱדוֹם לְשַׁמָּה כֹּל עֹבֵר עָלֶיהָ יִשֹּׁם וְיִשְׁרֹק עַל כָּל מַכּוֹתֶֽהָ׃
translation: "Edom will become an astonishment. Everyone who passes by it will be astonished, and will hiss at all its plagues. (Jeremiah 49:17)

text: וְאָֽנֹכִי נְטַעְתִּיךְ שֹׂרֵק כֻּלֹּה זֶרַע אֱמֶת וְאֵיךְ נֶהְפַּכְתְּ לִי סוּרֵי הַגֶּפֶן נָכְרִיָּֽה׃
translation: Yet I had planted you a noble vine, a pure and faithful seed. How then have you turned into the degenerate branches of a foreign vine to me? (Jeremiah 2:21)

text: וְהָיָה בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא יִשְׁרֹק יְהוָה לַזְּבוּב אֲשֶׁר בִּקְצֵה יְאֹרֵי מִצְרָיִם וְלַדְּבוֹרָה אֲשֶׁר בְּאֶרֶץ אַשּֽׁוּר׃
translation: It will happen in that day that the LORD will whistle for the fly that is in the uttermost part of the rivers of Egypt, and for the bee that is in the land of Assyria. (Isaiah 7:18)

text: מִקֶּצֶף יְהוָה לֹא תֵשֵׁב וְהָיְתָה שְׁמָמָה כֻּלָּהּ כֹּל עֹבֵר עַל בָּבֶל יִשֹּׁם וְיִשְׁרֹק עַל כָּל מַכּוֹתֶֽיהָ׃
translation: Because of the LORD's wrath she won't be inhabited, but she will be wholly desolate. Everyone who goes by Babylon will be astonished, and hiss at all her plagues. (Jeremiah 50:13)

text: כִּֽי תָבוֹא חָכְמָה בְלִבֶּךָ וְדַעַת לְֽנַפְשְׁךָ יִנְעָֽם׃
translation: For wisdom will enter into your heart. Knowledge will be pleasant to your soul. (Proverbs 2:10)

text: תּוֹעֲבַת יְהוָה מַחְשְׁבוֹת רָע וּטְהֹרִים אִמְרֵי נֹֽעַם׃
translation: The LORD detests the thoughts of the wicked, but the thoughts of the pure are pleasing. (Proverbs 15:26)

text: וּבְנֵי כָּלֵב בֶּן יְפֻנֶּה עִירוּ אֵלָה וָנָעַם וּבְנֵי אֵלָה וּקְנַֽז׃
translation: The sons of Caleb the son of Jephunneh: Iru, Elah, and Naam. The son of Elah: Kenaz. (1 Chronicles 4:15)

text: דְּרָכֶיהָ דַרְכֵי נֹעַם וְֽכָל נְתִיבוֹתֶיהָ שָׁלֽוֹם׃
translation: Her ways are ways of pleasantness. All her paths are peace. (Proverbs 3:17)

text: וְלַמּוֹכִיחִים יִנְעָם וַֽעֲלֵיהֶם תָּבוֹא בִרְכַּת טֽוֹב׃
translation: but it will go well with those who convict the guilty, and a rich blessing will come on them. (Proverbs 24:25)

text: מַה יָּפִית וּמַה נָּעַמְתְּ אַהֲבָה בַּתַּֽעֲנוּגִֽים׃
translation: This, your stature, is like a palm tree, your breasts like its fruit. (Song of Solomon 7:7)

text: וַתַּשְׁקוּ אֶת הַנְּזִרִים יָיִן וְעַל הַנְּבִיאִים צִוִּיתֶם לֵאמֹר לֹא תִּנָּבְאֽוּ׃
translation: "But you gave the Nazirites wine to drink, and commanded the prophets, saying, 'Don't prophesy!' (Amos 2:12)

text: וָאָקִים מִבְּנֵיכֶם לִנְבִיאִים וּמִבַּחוּרֵיכֶם לִנְזִרִים הַאַף אֵֽין זֹאת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל נְאֻם יְהוָֽה׃
translation: I raised up some of your sons for prophets, and some of your young men for Nazirites. Isn't this true, you children of Israel?" says the LORD. (Amos 2:11)

text: וְזֹאת תּוֹרַת הַנָּזִיר בְּיוֹם מְלֹאת יְמֵי נִזְרוֹ יָבִיא אֹתוֹ אֶל פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃
translation: "'This is the law of the Nazirite: when the days of his separation are fulfilled, he shall be brought to the door of the Tent of Meeting, (Numbers 6:13)

text: בִּרְכֹת אָבִיךָ גָּֽבְרוּ עַל בִּרְכֹת הוֹרַי עַֽד תַּאֲוַת גִּבְעֹת עוֹלָם תִּֽהְיֶין לְרֹאשׁ יוֹסֵף וּלְקָדְקֹד נְזִיר אֶחָֽיו׃
translation: The blessings of your father have prevailed above the blessings of my ancestors, above the boundaries of the ancient hills. They will be on the head of Joseph, on the crown of the head of him who is separated from his brothers. (Genesis 49:26)

text: דַּבֵּר אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵהֶם אִישׁ אֽוֹ אִשָּׁה כִּי יַפְלִא לִנְדֹּר נֶדֶר נָזִיר לְהַזִּיר לַֽיהוָֽה׃
translation: "Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them: 'When either man or woman shall make a special vow, the vow of a Nazirite, to separate himself to the LORD, (Numbers 6:2)

text: יוֹבֵל הִוא שְׁנַת הַחֲמִשִּׁים שָׁנָה תִּהְיֶה לָכֶם לֹא תִזְרָעוּ וְלֹא תִקְצְרוּ אֶת סְפִיחֶיהָ וְלֹא תִבְצְרוּ אֶת נְזִרֶֽיהָ׃
translation: That fiftieth year shall be a jubilee to you. In it you shall not sow, neither reap that which grows of itself, nor gather from the undressed vines. (Leviticus 25:11)

text: וְהוּכַח בְּמַכְאוֹב עַל מִשְׁכָּבוֹ וריב וְרוֹב עֲצָמָיו אֵתָֽן׃
translation: "He is chastened also with pain on his bed, with continual strife in his bones, (Job 33:19)

text: רַבִּים מַכְאוֹבִים לָרָשָׁע וְהַבּוֹטֵחַ בַּיהוָה חֶסֶד יְסוֹבְבֶֽנּוּ׃
translation: Many sorrows come to the wicked, but loving kindness shall surround him who trusts in the LORD. (Psalms 32:10)

text: כִּֽי אֲנִי לְצֶלַע נָכוֹן וּמַכְאוֹבִי נֶגְדִּי תָמִֽיד׃
translation: For I will declare my iniquity. I will be sorry for my sin. (Psalms 38:18)

text: כִּֽי אַתָּה אֲשֶׁר הִכִּיתָ רָדָפוּ וְאֶל מַכְאוֹב חֲלָלֶיךָ יְסַפֵּֽרוּ׃
translation: Charge them with crime upon crime. Don't let them come into your righteousness. (Psalms 69:27)

text: כִּי בְּרֹב חָכְמָה רָב כָּעַס וְיוֹסִיף דַּעַת יוֹסִיף מַכְאֽוֹב׃
translation: For in much wisdom is much grief; and he who increases knowledge increases sorrow. (Ecclesiastes 1:18)

text: אָכֵן חֳלָיֵנוּ הוּא נָשָׂא וּמַכְאֹבֵינוּ סְבָלָם וַאֲנַחְנוּ חֲשַׁבְנֻהוּ נָגוּעַ מֻכֵּה אֱלֹהִים וּמְעֻנֶּֽה׃
translation: Surely he has borne our sickness and carried our suffering; yet we considered him plagued, struck by God, and afflicted. (Isaiah 53:4)

text: יָחוֹגּוּ וְיָנוּעוּ כַּשִּׁכּוֹר וְכָל חָכְמָתָם תִּתְבַּלָּֽע׃
translation: They reel back and forth, and stagger like a drunken man, and are at their wits' end. (Psalms 107:27)

text: שָׁלֹשׁ רְגָלִים תָּחֹג לִי בַּשָּׁנָֽה׃
translation: "You shall observe a feast to me three times a year. (Exodus 23:14)

text: וְהָיָה הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה לָכֶם לְזִכָּרוֹן וְחַגֹּתֶם אֹתוֹ חַג לַֽיהוָה לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶם חֻקַּת עוֹלָם תְּחָגֻּֽהוּ׃
translation: This day shall be a memorial for you. You shall keep it as a feast to the LORD. You shall keep it as a feast throughout your generations by an ordinance forever. (Exodus 12:14)

text: וְחַגֹּתֶם אֹתוֹ חַג לַֽיהוָה שִׁבְעַת יָמִים בַּשָּׁנָה חֻקַּת עוֹלָם לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶם בַּחֹדֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִי תָּחֹגּוּ אֹתֽוֹ׃
translation: You shall keep it as a feast to the LORD seven days in the year. It is a statute forever throughout your generations. You shall keep it in the seventh month. (Leviticus 23:41)

text: זֹאת תִּהְיֶה חַטַּאת מִצְרָיִם וְחַטַּאת כָּל הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר לֹא יַֽעֲלוּ לָחֹג אֶת חַג הַסֻּכּֽוֹת׃
translation: This will be the punishment of Egypt and the punishment of all the nations that don't go up to keep the feast of booths. (Zechariah 14:19)

text: אֵלֶּה אֶזְכְּרָה וְאֶשְׁפְּכָה עָלַי נַפְשִׁי כִּי אֶֽעֱבֹר בַּסָּךְ אֶדַּדֵּם עַד בֵּית אֱלֹהִים בְּקוֹל רִנָּה וְתוֹדָה הָמוֹן חוֹגֵֽג׃
translation: Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him for the saving help of his presence. (Psalms 42:5)

text: וּבְרֹב גְּאוֹנְךָ תַּהֲרֹס קָמֶיךָ תְּשַׁלַּח חֲרֹנְךָ יֹאכְלֵמוֹ כַּקַּֽשׁ׃
translation: In the greatness of your excellency, you overthrow those who rise up against you. You send out your wrath. It consumes them as stubble. (Exodus 15:7)

text: לֹֽא יַבְרִיחֶנּוּ בֶן קָשֶׁת לְקַשׁ נֶהְפְּכוּ לוֹ אַבְנֵי קָֽלַע׃
translation: Out of his nostrils a smoke goes, as of a boiling pot over a fire of reeds. (Job 41:20)

text: תַּהֲרוּ חֲשַׁשׁ תֵּלְדוּ קַשׁ רוּחֲכֶם אֵשׁ תֹּאכַלְכֶֽם׃
translation: You will conceive chaff. You will give birth to stubble. Your breath is a fire that will devour you. (Isaiah 33:11)

text: אֱֽלֹהַי שִׁיתֵמוֹ כַגַּלְגַּל כְּקַשׁ לִפְנֵי רֽוּחַ׃
translation: As the fire that burns the forest, as the flame that sets the mountains on fire, (Psalms 83:14)

text: וַאֲפִיצֵם כְּקַשׁ עוֹבֵר לְרוּחַ מִדְבָּֽר׃
translation: "Therefore I will scatter them as the stubble that passes away by the wind of the wilderness. (Jeremiah 13:24)

text: מִי הֵעִיר מִמִּזְרָח צֶדֶק יִקְרָאֵהוּ לְרַגְלוֹ יִתֵּן לְפָנָיו גּוֹיִם וּמְלָכִים יַרְדְּ יִתֵּן כֶּֽעָפָר חַרְבּוֹ כְּקַשׁ נִדָּף קַשְׁתּֽוֹ׃
translation: Who has raised up one from the east? Who called him to his feet in righteousness? He hands over nations to him and makes him rule over kings. He gives them like the dust to his sword, like the driven stubble to his bow. (Isaiah 41:2)

text: וְגַם יַד יְהוָה הָיְתָה בָּם לְהֻמָּם מִקֶּרֶב הַֽמַּחֲנֶה עַד תֻּמָּֽם׃
translation: Moreover the LORD's hand was against them, to destroy them from the middle of the camp, until they were consumed. (Deuteronomy 2:15)

text: וַיִּשְׁלַח חִצִּים וַיְפִיצֵם בָּרָק ויהמם וַיָּהֹֽם׃
translation: He sent out arrows and scattered them, lightning and confused them. (2 Samuel 22:15)

text: וַיִּשְׁלַח חִצָּיו וַיְפִיצֵם וּבְרָקִים רָב וַיְהֻמֵּֽם׃
translation: Then the channels of waters appeared. The foundations of the world were laid bare at your rebuke, LORD, at the blast of the breath of your nostrils. (Psalms 18:15)

text: בְּרוֹק בָּרָק וּתְפִיצֵם שְׁלַח חִצֶּיךָ וּתְהֻמֵּֽם׃
translation: Throw out lightning, and scatter them. Send out your arrows, and rout them. (Psalms 144:6)

text: אֶת אֵֽימָתִי אֲשַׁלַּח לְפָנֶיךָ וְהַמֹּתִי אֶת כָּל הָעָם אֲשֶׁר תָּבֹא בָּהֶם וְנָתַתִּי אֶת כָּל אֹיְבֶיךָ אֵלֶיךָ עֹֽרֶף׃
translation: I will send my terror before you, and will confuse all the people to whom you come, and I will make all your enemies turn their backs to you. (Exodus 23:27)

text: וַיְהֻמֵּם יְהוָה לִפְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיַּכֵּם מַכָּֽה גְדוֹלָה בְּגִבְעוֹן וַֽיִּרְדְּפֵם דֶּרֶךְ מַעֲלֵה בֵית חוֹרֹן וַיַּכֵּם עַד עֲזֵקָה וְעַד מַקֵּדָֽה׃
translation: The LORD confused them before Israel. He killed them with a great slaughter at Gibeon, and chased them by the way of the ascent of Beth Horon, and struck them to Azekah and to Makkedah. (Joshua 10:10)

text: הָפֵץ עֶבְרוֹת אַפֶּךָ וּרְאֵה כָל גֵּאֶה וְהַשְׁפִּילֵֽהוּ׃
translation: Pour out the fury of your anger. Look at everyone who is proud, and bring him low. (Job 40:11)

text: רְאֵה כָל גֵּאֶה הַכְנִיעֵהוּ וַהֲדֹךְ רְשָׁעִים תַּחְתָּֽם׃
translation: Look at everyone who is proud, and humble him. Crush the wicked in their place. (Job 40:12)

text: הִנָּשֵׂא שֹׁפֵט הָאָרֶץ הָשֵׁב גְּמוּל עַל גֵּאִֽים׃
translation: Rise up, you judge of the earth. Pay back the proud what they deserve. (Psalms 94:2)

text: בֵּית גֵּאִים יִסַּח יְהוָה וְיַצֵּב גְּבוּל אַלְמָנָֽה׃
translation: The LORD will uproot the house of the proud, but he will keep the widow's borders intact. (Proverbs 15:25)

text: טוֹב שְׁפַל רוּחַ אֶת עניים עֲנָוִים מֵֽחַלֵּק שָׁלָל אֶת גֵּאִֽים׃
translation: It is better to be of a lowly spirit with the poor, than to divide the plunder with the proud. (Proverbs 16:19)

text: שָׁמַעְנוּ גְאוֹן מוֹאָב גֵּאֶה מְאֹד גָּבְהוֹ וּגְאוֹנוֹ וְגַאֲוָתוֹ וְרֻם לִבּֽוֹ׃
translation: "We have heard of the pride of Moab. He is very proud in his loftiness, his pride, his arrogance, and the arrogance of his heart. (Jeremiah 48:29)

text: מַעְיַן גַּנִּים בְּאֵר מַיִם חַיִּים וְנֹזְלִים מִן לְבָנֽוֹן׃
translation: a fountain of gardens, a well of living waters, flowing streams from Lebanon. (Song of Solomon 4:15)

text: אֲשֶֽׁר יִזְּלוּ שְׁחָקִים יִרְעֲפוּ עֲלֵי אָדָם רָֽב׃
translation: which the skies pour down and which drop on man abundantly. (Job 36:28)

text: יִשְׁלַח דְּבָרוֹ וְיַמְסֵם יַשֵּׁב רוּחוֹ יִזְּלוּ מָֽיִם׃
translation: He sends out his word, and melts them. He causes his wind to blow, and the waters flow. (Psalms 147:18)

text: הָרִים נָזְלוּ מִפְּנֵי יְהוָה זֶה סִינַי מִפְּנֵי יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
translation: The mountains quaked at the LORD's presence, even Sinai at the presence of the LORD, the God of Israel. (Judges 5:5)

text: וַיּוֹצִא נוֹזְלִים מִסָּלַע וַיּוֹרֶד כַּנְּהָרוֹת מָֽיִם׃
translation: He brought streams also out of the rock, and caused waters to run down like rivers. (Psalms 78:16)

text: וַיַּהֲפֹךְ לְדָם יְאֹרֵיהֶם וְנֹזְלֵיהֶם בַּל יִשְׁתָּיֽוּן׃
translation: he turned their rivers into blood, and their streams, so that they could not drink. (Psalms 78:44)

text: שֶׁמֶן לַמָּאֹר בְּשָׂמִים לְשֶׁמֶן הַמִּשְׁחָה וְלִקְטֹרֶת הַסַּמִּֽים׃
translation: oil for the light, spices for the anointing oil and for the sweet incense, (Exodus 25:6)

text: וְשֶׁמֶן לַמָּאוֹר וּבְשָׂמִים לְשֶׁמֶן הַמִּשְׁחָה וְלִקְטֹרֶת הַסַּמִּֽים׃
translation: oil for the light, spices for the anointing oil and for the sweet incense, (Exodus 35:8)

text: וְאֶת הַבֹּשֶׂם וְאֶת הַשָּׁמֶן לְמָאוֹר וּלְשֶׁמֶן הַמִּשְׁחָה וְלִקְטֹרֶת הַסַּמִּֽים׃
translation: with the spice and the oil for the light, for the anointing oil, and for the sweet incense. (Exodus 35:28)

text: וַיַּקְטֵר עָלָיו קְטֹרֶת סַמִּים כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהוָה אֶת מֹשֶֽׁה׃
translation: and he burned incense of sweet spices on it, as the LORD commanded Moses. (Exodus 40:27)

text: וְהִקְטִיר עָלָיו אַהֲרֹן קְטֹרֶת סַמִּים בַּבֹּקֶר בַּבֹּקֶר בְּהֵיטִיבוֹ אֶת הַנֵּרֹת יַקְטִירֶֽנָּה׃
translation: Aaron shall burn incense of sweet spices on it every morning. When he tends the lamps, he shall burn it. (Exodus 30:7)

text: וְאֵת שֶׁמֶן הַמִּשְׁחָה וְאֶת קְטֹרֶת הַסַּמִּים לַקֹּדֶשׁ כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר צִוִּיתִךָ יַעֲשֽׂוּ׃
translation: the anointing oil, and the incense of sweet spices for the holy place: according to all that I have commanded you they shall do." (Exodus 31:11)

text: יָבֵשׁ חָצִיר נָבֵֽל צִיץ וּדְבַר אֱלֹהֵינוּ יָקוּם לְעוֹלָֽם׃
translation: The grass withers, the flower fades; but the word of our God stands forever." (Isaiah 40:8)

text: כְּצִיץ יָצָא וַיִּמָּל וַיִּבְרַח כַּצֵּל וְלֹא יַעֲמֽוֹד׃
translation: He grows up like a flower, and is cut down. He also flees like a shadow, and doesn't continue. (Job 14:2)

text: וְקָלַע כְּרוּבִים וְתִמֹרוֹת וּפְטֻרֵי צִצִּים וְצִפָּה זָהָב מְיֻשָּׁר עַל הַמְּחֻקֶּֽה׃
translation: He carved cherubim, palm trees, and open flowers; and he overlaid them with gold fitted on the engraved work. (1 Kings 6:35)

text: יָבֵשׁ חָצִיר נָבֵֽל צִיץ כִּי רוּחַ יְהוָה נָשְׁבָה בּוֹ אָכֵן חָצִיר הָעָֽם׃
translation: The grass withers, the flower fades, because the LORD's breath blows on it. Surely the people are like grass. (Isaiah 40:7)

text: תְּנוּ צִיץ לְמוֹאָב כִּי נָצֹא תֵּצֵא וְעָרֶיהָ לְשַׁמָּה תִֽהְיֶינָה מֵאֵין יוֹשֵׁב בָּהֵֽן׃
translation: Give wings to Moab, that she may fly and get herself away: and her cities will become a desolation, without anyone to dwell in them. (Jeremiah 48:9)

text: קוֹל אֹמֵר קְרָא וְאָמַר מָה אֶקְרָא כָּל הַבָּשָׂר חָצִיר וְכָל חַסְדּוֹ כְּצִיץ הַשָּׂדֶֽה׃
translation: The voice of one saying, "Cry out!" One said, "What shall I cry?" "All flesh is like grass, and all its glory is like the flower of the field. (Isaiah 40:6)

text: מִמַּֽחֲצִיתָם תִּקָּחוּ וְנָתַתָּה לְאֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן תְּרוּמַת יְהוָֽה׃
translation: Take it from their half, and give it to Eleazar the priest, for the LORD's wave offering. (Numbers 31:29)

text: וְלִבְנֵי קְהָת הַנּוֹתָרִים מִמִּשְׁפַּחַת הַמַּטֶּה מִֽמַּחֲצִית מַטֵּה חֲצִי מְנַשֶּׁה בַּגּוֹרָל עָרִים עָֽשֶׂר׃
translation: the son of Amzi, the son of Bani, the son of Shemer, (1 Chronicles 6:46)

text: וּמִֽמַּחֲצִית מַטֵּה מְנַשֶּׁה אֶת תַּעְנַךְ וְאֶת מִגְרָשֶׁהָ וְאֶת גַּת רִמּוֹן וְאֶת מִגְרָשֶׁהָ עָרִים שְׁתָּֽיִם׃
translation: Out of the half-tribe of Manasseh, Taanach with its pasture lands, and Gath Rimmon with its pasture lands: two cities. (Joshua 21:25)

text: הֶֽעָשִׁיר לֹֽא יַרְבֶּה וְהַדַּל לֹא יַמְעִיט מִֽמַּחֲצִית הַשָּׁקֶל לָתֵת אֶת תְּרוּמַת יְהוָה לְכַפֵּר עַל נַפְשֹׁתֵיכֶֽם׃
translation: The rich shall not give more, and the poor shall not give less, than the half shekel, when they give the offering of the LORD, to make atonement for your souls. (Exodus 30:15)

text: וּמִֽמַּחֲצִית מַטֵּה מְנַשֶּׁה אֶת עָנֵר וְאֶת מִגְרָשֶׁיהָ וְאֶת בִּלְעָם וְאֶת מִגְרָשֶׁיהָ לְמִשְׁפַּחַת לִבְנֵי קְהָת הַנּוֹתָרִֽים׃
translation: to them they gave Hebron in the land of Judah, and its pasture lands around it; (1 Chronicles 6:55)

text: זֶה יִתְּנוּ כָּל הָעֹבֵר עַל הַפְּקֻדִים מַחֲצִית הַשֶּׁקֶל בְּשֶׁקֶל הַקֹּדֶשׁ עֶשְׂרִים גֵּרָה הַשֶּׁקֶל מַחֲצִית הַשֶּׁקֶל תְּרוּמָה לַֽיהוָֽה׃
translation: They shall give this, everyone who passes over to those who are counted, half a shekel according to the shekel of the sanctuary (the shekel is twenty gerahs); half a shekel for an offering to the LORD. (Exodus 30:13)

text: לֹא תִלְבַּשׁ שַֽׁעַטְנֵז צֶמֶר וּפִשְׁתִּים יַחְדָּֽו׃
translation: You shall not wear clothes of wool and linen woven together. (Deuteronomy 22:11)

text: דָּרְשָׁה צֶמֶר וּפִשְׁתִּים וַתַּעַשׂ בְּחֵפֶץ כַּפֶּֽיהָ׃
translation: She seeks wool and flax, and works eagerly with her hands. (Proverbs 31:13)

text: וְהַבֶּגֶד כִּֽי יִהְיֶה בוֹ נֶגַע צָרָעַת בְּבֶגֶד צֶמֶר אוֹ בְּבֶגֶד פִּשְׁתִּֽים׃
translation: "The garment also that the plague of leprosy is in, whether it is a woolen garment, or a linen garment; (Leviticus 13:47)

text: דַּמֶּשֶׂק סֹחַרְתֵּךְ בְּרֹב מַעֲשַׂיִךְ מֵרֹב כָּל הוֹן בְּיֵין חֶלְבּוֹן וְצֶמֶר צָֽחַר׃
translation: "'"Damascus was your merchant for the multitude of your handiworks by reason of the multitude of all kinds of riches, with the wine of Helbon, and white wool. (Ezekiel 27:18)

text: לָכֵן אָשׁוּב וְלָקַחְתִּי דְגָנִי בְּעִתּוֹ וְתִירוֹשִׁי בְּמֽוֹעֲדוֹ וְהִצַּלְתִּי צַמְרִי וּפִשְׁתִּי לְכַסּוֹת אֶת עֶרְוָתָֽהּ׃
translation: I will also cause all her celebrations to cease: her feasts, her new moons, her Sabbaths, and all her solemn assemblies. (Hosea 2:11)

text: לְכוּ נָא וְנִוָּֽכְחָה יֹאמַר יְהוָה אִם יִֽהְיוּ חֲטָאֵיכֶם כַּשָּׁנִים כַּשֶּׁלֶג יַלְבִּינוּ אִם יַאְדִּימוּ כַתּוֹלָע כַּצֶּמֶר יִהְיֽוּ׃
translation: "Come now, and let's reason together," says the LORD: "Though your sins are as scarlet, they shall be as white as snow. Though they are red like crimson, they shall be as wool. (Isaiah 1:18)

text: תּוֹעֲבַת יְהוָה אֶבֶן וָאָבֶן וּמֹאזְנֵי מִרְמָה לֹא טֽוֹב׃
translation: The LORD detests differing weights, and dishonest scales are not pleasing. (Proverbs 20:23)

text: וָאֶכְתֹּב בַּסֵּפֶר וָֽאֶחְתֹּם וָאָעֵד עֵדִים וָאֶשְׁקֹל הַכֶּסֶף בְּמֹאזְנָֽיִם׃
translation: I signed the deed, sealed it, called witnesses, and weighed the money in the balances to him. (Jeremiah 32:10)

text: מֹֽאזְנֵי צֶדֶק וְאֵֽיפַת צֶדֶק וּבַת צֶדֶק יְהִי לָכֶֽם׃
translation: "You shall have just balances, a just ephah, and a just bath. (Ezekiel 45:10)

text: לוּ שָׁקוֹל יִשָּׁקֵל כַּעְשִׂי והיתי וְהַוָּתִי בְּֽמֹאזְנַיִם יִשְׂאוּ יָֽחַד׃
translation: "Oh that my anguish were weighed, and all my calamity laid in the balances! (Job 6:2)

text: מֹאזְנֵי מִרְמָה תּוֹעֲבַת יְהוָה וְאֶבֶן שְׁלֵמָה רְצוֹנֽוֹ׃
translation: A false balance is an abomination to the LORD, but accurate weights are his delight. (Proverbs 11:1)

text: כְּנַעַן בְּיָדוֹ מֹאזְנֵי מִרְמָה לַעֲשֹׁק אָהֵֽב׃
translation: Ephraim said, "Surely I have become rich. I have found myself wealth. In all my wealth they won't find in me any iniquity that is sin." (Hosea 12:8)

text: וְהַנְּתִינִים יֹשְׁבִים בָּעֹפֶל וְצִיחָא וְגִשְׁפָּא עַל הַנְּתִינִֽים׃
translation: But the temple servants lived in Ophel; and Ziha and Gishpa were over the temple servants. (Nehemiah 11:21)

text: הִנֵּה עֻפְּלָה לֹא יָשְׁרָה נַפְשׁוֹ בּוֹ וְצַדִּיק בֶּאֱמוּנָתוֹ יִחְיֶֽה׃
translation: Behold, his soul is puffed up. It is not upright in him, but the righteous will live by his faith. (Habakkuk 2:4)

text: וַיָּבֹא אֶל הָעֹפֶל וַיִּקַּח מִיָּדָם וַיִּפְקֹד בַּבָּיִת וַיְשַׁלַּח אֶת הָאֲנָשִׁים וַיֵּלֵֽכוּ׃
translation: When he came to the hill, he took them from their hand, and stored them in the house. Then he let the men go, and they departed. (2 Kings 5:24)

text: הוּא בָּנָה אֶת שַׁעַר בֵּית יְהוָה הָעֶלְיוֹן וּבְחוֹמַת הָעֹפֶל בָּנָה לָרֹֽב׃
translation: He built the upper gate of the LORD's house, and he built much on the wall of Ophel. (2 Chronicles 27:3)

text: וְהַנְּתִינִים הָיוּ יֹשְׁבִים בָּעֹפֶל עַד נֶגֶד שַׁעַר הַמַּיִם לַמִּזְרָח וְהַמִּגְדָּל הַיּוֹצֵֽא׃
translation: (Now the temple servants lived in Ophel, to the place opposite the water gate toward the east, and the tower that stands out.) (Nehemiah 3:26)

text: וַיַּעְפִּלוּ לַעֲלוֹת אֶל רֹאשׁ הָהָר וַאֲרוֹן בְּרִית יְהוָה וּמֹשֶׁה לֹא מָשׁוּ מִקֶּרֶב הַֽמַּחֲנֶֽה׃
translation: But they presumed to go up to the top of the mountain. Nevertheless, the ark of the LORD's covenant and Moses didn't depart out of the camp. (Numbers 14:44)

text: חַג הַסֻּכֹּת תַּעֲשֶׂה לְךָ שִׁבְעַת יָמִים בְּאָסְפְּךָ מִֽגָּרְנְךָ וּמִיִּקְבֶֽךָ׃
translation: You shall keep the feast of booths seven days, after you have gathered in from your threshing floor and from your wine press. (Deuteronomy 16:13)

text: גֹּרֶן וָיֶקֶב לֹא יִרְעֵם וְתִירוֹשׁ יְכַחֶשׁ בָּֽהּ׃
translation: The threshing floor and the wine press won't feed them, and the new wine will fail her. (Hosea 9:2)

text: וּמָלְאוּ הַגֳּרָנוֹת בָּר וְהֵשִׁיקוּ הַיְקָבִים תִּירוֹשׁ וְיִצְהָֽר׃
translation: The threshing floors will be full of wheat, and the vats will overflow with new wine and oil. (Joel 2:24)

text: בֵּין שׁוּרֹתָם יַצְהִירוּ יְקָבִים דָּרְכוּ וַיִּצְמָֽאוּ׃
translation: They make oil within the walls of these men. They tread wine presses, and suffer thirst. (Job 24:11)

text: וְיִמָּלְאוּ אֲסָמֶיךָ שָׂבָע וְתִירוֹשׁ יְקָבֶיךָ יִפְרֹֽצוּ׃
translation: so your barns will be filled with plenty, and your vats will overflow with new wine. (Proverbs 3:10)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר אַל יוֹשִׁעֵךְ יְהוָה מֵאַיִן אֽוֹשִׁיעֵךְ הֲמִן הַגֹּרֶן אוֹ מִן הַיָּֽקֶב׃
translation: He said, "If the LORD doesn't help you, where could I get help for you? From the threshing floor, or from the wine press?" (2 Kings 6:27)

text: כַּעֲבוֹר סוּפָה וְאֵין רָשָׁע וְצַדִּיק יְסוֹד עוֹלָֽם׃
translation: When the whirlwind passes, the wicked is no more; but the righteous stand firm forever. (Proverbs 10:25)

text: תַּשִּׂיגֵהוּ כַמַּיִם בַּלָּהוֹת לַיְלָה גְּנָבַתּוּ סוּפָֽה׃
translation: Terrors overtake him like waters. A storm steals him away in the night. (Job 27:20)

text: מִן הַחֶדֶר תָּבוֹא סוּפָה וּֽמִמְּזָרִים קָרָֽה׃
translation: Out of its room comes the storm, and cold out of the north. (Job 37:9)

text: מַשָּׂא מִדְבַּר יָם כְּסוּפוֹת בַּנֶּגֶב לַֽחֲלֹף מִמִּדְבָּר בָּא מֵאֶרֶץ נוֹרָאָֽה׃
translation: The burden of the wilderness of the sea. As whirlwinds in the South sweep through, it comes from the wilderness, from an awesome land. (Isaiah 21:1)

text: כֵּן תִּרְדְּפֵם בְּסַעֲרֶךָ וּבְסוּפָתְךָ תְבַהֲלֵֽם׃
translation: Fill their faces with confusion, that they may seek your name, LORD. (Psalms 83:16)

text: עַל כֵּן יֵֽאָמַר בְּסֵפֶר מִלְחֲמֹת יְהוָה אֶת וָהֵב בְּסוּפָה וְאֶת הַנְּחָלִים אַרְנֽוֹן׃
translation: Therefore it is said in The Book of the Wars of the LORD, "Vaheb in Suphah, the valleys of the Arnon, (Numbers 21:14)

text: רָטֹב הוּא לִפְנֵי שָׁמֶשׁ וְעַל גַּנָּתוֹ יֹֽנַקְתּוֹ תֵצֵֽא׃
translation: He is green before the sun. His shoots go out along his garden. (Job 8:16)

text: בְּנוּ בָתִּים וְשֵׁבוּ וְנִטְעוּ גַנּוֹת וְאִכְלוּ אֶת פִּרְיָֽן׃
translation: "Build houses and dwell in them. Plant gardens and eat their fruit. (Jeremiah 29:5)

text: עָשִׂיתִי לִי גַּנּוֹת וּפַרְדֵּסִים וְנָטַעְתִּי בָהֶם עֵץ כָּל פֶּֽרִי׃
translation: I made myself gardens and parks, and I planted trees in them of all kinds of fruit. (Ecclesiastes 2:5)

text: כִּי יֵבֹשׁוּ מֵאֵילִים אֲשֶׁר חֲמַדְתֶּם וְתַחְפְּרוּ מֵהַגַּנּוֹת אֲשֶׁר בְּחַרְתֶּֽם׃
translation: For they shall be ashamed of the oaks which you have desired, and you shall be confounded for the gardens that you have chosen. (Isaiah 1:29)

text: כִּי תִֽהְיוּ כְּאֵלָה נֹבֶלֶת עָלֶהָ וּֽכְגַנָּה אֲשֶׁר מַיִם אֵין לָֽהּ׃
translation: For you shall be as an oak whose leaf fades, and as a garden that has no water. (Isaiah 1:30)

text: כִּנְחָלִים נִטָּיוּ כְּגַנֹּת עֲלֵי נָהָר כַּאֲהָלִים נָטַע יְהוָה כַּאֲרָזִים עֲלֵי מָֽיִם׃
translation: As valleys they are spread out, as gardens by the riverside, as aloes which the LORD has planted, as cedar trees beside the waters. (Numbers 24:6)

text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ יְרֻשַּׁת פְּלֵיטָה לְבִנְיָמִן וְלֹֽא יִמָּחֶה שֵׁבֶט מִיִּשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
translation: They said, "There must be an inheritance for those who are escaped of Benjamin, that a tribe not be blotted out from Israel. (Judges 21:17)

text: וְהִנֵּה הֵם גֹּמְלִים עָלֵינוּ לָבוֹא לְגָרְשֵׁנוּ מִיְּרֻשָּׁתְךָ אֲשֶׁר הֽוֹרַשְׁתָּֽנוּ׃
translation: behold, how they reward us, to come to cast us out of your possession, which you have given us to inherit. (2 Chronicles 20:11)

text: כִּֽי אַתָּה אֱלֹהִים שָׁמַעְתָּ לִנְדָרָי נָתַתָּ יְרֻשַּׁת יִרְאֵי שְׁמֶֽךָ׃
translation: You will prolong the king's life. His years will be for generations. (Psalms 61:6)

text: וְהָיָה אֱדוֹם יְרֵשָׁה וְהָיָה יְרֵשָׁה שֵׂעִיר אֹיְבָיו וְיִשְׂרָאֵל עֹשֶׂה חָֽיִל׃
translation: Edom shall be a possession. Seir, his enemy, also shall be a possession, while Israel does valiantly. (Numbers 24:18)

text: מֹשֶׁה עֶֽבֶד יְהוָה וּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הִכּוּם וַֽיִּתְּנָהּ מֹשֶׁה עֶֽבֶד יְהוָה יְרֻשָּׁה לָרֻֽאוּבֵנִי וְלַגָּדִי וְלַחֲצִי שֵׁבֶט הַֽמְנַשֶּֽׁה׃
translation: Moses the servant of the LORD and the children of Israel struck them. Moses the servant of the LORD gave it for a possession to the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh. (Joshua 12:6)

text: אַל תִּתְגָּרוּ בָם כִּי לֹֽא אֶתֵּן לָכֶם מֵֽאַרְצָם עַד מִדְרַךְ כַּף רָגֶל כִּֽי יְרֻשָּׁה לְעֵשָׂו נָתַתִּי אֶת הַר שֵׂעִֽיר׃
translation: Don't contend with them; for I will not give you any of their land, no, not so much as for the sole of the foot to tread on, because I have given Mount Seir to Esau for a possession. (Deuteronomy 2:5)

text: כִּי מִי אֱלוֹהַּ מִבַּלְעֲדֵי יְהוָה וּמִי צוּר זוּלָתִי אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃
translation: the God who arms me with strength, and makes my way perfect? (Psalms 18:32)

text: יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ בְּעָלוּנוּ אֲדֹנִים זֽוּלָתֶךָ לְבַד בְּךָ נַזְכִּיר שְׁמֶֽךָ׃
translation: LORD our God, other lords besides you have had dominion over us, but we will only acknowledge your name. (Isaiah 26:13)

text: יְהוָה אֵין כָּמוֹךָ וְאֵין אֱלֹהִים זוּלָתֶךָ בְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר שָׁמַעְנוּ בְּאָזְנֵֽינוּ׃
translation: LORD, there is no one like you, neither is there any God besides you, according to all that we have heard with our ears. (1 Chronicles 17:20)

text: אֲנִי יְהוָה וְאֵין עוֹד זוּלָתִי אֵין אֱלֹהִים אֲאַזֶּרְךָ וְלֹא יְדַעְתָּֽנִי׃
translation: I am the LORD, and there is no one else. Besides me, there is no God. I will strengthen you, though you have not known me, (Isaiah 45:5)

text: וְאָנֹכִי יְהוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם וֵאלֹהִים זֽוּלָתִי לֹא תֵדָע וּמוֹשִׁיעַ אַיִן בִּלְתִּֽי׃
translation: "Yet I am the LORD your God from the land of Egypt; and you shall acknowledge no god but me, and besides me there is no savior. (Hosea 13:4)

text: וּמֵעוֹלָם לֹא שָׁמְעוּ לֹא הֶאֱזִינוּ עַיִן לֹֽא רָאָתָה אֱלֹהִים זוּלָתְךָ יַעֲשֶׂה לִמְחַכֵּה לֽוֹ׃
translation: When you did awesome things which we didn't look for, you came down, and the mountains quaked at your presence. (Isaiah 64:3)

text: וּבְחֹרֵב הִקְצַפְתֶּם אֶת יְהוָה וַיִּתְאַנַּף יְהוָה בָּכֶם לְהַשְׁמִיד אֶתְכֶֽם׃
translation: Also in Horeb you provoked the LORD to wrath, and the LORD was angry with you to destroy you. (Deuteronomy 9:8)

text: עַד מָה יְהוָה תֶּאֱנַף לָנֶצַח תִּבְעַר כְּמוֹ אֵשׁ קִנְאָתֶֽךָ׃
translation: How long, LORD? Will you be angry forever? Will your jealousy burn like fire? (Psalms 79:5)

text: הַלְעוֹלָם תֶּֽאֱנַף בָּנוּ תִּמְשֹׁךְ אַפְּךָ לְדֹר וָדֹֽר׃
translation: Won't you revive us again, that your people may rejoice in you? (Psalms 85:6)

text: אֱלֹהִים זְנַחְתָּנוּ פְרַצְתָּנוּ אָנַפְתָּ תְּשׁוֹבֵב לָֽנוּ׃
translation: You have shown your people hard things. You have made us drink the wine that makes us stagger. (Psalms 60:3)

text: גַּם בִּי הִתְאַנַּף יְהוָה בִּגְלַלְכֶם לֵאמֹר גַּם אַתָּה לֹא תָבֹא שָֽׁם׃
translation: Also the LORD was angry with me for your sakes, saying, "You also shall not go in there. (Deuteronomy 1:37)

text: וּֽבְאַהֲרֹן הִתְאַנַּף יְהוָה מְאֹד לְהַשְׁמִידוֹ וָֽאֶתְפַּלֵּל גַּם בְּעַד אַהֲרֹן בָּעֵת הַהִֽוא׃
translation: The LORD was angry enough with Aaron to destroy him. I prayed for Aaron also at the same time. (Deuteronomy 9:20)

text: אֱלִיאֵל הַֽמַּחֲוִים וִירִיבַי וְיוֹשַׁוְיָה בְּנֵי אֶלְנָעַם וְיִתְמָה הַמּוֹאָבִֽי׃
translation: Eliel the Mahavite, and Jeribai, and Joshaviah, the sons of Elnaam, and Ithmah the Moabite, (1 Chronicles 11:46)

text: וְאֵלֶּה הַמִּתְקַשְּׁרִים עָלָיו זָבָד בֶּן שִׁמְעָת הָֽעַמּוֹנִית וִיהוֹזָבָד בֶּן שִׁמְרִית הַמּוֹאָבִֽית׃
translation: These are those who conspired against him: Zabad the son of Shimeath the Ammonitess and Jehozabad the son of Shimrith the Moabitess. (2 Chronicles 24:26)

text: וַיִּשְׂאוּ לָהֶם נָשִׁים מֹֽאֲבִיּוֹת שֵׁם הָֽאַחַת עָרְפָּה וְשֵׁם הַשֵּׁנִית רוּת וַיֵּשְׁבוּ שָׁם כְּעֶשֶׂר שָׁנִֽים׃
translation: They took for themselves wives of the women of Moab. The name of the one was Orpah, and the name of the other was Ruth. They lived there about ten years. (Ruth 1:4)

text: וַיַּעַן הַנַּעַר הַנִּצָּב עַל הַקּוֹצְרִים וַיֹּאמַר נַעֲרָה מֽוֹאֲבִיָּה הִיא הַשָּׁבָה עִֽם נָעֳמִי מִשְּׂדֵה מוֹאָֽב׃
translation: The servant who was set over the reapers answered, "It is the Moabite lady who came back with Naomi out of the country of Moab. (Ruth 2:6)

text: לֹֽא יָבֹא עַמּוֹנִי וּמוֹאָבִי בִּקְהַל יְהוָה גַּם דּוֹר עֲשִׂירִי לֹא יָבֹא לָהֶם בִּקְהַל יְהוָה עַד עוֹלָֽם׃
translation: because they didn't meet you with bread and with water on the way when you came out of Egypt, and because they hired against you Balaam the son of Beor from Pethor of Mesopotamia, to curse you. (Deuteronomy 23:4)

text: וַתָּשָׁב נָעֳמִי וְרוּת הַמּוֹאֲבִיָּה כַלָּתָהּ עִמָּהּ הַשָּׁבָה מִשְּׂדֵי מוֹאָב וְהֵמָּה בָּאוּ בֵּית לֶחֶם בִּתְחִלַּת קְצִיר שְׂעֹרִֽים׃
translation: So Naomi returned, and Ruth the Moabitess, her daughter-in-law, with her, who returned out of the country of Moab. They came to Bethlehem in the beginning of barley harvest. (Ruth 1:22)

text: צִידֹנִים יִקְרְאוּ לְחֶרְמוֹן שִׂרְיֹן וְהָאֱמֹרִי יִקְרְאוּ לוֹ שְׂנִֽיר׃
translation: (The Sidonians call Hermon Sirion, and the Amorites call it Senir.) (Deuteronomy 3:9)

text: וְצִידוֹנִים וַֽעֲמָלֵק וּמָעוֹן לָחֲצוּ אֶתְכֶם וַתִּצְעֲקוּ אֵלַי וָאוֹשִׁיעָה אֶתְכֶם מִיָּדָֽם׃
translation: The Sidonians also, and the Amalekites, and the Maonites, oppressed you; and you cried to me, and I saved you out of their hand. (Judges 10:12)

text: וַיֵּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה אַחֲרֵי עַשְׁתֹּרֶת אֱלֹהֵי צִדֹנִים וְאַחֲרֵי מִלְכֹּם שִׁקֻּץ עַמֹּנִֽים׃
translation: For Solomon went after Ashtoreth the goddess of the Sidonians, and after Milcom the abomination of the Ammonites. (1 Kings 11:5)

text: מִתֵּימָן כָּל אֶרֶץ הַֽכְּנַעֲנִי וּמְעָרָה אֲשֶׁר לַצִּידֹנִים עַד אֲפֵקָה עַד גְּבוּל הָאֱמֹרִֽי׃
translation: on the south; all the land of the Canaanites, and Mearah that belongs to the Sidonians, to Aphek, to the border of the Amorites; (Joshua 13:4)

text: וַעֲצֵי אֲרָזִים לְאֵין מִסְפָּר כִּֽי הֵבִיאוּ הַצִּֽידֹנִים וְהַצֹּרִים עֲצֵי אֲרָזִים לָרֹב לְדָוִֽיד׃
translation: and cedar trees without number, for the Sidonians and the people of Tyre brought cedar trees in abundance to David. (1 Chronicles 22:4)

text: וְהַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה אָהַב נָשִׁים נָכְרִיּוֹת רַבּוֹת וְאֶת בַּת פַּרְעֹה מוֹאֲבִיּוֹת עַמֳּנִיּוֹת אֲדֹמִיֹּת צֵדְנִיֹּת חִתִּיֹּֽת׃
translation: Now King Solomon loved many foreign women, together with the daughter of Pharaoh: women of the Moabites, Ammonites, Edomites, Sidonians, and Hittites, (1 Kings 11:1)

text: לֹא יֻתַּן סְגוֹר תַּחְתֶּיהָ וְלֹא יִשָּׁקֵל כֶּסֶף מְחִירָֽהּ׃
translation: It can't be gotten for gold, neither will silver be weighed for its price. (Job 28:15)

text: וּכְלוּב אֲחִֽי שׁוּחָה הוֹלִיד אֶת מְחִיר הוּא אֲבִי אֶשְׁתּֽוֹן׃
translation: Chelub the brother of Shuhah became the father of Mehir, who was the father of Eshton. (1 Chronicles 4:11)

text: תִּמְכֹּֽר עַמְּךָ בְלֹא הוֹן וְלֹא רִבִּיתָ בִּמְחִירֵיהֶֽם׃
translation: You make us a reproach to our neighbors, a scoffing and a derision to those who are around us. (Psalms 44:13)

text: לָמָּה זֶּה מְחִיר בְּיַד כְּסִיל לִקְנוֹת חָכְמָה וְלֶב אָֽיִן׃
translation: Why is there money in the hand of a fool to buy wisdom, since he has no understanding? (Proverbs 17:16)

text: חֵילְךָ וְאוֹצְרוֹתֶיךָ לָבַז אֶתֵּן לֹא בִמְחִיר וּבְכָל חַטֹּאותֶיךָ וּבְכָל גְּבוּלֶֽיךָ׃
translation: I will give your substance and your treasures for a plunder without price, and that for all your sins, even in all your borders. (Jeremiah 15:13)

text: מֵימֵינוּ בְּכֶסֶף שָׁתִינוּ עֵצֵינוּ בִּמְחִיר יָבֹֽאוּ׃
translation: We must pay for water to drink. Our wood is sold to us. (Lamentations 5:4)

text: עֵת לִקְרוֹעַ וְעֵת לִתְפּוֹר עֵת לַחֲשׁוֹת וְעֵת לְדַבֵּֽר׃
translation: a time to tear, and a time to sew; a time to keep silence, and a time to speak; (Ecclesiastes 3:7)

text: הַעַל אֵלֶּה תִתְאַפַּק יְהוָה תֶּחֱשֶׁה וּתְעַנֵּנוּ עַד מְאֹֽד׃
translation: Our holy and our beautiful house where our fathers praised you is burned with fire. All our pleasant places are laid waste. (Isaiah 64:11)

text: הֶחֱשֵׁיתִי מֵֽעוֹלָם אַחֲרִישׁ אֶתְאַפָּק כַּיּוֹלֵדָה אֶפְעֶה אֶשֹּׁם וְאֶשְׁאַף יָֽחַד׃
translation: "I have been silent a long time. I have been quiet and restrained myself. Now I will cry out like a travailing woman. I will both gasp and pant. (Isaiah 42:14)

text: יָקֵם סְעָרָה לִדְמָמָה וַיֶּחֱשׁוּ גַּלֵּיהֶֽם׃
translation: He makes the storm a calm, so that its waves are still. (Psalms 107:29)

text: הִנֵּה כְתוּבָה לְפָנָי לֹא אֶחֱשֶׂה כִּי אִם שִׁלַּמְתִּי וְשִׁלַּמְתִּי עַל חֵיקָֽם׃
translation: "Behold, it is written before me: I will not keep silence, but will repay, yes, I will repay into their bosom (Isaiah 65:6)

text: לְדָוִד אֵלֶיךָ יְהוָה אֶקְרָא צוּרִי אַֽל תֶּחֱרַשׁ מִמֶּנִּי פֶּן תֶּֽחֱשֶׁה מִמֶּנִּי וְנִמְשַׁלְתִּי עִם יוֹרְדֵי בֽוֹר׃
translation: By David. To you, LORD, I call. My rock, don't be deaf to me, lest, if you are silent to me, I would become like those who go down into the pit. (Psalms 28:1)

text: בְּרָב כֹּחַ יִתְחַפֵּשׂ לְבוּשִׁי כְּפִי כֻתָּנְתִּי יַֽאַזְרֵֽנִי׃
translation: My garment is disfigured by great force. It binds me about as the collar of my tunic. (Job 30:18)

text: קֶשֶׁת גִּבֹּרִים חַתִּים וְנִכְשָׁלִים אָזְרוּ חָֽיִל׃
translation: "The bows of the mighty men are broken. Those who stumbled are armed with strength. (1 Samuel 2:4)

text: וַתַּזְרֵנִי חַיִל לַמִּלְחָמָה תַּכְרִיעַ קָמַי תַּחְתֵּֽנִי׃
translation: For you have armed me with strength for the battle. You have subdued under me those who rose up against me. (2 Samuel 22:40)

text: אֱזָר נָא כְגֶבֶר חֲלָצֶיךָ וְאֶשְׁאָלְךָ וְהוֹדִיעֵֽנִי׃
translation: Brace yourself like a man, for I will question you, then you answer me! (Job 38:3)

text: אֱזָר נָא כְגֶבֶר חֲלָצֶיךָ אֶשְׁאָלְךָ וְהוֹדִיעֵֽנִי׃
translation: "Now brace yourself like a man. I will question you, and you will answer me. (Job 40:7)

text: הָאֵל הַמְאַזְּרֵנִי חָיִל וַיִּתֵּן תָּמִים דַּרְכִּֽי׃
translation: He makes my feet like deer's feet, and sets me on my high places. (Psalms 18:33)

text: אָבְלָה יְהוּדָה וּשְׁעָרֶיהָ אֻמְלְלוּ קָדְרוּ לָאָרֶץ וְצִוְחַת יְרוּשָׁלִַם עָלָֽתָה׃
translation: "Judah mourns, and its gates languish. They sit in black on the ground. The cry of Jerusalem goes up. (Jeremiah 14:2)

text: אָבְלָה נָֽבְלָה הָאָרֶץ אֻמְלְלָה נָבְלָה תֵּבֵל אֻמְלָלוּ מְרוֹם עַם הָאָֽרֶץ׃
translation: The earth mourns and fades away. The world languishes and fades away. The lofty people of the earth languish. (Isaiah 24:4)

text: שֻׁדַּד שָׂדֶה אָבְלָה אֲדָמָה כִּי שֻׁדַּד דָּגָן הוֹבִישׁ תִּירוֹשׁ אֻמְלַל יִצְהָֽר׃
translation: The field is laid waste. The land mourns, for the grain is destroyed, The new wine has dried up, and the oil languishes. (Joel 1:10)

text: שְׂבֵעִים בַּלֶּחֶם נִשְׂכָּרוּ וּרְעֵבִים חָדֵלּוּ עַד עֲקָרָה יָלְדָה שִׁבְעָה וְרַבַּת בָּנִים אֻמְלָֽלָה׃
translation: Those who were full have hired themselves out for bread. Those who were hungry are satisfied. Yes, the barren has borne seven. She who has many children languishes. (1 Samuel 2:5)

text: אָבַל אֻמְלְלָה אָרֶץ הֶחְפִּיר לְבָנוֹן קָמַל הָיָה הַשָּׁרוֹן כָּֽעֲרָבָה וְנֹעֵר בָּשָׁן וְכַרְמֶֽל׃
translation: The land mourns and languishes. Lebanon is confounded and withers away. Sharon is like a desert, and Bashan and Carmel are stripped bare. (Isaiah 33:9)

text: עַל כֵּן תֶּאֱבַל הָאָרֶץ וְאֻמְלַל כָּל יוֹשֵׁב בָּהּ בְּחַיַּת הַשָּׂדֶה וּבְעוֹף הַשָּׁמָיִם וְגַם דְּגֵי הַיָּם יֵאָסֵֽפוּ׃
translation: Therefore the land will mourn, and everyone who dwells in it will waste away, with all living things in her, even the animals of the field and the birds of the sky; yes, the fish of the sea also die. (Hosea 4:3)

text: הִנֵּה אֵמָתִי לֹא תְבַעֲתֶךָּ וְאַכְפִּי עָלֶיךָ לֹא יִכְבָּֽד׃
translation: Behold, my terror will not make you afraid, neither will my pressure be heavy on you. (Job 33:7)

text: וְרוּחַ יְהוָה סָרָה מֵעִם שָׁאוּל וּבִֽעֲתַתּוּ רֽוּחַ רָעָה מֵאֵת יְהוָֽה׃
translation: Now the LORD's Spirit departed from Saul, and an evil spirit from the LORD troubled him. (1 Samuel 16:14)

text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ עַבְדֵֽי שָׁאוּל אֵלָיו הִנֵּה נָא רֽוּחַ אֱלֹהִים רָעָה מְבַעִתֶּֽךָ׃
translation: Saul's servants said to him, "See now, an evil spirit from God troubles you. (1 Samuel 16:15)

text: יָסֵר מֵעָלַי שִׁבְטוֹ וְאֵמָתוֹ אַֽל תְּבַעֲתַֽנִּי׃
translation: Let him take his rod away from me. Let his terror not make me afraid; (Job 9:34)

text: כַּפְּךָ מֵעָלַי הַרְחַק וְאֵמָתְךָ אַֽל תְּבַעֲתַֽנִּי׃
translation: withdraw your hand far from me, and don't let your terror make me afraid. (Job 13:21)

text: אֲפָפוּנִי חֶבְלֵי מָוֶת וְֽנַחֲלֵי בְלִיַּעַל יְבַֽעֲתֽוּנִי׃
translation: The cords of Sheol were around me. The snares of death came on me. (Psalms 18:5)

text: אָז תָּבִין צֶדֶק וּמִשְׁפָּט וּמֵישָׁרִים כָּל מַעְגַּל טֽוֹב׃
translation: Then you will understand righteousness and justice, equity and every good path. (Proverbs 2:9)

text: נַפְשִׁי יְשׁוֹבֵב יַֽנְחֵנִי בְמַעְגְּלֵי צֶדֶק לְמַעַן שְׁמֽוֹ׃
translation: He restores my soul. He guides me in the paths of righteousness for his name's sake. (Psalms 23:3)

text: תָּמֹךְ אֲשֻׁרַי בְּמַעְגְּלוֹתֶיךָ בַּל נָמוֹטּוּ פְעָמָֽי׃
translation: My steps have held fast to your paths. My feet have not slipped. (Psalms 17:5)

text: בְּדֶרֶךְ חָכְמָה הֹרֵתִיךָ הִדְרַכְתִּיךָ בְּמַעְגְּלֵי יֹֽשֶׁר׃
translation: I have taught you in the way of wisdom. I have led you in straight paths. (Proverbs 4:11)

text: אֲשֶׁר אָרְחֹתֵיהֶם עִקְּשִׁים וּנְלוֹזִים בְּמַעְגְּלוֹתָֽם׃
translation: who are crooked in their ways, and wayward in their paths, (Proverbs 2:15)

text: טָֽמְנֽוּ גֵאִים פַּח לִי וַחֲבָלִים פָּרְשׂוּ רֶשֶׁת לְיַד מַעְגָּל מֹקְשִׁים שָֽׁתוּ לִי סֶֽלָה׃
translation: I said to the LORD, "You are my God." Listen to the cry of my petitions, LORD. (Psalms 140:6)

text: וַאֲנִי שְׁלֹשֶׁת הַחִצִּים צִדָּה אוֹרֶה לְשַֽׁלַּֽח לִי לְמַטָּרָֽה׃
translation: I will shoot three arrows on its side, as though I shot at a mark. (1 Samuel 20:20)

text: שָׁלֵו הָיִיתִי וַֽיְפַרְפְּרֵנִי וְאָחַז בְּעָרְפִּי וַֽיְפַצְפְּצֵנִי וַיְקִימֵנִי לוֹ לְמַטָּרָֽה׃
translation: I was at ease, and he broke me apart. Yes, he has taken me by the neck, and dashed me to pieces. He has also set me up for his target. (Job 16:12)

text: וְאֶֽל יִרְמְיָהוּ הָיָה דְבַר יְהוָה בִּֽהְיֹתוֹ עָצוּר בַּחֲצַר הַמַּטָּרָה לֵאמֹֽר׃
translation: Now the LORD's word came to Jeremiah while he was shut up in the court of the guard, saying, (Jeremiah 39:15)

text: דָּרַךְ קַשְׁתוֹ וַיַּצִּיבֵנִי כַּמַּטָּרָא לַחֵֽץ׃
translation: He has bent his bow, and set me as a mark for the arrow. (Lamentations 3:12)

text: וַיְהִי דְבַר יְהוָה אֶֽל יִרְמְיָהוּ שֵׁנִית וְהוּא עוֹדֶנּוּ עָצוּר בַּחֲצַר הַמַּטָּרָה לֵאמֹֽר׃
translation: Moreover the LORD's word came to Jeremiah the second time, while he was still locked up in the court of the guard, saying, (Jeremiah 33:1)

text: וַיִּמְשְׁכוּ אֶֽת יִרְמְיָהוּ בַּֽחֲבָלִים וַיַּעֲלוּ אֹתוֹ מִן הַבּוֹר וַיֵּשֶׁב יִרְמְיָהוּ בַּחֲצַר הַמַּטָּרָֽה׃
translation: So they lifted Jeremiah up with the cords, and took him up out of the dungeon; and Jeremiah remained in the court of the guard. (Jeremiah 38:13)

text: וּמִשְׁקָל לְמִסְמְרוֹת לִשְׁקָלִים חֲמִשִּׁים זָהָב וְהָעֲלִיּוֹת חִפָּה זָהָֽב׃
translation: The weight of the nails was fifty shekels of gold. He overlaid the upper rooms with gold. (2 Chronicles 3:9)

text: וְהוּא כְּחָתָן יֹצֵא מֵחֻפָּתוֹ יָשִׂישׂ כְּגִבּוֹר לָרוּץ אֹֽרַח׃
translation: His going out is from the end of the heavens, his circuit to its ends. There is nothing hidden from its heat. (Psalms 19:6)

text: לְחֻפָּה שְׁלֹשָׁה עָשָׂר לְיֶֽשֶׁבְאָב אַרְבָּעָה עָשָֽׂר׃
translation: the thirteenth to Huppah, the fourteenth to Jeshebeab, (1 Chronicles 24:13)

text: וַיְחַף אֶת הַבַּיִת הַקֹּרוֹת הַסִּפִּים וְקִֽירוֹתָיו וְדַלְתוֹתָיו זָהָב וּפִתַּח כְּרוּבִים עַל הַקִּירֽוֹת׃
translation: He also overlaid the house, the beams, the thresholds, its walls, and its doors with gold, and engraved cherubim on the walls. (2 Chronicles 3:7)

text: וַיָּשָׁב מָרְדֳּכַי אֶל שַׁעַר הַמֶּלֶךְ וְהָמָן נִדְחַף אֶל בֵּיתוֹ אָבֵל וַחֲפוּי רֹֽאשׁ׃
translation: Mordecai came back to the king's gate, but Haman hurried to his house, mourning and having his head covered. (Esther 6:12)

text: אִסְפוּ עָם קַדְּשׁוּ קָהָל קִבְצוּ זְקֵנִים אִסְפוּ עֽוֹלָלִים וְיֹנְקֵי שָׁדָיִם יֵצֵא חָתָן מֵֽחֶדְרוֹ וְכַלָּה מֵחֻפָּתָֽהּ׃
translation: Gather the people. Sanctify the assembly. Assemble the elders. Gather the children, and those who nurse from breasts. Let the bridegroom go out of his room, and the bride out of her chamber. (Joel 2:16)

text: רָאשֵׁי הָעָם פַּרְעֹשׁ פַּחַת מוֹאָב עֵילָם זַתּוּא בָּנִֽי׃
translation: Bunni, Azgad, Bebai, (Nehemiah 10:15)

text: פַּחַד וָפַחַת וָפָח עָלֶיךָ יוֹשֵׁב מוֹאָב נְאֻם יְהוָֽה׃
translation: Terror, the pit, and the snare are on you, inhabitant of Moab," says the LORD. (Jeremiah 48:43)

text: מִבְּנֵי פַּחַת מוֹאָב אֶלְיְהֽוֹעֵינַי בֶּן זְרַֽחְיָה וְעִמּוֹ מָאתַיִם הַזְּכָרִֽים׃
translation: Of the sons of Pahathmoab, Eliehoenai the son of Zerahiah; and with him two hundred males. (Ezra 8:4)

text: פַּחַד וָפַחַת וָפָח עָלֶיךָ יוֹשֵׁב הָאָֽרֶץ׃
translation: Fear, the pit, and the snare are on you who inhabit the earth. (Isaiah 24:17)

text: פַּחַד וָפַחַת הָיָה לָנוּ הַשֵּׁאת וְהַשָּֽׁבֶר׃
translation: Terror and the pit have come on us, devastation and destruction." (Lamentations 3:47)

text: בְּנֵֽי פַחַת מוֹאָב לִבְנֵי יֵשׁוּעַ יוֹאָב אַלְפַּיִם שְׁמֹנֶה מֵאוֹת וּשְׁנֵים עָשָֽׂר׃
translation: The children of Pahathmoab, of the children of Jeshua and Joab, two thousand eight hundred twelve. (Ezra 2:6)

text: כִּֽי שֻׁלַּח בְּרֶשֶׁת בְּרַגְלָיו וְעַל שְׂבָכָה יִתְהַלָּֽךְ׃
translation: For he is cast into a net by his own feet, and he wanders into its mesh. (Job 18:8)

text: וַיִּֽהְיוּ הָֽרִמֹּנִים תִּשְׁעִים וְשִׁשָּׁה רוּחָה כָּל הָרִמּוֹנִים מֵאָה עַל הַשְּׂבָכָה סָבִֽיב׃
translation: There were ninety-six pomegranates on the sides; all the pomegranates were one hundred on the network all around. (Jeremiah 52:23)

text: וְכֹתָרֹת עַל שְׁנֵי הָֽעַמּוּדִים גַּם מִמַּעַל מִלְּעֻמַּת הַבֶּטֶן אֲשֶׁר לְעֵבֶר שבכה הַשְּׂבָכָה וְהָרִמּוֹנִים מָאתַיִם טֻרִים סָבִיב עַל הַכֹּתֶרֶת הַשֵּׁנִֽית׃
translation: There were capitals above also on the two pillars, close by the belly which was beside the network. There were two hundred pomegranates in rows around the other capital. (1 Kings 7:20)

text: עַמּוּדִים שְׁנַיִם וְהַגֻּלּוֹת וְהַכֹּתָרוֹת עַל רֹאשׁ הָעַמּוּדִים שְׁתָּיִם וְהַשְּׂבָכוֹת שְׁתַּיִם לְכַסּוֹת אֶת שְׁתֵּי גֻּלּוֹת הַכֹּֽתָרוֹת אֲשֶׁר עַל רֹאשׁ הָֽעַמּוּדִֽים׃
translation: the two pillars, the bowls, the two capitals which were on the top of the pillars, the two networks to cover the two bowls of the capitals that were on the top of the pillars, (2 Chronicles 4:12)

text: וְכֹתֶרֶת עָלָיו נְחֹשֶׁת וְקוֹמַת הַכֹּתֶרֶת הָאַחַת חָמֵשׁ אַמּוֹת וּשְׂבָכָה וְרִמּוֹנִים עַֽל הַכּוֹתֶרֶת סָבִיב הַכֹּל נְחֹשֶׁת וְכָאֵלֶּה לַֽעַמּוּד הַשֵּׁנִי וְרִמּוֹנִֽים׃
translation: A capital of bronze was on it; and the height of the one capital was five cubits, with network and pomegranates on the capital all around, all of bronze. The second pillar also had the same, with pomegranates. (Jeremiah 52:22)

text: וַיַּעַשׂ אֶת הָעַמּוּדִים וּשְׁנֵי טוּרִים סָבִיב עַל הַשְּׂבָכָה הָאֶחָת לְכַסּוֹת אֶת הַכֹּֽתָרֹת אֲשֶׁר עַל רֹאשׁ הָֽרִמֹּנִים וְכֵן עָשָׂה לַכֹּתֶרֶת הַשֵּׁנִֽית׃
translation: So he made the pillars; and there were two rows of pomegranates around the one network, to cover the capitals that were on the top of the pillars; and he did so for the other capital. (1 Kings 7:18)

text: הַֽלְלוּ אֶת יְהוָה כָּל גּוֹיִם שַׁבְּחוּהוּ כָּל הָאֻמִּֽים׃
translation: Praise the LORD, all you nations! Extol him, all you peoples! (Psalms 117:1)

text: מַשְׁבִּיחַ שְׁאוֹן יַמִּים שְׁאוֹן גַּלֵּיהֶם וַהֲמוֹן לְאֻמִּֽים׃
translation: They also who dwell in faraway places are afraid at your wonders. You call the morning's dawn and the evening with songs of joy. (Psalms 65:8)

text: שַׁבְּחִי יְרוּשָׁלִַם אֶת יְהוָה הַֽלְלִי אֱלֹהַיִךְ צִיּֽוֹן׃
translation: Praise the LORD, Jerusalem! Praise your God, Zion! (Psalms 147:12)

text: כָּל רוּחוֹ יוֹצִיא כְסִיל וְחָכָם בְּאָחוֹר יְשַׁבְּחֶֽנָּה׃
translation: A fool vents all of his anger, but a wise man brings himself under control. (Proverbs 29:11)

text: כִּי טוֹב חַסְדְּךָ מֵֽחַיִּים שְׂפָתַי יְשַׁבְּחֽוּנְךָ׃
translation: So I will bless you while I live. I will lift up my hands in your name. (Psalms 63:4)

text: דּוֹר לְדוֹר יְשַׁבַּח מַעֲשֶׂיךָ וּגְבוּרֹתֶיךָ יַגִּֽידוּ׃
translation: One generation will commend your works to another, and will declare your mighty acts. (Psalms 145:4)

text: וּבְשׁוּשַׁן הַבִּירָה הָרְגוּ הַיְּהוּדִים וְאַבֵּד חֲמֵשׁ מֵאוֹת אִֽישׁ׃
translation: In the citadel of Susa, the Jews killed and destroyed five hundred men. (Esther 9:6)

text: בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא בָּא מִסְפַּר הַֽהֲרוּגִים בְּשׁוּשַׁן הַבִּירָה לִפְנֵי הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
translation: On that day, the number of those who were slain in the citadel of Susa was brought before the king. (Esther 9:11)

text: בַּיָּמִים הָהֵם כְּשֶׁבֶת הַמֶּלֶךְ אֲחַשְׁוֵרוֹשׁ עַל כִּסֵּא מַלְכוּתוֹ אֲשֶׁר בְּשׁוּשַׁן הַבִּירָֽה׃
translation: in those days, when the King Ahasuerus sat on the throne of his kingdom, which was in Susa the palace, (Esther 1:2)

text: דִּבְרֵי נְחֶמְיָה בֶּן חֲכַלְיָה וַיְהִי בְחֹֽדֶשׁ כסלו כִּסְלֵיו שְׁנַת עֶשְׂרִים וַאֲנִי הָיִיתִי בְּשׁוּשַׁן הַבִּירָֽה׃
translation: The words of Nehemiah the son of Hacaliah. Now in the month Chislev, in the twentieth year, as I was in Susa the palace, (Nehemiah 1:1)

text: וְלִשְׁלֹמֹה בְנִי תֵּן לֵבָב שָׁלֵם לִשְׁמוֹר מִצְוֺתֶיךָ עֵדְוֺתֶיךָ וְחֻקֶּיךָ וְלַעֲשׂוֹת הַכֹּל וְלִבְנוֹת הַבִּירָה אֲשֶׁר הֲכִינֽוֹתִי׃
translation: and give to Solomon my son a perfect heart, to keep your commandments, your testimonies, and your statutes, and to do all these things, and to build the palace, for which I have made provision." (1 Chronicles 29:19)

text: הָֽרָצִים יָצְאוּ דְחוּפִים בִּדְבַר הַמֶּלֶךְ וְהַדָּת נִתְּנָה בְּשׁוּשַׁן הַבִּירָה וְהַמֶּלֶךְ וְהָמָן יָשְׁבוּ לִשְׁתּוֹת וְהָעִיר שׁוּשָׁן נָבֽוֹכָה׃
translation: The couriers went out in haste by the king's commandment, and the decree was given out in the citadel of Susa. The king and Haman sat down to drink; but the city of Susa was perplexed. (Esther 3:15)

text: קַוֵּה לְשָׁלוֹם וְאֵין טוֹב לְעֵת מַרְפֵּה וְהִנֵּה בְעָתָֽה׃
translation: We looked for peace, but no good came; and for a time of healing, and behold, dismay! (Jeremiah 8:15)

text: וְאַחֲרֵי כָּל זֹאת נְגָפוֹ יְהוָה בְּמֵעָיו לָחֳלִי לְאֵין מַרְפֵּֽא׃
translation: After all this the LORD struck him in his bowels with an incurable disease. (2 Chronicles 21:18)

text: כִּֽי חַיִּים הֵם לְמֹצְאֵיהֶם וּֽלְכָל בְּשָׂרוֹ מַרְפֵּֽא׃
translation: For they are life to those who find them, and health to their whole body. (Proverbs 4:22)

text: יֵשׁ בּוֹטֶה כְּמַדְקְרוֹת חָרֶב וּלְשׁוֹן חֲכָמִים מַרְפֵּֽא׃
translation: There is one who speaks rashly like the piercing of a sword, but the tongue of the wise heals. (Proverbs 12:18)

text: הִנְנִי מַעֲלֶה לָּהּ אֲרֻכָה וּמַרְפֵּא וּרְפָאתִים וְגִלֵּיתִי לָהֶם עֲתֶרֶת שָׁלוֹם וֶאֱמֶֽת׃
translation: behold, I will bring it health and healing, and I will cure them; and I will reveal to them abundance of peace and truth. (Jeremiah 33:6)

text: אִם רוּחַ הַמּוֹשֵׁל תַּעֲלֶה עָלֶיךָ מְקוֹמְךָ אַל תַּנַּח כִּי מַרְפֵּא יַנִּיחַ חֲטָאִים גְּדוֹלִֽים׃
translation: If the spirit of the ruler rises up against you, don't leave your place; for gentleness lays great offenses to rest. (Ecclesiastes 10:4)

text: אִם תְּדַבֵּרְנָה שְׂפָתַי עַוְלָה וּלְשׁוֹנִי אִם יֶהְגֶּה רְמִיָּֽה׃
translation: surely my lips will not speak unrighteousness, neither will my tongue utter deceit. (Job 27:4)

text: מַה יִּתֵּן לְךָ וּמַה יֹּסִיף לָךְ לָשׁוֹן רְמִיָּֽה׃
translation: What will be given to you, and what will be done more to you, you deceitful tongue? (Psalms 120:3)

text: יְֽהוָה הַצִּילָה נַפְשִׁי מִשְּׂפַת שֶׁקֶר מִלָּשׁוֹן רְמִיָּֽה׃
translation: Deliver my soul, LORD, from lying lips, from a deceitful tongue. (Psalms 120:2)

text: אָרוּר עֹשֶׂה מְלֶאכֶת יְהוָה רְמִיָּה וְאָרוּר מֹנֵעַ חַרְבּוֹ מִדָּֽם׃
translation: "Cursed is he who does the work of the LORD negligently; and cursed is he who keeps back his sword from blood. (Jeremiah 48:10)

text: וּמִֽיִּשְׂרָאֵל מִבְּנֵי פַרְעֹשׁ רַמְיָה וְיִזִּיָּה וּמַלְכִּיָּה וּמִיָּמִן וְאֶלְעָזָר וּמַלְכִּיָּה וּבְנָיָֽה׃
translation: Of Israel: Of the sons of Parosh: Ramiah, Izziah, Malchijah, Mijamin, Eleazar, Malchijah, and Benaiah. (Ezra 10:25)

text: הַלְאֵל תְּדַבְּרוּ עַוְלָה וְלוֹ תְּֽדַבְּרוּ רְמִיָּֽה׃
translation: Will you speak unrighteously for God, and talk deceitfully for him? (Job 13:7)

text: צִיָּה גַם חֹם יִגְזְלוּ מֵֽימֵי שֶׁלֶג שְׁאוֹל חָטָֽאוּ׃
translation: Drought and heat consume the snow waters, so does Sheol those who have sinned. (Job 24:19)

text: בְּחֶסֶר וּבְכָפָן גַּלְמוּד הַֽעֹרְקִים צִיָּה אֶמֶשׁ שׁוֹאָה וּמְשֹׁאָֽה׃
translation: They are gaunt from lack and famine. They gnaw the dry ground, in the gloom of waste and desolation. (Job 30:3)

text: וַיּוֹסִיפוּ עוֹד לַחֲטֹא לוֹ לַֽמְרוֹת עֶלְיוֹן בַּצִּיָּֽה׃
translation: Yet they still went on to sin against him, to rebel against the Most High in the desert. (Psalms 78:17)

text: פָּתַח צוּר וַיָּזוּבוּ מָיִם הָלְכוּ בַּצִּיּוֹת נָהָֽר׃
translation: He opened the rock, and waters gushed out. They ran as a river in the dry places. (Psalms 105:41)

text: יְשֻׂשׂוּם מִדְבָּר וְצִיָּה וְתָגֵל עֲרָבָה וְתִפְרַח כַּחֲבַצָּֽלֶת׃
translation: The wilderness and the dry land will be glad. The desert will rejoice and blossom like a rose. (Isaiah 35:1)

text: בּוֹשָׁה אִמְּכֶם מְאֹד חָפְרָה יֽוֹלַדְתְּכֶם הִנֵּה אַחֲרִית גּוֹיִם מִדְבָּר צִיָּה וַעֲרָבָֽה׃
translation: your mother will be utterly disappointed. She who bore you will be confounded. Behold, she will be the least of the nations, a wilderness, a dry land, and a desert. (Jeremiah 50:12)

text: אֶת הַיָּרֵחַ וְכוֹכָבִים לְמֶמְשְׁלוֹת בַּלָּיְלָה כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
translation: the moon and stars to rule by night, for his loving kindness endures forever; (Psalms 136:9)

text: מַֽלְכוּתְךָ מַלְכוּת כָּל עֹֽלָמִים וּמֶֽמְשֶׁלְתְּךָ בְּכָל דּוֹר וָדֽוֹר׃
translation: Your kingdom is an everlasting kingdom. Your dominion endures throughout all generations. The LORD is faithful in all his words, and loving in all his deeds. (Psalms 145:13)

text: אֶת הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ לְמֶמְשֶׁלֶת בַּיּוֹם כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
translation: the sun to rule by day, for his loving kindness endures forever; (Psalms 136:8)

text: בָּרֲכוּ יְהוָה כָּֽל מַעֲשָׂיו בְּכָל מְקֹמוֹת מֶמְשַׁלְתּוֹ בָּרֲכִי נַפְשִׁי אֶת יְהוָֽה׃
translation: Praise the LORD, all you works of his, in all places of his dominion. Praise the LORD, my soul! (Psalms 103:22)

text: הָיְתָה יְהוּדָה לְקָדְשׁוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל מַמְשְׁלוֹתָֽיו׃
translation: Judah became his sanctuary, Israel his dominion. (Psalms 114:2)

text: וְיֶחֱזַק מֶֽלֶךְ הַנֶּגֶב וּמִן שָׂרָיו וְיֶחֱזַק עָלָיו וּמָשָׁל מִמְשָׁל רַב מֶמְשַׁלְתּֽוֹ׃
translation: "The king of the south will be strong. One of his princes will become stronger than him, and have dominion. His dominion will be a great dominion. (Daniel 11:5)

text: כִּי פַחַד אֵלַי אֵיד אֵל וּמִשְּׂאֵתוֹ לֹא אוּכָֽל׃
translation: For calamity from God is a terror to me. Because of his majesty, I can do nothing. (Job 31:23)

text: הֲלֹא שְׂאֵתוֹ תְּבַעֵת אֶתְכֶם וּפַחְדּוֹ יִפֹּל עֲלֵיכֶֽם׃
translation: Won't his majesty make you afraid and his dread fall on you? (Job 13:11)

text: אָיֹם וְנוֹרָא הוּא מִמֶּנּוּ מִשְׁפָּטוֹ וּשְׂאֵתוֹ יֵצֵֽא׃
translation: They are feared and dreaded. Their judgment and their dignity proceed from themselves. (Habakkuk 1:7)

text: רְאוּבֵן בְּכֹרִי אַתָּה כֹּחִי וְרֵאשִׁית אוֹנִי יֶתֶר שְׂאֵת וְיֶתֶר עָֽז׃
translation: "Reuben, you are my firstborn, my might, and the beginning of my strength, excelling in dignity, and excelling in power. (Genesis 49:3)

text: מִשֵּׂתוֹ יָגוּרוּ אֵלִים מִשְּׁבָרִים יִתְחַטָּֽאוּ׃
translation: They are joined to one another. They stick together, so that they can't be pulled apart. (Job 41:17)

text: אַךְ מִשְּׂאֵתוֹ יָעֲצוּ לְהַדִּיחַ יִרְצוּ כָזָב בְּפִיו יְבָרֵכוּ וּבְקִרְבָּם יְקַלְלוּ סֶֽלָה׃
translation: My soul, wait in silence for God alone, for my expectation is from him. (Psalms 62:5)

text: וְאִיּוֹב הֶבֶל יִפְצֶה פִּיהוּ בִּבְלִי דַעַת מִלִּין יַכְבִּֽר׃
translation: therefore Job opens his mouth with empty talk, and he multiplies words without knowledge." (Job 35:16)

text: אֲשֶׁר פָּצוּ שְׂפָתָי וְדִבֶּר פִּי בַּצַּר לִֽי׃
translation: which my lips promised, and my mouth spoke, when I was in distress. (Psalms 66:14)

text: הַנּוֹתֵן תְּשׁוּעָה לַמְּלָכִים הַפּוֹצֶה אֶת דָּוִד עַבְדּוֹ מֵחֶרֶב רָעָֽה׃
translation: You are he who gives salvation to kings, who rescues David, his servant, from the deadly sword. (Psalms 144:10)

text: פָּצוּ עָלַי פִּיהֶם אַרְיֵה טֹרֵף וְשֹׁאֵֽג׃
translation: I am poured out like water. All my bones are out of joint. My heart is like wax. It is melted within me. (Psalms 22:14)

text: שְׁלַח יָדֶיךָ מִמָּרוֹם פְּצֵנִי וְהַצִּילֵנִי מִמַּיִם רַבִּים מִיַּד בְּנֵי נֵכָֽר׃
translation: Stretch out your hand from above, rescue me, and deliver me out of great waters, out of the hands of foreigners, (Psalms 144:7)

text: פָּצוּ עָלֵינוּ פִּיהֶם כָּל אֹיְבֵֽינוּ׃
translation: "All our enemies have opened their mouth wide against us. (Lamentations 3:46)

text: יְהוָה מָֽה רַבּוּ צָרָי רַבִּים קָמִים עָלָֽי׃
translation: Many there are who say of my soul, "There is no help for him in God." Selah. (Psalms 3:2)

text: נָתַתָּה שִׂמְחָה בְלִבִּי מֵעֵת דְּגָנָם וְתִֽירוֹשָׁם רָֽבּוּ׃
translation: In peace I will both lay myself down and sleep, for you alone, LORD, make me live in safety. (Psalms 4:8)

text: רְאֵֽה אוֹיְבַי כִּי רָבּוּ וְשִׂנְאַת חָמָס שְׂנֵאֽוּנִי׃
translation: Consider my enemies, for they are many. They hate me with cruel hatred. (Psalms 25:19)

text: אִם חָטָאתָ מַה תִּפְעָל בּוֹ וְרַבּוּ פְשָׁעֶיךָ מַה תַּעֲשֶׂה לּֽוֹ׃
translation: If you have sinned, what effect do you have against him? If your transgressions are multiplied, what do you do to him? (Job 35:6)

text: וְֽאֹיְבַי חַיִּים עָצֵמוּ וְרַבּוּ שֹׂנְאַי שָֽׁקֶר׃
translation: They who give evil for good are also adversaries to me, because I follow what is good. (Psalms 38:20)

text: וַֽיְהִי כִּֽי הֵחֵל הָֽאָדָם לָרֹב עַל פְּנֵי הָֽאֲדָמָה וּבָנוֹת יֻלְּדוּ לָהֶֽם׃
translation: When men began to multiply on the surface of the ground, and daughters were born to them, (Genesis 6:1)

text: וּבֶן הֵלֶם אָחִיו צוֹפַח וְיִמְנָע וְשֵׁלֶשׁ וְעָמָֽל׃
translation: The sons of Helem his brother: Zophah, Imna, Shelesh, and Amal. (1 Chronicles 7:35)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו קְחָה לִי עֶגְלָה מְשֻׁלֶּשֶׁת וְעֵז מְשֻׁלֶּשֶׁת וְאַיִל מְשֻׁלָּשׁ וְתֹר וְגוֹזָֽל׃
translation: He said to him, "Bring me a heifer three years old, a female goat three years old, a ram three years old, a turtledove, and a young pigeon." (Genesis 15:9)

text: וַיַּרְא יוֹסֵף לְאֶפְרַיִם בְּנֵי שִׁלֵּשִׁים גַּם בְּנֵי מָכִיר בֶּן מְנַשֶּׁה יֻלְּדוּ עַל בִּרְכֵּי יוֹסֵֽף׃
translation: Joseph saw Ephraim's children to the third generation. The children also of Machir, the son of Manasseh, were born on Joseph's knees. (Genesis 50:23)

text: וְשִׁלַּשְׁתָּ תֵּרֵד מְאֹד וּבָאתָ אֶל הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר נִסְתַּרְתָּ שָּׁם בְּיוֹם הַֽמַּעֲשֶׂה וְיָשַׁבְתָּ אֵצֶל הָאֶבֶן הָאָֽזֶל׃
translation: When you have stayed three days, go down quickly and come to the place where you hid yourself when this started, and remain by the stone Ezel. (1 Samuel 20:19)

text: תָּכִין לְךָ הַדֶּרֶךְ וְשִׁלַּשְׁתָּ אֶת גְּבוּל אַרְצְךָ אֲשֶׁר יַנְחִֽילְךָ יְהוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ וְהָיָה לָנוּס שָׁמָּה כָּל רֹצֵֽחַ׃
translation: You shall prepare the way, and divide the borders of your land which the LORD your God causes you to inherit into three parts, that every man slayer may flee there. (Deuteronomy 19:3)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר מִלְאוּ אַרְבָּעָה כַדִּים מַיִם וְיִֽצְקוּ עַל הָעֹלָה וְעַל הָעֵצִים וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁנוּ וַיִּשְׁנוּ וַיֹּאמֶר שַׁלֵּשׁוּ וַיְשַׁלֵּֽשׁוּ׃
translation: He said, "Do it a second time;" and they did it the second time. He said, "Do it a third time;" and they did it the third time. (1 Kings 18:34)

text: תְּשִׁיתֵמוֹ כְּתַנּוּר אֵשׁ לְעֵת פָּנֶיךָ יְהוָה בְּאַפּוֹ יְבַלְּעֵם וְֽתֹאכְלֵם אֵֽשׁ׃
translation: You will destroy their descendants from the earth, their posterity from among the children of men. (Psalms 21:10)

text: עוֹרֵנוּ כְּתַנּוּר נִכְמָרוּ מִפְּנֵי זַלְעֲפוֹת רָעָֽב׃
translation: Our skin is black like an oven, because of the burning heat of famine. (Lamentations 5:10)

text: מִדָּה שֵׁנִית הֶחֱזִיק מַלְכִּיָּה בֶן חָרִם וְחַשּׁוּב בֶּן פַּחַת מוֹאָב וְאֵת מִגְדַּל הַתַּנּוּרִֽים׃
translation: Malchijah the son of Harim and Hasshub the son of Pahathmoab repaired another portion and the tower of the furnaces. (Nehemiah 3:11)

text: וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר יִפֹּל מִנִּבְלָתָם עָלָיו יִטְמָא תַּנּוּר וְכִירַיִם יֻתָּץ טְמֵאִים הֵם וּטְמֵאִים יִהְיוּ לָכֶֽם׃
translation: Everything whereupon part of their carcass falls shall be unclean; whether oven, or range for pots, it shall be broken in pieces. They are unclean, and shall be unclean to you. (Leviticus 11:35)

text: כִּֽי קֵרְבוּ כַתַּנּוּר לִבָּם בְּאָרְבָּם כָּל הַלַּיְלָה יָשֵׁן אֹֽפֵהֶם בֹּקֶר הוּא בֹעֵר כְּאֵשׁ לֶהָבָֽה׃
translation: For they have prepared their heart like an oven, while they lie in wait. Their anger smolders all night. In the morning it burns as a flaming fire. (Hosea 7:6)
