text: וְכָל מִנְחָה אֲשֶׁר תֵּֽאָפֶה בַּתַּנּוּר וְכָל נַעֲשָׂה בַמַּרְחֶשֶׁת וְעַֽל מַחֲבַת לַכֹּהֵן הַמַּקְרִיב אֹתָהּ לוֹ תִֽהְיֶֽה׃
translation: Every meal offering that is baked in the oven, and all that is prepared in the pan and on the griddle, shall be the priest's who offers it. (Leviticus 7:9)

text: וַתֹּאמֶר שָׂרָה צְחֹק עָשָׂה לִי אֱלֹהִים כָּל הַשֹּׁמֵעַ יִֽצְחַק לִֽי׃
translation: Sarah said, "God has made me laugh. Everyone who hears will laugh with me." (Genesis 21:6)

text: וַתֵּרֶא שָׂרָה אֶֽת בֶּן הָגָר הַמִּצְרִית אֲשֶׁר יָלְדָה לְאַבְרָהָם מְצַחֵֽק׃
translation: Sarah saw the son of Hagar the Egyptian, whom she had borne to Abraham, mocking. (Genesis 21:9)

text: וַתִּצְחַק שָׂרָה בְּקִרְבָּהּ לֵאמֹר אַחֲרֵי בְלֹתִי הָֽיְתָה לִּי עֶדְנָה וַֽאדֹנִי זָקֵֽן׃
translation: Sarah laughed within herself, saying, "After I have grown old will I have pleasure, my lord being old also?" (Genesis 18:12)

text: וַתְּכַחֵשׁ שָׂרָה לֵאמֹר לֹא צָחַקְתִּי כִּי יָרֵאָה וַיֹּאמֶר לֹא כִּי צָחָֽקְתְּ׃
translation: Then Sarah denied it, saying, "I didn't laugh," for she was afraid. He said, "No, but you did laugh." (Genesis 18:15)

text: וַיַּשְׁכִּימוּ מִֽמָּחֳרָת וַיַּעֲלוּ עֹלֹת וַיַּגִּשׁוּ שְׁלָמִים וַיֵּשֶׁב הָעָם לֶֽאֱכֹל וְשָׁתוֹ וַיָּקֻמוּ לְצַחֵֽק׃
translation: They rose up early on the next day, and offered burnt offerings, and brought peace offerings; and the people sat down to eat and to drink, and rose up to play. (Exodus 32:6)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֶל אַבְרָהָם לָמָּה זֶּה צָחֲקָה שָׂרָה לֵאמֹר הַאַף אֻמְנָם אֵלֵד וַאֲנִי זָקַֽנְתִּי׃
translation: The LORD said to Abraham, "Why did Sarah laugh, saying, 'Will I really bear a child when I am old?' (Genesis 18:13)

text: וְעֹרֹת אֵילִם מְאָדָּמִים וְעֹרֹת תְּחָשִׁים וַעֲצֵי שִׁטִּֽים׃
translation: rams' skins dyed red, sea cow hides, acacia wood, (Exodus 25:5)

text: וְעֹרֹת אֵילִם מְאָדָּמִים וְעֹרֹת תְּחָשִׁים וַעֲצֵי שִׂטִּֽים׃
translation: rams' skins dyed red, sea cow hides, acacia wood, (Exodus 35:7)

text: וְעָשִׂיתָ מִכְסֶה לָאֹהֶל עֹרֹת אֵילִם מְאָדָּמִים וּמִכְסֵה עֹרֹת תְּחָשִׁים מִלְמָֽעְלָה׃
translation: You shall make a covering for the tent of rams' skins dyed red, and a covering of sea cow hides above. (Exodus 26:14)

text: וַיַּעַשׂ מִכְסֶה לָאֹהֶל עֹרֹת אֵלִים מְאָדָּמִים וּמִכְסֵה עֹרֹת תְּחָשִׁים מִלְמָֽעְלָה׃
translation: He made a covering for the tent of rams' skins dyed red, and a covering of sea cow hides above. (Exodus 36:19)

text: וְאֶת מִכְסֵה עוֹרֹת הָֽאֵילִם הַמְאָדָּמִים וְאֶת מִכְסֵה עֹרֹת הַתְּחָשִׁים וְאֵת פָּרֹכֶת הַמָּסָֽךְ׃
translation: the covering of rams' skins dyed red, the covering of sea cow hides, the veil of the screen, (Exodus 39:34)

text: וְנָתְנוּ אֹתָהּ וְאֶת כָּל כֵּלֶיהָ אֶל מִכְסֵה עוֹר תָּחַשׁ וְנָתְנוּ עַל הַמּֽוֹט׃
translation: They shall put it and all its vessels within a covering of sealskin, and shall put it on the frame. (Numbers 4:10)

text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ שָׁלוֹם לְעַבְדְּךָ לְאָבִינוּ עוֹדֶנּוּ חָי וַֽיִּקְּדוּ וישתחו וַיִּֽשְׁתַּחֲוּֽוּ׃
translation: They said, "Your servant, our father, is well. He is still alive." They bowed down humbly. (Genesis 43:28)

text: וַיְמַהֵר מֹשֶׁה וַיִּקֹּד אַרְצָה וַיִּשְׁתָּֽחוּ׃
translation: Moses hurried and bowed his head toward the earth, and worshiped. (Exodus 34:8)

text: וַיִּקֹּד הָאִישׁ וַיִּשְׁתַּחוּ לַֽיהוָֽה׃
translation: The man bowed his head, and worshiped the LORD. (Genesis 24:26)

text: וַיִּקֹּד יְהוֹשָׁפָט אַפַּיִם אָרְצָה וְכָל יְהוּדָה וְיֹשְׁבֵי יְרוּשָׁלִַם נָֽפְלוּ לִפְנֵי יְהוָה לְהִֽשְׁתַּחֲוֺת לַיהוָֽה׃
translation: Jehoshaphat bowed his head with his face to the ground; and all Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem fell down before the LORD, worshiping the LORD. (2 Chronicles 20:18)

text: וַֽיַּאֲמֵן הָעָם וַֽיִּשְׁמְעוּ כִּֽי פָקַד יְהוָה אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְכִי רָאָה אֶת עָנְיָם וַֽיִּקְּדוּ וַיִּֽשְׁתַּחֲוּֽוּ׃
translation: The people believed, and when they heard that the LORD had visited the children of Israel, and that he had seen their affliction, then they bowed their heads and worshiped. (Exodus 4:31)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְחִזְקִיָּהוּ הַמֶּלֶךְ וְהַשָּׂרִים לַלְוִיִּם לְהַלֵּל לַֽיהוָה בְּדִבְרֵי דָוִיד וְאָסָף הַחֹזֶה וַֽיְהַלְלוּ עַד לְשִׂמְחָה וַֽיִּקְּדוּ וַיִּֽשְׁתַּחֲוֽוּ׃
translation: Moreover Hezekiah the king and the princes commanded the Levites to sing praises to the LORD with the words of David, and of Asaph the seer. They sang praises with gladness, and they bowed their heads and worshiped. (2 Chronicles 29:30)

text: דְּֽעוּ אֵפוֹ כִּי אֱלוֹהַּ עִוְּתָנִי וּמְצוּדוֹ עָלַי הִקִּֽיף׃
translation: know now that God has subverted me, and has surrounded me with his net. (Job 19:6)

text: וְאִם לֹא אֵפוֹ מִי יַכְזִיבֵנִי וְיָשֵׂם לְאַל מִלָּתִֽי׃
translation: If it isn't so now, who will prove me a liar, and make my speech worth nothing?" (Job 24:25)

text: מִֽי יִתֵּן אֵפוֹ וְיִכָּתְבוּן מִלָּי מִֽי יִתֵּן בַּסֵּפֶר וְיֻחָֽקוּ׃
translation: "Oh that my words were now written! Oh that they were inscribed in a book! (Job 19:23)

text: וְאַיֵּה אֵפוֹ תִקְוָתִי וְתִקְוָתִי מִי יְשׁוּרֶֽנָּה׃
translation: where then is my hope? As for my hope, who will see it? (Job 17:15)

text: מַשָּׂא גֵּיא חִזָּיוֹן מַה לָּךְ אֵפוֹא כִּֽי עָלִית כֻּלָּךְ לַגַּגּֽוֹת׃
translation: The burden of the valley of vision. What ails you now, that you have all gone up to the housetops? (Isaiah 22:1)

text: אֶרֶץ נִתְּנָה בְֽיַד רָשָׁע פְּנֵֽי שֹׁפְטֶיהָ יְכַסֶּה אִם לֹא אֵפוֹא מִי הֽוּא׃
translation: The earth is given into the hand of the wicked. He covers the faces of its judges. If not he, then who is it? (Job 9:24)

text: מְעַט שֵׁנוֹת מְעַט תְּנוּמוֹת מְעַט חִבֻּק יָדַיִם לִשְׁכָּֽב׃
translation: A little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to sleep— (Proverbs 6:10)

text: מְעַט שֵׁנוֹת מְעַט תְּנוּמוֹת מְעַט חִבֻּק יָדַיִם לִשְׁכָּֽב׃
translation: a little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to sleep, (Proverbs 24:33)

text: וַיָּרָץ עֵשָׂו לִקְרָאתוֹ וַֽיְחַבְּקֵהוּ וַיִּפֹּל עַל צַוָּארָו וַׄיִּׄשָּׁׄקֵׄהׄוּׄ וַיִּבְכּֽוּ׃
translation: Esau ran to meet him, embraced him, fell on his neck, kissed him, and they wept. (Genesis 33:4)

text: וְלָמָּה תִשְׁגֶּה בְנִי בְזָרָה וּתְחַבֵּק חֵק נָכְרִיָּֽה׃
translation: For why should you, my son, be captivated with an adulteress? Why embrace the bosom of another? (Proverbs 5:20)

text: הַכְּסִיל חֹבֵק אֶת יָדָיו וְאֹכֵל אֶת בְּשָׂרֽוֹ׃
translation: The fool folds his hands together and ruins himself. (Ecclesiastes 4:5)

text: שְׂמֹאלוֹ תַּחַת לְרֹאשִׁי וִימִינוֹ תְּחַבְּקֵֽנִי׃
translation: His left hand is under my head. His right hand embraces me. (Song of Solomon 2:6)

text: וַיָּבֹאוּ הַמַּלְאָכִים וְהִנֵּה הַתְּרָפִים אֶל הַמִּטָּה וּכְבִיר הָעִזִּים מְרַאֲשֹׁתָֽיו׃
translation: When the messengers came in, behold, the teraphim was in the bed, with the pillow of goats' hair at its head. (1 Samuel 19:16)

text: וְלָבָן הָלַךְ לִגְזֹז אֶת צֹאנוֹ וַתִּגְנֹב רָחֵל אֶת הַתְּרָפִים אֲשֶׁר לְאָבִֽיהָ׃
translation: Now Laban had gone to shear his sheep; and Rachel stole the teraphim that were her father's. (Genesis 31:19)

text: וַיִּיטַב לֵב הַכֹּהֵן וַיִּקַּח אֶת הָאֵפוֹד וְאֶת הַתְּרָפִים וְאֶת הַפָּסֶל וַיָּבֹא בְּקֶרֶב הָעָֽם׃
translation: The priest's heart was glad, and he took the ephod, the teraphim, and the engraved image, and went with the people. (Judges 18:20)

text: וַתִּקַּח מִיכַל אֶת הַתְּרָפִים וַתָּשֶׂם אֶל הַמִּטָּה וְאֵת כְּבִיר הָֽעִזִּים שָׂמָה מְרַֽאֲשֹׁתָיו וַתְּכַס בַּבָּֽגֶד׃
translation: Michal took the teraphim and laid it in the bed, and put a pillow of goats' hair at its head and covered it with clothes. (1 Samuel 19:13)

text: וְהָאִישׁ מִיכָה לוֹ בֵּית אֱלֹהִים וַיַּעַשׂ אֵפוֹד וּתְרָפִים וַיְמַלֵּא אֶת יַד אַחַד מִבָּנָיו וַיְהִי לוֹ לְכֹהֵֽן׃
translation: The man Micah had a house of gods, and he made an ephod, and teraphim, and consecrated one of his sons, who became his priest. (Judges 17:5)

text: כִּי יָמִים רַבִּים יֵֽשְׁבוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֵין מֶלֶךְ וְאֵין שָׂר וְאֵין זֶבַח וְאֵין מַצֵּבָה וְאֵין אֵפוֹד וּתְרָפִֽים׃
translation: For the children of Israel shall live many days without king, without prince, without sacrifice, without sacred stone, and without ephod or idols. (Hosea 3:4)

text: וּמִֽמַּחֲצִית בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר חָצָה מֹשֶׁה מִן הָאֲנָשִׁים הַצֹּבְאִֽים׃
translation: Of the children of Israel's half, which Moses divided off from the men who fought (Numbers 31:42)

text: וְרוּחוֹ כְּנַחַל שׁוֹטֵף עַד צַוָּאר יֶֽחֱצֶה לַהֲנָפָה גוֹיִם בְּנָפַת שָׁוְא וְרֶסֶן מַתְעֶה עַל לְחָיֵי עַמִּֽים׃
translation: His breath is as an overflowing stream that reaches even to the neck, to sift the nations with the sieve of destruction. A bridle that leads to ruin will be in the jaws of the peoples. (Isaiah 30:28)

text: וַיַּחַץ אֶת שְׁלֹשׁ מֵאוֹת הָאִישׁ שְׁלֹשָׁה רָאשִׁים וַיִּתֵּן שׁוֹפָרוֹת בְּיַד כֻּלָּם וְכַדִּים רֵקִים וְלַפִּדִים בְּתוֹךְ הַכַּדִּֽים׃
translation: He divided the three hundred men into three companies, and he put into the hands of all of them trumpets and empty pitchers, with torches within the pitchers. (Judges 7:16)

text: וַיִּירָא יַעֲקֹב מְאֹד וַיֵּצֶר לוֹ וַיַּחַץ אֶת הָעָם אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ וְאֶת הַצֹּאן וְאֶת הַבָּקָר וְהַגְּמַלִּים לִשְׁנֵי מַחֲנֽוֹת׃
translation: He said, "If Esau comes to the one company, and strikes it, then the company which is left will escape." (Genesis 32:8)

text: וַיִּקַּח אֶת הָעָם וַֽיֶּחֱצֵם לִשְׁלֹשָׁה רָאשִׁים וַיֶּאֱרֹב בַּשָּׂדֶה וַיַּרְא וְהִנֵּה הָעָם יֹצֵא מִן הָעִיר וַיָּקָם עֲלֵיהֶם וַיַּכֵּֽם׃
translation: He took the people and divided them into three companies, and laid wait in the field; and he looked, and behold, the people came out of the city. So, he rose up against them and struck them. (Judges 9:43)

text: וְכִֽי יִגֹּף שֽׁוֹר אִישׁ אֶת שׁוֹר רֵעֵהוּ וָמֵת וּמָכְרוּ אֶת הַשּׁוֹר הַחַי וְחָצוּ אֶת כַּסְפּוֹ וְגַם אֶת הַמֵּת יֶֽחֱצֽוּן׃
translation: "If one man's bull injures another's, so that it dies, then they shall sell the live bull, and divide its price; and they shall also divide the dead animal. (Exodus 21:35)

text: וּבְנֵי כַּרְמִי עָכָר עוֹכֵר יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר מָעַל בַּחֵֽרֶם׃
translation: The son of Carmi: Achar, the troubler of Israel, who committed a trespass in the devoted thing. (1 Chronicles 2:7)

text: עוֹכֵר בֵּיתוֹ יִנְחַל רוּחַ וְעֶבֶד אֱוִיל לַחֲכַם לֵֽב׃
translation: He who troubles his own house shall inherit the wind. The foolish shall be servant to the wise of heart. (Proverbs 11:29)

text: בֵּית צַדִּיק חֹסֶן רָב וּבִתְבוּאַת רָשָׁע נֶעְכָּֽרֶת׃
translation: In the house of the righteous is much treasure, but the income of the wicked brings trouble. (Proverbs 15:6)

text: עֹכֵר בֵּיתוֹ בּוֹצֵעַ בָּצַע וְשׂוֹנֵא מַתָּנֹת יִחְיֶֽה׃
translation: He who is greedy for gain troubles his own house, but he who hates bribes will live. (Proverbs 15:27)

text: נֶאֱלַמְתִּי דוּמִיָּה הֶחֱשֵׁיתִי מִטּוֹב וּכְאֵבִי נֶעְכָּֽר׃
translation: My heart was hot within me. While I meditated, the fire burned. I spoke with my tongue: (Psalms 39:3)

text: וַיְהִי כִּרְאוֹת אַחְאָב אֶת אֵלִיָּהוּ וַיֹּאמֶר אַחְאָב אֵלָיו הַאַתָּה זֶה עֹכֵר יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
translation: When Ahab saw Elijah, Ahab said to him, "Is that you, you troubler of Israel?" (1 Kings 18:17)

text: וַיַּעַן יוֹסֵף וַיֹּאמֶר זֶה פִּתְרֹנוֹ שְׁלֹשֶׁת הַסַּלִּים שְׁלֹשֶׁת יָמִים הֵֽם׃
translation: Joseph answered, "This is its interpretation. The three baskets are three days. (Genesis 40:18)

text: וְנָתַתָּ אוֹתָם עַל סַל אֶחָד וְהִקְרַבְתָּ אֹתָם בַּסָּל וְאֶת הַפָּר וְאֵת שְׁנֵי הָאֵילִֽם׃
translation: You shall put them into one basket, and bring them in the basket, with the bull and the two rams. (Exodus 29:3)

text: וְאָכַל אַהֲרֹן וּבָנָיו אֶת בְּשַׂר הָאַיִל וְאֶת הַלֶּחֶם אֲשֶׁר בַּסָּל פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃
translation: Aaron and his sons shall eat the meat of the ram, and the bread that is in the basket, at the door of the Tent of Meeting. (Exodus 29:32)

text: וּבַסַּל הָֽעֶלְיוֹן מִכֹּל מַאֲכַל פַּרְעֹה מַעֲשֵׂה אֹפֶה וְהָעוֹף אֹכֵל אֹתָם מִן הַסַּל מֵעַל רֹאשִֽׁי׃
translation: In the uppermost basket there were all kinds of baked food for Pharaoh, and the birds ate them out of the basket on my head." (Genesis 40:17)

text: וְאֶת הָאַיִל יַעֲשֶׂה זֶבַח שְׁלָמִים לַֽיהוָה עַל סַל הַמַּצּוֹת וְעָשָׂה הַכֹּהֵן אֶת מִנְחָתוֹ וְאֶת נִסְכּֽוֹ׃
translation: He shall offer the ram for a sacrifice of peace offerings to the LORD, with the basket of unleavened bread. The priest shall offer also its meal offering and its drink offering. (Numbers 6:17)

text: קַח אֶֽת אַהֲרֹן וְאֶת בָּנָיו אִתּוֹ וְאֵת הַבְּגָדִים וְאֵת שֶׁמֶן הַמִּשְׁחָה וְאֵת פַּר הַֽחַטָּאת וְאֵת שְׁנֵי הָֽאֵילִים וְאֵת סַל הַמַּצּֽוֹת׃
translation: "Take Aaron and his sons with him, and the garments, and the anointing oil, and the bull of the sin offering, and the two rams, and the basket of unleavened bread; (Leviticus 8:2)

text: וְהִנֵּה שֶׁבַע שִׁבֳּלִים דַּקּוֹת וּשְׁדוּפֹת קָדִים צֹמְחוֹת אַחֲרֵיהֶֽן׃
translation: Behold, seven heads of grain, thin and blasted with the east wind, sprung up after them. (Genesis 41:6)

text: וְהִנֵּה שֶׁבַע שִׁבֳּלִים צְנֻמוֹת דַּקּוֹת שְׁדֻפוֹת קָדִים צֹמְחוֹת אַחֲרֵיהֶֽם׃
translation: and behold, seven heads of grain, withered, thin, and blasted with the east wind, sprung up after them. (Genesis 41:23)

text: וְאַחַר הָרַעַשׁ אֵשׁ לֹא בָאֵשׁ יְהוָה וְאַחַר הָאֵשׁ קוֹל דְּמָמָה דַקָּֽה׃
translation: After the earthquake a fire passed; but the LORD was not in the fire. After the fire, there was a still small voice. (1 Kings 19:12)

text: וְהִנֵּה שֶׁבַע פָּרוֹת אֲחֵרוֹת עֹלוֹת אַחֲרֵיהֶן מִן הַיְאֹר רָעוֹת מַרְאֶה וְדַקּוֹת בָּשָׂר וַֽתַּעֲמֹדְנָה אֵצֶל הַפָּרוֹת עַל שְׂפַת הַיְאֹֽר׃
translation: Behold, seven other cattle came up after them out of the river, ugly and thin, and stood by the other cattle on the brink of the river. (Genesis 41:3)

text: וַֽיְמַהֲרוּ וַיּוֹרִדוּ אִישׁ אֶת אַמְתַּחְתּוֹ אָרְצָה וַֽיִּפְתְּחוּ אִישׁ אַמְתַּחְתּֽוֹ׃
translation: Then they hurried, and each man took his sack down to the ground, and each man opened his sack. (Genesis 44:11)

text: וְכֶסֶף אַחֵר הוֹרַדְנוּ בְיָדֵנוּ לִשְׁבָּר אֹכֶל לֹא יָדַעְנוּ מִי שָׂם כַּסְפֵּנוּ בְּאַמְתְּחֹתֵֽינוּ׃
translation: We have brought down other money in our hand to buy food. We don't know who put our money in our sacks." (Genesis 43:22)

text: וְכֶסֶף מִשְׁנֶה קְחוּ בְיֶדְכֶם וְאֶת הַכֶּסֶף הַמּוּשָׁב בְּפִי אַמְתְּחֹֽתֵיכֶם תָּשִׁיבוּ בְיֶדְכֶם אוּלַי מִשְׁגֶּה הֽוּא׃
translation: and take double money in your hand, and take back the money that was returned in the mouth of your sacks. Perhaps it was an oversight. (Genesis 43:12)

text: הֵן כֶּסֶף אֲשֶׁר מָצָאנוּ בְּפִי אַמְתְּחֹתֵינוּ הֱשִׁיבֹנוּ אֵלֶיךָ מֵאֶרֶץ כְּנָעַן וְאֵיךְ נִגְנֹב מִבֵּית אֲדֹנֶיךָ כֶּסֶף אוֹ זָהָֽב׃
translation: Behold, the money, which we found in our sacks' mouths, we brought again to you out of the land of Canaan. How then should we steal silver or gold out of your lord's house? (Genesis 44:8)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁלוֹם לָכֶם אַל תִּירָאוּ אֱלֹהֵיכֶם וֵֽאלֹהֵי אֲבִיכֶם נָתַן לָכֶם מַטְמוֹן בְּאַמְתְּחֹתֵיכֶם כַּסְפְּכֶם בָּא אֵלָי וַיּוֹצֵא אֲלֵהֶם אֶת שִׁמְעֽוֹן׃
translation: He said, "Peace be to you. Don't be afraid. Your God, and the God of your father, has given you treasure in your sacks. I received your money." He brought Simeon out to them. (Genesis 43:23)

text: וַיְצַו אֶת אֲשֶׁר עַל בֵּיתוֹ לֵאמֹר מַלֵּא אֶת אַמְתְּחֹת הָֽאֲנָשִׁים אֹכֶל כַּאֲשֶׁר יוּכְלוּן שְׂאֵת וְשִׂים כֶּֽסֶף אִישׁ בְּפִי אַמְתַּחְתּֽוֹ׃
translation: He commanded the steward of his house, saying, "Fill the men's sacks with food, as much as they can carry, and put each man's money in his sack's mouth. (Genesis 44:1)

text: טוֹב מַרְאֵה עֵינַיִם מֵֽהֲלָךְ נָפֶשׁ גַּם זֶה הֶבֶל וּרְעוּת רֽוּחַ׃
translation: Better is the sight of the eyes than the wandering of the desire. This also is vanity and a chasing after wind. (Ecclesiastes 6:9)

text: רָאִיתִי אֶת כָּל הַֽמַּעֲשִׂים שֶֽׁנַּעֲשׂוּ תַּחַת הַשָּׁמֶשׁ וְהִנֵּה הַכֹּל הֶבֶל וּרְעוּת רֽוּחַ׃
translation: I have seen all the works that are done under the sun; and behold, all is vanity and a chasing after wind. (Ecclesiastes 1:14)

text: שָׁמָּה קִנְּנָה קִפּוֹז וַתְּמַלֵּט וּבָקְעָה וְדָגְרָה בְצִלָּהּ אַךְ שָׁם נִקְבְּצוּ דַיּוֹת אִשָּׁה רְעוּתָֽהּ׃
translation: The arrow snake will make her nest there, and lay, hatch, and gather under her shade. Yes, the kites will be gathered there, every one with her mate. (Isaiah 34:15)

text: וָאֹמַר לֹא אֶרְעֶה אֶתְכֶם הַמֵּתָה תָמוּת וְהַנִּכְחֶדֶת תִּכָּחֵד וְהַנִּשְׁאָרוֹת תֹּאכַלְנָה אִשָּׁה אֶת בְּשַׂר רְעוּתָֽהּ׃
translation: Then I said, "I will not feed you. That which dies, let it die; and that which is to be cut off, let it be cut off; and let those who are left eat each other's flesh." (Zechariah 11:9)

text: דַּבֶּר נָא בְּאָזְנֵי הָעָם וְיִשְׁאֲלוּ אִישׁ מֵאֵת רֵעֵהוּ וְאִשָּׁה מֵאֵת רְעוּתָהּ כְּלֵי כֶסֶף וּכְלֵי זָהָֽב׃
translation: Speak now in the ears of the people, and let every man ask of his neighbor, and every woman of her neighbor, jewels of silver, and jewels of gold." (Exodus 11:2)

text: וְשָׂנֵאתִי אֶת הַחַיִּים כִּי רַע עָלַי הַֽמַּעֲשֶׂה שֶׁנַּעֲשָׂה תַּחַת הַשָּׁמֶשׁ כִּֽי הַכֹּל הֶבֶל וּרְעוּת רֽוּחַ׃
translation: So I hated life, because the work that is worked under the sun was grievous to me; for all is vanity and a chasing after wind. (Ecclesiastes 2:17)

text: אָז אָמַר שְׁלֹמֹה יְהוָה אָמַר לִשְׁכֹּן בָּעֲרָפֶֽל׃
translation: Then Solomon said, "The LORD has said that he would dwell in the thick darkness. (1 Kings 8:12)

text: אָז אָמַר שְׁלֹמֹה יְהוָה אָמַר לִשְׁכּוֹן בָּעֲרָפֶֽל׃
translation: Then Solomon said, "The LORD has said that he would dwell in the thick darkness. (2 Chronicles 6:1)

text: וְֽאָמַרְתָּ מַה יָּדַֽע אֵל הַבְעַד עֲרָפֶל יִשְׁפּֽוֹט׃
translation: You say, 'What does God know? Can he judge through the thick darkness? (Job 22:13)

text: וַיַּעֲמֹד הָעָם מֵרָחֹק וּמֹשֶׁה נִגַּשׁ אֶל הָֽעֲרָפֶל אֲשֶׁר שָׁם הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃
translation: The people stayed at a distance, and Moses came near to the thick darkness where God was. (Exodus 20:21)

text: וַיֵּט שָׁמַיִם וַיֵּרַד וַעֲרָפֶל תַּחַת רַגְלָֽיו׃
translation: He bowed the heavens also, and came down. Thick darkness was under his feet. (2 Samuel 22:10)

text: וַיֵּט שָׁמַיִם וַיֵּרַד וַעֲרָפֶל תַּחַת רַגְלָֽיו׃
translation: He rode on a cherub, and flew. Yes, he soared on the wings of the wind. (Psalms 18:10)

text: וּבְנֵי חֶבְרוֹן קֹרַח וְתַפֻּחַ וְרֶקֶם וָשָֽׁמַע׃
translation: The sons of Hebron: Korah, Tappuah, Rekem, and Shema. (1 Chronicles 2:43)

text: וְשֶׁמַע הוֹלִיד אֶת רַחַם אֲבִי יָרְקֳעָם וְרֶקֶם הוֹלִיד אֶת שַׁמָּֽי׃
translation: Shema became the father of Raham, the father of Jorkeam; and Rekem became the father of Shammai. (1 Chronicles 2:44)

text: לֹא נִכְחַד עָצְמִי מִמֶּךָּ אֲשֶׁר עֻשֵּׂיתִי בַסֵּתֶר רֻקַּמְתִּי בְּֽתַחְתִּיּוֹת אָֽרֶץ׃
translation: My frame wasn't hidden from you, when I was made in secret, woven together in the depths of the earth. (Psalms 139:15)

text: וְעָשִׂיתָ מָסָךְ לְפֶתַח הָאֹהֶל תְּכֵלֶת וְאַרְגָּמָן וְתוֹלַעַת שָׁנִי וְשֵׁשׁ מָשְׁזָר מַעֲשֵׂה רֹקֵֽם׃
translation: "You shall make a screen for the door of the Tent, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, the work of the embroiderer. (Exodus 26:36)

text: וַיַּעַשׂ מָסָךְ לְפֶתַח הָאֹהֶל תְּכֵלֶת וְאַרְגָּמָן וְתוֹלַעַת שָׁנִי וְשֵׁשׁ מָשְׁזָר מַעֲשֵׂה רֹקֵֽם׃
translation: He made a screen for the door of the tent, of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen, the work of an embroiderer; (Exodus 36:37)

text: וְאִתּוֹ אָהֳלִיאָב בֶּן אֲחִיסָמָךְ לְמַטֵּה דָן חָרָשׁ וְחֹשֵׁב וְרֹקֵם בַּתְּכֵלֶת וּבָֽאַרְגָּמָן וּבְתוֹלַעַת הַשָּׁנִי וּבַשֵּֽׁשׁ׃
translation: With him was Oholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, an engraver, and a skillful workman, and an embroiderer in blue, in purple, in scarlet, and in fine linen. (Exodus 38:23)

text: וַיַּעַשׂ אֶת מְעִיל הָאֵפֹד מַעֲשֵׂה אֹרֵג כְּלִיל תְּכֵֽלֶת׃
translation: He made the robe of the ephod of woven work, all of blue. (Exodus 39:22)

text: וְכָל מִנְחַת כֹּהֵן כָּלִיל תִּהְיֶה לֹא תֵאָכֵֽל׃
translation: That which is left of it Aaron and his sons shall eat. It shall be eaten without yeast in a holy place. They shall eat it in the court of the Tent of Meeting. (Leviticus 6:16)

text: וְעָשִׂיתָ אֶת מְעִיל הָאֵפוֹד כְּלִיל תְּכֵֽלֶת׃
translation: "You shall make the robe of the ephod all of blue. (Exodus 28:31)

text: וְהַכֹּהֵן הַמָּשִׁיחַ תַּחְתָּיו מִבָּנָיו יַעֲשֶׂה אֹתָהּ חָק עוֹלָם לַיהוָה כָּלִיל תָּקְטָֽר׃
translation: He shall take from there his handful of the fine flour of the meal offering, and of its oil, and all the frankincense which is on the meal offering, and shall burn it on the altar for a pleasant aroma, as its memorial portion, to the LORD. (Leviticus 6:15)

text: יוֹרוּ מִשְׁפָּטֶיךָ לְיַעֲקֹב וְתוֹרָתְךָ לְיִשְׂרָאֵל יָשִׂימוּ קְטוֹרָה בְּאַפֶּךָ וְכָלִיל עַֽל מִזְבְּחֶֽךָ׃
translation: They shall teach Jacob your ordinances, and Israel your law. They shall put incense before you, and whole burnt offering on your altar. (Deuteronomy 33:10)

text: וְנָתְנוּ עָלָיו כְּסוּי עוֹר תַּחַשׁ וּפָרְשׂוּ בֶֽגֶד כְּלִיל תְּכֵלֶת מִלְמָעְלָה וְשָׂמוּ בַּדָּֽיו׃
translation: put a covering of sealskin on it, spread a blue cloth over it, and put in its poles. (Numbers 4:6)

text: וַֽיַּעֲשׂוּ אֶת הַכָּתְנֹת שֵׁשׁ מַעֲשֵׂה אֹרֵג לְאַהֲרֹן וּלְבָנָֽיו׃
translation: They made the tunics of fine linen of woven work for Aaron and for his sons, (Exodus 39:27)

text: יָמַי קַלּוּ מִנִּי אָרֶג וַיִּכְלוּ בְּאֶפֶס תִּקְוָֽה׃
translation: My days are swifter than a weaver's shuttle, and are spent without hope. (Job 7:6)

text: וּבֹשׁוּ עֹבְדֵי פִשְׁתִּים שְׂרִיקוֹת וְאֹרְגִים חוֹרָֽי׃
translation: Moreover those who work in combed flax, and those who weave white cloth, will be confounded. (Isaiah 19:9)

text: וַיִּתֹּץ אֶת בָּתֵּי הַקְּדֵשִׁים אֲשֶׁר בְּבֵית יְהוָה אֲשֶׁר הַנָּשִׁים אֹרְגוֹת שָׁם בָּתִּים לָאֲשֵׁרָֽה׃
translation: He broke down the houses of the male shrine prostitutes that were in the LORD's house, where the women wove hangings for the Asherah. (2 Kings 23:7)

text: וַתִּתְקַע בַּיָּתֵד וַתֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו פְּלִשְׁתִּים עָלֶיךָ שִׁמְשׁוֹן וַיִּיקַץ מִשְּׁנָתוֹ וַיִּסַּע אֶת הַיְתַד הָאֶרֶג וְאֶת הַמַּסָּֽכֶת׃
translation: She fastened it with the pin, and said to him, "The Philistines are on you, Samson!" He awakened out of his sleep, and plucked away the pin of the beam and the fabric. (Judges 16:14)

text: וחץ וְעֵץ חֲנִיתוֹ כִּמְנוֹר אֹֽרְגִים וְלַהֶבֶת חֲנִיתוֹ שֵׁשׁ מֵאוֹת שְׁקָלִים בַּרְזֶל וְנֹשֵׂא הַצִּנָּה הֹלֵךְ לְפָנָֽיו׃
translation: The staff of his spear was like a weaver's beam; and his spear's head weighed six hundred shekels of iron. His shield bearer went before him. (1 Samuel 17:7)

text: וְקַצֹּתָה אֶת כַּפָּהּ לֹא תָחוֹס עֵינֶֽךָ׃
translation: then you shall cut off her hand. Your eye shall have no pity. (Deuteronomy 25:12)

text: וְאֶת דְּדָן וְאֶת תֵּימָא וְאֶת בּוּז וְאֵת כָּל קְצוּצֵי פֵאָֽה׃
translation: Dedan, Tema, Buz, and all who have the corners of their beard cut off; (Jeremiah 25:23)

text: יְהוָה צַדִּיק קִצֵּץ עֲבוֹת רְשָׁעִֽים׃
translation: The LORD is righteous. He has cut apart the cords of the wicked. (Psalms 129:4)

text: וַיָּנָס אֲדֹנִי בֶזֶק וַֽיִּרְדְּפוּ אַחֲרָיו וַיֹּאחֲזוּ אֹתוֹ וַֽיְקַצְּצוּ אֶת בְּהֹנוֹת יָדָיו וְרַגְלָֽיו׃
translation: But Adoni-Bezek fled. They pursued him, caught him, and cut off his thumbs and his big toes. (Judges 1:6)

text: מַשְׁבִּית מִלְחָמוֹת עַד קְצֵה הָאָרֶץ קֶשֶׁת יְשַׁבֵּר וְקִצֵּץ חֲנִית עֲגָלוֹת יִשְׂרֹף בָּאֵֽשׁ׃
translation: "Be still, and know that I am God. I will be exalted among the nations. I will be exalted in the earth." (Psalms 46:10)

text: וְהָיוּ גְמַלֵּיהֶם לָבַז וַהֲמוֹן מִקְנֵיהֶם לְשָׁלָל וְזֵרִתִים לְכָל רוּחַ קְצוּצֵי פֵאָה וּמִכָּל עֲבָרָיו אָבִיא אֶת אֵידָם נְאֻם יְהוָֽה׃
translation: Their camels will be a booty, and the multitude of their livestock a plunder. I will scatter to all winds those who have the corners of their beards cut off; and I will bring their calamity from every side of them," says the LORD. (Jeremiah 49:32)

text: וְאַחֲרֵי טָֽהֳרָתוֹ שִׁבְעַת יָמִים יִסְפְּרוּ לֽוֹ׃
translation: After he is cleansed, they shall reckon to him seven days. (Ezekiel 44:26)

text: זֹאת תּוֹרַת אֲשֶׁר בּוֹ נֶגַע צָרָעַת אֲשֶׁר לֹֽא תַשִּׂיג יָדוֹ בְּטָהֳרָתֽוֹ׃
translation: This is the law for him in whom is the plague of leprosy, who is not able to afford the sacrifice for his cleansing. (Leviticus 14:32)

text: כָּל לְבָבוֹ הֵכִין לִדְרוֹשׁ הָאֱלֹהִים יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתָיו וְלֹא כְּטָהֳרַת הַקֹּֽדֶשׁ׃
translation: who sets his heart to seek God, the LORD, the God of his fathers, even if they aren't clean according to the purification of the sanctuary." (2 Chronicles 30:19)

text: וַֽיִּשְׁמְרוּ מִשְׁמֶרֶת אֱלֹֽהֵיהֶם וּמִשְׁמֶרֶת הַֽטָּהֳרָה וְהַמְשֹׁרְרִים וְהַשֹּׁעֲרִים כְּמִצְוַת דָּוִיד שְׁלֹמֹה בְנֽוֹ׃
translation: They performed the duty of their God and the duty of the purification, and so did the singers and the gatekeepers, according to the commandment of David and of Solomon his son. (Nehemiah 12:45)

text: וְהֵבִיא אֹתָם בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁמִינִי לְטָהֳרָתוֹ אֶל הַכֹּהֵן אֶל פֶּתַח אֹֽהֶל מוֹעֵד לִפְנֵי יְהוָֽה׃
translation: "On the eighth day he shall bring them for his cleansing to the priest, to the door of the Tent of Meeting, before the LORD. (Leviticus 14:23)

text: וְאִם פָּשֹׂה תִפְשֶׂה הַמִּסְפַּחַת בָּעוֹר אַחֲרֵי הֵרָאֹתוֹ אֶל הַכֹּהֵן לְטָהֳרָתוֹ וְנִרְאָה שֵׁנִית אֶל הַכֹּהֵֽן׃
translation: But if the scab spreads on the skin after he has shown himself to the priest for his cleansing, he shall show himself to the priest again. (Leviticus 13:7)

text: וַיָּמִירוּ אֶת כְּבוֹדָם בְּתַבְנִית שׁוֹר אֹכֵל עֵֽשֶׂב׃
translation: Thus they exchanged their glory for an image of a bull that eats grass. (Psalms 106:20)

text: כְּרֻבָּם כֵּן חָֽטְאוּ לִי כְּבוֹדָם בְּקָלוֹן אָמִֽיר׃
translation: As they were multiplied, so they sinned against me. I will change their glory into shame. (Hosea 4:7)

text: עַל כֵּן לֹא נִירָא בְּהָמִיר אָרֶץ וּבְמוֹט הָרִים בְּלֵב יַמִּֽים׃
translation: though its waters roar and are troubled, though the mountains tremble with their swelling. Selah. (Psalms 46:3)

text: נִבְזֶה בְּֽעֵינָיו נִמְאָס וְאֶת יִרְאֵי יְהוָה יְכַבֵּד נִשְׁבַּע לְהָרַע וְלֹא יָמִֽר׃
translation: in whose eyes a vile man is despised, but who honors those who fear the LORD; he who keeps an oath even when it hurts, and doesn't change; (Psalms 15:4)

text: הַהֵימִיר גּוֹי אֱלֹהִים וְהֵמָּה לֹא אֱלֹהִים וְעַמִּי הֵמִיר כְּבוֹדוֹ בְּלוֹא יוֹעִֽיל׃
translation: Has a nation changed its gods, which really are no gods? But my people have changed their glory for that which doesn't profit. (Jeremiah 2:11)

text: וְלֹא יִמְכְּרוּ מִמֶּנּוּ וְלֹא יָמֵר וְלֹא יעבור יַעֲבִיר רֵאשִׁית הָאָרֶץ כִּי קֹדֶשׁ לַיהוָֽה׃
translation: They shall sell none of it, nor exchange it, nor shall the first fruits of the land be alienated, for it is holy to the LORD. (Ezekiel 48:14)

text: וּנְשִׂיא בֵֽית אָב לְמִשְׁפְּחֹת הַקְּהָתִי אֶלִיצָפָן בֶּן עֻזִּיאֵֽל׃
translation: The prince of the fathers' house of the families of the Kohathites shall be Elizaphan the son of Uzziel. (Numbers 3:30)

text: אַל תַּכְרִיתוּ אֶת שֵׁבֶט מִשְׁפְּחֹת הַקְּהָתִי מִתּוֹךְ הַלְוִיִּֽם׃
translation: "Don't cut off the tribe of the families of the Kohathites from among the Levites; (Numbers 4:18)

text: וְנָסְעוּ הַקְּהָתִים נֹשְׂאֵי הַמִּקְדָּשׁ וְהֵקִימוּ אֶת הַמִּשְׁכָּן עַד בֹּאָֽם׃
translation: The Kohathites set forward, bearing the sanctuary. The others set up the tabernacle before they arrived. (Numbers 10:21)

text: וַיִּפְקֹד מֹשֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן וּנְשִׂיאֵי הָעֵדָה אֶת בְּנֵי הַקְּהָתִי לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם וּלְבֵית אֲבֹתָֽם׃
translation: Moses and Aaron and the princes of the congregation counted the sons of the Kohathites by their families, and by their fathers' houses, (Numbers 4:34)

text: וְאֵלֶּה הָעֹמְדִים וּבְנֵיהֶם מִבְּנֵי הַקְּהָתִי הֵימָן הַמְשׁוֹרֵר בֶּן יוֹאֵל בֶּן שְׁמוּאֵֽל׃
translation: The sons of Kohath were Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel. (1 Chronicles 6:18)

text: וַֽיְהִי לִבְנֵי אַהֲרֹן מִמִּשְׁפְּחוֹת הַקְּהָתִי מִבְּנֵי לֵוִי כִּי לָהֶם הָיָה הַגּוֹרָל רִיאשֹׁנָֽה׃
translation: and they were for the children of Aaron, of the families of the Kohathites, who were of the children of Levi; for theirs was the first lot. (Joshua 21:10)

text: לְמַעַן תִּֽמְחַץ רַגְלְךָ בְּדָם לְשׁוֹן כְּלָבֶיךָ מֵאֹיְבִים מִנֵּֽהוּ׃
translation: They have seen your processions, God, even the processions of my God, my King, into the sanctuary. (Psalms 68:24)

text: וָאֲכַלֵּם וָאֶמְחָצֵם וְלֹא יְקוּמוּן וַֽיִּפְּלוּ תַּחַת רַגְלָֽי׃
translation: I have consumed them, and struck them through, so that they can't arise. Yes, they have fallen under my feet. (2 Samuel 22:39)

text: בְּכֹחוֹ רָגַע הַיָּם ובתובנתו וּבִתְבוּנָתוֹ מָחַץ רָֽהַב׃
translation: He stirs up the sea with his power, and by his understanding he strikes through Rahab. (Job 26:12)

text: אֶמְחָצֵם וְלֹא יֻכְלוּ קוּם יִפְּלוּ תַּחַת רַגְלָֽי׃
translation: For you have armed me with strength to the battle. You have subdued under me those who rose up against me. (Psalms 18:39)

text: אֲדֹנָי עַל יְמִֽינְךָ מָחַץ בְּיוֹם אַפּוֹ מְלָכִֽים׃
translation: The Lord is at your right hand. He will crush kings in the day of his wrath. (Psalms 110:5)

text: בָּרֵךְ יְהוָה חֵילוֹ וּפֹעַל יָדָיו תִּרְצֶה מְחַץ מָתְנַיִם קָמָיו וּמְשַׂנְאָיו מִן יְקוּמֽוּן׃
translation: LORD, bless his skills. Accept the work of his hands. Strike through the hips of those who rise up against him, of those who hate him, that they not rise again." (Deuteronomy 33:11)

text: בְּנֵי יְהוּדָה נֹשְׂאֵי צִנָּה וָרֹמַח שֵׁשֶׁת אֲלָפִים וּשְׁמוֹנֶה מֵאוֹת חֲלוּצֵי צָבָֽא׃
translation: Of the children of Simeon, mighty men of valor for the war: seven thousand one hundred. (1 Chronicles 12:25)

text: וַאֲנַחְנוּ עֹשִׂים בַּמְּלָאכָה וְחֶצְיָם מַחֲזִיקִים בָּֽרְמָחִים מֵעֲלוֹת הַשַּׁחַר עַד צֵאת הַכּוֹכָבִֽים׃
translation: When our enemies heard that it was known to us, and God had brought their counsel to nothing, all of us returned to the wall, everyone to his work. (Nehemiah 4:15)

text: וּבְכָל עִיר וָעִיר צִנּוֹת וּרְמָחִים וַֽיְחַזְּקֵם לְהַרְבֵּה מְאֹד וַיְהִי לוֹ יְהוּדָה וּבִנְיָמִֽן׃
translation: He put shields and spears in every city, and made them exceedingly strong. Judah and Benjamin belonged to him. (2 Chronicles 11:12)

text: וַיַּרְא פִּֽינְחָס בֶּן אֶלְעָזָר בֶּֽן אַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֵן וַיָּקָם מִתּוֹךְ הָֽעֵדָה וַיִּקַּח רֹמַח בְּיָדֽוֹ׃
translation: When Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, saw it, he rose up from the middle of the congregation, and took a spear in his hand. (Numbers 25:7)

text: יִבְחַר אֱלֹהִים חֲדָשִׁים אָז לָחֶם שְׁעָרִים מָגֵן אִם יֵֽרָאֶה וָרֹמַח בְּאַרְבָּעִים אֶלֶף בְּיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
translation: They chose new gods. Then war was in the gates. Was there a shield or spear seen among forty thousand in Israel? (Judges 5:8)

text: וָֽאַעֲמִיד מִֽתַּחְתִּיּוֹת לַמָּקוֹם מֵאַחֲרֵי לַחוֹמָה בצחחיים בַּצְּחִיחִים וָֽאַעֲמִיד אֶת הָעָם לְמִשְׁפָּחוֹת עִם חַרְבֹתֵיהֶם רָמְחֵיהֶם וְקַשְּׁתֹתֵיהֶֽם׃
translation: But when Sanballat, Tobiah, the Arabians, the Ammonites, and the Ashdodites heard that the repairing of the walls of Jerusalem went forward, and that the breaches began to be filled, they were very angry; (Nehemiah 4:7)

text: וָאֹמַר אֲלֵכֶם לֹא תַֽעַרְצוּן וְֽלֹא תִֽירְאוּן מֵהֶֽם׃
translation: Then I said to you, "Don't be terrified. Don't be afraid of them. (Deuteronomy 1:29)

text: אֵל נַעֲרָץ בְּסוֹד קְדֹשִׁים רַבָּה וְנוֹרָא עַל כָּל סְבִיבָֽיו׃
translation: LORD, God of Armies, who is a mighty one, like you? LORD, your faithfulness is around you. (Psalms 89:8)

text: לֹא תַעֲרֹץ מִפְּנֵיהֶם כִּֽי יְהוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בְּקִרְבֶּךָ אֵל גָּדוֹל וְנוֹרָֽא׃
translation: You shall not be scared of them; for the LORD your God is among you, a great and awesome God. (Deuteronomy 7:21)

text: כִּי אֶֽעֱרוֹץ הָמוֹן רַבָּה וּבוּז מִשְׁפָּחוֹת יְחִתֵּנִי וָאֶדֹּם לֹא אֵצֵא פָֽתַח׃
translation: because I feared the great multitude, and the contempt of families terrified me, so that I kept silence, and didn't go out of the door— (Job 31:34)

text: וּבָאוּ בִּמְעָרוֹת צֻרִים וּבִמְחִלּוֹת עָפָר מִפְּנֵי פַּחַד יְהוָה וּמֵהֲדַר גְּאוֹנוֹ בְּקוּמוֹ לַעֲרֹץ הָאָֽרֶץ׃
translation: Men shall go into the caves of the rocks, and into the holes of the earth, from before the terror of the LORD, and from the glory of his majesty, when he arises to shake the earth mightily. (Isaiah 2:19)

text: לָבוֹא בְּנִקְרוֹת הַצֻּרִים וּבִסְעִפֵי הַסְּלָעִים מִפְּנֵי פַּחַד יְהוָה וּמֵהֲדַר גְּאוֹנוֹ בְּקוּמוֹ לַעֲרֹץ הָאָֽרֶץ׃
translation: to go into the caverns of the rocks, and into the clefts of the ragged rocks, from before the terror of the LORD, and from the glory of his majesty, when he arises to shake the earth mightily. (Isaiah 2:21)

text: צִדְקַת תָּמִים תְּיַשֵּׁר דַּרְכּוֹ וּבְרִשְׁעָתוֹ יִפֹּל רָשָֽׁע׃
translation: The righteousness of the blameless will direct his way, but the wicked shall fall by his own wickedness. (Proverbs 11:5)

text: צְדָקָה תִּצֹּר תָּם דָּרֶךְ וְרִשְׁעָה תְּסַלֵּף חַטָּֽאת׃
translation: Righteousness guards the way of integrity, but wickedness overthrows the sinner. (Proverbs 13:6)

text: וּבְשׁוּב רָשָׁע מֵֽרִשְׁעָתוֹ וְעָשָׂה מִשְׁפָּט וּצְדָקָה עֲלֵיהֶם הוּא יִֽחְיֶֽה׃
translation: When the wicked turns from his wickedness and does that which is lawful and right, he will live by it. (Ezekiel 33:19)

text: וְהָיָה אִם בִּן הַכּוֹת הָרָשָׁע וְהִפִּילוֹ הַשֹּׁפֵט וְהִכָּהוּ לְפָנָיו כְּדֵי רִשְׁעָתוֹ בְּמִסְפָּֽר׃
translation: It shall be, if the wicked man is worthy to be beaten, that the judge shall cause him to lie down and to be beaten before his face, according to his wickedness, by number. (Deuteronomy 25:2)

text: וּבְשׁוּב רָשָׁע מֵֽרִשְׁעָתוֹ אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה וַיַּעַשׂ מִשְׁפָּט וּצְדָקָה הוּא אֶת נַפְשׁוֹ יְחַיֶּֽה׃
translation: Again, when the wicked man turns away from his wickedness that he has committed, and does that which is lawful and right, he will save his soul alive. (Ezekiel 18:27)

text: וְעַתָּה אֲנַחְנוּ מְאַשְּׁרִים זֵדִים גַּם נִבְנוּ עֹשֵׂי רִשְׁעָה גַּם בָּחֲנוּ אֱלֹהִים וַיִּמָּלֵֽטוּ׃
translation: Now we call the proud happy; yes, those who work wickedness are built up; yes, they tempt God, and escape.' (Malachi 3:15)

text: וַתִּשְׁכַּח כִּי רֶגֶל תְּזוּרֶהָ וְחַיַּת הַשָּׂדֶה תְּדוּשֶֽׁהָ׃
translation: and forgets that the foot may crush them, or that the wild animal may trample them. (Job 39:15)

text: בְּזַעַם תִּצְעַד אָרֶץ בְּאַף תָּדוּשׁ גּוֹיִֽם׃
translation: You marched through the land in wrath. You threshed the nations in anger. (Habakkuk 3:12)

text: לֹא תַחְסֹם שׁוֹר בְּדִישֽׁוֹ׃
translation: You shall not muzzle the ox when he treads out the grain. (Deuteronomy 25:4)

text: וַיָּשָׁב אָרְנָן וַיַּרְא אֶת הַמַּלְאָךְ וְאַרְבַּעַת בָּנָיו עִמּוֹ מִֽתְחַבְּאִים וְאָרְנָן דָּשׁ חִטִּֽים׃
translation: Ornan turned back and saw the angel; and his four sons who were with him hid themselves. Now Ornan was threshing wheat. (1 Chronicles 21:20)

text: כִּֽי תָנוּחַ יַד יְהוָה בָּהָר הַזֶּה וְנָדוֹשׁ מוֹאָב תַּחְתָּיו כְּהִדּוּשׁ מַתְבֵּן במי בְּמוֹ מַדְמֵנָֽה׃
translation: For the LORD's hand will rest in this mountain. Moab will be trodden down in his place, even like straw is trodden down in the water of the dunghill. (Isaiah 25:10)

text: כִּי לֹא בֶֽחָרוּץ יוּדַשׁ קֶצַח וְאוֹפַן עֲגָלָה עַל כַּמֹּן יוּסָּב כִּי בַמַּטֶּה יֵחָבֶט קֶצַח וְכַמֹּן בַּשָּֽׁבֶט׃
translation: For the dill isn't threshed with a sharp instrument, neither is a cart wheel turned over the cumin; but the dill is beaten out with a stick, and the cumin with a rod. (Isaiah 28:27)

text: אִם עַל שַׁדַּי יִתְעַנָּג יִקְרָא אֱלוֹהַּ בְּכָל עֵֽת׃
translation: Will he delight himself in the Almighty, and call on God at all times? (Job 27:10)

text: כִּי אָז עַל שַׁדַּי תִּתְעַנָּג וְתִשָּׂא אֶל אֱלוֹהַּ פָּנֶֽיךָ׃
translation: For then you will delight yourself in the Almighty, and will lift up your face to God. (Job 22:26)

text: וְהִתְעַנַּג עַל יְהוָה וְיִֽתֶּן לְךָ מִשְׁאֲלֹת לִבֶּֽךָ׃
translation: Also delight yourself in the LORD, and he will give you the desires of your heart. (Psalms 37:4)

text: וַעֲנָוִים יִֽירְשׁוּ אָרֶץ וְהִתְעַנְּגוּ עַל רֹב שָׁלֽוֹם׃
translation: But the humble shall inherit the land, and shall delight themselves in the abundance of peace. (Psalms 37:11)

text: לְמַעַן תִּֽינְקוּ וּשְׂבַעְתֶּם מִשֹּׁד תַּנְחֻמֶיהָ לְמַעַן תָּמֹצּוּ וְהִתְעַנַּגְתֶּם מִזִּיז כְּבוֹדָֽהּ׃
translation: that you may nurse and be satisfied at the comforting breasts; that you may drink deeply, and be delighted with the abundance of her glory." (Isaiah 66:11)

text: הַנָּוָה וְהַמְּעֻנָּגָה דָּמִיתִי בַּת צִיּֽוֹן׃
translation: I will cut off the beautiful and delicate one, the daughter of Zion. (Jeremiah 6:2)

text: מַלְאָךְ רָשָׁע יִפֹּל בְּרָע וְצִיר אֱמוּנִים מַרְפֵּֽא׃
translation: A wicked messenger falls into trouble, but a trustworthy envoy gains healing. (Proverbs 13:17)

text: הַדֶּלֶת תִּסּוֹב עַל צִירָהּ וְעָצֵל עַל מִטָּתֽוֹ׃
translation: As the door turns on its hinges, so does the sluggard on his bed. (Proverbs 26:14)

text: בּוֹשׁוּ וְגַֽם נִכְלְמוּ כֻּלָּם יַחְדָּו הָלְכוּ בַכְּלִמָּה חָרָשֵׁי צִירִֽים׃
translation: They will be disappointed, yes, confounded, all of them. Those who are makers of idols will go into confusion together. (Isaiah 45:16)

text: כְּצִנַּת שֶׁלֶג בְּיוֹם קָצִיר צִיר נֶאֱמָן לְשֹׁלְחָיו וְנֶפֶשׁ אֲדֹנָיו יָשִֽׁיב׃
translation: As the cold of snow in the time of harvest, so is a faithful messenger to those who send him; for he refreshes the soul of his masters. (Proverbs 25:13)

text: שְׁמוּעָה שָׁמַעְתִּי מֵאֵת יְהוָה וְצִיר בַּגּוֹיִם שָׁלוּחַ הִֽתְקַבְּצוּ וּבֹאוּ עָלֶיהָ וְקוּמוּ לַמִּלְחָמָֽה׃
translation: I have heard news from the LORD, and an ambassador is sent among the nations, saying, "Gather yourselves together! Come against her! Rise up to the battle!" (Jeremiah 49:14)

text: עַל כֵּן מָלְאוּ מָתְנַי חַלְחָלָה צִירִים אֲחָזוּנִי כְּצִירֵי יֽוֹלֵדָה נַעֲוֵיתִי מִשְּׁמֹעַ נִבְהַלְתִּי מֵרְאֽוֹת׃
translation: Therefore my thighs are filled with anguish. Pains have seized me, like the pains of a woman in labor. I am in so much pain that I can't hear. I am so dismayed that I can't see. (Isaiah 21:3)

text: וַיִּשְׁפֹּט אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל עֶשְׂרִים וְשָׁלֹשׁ שָׁנָה וַיָּמָת וַיִּקָּבֵר בְּשָׁמִֽיר׃
translation: He judged Israel twenty-three years, and died, and was buried in Shamir. (Judges 10:2)

text: בְּנֵי עֻזִּיאֵל מִיכָה לִבְנֵי מִיכָה שמור שָׁמִֽיר׃
translation: The sons of Uzziel: Micah; of the sons of Micah, Shamir. (1 Chronicles 24:24)

text: בַּחִצִּים וּבַקֶּשֶׁת יָבוֹא שָׁמָּה כִּי שָׁמִיר וָשַׁיִת תִּֽהְיֶה כָל הָאָֽרֶץ׃
translation: People will go there with arrows and with bow, because all the land will be briers and thorns. (Isaiah 7:24)

text: וְהָיָה אֽוֹר יִשְׂרָאֵל לְאֵשׁ וּקְדוֹשׁוֹ לְלֶהָבָה וּבָעֲרָה וְאָֽכְלָה שִׁיתוֹ וּשְׁמִירוֹ בְּיוֹם אֶחָֽד׃
translation: The light of Israel will be for a fire, and his Holy One for a flame; and it will burn and devour his thorns and his briers in one day. (Isaiah 10:17)

text: חֵמָה אֵין לִי מִֽי יִתְּנֵנִי שָׁמִיר שַׁיִת בַּמִּלְחָמָה אֶפְשְׂעָה בָהּ אֲצִיתֶנָּה יָּֽחַד׃
translation: Wrath is not in me, but if I should find briers and thorns, I would do battle! I would march on them and I would burn them together. (Isaiah 27:4)

text: חַטַּאת יְהוּדָה כְּתוּבָה בְּעֵט בַּרְזֶל בְּצִפֹּרֶן שָׁמִיר חֲרוּשָׁה עַל לוּחַ לִבָּם וּלְקַרְנוֹת מִזְבְּחוֹתֵיכֶֽם׃
translation: "The sin of Judah is written with a pen of iron, and with the point of a diamond. It is engraved on the tablet of their heart, and on the horns of your altars. (Jeremiah 17:1)

text: מֵחֹרֶף עָצֵל לֹא יַחֲרֹשׁ ישאל וְשָׁאַל בַּקָּצִיר וָאָֽיִן׃
translation: The sluggard will not plow by reason of the winter; therefore he shall beg in harvest, and have nothing. (Proverbs 20:4)

text: טָמַן עָצֵל יָדוֹ בַּצַּלָּחַת נִלְאָה לַֽהֲשִׁיבָהּ אֶל פִּֽיו׃
translation: The sluggard buries his hand in the dish. He is too lazy to bring it back to his mouth. (Proverbs 26:15)

text: לֵֽךְ אֶל נְמָלָה עָצֵל רְאֵה דְרָכֶיהָ וַחֲכָֽם׃
translation: Go to the ant, you sluggard. Consider her ways, and be wise; (Proverbs 6:6)

text: עַד מָתַי עָצֵל תִּשְׁכָּב מָתַי תָּקוּם מִשְּׁנָתֶֽךָ׃
translation: How long will you sleep, sluggard? When will you arise out of your sleep? (Proverbs 6:9)

text: כַּחֹמֶץ לַשִּׁנַּיִם וְכֶעָשָׁן לָעֵינָיִם כֵּן הֶעָצֵל לְשֹׁלְחָֽיו׃
translation: As vinegar to the teeth, and as smoke to the eyes, so is the sluggard to those who send him. (Proverbs 10:26)

text: מִתְאַוָּה וָאַיִן נַפְשׁוֹ עָצֵל וְנֶפֶשׁ חָרֻצִים תְּדֻשָּֽׁן׃
translation: The soul of the sluggard desires, and has nothing, but the desire of the diligent shall be fully satisfied. (Proverbs 13:4)

text: שִֽׁירוּ לוֹ שִׁיר חָדָשׁ הֵיטִיבוּ נַגֵּן בִּתְרוּעָֽה׃
translation: Sing to him a new song. Play skillfully with a shout of joy! (Psalms 33:3)

text: יְהוָה לְהוֹשִׁיעֵנִי וּנְגִנוֹתַי נְנַגֵּן כָּל יְמֵי חַיֵּינוּ עַל בֵּית יְהוָֽה׃
translation: The LORD will save me. Therefore we will sing my songs with stringed instruments all the days of our life in the LORD's house. (Isaiah 38:20)

text: וְעַתָּה קְחוּ לִי מְנַגֵּן וְהָיָה כְּנַגֵּן הַֽמְנַגֵּן וַתְּהִי עָלָיו יַד יְהוָֽה׃
translation: But now bring me a musician." When the musician played, the LORD's hand came on him. (2 Kings 3:15)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל אֶל עֲבָדָיו רְאוּ נָא לִי אִישׁ מֵיטִיב לְנַגֵּן וַהֲבִיאוֹתֶם אֵלָֽי׃
translation: Saul said to his servants, "Provide me now a man who can play well, and bring him to me." (1 Samuel 16:17)

text: קְחִי כִנּוֹר סֹבִּי עִיר זוֹנָה נִשְׁכָּחָה הֵיטִיבִי נַגֵּן הַרְבִּי שִׁיר לְמַעַן תִּזָּכֵֽרִי׃
translation: Take a harp; go about the city, you prostitute that has been forgotten. Make sweet melody. Sing many songs, that you may be remembered. (Isaiah 23:16)

text: וַתְּהִי רוּחַ יְהוָה רָעָה אֶל שָׁאוּל וְהוּא בְּבֵיתוֹ יוֹשֵׁב וַחֲנִיתוֹ בְּיָדוֹ וְדָוִד מְנַגֵּן בְּיָֽד׃
translation: An evil spirit from the LORD was on Saul as he sat in his house with his spear in his hand; and David was playing music with his hand. (1 Samuel 19:9)

text: בֵּן חָכָם מוּסַר אָב וְלֵץ לֹא שָׁמַע גְּעָרָֽה׃
translation: A wise son listens to his father's instruction, but a scoffer doesn't listen to rebuke. (Proverbs 13:1)

text: כֹּפֶר נֶֽפֶשׁ אִישׁ עָשְׁרוֹ וְרָשׁ לֹא שָׁמַע גְּעָרָֽה׃
translation: The ransom of a man's life is his riches, but the poor hear no threats. (Proverbs 13:8)

text: טוֹב לִשְׁמֹעַ גַּעֲרַת חָכָם מֵאִישׁ שֹׁמֵעַ שִׁיר כְּסִילִֽים׃
translation: It is better to hear the rebuke of the wise than for a man to hear the song of fools. (Ecclesiastes 7:5)

text: שְׂרֻפָה בָאֵשׁ כְּסוּחָה מִגַּעֲרַת פָּנֶיךָ יֹאבֵֽדוּ׃
translation: Let your hand be on the man of your right hand, on the son of man whom you made strong for yourself. (Psalms 80:17)

text: תֵּחַת גְּעָרָה בְמֵבִין מֵהַכּוֹת כְּסִיל מֵאָֽה׃
translation: A rebuke enters deeper into one who has understanding than a hundred lashes into a fool. (Proverbs 17:10)

text: בָּנַיִךְ עֻלְּפוּ שָׁכְבוּ בְּרֹאשׁ כָּל חוּצוֹת כְּתוֹא מִכְמָר הַֽמְלֵאִים חֲמַת יְהוָה גַּעֲרַת אֱלֹהָֽיִךְ׃
translation: Your sons have fainted. They lie at the head of all the streets, like an antelope in a net. They are full of the LORD's wrath, the rebuke of your God. (Isaiah 51:20)

text: כִּֽי הִנֵּה רְחֵקֶיךָ יֹאבֵדוּ הִצְמַתָּה כָּל זוֹנֶה מִמֶּֽךָּ׃
translation: For, behold, those who are far from you shall perish. You have destroyed all those who are unfaithful to you. (Psalms 73:27)

text: וַיָּשֶׁב עֲלֵיהֶם אֶת אוֹנָם וּבְרָעָתָם יַצְמִיתֵם יַצְמִיתֵם יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃
translation: He has brought on them their own iniquity, and will cut them off in their own wickedness. The LORD, our God, will cut them off. (Psalms 94:23)

text: וְאֹיְבַי תַּתָּה לִּי עֹרֶף מְשַׂנְאַי וָאַצְמִיתֵֽם׃
translation: You have also made my enemies turn their backs to me, that I might cut off those who hate me. (2 Samuel 22:41)

text: וְֽאֹיְבַי נָתַתָּה לִּי עֹרֶף וּמְשַׂנְאַי אַצְמִיתֵֽם׃
translation: They cried, but there was no one to save; even to the LORD, but he didn't answer them. (Psalms 18:41)

text: ישוב יָשִׁיב הָרַע לְשֹׁרְרָי בַּאֲמִתְּךָ הַצְמִיתֵֽם׃
translation: For he has delivered me out of all trouble. My eye has seen triumph over my enemies. (Psalms 54:7)

text: צִמְּתַתְנִי קִנְאָתִי כִּֽי שָׁכְחוּ דְבָרֶיךָ צָרָֽי׃
translation: My zeal wears me out, because my enemies ignore your words. (Psalms 119:139)

text: חִכּוֹ מַֽמְתַקִּים וְכֻלּוֹ מַחֲּמַדִּים זֶה דוֹדִי וְזֶה רֵעִי בְּנוֹת יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
translation: His mouth is sweetness; yes, he is altogether lovely. This is my beloved, and this is my friend, daughters of Jerusalem. (Song of Solomon 5:16)

text: הֻכָּה אֶפְרַיִם שָׁרְשָׁם יָבֵשׁ פְּרִי בלי בַֽל יַעֲשׂוּן גַּם כִּי יֵֽלֵדוּן וְהֵמַתִּי מַחֲמַדֵּי בִטְנָֽם׃
translation: Ephraim is struck. Their root has dried up. They will bear no fruit. Even though they give birth, yet I will kill the beloved ones of their womb." (Hosea 9:16)

text: וַֽיִּשְׂרְפוּ אֶת בֵּית הָאֱלֹהִים וַֽיְנַתְּצוּ אֵת חוֹמַת יְרוּשָׁלִָם וְכָל אַרְמְנוֹתֶיהָ שָׂרְפוּ בָאֵשׁ וְכָל כְּלֵי מַחֲמַדֶּיהָ לְהַשְׁחִֽית׃
translation: They burned God's house, broke down the wall of Jerusalem, burned all its palaces with fire, and destroyed all of its valuable vessels. (2 Chronicles 36:19)

text: דָּרַךְ קַשְׁתּוֹ כְּאוֹיֵב נִצָּב יְמִינוֹ כְּצָר וַֽיַּהֲרֹג כֹּל מַחֲמַדֵּי עָיִן בְּאֹהֶל בַּת צִיּוֹן שָׁפַךְ כָּאֵשׁ חֲמָתֽוֹ׃
translation: He has bent his bow like an enemy. He has stood with his right hand as an adversary. He has killed all that were pleasant to the eye. In the tent of the daughter of Zion, he has poured out his wrath like fire. (Lamentations 2:4)

text: בֶּן אָדָם הִנְנִי לֹקֵחַ מִמְּךָ אֶת מַחְמַד עֵינֶיךָ בְּמַגֵּפָה וְלֹא תִסְפֹּד וְלֹא תִבְכֶּה וְלוֹא תָבוֹא דִּמְעָתֶֽךָ׃
translation: "Son of man, behold, I will take away from you the desire of your eyes with one stroke; yet you shall neither mourn nor weep, neither shall your tears run down. (Ezekiel 24:16)

text: יָדוֹ פָּרַשׂ צָר עַל כָּל מַחֲמַדֶּיהָ כִּֽי רָאֲתָה גוֹיִם בָּאוּ מִקְדָּשָׁהּ אֲשֶׁר צִוִּיתָה לֹא יָבֹאוּ בַקָּהָל לָֽךְ׃
translation: The adversary has spread out his hand on all her pleasant things; for she has seen that the nations have entered into her sanctuary, concerning whom you commanded that they should not enter into your assembly. (Lamentations 1:10)

text: לִדְלָיָהוּ שְׁלֹשָׁה וְעֶשְׂרִים לְמַֽעַזְיָהוּ אַרְבָּעָה וְעֶשְׂרִֽים׃
translation: the twenty-third to Delaiah, and the twenty-fourth to Maaziah. (1 Chronicles 24:18)

text: בְּנֵי דְלָיָה בְנֵי טוֹבִיָּה בְּנֵי נְקוֹדָא שֵׁשׁ מֵאוֹת חֲמִשִּׁים וּשְׁנָֽיִם׃
translation: the children of Delaiah, the children of Tobiah, the children of Nekoda, six hundred fifty-two. (Ezra 2:60)

text: בְּנֵי דְלָיָה בְנֵֽי טוֹבִיָּה בְּנֵי נְקוֹדָא שֵׁשׁ מֵאוֹת וְאַרְבָּעִים וּשְׁנָֽיִם׃
translation: The children of Delaiah, the children of Tobiah, the children of Nekoda: six hundred forty-two. (Nehemiah 7:62)

text: וַיְּיִף בְּגָדְלוֹ בְּאֹרֶךְ דָּֽלִיּוֹתָיו כִּֽי הָיָה שָׁרְשׁוֹ אֶל מַיִם רַבִּֽים׃
translation: Thus it was beautiful in its greatness, in the length of its branches; for its root was by many waters. (Ezekiel 31:7)

text: וּבְנֵי אֶלְיוֹעֵינַי הדיוהו הוֹדַוְיָהוּ וְאֶלְיָשִׁיב וּפְלָיָה וְעַקּוּב וְיוֹחָנָן וּדְלָיָה וַעֲנָנִי שִׁבְעָֽה׃
translation: The sons of Elioenai: Hodaviah, Eliashib, Pelaiah, Akkub, Johanan, Delaiah, and Anani, seven. (1 Chronicles 3:24)

text: יָפֶה עֲשִׂיתִיו בְּרֹב דָּֽלִיּוֹתָיו וַיְקַנְאֻהוּ כָּל עֲצֵי עֵדֶן אֲשֶׁר בְּגַן הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃
translation: I made it beautiful by the multitude of its branches, so that all the trees of Eden, that were in the garden of God, envied it.' (Ezekiel 31:9)

text: הֶן אֵל שַׂגִּיא וְלֹא נֵדָע מִסְפַּר שָׁנָיו וְלֹא חֵֽקֶר׃
translation: Behold, God is great, and we don't know him. The number of his years is unsearchable. (Job 36:26)

text: שַׁדַּי לֹֽא מְצָאנֻהוּ שַׂגִּיא כֹחַ וּמִשְׁפָּט וְרֹב צְדָקָה לֹא יְעַנֶּֽה׃
translation: We can't reach the Almighty. He is exalted in power. In justice and great righteousness, he will not oppress. (Job 37:23)

text: שֵׁן רֹעָה וְרֶגֶל מוּעָדֶת מִבְטָח בּוֹגֵד בְּיוֹם צָרָֽה׃
translation: Confidence in someone unfaithful in time of trouble is like a bad tooth or a lame foot. (Proverbs 25:19)

text: בָּרוּךְ הַגֶּבֶר אֲשֶׁר יִבְטַח בַּֽיהוָה וְהָיָה יְהוָה מִבְטַחֽוֹ׃
translation: "Blessed is the man who trusts in the LORD, and whose confidence is in the LORD. (Jeremiah 17:7)

text: כִּֽי אַתָּה תִקְוָתִי אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה מִבְטַחִי מִנְּעוּרָֽי׃
translation: For you are my hope, Lord GOD, my confidence from my youth. (Psalms 71:5)

text: בְּיִרְאַת יְהוָה מִבְטַח עֹז וּלְבָנָיו יִהְיֶה מַחְסֶֽה׃
translation: In the fear of the LORD is a secure fortress, and he will be a refuge for his children. (Proverbs 14:26)

text: עִיר גִּבֹּרִים עָלָה חָכָם וַיֹּרֶד עֹז מִבְטֶחָֽה׃
translation: A wise man scales the city of the mighty, and brings down the strength of its confidence. (Proverbs 21:22)

text: לִהְיוֹת בַּיהוָה מִבְטַחֶךָ הוֹדַעְתִּיךָ הַיּוֹם אַף אָֽתָּה׃
translation: I teach you today, even you, so that your trust may be in the LORD. (Proverbs 22:19)

text: טוֹב כַּעַס מִשְּׂחֹק כִּֽי בְרֹעַ פָּנִים יִיטַב לֵֽב׃
translation: Sorrow is better than laughter; for by the sadness of the face the heart is made good. (Ecclesiastes 7:3)

text: שְׂחֹק לְרֵעֵהוּ אֶֽהְיֶה קֹרֵא לֶאֱלוֹהַּ וַֽיַּעֲנֵהוּ שְׂחוֹק צַדִּיק תָּמִֽים׃
translation: I am like one who is a joke to his neighbor, I, who called on God, and he answered. The just, the blameless man is a joke. (Job 12:4)

text: כִּשְׂחוֹק לִכְסִיל עֲשׂוֹת זִמָּה וְחָכְמָה לְאִישׁ תְּבוּנָֽה׃
translation: It is a fool's pleasure to do wickedness, but wisdom is a man of understanding's pleasure. (Proverbs 10:23)

text: לִשְׂחוֹק אָמַרְתִּי מְהוֹלָל וּלְשִׂמְחָה מַה זֹּה עֹשָֽׂה׃
translation: I said of laughter, "It is foolishness;" and of mirth, "What does it accomplish?" (Ecclesiastes 2:2)

text: הָיִיתִי שְּׂחֹק לְכָל עַמִּי נְגִינָתָם כָּל הַיּֽוֹם׃
translation: I have become a derision to all my people, and their song all day long. (Lamentations 3:14)

text: עַד יְמַלֵּה שְׂחוֹק פִּיךָ וּשְׂפָתֶיךָ תְרוּעָֽה׃
translation: He will still fill your mouth with laughter, your lips with shouting. (Job 8:21)

text: אֲשֶׁר אָמְרוּ נִירֲשָׁה לָּנוּ אֵת נְאוֹת אֱלֹהִֽים׃
translation: My God, make them like tumbleweed, like chaff before the wind. (Psalms 83:13)

text: עֵֽדֹתֶיךָ נֶאֶמְנוּ מְאֹד לְבֵיתְךָ נַאֲוָה קֹדֶשׁ יְהוָה לְאֹרֶךְ יָמִֽים׃
translation: Your statutes stand firm. Holiness adorns your house, LORD, forever more. (Psalms 93:5)

text: וְנָדַמּוּ נְאוֹת הַשָּׁלוֹם מִפְּנֵי חֲרוֹן אַף יְהוָֽה׃
translation: The peaceful folds are brought to silence because of the fierce anger of the LORD. (Jeremiah 25:37)

text: יִרְעֲפוּ נְאוֹת מִדְבָּר וְגִיל גְּבָעוֹת תַּחְגֹּֽרְנָה׃
translation: The pastures are covered with flocks. The valleys also are clothed with grain. They shout for joy! They also sing. (Psalms 65:13)

text: נָאווּ לְחָיַיִךְ בַּתֹּרִים צַוָּארֵךְ בַּחֲרוּזִֽים׃
translation: Your cheeks are beautiful with earrings, your neck with strings of jewels. (Song of Solomon 1:10)

text: גַּם בַּהֲמוֹת שָׂדֶה תַּעֲרוֹג אֵלֶיךָ כִּי יָֽבְשׁוּ אֲפִיקֵי מָיִם וְאֵשׁ אָכְלָה נְאוֹת הַמִּדְבָּֽר׃
translation: Yes, the animals of the field pant to you, for the water brooks have dried up, and the fire has devoured the pastures of the wilderness. (Joel 1:20)

text: לֹא נָסוֹג אָחוֹר לִבֵּנוּ וַתֵּט אֲשֻׁרֵינוּ מִנִּי אָרְחֶֽךָ׃
translation: though you have crushed us in the haunt of jackals, and covered us with the shadow of death. (Psalms 44:19)

text: יֵבֹשׁוּ וְיִכָּלְמוּ מְבַקְשֵׁי נַפְשִׁי יִסֹּגוּ אָחוֹר וְיַחְפְּרוּ חֹשְׁבֵי רָעָתִֽי׃
translation: Let those who seek after my soul be disappointed and brought to dishonor. Let those who plot my ruin be turned back and confounded. (Psalms 35:4)

text: יֵבֹשׁוּ וְיַחְפְּרוּ מְבַקְשֵׁי נַפְשִׁי יִסֹּגוּ אָחוֹר וְיִכָּלְמוּ חֲפֵצֵי רָעָתִֽי׃
translation: Let them be turned because of their shame who say, "Aha! Aha!" (Psalms 70:3)

text: מִדְּרָכָיו יִשְׂבַּע סוּג לֵב וּמֵעָלָיו אִישׁ טֽוֹב׃
translation: The unfaithful will be repaid for his own ways; likewise a good man will be rewarded for his ways. (Proverbs 14:14)

text: כֻּלּוֹ סָג יַחְדָּו נֶאֱלָחוּ אֵין עֹֽשֵׂה טוֹב אֵין גַּם אֶחָֽד׃
translation: Have the workers of iniquity no knowledge, who eat up my people as they eat bread, and don't call on God? (Psalms 53:4)

text: וַיִּסֹּגוּ וַֽיִּבְגְּדוּ כַּאֲבוֹתָם נֶהְפְּכוּ כְּקֶשֶׁת רְמִיָּֽה׃
translation: but turned back, and dealt treacherously like their fathers. They were twisted like a deceitful bow. (Psalms 78:57)

text: הָפַךְ יָם לְֽיַבָּשָׁה בַּנָּהָר יַֽעַבְרוּ בְרָגֶל שָׁם נִשְׂמְחָה בּֽוֹ׃
translation: He turned the sea into dry land. They went through the river on foot. There, we rejoiced in him. (Psalms 66:6)

text: וְהוֹדַעְתֶּם אֶת בְּנֵיכֶם לֵאמֹר בַּיַּבָּשָׁה עָבַר יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת הַיַּרְדֵּן הַזֶּֽה׃
translation: Then you shall let your children know, saying, 'Israel came over this Jordan on dry land. (Joshua 4:22)

text: וַיָּבֹאוּ בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּתוֹךְ הַיָּם בַּיַּבָּשָׁה וְהַמַּיִם לָהֶם חֹמָה מִֽימִינָם וּמִשְּׂמֹאלָֽם׃
translation: The children of Israel went into the middle of the sea on the dry ground; and the waters were a wall to them on their right hand and on their left. (Exodus 14:22)

text: וּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הָלְכוּ בַיַּבָּשָׁה בְּתוֹךְ הַיָּם וְהַמַּיִם לָהֶם חֹמָה מִֽימִינָם וּמִשְּׂמֹאלָֽם׃
translation: But the children of Israel walked on dry land in the middle of the sea, and the waters were a wall to them on their right hand and on their left. (Exodus 14:29)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֱלֹהִים יִקָּווּ הַמַּיִם מִתַּחַת הַשָּׁמַיִם אֶל מָקוֹם אֶחָד וְתֵרָאֶה הַיַּבָּשָׁה וַֽיְהִי כֵֽן׃
translation: God said, "Let the waters under the sky be gathered together to one place, and let the dry land appear;" and it was so. (Genesis 1:9)

text: וְהַיָּם בָּקַעְתָּ לִפְנֵיהֶם וַיַּֽעַבְרוּ בְתוֹךְ הַיָּם בַּיַּבָּשָׁה וְֽאֶת רֹדְפֵיהֶם הִשְׁלַכְתָּ בִמְצוֹלֹת כְּמוֹ אֶבֶן בְּמַיִם עַזִּֽים׃
translation: You divided the sea before them, so that they went through the middle of the sea on the dry land; and you cast their pursuers into the depths, as a stone into the mighty waters. (Nehemiah 9:11)

text: כִּי כֶחָצִיר מְהֵרָה יִמָּלוּ וּכְיֶרֶק דֶּשֶׁא יִבּוֹלֽוּן׃
translation: For they shall soon be cut down like the grass, and wither like the green herb. (Psalms 37:2)

text: כִּֽי מֵי נִמְרִים מְשַׁמּוֹת יִֽהְיוּ כִּֽי יָבֵשׁ חָצִיר כָּלָה דֶשֶׁא יֶרֶק לֹא הָיָֽה׃
translation: For the waters of Nimrim will be desolate; for the grass has withered away, the tender grass fails, there is no green thing. (Isaiah 15:6)

text: כָּל רֶמֶשׂ אֲשֶׁר הוּא חַי לָכֶם יִהְיֶה לְאָכְלָה כְּיֶרֶק עֵשֶׂב נָתַתִּי לָכֶם אֶת כֹּֽל׃
translation: Every moving thing that lives will be food for you. As I gave you the green herb, I have given everything to you. (Genesis 9:3)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה וְאָבִיהָ יָרֹק יָרַק בְּפָנֶיהָ הֲלֹא תִכָּלֵם שִׁבְעַת יָמִים תִּסָּגֵר שִׁבְעַת יָמִים מִחוּץ לַֽמַּחֲנֶה וְאַחַר תֵּאָסֵֽף׃
translation: The LORD said to Moses, "If her father had but spit in her face, shouldn't she be ashamed seven days? Let her be shut up outside of the camp seven days, and after that she shall be brought in again." (Numbers 12:14)

text: וַיֵּצֵא קַיִן מִלִּפְנֵי יְהוָה וַיֵּשֶׁב בְּאֶֽרֶץ נוֹד קִדְמַת עֵֽדֶן׃
translation: Cain left the LORD's presence, and lived in the land of Nod, east of Eden. (Genesis 4:16)

text: יְטוּר נָפִישׁ וָקֵדְמָה אֵלֶּה הֵם בְּנֵי יִשְׁמָעֵֽאל׃
translation: Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah. These are the sons of Ishmael. (1 Chronicles 1:31)

text: יִהְיוּ כַּחֲצִיר גַּגּוֹת שֶׁקַּדְמַת שָׁלַף יָבֵֽשׁ׃
translation: Let them be as the grass on the housetops, which withers before it grows up, (Psalms 129:6)

text: וְשֵׁם הַנָּהָר הַשְּׁלִישִׁי חִדֶּקֶל הוּא הַֽהֹלֵךְ קִדְמַת אַשּׁוּר וְהַנָּהָר הָֽרְבִיעִי הוּא פְרָֽת׃
translation: The name of the third river is Hiddekel. This is the one which flows in front of Assyria. The fourth river is the Euphrates. (Genesis 2:14)

text: וַאֲחוֹתַיִךְ סְדֹם וּבְנוֹתֶיהָ תָּשֹׁבְןָ לְקַדְמָתָן וְשֹֽׁמְרוֹן וּבְנוֹתֶיהָ תָּשֹׁבְןָ לְקַדְמָתָן וְאַתְּ וּבְנוֹתַיִךְ תְּשֻׁבֶינָה לְקַדְמַתְכֶֽן׃
translation: Your sisters, Sodom and her daughters, will return to their former estate; and Samaria and her daughters will return to their former estate; and you and your daughters will return to your former estate. (Ezekiel 16:55)

text: וְהִרְבֵּיתִי עֲלֵיכֶם אָדָם וּבְהֵמָה וְרָבוּ וּפָרוּ וְהוֹשַׁבְתִּי אֶתְכֶם כְּקַדְמֽוֹתֵיכֶם וְהֵטִֽבֹתִי מֵרִאשֹׁתֵיכֶם וִֽידַעְתֶּם כִּֽי אֲנִי יְהוָֽה׃
translation: I will multiply man and animal on you. They will increase and be fruitful. I will cause you to be inhabited as you were before, and you will do better than at your beginnings. Then you will know that I am the LORD. (Ezekiel 36:11)

text: סָר סָבְאָם הַזְנֵה הִזְנוּ אָהֲבוּ הֵבוּ קָלוֹן מָגִנֶּֽיהָ׃
translation: Their drink has become sour. They play the prostitute continually. Her rulers dearly love their shameful way. (Hosea 4:18)

text: מַלְכֵי תַרְשִׁישׁ וְאִיִּים מִנְחָה יָשִׁיבוּ מַלְכֵי שְׁבָא וּסְבָא אֶשְׁכָּר יַקְרִֽיבוּ׃
translation: The kings of Tarshish and of the islands will bring tribute. The kings of Sheba and Seba shall offer gifts. (Psalms 72:10)

text: וּבְנֵי כוּשׁ סְבָא וַֽחֲוִילָה וְסַבְתָּה וְרַעְמָה וְסַבְתְּכָא וּבְנֵי רַעְמָה שְׁבָא וּדְדָֽן׃
translation: The sons of Cush were: Seba, Havilah, Sabtah, Raamah, and Sabteca. The sons of Raamah were: Sheba and Dedan. (Genesis 10:7)

text: וּבְנֵי כוּשׁ סְבָא וַחֲוִילָה וְסַבְתָּא וְרַעְמָא וְסַבְתְּכָא וּבְנֵי רַעְמָא שְׁבָא וּדְדָֽן׃
translation: The sons of Cush: Seba, Havilah, Sabta, Raama, Sabteca. The sons of Raamah: Sheba and Dedan. (1 Chronicles 1:9)

text: אֵתָיוּ אֶקְחָה יַיִן וְנִסְבְּאָה שֵׁכָר וְהָיָה כָזֶה יוֹם מָחָר גָּדוֹל יֶתֶר מְאֹֽד׃
translation: "Come," they say, "I will get wine, and we will fill ourselves with strong drink; and tomorrow will be as today, great beyond measure." (Isaiah 56:12)

text: כִּי אֲנִי יְהוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ קְדוֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל מוֹשִׁיעֶךָ נָתַתִּי כָפְרְךָ מִצְרַיִם כּוּשׁ וּסְבָא תַּחְתֶּֽיךָ׃
translation: For I am the LORD your God, the Holy One of Israel, your Savior. I have given Egypt as your ransom, Ethiopia and Seba in your place. (Isaiah 43:3)

text: זָמְמָה שָׂדֶה וַתִּקָּחֵהוּ מִפְּרִי כַפֶּיהָ נטע נָטְעָה כָּֽרֶם׃
translation: She considers a field, and buys it. With the fruit of her hands, she plants a vineyard. (Proverbs 31:16)

text: וַעֲשִׂיתֶם לוֹ כַּאֲשֶׁר זָמַם לַעֲשׂוֹת לְאָחִיו וּבִֽעַרְתָּ הָרָע מִקִּרְבֶּֽךָ׃
translation: then you shall do to him as he had thought to do to his brother. So you shall remove the evil from among you. (Deuteronomy 19:19)

text: אִם נָבַלְתָּ בְהִתְנַשֵּׂא וְאִם זַמּוֹתָ יָד לְפֶֽה׃
translation: "If you have done foolishly in lifting up yourself, or if you have thought evil, put your hand over your mouth. (Proverbs 30:32)

text: זֹמֵם רָשָׁע לַצַּדִּיק וְחֹרֵק עָלָיו שִׁנָּֽיו׃
translation: The wicked plots against the just, and gnashes at him with his teeth. (Psalms 37:12)

text: בָּחַנְתָּ לִבִּי פָּקַדְתָּ לַּיְלָה צְרַפְתַּנִי בַל תִּמְצָא זַמֹּתִי בַּל יַעֲבָר פִּֽי׃
translation: You have proved my heart. You have visited me in the night. You have tried me, and found nothing. I have resolved that my mouth shall not disobey. (Psalms 17:3)

text: כֵּן שַׁבְתִּי זָמַמְתִּי בַּיָּמִים הָאֵלֶּה לְהֵיטִיב אֶת יְרוּשָׁלִַם וְאֶת בֵּית יְהוּדָה אַל תִּירָֽאוּ׃
translation: so again I have thought in these days to do good to Jerusalem and to the house of Judah. Don't be afraid. (Zechariah 8:15)

text: הַמַּעְתִּיק הָרִים וְלֹא יָדָעוּ אֲשֶׁר הֲפָכָם בְּאַפּֽוֹ׃
translation: He removes the mountains, and they don't know it, when he overturns them in his anger. (Job 9:5)

text: וְאוּלָם הַר נוֹפֵל יִבּוֹל וְצוּר יֶעְתַּק מִמְּקֹמֽוֹ׃
translation: "But the mountain falling comes to nothing. The rock is removed out of its place. (Job 14:18)

text: טֹֽרֵף נַפְשׁוֹ בְּאַפּוֹ הַלְמַעַנְךָ תֵּעָזַב אָרֶץ וְיֶעְתַּק צוּר מִמְּקֹמֽוֹ׃
translation: You who tear yourself in your anger, will the earth be forsaken for you? Or will the rock be removed out of its place? (Job 18:4)

text: מַדּוּעַ רְשָׁעִים יִחְיוּ עָתְקוּ גַּם גָּבְרוּ חָֽיִל׃
translation: "Why do the wicked live, become old, yes, and grow mighty in power? (Job 21:7)

text: חַתּוּ לֹא עָנוּ עוֹד הֶעְתִּיקוּ מֵהֶם מִלִּֽים׃
translation: "They are amazed. They answer no more. They don't have a word to say. (Job 32:15)

text: תֵּאָלַמְנָה שִׂפְתֵי שָׁקֶר הַדֹּבְרוֹת עַל צַדִּיק עָתָק בְּגַאֲוָה וָבֽוּז׃
translation: Oh how great is your goodness, which you have laid up for those who fear you, which you have worked for those who take refuge in you, before the sons of men! (Psalms 31:19)

text: וּבְהֵעָלוֹת הֶֽעָנָן מֵעַל הַמִּשְׁכָּן יִסְעוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּכֹל מַסְעֵיהֶֽם׃
translation: When the cloud was taken up from over the tabernacle, the children of Israel went onward, throughout all their journeys; (Exodus 40:36)

text: וּתְקַעְתֶּם תְּרוּעָה שֵׁנִית וְנָֽסְעוּ הַֽמַּחֲנוֹת הַחֹנִים תֵּימָנָה תְּרוּעָה יִתְקְעוּ לְמַסְעֵיהֶֽם׃
translation: When you blow an alarm the second time, the camps that lie on the south side shall go forward. They shall blow an alarm for their journeys. (Numbers 10:6)

text: וַיִּסְעוּ בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵל לְמַסְעֵיהֶם מִמִּדְבַּר סִינָי וַיִּשְׁכֹּן הֶעָנָן בְּמִדְבַּר פָּארָֽן׃
translation: The children of Israel went forward on their journeys out of the wilderness of Sinai; and the cloud stayed in the wilderness of Paran. (Numbers 10:12)

text: אֵלֶּה מַסְעֵי בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵל לְצִבְאֹתָם וַיִּסָּֽעוּ׃
translation: Thus were the travels of the children of Israel according to their armies; and they went forward. (Numbers 10:28)

text: וַיִּכְתֹּב מֹשֶׁה אֶת מוֹצָאֵיהֶם לְמַסְעֵיהֶם עַל פִּי יְהוָה וְאֵלֶּה מַסְעֵיהֶם לְמוֹצָאֵיהֶֽם׃
translation: Moses wrote the starting points of their journeys by the commandment of the LORD. These are their journeys according to their starting points. (Numbers 33:2)

text: אֵלֶּה מַסְעֵי בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר יָצְאוּ מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם לְצִבְאֹתָם בְּיַד מֹשֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹֽן׃
translation: These are the journeys of the children of Israel, when they went out of the land of Egypt by their armies under the hand of Moses and Aaron. (Numbers 33:1)

text: בַּֽחוּצוֹת יִתְהוֹלְלוּ הָרֶכֶב יִֽשְׁתַּקְשְׁקוּן בָּרְחֹבוֹת מַרְאֵיהֶן כַּלַּפִּידִם כַּבְּרָקִים יְרוֹצֵֽצוּ׃
translation: He summons his picked troops. They stumble on their way. They dash to its wall, and the protective shield is put in place. (Nahum 2:5)

text: מִפִּיו לַפִּידִים יַהֲלֹכוּ כִּידוֹדֵי אֵשׁ יִתְמַלָּֽטוּ׃
translation: Who has first given to me, that I should repay him? Everything under the heavens is mine. (Job 41:11)

text: וַיְהִי הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ בָּאָה וַעֲלָטָה הָיָה וְהִנֵּה תַנּוּר עָשָׁן וְלַפִּיד אֵשׁ אֲשֶׁר עָבַר בֵּין הַגְּזָרִים הָאֵֽלֶּה׃
translation: It came to pass that, when the sun went down, and it was dark, behold, a smoking furnace and a flaming torch passed between these pieces. (Genesis 15:17)

text: לְמַעַן צִיּוֹן לֹא אֶחֱשֶׁה וּלְמַעַן יְרוּשָׁלִַם לֹא אֶשְׁקוֹט עַד יֵצֵא כַנֹּגַהּ צִדְקָהּ וִישׁוּעָתָהּ כְּלַפִּיד יִבְעָֽר׃
translation: For Zion's sake I will not hold my peace, and for Jerusalem's sake I will not rest, until her righteousness shines out like the dawn, and her salvation like a burning lamp. (Isaiah 62:1)

text: וּגְוִיָּתוֹ כְתַרְשִׁישׁ וּפָנָיו כְּמַרְאֵה בָרָק וְעֵינָיו כְּלַפִּידֵי אֵשׁ וּזְרֹֽעֹתָיו וּמַרְגְּלֹתָיו כְּעֵין נְחֹשֶׁת קָלָל וְקוֹל דְּבָרָיו כְּקוֹל הָמֽוֹן׃
translation: His body also was like beryl, and his face as the appearance of lightning, and his eyes as flaming torches. His arms and his feet were like burnished bronze. The voice of his words was like the voice of a multitude. (Daniel 10:6)

text: וְכָל הָעָם רֹאִים אֶת הַקּוֹלֹת וְאֶת הַלַּפִּידִם וְאֵת קוֹל הַשֹּׁפָר וְאֶת הָהָר עָשֵׁן וַיַּרְא הָעָם וַיָּנֻעוּ וַיַּֽעַמְדוּ מֵֽרָחֹֽק׃
translation: All the people perceived the thunderings, the lightnings, the sound of the trumpet, and the mountain smoking. When the people saw it, they trembled, and stayed at a distance. (Exodus 20:18)

text: וַיְהִי לֶֽחֶם שְׁלֹמֹה לְיוֹם אֶחָד שְׁלֹשִׁים כֹּר סֹלֶת וְשִׁשִּׁים כֹּר קָֽמַח׃
translation: Solomon sent to Hiram, saying, (1 Kings 5:2)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר וּקְחוּ קֶמַח וַיַּשְׁלֵךְ אֶל הַסִּיר וַיֹּאמֶר צַק לָעָם וְיֹאכֵלוּ וְלֹא הָיָה דָּבָר רָע בַּסִּֽיר׃
translation: But he said, "Then bring meal." He threw it into the pot; and he said, "Serve it to the people, that they may eat." And there was nothing harmful in the pot. (2 Kings 4:41)

text: וַתַּעֲלֵהוּ עִמָּהּ כַּאֲשֶׁר גְּמָלַתּוּ בְּפָרִים שְׁלֹשָׁה וְאֵיפָה אַחַת קֶמַח וְנֵבֶל יַיִן וַתְּבִאֵהוּ בֵית יְהוָה שִׁלוֹ וְהַנַּעַר נָֽעַר׃
translation: When she had weaned him, she took him up with her, with three bulls, and one ephah of meal, and a container of wine, and brought him to the LORD's house in Shiloh. The child was young. (1 Samuel 1:24)

text: כִּֽי אָמְנָם לֹא שֶׁקֶר מִלָּי תְּמִים דֵּעוֹת עִמָּֽךְ׃
translation: For truly my words are not false. One who is perfect in knowledge is with you. (Job 36:4)

text: הַֽאֻמְנָם אֵלֶם צֶדֶק תְּדַבֵּרוּן מֵישָׁרִים תִּשְׁפְּטוּ בְּנֵי אָדָֽם׃
translation: No, in your heart you plot injustice. You measure out the violence of your hands in the earth. (Psalms 58:2)

text: אָמְנָם יְהוָה הֶחֱרִיבוּ מַלְכֵי אַשּׁוּר אֶת הַגּוֹיִם וְאֶת אַרְצָֽם׃
translation: Truly, LORD, the kings of Assyria have laid waste the nations and their lands, (2 Kings 19:17)

text: אָמְנָם יָדַעְתִּי כִי כֵן וּמַה יִּצְדַּק אֱנוֹשׁ עִם אֵֽל׃
translation: "Truly I know that it is so, but how can man be just with God? (Job 9:2)

text: אָמְנָם כִּי אַתֶּם עָם וְעִמָּכֶם תָּמוּת חָכְמָֽה׃
translation: "No doubt, but you are the people, and wisdom will die with you. (Job 12:2)

text: אִם אָמְנָם עָלַי תַּגְדִּילוּ וְתוֹכִיחוּ עָלַי חֶרְפָּתִּֽי׃
translation: If indeed you will magnify yourselves against me, and plead against me my reproach, (Job 19:5)

text: כְּשָׂכִיר כְּתוֹשָׁב יִהְיֶה עִמָּךְ עַד שְׁנַת הַיֹּבֵל יַעֲבֹד עִמָּֽךְ׃
translation: As a hired servant, and as a temporary resident, he shall be with you; he shall serve with you until the Year of Jubilee. (Leviticus 25:40)

text: תּוֹשָׁב וְשָׂכִיר לֹא יֹאכַל בּֽוֹ׃
translation: A foreigner and a hired servant shall not eat of it. (Exodus 12:45)

text: וְכָל זָר לֹא יֹאכַל קֹדֶשׁ תּוֹשַׁב כֹּהֵן וְשָׂכִיר לֹא יֹאכַל קֹֽדֶשׁ׃
translation: "'No stranger shall eat of the holy thing: a foreigner living with the priests, or a hired servant, shall not eat of the holy thing. (Leviticus 22:10)

text: גֵּר וְתוֹשָׁב אָנֹכִי עִמָּכֶם תְּנוּ לִי אֲחֻזַּת קֶבֶר עִמָּכֶם וְאֶקְבְּרָה מֵתִי מִלְּפָנָֽי׃
translation: "I am a stranger and a foreigner living with you. Give me a possession of a burying-place with you, that I may bury my dead out of my sight." (Genesis 23:4)

text: וְהָאָרֶץ לֹא תִמָּכֵר לִצְמִתֻת כִּי לִי הָאָרֶץ כִּֽי גֵרִים וְתוֹשָׁבִים אַתֶּם עִמָּדִֽי׃
translation: "'The land shall not be sold in perpetuity, for the land is mine; for you are strangers and live as foreigners with me. (Leviticus 25:23)

text: וְכִֽי יָמוּךְ אָחִיךָ וּמָטָה יָדוֹ עִמָּךְ וְהֶֽחֱזַקְתָּ בּוֹ גֵּר וְתוֹשָׁב וָחַי עִמָּֽךְ׃
translation: "'If your brother has become poor, and his hand can't support himself among you, then you shall uphold him. He shall live with you like an alien and a temporary resident. (Leviticus 25:35)

text: וַיְהִי מִבְחַר עֲמָקַיִךְ מָלְאוּ רָכֶב וְהַפָּרָשִׁים שֹׁת שָׁתוּ הַשָּֽׁעְרָה׃
translation: Your choicest valleys were full of chariots, and the horsemen set themselves in array at the gate. (Isaiah 22:7)

text: יוֹאֵל אֲחִי נָתָן מִבְחָר בֶּן הַגְרִֽי׃
translation: Joel the brother of Nathan, Mibhar the son of Hagri, (1 Chronicles 11:38)

text: וְקִדַּשְׁתִּי עָלֶיךָ מַשְׁחִתִים אִישׁ וְכֵלָיו וְכָֽרְתוּ מִבְחַר אֲרָזֶיךָ וְהִפִּילוּ עַל הָאֵֽשׁ׃
translation: I will prepare destroyers against you, everyone with his weapons, and they will cut down your choice cedars, and cast them into the fire. (Jeremiah 22:7)

text: שֻׁדַּד מוֹאָב וְעָרֶיהָ עָלָה וּמִבְחַר בַּֽחוּרָיו יָרְדוּ לַטָּבַח נְאֻם הַמֶּלֶךְ יְהוָה צְבָאוֹת שְׁמֽוֹ׃
translation: Moab is laid waste, and they have gone up into his cities, and his chosen young men have gone down to the slaughter," says the King, whose name is the LORD of Armies. (Jeremiah 48:15)

text: מִבְחַר הַצֹּאן לָקוֹחַ וְגַם דּוּר הָעֲצָמִים תַּחְתֶּיהָ רַתַּח רְתָחֶיהָ גַּם בָּשְׁלוּ עֲצָמֶיהָ בְּתוֹכָֽהּ׃
translation: Take the choice of the flock, and also a pile of wood for the bones under the cauldron. Make it boil well. Yes, let its bones be boiled within it." (Ezekiel 24:5)

text: שְׁמָעֵנוּ אֲדֹנִי נְשִׂיא אֱלֹהִים אַתָּה בְּתוֹכֵנוּ בְּמִבְחַר קְבָרֵינוּ קְבֹר אֶת מֵתֶךָ אִישׁ מִמֶּנּוּ אֶת קִבְרוֹ לֹֽא יִכְלֶה מִמְּךָ מִקְּבֹר מֵתֶֽךָ׃
translation: "Hear us, my lord. You are a prince of God among us. Bury your dead in the best of our tombs. None of us will withhold from you his tomb. Bury your dead." (Genesis 23:6)

text: הֵן אֱמֶת חָפַצְתָּ בַטֻּחוֹת וּבְסָתֻם חָכְמָה תוֹדִיעֵֽנִי׃
translation: Let me hear joy and gladness, that the bones which you have broken may rejoice. (Psalms 51:8)

text: הִנֵּה חָכָם אַתָּה מדנאל מִדָּֽנִיֵּאל כָּל סָתוּם לֹא עֲמָמֽוּךָ׃
translation: behold, you are wiser than Daniel. There is no secret that is hidden from you. (Ezekiel 28:3)

text: גַּם כִּי אֶזְעַק וַאֲשַׁוֵּעַ שָׂתַם תְּפִלָּתִֽי׃
translation: Yes, when I cry, and call for help, he shuts out my prayer. (Lamentations 3:8)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר לֵךְ דָּנִיֵּאל כִּֽי סְתֻמִים וַחֲתֻמִים הַדְּבָרִים עַד עֵת קֵֽץ׃
translation: He said, "Go your way, Daniel; for the words are shut up and sealed until the time of the end. (Daniel 12:9)

text: וַיִּוָּעַץ עִם שָׂרָיו וְגִבֹּרָיו לִסְתּוֹם אֶת מֵימֵי הָעֲיָנוֹת אֲשֶׁר מִחוּץ לָעִיר וַֽיַּעְזְרֽוּהוּ׃
translation: he took counsel with his princes and his mighty men to stop the waters of the springs which were outside of the city, and they helped him. (2 Chronicles 32:3)

text: וְכָל הַבְּאֵרֹת אֲשֶׁר חָֽפְרוּ עַבְדֵי אָבִיו בִּימֵי אַבְרָהָם אָבִיו סִתְּמוּם פְּלִשְׁתִּים וַיְמַלְאוּם עָפָֽר׃
translation: Now all the wells which his father's servants had dug in the days of Abraham his father, the Philistines had stopped, and filled with earth. (Genesis 26:15)

text: וַתִּזְנִי אֶל בְּנֵי אַשּׁוּר מִבִּלְתִּי שָׂבְעָתֵךְ וַתִּזְנִים וְגַם לֹא שָׂבָֽעַתְּ׃
translation: You have played the prostitute also with the Assyrians, because you were insatiable; yes, you have played the prostitute with them, and yet you weren't satisfied. (Ezekiel 16:28)

text: וַאֲכַלְתֶּם חֵלֶב לְשָׂבְעָה וּשְׁתִיתֶם דָּם לְשִׁכָּרוֹן מִזִּבְחִי אֲשֶׁר זָבַחְתִּי לָכֶֽם׃
translation: You shall eat fat until you are full, and drink blood until you are drunk, of my sacrifice which I have sacrificed for you. (Ezekiel 39:19)

text: וַיִּקְרָא אֹתָהּ שִׁבְעָה עַל כֵּן שֵׁם הָעִיר בְּאֵר שֶׁבַע עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּֽה׃
translation: He called it "Shibah". Therefore the name of the city is "Beersheba" to this day. (Genesis 26:33)

text: לָמָּה תִשְׁקְלוּ כֶסֶף בְּֽלוֹא לֶחֶם וִיגִיעֲכֶם בְּלוֹא לְשָׂבְעָה שִׁמְעוּ שָׁמוֹעַ אֵלַי וְאִכְלוּ טוֹב וְתִתְעַנַּג בַּדֶּשֶׁן נַפְשְׁכֶֽם׃
translation: Why do you spend money for that which is not bread, and your labor for that which doesn't satisfy? Listen diligently to me, and eat that which is good, and let your soul delight itself in richness. (Isaiah 55:2)

text: כָּל קֳבֵל דִּי מִן קֳדָם מַלְכָּא וְשִׁבְעַת יָעֲטֹהִי שְׁלִיחַ לְבַקָּרָא עַל יְהוּד וְלִֽירוּשְׁלֶם בְּדָת אֱלָהָךְ דִּי בִידָֽךְ׃
translation: Because you are sent by the king and his seven counselors to inquire concerning Judah and Jerusalem, according to the law of your God which is in your hand, (Ezra 7:14)

text: וְהַכְּלָבִים עַזֵּי נֶפֶשׁ לֹא יָֽדְעוּ שָׂבְעָה וְהֵמָּה רֹעִים לֹא יָדְעוּ הָבִין כֻּלָּם לְדַרְכָּם פָּנוּ אִישׁ לְבִצְעוֹ מִקָּצֵֽהוּ׃
translation: Yes, the dogs are greedy. They can never have enough. They are shepherds who can't understand. They have all turned to their own way, each one to his gain, from every quarter. (Isaiah 56:11)

text: פֶּן יִטְרֹף כְּאַרְיֵה נַפְשִׁי פֹּרֵק וְאֵין מַצִּֽיל׃
translation: LORD, my God, if I have done this, if there is iniquity in my hands, (Psalms 7:3)

text: עֲבָדִים מָשְׁלוּ בָנוּ פֹּרֵק אֵין מִיָּדָֽם׃
translation: Servants rule over us. There is no one to deliver us out of their hand. (Lamentations 5:8)

text: וַיִּפְרְקֵנוּ מִצָּרֵינוּ כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
translation: and has delivered us from our adversaries, for his loving kindness endures forever; (Psalms 136:24)

text: וָאֹמַר לָהֶם לְמִי זָהָב הִתְפָּרָקוּ וַיִּתְּנוּ לִי וָאַשְׁלִכֵהוּ בָאֵשׁ וַיֵּצֵא הָעֵגֶל הַזֶּֽה׃
translation: I said to them, 'Whoever has any gold, let them take it off.' So they gave it to me; and I threw it into the fire, and out came this calf." (Exodus 32:24)

text: וְאַֽל תַּעֲמֹד עַל הַפֶּרֶק לְהַכְרִית אֶת פְּלִיטָיו וְאַל תַּסְגֵּר שְׂרִידָיו בְּיוֹם צָרָֽה׃
translation: Don't stand in the crossroads to cut off those of his who escape. Don't deliver up those of his who remain in the day of distress. (Obadiah 1:14)

text: וְעַל חַרְבְּךָ תִֽחְיֶה וְאֶת אָחִיךָ תַּעֲבֹד וְהָיָה כַּאֲשֶׁר תָּרִיד וּפָרַקְתָּ עֻלּוֹ מֵעַל צַוָּארֶֽךָ׃
translation: You will live by your sword, and you will serve your brother. It will happen, when you will break loose, that you will shake his yoke from off your neck." (Genesis 27:40)

text: זֶה לַחְמֵנוּ חָם הִצְטַיַּדְנוּ אֹתוֹ מִבָּתֵּינוּ בְּיוֹם צֵאתֵנוּ לָלֶכֶת אֲלֵיכֶם וְעַתָּה הִנֵּה יָבֵשׁ וְהָיָה נִקֻּדִֽים׃
translation: This our bread we took hot for our supplies out of our houses on the day we went out to go to you; but now, behold, it is dry, and has become moldy. (Joshua 9:12)

text: וְלָקַחַתְּ בְּיָדֵךְ עֲשָׂרָה לֶחֶם וְנִקֻּדִים וּבַקְבֻּק דְּבַשׁ וּבָאת אֵלָיו הוּא יַגִּיד לָךְ מַה יִּֽהְיֶה לַנָּֽעַר׃
translation: Take with you ten loaves of bread, some cakes, and a jar of honey, and go to him. He will tell you what will become of the child." (1 Kings 14:3)

text: וּמֵישַׁע מֶֽלֶךְ מוֹאָב הָיָה נֹקֵד וְהֵשִׁיב לְמֶֽלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵאָה אֶלֶף כָּרִים וּמֵאָה אֶלֶף אֵילִים צָֽמֶר׃
translation: Now Mesha king of Moab was a sheep breeder; and he supplied the king of Israel with one hundred thousand lambs and the wool of one hundred thousand rams. (2 Kings 3:4)

text: רָשׁ וְאִישׁ תְּכָכִים נִפְגָּשׁוּ מֵאִיר עֵינֵי שְׁנֵיהֶם יְהוָֽה׃
translation: The poor man and the oppressor have this in common: The LORD gives sight to the eyes of both. (Proverbs 29:13)

text: חֶֽסֶד וֶאֱמֶת נִפְגָּשׁוּ צֶדֶק וְשָׁלוֹם נָשָֽׁקוּ׃
translation: Truth springs out of the earth. Righteousness has looked down from heaven. (Psalms 85:11)

text: עָשִׁיר וָרָשׁ נִפְגָּשׁוּ עֹשֵׂה כֻלָּם יְהוָֽה׃
translation: The rich and the poor have this in common: The LORD is the maker of them all. (Proverbs 22:2)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר מִי לְךָ כָּל הַמַּחֲנֶה הַזֶּה אֲשֶׁר פָּגָשְׁתִּי וַיֹּאמֶר לִמְצֹא חֵן בְּעֵינֵי אֲדֹנִֽי׃
translation: Esau said, "What do you mean by all this company which I met?" Jacob said, "To find favor in the sight of my lord." (Genesis 33:8)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֶֽל אַהֲרֹן לֵךְ לִקְרַאת מֹשֶׁה הַמִּדְבָּרָה וַיֵּלֶךְ וַֽיִּפְגְּשֵׁהוּ בְּהַר הָאֱלֹהִים וַיִּשַּׁק לֽוֹ׃
translation: The LORD said to Aaron, "Go into the wilderness to meet Moses." He went, and met him on God's mountain, and kissed him. (Exodus 4:27)

text: וְהָיָה הִיא רֹכֶבֶת עַֽל הַחֲמוֹר וְיֹרֶדֶת בְּסֵתֶר הָהָר וְהִנֵּה דָוִד וַאֲנָשָׁיו יֹרְדִים לִקְרָאתָהּ וַתִּפְגֹּשׁ אֹתָֽם׃
translation: As she rode on her donkey, and came down hidden by the mountain, behold, David and his men came down toward her, and she met them. (1 Samuel 25:20)

text: כִּי הוּא יַכְאִיב וְיֶחְבָּשׁ יִמְחַץ וידו וְיָדָיו תִּרְפֶּֽינָה׃
translation: For he wounds and binds up. He injures and his hands make whole. (Job 5:18)

text: אַךְ בְּשָׂרוֹ עָלָיו יִכְאָב וְנַפְשׁוֹ עָלָיו תֶּאֱבָֽל׃
translation: But his flesh on him has pain, and his soul within him mourns." (Job 14:22)

text: אִֽם אֲדַבְּרָה לֹא יֵחָשֵׂךְ כְּאֵבִי וְאַחְדְּלָה מַה מִנִּי יַהֲלֹֽךְ׃
translation: "Though I speak, my grief is not subsided. Though I forbear, what am I eased? (Job 16:6)

text: גַּם בִּשְׂחוֹק יִכְאַב לֵב וְאַחֲרִיתָהּ שִׂמְחָה תוּגָֽה׃
translation: Even in laughter the heart may be sorrowful, and mirth may end in heaviness. (Proverbs 14:13)

text: וַאֲנִי עָנִי וְכוֹאֵב יְשׁוּעָתְךָ אֱלֹהִים תְּשַׂגְּבֵֽנִי׃
translation: I will praise the name of God with a song, and will magnify him with thanksgiving. (Psalms 69:30)

text: הִנֵּה עֲבָדַי יָרֹנּוּ מִטּוּב לֵב וְאַתֶּם תִּצְעֲקוּ מִכְּאֵב לֵב וּמִשֵּׁבֶר רוּחַ תְּיֵלִֽילוּ׃
translation: Behold, my servants will sing for joy of heart, but you will cry for sorrow of heart, and will wail for anguish of spirit. (Isaiah 65:14)

text: קְבוּרַת חֲמוֹר יִקָּבֵר סָחוֹב וְהַשְׁלֵךְ מֵהָלְאָה לְשַׁעֲרֵי יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
translation: He will be buried with the burial of a donkey, drawn and cast out beyond the gates of Jerusalem." (Jeremiah 22:19)

text: וַיִּקְבְֹּר אֹתוֹ בִּקְבֻרָתוֹ בְּגַן עֻזָּא וַיִּמְלֹךְ יֹאשִׁיָּהוּ בְנוֹ תַּחְתָּֽיו׃
translation: He was buried in his tomb in the garden of Uzza, and Josiah his son reigned in his place. (2 Kings 21:26)

text: וְשָֽׁכַבְתִּי עִם אֲבֹתַי וּנְשָׂאתַנִי מִמִּצְרַיִם וּקְבַרְתַּנִי בִּקְבֻרָתָם וַיֹּאמַר אָנֹכִי אֶֽעֱשֶׂה כִדְבָרֶֽךָ׃
translation: but when I sleep with my fathers, you shall carry me out of Egypt, and bury me in their burying place." Joseph said, "I will do as you have said." (Genesis 47:30)

text: וַיַּרְכִּבוּ אֹתוֹ עֲבָדָיו יְרוּשָׁלְָמָה וַיִּקְבְּרוּ אֹתוֹ בִקְבֻרָתוֹ עִם אֲבֹתָיו בְּעִיר דָּוִֽד׃
translation: His servants carried him in a chariot to Jerusalem, and buried him in his tomb with his fathers in David's city. (2 Kings 9:28)

text: לֹֽא תֵחַד אִתָּם בִּקְבוּרָה כִּֽי אַרְצְךָ שִׁחַתָּ עַמְּךָ הָרָגְתָּ לֹֽא יִקָּרֵא לְעוֹלָם זֶרַע מְרֵעִֽים׃
translation: You will not join them in burial, because you have destroyed your land. You have killed your people. The offspring of evildoers will not be named forever. (Isaiah 14:20)

text: וַיִּקְבֹּר אֹתוֹ בַגַּיְ בְּאֶרֶץ מוֹאָב מוּל בֵּית פְּעוֹר וְלֹֽא יָדַע אִישׁ אֶת קְבֻרָתוֹ עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּֽה׃
translation: He buried him in the valley in the land of Moab opposite Beth Peor, but no man knows where his tomb is to this day. (Deuteronomy 34:6)

text: גָּעַרְתָּ גוֹיִם אִבַּדְתָּ רָשָׁע שְׁמָם מָחִיתָ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶֽד׃
translation: The enemy is overtaken by endless ruin. The very memory of the cities which you have overthrown has perished. (Psalms 9:6)

text: וְעַתָּה לָמָּה לֹא גָעַרְתָּ בְּיִרְמְיָהוּ הָֽעֲנְּתֹתִי הַמִּתְנַבֵּא לָכֶֽם׃
translation: Now therefore, why have you not rebuked Jeremiah of Anathoth, who makes himself a prophet to you, (Jeremiah 29:27)

text: וַיִּגְעַר בְּיַם סוּף וַֽיֶּחֱרָב וַיּוֹלִיכֵם בַּתְּהֹמוֹת כַּמִּדְבָּֽר׃
translation: He rebuked the Red Sea also, and it was dried up; so he led them through the depths, as through a desert. (Psalms 106:9)

text: וְגַם שֹׁל תָּשֹׁלּוּ לָהּ מִן הַצְּבָתִים וַעֲזַבְתֶּם וְלִקְּטָה וְלֹא תִגְעֲרוּ בָֽהּ׃
translation: Also pull out some for her from the bundles, and leave it. Let her glean, and don't rebuke her." (Ruth 2:16)

text: גָּעַרְתָּ זֵדִים אֲרוּרִים הַשֹּׁגִים מִמִּצְוֺתֶֽיךָ׃
translation: You have rebuked the proud who are cursed, who wander from your commandments. (Psalms 119:21)
