text: גּוֹעֵר בַּיָּם וַֽיַּבְּשֵׁהוּ וְכָל הַנְּהָרוֹת הֶֽחֱרִיב אֻמְלַל בָּשָׁן וְכַרְמֶל וּפֶרַח לְבָנוֹן אֻמְלָֽל׃
translation: He rebukes the sea and makes it dry, and dries up all the rivers. Bashan and Carmel languish. The flower of Lebanon languishes. (Nahum 1:4)

text: הַֽחָכְמָה תָּעֹז לֶחָכָם מֵֽעֲשָׂרָה שַׁלִּיטִים אֲשֶׁר הָיוּ בָּעִֽיר׃
translation: Wisdom is a strength to the wise man more than ten rulers who are in a city. (Ecclesiastes 7:19)

text: יֵשׁ רָעָה רָאִיתִי תַּחַת הַשָּׁמֶשׁ כִּשְׁגָגָה שֶׁיֹּצָא מִלִּפְנֵי הַשַּׁלִּֽיט׃
translation: There is an evil which I have seen under the sun, the sort of error which proceeds from the ruler. (Ecclesiastes 10:5)

text: וּמַלְכִין תַּקִּיפִין הֲווֹ עַל יְרוּשְׁלֶם וְשַׁלִּיטִין בְּכֹל עֲבַר נַהֲרָה וּמִדָּה בְלוֹ וַהֲלָךְ מִתְיְהֵב לְהֽוֹן׃
translation: There have also been mighty kings over Jerusalem who have ruled over all the country beyond the River; and tribute, custom, and toll was paid to them. (Ezra 4:20)

text: וְדִי אֲמַרוּ לְמִשְׁבַּק עִקַּר שָׁרְשׁוֹהִי דִּי אִֽילָנָא מַלְכוּתָךְ לָךְ קַיָּמָה מִן דִּי תִנְדַּע דִּי שַׁלִּטִן שְׁמַיָּֽא׃
translation: "Whereas the king saw a holy watcher coming down from the sky and saying, 'Cut down the tree, and destroy it; nevertheless leave the stump of its roots in the earth, even with a band of iron and bronze, in the tender grass of the field, and let it be wet with the dew of the sky. Let his portion be with the animals of the field, until seven times pass over him.' (Daniel 4:23)

text: וְיוֹסֵף הוּא הַשַּׁלִּיט עַל הָאָרֶץ הוּא הַמַּשְׁבִּיר לְכָל עַם הָאָרֶץ וַיָּבֹאוּ אֲחֵי יוֹסֵף וַיִּשְׁתַּֽחֲווּ לוֹ אַפַּיִם אָֽרְצָה׃
translation: Joseph was the governor over the land. It was he who sold to all the people of the land. Joseph's brothers came, and bowed themselves down to him with their faces to the earth. (Genesis 42:6)

text: עָנֵה וְאָמַר לְאַרְיוֹךְ שַׁלִּיטָא דִֽי מַלְכָּא עַל מָה דָתָא מְהַחְצְפָה מִן קֳדָם מַלְכָּא אֱדַיִן מִלְּתָא הוֹדַע אַרְיוֹךְ לְדָנִיֵּֽאל׃
translation: He answered Arioch the king's captain, "Why is the decree so urgent from the king?" Then Arioch made the thing known to Daniel. (Daniel 2:15)

text: אֲפָפוּנִי חֶבְלֵי מָוֶת וּמְצָרֵי שְׁאוֹל מְצָאוּנִי צָרָה וְיָגוֹן אֶמְצָֽא׃
translation: The cords of death surrounded me, the pains of Sheol got a hold of me. I found trouble and sorrow. (Psalms 116:3)

text: שִׁכָּרוֹן וְיָגוֹן תִּמָּלֵאִי כּוֹס שַׁמָּה וּשְׁמָמָה כּוֹס אֲחוֹתֵךְ שֹׁמְרֽוֹן׃
translation: You will be filled with drunkenness and sorrow, with the cup of astonishment and desolation, with the cup of your sister Samaria. (Ezekiel 23:33)

text: מַבְלִיגִיתִי עֲלֵי יָגוֹן עָלַי לִבִּי דַוָּֽי׃
translation: Oh that I could comfort myself against sorrow! My heart is faint within me. (Jeremiah 8:18)

text: לָמָּה זֶּה מֵרֶחֶם יָצָאתִי לִרְאוֹת עָמָל וְיָגוֹן וַיִּכְלוּ בְּבֹשֶׁת יָמָֽי׃
translation: Why did I come out of the womb to see labor and sorrow, that my days should be consumed with shame? (Jeremiah 20:18)

text: וַיִּמְעֲטוּ וַיָּשֹׁחוּ מֵעֹצֶר רָעָה וְיָגֽוֹן׃
translation: Again, they are diminished and bowed down through oppression, trouble, and sorrow. (Psalms 107:39)

text: עַד אָנָה אָשִׁית עֵצוֹת בְּנַפְשִׁי יָגוֹן בִּלְבָבִי יוֹמָם עַד אָנָה יָרוּם אֹיְבִי עָלָֽי׃
translation: Behold, and answer me, LORD, my God. Give light to my eyes, lest I sleep in death; (Psalms 13:3)

text: וַיְחַפֵּשׂ בַּגָּדוֹל הֵחֵל וּבַקָּטֹן כִּלָּה וַיִּמָּצֵא הַגָּבִיעַ בְּאַמְתַּחַת בִּנְיָמִֽן׃
translation: He searched, beginning with the oldest, and ending at the youngest. The cup was found in Benjamin's sack. (Genesis 44:12)

text: וּבַמְּנֹרָה אַרְבָּעָה גְבִעִים מְשֻׁקָּדִים כַּפְתֹּרֶיהָ וּפְרָחֶֽיהָ׃
translation: and in the lamp stand four cups made like almond blossoms, its buds and its flowers; (Exodus 25:34)

text: וּבַמְּנֹרָה אַרְבָּעָה גְבִעִים מְשֻׁקָּדִים כַּפְתֹּרֶיהָ וּפְרָחֶֽיהָ׃
translation: In the lamp stand were four cups made like almond blossoms, its buds and its flowers; (Exodus 37:20)

text: וָאֶתֵּן לִפְנֵי בְּנֵי בֵית הָרֵכָבִים גְּבִעִים מְלֵאִים יַיִן וְכֹסוֹת וָאֹמַר אֲלֵיהֶם שְׁתוּ יָֽיִן׃
translation: I set before the sons of the house of the Rechabites bowls full of wine, and cups; and I said to them, "Drink wine!" (Jeremiah 35:5)

text: וְעָשִׂיתָ מְנֹרַת זָהָב טָהוֹר מִקְשָׁה תֵּעָשֶׂה הַמְּנוֹרָה יְרֵכָהּ וְקָנָהּ גְּבִיעֶיהָ כַּפְתֹּרֶיהָ וּפְרָחֶיהָ מִמֶּנָּה יִהְיֽוּ׃
translation: "You shall make a lamp stand of pure gold. The lamp stand shall be made of hammered work. Its base, its shaft, its cups, its buds, and its flowers shall be of one piece with it. (Exodus 25:31)

text: וְאֶת גְּבִיעִי גְּבִיעַ הַכֶּסֶף תָּשִׂים בְּפִי אַמְתַּחַת הַקָּטֹן וְאֵת כֶּסֶף שִׁבְרוֹ וַיַּעַשׂ כִּדְבַר יוֹסֵף אֲשֶׁר דִּבֵּֽר׃
translation: Put my cup, the silver cup, in the sack's mouth of the youngest, with his grain money." He did according to the word that Joseph had spoken. (Genesis 44:2)

text: לַיִשׁ אֹבֵד מִבְּלִי טָרֶף וּבְנֵי לָבִיא יִתְפָּרָֽדוּ׃
translation: The old lion perishes for lack of prey. The cubs of the lioness are scattered abroad. (Job 4:11)

text: כָּרַע שָׁכַב כַּאֲרִי וּכְלָבִיא מִי יְקִימֶנּוּ מְבָרֲכֶיךָ בָרוּךְ וְאֹרְרֶיךָ אָרֽוּר׃
translation: He couched, he lay down as a lion, as a lioness; who shall rouse him up? Everyone who blesses you is blessed. Everyone who curses you is cursed." (Numbers 24:9)

text: וְאָמַרְתָּ מָה אִמְּךָ לְבִיָּא בֵּין אֲרָיוֹת רָבָצָה בְּתוֹךְ כְּפִרִים רִבְּתָה גוּרֶֽיהָ׃
translation: and say, 'What was your mother? A lioness. She couched among lions, in the middle of the young lions she nourished her cubs. (Ezekiel 19:2)

text: גּוּר אַרְיֵה יְהוּדָה מִטֶּרֶף בְּנִי עָלִיתָ כָּרַע רָבַץ כְּאַרְיֵה וּכְלָבִיא מִי יְקִימֶֽנּוּ׃
translation: Judah is a lion's cub. From the prey, my son, you have gone up. He stooped down, he crouched as a lion, as a lioness. Who will rouse him up? (Genesis 49:9)

text: הֶן עָם כְּלָבִיא יָקוּם וְכַאֲרִי יִתְנַשָּׂא לֹא יִשְׁכַּב עַד יֹאכַל טֶרֶף וְדַם חֲלָלִים יִשְׁתֶּֽה׃
translation: Behold, a people rises up as a lioness. As a lion he lifts himself up. He shall not lie down until he eats of the prey, and drinks the blood of the slain." (Numbers 23:24)

text: כִּֽי גוֹי עָלָה עַל אַרְצִי עָצוּם וְאֵין מִסְפָּר שִׁנָּיו שִׁנֵּי אַרְיֵה וּֽמְתַלְּעוֹת לָבִיא לֽוֹ׃
translation: For a nation has come up on my land, strong, and without number. His teeth are the teeth of a lion, and he has the fangs of a lioness. (Joel 1:6)

text: וּבְכָל כְּרָמִים מִסְפֵּד כִּֽי אֶעֱבֹר בְּקִרְבְּךָ אָמַר יְהוָֽה׃
translation: In all vineyards there will be wailing, for I will pass through the middle of you," says the LORD. (Amos 5:17)

text: בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא יִגְדַּל הַמִּסְפֵּד בִּירוּשָׁלִַם כְּמִסְפַּד הֲדַדְ רִמּוֹן בְּבִקְעַת מְגִדּֽוֹן׃
translation: In that day there will be a great mourning in Jerusalem, like the mourning of Hadadrimmon in the valley of Megiddo. (Zechariah 12:11)

text: וְגַם עַתָּה נְאֻם יְהוָה שֻׁבוּ עָדַי בְּכָל לְבַבְכֶם וּבְצוֹם וּבְבְכִי וּבְמִסְפֵּֽד׃
translation: "Yet even now," says the LORD, "turn to me with all your heart, and with fasting, and with weeping, and with mourning." (Joel 2:12)

text: עַל כָּל גַּגּוֹת מוֹאָב וּבִרְחֹבֹתֶיהָ כֻּלֹּה מִסְפֵּד כִּֽי שָׁבַרְתִּי אֶת מוֹאָב כִּכְלִי אֵֽין חֵפֶץ בּוֹ נְאֻם יְהוָֽה׃
translation: On all the housetops of Moab, and in its streets, there is lamentation everywhere; for I have broken Moab like a vessel in which no one delights," says the LORD. (Jeremiah 48:38)

text: וּבְכָל מְדִינָה וּמְדִינָה מְקוֹם אֲשֶׁר דְּבַר הַמֶּלֶךְ וְדָתוֹ מַגִּיעַ אֵבֶל גָּדוֹל לַיְּהוּדִים וְצוֹם וּבְכִי וּמִסְפֵּד שַׂק וָאֵפֶר יֻצַּע לָֽרַבִּֽים׃
translation: In every province, wherever the king's commandment and his decree came, there was great mourning among the Jews, and fasting, and weeping, and wailing; and many lay in sackcloth and ashes. (Esther 4:3)

text: קִדַּמְתִּי בַנֶּשֶׁף וָאֲשַׁוֵּעָה לדבריך לִדְבָרְךָ יִחָֽלְתִּי׃
translation: I rise before dawn and cry for help. I put my hope in your words. (Psalms 119:147)

text: אִם שָׁכַבְתִּי וְאָמַרְתִּי מָתַי אָקוּם וּמִדַּד עָרֶב וְשָׂבַעְתִּי נְדֻדִים עֲדֵי נָֽשֶׁף׃
translation: When I lie down, I say, 'When will I arise, and the night be gone?' I toss and turn until the dawning of the day. (Job 7:4)

text: וְעֵין נֹאֵף שָׁמְרָֽה נֶשֶׁף לֵאמֹר לֹא תְשׁוּרֵנִי עָיִן וְסֵתֶר פָּנִים יָשִֽׂים׃
translation: The eye also of the adulterer waits for the twilight, saying, 'No eye will see me.' He disguises his face. (Job 24:15)

text: נְגַֽשְׁשָׁה כַֽעִוְרִים קִיר וּכְאֵין עֵינַיִם נְגַשֵּׁשָׁה כָּשַׁלְנוּ בַֽצָּהֳרַיִם כַּנֶּשֶׁף בָּאַשְׁמַנִּים כַּמֵּתִֽים׃
translation: We grope for the wall like the blind. Yes, we grope as those who have no eyes. We stumble at noon as if it were twilight. Among those who are strong, we are like dead men. (Isaiah 59:10)

text: וַיָּקוּמוּ בַנֶּשֶׁף לָבוֹא אֶל מַחֲנֵה אֲרָם וַיָּבֹאוּ עַד קְצֵה מַחֲנֵה אֲרָם וְהִנֵּה אֵֽין שָׁם אִֽישׁ׃
translation: They rose up in the twilight to go to the camp of the Syrians. When they had come to the outermost part of the camp of the Syrians, behold, no man was there. (2 Kings 7:5)

text: וַיָּקוּמוּ וַיָּנוּסוּ בַנֶּשֶׁף וַיַּעַזְבוּ אֶת אָהֳלֵיהֶם וְאֶת סֽוּסֵיהֶם וְאֶת חֲמֹרֵיהֶם הַֽמַּחֲנֶה כַּאֲשֶׁר הִיא וַיָּנֻסוּ אֶל נַפְשָֽׁם׃
translation: Therefore they arose and fled in the twilight, and left their tents, their horses, and their donkeys, even the camp as it was, and fled for their life. (2 Kings 7:7)

text: אֵלֶּה בִּקְשׁוּ כְתָבָם הַמִּתְיַחְשִׂים וְלֹא נִמְצָאוּ וַֽיְגֹאֲלוּ מִן הַכְּהֻנָּֽה׃
translation: These sought their place among those who were registered by genealogy, but they were not found; therefore they were deemed disqualified and removed from the priesthood. (Ezra 2:62)

text: אֵלֶּה בִּקְשׁוּ כְתָבָם הַמִּתְיַחְשִׂים וְלֹא נִמְצָא וַיְגֹֽאֲלוּ מִן הַכְּהֻנָּֽה׃
translation: These searched for their genealogical records, but couldn't find them. Therefore they were deemed disqualified and removed from the priesthood. (Nehemiah 7:64)

text: זָכְרָה לָהֶם אֱלֹהָי עַל גָּאֳלֵי הַכְּהֻנָּה וּבְרִית הַכְּהֻנָּה וְהַלְוִיִּֽם׃
translation: Remember them, my God, because they have defiled the priesthood and the covenant of the priesthood and of the Levites. (Nehemiah 13:29)

text: וְאֶת אַהֲרֹן וְאֶת בָּנָיו תִּפְקֹד וְשָׁמְרוּ אֶת כְּהֻנָּתָם וְהַזָּר הַקָּרֵב יוּמָֽת׃
translation: You shall appoint Aaron and his sons, and they shall keep their priesthood, but the stranger who comes near shall be put to death." (Numbers 3:10)

text: וַיַּקְרֵב אֹֽתְךָ וְאֶת כָּל אַחֶיךָ בְנֵי לֵוִי אִתָּךְ וּבִקַּשְׁתֶּם גַּם כְּהֻנָּֽה׃
translation: and that he has brought you near, and all your brothers the sons of Levi with you? Do you seek the priesthood also? (Numbers 16:10)

text: וּמָשַׁחְתָּ אֹתָם כַּאֲשֶׁר מָשַׁחְתָּ אֶת אֲבִיהֶם וְכִהֲנוּ לִי וְהָיְתָה לִהְיֹת לָהֶם מָשְׁחָתָם לִכְהֻנַּת עוֹלָם לְדֹרֹתָֽם׃
translation: You shall anoint them, as you anointed their father, that they may minister to me in the priest's office. Their anointing shall be to them for an everlasting priesthood throughout their generations." (Exodus 40:15)

text: וַיִּֽתְנַצְּלוּ בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת עֶדְיָם מֵהַר חוֹרֵֽב׃
translation: The children of Israel stripped themselves of their jewelry from Mount Horeb onward. (Exodus 33:6)

text: הַמַּשְׂבִּיַע בַּטּוֹב עֶדְיֵךְ תִּתְחַדֵּשׁ כַּנֶּשֶׁר נְעוּרָֽיְכִי׃
translation: who satisfies your desire with good things, so that your youth is renewed like the eagle's. (Psalms 103:5)

text: הֲתִשְׁכַּח בְּתוּלָה עֶדְיָהּ כַּלָּה קִשֻּׁרֶיהָ וְעַמִּי שְׁכֵחוּנִי יָמִים אֵין מִסְפָּֽר׃
translation: "Can a virgin forget her ornaments, or a bride her attire? Yet my people have forgotten me for days without number. (Jeremiah 2:32)

text: וַיִּשְׁמַע הָעָם אֶת הַדָּבָר הָרָע הַזֶּה וַיִּתְאַבָּלוּ וְלֹא שָׁתוּ אִישׁ עֶדְיוֹ עָלָֽיו׃
translation: When the people heard this evil news, they mourned; and no one put on his jewelry. (Exodus 33:4)

text: אַל תִּֽהְיוּ כְּסוּס כְּפֶרֶד אֵין הָבִין בְּמֶֽתֶג וָרֶסֶן עֶדְיוֹ לִבְלוֹם בַּל קְרֹב אֵלֶֽיךָ׃
translation: Don't be like the horse, or like the mule, which have no understanding, who are controlled by bit and bridle, or else they will not come near to you. (Psalms 32:9)

text: בְּנוֹת יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל שָׁאוּל בְּכֶינָה הַמַּלְבִּֽשְׁכֶם שָׁנִי עִם עֲדָנִים הַֽמַּעֲלֶה עֲדִי זָהָב עַל לְבוּשְׁכֶֽן׃
translation: You daughters of Israel, weep over Saul, who clothed you delicately in scarlet, who put ornaments of gold on your clothing. (2 Samuel 1:24)

text: כִּֽי כִסָּה פָנָיו בְּחֶלְבּוֹ וַיַּעַשׂ פִּימָה עֲלֵי כָֽסֶל׃
translation: because he has covered his face with his fatness, and gathered fat on his thighs. (Job 15:27)

text: זֶה דַרְכָּם כֵּסֶל לָמוֹ וְאַחֲרֵיהֶם בְּפִיהֶם יִרְצוּ סֶֽלָה׃
translation: They are appointed as a flock for Sheol. Death shall be their shepherd. The upright shall have dominion over them in the morning. Their beauty shall decay in Sheol, far from their mansion. (Psalms 49:14)

text: וְיָשִׂימוּ בֵֽאלֹהִים כִּסְלָם וְלֹא יִשְׁכְּחוּ מַֽעַלְלֵי אֵל וּמִצְוֺתָיו יִנְצֹֽרוּ׃
translation: that they might set their hope in God, and not forget God's deeds, but keep his commandments, (Psalms 78:7)

text: כִּֽי יְהוָה יִהְיֶה בְכִסְלֶךָ וְשָׁמַר רַגְלְךָ מִלָּֽכֶד׃
translation: for the LORD will be your confidence, and will keep your foot from being taken. (Proverbs 3:26)

text: וּבְאַחַת יִבְעֲרוּ וְיִכְסָלוּ מוּסַר הֲבָלִים עֵץ הֽוּא׃
translation: But they are together brutish and foolish, instructed by idols! It is just wood. (Jeremiah 10:8)

text: אֲשֶׁר יָקוֹט כִּסְלוֹ וּבֵית עַכָּבִישׁ מִבְטַחֽוֹ׃
translation: whose confidence will break apart, whose trust is a spider's web. (Job 8:14)

text: לִפְעֻלּוֹת אָדָם בִּדְבַר שְׂפָתֶיךָ אֲנִי שָׁמַרְתִּי אָרְחוֹת פָּרִֽיץ׃
translation: As for the deeds of men, by the word of your lips, I have kept myself from the ways of the violent. (Psalms 17:4)

text: רָשָׁע עֹשֶׂה פְעֻלַּת שָׁקֶר וְזֹרֵעַ צְדָקָה שֶׂכֶר אֱמֶֽת׃
translation: Wicked people earn deceitful wages, but one who sows righteousness reaps a sure reward. (Proverbs 11:18)

text: וְאַתֶּם חִזְקוּ וְאַל יִרְפּוּ יְדֵיכֶם כִּי יֵשׁ שָׂכָר לִפְעֻלַּתְכֶֽם׃
translation: But you be strong! Don't let your hands be slack, for your work will be rewarded." (2 Chronicles 15:7)

text: זֹאת פְּעֻלַּת שֹׂטְנַי מֵאֵת יְהוָה וְהַדֹּבְרִים רָע עַל נַפְשִֽׁי׃
translation: This is the reward of my adversaries from the LORD, of those who speak evil against my soul. (Psalms 109:20)

text: פְּעֻלַּת צַדִּיק לְחַיִּים תְּבוּאַת רָשָׁע לְחַטָּֽאת׃
translation: The labor of the righteous leads to life. The increase of the wicked leads to sin. (Proverbs 10:16)

text: כִּי לֹא יָבִינוּ אֶל פְּעֻלֹּת יְהוָה וְאֶל מַעֲשֵׂה יָדָיו יֶהֶרְסֵם וְלֹא יִבְנֵֽם׃
translation: Because they don't respect the works of the LORD, nor the operation of his hands, he will break them down and not build them up. (Psalms 28:5)

text: שָׁלוֹם רָב לְאֹהֲבֵי תוֹרָתֶךָ וְאֵֽין לָמוֹ מִכְשֽׁוֹל׃
translation: Those who love your law have great peace. Nothing causes them to stumble. (Psalms 119:165)

text: וְאָמַר סֹֽלּוּ סֹלּוּ פַּנּוּ דָרֶךְ הָרִימוּ מִכְשׁוֹל מִדֶּרֶךְ עַמִּֽי׃
translation: He will say, "Build up, build up, prepare the way! Remove the stumbling-block out of the way of my people." (Isaiah 57:14)

text: לֹא תְקַלֵּל חֵרֵשׁ וְלִפְנֵי עִוֵּר לֹא תִתֵּן מִכְשֹׁל וְיָרֵאתָ מֵּאֱלֹהֶיךָ אֲנִי יְהוָֽה׃
translation: "'You shall not curse the deaf, nor put a stumbling block before the blind; but you shall fear your God. I am the LORD. (Leviticus 19:14)

text: וְהָיָה לְמִקְדָּשׁ וּלְאֶבֶן נֶגֶף וּלְצוּר מִכְשׁוֹל לִשְׁנֵי בָתֵּי יִשְׂרָאֵל לְפַח וּלְמוֹקֵשׁ לְיוֹשֵׁב יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
translation: He will be a sanctuary, but for both houses of Israel, he will be a stumbling stone and a rock that makes them fall. For the people of Jerusalem, he will be a trap and a snare. (Isaiah 8:14)

text: בֶּן אָדָם הָאֲנָשִׁים הָאֵלֶּה הֶעֱלוּ גִלּֽוּלֵיהֶם עַל לִבָּם וּמִכְשׁוֹל עֲוֺנָם נָתְנוּ נֹכַח פְּנֵיהֶם הַאִדָּרֹשׁ אִדָּרֵשׁ לָהֶֽם׃
translation: "Son of man, these men have taken their idols into their heart, and put the stumbling block of their iniquity before their face. Should I be inquired of at all by them? (Ezekiel 14:3)

text: לְמַעַן לָמוּג לֵב וְהַרְבֵּה הַמִּכְשֹׁלִים עַל כָּל שַׁעֲרֵיהֶם נָתַתִּי אִבְחַת חָרֶב אָח עֲשׂוּיָה לְבָרָק מְעֻטָּה לְטָֽבַח׃
translation: You shall appoint a way for the sword to come to Rabbah of the children of Ammon, and to Judah in Jerusalem the fortified. (Ezekiel 21:20)

text: אַחֲרֵי נִמְכַּר גְּאֻלָּה תִּהְיֶה לּוֹ אֶחָד מֵאֶחָיו יִגְאָלֶֽנּוּ׃
translation: after he is sold he may be redeemed. One of his brothers may redeem him; (Leviticus 25:48)

text: וְעָרֵי הַלְוִיִּם בָּתֵּי עָרֵי אֲחֻזָּתָם גְּאֻלַּת עוֹלָם תִּהְיֶה לַלְוִיִּֽם׃
translation: "'Nevertheless, in the cities of the Levites, the Levites may redeem the houses in the cities of their possession at any time. (Leviticus 25:32)

text: אִם עוֹד רַבּוֹת בַּשָּׁנִים לְפִיהֶן יָשִׁיב גְּאֻלָּתוֹ מִכֶּסֶף מִקְנָתֽוֹ׃
translation: If there are yet many years, according to them he shall give back the price of his redemption out of the money that he was bought for. (Leviticus 25:51)

text: וּבְכֹל אֶרֶץ אֲחֻזַּתְכֶם גְּאֻלָּה תִּתְּנוּ לָאָֽרֶץ׃
translation: In all the land of your possession you shall grant a redemption for the land. (Leviticus 25:24)

text: וְאִישׁ כִּי לֹא יִֽהְיֶה לּוֹ גֹּאֵל וְהִשִּׂיגָה יָדוֹ וּמָצָא כְּדֵי גְאֻלָּתֽוֹ׃
translation: If a man has no one to redeem it, and he becomes prosperous and finds sufficient means to redeem it, (Leviticus 25:26)

text: וְאִם מְעַט נִשְׁאַר בַּשָּׁנִים עַד שְׁנַת הַיֹּבֵל וְחִשַּׁב לוֹ כְּפִי שָׁנָיו יָשִׁיב אֶת גְּאֻלָּתֽוֹ׃
translation: If there remain but a few years to the year of jubilee, then he shall reckon with him; according to his years of service he shall give back the price of his redemption. (Leviticus 25:52)

text: הוֹכֵחַ בְּדָבָר לֹא יִסְכּוֹן וּמִלִּים לֹא יוֹעִיל בָּֽם׃
translation: Should he reason with unprofitable talk, or with speeches with which he can do no good? (Job 15:3)

text: כִּֽי אָמַר לֹא יִסְכָּן גָּבֶר בִּרְצֹתוֹ עִם אֱלֹהִֽים׃
translation: For he has said, 'It profits a man nothing that he should delight himself with God.' (Job 34:9)

text: כִּֽי תֹאמַר מַה יִּסְכָּן לָךְ מָֽה אֹעִיל מֵֽחַטָּאתִֽי׃
translation: that you ask, 'What advantage will it be to you? What profit will I have, more than if I had sinned?' (Job 35:3)

text: מַסִּיעַ אֲבָנִים יֵעָצֵב בָּהֶם בּוֹקֵעַ עֵצִים יִסָּכֶן בָּֽם׃
translation: Whoever carves out stones may be injured by them. Whoever splits wood may be endangered by it. (Ecclesiastes 10:9)

text: הַלְאֵל יִסְכָּן גָּבֶר כִּֽי יִסְכֹּן עָלֵימוֹ מַשְׂכִּֽיל׃
translation: "Can a man be profitable to God? Surely he who is wise is profitable to himself. (Job 22:2)

text: הַסְכֶּן נָא עִמּוֹ וּשְׁלם בָּהֶם תְּֽבוֹאַתְךָ טוֹבָֽה׃
translation: "Acquaint yourself with him now, and be at peace. By it, good will come to you. (Job 22:21)

text: וְשָׁתוּ וְהִֽתְגֹּֽעֲשׁוּ וְהִתְהֹלָלוּ מִפְּנֵי הַחֶרֶב אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי שֹׁלֵחַ בֵּינֹתָֽם׃
translation: They will drink, and reel back and forth, and be insane, because of the sword that I will send among them." (Jeremiah 25:16)

text: מִי זֶה כַּיְאֹר יַֽעֲלֶה כַּנְּהָרוֹת יִֽתְגָּעֲשׁוּ מֵימָֽיו׃
translation: "Who is this who rises up like the Nile, like rivers whose waters surge? (Jeremiah 46:7)

text: וַתִּגְעַשׁ וַתִּרְעַשׁ הָאָרֶץ וּמוֹסְדֵי הָרִים יִרְגָּזוּ וַיִּתְגָּֽעֲשׁוּ כִּי חָרָה לֽוֹ׃
translation: Smoke went out of his nostrils. Consuming fire came out of his mouth. Coals were kindled by it. (Psalms 18:8)

text: ותגעש וַיִּתְגָּעַשׁ וַתִּרְעַשׁ הָאָרֶץ מוֹסְדוֹת הַשָּׁמַיִם יִרְגָּזוּ וַיִּֽתְגָּעֲשׁוּ כִּֽי חָרָה לֽוֹ׃
translation: Then the earth shook and trembled. The foundations of heaven quaked and were shaken, because he was angry. (2 Samuel 22:8)

text: בְּנָיָהוּ פִּרְעָתֹנִי הִדַּי מִנַּחֲלֵי גָֽעַשׁ׃
translation: Benaiah a Pirathonite, Hiddai of the brooks of Gaash. (2 Samuel 23:30)

text: חוּרַי מִנַּחֲלֵי גָעַשׁ אֲבִיאֵל הָעַרְבָתִֽי׃
translation: Hurai of the brooks of Gaash, Abiel the Arbathite, (1 Chronicles 11:32)

text: נֹתֵן לַיָּעֵף כֹּחַ וּלְאֵין אוֹנִים עָצְמָה יַרְבֶּֽה׃
translation: He gives power to the weak. He increases the strength of him who has no might. (Isaiah 40:29)

text: וְיִֽעֲפוּ נְעָרִים וְיִגָעוּ וּבַחוּרִים כָּשׁוֹל יִכָּשֵֽׁלוּ׃
translation: Even the youths faint and get weary, and the young men utterly fall; (Isaiah 40:30)

text: וְקוֹיֵ יְהוָה יַחֲלִיפוּ כֹחַ יַעֲלוּ אֵבֶר כַּנְּשָׁרִים יָרוּצוּ וְלֹא יִיגָעוּ יֵלְכוּ וְלֹא יִיעָֽפוּ׃
translation: but those who wait for the LORD will renew their strength. They will mount up with wings like eagles. They will run, and not be weary. They will walk, and not faint. (Isaiah 40:31)

text: הֲלוֹא הִנֵּה מֵאֵת יְהוָה צְבָאוֹת וְיִֽיגְעוּ עַמִּים בְּדֵי אֵשׁ וּלְאֻמִּים בְּדֵי רִיק יִעָֽפוּ׃
translation: Behold, isn't it from the LORD of Armies that the peoples labor for the fire, and the nations weary themselves for vanity? (Habakkuk 2:13)

text: פֶּרֶה לִמֻּד מִדְבָּר בְּאַוַּת נפשו נַפְשָׁהּ שָׁאֲפָה רוּחַ תַּאֲנָתָהּ מִי יְשִׁיבֶנָּה כָּל מְבַקְשֶׁיהָ לֹא יִיעָפוּ בְּחָדְשָׁהּ יִמְצָאֽוּנְהָ׃
translation: a wild donkey used to the wilderness, that sniffs the wind in her craving. When she is in heat, who can turn her away? All those who seek her will not weary themselves. In her month, they will find her. (Jeremiah 2:24)

text: וְעוֹד אֲנִי מְדַבֵּר בַּתְּפִלָּה וְהָאִישׁ גַּבְרִיאֵל אֲשֶׁר רָאִיתִי בֶחָזוֹן בַּתְּחִלָּה מֻעָף בִּיעָף נֹגֵעַ אֵלַי כְּעֵת מִנְחַת עָֽרֶב׃
translation: yes, while I was speaking in prayer—the man Gabriel, whom I had seen in the vision at the beginning, being caused to fly swiftly, touched me about the time of the evening offering. (Daniel 9:21)

text: מִֽי יִתֵּן תָּבוֹא שֶֽׁאֱלָתִי וְתִקְוָתִי יִתֵּן אֱלֽוֹהַּ׃
translation: "Oh that I might have my request, that God would grant the thing that I long for, (Job 6:8)

text: וַיִּתֵּן לָהֶם שֶׁאֱלָתָם וַיְשַׁלַּח רָזוֹן בְּנַפְשָֽׁם׃
translation: He gave them their request, but sent leanness into their soul. (Psalms 106:15)

text: אֶל הַנַּעַר הַזֶּה הִתְפַּלָּלְתִּי וַיִּתֵּן יְהוָה לִי אֶת שְׁאֵלָתִי אֲשֶׁר שָׁאַלְתִּי מֵעִמּֽוֹ׃
translation: I prayed for this child, and the LORD has given me my petition which I asked of him. (1 Samuel 1:27)

text: וַיַּעַן עֵלִי וַיֹּאמֶר לְכִי לְשָׁלוֹם וֵאלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל יִתֵּן אֶת שֵׁלָתֵךְ אֲשֶׁר שָׁאַלְתְּ מֵעִמּֽוֹ׃
translation: Then Eli answered, "Go in peace; and may the God of Israel grant your petition that you have asked of him." (1 Samuel 1:17)

text: וְעַתָּה שְׁאֵלָה אַחַת אָֽנֹכִי שֹׁאֵל מֵֽאִתָּךְ אַל תָּשִׁבִי אֶת פָּנָי וַתֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו דַּבֵּֽר׃
translation: Now I ask one petition of you. Don't deny me." She said to him, "Say on." (1 Kings 2:16)

text: כִּֽי יִפֹּל לֹֽא יוּטָל כִּֽי יְהוָה סוֹמֵךְ יָדֽוֹ׃
translation: Though he stumble, he shall not fall, for the LORD holds him up with his hand. (Psalms 37:24)

text: הֵן תֹּחַלְתּוֹ נִכְזָבָה הֲגַם אֶל מַרְאָיו יֻטָֽל׃
translation: "Can you draw out Leviathan with a fish hook, or press down his tongue with a cord? (Job 41:1)

text: בַּחֵיק יוּטַל אֶת הַגּוֹרָל וּמֵיְהוָה כָּל מִשְׁפָּטֽוֹ׃
translation: The lot is cast into the lap, but its every decision is from the LORD. (Proverbs 16:33)

text: הִנֵּה יְהוָה מְטַלְטֶלְךָ טַלְטֵלָה גָּבֶר וְעֹטְךָ עָטֹֽה׃
translation: Behold, the LORD will overcome you and hurl you away violently. Yes, he will grasp you firmly. (Isaiah 22:17)

text: וַיָּטֶל שָׁאוּל אֶֽת הַחֲנִית וַיֹּאמֶר אַכֶּה בְדָוִד וּבַקִּיר וַיִּסֹּב דָּוִד מִפָּנָיו פַּעֲמָֽיִם׃
translation: and Saul threw the spear, for he said, "I will pin David to the wall!" David escaped from his presence twice. (1 Samuel 18:11)

text: וַֽיהוָה הֵטִיל רֽוּחַ גְּדוֹלָה אֶל הַיָּם וַיְהִי סַֽעַר גָּדוֹל בַּיָּם וְהָאֳנִיָּה חִשְּׁבָה לְהִשָּׁבֵֽר׃
translation: But the LORD sent out a great wind on the sea, and there was a mighty storm on the sea, so that the ship was likely to break up. (Jonah 1:4)

text: וָאֶקְנֶה אֶת הָאֵזוֹר כִּדְבַר יְהוָה וָאָשִׂם עַל מָתְנָֽי׃
translation: So I bought a belt according to the LORD's word, and put it on my waist. (Jeremiah 13:2)

text: וְהָיָה צֶדֶק אֵזוֹר מָתְנָיו וְהָאֱמוּנָה אֵזוֹר חֲלָצָֽיו׃
translation: Righteousness will be the belt around his waist, and faithfulness the belt around his waist. (Isaiah 11:5)

text: מוּסַר מְלָכִים פִּתֵּחַ וַיֶּאְסֹר אֵזוֹר בְּמָתְנֵיהֶֽם׃
translation: He loosens the bond of kings. He binds their waist with a belt. (Job 12:18)

text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֵלָיו אִישׁ בַּעַל שֵׂעָר וְאֵזוֹר עוֹר אָזוּר בְּמָתְנָיו וַיֹּאמַר אֵלִיָּה הַתִּשְׁבִּי הֽוּא׃
translation: They answered him, "He was a hairy man, and wearing a leather belt around his waist." He said, "It's Elijah the Tishbite." (2 Kings 1:8)

text: כֹּֽה אָמַר יְהוָה אֵלַי הָלוֹךְ וְקָנִיתָ לְּךָ אֵזוֹר פִּשְׁתִּים וְשַׂמְתּוֹ עַל מָתְנֶיךָ וּבַמַּיִם לֹא תְבִאֵֽהוּ׃
translation: The LORD said to me, "Go, and buy yourself a linen belt, and put it on your waist, and don't put it in water." (Jeremiah 13:1)

text: קַח אֶת הָאֵזוֹר אֲשֶׁר קָנִיתָ אֲשֶׁר עַל מָתְנֶיךָ וְקוּם לֵךְ פְּרָתָה וְטָמְנֵהוּ שָׁם בִּנְקִיק הַסָּֽלַע׃
translation: "Take the belt that you have bought, which is on your waist, and arise, go to the Euphrates, and hide it there in a cleft of the rock." (Jeremiah 13:4)

text: אֱדַיִן גֻּבְרַיָּא אִלֵּךְ הַרְגִּשׁוּ וְהַשְׁכַּחוּ לְדָנִיֵּאל בָּעֵא וּמִתְחַנַּן קֳדָם אֱלָהֵֽהּ׃
translation: Then they came near, and spoke before the king concerning the king's decree: "Haven't you signed a decree that every man who makes a petition to any god or man within thirty days, except to you, O king, shall be cast into the den of lions?" The king answered, "This thing is true, according to the law of the Medes and Persians, which doesn't alter." (Daniel 6:12)

text: בֵּאדַיִן נְבוּכַדְנֶצַּר בִּרְגַז וַחֲמָה אֲמַר לְהַיְתָיָה לְשַׁדְרַךְ מֵישַׁךְ וַעֲבֵד נְגוֹ בֵּאדַיִן גֻּבְרַיָּא אִלֵּךְ הֵיתָיוּ קֳדָם מַלְכָּֽא׃
translation: Then Nebuchadnezzar in rage and fury commanded that Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego be brought. Then these men were brought before the king. (Daniel 3:13)

text: אֱדַיִן גֻּבְרַיָּא אִלֵּךְ אָֽמְרִין דִּי לָא נְהַשְׁכַּח לְדָנִיֵּאל דְּנָה כָּל עִלָּא לָהֵן הַשְׁכַּחְנָֽה עֲלוֹהִי בְּדָת אֱלָהֵֽהּ׃
translation: Then these presidents and local governors assembled together to the king, and said this to him, "King Darius, live forever! (Daniel 6:6)

text: תִּתְקְפֵהוּ לָנֶצַח וַֽיַּהֲלֹךְ מְשַׁנֶּה פָנָיו וַֽתְּשַׁלְּחֵֽהוּ׃
translation: You forever prevail against him, and he departs. You change his face, and send him away. (Job 14:20)

text: מַה שֶּֽׁהָיָה כְּבָר נִקְרָא שְׁמוֹ וְנוֹדָע אֲשֶׁר הוּא אָדָם וְלֹא יוּכַל לָדִין עִם שהתקיף שֶׁתַּקִּיף מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃
translation: Whatever has been, its name was given long ago; and it is known what man is; neither can he contend with him who is mightier than he. (Ecclesiastes 6:10)

text: וְיָשֵׂם פָּנָיו לָבוֹא בְּתֹקֶף כָּל מַלְכוּתוֹ וִישָׁרִים עִמּוֹ וְעָשָׂה וּבַת הַנָּשִׁים יִתֶּן לוֹ לְהַשְׁחִיתָהּ וְלֹא תַעֲמֹד וְלֹא לוֹ תִהְיֶֽה׃
translation: He will set his face to come with the strength of his whole kingdom, and with him equitable conditions. He will perform them. He will give him the daughter of women, to destroy the kingdom, but she will not stand, and won't be for him. (Daniel 11:17)

text: וְכָל מַעֲשֵׂה תָקְפּוֹ וּגְבוּרָתוֹ וּפָרָשַׁת גְּדֻלַּת מָרְדֳּכַי אֲשֶׁר גִּדְּלוֹ הַמֶּלֶךְ הֲלוֹא הֵם כְּתוּבִים עַל סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי מָדַי וּפָרָֽס׃
translation: Aren't all the acts of his power and of his might, and the full account of the greatness of Mordecai, to which the king advanced him, written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Media and Persia? (Esther 10:2)

text: שִׁמְעוּ זֹאת הַשֹּׁאֲפִים אֶבְיוֹן וְלַשְׁבִּית ענוי עֲנִיֵּי אָֽרֶץ׃
translation: Hear this, you who desire to swallow up the needy, and cause the poor of the land to fail, (Amos 8:4)

text: חָנֵּנִי אֱלֹהִים כִּֽי שְׁאָפַנִי אֱנוֹשׁ כָּל הַיּוֹם לֹחֵם יִלְחָצֵֽנִי׃
translation: My enemies want to swallow me up all day long, for they are many who fight proudly against me. (Psalms 56:2)

text: אֲשֶׁר קְצִירוֹ רָעֵב יֹאכֵל וְאֶֽל מִצִּנִּים יִקָּחֵהוּ וְשָׁאַף צַמִּים חֵילָֽם׃
translation: whose harvest the hungry eat up, and take it even out of the thorns. The snare gapes for their substance. (Job 5:5)

text: כְּעֶבֶד יִשְׁאַף צֵל וּכְשָׂכִיר יְקַוֶּה פָעֳלֽוֹ׃
translation: As a servant who earnestly desires the shadow, as a hireling who looks for his wages, (Job 7:2)

text: אַל תִּשְׁאַף הַלָּיְלָה לַעֲלוֹת עַמִּים תַּחְתָּֽם׃
translation: Don't desire the night, when people are cut off in their place. (Job 36:20)

text: יִשְׁלַח מִשָּׁמַיִם וְֽיוֹשִׁיעֵנִי חֵרֵף שֹׁאֲפִי סֶלָה יִשְׁלַח אֱלֹהִים חַסְדּוֹ וַאֲמִתּֽוֹ׃
translation: My soul is among lions. I lie among those who are set on fire, even the sons of men, whose teeth are spears and arrows, and their tongue a sharp sword. (Psalms 57:4)

text: אֶֽזְכְּרָה נְגִינָתִי בַּלָּיְלָה עִם לְבָבִי אָשִׂיחָה וַיְחַפֵּשׂ רוּחִֽי׃
translation: "Will the Lord reject us forever? Will he be favorable no more? (Psalms 77:7)

text: יָשִׂיחוּ בִי יֹשְׁבֵי שָׁעַר וּנְגִינוֹת שׁוֹתֵי שֵׁכָֽר׃
translation: But as for me, my prayer is to you, LORD, in an acceptable time. God, in the abundance of your loving kindness, answer me in the truth of your salvation. (Psalms 69:13)

text: וְעַתָּה נְגִינָתָם הָיִיתִי וָאֱהִי לָהֶם לְמִלָּֽה׃
translation: "Now I have become their song. Yes, I am a byword to them. (Job 30:9)

text: לַמְנַצֵּחַ בִּנְגִינוֹת עַֽל הַשְּׁמִינִית מִזְמוֹר לְדָוִֽד׃
translation: For the Chief Musician; on stringed instruments, upon the eight-stringed lyre. A Psalm by David. LORD, don't rebuke me in your anger, neither discipline me in your wrath. (Psalms 6:1)

text: לַמְנַצֵּחַ בִּנְגִינֹת מִזְמוֹר לְאָסָף שִֽׁיר׃
translation: For the Chief Musician. On stringed instruments. A Psalm by Asaph. A song. In Judah, God is known. His name is great in Israel. (Psalms 76:1)

text: זְקֵנִים מִשַּׁעַר שָׁבָתוּ בַּחוּרִים מִנְּגִינָתָֽם׃
translation: The elders have ceased from the gate, and the young men from their music. (Lamentations 5:14)

text: יָפִיחַ כְּזָבִים עֵד שָׁקֶר וּמְשַׁלֵּחַ מְדָנִים בֵּין אַחִֽים׃
translation: a false witness who utters lies, and he who sows discord among brothers. (Proverbs 6:19)

text: עֵד אֱמוּנִים לֹא יְכַזֵּב וְיָפִיחַ כְּזָבִים עֵד שָֽׁקֶר׃
translation: A truthful witness will not lie, but a false witness pours out lies. (Proverbs 14:5)

text: עֵד שְׁקָרִים לֹא יִנָּקֶה וְיָפִיחַ כְּזָבִים לֹא יִמָּלֵֽט׃
translation: A false witness shall not be unpunished. He who pours out lies shall not go free. (Proverbs 19:5)

text: יָפִיחַ אֱמוּנָה יַגִּיד צֶדֶק וְעֵד שְׁקָרִים מִרְמָֽה׃
translation: He who is truthful testifies honestly, but a false witness lies. (Proverbs 12:17)

text: מַצִּיל נְפָשׁוֹת עֵד אֱמֶת וְיָפִחַ כְּזָבִים מִרְמָֽה׃
translation: A truthful witness saves souls, but a false witness is deceitful. (Proverbs 14:25)

text: עֵד שְׁקָרִים לֹא יִנָּקֶה וְיָפִיחַ כְּזָבִים יֹאבֵֽד׃
translation: A false witness shall not be unpunished. He who utters lies shall perish. (Proverbs 19:9)

text: עֲנוֹ תִנְיָנוּת וְאָמְרִין מַלְכָּא חֶלְמָא יֵאמַר לְעַבְדוֹהִי וּפִשְׁרָה נְהַחֲוֵֽה׃
translation: They answered the second time and said, "Let the king tell his servants the dream, and we will show the interpretation." (Daniel 2:7)

text: וְדָנִיֵּאל עַל וּבְעָה מִן מַלְכָּא דִּי זְמָן יִנְתֵּן לֵהּ וּפִשְׁרָא לְהַֽחֲוָיָה לְמַלְכָּֽא׃
translation: Daniel went in, and desired of the king that he would appoint him a time, and he would show the king the interpretation. (Daniel 2:16)

text: וַֽיְדַבְּרוּ הַכַּשְׂדִּים לַמֶּלֶךְ אֲרָמִית מַלְכָּא לְעָלְמִין חֱיִי אֱמַר חֶלְמָא לעבדיך לְעַבְדָךְ וּפִשְׁרָא נְחַוֵּֽא׃
translation: Then the Chaldeans spoke to the king in the Syrian language, "O king, live forever! Tell your servants the dream, and we will show the interpretation." (Daniel 2:4)

text: וְהֵן חֶלְמָא וּפִשְׁרֵהּ תְּֽהַחֲוֺן מַתְּנָן וּנְבִזְבָּה וִיקָר שַׂגִּיא תְּקַבְּלוּן מִן קֳדָמָי לָהֵן חֶלְמָא וּפִשְׁרֵהּ הַחֲוֺֽנִי׃
translation: But if you show the dream and its interpretation, you will receive from me gifts, rewards, and great honor. Therefore show me the dream and its interpretation." (Daniel 2:6)

text: כָּל קֳבֵל דְּנָה מַלְכָּא בְּנַס וּקְצַף שַׂגִּיא וַאֲמַר לְהוֹבָדָה לְכֹל חַכִּימֵי בָבֶֽל׃
translation: Because of this, the king was angry and very furious, and commanded that all the wise men of Babylon be destroyed. (Daniel 2:12)

text: וּמִנִּי שִׂים טְעֵם לְהַנְעָלָה קָֽדָמַי לְכֹל חַכִּימֵי בָבֶל דִּֽי פְשַׁר חֶלְמָא יְהֽוֹדְעֻנַּֽנִי׃
translation: How great are his signs! How mighty are his wonders! His kingdom is an everlasting kingdom. His dominion is from generation to generation. (Daniel 4:3)

text: אֱדַיִן עללין עָֽלִּין כֹּל חַכִּימֵי מַלְכָּא וְלָֽא כָהֲלִין כְּתָבָא לְמִקְרֵא ופשרא וּפִשְׁרֵהּ לְהוֹדָעָה לְמַלְכָּֽא׃
translation: Then all the king's wise men came in; but they could not read the writing, and couldn't make known to the king the interpretation. (Daniel 5:8)

text: וְדִינָא יִתִּב וְשָׁלְטָנֵהּ יְהַעְדּוֹן לְהַשְׁמָדָה וּלְהוֹבָדָה עַד סוֹפָֽא׃
translation: "'But the judgment will be set, and they will take away his dominion, to consume and to destroy it to the end. (Daniel 7:26)

text: וּשְׁאָר חֵֽיוָתָא הֶעְדִּיו שָׁלְטָנְהוֹן וְאַרְכָה בְחַיִּין יְהִיבַת לְהוֹן עַד זְמַן וְעִדָּֽן׃
translation: As for the rest of the animals, their dominion was taken away; yet their lives were prolonged for a season and a time. (Daniel 7:12)

text: אנתה אַנְתְּ הוּא מַלְכָּא דִּי רְבַית וּתְקֵפְתְּ וּרְבוּתָךְ רְבָת וּמְטָת לִשְׁמַיָּא וְשָׁלְטָנָךְ לְסוֹף אַרְעָֽא׃
translation: Then Daniel, whose name was Belteshazzar, was stricken mute for a while, and his thoughts troubled him. The king answered, "Belteshazzar, don't let the dream or the interpretation, trouble you." Belteshazzar answered, "My lord, may the dream be for those who hate you, and its interpretation to your adversaries. (Daniel 4:19)

text: וּמַלְכוּתָה וְשָׁלְטָנָא וּרְבוּתָא דִּי מַלְכְוָת תְּחוֹת כָּל שְׁמַיָּא יְהִיבַת לְעַם קַדִּישֵׁי עֶלְיוֹנִין מַלְכוּתֵהּ מַלְכוּת עָלַם וְכֹל שָׁלְטָנַיָּא לֵהּ יִפְלְחוּן וְיִֽשְׁתַּמְּעֽוּן׃
translation: The kingdom and the dominion, and the greatness of the kingdoms under the whole sky, will be given to the people of the saints of the Most High. His kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and all dominions will serve and obey him.' (Daniel 7:27)

text: אַךְ מַעְיָן וּבוֹר מִקְוֵה מַיִם יִהְיֶה טָהוֹר וְנֹגֵעַ בְּנִבְלָתָם יִטְמָֽא׃
translation: Nevertheless a spring or a cistern in which water is gathered shall be clean, but that which touches their carcass shall be unclean. (Leviticus 11:36)

text: וּמוֹצָא הַסּוּסִים אֲשֶׁר לִשְׁלֹמֹה מִמִּצְרָיִם וּמִקְוֵה סֹחֲרֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ יִקְחוּ מִקְוֵה בִּמְחִֽיר׃
translation: The horses which Solomon had were brought out of Egypt. The king's merchants received them in droves, each drove at a price. (1 Kings 10:28)

text: וּמוֹצָא הַסּוּסִים אֲשֶׁר לִשְׁלֹמֹה מִמִּצְרָיִם וּמִקְוֵא סֹחֲרֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ מִקְוֵא יִקְחוּ בִּמְחִֽיר׃
translation: The horses which Solomon had were brought out of Egypt and from Kue. The king's merchants purchased them from Kue. (2 Chronicles 1:16)

text: וַיִּקְרָא אֱלֹהִים לַיַּבָּשָׁה אֶרֶץ וּלְמִקְוֵה הַמַּיִם קָרָא יַמִּים וַיַּרְא אֱלֹהִים כִּי טֽוֹב׃
translation: God called the dry land "earth", and the gathering together of the waters he called "seas". God saw that it was good. (Genesis 1:10)

text: מִקְוֵה יִשְׂרָאֵל מֽוֹשִׁיעוֹ בְּעֵת צָרָה לָמָּה תִֽהְיֶה כְּגֵר בָּאָרֶץ וּכְאֹרֵחַ נָטָה לָלֽוּן׃
translation: You hope of Israel, its Savior in the time of trouble, why should you be as a foreigner in the land, and as a wayfaring man who turns aside to stay for a night? (Jeremiah 14:8)

text: כִּֽי גֵרִים אֲנַחְנוּ לְפָנֶיךָ וְתוֹשָׁבִים כְּכָל אֲבֹתֵינוּ כַּצֵּל יָמֵינוּ עַל הָאָרֶץ וְאֵין מִקְוֶֽה׃
translation: For we are strangers before you and foreigners, as all our fathers were. Our days on the earth are as a shadow, and there is no remaining. (1 Chronicles 29:15)

text: אִם כֹּחָהּ אָכַלְתִּי בְלִי כָסֶף וְנֶפֶשׁ בְּעָלֶיהָ הִפָּֽחְתִּי׃
translation: if I have eaten its fruits without money, or have caused its owners to lose their life, (Job 31:39)

text: מִנְּחִירָיו יֵצֵא עָשָׁן כְּדוּד נָפוּחַ וְאַגְמֹֽן׃
translation: "I will not keep silence concerning his limbs, nor his mighty strength, nor his goodly frame. (Job 41:12)

text: וַנִּירָם אָבַד חֶשְׁבּוֹן עַד דִּיבוֹן וַנַּשִּׁים עַד נֹפַח אֲשֶׁרׄ עַד מֵֽידְבָֽא׃
translation: We have shot at them. Heshbon has perished even to Dibon. We have laid waste even to Nophah, Which reaches to Medeba." (Numbers 21:30)

text: כָּל חֹשֶׁךְ טָמוּן לִצְפּוּנָיו תְּאָכְלֵהוּ אֵשׁ לֹֽא נֻפָּח יֵרַע שָׂרִיד בְּאָהֳלֽוֹ׃
translation: All darkness is laid up for his treasures. An unfanned fire will devour him. It will consume that which is left in his tent. (Job 20:26)

text: הן הִנֵּה אָֽנֹכִי בָּרָאתִי חָרָשׁ נֹפֵחַ בְּאֵשׁ פֶּחָם וּמוֹצִיא כְלִי לְמַעֲשֵׂהוּ וְאָנֹכִי בָּרָאתִי מַשְׁחִית לְחַבֵּֽל׃
translation: "Behold, I have created the blacksmith who fans the coals into flame, and forges a weapon for his work; and I have created the destroyer to destroy. (Isaiah 54:16)

text: וַיִּיצֶר יְהוָה אֱלֹהִים אֶת הָֽאָדָם עָפָר מִן הָאֲדָמָה וַיִּפַּח בְּאַפָּיו נִשְׁמַת חַיִּים וַֽיְהִי הָֽאָדָם לְנֶפֶשׁ חַיָּֽה׃
translation: The LORD God formed man from the dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life; and man became a living soul. (Genesis 2:7)

text: כְּאֵשׁ תִּבְעַר יָעַר וּכְלֶהָבָה תְּלַהֵט הָרִֽים׃
translation: so pursue them with your tempest, and terrify them with your storm. (Psalms 83:15)

text: אֵשׁ לְפָנָיו תֵּלֵךְ וּתְלַהֵט סָבִיב צָרָֽיו׃
translation: A fire goes before him, and burns up his adversaries on every side. (Psalms 97:3)

text: עֹשֶׂה מַלְאָכָיו רוּחוֹת מְשָׁרְתָיו אֵשׁ לֹהֵֽט׃
translation: He makes his messengers winds, and his servants flames of fire. (Psalms 104:4)

text: וַתִּבְעַר אֵשׁ בַּעֲדָתָם לֶהָבָה תְּלַהֵט רְשָׁעִֽים׃
translation: A fire was kindled in their company. The flame burned up the wicked. (Psalms 106:18)

text: אֵלֶיךָ יְהוָה אֶקְרָא כִּי אֵשׁ אָֽכְלָה נְאוֹת מִדְבָּר וְלֶהָבָה לִהֲטָה כָּל עֲצֵי הַשָּׂדֶֽה׃
translation: LORD, I cry to you, for the fire has devoured the pastures of the wilderness, and the flame has burned all the trees of the field. (Joel 1:19)

text: וַיִּשְׁפֹּךְ עָלָיו חֵמָה אַפּוֹ וֶעֱזוּז מִלְחָמָה וַתְּלַהֲטֵהוּ מִסָּבִיב וְלֹא יָדָע וַתִּבְעַר בּוֹ וְלֹא יָשִׂים עַל לֵֽב׃
translation: Therefore he poured the fierceness of his anger on him, and the strength of battle. It set him on fire all around, but he didn't know. It burned him, but he didn't take it to heart." (Isaiah 42:25)

text: אִם עַל פִּיךָ יַגְבִּיהַּ נָשֶׁר וְכִי יָרִים קִנּֽוֹ׃
translation: Is it at your command that the eagle mounts up, and makes his nest on high? (Job 39:27)

text: כְּצִפּוֹר נוֹדֶדֶת מִן קִנָּהּ כֵּֽן אִישׁ נוֹדֵד מִמְּקוֹמֽוֹ׃
translation: As a bird that wanders from her nest, so is a man who wanders from his home. (Proverbs 27:8)

text: וָאֹמַר עִם קִנִּי אֶגְוָע וְכַחוֹל אַרְבֶּה יָמִֽים׃
translation: Then I said, 'I will die in my own house, I will count my days as the sand. (Job 29:18)

text: הוֹי בֹּצֵעַ בֶּצַע רָע לְבֵיתוֹ לָשׂוּם בַּמָּרוֹם קִנּוֹ לְהִנָּצֵל מִכַּף רָֽע׃
translation: Woe to him who gets an evil gain for his house, that he may set his nest on high, that he may be delivered from the hand of evil! (Habakkuk 2:9)

text: כְּנֶשֶׁר יָעִיר קִנּוֹ עַל גּוֹזָלָיו יְרַחֵף יִפְרֹשׂ כְּנָפָיו יִקָּחֵהוּ יִשָּׂאֵהוּ עַל אֶבְרָתֽוֹ׃
translation: As an eagle that stirs up her nest, that flutters over her young, he spread abroad his wings, he took them, he bore them on his feathers. (Deuteronomy 32:11)

text: אִם תַּגְבִּיהַּ כַּנֶּשֶׁר וְאִם בֵּין כּֽוֹכָבִים שִׂים קִנֶּךָ מִשָּׁם אוֹרִֽידְךָ נְאֻם יְהוָֽה׃
translation: Though you mount on high as the eagle, and though your nest is set among the stars, I will bring you down from there," says the LORD. (Obadiah 1:4)

text: וַֽיְהִי לְשִׁבְעַת הַיָּמִים וּמֵי הַמַּבּוּל הָיוּ עַל הָאָֽרֶץ׃
translation: After the seven days, the floodwaters came on the earth. (Genesis 7:10)

text: וַֽיְחִי נֹחַ אַחַר הַמַּבּוּל שְׁלֹשׁ מֵאוֹת שָׁנָה וַֽחֲמִשִּׁים שָׁנָֽה׃
translation: Noah lived three hundred fifty years after the flood. (Genesis 9:28)

text: יְהוָה לַמַּבּוּל יָשָׁב וַיֵּשֶׁב יְהוָה מֶלֶךְ לְעוֹלָֽם׃
translation: The LORD sat enthroned at the Flood. Yes, the LORD sits as King forever. (Psalms 29:10)

text: וְנֹחַ בֶּן שֵׁשׁ מֵאוֹת שָׁנָה וְהַמַּבּוּל הָיָה מַיִם עַל הָאָֽרֶץ׃
translation: Noah was six hundred years old when the flood of waters came on the earth. (Genesis 7:6)

text: וַיָּבֹא נֹחַ וּבָנָיו וְאִשְׁתּוֹ וּנְשֵֽׁי בָנָיו אִתּוֹ אֶל הַתֵּבָה מִפְּנֵי מֵי הַמַּבּֽוּל׃
translation: Noah went into the ship with his sons, his wife, and his sons' wives, because of the floodwaters. (Genesis 7:7)

text: וְאֵלֶּה תּוֹלְדֹת בְּנֵי נֹחַ שֵׁם חָם וָיָפֶת וַיִּוָּלְדוּ לָהֶם בָּנִים אַחַר הַמַּבּֽוּל׃
translation: Now this is the history of the generations of the sons of Noah and of Shem, Ham, and Japheth. Sons were born to them after the flood. (Genesis 10:1)

text: וְלָֽקְחוּ לַטָּמֵא מֵעֲפַר שְׂרֵפַת הַֽחַטָּאת וְנָתַן עָלָיו מַיִם חַיִּים אֶל כֶּֽלִי׃
translation: "For the unclean, they shall take of the ashes of the burning of the sin offering; and running water shall be poured on them in a vessel. (Numbers 19:17)

text: בֵּית קָדְשֵׁנוּ וְתִפְאַרְתֵּנוּ אֲשֶׁר הִֽלְלוּךָ אֲבֹתֵינוּ הָיָה לִשְׂרֵפַת אֵשׁ וְכָל מַחֲמַדֵּינוּ הָיָה לְחָרְבָּֽה׃
translation: Your holy cities have become a wilderness. Zion has become a wilderness, Jerusalem a desolation. (Isaiah 64:10)

text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אִישׁ אֶל רֵעֵהוּ הָבָה נִלְבְּנָה לְבֵנִים וְנִשְׂרְפָה לִשְׂרֵפָה וַתְּהִי לָהֶם הַלְּבֵנָה לְאָבֶן וְהַחֵמָר הָיָה לָהֶם לַחֹֽמֶר׃
translation: They said to one another, "Come, let's make bricks, and burn them thoroughly." They had brick for stone, and they used tar for mortar. (Genesis 11:3)

text: אֱמֹר אֶל אֶלְעָזָר בֶּן אַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֵן וְיָרֵם אֶת הַמַּחְתֹּת מִבֵּין הַשְּׂרֵפָה וְאֶת הָאֵשׁ זְרֵה הָלְאָה כִּי קָדֵֽשׁוּ׃
translation: "Speak to the children of Israel, and take rods from them, one for each fathers' house, of all their princes according to their fathers' houses, twelve rods. Write each man's name on his rod. (Numbers 17:2)

text: הָאֹמֵר לְכוֹרֶשׁ רֹעִי וְכָל חֶפְצִי יַשְׁלִם וְלֵאמֹר לִירוּשָׁלִַם תִּבָּנֶה וְהֵיכָל תִּוָּסֵֽד׃
translation: who says of Cyrus, 'He is my shepherd, and shall perform all my pleasure,' even saying of Jerusalem, 'She will be built;' and of the temple, 'Your foundation will be laid.'" (Isaiah 44:28)

text: עֲשָׂרָה בָקָר בְּרִאִים וְעֶשְׂרִים בָּקָר רְעִי וּמֵאָה צֹאן לְבַד מֵֽאַיָּל וּצְבִי וְיַחְמוּר וּבַרְבֻּרִים אֲבוּסִֽים׃
translation: "You know that David my father could not build a house for the name of the LORD his God because of the wars which were around him on every side, until the LORD put his enemies under the soles of his feet. (1 Kings 5:3)

text: וַֽיְהִי רִיב בֵּין רֹעֵי מִקְנֵֽה אַבְרָם וּבֵין רֹעֵי מִקְנֵה לוֹט וְהַֽכְּנַעֲנִי וְהַפְּרִזִּי אָז יֹשֵׁב בָּאָֽרֶץ׃
translation: There was strife between the herdsmen of Abram's livestock and the herdsmen of Lot's livestock. The Canaanites and the Perizzites lived in the land at that time. (Genesis 13:7)

text: דּוֹרִי נִסַּע וְנִגְלָה מִנִּי כְּאֹהֶל רֹעִי קִפַּדְתִּי כָאֹרֵג חַיַּי מִדַּלָּה יְבַצְּעֵנִי מִיּוֹם עַד לַיְלָה תַּשְׁלִימֵֽנִי׃
translation: My dwelling is removed, and is carried away from me like a shepherd's tent. I have rolled up my life like a weaver. He will cut me off from the loom. From day even to night you will make an end of me. (Isaiah 38:12)

text: וַיָּרִיבוּ רֹעֵי גְרָר עִם רֹעֵי יִצְחָק לֵאמֹר לָנוּ הַמָּיִם וַיִּקְרָא שֵֽׁם הַבְּאֵר עֵשֶׂק כִּי הִֽתְעַשְּׂקוּ עִמּֽוֹ׃
translation: The herdsmen of Gerar argued with Isaac's herdsmen, saying, "The water is ours." So he called the name of the well Esek, because they contended with him. (Genesis 26:20)

text: וְשָׁם אִישׁ מֵעַבְדֵי שָׁאוּל בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא נֶעְצָר לִפְנֵי יְהוָה וּשְׁמוֹ דֹּאֵג הָאֲדֹמִי אַבִּיר הָרֹעִים אֲשֶׁר לְשָׁאֽוּל׃
translation: David said to Ahimelech, "Isn't there here under your hand spear or sword? For I haven't brought my sword or my weapons with me, because the king's business required haste." (1 Samuel 21:8)

text: הַעֶבֶד יִשְׂרָאֵל אִם יְלִיד בַּיִת הוּא מַדּוּעַ הָיָה לָבַֽז׃
translation: Is Israel a slave? Is he born into slavery? Why has he become a captive? (Jeremiah 2:14)

text: הִמּוֹל יִמּוֹל יְלִיד בֵּֽיתְךָ וּמִקְנַת כַּסְפֶּךָ וְהָיְתָה בְרִיתִי בִּבְשַׂרְכֶם לִבְרִית עוֹלָֽם׃
translation: He who is born in your house, and he who is bought with your money, must be circumcised. My covenant shall be in your flesh for an everlasting covenant. (Genesis 17:13)

text: וְכָל אַנְשֵׁי בֵיתוֹ יְלִיד בָּיִת וּמִקְנַת כֶּסֶף מֵאֵת בֶּן נֵכָר נִמֹּלוּ אִתּֽוֹ׃
translation: All the men of his house, those born in the house, and those bought with money from a foreigner, were circumcised with him. (Genesis 17:27)

text: אֶפֶס כִּֽי עַז הָעָם הַיֹּשֵׁב בָּאָרֶץ וְהֶֽעָרִים בְּצֻרוֹת גְּדֹלֹת מְאֹד וְגַם יְלִדֵי הָֽעֲנָק רָאִינוּ שָֽׁם׃
translation: However, the people who dwell in the land are strong, and the cities are fortified and very large. Moreover, we saw the children of Anak there. (Numbers 13:28)

text: וַיֹּרֶשׁ מִשָּׁם כָּלֵב אֶת שְׁלוֹשָׁה בְּנֵי הָעֲנָק אֶת שֵׁשַׁי וְאֶת אֲחִימַן וְאֶת תַּלְמַי יְלִידֵי הָעֲנָֽק׃
translation: Caleb drove out the three sons of Anak: Sheshai, and Ahiman, and Talmai, the children of Anak. (Joshua 15:14)

text: וַיִּשְׁמַע אַבְרָם כִּי נִשְׁבָּה אָחִיו וַיָּרֶק אֶת חֲנִיכָיו יְלִידֵי בֵיתוֹ שְׁמֹנָה עָשָׂר וּשְׁלֹשׁ מֵאוֹת וַיִּרְדֹּף עַד דָּֽן׃
translation: When Abram heard that his relative was taken captive, he led out his three hundred eighteen trained men, born in his house, and pursued as far as Dan. (Genesis 14:14)

text: וְלַאֲשֶׁר בְּרָכָל וְלַֽאֲשֶׁר בְּעָרֵי הַיְּרַחְמְאֵלִי וְלַאֲשֶׁר בְּעָרֵי הַקֵּינִֽי׃
translation: to those who were in Racal, to those who were in the cities of the Jerahmeelites, to those who were in the cities of the Kenites, (1 Samuel 30:29)

text: תְּבֹרַךְ מִנָּשִׁים יָעֵל אֵשֶׁת חֶבֶר הַקֵּינִי מִנָּשִׁים בָּאֹהֶל תְּבֹרָֽךְ׃
translation: "Jael shall be blessed above women, the wife of Heber the Kenite; blessed shall she be above women in the tent. (Judges 5:24)

text: אֶת הַקֵּינִי וְאֶת הַקְּנִזִּי וְאֵת הַקַּדְמֹנִֽי׃
translation: the land of the Kenites, the Kenizzites, the Kadmonites, (Genesis 15:19)

text: וַיַּרְא אֶת הַקֵּינִי וַיִּשָּׂא מְשָׁלוֹ וַיֹּאמַר אֵיתָן מֽוֹשָׁבֶךָ וְשִׂים בַּסֶּלַע קִנֶּֽךָ׃
translation: He looked at the Kenite, and took up his parable, and said, "Your dwelling place is strong. Your nest is set in the rock. (Numbers 24:21)

text: וּמִשְׁפְּחוֹת סֹפְרִים ישבו יֹשְׁבֵי יַעְבֵּץ תִּרְעָתִים שִׁמְעָתִים שׂוּכָתִים הֵמָּה הַקִּינִים הַבָּאִים מֵחַמַּת אֲבִי בֵית רֵכָֽב׃
translation: The families of scribes who lived at Jabez: the Tirathites, the Shimeathites, and the Sucathites. These are the Kenites who came from Hammath, the father of the house of Rechab. (1 Chronicles 2:55)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר אָכִישׁ אַל פְּשַׁטְתֶּם הַיּוֹם וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד עַל נֶגֶב יְהוּדָה וְעַל נֶגֶב הַיַּרְחְמְאֵלִי וְאֶל נֶגֶב הַקֵּינִֽי׃
translation: Achish said, "Against whom have you made a raid today?" David said, "Against the South of Judah, against the South of the Jerahmeelites, and against the South of the Kenites." (1 Samuel 27:10)

text: וַתִּתֶּן לִי מָגֵן יִשְׁעֶךָ וִֽימִינְךָ תִסְעָדֵנִי וְֽעַנְוַתְךָ תַרְבֵּֽנִי׃
translation: You have enlarged my steps under me, My feet have not slipped. (Psalms 18:36)

text: אִם אָמַרְתִּי מָטָה רַגְלִי חַסְדְּךָ יְהוָה יִסְעָדֵֽנִי׃
translation: When I said, "My foot is slipping!" Your loving kindness, LORD, held me up. (Psalms 94:18)

text: חֶסֶד וֶאֱמֶת יִצְּרוּ מֶלֶךְ וְסָעַד בַּחֶסֶד כִּסְאֽוֹ׃
translation: Love and faithfulness keep the king safe. His throne is sustained by love. (Proverbs 20:28)

text: יִשְׁלַֽח עֶזְרְךָ מִקֹּדֶשׁ וּמִצִּיּוֹן יִסְעָדֶֽךָּ׃
translation: remember all your offerings, and accept your burned sacrifice. Selah. (Psalms 20:3)

text: סְעָדֵנִי וְאִוָּשֵׁעָה וְאֶשְׁעָה בְחֻקֶּיךָ תָמִֽיד׃
translation: Hold me up, and I will be safe, and will have respect for your statutes continually. (Psalms 119:117)

text: וַיְדַבֵּר הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶל אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים בֹּאָה אִתִּי הַבַּיְתָה וּֽסְעָדָה וְאֶתְּנָה לְךָ מַתָּֽת׃
translation: The king said to the man of God, "Come home with me and refresh yourself, and I will give you a reward." (1 Kings 13:7)

text: וְדָוִיד אָז בַּמְּצוּדָה וּנְצִיב פְּלִשְׁתִּים אָז בְּבֵית לָֽחֶם׃
translation: David was then in the stronghold, and the garrison of the Philistines was in Bethlehem at that time. (1 Chronicles 11:16)

text: וַתַּבֵּט אִשְׁתּוֹ מֵאַחֲרָיו וַתְּהִי נְצִיב מֶֽלַח׃
translation: But Lot's wife looked back from behind him, and she became a pillar of salt. (Genesis 19:26)

text: וְאֵלֶּה שָׂרֵי הנציבים הַנִּצָּבִים אֲשֶׁר לַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה חֲמִשִּׁים וּמָאתָיִם הָרֹדִים בָּעָֽם׃
translation: These were the chief officers of King Solomon, even two-hundred fifty, who ruled over the people. (2 Chronicles 8:10)

text: וַיָּשֶׂם בֶּֽאֱדוֹם נְצִיבִים וַיִּהְיוּ כָל אֱדוֹם עֲבָדִים לְדָוִיד וַיּוֹשַׁע יְהוָה אֶת דָּוִיד בְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר הָלָֽךְ׃
translation: He put garrisons in Edom; and all the Edomites became servants to David. The LORD gave victory to David wherever he went. (1 Chronicles 18:13)

text: גֶּבֶר בֶּן אֻרִי בְּאֶרֶץ גִּלְעָד אֶרֶץ סִיחוֹן מֶלֶךְ הָאֱמֹרִי וְעֹג מֶלֶךְ הַבָּשָׁן וּנְצִיב אֶחָד אֲשֶׁר בָּאָֽרֶץ׃
translation: Geber the son of Uri, in the land of Gilead, the country of Sihon king of the Amorites and of Og king of Bashan; and he was the only officer who was in the land. (1 Kings 4:19)

text: וַיִּתֶּן חַיִל בְּכָל עָרֵי יְהוּדָה הַבְּצֻרוֹת וַיִּתֵּן נְצִיבִים בְּאֶרֶץ יְהוּדָה וּבְעָרֵי אֶפְרַיִם אֲשֶׁר לָכַד אָסָא אָבִֽיו׃
translation: He placed forces in all the fortified cities of Judah, and set garrisons in the land of Judah and in the cities of Ephraim, which Asa his father had taken. (2 Chronicles 17:2)

text: חֵלֶם חֲזֵית וִֽידַחֲלִנַּנִי וְהַרְהֹרִין עַֽל מִשְׁכְּבִי וְחֶזְוֵי רֵאשִׁי יְבַהֲלֻנַּֽנִי׃
translation: It has seemed good to me to show the signs and wonders that the Most High God has worked toward me. (Daniel 4:2)

text: אֶתְכְּרִיַּת רוּחִי אֲנָה דָנִיֵּאל בְּגוֹא נִדְנֶה וְחֶזְוֵי רֵאשִׁי יְבַהֲלֻנַּֽנִי׃
translation: "As for me, Daniel, my spirit was grieved within my body, and the visions of my head troubled me. (Daniel 7:15)

text: וְאֶת כֶּשֶׂד וְאֶת חֲזוֹ וְאֶת פִּלְדָּשׁ וְאֶת יִדְלָף וְאֵת בְּתוּאֵֽל׃
translation: Chesed, Hazo, Pildash, Jidlaph, and Bethuel." (Genesis 22:22)

text: וְחֶזְוֵי רֵאשִׁי עַֽל מִשְׁכְּבִי חָזֵה הֲוֵית וַאֲלוּ אִילָן בְּגוֹא אַרְעָא וְרוּמֵהּ שַׂגִּֽיא׃
translation: Then the magicians, the enchanters, the Chaldeans, and the soothsayers came in; and I told them the dream, but they didn't make known to me its interpretation. (Daniel 4:7)

text: בִּשְׁנַת חֲדָה לְבֵלְאשַׁצַּר מֶלֶךְ בָּבֶל דָּנִיֵּאל חֵלֶם חֲזָה וְחֶזְוֵי רֵאשֵׁהּ עַֽל מִשְׁכְּבֵהּ בֵּאדַיִן חֶלְמָא כְתַב רֵאשׁ מִלִּין אֲמַֽר׃
translation: In the first year of Belshazzar king of Babylon, Daniel had a dream and visions of his head while on his bed. Then he wrote the dream and told the sum of the matters. (Daniel 7:1)

text: זֹאת הַבְּהֵמָה אֲשֶׁר תֹּאכֵלוּ שׁוֹר שֵׂה כְשָׂבִים וְשֵׂה עִזִּֽים׃
translation: These are the animals which you may eat: the ox, the sheep, the goat, (Deuteronomy 14:4)

text: אִם כֶּשֶׂב הֽוּא מַקְרִיב אֶת קָרְבָּנוֹ וְהִקְרִיב אֹתוֹ לִפְנֵי יְהוָֽה׃
translation: If he offers a lamb for his offering, then he shall offer it before the LORD; (Leviticus 3:7)

text: לִֽרְצֹנְכֶם תָּמִים זָכָר בַּבָּקָר בַּכְּשָׂבִים וּבָֽעִזִּֽים׃
translation: that you may be accepted, you shall offer a male without defect, of the bulls, of the sheep, or of the goats. (Leviticus 22:19)

text: דַּבֵּר אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר כָּל חֵלֶב שׁוֹר וְכֶשֶׂב וָעֵז לֹא תֹאכֵֽלוּ׃
translation: "Speak to the children of Israel, saying, 'You shall eat no fat, of bull, or sheep, or goat. (Leviticus 7:23)

text: וְאִם מִן הַצֹּאן קָרְבָּנוֹ מִן הַכְּשָׂבִים אוֹ מִן הָעִזִּים לְעֹלָה זָכָר תָּמִים יַקְרִיבֶֽנּוּ׃
translation: "'If his offering is from the flock, from the sheep or from the goats, for a burnt offering, he shall offer a male without defect. (Leviticus 1:10)

text: אִישׁ אִישׁ מִבֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר יִשְׁחַט שׁוֹר אוֹ כֶשֶׂב אוֹ עֵז בַּֽמַּחֲנֶה אוֹ אֲשֶׁר יִשְׁחַט מִחוּץ לַֽמַּחֲנֶֽה׃
translation: Whatever man there is of the house of Israel who kills a bull, or lamb, or goat in the camp, or who kills it outside the camp, (Leviticus 17:3)

text: וַיָּבֹא אֲלֵיהֶם יוֹסֵף בַּבֹּקֶר וַיַּרְא אֹתָם וְהִנָּם זֹעֲפִֽים׃
translation: Joseph came in to them in the morning, and saw them, and saw that they were sad. (Genesis 40:6)

text: אִוֶּלֶת אָדָם תְּסַלֵּף דַּרְכּוֹ וְעַל יְהוָה יִזְעַף לִבּֽוֹ׃
translation: The foolishness of man subverts his way; his heart rages against the LORD. (Proverbs 19:3)

text: וַיֵּלֶךְ מֶֽלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל עַל בֵּיתוֹ סַר וְזָעֵף וַיָּבֹא שֹׁמְרֽוֹנָה׃
translation: The king of Israel went to his house sullen and angry, and came to Samaria. (1 Kings 20:43)

text: וַיִּשְׂאוּ אֶת יוֹנָה וַיְטִלֻהוּ אֶל הַיָּם וַיַּעֲמֹד הַיָּם מִזַּעְפּֽוֹ׃
translation: So they took up Jonah and threw him into the sea; and the sea ceased its raging. (Jonah 1:15)

text: זַעַף יְהוָה אֶשָּׂא כִּי חָטָאתִי לוֹ עַד אֲשֶׁר יָרִיב רִיבִי וְעָשָׂה מִשְׁפָּטִי יוֹצִיאֵנִי לָאוֹר אֶרְאֶה בְּצִדְקָתֽוֹ׃
translation: I will bear the indignation of the LORD, because I have sinned against him, until he pleads my case and executes judgment for me. He will bring me out to the light. I will see his righteousness. (Micah 7:9)

text: וְהִשְׁמִיעַ יְהוָה אֶת הוֹד קוֹלוֹ וְנַחַת זְרוֹעוֹ יַרְאֶה בְּזַעַף אַף וְלַהַב אֵשׁ אוֹכֵלָה נֶפֶץ וָזֶרֶם וְאֶבֶן בָּרָֽד׃
translation: The LORD will cause his glorious voice to be heard, and will show the descent of his arm, with the indignation of his anger and the flame of a devouring fire, with a blast, storm, and hailstones. (Isaiah 30:30)

text: וַתֹּאכַלְנָה הַפָּרוֹת הָרַקּוֹת וְהָרָעוֹת אֵת שֶׁבַע הַפָּרוֹת הָרִאשֹׁנוֹת הַבְּרִיאֹֽת׃
translation: The thin and ugly cattle ate up the first seven fat cattle; (Genesis 41:20)

text: וַיַּקְרֵב אֶת הַמִּנְחָה לְעֶגְלוֹן מֶלֶךְ מוֹאָב וְעֶגְלוֹן אִישׁ בָּרִיא מְאֹֽד׃
translation: He offered the tribute to Eglon king of Moab. Now Eglon was a very fat man. (Judges 3:17)

text: כִּי אֵין חַרְצֻבּוֹת לְמוֹתָם וּבָרִיא אוּלָֽם׃
translation: For there are no struggles in their death, but their strength is firm. (Psalms 73:4)

text: וַיִּישָׁן וַֽיַּחֲלֹם שֵׁנִית וְהִנֵּה שֶׁבַע שִׁבֳּלִים עֹלוֹת בְּקָנֶה אֶחָד בְּרִיאוֹת וְטֹבֽוֹת׃
translation: He slept and dreamed a second time; and behold, seven heads of grain came up on one stalk, healthy and good. (Genesis 41:5)

text: אֶת הַחֵלֶב תֹּאכֵלוּ וְאֶת הַצֶּמֶר תִּלְבָּשׁוּ הַבְּרִיאָה תִּזְבָּחוּ הַצֹּאן לֹא תִרְעֽוּ׃
translation: You eat the fat. You clothe yourself with the wool. You kill the fatlings, but you don't feed the sheep. (Ezekiel 34:3)

text: וְהִנֵּה מִן הַיְאֹר עֹלֹת שֶׁבַע פָּרוֹת יְפוֹת מַרְאֶה וּבְרִיאֹת בָּשָׂר וַתִּרְעֶינָה בָּאָֽחוּ׃
translation: Behold, seven cattle came up out of the river. They were sleek and fat, and they fed in the marsh grass. (Genesis 41:2)

text: אֲרוֹמִמְךָ יְהוָה כִּי דִלִּיתָנִי וְלֹא שִׂמַּחְתָּ אֹיְבַי לִֽי׃
translation: LORD my God, I cried to you, and you have healed me. (Psalms 30:2)

text: מַיִם עֲמֻקִּים עֵצָה בְלֶב אִישׁ וְאִישׁ תְּבוּנָה יִדְלֶֽנָּה׃
translation: Counsel in the heart of man is like deep water, but a man of understanding will draw it out. (Proverbs 20:5)

text: וּמִדַּלּוֹת הָאָרֶץ הִשְׁאִיר נְבוּזַרְאֲדָן רַב טַבָּחִים לְכֹרְמִים וּלְיֹגְבִֽים׃
translation: But Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard left of the poorest of the land to be vineyard keepers and farmers. (Jeremiah 52:16)

text: וּמִדַּלַּת הָאָרֶץ הִשְׁאִיר רַב טַבָּחִים לְכֹֽרְמִים וּלְיֹגְבִֽים׃
translation: But the captain of the guard left some of the poorest of the land to work the vineyards and fields. (2 Kings 25:12)

text: רֹאשֵׁךְ עָלַיִךְ כַּכַּרְמֶל וְדַלַּת רֹאשֵׁךְ כָּאַרְגָּמָן מֶלֶךְ אָסוּר בָּרְהָטִֽים׃
translation: How beautiful and how pleasant you are, love, for delights! (Song of Solomon 7:6)

text: וּלְכֹהֵן מִדְיָן שֶׁבַע בָּנוֹת וַתָּבֹאנָה וַתִּדְלֶנָה וַתְּמַלֶּאנָה אֶת הָרְהָטִים לְהַשְׁקוֹת צֹאן אֲבִיהֶֽן׃
translation: Now the priest of Midian had seven daughters. They came and drew water, and filled the troughs to water their father's flock. (Exodus 2:16)

text: וְיוֹאֵל בֶּן זִכְרִי פָּקִיד עֲלֵיהֶם וִיהוּדָה בֶן הַסְּנוּאָה עַל הָעִיר מִשְׁנֶֽה׃
translation: Joel the son of Zichri was their overseer; and Judah the son of Hassenuah was second over the city. (Nehemiah 11:9)

text: וַאֲחֵיהֶם גִּבּוֹרֵי חַיִל מֵאָה עֶשְׂרִים וּשְׁמֹנָה וּפָקִיד עֲלֵיהֶם זַבְדִּיאֵל בֶּן הַגְּדוֹלִֽים׃
translation: and their brothers, mighty men of valor, one hundred twenty-eight; and their overseer was Zabdiel, the son of Haggedolim. (Nehemiah 11:14)

text: וּמַעֲשֵׂיָה וּֽשְׁמַֽעְיָה וְאֶלְעָזָר וְעֻזִּי וִֽיהוֹחָנָן וּמַלְכִּיָּה וְעֵילָם וָעָזֶר וַיַּשְׁמִיעוּ הַמְשֹׁרְרִים וְיִֽזְרַחְיָה הַפָּקִֽיד׃
translation: and Maaseiah, Shemaiah, Eleazar, Uzzi, Jehohanan, Malchijah, Elam, and Ezer. The singers sang loud, with Jezrahiah their overseer. (Nehemiah 12:42)

text: יַעֲשֶׂה פַרְעֹה וְיַפְקֵד פְּקִדִים עַל הָאָרֶץ וְחִמֵּשׁ אֶת אֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם בְּשֶׁבַע שְׁנֵי הַשָּׂבָֽע׃
translation: Let Pharaoh do this, and let him appoint overseers over the land, and take up the fifth part of the land of Egypt's produce in the seven plenteous years. (Genesis 41:34)

text: וַיִּשְׁמַע פַּשְׁחוּר בֶּן אִמֵּר הַכֹּהֵן וְהֽוּא פָקִיד נָגִיד בְּבֵית יְהוָה אֶֽת יִרְמְיָהוּ נִבָּא אֶת הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵֽלֶּה׃
translation: Now Pashhur, the son of Immer the priest, who was chief officer in the LORD's house, heard Jeremiah prophesying these things. (Jeremiah 20:1)

text: וּפְקִיד הַלְוִיִּם בִּירוּשָׁלִַם עֻזִּי בֶן בָּנִי בֶּן חֲשַׁבְיָה בֶּן מַתַּנְיָה בֶּן מִיכָא מִבְּנֵי אָסָף הַמְשֹׁרְרִים לְנֶגֶד מְלֶאכֶת בֵּית הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃
translation: The overseer also of the Levites at Jerusalem was Uzzi the son of Bani, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Mica, of the sons of Asaph, the singers responsible for the service of God's house. (Nehemiah 11:22)

text: וַיֵּלְכוּ לִמְבוֹא גְדֹר עַד לְמִזְרַח הַגָּיְא לְבַקֵּשׁ מִרְעֶה לְצֹאנָֽם׃
translation: They went to the entrance of Gedor, even to the east side of the valley, to seek pasture for their flocks. (1 Chronicles 4:39)

text: יְתוּר הָרִים מִרְעֵהוּ וְאַחַר כָּל יָרוֹק יִדְרֽוֹשׁ׃
translation: The range of the mountains is his pasture. He searches after every green thing. (Job 39:8)

text: מַה נֶּאֶנְחָה בְהֵמָה נָבֹכוּ עֶדְרֵי בָקָר כִּי אֵין מִרְעֶה לָהֶם גַּם עֶדְרֵי הַצֹּאן נֶאְשָֽׁמוּ׃
translation: How the animals groan! The herds of livestock are perplexed, because they have no pasture. Yes, the flocks of sheep are made desolate. (Joel 1:18)

text: וַֽיִּמְצְאוּ מִרְעֶה שָׁמֵן וָטוֹב וְהָאָרֶץ רַחֲבַת יָדַיִם וְשֹׁקֶטֶת וּשְׁלֵוָה כִּי מִן חָם הַיֹּשְׁבִים שָׁם לְפָנִֽים׃
translation: They found rich, good pasture, and the land was wide, and quiet, and peaceful, for those who lived there before were descended from Ham. (1 Chronicles 4:40)

text: אַיֵּה מְעוֹן אֲרָיוֹת וּמִרְעֶה הוּא לַכְּפִרִים אֲשֶׁר הָלַךְ אַרְיֵה לָבִיא שָׁם גּוּר אַרְיֵה וְאֵין מַחֲרִֽיד׃
translation: The lion tore in pieces enough for his cubs, and strangled prey for his lionesses, and filled his caves with the kill and his dens with prey. (Nahum 2:12)

text: הַמְעַט מִכֶּם הַמִּרְעֶה הַטּוֹב תִּרְעוּ וְיֶתֶר מִרְעֵיכֶם תִּרְמְסוּ בְּרַגְלֵיכֶם וּמִשְׁקַע מַיִם תִּשְׁתּוּ וְאֵת הַנּוֹתָרִים בְּרַגְלֵיכֶם תִּרְפֹּשֽׂוּן׃
translation: Does it seem a small thing to you to have fed on the good pasture, but you must tread down with your feet the residue of your pasture? And to have drunk of the clear waters, but must you foul the residue with your feet? (Ezekiel 34:18)

text: יָדִין בַּגּוֹיִם מָלֵא גְוִיּוֹת מָחַץ רֹאשׁ עַל אֶרֶץ רַבָּֽה׃
translation: He will judge among the nations. He will heap up dead bodies. He will crush the ruler of the whole earth. (Psalms 110:6)

text: וַיָּשִׂמוּ אֶת כֵּלָיו בֵּית עַשְׁתָּרוֹת וְאֶת גְּוִיָּתוֹ תָּקְעוּ בְּחוֹמַת בֵּית שָֽׁן׃
translation: They put his armor in the house of the Ashtaroth, and they fastened his body to the wall of Beth Shan. (1 Samuel 31:10)

text: וּפְנֵיהֶם וְכַנְפֵיהֶם פְּרֻדוֹת מִלְמָעְלָה לְאִישׁ שְׁתַּיִם חֹבְרוֹת אִישׁ וּשְׁתַּיִם מְכַסּוֹת אֵת גְּוִיֹתֵיהֶֽנָה׃
translation: Such were their faces. Their wings were spread out above. Two wings of each one touched another, and two covered their bodies. (Ezekiel 1:11)

text: וּתְבוּאָתָהּ מַרְבָּה לַמְּלָכִים אֲשֶׁר נָתַתָּה עָלֵינוּ בְּחַטֹּאותֵינוּ וְעַל גְּוִיֹּתֵינוּ מֹשְׁלִים וּבִבְהֶמְתֵּנוּ כִּרְצוֹנָם וּבְצָרָה גְדוֹלָה אֲנָֽחְנוּ׃
translation: It yields much increase to the kings whom you have set over us because of our sins. Also they have power over our bodies and over our livestock, at their pleasure, and we are in great distress. (Nehemiah 9:37)

text: פָּרָשׁ מַעֲלֶה וְלַהַב חֶרֶב וּבְרַק חֲנִית וְרֹב חָלָל וְכֹבֶד פָּגֶר וְאֵין קֵצֶה לַגְּוִיָּה יכשלו וְכָשְׁלוּ בִּגְוִיָּתָֽם׃
translation: the horseman charging, and the flashing sword, the glittering spear, and a multitude of slain, and a great heap of corpses, and there is no end of the bodies. They stumble on their bodies (Nahum 3:3)

text: וְתַחַת הָרָקִיעַ כַּנְפֵיהֶם יְשָׁרוֹת אִשָּׁה אֶל אֲחוֹתָהּ לְאִישׁ שְׁתַּיִם מְכַסּוֹת לָהֵנָּה וּלְאִישׁ שְׁתַּיִם מְכַסּוֹת לָהֵנָּה אֵת גְּוִיֹּתֵיהֶֽם׃
translation: Under the expanse, their wings were straight, one toward the other. Each one had two which covered on this side, and each one had two which covered their bodies on that side. (Ezekiel 1:23)

text: בִּנְיָמִין זְאֵב יִטְרָף בַּבֹּקֶר יֹאכַל עַד וְלָעֶרֶב יְחַלֵּק שָׁלָֽל׃
translation: "Benjamin is a ravenous wolf. In the morning he will devour the prey. At evening he will divide the plunder." (Genesis 49:27)

text: שָׂרֶיהָ בְקִרְבָּהּ אֲרָיוֹת שֹֽׁאֲגִים שֹׁפְטֶיהָ זְאֵבֵי עֶרֶב לֹא גָרְמוּ לַבֹּֽקֶר׃
translation: Her princes within her are roaring lions. Her judges are evening wolves. They leave nothing until the next day. (Zephaniah 3:3)

text: שָׂרֶיהָ בְקִרְבָּהּ כִּזְאֵבִים טֹרְפֵי טָרֶף לִשְׁפָּךְ דָּם לְאַבֵּד נְפָשׁוֹת לְמַעַן בְּצֹעַ בָּֽצַע׃
translation: Her princes within it are like wolves ravening the prey, to shed blood and to destroy souls, that they may get dishonest gain. (Ezekiel 22:27)

text: זְאֵב וְטָלֶה יִרְעוּ כְאֶחָד וְאַרְיֵה כַּבָּקָר יֹֽאכַל תֶּבֶן וְנָחָשׁ עָפָר לַחְמוֹ לֹֽא יָרֵעוּ וְלֹֽא יַשְׁחִיתוּ בְּכָל הַר קָדְשִׁי אָמַר יְהוָֽה׃
translation: The wolf and the lamb will feed together. The lion will eat straw like the ox. Dust will be the serpent's food. They will not hurt nor destroy in all my holy mountain," says the LORD. (Isaiah 65:25)

text: יַחְמֹס כַּגֶּפֶן בִּסְרוֹ וְיַשְׁלֵךְ כַּזַּיִת נִצָּתֽוֹ׃
translation: He will shake off his unripe grape as the vine, and will cast off his flower as the olive tree. (Job 15:33)

text: וַיֵּצֵא בַּיּוֹם הַשֵּׁנִי וְהִנֵּה שְׁנֵֽי אֲנָשִׁים עִבְרִים נִצִּים וַיֹּאמֶר לָֽרָשָׁע לָמָּה תַכֶּה רֵעֶֽךָ׃
translation: He went out the second day, and behold, two men of the Hebrews were fighting with each other. He said to him who did the wrong, "Why do you strike your fellow?" (Exodus 2:13)

text: וּלְשִׁפְחָֽתְךָ שְׁנֵי בָנִים וַיִּנָּצוּ שְׁנֵיהֶם בַּשָּׂדֶה וְאֵין מַצִּיל בֵּֽינֵיהֶם וַיַּכּוֹ הָאֶחָד אֶת הָאֶחָד וַיָּמֶת אֹתֽוֹ׃
translation: Your servant had two sons; and they both fought together in the field, and there was no one to part them, but the one struck the other and killed him. (2 Samuel 14:6)

text: וַיֵּצֵא בֶּן אִשָּׁה יִשְׂרְאֵלִית וְהוּא בֶּן אִישׁ מִצְרִי בְּתוֹךְ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּנָּצוּ בַּֽמַּחֲנֶה בֶּן הַיִּשְׂרְאֵלִית וְאִישׁ הַיִּשְׂרְאֵלִֽי׃
translation: The son of an Israelite woman, whose father was an Egyptian, went out among the children of Israel; and the son of the Israelite woman and a man of Israel strove together in the camp. (Leviticus 24:10)

text: בְּהַצּוֹתוֹ אֶת אֲרַם נַהֲרַיִם וְאֶת אֲרַם צוֹבָה וַיָּשָׁב יוֹאָב וַיַּךְ אֶת אֱדוֹם בְּגֵיא מֶלַח שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר אָֽלֶף׃
translation: You have made the land tremble. You have torn it. Mend its fractures, for it quakes. (Psalms 60:2)

text: כִּֽי יִנָּצוּ אֲנָשִׁים יַחְדָּו אִישׁ וְאָחִיו וְקָֽרְבָה אֵשֶׁת הָֽאֶחָד לְהַצִּיל אֶת אִישָׁהּ מִיַּד מַכֵּהוּ וְשָׁלְחָה יָדָהּ וְהֶחֱזִיקָה בִּמְבֻשָֽׁיו׃
translation: When men strive against each other, and the wife of one draws near to deliver her husband out of the hand of him who strikes him, and puts out her hand, and grabs him by his private parts, (Deuteronomy 25:11)

text: וַיַּכְרֵת יְהוָה מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל רֹאשׁ וְזָנָב כִּפָּה וְאַגְמוֹן יוֹם אֶחָֽד׃
translation: Yet the people have not turned to him who struck them, neither have they sought the LORD of Armies. (Isaiah 9:13)

text: זָקֵן וּנְשׂוּא פָנִים הוּא הָרֹאשׁ וְנָבִיא מֽוֹרֶה שֶּׁקֶר הוּא הַזָּנָֽב׃
translation: Therefore the LORD will cut off from Israel head and tail, palm branch and reed, in one day. (Isaiah 9:14)

text: וְלֹֽא יִהְיֶה לְמִצְרַיִם מַֽעֲשֶׂה אֲשֶׁר יַעֲשֶׂה רֹאשׁ וְזָנָב כִּפָּה וְאַגְמֽוֹן׃
translation: Neither shall there be any work for Egypt, which head or tail, palm branch or rush, may do. (Isaiah 19:15)

text: הוּא יַלְוְךָ וְאַתָּה לֹא תַלְוֶנּוּ הוּא יִהְיֶה לְרֹאשׁ וְאַתָּה תִּֽהְיֶה לְזָנָֽב׃
translation: He will lend to you, and you won't lend to him. He will be the head, and you will be the tail. (Deuteronomy 28:44)

text: אֲשֶׁר קָֽרְךָ בַּדֶּרֶךְ וַיְזַנֵּב בְּךָ כָּל הַנֶּחֱשָׁלִים אַֽחַרֶיךָ וְאַתָּה עָיֵף וְיָגֵעַ וְלֹא יָרֵא אֱלֹהִֽים׃
translation: how he met you by the way, and struck the rearmost of you, all who were feeble behind you, when you were faint and weary; and he didn't fear God. (Deuteronomy 25:18)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה שְׁלַח יָֽדְךָ וֶאֱחֹז בִּזְנָבוֹ וַיִּשְׁלַח יָדוֹ וַיַּחֲזֶק בּוֹ וַיְהִי לְמַטֶּה בְּכַפּֽוֹ׃
translation: The LORD said to Moses, "Stretch out your hand, and take it by the tail." He stretched out his hand, and took hold of it, and it became a rod in his hand. (Exodus 4:4)

text: וְהִכְרַתִּי כְשָׁפִים מִיָּדֶךָ וּֽמְעוֹנְנִים לֹא יִֽהְיוּ לָֽךְ׃
translation: I will cut off the cities of your land and will tear down all your strongholds. (Micah 5:11)

text: וַיִּקְרָא גַּם פַּרְעֹה לַֽחֲכָמִים וְלַֽמְכַשְּׁפִים וַיַּֽעֲשׂוּ גַם הֵם חַרְטֻמֵּי מִצְרַיִם בְּלַהֲטֵיהֶם כֵּֽן׃
translation: Then Pharaoh also called for the wise men and the sorcerers. They also, the magicians of Egypt, did the same thing with their enchantments. (Exodus 7:11)

text: לֹֽא יִמָּצֵא בְךָ מַעֲבִיר בְּנֽוֹ וּבִתּוֹ בָּאֵשׁ קֹסֵם קְסָמִים מְעוֹנֵן וּמְנַחֵשׁ וּמְכַשֵּֽׁף׃
translation: There shall not be found with you anyone who makes his son or his daughter to pass through the fire, one who uses divination, one who tells fortunes, or an enchanter, or a sorcerer, (Deuteronomy 18:10)

text: מֵרֹב זְנוּנֵי זוֹנָה טוֹבַת חֵן בַּעֲלַת כְּשָׁפִים הַמֹּכֶרֶת גּוֹיִם בִּזְנוּנֶיהָ וּמִשְׁפָּחוֹת בִּכְשָׁפֶֽיהָ׃
translation: because of the multitude of the prostitution of the alluring prostitute, the mistress of witchcraft, who sells nations through her prostitution, and families through her witchcraft. (Nahum 3:4)

text: עִמְדִי נָא בַחֲבָרַיִךְ וּבְרֹב כְּשָׁפַיִךְ בַּאֲשֶׁר יָגַעַתְּ מִנְּעוּרָיִךְ אוּלַי תּוּכְלִי הוֹעִיל אוּלַי תַּעֲרֽוֹצִי׃
translation: "Stand now with your enchantments and with the multitude of your sorceries, in which you have labored from your youth, as if you might profit, as if you might prevail. (Isaiah 47:12)

text: וַיְהִי כִּרְאוֹת יְהוֹרָם אֶת יֵהוּא וַיֹּאמֶר הֲשָׁלוֹם יֵהוּא וַיֹּאמֶר מָה הַשָּׁלוֹם עַד זְנוּנֵי אִיזֶבֶל אִמְּךָ וּכְשָׁפֶיהָ הָרַבִּֽים׃
translation: When Joram saw Jehu, he said, "Is it peace, Jehu?" He answered, "What peace, so long as the prostitution of your mother Jezebel and her witchcraft abound?" (2 Kings 9:22)

text: וְסָרוּ הַֽצְפַרְדְּעִים מִמְּךָ וּמִבָּתֶּיךָ וּמֵעֲבָדֶיךָ וּמֵעַמֶּךָ רַק בַּיְאֹר תִּשָּׁאַֽרְנָה׃
translation: The magicians did the same thing with their enchantments, and brought up frogs on the land of Egypt. (Exodus 8:7)

text: יְשַׁלַּח בָּהֶם עָרֹב וַיֹּאכְלֵם וּצְפַרְדֵּעַ וַתַּשְׁחִיתֵֽם׃
translation: He sent among them swarms of flies, which devoured them; and frogs, which destroyed them. (Psalms 78:45)

text: שָׁרַץ אַרְצָם צְפַרְדְּעִים בְּחַדְרֵי מַלְכֵיהֶֽם׃
translation: Their land swarmed with frogs, even in the rooms of their kings. (Psalms 105:30)

text: וַיַּעַשׂ יְהוָה כִּדְבַר מֹשֶׁה וַיָּמֻתוּ הַֽצְפַרְדְּעִים מִן הַבָּתִּים מִן הַחֲצֵרֹת וּמִן הַשָּׂדֹֽת׃
translation: Moses said to Pharaoh, "I give you the honor of setting the time that I should pray for you, and for your servants, and for your people, that the frogs be destroyed from you and your houses, and remain in the river only." (Exodus 8:9)

text: וַיֵּט אַהֲרֹן אֶת יָדוֹ עַל מֵימֵי מִצְרָיִם וַתַּעַל הַצְּפַרְדֵּעַ וַתְּכַס אֶת אֶרֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
translation: If you refuse to let them go, behold, I will plague all your borders with frogs. (Exodus 8:2)

text: וַיֵּצֵא מֹשֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן מֵעִם פַּרְעֹה וַיִּצְעַק מֹשֶׁה אֶל יְהוָה עַל דְּבַר הַֽצְפַרְדְּעִים אֲשֶׁר שָׂם לְפַרְעֹֽה׃
translation: Then Pharaoh called for Moses and Aaron, and said, "Entreat the LORD, that he take away the frogs from me and from my people; and I will let the people go, that they may sacrifice to the LORD." (Exodus 8:8)

text: וּבָשָׂר כִּֽי יִהְיֶה בֽוֹ בְעֹרוֹ שְׁחִין וְנִרְפָּֽא׃
translation: "When the body has a boil on its skin, and it has healed, (Leviticus 13:18)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְשַׁעְיָהוּ יִשְׂאוּ דְּבֶלֶת תְּאֵנִים וְיִמְרְחוּ עַֽל הַשְּׁחִין וְיֶֽחִי׃
translation: Now Isaiah had said, "Let them take a cake of figs, and lay it for a poultice on the boil, and he shall recover." (Isaiah 38:21)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְשַֽׁעְיָהוּ קְחוּ דְּבֶלֶת תְּאֵנִים וַיִּקְחוּ וַיָּשִׂימוּ עַֽל הַשְּׁחִין וַיֶּֽחִי׃
translation: Isaiah said, "Take a cake of figs." They took and laid it on the boil, and he recovered. (2 Kings 20:7)

text: יַכְּכָה יְהוָה בִּשְׁחִין רָע עַל הַבִּרְכַּיִם וְעַל הַשֹּׁקַיִם אֲשֶׁר לֹא תוּכַל לְהֵרָפֵא מִכַּף רַגְלְךָ וְעַד קָדְקֳדֶֽךָ׃
translation: The LORD will strike you in the knees and in the legs with a sore boil, of which you cannot be healed, from the sole of your foot to the crown of your head. (Deuteronomy 28:35)

text: וְהָיָה לְאָבָק עַל כָּל אֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם וְהָיָה עַל הָאָדָם וְעַל הַבְּהֵמָה לִשְׁחִין פֹּרֵחַ אֲבַעְבֻּעֹת בְּכָל אֶרֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
translation: It shall become small dust over all the land of Egypt, and shall be boils and blisters breaking out on man and on animal, throughout all the land of Egypt." (Exodus 9:9)

text: וַיִּקְחוּ אֶת פִּיחַ הַכִּבְשָׁן וַיַּֽעַמְדוּ לִפְנֵי פַרְעֹה וַיִּזְרֹק אֹתוֹ מֹשֶׁה הַשָּׁמָיְמָה וַיְהִי שְׁחִין אֲבַעְבֻּעֹת פֹּרֵחַ בָּאָדָם וּבַבְּהֵמָֽה׃
translation: They took ashes of the furnace, and stood before Pharaoh; and Moses sprinkled it up toward the sky; and it became boils and blisters breaking out on man and on animal. (Exodus 9:10)

text: כִּי כָלָה וְנֶחֱרָצָה אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה צְבָאוֹת עֹשֶׂה בְּקֶרֶב כָּל הָאָֽרֶץ׃
translation: For the Lord, GOD of Armies, will make a full end, and that determined, throughout all the earth. (Isaiah 10:23)

text: אִם חֲרוּצִים יָמָיו מִֽסְפַּר חֳדָשָׁיו אִתָּךְ חקו חֻקָּיו עָשִׂיתָ וְלֹא יַעֲבֽוֹר׃
translation: Seeing his days are determined, the number of his months is with you, and you have appointed his bounds that he can't pass. (Job 14:5)

text: כִּי אִם יִהְיֶה עַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל כְּחוֹל הַיָּם שְׁאָר יָשׁוּב בּוֹ כִּלָּיוֹן חָרוּץ שׁוֹטֵף צְדָקָֽה׃
translation: For though your people, Israel, are like the sand of the sea, only a remnant of them will return. A destruction is determined, overflowing with righteousness. (Isaiah 10:22)

text: וַיְהִי עַבְדְּךָ עֹשֵׂה הֵנָּה וָהֵנָּה וְהוּא אֵינֶנּוּ וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו מֶֽלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל כֵּן מִשְׁפָּטֶךָ אַתָּה חָרָֽצְתָּ׃
translation: As your servant was busy here and there, he was gone." The king of Israel said to him, "So shall your judgment be. You yourself have decided it." (1 Kings 20:40)

text: וַיָּשֻׁבוּ כָל הָעָם אֶל הַמַּחֲנֶה אֶל יְהוֹשֻׁעַ מַקֵּדָה בְּשָׁלוֹם לֹֽא חָרַץ לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לְאִישׁ אֶת לְשֹׁנֽוֹ׃
translation: all the people returned to the camp to Joshua at Makkedah in peace. None moved his tongue against any of the children of Israel. (Joshua 10:21)

text: וְעַתָּה אַל תִּתְלוֹצָצוּ פֶּֽן יֶחְזְקוּ מֽוֹסְרֵיכֶם כִּֽי כָלָה וְנֶחֱרָצָה שָׁמַעְתִּי מֵאֵת אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה צְבָאוֹת עַל כָּל הָאָֽרֶץ׃
translation: Now therefore don't be scoffers, lest your bonds be made strong; for I have heard a decree of destruction from the Lord, GOD of Armies, on the whole earth. (Isaiah 28:22)

text: אִם לֹא בֵרֲכוּנִי חלצו חֲלָצָיו וּמִגֵּז כְּבָשַׂי יִתְחַמָּֽם׃
translation: if his heart hasn't blessed me, if he hasn't been warmed with my sheep's fleece; (Job 31:20)

text: חַם לִבִּי בְּקִרְבִּי בַּהֲגִיגִי תִבְעַר אֵשׁ דִּבַּרְתִּי בִּלְשֽׁוֹנִי׃
translation: "LORD, show me my end, what is the measure of my days. Let me know how frail I am. (Psalms 39:4)

text: וַיִּלְקְטוּ אֹתוֹ בַּבֹּקֶר בַּבֹּקֶר אִישׁ כְּפִי אָכְלוֹ וְחַם הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ וְנָמָֽס׃
translation: They gathered it morning by morning, everyone according to his eating. When the sun grew hot, it melted. (Exodus 16:21)

text: הַנֵּֽחָמִים בָּֽאֵלִים תַּחַת כָּל עֵץ רַעֲנָן שֹׁחֲטֵי הַיְלָדִים בַּנְּחָלִים תַּחַת סְעִפֵי הַסְּלָעִֽים׃
translation: you who inflame yourselves among the oaks, under every green tree; who kill the children in the valleys, under the clefts of the rocks? (Isaiah 57:5)

text: כֻּלָּם יֵחַמּוּ כַּתַּנּוּר וְאָכְלוּ אֶת שֹֽׁפְטֵיהֶם כָּל מַלְכֵיהֶם נָפָלוּ אֵין קֹרֵא בָהֶם אֵלָֽי׃
translation: They are all hot as an oven, and devour their judges. All their kings have fallen. There is no one among them who calls to me. (Hosea 7:7)

text: הִנֵּה הָיוּ כְקַשׁ אֵשׁ שְׂרָפָתַם לֹֽא יַצִּילוּ אֶת נַפְשָׁם מִיַּד לֶֽהָבָה אֵין גַּחֶלֶת לַחְמָם אוּר לָשֶׁבֶת נֶגְדּֽוֹ׃
translation: Behold, they are like stubble. The fire will burn them. They won't deliver themselves from the power of the flame. It won't be a coal to warm at or a fire to sit by. (Isaiah 47:14)

text: אוֹ בֵן יִגָּח אוֹ בַת יִגָּח כַּמִּשְׁפָּט הַזֶּה יֵעָשֶׂה לּֽוֹ׃
translation: Whether it has gored a son or has gored a daughter, according to this judgment it shall be done to him. (Exodus 21:31)

text: אִם עֶבֶד יִגַּח הַשּׁוֹר אוֹ אָמָה כֶּסֶף שְׁלֹשִׁים שְׁקָלִים יִתֵּן לַֽאדֹנָיו וְהַשּׁוֹר יִסָּקֵֽל׃
translation: If the bull gores a male servant or a female servant, thirty shekels of silver shall be given to their master, and the ox shall be stoned. (Exodus 21:32)

text: וַיַּעַשׂ לוֹ צִדְקִיָּה בֶֽן כְּנַעֲנָה קַרְנֵי בַרְזֶל וַיֹּאמֶר כֹּֽה אָמַר יְהוָה בְּאֵלֶּה תְּנַגַּח אֶת אֲרָם עַד כַּלֹּתָֽם׃
translation: Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah made himself horns of iron, and said, "The LORD says, 'With these you will push the Syrians, until they are consumed.'" (1 Kings 22:11)

text: וַיַּעַשׂ לוֹ צִדְקִיָּהוּ בֶֽן כְּנַעֲנָה קַרְנֵי בַרְזֶל וַיֹּאמֶר כֹּֽה אָמַר יְהוָה בְּאֵלֶּה תְּנַגַּח אֶת אֲרָם עַד כַּלּוֹתָֽם׃
translation: Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah made himself horns of iron and said, "The LORD says, 'With these you shall push the Syrians, until they are consumed.'" (2 Chronicles 18:10)

text: רָאִיתִי אֶת הָאַיִל מְנַגֵּחַ יָמָּה וְצָפוֹנָה וָנֶגְבָּה וְכָל חַיּוֹת לֹֽא יַֽעַמְדוּ לְפָנָיו וְאֵין מַצִּיל מִיָּדוֹ וְעָשָׂה כִרְצֹנוֹ וְהִגְדִּֽיל׃
translation: I saw the ram pushing westward, northward, and southward. No animals could stand before him. There wasn't any who could deliver out of his hand, but he did according to his will, and magnified himself. (Daniel 8:4)

text: וּבְעֵת קֵץ יִתְנַגַּח עִמּוֹ מֶלֶךְ הַנֶּגֶב וְיִשְׂתָּעֵר עָלָיו מֶלֶךְ הַצָּפוֹן בְּרֶכֶב וּבְפָרָשִׁים וּבָאֳנִיּוֹת רַבּוֹת וּבָא בַאֲרָצוֹת וְשָׁטַף וְעָבָֽר׃
translation: "At the time of the end the king of the south will contend with him; and the king of the north will come against him like a whirlwind, with chariots, with horsemen, and with many ships. He will enter into the countries, and will overflow and pass through. (Daniel 11:40)

text: וְעָשִׂיתָ קַרְסֵי נְחֹשֶׁת חֲמִשִּׁים וְהֵבֵאתָ אֶת הַקְּרָסִים בַּלֻּלָאֹת וְחִבַּרְתָּ אֶת הָאֹהֶל וְהָיָה אֶחָֽד׃
translation: You shall make fifty clasps of bronze, and put the clasps into the loops, and couple the tent together, that it may be one. (Exodus 26:11)

text: וְעָשִׂיתָ לֻֽלְאֹת תְּכֵלֶת עַל שְׂפַת הַיְרִיעָה הָאֶחָת מִקָּצָה בַּחֹבָרֶת וְכֵן תַּעֲשֶׂה בִּשְׂפַת הַיְרִיעָה הַקִּיצוֹנָה בַּמַּחְבֶּרֶת הַשֵּׁנִֽית׃
translation: You shall make loops of blue on the edge of the one curtain from the edge in the coupling, and you shall do likewise on the edge of the curtain that is outermost in the second coupling. (Exodus 26:4)

text: וְעָשִׂיתָ חֲמִשִּׁים לֻֽלָאֹת עַל שְׂפַת הַיְרִיעָה הָֽאֶחָת הַקִּיצֹנָה בַּחֹבָרֶת וַחֲמִשִּׁים לֻֽלָאֹת עַל שְׂפַת הַיְרִיעָה הַחֹבֶרֶת הַשֵּׁנִֽית׃
translation: You shall make fifty loops on the edge of the one curtain that is outermost in the coupling, and fifty loops on the edge of the curtain which is outermost in the second coupling. (Exodus 26:10)

text: וַיַּעַשׂ לֻֽלְאֹת תְּכֵלֶת עַל שְׂפַת הַיְרִיעָה הָֽאֶחָת מִקָּצָה בַּמַּחְבָּרֶת כֵּן עָשָׂה בִּשְׂפַת הַיְרִיעָה הַקִּיצוֹנָה בַּמַּחְבֶּרֶת הַשֵּׁנִֽית׃
translation: He made loops of blue on the edge of the one curtain from the edge in the coupling. Likewise he made in the edge of the curtain that was outermost in the second coupling. (Exodus 36:11)

text: וַיַּעַשׂ לֻֽלָאֹת חֲמִשִּׁים עַל שְׂפַת הַיְרִיעָה הַקִּיצֹנָה בַּמַּחְבָּרֶת וַחֲמִשִּׁים לֻלָאֹת עָשָׂה עַל שְׂפַת הַיְרִיעָה הַחֹבֶרֶת הַשֵּׁנִֽית׃
translation: He made fifty loops on the edge of the curtain that was outermost in the coupling, and he made fifty loops on the edge of the curtain which was outermost in the second coupling. (Exodus 36:17)

text: חֲמִשִּׁים לֻֽלָאֹת תַּעֲשֶׂה בַּיְרִיעָה הָאֶחָת וַחֲמִשִּׁים לֻֽלָאֹת תַּעֲשֶׂה בִּקְצֵה הַיְרִיעָה אֲשֶׁר בַּמַּחְבֶּרֶת הַשֵּׁנִית מַקְבִּילֹת הַלֻּלָאֹת אִשָּׁה אֶל אֲחֹתָֽהּ׃
translation: You shall make fifty loops in the one curtain, and you shall make fifty loops in the edge of the curtain that is in the second coupling. The loops shall be opposite one another. (Exodus 26:5)

text: וְעַמֻּדָיו עֶשְׂרִים וְאַדְנֵיהֶם עֶשְׂרִים נְחֹשֶׁת וָוֵי הָעַמֻּדִים וַחֲשֻׁקֵיהֶם כָּֽסֶף׃
translation: Its pillars shall be twenty, and their sockets twenty, of bronze. The hooks of the pillars and their fillets shall be of silver. (Exodus 27:10)

text: עַמּוּדֵיהֶם עֶשְׂרִים וְאַדְנֵיהֶם עֶשְׂרִים נְחֹשֶׁת וָוֵי הָעַמֻּדִים וַחֲשֻׁקֵיהֶם כָּֽסֶף׃
translation: their pillars were twenty, and their sockets twenty, of bronze; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets were of silver. (Exodus 38:10)

text: כָּל עַמּוּדֵי הֶֽחָצֵר סָבִיב מְחֻשָּׁקִים כֶּסֶף וָוֵיהֶם כָּסֶף וְאַדְנֵיהֶם נְחֹֽשֶׁת׃
translation: All the pillars of the court around shall be filleted with silver; their hooks of silver, and their sockets of bronze. (Exodus 27:17)

text: וְעַמֻּֽדֵיהֶם אַרְבָּעָה וְאַדְנֵיהֶם אַרְבָּעָה נְחֹשֶׁת וָוֵיהֶם כֶּסֶף וְצִפּוּי רָאשֵׁיהֶם וַחֲשֻׁקֵיהֶם כָּֽסֶף׃
