translation: Their pillars were four, and their sockets four, of bronze; their hooks of silver, and the overlaying of their capitals, and their fillets, of silver. (Exodus 38:19)

text: וְאֶת עַמּוּדָיו חֲמִשָּׁה וְאֶת וָוֵיהֶם וְצִפָּה רָאשֵׁיהֶם וַחֲשֻׁקֵיהֶם זָהָב וְאַדְנֵיהֶם חֲמִשָּׁה נְחֹֽשֶׁת׃
translation: and the five pillars of it with their hooks. He overlaid their capitals and their fillets with gold, and their five sockets were of bronze. (Exodus 36:38)

text: וְלִפְאַת צָפוֹן מֵאָה בָֽאַמָּה עַמּוּדֵיהֶם עֶשְׂרִים וְאַדְנֵיהֶם עֶשְׂרִים נְחֹשֶׁת וָוֵי הָֽעַמּוּדִים וַחֲשֻׁקֵיהֶם כָּֽסֶף׃
translation: For the north side one hundred cubits, their pillars twenty, and their sockets twenty, of bronze; the hooks of the pillars, and their fillets, of silver. (Exodus 38:11)

text: הִנֵּה נָתַתִּי אֶת פָּנֶיךָ חֲזָקִים לְעֻמַּת פְּנֵיהֶם וְאֶֽת מִצְחֲךָ חָזָק לְעֻמַּת מִצְחָֽם׃
translation: Behold, I have made your face hard against their faces, and your forehead hard against their foreheads. (Ezekiel 3:8)

text: כְּשָׁמִיר חָזָק מִצֹּר נָתַתִּי מִצְחֶךָ לֹֽא תִירָא אוֹתָם וְלֹא תֵחַת מִפְּנֵיהֶם כִּי בֵּֽית מְרִי הֵֽמָּה׃
translation: I have made your forehead as a diamond, harder than flint. Don't be afraid of them, neither be dismayed at their looks, though they are a rebellious house." (Ezekiel 3:9)

text: וַיִּזְעַף עֻזִּיָּהוּ וּבְיָדוֹ מִקְטֶרֶת לְהַקְטִיר וּבְזַעְפּוֹ עִם הַכֹּהֲנִים וְהַצָּרַעַת זָרְחָה בְמִצְחוֹ לִפְנֵי הַכֹּֽהֲנִים בְּבֵית יְהוָה מֵעַל לְמִזְבַּח הַקְּטֹֽרֶת׃
translation: Then Uzziah was angry. He had a censer in his hand to burn incense, and while he was angry with the priests, the leprosy broke out on his forehead before the priests in the LORD's house, beside the altar of incense. (2 Chronicles 26:19)

text: וַיִּפֶן אֵלָיו עֲזַרְיָהוּ כֹהֵן הָרֹאשׁ וְכָל הַכֹּהֲנִים וְהִנֵּה הוּא מְצֹרָע בְּמִצְחוֹ וַיַּבְהִלוּהוּ מִשָּׁם וְגַם הוּא נִדְחַף לָצֵאת כִּי נִגְּעוֹ יְהוָֽה׃
translation: Azariah the chief priest and all the priests looked at him, and behold, he was leprous in his forehead; and they thrust him out quickly from there. Indeed, he himself also hurried to go out, because the LORD had struck him. (2 Chronicles 26:20)

text: וּבֵית יִשְׂרָאֵל לֹא יֹאבוּ לִשְׁמֹעַ אֵלֶיךָ כִּֽי אֵינָם אֹבִים לִשְׁמֹעַ אֵלָי כִּי כָּל בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל חִזְקֵי מֵצַח וּקְשֵׁי לֵב הֵֽמָּה׃
translation: But the house of Israel will not listen to you, for they will not listen to me; for all the house of Israel are obstinate and hard-hearted. (Ezekiel 3:7)

text: וְעָשִׂיתָ אֹתָהּ קְטֹרֶת רֹקַח מַעֲשֵׂה רוֹקֵחַ מְמֻלָּח טָהוֹר קֹֽדֶשׁ׃
translation: You shall make incense of it, a perfume after the art of the perfumer, seasoned with salt, pure and holy. (Exodus 30:35)

text: וּמִן בְּנֵי הַכֹּהֲנִים רֹקְחֵי הַמִּרְקַחַת לַבְּשָׂמִֽים׃
translation: Some of the sons of the priests prepared the mixing of the spices. (1 Chronicles 9:30)

text: אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יִרְקַח כָּמֹהוּ וַאֲשֶׁר יִתֵּן מִמֶּנּוּ עַל זָר וְנִכְרַת מֵעַמָּֽיו׃
translation: Whoever compounds any like it, or whoever puts any of it on a stranger, he shall be cut off from his people.'" (Exodus 30:33)

text: וַיַּעַשׂ אֶת שֶׁמֶן הַמִּשְׁחָה קֹדֶשׁ וְאֶת קְטֹרֶת הַסַּמִּים טָהוֹר מַעֲשֵׂה רֹקֵֽחַ׃
translation: He made the holy anointing oil and the pure incense of sweet spices, after the art of the perfumer. (Exodus 37:29)

text: אֶנְהָֽגֲךָ אֲבִֽיאֲךָ אֶל בֵּית אִמִּי תְּלַמְּדֵנִי אַשְׁקְךָ מִיַּיִן הָרֶקַח מֵעֲסִיס רִמֹּנִֽי׃
translation: I would lead you, bringing you into the house of my mother, who would instruct me. I would have you drink spiced wine, of the juice of my pomegranate. (Song of Solomon 8:2)

text: וַתָּשֻׁרִי לַמֶּלֶךְ בַּשֶּׁמֶן וַתַּרְבִּי רִקֻּחָיִךְ וַתְּשַׁלְּחִי צִרַיִךְ עַד מֵרָחֹק וַתַּשְׁפִּילִי עַד שְׁאֽוֹל׃
translation: You went to the king with oil, increased your perfumes, sent your ambassadors far off, and degraded yourself even to Sheol. (Isaiah 57:9)

text: כֹּל מַפְרֶסֶת פַּרְסָה וְשֹׁסַעַת שֶׁסַע פְּרָסֹת מַעֲלַת גֵּרָה בַּבְּהֵמָה אֹתָהּ תֹּאכֵֽלוּ׃
translation: Whatever parts the hoof, and is cloven-footed, and chews the cud among the animals, that you may eat. (Leviticus 11:3)

text: וְכָל בְּהֵמָה מַפְרֶסֶת פַּרְסָה וְשֹׁסַעַת שֶׁסַע שְׁתֵּי פְרָסוֹת מַעֲלַת גֵּרָה בַּבְּהֵמָה אֹתָהּ תֹּאכֵֽלוּ׃
translation: Every animal that parts the hoof, and has the hoof split in two and chews the cud, among the animals, you may eat. (Deuteronomy 14:6)

text: וַיְשַׁסַּע דָּוִד אֶת אֲנָשָׁיו בַּדְּבָרִים וְלֹא נְתָנָם לָקוּם אֶל שָׁאוּל וְשָׁאוּל קָם מֵהַמְּעָרָה וַיֵּלֶךְ בַּדָּֽרֶךְ׃
translation: David also arose afterward, and went out of the cave and cried after Saul, saying, "My lord the king!" When Saul looked behind him, David bowed with his face to the earth, and showed respect. (1 Samuel 24:8)

text: וְאֶת הַחֲזִיר כִּֽי מַפְרִיס פַּרְסָה הוּא וְשֹׁסַע שֶׁסַע פַּרְסָה וְהוּא גֵּרָה לֹֽא יִגָּר טָמֵא הוּא לָכֶֽם׃
translation: The pig, because it has a split hoof, and is cloven-footed, but doesn't chew the cud, is unclean to you. (Leviticus 11:7)

text: וַתִּצְלַח עָלָיו רוּחַ יְהוָה וַֽיְשַׁסְּעֵהוּ כְּשַׁסַּע הַגְּדִי וּמְאוּמָה אֵין בְּיָדוֹ וְלֹא הִגִּיד לְאָבִיו וּלְאִמּוֹ אֵת אֲשֶׁר עָשָֽׂה׃
translation: The LORD's Spirit came mightily on him, and he tore him as he would have torn a young goat with his bare hands, but he didn't tell his father or his mother what he had done. (Judges 14:6)

text: לְֽכָל הַבְּהֵמָה אֲשֶׁר הִוא מַפְרֶסֶת פַּרְסָה וְשֶׁסַע אֵינֶנָּה שֹׁסַעַת וְגֵרָה אֵינֶנָּה מַעֲלָה טְמֵאִים הֵם לָכֶם כָּל הַנֹּגֵעַ בָּהֶם יִטְמָֽא׃
translation: "'Every animal which has a split hoof that isn't completely divided, or doesn't chew the cud, is unclean to you. Everyone who touches them shall be unclean. (Leviticus 11:26)

text: וַיִּקְרָא הַשֹּֽׁעֲרִים וַיַּגִּידוּ בֵּית הַמֶּלֶךְ פְּנִֽימָה׃
translation: Then the gatekeepers called out and told it to the king's household within. (2 Kings 7:11)

text: וּדְבִיר בְּתוֹךְ הַבַּיִת מִפְּנִימָה הֵכִין לְתִתֵּן שָׁם אֶת אֲרוֹן בְּרִית יְהוָֽה׃
translation: He prepared an inner sanctuary in the middle of the house within, to set the ark of the LORD's covenant there. (1 Kings 6:19)

text: וְאֶרֶז אֶל הַבַּיִת פְּנִימָה מִקְלַעַת פְּקָעִים וּפְטוּרֵי צִצִּים הַכֹּל אֶרֶז אֵין אֶבֶן נִרְאָֽה׃
translation: There was cedar on the house within, carved with buds and open flowers. All was cedar. No stone was visible. (1 Kings 6:18)

text: הֵן לֹא הוּבָא אֶת דָּמָהּ אֶל הַקֹּדֶשׁ פְּנִימָה אָכוֹל תֹּאכְלוּ אֹתָהּ בַּקֹּדֶשׁ כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוֵּֽיתִי׃
translation: Behold, its blood was not brought into the inner part of the sanctuary. You certainly should have eaten it in the sanctuary, as I commanded." (Leviticus 10:18)

text: וּבָא לִפְנִימָה וַיָּמָד אֵֽיל הַפֶּתַח שְׁתַּיִם אַמּוֹת וְהַפֶּתַח שֵׁשׁ אַמּוֹת וְרֹחַב הַפֶּתַח שֶׁבַע אַמּֽוֹת׃
translation: Then he went inward and measured each post of the entrance, two cubits; and the entrance, six cubits; and the width of the entrance, seven cubits. (Ezekiel 41:3)

text: וַיְצַף שְׁלֹמֹה אֶת הַבַּיִת מִפְּנִימָה זָהָב סָגוּר וַיְעַבֵּר ברתיקות בְּרַתּוּקוֹת זָהָב לִפְנֵי הַדְּבִיר וַיְצַפֵּהוּ זָהָֽב׃
translation: So Solomon overlaid the house within with pure gold. He drew chains of gold across before the inner sanctuary, and he overlaid it with gold. (1 Kings 6:21)

text: וְאִישׁ כִּי יִמָּרֵט רֹאשׁוֹ קֵרֵחַ הוּא טָהוֹר הֽוּא׃
translation: "If a man's hair has fallen from his head, he is bald. He is clean. (Leviticus 13:40)

text: וְאִם מִפְּאַת פָּנָיו יִמָּרֵט רֹאשׁוֹ גִּבֵּחַ הוּא טָהוֹר הֽוּא׃
translation: If his hair has fallen off from the front part of his head, his forehead is bald. He is clean. (Leviticus 13:41)

text: גֵּוִי נָתַתִּי לְמַכִּים וּלְחָיַי לְמֹֽרְטִים פָּנַי לֹא הִסְתַּרְתִּי מִכְּלִמּוֹת וָרֹֽק׃
translation: I gave my back to those who beat me, and my cheeks to those who plucked off the hair. I didn't hide my face from shame and spitting. (Isaiah 50:6)

text: וּכְשָׁמְעִי אֶת הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה קָרַעְתִּי אֶת בִּגְדִי וּמְעִילִי וָאֶמְרְטָה מִשְּׂעַר רֹאשִׁי וּזְקָנִי וָאֵשְׁבָה מְשׁוֹמֵֽם׃
translation: When I heard this thing, I tore my garment and my robe, and pulled the hair out of my head and of my beard, and sat down confounded. (Ezra 9:3)

text: וָאָרִיב עִמָּם וָאֲקַֽלְלֵם וָאַכֶּה מֵהֶם אֲנָשִׁים וָֽאֶמְרְטֵם וָאַשְׁבִּיעֵם בֵּֽאלֹהִים אִם תִּתְּנוּ בְנֹֽתֵיכֶם לִבְנֵיהֶם וְאִם תִּשְׂאוּ מִבְּנֹתֵיהֶם לִבְנֵיכֶם וְלָכֶֽם׃
translation: I contended with them, cursed them, struck certain of them, plucked off their hair, and made them swear by God, "You shall not give your daughters to their sons, nor take their daughters for your sons, or for yourselves. (Nehemiah 13:25)

text: גַּם יְהוָה יִתֵּן הַטּוֹב וְאַרְצֵנוּ תִּתֵּן יְבוּלָֽהּ׃
translation: Righteousness goes before him, and prepares the way for his steps. (Psalms 85:13)

text: עַל כֵּן עֲלֵיכֶם כָּלְאוּ שָמַיִם מִטָּל וְהָאָרֶץ כָּלְאָה יְבוּלָֽהּ׃
translation: Therefore for your sake the heavens withhold the dew, and the earth withholds its fruit. (Haggai 1:10)

text: וְנָתַתִּי גִשְׁמֵיכֶם בְּעִתָּם וְנָתְנָה הָאָרֶץ יְבוּלָהּ וְעֵץ הַשָּׂדֶה יִתֵּן פִּרְיֽוֹ׃
translation: then I will give you your rains in their season, and the land shall yield its increase, and the trees of the field shall yield their fruit. (Leviticus 26:4)

text: אֶרֶץ נָתְנָה יְבוּלָהּ יְבָרְכֵנוּ אֱלֹהִים אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃
translation: God will bless us. All the ends of the earth shall fear him. (Psalms 67:7)

text: וַיִּתֵּן לֶחָסִיל יְבוּלָם וִֽיגִיעָם לָאַרְבֶּֽה׃
translation: He also gave their increase to the caterpillar, and their labor to the locust. (Psalms 78:46)

text: וְתַם לָרִיק כֹּחֲכֶם וְלֹֽא תִתֵּן אַרְצְכֶם אֶת יְבוּלָהּ וְעֵץ הָאָרֶץ לֹא יִתֵּן פִּרְיֽוֹ׃
translation: Your strength will be spent in vain; for your land won't yield its increase, neither will the trees of the land yield their fruit. (Leviticus 26:20)

text: כָּל עָרֵי הַגֵּרְשֻׁנִּי לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם שְׁלֹשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה עִיר וּמִגְרְשֵׁיהֶֽן׃
translation: All the cities of the Gershonites according to their families were thirteen cities with their pasture lands. (Joshua 21:33)

text: לְגֵרְשׁוֹן מִשְׁפַּחַת הַלִּבְנִי וּמִשְׁפַּחַת הַשִּׁמְעִי אֵלֶּה הֵם מִשְׁפְּחֹת הַגֵּרְשֻׁנִּֽי׃
translation: Of Gershon was the family of the Libnites, and the family of the Shimeites. These are the families of the Gershonites. (Numbers 3:21)

text: וּנְשִׂיא בֵֽית אָב לַגֵּרְשֻׁנִּי אֶלְיָסָף בֶּן לָאֵֽל׃
translation: Eliasaph the son of Lael shall be the prince of the fathers' house of the Gershonites. (Numbers 3:24)

text: מִשְׁפְּחֹת הַגֵּרְשֻׁנִּי אַחֲרֵי הַמִּשְׁכָּן יַחֲנוּ יָֽמָּה׃
translation: The families of the Gershonites shall encamp behind the tabernacle westward. (Numbers 3:23)

text: זֹאת עֲבֹדַת מִשְׁפְּחֹת הַגֵּרְשֻׁנִּי לַעֲבֹד וּלְמַשָּֽׂא׃
translation: "This is the service of the families of the Gershonites, in serving and in bearing burdens: (Numbers 4:24)

text: בְּנֵי לַעְדָּן בְּנֵי הַגֵּרְשֻׁנִּי לְלַעְדָּן רָאשֵׁי הָאָבוֹת לְלַעְדָּן הַגֵּרְשֻׁנִּי יְחִיאֵלִֽי׃
translation: The sons of Ladan, the sons of the Gershonites belonging to Ladan, the heads of the fathers' households belonging to Ladan the Gershonite: Jehieli. (1 Chronicles 26:21)

text: הַוּוֹת תַּחְשֹׁב לְשׁוֹנֶךָ כְּתַעַר מְלֻטָּשׁ עֹשֵׂה רְמִיָּֽה׃
translation: You love all devouring words, you deceitful tongue. (Psalms 52:4)

text: הוֹי חֶרֶב לַֽיהוָה עַד אָנָה לֹא תִשְׁקֹטִי הֵאָֽסְפִי אַל תַּעְרֵךְ הֵרָגְעִי וָדֹֽמִּי׃
translation: "'You sword of the LORD, how long will it be before you are quiet? Put yourself back into your scabbard; rest, and be still.' (Jeremiah 47:6)

text: וְיָֽדְעוּ כָּל בָּשָׂר כִּי אֲנִי יְהוָה הוֹצֵאתִי חַרְבִּי מִתַּעְרָהּ לֹא תָשׁוּב עֽוֹד׃
translation: It is sharpened that it may make a slaughter. It is polished that it may be as lightning. Should we then make mirth? The rod of my son condemns every tree. (Ezekiel 21:10)

text: וְאָמַרְתָּ לְאַדְמַת יִשְׂרָאֵל כֹּה אָמַר יְהוָה הִנְנִי אֵלַיִךְ וְהוֹצֵאתִי חַרְבִּי מִתַּעְרָהּ וְהִכְרַתִּי מִמֵּךְ צַדִּיק וְרָשָֽׁע׃
translation: The LORD's word came to me, saying, (Ezekiel 21:8)

text: יַעַן אֲשֶׁר הִכְרַתִּי מִמֵּךְ צַדִּיק וְרָשָׁע לָכֵן תֵּצֵא חַרְבִּי מִתַּעְרָהּ אֶל כָּל בָּשָׂר מִנֶּגֶב צָפֽוֹן׃
translation: "Son of man, prophesy, and say, 'The LORD says: "A sword! A sword! It is sharpened, and also polished. (Ezekiel 21:9)

text: וְכֹֽה תַעֲשֶׂה לָהֶם לְטַֽהֲרָם הַזֵּה עֲלֵיהֶם מֵי חַטָּאת וְהֶעֱבִירוּ תַעַר עַל כָּל בְּשָׂרָם וְכִבְּסוּ בִגְדֵיהֶם וְהִטֶּהָֽרוּ׃
translation: You shall do this to them to cleanse them: sprinkle the water of cleansing on them, let them shave their whole bodies with a razor, let them wash their clothes, and cleanse themselves. (Numbers 8:7)

text: הוֹרֵנִי יְהוָה דַּרְכֶּךָ וּנְחֵנִי בְּאֹרַח מִישׁוֹר לְמַעַן שׁוֹרְרָֽי׃
translation: Teach me your way, LORD. Lead me in a straight path, because of my enemies. (Psalms 27:11)

text: יְהוָה נְחֵנִי בְצִדְקָתֶךָ לְמַעַן שׁוֹרְרָי הושר הַיְשַׁר לְפָנַי דַּרְכֶּֽךָ׃
translation: For there is no faithfulness in their mouth. Their heart is destruction. Their throat is an open tomb. They flatter with their tongue. (Psalms 5:9)

text: שָׁאֲפוּ שׁוֹרְרַי כָּל הַיּוֹם כִּֽי רַבִּים לֹחֲמִים לִי מָרֽוֹם׃
translation: When I am afraid, I will put my trust in you. (Psalms 56:3)

text: אֱלֹהֵי חסדו חַסְדִּי יְקַדְּמֵנִי אֱלֹהִים יַרְאֵנִי בְשֹׁרְרָֽי׃
translation: Don't kill them, or my people may forget. Scatter them by your power, and bring them down, Lord our shield. (Psalms 59:11)

text: בִּי שָׂרִים יָשֹׂרוּ וּנְדִיבִים כָּל שֹׁפְטֵי צֶֽדֶק׃
translation: By me princes rule, nobles, and all the righteous rulers of the earth. (Proverbs 8:16)

text: הֵן לְצֶדֶק יִמְלָךְ מֶלֶךְ וּלְשָׂרִים לְמִשְׁפָּט יָשֹֽׂרוּ׃
translation: Behold, a king shall reign in righteousness, and princes shall rule in justice. (Isaiah 32:1)

text: תָּעוּ בַמִּדְבָּר בִּישִׁימוֹן דָּרֶךְ עִיר מוֹשָׁב לֹא מָצָֽאוּ׃
translation: They wandered in the wilderness in a desert way. They found no city to live in. (Psalms 107:4)

text: אֱֽלֹהִים בְּצֵאתְךָ לִפְנֵי עַמֶּךָ בְּצַעְדְּךָ בִֽישִׁימוֹן סֶֽלָה׃
translation: The earth trembled. The sky also poured down rain at the presence of the God of Sinai— at the presence of God, the God of Israel. (Psalms 68:8)

text: וַיִּקַּח בָּלָק אֶת בִּלְעָם רֹאשׁ הַפְּעוֹר הַנִּשְׁקָף עַל פְּנֵי הַיְשִׁימֹֽן׃
translation: Balak took Balaam to the top of Peor, that looks down on the desert. (Numbers 23:28)

text: וַיִּתְאַוּוּ תַאֲוָה בַּמִּדְבָּר וַיְנַסּוּ אֵל בִּֽישִׁימֽוֹן׃
translation: but gave in to craving in the desert, and tested God in the wasteland. (Psalms 106:14)

text: וּמִבָּמוֹת הַגַּיְא אֲשֶׁר בִּשְׂדֵה מוֹאָב רֹאשׁ הַפִּסְגָּה וְנִשְׁקָפָה עַל פְּנֵי הַיְשִׁימֹֽן׃
translation: and from Bamoth to the valley that is in the field of Moab, to the top of Pisgah, which looks down on the desert. (Numbers 21:20)

text: כַּמָּה יַמְרוּהוּ בַמִּדְבָּר יַעֲצִיבוּהוּ בִּֽישִׁימֽוֹן׃
translation: How often they rebelled against him in the wilderness, and grieved him in the desert! (Psalms 78:40)

text: יְראוּ אֶת יְהוָה קְדֹשָׁיו כִּי אֵין מַחְסוֹר לִירֵאָֽיו׃
translation: The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger, but those who seek the LORD shall not lack any good thing. (Psalms 34:10)

text: בְּכָל עֶצֶב יִהְיֶה מוֹתָר וּדְבַר שְׂפָתַיִם אַךְ לְמַחְסֽוֹר׃
translation: In all hard work there is profit, but the talk of the lips leads only to poverty. (Proverbs 14:23)

text: עֹשֵֽׁק דָּל לְהַרְבּוֹת לוֹ נֹתֵן לְעָשִׁיר אַךְ לְמַחְסֽוֹר׃
translation: Whoever oppresses the poor for his own increase and whoever gives to the rich, both come to poverty. (Proverbs 22:16)

text: נוֹתֵן לָרָשׁ אֵין מַחְסוֹר וּמַעְלִים עֵינָיו רַב מְאֵרֽוֹת׃
translation: One who gives to the poor has no lack; but one who closes his eyes will have many curses. (Proverbs 28:27)

text: אִישׁ מַחְסוֹר אֹהֵב שִׂמְחָה אֹהֵב יַֽיִן וָשֶׁמֶן לֹא יַעֲשִֽׁיר׃
translation: He who loves pleasure will be a poor man. He who loves wine and oil won't be rich. (Proverbs 21:17)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר הָאִישׁ הַזָּקֵן שָׁלוֹם לָךְ רַק כָּל מַחְסוֹרְךָ עָלָי רַק בָּרְחוֹב אַל תָּלַֽן׃
translation: The old man said, "Peace be to you! Just let me supply all your needs, but don't sleep in the street." (Judges 19:20)

text: וְרָאִיתָ בַּשִּׁבְיָה אֵשֶׁת יְפַת תֹּאַר וְחָשַׁקְתָּ בָהּ וְלָקַחְתָּ לְךָ לְאִשָּֽׁה׃
translation: and see among the captives a beautiful woman, and you are attracted to her, and desire to take her as your wife, (Deuteronomy 21:11)

text: וְאֶת יְעוּץ וְאֶת שָֽׂכְיָה וְאֶת מִרְמָה אֵלֶּה בָנָיו רָאשֵׁי אָבֽוֹת׃
translation: Jeuz, Shachia, and Mirmah. These were his sons, heads of fathers' households. (1 Chronicles 8:10)

text: וַיַּעֲזֹב הֶֽחָלוּץ אֶת הַשִּׁבְיָה וְאֶת הַבִּזָּה לִפְנֵי הַשָּׂרִים וְכָל הַקָּהָֽל׃
translation: So the armed men left the captives and the plunder before the princes and all the assembly. (2 Chronicles 28:14)

text: אַשְׁכִּיר חִצַּי מִדָּם וְחַרְבִּי תֹּאכַל בָּשָׂר מִדַּם חָלָל וְשִׁבְיָה מֵרֹאשׁ פַּרְעוֹת אוֹיֵֽב׃
translation: I will make my arrows drunk with blood. My sword shall devour flesh with the blood of the slain and the captives, from the head of the leaders of the enemy." (Deuteronomy 32:42)

text: וְעַתָּה שְׁמָעוּנִי וְהָשִׁיבוּ הַשִּׁבְיָה אֲשֶׁר שְׁבִיתֶם מֵאֲחֵיכֶם כִּי חֲרוֹן אַף יְהוָה עֲלֵיכֶֽם׃
translation: Now hear me therefore, and send back the captives that you have taken captive from your brothers, for the fierce wrath of the LORD is on you." (2 Chronicles 28:11)

text: אוֹי לְךָ מוֹאָב אָבַד עַם כְּמוֹשׁ כִּֽי לֻקְּחוּ בָנֶיךָ בַּשֶּׁבִי וּבְנֹתֶיךָ בַּשִּׁבְיָֽה׃
translation: Woe to you, O Moab! The people of Chemosh are undone; for your sons are taken away captive, and your daughters into captivity. (Jeremiah 48:46)

text: וְעוֹד אֲדוֹמִים בָּאוּ וַיַּכּוּ בִיהוּדָה וַיִּשְׁבּוּ שֶֽׁבִי׃
translation: For again the Edomites had come and struck Judah, and carried away captives. (2 Chronicles 28:17)

text: וַיָּקֶם יְהוָה שָׂטָן לִשְׁלֹמֹה אֵת הֲדַד הָאֲדֹמִי מִזֶּרַע הַמֶּלֶךְ הוּא בֶּאֱדֽוֹם׃
translation: The LORD raised up an adversary to Solomon: Hadad the Edomite. He was one of the king's offspring in Edom. (1 Kings 11:14)

text: בְּבוֹא דּוֹאֵג הָאֲדֹמִי וַיַּגֵּד לְשָׁאוּל וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ בָּא דָוִד אֶל בֵּית אֲחִימֶֽלֶךְ׃
translation: Your tongue plots destruction, like a sharp razor, working deceitfully. (Psalms 52:2)

text: לֹֽא תְתַעֵב אֲדֹמִי כִּי אָחִיךָ הוּא לֹא תְתַעֵב מִצְרִי כִּי גֵר הָיִיתָ בְאַרְצֽוֹ׃
translation: The children of the third generation who are born to them may enter into the LORD's assembly. (Deuteronomy 23:8)

text: וַיְהִי גְבוּלָם מֵחֵלֶף מֵֽאֵלוֹן בְּצַעֲנַנִּים וַאֲדָמִי הַנֶּקֶב וְיַבְנְאֵל עַד לַקּוּם וַיְהִי תֹצְאֹתָיו הַיַּרְדֵּֽן׃
translation: Their border was from Heleph, from the oak in Zaanannim, Adami-nekeb, and Jabneel, to Lakkum. It ended at the Jordan. (Joshua 19:33)

text: וַיִּבְרַח אֲדַד הוּא וַאֲנָשִׁים אֲדֹמִיִּים מֵעַבְדֵי אָבִיו אִתּוֹ לָבוֹא מִצְרָיִם וַהֲדַד נַעַר קָטָֽן׃
translation: Hadad fled, he and certain Edomites of his father's servants with him, to go into Egypt, when Hadad was still a little child. (1 Kings 11:17)

text: וַיֵּֽרָאוּ אֲפִקֵי יָם יִגָּלוּ מֹסְדוֹת תֵּבֵל בְּגַעֲרַת יְהוָה מִנִּשְׁמַת רוּחַ אַפּֽוֹ׃
translation: Then the channels of the sea appeared. The foundations of the world were laid bare by the LORD's rebuke, at the blast of the breath of his nostrils. (2 Samuel 22:16)

text: וַיֵּרָאוּ אֲפִיקֵי מַיִם וַֽיִּגָּלוּ מוֹסְדוֹת תֵּבֵל מִגַּעֲרָתְךָ יְהוָה מִנִּשְׁמַת רוּחַ אַפֶּֽךָ׃
translation: He sent from on high. He took me. He drew me out of many waters. (Psalms 18:16)

text: הֲלוֹא תֵֽדְעוּ הֲלוֹא תִשְׁמָעוּ הֲלוֹא הֻגַּד מֵרֹאשׁ לָכֶם הֲלוֹא הֲבִינֹתֶם מוֹסְדוֹת הָאָֽרֶץ׃
translation: Haven't you known? Haven't you heard? Haven't you been told from the beginning? Haven't you understood from the foundations of the earth? (Isaiah 40:21)

text: וְלֹֽא יִקְחוּ מִמְּךָ אֶבֶן לְפִנָּה וְאֶבֶן לְמֽוֹסָדוֹת כִּֽי שִׁמְמוֹת עוֹלָם תִּֽהְיֶה נְאֻם יְהוָֽה׃
translation: They won't take a cornerstone from you, nor a stone for foundations; but you will be desolate forever," says the LORD. (Jeremiah 51:26)

text: וְרָאִיתִי לַבַּיִת גֹּבַהּ סָבִיב סָבִיב מיסדות מוּסְדוֹת הַצְּלָעוֹת מְלוֹ הַקָּנֶה שֵׁשׁ אַמּוֹת אַצִּֽילָה׃
translation: I saw also that the house had a raised base all around. The foundations of the side rooms were a full reed of six great cubits. (Ezekiel 41:8)

text: וּבָנוּ מִמְּךָ חָרְבוֹת עוֹלָם מוֹסְדֵי דוֹר וָדוֹר תְּקוֹמֵם וְקֹרָא לְךָ גֹּדֵר פֶּרֶץ מְשֹׁבֵב נְתִיבוֹת לָשָֽׁבֶת׃
translation: Those who will be of you will build the old waste places. You will raise up the foundations of many generations. You will be called Repairer of the Breach, Restorer of Paths with Dwellings. (Isaiah 58:12)

text: רַע רַע יֹאמַר הַקּוֹנֶה וְאֹזֵל לוֹ אָז יִתְהַלָּֽל׃
translation: "It's no good, it's no good," says the buyer; but when he is gone his way, then he boasts. (Proverbs 20:14)

text: אָֽזְלוּ מַיִם מִנִּי יָם וְנָהָר יֶחֱרַב וְיָבֵֽשׁ׃
translation: As the waters fail from the sea, and the river wastes and dries up, (Job 14:11)

text: אֱדַיִן דָּֽנִיֵּאל לְבַיְתֵהּ אֲזַל וְלַחֲנַנְיָה מִֽישָׁאֵל וַעֲזַרְיָה חַבְרוֹהִי מִלְּתָא הוֹדַֽע׃
translation: Then Daniel went to his house and made the thing known to Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah, his companions: (Daniel 2:17)

text: מַה תֵּזְלִי מְאֹד לְשַׁנּוֹת אֶת דַּרְכֵּךְ גַּם מִמִּצְרַיִם תֵּבוֹשִׁי כַּאֲשֶׁר בֹּשְׁתְּ מֵאַשּֽׁוּר׃
translation: Why do you go about so much to change your ways? You will be ashamed of Egypt also, as you were ashamed of Assyria. (Jeremiah 2:36)

text: אֱדַיִן אֲזַל מַלְכָּא לְהֵֽיכְלֵהּ וּבָת טְוָת וְדַחֲוָן לָא הַנְעֵל קָֽדָמוֹהִי וְשִׁנְתֵּהּ נַדַּת עֲלֽוֹהִי׃
translation: Then the king arose very early in the morning, and went in haste to the den of lions. (Daniel 6:19)

text: כִּֽי יָדִין יְהוָה עַמּוֹ וְעַל עֲבָדָיו יִתְנֶחָם כִּי יִרְאֶה כִּי אָזְלַת יָד וְאֶפֶס עָצוּר וְעָזֽוּב׃
translation: For the LORD will judge his people, and have compassion on his servants, when he sees that their power is gone, that there is no one remaining, shut up or left at large. (Deuteronomy 32:36)

text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ לְיִפְתָּח לְכָה וְהָיִיתָה לָּנוּ לְקָצִין וְנִֽלָּחֲמָה בִּבְנֵי עַמּֽוֹן׃
translation: They said to Jephthah, "Come and be our chief, that we may fight with the children of Ammon." (Judges 11:6)

text: אֲשֶׁר אֵֽין לָהּ קָצִין שֹׁטֵר וּמֹשֵֽׁל׃
translation: which having no chief, overseer, or ruler, (Proverbs 6:7)

text: שִׁמְעוּ דְבַר יְהוָה קְצִינֵי סְדֹם הַאֲזִינוּ תּוֹרַת אֱלֹהֵינוּ עַם עֲמֹרָֽה׃
translation: Hear the LORD's word, you rulers of Sodom! Listen to the law of our God, you people of Gomorrah! (Isaiah 1:10)

text: וּמִשָּׁם עָבַר קֵדְמָה מִזְרָחָה גִּתָּה חֵפֶר עִתָּה קָצִין וְיָצָא רִמּוֹן הַמְּתֹאָר הַנֵּעָֽה׃
translation: From there it passed along eastward to Gath Hepher, to Ethkazin; and it went out at Rimmon which stretches to Neah. (Joshua 19:13)

text: כָּל קְצִינַיִךְ נָֽדְדוּ יַחַד מִקֶּשֶׁת אֻסָּרוּ כָּל נִמְצָאַיִךְ אֻסְּרוּ יַחְדָּו מֵרָחוֹק בָּרָֽחוּ׃
translation: All your rulers fled away together. They were bound by the archers. All who were found by you were bound together. They fled far away. (Isaiah 22:3)

text: וָאֹמַר שִׁמְעוּ נָא רָאשֵׁי יַעֲקֹב וּקְצִינֵי בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל הֲלוֹא לָכֶם לָדַעַת אֶת הַמִּשְׁפָּֽט׃
translation: I said, "Please listen, you heads of Jacob, and rulers of the house of Israel: Isn't it for you to know justice? (Micah 3:1)

text: בְּנֵי צוֹפָח סוּחַ וְחַרְנֶפֶר וְשׁוּעָל וּבֵרִי וְיִמְרָֽה׃
translation: The sons of Zophah: Suah, Harnepher, Shual, Beri, Imrah, (1 Chronicles 7:36)

text: אֶֽחֱזוּ לָנוּ שֽׁוּעָלִים שֽׁוּעָלִים קְטַנִּים מְחַבְּלִים כְּרָמִים וּכְרָמֵינוּ סְמָדַֽר׃
translation: Catch for us the foxes, the little foxes that plunder the vineyards; for our vineyards are in blossom. (Song of Solomon 2:15)

text: עַל הַר צִיּוֹן שֶׁשָּׁמֵם שׁוּעָלִים הִלְּכוּ בֽוֹ׃
translation: for the mountain of Zion, which is desolate. The foxes walk on it. (Lamentations 5:18)

text: וַיֵּֽשְׁבוּ בִּבְאֵֽר שֶׁבַע וּמוֹלָדָה וַחֲצַר שׁוּעָֽל׃
translation: They lived at Beersheba, Moladah, Hazarshual, (1 Chronicles 4:28)

text: וַחֲצַר שׁוּעָל וּבְאֵר שֶׁבַע וּבִזְיוֹתְיָֽה׃
translation: Hazar Shual, Beersheba, Biziothiah, (Joshua 15:28)

text: וּבַחֲצַר שׁוּעָל וּבִבְאֵר שֶׁבַע וּבְנֹתֶֽיהָ׃
translation: in Hazar Shual, in Beersheba and its towns, (Nehemiah 11:27)

text: וַיִּבֶן שְׁלֹמֹה אֶת גָּזֶר וְאֶת בֵּית חֹרֹן תַּחְתּֽוֹן׃
translation: Solomon built in the land Gezer, Beth Horon the lower, (1 Kings 9:17)

text: וּבִתּוֹ שֶׁאֱרָה וַתִּבֶן אֶת בֵּית חוֹרוֹן הַתַּחְתּוֹן וְאֶת הָעֶלְיוֹן וְאֵת אֻזֵּן שֶׁאֱרָֽה׃
translation: His daughter was Sheerah, who built Beth Horon the lower and the upper, and Uzzen Sheerah. (1 Chronicles 7:24)

text: וְאֵת בְּקִיעֵי עִיר דָּוִד רְאִיתֶם כִּי רָבּוּ וַֽתְּקַבְּצוּ אֶת מֵי הַבְּרֵכָה הַתַּחְתּוֹנָֽה׃
translation: You saw the breaches of David's city, that they were many; and you gathered together the waters of the lower pool. (Isaiah 22:9)

text: וַיָּמָד רֹחַב מִלִּפְנֵי הַשַּׁעַר הַתַּחְתּוֹנָה לִפְנֵי הֶחָצֵר הַפְּנִימִי מִחוּץ מֵאָה אַמָּה הַקָּדִים וְהַצָּפֽוֹן׃
translation: Then he measured the width from the forefront of the lower gate to the forefront of the inner court outside, one hundred cubits, both on the east and on the north. (Ezekiel 40:19)

text: וַיִּבֶן אֶת בֵּית חוֹרוֹן הָֽעֶלְיוֹן וְאֶת בֵּית חוֹרוֹן הַתַּחְתּוֹן עָרֵי מָצוֹר חוֹמוֹת דְּלָתַיִם וּבְרִֽיחַ׃
translation: Also he built Beth Horon the upper and Beth Horon the lower, fortified cities with walls, gates, and bars; (2 Chronicles 8:5)

text: וְיָֽרַד יָמָּה אֶל גְּבוּל הַיַּפְלֵטִי עַד גְּבוּל בֵּית חוֹרֹן תַּחְתּוֹן וְעַד גָּזֶר וְהָיוּ תצאתו תֹצְאֹתָיו יָֽמָּה׃
translation: and it went down westward to the border of the Japhletites, to the border of Beth Horon the lower, and on to Gezer; and ended at the sea. (Joshua 16:3)

text: צִוָּה אֱלֹהֶיךָ עֻזֶּךָ עוּזָּה אֱלֹהִים זוּ פָּעַלְתָּ לָּֽנוּ׃
translation: Because of your temple at Jerusalem, kings shall bring presents to you. (Psalms 68:29)

text: לְךָ זְרוֹעַ עִם גְּבוּרָה תָּעֹז יָדְךָ תָּרוּם יְמִינֶֽךָ׃
translation: Righteousness and justice are the foundation of your throne. Loving kindness and truth go before your face. (Psalms 89:14)

text: וְהֶחֱזִיקָה בּוֹ וְנָשְׁקָה לּוֹ הֵעֵזָה פָנֶיהָ וַתֹּאמַר לֽוֹ׃
translation: So she caught him, and kissed him. With an impudent face she said to him: (Proverbs 7:13)

text: קוּמָה יְהוָה אַל יָעֹז אֱנוֹשׁ יִשָּׁפְטוּ גוֹיִם עַל פָּנֶֽיךָ׃
translation: Put them in fear, LORD. Let the nations know that they are only men. Selah. (Psalms 9:20)

text: בְּאַמְּצוֹ שְׁחָקִים מִמָּעַל בַּעֲזוֹז עִינוֹת תְּהוֹם׃
translation: when he established the clouds above, when the springs of the deep became strong, (Proverbs 8:28)

text: הֵעֵז אִישׁ רָשָׁע בְּפָנָיו וְיָשָׁר הוּא יכין יָבִין דרכיו דַּרְכּֽוֹ׃
translation: A wicked man hardens his face; but as for the upright, he establishes his ways. (Proverbs 21:29)

text: בַּעֲצַלְתַּיִם יִמַּךְ הַמְּקָרֶה וּבְשִׁפְלוּת יָדַיִם יִדְלֹף הַבָּֽיִת׃
translation: By slothfulness the roof sinks in; and through idleness of the hands the house leaks. (Ecclesiastes 10:18)

text: וַתֵּלֶךְ וַתָּבוֹא וַתְּלַקֵּט בַּשָּׂדֶה אַחֲרֵי הַקֹּצְרִים וַיִּקֶר מִקְרֶהָ חֶלְקַת הַשָּׂדֶה לְבֹעַז אֲשֶׁר מִמִּשְׁפַּחַת אֱלִימֶֽלֶךְ׃
translation: She went, and came and gleaned in the field after the reapers; and she happened to come to the portion of the field belonging to Boaz, who was of the family of Elimelech. (Ruth 2:3)

text: הֶֽחָכָם עֵינָיו בְּרֹאשׁוֹ וְהַכְּסִיל בַּחֹשֶׁךְ הוֹלֵךְ וְיָדַעְתִּי גַם אָנִי שֶׁמִּקְרֶה אֶחָד יִקְרֶה אֶת כֻּלָּֽם׃
translation: The wise man's eyes are in his head, and the fool walks in darkness—and yet I perceived that one event happens to them all. (Ecclesiastes 2:14)

text: וְלֹֽא דִבֶּר שָׁאוּל מְאוּמָה בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא כִּי אָמַר מִקְרֶה הוּא בִּלְתִּי טָהוֹר הוּא כִּֽי לֹא טָהֽוֹר׃
translation: Nevertheless Saul didn't say anything that day, for he thought, "Something has happened to him. He is not clean. Surely he is not clean." (1 Samuel 20:26)

text: וְהוּא יָצָא וַעֲבָדָיו בָּאוּ וַיִּרְאוּ וְהִנֵּה דַּלְתוֹת הָעֲלִיָּה נְעֻלוֹת וַיֹּאמְרוּ אַךְ מֵסִיךְ הוּא אֶת רַגְלָיו בַּחֲדַר הַמְּקֵרָֽה׃
translation: After he had gone, his servants came and saw that the doors of the upper room were locked. They said, "Surely he is covering his feet in the upper room." (Judges 3:24)

text: וְאָמַרְתִּֽי אֲנִי בְּלִבִּי כְּמִקְרֵה הַכְּסִיל גַּם אֲנִי יִקְרֵנִי וְלָמָּה חָכַמְתִּי אֲנִי אָז יוֹתֵר וְדִבַּרְתִּי בְלִבִּי שֶׁגַּם זֶה הָֽבֶל׃
translation: Then I said in my heart, "As it happens to the fool, so will it happen even to me; and why was I then more wise?" Then I said in my heart that this also is vanity. (Ecclesiastes 2:15)

text: הָקִיצוּ שִׁכּוֹרִים וּבְכוּ וְהֵילִלוּ כָּל שֹׁתֵי יָיִן עַל עָסִיס כִּי נִכְרַת מִפִּיכֶֽם׃
translation: Wake up, you drunkards, and weep! Wail, all you drinkers of wine, because of the sweet wine, for it is cut off from your mouth. (Joel 1:5)

text: יְהוָה מָסַךְ בְּקִרְבָּהּ רוּחַ עִוְעִים וְהִתְעוּ אֶת מִצְרַיִם בְּכָֽל מַעֲשֵׂהוּ כְּהִתָּעוֹת שִׁכּוֹר בְּקִיאֽוֹ׃
translation: The LORD has mixed a spirit of perverseness in the middle of her; and they have caused Egypt to go astray in all of its works, like a drunken man staggers in his vomit. (Isaiah 19:14)

text: נוֹעַ תָּנוּעַ אֶרֶץ כַּשִּׁכּוֹר וְהִֽתְנוֹדְדָה כַּמְּלוּנָה וְכָבַד עָלֶיהָ פִּשְׁעָהּ וְנָפְלָה וְלֹא תֹסִיף קֽוּם׃
translation: The earth will stagger like a drunken man, and will sway back and forth like a hammock. Its disobedience will be heavy on it, and it will fall and not rise again. (Isaiah 24:20)

text: וְחַנָּה הִיא מְדַבֶּרֶת עַל לִבָּהּ רַק שְׂפָתֶיהָ נָּעוֹת וְקוֹלָהּ לֹא יִשָּׁמֵעַ וַיַּחְשְׁבֶהָ עֵלִי לְשִׁכֹּרָֽה׃
translation: Now Hannah spoke in her heart. Only her lips moved, but her voice was not heard. Therefore Eli thought she was drunk. (1 Samuel 1:13)

text: וַיֵּצְאוּ בַּֽצָּהֳרָיִם וּבֶן הֲדַד שֹׁתֶה שִׁכּוֹר בַּסֻּכּוֹת הוּא וְהַמְּלָכִים שְׁלֹשִֽׁים וּשְׁנַיִם מֶלֶךְ עֹזֵר אֹתֽוֹ׃
translation: They went out at noon. But Ben Hadad was drinking himself drunk in the pavilions, he and the kings, the thirty-two kings who helped him. (1 Kings 20:16)

text: הוֹי עֲטֶרֶת גֵּאוּת שִׁכֹּרֵי אֶפְרַיִם וְצִיץ נֹבֵל צְבִי תִפְאַרְתּוֹ אֲשֶׁר עַל רֹאשׁ גֵּֽיא שְׁמָנִים הֲלוּמֵי יָֽיִן׃
translation: Woe to the crown of pride of the drunkards of Ephraim, and to the fading flower of his glorious beauty, which is on the head of the fertile valley of those who are overcome with wine! (Isaiah 28:1)

text: דֹּב אֹרֵב הוּא לִי אריה אֲרִי בְּמִסְתָּרִֽים׃
translation: He is to me as a bear lying in wait, as a lion in hiding. (Lamentations 3:10)

text: וּפָרָה וָדֹב תִּרְעֶינָה יַחְדָּו יִרְבְּצוּ יַלְדֵיהֶן וְאַרְיֵה כַּבָּקָר יֹֽאכַל תֶּֽבֶן׃
translation: The cow and the bear will graze. Their young ones will lie down together. The lion will eat straw like the ox. (Isaiah 11:7)

text: נֶהֱמֶה כַדֻּבִּים כֻּלָּנוּ וְכַיּוֹנִים הָגֹה נֶהְגֶּה נְקַוֶּה לַמִּשְׁפָּט וָאַיִן לִֽישׁוּעָה רָחֲקָה מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃
translation: We all roar like bears and moan sadly like doves. We look for justice, but there is none, for salvation, but it is far off from us. (Isaiah 59:11)

text: כַּאֲשֶׁר יָנוּס אִישׁ מִפְּנֵי הָאֲרִי וּפְגָעוֹ הַדֹּב וּבָא הַבַּיִת וְסָמַךְ יָדוֹ עַל הַקִּיר וּנְשָׁכוֹ הַנָּחָֽשׁ׃
translation: As if a man fled from a lion, and a bear met him; or he went into the house and leaned his hand on the wall, and a snake bit him. (Amos 5:19)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל שָׁאוּל רֹעֶה הָיָה עַבְדְּךָ לְאָבִיו בַּצֹּאן וּבָא הָֽאֲרִי וְאֶת הַדּוֹב וְנָשָׂא שֶׂה מֵהָעֵֽדֶר׃
translation: David said to Saul, "Your servant was keeping his father's sheep; and when a lion or a bear came and took a lamb out of the flock, (1 Samuel 17:34)

text: וַיִּפֶן אַֽחֲרָיו וַיִּרְאֵם וַֽיְקַלְלֵם בְּשֵׁם יְהוָה וַתֵּצֶאנָה שְׁתַּיִם דֻּבִּים מִן הַיַּעַר וַתְּבַקַּעְנָה מֵהֶם אַרְבָּעִים וּשְׁנֵי יְלָדִֽים׃
translation: He looked behind him and saw them, and cursed them in the LORD's name. Then two female bears came out of the woods and mauled forty-two of those youths. (2 Kings 2:24)

text: אִֽם יִשְׁמְעוּ וְֽיַעֲבֹדוּ יְכַלּוּ יְמֵיהֶם בַּטּוֹב וּשְׁנֵיהֶם בַּנְּעִימִֽים׃
translation: If they listen and serve him, they will spend their days in prosperity, and their years in pleasures. (Job 36:11)

text: הַֽלְלוּ יָהּ כִּי טוֹב יְהוָה זַמְּרוּ לִשְׁמוֹ כִּי נָעִֽים׃
translation: Praise the LORD, for the LORD is good. Sing praises to his name, for that is pleasant. (Psalms 135:3)

text: כִּֽי נָעִים כִּֽי תִשְׁמְרֵם בְּבִטְנֶךָ יִכֹּנוּ יַחְדָּו עַל שְׂפָתֶֽיךָ׃
translation: For it is a pleasant thing if you keep them within you, if all of them are ready on your lips. (Proverbs 22:18)

text: וּבְדַעַת חֲדָרִים יִמָּלְאוּ כָּל הוֹן יָקָר וְנָעִֽים׃
translation: by knowledge the rooms are filled with all rare and beautiful treasure. (Proverbs 24:4)

text: תּֽוֹדִיעֵנִי אֹרַח חַיִּים שֹׂבַע שְׂמָחוֹת אֶת פָּנֶיךָ נְעִמוֹת בִּימִינְךָ נֶֽצַח׃
translation: You will show me the path of life. In your presence is fullness of joy. In your right hand there are pleasures forever more. (Psalms 16:11)

text: שָׁאוּל וִיהוֹנָתָן הַנֶּאֱהָבִים וְהַנְּעִימִם בְּחַיֵּיהֶם וּבְמוֹתָם לֹא נִפְרָדוּ מִנְּשָׁרִים קַלּוּ מֵאֲרָיוֹת גָּבֵֽרוּ׃
translation: Saul and Jonathan were lovely and pleasant in their lives. In their death, they were not divided. They were swifter than eagles. They were stronger than lions. (2 Samuel 1:23)

text: גָּדוֹל יְהוָה וּמְהֻלָּל מְאֹד וְלִגְדֻלָּתוֹ אֵין חֵֽקֶר׃
translation: Great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised! His greatness is unsearchable. (Psalms 145:3)

text: וֶעֱזוּז נוֹרְאֹתֶיךָ יֹאמֵרוּ וגדולתיך וּגְדוּלָּתְךָ אֲסַפְּרֶֽנָּה׃
translation: Men will speak of the might of your awesome acts. I will declare your greatness. (Psalms 145:6)

text: בַּעֲבוּר דְּבָֽרְךָ וּֽכְלִבְּךָ עָשִׂיתָ אֵת כָּל הַגְּדוּלָּה הַזֹּאת לְהוֹדִיעַ אֶת עַבְדֶּֽךָ׃
translation: For your word's sake, and according to your own heart, you have worked all this greatness, to make your servant know it. (2 Samuel 7:21)

text: תֶּרֶב גְּֽדֻלָּתִי וְתִסֹּב תְּֽנַחֲמֵֽנִי׃
translation: Increase my honor and comfort me again. (Psalms 71:21)

text: יְהוָה בַּעֲבוּר עַבְדְּךָ וּֽכְלִבְּךָ עָשִׂיתָ אֵת כָּל הַגְּדוּלָּה הַזֹּאת לְהֹדִיעַ אֶת כָּל הַגְּדֻלּֽוֹת׃
translation: LORD, for your servant's sake, and according to your own heart, you have done all this greatness, to make known all these great things. (1 Chronicles 17:19)

text: בְּהַרְאֹתוֹ אֶת עֹשֶׁר כְּבוֹד מַלְכוּתוֹ וְאֶת יְקָר תִּפְאֶרֶת גְּדוּלָּתוֹ יָמִים רַבִּים שְׁמוֹנִים וּמְאַת יֽוֹם׃
translation: He displayed the riches of his glorious kingdom and the honor of his excellent majesty many days, even one hundred eighty days. (Esther 1:4)

text: לִרְאוֹת בְּטוֹבַת בְּחִירֶיךָ לִשְׂמֹחַ בְּשִׂמְחַת גּוֹיֶךָ לְהִתְהַלֵּל עִם נַחֲלָתֶֽךָ׃
translation: that I may see the prosperity of your chosen, that I may rejoice in the gladness of your nation, that I may glory with your inheritance. (Psalms 106:5)

text: זֶרַע יִשְׂרָאֵל עַבְדּוֹ בְּנֵי יַעֲקֹב בְּחִירָֽיו׃
translation: you offspring of Israel his servant, you children of Jacob, his chosen ones. (1 Chronicles 16:13)

text: כָּרַתִּֽי בְרִית לִבְחִירִי נִשְׁבַּעְתִּי לְדָוִד עַבְדִּֽי׃
translation: 'I will establish your offspring forever, and build up your throne to all generations.'" Selah. (Psalms 89:4)

text: זֶרַע אַבְרָהָם עַבְדּוֹ בְּנֵי יַעֲקֹב בְּחִירָֽיו׃
translation: you offspring of Abraham, his servant, you children of Jacob, his chosen ones. (Psalms 105:6)

text: וַיּוֹצִא עַמּוֹ בְשָׂשׂוֹן בְּרִנָּה אֶת בְּחִירָֽיו׃
translation: He brought his people out with joy, his chosen with singing. (Psalms 105:43)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר לְֽהַשְׁמִידָם לוּלֵי מֹשֶׁה בְחִירוֹ עָמַד בַּפֶּרֶץ לְפָנָיו לְהָשִׁיב חֲמָתוֹ מֵֽהַשְׁחִֽית׃
translation: Therefore he said that he would destroy them, had Moses, his chosen, not stood before him in the breach, to turn away his wrath, so that he wouldn't destroy them. (Psalms 106:23)

text: וְֽאֶשְׁחָקֵם כְּעָפָר עַל פְּנֵי רוּחַ כְּטִיט חוּצוֹת אֲרִיקֵֽם׃
translation: You have delivered me from the strivings of the people. You have made me the head of the nations. A people whom I have not known shall serve me. (Psalms 18:43)

text: תַּחְתָּיו חַדּוּדֵי חָרֶשׂ יִרְפַּד חָרוּץ עֲלֵי טִֽיט׃
translation: There is strength in his neck. Terror dances before him. (Job 41:22)

text: וַיַּעֲלֵנִי מִבּוֹר שָׁאוֹן מִטִּיט הַיָּוֵן וַיָּקֶם עַל סֶלַע רַגְלַי כּוֹנֵן אֲשֻׁרָֽי׃
translation: He has put a new song in my mouth, even praise to our God. Many shall see it, and fear, and shall trust in the LORD. (Psalms 40:3)

text: וְהָרְשָׁעִים כַּיָּם נִגְרָשׁ כִּי הַשְׁקֵט לֹא יוּכָל וַיִּגְרְשׁוּ מֵימָיו רֶפֶשׁ וָטִֽיט׃
translation: But the wicked are like the troubled sea; for it can't rest and its waters cast up mire and mud. (Isaiah 57:20)

text: מֵי מָצוֹר שַֽׁאֲבִי לָךְ חַזְּקִי מִבְצָרָיִךְ בֹּאִי בַטִּיט וְרִמְסִי בַחֹמֶר הַחֲזִיקִי מַלְבֵּֽן׃
translation: Draw water for the siege. Strengthen your fortresses. Go into the clay, and tread the mortar. Make the brick kiln strong. (Nahum 3:14)

text: הַעִירוֹתִי מִצָּפוֹן וַיַּאת מִמִּזְרַח שֶׁמֶשׁ יִקְרָא בִשְׁמִי וְיָבֹא סְגָנִים כְּמוֹ חֹמֶר וּכְמוֹ יוֹצֵר יִרְמָס טִֽיט׃
translation: "I have raised up one from the north, and he has come, from the rising of the sun, one who calls on my name, and he shall come on rulers as on mortar, and as the potter treads clay. (Isaiah 41:25)

text: חֹרֶיהָ וְאֵֽין שָׁם מְלוּכָה יִקְרָאוּ וְכָל שָׂרֶיהָ יִהְיוּ אָֽפֶס׃
translation: They shall call its nobles to the kingdom, but none shall be there; and all its princes shall be nothing. (Isaiah 34:12)

text: וַיִּשְׁחַט מֶלֶךְ בָּבֶל אֶת בְּנֵי צִדְקִיָּהוּ בְּרִבְלָה לְעֵינָיו וְאֵת כָּל חֹרֵי יְהוּדָה שָׁחַט מֶלֶךְ בָּבֶֽל׃
translation: Then the king of Babylon killed Zedekiah's sons in Riblah before his eyes. The king of Babylon also killed all the nobles of Judah. (Jeremiah 39:6)

text: וָאָרִיבָה אֵת חֹרֵי יְהוּדָה וָאֹמְרָה לָהֶם מָֽה הַדָּבָר הָרָע הַזֶּה אֲשֶׁר אַתֶּם עֹשִׂים וּֽמְחַלְּלִים אֶת יוֹם הַשַּׁבָּֽת׃
translation: Then I contended with the nobles of Judah, and said to them, "What evil thing is this that you do, and profane the Sabbath day? (Nehemiah 13:17)

text: וַתִּכְתֹּב סְפָרִים בְּשֵׁם אַחְאָב וַתַּחְתֹּם בְּחֹתָמוֹ וַתִּשְׁלַח הספרים סְפָרִים אֶל הַזְקֵנִים וְאֶל הַֽחֹרִים אֲשֶׁר בְּעִירוֹ הַיֹּשְׁבִים אֶת נָבֽוֹת׃
translation: So she wrote letters in Ahab's name and sealed them with his seal, and sent the letters to the elders and to the nobles who were in his city, who lived with Naboth. (1 Kings 21:8)

text: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ אַנְשֵׁי עִירוֹ הַזְּקֵנִים וְהַחֹרִים אֲשֶׁר הַיֹּֽשְׁבִים בְּעִירוֹ כַּאֲשֶׁר שָׁלְחָה אֲלֵיהֶם אִיזָבֶל כַּאֲשֶׁר כָּתוּב בַּסְּפָרִים אֲשֶׁר שָׁלְחָה אֲלֵיהֶֽם׃
translation: The men of his city, even the elders and the nobles who lived in his city, did as Jezebel had instructed them in the letters which she had written and sent to them. (1 Kings 21:11)

text: וָאֹמַר אֶל הַחֹרִים וְאֶל הַסְּגָנִים וְאֶל יֶתֶר הָעָם הַמְּלָאכָה הַרְבֵּה וּרְחָבָה וַאֲנַחְנוּ נִפְרָדִים עַל הַחוֹמָה רְחוֹקִים אִישׁ מֵאָחִֽיו׃
translation: Therefore I set guards in the lowest parts of the space behind the wall, in the open places. I set the people by family groups with their swords, their spears, and their bows. (Nehemiah 4:13)

text: וְהַמְשֹׁרְרִים הֵימָן אָסָף וְאֵיתָן בִּמְצִלְתַּיִם נְחֹשֶׁת לְהַשְׁמִֽיעַ׃
translation: So the singers, Heman, Asaph, and Ethan, were given cymbals of bronze to sound aloud; (1 Chronicles 15:19)

text: וְעִמָּהֶם הֵימָן וִֽידוּתוּן חֲצֹצְרוֹת וּמְצִלְתַּיִם לְמַשְׁמִיעִים וּכְלֵי שִׁיר הָאֱלֹהִים וּבְנֵי יְדוּתוּן לַשָּֽׁעַר׃
translation: and with them Heman and Jeduthun with trumpets and cymbals for those that should sound aloud, and with instruments for the songs of God, and the sons of Jeduthun to be at the gate. (1 Chronicles 16:42)

text: וְדָוִיד וְכָל יִשְׂרָאֵל מְשַׂחֲקִים לִפְנֵי הָאֱלֹהִים בְּכָל עֹז וּבְשִׁירִים וּבְכִנֹּרוֹת וּבִנְבָלִים וּבְתֻפִּים וּבִמְצִלְתַּיִם וּבַחֲצֹצְרֽוֹת׃
translation: David and all Israel played before God with all their might, even with songs, with harps, with stringed instruments, with tambourines, with cymbals, and with trumpets. (1 Chronicles 13:8)

text: וְכָל יִשְׂרָאֵל מַעֲלִים אֶת אֲרוֹן בְּרִית יְהוָה בִּתְרוּעָה וּבְקוֹל שׁוֹפָר וּבַחֲצֹצְרוֹת וּבִמְצִלְתָּיִם מַשְׁמִעִים בִּנְבָלִים וְכִנֹּרֽוֹת׃
translation: Thus all Israel brought the ark of the LORD's covenant up with shouting, with sound of the cornet, with trumpets, and with cymbals, sounding aloud with stringed instruments and harps. (1 Chronicles 15:28)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִיד לְשָׂרֵי הַלְוִיִּם לְהַֽעֲמִיד אֶת אֲחֵיהֶם הַמְשֹׁרְרִים בִּכְלֵי שִׁיר נְבָלִים וְכִנֹּרוֹת וּמְצִלְתָּיִם מַשְׁמִיעִים לְהָרִֽים בְּקוֹל לְשִׂמְחָֽה׃
translation: David spoke to the chief of the Levites to appoint their brothers as singers with instruments of music, stringed instruments, harps, and cymbals, sounding aloud and lifting up their voices with joy. (1 Chronicles 15:16)

text: אָסָף הָרֹאשׁ וּמִשְׁנֵהוּ זְכַרְיָה יְעִיאֵל וּשְׁמִֽירָמוֹת וִֽיחִיאֵל וּמַתִּתְיָה וֶאֱלִיאָב וּבְנָיָהוּ וְעֹבֵד אֱדֹם וִֽיעִיאֵל בִּכְלֵי נְבָלִים וּבְכִנֹּרוֹת וְאָסָף בַּֽמְצִלְתַּיִם מַשְׁמִֽיעַ׃
translation: Asaph the chief, and second to him Zechariah, then Jeiel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Mattithiah, Eliab, Benaiah, Obed-Edom, and Jeiel, with stringed instruments and with harps; and Asaph with cymbals, sounding aloud; (1 Chronicles 16:5)

text: כְּעַן כָּל קֳבֵל דִּֽי מְלַח הֵֽיכְלָא מְלַחְנָא וְעַרְוַת מַלְכָּא לָא אֲֽרִֽיךְ לַנָא לְמֶֽחֱזֵא עַל דְּנָה שְׁלַחְנָא וְהוֹדַעְנָא לְמַלְכָּֽא׃
translation: Now because we eat the salt of the palace and it is not appropriate for us to see the king's dishonor, therefore we have sent and informed the king, (Ezra 4:14)

text: אֱדַיִן שֵׁשְׁבַּצַּר דֵּךְ אֲתָא יְהַב אֻשַּׁיָּא דִּי בֵית אֱלָהָא דִּי בִירוּשְׁלֶם וּמִן אֱדַיִן וְעַד כְּעַן מִתְבְּנֵא וְלָא שְׁלִֽם׃
translation: Then the same Sheshbazzar came and laid the foundations of God's house which is in Jerusalem. Since that time even until now it has been being built, and yet it is not completed. (Ezra 5:16)

text: כְּעַן אֲנָה נְבוּכַדְנֶצַּר מְשַׁבַּח וּמְרוֹמֵם וּמְהַדַּר לְמֶלֶךְ שְׁמַיָּא דִּי כָל מַעֲבָדוֹהִי קְשֹׁט וְאֹרְחָתֵהּ דִּין וְדִי מַהְלְכִין בְּגֵוָה יָכִל לְהַשְׁפָּלָֽה׃
translation: At the end of the days I, Nebuchadnezzar, lifted up my eyes to heaven, and my understanding returned to me; and I blessed the Most High, and I praised and honored him who lives forever, for his dominion is an everlasting dominion, and his kingdom from generation to generation. (Daniel 4:34)

text: וְגֻבְרַיָּא אִלֵּךְ תְּלָתֵּהוֹן שַׁדְרַךְ מֵישַׁךְ וַעֲבֵד נְגוֹ נְפַלוּ לְגֽוֹא אַתּוּן נוּרָא יָֽקִדְתָּא מְכַפְּתִֽין׃
translation: These three men, Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, fell down bound into the middle of the burning fiery furnace. (Daniel 3:23)

text: נִדְבָּכִין דִּי אֶבֶן גְּלָל תְּלָתָא וְנִדְבָּךְ דִּי אָע חֲדַת וְנִפְקְתָא מִן בֵּית מַלְכָּא תִּתְיְהִֽב׃
translation: with three courses of great stones and a course of new timber. Let the expenses be given out of the king's house. (Ezra 6:4)

text: וְשֵׁיצִיא בַּיְתָה דְנָה עַד יוֹם תְּלָתָה לִירַח אֲדָר דִּי הִיא שְׁנַת שֵׁת לְמַלְכוּת דָּרְיָוֶשׁ מַלְכָּֽא׃
translation: This house was finished on the third day of the month Adar, which was in the sixth year of the reign of Darius the king. (Ezra 6:15)

text: וְקַרְנַיָּא עֲשַׂר מִנַּהּ מַלְכוּתָה עַשְׂרָה מַלְכִין יְקֻמוּן וְאָחֳרָן יְקוּם אַחֲרֵיהוֹן וְהוּא יִשְׁנֵא מִן קַדְמָיֵא וּתְלָתָה מַלְכִין יְהַשְׁפִּֽל׃
translation: As for the ten horns, ten kings will arise out of this kingdom. Another will arise after them; and he will be different from the former, and he will put down three kings. (Daniel 7:24)

text: בֵּאדַיִן אֲמַר בֵּלְשַׁאצַּר וְהַלְבִּישׁוּ לְדָֽנִיֵּאל אַרְגְּוָנָא והמונכא וְהַֽמְנִיכָא דִֽי דַהֲבָא עַֽל צַוְּארֵהּ וְהַכְרִזֽוּ עֲלוֹהִי דִּֽי לֶהֱוֵא שַׁלִּיט תַּלְתָּא בְּמַלְכוּתָֽא׃
translation: Then Belshazzar commanded, and they clothed Daniel with purple, and put a chain of gold about his neck, and made proclamation concerning him, that he should be the third ruler in the kingdom. (Daniel 5:29)

text: וְעֵלָּא מִנְּהוֹן סָרְכִין תְּלָתָא דִּי דָנִיֵּאל חַֽד מִנְּהוֹן דִּֽי לֶהֱוֺן אֲחַשְׁדַּרְפְּנַיָּא אִלֵּין יָהֲבִין לְהוֹן טַעְמָא וּמַלְכָּא לָֽא לֶהֱוֵא נָזִֽק׃
translation: Then this Daniel was distinguished above the presidents and the local governors, because an excellent spirit was in him; and the king thought to set him over the whole realm. (Daniel 6:3)

text: שְׁפַר קֳדָם דָּרְיָוֶשׁ וַהֲקִים עַל מַלְכוּתָא לַאֲחַשְׁדַּרְפְּנַיָּא מְאָה וְעֶשְׂרִין דִּי לֶהֱוֺן בְּכָל מַלְכוּתָֽא׃
translation: and over them three presidents, of whom Daniel was one, that these local governors might give account to them, and that the king should suffer no loss. (Daniel 6:2)

text: אֱדַיִן סָרְכַיָּא וַאֲחַשְׁדַּרְפְּנַיָּא אִלֵּן הַרְגִּשׁוּ עַל מַלְכָּא וְכֵן אָמְרִין לֵהּ דָּרְיָוֶשׁ מַלְכָּא לְעָלְמִין חֱיִֽי׃
translation: All the presidents of the kingdom, the deputies and the local governors, the counselors and the governors, have consulted together to establish a royal statute and to make a strong decree, that whoever asks a petition of any god or man for thirty days, except of you, O king, he shall be cast into the den of lions. (Daniel 6:7)

text: וַֽיִּתְּנוּ אֶת דָּתֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ לַאֲחַשְׁדַּרְפְּנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ וּפַחֲווֹת עֵבֶר הַנָּהָר וְנִשְּׂאוּ אֶת הָעָם וְאֶת בֵּֽית הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃
translation: They delivered the king's commissions to the king's local governors and to the governors beyond the River. So they supported the people and God's house. (Ezra 8:36)

text: וְכָל שָׂרֵי הַמְּדִינוֹת וְהָאֲחַשְׁדַּרְפְּנִים וְהַפַּחוֹת וְעֹשֵׂי הַמְּלָאכָה אֲשֶׁר לַמֶּלֶךְ מְנַשְּׂאִים אֶת הַיְּהוּדִים כִּֽי נָפַל פַּֽחַד מָרְדֳּכַי עֲלֵיהֶֽם׃
translation: All the princes of the provinces, the local governors, the governors, and those who did the king's business helped the Jews, because the fear of Mordecai had fallen on them. (Esther 9:3)

text: אֱדַיִן דָּנִיֵּאל דְּנָה הֲוָא מִתְנַצַּח עַל סָרְכַיָּא וַאֲחַשְׁדַּרְפְּנַיָּא כָּל קֳבֵל דִּי רוּחַ יַתִּירָא בֵּהּ וּמַלְכָּא עֲשִׁית לַהֲקָמוּתֵהּ עַל כָּל מַלְכוּתָֽא׃
translation: Then the presidents and the local governors sought to find occasion against Daniel as touching the kingdom; but they could find no occasion or fault, because he was faithful. There wasn't any error or fault found in him. (Daniel 6:4)

text: יֵבֹשׁוּ זֵדִים כִּי שֶׁקֶר עִוְּתוּנִי אֲנִי אָשִׂיחַ בְּפִקּוּדֶֽיךָ׃
translation: Let the proud be disappointed, for they have overthrown me wrongfully. I will meditate on your precepts. (Psalms 119:78)

text: זֵדִים הֱלִיצֻנִי עַד מְאֹד מִתּֽוֹרָתְךָ לֹא נָטִֽיתִי׃
translation: The arrogant mock me excessively, but I don't swerve from your law. (Psalms 119:51)

text: טָפְלוּ עָלַי שֶׁקֶר זֵדִים אֲנִי בְּכָל לֵב אֱצֹּר פִּקּוּדֶֽיךָ׃
translation: The proud have smeared a lie upon me. With my whole heart, I will keep your precepts. (Psalms 119:69)

text: כָּֽרוּ לִי זֵדִים שִׁיחוֹת אֲשֶׁר לֹא כְתוֹרָתֶֽךָ׃
translation: The proud have dug pits for me, contrary to your law. (Psalms 119:85)

text: עֲרֹב עַבְדְּךָ לְטוֹב אַֽל יַעַשְׁקֻנִי זֵדִֽים׃
translation: Ensure your servant's well-being. Don't let the proud oppress me. (Psalms 119:122)

text: אֱלֹהִים זֵדִים קָֽמוּ עָלַי וַעֲדַת עָרִיצִים בִּקְשׁוּ נַפְשִׁי וְלֹא שָׂמוּךָ לְנֶגְדָּֽם׃
translation: God, the proud have risen up against me. A company of violent men have sought after my soul, and they don't hold regard for you before them. (Psalms 86:14)

text: לְדָוִד מַשְׂכִּיל אַשְׁרֵי נְֽשׂוּי פֶּשַׁע כְּסוּי חֲטָאָֽה׃
translation: By David. A contemplative psalm. Blessed is he whose disobedience is forgiven, whose sin is covered. (Psalms 32:1)

text: מַשְׂכִּיל לְאָסָף הַאֲזִינָה עַמִּי תּוֹרָתִי הַטּוּ אָזְנְכֶם לְאִמְרֵי פִֽי׃
translation: A contemplation by Asaph. Hear my teaching, my people. Turn your ears to the words of my mouth. (Psalms 78:1)

text: לַמְנַצֵּחַ עַֽל מָחֲלַת מַשְׂכִּיל לְדָוִֽד׃
translation: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of "Mahalath." A contemplation by David. The fool has said in his heart, "There is no God." They are corrupt, and have done abominable iniquity. There is no one who does good. (Psalms 53:1)

text: שִׁיר מִזְמוֹר לִבְנֵי קֹרַח לַמְנַצֵּחַ עַל מָחֲלַת לְעַנּוֹת מַשְׂכִּיל לְהֵימָן הָאֶזְרָחִֽי׃
translation: A Song. A Psalm by the sons of Korah. For the Chief Musician. To the tune of "The Suffering of Affliction." A contemplation by Heman, the Ezrahite. LORD, the God of my salvation, I have cried day and night before you. (Psalms 88:1)

text: מַשְׂכִּיל לְדָוִד בִּהְיוֹתוֹ בַמְּעָרָה תְפִלָּֽה׃
translation: A contemplation by David, when he was in the cave. A Prayer. I cry with my voice to the LORD. With my voice, I ask the LORD for mercy. (Psalms 142:1)

text: לַמְנַצֵּחַ מַשְׂכִּיל לִבְנֵי קֹֽרַח׃
translation: For the Chief Musician. A contemplation by the sons of Korah. As the deer pants for the water brooks, so my soul pants after you, God. (Psalms 42:1)

text: אֶרְפָּא מְשׁוּבָתָם אֹהֲבֵם נְדָבָה כִּי שָׁב אַפִּי מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃
translation: I will be like the dew to Israel. He will blossom like the lily, and send down his roots like Lebanon. (Hosea 14:5)

text: כִּי מְשׁוּבַת פְּתָיִם תַּֽהַרְגֵם וְשַׁלְוַת כְּסִילִים תְּאַבְּדֵֽם׃
translation: For the backsliding of the simple will kill them. The careless ease of fools will destroy them. (Proverbs 1:32)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֵלַי צִדְּקָה נַפְשָׁהּ מְשֻׁבָה יִשְׂרָאֵל מִבֹּגֵדָה יְהוּדָֽה׃
translation: The LORD said to me, "Backsliding Israel has shown herself more righteous than treacherous Judah. (Jeremiah 3:11)

text: וְעַמִּי תְלוּאִים לִמְשֽׁוּבָתִי וְאֶל עַל יִקְרָאֻהוּ יַחַד לֹא יְרוֹמֵם׃
translation: My people are determined to turn from me. Though they call to the Most High, he certainly won't exalt them. (Hosea 11:7)

text: שׁוּבוּ בָּנִים שׁוֹבָבִים אֶרְפָּה מְשׁוּבֹֽתֵיכֶם הִנְנוּ אָתָנוּ לָךְ כִּי אַתָּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃
translation: Return, you backsliding children, and I will heal your backsliding. "Behold, we have come to you; for you are the LORD our God. (Jeremiah 3:22)

text: אִם עֲוֺנֵינוּ עָנוּ בָנוּ יְהוָה עֲשֵׂה לְמַעַן שְׁמֶךָ כִּֽי רַבּוּ מְשׁוּבֹתֵינוּ לְךָ חָטָֽאנוּ׃
translation: Though our iniquities testify against us, work for your name's sake, LORD; for our rebellions are many. We have sinned against you. (Jeremiah 14:7)

text: חָזֵה הֲוֵית וְקַרְנָא דִכֵּן עָבְדָה קְרָב עִם קַדִּישִׁין וְיָכְלָה לְהֽוֹן׃
translation: I saw, and the same horn made war with the saints, and prevailed against them, (Daniel 7:21)

text: וִֽיקַבְּלוּן מַלְכוּתָא קַדִּישֵׁי עֶלְיוֹנִין וְיַחְסְנוּן מַלְכוּתָא עַֽד עָלְמָא וְעַד עָלַם עָלְמַיָּֽא׃
translation: But the saints of the Most High will receive the kingdom, and possess the kingdom forever, even forever and ever.' (Daniel 7:18)

text: חָזֵה הֲוֵית בְּחֶזְוֵי רֵאשִׁי עַֽל מִשְׁכְּבִי וַאֲלוּ עִיר וְקַדִּישׁ מִן שְׁמַיָּא נָחִֽת׃
translation: These were the visions of my head on my bed: I saw, and behold, a tree in the middle of the earth; and its height was great. (Daniel 4:10)

text: עַד דִּֽי אֲתָה עַתִּיק יֽוֹמַיָּא וְדִינָא יְהִב לְקַדִּישֵׁי עֶלְיוֹנִין וְזִמְנָא מְטָה וּמַלְכוּתָא הֶחֱסִנוּ קַדִּישִֽׁין׃
translation: until the Ancient of Days came, and judgment was given to the saints of the Most High, and the time came that the saints possessed the kingdom. (Daniel 7:22)

text: וְעַד אָחֳרֵין עַל קָֽדָמַי דָּנִיֵּאל דִּֽי שְׁמֵהּ בֵּלְטְשַׁאצַּר כְּשֻׁם אֱלָהִי וְדִי רֽוּחַ אֱלָהִין קַדִּישִׁין בֵּהּ וְחֶלְמָא קָֽדָמוֹהִי אַמְרֵֽת׃
translation: I saw a dream which made me afraid; and the thoughts on my bed and the visions of my head troubled me. (Daniel 4:5)

text: וּמִלִּין לְצַד עליא עִלָּאָה יְמַלִּל וּלְקַדִּישֵׁי עֶלְיוֹנִין יְבַלֵּא וְיִסְבַּר לְהַשְׁנָיָה זִמְנִין וְדָת וְיִתְיַהֲבוּן בִּידֵהּ עַד עִדָּן וְעִדָּנִין וּפְלַג עִדָּֽן׃
translation: He will speak words against the Most High, and will wear out the saints of the Most High. He will plan to change the times and the law; and they will be given into his hand until a time and times and half a time. (Daniel 7:25)

text: וּֽזֲהַב הָאָרֶץ הַהִוא טוֹב שָׁם הַבְּדֹלַח וְאֶבֶן הַשֹּֽׁהַם׃
translation: and the gold of that land is good. Bdellium and onyx stone are also there. (Genesis 2:12)

text: וְהַטּוּר הָרְבִיעִי תַּרְשִׁישׁ וְשֹׁהַם וְיָשְׁפֵה מְשֻׁבָּצִים זָהָב יִהְיוּ בְּמִלּוּאֹתָֽם׃
translation: and the fourth row a chrysolite, an onyx, and a jasper. They shall be enclosed in gold in their settings. (Exodus 28:20)

text: בְּנֵי מְרָרִי לְיַֽעֲזִיָּהֽוּ בְנוֹ וְשֹׁהַם וְזַכּוּר וְעִבְרִֽי׃
translation: The sons of Merari by Jaaziah: Beno, Shoham, Zaccur, and Ibri. (1 Chronicles 24:27)

text: לֹֽא תְסֻלֶּה בְּכֶתֶם אוֹפִיר בְּשֹׁהַם יָקָר וְסַפִּֽיר׃
translation: It can't be valued with the gold of Ophir, with the precious onyx, or the sapphire. (Job 28:16)

text: אַבְנֵי שֹׁהַם וְאַבְנֵי מִלֻּאִים לָאֵפֹד וְלַחֹֽשֶׁן׃
translation: onyx stones, and stones to be set for the ephod and for the breastplate. (Exodus 25:7)

text: וְלָקַחְתָּ אֶת שְׁתֵּי אַבְנֵי שֹׁהַם וּפִתַּחְתָּ עֲלֵיהֶם שְׁמוֹת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
translation: You shall take two onyx stones, and engrave on them the names of the children of Israel. (Exodus 28:9)

text: אַלּוּף מַגְדִּיאֵל אַלּוּף עִירָם אֵלֶּה אַלּוּפֵי אֱדֽוֹם׃
translation: chief Magdiel, and chief Iram. These are the chiefs of Edom. (1 Chronicles 1:54)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֶת קֹלְךָ שָׁמַעְתִּי בַּגָּן וָאִירָא כִּֽי עֵירֹם אָנֹכִי וָאֵחָבֵֽא׃
translation: The man said, "I heard your voice in the garden, and I was afraid, because I was naked; so I hid myself." (Genesis 3:10)

text: אַלּוּף מַגְדִּיאֵל אַלּוּף עִירָם אֵלֶּה אַלּוּפֵי אֱדוֹם לְמֹֽשְׁבֹתָם בְּאֶרֶץ אֲחֻזָּתָם הוּא עֵשָׂו אֲבִי אֱדֽוֹם׃
translation: chief Magdiel, and chief Iram. These are the chiefs of Edom, according to their habitations in the land of their possession. This is Esau, the father of the Edomites. (Genesis 36:43)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר מִי הִגִּיד לְךָ כִּי עֵירֹם אָתָּה הֲמִן הָעֵץ אֲשֶׁר צִוִּיתִיךָ לְבִלְתִּי אֲכָל מִמֶּנּוּ אָכָֽלְתָּ׃
translation: God said, "Who told you that you were naked? Have you eaten from the tree that I commanded you not to eat from?" (Genesis 3:11)

text: רְבָבָה כְּצֶמַח הַשָּׂדֶה נְתַתִּיךְ וַתִּרְבִּי וַֽתִּגְדְּלִי וַתָּבֹאִי בַּעֲדִי עֲדָיִים שָׁדַיִם נָכֹנוּ וּשְׂעָרֵךְ צִמֵּחַ וְאַתְּ עֵרֹם וְעֶרְיָֽה׃
translation: I caused you to multiply as that which grows in the field, and you increased and grew great, and you attained to excellent beauty. Your breasts were formed, and your hair grew; yet you were naked and bare. (Ezekiel 16:7)

text: וְאֵת כָּל תּוֹעֲבֹתַיִךְ וְתַזְנֻתַיִךְ לֹא זכרתי זָכַרְתְּ אֶת יְמֵי נְעוּרָיִךְ בִּֽהְיוֹתֵךְ עֵרֹם וְעֶרְיָה מִתְבּוֹסֶסֶת בְּדָמֵךְ הָיִֽית׃
translation: In all your abominations and your prostitution you have not remembered the days of your youth, when you were naked and bare, and were wallowing in your blood. (Ezekiel 16:22)

text: לָכֵן אָמַרְתִּי שִׁמְעָה לִּי אֲחַוֶּה דֵּעִי אַף אָֽנִי׃
translation: Therefore I said, 'Listen to me; I also will show my opinion.' (Job 32:10)

text: אַעֲנֶה אַף אֲנִי חֶלְקִי אֲחַוֶּה דֵעִי אַף אָֽנִי׃
translation: I also will answer my part, and I also will show my opinion. (Job 32:17)

text: יוֹם לְיוֹם יַבִּיעַֽ אֹמֶר וְלַיְלָה לְּלַיְלָה יְחַוֶּה דָּֽעַת׃
translation: There is no speech nor language where their voice is not heard. (Psalms 19:3)

text: אֲחַוְךָ שְֽׁמַֽע לִי וְזֶֽה חָזִיתִי וַאֲסַפֵּֽרָה׃
translation: "I will show you, listen to me; that which I have seen I will declare (Job 15:17)

text: וַיִּקְרָא הָֽאָדָם שֵׁם אִשְׁתּוֹ חַוָּה כִּי הִוא הָֽיְתָה אֵם כָּל חָֽי׃
translation: The man called his wife Eve because she would be the mother of all the living. (Genesis 3:20)

text: וְיָאִיר בֶּן מְנַשֶּׁה הָלַךְ וַיִּלְכֹּד אֶת חַוֺּתֵיהֶם וַיִּקְרָא אֶתְהֶן חַוֺּת יָאִֽיר׃
translation: Jair the son of Manasseh went and took its villages, and called them Havvoth Jair. (Numbers 32:41)

text: נִֽדֲרוּ וְשַׁלְּמוּ לַיהוָה אֱֽלֹהֵיכֶם כָּל סְבִיבָיו יוֹבִילוּ שַׁי לַמּוֹרָֽא׃
translation: He will cut off the spirit of princes. He is feared by the kings of the earth. (Psalms 76:12)

text: אֶת יְהוָה צְבָאוֹת אֹתוֹ תַקְדִּישׁוּ וְהוּא מוֹרַאֲכֶם וְהוּא מַֽעֲרִֽצְכֶֽם׃
translation: The LORD of Armies is who you must respect as holy. He is the one you must fear. He is the one you must dread. (Isaiah 8:13)

text: וַיּוֹצִאֵנוּ יְהוָה מִמִּצְרַיִם בְּיָד חֲזָקָה וּבִזְרֹעַ נְטוּיָה וּבְמֹרָא גָּדֹל וּבְאֹתוֹת וּבְמֹפְתִֽים׃
translation: The LORD brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand, with an outstretched arm, with great terror, with signs, and with wonders; (Deuteronomy 26:8)

text: וּלְכֹל הַיָּד הַחֲזָקָה וּלְכֹל הַמּוֹרָא הַגָּדוֹל אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה מֹשֶׁה לְעֵינֵי כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
translation: and in all the mighty hand, and in all the awesome deeds, which Moses did in the sight of all Israel. (Deuteronomy 34:12)

text: בְּרִיתִי הָיְתָה אִתּוֹ הַֽחַיִּים וְהַשָּׁלוֹם וָאֶתְּנֵֽם לוֹ מוֹרָא וַיִּֽירָאֵנִי וּמִפְּנֵי שְׁמִי נִחַת הֽוּא׃
translation: "My covenant was with him of life and peace; and I gave them to him that he might be reverent toward me; and he was reverent toward me, and stood in awe of my name. (Malachi 2:5)

text: לֹא תֹאמְרוּן קֶשֶׁר לְכֹל אֲשֶׁר יֹאמַר הָעָם הַזֶּה קָשֶׁר וְאֶת מוֹרָאוֹ לֹֽא תִֽירְאוּ וְלֹא תַעֲרִֽיצוּ׃
translation: "Don't call a conspiracy all that this people call a conspiracy. Don't fear their threats or be terrorized. (Isaiah 8:12)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר לִי מִי אָתָּה ויאמר וָאֹמַר אֵלָיו עֲמָלֵקִי אָנֹֽכִי׃
translation: He said to me, 'Who are you?' I answered him, 'I am an Amalekite.' (2 Samuel 1:8)

text: וַיֵּרֶד הָעֲמָלֵקִי וְהַֽכְּנַעֲנִי הַיֹּשֵׁב בָּהָר הַהוּא וַיַּכּוּם וַֽיַּכְּתוּם עַד הַֽחָרְמָֽה׃
translation: Then the Amalekites came down, and the Canaanites who lived in that mountain, and struck them and beat them down even to Hormah. (Numbers 14:45)

text: וַיָּמָת עַבְדּוֹן בֶּן הִלֵּל הַפִּרְעָתוֹנִי וַיִּקָּבֵר בְּפִרְעָתוֹן בְּאֶרֶץ אֶפְרַיִם בְּהַר הָעֲמָלֵקִֽי׃
translation: Abdon the son of Hillel the Pirathonite died, and was buried in Pirathon in the land of Ephraim, in the hill country of the Amalekites. (Judges 12:15)

text: וְהָֽעֲמָלֵקִי וְהַֽכְּנַעֲנִי יוֹשֵׁב בָּעֵמֶק מָחָר פְּנוּ וּסְעוּ לָכֶם הַמִּדְבָּר דֶּרֶךְ יַם סֽוּף׃
translation: Since the Amalekite and the Canaanite dwell in the valley, tomorrow turn and go into the wilderness by the way to the Red Sea." (Numbers 14:25)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל הַנַּעַר הַמַּגִּיד לוֹ אֵי מִזֶּה אָתָּה וַיֹּאמֶר בֶּן אִישׁ גֵּר עֲמָלֵקִי אָנֹֽכִי׃
translation: David said to the young man who told him, "Where are you from?" He answered, "I am the son of a foreigner, an Amalekite." (2 Samuel 1:13)

text: כִּי הָעֲמָלֵקִי וְהַכְּנַעֲנִי שָׁם לִפְנֵיכֶם וּנְפַלְתֶּם בֶּחָרֶב כִּֽי עַל כֵּן שַׁבְתֶּם מֵאַחֲרֵי יְהוָה וְלֹא יִהְיֶה יְהוָה עִמָּכֶֽם׃
translation: For there the Amalekite and the Canaanite are before you, and you will fall by the sword because you turned back from following the LORD; therefore the LORD will not be with you." (Numbers 14:43)

text: אֲדֹנָי כַּמָּה תִּרְאֶה הָשִׁיבָה נַפְשִׁי מִשֹּׁאֵיהֶם מִכְּפִירִים יְחִידָתִֽי׃
translation: Lord, how long will you look on? Rescue my soul from their destruction, my precious life from the lions. (Psalms 35:17)

text: כִּי בֵן הָיִיתִי לְאָבִי רַךְ וְיָחִיד לִפְנֵי אִמִּֽי׃
translation: For I was a son to my father, tender and an only child in the sight of my mother. (Proverbs 4:3)

text: פְּנֵה אֵלַי וְחָנֵּנִי כִּֽי יָחִיד וְעָנִי אָֽנִי׃
translation: Turn to me, and have mercy on me, for I am desolate and afflicted. (Psalms 25:16)

text: הַצִּילָה מֵחֶרֶב נַפְשִׁי מִיַּד כֶּלֶב יְחִידָתִֽי׃
translation: Save me from the lion's mouth! Yes, you have rescued me from the horns of the wild oxen. (Psalms 22:21)

text: אֱלֹהִים מוֹשִׁיב יְחִידִים בַּיְתָה מוֹצִיא אֲסִירִים בַּכּוֹשָׁרוֹת אַךְ סוֹרֲרִים שָׁכְנוּ צְחִיחָֽה׃
translation: God, when you went out before your people, when you marched through the wilderness... Selah. (Psalms 68:7)

text: בַּת עַמִּי חִגְרִי שָׂק וְהִתְפַּלְּשִׁי בָאֵפֶר אֵבֶל יָחִיד עֲשִׂי לָךְ מִסְפַּד תַּמְרוּרִים כִּי פִתְאֹם יָבֹא הַשֹּׁדֵד עָלֵֽינוּ׃
translation: Daughter of my people, clothe yourself with sackcloth, and wallow in ashes! Mourn, as for an only son, most bitter lamentation, for the destroyer will suddenly come on us. (Jeremiah 6:26)

text: וַיֵּצֵא הָרִאשׁוֹן אַדְמוֹנִי כֻּלּוֹ כְּאַדֶּרֶת שֵׂעָר וַיִּקְרְאוּ שְׁמוֹ עֵשָֽׂו׃
translation: The first came out red all over, like a hairy garment. They named him Esau. (Genesis 25:25)

text: וַיָּרֶם אֶת אַדֶּרֶת אֵלִיָּהוּ אֲשֶׁר נָפְלָה מֵעָלָיו וַיָּשָׁב וַֽיַּעֲמֹד עַל שְׂפַת הַיַּרְדֵּֽן׃
translation: He also took up Elijah's mantle that fell from him, and went back and stood by the bank of the Jordan. (2 Kings 2:13)

text: וַיִּקַּח אֵלִיָּהוּ אֶת אַדַּרְתּוֹ וַיִּגְלֹם וַיַּכֶּה אֶת הַמַּיִם וַיֵּחָצוּ הֵנָּה וָהֵנָּה וַיַּעַבְרוּ שְׁנֵיהֶם בֶּחָרָבָֽה׃
translation: Elijah took his mantle, and rolled it up, and struck the waters; and they were divided here and there, so that they both went over on dry ground. (2 Kings 2:8)

text: וְהָיָה בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא יֵבֹשׁוּ הַנְּבִיאִים אִישׁ מֵחֶזְיֹנוֹ בְּהִנָּֽבְאֹתוֹ וְלֹא יִלְבְּשׁוּ אַדֶּרֶת שֵׂעָר לְמַעַן כַּחֵֽשׁ׃
translation: It will happen in that day that the prophets will each be ashamed of his vision when he prophesies; they won't wear a hairy mantle to deceive, (Zechariah 13:4)

text: אֶל שָׂדֶה טּוֹב אֶל מַיִם רַבִּים הִיא שְׁתוּלָה לַעֲשׂוֹת עָנָף וְלָשֵׂאת פֶּרִי לִהְיוֹת לְגֶפֶן אַדָּֽרֶת׃
translation: It was planted in a good soil by many waters, that it might produce branches and that it might bear fruit, that it might be a good vine."' (Ezekiel 17:8)

text: וַיִּגַּע הַדָּבָר אֶל מֶלֶך נִֽינְוֵה וַיָּקָם מִכִּסְאוֹ וַיַּעֲבֵר אַדַּרְתּוֹ מֵֽעָלָיו וַיְכַס שַׂק וַיֵּשֶׁב עַל הָאֵֽפֶר׃
translation: The news reached the king of Nineveh, and he arose from his throne, took off his royal robe, covered himself with sackcloth, and sat in ashes. (Jonah 3:6)

text: לֶחֶם אַבִּירִים אָכַל אִישׁ צֵידָה שָׁלַח לָהֶם לָשֹֽׂבַע׃
translation: Man ate the bread of angels. He sent them food to the full. (Psalms 78:25)

text: וְעַתָּה שָׂא נָא כֵלֶיךָ תֶּלְיְךָ וְקַשְׁתֶּךָ וְצֵא הַשָּׂדֶה וְצוּדָה לִּי צידה צָֽיִד׃
translation: Now therefore, please take your weapons, your quiver and your bow, and go out to the field, and get me venison. (Genesis 27:3)

text: וַיִּשְׁאַל לוֹ בַּֽיהוָה וְצֵידָה נָתַן לוֹ וְאֵת חֶרֶב גָּלְיָת הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי נָתַן לֽוֹ׃
translation: He inquired of the LORD for him, gave him food, and gave him the sword of Goliath the Philistine." (1 Samuel 22:10)

text: וַיַּֽעֲשׂוּ כֵן בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּתֵּן לָהֶם יוֹסֵף עֲגָלוֹת עַל פִּי פַרְעֹה וַיִּתֵּן לָהֶם צֵדָה לַדָּֽרֶךְ׃
translation: The sons of Israel did so. Joseph gave them wagons, according to the commandment of Pharaoh, and gave them provision for the way. (Genesis 45:21)

text: וַיְצַו יוֹסֵף וַיְמַלְאוּ אֶת כְּלֵיהֶם בָּר וּלְהָשִׁיב כַּסְפֵּיהֶם אִישׁ אֶל שַׂקּוֹ וְלָתֵת לָהֶם צֵדָה לַדָּרֶךְ וַיַּעַשׂ לָהֶם כֵּֽן׃
translation: Then Joseph gave a command to fill their bags with grain, and to restore each man's money into his sack, and to give them food for the way. So it was done to them. (Genesis 42:25)

text: פִּתְאֹם נָפְלָה בָבֶל וַתִּשָּׁבֵר הֵילִילוּ עָלֶיהָ קְחוּ צֳרִי לְמַכְאוֹבָהּ אוּלַי תֵּרָפֵֽא׃
translation: Babylon has suddenly fallen and been destroyed! Wail for her! Take balm for her pain. Perhaps she may be healed. (Jeremiah 51:8)

text: וְהַצֹּרִים יָשְׁבוּ בָהּ מְבִיאִים דָּאג וְכָל מֶכֶר וּמֹכְרִים בַּשַּׁבָּת לִבְנֵי יְהוּדָה וּבִירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
translation: Some men of Tyre also lived there, who brought in fish and all kinds of wares, and sold on the Sabbath to the children of Judah, and in Jerusalem. (Nehemiah 13:16)

text: יְהוּדָה וְאֶרֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵל הֵמָּה רֹכְלָיִךְ בְּחִטֵּי מִנִּית וּפַנַּג וּדְבַשׁ וָשֶׁמֶן וָצֹרִי נָתְנוּ מַעֲרָבֵֽךְ׃
translation: "'"Judah and the land of Israel were your traders. They traded wheat of Minnith, confections, honey, oil, and balm for your merchandise. (Ezekiel 27:17)

text: הַצֳרִי אֵין בְּגִלְעָד אִם רֹפֵא אֵין שָׁם כִּי מַדּוּעַ לֹא עָֽלְתָה אֲרֻכַת בַּת עַמִּֽי׃
translation: Is there no balm in Gilead? Is there no physician there? Why then isn't the health of the daughter of my people recovered? (Jeremiah 8:22)

text: עֲלִי גִלְעָד וּקְחִי צֳרִי בְּתוּלַת בַּת מִצְרָיִם לַשָּׁוְא הרביתי הִרְבֵּית רְפֻאוֹת תְּעָלָה אֵין לָֽךְ׃
translation: Go up into Gilead, and take balm, virgin daughter of Egypt. You use many medicines in vain. There is no healing for you. (Jeremiah 46:11)

text: לִידוּתוּן בְּנֵי יְדוּתוּן גְּדַלְיָהוּ וּצְרִי וִֽישַׁעְיָהוּ חֲשַׁבְיָהוּ וּמַתִּתְיָהוּ שִׁשָּׁה עַל יְדֵי אֲבִיהֶם יְדוּתוּן בַּכִּנּוֹר הַנִּבָּא עַל הֹדוֹת וְהַלֵּל לַיהוָֽה׃
translation: Of Jeduthun, the sons of Jeduthun: Gedaliah, Zeri, Jeshaiah, Shimei, Hashabiah, and Mattithiah, six, under the hands of their father Jeduthun, who prophesied in giving thanks and praising the LORD with the harp. (1 Chronicles 25:3)

text: וְאֶת בָּנֶיהָ לֹא אֲרַחֵם כִּֽי בְנֵי זְנוּנִים הֵֽמָּה׃
translation: Therefore behold, I will hedge up your way with thorns, and I will build a wall against her, that she can't find her way. (Hosea 2:6)

text: וַתֵּרֶא אֲחוֹתָהּ אָהֳלִיבָה וַתַּשְׁחֵת עַגְבָתָהּ מִמֶּנָּה וְאֶת תַּזְנוּתֶיהָ מִזְּנוּנֵי אֲחוֹתָֽהּ׃
translation: "Her sister Oholibah saw this, yet she was more corrupt in her lusting than she, and in her prostitution which was more depraved than the prostitution of her sister. (Ezekiel 23:11)

text: עַמִּי בְּעֵצוֹ יִשְׁאָל וּמַקְלוֹ יַגִּיד לוֹ כִּי רוּחַ זְנוּנִים הִתְעָה וַיִּזְנוּ מִתַּחַת אֱלֹהֵיהֶֽם׃
translation: My people consult with their wooden idol, and answer to a stick of wood. Indeed the spirit of prostitution has led them astray, and they have been unfaithful to their God. (Hosea 4:12)

text: וְעָשׂוּ אוֹתָךְ בְּשִׂנְאָה וְלָקְחוּ כָּל יְגִיעֵךְ וַעֲזָבוּךְ עֵירֹם וְעֶרְיָה וְנִגְלָה עֶרְוַת זְנוּנַיִךְ וְזִמָּתֵךְ וְתַזְנוּתָֽיִךְ׃
translation: They will deal with you in hatred, and will take away all your labor, and will leave you naked and bare. The nakedness of your prostitution will be uncovered, both your lewdness and your prostitution. (Ezekiel 23:29)

text: לֹא יִתְּנוּ מַעַלְלֵיהֶם לָשׁוּב אֶל אֱלֹֽהֵיהֶם כִּי רוּחַ זְנוּנִים בְּקִרְבָּם וְאֶת יְהוָה לֹא יָדָֽעוּ׃
translation: Their deeds won't allow them to turn to their God, for the spirit of prostitution is within them, and they don't know the LORD. (Hosea 5:4)

text: רִיבוּ בְאִמְּכֶם רִיבוּ כִּֽי הִיא לֹא אִשְׁתִּי וְאָנֹכִי לֹא אִישָׁהּ וְתָסֵר זְנוּנֶיהָ מִפָּנֶיה וְנַאֲפוּפֶיהָ מִבֵּין שָׁדֶֽיהָ׃
translation: Indeed, on her children I will have no mercy, for they are children of unfaithfulness. (Hosea 2:4)

text: תְּחַדֵּשׁ עֵדֶיךָ נֶגְדִּי וְתֶרֶב כַּֽעַשְׂךָ עִמָּדִי חֲלִיפוֹת וְצָבָא עִמִּֽי׃
translation: You renew your witnesses against me, and increase your indignation on me. Changes and warfare are with me. (Job 10:17)

text: אִם יָמוּת גֶּבֶר הֲיִחְיֶה כָּל יְמֵי צְבָאִי אֲיַחֵל עַד בּוֹא חֲלִיפָתִֽי׃
translation: If a man dies, will he live again? I would wait all the days of my warfare, until my release should come. (Job 14:14)

text: לְכֻלָּם נָתַן לָאִישׁ חֲלִפוֹת שְׂמָלֹת וּלְבִנְיָמִן נָתַן שְׁלֹשׁ מֵאוֹת כֶּסֶף וְחָמֵשׁ חֲלִפֹת שְׂמָלֹֽת׃
translation: He gave each one of them changes of clothing, but to Benjamin he gave three hundred pieces of silver and five changes of clothing. (Genesis 45:22)

text: יִשְׁמַע אֵל וְֽיַעֲנֵם וְיֹשֵׁב קֶדֶם סֶלָה אֲשֶׁר אֵין חֲלִיפוֹת לָמוֹ וְלֹא יָרְאוּ אֱלֹהִֽים׃
translation: He raises his hands against his friends. He has violated his covenant. (Psalms 55:20)

text: וְאִם לֹא תוּכְלוּ לְהַגִּיד לִי וּנְתַתֶּם אַתֶּם לִי שְׁלֹשִׁים סְדִינִים וּשְׁלֹשִׁים חֲלִיפוֹת בְּגָדִים וַיֹּאמְרוּ לוֹ חוּדָה חִידָתְךָ וְנִשְׁמָעֶֽנָּה׃
translation: but if you can't tell me the answer, then you shall give me thirty linen garments and thirty changes of clothing." They said to him, "Tell us your riddle, that we may hear it." (Judges 14:13)

text: בִּרְבוֹת צַדִּיקִים יִשְׂמַח הָעָם וּבִמְשֹׁל רָשָׁע יֵאָנַֽח עָֽם׃
translation: When the righteous thrive, the people rejoice; but when the wicked rule, the people groan. (Proverbs 29:2)

text: אָבַל תִּירוֹשׁ אֻמְלְלָה גָפֶן נֶאֶנְחוּ כָּל שִׂמְחֵי לֵֽב׃
translation: The new wine mourns. The vine languishes. All the merry-hearted sigh. (Isaiah 24:7)

text: וְאַתָּה בֶן אָדָם הֵֽאָנַח בְּשִׁבְרוֹן מָתְנַיִם וּבִמְרִירוּת תֵּֽאָנַח לְעֵינֵיהֶֽם׃
translation: It is given to be polished, that it may be handled. The sword is sharpened. Yes, it is polished to give it into the hand of the killer."' (Ezekiel 21:11)

text: דַּרְכֵי צִיּוֹן אֲבֵלוֹת מִבְּלִי בָּאֵי מוֹעֵד כָּל שְׁעָרֶיהָ שֽׁוֹמֵמִין כֹּהֲנֶיהָ נֶאֱנָחִים בְּתוּלֹתֶיהָ נּוּגוֹת וְהִיא מַר לָֽהּ׃
translation: The roads to Zion mourn, because no one comes to the solemn assembly. All her gates are desolate. Her priests sigh. Her virgins are afflicted, and she herself is in bitterness. (Lamentations 1:4)

text: כָּל עַמָּהּ נֶאֱנָחִים מְבַקְּשִׁים לֶחֶם נָתְנוּ מחמודיהם מַחֲמַדֵּיהֶם בְּאֹכֶל לְהָשִׁיב נָפֶשׁ רְאֵה יְהוָה וְֽהַבִּיטָה כִּי הָיִיתִי זוֹלֵלָֽה׃
translation: All her people sigh. They seek bread. They have given their pleasant things for food to refresh their soul. "Look, LORD, and see, for I have become despised." (Lamentations 1:11)

text: חֵטְא חָֽטְאָה יְרוּשָׁלִַם עַל כֵּן לְנִידָה הָיָתָה כָּֽל מְכַבְּדֶיהָ הִזִּילוּהָ כִּי רָאוּ עֶרְוָתָהּ גַּם הִיא נֶאֶנְחָה וַתָּשָׁב אָחֽוֹר׃
translation: Jerusalem has grievously sinned. Therefore she has become unclean. All who honored her despise her, because they have seen her nakedness. Yes, she sighs and turns backward. (Lamentations 1:8)

text: יַחַד יָבֹאוּ גְדוּדָיו וַיָּסֹלּוּ עָלַי דַּרְכָּם וַיַּחֲנוּ סָבִיב לְאָהֳלִֽי׃
translation: His troops come on together, build a siege ramp against me, and encamp around my tent. (Job 19:12)

text: דֶּרֶךְ עָצֵל כִּמְשֻׂכַת חָדֶק וְאֹרַח יְשָׁרִים סְלֻלָֽה׃
translation: The way of the sluggard is like a thorn patch, but the path of the upright is a highway. (Proverbs 15:19)

text: עַל יָמִין פִּרְחַח יָקוּמוּ רַגְלַי שִׁלֵּחוּ וַיָּסֹלּוּ עָלַי אָרְחוֹת אֵידָֽם׃
translation: On my right hand rise the rabble. They thrust aside my feet. They cast their ways of destruction up against me. (Job 30:12)

text: עוֹדְךָ מִסְתּוֹלֵל בְּעַמִּי לְבִלְתִּי שַׁלְּחָֽם׃
translation: because you still exalt yourself against my people, that you won't let them go. (Exodus 9:17)

text: שִׁירוּ לֵֽאלֹהִים זַמְּרוּ שְׁמוֹ סֹלּוּ לָרֹכֵב בָּעֲרָבוֹת בְּיָהּ שְׁמוֹ וְעִלְזוּ לְפָנָֽיו׃
translation: A father of the fatherless, and a defender of the widows, is God in his holy habitation. (Psalms 68:5)

text: סַלְסְלֶהָ וּֽתְרוֹמְמֶךָּ תְּכַבֵּדְךָ כִּי תְחַבְּקֶֽנָּה׃
translation: Esteem her, and she will exalt you. She will bring you to honor when you embrace her. (Proverbs 4:8)

text: וַיִּסְעוּ בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵרַעְמְסֵס סֻכֹּתָה כְּשֵׁשׁ מֵאוֹת אֶלֶף רַגְלִי הַגְּבָרִים לְבַד מִטָּֽף׃
translation: The children of Israel traveled from Rameses to Succoth, about six hundred thousand on foot who were men, in addition to children. (Exodus 12:37)

text: וַיְשַׁמַּע שָׁאוּל אֶת הָעָם וַֽיִּפְקְדֵם בַּטְּלָאִים מָאתַיִם אֶלֶף רַגְלִי וַעֲשֶׂרֶת אֲלָפִים אֶת אִישׁ יְהוּדָֽה׃
translation: Saul summoned the people, and counted them in Telaim, two hundred thousand footmen and ten thousand men of Judah. (1 Samuel 15:4)

text: וַיִּלָּחֲמוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים וַיִּנָּגֶף יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיָּנֻסוּ אִישׁ לְאֹהָלָיו וַתְּהִי הַמַּכָּה גְּדוֹלָה מְאֹד וַיִּפֹּל מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל שְׁלֹשִׁים אֶלֶף רַגְלִֽי׃
translation: The Philistines fought, and Israel was defeated, and each man fled to his tent. There was a very great slaughter; for thirty thousand footmen of Israel fell. (1 Samuel 4:10)

text: וַיִּֽתְיַצְּבוּ פִּנּוֹת כָּל הָעָם כֹּל שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בִּקְהַל עַם הָאֱלֹהִים אַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת אֶלֶף אִישׁ רַגְלִי שֹׁלֵֽף חָֽרֶב׃
translation: The chiefs of all the people, even of all the tribes of Israel, presented themselves in the assembly of the people of God, four hundred thousand footmen who drew sword. (Judges 20:2)

text: כִּי אֶת רַגְלִים רַצְתָּה וַיַּלְאוּךָ וְאֵיךְ תְּתַֽחֲרֶה אֶת הַסּוּסִים וּבְאֶרֶץ שָׁלוֹם אַתָּה בוֹטֵחַ וְאֵיךְ תַּעֲשֶׂה בִּגְאוֹן הַיַּרְדֵּֽן׃
translation: "If you have run with the footmen, and they have wearied you, then how can you contend with horses? Though in a land of peace you are secure, yet how will you do in the pride of the Jordan? (Jeremiah 12:5)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה שֵׁשׁ מֵאוֹת אֶלֶף רַגְלִי הָעָם אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי בְּקִרְבּוֹ וְאַתָּה אָמַרְתָּ בָּשָׂר אֶתֵּן לָהֶם וְאָכְלוּ חֹדֶשׁ יָמִֽים׃
translation: Moses said, "The people, among whom I am, are six hundred thousand men on foot; and you have said, 'I will give them meat, that they may eat a whole month.' (Numbers 11:21)

text: מִבֶּטֶן מִי יָצָא הַקָּרַח וּכְפֹר שָׁמַיִם מִי יְלָדֽוֹ׃
translation: Whose womb did the ice come out of? Who has given birth to the gray frost of the sky? (Job 38:29)

text: הַנֹּתֵן שֶׁלֶג כַּצָּמֶר כְּפוֹר כָּאֵפֶר יְפַזֵּֽר׃
translation: He gives snow like wool, and scatters frost like ashes. (Psalms 147:16)

text: כְּפוֹרֵי זָהָב שְׁלֹשִׁים כְּפוֹרֵי כֶסֶף מִשְׁנִים אַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת וַעֲשָׂרָה כֵּלִים אֲחֵרִים אָֽלֶף׃
translation: thirty bowls of gold, four hundred ten silver bowls of a second kind, and one thousand other vessels. (Ezra 1:10)

text: וּכְפֹרֵי זָהָב עֶשְׂרִים לַאֲדַרְכֹנִים אָלֶף וּכְלֵי נְחֹשֶׁת מֻצְהָב טוֹבָה שְׁנַיִם חֲמוּדֹת כַּזָּהָֽב׃
translation: twenty bowls of gold weighing one thousand darics, and two vessels of fine bright bronze, precious as gold. (Ezra 8:27)

text: וַתַּעַל שִׁכְבַת הַטָּל וְהִנֵּה עַל פְּנֵי הַמִּדְבָּר דַּק מְחֻסְפָּס דַּק כַּכְּפֹר עַל הָאָֽרֶץ׃
translation: When the dew that lay had gone, behold, on the surface of the wilderness was a small round thing, small as the frost on the ground. (Exodus 16:14)

text: וַיָּשִׂימוּ אֶת כֵּלָיו בֵּית אֱלֹהֵיהֶם וְאֶת גֻּלְגָּלְתּוֹ תָקְעוּ בֵּית דָּגֽוֹן׃
translation: They put his armor in the house of their gods, and fastened his head in the house of Dagon. (1 Chronicles 10:10)

text: וְלָקַחְתָּ חֲמֵשֶׁת חֲמֵשֶׁת שְׁקָלִים לַגֻּלְגֹּלֶת בְּשֶׁקֶל הַקֹּדֶשׁ תִּקָּח עֶשְׂרִים גֵּרָה הַשָּֽׁקֶל׃
translation: you shall take five shekels apiece for each one; according to the shekel of the sanctuary you shall take them (the shekel is twenty gerahs); (Numbers 3:47)

text: וַתַּשְׁלֵךְ אִשָּׁה אַחַת פֶּלַח רֶכֶב עַל רֹאשׁ אֲבִימֶלֶךְ וַתָּרִץ אֶת גֻּלְגָּלְתּֽוֹ׃
translation: A certain woman cast an upper millstone on Abimelech's head, and broke his skull. (Judges 9:53)

text: וַיֵּלְכוּ לְקָבְרָהּ וְלֹא מָצְאוּ בָהּ כִּי אִם הַגֻּלְגֹּלֶת וְהָרַגְלַיִם וְכַפּוֹת הַיָּדָֽיִם׃
translation: They went to bury her, but they found no more of her than the skull, the feet, and the palms of her hands. (2 Kings 9:35)

text: וַיִּסָּֽפְרוּ הַלְוִיִּם מִבֶּן שְׁלֹשִׁים שָׁנָה וָמָעְלָה וַיְהִי מִסְפָּרָם לְגֻלְגְּלֹתָם לִגְבָרִים שְׁלֹשִׁים וּשְׁמוֹנָה אָֽלֶף׃
translation: The Levites were counted from thirty years old and upward; and their number by their polls, man by man, was thirty-eight thousand. (1 Chronicles 23:3)

text: שְׂאוּ אֶת רֹאשׁ כָּל עֲדַת בְּנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵל לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם לְבֵית אֲבֹתָם בְּמִסְפַּר שֵׁמוֹת כָּל זָכָר לְגֻלְגְּלֹתָֽם׃
translation: "Take a census of all the congregation of the children of Israel, by their families, by their fathers' houses, according to the number of the names, every male, one by one, (Numbers 1:2)

text: בְּאֵר חֲפָרוּהָ שָׂרִים כָּרוּהָ נְדִיבֵי הָעָם בִּמְחֹקֵק בְּמִשְׁעֲנֹתָם וּמִמִּדְבָּר מַתָּנָֽה׃
translation: the well, which the princes dug, which the nobles of the people dug, with the scepter, and with their poles." From the wilderness they traveled to Mattanah; (Numbers 21:18)

text: אִם יָקוּם וְהִתְהַלֵּךְ בַּחוּץ עַל מִשְׁעַנְתּוֹ וְנִקָּה הַמַּכֶּה רַק שִׁבְתּוֹ יִתֵּן וְרַפֹּא יְרַפֵּֽא׃
translation: if he rises again and walks around with his staff, then he who struck him shall be cleared; only he shall pay for the loss of his time, and shall provide for his healing until he is thoroughly healed. (Exodus 21:19)

text: וְיָֽדְעוּ כָּל יֹשְׁבֵי מִצְרַיִם כִּי אֲנִי יְהוָה יַעַן הֱיוֹתָם מִשְׁעֶנֶת קָנֶה לְבֵית יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
translation: "'"All the inhabitants of Egypt will know that I am the LORD, because they have been a staff of reed to the house of Israel. (Ezekiel 29:6)

text: גַּם כִּֽי אֵלֵךְ בְּגֵיא צַלְמָוֶת לֹא אִירָא רָע כִּי אַתָּה עִמָּדִי שִׁבְטְךָ וּמִשְׁעַנְתֶּךָ הֵמָּה יְנַֽחֲמֻֽנִי׃
translation: Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for you are with me. Your rod and your staff, they comfort me. (Psalms 23:4)

text: כֹּה אָמַר יְהוָה צְבָאוֹת עֹד יֵֽשְׁבוּ זְקֵנִים וּזְקֵנוֹת בִּרְחֹבוֹת יְרוּשָׁלִָם וְאִישׁ מִשְׁעַנְתּוֹ בְּיָדוֹ מֵרֹב יָמִֽים׃
translation: The LORD of Armies says: "Old men and old women will again dwell in the streets of Jerusalem, every man with his staff in his hand because of their old age. (Zechariah 8:4)

text: כִּי הִנֵּה הָאָדוֹן יְהוָה צְבָאוֹת מֵסִיר מִירוּשָׁלִַם וּמִיהוּדָה מַשְׁעֵן וּמַשְׁעֵנָה כֹּל מִשְׁעַן לֶחֶם וְכֹל מִשְׁעַן מָֽיִם׃
translation: For, behold, the Lord, GOD of Armies, takes away from Jerusalem and from Judah supply and support, the whole supply of bread, and the whole supply of water; (Isaiah 3:1)

text: בַּעְנָשׁ לֵץ יֶחְכַּם פֶּתִי וּבְהַשְׂכִּיל לְחָכָם יִקַּח דָּֽעַת׃
translation: When the mocker is punished, the simple gains wisdom. When the wise is instructed, he receives knowledge. (Proverbs 21:11)

text: עָרוּם רָאָה רָעָה ויסתר וְנִסְתָּר וּפְתָיִים עָבְרוּ וְֽנֶעֱנָֽשׁוּ׃
translation: A prudent man sees danger and hides himself; but the simple pass on, and suffer for it. (Proverbs 22:3)

text: גַּם עֲנוֹשׁ לַצַּדִּיק לֹא טוֹב לְהַכּוֹת נְדִיבִים עַל יֹֽשֶׁר׃
translation: Also to punish the righteous is not good, nor to flog officials for their integrity. (Proverbs 17:26)

text: עָרוּם רָאָה רָעָה נִסְתָּר פְּתָאיִם עָבְרוּ נֶעֱנָֽשׁוּ׃
translation: A prudent man sees danger and takes refuge; but the simple pass on, and suffer for it. (Proverbs 27:12)

text: גרל גְּֽדָל חֵמָה נֹשֵׂא עֹנֶשׁ כִּי אִם תַּצִּיל וְעוֹד תּוֹסִֽף׃
translation: A hot-tempered man must pay the penalty, for if you rescue him, you must do it again. (Proverbs 19:19)

text: וַיְסִירֵהוּ מֶֽלֶךְ מִצְרַיִם בִּֽירוּשָׁלִָם וַֽיַּעֲנֹשׁ אֶת הָאָרֶץ מֵאָה כִכַּר כֶּסֶף וְכִכַּר זָהָֽב׃
translation: The king of Egypt removed him from office at Jerusalem, and fined the land one hundred talents of silver and a talent of gold. (2 Chronicles 36:3)

text: כַּפְתֹּרֵיהֶם וּקְנֹתָם מִמֶּנָּה יִהְיוּ כֻּלָּהּ מִקְשָׁה אַחַת זָהָב טָהֽוֹר׃
translation: Their buds and their branches shall be of one piece with it, all of it one beaten work of pure gold. (Exodus 25:36)

text: כַּפְתֹּרֵיהֶם וּקְנֹתָם מִמֶּנָּה הָיוּ כֻּלָּהּ מִקְשָׁה אַחַת זָהָב טָהֽוֹר׃
translation: Their buds and their branches were of one piece with it. The whole thing was one beaten work of pure gold. (Exodus 37:22)

text: וְנוֹתְרָה בַת צִיּוֹן כְּסֻכָּה בְכָרֶם כִּמְלוּנָה בְמִקְשָׁה כְּעִיר נְצוּרָֽה׃
translation: The daughter of Zion is left like a shelter in a vineyard, like a hut in a field of melons, like a besieged city. (Isaiah 1:8)

text: וְעָשִׂיתָ שְׁנַיִם כְּרֻבִים זָהָב מִקְשָׁה תַּעֲשֶׂה אֹתָם מִשְּׁנֵי קְצוֹת הַכַּפֹּֽרֶת׃
