translation: You shall make two cherubim of hammered gold. You shall make them at the two ends of the mercy seat. (Exodus 25:18)

text: וַיַּעַשׂ שְׁנֵי כְרֻבִים זָהָב מִקְשָׁה עָשָׂה אֹתָם מִשְּׁנֵי קְצוֹת הַכַּפֹּֽרֶת׃
translation: He made two cherubim of gold. He made them of beaten work, at the two ends of the mercy seat: (Exodus 37:7)

text: עֲשֵׂה לְךָ שְׁתֵּי חֲצֽוֹצְרֹת כֶּסֶף מִקְשָׁה תַּעֲשֶׂה אֹתָם וְהָיוּ לְךָ לְמִקְרָא הָֽעֵדָה וּלְמַסַּע אֶת הַֽמַּחֲנֽוֹת׃
translation: "Make two trumpets of silver. You shall make them of beaten work. You shall use them for the calling of the congregation and for the journeying of the camps. (Numbers 10:2)

text: וְעָבְיוֹ טֶפַח וּשְׂפָתוֹ כְּמַעֲשֵׂה שְׂפַת כּוֹס פֶּרַח שׁוֹשָׁן אַלְפַּיִם בַּת יָכִֽיל׃
translation: It was a hand width thick. Its brim was worked like the brim of a cup, like the flower of a lily. It held two thousand baths. (1 Kings 7:26)

text: אַף יָדִי יָסְדָה אֶרֶץ וִֽימִינִי טִפְּחָה שָׁמָיִם קֹרֵא אֲנִי אֲלֵיהֶם יַעַמְדוּ יַחְדָּֽו׃
translation: Yes, my hand has laid the foundation of the earth, and my right hand has spread out the heavens. when I call to them, they stand up together. (Isaiah 48:13)

text: וְעָבְיוֹ טֶפַח וּשְׂפָתוֹ כְּמַעֲשֵׂה שְׂפַת כּוֹס פֶּרַח שֽׁוֹשַׁנָּה מַחֲזִיק בַּתִּים שְׁלֹשֶׁת אֲלָפִים יָכִֽיל׃
translation: It was a handbreadth thick. Its brim was made like the brim of a cup, like the flower of a lily. It received and held three thousand baths. (2 Chronicles 4:5)

text: כָּל אֵלֶּה אֲבָנִים יְקָרֹת כְּמִדֹּת גָּזִית מְגֹרָרוֹת בַּמְּגֵרָה מִבַּיִת וּמִחוּץ וּמִמַּסָּד עַד הַטְּפָחוֹת וּמִחוּץ עַד הֶחָצֵר הַגְּדוֹלָֽה׃
translation: All these were of costly stones, even of stone cut according to measure, sawed with saws, inside and outside, even from the foundation to the coping, and so on the outside to the great court. (1 Kings 7:9)

text: תִּקְרָא כְיוֹם מוֹעֵד מְגוּרַי מִסָּבִיב וְלֹא הָיָה בְּיוֹם אַף יְהוָה פָּלִיט וְשָׂרִיד אֲשֶׁר טִפַּחְתִּי וְרִבִּיתִי אֹיְבִי כִלָּֽם׃
translation: "You have called, as in the day of a solemn assembly, my terrors on every side. There was no one that escaped or remained in the day of the LORD's anger. My enemy has consumed those whom I have cared for and brought up. (Lamentations 2:22)

text: רְאֵה יְהוָה וְֽהַבִּיטָה לְמִי עוֹלַלְתָּ כֹּה אִם תֹּאכַלְנָה נָשִׁים פִּרְיָם עֹלֲלֵי טִפֻּחִים אִם יֵהָרֵג בְּמִקְדַּשׁ אֲדֹנָי כֹּהֵן וְנָבִֽיא׃
translation: "Look, LORD, and see to whom you have done thus! Should the women eat their offspring, the children that they held and bounced on their knees? Should the priest and the prophet be killed in the sanctuary of the Lord? (Lamentations 2:20)

text: וַיַּעַשׂ קַרְסֵי נְחֹשֶׁת חֲמִשִּׁים לְחַבֵּר אֶת הָאֹהֶל לִֽהְיֹת אֶחָֽד׃
translation: He made fifty clasps of bronze to couple the tent together, that it might be a unit. (Exodus 36:18)

text: קָרְסוּ כָֽרְעוּ יַחְדָּו לֹא יָכְלוּ מַלֵּט מַשָּׂא וְנַפְשָׁם בַּשְּׁבִי הָלָֽכָה׃
translation: They stoop and they bow down together. They could not deliver the burden, but they have gone into captivity. (Isaiah 46:2)

text: וְעָשִׂיתָ חֲמִשִּׁים קַרְסֵי זָהָב וְחִבַּרְתָּ אֶת הַיְרִיעֹת אִשָּׁה אֶל אֲחֹתָהּ בַּקְּרָסִים וְהָיָה הַמִּשְׁכָּן אֶחָֽד׃
translation: You shall make fifty clasps of gold, and couple the curtains to one another with the clasps. The tabernacle shall be a unit. (Exodus 26:6)

text: וַיַּעַשׂ חֲמִשִּׁים קַרְסֵי זָהָב וַיְחַבֵּר אֶת הַיְרִעֹת אַחַת אֶל אַחַת בַּקְּרָסִים וַֽיְהִי הַמִּשְׁכָּן אֶחָֽד׃
translation: He made fifty clasps of gold, and coupled the curtains to one another with the clasps: so the tabernacle was a unit. (Exodus 36:13)

text: אֶת הַמִּשְׁכָּן אֶֽת אָהֳלוֹ וְאֶת מִכְסֵהוּ אֶת קְרָסָיו וְאֶת קְרָשָׁיו אֶת בְּרִיחָו אֶת עַמֻּדָיו וְאֶת אֲדָנָֽיו׃
translation: the tabernacle, its outer covering, its roof, its clasps, its boards, its bars, its pillars, and its sockets; (Exodus 35:11)

text: וַיָּבִיאוּ אֶת הַמִּשְׁכָּן אֶל מֹשֶׁה אֶת הָאֹהֶל וְאֶת כָּל כֵּלָיו קְרָסָיו קְרָשָׁיו בריחו בְּרִיחָיו וְעַמֻּדָיו וַאֲדָנָֽיו׃
translation: They brought the tabernacle to Moses: the tent, with all its furniture, its clasps, its boards, its bars, its pillars, its sockets, (Exodus 39:33)

text: וַיִּבֶן עֻזִּיָּהוּ מִגְדָּלִים בִּירוּשָׁלִַם עַל שַׁעַר הַפִּנָּה וְעַל שַׁעַר הַגַּיְא וְעַל הַמִּקְצוֹעַ וַֽיְחַזְּקֵֽם׃
translation: Moreover Uzziah built towers in Jerusalem at the corner gate, at the valley gate, and at the turning of the wall, and fortified them. (2 Chronicles 26:9)

text: אַחֲרָיו הֶחֱזִיק בִּנּוּי בֶּן חֵנָדָד מִדָּה שֵׁנִית מִבֵּית עֲזַרְיָה עַד הַמִּקְצוֹעַ וְעַד הַפִּנָּֽה׃
translation: After him, Binnui the son of Henadad repaired another portion, from the house of Azariah to the turning of the wall, and to the corner. (Nehemiah 3:24)

text: בְּאַרְבַּעַת מִקְצֹעוֹת הֶֽחָצֵר חֲצֵרוֹת קְטֻרוֹת אַרְבָּעִים אֹרֶךְ וּשְׁלֹשִׁים רֹחַב מִדָּה אַחַת לְאַרְבַּעְתָּם מְׄהֻׄקְׄצָׄעֽׄוֹׄתׄ׃
translation: In the four corners of the court there were courts enclosed, forty cubits long and thirty wide. These four in the corners were the same size. (Ezekiel 46:22)

text: וַיְחַזֵּק עַל יָדוֹ עֵזֶר בֶּן יֵשׁוּעַ שַׂר הַמִּצְפָּה מִדָּה שֵׁנִית מִנֶּגֶד עֲלֹת הַנֶּשֶׁק הַמִּקְצֹֽעַ׃
translation: Next to him, Ezer the son of Jeshua, the ruler of Mizpah, repaired another portion across from the ascent to the armory at the turning of the wall. (Nehemiah 3:19)

text: וְהָיוּ תוֹאֲמִם מִלְּמַטָּה וְיַחְדָּו יִהְיוּ תַמִּים אֶל רֹאשׁוֹ אֶל הַטַּבַּעַת הָאֶחָת כֵּן עָשָׂה לִשְׁנֵיהֶם לִשְׁנֵי הַמִּקְצֹעֹֽת׃
translation: They were double beneath, and in the same way they were all the way to its top to one ring. He did this to both of them in the two corners. (Exodus 36:29)

text: וַיּוֹצִיאֵנִי אֶל הֶֽחָצֵר הַחִיצֹנָה וַיַּעֲבִירֵנִי אֶל אַרְבַּעַת מִקְצוֹעֵי הֶחָצֵר וְהִנֵּה חָצֵר בְּמִקְצֹעַ הֶחָצֵר חָצֵר בְּמִקְצֹעַ הֶחָצֵֽר׃
translation: Then he brought me out into the outer court and caused me to pass by the four corners of the court; and behold, in every corner of the court there was a court. (Ezekiel 46:21)

text: וְשִׁבַּצְתָּ הַכְּתֹנֶת שֵׁשׁ וְעָשִׂיתָ מִצְנֶפֶת שֵׁשׁ וְאַבְנֵט תַּעֲשֶׂה מַעֲשֵׂה רֹקֵֽם׃
translation: You shall weave the tunic with fine linen. You shall make a turban of fine linen. You shall make a sash, the work of the embroiderer. (Exodus 28:39)

text: וְשַׂמְתָּ הַמִּצְנֶפֶת עַל רֹאשׁוֹ וְנָתַתָּ אֶת נֵזֶר הַקֹּדֶשׁ עַל הַמִּצְנָֽפֶת׃
translation: You shall set the turban on his head, and put the holy crown on the turban. (Exodus 29:6)

text: וְאֵת הַמִּצְנֶפֶת שֵׁשׁ וְאֶת פַּאֲרֵי הַמִּגְבָּעֹת שֵׁשׁ וְאֶת מִכְנְסֵי הַבָּד שֵׁשׁ מָשְׁזָֽר׃
translation: the turban of fine linen, the linen headbands of fine linen, the linen trousers of fine twined linen, (Exodus 39:28)

text: וְשַׂמְתָּ אֹתוֹ עַל פְּתִיל תְּכֵלֶת וְהָיָה עַל הַמִּצְנָפֶת אֶל מוּל פְּנֵֽי הַמִּצְנֶפֶת יִהְיֶֽה׃
translation: You shall put it on a lace of blue, and it shall be on the sash. It shall be on the front of the sash. (Exodus 28:37)

text: וַיִּתְּנוּ עָלָיו פְּתִיל תְּכֵלֶת לָתֵת עַל הַמִּצְנֶפֶת מִלְמָעְלָה כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהוָה אֶת מֹשֶֽׁה׃
translation: They tied to it a lace of blue, to fasten it on the turban above, as the LORD commanded Moses. (Exodus 39:31)

text: כֹּה אָמַר אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה הָסִיר הַמִּצְנֶפֶת וְהָרִים הָֽעֲטָרָה זֹאת לֹא זֹאת הַשָּׁפָלָה הַגְבֵּהַ וְהַגָּבֹהַ הַשְׁפִּֽיל׃
translation: I will pour out my indignation on you. I will blow on you with the fire of my wrath. I will deliver you into the hand of brutish men, skillful to destroy. (Ezekiel 21:31)

text: לְרֹקַע הָאָרֶץ עַל הַמָּיִם כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
translation: to him who spread out the earth above the waters, for his loving kindness endures forever; (Psalms 136:6)

text: הַפֶּסֶל נָסַךְ חָרָשׁ וְצֹרֵף בַּזָּהָב יְרַקְּעֶנּוּ וּרְתֻקוֹת כֶּסֶף צוֹרֵֽף׃
translation: A workman has cast an image, and the goldsmith overlays it with gold, and casts silver chains for it. (Isaiah 40:19)

text: וַיִּקַּח אֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן אֵת מַחְתּוֹת הַנְּחֹשֶׁת אֲשֶׁר הִקְרִיבוּ הַשְּׂרֻפִים וַֽיְרַקְּעוּם צִפּוּי לַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃
translation: You shall lay them up in the Tent of Meeting before the covenant, where I meet with you. (Numbers 17:4)

text: כֶּסֶף מְרֻקָּע מִתַּרְשִׁישׁ יוּבָא וְזָהָב מֵֽאוּפָז מַעֲשֵׂה חָרָשׁ וִידֵי צוֹרֵף תְּכֵלֶת וְאַרְגָּמָן לְבוּשָׁם מַעֲשֵׂה חֲכָמִים כֻּלָּֽם׃
translation: There is silver beaten into plates, which is brought from Tarshish, and gold from Uphaz, the work of the engraver and of the hands of the goldsmith. Their clothing is blue and purple. They are all the work of skillful men. (Jeremiah 10:9)

text: כֹּֽה אָמַר הָאֵל יְהוָה בּוֹרֵא הַשָּׁמַיִם וְנוֹטֵיהֶם רֹקַע הָאָרֶץ וְצֶאֱצָאֶיהָ נֹתֵן נְשָׁמָה לָעָם עָלֶיהָ וְרוּחַ לַהֹלְכִים בָּֽהּ׃
translation: God the LORD, he who created the heavens and stretched them out, he who spread out the earth and that which comes out of it, he who gives breath to its people and spirit to those who walk in it, says: (Isaiah 42:5)

text: כֹּֽה אָמַר יְהוָה גֹּאֲלֶךָ וְיֹצֶרְךָ מִבָּטֶן אָנֹכִי יְהוָה עֹשֶׂה כֹּל נֹטֶה שָׁמַיִם לְבַדִּי רֹקַע הָאָרֶץ מי אתי מֵאִתִּֽי׃
translation: The LORD, your Redeemer, and he who formed you from the womb says: "I am the LORD, who makes all things; who alone stretches out the heavens; who spreads out the earth by myself; (Isaiah 44:24)

text: לֹא תִּגְנֹבוּ וְלֹא תְכַחֲשׁוּ וְלֹֽא תְשַׁקְּרוּ אִישׁ בַּעֲמִיתֽוֹ׃
translation: "'You shall not steal. "'You shall not lie. "'You shall not deceive one another. (Leviticus 19:11)

text: וְאֶל אֵשֶׁת עֲמִֽיתְךָ לֹא תִתֵּן שְׁכָבְתְּךָ לְזָרַע לְטָמְאָה בָֽהּ׃
translation: "'You shall not lie carnally with your neighbor's wife, and defile yourself with her. (Leviticus 18:20)

text: וְאִישׁ כִּֽי יִתֵּן מוּם בַּעֲמִיתוֹ כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה כֵּן יֵעָשֶׂה לּֽוֹ׃
translation: If anyone injures his neighbor, it shall be done to him as he has done: (Leviticus 24:19)

text: וְלֹא תוֹנוּ אִישׁ אֶת עֲמִיתוֹ וְיָרֵאתָ מֵֽאֱלֹהֶיךָ כִּי אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃
translation: You shall not wrong one another, but you shall fear your God; for I am the LORD your God. (Leviticus 25:17)

text: בְּמִסְפַּר שָׁנִים אַחַר הַיּוֹבֵל תִּקְנֶה מֵאֵת עֲמִיתֶךָ בְּמִסְפַּר שְׁנֵֽי תְבוּאֹת יִמְכָּר לָֽךְ׃
translation: According to the number of years after the Jubilee you shall buy from your neighbor. According to the number of years of the crops he shall sell to you. (Leviticus 25:15)

text: לֹֽא תִשְׂנָא אֶת אָחִיךָ בִּלְבָבֶךָ הוֹכֵחַ תּוֹכִיחַ אֶת עֲמִיתֶךָ וְלֹא תִשָּׂא עָלָיו חֵֽטְא׃
translation: "'You shall not hate your brother in your heart. You shall surely rebuke your neighbor, and not bear sin because of him. (Leviticus 19:17)

text: וְאִישׁ אֽוֹ אִשָּׁה כִּֽי יִהְיֶה בְעוֹר בְּשָׂרָם בֶּהָרֹת בֶּהָרֹת לְבָנֹֽת׃
translation: "When a man or a woman has bright spots in the skin of the body, even white bright spots, (Leviticus 13:38)

text: וְאִם תַּחְתֶּיהָ תַּעֲמֹד הַבַּהֶרֶת לֹא פָשָׂתָה צָרֶבֶת הַשְּׁחִין הִוא וְטִהֲרוֹ הַכֹּהֵֽן׃
translation: But if the bright spot stays in its place, and hasn't spread, it is the scar from the boil; and the priest shall pronounce him clean. (Leviticus 13:23)

text: וְרָאָה הַכֹּהֵן וְהִנֵּה בְעוֹר בְּשָׂרָם בֶּהָרֹת כֵּהוֹת לְבָנֹת בֹּהַק הוּא פָּרַח בָּעוֹר טָהוֹר הֽוּא׃
translation: then the priest shall examine them. Behold, if the bright spots on the skin of their body are a dull white, it is a harmless rash. It has broken out in the skin. He is clean. (Leviticus 13:39)

text: וְאִם יִרְאֶנָּה הַכֹּהֵן וְהִנֵּה אֵֽין בַּבֶּהֶרֶת שֵׂעָר לָבָן וּשְׁפָלָה אֵינֶנָּה מִן הָעוֹר וְהִוא כֵהָה וְהִסְגִּירוֹ הַכֹּהֵן שִׁבְעַת יָמִֽים׃
translation: But if the priest examines it, and behold, there is no white hair in the bright spot, and it isn't deeper than the skin, but has faded, then the priest shall isolate him seven days. (Leviticus 13:26)

text: וְאִם תַּחְתֶּיהָ תַעֲמֹד הַבַּהֶרֶת לֹא פָשְׂתָה בָעוֹר וְהִוא כֵהָה שְׂאֵת הַמִּכְוָה הִוא וְטִֽהֲרוֹ הַכֹּהֵן כִּֽי צָרֶבֶת הַמִּכְוָה הִֽוא׃
translation: If the bright spot stays in its place, and hasn't spread in the skin, but is faded, it is the swelling from the burn, and the priest shall pronounce him clean, for it is the scar from the burn. (Leviticus 13:28)

text: לֹא יָדְעוּ וְלֹא יָבִינוּ כִּי טַח מֵֽרְאוֹת עֵֽינֵיהֶם מֵהַשְׂכִּיל לִבֹּתָֽם׃
translation: They don't know, neither do they consider, for he has shut their eyes, that they can't see, and their hearts, that they can't understand. (Isaiah 44:18)

text: וְהִנֵּה נָפַל הַקִּיר הֲלוֹא יֵאָמֵר אֲלֵיכֶם אַיֵּה הַטִּיחַ אֲשֶׁר טַחְתֶּֽם׃
translation: Behold, when the wall has fallen, won't it be said to you, "Where is the plaster with which you have plastered it?" (Ezekiel 13:12)

text: וְלָקְחוּ אֲבָנִים אֲחֵרוֹת וְהֵבִיאוּ אֶל תַּחַת הָאֲבָנִים וְעָפָר אַחֵר יִקַּח וְטָח אֶת הַבָּֽיִת׃
translation: They shall take other stones, and put them in the place of those stones; and he shall take other mortar, and shall plaster the house. (Leviticus 14:42)

text: וְאִם יָשׁוּב הַנֶּגַע וּפָרַח בַּבַּיִת אַחַר חִלֵּץ אֶת הָאֲבָנִים וְאַחֲרֵי הִקְצוֹת אֶת הַבַּיִת וְאַחֲרֵי הִטּֽוֹחַ׃
translation: "If the plague comes again, and breaks out in the house after he has taken out the stones, and after he has scraped the house, and after it was plastered, (Leviticus 14:43)

text: וְהָרַסְתִּי אֶת הַקִּיר אֲשֶׁר טַחְתֶּם תָּפֵל וְהִגַּעְתִּיהוּ אֶל הָאָרֶץ וְנִגְלָה יְסֹדוֹ וְנָֽפְלָה וּכְלִיתֶם בְּתוֹכָהּ וִֽידַעְתֶּם כִּֽי אֲנִי יְהוָֽה׃
translation: So I will break down the wall that you have plastered with whitewash, and bring it down to the ground, so that its foundation will be uncovered. It will fall, and you will be consumed in the middle of it. Then you will know that I am the LORD. (Ezekiel 13:14)

text: כָּסּוּ הָרִים צִלָּהּ וַעֲנָפֶיהָ אַֽרְזֵי אֵֽל׃
translation: It sent out its branches to the sea, its shoots to the River. (Psalms 80:11)

text: אִמְּךָ כַגֶּפֶן בְּדָמְךָ עַל מַיִם שְׁתוּלָה פֹּֽרִיָּה וַֽעֲנֵפָה הָיְתָה מִמַּיִם רַבִּֽים׃
translation: "'Your mother was like a vine in your blood, planted by the waters. It was fruitful and full of branches by reason of many waters. (Ezekiel 19:10)

text: וְאַתֶּם הָרֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל עַנְפְּכֶם תִּתֵּנוּ וּפֶרְיְכֶם תִּשְׂאוּ לְעַמִּי יִשְׂרָאֵל כִּי קֵרְבוּ לָבֽוֹא׃
translation: "'"But you, mountains of Israel, you shall shoot out your branches and yield your fruit to my people Israel; for they are at hand to come. (Ezekiel 36:8)

text: וּלְקַחְתֶּם לָכֶם בַּיּוֹם הָרִאשׁוֹן פְּרִי עֵץ הָדָר כַּפֹּת תְּמָרִים וַעֲנַף עֵץ עָבֹת וְעַרְבֵי נָחַל וּשְׂמַחְתֶּם לִפְנֵי יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם שִׁבְעַת יָמִֽים׃
translation: You shall take on the first day the fruit of majestic trees, branches of palm trees, and boughs of thick trees, and willows of the brook; and you shall rejoice before the LORD your God seven days. (Leviticus 23:40)

text: בְּהַר מְרוֹם יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶשְׁתֳּלֶנּוּ וְנָשָׂא עָנָף וְעָשָׂה פֶרִי וְהָיָה לְאֶרֶז אַדִּיר וְשָׁכְנוּ תַחְתָּיו כֹּל צִפּוֹר כָּל כָּנָף בְּצֵל דָּלִיּוֹתָיו תִּשְׁכֹּֽנָּה׃
translation: I will plant it in the mountain of the height of Israel; and it will produce boughs, and bear fruit, and be a good cedar. Birds of every kind will dwell in the shade of its branches. (Ezekiel 17:23)

text: וַיִּקַּח חֲנַנְיָה הַנָּבִיא אֶת הַמּוֹטָה מֵעַל צַוַּאר יִרְמְיָה הַנָּבִיא וַֽיִּשְׁבְּרֵֽהוּ׃
translation: Then Hananiah the prophet took the bar from off the prophet Jeremiah's neck, and broke it. (Jeremiah 28:10)

text: כֹּֽה אָמַר יְהוָה אֵלַי עֲשֵׂה לְךָ מוֹסֵרוֹת וּמֹטוֹת וּנְתַתָּם עַל צַוָּארֶֽךָ׃
translation: the LORD says to me: "Make bonds and bars, and put them on your neck. (Jeremiah 27:2)

text: וַיִּשְׂאוּ בְנֵֽי הַלְוִיִּם אֵת אֲרוֹן הָֽאֱלֹהִים כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה מֹשֶׁה כִּדְבַר יְהוָה בִּכְתֵפָם בַּמֹּטוֹת עֲלֵיהֶֽם׃
translation: The children of the Levites bore God's ark on their shoulders with its poles, as Moses commanded according to the LORD's word. (1 Chronicles 15:15)

text: אָז תִּקְרָא וַיהוָה יַעֲנֶה תְּשַׁוַּע וְיֹאמַר הִנֵּנִי אִם תָּסִיר מִתּֽוֹכְךָ מוֹטָה שְׁלַח אֶצְבַּע וְדַבֶּר אָֽוֶן׃
translation: Then you will call, and the LORD will answer. You will cry for help, and he will say, 'Here I am.' "If you take away from among you the yoke, finger pointing, and speaking wickedly; (Isaiah 58:9)

text: הָלוֹךְ וְאָמַרְתָּ אֶל חֲנַנְיָה לֵאמֹר כֹּה אָמַר יְהוָה מוֹטֹת עֵץ שָׁבָרְתָּ וְעָשִׂיתָ תַחְתֵּיהֶן מֹטוֹת בַּרְזֶֽל׃
translation: "Go, and tell Hananiah, saying, 'The LORD says, "You have broken the bars of wood, but you have made in their place bars of iron." (Jeremiah 28:13)

text: הֲלוֹא זֶה צוֹם אֶבְחָרֵהוּ פַּתֵּחַ חַרְצֻבּוֹת רֶשַׁע הַתֵּר אֲגֻדּוֹת מוֹטָה וְשַׁלַּח רְצוּצִים חָפְשִׁים וְכָל מוֹטָה תְּנַתֵּֽקוּ׃
translation: "Isn't this the fast that I have chosen: to release the bonds of wickedness, to undo the straps of the yoke, to let the oppressed go free, and that you break every yoke? (Isaiah 58:6)

text: אֵלֶּה קריאי קְרוּאֵי הָעֵדָה נְשִׂיאֵי מַטּוֹת אֲבוֹתָם רָאשֵׁי אַלְפֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הֵֽם׃
translation: These are those who were called of the congregation, the princes of the tribes of their fathers; they were the heads of the thousands of Israel. (Numbers 1:16)

text: וַיָּקֻמוּ לִפְנֵי מֹשֶׁה וַאֲנָשִׁים מִבְּנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵל חֲמִשִּׁים וּמָאתָיִם נְשִׂיאֵי עֵדָה קְרִאֵי מוֹעֵד אַנְשֵׁי שֵֽׁם׃
translation: They rose up before Moses, with some of the children of Israel, two hundred fifty princes of the congregation, called to the assembly, men of renown. (Numbers 16:2)

text: וּמִנִּי שִׂים טְעֵם וּבַקַּרוּ וְהַשְׁכַּחוּ דִּי קִרְיְתָא דָךְ מִן יוֹמָת עָֽלְמָא עַל מַלְכִין מִֽתְנַשְּׂאָה וּמְרַד וְאֶשְׁתַּדּוּר מִתְעֲבֶד בַּֽהּ׃
translation: I decreed, and search has been made, and it was found that this city has made insurrection against kings in the past, and that rebellion and revolts have been made in it. (Ezra 4:19)

text: כִּי לִי כָל חַיְתוֹ יָעַר בְּהֵמוֹת בְּהַרְרֵי אָֽלֶף׃
translation: For every animal of the forest is mine, and the livestock on a thousand hills. (Psalms 50:10)

text: יְֽהוָה בִּרְצוֹנְךָ הֶעֱמַדְתָּה לְֽהַרְרִי עֹז הִסְתַּרְתָּ פָנֶיךָ הָיִיתִי נִבְהָֽל׃
translation: I cried to you, LORD. I made supplication to the Lord: (Psalms 30:8)

text: לִבְנֵי קֹרַח מִזְמוֹר שִׁיר יְסוּדָתוֹ בְּהַרְרֵי קֹֽדֶשׁ׃
translation: A Psalm by the sons of Korah; a Song. His foundation is in the holy mountains. (Psalms 87:1)

text: צִדְקָֽתְךָ כְּֽהַרְרֵי אֵל מִשְׁפָּטֶךָ תְּהוֹם רַבָּה אָדָֽם וּבְהֵמָה תוֹשִׁיעַ יְהוָֽה׃
translation: How precious is your loving kindness, God! The children of men take refuge under the shadow of your wings. (Psalms 36:7)

text: נָאוֹר אַתָּה אַדִּיר מֵֽהַרְרֵי טָֽרֶף׃
translation: Valiant men lie plundered, they have slept their last sleep. None of the men of war can lift their hands. (Psalms 76:5)

text: הֲרָרִי בַּשָּׂדֶה חֵילְךָ כָל אוֹצְרוֹתֶיךָ לָבַז אֶתֵּן בָּמֹתֶיךָ בְּחַטָּאת בְּכָל גְּבוּלֶֽיךָ׃
translation: My mountain in the field, I will give your substance and all your treasures for a plunder, and your high places, because of sin, throughout all your borders. (Jeremiah 17:3)

text: בִּמְלֹאות שִׂפְקוֹ יֵצֶר לוֹ כָּל יַד עָמֵל תְּבוֹאֶֽנּוּ׃
translation: In the fullness of his sufficiency, distress will overtake him. The hand of everyone who is in misery will come on him. (Job 20:22)

text: כִּֽי חֵמָה פֶּן יְסִֽיתְךָ בְסָפֶק וְרָב כֹּפֶר אַל יַטֶּֽךָּ׃
translation: Don't let riches entice you to wrath, neither let the great size of a bribe turn you aside. (Job 36:18)

text: יִשְׂפֹּק עָלֵימוֹ כַפֵּימוֹ וְיִשְׁרֹק עָלָיו מִמְּקֹמֽוֹ׃
translation: Men will clap their hands at him, and will hiss him out of his place. (Job 27:23)

text: כִּי יֹסִיף עַֽל חַטָּאתוֹ פֶשַׁע בֵּינֵינוּ יִסְפּוֹק וְיֶרֶב אֲמָרָיו לָאֵֽל׃
translation: For he adds rebellion to his sin. He claps his hands among us, and multiplies his words against God." (Job 34:37)

text: תַּֽחַת רְשָׁעִים סְפָקָם בִּמְקוֹם רֹאִֽים׃
translation: He strikes them as wicked men in the open sight of others; (Job 34:26)

text: הַשְׁכִּירֻהוּ כִּי עַל יְהוָה הִגְדִּיל וְסָפַק מוֹאָב בְּקִיאוֹ וְהָיָה לִשְׂחֹק גַּם הֽוּא׃
translation: "Make him drunk, for he magnified himself against the LORD. Moab will wallow in his vomit, and he also will be in derision. (Jeremiah 48:26)

text: וְשַׁעֲרַיִם וַעֲדִיתַיִם וְהַגְּדֵרָה וּגְדֵרֹתָיִם עָרִים אַרְבַּֽע עֶשְׂרֵה וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃
translation: Shaaraim, Adithaim and Gederah (or Gederothaim); fourteen cities with their villages. (Joshua 15:36)

text: וְֽהָיְתָה חֶבֶל הַיָּם נְוֺת כְּרֹת רֹעִים וְגִדְרוֹת צֹֽאן׃
translation: The sea coast will be pastures, with cottages for shepherds and folds for flocks. (Zephaniah 2:6)

text: בְּנֽוּ לָכֶם עָרִים לְטַפְּכֶם וּגְדֵרֹת לְצֹנַאֲכֶם וְהַיֹּצֵא מִפִּיכֶם תַּעֲשֽׂוּ׃
translation: Build cities for your little ones, and folds for your sheep; and do that which has proceeded out of your mouth." (Numbers 32:24)

text: וַיִּגְּשׁוּ אֵלָיו וַיֹּאמְרוּ גִּדְרֹת צֹאן נִבְנֶה לְמִקְנֵנוּ פֹּה וְעָרִים לְטַפֵּֽנוּ׃
translation: They came near to him, and said, "We will build sheepfolds here for our livestock, and cities for our little ones; (Numbers 32:16)

text: וְאֶת בֵּית נִמְרָה וְאֶת בֵּית הָרָן עָרֵי מִבְצָר וְגִדְרֹת צֹֽאן׃
translation: Beth Nimrah, and Beth Haran: fortified cities and folds for sheep. (Numbers 32:36)

text: הֵמָּה הַיּוֹצְרִים וְיֹשְׁבֵי נְטָעִים וּגְדֵרָה עִם הַמֶּלֶךְ בִּמְלַאכְתּוֹ יָשְׁבוּ שָֽׁם׃
translation: These were the potters, and the inhabitants of Netaim and Gederah; they lived there with the king for his work. (1 Chronicles 4:23)

text: טוֹב מְעַט בְּיִרְאַת יְהוָה מֵאוֹצָר רָב וּמְהוּמָה בֽוֹ׃
translation: Better is little, with the fear of the LORD, than great treasure with trouble. (Proverbs 15:16)

text: וּנְתָנָם יְהוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לְפָנֶיךָ וְהָמָם מְהוּמָה גְדֹלָה עַד הִשָּׁמְדָֽם׃
translation: But the LORD your God will deliver them up before you, and will confuse them with a great confusion, until they are destroyed. (Deuteronomy 7:23)

text: וּבָעִתִּים הָהֵם אֵין שָׁלוֹם לַיּוֹצֵא וְלַבָּא כִּי מְהוּמֹת רַבּוֹת עַל כָּל יוֹשְׁבֵי הָאֲרָצֽוֹת׃
translation: In those times there was no peace to him who went out, nor to him who came in; but great troubles were on all the inhabitants of the lands. (2 Chronicles 15:5)

text: בָּאָה הַצְּפִירָה אֵלֶיךָ יוֹשֵׁב הָאָרֶץ בָּא הָעֵת קָרוֹב הַיּוֹם מְהוּמָה וְלֹא הֵד הָרִֽים׃
translation: Your doom has come to you, inhabitant of the land! The time has come! The day is near, a day of tumult, and not of joyful shouting, on the mountains. (Ezekiel 7:7)

text: וַיִּזָּעֵק שָׁאוּל וְכָל הָעָם אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ וַיָּבֹאוּ עַד הַמִּלְחָמָה וְהִנֵּה הָיְתָה חֶרֶב אִישׁ בְּרֵעֵהוּ מְהוּמָה גְּדוֹלָה מְאֹֽד׃
translation: Saul and all the people who were with him were gathered together, and came to the battle; and behold, they were all striking each other with their swords in very great confusion. (1 Samuel 14:20)

text: וְהָיָה בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא תִּֽהְיֶה מְהֽוּמַת יְהוָה רַבָּה בָּהֶם וְהֶחֱזִיקוּ אִישׁ יַד רֵעֵהוּ וְעָלְתָה יָדוֹ עַל יַד רֵעֵֽהוּ׃
translation: It will happen in that day that a great panic from the LORD will be among them; and they will each seize the hand of his neighbor, and his hand will rise up against the hand of his neighbor. (Zechariah 14:13)

text: וְשָׂרְפוּ בָתַּיִךְ בָּאֵשׁ וְעָשׂוּ בָךְ שְׁפָטִים לְעֵינֵי נָשִׁים רַבּוֹת וְהִשְׁבַּתִּיךְ מִזּוֹנָה וְגַם אֶתְנַן לֹא תִתְּנִי עֽוֹד׃
translation: They will burn your houses with fire, and execute judgments on you in the sight of many women. I will cause you to cease from playing the prostitute, and you will also give no hire any more. (Ezekiel 16:41)

text: אַל תִּשְׂמַח יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל גִּיל כָּֽעַמִּים כִּי זָנִיתָ מֵעַל אֱלֹהֶיךָ אָהַבְתָּ אֶתְנָן עַל כָּל גָּרְנוֹת דָּגָֽן׃
translation: Don't rejoice, Israel, to jubilation like the nations; for you were unfaithful to your God. You love the wages of a prostitute at every grain threshing floor. (Hosea 9:1)

text: לֹא תָבִיא אֶתְנַן זוֹנָה וּמְחִיר כֶּלֶב בֵּית יְהוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לְכָל נֶדֶר כִּי תוֹעֲבַת יְהוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ גַּם שְׁנֵיהֶֽם׃
translation: You shall not lend on interest to your brother: interest of money, interest of food, interest of anything that is lent on interest. (Deuteronomy 23:19)

text: וַיְהִי בָךְ הֵפֶךְ מִן הַנָּשִׁים בְּתַזְנוּתַיִךְ וְאַחֲרַיִךְ לֹא זוּנָּה וּבְתִתֵּךְ אֶתְנָן וְאֶתְנַן לֹא נִתַּן לָךְ וַתְּהִי לְהֶֽפֶךְ׃
translation: You are different from other women in your prostitution, in that no one follows you to play the prostitute; and whereas you give hire, and no hire is given to you, therefore you are different."' (Ezekiel 16:34)

text: וְהָיָה מִקֵּץ שִׁבְעִים שָׁנָה יִפְקֹד יְהוָה אֶת צֹר וְשָׁבָה לְאֶתְנַנָּה וְזָֽנְתָה אֶת כָּל מַמְלְכוֹת הָאָרֶץ עַל פְּנֵי הָאֲדָמָֽה׃
translation: It will happen after the end of seventy years that the LORD will visit Tyre. She will return to her wages, and will play the prostitute with all the kingdoms of the world on the surface of the earth. (Isaiah 23:17)

text: וְהָיָה סַחְרָהּ וְאֶתְנַנָּהּ קֹדֶשׁ לַֽיהוָה לֹא יֵֽאָצֵר וְלֹא יֵֽחָסֵן כִּי לַיֹּשְׁבִים לִפְנֵי יְהוָה יִֽהְיֶה סַחְרָהּ לֶאֱכֹל לְשָׂבְעָה וְלִמְכַסֶּה עָתִֽיק׃
translation: Her merchandise and her wages will be holiness to the LORD. It will not be treasured nor laid up; for her merchandise will be for those who dwell before the LORD, to eat sufficiently, and for durable clothing. (Isaiah 23:18)

text: וְאֶת יַתִּר וְאֶת מִגְרָשֶׁהָ וְאֶת אֶשְׁתְּמֹעַ וְאֶת מִגְרָשֶֽׁהָ׃
translation: Jattir with its pasture lands, Eshtemoa with its pasture lands, (Joshua 21:14)

text: לַאֲשֶׁר בְּבֵֽית אֵל וְלַאֲשֶׁר בְּרָמֽוֹת נֶגֶב וְלַאֲשֶׁר בְּיַתִּֽר׃
translation: He sent it to those who were in Bethel, to those who were in Ramoth of the South, to those who were in Jattir, (1 Samuel 30:27)

text: וּבָהָר שָׁמִיר וְיַתִּיר וְשׂוֹכֹֽה׃
translation: In the hill country, Shamir, Jattir, Socoh, (Joshua 15:48)

text: וְשִׁמְעֵת עליך עֲלָךְ דִּי רוּחַ אֱלָהִין בָּךְ וְנַהִירוּ וְשָׂכְלְתָנוּ וְחָכְמָה יַתִּירָה הִשְׁתְּכַחַת בָּֽךְ׃
translation: I have heard of you, that the spirit of the gods is in you and that light, understanding, and excellent wisdom are found in you. (Daniel 5:14)

text: וְלִבְנֵי אַהֲרֹן נָתְנוּ אֶת עָרֵי הַמִּקְלָט אֶת חֶבְרוֹן וְאֶת לִבְנָה וְאֶת מִגְרָשֶׁיהָ וְאֶת יַתִּר וְאֶֽת אֶשְׁתְּמֹעַ וְאֶת מִגְרָשֶֽׁיהָ׃
translation: the son of Ethan, the son of Zimmah, the son of Shimei, (1 Chronicles 6:42)

text: נַפְשׁוֹ גֶּחָלִים תְּלַהֵט וְלַהַב מִפִּיו יֵצֵֽא׃
translation: Who can strip off his outer garment? Who will come within his jaws? (Job 41:13)

text: וְֽנִבְהָלוּ צִירִים וַֽחֲבָלִים יֹֽאחֵזוּן כַּיּוֹלֵדָה יְחִילוּן אִישׁ אֶל רֵעֵהוּ יִתְמָהוּ פְּנֵי לְהָבִים פְּנֵיהֶֽם׃
translation: They will be dismayed. Pangs and sorrows will seize them. They will be in pain like a woman in labor. They will look in amazement one at another. Their faces will be faces of flame. (Isaiah 13:8)

text: מֵעִם יְהוָה צְבָאוֹת תִּפָּקֵד בְּרַעַם וּבְרַעַשׁ וְקוֹל גָּדוֹל סוּפָה וּסְעָרָה וְלַהַב אֵשׁ אוֹכֵלָֽה׃
translation: She will be visited by the LORD of Armies with thunder, with earthquake, with great noise, with whirlwind and storm, and with the flame of a devouring fire. (Isaiah 29:6)

text: כִּֽי הִנֵּה יְהוָה בָּאֵשׁ יָבוֹא וְכַסּוּפָה מַרְכְּבֹתָיו לְהָשִׁיב בְּחֵמָה אַפּוֹ וְגַעֲרָתוֹ בְּלַהֲבֵי אֵֽשׁ׃
translation: For, behold, the LORD will come with fire, and his chariots will be like the whirlwind; to give his anger with fierceness, and his rebuke with flames of fire. (Isaiah 66:15)

text: כְּקוֹל מַרְכָּבוֹת עַל רָאשֵׁי הֶֽהָרִים יְרַקֵּדוּן כְּקוֹל לַהַב אֵשׁ אֹכְלָה קָשׁ כְּעַם עָצוּם עֱרוּךְ מִלְחָמָֽה׃
translation: Like the noise of chariots on the tops of the mountains, they leap, like the noise of a flame of fire that devours the stubble, like a strong people set in battle array. (Joel 2:5)

text: וַיָּבֹא גַֽם הַנִּצָּב אַחַר הַלַּהַב וַיִּסְגֹּר הַחֵלֶב בְּעַד הַלַּהַב כִּי לֹא שָׁלַף הַחֶרֶב מִבִּטְנוֹ וַיֵּצֵא הַֽפַּרְשְׁדֹֽנָה׃
translation: The handle also went in after the blade; and the fat closed on the blade, for he didn't draw the sword out of his body; and it came out behind. (Judges 3:22)

text: לִרְקָמוֹת תּוּבַל לַמֶּלֶךְ בְּתוּלוֹת אַחֲרֶיהָ רֵעוֹתֶיהָ מוּבָאוֹת לָֽךְ׃
translation: With gladness and rejoicing they shall be led. They shall enter into the king's palace. (Psalms 45:15)

text: וָאַלְבִּישֵׁךְ רִקְמָה וָאֶנְעֲלֵךְ תָּחַשׁ וָאֶחְבְּשֵׁךְ בַּשֵּׁשׁ וַאֲכַסֵּךְ מֶֽשִׁי׃
translation: I clothed you also with embroidered work and put leather sandals on you. I dressed you with fine linen and covered you with silk. (Ezekiel 16:10)

text: וַתִּקְחִי אֶת בִּגְדֵי רִקְמָתֵךְ וַתְּכַסִּים וְשַׁמְנִי וּקְטָרְתִּי נתתי נָתַתְּ לִפְנֵיהֶֽם׃
translation: You took your embroidered garments, covered them, and set my oil and my incense before them. (Ezekiel 16:18)

text: הֵמָּה רֹכְלַיִךְ בְּמַכְלֻלִים בִּגְלוֹמֵי תְּכֵלֶת וְרִקְמָה וּבְגִנְזֵי בְּרֹמִים בַּחֲבָלִים חֲבֻשִׁים וַאֲרֻזִים בְּמַרְכֻלְתֵּֽךְ׃
translation: These were your traders in choice wares, in wrappings of blue and embroidered work, and in cedar chests of rich clothing bound with cords, among your merchandise. (Ezekiel 27:24)

text: שֵׁשׁ בְּרִקְמָה מִמִּצְרַיִם הָיָה מִפְרָשֵׂךְ לִהְיוֹת לָךְ לְנֵס תְּכֵלֶת וְאַרְגָּמָן מֵאִיֵּי אֱלִישָׁה הָיָה מְכַסֵּֽךְ׃
translation: Your sail was of fine linen with embroidered work from Egypt, that it might be to you for a banner. Blue and purple from the islands of Elishah was your awning. (Ezekiel 27:7)

text: צוּף דְּבַשׁ אִמְרֵי נֹעַם מָתוֹק לַנֶּפֶשׁ וּמַרְפֵּא לָעָֽצֶם׃
translation: Pleasant words are a honeycomb, sweet to the soul, and health to the bones. (Proverbs 16:24)

text: אֱכָל בְּנִי דְבַשׁ כִּי טוֹב וְנֹפֶת מָתוֹק עַל חִכֶּֽךָ׃
translation: My son, eat honey, for it is good, the droppings of the honeycomb, which are sweet to your taste; (Proverbs 24:13)

text: נֶפֶשׁ שְׂבֵעָה תָּבוּס נֹפֶת וְנֶפֶשׁ רְעֵבָה כָּל מַר מָתֽוֹק׃
translation: A full soul loathes a honeycomb; but to a hungry soul, every bitter thing is sweet. (Proverbs 27:7)

text: וּמָתוֹק הָאוֹר וְטוֹב לַֽעֵינַיִם לִרְאוֹת אֶת הַשָּֽׁמֶשׁ׃
translation: Truly the light is sweet, and it is a pleasant thing for the eyes to see the sun. (Ecclesiastes 11:7)

text: כְּתַפּוּחַ בַּעֲצֵי הַיַּעַר כֵּן דּוֹדִי בֵּין הַבָּנִים בְּצִלּוֹ חִמַּדְתִּי וְיָשַׁבְתִּי וּפִרְיוֹ מָתוֹק לְחִכִּֽי׃
translation: As the apple tree among the trees of the wood, so is my beloved among the sons. I sat down under his shadow with great delight, his fruit was sweet to my taste. (Song of Solomon 2:3)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶם מֵהָֽאֹכֵל יָצָא מַאֲכָל וּמֵעַז יָצָא מָתוֹק וְלֹא יָכְלוּ לְהַגִּיד הַחִידָה שְׁלֹשֶׁת יָמִֽים׃
translation: He said to them, "Out of the eater came out food. Out of the strong came out sweetness." They couldn't in three days declare the riddle. (Judges 14:14)

text: חוֹחַ עָלָה בְיַד שִׁכּוֹר וּמָשָׁל בְּפִי כְסִילִֽים׃
translation: Like a thorn bush that goes into the hand of a drunkard, so is a parable in the mouth of fools. (Proverbs 26:9)

text: כְּשֽׁוֹשַׁנָּה בֵּין הַחוֹחִים כֵּן רַעְיָתִי בֵּין הַבָּנֽוֹת׃
translation: As a lily among thorns, so is my love among the daughters. (Song of Solomon 2:2)

text: תַּחַת חִטָּה יֵצֵא חוֹחַ וְתַֽחַת שְׂעֹרָה בָאְשָׁה תַּמּוּ דִּבְרֵי אִיּֽוֹב׃
translation: let briers grow instead of wheat, and stinkweed instead of barley." The words of Job are ended. (Job 31:40)

text: וְעָלְתָה אַרְמְנֹתֶיהָ סִירִים קִמּוֹשׂ וָחוֹחַ בְּמִבְצָרֶיהָ וְהָיְתָה נְוֵה תַנִּים חָצִיר לִבְנוֹת יַעֲנָֽה׃
translation: Thorns will come up in its palaces, nettles and thistles in its fortresses; and it will be a habitation of jackals, a court for ostriches. (Isaiah 34:13)

text: כִּֽי הִנֵּה הָֽלְכוּ מִשֹּׁד מִצְרַיִם תְּקַבְּצֵם מֹף תְּקַבְּרֵם מַחְמַד לְכַסְפָּם קִמּוֹשׂ יִֽירָשֵׁם חוֹחַ בְּאָהֳלֵיהֶֽם׃
translation: For, behold, when they flee destruction, Egypt will gather them up. Memphis will bury them. Nettles will possess their pleasant things of silver. Thorns will be in their tents. (Hosea 9:6)

text: וְאִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל רָאוּ כִּי צַר לוֹ כִּי נִגַּשׂ הָעָם וַיִּֽתְחַבְּאוּ הָעָם בַּמְּעָרוֹת וּבַֽחֲוָחִים וּבַסְּלָעִים וּבַצְּרִחִים וּבַבֹּרֽוֹת׃
translation: When the men of Israel saw that they were in trouble (for the people were distressed), then the people hid themselves in caves, in thickets, in rocks, in tombs, and in pits. (1 Samuel 13:6)

text: הַאַף שׂוֹנֵא מִשְׁפָּט יַחֲבוֹשׁ וְאִם צַדִּיק כַּבִּיר תַּרְשִֽׁיעַ׃
translation: Should even one who hates justice govern? Will you condemn him who is righteous and mighty, (Job 34:17)

text: הֶן אֵל כַּבִּיר וְלֹא יִמְאָס כַּבִּיר כֹּחַֽ לֵֽב׃
translation: "Behold, God is mighty, and doesn't despise anyone. He is mighty in strength of understanding. (Job 36:5)

text: אִם אֶשְׂמַח כִּי רַב חֵילִי וְכִֽי כַבִּיר מָצְאָה יָדִֽי׃
translation: If I have rejoiced because my wealth was great, and because my hand had gotten much; (Job 31:25)

text: יָרֹעַ כַּבִּירִים לֹא חֵקֶר וַיַּעֲמֵד אֲחֵרִים תַּחְתָּֽם׃
translation: He breaks mighty men in pieces in ways past finding out, and sets others in their place. (Job 34:24)

text: הִנֵּה חָזָק וְאַמִּץ לַֽאדֹנָי כְּזֶרֶם בָּרָד שַׂעַר קָטֶב כְּזֶרֶם מַיִם כַּבִּירִים שֹׁטְפִים הִנִּיחַ לָאָרֶץ בְּיָֽד׃
translation: Behold, the Lord has one who is mighty and strong. Like a storm of hail, a destroying storm, and like a storm of mighty waters overflowing, he will cast them down to the earth with his hand. (Isaiah 28:2)

text: וְעַתָּה דִּבֶּר יְהוָה לֵאמֹר בְּשָׁלֹשׁ שָׁנִים כִּשְׁנֵי שָׂכִיר וְנִקְלָה כְּבוֹד מוֹאָב בְּכֹל הֶהָמוֹן הָרָב וּשְׁאָר מְעַט מִזְעָר לוֹא כַבִּֽיר׃
translation: But now the LORD has spoken, saying, "Within three years, as a worker bound by contract would count them, the glory of Moab shall be brought into contempt, with all his great multitude; and the remnant will be very small and feeble." (Isaiah 16:14)

text: וְהָרִֽצְפָה אֶל כֶּתֶף הַשְּׁעָרִים לְעֻמַּת אֹרֶךְ הַשְּׁעָרִים הָרִֽצְפָה הַתַּחְתּוֹנָֽה׃
translation: The pavement was by the side of the gates, corresponding to the length of the gates, even the lower pavement. (Ezekiel 40:18)

text: וַיֻּגַּד לְדָוִד אֵת אֲשֶׁר עָשְׂתָה רִצְפָּה בַת אַיָּה פִּלֶגֶשׁ שָׁאֽוּל׃
translation: David was told what Rizpah the daughter of Aiah, the concubine of Saul, had done. (2 Samuel 21:11)

text: וּלְשָׁאוּל פִּלֶגֶשׁ וּשְׁמָהּ רִצְפָּה בַת אַיָּה וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל אַבְנֵר מַדּוּעַ בָּאתָה אֶל פִּילֶגֶשׁ אָבִֽי׃
translation: Now Saul had a concubine, whose name was Rizpah, the daughter of Aiah; and Ishbosheth said to Abner, "Why have you gone in to my father's concubine?" (2 Samuel 3:7)

text: וַיְבִיאֵנִי אֶל הֶֽחָצֵר הַחִיצוֹנָה וְהִנֵּה לְשָׁכוֹת וְרִֽצְפָה עָשׂוּי לֶחָצֵר סָבִיב סָבִיב שְׁלֹשִׁים לְשָׁכוֹת אֶל הָרִֽצְפָֽה׃
translation: Then he brought me into the outer court. Behold, there were rooms and a pavement made for the court all around. Thirty rooms were on the pavement. (Ezekiel 40:17)

text: נֶגֶד הָֽעֶשְׂרִים אֲשֶׁר לֶחָצֵר הַפְּנִימִי וְנֶגֶד רִֽצְפָה אֲשֶׁר לֶחָצֵר הַחִֽיצוֹנָה אַתִּיק אֶל פְּנֵֽי אַתִּיק בַּשְּׁלִשִֽׁים׃
translation: Opposite the twenty cubits which belonged to the inner court, and opposite the pavement which belonged to the outer court, was gallery against gallery in the three stories. (Ezekiel 42:3)

text: וְאֶל מְצוֹר יְרוּשָׁלִַם תָּכִין פָּנֶיךָ וּֽזְרֹעֲךָ חֲשׂוּפָה וְנִבֵּאתָ עָלֶֽיהָ׃
translation: You shall set your face toward the siege of Jerusalem, with your arm uncovered; and you shall prophesy against it. (Ezekiel 4:7)

text: שָׂם גַּפְנִי לְשַׁמָּה וּתְאֵנָתִי לִקְצָפָה חָשֹׂף חֲשָׂפָהּ וְהִשְׁלִיךְ הִלְבִּינוּ שָׂרִיגֶֽיהָ׃
translation: He has laid my vine waste, and stripped my fig tree. He has stripped its bark, and thrown it away. Its branches are made white. (Joel 1:7)

text: חָשַׂף יְהוָה אֶת זְרוֹעַ קָדְשׁוֹ לְעֵינֵי כָּל הַגּוֹיִם וְרָאוּ כָּל אַפְסֵי אָרֶץ אֵת יְשׁוּעַת אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃
translation: The LORD has made his holy arm bare in the eyes of all the nations. All the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God. (Isaiah 52:10)

text: מִֽהְיוֹתָם בָּא אֶל עֲרֵמַת עֶשְׂרִים וְהָיְתָה עֲשָׂרָה בָּא אֶל הַיֶּקֶב לַחְשֹׂף חֲמִשִּׁים פּוּרָה וְהָיְתָה עֶשְׂרִֽים׃
translation: Through all that time, when one came to a heap of twenty measures, there were only ten. When one came to the wine vat to draw out fifty, there were only twenty. (Haggai 2:16)

text: כִּֽי אֲנִי חָשַׂפְתִּי אֶת עֵשָׂו גִּלֵּיתִי אֶת מִסְתָּרָיו וְנֶחְבָּה לֹא יוּכָל שֻׁדַּד זַרְעוֹ וְאֶחָיו וּשְׁכֵנָיו וְאֵינֶֽנּוּ׃
translation: But I have made Esau bare, I have uncovered his secret places, and he will not be able to hide himself. His offspring is destroyed, with his brothers and his neighbors; and he is no more. (Jeremiah 49:10)

text: וּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הָתְפָּקְדוּ וְכָלְכְּלוּ וַיֵּלְכוּ לִקְרָאתָם וַיַּחֲנוּ בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵל נֶגְדָּם כִּשְׁנֵי חֲשִׂפֵי עִזִּים וַאֲרָם מִלְאוּ אֶת הָאָֽרֶץ׃
translation: The children of Israel were mustered and given provisions, and went against them. The children of Israel encamped before them like two little flocks of young goats, but the Syrians filled the country. (1 Kings 20:27)

text: וּשְׁאָר אֻמַּיָּא דִּי הַגְלִי אָסְנַפַּר רַבָּא וְיַקִּירָא וְהוֹתֵב הִמּוֹ בְּקִרְיָה דִּי שָׁמְרָיִן וּשְׁאָר עֲבַֽר נַהֲרָה וּכְעֶֽנֶת׃
translation: and the rest of the nations whom the great and noble Osnappar brought over and settled in the city of Samaria, and in the rest of the country beyond the River, and so forth, wrote. (Ezra 4:10)

text: וְדָתָא נֶפְקַת וְחַכִּֽימַיָּא מִֽתְקַטְּלִין וּבְעוֹ דָּנִיֵּאל וְחַבְרוֹהִי לְהִתְקְטָלָֽה׃
translation: So the decree went out, and the wise men were to be slain. They sought Daniel and his companions to be slain. (Daniel 2:13)

text: בֵּאדַיִן הַיְתִיו מָאנֵי דַהֲבָא דִּי הַנְפִּקוּ מִן הֵֽיכְלָא דִּֽי בֵית אֱלָהָא דִּי בִירֽוּשְׁלֶם וְאִשְׁתִּיו בְּהוֹן מַלְכָּא וְרַבְרְבָנוֹהִי שֵׁגְלָתֵהּ וּלְחֵנָתֵֽהּ׃
translation: Then they brought the golden vessels that were taken out of the temple of God's house which was at Jerusalem; and the king and his lords, his wives and his concubines, drank from them. (Daniel 5:3)

text: נְהַר דִּי נוּר נָגֵד וְנָפֵק מִן קֳדָמוֹהִי אֶלֶף אלפים אַלְפִין יְשַׁמְּשׁוּנֵּהּ וְרִבּוֹ רבון רִבְבָן קָֽדָמוֹהִי יְקוּמוּן דִּינָא יְתִב וְסִפְרִין פְּתִֽיחוּ׃
translation: A fiery stream issued and came out from before him. Thousands of thousands ministered to him. Ten thousand times ten thousand stood before him. The judgment was set. The books were opened. (Daniel 7:10)

text: אַף שֹׁכְנֵי בָֽתֵּי חֹמֶר אֲשֶׁר בֶּעָפָר יְסוֹדָם יְדַכְּאוּם לִפְנֵי עָֽשׁ׃
translation: How much more those who dwell in houses of clay, whose foundation is in the dust, who are crushed before the moth! (Job 4:19)

text: בָּנָה כָעָשׁ בֵּיתוֹ וּכְסֻכָּה עָשָׂה נֹצֵֽר׃
translation: He builds his house as the moth, as a booth which the watchman makes. (Job 27:18)

text: בְּֽתוֹכָחוֹת עַל עָוֺן יִסַּרְתָּ אִישׁ וַתֶּמֶס כָּעָשׁ חֲמוּדוֹ אַךְ הֶבֶל כָּל אָדָם סֶֽלָה׃
translation: "Hear my prayer, LORD, and give ear to my cry. Don't be silent at my tears. For I am a stranger with you, a foreigner, as all my fathers were. (Psalms 39:12)

text: כִּי כַבֶּגֶד יֹאכְלֵם עָשׁ וְכַצֶּמֶר יֹאכְלֵם סָס וְצִדְקָתִי לְעוֹלָם תִּֽהְיֶה וִישׁוּעָתִי לְדוֹר דּוֹרִֽים׃
translation: For the moth will eat them up like a garment, and the worm will eat them like wool; but my righteousness will be forever, and my salvation to all generations." (Isaiah 51:8)

text: הֵן אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה יַֽעֲזָר לִי מִי הוּא יַרְשִׁיעֵנִי הֵן כֻּלָּם כַּבֶּגֶד יִבְלוּ עָשׁ יֹאכְלֵֽם׃
translation: Behold, the Lord GOD will help me! Who is he who will condemn me? Behold, they will all grow old like a garment. The moths will eat them up. (Isaiah 50:9)

text: מֵפֵר מַחְשְׁבוֹת עֲרוּמִים וְֽלֹא תַעֲשֶׂינָה יְדֵיהֶם תּוּשִׁיָּֽה׃
translation: He frustrates the plans of the crafty, so that their hands can't perform their enterprise. (Job 5:12)

text: הַאִם אֵין עֶזְרָתִי בִי וְתֻשִׁיָּה נִדְּחָה מִמֶּֽנִּי׃
translation: Isn't it that I have no help in me, that wisdom is driven away from me? (Job 6:13)

text: מַה יָּעַצְתָּ לְלֹא חָכְמָה וְתוּשִׁיָּה לָרֹב הוֹדָֽעְתָּ׃
translation: How have you counseled him who has no wisdom, and plentifully declared sound knowledge! (Job 26:3)

text: תִּשָּׂאֵנִי אֶל רוּחַ תַּרְכִּיבֵנִי וּתְמֹגְגֵנִי תשוה תּוּשִׁיָּֽה׃
translation: You lift me up to the wind, and drive me with it. You dissolve me in the storm. (Job 30:22)

text: וצפן יִצְפֹּן לַיְשָׁרִים תּוּשִׁיָּה מָגֵן לְהֹלְכֵי תֹֽם׃
translation: He lays up sound wisdom for the upright. He is a shield to those who walk in integrity, (Proverbs 2:7)

text: בְּנִי אַל יָלֻזוּ מֵעֵינֶיךָ נְצֹר תֻּשִׁיָּה וּמְזִמָּֽה׃
translation: My son, let them not depart from your eyes. Keep sound wisdom and discretion, (Proverbs 3:21)

text: מְעֻוָּת לֹא יוּכַל לִתְקֹן וְחֶסְרוֹן לֹא יוּכַל לְהִמָּנֽוֹת׃
translation: That which is crooked can't be made straight; and that which is lacking can't be counted. (Ecclesiastes 1:15)

text: הַאֵל יְעַוֵּת מִשְׁפָּט וְאִם שַׁדַּי יְעַוֵּֽת צֶֽדֶק׃
translation: Does God pervert justice? Or does the Almighty pervert righteousness? (Job 8:3)

text: אַף אָמְנָם אֵל לֹֽא יַרְשִׁיעַ וְשַׁדַּי לֹֽא יְעַוֵּת מִשְׁפָּֽט׃
translation: Yes surely, God will not do wickedly, neither will the Almighty pervert justice. (Job 34:12)

text: יְהוָה שֹׁמֵר אֶת גֵּרִים יָתוֹם וְאַלְמָנָה יְעוֹדֵד וְדֶרֶךְ רְשָׁעִים יְעַוֵּֽת׃
translation: The LORD preserves the foreigners. He upholds the fatherless and widow, but he turns the way of the wicked upside down. (Psalms 146:9)

text: לְעַוֵּת אָדָם בְּרִיבוֹ אֲדֹנָי לֹא רָאָֽה׃
translation: to subvert a man in his cause, the Lord doesn't approve. (Lamentations 3:36)

text: רְאֵה אֶת מַעֲשֵׂה הָאֱלֹהִים כִּי מִי יוּכַל לְתַקֵּן אֵת אֲשֶׁר עִוְּתֽוֹ׃
translation: Consider the work of God, for who can make that straight which he has made crooked? (Ecclesiastes 7:13)

text: כִּֽי כָלוּ בְעָשָׁן יָמָי וְעַצְמוֹתַי כְּמוֹ קֵד נִחָֽרוּ׃
translation: My heart is blighted like grass, and withered, for I forget to eat my bread. (Psalms 102:4)

text: עוֹרִי שָׁחַר מֵעָלָי וְעַצְמִי חָרָה מִנִּי חֹֽרֶב׃
translation: My skin grows black and peels from me. My bones are burned with heat. (Job 30:30)

text: פֶּחָם לְגֶחָלִים וְעֵצִים לְאֵשׁ וְאִישׁ מדונים מִדְיָנִים לְחַרְחַר רִֽיב׃
translation: As coals are to hot embers, and wood to fire, so is a contentious man to kindling strife. (Proverbs 26:21)

text: הִנֵּה בִּֽהְיוֹתוֹ תָמִים לֹא יֵֽעָשֶׂה לִמְלָאכָה אַף כִּי אֵשׁ אֲכָלַתְהוּ וַיֵּחָר וְנַעֲשָׂה עוֹד לִמְלָאכָֽה׃
translation: Behold, when it was whole, it was suitable for no work. How much less, when the fire has devoured it, and it has been burned, will it yet be suitable for any work?" (Ezekiel 15:5)

text: וְהָיָה כְּעַרְעָר בָּֽעֲרָבָה וְלֹא יִרְאֶה כִּי יָבוֹא טוֹב וְשָׁכַן חֲרֵרִים בַּמִּדְבָּר אֶרֶץ מְלֵחָה וְלֹא תֵשֵֽׁב׃
translation: For he will be like a bush in the desert, and will not see when good comes, but will inhabit the parched places in the wilderness, an uninhabited salt land. (Jeremiah 17:6)

text: עַל כֵּן אָלָה אָכְלָה אֶרֶץ וַֽיֶּאְשְׁמוּ יֹשְׁבֵי בָהּ עַל כֵּן חָרוּ יֹשְׁבֵי אֶרֶץ וְנִשְׁאַר אֱנוֹשׁ מִזְעָֽר׃
translation: Therefore the curse has devoured the earth, and those who dwell therein are found guilty. Therefore the inhabitants of the earth are burned, and few men are left. (Isaiah 24:6)

text: וְאָבוּס עַמִּים בְּאַפִּי וַאֲשַׁכְּרֵם בַּחֲמָתִי וְאוֹרִיד לָאָרֶץ נִצְחָֽם׃
translation: I trod down the peoples in my anger and made them drunk in my wrath. I poured their lifeblood out on the earth." (Isaiah 63:6)

text: בְּךָ צָרֵינוּ נְנַגֵּחַ בְּשִׁמְךָ נָבוּס קָמֵֽינוּ׃
translation: For I will not trust in my bow, neither will my sword save me. (Psalms 44:6)

text: לִשְׁבֹּר אַשּׁוּר בְּאַרְצִי וְעַל הָרַי אֲבוּסֶנּוּ וְסָר מֵֽעֲלֵיהֶם עֻלּוֹ וְסֻבֳּלוֹ מֵעַל שִׁכְמוֹ יָסֽוּר׃
translation: that I will break the Assyrian in my land, and tread him under foot on my mountains. Then his yoke will leave them, and his burden leave their shoulders. (Isaiah 14:25)

text: רֹעִים רַבִּים שִֽׁחֲתוּ כַרְמִי בֹּסְסוּ אֶת חֶלְקָתִי נָֽתְנוּ אֶת חֶלְקַת חֶמְדָּתִי לְמִדְבַּר שְׁמָמָֽה׃
translation: Many shepherds have destroyed my vineyard. They have trodden my portion under foot. They have made my pleasant portion a desolate wilderness. (Jeremiah 12:10)

text: וָאֶעֱבֹר עָלַיִךְ וָֽאֶרְאֵךְ מִתְבּוֹסֶסֶת בְּדָמָיִךְ וָאֹמַר לָךְ בְּדָמַיִךְ חֲיִי וָאֹמַר לָךְ בְּדָמַיִךְ חֲיִֽי׃
translation: "'"When I passed by you, and saw you wallowing in your blood, I said to you, 'Though you are in your blood, live!' Yes, I said to you, 'Though you are in your blood, live!' (Ezekiel 16:6)

text: וְהָיוּ כְגִבֹּרִים בּוֹסִים בְּטִיט חוּצוֹת בַּמִּלְחָמָה וְנִלְחֲמוּ כִּי יְהוָה עִמָּם וְהֹבִישׁוּ רֹכְבֵי סוּסִֽים׃
translation: They will be as mighty men, treading down muddy streets in the battle. They will fight, because the LORD is with them. The riders on horses will be confounded. (Zechariah 10:5)

text: כִּי לֹא לְעוֹלָם חֹסֶן וְאִם נֵזֶר לְדוֹר דור וָדֽוֹר׃
translation: for riches are not forever, nor does the crown endure to all generations. (Proverbs 27:24)

text: וְהָיָה הֶחָסֹן לִנְעֹרֶת וּפֹעֲלוֹ לְנִיצוֹץ וּבָעֲרוּ שְׁנֵיהֶם יַחְדָּו וְאֵין מְכַבֶּֽה׃
translation: The strong will be like tinder, and his work like a spark. They will both burn together, and no one will quench them." (Isaiah 1:31)

text: וְהָיָה אֱמוּנַת עִתֶּיךָ חֹסֶן יְשׁוּעֹת חָכְמַת וָדָעַת יִרְאַת יְהוָה הִיא אוֹצָרֽוֹ׃
translation: There will be stability in your times, abundance of salvation, wisdom, and knowledge. The fear of the LORD is your treasure. (Isaiah 33:6)

text: קֶשֶׁר נְבִיאֶיהָ בְּתוֹכָהּ כַּאֲרִי שׁוֹאֵג טֹרֵֽף טָרֶף נֶפֶשׁ אָכָלוּ חֹסֶן וִיקָר יִקָּחוּ אַלְמְנוֹתֶיהָ הִרְבּוּ בְתוֹכָֽהּ׃
translation: There is a conspiracy of her prophets within it, like a roaring lion ravening the prey. They have devoured souls. They take treasure and precious things. They have made many widows within it. (Ezekiel 22:25)

text: וְאָנֹכִי הִשְׁמַדְתִּי אֶת הָֽאֱמֹרִי מִפְּנֵיהֶם אֲשֶׁר כְּגֹבַהּ אֲרָזִים גָּבְהוֹ וְחָסֹן הוּא כָּֽאַלּוֹנִים וָאַשְׁמִיד פִּרְיוֹ מִמַּעַל וְשָׁרָשָׁיו מִתָּֽחַת׃
translation: Yet I destroyed the Amorite before them, whose height was like the height of the cedars, and he was strong as the oaks; yet I destroyed his fruit from above, and his roots from beneath. (Amos 2:9)

text: קִרְבֵת עַל חַד מִן קָאֲמַיָּא וְיַצִּיבָא אֶבְעֵֽא מִנֵּהּ עַֽל כָּל דְּנָה וַאֲמַר לִי וּפְשַׁר מִלַּיָּא יְהוֹדְעִנַּֽנִי׃
translation: I came near to one of those who stood by, and asked him the truth concerning all this. "So he told me, and made me know the interpretation of the things. (Daniel 7:16)

text: לָךְ אֱלָהּ אֲבָהָתִי מְהוֹדֵא וּמְשַׁבַּח אֲנָה דִּי חָכְמְתָא וּגְבוּרְתָא יְהַבְתְּ לִי וּכְעַן הֽוֹדַעְתַּנִי דִּֽי בְעֵינָא מִנָּךְ דִּֽי מִלַּת מַלְכָּא הוֹדַעְתֶּֽנָא׃
translation: I thank you and praise you, O God of my fathers, who have given me wisdom and might, and have now made known to me what we desired of you; for you have made known to us the king's matter." (Daniel 2:23)

text: וַיִּמְצָא אִישׁ אַחֵר וַיֹּאמֶר הַכֵּינִי נָא וַיַּכֵּהוּ הָאִישׁ הַכֵּה וּפָצֹֽעַ׃
translation: Then he found another man, and said, "Please strike me." The man struck him and wounded him. (1 Kings 20:37)

text: אֲשֶׁר בִּשְׂעָרָה יְשׁוּפֵנִי וְהִרְבָּה פְצָעַי חִנָּֽם׃
translation: For he breaks me with a storm, and multiplies my wounds without cause. (Job 9:17)

text: נֶאֱמָנִים פִּצְעֵי אוֹהֵב וְנַעְתָּרוֹת נְשִׁיקוֹת שׂוֹנֵֽא׃
translation: The wounds of a friend are faithful, although the kisses of an enemy are profuse. (Proverbs 27:6)

text: מְצָאֻנִי הַשֹּׁמְרִים הַסֹּבְבִים בָּעִיר הִכּוּנִי פְצָעוּנִי נָשְׂאוּ אֶת רְדִידִי מֵֽעָלַי שֹׁמְרֵי הַחֹמֽוֹת׃
translation: The watchmen who go about the city found me. They beat me. They bruised me. The keepers of the walls took my cloak away from me. (Song of Solomon 5:7)

text: לְמִי אוֹי לְמִי אֲבוֹי לְמִי מדונים מִדְיָנִים לְמִי שִׂיחַ לְמִי פְּצָעִים חִנָּם לְמִי חַכְלִלוּת עֵינָֽיִם׃
translation: Who has woe? Who has sorrow? Who has strife? Who has complaints? Who has needless bruises? Who has bloodshot eyes? (Proverbs 23:29)

text: נָתִיב לֹֽא יְדָעוֹ עָיִט וְלֹא שְׁזָפַתּוּ עֵין אַיָּֽה׃
translation: That path no bird of prey knows, neither has the falcon's eye seen it. (Job 28:7)

text: וַיֵּרֶד הָעַיִט עַל הַפְּגָרִים וַיַּשֵּׁב אֹתָם אַבְרָֽם׃
translation: The birds of prey came down on the carcasses, and Abram drove them away. (Genesis 15:11)

text: וְלָמָּה לֹא שָׁמַעְתָּ בְּקוֹל יְהוָה וַתַּעַט אֶל הַשָּׁלָל וַתַּעַשׂ הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהוָֽה׃
translation: Why then didn't you obey the LORD's voice, but took the plunder, and did that which was evil in the LORD's sight?" (1 Samuel 15:19)

text: יֵעָזְבוּ יַחְדָּו לְעֵיט הָרִים וּֽלְבֶהֱמַת הָאָרֶץ וְקָץ עָלָיו הָעַיִט וְכָל בֶּהֱמַת הָאָרֶץ עָלָיו תֶּחֱרָֽף׃
translation: They will be left together for the ravenous birds of the mountains, and for the animals of the earth. The ravenous birds will eat them in the summer, and all the animals of the earth will eat them in the winter. (Isaiah 18:6)

text: הַעַיִט צָבוּעַ נַחֲלָתִי לִי הַעַיִט סָבִיב עָלֶיהָ לְכוּ אִסְפוּ כָּל חַיַּת הַשָּׂדֶה הֵתָיוּ לְאָכְלָֽה׃
translation: Is my heritage to me as a speckled bird of prey? Are the birds of prey against her all around? Go, assemble all the animals of the field. Bring them to devour. (Jeremiah 12:9)

text: קֹרֵא מִמִּזְרָח עַיִט מֵאֶרֶץ מֶרְחָק אִישׁ עצתו עֲצָתִי אַף דִּבַּרְתִּי אַף אֲבִיאֶנָּה יָצַרְתִּי אַף אֶעֱשֶֽׂנָּה׃
translation: I call a ravenous bird from the east, the man of my counsel from a far country. Yes, I have spoken. I will also bring it to pass. I have planned. I will also do it. (Isaiah 46:11)

text: מִֽי שִׁלַּח פֶּרֶא חָפְשִׁי וּמֹסְרוֹת עָרוֹד מִי פִתֵּֽחַ׃
translation: "Who has set the wild donkey free? Or who has loosened the bonds of the swift donkey, (Job 39:5)

text: הֲיִֽנְהַק פֶּרֶא עֲלֵי דֶשֶׁא אִם יִגְעֶה שּׁוֹר עַל בְּלִילֽוֹ׃
translation: Does the wild donkey bray when he has grass? Or does the ox low over his fodder? (Job 6:5)

text: וְאִישׁ נָבוּב יִלָּבֵב וְעַיִר פֶּרֶא אָדָם יִוָּלֵֽד׃
translation: An empty-headed man becomes wise when a man is born as a wild donkey's colt. (Job 11:12)

text: יַשְׁקוּ כָּל חַיְתוֹ שָׂדָי יִשְׁבְּרוּ פְרָאִים צְמָאָֽם׃
translation: They give drink to every animal of the field. The wild donkeys quench their thirst. (Psalms 104:11)

text: הֵן פְּרָאִים בַּֽמִּדְבָּר יָצְאוּ בְּפָעֳלָם מְשַׁחֲרֵי לַטָּרֶף עֲרָבָה לוֹ לֶחֶם לַנְּעָרִֽים׃
translation: Behold, as wild donkeys in the desert, they go out to their work, seeking diligently for food. The wilderness yields them bread for their children. (Job 24:5)

text: וּפְרָאִים עָמְדוּ עַל שְׁפָיִם שָׁאֲפוּ רוּחַ כַּתַּנִּים כָּלוּ עֵינֵיהֶם כִּי אֵין עֵֽשֶׂב׃
translation: The wild donkeys stand on the bare heights. They pant for air like jackals. Their eyes fail, because there is no vegetation. (Jeremiah 14:6)

text: וַיֵּרַע הַדָּבָר מְאֹד בְּעֵינֵי אַבְרָהָם עַל אוֹדֹת בְּנֽוֹ׃
translation: The thing was very grievous in Abraham's sight on account of his son. (Genesis 21:11)

text: וַיְהִי כִּֽי זָעֲקוּ בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל יְהוָה עַל אֹדוֹת מִדְיָֽן׃
translation: When the children of Israel cried to the LORD because of Midian, (Judges 6:7)

text: וְהוֹכִחַ אַבְרָהָם אֶת אֲבִימֶלֶךְ עַל אֹדוֹת בְּאֵר הַמַּיִם אֲשֶׁר גָּזְלוּ עַבְדֵי אֲבִימֶֽלֶךְ׃
translation: Abraham complained to Abimelech because of a water well, which Abimelech's servants had violently taken away. (Genesis 21:25)

text: לַמָּקוֹם הַהוּא קָרָא נַחַל אֶשְׁכּוֹל עַל אֹדוֹת הָֽאֶשְׁכּוֹל אֲשֶׁר כָּרְתוּ מִשָּׁם בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
translation: That place was called the valley of Eshcol, because of the cluster which the children of Israel cut down from there. (Numbers 13:24)

text: וַתְּדַבֵּר מִרְיָם וְאַהֲרֹן בְּמֹשֶׁה עַל אֹדוֹת הָאִשָּׁה הַכֻּשִׁית אֲשֶׁר לָקָח כִּֽי אִשָּׁה כֻשִׁית לָקָֽח׃
translation: Miriam and Aaron spoke against Moses because of the Cushite woman whom he had married; for he had married a Cushite woman. (Numbers 12:1)

text: וַתֹּאמֶר לוֹ אַל אוֹדֹת הָרָעָה הַגְּדוֹלָה הַזֹּאת מֵאַחֶרֶת אֲשֶׁר עָשִׂיתָ עִמִּי לְשַׁלְּחֵנִי וְלֹא אָבָה לִשְׁמֹעַֽ לָֽהּ׃
translation: She said to him, "Not so, because this great wrong in sending me away is worse than the other that you did to me!" But he would not listen to her. (2 Samuel 13:16)

text: בְּנֵי מְנַשֶּׁה אַשְׂרִיאֵל אֲשֶׁר יָלָדָה פִּֽילַגְשׁוֹ הָֽאֲרַמִּיָּה יָלְדָה אֶת מָכִיר אֲבִי גִלְעָֽד׃
translation: The sons of Manasseh: Asriel, whom his concubine the Aramitess bore. She bore Machir the father of Gilead. (1 Chronicles 7:14)

text: וַיִּגְנֹב יַעֲקֹב אֶת לֵב לָבָן הָאֲרַמִּי עַל בְּלִי הִגִּיד לוֹ כִּי בֹרֵחַ הֽוּא׃
translation: Jacob deceived Laban the Syrian, in that he didn't tell him that he was running away. (Genesis 31:20)

text: וַיֵּלֶךְ אֶת יוֹרָם בֶּן אַחְאָב לַמִּלְחָמָה עִם חֲזָהאֵל מֶֽלֶךְ אֲרָם בְּרָמֹת גִּלְעָד וַיַּכּוּ אֲרַמִּים אֶת יוֹרָֽם׃
translation: He went with Joram the son of Ahab to war against Hazael king of Syria at Ramoth Gilead, and the Syrians wounded Joram. (2 Kings 8:28)

text: וַיִּשְׁלַח יִצְחָק אֶֽת יַעֲקֹב וַיֵּלֶךְ פַּדֶּנָֽה אֲרָם אֶל לָבָן בֶּן בְּתוּאֵל הָֽאֲרַמִּי אֲחִי רִבְקָה אֵם יַעֲקֹב וְעֵשָֽׂו׃
translation: Isaac sent Jacob away. He went to Paddan Aram to Laban, son of Bethuel the Syrian, the brother of Rebekah, Jacob's and Esau's mother. (Genesis 28:5)

text: וַיְהִי יִצְחָק בֶּן אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה בְּקַחְתּוֹ אֶת רִבְקָה בַּת בְּתוּאֵל הָֽאֲרַמִּי מִפַּדַּן אֲרָם אֲחוֹת לָבָן הָאֲרַמִּי לוֹ לְאִשָּֽׁה׃
translation: Isaac was forty years old when he took Rebekah, the daughter of Bethuel the Syrian of Paddan Aram, the sister of Laban the Syrian, to be his wife. (Genesis 25:20)

text: וַיָּבֹא אֱלֹהִים אֶל לָבָן הָאֲרַמִּי בַּחֲלֹם הַלָּיְלָה וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ הִשָּׁמֶר לְךָ פֶּן תְּדַבֵּר עִֽם יַעֲקֹב מִטּוֹב עַד רָֽע׃
translation: God came to Laban the Syrian in a dream of the night, and said to him, "Be careful that you don't speak to Jacob either good or bad." (Genesis 31:24)

text: וְכָל הָעָם יִשְׁמְעוּ וְיִרָאוּ וְלֹא יְזִידוּן עֽוֹד׃
translation: All the people shall hear and fear, and do no more presumptuously. (Deuteronomy 17:13)

text: וְהֵם וַאֲבֹתֵינוּ הֵזִידוּ וַיַּקְשׁוּ אֶת עָרְפָּם וְלֹא שָׁמְעוּ אֶל מִצְוֺתֶֽיךָ׃
translation: "But they and our fathers behaved proudly, hardened their neck, didn't listen to your commandments, (Nehemiah 9:16)

text: וְכִֽי יָזִד אִישׁ עַל רֵעֵהוּ לְהָרְגוֹ בְעָרְמָה מֵעִם מִזְבְּחִי תִּקָּחֶנּוּ לָמֽוּת׃
translation: If a man schemes and comes presumptuously on his neighbor to kill him, you shall take him from my altar, that he may die. (Exodus 21:14)

text: וָאֲדַבֵּר אֲלֵיכֶם וְלֹא שְׁמַעְתֶּם וַתַּמְרוּ אֶת פִּי יְהוָה וַתָּזִדוּ וַתַּעֲלוּ הָהָֽרָה׃
translation: So I spoke to you, and you didn't listen; but you rebelled against the commandment of the LORD, and were presumptuous, and went up into the hill country. (Deuteronomy 1:43)

text: עַתָּה יָדַעְתִּי כִּֽי גָדוֹל יְהוָה מִכָּל הָאֱלֹהִים כִּי בַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר זָדוּ עֲלֵיהֶֽם׃
translation: Now I know that the LORD is greater than all gods because of the way that they treated people arrogantly." (Exodus 18:11)

text: וַתִּתֵּן אֹתֹת וּמֹֽפְתִים בְּפַרְעֹה וּבְכָל עֲבָדָיו וּבְכָל עַם אַרְצוֹ כִּי יָדַעְתָּ כִּי הֵזִידוּ עֲלֵיהֶם וַתַּֽעַשׂ לְךָ שֵׁם כְּהַיּוֹם הַזֶּֽה׃
translation: and showed signs and wonders against Pharaoh, against all his servants, and against all the people of his land, for you knew that they dealt proudly against them, and made a name for yourself, as it is today. (Nehemiah 9:10)

text: חֶרְדַּת אָדָם יִתֵּן מוֹקֵשׁ וּבוֹטֵחַ בַּיהוָה יְשֻׂגָּֽב׃
translation: The fear of man proves to be a snare, but whoever puts his trust in the LORD is kept safe. (Proverbs 29:25)

text: תָּעָה לְבָבִי פַּלָּצוּת בִּֽעֲתָתְנִי אֵת נֶשֶׁף חִשְׁקִי שָׂם לִי לַחֲרָדָֽה׃
translation: My heart flutters. Horror has frightened me. The twilight that I desired has been turned into trembling for me. (Isaiah 21:4)

text: כִּי כֹה אָמַר יְהוָה קוֹל חֲרָדָה שָׁמָעְנוּ פַּחַד וְאֵין שָׁלֽוֹם׃
translation: For the LORD says: "We have heard a voice of trembling; a voice of fear, and not of peace. (Jeremiah 30:5)

text: וַיִּסְעוּ מֵֽהַר שָׁפֶר וַֽיַּחֲנוּ בַּחֲרָדָֽה׃
translation: They traveled from Mount Shepher, and encamped in Haradah. (Numbers 33:24)

text: וַיִּסְעוּ מֵחֲרָדָה וַֽיַּחֲנוּ בְּמַקְהֵלֹֽת׃
translation: They traveled from Haradah, and encamped in Makheloth. (Numbers 33:25)

text: וַתְּהִי חֲרָדָה בַמַּחֲנֶה בַשָּׂדֶה וּבְכָל הָעָם הַמַּצָּב וְהַמַּשְׁחִית חָרְדוּ גַּם הֵמָּה וַתִּרְגַּז הָאָרֶץ וַתְּהִי לְחֶרְדַּת אֱלֹהִֽים׃
translation: There was a trembling in the camp, in the field, and among all the people; the garrison and the raiders also trembled; and the earth quaked, so there was an exceedingly great trembling. (1 Samuel 14:15)

text: הֲטוֹב כִּֽי יַחְקֹר אֶתְכֶם אִם כְּהָתֵל בֶּאֱנוֹשׁ תְּהָתֵלּוּ בֽוֹ׃
translation: Is it good that he should search you out? Or as one deceives a man, will you deceive him? (Job 13:9)

text: אִם לֹא הֲתֻלִים עִמָּדִי וּבְהַמְּרוֹתָם תָּלַן עֵינִֽי׃
translation: Surely there are mockers with me. My eye dwells on their provocation. (Job 17:2)

text: וְאִישׁ בְּרֵעֵהוּ יְהָתֵלּוּ וֶאֱמֶת לֹא יְדַבֵּרוּ לִמְּדוּ לְשׁוֹנָם דַּבֶּר שֶׁקֶר הַעֲוֵה נִלְאֽוּ׃
translation: "Everyone beware of his neighbor, and don't trust in any brother; for every brother will utterly supplant, and every neighbor will go around like a slanderer. (Jeremiah 9:4)

text: וַאֲבִיכֶן הֵתֶל בִּי וְהֶחֱלִף אֶת מַשְׂכֻּרְתִּי עֲשֶׂרֶת מֹנִים וְלֹֽא נְתָנוֹ אֱלֹהִים לְהָרַע עִמָּדִֽי׃
translation: Your father has deceived me, and changed my wages ten times, but God didn't allow him to hurt me. (Genesis 31:7)

text: רֹעֶה אֵפֶר לֵב הוּתַל הִטָּהוּ וְלֹֽא יַצִּיל אֶת נַפְשׁוֹ וְלֹא יֹאמַר הֲלוֹא שֶׁקֶר בִּימִינִֽי׃
translation: He feeds on ashes. A deceived heart has turned him aside; and he can't deliver his soul, nor say, "Isn't there a lie in my right hand?" (Isaiah 44:20)

text: וַתֹּאמֶר דְּלִילָה אֶל שִׁמְשׁוֹן הִנֵּה הֵתַלְתָּ בִּי וַתְּדַבֵּר אֵלַי כְּזָבִים עַתָּה הַגִּֽידָה נָּא לִי בַּמֶּה תֵּאָסֵֽר׃
translation: Delilah said to Samson, "Behold, you have mocked me, and told me lies. Now please tell me how you might be bound." (Judges 16:10)

text: וְהַמַּעְבָּרוֹת נִתְפָּשׂוּ וְאֶת הָאֲגַמִּים שָׂרְפוּ בָאֵשׁ וְאַנְשֵׁי הַמִּלְחָמָה נִבְהָֽלוּ׃
translation: So the passages are seized. They have burned the reeds with fire. The men of war are frightened." (Jeremiah 51:32)

text: וְהָיָה כְעוֹף נוֹדֵד קֵן מְשֻׁלָּח תִּֽהְיֶינָה בְּנוֹת מוֹאָב מַעְבָּרֹת לְאַרְנֽוֹן׃
translation: For it will be that as wandering birds, as a scattered nest, so will the daughters of Moab be at the fords of the Arnon. (Isaiah 16:2)

text: וְהָאֲנָשִׁים רָדְפוּ אַֽחֲרֵיהֶם דֶּרֶךְ הַיַּרְדֵּן עַל הַֽמַּעְבְּרוֹת וְהַשַּׁעַר סָגָרוּ אַחֲרֵי כַּאֲשֶׁר יָצְאוּ הָרֹדְפִים אַחֲרֵיהֶֽם׃
translation: The men pursued them along the way to the fords of the Jordan River. As soon as those who pursued them had gone out, they shut the gate. (Joshua 2:7)

text: וְהָיָה כֹּל מַֽעֲבַר מַטֵּה מֽוּסָדָה אֲשֶׁר יָנִיחַ יְהוָה עָלָיו בְּתֻפִּים וּבְכִנֹּרוֹת וּבְמִלְחֲמוֹת תְּנוּפָה נִלְחַם בה בָּֽם׃
translation: Every stroke of the rod of punishment, which the LORD will lay on him, will be with the sound of tambourines and harps. He will fight with them in battles, brandishing weapons. (Isaiah 30:32)

text: וַיָּקָם בַּלַּיְלָה הוּא וַיִּקַּח אֶת שְׁתֵּי נָשָׁיו וְאֶת שְׁתֵּי שִׁפְחֹתָיו וְאֶת אַחַד עָשָׂר יְלָדָיו וַֽיַּעֲבֹר אֵת מַעֲבַר יַבֹּֽק׃
translation: He took them, and sent them over the stream, and sent over that which he had. (Genesis 32:23)

text: וַיִּלְכֹּד גִּלְעָד אֶֽת מַעְבְּרוֹת הַיַּרְדֵּן לְאֶפְרָיִם וְֽהָיָה כִּי יֹאמְרוּ פְּלִיטֵי אֶפְרַיִם אֶעֱבֹרָה וַיֹּאמְרוּ לוֹ אַנְשֵֽׁי גִלְעָד הַֽאֶפְרָתִי אַתָּה וַיֹּאמֶֽר לֹֽא׃
translation: The Gileadites took the fords of the Jordan against the Ephraimites. Whenever a fugitive of Ephraim said, "Let me go over," the men of Gilead said to him, "Are you an Ephraimite?" If he said, "No;" (Judges 12:5)

text: וַיָּבֵיא אוֹתִי שָׁמָּה וְהִנֵּה אִישׁ מַרְאֵהוּ כְּמַרְאֵה נְחֹשֶׁת וּפְתִיל פִּשְׁתִּים בְּיָדוֹ וּקְנֵה הַמִּדָּה וְהוּא עֹמֵד בַּשָּֽׁעַר׃
translation: He brought me there; and, behold, there was a man whose appearance was like the appearance of bronze, with a line of flax in his hand and a measuring reed; and he stood in the gate. (Ezekiel 40:3)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר מָה הָֽעֵרָבוֹן אֲשֶׁר אֶתֶּן לָּךְ וַתֹּאמֶר חֹתָֽמְךָ וּפְתִילֶךָ וּמַטְּךָ אֲשֶׁר בְּיָדֶךָ וַיִּתֶּן לָּהּ וַיָּבֹא אֵלֶיהָ וַתַּהַר לֽוֹ׃
translation: He said, "What pledge will I give you?" She said, "Your signet and your cord, and your staff that is in your hand." He gave them to her, and came in to her, and she conceived by him. (Genesis 38:18)

text: וַֽיְרַקְּעוּ אֶת פַּחֵי הַזָּהָב וְקִצֵּץ פְּתִילִם לַעֲשׂוֹת בְּתוֹךְ הַתְּכֵלֶת וּבְתוֹךְ הָֽאַרְגָּמָן וּבְתוֹךְ תּוֹלַעַת הַשָּׁנִי וּבְתוֹךְ הַשֵּׁשׁ מַעֲשֵׂה חֹשֵֽׁב׃
translation: They beat the gold into thin plates, and cut it into wires, to work it in with the blue, the purple, the scarlet, and the fine linen, the work of the skillful workman. (Exodus 39:3)

text: וְיִרְכְּסוּ אֶת הַחֹשֶׁן מטבעתו מִֽטַּבְּעֹתָיו אֶל טַבְּעֹת הָאֵפֹד בִּפְתִיל תְּכֵלֶת לִֽהְיוֹת עַל חֵשֶׁב הָאֵפוֹד וְלֹֽא יִזַּח הַחֹשֶׁן מֵעַל הָאֵפֽוֹד׃
translation: They shall bind the breastplate by its rings to the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue, that it may be on the skillfully woven band of the ephod, and that the breastplate may not swing out from the ephod. (Exodus 28:28)

text: דַּבֵּר אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵהֶם וְעָשׂוּ לָהֶם צִיצִת עַל כַּנְפֵי בִגְדֵיהֶם לְדֹרֹתָם וְנָֽתְנוּ עַל צִיצִת הַכָּנָף פְּתִיל תְּכֵֽלֶת׃
translation: "Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them that they should make themselves fringes on the borders of their garments throughout their generations, and that they put on the fringe of each border a cord of blue. (Numbers 15:38)

text: אִם אֲקַוֶּה שְׁאוֹל בֵּיתִי בַּחֹשֶׁךְ רִפַּדְתִּי יְצוּעָֽי׃
translation: If I look for Sheol as my house, if I have spread my couch in the darkness, (Job 17:13)

text: אִם אָבֹא בְּאֹהֶל בֵּיתִי אִם אֶעֱלֶה עַל עֶרֶשׂ יְצוּעָֽי׃
translation: "Surely I will not come into the structure of my house, nor go up into my bed; (Psalms 132:3)

text: פַּחַז כַּמַּיִם אַל תּוֹתַר כִּי עָלִיתָ מִשְׁכְּבֵי אָבִיךָ אָז חִלַּלְתָּ יְצוּעִי עָלָֽה׃
translation: Boiling over like water, you shall not excel, because you went up to your father's bed, then defiled it. He went up to my couch. (Genesis 49:4)

text: וַיִּבֶן אֶת היצוע הַיָּצִיעַ עַל כָּל הַבַּיִת חָמֵשׁ אַמּוֹת קֽוֹמָתוֹ וַיֶּאֱחֹז אֶת הַבַּיִת בַּעֲצֵי אֲרָזִֽים׃
translation: He built the floors all along the house, each five cubits high; and they rested on the house with timbers of cedar. (1 Kings 6:10)

text: וַיִּבֶן עַל קִיר הַבַּיִת יצוע יָצִיעַ סָבִיב אֶת קִירוֹת הַבַּיִת סָבִיב לַֽהֵיכָל וְלַדְּבִיר וַיַּעַשׂ צְלָעוֹת סָבִֽיב׃
translation: Against the wall of the house, he built floors all around, against the walls of the house all around, both of the temple and of the inner sanctuary; and he made side rooms all around. (1 Kings 6:5)

text: וּבְנֵי רְאוּבֵן בְּכֽוֹר יִשְׂרָאֵל כִּי הוּא הַבְּכוֹר וּֽבְחַלְּלוֹ יְצוּעֵי אָבִיו נִתְּנָה בְּכֹרָתוֹ לִבְנֵי יוֹסֵף בֶּן יִשְׂרָאֵל וְלֹא לְהִתְיַחֵשׂ לַבְּכֹרָֽה׃
translation: The sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel (for he was the firstborn, but because he defiled his father's couch, his birthright was given to the sons of Joseph the son of Israel; and the genealogy is not to be listed according to the birthright. (1 Chronicles 5:1)

text: וְשִׂפַּח אֲדֹנָי קָדְקֹד בְּנוֹת צִיּוֹן וַיהוָה פָּתְהֵן יְעָרֶֽה׃
translation: therefore the Lord brings sores on the crown of the head of the women of Zion, and the LORD will make their scalps bald." (Isaiah 3:17)

text: יָשׁוּב עֲמָלוֹ בְרֹאשׁוֹ וְעַל קָדְקֳדוֹ חֲמָסוֹ יֵרֵֽד׃
translation: I will give thanks to the LORD according to his righteousness, and will sing praise to the name of the LORD Most High. (Psalms 7:17)

text: אַךְ אֱלֹהִים יִמְחַץ רֹאשׁ אֹיְבָיו קָדְקֹד שֵׂעָר מִתְהַלֵּךְ בַּאֲשָׁמָֽיו׃
translation: The Lord said, "I will bring you again from Bashan, I will bring you again from the depths of the sea, (Psalms 68:22)

text: גַּם בְּנֵי נֹף ותחפנס וְתַחְפַּנְחֵס יִרְעוּךְ קָדְקֹֽד׃
translation: The children also of Memphis and Tahpanhes have broken the crown of your head. (Jeremiah 2:16)

text: וּלְגָד אָמַר בָּרוּךְ מַרְחִיב גָּד כְּלָבִיא שָׁכֵן וְטָרַף זְרוֹעַ אַף קָדְקֹֽד׃
translation: About Gad he said, "He who enlarges Gad is blessed. He dwells as a lioness, and tears the arm and the crown of the head. (Deuteronomy 33:20)

text: וַיֵּצֵא הַשָּׂטָן מֵאֵת פְּנֵי יְהוָה וַיַּךְ אֶת אִיּוֹב בִּשְׁחִין רָע מִכַּף רַגְלוֹ עד וְעַד קָדְקֳדֽוֹ׃
translation: So Satan went out from the presence of the LORD, and struck Job with painful sores from the sole of his foot to his head. (Job 2:7)

text: עֵינֵי יְהוָה אֶל צַדִּיקִים וְאָזְנָיו אֶל שַׁוְעָתָֽם׃
translation: The LORD's face is against those who do evil, to cut off their memory from the earth. (Psalms 34:16)

text: קַוֺּה קִוִּיתִי יְהוָה וַיֵּט אֵלַי וַיִּשְׁמַע שַׁוְעָתִֽי׃
translation: He brought me up also out of a horrible pit, out of the miry clay. He set my feet on a rock, and gave me a firm place to stand. (Psalms 40:2)

text: רְצוֹן יְרֵאָיו יַעֲשֶׂה וְֽאֶת שַׁוְעָתָם יִשְׁמַע וְיוֹשִׁיעֵֽם׃
translation: He will fulfill the desire of those who fear him. He also will hear their cry, and will save them. (Psalms 145:19)

text: קוֹלִי שָׁמָעְתָּ אַל תַּעְלֵם אָזְנְךָ לְרַוְחָתִי לְשַׁוְעָתִֽי׃
translation: You heard my voice: "Don't hide your ear from my sighing, and my cry." (Lamentations 3:56)

text: יְהוָה שִׁמְעָה תְפִלָּתִי וְשַׁוְעָתִי אֵלֶיךָ תָבֽוֹא׃
translation: Don't hide your face from me in the day of my distress. Turn your ear to me. Answer me quickly in the day when I call. (Psalms 102:2)

text: בַּצַּר לִי אֶקְרָא יְהוָה וְאֶל אֱלֹהַי אֶקְרָא וַיִּשְׁמַע מֵהֵֽיכָלוֹ קוֹלִי וְשַׁוְעָתִי בְּאָזְנָֽיו׃
translation: In my distress, I called on the LORD. Yes, I called to my God. He heard my voice out of his temple. My cry came into his ears. (2 Samuel 22:7)

text: כִּי נִמְצְאוּ בְעַמִּי רְשָׁעִים יָשׁוּר כְּשַׁךְ יְקוּשִׁים הִצִּיבוּ מַשְׁחִית אֲנָשִׁים יִלְכֹּֽדוּ׃
translation: For wicked men are found among my people. They watch, as fowlers lie in wait. They set a trap. They catch men. (Jeremiah 5:26)

text: כֹּה אָמַר אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה יַעַן עֲשׂוֹת פְּלִשְׁתִּים בִּנְקָמָה וַיִּנָּקְמוּ נָקָם בִּשְׁאָט בְּנֶפֶשׁ לְמַשְׁחִית אֵיבַת עוֹלָֽם׃
translation: "'The Lord GOD says: "Because the Philistines have taken revenge, and have taken vengeance with contempt of soul to destroy with perpetual hostility," (Ezekiel 25:15)

text: וַיַּעַשׂ הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהוָה כְּבֵית אַחְאָב כִּי הֵמָּה הָֽיוּ לוֹ יֽוֹעֲצִים אַחֲרֵי מוֹת אָבִיו לְמַשְׁחִית לֽוֹ׃
translation: He did that which was evil in the LORD's sight, as did Ahab's house, for they were his counselors after the death of his father, to his destruction. (2 Chronicles 22:4)

text: וַיַּֽעַמְדוּ בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן וּמוֹאָב עַל יֹשְׁבֵי הַר שֵׂעִיר לְהַחֲרִים וּלְהַשְׁמִיד וּכְכַלּוֹתָם בְּיוֹשְׁבֵי שֵׂעִיר עָזְרוּ אִישׁ בְּרֵעֵהוּ לְמַשְׁחִֽית׃
translation: For the children of Ammon and Moab stood up against the inhabitants of Mount Seir to utterly kill and destroy them. When they had finished the inhabitants of Seir, everyone helped to destroy each other. (2 Chronicles 20:23)

text: וַאֲנִי נִשְׁאַרְתִּי לְבַדִּי וָֽאֶרְאֶה אֶת הַמַּרְאָה הַגְּדֹלָה הַזֹּאת וְלֹא נִשְׁאַר בִּי כֹּח וְהוֹדִי נֶהְפַּךְ עָלַי לְמַשְׁחִית וְלֹא עָצַרְתִּי כֹּֽחַ׃
translation: So I was left alone and saw this great vision. No strength remained in me; for my face grew deathly pale, and I retained no strength. (Daniel 10:8)

text: הִנְנִי אֵלֶיךָ הַר הַמַּשְׁחִית נְאֻם יְהוָה הַמַּשְׁחִית אֶת כָּל הָאָרֶץ וְנָטִיתִי אֶת יָדִי עָלֶיךָ וְגִלְגַּלְתִּיךָ מִן הַסְּלָעִים וּנְתַתִּיךָ לְהַר שְׂרֵפָֽה׃
translation: "Behold, I am against you, destroying mountain," says the LORD, "which destroys all the earth. I will stretch out my hand on you, roll you down from the rocks, and will make you a burned mountain. (Jeremiah 51:25)

text: אָמַר אֲדֹנָי מִבָּשָׁן אָשִׁיב אָשִׁיב מִֽמְּצֻלוֹת יָֽם׃
translation: that you may crush them, dipping your foot in blood, that the tongues of your dogs may have their portion from your enemies." (Psalms 68:23)

text: יָשׁוּב יְרַֽחֲמֵנוּ יִכְבֹּשׁ עֲוֺֽנֹתֵינוּ וְתַשְׁלִיךְ בִּמְצֻלוֹת יָם כָּל חַטֹּאותָֽם׃
translation: He will again have compassion on us. He will tread our iniquities under foot. You will cast all their sins into the depths of the sea. (Micah 7:19)

text: תְּהֹמֹת יְכַסְיֻמוּ יָרְדוּ בִמְצוֹלֹת כְּמוֹ אָֽבֶן׃
translation: The deeps cover them. They went down into the depths like a stone. (Exodus 15:5)

text: יַרְתִּיחַ כַּסִּיר מְצוּלָה יָם יָשִׂים כַּמֶּרְקָחָֽה׃
translation: The flakes of his flesh are joined together. They are firm on him. They can't be moved. (Job 41:23)

text: הֵמָּה רָאוּ מַעֲשֵׂי יְהוָה וְנִפְלְאוֹתָיו בִּמְצוּלָֽה׃
translation: these see the LORD's deeds, and his wonders in the deep. (Psalms 107:24)

text: אַל תִּשְׁטְפֵנִי שִׁבֹּלֶת מַיִם וְאַל תִּבְלָעֵנִי מְצוּלָה וְאַל תֶּאְטַר עָלַי בְּאֵר פִּֽיהָ׃
translation: Answer me, LORD, for your loving kindness is good. According to the multitude of your tender mercies, turn to me. (Psalms 69:16)

text: נָשַׁפְתָּ בְרוּחֲךָ כִּסָּמוֹ יָם צָֽלֲלוּ כַּֽעוֹפֶרֶת בְּמַיִם אַדִּירִֽים׃
translation: You blew with your wind. The sea covered them. They sank like lead in the mighty waters. (Exodus 15:10)

text: יְסֻכֻּהוּ צֶאֱלִים צִֽלֲלוֹ יְסֻבּוּהוּ עַרְבֵי נָֽחַל׃
translation: The lotuses cover him with their shade. The willows of the brook surround him. (Job 40:22)

text: עַד שֶׁיָּפוּחַ הַיּוֹם וְנָסוּ הַצְּלָלִים אֵלֶךְ לִי אֶל הַר הַמּוֹר וְאֶל גִּבְעַת הַלְּבוֹנָֽה׃
translation: Until the day is cool, and the shadows flee away, I will go to the mountain of myrrh, to the hill of frankincense. (Song of Solomon 4:6)

text: הִנֵּה אַשּׁוּר אֶרֶז בַּלְּבָנוֹן יְפֵה עָנָף וְחֹרֶשׁ מֵצַל וּגְבַהּ קוֹמָה וּבֵין עֲבֹתִים הָיְתָה צַמַּרְתּֽוֹ׃
translation: Behold, the Assyrian was a cedar in Lebanon with beautiful branches, and with a forest-like shade, of high stature; and its top was among the thick boughs. (Ezekiel 31:3)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֶל שְׁמוּאֵל הִנֵּה אָנֹכִי עֹשֶׂה דָבָר בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר כָּל שֹׁמְעוֹ תְּצִלֶּינָה שְׁתֵּי אָזְנָֽיו׃
translation: The LORD said to Samuel, "Behold, I will do a thing in Israel at which both the ears of everyone who hears it will tingle. (1 Samuel 3:11)

text: קַדְּשׁוּ עָלֶיהָ מִלְחָמָה קוּמוּ וְנַעֲלֶה בַֽצָּהֳרָיִם אוֹי לָנוּ כִּי פָנָה הַיּוֹם כִּי יִנָּטוּ צִלְלֵי עָֽרֶב׃
translation: "Prepare war against her! Arise! Let's go up at noon. Woe to us! For the day declines, for the shadows of the evening are stretched out. (Jeremiah 6:4)

text: שַׁבַּת שַׁבָּתוֹן הִיא לָכֶם וְעִנִּיתֶם אֶת נַפְשֹׁתֵיכֶם חֻקַּת עוֹלָֽם׃
translation: It is a Sabbath of solemn rest to you, and you shall afflict your souls. It is a statute forever. (Leviticus 16:31)

text: וּבַשָּׁנָה הַשְּׁבִיעִת שַׁבַּת שַׁבָּתוֹן יִהְיֶה לָאָרֶץ שַׁבָּת לַיהוָה שָֽׂדְךָ לֹא תִזְרָע וְכַרְמְךָ לֹא תִזְמֹֽר׃
translation: but in the seventh year there shall be a Sabbath of solemn rest for the land, a Sabbath to the LORD. You shall not sow your field or prune your vineyard. (Leviticus 25:4)

text: אֵת סְפִיחַ קְצִֽירְךָ לֹא תִקְצוֹר וְאֶת עִנְּבֵי נְזִירֶךָ לֹא תִבְצֹר שְׁנַת שַׁבָּתוֹן יִהְיֶה לָאָֽרֶץ׃
translation: What grows of itself in your harvest you shall not reap, and you shall not gather the grapes of your undressed vine. It shall be a year of solemn rest for the land. (Leviticus 25:5)

text: שַׁבַּת שַׁבָּתוֹן הוּא לָכֶם וְעִנִּיתֶם אֶת נַפְשֹׁתֵיכֶם בְּתִשְׁעָה לַחֹדֶשׁ בָּעֶרֶב מֵעֶרֶב עַד עֶרֶב תִּשְׁבְּתוּ שַׁבַּתְּכֶֽם׃
translation: It shall be a Sabbath of solemn rest for you, and you shall deny yourselves. In the ninth day of the month at evening, from evening to evening, you shall keep your Sabbath." (Leviticus 23:32)

text: דַּבֵּר אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר בַּחֹדֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִי בְּאֶחָד לַחֹדֶשׁ יִהְיֶה לָכֶם שַׁבָּתוֹן זִכְרוֹן תְּרוּעָה מִקְרָא קֹֽדֶשׁ׃
translation: "Speak to the children of Israel, saying, 'In the seventh month, on the first day of the month, there shall be a solemn rest for you, a memorial of blowing of trumpets, a holy convocation. (Leviticus 23:24)

text: שֵׁשֶׁת יָמִים יֵעָשֶׂה מְלָאכָה וּבַיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי שַׁבַּת שַׁבָּתוֹן קֹדֶשׁ לַיהוָה כָּל הָעֹשֶׂה מְלָאכָה בְּיוֹם הַשַּׁבָּת מוֹת יוּמָֽת׃
translation: Six days shall work be done, but on the seventh day is a Sabbath of solemn rest, holy to the LORD. Whoever does any work on the Sabbath day shall surely be put to death. (Exodus 31:15)

text: וַיִּבֶן אֶת הֶחָצֵר הַפְּנִימִית שְׁלֹשָׁה טוּרֵי גָזִית וְטוּר כְּרֻתֹת אֲרָזִֽים׃
translation: He built the inner court with three courses of cut stone and a course of cedar beams. (1 Kings 6:36)

text: וּמִלְמַעְלָה אֲבָנִים יְקָרוֹת כְּמִדּוֹת גָּזִית וָאָֽרֶז׃
translation: Above were costly stones, even cut stone, according to measure, and cedar wood. (1 Kings 7:11)

text: גָּדַר דְּרָכַי בְּגָזִית נְתִיבֹתַי עִוָּֽה׃
translation: He has walled up my ways with cut stone. He has made my paths crooked. (Lamentations 3:9)

text: וְאִם מִזְבַּח אֲבָנִים תַּֽעֲשֶׂה לִּי לֹֽא תִבְנֶה אֶתְהֶן גָּזִית כִּי חַרְבְּךָ הֵנַפְתָּ עָלֶיהָ וַתְּחַֽלְלֶֽהָ׃
translation: If you make me an altar of stone, you shall not build it of cut stones; for if you lift up your tool on it, you have polluted it. (Exodus 20:25)

text: וְחָצֵר הַגְּדוֹלָה סָבִיב שְׁלֹשָׁה טוּרִים גָּזִית וְטוּר כְּרֻתֹת אֲרָזִים וְלַחֲצַר בֵּית יְהוָה הַפְּנִימִית וּלְאֻלָם הַבָּֽיִת׃
translation: The great court around had three courses of cut stone with a course of cedar beams, like the inner court of the LORD's house and the porch of the house. (1 Kings 7:12)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִיד לִכְנוֹס אֶת הַגֵּרִים אֲשֶׁר בְּאֶרֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיַּעֲמֵד חֹֽצְבִים לַחְצוֹב אַבְנֵי גָזִית לִבְנוֹת בֵּית הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃
translation: David gave orders to gather together the foreigners who were in the land of Israel; and he set masons to cut dressed stones to build God's house. (1 Chronicles 22:2)

text: וְאֵרַשְׂתִּיךְ לִי לְעוֹלָם וְאֵרַשְׂתִּיךְ לִי בְּצֶדֶק וּבְמִשְׁפָּט וּבְחֶסֶד וּֽבְרַחֲמִֽים׃
translation: It will happen in that day, that I will respond," says the LORD. "I will respond to the heavens, and they will respond to the earth; (Hosea 2:21)

text: כִּי בַשָּׂדֶה מְצָאָהּ צָעֲקָה הנער הַֽנַּעֲרָה הַמְאֹרָשָׂה וְאֵין מוֹשִׁיעַ לָֽהּ׃
translation: for he found her in the field, the pledged to be married lady cried, and there was no one to save her. (Deuteronomy 22:27)

text: וְאֵרַשְׂתִּיךְ לִי בֶּאֱמוּנָה וְיָדַעַתְּ אֶת יְהוָֽה׃
translation: and the earth will respond to the grain, and the new wine, and the oil; and they will respond to Jezreel. (Hosea 2:22)

text: כִּי יִהְיֶה נער נַעֲרָה בְתוּלָה מְאֹרָשָׂה לְאִישׁ וּמְצָאָהּ אִישׁ בָּעִיר וְשָׁכַב עִמָּֽהּ׃
translation: If there is a young lady who is a virgin pledged to be married to a husband, and a man finds her in the city, and lies with her, (Deuteronomy 22:23)

text: וְכִֽי יְפַתֶּה אִישׁ בְּתוּלָה אֲשֶׁר לֹא אֹרָשָׂה וְשָׁכַב עִמָּהּ מָהֹר יִמְהָרֶנָּה לּוֹ לְאִשָּֽׁה׃
translation: If its owner is with it, he shall not make it good. If it is a leased thing, it came for its lease. (Exodus 22:15)

text: כִּֽי יִמְצָא אִישׁ נער נַעֲרָה בְתוּלָה אֲשֶׁר לֹא אֹרָשָׂה וּתְפָשָׂהּ וְשָׁכַב עִמָּהּ וְנִמְצָֽאוּ׃
translation: If a man finds a lady who is a virgin, who is not pledged to be married, grabs her and lies with her, and they are found, (Deuteronomy 22:28)

text: מְלֵאָתְךָ וְדִמְעֲךָ לֹא תְאַחֵר בְּכוֹר בָּנֶיךָ תִּתֶּן לִּֽי׃
translation: "You shall not blaspheme God, nor curse a ruler of your people. (Exodus 22:28)

text: וְנֶחְשַׁב לָכֶם תְּרוּמַתְכֶם כַּדָּגָן מִן הַגֹּרֶן וְכַֽמְלֵאָה מִן הַיָּֽקֶב׃
translation: Your wave offering shall be credited to you, as though it were the grain of the threshing floor, and as the fullness of the wine press. (Numbers 18:27)

text: הִנֵּה אָנֹכִי מֵעִיק תַּחְתֵּיכֶם כַּאֲשֶׁר תָּעִיק הָעֲגָלָה הַֽמְלֵאָה לָהּ עָמִֽיר׃
translation: Behold, I will crush you in your place, as a cart crushes that is full of grain. (Amos 2:13)

text: הוֹי עִיר דָּמִים כֻּלָּהּ כַּחַשׁ פֶּרֶק מְלֵאָה לֹא יָמִישׁ טָֽרֶף׃
translation: Woe to the bloody city! It is all full of lies and robbery—no end to the prey. (Nahum 3:1)

text: לֹא תִזְרַע כַּרְמְךָ כִּלְאָיִם פֶּן תִּקְדַּשׁ הַֽמְלֵאָה הַזֶּרַע אֲשֶׁר תִּזְרָע וּתְבוּאַת הַכָּֽרֶם׃
translation: You shall not sow your vineyard with two kinds of seed, lest all the fruit be defiled, the seed which you have sown, and the increase of the vineyard. (Deuteronomy 22:9)

text: אֵיכָה הָיְתָה לְזוֹנָה קִרְיָה נֶאֱמָנָה מְלֵאֲתִי מִשְׁפָּט צֶדֶק יָלִין בָּהּ וְעַתָּה מְרַצְּחִֽים׃
translation: How the faithful city has become a prostitute! She was full of justice. Righteousness lodged in her, but now there are murderers. (Isaiah 1:21)

text: מְקוֹם סַפִּיר אֲבָנֶיהָ וְעַפְרֹת זָהָב לֽוֹ׃
translation: Sapphires come from its rocks. It has dust of gold. (Job 28:6)

text: יָדָיו גְּלִילֵי זָהָב מְמֻלָּאִים בַּתַּרְשִׁישׁ מֵעָיו עֶשֶׁת שֵׁן מְעֻלֶּפֶת סַפִּירִֽים׃
translation: His hands are like rings of gold set with beryl. His body is like ivory work overlaid with sapphires. (Song of Solomon 5:14)

text: וְהַטּוּר הַשֵּׁנִי נֹפֶךְ סַפִּיר וְיָהֲלֹֽם׃
translation: and the second row a turquoise, a sapphire, and an emerald; (Exodus 28:18)

text: וְהַטּוּר הַשֵּׁנִי נֹפֶךְ סַפִּיר וְיָהֲלֹֽם׃
translation: and the second row, a turquoise, a sapphire, and an emerald; (Exodus 39:11)

text: עֲנִיָּה סֹעֲרָה לֹא נֻחָמָה הִנֵּה אָנֹכִי מַרְבִּיץ בַּפּוּךְ אֲבָנַיִךְ וִיסַדְתִּיךְ בַּסַּפִּירִֽים׃
translation: "You afflicted, tossed with storms, and not comforted, behold, I will set your stones in beautiful colors, and lay your foundations with sapphires. (Isaiah 54:11)

text: וַיִּרְאוּ אֵת אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְתַחַת רַגְלָיו כְּמַעֲשֵׂה לִבְנַת הַסַּפִּיר וּכְעֶצֶם הַשָּׁמַיִם לָטֹֽהַר׃
translation: They saw the God of Israel. Under his feet was like a paved work of sapphire stone, like the skies for clearness. (Exodus 24:10)

text: וְהַבְּרִיחַ הַתִּיכֹן בְּתוֹךְ הַקְּרָשִׁים מַבְרִחַ מִן הַקָּצֶה אֶל הַקָּצֶֽה׃
translation: The middle bar in the middle of the boards shall pass through from end to end. (Exodus 26:28)

text: וַיַּעַשׂ אֶת הַבְּרִיחַ הַתִּיכֹן לִבְרֹחַ בְּתוֹךְ הַקְּרָשִׁים מִן הַקָּצֶה אֶל הַקָּצֶֽה׃
translation: He made the middle bar to pass through in the middle of the boards from the one end to the other. (Exodus 36:33)

text: וַיְהִי יְשַׁעְיָהוּ לֹא יָצָא העיר חָצֵר הַתִּֽיכֹנָה וּדְבַר יְהוָה הָיָה אֵלָיו לֵאמֹֽר׃
translation: Before Isaiah had gone out into the middle part of the city, the LORD's word came to him, saying, (2 Kings 20:4)

text: כִּי מְשֻׁלָּשׁוֹת הֵנָּה וְאֵין לָהֶן עַמּוּדִים כְּעַמּוּדֵי הַחֲצֵרוֹת עַל כֵּן נֶאֱצַל מֵהַתַּחְתּוֹנוֹת וּמֵהַתִּֽיכֹנוֹת מֵהָאָֽרֶץ׃
translation: For they were in three stories, and they didn't have pillars as the pillars of the courts. Therefore the uppermost was set back more than the lowest and the middle from the ground. (Ezekiel 42:6)

text: פֶּתַח הַצֵּלָע הַתִּיכֹנָה אֶל כֶּתֶף הַבַּיִת הַיְמָנִית וּבְלוּלִּים יַֽעֲלוּ עַל הַתִּיכֹנָה וּמִן הַתִּֽיכֹנָה אֶל הַשְּׁלִשִֽׁים׃
translation: The door for the middle side rooms was in the right side of the house. They went up by winding stairs into the middle floor, and out of the middle into the third. (1 Kings 6:8)
