text: כָּֽל דַּרְכֵי אִישׁ זַךְ בְּעֵינָיו וְתֹכֵן רוּחוֹת יְהוָֽה׃
translation: All the ways of a man are clean in his own eyes, but the LORD weighs the motives. (Proverbs 16:2)

text: זַךְ אֲנִי בְּֽלִי פָשַׁע חַף אָנֹכִי וְלֹא עָוֺן לִֽי׃
translation: 'I am clean, without disobedience. I am innocent, neither is there iniquity in me. (Job 33:9)

text: גַּם בְּמַעֲלָלָיו יִתְנַכֶּר נָעַר אִם זַךְ וְאִם יָשָׁר פָּעֳלֽוֹ׃
translation: Even a child makes himself known by his doings, whether his work is pure, and whether it is right. (Proverbs 20:11)

text: הֲפַכְפַּךְ דֶּרֶךְ אִישׁ וָזָר וְזַךְ יָשָׁר פָּעֳלֽוֹ׃
translation: The way of the guilty is devious, but the conduct of the innocent is upright. (Proverbs 21:8)

text: וַתֹּאמֶר זַךְ לִקְחִי וּבַר הָיִיתִי בְעֵינֶֽיךָ׃
translation: For you say, 'My doctrine is pure. I am clean in your eyes.' (Job 11:4)

text: עַל לֹא חָמָס בְּכַפָּי וּֽתְפִלָּתִי זַכָּֽה׃
translation: although there is no violence in my hands, and my prayer is pure. (Job 16:17)

text: ועת וְעַתָּה פִּתּוּחֶיהָ יָּחַד בְּכַשִּׁיל וְכֵֽילַפֹּת יַהֲלֹמֽוּן׃
translation: Now they break all its carved work down with hatchet and hammers. (Psalms 74:6)

text: וְעָשִׂיתָ צִּיץ זָהָב טָהוֹר וּפִתַּחְתָּ עָלָיו פִּתּוּחֵי חֹתָם קֹדֶשׁ לַֽיהוָֽה׃
translation: "You shall make a plate of pure gold, and engrave on it, like the engravings of a signet, 'HOLY TO THE LORD.' (Exodus 28:36)

text: וַֽיַּעֲשׂוּ אֶת אַבְנֵי הַשֹּׁהַם מֻֽסַבֹּת מִשְׁבְּצֹת זָהָב מְפֻתָּחֹת פִּתּוּחֵי חוֹתָם עַל שְׁמוֹת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
translation: They worked the onyx stones, enclosed in settings of gold, engraved with the engravings of a signet, according to the names of the children of Israel. (Exodus 39:6)

text: וְאֵת כָּל קִירוֹת הַבַּיִת מֵסַב קָלַע פִּתּוּחֵי מִקְלְעוֹת כְּרוּבִים וְתִֽמֹרֹת וּפְטוּרֵי צִצִּים מִלִּפְנִים וְלַחִיצֽוֹן׃
translation: He carved all the walls of the house around with carved figures of cherubim, palm trees, and open flowers, inside and outside. (1 Kings 6:29)

text: מַעֲשֵׂה חָרַשׁ אֶבֶן פִּתּוּחֵי חֹתָם תְּפַתַּח אֶת שְׁתֵּי הָאֲבָנִים עַל שְׁמֹת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מֻסַבֹּת מִשְׁבְּצוֹת זָהָב תַּעֲשֶׂה אֹתָֽם׃
translation: With the work of an engraver in stone, like the engravings of a signet, you shall engrave the two stones, according to the names of the children of Israel. You shall make them to be enclosed in settings of gold. (Exodus 28:11)

text: וְהָאֲבָנִים עַל שְׁמֹת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הֵנָּה שְׁתֵּים עֶשְׂרֵה עַל שְׁמֹתָם פִּתּוּחֵי חֹתָם אִישׁ עַל שְׁמוֹ לִשְׁנֵים עָשָׂר שָֽׁבֶט׃
translation: The stones were according to the names of the children of Israel, twelve, according to their names; like the engravings of a signet, everyone according to his name, for the twelve tribes. (Exodus 39:14)

text: וְגַם אֲנִי חָשַׂפְתִּי שׁוּלַיִךְ עַל פָּנָיִךְ וְנִרְאָה קְלוֹנֵֽךְ׃
translation: Therefore I will also uncover your skirts on your face, and your shame will appear. (Jeremiah 13:26)

text: וַֽיַּעֲשׂוּ עַל שׁוּלֵי הַמְּעִיל רִמּוֹנֵי תְּכֵלֶת וְאַרְגָּמָן וְתוֹלַעַת שָׁנִי מָשְׁזָֽר׃
translation: They made on the skirts of the robe pomegranates of blue, purple, scarlet, and twined linen. (Exodus 39:24)

text: וְכִי תֹאמְרִי בִּלְבָבֵךְ מַדּוּעַ קְרָאֻנִי אֵלֶּה בְּרֹב עֲוֺנֵךְ נִגְלוּ שׁוּלַיִךְ נֶחְמְסוּ עֲקֵבָֽיִךְ׃
translation: If you say in your heart, "Why have these things come on me?" Your skirts are uncovered because of the greatness of your iniquity, and your heels suffer violence. (Jeremiah 13:22)

text: הִנְנִי אֵלַיִךְ נְאֻם יְהוָה צְבָאוֹת וְגִלֵּיתִי שׁוּלַיִךְ עַל פָּנָיִךְ וְהַרְאֵיתִי גוֹיִם מַעְרֵךְ וּמַמְלָכוֹת קְלוֹנֵֽךְ׃
translation: "Behold, I am against you," says the LORD of Armies, "and I will lift your skirts over your face. I will show the nations your nakedness, and the kingdoms your shame. (Nahum 3:5)

text: בִּשְׁנַת מוֹת הַמֶּלֶךְ עֻזִּיָּהוּ וָאֶרְאֶה אֶת אֲדֹנָי יֹשֵׁב עַל כִּסֵּא רָם וְנִשָּׂא וְשׁוּלָיו מְלֵאִים אֶת הַהֵיכָֽל׃
translation: In the year that King Uzziah died, I saw the Lord sitting on a throne, high and lifted up; and his train filled the temple. (Isaiah 6:1)

text: טֻמְאָתָהּ בְּשׁוּלֶיהָ לֹא זָֽכְרָה אַחֲרִיתָהּ וַתֵּרֶד פְּלָאִים אֵין מְנַחֵם לָהּ רְאֵה יְהוָה אֶת עָנְיִי כִּי הִגְדִּיל אוֹיֵֽב׃
translation: Her filthiness was in her skirts. She didn't remember her latter end. Therefore she has come down astoundingly. She has no comforter. "See, LORD, my affliction; for the enemy has magnified himself." (Lamentations 1:9)

text: וְאֶת הַחֲלָבִים מִן הַשּׁוֹר וּמִן הָאַיִל הָֽאַלְיָה וְהַֽמְכַסֶּה וְהַכְּלָיֹת וְיֹתֶרֶת הַכָּבֵֽד׃
translation: and the fat of the bull and of the ram, the fat tail, and that which covers the innards, and the kidneys, and the cover of the liver; (Leviticus 9:19)

text: וְאֵת שְׁתֵּי הַכְּלָיֹת וְאֶת הַחֵלֶב אֲשֶׁר עֲלֵהֶן אֲשֶׁר עַל הַכְּסָלִים וְאֶת הַיֹּתֶרֶת עַל הַכָּבֵד עַל הַכְּלָיוֹת יְסִירֶֽנָּה׃
translation: and the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the loins, and the cover on the liver, with the kidneys, he shall take away. (Leviticus 3:4)

text: וְאֵת שְׁתֵּי הַכְּלָיֹת וְאֶת הַחֵלֶב אֲשֶׁר עֲלֵהֶן אֲשֶׁר עַל הַכְּסָלִים וְאֶת הַיֹּתֶרֶת עַל הַכָּבֵד עַל הַכְּלָיֹת יְסִירֶֽנָּה׃
translation: and the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the loins, and the cover on the liver, with the kidneys, he shall take away. (Leviticus 3:10)

text: וְאֵת שְׁתֵּי הַכְּלָיֹת וְאֶת הַחֵלֶב אֲשֶׁר עֲלֵהֶן אֲשֶׁר עַל הַכְּסָלִים וְאֶת הַיֹּתֶרֶת עַל הַכָּבֵד עַל הַכְּלָיֹת יְסִירֶֽנָּה׃
translation: and the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the loins, and the cover on the liver, with the kidneys, he shall take away. (Leviticus 3:15)

text: וְאֵת שְׁתֵּי הַכְּלָיֹת וְאֶת הַחֵלֶב אֲשֶׁר עֲלֵיהֶן אֲשֶׁר עַל הַכְּסָלִים וְאֶת הַיֹּתֶרֶת עַל הַכָּבֵד עַל הַכְּלָיוֹת יְסִירֶֽנָּה׃
translation: and the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the loins, and the cover on the liver, with the kidneys, he shall remove, (Leviticus 4:9)

text: וְאֵת שְׁתֵּי הַכְּלָיֹת וְאֶת הַחֵלֶב אֲשֶׁר עֲלֵיהֶן אֲשֶׁר עַל הַכְּסָלִים וְאֶת הַיֹּתֶרֶת עַל הַכָּבֵד עַל הַכְּלָיֹת יְסִירֶֽנָּה׃
translation: and he shall take away the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the loins, and the cover on the liver, with the kidneys; (Leviticus 7:4)

text: כְּתֵפֹת עָֽשׂוּ לוֹ חֹבְרֹת עַל שְׁנֵי קצוותו קְצוֹתָיו חֻבָּֽר׃
translation: They made shoulder straps for it, joined together. It was joined together at the two ends. (Exodus 39:4)

text: וּלְמִקְצָת הַיָּמִים אֲשֶׁר אָמַר הַמֶּלֶךְ לַהֲבִיאָם וַיְבִיאֵם שַׂר הַסָּרִיסִים לִפְנֵי נְבֻכַדְנֶצַּֽר׃
translation: At the end of the days which the king had appointed for bringing them in, the prince of the eunuchs brought them in before Nebuchadnezzar. (Daniel 1:18)

text: לִקְצָת יַרְחִין תְּרֵֽי עֲשַׂר עַל הֵיכַל מַלְכוּתָא דִּי בָבֶל מְהַלֵּךְ הֲוָֽה׃
translation: Whereas it was commanded to leave the stump of the roots of the tree, your kingdom shall be sure to you after you know that Heaven rules. (Daniel 4:26)

text: וּמִקְצָת יָמִים עֲשָׂרָה נִרְאָה מַרְאֵיהֶם טוֹב וּבְרִיאֵי בָּשָׂר מִן כָּל הַיְלָדִים הָאֹכְלִים אֵת פַּתְבַּג הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
translation: At the end of ten days, their faces appeared fairer and they were fatter in flesh than all the youths who ate of the king's delicacies. (Daniel 1:15)

text: כְּרוּב אֶחָד מִקָּצָה מִזֶּה וּכְרוּב אֶחָד מִקָּצָה מִזֶּה מִן הַכַּפֹּרֶת עָשָׂה אֶת הַכְּרֻבִים מִשְּׁנֵי קצוותו קְצוֹתָֽיו׃
translation: one cherub at the one end, and one cherub at the other end. He made the cherubim of one piece with the mercy seat at its two ends. (Exodus 37:8)

text: וּמִקְצָת רָאשֵׁי הָֽאָבוֹת נָתְנוּ לַמְּלָאכָה הַתִּרְשָׁתָא נָתַן לָאוֹצָר זָהָב דַּרְכְּמֹנִים אֶלֶף מִזְרָקוֹת חֲמִשִּׁים כָּתְנוֹת כֹּֽהֲנִים שְׁלֹשִׁים וַחֲמֵשׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃
translation: their camels, four hundred thirty-five; their donkeys, six thousand seven hundred twenty. (Nehemiah 7:69)

text: אָרוּר מַקְלֶה אָבִיו וְאִמּוֹ וְאָמַר כָּל הָעָם אָמֵֽן׃
translation: 'Cursed is he who dishonors his father or his mother.' All the people shall say, 'Amen.' (Deuteronomy 27:16)

text: כִּֽי כְסָלַי מָלְאוּ נִקְלֶה וְאֵין מְתֹם בִּבְשָׂרִֽי׃
translation: I am faint and severely bruised. I have groaned by reason of the anguish of my heart. (Psalms 38:8)

text: טוֹב נִקְלֶה וְעֶבֶד לוֹ מִמְּתַכַּבֵּד וַחֲסַר לָֽחֶם׃
translation: Better is he who is little known, and has a servant, than he who honors himself and lacks bread. (Proverbs 12:9)

text: וַיֹּאכְלוּ מֵעֲבוּר הָאָרֶץ מִמָּֽחֳרַת הַפֶּסַח מַצּוֹת וְקָלוּי בְּעֶצֶם הַיּוֹם הַזֶּֽה׃
translation: They ate unleavened cakes and parched grain of the produce of the land on the next day after the Passover, in the same day. (Joshua 5:11)

text: וְנִגַּשׂ הָעָם אִישׁ בְּאִישׁ וְאִישׁ בְּרֵעֵהוּ יִרְהֲבוּ הַנַּעַר בַּזָּקֵן וְהַנִּקְלֶה בַּנִּכְבָּֽד׃
translation: The people will be oppressed, everyone by another, and everyone by his neighbor. The child will behave himself proudly against the old man, and the wicked against the honorable. (Isaiah 3:5)

text: אַרְבָּעִים יַכֶּנּוּ לֹא יֹסִיף פֶּן יֹסִיף לְהַכֹּתוֹ עַל אֵלֶּה מַכָּה רַבָּה וְנִקְלָה אָחִיךָ לְעֵינֶֽיךָ׃
translation: He may sentence him to no more than forty stripes. He shall not give more, lest if he should give more and beat him more than that many stripes, then your brother will be degraded in your sight. (Deuteronomy 25:3)

text: וַיִּלְבַּשׁ קְלָלָה כְּמַדּוֹ וַתָּבֹא כַמַּיִם בְּקִרְבּוֹ וְכַשֶּׁמֶן בְּעַצְמוֹתָֽיו׃
translation: He clothed himself also with cursing as with his garment. It came into his inward parts like water, like oil into his bones. (Psalms 109:18)

text: רֹכְבֵי אֲתֹנוֹת צְחֹרוֹת יֹשְׁבֵי עַל מִדִּין וְהֹלְכֵי עַל דֶּרֶךְ שִֽׂיחוּ׃
translation: "Speak, you who ride on white donkeys, you who sit on rich carpets, and you who walk by the way. (Judges 5:10)

text: אֲרֻכָּה מֵאֶרֶץ מִדָּהּ וּרְחָבָה מִנִּי יָֽם׃
translation: Its measure is longer than the earth, and broader than the sea. (Job 11:9)

text: זֶה גוֹרָלֵךְ מְנָת מִדַּיִךְ מֵֽאִתִּי נְאֻם יְהוָה אֲשֶׁר שָׁכַחַתְּ אוֹתִי וַֽתִּבְטְחִי בַּשָּֽׁקֶר׃
translation: This is your lot, the portion measured to you from me," says the LORD, "because you have forgotten me, and trusted in falsehood." (Jeremiah 13:25)

text: וַיָּרָץ אִישׁ בִּנְיָמִן מֵהַמַּעֲרָכָה וַיָּבֹא שִׁלֹה בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא וּמַדָּיו קְרֻעִים וַאֲדָמָה עַל רֹאשֽׁוֹ׃
translation: A man of Benjamin ran out of the army and came to Shiloh the same day, with his clothes torn and with dirt on his head. (1 Samuel 4:12)

text: וַיַּלְבֵּשׁ שָׁאוּל אֶת דָּוִד מַדָּיו וְנָתַן קוֹבַע נְחֹשֶׁת עַל רֹאשׁוֹ וַיַּלְבֵּשׁ אֹתוֹ שִׁרְיֽוֹן׃
translation: Saul dressed David with his clothing. He put a helmet of bronze on his head, and he clad him with a coat of mail. (1 Samuel 17:38)

text: הָאֵל מָעוּזִּי חָיִל וַיַּתֵּר תָּמִים דרכו דַּרְכִּֽי׃
translation: God is my strong fortress. He makes my way perfect. (2 Samuel 22:33)

text: עֹשֶׂה מִשְׁפָּט לָעֲשׁוּקִים נֹתֵן לֶחֶם לָרְעֵבִים יְהוָה מַתִּיר אֲסוּרִֽים׃
translation: who executes justice for the oppressed; who gives food to the hungry. The LORD frees the prisoners. (Psalms 146:7)

text: וְיֹאֵל אֱלוֹהַּ וִֽידַכְּאֵנִי יַתֵּר יָדוֹ וִֽיבַצְּעֵֽנִי׃
translation: even that it would please God to crush me; that he would let loose his hand, and cut me off! (Job 6:9)

text: אַף לְזֹאת יֶחֱרַד לִבִּי וְיִתַּר מִמְּקוֹמֽוֹ׃
translation: "Yes, at this my heart trembles, and is moved out of its place. (Job 37:1)

text: שָׁלַח מֶלֶךְ וַיַּתִּירֵהוּ מֹשֵׁל עַמִּים וַֽיְפַתְּחֵֽהוּ׃
translation: The king sent and freed him, even the ruler of peoples, and let him go free. (Psalms 105:20)

text: מַעֲדֶה בֶּגֶד בְּיוֹם קָרָה חֹמֶץ עַל נָתֶר וְשָׁר בַּשִּׁרִים עַל לֶב רָֽע׃
translation: As one who takes away a garment in cold weather, or vinegar on soda, so is one who sings songs to a heavy heart. (Proverbs 25:20)

text: וְרֹחַב פְּנֵי הַבַּיִת וְהַגִּזְרָה לַקָּדִים מֵאָה אַמָּֽה׃
translation: also the width of the face of the temple, and of the separate place toward the east, one hundred cubits. (Ezekiel 41:14)

text: וּמָדַד אֶת הַבַּיִת אֹרֶךְ מֵאָה אַמָּה וְהַגִּזְרָה וְהַבִּנְיָה וְקִירוֹתֶיהָ אֹרֶךְ מֵאָה אַמָּֽה׃
translation: So he measured the temple, one hundred cubits long; and the separate place, and the building, with its walls, one hundred cubits long; (Ezekiel 41:13)

text: וְנָשָׂא הַשָּׂעִיר עָלָיו אֶת כָּל עֲוֺנֹתָם אֶל אֶרֶץ גְּזֵרָה וְשִׁלַּח אֶת הַשָּׂעִיר בַּמִּדְבָּֽר׃
translation: The goat shall carry all their iniquities on himself to a solitary land, and he shall release the goat in the wilderness. (Leviticus 16:22)

text: וְחֹבֵר חָבֶר וְשֹׁאֵל אוֹב וְיִדְּעֹנִי וְדֹרֵשׁ אֶל הַמֵּתִֽים׃
translation: or a charmer, or someone who consults with a familiar spirit, or a wizard, or a necromancer. (Deuteronomy 18:11)

text: אַל תִּפְנוּ אֶל הָאֹבֹת וְאֶל הַיִּדְּעֹנִים אַל תְּבַקְשׁוּ לְטָמְאָה בָהֶם אֲנִי יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃
translation: "'Don't turn to those who are mediums, nor to the wizards. Don't seek them out, to be defiled by them. I am the LORD your God. (Leviticus 19:31)

text: וּשְׁמוּאֵל מֵת וַיִּסְפְּדוּ לוֹ כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּקְבְּרֻהוּ בָרָמָה וּבְעִירוֹ וְשָׁאוּל הֵסִיר הָאֹבוֹת וְאֶת הַיִּדְּעֹנִים מֵהָאָֽרֶץ׃
translation: Now Samuel was dead, and all Israel had mourned for him and buried him in Ramah, even in his own city. Saul had sent away those who had familiar spirits and the wizards out of the land. (1 Samuel 28:3)

text: וְהֶעֱבִיר אֶת בְּנוֹ בָּאֵשׁ וְעוֹנֵן וְנִחֵשׁ וְעָשָׂה אוֹב וְיִדְּעֹנִים הִרְבָּה לַעֲשׂוֹת הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהוָה לְהַכְעִֽיס׃
translation: He made his son to pass through the fire, practiced sorcery, used enchantments, and dealt with those who had familiar spirits and with wizards. He did much evil in the LORD's sight, to provoke him to anger. (2 Kings 21:6)

text: וְאִישׁ אֽוֹ אִשָּׁה כִּֽי יִהְיֶה בָהֶם אוֹב אוֹ יִדְּעֹנִי מוֹת יוּמָתוּ בָּאֶבֶן יִרְגְּמוּ אֹתָם דְּמֵיהֶם בָּֽם׃
translation: "'A man or a woman that is a medium or is a wizard shall surely be put to death. They shall be stoned with stones. Their blood shall be upon themselves.'" (Leviticus 20:27)

text: וְהַנֶּפֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר תִּפְנֶה אֶל הָֽאֹבֹת וְאֶל הַיִּדְּעֹנִים לִזְנוֹת אַחֲרֵיהֶם וְנָתַתִּי אֶת פָּנַי בַּנֶּפֶשׁ הַהִוא וְהִכְרַתִּי אֹתוֹ מִקֶּרֶב עַמּֽוֹ׃
translation: "'The person that turns to those who are mediums and wizards, to play the prostitute after them, I will even set my face against that person, and will cut him off from among his people. (Leviticus 20:6)

text: וַיִּקְרָא אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה צְבָאוֹת בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא לִבְכִי וּלְמִסְפֵּד וּלְקָרְחָה וְלַחֲגֹר שָֽׂק׃
translation: In that day, the Lord, GOD of Armies, called to weeping, to mourning, to baldness, and to dressing in sackcloth; (Isaiah 22:12)

text: וְהִקְרִיחוּ אֵלַיִךְ קָרְחָה וְחָגְרוּ שַׂקִּים וּבָכוּ אֵלַיִךְ בְּמַר נֶפֶשׁ מִסְפֵּד מָֽר׃
translation: They will make themselves bald for you, and clothe themselves with sackcloth. They will weep for you in bitterness of soul, with bitter mourning. (Ezekiel 27:31)

text: קָרְחִי וָגֹזִּי עַל בְּנֵי תַּעֲנוּגָיִךְ הַרְחִבִי קָרְחָתֵךְ כַּנֶּשֶׁר כִּי גָלוּ מִמֵּֽךְ׃
translation: Shave your heads, and cut off your hair for the children of your delight. Enlarge your baldness like the vulture, for they have gone into captivity from you! (Micah 1:16)

text: וְחָגְרוּ שַׂקִּים וְכִסְּתָה אוֹתָם פַּלָּצוּת וְאֶל כָּל פָּנִים בּוּשָׁה וּבְכָל רָאשֵׁיהֶם קָרְחָֽה׃
translation: They will also clothe themselves with sackcloth, and horror will cover them. Shame will be on all faces, and baldness on all their heads. (Ezekiel 7:18)

text: לֹֽא יקרחה יִקְרְחוּ קָרְחָה בְּרֹאשָׁם וּפְאַת זְקָנָם לֹא יְגַלֵּחוּ וּבִבְשָׂרָם לֹא יִשְׂרְטוּ שָׂרָֽטֶת׃
translation: "'They shall not shave their heads or shave off the corners of their beards or make any cuttings in their flesh. (Leviticus 21:5)

text: כִּי כָל רֹאשׁ קָרְחָה וְכָל זָקָן גְּרֻעָה עַל כָּל יָדַיִם גְּדֻדֹת וְעַל מָתְנַיִם שָֽׂק׃
translation: For every head is bald, and every beard clipped. There are cuttings on all the hands, and sackcloth on the waist. (Jeremiah 48:37)

text: תִּקְעוּ שׁוֹפָר בְּצִיּוֹן קַדְּשׁוּ צוֹם קִרְאוּ עֲצָרָֽה׃
translation: Blow the trumpet in Zion! Sanctify a fast. Call a solemn assembly. (Joel 2:15)

text: בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁמִינִי עֲצֶרֶת תִּהְיֶה לָכֶם כָּל מְלֶאכֶת עֲבֹדָה לֹא תַעֲשֽׂוּ׃
translation: "'On the eighth day you shall have a solemn assembly. You shall do no regular work; (Numbers 29:35)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר יֵהוּא קַדְּשׁוּ עֲצָרָה לַבַּעַל וַיִּקְרָֽאוּ׃
translation: Jehu said, "Sanctify a solemn assembly for Baal!" So they proclaimed it. (2 Kings 10:20)

text: שָׂנֵאתִי מָאַסְתִּי חַגֵּיכֶם וְלֹא אָרִיחַ בְּעַצְּרֹֽתֵיכֶֽם׃
translation: I hate, I despise your feasts, and I can't stand your solemn assemblies. (Amos 5:21)

text: שֵׁשֶׁת יָמִים תֹּאכַל מַצּוֹת וּבַיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי עֲצֶרֶת לַיהוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לֹא תַעֲשֶׂה מְלָאכָֽה׃
translation: Six days you shall eat unleavened bread. On the seventh day shall be a solemn assembly to the LORD your God. You shall do no work. (Deuteronomy 16:8)

text: קַדְּשׁוּ צוֹם קִרְאוּ עֲצָרָה אִסְפוּ זְקֵנִים כֹּל יֹשְׁבֵי הָאָרֶץ בֵּית יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם וְזַעֲקוּ אֶל יְהוָֽה׃
translation: Sanctify a fast. Call a solemn assembly. Gather the elders and all the inhabitants of the land to the house of the LORD, your God, and cry to the LORD. (Joel 1:14)

text: אָז תָּבֹאנָה שְׁתַּיִם נָשִׁים זֹנוֹת אֶל הַמֶּלֶךְ וַֽתַּעֲמֹדְנָה לְפָנָֽיו׃
translation: Then two women who were prostitutes came to the king, and stood before him. (1 Kings 3:16)

text: עַתָּה יְרַחֲקוּ אֶת זְנוּתָם וּפִגְרֵי מַלְכֵיהֶם מִמֶּנִּי וְשָׁכַנְתִּי בְתוֹכָם לְעוֹלָֽם׃
translation: Now let them put away their prostitution, and the dead bodies of their kings far from me. Then I will dwell among them forever. (Ezekiel 43:9)

text: בְּבֵית יִשְׂרָאֵל רָאִיתִי שעריריה שַׁעֲרֽוּרִיָּה שָׁם זְנוּת לְאֶפְרַיִם נִטְמָא יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
translation: In the house of Israel I have seen a horrible thing. There is prostitution in Ephraim. Israel is defiled. (Hosea 6:10)

text: וְהָיָה מִקֹּל זְנוּתָהּ וַתֶּחֱנַף אֶת הָאָרֶץ וַתִּנְאַף אֶת הָאֶבֶן וְאֶת הָעֵֽץ׃
translation: Because she took her prostitution lightly, the land was polluted, and she committed adultery with stones and with wood. (Jeremiah 3:9)

text: זְנוּת וְיַיִן וְתִירוֹשׁ יִֽקַּֽח לֵֽב׃
translation: Prostitution, wine, and new wine take away understanding. (Hosea 4:11)

text: וּבְנֵיכֶם יִהְיוּ רֹעִים בַּמִּדְבָּר אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה וְנָשְׂאוּ אֶת זְנוּתֵיכֶם עַד תֹּם פִּגְרֵיכֶם בַּמִּדְבָּֽר׃
translation: Your children shall be wanderers in the wilderness forty years, and shall bear your prostitution, until your dead bodies are consumed in the wilderness. (Numbers 14:33)

text: כָּל הַנִּמְצָא יִדָּקֵר וְכָל הַנִּסְפֶּה יִפּוֹל בֶּחָֽרֶב׃
translation: Everyone who is found will be thrust through. Everyone who is captured will fall by the sword. (Isaiah 13:15)

text: וְנָפְלוּ חֲלָלִים בְּאֶרֶץ כַּשְׂדִּים וּמְדֻקָּרִים בְּחוּצוֹתֶֽיהָ׃
translation: They will fall down slain in the land of the Chaldeans, and thrust through in her streets. (Jeremiah 51:4)

text: טוֹבִים הָיוּ חַלְלֵי חֶרֶב מֵֽחַלְלֵי רָעָב שֶׁהֵם יָזוּבוּ מְדֻקָּרִים מִתְּנוּבֹת שָׂדָֽי׃
translation: Those who are killed with the sword are better than those who are killed with hunger; for these pine away, stricken through, for lack of the fruits of the field. (Lamentations 4:9)

text: וַיִּקְרָא מְהֵרָה אֶל הַנַּעַר נֹשֵׂא כֵלָיו וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ שְׁלֹף חַרְבְּךָ וּמוֹתְתֵנִי פֶּן יֹאמְרוּ לִי אִשָּׁה הֲרָגָתְהוּ וַיִּדְקְרֵהוּ נַעֲרוֹ וַיָּמֹֽת׃
translation: Then he called hastily to the young man, his armor bearer, and said to him, "Draw your sword and kill me, that men not say of me, 'A woman killed him.' His young man thrust him through, and he died." (Judges 9:54)

text: כִּי אִם הִכִּיתֶם כָּל חֵיל כַּשְׂדִּים הַנִּלְחָמִים אִתְּכֶם וְנִשְׁאֲרוּ בָם אֲנָשִׁים מְדֻקָּרִים אִישׁ בְּאָהֳלוֹ יָקוּמוּ וְשָֽׂרְפוּ אֶת הָעִיר הַזֹּאת בָּאֵֽשׁ׃
translation: For though you had struck the whole army of the Chaldeans who fight against you, and only wounded men remained among them, they would each rise up in his tent and burn this city with fire.'" (Jeremiah 37:10)

text: וַיָּקָם אַחֲרָיו יָאִיר הַגִּלְעָדִי וַיִּשְׁפֹּט אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל עֶשְׂרִים וּשְׁתַּיִם שָׁנָֽה׃
translation: After him Jair, the Gileadite, arose. He judged Israel twenty-two years. (Judges 10:3)

text: בְּנֵי מְנַשֶּׁה לְמָכִיר מִשְׁפַּחַת הַמָּכִירִי וּמָכִיר הוֹלִיד אֶת גִּלְעָד לְגִלְעָד מִשְׁפַּחַת הַגִּלְעָדִֽי׃
translation: The sons of Manasseh: of Machir, the family of the Machirites; and Machir became the father of Gilead; of Gilead, the family of the Gileadites. (Numbers 26:29)

text: וַיִּשְׁפֹּט יִפְתָּח אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל שֵׁשׁ שָׁנִים וַיָּמָת יִפְתָּח הַגִּלְעָדִי וַיִּקָּבֵר בְּעָרֵי גִלְעָֽד׃
translation: Jephthah judged Israel six years. Then Jephthah the Gileadite died, and was buried in the cities of Gilead. (Judges 12:7)

text: וּבַרְזִלַּי הַגִּלְעָדִי יָרַד מֵרֹגְלִים וַיַּעֲבֹר אֶת הַמֶּלֶךְ הַיַּרְדֵּן לְשַׁלְּחוֹ אֶת בירדן הַיַּרְדֵּֽן׃
translation: Now Barzillai was a very aged man, even eighty years old. He had provided the king with sustenance while he stayed at Mahanaim, for he was a very great man. (2 Samuel 19:32)

text: וְיִפְתָּח הַגִּלְעָדִי הָיָה גִּבּוֹר חַיִל וְהוּא בֶּן אִשָּׁה זוֹנָה וַיּוֹלֶד גִּלְעָד אֶת יִפְתָּֽח׃
translation: Now Jephthah the Gileadite was a mighty man of valor. He was the son of a prostitute. Gilead became the father of Jephthah. (Judges 11:1)

text: וְלִבְנֵי בַרְזִלַּי הַגִּלְעָדִי תַּֽעֲשֶׂה חֶסֶד וְהָיוּ בְּאֹכְלֵי שֻׁלְחָנֶךָ כִּי כֵן קָרְבוּ אֵלַי בְּבָרְחִי מִפְּנֵי אַבְשָׁלוֹם אָחִֽיךָ׃
translation: But show kindness to the sons of Barzillai the Gileadite, and let them be among those who eat at your table; for so they came to me when I fled from Absalom your brother. (1 Kings 2:7)

text: וְאִם בְּשִׂנְאָה יֶהְדָּפֶנּוּ אֽוֹ הִשְׁלִיךְ עָלָיו בִּצְדִיָּה וַיָּמֹֽת׃
translation: If he shoved him out of hatred, or hurled something at him while lying in wait, so that he died, (Numbers 35:20)

text: לַהֲדֹף אֶת כָּל אֹיְבֶיךָ מִפָּנֶיךָ כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהוָֽה׃
translation: to thrust out all your enemies from before you, as the LORD has spoken. (Deuteronomy 6:19)

text: לֹֽא יַרְעִיב יְהוָה נֶפֶשׁ צַדִּיק וְהַוַּת רְשָׁעִים יֶהְדֹּֽף׃
translation: The LORD will not allow the soul of the righteous to go hungry, but he thrusts away the desire of the wicked. (Proverbs 10:3)

text: מַדּוּעַ נִסְחַף אַבִּירֶיךָ לֹא עָמַד כִּי יְהוָה הֲדָפֽוֹ׃
translation: Why are your strong ones swept away? They didn't stand, because the LORD pushed them. (Jeremiah 46:15)

text: יֶהְדְּפֻהוּ מֵאוֹר אֶל חֹשֶׁךְ וּֽמִתֵּבֵל יְנִדֻּֽהוּ׃
translation: He will be driven from light into darkness, and chased out of the world. (Job 18:18)

text: יַעַן בְּצַד וּבְכָתֵף תֶּהְדֹּפוּ וּבְקַרְנֵיכֶם תְּנַגְּחוּ כָּל הַנַּחְלוֹת עַד אֲשֶׁר הֲפִיצוֹתֶם אוֹתָנָה אֶל הַחֽוּצָה׃
translation: Because you thrust with side and with shoulder, and push all the diseased with your horns, until you have scattered them abroad, (Ezekiel 34:21)

text: וַיַּרְקִידֵם כְּמוֹ עֵגֶל לְבָנוֹן וְשִׂרְיֹן כְּמוֹ בֶן רְאֵמִֽים׃
translation: He makes them also to skip like a calf; Lebanon and Sirion like a young, wild ox. (Psalms 29:6)

text: מַשִּׂיגֵהוּ חֶרֶב בְּלִי תָקוּם חֲנִית מַסָּע וְשִׁרְיָֽה׃
translation: His sneezing flashes out light. His eyes are like the eyelids of the morning. (Job 41:18)

text: וַיָּכֶן לָהֶם עֻזִּיָּהוּ לְכָל הַצָּבָא מָגִנִּים וּרְמָחִים וְכוֹבָעִים וְשִׁרְיֹנוֹת וּקְשָׁתוֹת וּלְאַבְנֵי קְלָעִֽים׃
translation: Uzziah prepared for them, even for all the army, shields, spears, helmets, coats of mail, bows, and stones for slinging. (2 Chronicles 26:14)

text: וַיִּלְבַּשׁ צְדָקָה כַּשִּׁרְיָן וְכוֹבַע יְשׁוּעָה בְּרֹאשׁוֹ וַיִּלְבַּשׁ בִּגְדֵי נָקָם תִּלְבֹּשֶׁת וַיַּעַט כַּמְעִיל קִנְאָֽה׃
translation: He put on righteousness as a breastplate, and a helmet of salvation on his head. He put on garments of vengeance for clothing, and was clad with zeal as a mantle. (Isaiah 59:17)

text: וַיְהִי מִן הַיּוֹם הַהוּא חֲצִי נְעָרַי עֹשִׂים בַּמְּלָאכָה וְחֶצְיָם מַחֲזִיקִים וְהָרְמָחִים הַמָּגִנִּים וְהַקְּשָׁתוֹת וְהַשִּׁרְיֹנִים וְהַשָּׂרִים אַחֲרֵי כָּל בֵּית יְהוּדָֽה׃
translation: Judah said, "The strength of the bearers of burdens is fading and there is much rubble, so that we are not able to build the wall." (Nehemiah 4:10)

text: בָּֽא זָדוֹן וַיָּבֹא קָלוֹן וְֽאֶת צְנוּעִים חָכְמָֽה׃
translation: When pride comes, then comes shame, but with humility comes wisdom. (Proverbs 11:2)

text: רַק בְּזָדוֹן יִתֵּן מַצָּה וְאֶת נוֹעָצִים חָכְמָֽה׃
translation: Pride only breeds quarrels, but wisdom is with people who take advice. (Proverbs 13:10)

text: זֵד יָהִיר לֵץ שְׁמוֹ עוֹשֶׂה בְּעֶבְרַת זָדֽוֹן׃
translation: The proud and arrogant man—"Scoffer" is his name— he works in the arrogance of pride. (Proverbs 21:24)

text: הִנֵּה הַיּוֹם הִנֵּה בָאָה יָֽצְאָה הַצְּפִרָה צָץ הַמַּטֶּה פָּרַח הַזָּדֽוֹן׃
translation: "'Behold, the day! Behold, it comes! Your doom has gone out. The rod has blossomed. Pride has budded. (Ezekiel 7:10)

text: הִנְנִי אֵלֶיךָ זָדוֹן נְאֻם אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה צְבָאוֹת כִּי בָּא יוֹמְךָ עֵת פְּקַדְתִּֽיךָ׃
translation: "Behold, I am against you, you proud one," says the Lord, GOD of Armies; "for your day has come, the time that I will visit you. (Jeremiah 50:31)

text: וְכָשַׁל זָדוֹן וְנָפַל וְאֵין לוֹ מֵקִים וְהִצַּתִּי אֵשׁ בְּעָרָיו וְאָכְלָה כָּל סְבִיבֹתָֽיו׃
translation: The proud one will stumble and fall, and no one will raise him up. I will kindle a fire in his cities, and it will devour all who are around him." (Jeremiah 50:32)

text: וְדָוִד אָז בַּמְּצוּדָה וּמַצַּב פְּלִשְׁתִּים אָז בֵּית לָֽחֶם׃
translation: David was then in the stronghold; and the garrison of the Philistines was then in Bethlehem. (2 Samuel 23:14)

text: וְחָנִיתִי כַדּוּר עָלָיִךְ וְצַרְתִּי עָלַיִךְ מֻצָּב וַהֲקִֽימֹתִי עָלַיִךְ מְצֻרֹֽת׃
translation: I will encamp against you all around you, and will lay siege against you with posted troops. I will raise siege works against you. (Isaiah 29:3)

text: וַיֵּצֵא מַצַּב פְּלִשְׁתִּים אֶֽל מַעֲבַר מִכְמָֽשׂ׃
translation: The garrison of the Philistines went out to the pass of Michmash. (1 Samuel 13:23)

text: וַהֲדַפְתִּיךָ מִמַּצָּבֶךָ וּמִמַּעֲמָֽדְךָ יֶהֶרְסֶֽךָ׃
translation: I will thrust you from your office. You will be pulled down from your station. (Isaiah 22:19)

text: וַיִּגָּלוּ שְׁנֵיהֶם אֶל מַצַּב פְּלִשְׁתִּים וַיֹּאמְרוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים הִנֵּה עִבְרִים יֹֽצְאִים מִן הַחֹרִים אֲשֶׁר הִתְחַבְּאוּ שָֽׁם׃
translation: Both of them revealed themselves to the garrison of the Philistines; and the Philistines said, "Behold, the Hebrews are coming out of the holes where they had hidden themselves!" (1 Samuel 14:11)

text: וּשְׁתֵּים עֶשְׂרֵה אֲבָנִים הֵקִים יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בְּתוֹךְ הַיַּרְדֵּן תַּחַת מַצַּב רַגְלֵי הַכֹּהֲנִים נֹשְׂאֵי אֲרוֹן הַבְּרִית וַיִּהְיוּ שָׁם עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּֽה׃
translation: Joshua set up twelve stones in the middle of the Jordan, in the place where the feet of the priests who bore the ark of the covenant stood; and they are there to this day. (Joshua 4:9)

text: תְּשִׁיבֵנוּ אָחוֹר מִנִּי צָר וּמְשַׂנְאֵינוּ שָׁסוּ לָֽמוֹ׃
translation: You have made us like sheep for food, and have scattered us among the nations. (Psalms 44:11)

text: וַיָּקֶם יְהוָה שֹֽׁפְטִים וַיּוֹשִׁיעוּם מִיַּד שֹׁסֵיהֶֽם׃
translation: The LORD raised up judges, who saved them out of the hand of those who plundered them. (Judges 2:16)

text: וַיַּעַשׂ חַיִל וַיַּךְ אֶת עֲמָלֵק וַיַּצֵּל אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל מִיַּד שֹׁסֵֽהוּ׃
translation: He did valiantly and struck the Amalekites, and delivered Israel out of the hands of those who plundered them. (1 Samuel 14:48)

text: וַיַּגִּדוּ לְדָוִד לֵאמֹר הִנֵּה פְלִשְׁתִּים נִלְחָמִים בִּקְעִילָה וְהֵמָּה שֹׁסִים אֶת הַגֳּרָנֽוֹת׃
translation: David was told, "Behold, the Philistines are fighting against Keilah, and are robbing the threshing floors." (1 Samuel 23:1)

text: לְעֵת עֶרֶב וְהִנֵּה בַלָּהָה בְּטֶרֶם בֹּקֶר אֵינֶנּוּ זֶה חֵלֶק שׁוֹסֵינוּ וְגוֹרָל לְבֹזְזֵֽינוּ׃
translation: At evening, behold, terror! Before the morning, they are no more. This is the portion of those who plunder us, and the lot of those who rob us. (Isaiah 17:14)

text: וַיִּמְאַס יְהוָה בְּכָל זֶרַע יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיְעַנֵּם וַֽיִּתְּנֵם בְּיַד שֹׁסִים עַד אֲשֶׁר הִשְׁלִיכָם מִפָּנָֽיו׃
translation: The LORD rejected all the offspring of Israel, afflicted them, and delivered them into the hands of raiders, until he had cast them out of his sight. (2 Kings 17:20)

text: וַתֵּרֶד הַגֹּרֶן וַתַּעַשׂ כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר צִוַּתָּה חֲמוֹתָֽהּ׃
translation: She went down to the threshing floor, and did everything that her mother-in-law told her. (Ruth 3:6)

text: וַתִּשֶּׂנָה קוֹלָן וַתִּבְכֶּינָה עוֹד וַתִּשַּׁק עָרְפָּה לַחֲמוֹתָהּ וְרוּת דָּבְקָה בָּֽהּ׃
translation: They lifted up their voices and wept again; then Orpah kissed her mother-in-law, but Ruth stayed with her. (Ruth 1:14)

text: וַתֹּאמֶר לָהּ נָעֳמִי חֲמוֹתָהּ בִּתִּי הֲלֹא אֲבַקֶּשׁ לָךְ מָנוֹחַ אֲשֶׁר יִֽיטַב לָֽךְ׃
translation: Naomi her mother-in-law said to her, "My daughter, shall I not seek rest for you, that it may be well with you? (Ruth 3:1)

text: וַתִּדְבַּק בְּנַעֲרוֹת בֹּעַז לְלַקֵּט עַד כְּלוֹת קְצִֽיר הַשְּׂעֹרִים וּקְצִיר הַֽחִטִּים וַתֵּשֶׁב אֶת חֲמוֹתָֽהּ׃
translation: So she stayed close to the maidens of Boaz, to glean to the end of barley harvest and of wheat harvest; and she lived with her mother-in-law. (Ruth 2:23)

text: כִּֽי בֵן מְנַבֵּל אָב בַּת קָמָה בְאִמָּהּ כַּלָּה בַּחֲמֹתָהּ אֹיְבֵי אִישׁ אַנְשֵׁי בֵיתֽוֹ׃
translation: For the son dishonors the father, the daughter rises up against her mother, the daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law; a man's enemies are the men of his own house. (Micah 7:6)

text: וַתֹּאמֶר שֵׁשׁ הַשְּׂעֹרִים הָאֵלֶּה נָתַן לִי כִּי אָמַר אֵלַי אַל תָּבוֹאִי רֵיקָם אֶל חֲמוֹתֵֽךְ׃
translation: She said, "He gave me these six measures of barley; for he said, 'Don't go empty to your mother-in-law.'" (Ruth 3:17)

text: מַֽעֲנֶה רַּךְ יָשִׁיב חֵמָה וּדְבַר עֶצֶב יַעֲלֶה אָֽף׃
translation: A gentle answer turns away wrath, but a harsh word stirs up anger. (Proverbs 15:1)

text: שִׂמְחָה לָאִישׁ בְּמַעֲנֵה פִיו וְדָבָר בְּעִתּוֹ מַה טּֽוֹב׃
translation: Joy comes to a man with the reply of his mouth. How good is a word at the right time! (Proverbs 15:23)

text: כֹּל פָּעַל יְהוָה לַֽמַּעֲנֵהוּ וְגַם רָשָׁע לְיוֹם רָעָֽה׃
translation: The LORD has made everything for its own end— yes, even the wicked for the day of evil. (Proverbs 16:4)

text: בִּדְבָרִים לֹא יִוָּסֶר עָבֶד כִּֽי יָבִין וְאֵין מַעֲנֶֽה׃
translation: A servant can't be corrected by words. Though he understands, yet he will not respond. (Proverbs 29:19)

text: עַל גַּבִּי חָרְשׁוּ חֹרְשִׁים הֶאֱרִיכוּ למענותם לְמַעֲנִיתָֽם׃
translation: The plowers plowed on my back. They made their furrows long. (Psalms 129:3)

text: וַיַּרְא אֱלִיהוּא כִּי אֵין מַעֲנֶה בְּפִי שְׁלֹשֶׁת הָאֲנָשִׁים וַיִּחַר אַפּֽוֹ׃
translation: When Elihu saw that there was no answer in the mouth of these three men, his wrath was kindled. (Job 32:5)

text: וְאֵלֶּה שְׁמוֹת הַיִּלֹּדִים לוֹ בִּירוּשָׁלִָם שַׁמּוּעַ וְשׁוֹבָב וְנָתָן וּשְׁלֹמֹֽה׃
translation: These are the names of those who were born to him in Jerusalem: Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon, (2 Samuel 5:14)

text: בַּעֲוֺן בִּצְעוֹ קָצַפְתִּי וְאַכֵּהוּ הַסְתֵּר וְאֶקְצֹף וַיֵּלֶךְ שׁוֹבָב בְּדֶרֶךְ לִבּֽוֹ׃
translation: I was angry because of the iniquity of his covetousness and struck him. I hid myself and was angry; and he went on backsliding in the way of his heart. (Isaiah 57:17)

text: וְאֵלֶּה שְׁמוֹת הַיְלוּדִים אֲשֶׁר הָיוּ לוֹ בִּירוּשָׁלִָם שַׁמּוּעַ וְשׁוֹבָב נָתָן וּשְׁלֹמֹֽה׃
translation: These are the names of the children whom he had in Jerusalem: Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon, (1 Chronicles 14:4)

text: מַה תִּתְהַֽלְלִי בָּֽעֲמָקִים זָב עִמְקֵךְ הַבַּת הַשּֽׁוֹבֵבָה הַבֹּֽטְחָה בְּאֹצְרֹתֶיהָ מִי יָבוֹא אֵלָֽי׃
translation: Why do you boast in the valleys, your flowing valley, backsliding daughter? You trusted in her treasures, saying, 'Who will come to me?' (Jeremiah 49:4)

text: וְאֵלֶּה נוּלְּדוּ לוֹ בִּירוּשָׁלָיִם שִׁמְעָא וְשׁוֹבָב וְנָתָן וּשְׁלֹמֹה אַרְבָּעָה לְבַת שׁוּעַ בַּת עַמִּיאֵֽל׃
translation: and these were born to him in Jerusalem: Shimea, Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon, four, by Bathshua the daughter of Ammiel; (1 Chronicles 3:5)

text: עַד מָתַי תִּתְחַמָּקִין הַבַּת הַשּֽׁוֹבֵבָה כִּֽי בָרָא יְהוָה חֲדָשָׁה בָּאָרֶץ נְקֵבָה תְּסוֹבֵֽב גָּֽבֶר׃
translation: How long will you go here and there, you backsliding daughter? For the LORD has created a new thing in the earth: a woman will encompass a man." (Jeremiah 31:22)

text: וַתִּקֹּד בַּת שֶׁבַע וַתִּשְׁתַּחוּ לַמֶּלֶךְ וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ מַה לָּֽךְ׃
translation: Bathsheba bowed and showed respect to the king. The king said, "What would you like?" (1 Kings 1:16)

text: וַתֹּאמֶר בַּת שֶׁבַע טוֹב אָנֹכִי אֲדַבֵּר עָלֶיךָ אֶל הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
translation: Bathsheba said, "All right. I will speak for you to the king." (1 Kings 2:18)

text: בְּֽבוֹא אֵלָיו נָתָן הַנָּבִיא כַּֽאֲשֶׁר בָּא אֶל בַּת שָֽׁבַע׃
translation: Wash me thoroughly from my iniquity. Cleanse me from my sin. (Psalms 51:2)

text: וַתִּקֹּד בַּת שֶׁבַע אַפַּיִם אֶרֶץ וַתִּשְׁתַּחוּ לַמֶּלֶךְ וַתֹּאמֶר יְחִי אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ דָּוִד לְעֹלָֽם׃
translation: Then Bathsheba bowed with her face to the earth and showed respect to the king, and said, "Let my lord King David live forever!" (1 Kings 1:31)

text: וַיִּשְׁלַח דָּוִד וַיִּדְרֹשׁ לָֽאִשָּׁה וַיֹּאמֶר הֲלוֹא זֹאת בַּת שֶׁבַע בַּת אֱלִיעָם אֵשֶׁת אוּרִיָּה הַחִתִּֽי׃
translation: David sent and inquired after the woman. One said, "Isn't this Bathsheba, the daughter of Eliam, Uriah the Hittite's wife?" (2 Samuel 11:3)

text: וַיַּעַן הַמֶּלֶךְ דָּוִד וַיֹּאמֶר קִרְאוּ לִי לְבַת שָׁבַע וַתָּבֹא לִפְנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ וַֽתַּעֲמֹד לִפְנֵי הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
translation: Then King David answered, "Call Bathsheba in to me." She came into the king's presence and stood before the king. (1 Kings 1:28)

text: בְּנוֹתַיִךְ בַּשָּׂדֶה בַּחֶרֶב יַהֲרֹג וְנָתַן עָלַיִךְ דָּיֵק וְשָׁפַךְ עָלַיִךְ סֹֽלְלָה וְהֵקִים עָלַיִךְ צִנָּֽה׃
translation: He will kill your daughters in the field with the sword. He will make forts against you, cast up a mound against you, and raise up the buckler against you. (Ezekiel 26:8)

text: וְנָתַתָּה עָלֶיהָ מָצוֹר וּבָנִיתָ עָלֶיהָ דָּיֵק וְשָׁפַכְתָּ עָלֶיהָ סֹֽלְלָה וְנָתַתָּה עָלֶיהָ מַחֲנוֹת וְשִׂים עָלֶיהָ כָּרִים סָבִֽיב׃
translation: Lay siege against it, build forts against it, and cast up a mound against it. Also set camps against it and plant battering rams against it all around. (Ezekiel 4:2)

text: וְלֹא בְחַיִל גָּדוֹל וּבְקָהָל רָב יַעֲשֶׂה אוֹתוֹ פַרְעֹה בַּמִּלְחָמָה בִּשְׁפֹּךְ סֹלְלָה וּבִבְנוֹת דָּיֵק לְהַכְרִית נְפָשׁוֹת רַבּֽוֹת׃
translation: Pharaoh with his mighty army and great company won't help him in the war, when they cast up mounds and build forts to cut off many persons. (Ezekiel 17:17)

text: כִּי כֹה אָמַר יְהוָה צְבָאוֹת כִּרְתוּ עֵצָה וְשִׁפְכוּ עַל יְרוּשָׁלִַם סֹלְלָה הִיא הָעִיר הָפְקַד כֻּלָּהּ עֹשֶׁק בְּקִרְבָּֽהּ׃
translation: For the LORD of Armies said, "Cut down trees, and cast up a mound against Jerusalem. This is the city to be visited. She is filled with oppression within herself. (Jeremiah 6:6)

text: וְיָבֹא מֶלֶךְ הַצָּפוֹן וְיִשְׁפֹּךְ סֽוֹלֲלָה וְלָכַד עִיר מִבְצָרוֹת וּזְרֹעוֹת הַנֶּגֶב לֹא יַעֲמֹדוּ וְעַם מִבְחָרָיו וְאֵין כֹּחַ לַעֲמֹֽד׃
translation: So the king of the north will come and cast up a mound, and take a well-fortified city. The forces of the south won't stand, neither will his select troops, neither will there be any strength to stand. (Daniel 11:15)

text: כִּי כֹה אָמַר יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל עַל בָּתֵּי הָעִיר הַזֹּאת וְעַל בָּתֵּי מַלְכֵי יְהוּדָה הַנְּתֻצִים אֶל הַסֹּלְלוֹת וְאֶל הֶחָֽרֶב׃
translation: For the LORD, the God of Israel, says concerning the houses of this city and concerning the houses of the kings of Judah, which are broken down to make a defense against the mounds and against the sword: (Jeremiah 33:4)

text: חֵלֶב בֶּֽן בַּעֲנָה הַנְּטֹפָתִי אִתַּי בֶּן רִיבַי מִגִּבְעַת בְּנֵי בִנְיָמִֽן׃
translation: Heleb the son of Baanah the Netophathite, Ittai the son of Ribai of Gibeah of the children of Benjamin, (2 Samuel 23:29)

text: וַיֵּאָסְפוּ בְּנֵי הַמְשֹׁרְרִים וּמִן הַכִּכָּר סְבִיבוֹת יְרוּשָׁלִַם וּמִן חַצְרֵי נְטֹפָתִֽי׃
translation: The sons of the singers gathered themselves together, both out of the plain around Jerusalem and from the villages of the Netophathites; (Nehemiah 12:28)

text: בְּנֵי שַׂלְמָא בֵּית לֶחֶם וּנְטוֹפָתִי עַטְרוֹת בֵּית יוֹאָב וַחֲצִי הַמָּנַחְתִּי הַצָּרְעִֽי׃
translation: The sons of Salma: Bethlehem, the Netophathites, Atroth Beth Joab, and half of the Manahathites, the Zorites. (1 Chronicles 2:54)

text: צַלְמוֹן הָֽאֲחֹחִי מַהְרַי הַנְּטֹפָתִֽי׃
translation: Zalmon the Ahohite, Maharai the Netophathite, (2 Samuel 23:28)

text: הַשְּׁנֵים עָשָׂר לִשְׁנֵים עָשָׂר הַחֹדֶשׁ חֶלְדַּי הַנְּטוֹפָתִי לְעָתְנִיאֵל וְעַל מַחֲלֻקְתּוֹ עֶשְׂרִים וְאַרְבָּעָה אָֽלֶף׃
translation: The twelfth captain for the twelfth month was Heldai the Netophathite, of Othniel. In his division were twenty-four thousand. (1 Chronicles 27:15)

text: וְעֹבַדְיָה בֶּֽן שְׁמַֽעְיָה בֶּן גָּלָל בֶּן יְדוּתוּן וּבֶרֶכְיָה בֶן אָסָא בֶּן אֶלְקָנָה הַיּוֹשֵׁב בְּחַצְרֵי נְטוֹפָתִֽי׃
translation: and Obadiah the son of Shemaiah, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun; and Berechiah the son of Asa, the son of Elkanah, who lived in the villages of the Netophathites. (1 Chronicles 9:16)

text: אֵֽין דָּן דִּינֵךְ לְמָזוֹר רְפֻאוֹת תְּעָלָה אֵין לָֽךְ׃
translation: There is no one to plead your cause, that you may be bound up. You have no healing medicines. (Jeremiah 30:13)

text: וַיֵּלְכוּ הַמַּיִם סָבִיב לַמִּזְבֵּחַ וְגַם אֶת הַתְּעָלָה מִלֵּא מָֽיִם׃
translation: The water ran around the altar; and he also filled the trench with water. (1 Kings 18:35)

text: מִֽי פִלַּג לַשֶּׁטֶף תְּעָלָה וְדֶרֶךְ לַחֲזִיז קֹלֽוֹת׃
translation: Who has cut a channel for the flood water, or the path for the thunderstorm, (Job 38:25)

text: וַיִּשְׁלַח מֶֽלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר אֶת רַב שָׁקֵה מִלָּכִישׁ יְרוּשָׁלְַמָה אֶל הַמֶּלֶךְ חִזְקִיָּהוּ בְּחֵיל כָּבֵד וַֽיַּעֲמֹד בִּתְעָלַת הַבְּרֵכָה הָעֶלְיוֹנָה בִּמְסִלַּת שְׂדֵה כוֹבֵֽס׃
translation: The king of Assyria sent Rabshakeh from Lachish to Jerusalem to King Hezekiah with a large army. He stood by the aqueduct from the upper pool in the fuller's field highway. (Isaiah 36:2)

text: וַיֵּאֹתוּ הַכֹּֽהֲנִים לְבִלְתִּי קְחַת כֶּסֶף מֵאֵת הָעָם וּלְבִלְתִּי חַזֵּק אֶת בֶּדֶק הַבָּֽיִת׃
translation: But Jehoiada the priest took a chest and bored a hole in its lid, and set it beside the altar, on the right side as one comes into the LORD's house; and the priests who kept the threshold put all the money that was brought into the LORD's house into it. (2 Kings 12:9)

text: וַיְהִי בִּשְׁנַת עֶשְׂרִים וְשָׁלֹשׁ שָׁנָה לַמֶּלֶךְ יְהוֹאָשׁ לֹֽא חִזְּקוּ הַכֹּהֲנִים אֶת בֶּדֶק הַבָּֽיִת׃
translation: Then King Jehoash called for Jehoiada the priest, and for the other priests, and said to them, "Why aren't you repairing the damage to the house? Now therefore take no more money from your treasurers, but deliver it for repair of the damage to the house." (2 Kings 12:7)

text: זִקְנֵי גְבַל וַחֲכָמֶיהָ הָיוּ בָךְ מַחֲזִיקֵי בִּדְקֵךְ כָּל אֳנִיּוֹת הַיָּם וּמַלָּֽחֵיהֶם הָיוּ בָךְ לַעֲרֹב מַעֲרָבֵֽךְ׃
translation: The old men of Gebal and its wise men were your repairers of ship seams in you. All the ships of the sea with their mariners were in you to deal in your merchandise. (Ezekiel 27:9)

text: יִקְחוּ לָהֶם הַכֹּהֲנִים אִישׁ מֵאֵת מַכָּרוֹ וְהֵם יְחַזְּקוּ אֶת בֶּדֶק הַבַּיִת לְכֹל אֲשֶׁר יִמָּצֵא שָׁם בָּֽדֶק׃
translation: But it was so, that in the twenty-third year of King Jehoash the priests had not repaired the damage to the house. (2 Kings 12:6)

text: וְלַגֹּֽדְרִים וּלְחֹצְבֵי הָאֶבֶן וְלִקְנוֹת עֵצִים וְאַבְנֵי מַחְצֵב לְחַזֵּק אֶת בֶּדֶק בֵּית יְהוָה וּלְכֹל אֲשֶׁר יֵצֵא עַל הַבַּיִת לְחָזְקָֽה׃
translation: But there were not made for the LORD's house cups of silver, snuffers, basins, trumpets, any vessels of gold or vessels of silver, of the money that was brought into the LORD's house; (2 Kings 12:13)

text: וַֽיִּתְּנוּ עַל יַד עֹשֵׂה הַמְּלָאכָה הַמֻּפְקָדִים בְּבֵית יְהוָה וַיִּתְּנוּ אֹתוֹ עוֹשֵׂי הַמְּלָאכָה אֲשֶׁר עֹשִׂים בְּבֵית יְהוָה לִבְדּוֹק וּלְחַזֵּק הַבָּֽיִת׃
translation: They delivered it into the hands of the workmen who had the oversight of the LORD's house; and the workmen who labored in the LORD's house gave it to mend and repair the house. (2 Chronicles 34:10)

text: בֵּאדַיִן מַלְכָּא בִּשְׁפַּרְפָּרָא יְקוּם בְּנָגְהָא וּבְהִתְבְּהָלָה לְגֻבָּא דִֽי אַרְיָוָתָא אֲזַֽל׃
translation: When he came near to the den to Daniel, he cried with a troubled voice. The king spoke and said to Daniel, "Daniel, servant of the living God, is your God, whom you serve continually, able to deliver you from the lions?" (Daniel 6:20)

text: מְשֵׁיזִב וּמַצִּל וְעָבֵד אָתִין וְתִמְהִין בִּשְׁמַיָּא וּבְאַרְעָא דִּי שֵׁיזִיב לְדָֽנִיֵּאל מִן יַד אַרְיָוָתָֽא׃
translation: So this Daniel prospered in the reign of Darius and in the reign of Cyrus the Persian. (Daniel 6:28)

text: וְכִנַּסְתִּי אֶתְכֶם וְנָפַחְתִּי עֲלֵיכֶם בְּאֵשׁ עֶבְרָתִי וְנִתַּכְתֶּם בְּתוֹכָֽהּ׃
translation: Yes, I will gather you, and blow on you with the fire of my wrath, and you will be melted in the middle of it. (Ezekiel 22:21)

text: כִּֽי קָצַר הַמַּצָּע מֵֽהִשְׂתָּרֵעַ וְהַמַּסֵּכָה צָרָה כְּהִתְכַּנֵּֽס׃
translation: For the bed is too short to stretch out on, and the blanket is too narrow to wrap oneself in. (Isaiah 28:20)

text: בּוֹנֵה יְרוּשָׁלִַם יְהוָה נִדְחֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל יְכַנֵּֽס׃
translation: The LORD builds up Jerusalem. He gathers together the outcasts of Israel. (Psalms 147:2)

text: עֵת לְהַשְׁלִיךְ אֲבָנִים וְעֵת כְּנוֹס אֲבָנִים עֵת לַחֲבוֹק וְעֵת לִרְחֹק מֵחַבֵּֽק׃
translation: a time to cast away stones, and a time to gather stones together; a time to embrace, and a time to refrain from embracing; (Ecclesiastes 3:5)

text: כָּנַסְתִּי לִי גַּם כֶּסֶף וְזָהָב וּסְגֻלַּת מְלָכִים וְהַמְּדִינוֹת עָשִׂיתִי לִי שָׁרִים וְשָׁרוֹת וְתַעֲנוּגֹת בְּנֵי הָאָדָם שִׁדָּה וְשִׁדּֽוֹת׃
translation: I also gathered silver and gold for myself, and the treasure of kings and of the provinces. I got myself male and female singers, and the delights of the sons of men: musical instruments of all sorts. (Ecclesiastes 2:8)

text: וְיָדְעוּ כִּי אֲנִי יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵיהֶם בְּהַגְלוֹתִי אֹתָם אֶל הַגּוֹיִם וְכִנַּסְתִּים עַל אַדְמָתָם וְלֹֽא אוֹתִיר עוֹד מֵהֶם שָֽׁם׃
translation: They will know that I am the LORD their God, in that I caused them to go into captivity among the nations, and have gathered them to their own land. Then I will leave none of them captive any more. (Ezekiel 39:28)

text: בְּלֵב יַמִּים גְּבוּלָיִךְ בֹּנַיִךְ כָּלְלוּ יָפְיֵֽךְ׃
translation: Your borders are in the heart of the seas. Your builders have perfected your beauty. (Ezekiel 27:4)

text: וּמִבְּנֵי פַּחַת מוֹאָב עַדְנָא וּכְלָל בְּנָיָה מַעֲשֵׂיָה מַתַּנְיָה בְצַלְאֵל וּבִנּוּי וּמְנַשֶּֽׁה׃
translation: Of the sons of Pahathmoab: Adna, Chelal, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattaniah, Bezalel, Binnui, and Manasseh. (Ezra 10:30)

text: אֱדַיִן שְׁאֵלְנָא לְשָׂבַיָּא אִלֵּךְ כְּנֵמָא אֲמַרְנָא לְּהֹם מַן שָׂם לְכֹם טְעֵם בַּיְתָא דְנָה לְמִבְנְיָה וְאֻשַּׁרְנָא דְנָה לְשַׁכְלָלָֽה׃
translation: Then we asked those elders, and said to them thus, "Who gave you a decree to build this house, and to finish this wall?" (Ezra 5:9)

text: בְּנֵי אַרְוַד וְחֵילֵךְ עַל חוֹמוֹתַיִךְ סָבִיב וְגַמָּדִים בְּמִגְדְּלוֹתַיִךְ הָיוּ שִׁלְטֵיהֶם תִּלּוּ עַל חוֹמוֹתַיִךְ סָבִיב הֵמָּה כָּלְלוּ יָפְיֵֽךְ׃
translation: The men of Arvad with your army were on your walls all around, and valiant men were in your towers. They hung their shields on your walls all around. They have perfected your beauty. (Ezekiel 27:11)

text: כְּעַן יְדִיעַ לֶהֱוֵא לְמַלְכָּא דִּי הֵן קִרְיְתָא דָךְ תִּתְבְּנֵא וְשׁוּרַיָּה יִֽשְׁתַּכְלְלוּן מִנְדָּֽה בְלוֹ וַהֲלָךְ לָא יִנְתְּנוּן וְאַפְּתֹם מַלְכִים תְּהַנְזִֽק׃
translation: Be it known now to the king that if this city is built and the walls finished, they will not pay tribute, custom, or toll, and in the end it will be hurtful to the kings. (Ezra 4:13)

text: גַּם הַיּוֹם מְרִי שִׂחִי יָדִי כָּבְדָה עַל אַנְחָתִֽי׃
translation: "Even today my complaint is rebellious. His hand is heavy in spite of my groaning. (Job 23:2)

text: אֲֽדֹנָי נֶגְדְּךָ כָל תַּאֲוָתִי וְאַנְחָתִי מִמְּךָ לֹא נִסְתָּֽרָה׃
translation: My heart throbs. My strength fails me. As for the light of my eyes, it has also left me. (Psalms 38:10)

text: כִּי כָלוּ בְיָגוֹן חַיַּי וּשְׁנוֹתַי בַּאֲנָחָה כָּשַׁל בַּעֲוֺנִי כֹחִי וַעֲצָמַי עָשֵֽׁשׁוּ׃
translation: Because of all my adversaries I have become utterly contemptible to my neighbors, a horror to my acquaintances. Those who saw me on the street fled from me. (Psalms 31:11)

text: מִקּוֹל אַנְחָתִי דָּבְקָה עַצְמִי לִבְשָׂרִֽי׃
translation: I am like a pelican of the wilderness. I have become as an owl of the waste places. (Psalms 102:6)

text: אָמַרְתָּ אֽוֹי נָא לִי כִּֽי יָסַף יְהוָה יָגוֹן עַל מַכְאֹבִי יָגַעְתִּי בְּאַנְחָתִי וּמְנוּחָה לֹא מָצָֽאתִי׃
translation: 'You said, "Woe is me now! For the LORD has added sorrow to my pain! I am weary with my groaning, and I find no rest."' (Jeremiah 45:3)

text: וּפְדוּיֵי יְהוָה יְשֻׁבוּן וּבָאוּ צִיּוֹן בְּרִנָּה וְשִׂמְחַת עוֹלָם עַל רֹאשָׁם שָׂשׂוֹן וְשִׂמְחָה יַשִּׂיגוּ וְנָסוּ יָגוֹן וַאֲנָחָֽה׃
translation: Then the LORD's ransomed ones will return, and come with singing to Zion; and everlasting joy will be on their heads. They will obtain gladness and joy, and sorrow and sighing will flee away." (Isaiah 35:10)

text: וְֽיָדַעְתָּ כִּי רַב זַרְעֶךָ וְצֶאֱצָאֶיךָ כְּעֵשֶׂב הָאָֽרֶץ׃
translation: You will know also that your offspring will be great, your offspring as the grass of the earth. (Job 5:25)

text: אִם יִרְבּוּ בָנָיו לְמוֹ חָרֶב וְצֶאֱצָאָיו לֹא יִשְׂבְּעוּ לָֽחֶם׃
translation: If his children are multiplied, it is for the sword. His offspring will not be satisfied with bread. (Job 27:14)

text: זַרְעָם נָכוֹן לִפְנֵיהֶם עִמָּם וְצֶאֱצָאֵיהֶם לְעֵינֵיהֶֽם׃
translation: Their child is established with them in their sight, their offspring before their eyes. (Job 21:8)

text: אֶזְרְעָה וְאַחֵר יֹאכֵל וְֽצֶאֱצָאַי יְשֹׁרָֽשׁוּ׃
translation: then let me sow, and let another eat. Yes, let the produce of my field be rooted out. (Job 31:8)

text: קִרְבוּ גוֹיִם לִשְׁמֹעַ וּלְאֻמִּים הַקְשִׁיבוּ תִּשְׁמַע הָאָרֶץ וּמְלֹאָהּ תֵּבֵל וְכָל צֶאֱצָאֶֽיהָ׃
translation: Come near, you nations, to hear! Listen, you peoples. Let the earth and all it contains hear, the world, and everything that comes from it. (Isaiah 34:1)

text: וַיְהִי כַחוֹל זַרְעֶךָ וְצֶאֱצָאֵי מֵעֶיךָ כִּמְעֹתָיו לֹֽא יִכָּרֵת וְֽלֹא יִשָּׁמֵד שְׁמוֹ מִלְּפָנָֽי׃
translation: Your offspring also would have been as the sand and the descendants of your body like its grains. His name would not be cut off nor destroyed from before me." (Isaiah 48:19)

text: אִם תִּקְטֹל אֱלוֹהַּ רָשָׁע וְאַנְשֵׁי דָמִים סוּרוּ מֶֽנִּי׃
translation: If only you, God, would kill the wicked. Get away from me, you bloodthirsty men! (Psalms 139:19)

text: לָאוֹר יָקוּם רוֹצֵחַ יִֽקְטָל עָנִי וְאֶבְיוֹן וּבַלַּיְלָה יְהִי כַגַּנָּֽב׃
translation: The murderer rises with the light. He kills the poor and needy. In the night he is like a thief. (Job 24:14)

text: בֵּהּ בְּלֵילְיָא קְטִיל בֵּלְאשַׁצַּר מַלְכָּא כשדיא כַשְׂדָּאָֽה׃
translation: In that night Belshazzar the Chaldean King was slain. (Daniel 5:30)

text: וְחַתּוּ גִבּוֹרֶיךָ תֵּימָן לְמַעַן יִכָּֽרֶת אִישׁ מֵהַר עֵשָׂו מִקָּֽטֶל׃
translation: Your mighty men, Teman, will be dismayed, to the end that everyone may be cut off from the mountain of Esau by slaughter. (Obadiah 1:9)

text: הֵן יִקְטְלֵנִי לא לוֹ אֲיַחֵל אַךְ דְּרָכַי אֶל פָּנָיו אוֹכִֽיחַ׃
translation: Behold, he will kill me. I have no hope. Nevertheless, I will maintain my ways before him. (Job 13:15)

text: מִזֶּרֶם הָרִים יִרְטָבוּ וּֽמִבְּלִי מַחְסֶה חִבְּקוּ צֽוּר׃
translation: They are wet with the showers of the mountains, and embrace the rock for lack of a shelter. (Job 24:8)

text: זֹרְמוּ מַיִם עָבוֹת קוֹל נָתְנוּ שְׁחָקִים אַף חֲצָצֶיךָ יִתְהַלָּֽכוּ׃
translation: The voice of your thunder was in the whirlwind. The lightnings lit up the world. The earth trembled and shook. (Psalms 77:18)

text: וְסֻכָּה תִּהְיֶה לְצֵל יוֹמָם מֵחֹרֶב וּלְמַחְסֶה וּלְמִסְתּוֹר מִזֶּרֶם וּמִמָּטָֽר׃
translation: There will be a pavilion for a shade in the daytime from the heat, and for a refuge and for a shelter from storm and from rain. (Isaiah 4:6)

text: זְרַמְתָּם שֵׁנָה יִהְיוּ בַּבֹּקֶר כֶּחָצִיר יַחֲלֹֽף׃
translation: You sweep them away as they sleep. In the morning they sprout like new grass. (Psalms 90:5)

text: רָאוּךָ יָחִילוּ הָרִים זֶרֶם מַיִם עָבָר נָתַן תְּהוֹם קוֹלוֹ רוֹם יָדֵיהוּ נָשָֽׂא׃
translation: The mountains saw you, and were afraid. The storm of waters passed by. The deep roared and lifted up its hands on high. (Habakkuk 3:10)

text: וְהָיָה אִישׁ כְּמַֽחֲבֵא רוּחַ וְסֵתֶר זָרֶם כְּפַלְגֵי מַיִם בְּצָיוֹן כְּצֵל סֶֽלַע כָּבֵד בְּאֶרֶץ עֲיֵפָֽה׃
translation: A man shall be as a hiding place from the wind, and a covert from the storm, as streams of water in a dry place, as the shade of a large rock in a weary land. (Isaiah 32:2)

text: שְׁתוּלִים בְּבֵית יְהוָה בְּחַצְרוֹת אֱלֹהֵינוּ יַפְרִֽיחוּ׃
translation: They will still produce fruit in old age. They will be full of sap and green, (Psalms 92:14)

text: אֶשְׁתְּךָ כְּגֶפֶן פֹּרִיָּה בְּיַרְכְּתֵי בֵיתֶךָ בָּנֶיךָ כִּשְׁתִלֵי זֵיתִים סָבִיב לְשֻׁלְחָנֶֽךָ׃
translation: Your wife will be as a fruitful vine in the innermost parts of your house, your children like olive shoots around your table. (Psalms 128:3)

text: וְעַתָּה שְׁתוּלָה בַמִּדְבָּר בְּאֶרֶץ צִיָּה וְצָמָֽא׃
translation: Now it is planted in the wilderness, in a dry and thirsty land. (Ezekiel 19:13)

text: אֶפְרַיִם כַּאֲשֶׁר רָאִיתִי לְצוֹר שְׁתוּלָה בְנָוֶה וְאֶפְרַיִם לְהוֹצִיא אֶל הֹרֵג בָּנָֽיו׃
translation: I have seen Ephraim, like Tyre, planted in a pleasant place; but Ephraim will bring out his children to the murderer. (Hosea 9:13)

text: וְהִנֵּה שְׁתוּלָה הֲתִצְלָח הֲלוֹא כְגַעַת בָּהּ רוּחַ הַקָּדִים תִּיבַשׁ יָבֹשׁ עַל עֲרֻגֹת צִמְחָהּ תִּיבָֽשׁ׃
translation: Yes, behold, being planted, will it prosper? Won't it utterly wither when the east wind touches it? It will wither in the ground where it grew."'" (Ezekiel 17:10)

text: וְֽהָיָה כְּעֵץ שָׁתוּל עַֽל פַּלְגֵי מָיִם אֲשֶׁר פִּרְיוֹ יִתֵּן בְּעִתּוֹ וְעָלֵהוּ לֹֽא יִבּוֹל וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר יַעֲשֶׂה יַצְלִֽיחַ׃
translation: He will be like a tree planted by the streams of water, that produces its fruit in its season, whose leaf also does not wither. Whatever he does shall prosper. (Psalms 1:3)

text: יֵשֵׁב בְּמַאְרַב חֲצֵרִים בַּֽמִּסְתָּרִים יַהֲרֹג נָקִי עֵינָיו לְֽחֵלְכָה יִצְפֹּֽנוּ׃
translation: He lies in wait near the villages. From ambushes, he murders the innocent. His eyes are secretly set against the helpless. (Psalms 10:8)

text: דִּמְיֹנוֹ כְּאַרְיֵה יִכְסוֹף לִטְרוֹף וְכִכְפִיר יֹשֵׁב בְּמִסְתָּרִֽים׃
translation: He is like a lion that is greedy of his prey, as it were a young lion lurking in secret places. (Psalms 17:12)

text: לִירוֹת בַּמִּסְתָּרִים תָּם פִּתְאֹם יֹרֻהוּ וְלֹא יִירָֽאוּ׃
translation: They encourage themselves in evil plans. They talk about laying snares secretly. They say, "Who will see them?" (Psalms 64:5)

text: יֶאֱרֹב בַּמִּסְתָּר כְּאַרְיֵה בְסֻכֹּה יֶאֱרֹב לַחֲטוֹף עָנִי יַחְטֹף עָנִי בְּמָשְׁכוֹ בְרִשְׁתּֽוֹ׃
translation: He lurks in secret as a lion in his ambush. He lies in wait to catch the helpless. He catches the helpless when he draws him in his net. (Psalms 10:9)

text: נָקַבְתָּ בְמַטָּיו רֹאשׁ פרזו פְּרָזָיו יִסְעֲרוּ לַהֲפִיצֵנִי עֲלִיצֻתָם כְּמוֹ לֶאֱכֹל עָנִי בַּמִּסְתָּֽר׃
translation: You pierced the heads of his warriors with their own spears. They came as a whirlwind to scatter me, gloating as if to devour the wretched in secret. (Habakkuk 3:14)

text: נִבְזֶה וַחֲדַל אִישִׁים אִישׁ מַכְאֹבוֹת וִידוּעַ חֹלִי וּכְמַסְתֵּר פָּנִים מִמֶּנּוּ נִבְזֶה וְלֹא חֲשַׁבְנֻֽהוּ׃
translation: He was despised and rejected by men, a man of suffering and acquainted with disease. He was despised as one from whom men hide their face; and we didn't respect him. (Isaiah 53:3)

text: הִנֵּה יַבִּיעוּן בְּפִיהֶם חֲרָבוֹת בְּשִׂפְתוֹתֵיהֶם כִּי מִי שֹׁמֵֽעַ׃
translation: But you, LORD, laugh at them. You scoff at all the nations. (Psalms 59:8)

text: לְשׁוֹן חֲכָמִים תֵּיטִיב דָּעַת וּפִי כְסִילִים יַבִּיעַ אִוֶּֽלֶת׃
translation: The tongue of the wise commends knowledge, but the mouths of fools gush out folly. (Proverbs 15:2)

text: לֵב צַדִּיק יֶהְגֶּה לַעֲנוֹת וּפִי רְשָׁעִים יַבִּיעַ רָעֽוֹת׃
translation: The heart of the righteous weighs answers, but the mouth of the wicked gushes out evil. (Proverbs 15:28)

text: יַבִּיעוּ יְדַבְּרוּ עָתָק יִֽתְאַמְּרוּ כָּל פֹּעֲלֵי אָֽוֶן׃
translation: They pour out arrogant words. All the evildoers boast. (Psalms 94:4)

text: תָּשׁוּבוּ לְֽתוֹכַחְתִּי הִנֵּה אַבִּיעָה לָכֶם רוּחִי אוֹדִיעָה דְבָרַי אֶתְכֶֽם׃
translation: Turn at my reproof. Behold, I will pour out my spirit on you. I will make known my words to you. (Proverbs 1:23)

text: מַיִם עֲמֻקִּים דִּבְרֵי פִי אִישׁ נַחַל נֹבֵעַ מְקוֹר חָכְמָֽה׃
translation: The words of a man's mouth are like deep waters. The fountain of wisdom is like a flowing brook. (Proverbs 18:4)

text: בְּֽרָעָתוֹ יִדָּחֶה רָשָׁע וְחֹסֶה בְמוֹתוֹ צַדִּֽיק׃
translation: The wicked is brought down in his calamity, but in death, the righteous has a refuge. (Proverbs 14:32)

text: נְאֻם אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה מְקַבֵּץ נִדְחֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל עוֹד אֲקַבֵּץ עָלָיו לְנִקְבָּצָֽיו׃
translation: The Lord GOD, who gathers the outcasts of Israel, says, "I will yet gather others to him, in addition to his own who are gathered." (Isaiah 56:8)

text: עַד אָנָה תְּהֽוֹתְתוּ עַל אִישׁ תְּרָצְּחוּ כֻלְּכֶם כְּקִיר נָטוּי גָּדֵר הַדְּחוּיָֽה׃
translation: They fully intend to throw him down from his lofty place. They delight in lies. They bless with their mouth, but they curse inwardly. Selah. (Psalms 62:4)

text: דַּחֹה דְחִיתַנִי לִנְפֹּל וַיהוָה עֲזָרָֽנִי׃
translation: You pushed me back hard, to make me fall, but the LORD helped me. (Psalms 118:13)

text: שָׁמְרֵנִי יְהוָה מִידֵי רָשָׁע מֵאִישׁ חֲמָסִים תִּנְצְרֵנִי אֲשֶׁר חָשְׁבוּ לִדְחוֹת פְּעָמָֽי׃
translation: The proud have hidden a snare for me, they have spread the cords of a net by the path. They have set traps for me. Selah. (Psalms 140:5)

text: וְנָשָׂא נֵס לַגּוֹיִם וְאָסַף נִדְחֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וּנְפֻצוֹת יְהוּדָה יְקַבֵּץ מֵאַרְבַּע כַּנְפוֹת הָאָֽרֶץ׃
translation: He will set up a banner for the nations, and will assemble the outcasts of Israel, and gather together the dispersed of Judah from the four corners of the earth. (Isaiah 11:12)

text: וַיִּיקֶץ נֹחַ מִיֵּינוֹ וַיֵּדַע אֵת אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה לוֹ בְּנוֹ הַקָּטָֽן׃
translation: Noah awoke from his wine, and knew what his youngest son had done to him. (Genesis 9:24)

text: וַיִּקַץ כְּיָשֵׁן אֲדֹנָי כְּגִבּוֹר מִתְרוֹנֵן מִיָּֽיִן׃
translation: Then the Lord awakened as one out of sleep, like a mighty man who shouts by reason of wine. (Psalms 78:65)

text: וַיִּיקַץ יַעֲקֹב מִשְּׁנָתוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר אָכֵן יֵשׁ יְהוָה בַּמָּקוֹם הַזֶּה וְאָנֹכִי לֹא יָדָֽעְתִּי׃
translation: Jacob awakened out of his sleep, and he said, "Surely the LORD is in this place, and I didn't know it." (Genesis 28:16)

text: וַתִּבְלַעְנָה הַשִּׁבֳּלִים הַדַּקּוֹת אֵת שֶׁבַע הַֽשִּׁבֳּלִים הַבְּרִיאוֹת וְהַמְּלֵאוֹת וַיִּיקַץ פַּרְעֹה וְהִנֵּה חֲלֽוֹם׃
translation: The thin heads of grain swallowed up the seven healthy and full ears. Pharaoh awoke, and behold, it was a dream. (Genesis 41:7)

text: וַתֹּאכַלְנָה הַפָּרוֹת רָעוֹת הַמַּרְאֶה וְדַקֹּת הַבָּשָׂר אֵת שֶׁבַע הַפָּרוֹת יְפֹת הַמַּרְאֶה וְהַבְּרִיאֹת וַיִּיקַץ פַּרְעֹֽה׃
translation: The ugly and thin cattle ate up the seven sleek and fat cattle. So Pharaoh awoke. (Genesis 41:4)

text: וַתָּבֹאנָה אֶל קִרְבֶּנָה וְלֹא נוֹדַע כִּי בָאוּ אֶל קִרְבֶּנָה וּמַרְאֵיהֶן רַע כַּאֲשֶׁר בַּתְּחִלָּה וָאִיקָֽץ׃
translation: and when they had eaten them up, it couldn't be known that they had eaten them, but they were still ugly, as at the beginning. So I awoke. (Genesis 41:21)

text: מַיִם שָׁאַל חָלָב נָתָנָה בְּסֵפֶל אַדִּירִים הִקְרִיבָה חֶמְאָֽה׃
translation: He asked for water. She gave him milk. She brought him butter in a lordly dish. (Judges 5:25)

text: בִּרְחֹץ הֲלִיכַי בְּחֵמָה וְצוּר יָצוּק עִמָּדִי פַּלְגֵי שָֽׁמֶן׃
translation: when my steps were washed with butter, and the rock poured out streams of oil for me, (Job 29:6)

text: חֶמְאָה וּדְבַשׁ יֹאכֵל לְדַעְתּוֹ מָאוֹס בָּרָע וּבָחוֹר בַּטּֽוֹב׃
translation: He shall eat butter and honey when he knows to refuse the evil and choose the good. (Isaiah 7:15)

text: אַל יֵרֶא בִפְלַגּוֹת נַהֲרֵי נַחֲלֵי דְּבַשׁ וְחֶמְאָֽה׃
translation: He will not look at the rivers, the flowing streams of honey and butter. (Job 20:17)

text: כִּי מִיץ חָלָב יוֹצִיא חֶמְאָה וּֽמִיץ אַף יוֹצִיא דָם וּמִיץ אַפַּיִם יוֹצִיא רִֽיב׃
translation: For as the churning of milk produces butter, and the wringing of the nose produces blood, so the forcing of wrath produces strife." (Proverbs 30:33)

text: וְהָיָה מֵרֹב עֲשׂוֹת חָלָב יֹאכַל חֶמְאָה כִּֽי חֶמְאָה וּדְבַשׁ יֹאכֵל כָּל הַנּוֹתָר בְּקֶרֶב הָאָֽרֶץ׃
translation: It shall happen, that because of the abundance of milk which they shall give he shall eat butter, for everyone will eat butter and honey that is left within the land. (Isaiah 7:22)

text: מַחְשְׁבוֹת חָרוּץ אַךְ לְמוֹתָר וְכָל אָץ אַךְ לְמַחְסֽוֹר׃
translation: The plans of the diligent surely lead to profit; and everyone who is hasty surely rushes to poverty. (Proverbs 21:5)

text: אִישׁ אֱמוּנוֹת רַב בְּרָכוֹת וְאָץ לְהַעֲשִׁיר לֹא יִנָּקֶֽה׃
translation: A faithful man is rich with blessings; but one who is eager to be rich will not go unpunished. (Proverbs 28:20)

text: גַּם בְּלֹא דַעַת נֶפֶשׁ לֹא טוֹב וְאָץ בְּרַגְלַיִם חוֹטֵֽא׃
translation: It isn't good to have zeal without knowledge, nor to be hasty with one's feet and miss the way. (Proverbs 19:2)

text: חָזִיתָ אִישׁ אָץ בִּדְבָרָיו תִּקְוָה לִכְסִיל מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃
translation: Do you see a man who is hasty in his words? There is more hope for a fool than for him. (Proverbs 29:20)

text: וְהַנֹּגְשִׂים אָצִים לֵאמֹר כַּלּוּ מַעֲשֵׂיכֶם דְּבַר יוֹם בְּיוֹמוֹ כַּאֲשֶׁר בִּהְיוֹת הַתֶּֽבֶן׃
translation: The taskmasters were urgent saying, "Fulfill your work quota daily, as when there was straw!" (Exodus 5:13)

text: עַל כֵּן אָמַרְתִּי שְׁעוּ מִנִּי אֲמָרֵר בַּבֶּכִי אַל תָּאִיצוּ לְנַֽחֲמֵנִי עַל שֹׁד בַּת עַמִּֽי׃
translation: Therefore I said, "Look away from me. I will weep bitterly. Don't labor to comfort me for the destruction of the daughter of my people. (Isaiah 22:4)

text: עַד אָן תְּמַלֶּל אֵלֶּה וְרוּחַ כַּבִּיר אִמְרֵי פִֽיךָ׃
translation: "How long will you speak these things? Shall the words of your mouth be a mighty wind? (Job 8:2)

text: אֱדַיִן דָּנִיֶּאל עִם מַלְכָּא מַלִּל מַלְכָּא לְעָלְמִין חֱיִֽי׃
translation: My God has sent his angel, and has shut the lions' mouths, and they have not hurt me, because innocence was found in me before him; and also before you, O king, I have done no harm." (Daniel 6:22)

text: יֹֽשֶׁר לִבִּי אֲמָרָי וְדַעַת שְׂפָתַי בָּרוּר מִלֵּֽלוּ׃
translation: My words will utter the uprightness of my heart. That which my lips know they will speak sincerely. (Job 33:3)

text: מִי יְמַלֵּל גְּבוּרוֹת יְהוָה יַשְׁמִיעַ כָּל תְּהִלָּתֽוֹ׃
translation: Who can utter the mighty acts of the LORD, or fully declare all his praise? (Psalms 106:2)

text: קֹרֵץ בְּעֵינָו מֹלֵל בְּרַגְלָו מֹרֶה בְּאֶצְבְּעֹתָֽיו׃
translation: who winks with his eyes, who signals with his feet, who motions with his fingers, (Proverbs 6:13)

text: וַתֹּאמֶר מִי מִלֵּל לְאַבְרָהָם הֵינִיקָה בָנִים שָׂרָה כִּֽי יָלַדְתִּי בֵן לִזְקֻנָֽיו׃
translation: She said, "Who would have said to Abraham that Sarah would nurse children? For I have borne him a son in his old age." (Genesis 21:7)

text: וַיֶּחֱמוּ הַצֹּאן אֶל הַמַּקְלוֹת וַתֵּלַדְןָ הַצֹּאן עֲקֻדִּים נְקֻדִּים וּטְלֻאִֽים׃
translation: The flocks conceived before the rods, and the flocks produced streaked, speckled, and spotted. (Genesis 30:39)

text: וַיָּקָם וַיָּבֹא וַיֵּלֶךְ שֹׁמְרוֹן הוּא בֵּֽית עֵקֶד הָרֹעִים בַּדָּֽרֶךְ׃
translation: He arose and departed, and went to Samaria. As he was at the shearing house of the shepherds on the way, (2 Kings 10:12)

text: וַיְהִי בְּעֵת יַחֵם הַצֹּאן וָאֶשָּׂא עֵינַי וָאֵרֶא בַּחֲלוֹם וְהִנֵּה הָֽעַתֻּדִים הָעֹלִים עַל הַצֹּאן עֲקֻדִּים נְקֻדִּים וּבְרֻדִּֽים׃
translation: During mating season, I lifted up my eyes, and saw in a dream, and behold, the male goats which leaped on the flock were streaked, speckled, and grizzled. (Genesis 31:10)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר תִּפְשׂוּם חַיִּים וַֽיִּתְפְּשׂוּם חַיִּים וַֽיִּשְׁחָטוּם אֶל בּוֹר בֵּֽית עֵקֶד אַרְבָּעִים וּשְׁנַיִם אִישׁ וְלֹֽא הִשְׁאִיר אִישׁ מֵהֶֽם׃
translation: He said, "Take them alive!" They took them alive, and killed them at the pit of the shearing house, even forty-two men. He didn't leave any of them. (2 Kings 10:14)

text: אִם כֹּה יֹאמַר נְקֻדִּים יִהְיֶה שְׂכָרֶךָ וְיָלְדוּ כָל הַצֹּאן נְקֻדִּים וְאִם כֹּה יֹאמַר עֲקֻדִּים יִהְיֶה שְׂכָרֶךָ וְיָלְדוּ כָל הַצֹּאן עֲקֻדִּֽים׃
translation: If he said, 'The speckled will be your wages,' then all the flock bore speckled. If he said, 'The streaked will be your wages,' then all the flock bore streaked. (Genesis 31:8)

text: גַּם אִם יִשְׁכְּבוּ שְׁנַיִם וְחַם לָהֶם וּלְאֶחָד אֵיךְ יֵחָֽם׃
translation: Again, if two lie together, then they have warmth; but how can one keep warm alone? (Ecclesiastes 4:11)

text: וְהַמֶּלֶךְ דָּוִד זָקֵן בָּא בַּיָּמִים וַיְכַסֻּהוּ בַּבְּגָדִים וְלֹא יִחַם לֽוֹ׃
translation: Now King David was old and advanced in years; and they covered him with clothes, but he couldn't keep warm. (1 Kings 1:1)

text: הֵן בְּעָווֹן חוֹלָלְתִּי וּבְחֵטְא יֶֽחֱמַתְנִי אִמִּֽי׃
translation: Purify me with hyssop, and I will be clean. Wash me, and I will be whiter than snow. (Psalms 51:7)

text: וְהָיָה בְּכָל יַחֵם הַצֹּאן הַמְקֻשָּׁרוֹת וְשָׂם יַעֲקֹב אֶת הַמַּקְלוֹת לְעֵינֵי הַצֹּאן בָּרֳהָטִים לְיַחְמֵנָּה בַּמַּקְלֽוֹת׃
translation: Whenever the stronger of the flock conceived, Jacob laid the rods in front of the eyes of the flock in the watering troughs, that they might conceive among the rods; (Genesis 30:41)

text: וַיַּצֵּג אֶת הַמַּקְלוֹת אֲשֶׁר פִּצֵּל בָּרֳהָטִים בְּשִֽׁקֲתוֹת הַמָּיִם אֲשֶׁר תָּבֹאןָ הַצֹּאן לִשְׁתּוֹת לְנֹכַח הַצֹּאן וַיֵּחַמְנָה בְּבֹאָן לִשְׁתּֽוֹת׃
translation: He set the rods which he had peeled opposite the flocks in the watering troughs where the flocks came to drink. They conceived when they came to drink. (Genesis 30:38)

text: רֵאשִׁית חָכְמָה קְנֵה חָכְמָה וּבְכָל קִנְיָנְךָ קְנֵה בִינָֽה׃
translation: Wisdom is supreme. Get wisdom. Yes, though it costs all your possessions, get understanding. (Proverbs 4:7)

text: מָֽה רַבּוּ מַעֲשֶׂיךָ יְֽהוָה כֻּלָּם בְּחָכְמָה עָשִׂיתָ מָלְאָה הָאָרֶץ קִנְיָנֶֽךָ׃
translation: LORD, how many are your works! In wisdom, you have made them all. The earth is full of your riches. (Psalms 104:24)

text: שָׂמוֹ אָדוֹן לְבֵיתוֹ וּמֹשֵׁל בְּכָל קִנְיָנֽוֹ׃
translation: He made him lord of his house, and ruler of all of his possessions, (Psalms 105:21)

text: מִקְנֵהֶם וְקִנְיָנָם וְכָל בְּהֶמְתָּם הֲלוֹא לָנוּ הֵם אַךְ נֵאוֹתָה לָהֶם וְיֵשְׁבוּ אִתָּֽנוּ׃
translation: Won't their livestock and their possessions and all their animals be ours? Only let's give our consent to them, and they will dwell with us." (Genesis 34:23)

text: וְכֹהֵן כִּֽי יִקְנֶה נֶפֶשׁ קִנְיַן כַּסְפּוֹ הוּא יֹאכַל בּוֹ וִילִיד בֵּיתוֹ הֵם יֹאכְלוּ בְלַחְמֽוֹ׃
translation: But if a priest buys a slave, purchased by his money, he shall eat of it; and those who are born in his house shall eat of his bread. (Leviticus 22:11)

text: כִּֽי הָיוּ בְנֵֽי יוֹסֵף שְׁנֵי מַטּוֹת מְנַשֶּׁה וְאֶפְרָיִם וְלֹֽא נָתְנוּ חֵלֶק לַלְוִיִּם בָּאָרֶץ כִּי אִם עָרִים לָשֶׁבֶת וּמִגְרְשֵׁיהֶם לְמִקְנֵיהֶם וּלְקִנְיָנָֽם׃
translation: For the children of Joseph were two tribes, Manasseh and Ephraim. They gave no portion to the Levites in the land, except cities to dwell in, with their pasture lands for their livestock and for their property. (Joshua 14:4)

text: בְּגַאֲוַת רָשָׁע יִדְלַק עָנִי יִתָּפְשׂוּ בִּמְזִמּוֹת זוּ חָשָֽׁבוּ׃
translation: In arrogance, the wicked hunt down the weak. They are caught in the schemes that they devise. (Psalms 10:2)

text: וַיָּשֻׁבוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִדְּלֹק אַחֲרֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים וַיָּשֹׁסּוּ אֶת מַחֲנֵיהֶֽם׃
translation: The children of Israel returned from chasing after the Philistines, and they plundered their camp. (1 Samuel 17:53)

text: וְלוֹ הֵכִין כְּלֵי מָוֶת חִצָּיו לְֽדֹלְקִים יִפְעָֽל׃
translation: Behold, he travails with iniquity. Yes, he has conceived mischief, and brought out falsehood. (Psalms 7:14)

text: הוֹי מַשְׁכִּימֵי בַבֹּקֶר שֵׁכָר יִרְדֹּפוּ מְאַחֲרֵי בַנֶּשֶׁף יַיִן יַדְלִיקֵֽם׃
translation: Woe to those who rise up early in the morning, that they may follow strong drink, who stay late into the night, until wine inflames them! (Isaiah 5:11)

text: הַרְבֵּה הָעֵצִים הַדְלֵק הָאֵשׁ הָתֵם הַבָּשָׂר וְהַרְקַח הַמֶּרְקָחָה וְהָעֲצָמוֹת יֵחָֽרוּ׃
translation: Heap on the wood. Make the fire hot. Boil the meat well. Make the broth thick, and let the bones be burned. (Ezekiel 24:10)

text: קַלִּים הָיוּ רֹדְפֵינוּ מִנִּשְׁרֵי שָׁמָיִם עַל הֶהָרִים דְּלָקֻנוּ בַּמִּדְבָּר אָרְבוּ לָֽנוּ׃
translation: Our pursuers were swifter than the eagles of the sky. They chased us on the mountains. They set an ambush for us in the wilderness. (Lamentations 4:19)

text: כִּֽי סַלְעִי וּמְצוּדָתִי אָתָּה וּלְמַעַן שִׁמְךָ תַּֽנְחֵנִי וּֽתְנַהֲלֵֽנִי׃
translation: Pluck me out of the net that they have laid secretly for me, for you are my stronghold. (Psalms 31:4)

text: בִּנְאוֹת דֶּשֶׁא יַרְבִּיצֵנִי עַל מֵי מְנֻחוֹת יְנַהֲלֵֽנִי׃
translation: He makes me lie down in green pastures. He leads me beside still waters. (Psalms 23:2)

text: נָחִיתָ בְחַסְדְּךָ עַם זוּ גָּאָלְתָּ נֵהַלְתָּ בְעָזְּךָ אֶל נְוֵה קָדְשֶֽׁךָ׃
translation: "You, in your loving kindness, have led the people that you have redeemed. You have guided them in your strength to your holy habitation. (Exodus 15:13)

text: אֵין מְנַהֵל לָהּ מִכָּל בָּנִים יָלָדָה וְאֵין מַחֲזִיק בְּיָדָהּ מִכָּל בָּנִים גִּדֵּֽלָה׃
translation: There is no one to guide her among all the sons to whom she has given birth; and there is no one who takes her by the hand among all the sons whom she has brought up. (Isaiah 51:18)

text: וַיּוֹשַׁע יְהוָה אֶת יְחִזְקִיָּהוּ וְאֵת יֹשְׁבֵי יְרוּשָׁלִַם מִיַּד סַנְחֵרִיב מֶֽלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר וּמִיַּד כֹּל וַֽיְנַהֲלֵם מִסָּבִֽיב׃
translation: Thus the LORD saved Hezekiah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem from the hand of Sennacherib the king of Assyria and from the hand of all others, and guided them on every side. (2 Chronicles 32:22)

text: לֹא יִרְעָבוּ וְלֹא יִצְמָאוּ וְלֹא יַכֵּם שָׁרָב וָשָׁמֶשׁ כִּי מְרַחֲמָם יְנַהֲגֵם וְעַל מַבּוּעֵי מַיִם יְנַהֲלֵֽם׃
translation: They shall not hunger nor thirst; neither shall the heat nor sun strike them, for he who has mercy on them will lead them. He will guide them by springs of water. (Isaiah 49:10)

text: צְֽרוֹר הַכֶּסֶף לָקַח בְּיָדוֹ לְיוֹם הַכֵּסֶא יָבֹא בֵיתֽוֹ׃
translation: He has taken a bag of money with him. He will come home at the full moon." (Proverbs 7:20)

text: צְרוֹר הַמֹּר דּוֹדִי לִי בֵּין שָׁדַי יָלִֽין׃
translation: My beloved is to me a sachet of myrrh, that lies between my breasts. (Song of Solomon 1:13)

text: חָתֻם בִּצְרוֹר פִּשְׁעִי וַתִּטְפֹּל עַל עֲוֺנִֽי׃
translation: My disobedience is sealed up in a bag. You fasten up my iniquity. (Job 14:17)

text: וַיְהִי הֵם מְרִיקִים שַׂקֵּיהֶם וְהִנֵּה אִישׁ צְרוֹר כַּסְפּוֹ בְּשַׂקּוֹ וַיִּרְאוּ אֶת צְרֹרוֹת כַּסְפֵּיהֶם הֵמָּה וַאֲבִיהֶם וַיִּירָֽאוּ׃
translation: As they emptied their sacks, behold, each man's bundle of money was in his sack. When they and their father saw their bundles of money, they were afraid. (Genesis 42:35)

text: כִּֽי הִנֵּה אָֽנֹכִי מְצַוֶּה וַהֲנִעוֹתִי בְכָֽל הַגּוֹיִם אֶת בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל כַּאֲשֶׁר יִנּוֹעַ בַּכְּבָרָה וְלֹֽא יִפּוֹל צְרוֹר אָֽרֶץ׃
translation: "For behold, I will command, and I will sift the house of Israel among all the nations as grain is sifted in a sieve, yet not the least kernel will fall on the earth. (Amos 9:9)

text: זְרַעְתֶּם הַרְבֵּה וְהָבֵא מְעָט אָכוֹל וְאֵין לְשָׂבְעָה שָׁתוֹ וְאֵין לְשָׁכְרָה לָבוֹשׁ וְאֵין לְחֹם לוֹ וְהַמִּשְׂתַּכֵּר מִשְׂתַּכֵּר אֶל צְרוֹר נָקֽוּב׃
translation: You have sown much, and bring in little. You eat, but you don't have enough. You drink, but you aren't filled with drink. You clothe yourselves, but no one is warm; and he who earns wages earns wages to put them into a bag with holes in it.' (Haggai 1:6)

text: יָשֵׂם מִדְבָּר לַֽאֲגַם מַיִם וְאֶרֶץ צִיָּה לְמֹצָאֵי מָֽיִם׃
translation: He turns a desert into a pool of water, and a dry land into water springs. (Psalms 107:35)

text: וְהָיוּ שָׁתֹתֶיהָ מְדֻכָּאִים כָּל עֹשֵׂי שֶׂכֶר אַגְמֵי נָֽפֶשׁ׃
translation: The pillars will be broken in pieces. All those who work for hire will be grieved in soul. (Isaiah 19:10)

text: הַהֹפְכִי הַצּוּר אֲגַם מָיִם חַלָּמִישׁ לְמַעְיְנוֹ מָֽיִם׃
translation: who turned the rock into a pool of water, the flint into a spring of waters. (Psalms 114:8)

text: וְשַׂמְתִּיהָ לְמוֹרַשׁ קִפֹּד וְאַגְמֵי מָיִם וְטֵֽאטֵאתִיהָ בְּמַטְאֲטֵא הַשְׁמֵד נְאֻם יְהוָה צְבָאֽוֹת׃
translation: "I will also make it a possession for the porcupine, and pools of water. I will sweep it with the broom of destruction," says the LORD of Armies. (Isaiah 14:23)

text: אַחֲרִיב הָרִים וּגְבָעוֹת וְכָל עֶשְׂבָּם אוֹבִישׁ וְשַׂמְתִּי נְהָרוֹת לָֽאִיִּים וַאֲגַמִּים אוֹבִֽישׁ׃
translation: I will destroy mountains and hills, and dry up all their herbs. I will make the rivers islands, and will dry up the pools. (Isaiah 42:15)

text: אֶפְתַּח עַל שְׁפָיִים נְהָרוֹת וּבְתוֹךְ בְּקָעוֹת מַעְיָנוֹת אָשִׂים מִדְבָּר לַאֲגַם מַיִם וְאֶרֶץ צִיָּה לְמוֹצָאֵי מָֽיִם׃
translation: I will open rivers on the bare heights, and springs in the middle of the valleys. I will make the wilderness a pool of water, and the dry land springs of water. (Isaiah 41:18)

text: דֶּרֶךְ רְשָׁעִים כָּֽאֲפֵלָה לֹא יָדְעוּ בַּמֶּה יִכָּשֵֽׁלוּ׃
translation: The way of the wicked is like darkness. They don't know what they stumble over. (Proverbs 4:19)

text: וְתָפֵק לָֽרָעֵב נַפְשֶׁךָ וְנֶפֶשׁ נַעֲנָה תַּשְׂבִּיעַ וְזָרַח בַּחֹשֶׁךְ אוֹרֶךָ וַאֲפֵלָתְךָ כַּֽצָּהֳרָֽיִם׃
translation: and if you pour out your soul to the hungry, and satisfy the afflicted soul, then your light will rise in darkness, and your obscurity will be as the noonday; (Isaiah 58:10)

text: וַיֵּט מֹשֶׁה אֶת יָדוֹ עַל הַשָּׁמָיִם וַיְהִי חֹֽשֶׁךְ אֲפֵלָה בְּכָל אֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם שְׁלֹשֶׁת יָמִֽים׃
translation: Moses stretched out his hand toward the sky, and there was a thick darkness in all the land of Egypt for three days. (Exodus 10:22)

text: עַל כֵּן רָחַק מִשְׁפָּט מִמֶּנּוּ וְלֹא תַשִּׂיגֵנוּ צְדָקָה נְקַוֶּה לָאוֹר וְהִנֵּה חֹשֶׁךְ לִנְגֹהוֹת בָּאֲפֵלוֹת נְהַלֵּֽךְ׃
translation: Therefore justice is far from us, and righteousness doesn't overtake us. We look for light, but see darkness; for brightness, but we walk in obscurity. (Isaiah 59:9)

text: לָכֵן יִֽהְיֶה דַרְכָּם לָהֶם כַּחֲלַקְלַקּוֹת בָּֽאֲפֵלָה יִדַּחוּ וְנָפְלוּ בָהּ כִּֽי אָבִיא עֲלֵיהֶם רָעָה שְׁנַת פְּקֻדָּתָם נְאֻם יְהוָֽה׃
translation: Therefore their way will be to them as slippery places in the darkness. They will be driven on, and fall therein; for I will bring evil on them, even the year of their visitation," says the LORD. (Jeremiah 23:12)

text: וְהָיִיתָ מְמַשֵּׁשׁ בַּֽצָּהֳרַיִם כַּאֲשֶׁר יְמַשֵּׁשׁ הָעִוֵּר בָּאֲפֵלָה וְלֹא תַצְלִיחַ אֶת דְּרָכֶיךָ וְהָיִיתָ אַךְ עָשׁוּק וְגָזוּל כָּל הַיָּמִים וְאֵין מוֹשִֽׁיעַ׃
translation: You will grope at noonday, as the blind gropes in darkness, and you shall not prosper in your ways. You will only be oppressed and robbed always, and there will be no one to save you. (Deuteronomy 28:29)

text: תְּחַטְּאֵנִי בְאֵזוֹב וְאֶטְהָר תְּכַבְּסֵנִי וּמִשֶּׁלֶג אַלְבִּֽין׃
translation: Hide your face from my sins, and blot out all of my iniquities. (Psalms 51:9)

text: וְלָקַח לְחַטֵּא אֶת הַבַּיִת שְׁתֵּי צִפֳּרִים וְעֵץ אֶרֶז וּשְׁנִי תוֹלַעַת וְאֵזֹֽב׃
translation: To cleanse the house he shall take two birds, cedar wood, scarlet, and hyssop. (Leviticus 14:49)

text: וְלָקַח הַכֹּהֵן עֵץ אֶרֶז וְאֵזוֹב וּשְׁנִי תוֹלָעַת וְהִשְׁלִיךְ אֶל תּוֹךְ שְׂרֵפַת הַפָּרָֽה׃
translation: The priest shall take cedar wood, hyssop, and scarlet, and cast it into the middle of the burning of the heifer. (Numbers 19:6)

text: וְצִוָּה הַכֹּהֵן וְלָקַח לַמִּטַּהֵר שְׁתֵּֽי צִפֳּרִים חַיּוֹת טְהֹרוֹת וְעֵץ אֶרֶז וּשְׁנִי תוֹלַעַת וְאֵזֹֽב׃
translation: then the priest shall command them to take for him who is to be cleansed two living clean birds, cedar wood, scarlet, and hyssop. (Leviticus 14:4)

text: וְחִטֵּא אֶת הַבַּיִת בְּדַם הַצִּפּוֹר וּבַמַּיִם הַֽחַיִּים וּבַצִּפֹּר הַחַיָּה וּבְעֵץ הָאֶרֶז וּבָאֵזֹב וּבִשְׁנִי הַתּוֹלָֽעַת׃
translation: He shall cleanse the house with the blood of the bird, and with the running water, with the living bird, with the cedar wood, with the hyssop, and with the scarlet; (Leviticus 14:52)

text: הַצִּילֵנִי מִטִּיט וְאַל אֶטְבָּעָה אִנָּצְלָה מִשֹּֽׂנְאַי וּמִמַּֽעֲמַקֵּי מָֽיִם׃
translation: Don't let the flood waters overwhelm me, neither let the deep swallow me up. Don't let the pit shut its mouth on me. (Psalms 69:15)

text: עַל מָה אֲדָנֶיהָ הָטְבָּעוּ אוֹ מִֽי יָרָה אֶבֶן פִּנָּתָֽהּ׃
translation: What were its foundations fastened on? Or who laid its cornerstone, (Job 38:6)

text: טָבְעוּ גוֹיִם בְּשַׁחַת עָשׂוּ בְּרֶֽשֶׁת זוּ טָמָנוּ נִלְכְּדָה רַגְלָֽם׃
translation: The LORD has made himself known. He has executed judgment. The wicked is snared by the work of his own hands. Meditation. Selah. (Psalms 9:16)

text: מַרְכְּבֹת פַּרְעֹה וְחֵילוֹ יָרָה בַיָּם וּמִבְחַר שָֽׁלִשָׁיו טֻבְּעוּ בְיַם סֽוּף׃
translation: He has cast Pharaoh's chariots and his army into the sea. His chosen captains are sunk in the Red Sea. (Exodus 15:4)

text: טָבַעְתִּי בִּיוֵן מְצוּלָה וְאֵין מָעֳמָד בָּאתִי בְמַעֲמַקֵּי מַיִם וְשִׁבֹּלֶת שְׁטָפָֽתְנִי׃
translation: I am weary with my crying. My throat is dry. My eyes fail looking for my God. (Psalms 69:3)

text: בְּטֶרֶם הָרִים הָטְבָּעוּ לִפְנֵי גְבָעוֹת חוֹלָֽלְתִּי׃
translation: Before the mountains were settled in place, before the hills, I was born; (Proverbs 8:25)

text: אֲנִי בְּצֶדֶק אֶחֱזֶה פָנֶיךָ אֶשְׂבְּעָה בְהָקִיץ תְּמוּנָתֶֽךָ׃
translation: As for me, I shall see your face in righteousness. I shall be satisfied, when I awake, with seeing your form. (Psalms 17:15)

text: יַעֲמֹד וְֽלֹא אַכִּיר מַרְאֵהוּ תְּמוּנָה לְנֶגֶד עֵינָי דְּמָמָה וָקוֹל אֶשְׁמָֽע׃
translation: It stood still, but I couldn't discern its appearance. A form was before my eyes. Silence, then I heard a voice, saying, (Job 4:16)

text: פֶּן תַּשְׁחִתוּן וַעֲשִׂיתֶם לָכֶם פֶּסֶל תְּמוּנַת כָּל סָמֶל תַּבְנִית זָכָר אוֹ נְקֵבָֽה׃
translation: lest you corrupt yourselves, and make yourself a carved image in the form of any figure, the likeness of male or female, (Deuteronomy 4:16)

text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהוָה אֲלֵיכֶם מִתּוֹךְ הָאֵשׁ קוֹל דְּבָרִים אַתֶּם שֹׁמְעִים וּתְמוּנָה אֵינְכֶם רֹאִים זוּלָתִי קֽוֹל׃
translation: The LORD spoke to you out of the middle of the fire: you heard the voice of words, but you saw no form; you only heard a voice. (Deuteronomy 4:12)

text: וְנִשְׁמַרְתֶּם מְאֹד לְנַפְשֹׁתֵיכֶם כִּי לֹא רְאִיתֶם כָּל תְּמוּנָה בְּיוֹם דִּבֶּר יְהוָה אֲלֵיכֶם בְּחֹרֵב מִתּוֹךְ הָאֵֽשׁ׃
translation: Be very careful, for you saw no kind of form on the day that the LORD spoke to you in Horeb out of the middle of the fire, (Deuteronomy 4:15)

text: לֹֽא תַֽעֲשֶׂה לְךָ פֶסֶל וְכָל תְּמוּנָה אֲשֶׁר בַּשָּׁמַיִם מִמַּעַל וַאֲשֶׁר בָּאָרֶץ מִתָּחַת וַאֲשֶׁר בַּמַּיִם מִתַּחַת לָאָֽרֶץ׃
translation: "You shall not make for yourselves an idol, nor any image of anything that is in the heavens above, or that is in the earth beneath, or that is in the water under the earth: (Exodus 20:4)

text: שִׁבְעָה שָׁבֻעֹת תִּסְפָּר לָךְ מֵהָחֵל חֶרְמֵשׁ בַּקָּמָה תָּחֵל לִסְפֹּר שִׁבְעָה שָׁבֻעֽוֹת׃
translation: You shall count for yourselves seven weeks. From the time you begin to put the sickle to the standing grain you shall begin to count seven weeks. (Deuteronomy 16:9)

text: וְהָיָה כֶּֽאֱסֹף קָצִיר קָמָה וּזְרֹעוֹ שִׁבֳּלִים יִקְצוֹר וְהָיָה כִּמְלַקֵּט שִׁבֳּלִים בְּעֵמֶק רְפָאִֽים׃
translation: It will be like when the harvester gathers the wheat, and his arm reaps the grain. Yes, it will be like when one gleans grain in the valley of Rephaim. (Isaiah 17:5)

text: וַיַּבְעֶר אֵשׁ בַּלַּפִּידִים וַיְשַׁלַּח בְּקָמוֹת פְּלִשְׁתִּים וַיַּבְעֵר מִגָּדִישׁ וְעַד קָמָה וְעַד כֶּרֶם זָֽיִת׃
translation: When he had set the torches on fire, he let them go into the standing grain of the Philistines, and burned up both the shocks and the standing grain, and also the olive groves. (Judges 15:5)

text: כִּֽי תֵצֵא אֵשׁ וּמָצְאָה קֹצִים וְנֶאֱכַל גָּדִישׁ אוֹ הַקָּמָה אוֹ הַשָּׂדֶה שַׁלֵּם יְשַׁלֵּם הַמַּבְעִר אֶת הַבְּעֵרָֽה׃
translation: "If a man causes a field or vineyard to be eaten by letting his animal loose, and it grazes in another man's field, he shall make restitution from the best of his own field, and from the best of his own vineyard. (Exodus 22:5)

text: כִּי רוּחַ יִזְרָעוּ וְסוּפָתָה יִקְצֹרוּ קָמָה אֵֽין לוֹ צֶמַח בְּלִי יַֽעֲשֶׂה קֶּמַח אוּלַי יַֽעֲשֶׂה זָרִים יִבְלָעֻֽהוּ׃
translation: For they sow the wind, and they will reap the whirlwind. He has no standing grain. The stalk will yield no head. If it does yield, strangers will swallow it up. (Hosea 8:7)

text: נִשְׁמְטוּ בִֽידֵי סֶלַע שֹׁפְטֵיהֶם וְשָׁמְעוּ אֲמָרַי כִּי נָעֵֽמוּ׃
translation: Their judges are thrown down by the sides of the rock. They will hear my words, for they are well spoken. (Psalms 141:6)

text: אֶת הַנָּכְרִי תִּגֹּשׂ וַאֲשֶׁר יִהְיֶה לְךָ אֶת אָחִיךָ תַּשְׁמֵט יָדֶֽךָ׃
translation: Of a foreigner you may require it; but whatever of yours is with your brother, your hand shall release. (Deuteronomy 15:3)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר שמטהו שִׁמְטוּהָ וַֽיִּשְׁמְטוּהָ וַיִּז מִדָּמָהּ אֶל הַקִּיר וְאֶל הַסּוּסִים וַֽיִּרְמְסֶֽנָּה׃
translation: He said, "Throw her down!" So they threw her down; and some of her blood was sprinkled on the wall, and on the horses. Then he trampled her under foot. (2 Kings 9:33)

text: וְהַשְּׁבִיעִת תִּשְׁמְטֶנָּה וּנְטַשְׁתָּהּ וְאָֽכְלוּ אֶבְיֹנֵי עַמֶּךָ וְיִתְרָם תֹּאכַל חַיַּת הַשָּׂדֶה כֵּֽן תַּעֲשֶׂה לְכַרְמְךָ לְזֵיתֶֽךָ׃
translation: but the seventh year you shall let it rest and lie fallow, that the poor of your people may eat; and what they leave the animal of the field shall eat. In the same way, you shall deal with your vineyard and with your olive grove. (Exodus 23:11)

text: וַיָּבֹאוּ עַד גֹּרֶן נָכוֹן וַיִּשְׁלַח עֻזָּא אֶל אֲרוֹן הָֽאֱלֹהִים וַיֹּאחֶז בּוֹ כִּי שָׁמְטוּ הַבָּקָֽר׃
translation: When they came to the threshing floor of Nacon, Uzzah reached for God's ark and took hold of it, for the cattle stumbled. (2 Samuel 6:6)

text: וַיָּבֹאוּ עַד גֹּרֶן כִּידֹן וַיִּשְׁלַח עֻזָּא אֶת יָדוֹ לֶאֱחֹז אֶת הָאָרוֹן כִּי שָֽׁמְטוּ הַבָּקָֽר׃
translation: When they came to Chidon's threshing floor, Uzza put out his hand to hold the ark, for the oxen stumbled. (1 Chronicles 13:9)

text: וְצִפִּיתָ אֹתוֹ זָהָב טָהוֹר וְעָשִׂיתָ לּוֹ זֵר זָהָב סָבִֽיב׃
