translation: You shall overlay it with pure gold, and make a gold molding around it. (Exodus 25:24)

text: וַיְצַף אֹתוֹ זָהָב טָהוֹר וַיַּעַשׂ לוֹ זֵר זָהָב סָבִֽיב׃
translation: He overlaid it with pure gold, and made a gold molding around it. (Exodus 37:11)

text: וְעָשִׂיתָ לּוֹ מִסְגֶּרֶת טֹפַח סָבִיב וְעָשִׂיתָ זֵר זָהָב לְמִסְגַּרְתּוֹ סָבִֽיב׃
translation: You shall make a rim of a hand width around it. You shall make a golden molding on its rim around it. (Exodus 25:25)

text: וַיְצַפֵּהוּ זָהָב טָהוֹר מִבַּיִת וּמִחוּץ וַיַּעַשׂ לוֹ זֵר זָהָב סָבִֽיב׃
translation: He overlaid it with pure gold inside and outside, and made a molding of gold for it around it. (Exodus 37:2)

text: וַיַּעַשׂ לוֹ מִסְגֶּרֶת טֹפַח סָבִיב וַיַּעַשׂ זֵר זָהָב לְמִסְגַּרְתּוֹ סָבִֽיב׃
translation: He made a border of a hand's width around it, and made a golden molding on its border around it. (Exodus 37:12)

text: וְצִפִּיתָ אֹתוֹ זָהָב טָהוֹר מִבַּיִת וּמִחוּץ תְּצַפֶּנּוּ וְעָשִׂיתָ עָלָיו זֵר זָהָב סָבִֽיב׃
translation: You shall overlay it with pure gold. You shall overlay it inside and outside, and you shall make a gold molding around it. (Exodus 25:11)

text: לָכֵן עַתָּה יִגְלוּ בְּרֹאשׁ גֹּלִים וְסָר מִרְזַח סְרוּחִֽים׃
translation: Therefore they will now go captive with the first who go captive. The feasting and lounging will end. (Amos 6:7)

text: וַיִּקְבְּרוּ אֹתוֹ בִּגְבוּל נַחֲלָתוֹ בְּתִמְנַת סֶרַח אֲשֶׁר בְּהַר אֶפְרָיִם מִצְּפוֹן לְהַר גָּֽעַשׁ׃
translation: They buried him in the border of his inheritance in Timnathserah, which is in the hill country of Ephraim, on the north of the mountain of Gaash. (Joshua 24:30)

text: לֶאֱדוֹם כֹּה אָמַר יְהוָה צְבָאוֹת הַאֵין עוֹד חָכְמָה בְּתֵימָן אָבְדָה עֵצָה מִבָּנִים נִסְרְחָה חָכְמָתָֽם׃
translation: Of Edom, the LORD of Armies says: "Is wisdom no more in Teman? Has counsel perished from the prudent? Has their wisdom vanished? (Jeremiah 49:7)

text: וְהָאַמָּה מִזֶּה וְהָאַמָּה מִזֶּה בָּעֹדֵף בְּאֹרֶךְ יְרִיעֹת הָאֹהֶל יִהְיֶה סָרוּחַ עַל צִדֵּי הַמִּשְׁכָּן מִזֶּה וּמִזֶּה לְכַסֹּתֽוֹ׃
translation: The cubit on the one side and the cubit on the other side, of that which remains in the length of the curtains of the tent, shall hang over the sides of the tabernacle on this side and on that side, to cover it. (Exodus 26:13)

text: עַל פִּי יְהוָה נָתְנוּ לוֹ אֶת הָעִיר אֲשֶׁר שָׁאָל אֶת תִּמְנַת סֶרַח בְּהַר אֶפְרָיִם וַיִּבְנֶה אֶת הָעִיר וַיֵּשֶׁב בָּֽהּ׃
translation: According to the LORD's commandment, they gave him the city which he asked, even Timnathserah in the hill country of Ephraim; and he built the city, and lived there. (Joshua 19:50)

text: כַּצִּפּוֹר לָנוּד כַּדְּרוֹר לָעוּף כֵּן קִֽלְלַת חִנָּם לא לוֹ תָבֹֽא׃
translation: Like a fluttering sparrow, like a darting swallow, so the undeserved curse doesn't come to rest. (Proverbs 26:2)

text: גַּם צִפּוֹר מָצְאָה בַיִת וּדְרוֹר קֵן לָהּ אֲשֶׁר שָׁתָה אֶפְרֹחֶיהָ אֶֽת מִזְבְּחוֹתֶיךָ יְהוָה צְבָאוֹת מַלְכִּי וֵאלֹהָֽי׃
translation: Blessed are those who dwell in your house. They are always praising you. Selah. (Psalms 84:4)

text: וְאַתָּה קַח לְךָ בְּשָׂמִים רֹאשׁ מָר דְּרוֹר חֲמֵשׁ מֵאוֹת וְקִנְּמָן בֶּשֶׂם מַחֲצִיתוֹ חֲמִשִּׁים וּמָאתָיִם וּקְנֵה בֹשֶׂם חֲמִשִּׁים וּמָאתָֽיִם׃
translation: "Also take fine spices: of liquid myrrh, five hundred shekels; and of fragrant cinnamon half as much, even two hundred and fifty; and of fragrant cane, two hundred and fifty; (Exodus 30:23)

text: וְכִֽי יִתֵּן מַתָּנָה מִנַּחֲלָתוֹ לְאַחַד מֵֽעֲבָדָיו וְהָיְתָה לּוֹ עַד שְׁנַת הַדְּרוֹר וְשָׁבַת לַנָּשִׂיא אַךְ נַחֲלָתוֹ בָּנָיו לָהֶם תִּהְיֶֽה׃
translation: But if he gives of his inheritance a gift to one of his servants, it shall be his to the year of liberty; then it shall return to the prince; but as for his inheritance, it shall be for his sons. (Ezekiel 46:17)

text: וַתָּשֻׁבוּ אַתֶּם הַיּוֹם וַתַּעֲשׂוּ אֶת הַיָּשָׁר בְּעֵינַי לִקְרֹא דְרוֹר אִישׁ לְרֵעֵהוּ וַתִּכְרְתוּ בְרִית לְפָנַי בַּבַּיִת אֲשֶׁר נִקְרָא שְׁמִי עָלָֽיו׃
translation: You had now turned, and had done that which is right in my eyes, in every man proclaiming liberty to his neighbor. You had made a covenant before me in the house which is called by my name; (Jeremiah 34:15)

text: רוּחַ אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה עָלָי יַעַן מָשַׁח יְהוָה אֹתִי לְבַשֵּׂר עֲנָוִים שְׁלָחַנִי לַחֲבֹשׁ לְנִשְׁבְּרֵי לֵב לִקְרֹא לִשְׁבוּיִם דְּרוֹר וְלַאֲסוּרִים פְּקַח קֽוֹחַ׃
translation: The Lord GOD's Spirit is on me, because the LORD has anointed me to preach good news to the humble. He has sent me to bind up the broken hearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives and release to those who are bound, (Isaiah 61:1)

text: אַשְׁרֵיךְ אֶרֶץ שֶׁמַּלְכֵּךְ בֶּן חוֹרִים וְשָׂרַיִךְ בָּעֵת יֹאכֵלוּ בִּגְבוּרָה וְלֹא בַשְּׁתִֽי׃
translation: Happy are you, land, when your king is the son of nobles, and your princes eat in due season, for strength, and not for drunkenness! (Ecclesiastes 10:17)

text: אוֹ בִֽשְׁתִי אוֹ בְעֵרֶב לַפִּשְׁתִּים וְלַצָּמֶר אוֹ בְעוֹר אוֹ בְּכָל מְלֶאכֶת עֽוֹר׃
translation: whether it is in warp or woof; of linen or of wool; whether in leather, or in anything made of leather; (Leviticus 13:48)

text: וְאִם יִרְאֶה הַכֹּהֵן וְהִנֵּה לֹא פָשָׂה הַנֶּגַע בַּבֶּגֶד אוֹ בַשְּׁתִי אוֹ בָעֵרֶב אוֹ בְּכָל כְּלִי עֽוֹר׃
translation: "If the priest examines it, and behold, the plague hasn't spread in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in anything of skin; (Leviticus 13:53)

text: וְהַבֶּגֶד אֽוֹ הַשְּׁתִי אוֹ הָעֵרֶב אֽוֹ כָל כְּלִי הָעוֹר אֲשֶׁר תְּכַבֵּס וְסָר מֵהֶם הַנָּגַע וְכֻבַּס שֵׁנִית וְטָהֵֽר׃
translation: The garment, either the warp, or the woof, or whatever thing of skin it is, which you shall wash, if the plague has departed from them, then it shall be washed the second time, and it will be clean." (Leviticus 13:58)

text: זֹאת תּוֹרַת נֶֽגַע צָרַעַת בֶּגֶד הַצֶּמֶר אוֹ הַפִּשְׁתִּים אוֹ הַשְּׁתִי אוֹ הָעֵרֶב אוֹ כָּל כְּלִי עוֹר לְטַהֲרוֹ אוֹ לְטַמְּאֽוֹ׃
translation: This is the law of the plague of mildew in a garment of wool or linen, either in the warp, or the woof, or in anything of skin, to pronounce it clean, or to pronounce it unclean. (Leviticus 13:59)

text: וְאִם תֵּרָאֶה עוֹד בַּבֶּגֶד אֽוֹ בַשְּׁתִי אֽוֹ בָעֵרֶב אוֹ בְכָל כְּלִי עוֹר פֹּרַחַת הִוא בָּאֵשׁ תִּשְׂרְפֶנּוּ אֵת אֲשֶׁר בּוֹ הַנָּֽגַע׃
translation: and if it appears again in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in anything of skin, it is spreading. You shall burn what the plague is in with fire. (Leviticus 13:57)

text: לֹֽא לָנֶצַח יָרִיב וְלֹא לְעוֹלָם יִטּֽוֹר׃
translation: He will not always accuse; neither will he stay angry forever. (Psalms 103:9)

text: כָּרְמִי שֶׁלִּי לְפָנָי הָאֶלֶף לְךָ שְׁלֹמֹה וּמָאתַיִם לְנֹטְרִים אֶת פִּרְיֽוֹ׃
translation: My own vineyard is before me. The thousand are for you, Solomon, two hundred for those who tend its fruit. (Song of Solomon 8:12)

text: הֲיִנְטֹר לְעוֹלָם אִם יִשְׁמֹר לָנֶצַח הִנֵּה דברתי דִבַּרְתְּ וַתַּעֲשִׂי הָרָעוֹת וַתּוּכָֽל׃
translation: "'Will he retain his anger forever? Will he keep it to the end?' Behold, you have spoken and have done evil things, and have had your way." (Jeremiah 3:5)

text: לֹֽא תִקֹּם וְלֹֽא תִטֹּר אֶת בְּנֵי עַמֶּךָ וְאָֽהַבְתָּ לְרֵעֲךָ כָּמוֹךָ אֲנִי יְהוָֽה׃
translation: "'You shall not take vengeance, nor bear any grudge against the children of your people; but you shall love your neighbor as yourself. I am the LORD. (Leviticus 19:18)

text: כֶּרֶם הָיָה לִשְׁלֹמֹה בְּבַעַל הָמוֹן נָתַן אֶת הַכֶּרֶם לַנֹּטְרִים אִישׁ יָבִא בְּפִרְיוֹ אֶלֶף כָּֽסֶף׃
translation: Solomon had a vineyard at Baal Hamon. He leased out the vineyard to keepers. Each was to bring a thousand shekels of silver for its fruit. (Song of Solomon 8:11)

text: אֵל קַנּוֹא וְנֹקֵם יְהוָה נֹקֵם יְהוָה וּבַעַל חֵמָה נֹקֵם יְהוָה לְצָרָיו וְנוֹטֵר הוּא לְאֹיְבָֽיו׃
translation: The LORD is a jealous God and avenges. The LORD avenges and is full of wrath. The LORD takes vengeance on his adversaries, and he maintains wrath against his enemies. (Nahum 1:2)

text: וְאִם אֱמֶת הָיָה הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה לֹא נִמְצְאוּ בְתוּלִים לנער לַֽנַּעֲרָֽה׃
translation: But if this thing is true, that the tokens of virginity were not found in the young lady, (Deuteronomy 22:20)

text: וַתִּזְנֶינָה בְמִצְרַיִם בִּנְעוּרֵיהֶן זָנוּ שָׁמָּה מֹעֲכוּ שְׁדֵיהֶן וְשָׁם עִשּׂוּ דַּדֵּי בְּתוּלֵיהֶֽן׃
translation: They played the prostitute in Egypt. They played the prostitute in their youth. Their breasts were fondled there, and their youthful nipples were caressed there. (Ezekiel 23:3)

text: וְהוּא אִשָּׁה בִבְתוּלֶיהָ יִקָּֽח׃
translation: "'He shall take a wife in her virginity. (Leviticus 21:13)

text: וְלָקַח אֲבִי הנער הַֽנַּעֲרָה וְאִמָּהּ וְהוֹצִיאוּ אֶת בְּתוּלֵי הנער הַֽנַּעֲרָה אֶל זִקְנֵי הָעִיר הַשָּֽׁעְרָה׃
translation: then the young lady's father and mother shall take and bring the tokens of the young lady's virginity to the elders of the city in the gate. (Deuteronomy 22:15)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר לֵכִי וַיִּשְׁלַח אוֹתָהּ שְׁנֵי חֳדָשִׁים וַתֵּלֶךְ הִיא וְרֵעוֹתֶיהָ וַתֵּבְךְּ עַל בְּתוּלֶיהָ עַל הֶהָרִֽים׃
translation: He said, "Go." He sent her away for two months; and she departed, she and her companions, and mourned her virginity on the mountains. (Judges 11:38)

text: וְאֶת תַּזְנוּתֶיהָ מִמִּצְרַיִם לֹא עָזָבָה כִּי אוֹתָהּ שָׁכְבוּ בִנְעוּרֶיהָ וְהֵמָּה עִשּׂוּ דַּדֵּי בְתוּלֶיהָ וַיִּשְׁפְּכוּ תַזְנוּתָם עָלֶֽיהָ׃
translation: She hasn't left her prostitution since leaving Egypt; for in her youth they lay with her. They caressed her youthful nipples and they poured out their prostitution on her. (Ezekiel 23:8)

text: חֵלֶק כְּחֵלֶק יֹאכֵלוּ לְבַד מִמְכָּרָיו עַל הָאָבֽוֹת׃
translation: They shall have like portions to eat, in addition to that which comes from the sale of his family possessions. (Deuteronomy 18:8)

text: וַיָּלִינוּ הָרֹכְלִים וּמֹכְרֵי כָל מִמְכָּר מִחוּץ לִירוּשָׁלִָם פַּעַם וּשְׁתָּֽיִם׃
translation: So the merchants and sellers of all kinds of wares camped outside of Jerusalem once or twice. (Nehemiah 13:20)

text: וְכִֽי תִמְכְּרוּ מִמְכָּר לַעֲמִיתֶךָ אוֹ קָנֹה מִיַּד עֲמִיתֶךָ אַל תּוֹנוּ אִישׁ אֶת אָחִֽיו׃
translation: "'If you sell anything to your neighbor, or buy from your neighbor, you shall not wrong one another. (Leviticus 25:14)

text: כִּֽי יָמוּךְ אָחִיךָ וּמָכַר מֵאֲחֻזָּתוֹ וּבָא גֹֽאֲלוֹ הַקָּרֹב אֵלָיו וְגָאַל אֵת מִמְכַּר אָחִֽיו׃
translation: "'If your brother becomes poor, and sells some of his possessions, then his kinsman who is next to him shall come, and redeem that which his brother has sold. (Leviticus 25:25)

text: וְאִישׁ כִּֽי יִמְכֹּר בֵּית מוֹשַׁב עִיר חוֹמָה וְהָיְתָה גְּאֻלָּתוֹ עַד תֹּם שְׁנַת מִמְכָּרוֹ יָמִים תִּהְיֶה גְאֻלָּתֽוֹ׃
translation: "'If a man sells a dwelling house in a walled city, then he may redeem it within a whole year after it has been sold. For a full year he shall have the right of redemption. (Leviticus 25:29)

text: וְחִשַּׁב עִם קֹנֵהוּ מִשְּׁנַת הִמָּכְרוֹ לוֹ עַד שְׁנַת הַיֹּבֵל וְהָיָה כֶּסֶף מִמְכָּרוֹ בְּמִסְפַּר שָׁנִים כִּימֵי שָׂכִיר יִהְיֶה עִמּֽוֹ׃
translation: He shall reckon with him who bought him from the year that he sold himself to him to the Year of Jubilee. The price of his sale shall be according to the number of years; he shall be with him according to the time of a hired servant. (Leviticus 25:50)

text: מְלַמֵּד יָדַי לַמִּלְחָמָה וְנִחַת קֶֽשֶׁת נְחוּשָׁה זְרֹעֹתָֽי׃
translation: He teaches my hands to war, so that my arms bend a bow of bronze. (2 Samuel 22:35)

text: מְלַמֵּד יָדַי לַמִּלְחָמָה וְֽנִחֲתָה קֶֽשֶׁת נְחוּשָׁה זְרוֹעֹתָֽי׃
translation: You have also given me the shield of your salvation. Your right hand sustains me. Your gentleness has made me great. (Psalms 18:35)

text: יִבְרַח מִנֵּשֶׁק בַּרְזֶל תַּחְלְפֵהוּ קֶשֶׁת נְחוּשָֽׁה׃
translation: He will flee from the iron weapon. The bronze arrow will strike him through. (Job 20:24)

text: בַּרְזֶל מֵעָפָר יֻקָּח וְאֶבֶן יָצוּק נְחוּשָֽׁה׃
translation: Iron is taken out of the earth, and copper is smelted out of the ore. (Job 28:2)

text: יַחְשֹׁב לְתֶבֶן בַּרְזֶל לְעֵץ רִקָּבוֹן נְחוּשָֽׁה׃
translation: Out of his mouth go burning torches. Sparks of fire leap out. (Job 41:19)

text: וְשָׁבַרְתִּי אֶת גְּאוֹן עֻזְּכֶם וְנָתַתִּי אֶת שְׁמֵיכֶם כַּבַּרְזֶל וְאֶֽת אַרְצְכֶם כַּנְּחֻשָֽׁה׃
translation: I will break the pride of your power, and I will make your sky like iron, and your soil like bronze. (Leviticus 26:19)

text: לְמַעַן יַחְסְרוּ לֶחֶם וָמָיִם וְנָשַׁמּוּ אִישׁ וְאָחִיו וְנָמַקּוּ בַּעֲוֺנָֽם׃
translation: that they may lack bread and water, be dismayed one with another, and pine away in their iniquity. (Ezekiel 4:17)

text: וְהַנִּשְׁאָרִים בָּכֶם יִמַּקּוּ בַּֽעֲוֺנָם בְּאַרְצֹת אֹיְבֵיכֶם וְאַף בַּעֲוֺנֹת אֲבֹתָם אִתָּם יִמָּֽקּוּ׃
translation: Those of you who are left will pine away in their iniquity in your enemies' lands; and also in the iniquities of their fathers they shall pine away with them. (Leviticus 26:39)

text: הִבְאִישׁוּ נָמַקּוּ חַבּוּרֹתָי מִפְּנֵי אִוַּלְתִּֽי׃
translation: I am in pain and bowed down greatly. I go mourning all day long. (Psalms 38:6)

text: וְנָמַקּוּ כָּל צְבָא הַשָּׁמַיִם וְנָגֹלּוּ כַסֵּפֶר הַשָּׁמָיִם וְכָל צְבָאָם יִבּוֹל כִּנְבֹל עָלֶה מִגֶּפֶן וּכְנֹבֶלֶת מִתְּאֵנָֽה׃
translation: All of the army of the sky will be dissolved. The sky will be rolled up like a scroll, and all its armies will fade away, as a leaf fades from off a vine or a fig tree. (Isaiah 34:4)

text: וּפְאֵרֵכֶם עַל רָאשֵׁיכֶם וְנַֽעֲלֵיכֶם בְּרַגְלֵיכֶם לֹא תִסְפְּדוּ וְלֹא תִבְכּוּ וּנְמַקֹּתֶם בַּעֲוֺנֹתֵיכֶם וּנְהַמְתֶּם אִישׁ אֶל אָחִֽיו׃
translation: Your turbans will be on your heads, and your sandals on your feet. You won't mourn or weep; but you will pine away in your iniquities, and moan one toward another. (Ezekiel 24:23)

text: וְאַתָּה בֶן אָדָם אֱמֹר אֶל בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל כֵּן אֲמַרְתֶּם לֵאמֹר כִּֽי פְשָׁעֵינוּ וְחַטֹּאתֵינוּ עָלֵינוּ וּבָם אֲנַחְנוּ נְמַקִּים וְאֵיךְ נִֽחְיֶֽה׃
translation: "You, son of man, tell the house of Israel: 'You say this, "Our transgressions and our sins are on us, and we pine away in them. How then can we live?"' (Ezekiel 33:10)

text: לֵאמֹר לַֽאֲסוּרִים צֵאוּ לַאֲשֶׁר בַּחֹשֶׁךְ הִגָּלוּ עַל דְּרָכִים יִרְעוּ וּבְכָל שְׁפָיִים מַרְעִיתָֽם׃
translation: saying to those who are bound, 'Come out!'; to those who are in darkness, 'Show yourselves!' "They shall feed along the paths, and their pasture shall be on all treeless heights. (Isaiah 49:9)

text: גָּזִּי נִזְרֵךְ וְֽהַשְׁלִיכִי וּשְׂאִי עַל שְׁפָיִם קִינָה כִּי מָאַס יְהוָה וַיִּטֹּשׁ אֶת דּוֹר עֶבְרָתֽוֹ׃
translation: Cut off your hair, and throw it away, and take up a lamentation on the bare heights; for the LORD has rejected and forsaken the generation of his wrath. (Jeremiah 7:29)

text: קוֹל עַל שְׁפָיִים נִשְׁמָע בְּכִי תַחֲנוּנֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל כִּי הֶעֱוּוּ אֶת דַּרְכָּם שָׁכְחוּ אֶת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיהֶֽם׃
translation: A voice is heard on the bare heights, the weeping and the petitions of the children of Israel; because they have perverted their way, they have forgotten the LORD their God. (Jeremiah 3:21)

text: בָּעֵת הַהִיא יֵאָמֵר לָֽעָם הַזֶּה וְלִירוּשָׁלִַם רוּחַ צַח שְׁפָיִים בַּמִּדְבָּר דֶּרֶךְ בַּת עַמִּי לוֹא לִזְרוֹת וְלוֹא לְהָבַֽר׃
translation: At that time it will be said to this people and to Jerusalem, "A hot wind blows from the bare heights in the wilderness toward the daughter of my people, not to winnow, nor to cleanse. (Jeremiah 4:11)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר בִּלְעָם לְבָלָק הִתְיַצֵּב עַל עֹלָתֶךָ וְאֵֽלְכָה אוּלַי יִקָּרֵה יְהוָה לִקְרָאתִי וּדְבַר מַה יַּרְאֵנִי וְהִגַּדְתִּי לָךְ וַיֵּלֶךְ שֶֽׁפִי׃
translation: Balaam said to Balak, "Stand by your burnt offering, and I will go. Perhaps the LORD will come to meet me. Whatever he shows me I will tell you." He went to a bare height. (Numbers 23:3)

text: עַֽל כָּל שְׁפָיִם בַּמִּדְבָּר בָּאוּ שֹֽׁדְדִים כִּי חֶרֶב לַֽיהוָה אֹֽכְלָה מִקְצֵה אֶרֶץ וְעַד קְצֵה הָאָרֶץ אֵין שָׁלוֹם לְכָל בָּשָֽׂר׃
translation: Destroyers have come on all the bare heights in the wilderness; for the sword of the LORD devours from the one end of the land even to the other end of the land. No flesh has peace. (Jeremiah 12:12)

text: הֲֽתִקְשָׁר רֵים בְּתֶלֶם עֲבֹתוֹ אִם יְשַׂדֵּד עֲמָקִים אַחֲרֶֽיךָ׃
translation: Can you hold the wild ox in the furrow with his harness? Or will he till the valleys after you? (Job 39:10)

text: הֲיֹאבֶה רֵּים עָבְדֶךָ אִם יָלִין עַל אֲבוּסֶֽךָ׃
translation: "Will the wild ox be content to serve you? Or will he stay by your feeding trough? (Job 39:9)

text: אֵל מוֹצִיאָם מִמִּצְרָיִם כְּתוֹעֲפֹת רְאֵם לֽוֹ׃
translation: God brings them out of Egypt. He has as it were the strength of the wild ox. (Numbers 23:22)

text: הוֹשִׁיעֵנִי מִפִּי אַרְיֵה וּמִקַּרְנֵי רֵמִים עֲנִיתָֽנִי׃
translation: I will declare your name to my brothers. Among the assembly, I will praise you. (Psalms 22:22)

text: וַתָּרֶם כִּרְאֵים קַרְנִי בַּלֹּתִי בְּשֶׁמֶן רַעֲנָֽן׃
translation: My eye has also seen my enemies. My ears have heard of the wicked enemies who rise up against me. (Psalms 92:11)

text: וְיָרְדוּ רְאֵמִים עִמָּם וּפָרִים עִם אַבִּירִים וְרִוְּתָה אַרְצָם מִדָּם וַעֲפָרָם מֵחֵלֶב יְדֻשָּֽׁן׃
translation: The wild oxen will come down with them, and the young bulls with the mighty bulls; and their land will be drunken with blood, and their dust made greasy with fat. (Isaiah 34:7)

text: אַתָּה הִצַּבְתָּ כָּל גְּבוּלוֹת אָרֶץ קַיִץ וָחֹרֶף אַתָּה יְצַרְתָּם׃
translation: You have set all the boundaries of the earth. You have made summer and winter. (Psalms 74:17)

text: גְּבֻלוֹת יַשִּׂיגוּ עֵדֶר גָּזְלוּ וַיִּרְעֽוּ׃
translation: There are people who remove the landmarks. They violently take away flocks, and feed them. (Job 24:2)

text: בְּהַנְחֵל עֶלְיוֹן גּוֹיִם בְּהַפְרִידוֹ בְּנֵי אָדָם יַצֵּב גְּבֻלֹת עַמִּים לְמִסְפַּר בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
translation: When the Most High gave to the nations their inheritance, when he separated the children of men, he set the bounds of the peoples according to the number of the children of Israel. (Deuteronomy 32:8)

text: וְיָרַד הַגְּבוּל הַיַּרְדֵּנָה וְהָיוּ תוֹצְאֹתָיו יָם הַמֶּלַח זֹאת תִּהְיֶה לָכֶם הָאָרֶץ לִגְבֻלֹתֶיהָ סָבִֽיב׃
translation: The border shall go down to the Jordan, and end at the Salt Sea. This shall be your land according to its borders around it.'" (Numbers 34:12)

text: וַיְכַלּוּ לִנְחֹל אֶת הָאָרֶץ לִגְבֽוּלֹתֶיהָ וַיִּתְּנוּ בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל נַחֲלָה לִיהוֹשֻׁעַ בִּן נוּן בְּתוֹכָֽם׃
translation: So they finished distributing the land for inheritance by its borders. The children of Israel gave an inheritance to Joshua the son of Nun among them. (Joshua 19:49)

text: הֲלוֹא אִם שִׁוָּה פָנֶיהָ וְהֵפִיץ קֶצַח וְכַמֹּן יִזְרֹק וְשָׂם חִטָּה שׂוֹרָה וּשְׂעֹרָה נִסְמָן וְכֻסֶּמֶת גְּבֻלָתֽוֹ׃
translation: When he has leveled its surface, doesn't he plant the dill, and scatter the cumin seed, and put in the wheat in rows, the barley in the appointed place, and the spelt in its place? (Isaiah 28:25)

text: הִנְּךָ יָפֶה דוֹדִי אַף נָעִים אַף עַרְשֵׂנוּ רַעֲנָנָֽה׃
translation: Behold, you are beautiful, my beloved, yes, pleasant; and our couch is verdant. (Song of Solomon 1:16)

text: כִּֽי אָמַרְתִּי תְּנַחֲמֵנִי עַרְשִׂי יִשָּׂא בְשִׂיחִי מִשְׁכָּבִֽי׃
translation: When I say, 'My bed will comfort me. My couch will ease my complaint,' (Job 7:13)

text: יָגַעְתִּי בְּֽאַנְחָתִי אַשְׂחֶה בְכָל לַיְלָה מִטָּתִי בְּדִמְעָתִי עַרְשִׂי אַמְסֶֽה׃
translation: My eye wastes away because of grief. It grows old because of all my adversaries. (Psalms 6:7)

text: יְֽהוָה יִסְעָדֶנּוּ עַל עֶרֶשׂ דְּוָי כָּל מִשְׁכָּבוֹ הָפַכְתָּ בְחָלְיֽוֹ׃
translation: I said, "LORD, have mercy on me! Heal me, for I have sinned against you." (Psalms 41:4)

text: מַרְבַדִּים רָבַדְתִּי עַרְשִׂי חֲטֻבוֹת אֵטוּן מִצְרָֽיִם׃
translation: I have spread my couch with carpets of tapestry, with striped cloths of the yarn of Egypt. (Proverbs 7:16)

text: הַשֹּֽׁכְבִים עַל מִטּוֹת שֵׁן וּסְרֻחִים עַל עַרְשׂוֹתָם וְאֹכְלִים כָּרִים מִצֹּאן וַעֲגָלִים מִתּוֹךְ מַרְבֵּֽק׃
translation: who lie on beds of ivory, and stretch themselves on their couches, and eat the lambs out of the flock, and the calves out of the middle of the stall, (Amos 6:4)

text: וַאֲכַלְתֶּם שָׁם לִפְנֵי יְהוָה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶם וּשְׂמַחְתֶּם בְּכֹל מִשְׁלַח יֶדְכֶם אַתֶּם וּבָתֵּיכֶם אֲשֶׁר בֵּֽרַכְךָ יְהוָה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ׃
translation: There you shall eat before the LORD your God, and you shall rejoice in all that you put your hand to, you and your households, in which the LORD your God has blessed you. (Deuteronomy 12:7)

text: יְצַו יְהוָה אִתְּךָ אֶת הַבְּרָכָה בַּאֲסָמֶיךָ וּבְכֹל מִשְׁלַח יָדֶךָ וּבֵרַכְךָ בָּאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר יְהוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ נֹתֵן לָֽךְ׃
translation: The LORD will command the blessing on you in your barns, and in all that you put your hand to. He will bless you in the land which the LORD your God gives you. (Deuteronomy 28:8)

text: וְכֹל הֶהָרִים אֲשֶׁר בַּמַּעְדֵּר יֵעָדֵרוּן לֹֽא תָבוֹא שָׁמָּה יִרְאַת שָׁמִיר וָשָׁיִת וְהָיָה לְמִשְׁלַח שׁוֹר וּלְמִרְמַס שֶֽׂה׃
translation: All the hills that were cultivated with the hoe, you shall not come there for fear of briers and thorns; but it shall be for the sending out of oxen, and for sheep to tread on." (Isaiah 7:25)

text: וְעָפוּ בְכָתֵף פְּלִשְׁתִּים יָמָּה יַחְדָּו יָבֹזּוּ אֶת בְּנֵי קֶדֶם אֱדוֹם וּמוֹאָב מִשְׁלוֹח יָדָם וּבְנֵי עַמּוֹן מִשְׁמַעְתָּֽם׃
translation: They will fly down on the shoulders of the Philistines on the west. Together they will plunder the children of the east. They will extend their power over Edom and Moab, and the children of Ammon will obey them. (Isaiah 11:14)

text: לַנָּכְרִי תַשִּׁיךְ וּלְאָחִיךָ לֹא תַשִּׁיךְ לְמַעַן יְבָרֶכְךָ יְהוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בְּכֹל מִשְׁלַח יָדֶךָ עַל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה בָא שָׁמָּה לְרִשְׁתָּֽהּ׃
translation: When you vow a vow to the LORD your God, you shall not be slack to pay it, for the LORD your God will surely require it of you; and it would be sin in you. (Deuteronomy 23:21)

text: נָתוֹן תִּתֵּן לוֹ וְלֹא יֵרַע לְבָבְךָ בְּתִתְּךָ לוֹ כִּי בִּגְלַל הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה יְבָרֶכְךָ יְהוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בְּכָֽל מַעֲשֶׂךָ וּבְכֹל מִשְׁלַח יָדֶֽךָ׃
translation: You shall surely give, and your heart shall not be grieved when you give to him, because it is for this thing the LORD your God will bless you in all your work and in all that you put your hand to. (Deuteronomy 15:10)

text: יָגוֹדּוּ עַל נֶפֶשׁ צַדִּיק וְדָם נָקִי יַרְשִֽׁיעוּ׃
translation: They gather themselves together against the soul of the righteous, and condemn the innocent blood. (Psalms 94:21)

text: וַֽיִּקְרְאוּ בְּקוֹל גָּדוֹל וַיִּתְגֹּֽדְדוּ כְּמִשְׁפָּטָם בַּחֲרָבוֹת וּבָֽרְמָחִים עַד שְׁפָךְ דָּם עֲלֵיהֶֽם׃
translation: They cried aloud, and cut themselves in their way with knives and lances until the blood gushed out on them. (1 Kings 18:28)

text: בָּאָה קָרְחָה אֶל עַזָּה נִדְמְתָה אַשְׁקְלוֹן שְׁאֵרִית עִמְקָם עַד מָתַי תִּתְגּוֹדָֽדִי׃
translation: Baldness has come on Gaza; Ashkelon is brought to nothing. You remnant of their valley, how long will you cut yourself? (Jeremiah 47:5)

text: בָּנִים אַתֶּם לַֽיהוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם לֹא תִתְגֹּֽדְדוּ וְלֹֽא תָשִׂימוּ קָרְחָה בֵּין עֵינֵיכֶם לָמֵֽת׃
translation: You are the children of the LORD your God. You shall not cut yourselves, nor make any baldness between your eyes for the dead. (Deuteronomy 14:1)

text: וּמֵתוּ גְדֹלִים וּקְטַנִּים בָּאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת לֹא יִקָּבֵרוּ וְלֹֽא יִסְפְּדוּ לָהֶם וְלֹא יִתְגֹּדַד וְלֹא יִקָּרֵחַ לָהֶֽם׃
translation: Both great and small will die in this land. They will not be buried. Men won't lament for them, cut themselves, or make themselves bald for them. (Jeremiah 16:6)

text: אֵי לָזֹאת אסלוח אֶֽסְלַֽח לָךְ בָּנַיִךְ עֲזָבוּנִי וַיִּשָּׁבְעוּ בְּלֹא אֱלֹהִים וָאַשְׂבִּעַ אוֹתָם וַיִּנְאָפוּ וּבֵית זוֹנָה יִתְגֹּדָֽדוּ׃
translation: "How can I pardon you? Your children have forsaken me, and sworn by what are no gods. When I had fed them to the full, they committed adultery, and assembled themselves in troops at the prostitutes' houses. (Jeremiah 5:7)

text: מִן גַּעֲרָתְךָ יְנוּסוּן מִן קוֹל רַֽעַמְךָ יֵחָפֵזֽוּן׃
translation: At your rebuke they fled. At the voice of your thunder they hurried away. (Psalms 104:7)

text: הֵמָּה רָאוּ כֵּן תָּמָהוּ נִבְהֲלוּ נֶחְפָּֽזוּ׃
translation: Trembling took hold of them there, pain, as of a woman in travail. (Psalms 48:6)

text: אֲנִי אָמַרְתִּי בְחָפְזִי כָּֽל הָאָדָם כֹּזֵֽב׃
translation: I said in my haste, "All people are liars." (Psalms 116:11)

text: וַאֲנִי אָמַרְתִּי בְחָפְזִי נִגְרַזְתִּי מִנֶּגֶד עֵינֶיךָ אָכֵן שָׁמַעְתָּ קוֹל תַּחֲנוּנַי בְּשַׁוְּעִי אֵלֶֽיךָ׃
translation: Oh love the LORD, all you his saints! The LORD preserves the faithful, and fully recompenses him who behaves arrogantly. (Psalms 31:23)

text: וַיֵּלְכוּ אַחֲרֵיהֶם עַד הַיַּרְדֵּן וְהִנֵּה כָל הַדֶּרֶךְ מְלֵאָה בְגָדִים וְכֵלִים אֲשֶׁר הִשְׁלִיכוּ אֲרָם בהחפזם בְּחָפְזָם וַיָּשֻׁבוּ הַמַּלְאָכִים וַיַּגִּדוּ לַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
translation: They went after them to the Jordan; and behold, all the path was full of garments and equipment which the Syrians had cast away in their haste. The messengers returned and told the king. (2 Kings 7:15)

text: וַיֵּלְכוּ אַחֲרֵי שְׁרִרוּת לִבָּם וְאַחֲרֵי הַבְּעָלִים אֲשֶׁר לִמְּדוּם אֲבוֹתָֽם׃
translation: The LORD says, "Because they have forsaken my law which I set before them, and have not obeyed my voice or walked in my ways, (Jeremiah 9:13)

text: וָֽאֲשַׁלְּחֵהוּ בִּשְׁרִירוּת לִבָּם יֵלְכוּ בְּֽמוֹעֲצוֹתֵיהֶֽם׃
translation: Oh that my people would listen to me, that Israel would walk in my ways! (Psalms 81:13)

text: וְאָמְרוּ נוֹאָשׁ כִּֽי אַחֲרֵי מַחְשְׁבוֹתֵינוּ נֵלֵךְ וְאִישׁ שְׁרִרוּת לִבּֽוֹ הָרָע נַעֲשֶֽׂה׃
translation: But they say, 'It is in vain; for we will walk after our own plans, and we will each follow the stubbornness of his evil heart.'" (Jeremiah 18:12)

text: וְאַתֶּם הֲרֵעֹתֶם לַעֲשׂוֹת מֵאֲבֽוֹתֵיכֶם וְהִנְּכֶם הֹלְכִים אִישׁ אַֽחֲרֵי שְׁרִרוּת לִבּֽוֹ הָרָע לְבִלְתִּי שְׁמֹעַ אֵלָֽי׃
translation: You have done evil more than your fathers, for behold, you each walk after the stubbornness of his evil heart, so that you don't listen to me. (Jeremiah 16:12)

text: וְלֹא שָֽׁמְעוּ וְלֹֽא הִטּוּ אֶת אָזְנָם וַיֵּֽלְכוּ בְּמֹעֵצוֹת בִּשְׁרִרוּת לִבָּם הָרָע וַיִּהְיוּ לְאָחוֹר וְלֹא לְפָנִֽים׃
translation: But they didn't listen or turn their ear, but walked in their own counsels and in the stubbornness of their evil heart, and went backward, and not forward. (Jeremiah 7:24)

text: אֹמְרִים אָמוֹר לִֽמְנַאֲצַי דִּבֶּר יְהוָה שָׁלוֹם יִֽהְיֶה לָכֶם וְכֹל הֹלֵךְ בִּשְׁרִרוּת לִבּוֹ אָֽמְרוּ לֹֽא תָבוֹא עֲלֵיכֶם רָעָֽה׃
translation: They say continually to those who despise me, 'The LORD has said, "You will have peace;"' and to everyone who walks in the stubbornness of his own heart they say, 'No evil will come on you.' (Jeremiah 23:17)

text: תַּֽהְפֻּכוֹת בְּלִבּוֹ חֹרֵשׁ רָע בְּכָל עֵת מדנים מִדְיָנִים יְשַׁלֵּֽחַ׃
translation: in whose heart is perverseness, who devises evil continually, who always sows discord. (Proverbs 6:14)

text: שִׂפְתֵי צַדִּיק יֵדְעוּן רָצוֹן וּפִי רְשָׁעִים תַּהְפֻּכֽוֹת׃
translation: The lips of the righteous know what is acceptable, but the mouth of the wicked is perverse. (Proverbs 10:32)

text: אִישׁ תַּהְפֻּכוֹת יְשַׁלַּח מָדוֹן וְנִרְגָּ<segtype="x-small">ן<seg> מַפְרִיד אַלּֽוּף׃
translation: A perverse man stirs up strife. A whisperer separates close friends. (Proverbs 16:28)

text: לְהַצִּילְךָ מִדֶּרֶךְ רָע מֵאִישׁ מְדַבֵּר תַּהְפֻּכֽוֹת׃
translation: to deliver you from the way of evil, from the men who speak perverse things, (Proverbs 2:12)

text: הַשְּׂמֵחִים לַעֲשׂוֹת רָע יָגִילוּ בְּֽתַהְפֻּכוֹת רָֽע׃
translation: who rejoice to do evil, and delight in the perverseness of evil, (Proverbs 2:14)

text: עֵינֶיךָ יִרְאוּ זָרוֹת וְלִבְּךָ יְדַבֵּר תַּהְפֻּכֽוֹת׃
translation: Your eyes will see strange things, and your mind will imagine confusing things. (Proverbs 23:33)

text: כִּי יָשֹׁחוּ בַמְּעוֹנוֹת יֵשְׁבוּ בַסֻּכָּה לְמוֹ אָֽרֶב׃
translation: when they crouch in their dens, and lie in wait in the thicket? (Job 38:40)

text: וַתָּבֹא חַיָּה בְמוֹ אָרֶב וּבִמְעוֹנֹתֶיהָ תִשְׁכֹּֽן׃
translation: Then the animals take cover, and remain in their dens. (Job 37:8)

text: תִּזְרַח הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ יֵאָסֵפוּן וְאֶל מְעוֹנֹתָם יִרְבָּצֽוּן׃
translation: The sun rises, and they steal away, and lie down in their dens. (Psalms 104:22)

text: מְעֹנָה אֱלֹהֵי קֶדֶם וּמִתַּחַת זְרֹעֹת עוֹלָם וַיְגָרֶשׁ מִפָּנֶיךָ אוֹיֵב וַיֹּאמֶר הַשְׁמֵֽד׃
translation: The eternal God is your dwelling place. Underneath are the everlasting arms. He thrust out the enemy from before you, and said, 'Destroy!' (Deuteronomy 33:27)

text: וַיְהִי בְשָׁלֵם סֻכּוֹ וּמְעוֹנָתוֹ בְצִיּֽוֹן׃
translation: There he broke the flaming arrows of the bow, the shield, and the sword, and the weapons of war. Selah. (Psalms 76:3)

text: הֲיִשְׁאַג אַרְיֵה בַּיַּעַר וְטֶרֶף אֵין לוֹ הֲיִתֵּן כְּפִיר קוֹלוֹ מִמְּעֹנָתוֹ בִּלְתִּי אִם לָכָֽד׃
translation: Will a lion roar in the thicket, when he has no prey? Does a young lion cry out of his den, if he has caught nothing? (Amos 3:4)

text: וּמִצְחַת נְחֹשֶׁת עַל רַגְלָיו וְכִידוֹן נְחֹשֶׁת בֵּין כְּתֵפָֽיו׃
translation: He had bronze shin armor on his legs and a bronze javelin between his shoulders. (1 Samuel 17:6)

text: עָלָיו תִּרְנֶה אַשְׁפָּה לַהַב חֲנִית וְכִידֽוֹן׃
translation: The quiver rattles against him, the flashing spear and the javelin. (Job 39:23)

text: כְּקַשׁ נֶחְשְׁבוּ תוֹתָח וְיִשְׂחַק לְרַעַשׁ כִּידֽוֹן׃
translation: His breath kindles coals. A flame goes out of his mouth. (Job 41:21)

text: וִיהוֹשֻׁעַ לֹֽא הֵשִׁיב יָדוֹ אֲשֶׁר נָטָה בַּכִּידוֹן עַד אֲשֶׁר הֶחֱרִים אֵת כָּל יֹשְׁבֵי הָעָֽי׃
translation: For Joshua didn't draw back his hand, with which he stretched out the javelin, until he had utterly destroyed all the inhabitants of Ai. (Joshua 8:26)

text: קֶשֶׁת וְכִידוֹן יַחֲזִיקוּ אַכְזָרִי הוּא וְלֹא יְרַחֵמוּ קוֹלָם כַּיָּם יֶהֱמֶה וְעַל סוּסִים יִרְכָּבוּ עָרוּךְ כְּאִישׁ לַמִּלְחָמָה עָלַיִךְ בַּת צִיּֽוֹן׃
translation: They take hold of bow and spear. They are cruel, and have no mercy. Their voice roars like the sea, and they ride on horses, everyone set in array, as a man to the battle, against you, daughter of Zion." (Jeremiah 6:23)

text: קֶשֶׁת וְכִידֹן יַחֲזִיקוּ אַכְזָרִי הֵמָּה וְלֹא יְרַחֵמוּ קוֹלָם כַּיָּם יֶהֱמֶה וְעַל סוּסִים יִרְכָּבוּ עָרוּךְ כְּאִישׁ לַמִּלְחָמָה עָלַיִךְ בַּת בָּבֶֽל׃
translation: They take up bow and spear. They are cruel, and have no mercy. Their voice roars like the sea. They ride on horses, everyone set in array, as a man to the battle, against you, daughter of Babylon. (Jeremiah 50:42)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל אִתַּי לֵךְ וַעֲבֹר וַֽיַּעֲבֹר אִתַּי הַגִּתִּי וְכָל אֲנָשָׁיו וְכָל הַטַּף אֲשֶׁר אִתּֽוֹ׃
translation: David said to Ittai, "Go and pass over." Ittai the Gittite passed over, and all his men, and all the little ones who were with him. (2 Samuel 15:22)

text: וְלֹֽא הֵסִיר דָּוִיד אֶת הָאָרוֹן אֵלָיו אֶל עִיר דָּוִיד וַיַּטֵּהוּ אֶל בֵּית עֹבֵֽד אֱדֹם הַגִּתִּֽי׃
translation: So David didn't move the ark with him into David's city, but carried it aside into Obed-Edom the Gittite's house. (1 Chronicles 13:13)

text: וְלֹֽא אָבָה דָוִד לְהָסִיר אֵלָיו אֶת אֲרוֹן יְהוָה עַל עִיר דָּוִד וַיַּטֵּהוּ דָוִד בֵּית עֹבֵֽד אֱדוֹם הַגִּתִּֽי׃
translation: So David would not move the LORD's ark to be with him in David's city; but David carried it aside into Obed-Edom the Gittite's house. (2 Samuel 6:10)

text: וַיֵּשֶׁב אֲרוֹן יְהוָה בֵּית עֹבֵד אֱדֹם הַגִּתִּי שְׁלֹשָׁה חֳדָשִׁים וַיְבָרֶךְ יְהוָה אֶת עֹבֵד אֱדֹם וְאֶת כָּל בֵּיתֽוֹ׃
translation: The LORD's ark remained in Obed-Edom the Gittite's house three months; and the LORD blessed Obed-Edom and all his house. (2 Samuel 6:11)

text: וַתְּהִי עוֹד מִלְחָמָה אֶת פְּלִשְׁתִּים וַיַּךְ אֶלְחָנָן בֶּן יעור יָעִיר אֶת לַחְמִי אֲחִי גָּלְיָת הַגִּתִּי וְעֵץ חֲנִיתוֹ כִּמְנוֹר אֹרְגִֽים׃
translation: Again there was war with the Philistines; and Elhanan the son of Jair killed Lahmi the brother of Goliath the Gittite, the staff of whose spear was like a weaver's beam. (1 Chronicles 20:5)

text: וַתְּהִי עוֹד הַמִּלְחָמָה בְּגוֹב עִם פְּלִשְׁתִּים וַיַּךְ אֶלְחָנָן בֶּן יַעְרֵי אֹרְגִים בֵּית הַלַּחְמִי אֵת גָּלְיָת הַגִּתִּי וְעֵץ חֲנִיתוֹ כִּמְנוֹר אֹרְגִֽים׃
translation: There was again war with the Philistines at Gob, and Elhanan the son of Jaare-Oregim the Bethlehemite killed Goliath the Gittite's brother, the staff of whose spear was like a weaver's beam. (2 Samuel 21:19)

text: וַיְהִי כְּהָכִין מַלְכוּת רְחַבְעָם וּכְחֶזְקָתוֹ עָזַב אֶת תּוֹרַת יְהוָה וְכָל יִשְׂרָאֵל עִמּֽוֹ׃
translation: When the kingdom of Rehoboam was established and he was strong, he abandoned the LORD's law, and all Israel with him. (2 Chronicles 12:1)

text: כִּי כֹה אָמַר יְהוָה אֵלַי כְּחֶזְקַת הַיָּד וְיִסְּרֵנִי מִלֶּכֶת בְּדֶרֶךְ הָֽעָם הַזֶּה לֵאמֹֽר׃
translation: For the LORD spoke this to me with a strong hand, and instructed me not to walk in the way of this people, saying, (Isaiah 8:11)

text: וּכְחֶזְקָתוֹ גָּבַהּ לִבּוֹ עַד לְהַשְׁחִית וַיִּמְעַל בַּיהוָה אֱלֹהָיו וַיָּבֹא אֶל הֵיכַל יְהוָה לְהַקְטִיר עַל מִזְבַּח הַקְּטֹֽרֶת׃
translation: But when he was strong, his heart was lifted up, so that he did corruptly and he trespassed against the LORD his God, for he went into the LORD's temple to burn incense on the altar of incense. (2 Chronicles 26:16)

text: וְיִתְכַּסּוּ שַׂקִּים הָֽאָדָם וְהַבְּהֵמָה וְיִקְרְאוּ אֶל אֱלֹהִים בְּחָזְקָה וְיָשֻׁבוּ אִישׁ מִדַּרְכּוֹ הָֽרָעָה וּמִן הֶחָמָס אֲשֶׁר בְּכַפֵּיהֶֽם׃
translation: but let them be covered with sackcloth, both man and animal, and let them cry mightily to God. Yes, let them turn everyone from his evil way and from the violence that is in his hands. (Jonah 3:8)

text: וַיִּצְעֲקוּ בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל יְהוָה כִּי תְּשַׁע מֵאוֹת רֶֽכֶב בַּרְזֶל לוֹ וְהוּא לָחַץ אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּחָזְקָה עֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָֽה׃
translation: The children of Israel cried to the LORD, for he had nine hundred chariots of iron; and he mightily oppressed the children of Israel for twenty years. (Judges 4:3)

text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֵלָיו אִישׁ אֶפְרַיִם מָֽה הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה עָשִׂיתָ לָּנוּ לְבִלְתִּי קְרֹאות לָנוּ כִּי הָלַכְתָּ לְהִלָּחֵם בְּמִדְיָן וַיְרִיבוּן אִתּוֹ בְּחָזְקָֽה׃
translation: The men of Ephraim said to him, "Why have you treated us this way, that you didn't call us when you went to fight with Midian?" They rebuked him sharply. (Judges 8:1)

text: וַיָּבֹאוּ מִן בְּנֵי בִנְיָמִן וִֽיהוּדָה עַד לַמְצָד לְדָוִֽיד׃
translation: David went out to meet them, and answered them, "If you have come peaceably to me to help me, my heart will be united with you; but if you have come to betray me to my adversaries, since there is no wrong in my hands, may the God of our fathers see this and rebuke it." (1 Chronicles 12:17)

text: וַיַּעַל דָּוִד מִשָּׁם וַיֵּשֶׁב בִּמְצָדוֹת עֵֽין גֶּֽדִי׃
translation: When Saul had returned from following the Philistines, he was told, "Behold, David is in the wilderness of En Gedi." (1 Samuel 24:1)

text: וַיֵּשֶׁב דָּוִיד בַּמְצָד עַל כֵּן קָרְאוּ לוֹ עִיר דָּוִֽיד׃
translation: David lived in the stronghold; therefore they called it David's city. (1 Chronicles 11:7)

text: הוּא מְרוֹמִים יִשְׁכֹּן מְצָדוֹת סְלָעִים מִשְׂגַּבּוֹ לַחְמוֹ נִתָּן מֵימָיו נֶאֱמָנִֽים׃
translation: he will dwell on high. His place of defense will be the fortress of rocks. His bread will be supplied. His waters will be sure. (Isaiah 33:16)

text: נִלְכְּדָה הַקְּרִיּוֹת וְהַמְּצָדוֹת נִתְפָּשָׂה וְֽהָיָה לֵב גִּבּוֹרֵי מוֹאָב בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא כְּלֵב אִשָּׁה מְצֵרָֽה׃
translation: Kerioth is taken, and the strongholds are seized. The heart of the mighty men of Moab at that day will be as the heart of a woman in her pangs. (Jeremiah 48:41)

text: חָדְלוּ גִבּוֹרֵי בָבֶל לְהִלָּחֵם יָֽשְׁבוּ בַּמְּצָדוֹת נָשְׁתָה גְבוּרָתָם הָיוּ לְנָשִׁים הִצִּיתוּ מִשְׁכְּנֹתֶיהָ נִשְׁבְּרוּ בְרִיחֶֽיהָ׃
translation: The mighty men of Babylon have stopped fighting, they remain in their strongholds. Their might has failed. They have become as women. Her dwelling places are set on fire. Her bars are broken. (Jeremiah 51:30)

text: יָפָה אַתְּ רַעְיָתִי כְּתִרְצָה נָאוָה כִּירוּשָׁלִָם אֲיֻמָּה כַּנִּדְגָּלֽוֹת׃
translation: You are beautiful, my love, as Tirzah, lovely as Jerusalem, awesome as an army with banners. (Song of Solomon 6:4)

text: הִנָּךְ יָפָה רַעְיָתִי הִנָּךְ יָפָה עֵינַיִךְ יוֹנִֽים׃
translation: Behold, you are beautiful, my love. Behold, you are beautiful. Your eyes are like doves. (Song of Solomon 1:15)

text: עָנָה דוֹדִי וְאָמַר לִי קוּמִי לָךְ רַעְיָתִי יָפָתִי וּלְכִי לָֽךְ׃
translation: My beloved spoke, and said to me, "Rise up, my love, my beautiful one, and come away. (Song of Solomon 2:10)

text: כֻּלָּךְ יָפָה רַעְיָתִי וּמוּם אֵין בָּֽךְ׃
translation: You are all beautiful, my love. There is no spot in you. (Song of Solomon 4:7)

text: לְסֻסָתִי בְּרִכְבֵי פַרְעֹה דִּמִּיתִיךְ רַעְיָתִֽי׃
translation: I have compared you, my love, to a steed in Pharaoh's chariots. (Song of Solomon 1:9)

text: הַתְּאֵנָה חָֽנְטָה פַגֶּיהָ וְהַגְּפָנִים סְמָדַר נָתְנוּ רֵיחַ קוּמִי לכי לָךְ רַעְיָתִי יָפָתִי וּלְכִי לָֽךְ׃
translation: The fig tree ripens her green figs. The vines are in blossom. They give out their fragrance. Arise, my love, my beautiful one, and come away." (Song of Solomon 2:13)

text: עַל יוֹמוֹ נָשַׁמּוּ אַחֲרֹנִים וְקַדְמֹנִים אָחֲזוּ שָֽׂעַר׃
translation: Those who come after will be astonished at his day, as those who went before were frightened. (Job 18:20)

text: וְעָֽרְבָה לַֽיהוָה מִנְחַת יְהוּדָה וִירֽוּשָׁלִָם כִּימֵי עוֹלָם וּכְשָׁנִים קַדְמֹנִיּֽוֹת׃
translation: Then the offering of Judah and Jerusalem will be pleasant to the LORD as in the days of old and as in ancient years. (Malachi 3:4)

text: אַֽל תִּזְכְּרוּ רִֽאשֹׁנוֹת וְקַדְמֹנִיּוֹת אַל תִּתְבֹּנָֽנוּ׃
translation: "Don't remember the former things, and don't consider the things of old. (Isaiah 43:18)

text: כַּאֲשֶׁר יֹאמַר מְשַׁל הַקַּדְמֹנִי מֵרְשָׁעִים יֵצֵא רֶשַׁע וְיָדִי לֹא תִֽהְיֶה בָּֽךְ׃
translation: Against whom has the king of Israel come out? Whom do you pursue? A dead dog? A flea? (1 Samuel 24:14)

text: וְהָיָה בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא יֵצְאוּ מַֽיִם חַיִּים מִירוּשָׁלִַם חֶצְיָם אֶל הַיָּם הַקַּדְמוֹנִי וְחֶצְיָם אֶל הַיָּם הָאַחֲרוֹן בַּקַּיִץ וּבָחֹרֶף יִֽהְיֶֽה׃
translation: It will happen in that day that living waters will go out from Jerusalem, half of them toward the eastern sea, and half of them toward the western sea. It will be so in summer and in winter. (Zechariah 14:8)

text: וּפְאַת קָדִים מִבֵּין חַוְרָן וּמִבֵּין דַּמֶּשֶׂק וּמִבֵּין הַגִּלְעָד וּמִבֵּין אֶרֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵל הַיַּרְדֵּן מִגְּבוּל עַל הַיָּם הַקַּדְמוֹנִי תָּמֹדּוּ וְאֵת פְּאַת קָדִֽימָה׃
translation: "The east side, between Hauran, Damascus, Gilead, and the land of Israel, shall be the Jordan; from the north border to the east sea you shall measure. This is the east side. (Ezekiel 47:18)

text: אֲנַחְנוּ פָּשַׁטְנוּ נֶגֶב הַכְּרֵתִי וְעַל אֲשֶׁר לִֽיהוּדָה וְעַל נֶגֶב כָּלֵב וְאֶת צִקְלַג שָׂרַפְנוּ בָאֵֽשׁ׃
translation: We made a raid on the South of the Cherethites, and on that which belongs to Judah, and on the South of Caleb; and we burned Ziklag with fire." (1 Samuel 30:14)

text: הוֹי יֹֽשְׁבֵי חֶבֶל הַיָּם גּוֹי כְּרֵתִים דְּבַר יְהוָה עֲלֵיכֶם כְּנַעַן אֶרֶץ פְּלִשְׁתִּים וְהַאֲבַדְתִּיךְ מֵאֵין יוֹשֵֽׁב׃
translation: Woe to the inhabitants of the sea coast, the nation of the Cherethites! The LORD's word is against you, Canaan, the land of the Philistines. I will destroy you until there is no inhabitant. (Zephaniah 2:5)

text: וְעַל יָדָם הֶחֱזִיק רְפָיָה בֶן חוּר שַׂר חֲצִי פֶּלֶךְ יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
translation: Next to them, Rephaiah the son of Hur, the ruler of half the district of Jerusalem, made repairs. (Nehemiah 3:9)

text: אַחֲרָיו הֶחֱזִיקוּ אֲחֵיהֶם בַּוַּי בֶּן חֵנָדָד שַׂר חֲצִי פֶּלֶךְ קְעִילָֽה׃
translation: After him, their brothers, Bavvai the son of Henadad, the ruler of half the district of Keilah made repairs. (Nehemiah 3:18)

text: יָדֶיהָ שִׁלְּחָה בַכִּישׁוֹר וְכַפֶּיהָ תָּמְכוּ פָֽלֶךְ׃
translation: She lays her hands to the distaff, and her hands hold the spindle. (Proverbs 31:19)

text: וְעַל יָדוֹ הֶחֱזִיק שַׁלּוּם בֶּן הַלּוֹחֵשׁ שַׂר חֲצִי פֶּלֶךְ יְרוּשָׁלִָם הוּא וּבְנוֹתָֽיו׃
translation: Next to him, Shallum the son of Hallohesh, the ruler of half the district of Jerusalem, he and his daughters made repairs. (Nehemiah 3:12)

text: אַחֲרָיו הֶחֱזִיקוּ הַלְוִיִּם רְחוּם בֶּן בָּנִי עַל יָדוֹ הֶחֱזִיק חֲשַׁבְיָה שַׂר חֲצִי פֶלֶךְ קְעִילָה לְפִלְכּֽוֹ׃
translation: After him, the Levites—Rehum the son of Bani made repairs. Next to him, Hashabiah, the ruler of half the district of Keilah, made repairs for his district. (Nehemiah 3:17)

text: יָחֻלוּ עַל רֹאשׁ יוֹאָב וְאֶל כָּל בֵּית אָבִיו וְֽאַל יִכָּרֵת מִבֵּית יוֹאָב זָב וּמְצֹרָע וּמַחֲזִיק בַּפֶּלֶךְ וְנֹפֵל בַּחֶרֶב וַחֲסַר לָֽחֶם׃
translation: Let it fall on the head of Joab and on all his father's house. Let there not fail from the house of Joab one who has a discharge, or who is a leper, or who leans on a staff, or who falls by the sword, or who lacks bread." (2 Samuel 3:29)

text: כַּחֲלוֹם יָעוּף וְלֹא יִמְצָאוּהוּ וְיֻדַּד כְּחֶזְיוֹן לָֽיְלָה׃
translation: He will fly away as a dream, and will not be found. Yes, he will be chased away like a vision of the night. (Job 20:8)

text: כְּכֹל הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה וּכְכֹל הַחִזָּיוֹן הַזֶּה כֵּן דִּבֶּר נָתָן אֶל דָּוִֽד׃
translation: Nathan spoke to David all these words, and according to all this vision. (2 Samuel 7:17)

text: וְחִתַּתַּנִי בַחֲלֹמוֹת וּֽמֵחֶזְיֹנוֹת תְּבַעֲתַֽנִּי׃
translation: then you scare me with dreams and terrify me through visions, (Job 7:14)

text: וְהָיָה אַֽחֲרֵי כֵן אֶשְׁפּוֹךְ אֶת רוּחִי עַל כָּל בָּשָׂר וְנִבְּאוּ בְּנֵיכֶם וּבְנֽוֹתֵיכֶם זִקְנֵיכֶם חֲלֹמוֹת יַחֲלֹמוּן בַּחוּרֵיכֶם חֶזְיֹנוֹת יִרְאֽוּ׃
translation: "For, behold, in those days, and in that time, when I restore the fortunes of Judah and Jerusalem, (Joel 3:1)

text: יִגֶל יְבוּל בֵּיתוֹ נִגָּרוֹת בְּיוֹם אַפּֽוֹ׃
translation: The increase of his house will depart. They will rush away in the day of his wrath. (Job 20:28)

text: עֵינִי נִגְּרָה וְלֹא תִדְמֶה מֵאֵין הֲפֻגֽוֹת׃
translation: My eye pours down and doesn't cease, without any intermission, (Lamentations 3:49)

text: וְנָמַסּוּ הֶֽהָרִים תַּחְתָּיו וְהָעֲמָקִים יִתְבַּקָּעוּ כַּדּוֹנַג מִפְּנֵי הָאֵשׁ כְּמַיִם מֻגָּרִים בְּמוֹרָֽד׃
translation: The mountains melt under him, and the valleys split apart like wax before the fire, like waters that are poured down a steep place. (Micah 1:4)

text: בְּיוֹם צָרָתִי אֲדֹנָי דָּרָשְׁתִּי יָדִי לַיְלָה נִגְּרָה וְלֹא תָפוּג מֵאֲנָה הִנָּחֵם נַפְשִֽׁי׃
translation: I remember God, and I groan. I complain, and my spirit is overwhelmed. Selah. (Psalms 77:3)

text: כִּי כוֹס בְּֽיַד יְהוָה וְיַיִן חָמַר מָלֵא מֶסֶךְ וַיַּגֵּר מִזֶּה אַךְ שְׁמָרֶיהָ יִמְצוּ יִשְׁתּוּ כֹּל רִשְׁעֵי אָֽרֶץ׃
translation: But I will declare this forever: I will sing praises to the God of Jacob. (Psalms 75:9)

text: יַעַן הֱיוֹת לְךָ אֵיבַת עוֹלָם וַתַּגֵּר אֶת בְּנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵל עַל יְדֵי חָרֶב בְּעֵת אֵידָם בְּעֵת עֲוֺן קֵֽץ׃
translation: "'"Because you have had a perpetual hostility, and have given over the children of Israel to the power of the sword in the time of their calamity, in the time of the iniquity of the end, (Ezekiel 35:5)

text: רַבַּת שָֽׂבְעָה לָּהּ נַפְשֵׁנוּ הַלַּעַג הַשַּׁאֲנַנִּים הַבּוּז לִגְאֵיוֹנִֽים׃
translation: Our soul is exceedingly filled with the scoffing of those who are at ease, with the contempt of the proud. (Psalms 123:4)

text: וְיָשַׁב עַמִּי בִּנְוֵה שָׁלוֹם וּֽבְמִשְׁכְּנוֹת מִבְטַחִים וּבִמְנוּחֹת שַׁאֲנַנּֽוֹת׃
translation: My people will live in a peaceful habitation, in safe dwellings, and in quiet resting places, (Isaiah 32:18)

text: לַפִּיד בּוּז לְעַשְׁתּוּת שַׁאֲנָן נָכוֹן לְמוֹעֲדֵי רָֽגֶל׃
translation: In the thought of him who is at ease there is contempt for misfortune. It is ready for them whose foot slips. (Job 12:5)

text: נָשִׁים שַֽׁאֲנַנּוֹת קֹמְנָה שְׁמַעְנָה קוֹלִי בָּנוֹת בֹּֽטחוֹת הַאְזֵנָּה אִמְרָתִֽי׃
translation: Rise up, you women who are at ease! Hear my voice! You careless daughters, give ear to my speech! (Isaiah 32:9)

text: חִרְדוּ שַֽׁאֲנַנּוֹת רְגָזָה בֹּֽטְחוֹת פְּשֹׁטָֽה וְעֹרָה וַחֲגוֹרָה עַל חֲלָצָֽיִם׃
translation: Tremble, you women who are at ease! Be troubled, you careless ones! Strip yourselves, make yourselves naked, and put sackcloth on your waist. (Isaiah 32:11)

text: הוֹי הַשַּׁאֲנַנִּים בְּצִיּוֹן וְהַבֹּטְחִים בְּהַר שֹׁמְרוֹן נְקֻבֵי רֵאשִׁית הַגּוֹיִם וּבָאוּ לָהֶם בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
translation: Woe to those who are at ease in Zion, and to those who are secure on the mountain of Samaria, the notable men of the chief of the nations, to whom the house of Israel come! (Amos 6:1)

text: וַיַּעְזְרֵהוּ הָֽאֱלֹהִים עַל פְּלִשְׁתִּים וְעַל הערביים הָֽעַרְבִים הַיֹּשְׁבִים בְּגוּר בָּעַל וְהַמְּעוּנִֽים׃
translation: God helped him against the Philistines, and against the Arabians who lived in Gur Baal, and the Meunim. (2 Chronicles 26:7)

text: וַיָּעַר יְהוָה עַל יְהוֹרָם אֵת רוּחַ הַפְּלִשְׁתִּים וְהָעַרְבִים אֲשֶׁר עַל יַד כּוּשִֽׁים׃
translation: The LORD stirred up against Jehoram the spirit of the Philistines and of the Arabians who are beside the Ethiopians; (2 Chronicles 21:16)

text: לֹֽא תֵשֵׁב לָנֶצַח וְלֹא תִשְׁכֹּן עַד דּוֹר וָדוֹר וְלֹֽא יַהֵל שָׁם עֲרָבִי וְרֹעִים לֹא יַרְבִּצוּ שָֽׁם׃
translation: It will never be inhabited, neither will it be lived in from generation to generation. The Arabian will not pitch a tent there, neither will shepherds make their flocks lie down there. (Isaiah 13:20)

text: שְׂאִֽי עֵינַיִךְ עַל שְׁפָיִם וּרְאִי אֵיפֹה לֹא שגלת שֻׁכַּבְתְּ עַל דְּרָכִים יָשַׁבְתְּ לָהֶם כַּעֲרָבִי בַּמִּדְבָּר וַתַּחֲנִיפִי אֶרֶץ בִּזְנוּתַיִךְ וּבְרָעָתֵֽךְ׃
translation: "Lift up your eyes to the bare heights, and see! Where have you not been lain with? You have sat waiting for them by the road, as an Arabian in the wilderness. You have polluted the land with your prostitution and with your wickedness. (Jeremiah 3:2)

text: וַיִּשְׁלַח אֵלַי סַנְבַלַּט כַּדָּבָר הַזֶּה פַּעַם חֲמִישִׁית אֶֽת נַעֲרוֹ וְאִגֶּרֶת פְּתוּחָה בְּיָדֽוֹ׃
translation: Then Sanballat sent his servant to me the same way the fifth time with an open letter in his hand, (Nehemiah 6:5)

text: גַּם טוֹבֹתָיו הָיוּ אֹמְרִים לְפָנַי וּדְבָרַי הָיוּ מוֹצִיאִים לוֹ אִגְּרוֹת שָׁלַח טוֹבִיָּה לְיָֽרְאֵֽנִי׃
translation: Also they spoke of his good deeds before me, and reported my words to him. Tobiah sent letters to put me in fear. (Nehemiah 6:19)

text: גַּם בַּיָּמִים הָהֵם מַרְבִּים חֹרֵי יְהוּדָה אִגְּרֹתֵיהֶם הוֹלְכוֹת עַל טוֹבִיָּה וַאֲשֶׁר לְטוֹבִיָּה בָּאוֹת אֲלֵיהֶֽם׃
translation: Moreover in those days the nobles of Judah sent many letters to Tobiah, and Tobiah's letters came to them. (Nehemiah 6:17)

text: וָֽאָבוֹא אֶֽל פַּֽחֲווֹת עֵבֶר הַנָּהָר וָאֶתְּנָה לָהֶם אֵת אִגְּרוֹת הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיִּשְׁלַח עִמִּי הַמֶּלֶךְ שָׂרֵי חַיִל וּפָרָשִֽׁים׃
translation: Then I came to the governors beyond the River, and gave them the king's letters. Now the king had sent captains of the army and horsemen with me. (Nehemiah 2:9)

text: וַתִּכְתֹּב אֶסְתֵּר הַמַּלְכָּה בַת אֲבִיחַיִל וּמָרְדֳּכַי הַיְּהוּדִי אֶת כָּל תֹּקֶף לְקַיֵּם אֵת אִגֶּרֶת הַפּוּרִים הַזֹּאת הַשֵּׁנִֽית׃
translation: Then Esther the queen, the daughter of Abihail, and Mordecai the Jew wrote with all authority to confirm this second letter of Purim. (Esther 9:29)

text: וָאוֹמַר לַמֶּלֶךְ אִם עַל הַמֶּלֶךְ טוֹב אִגְּרוֹת יִתְּנוּ לִי עַֽל פַּחֲווֹת עֵבֶר הַנָּהָר אֲשֶׁר יַעֲבִירוּנִי עַד אֲשֶׁר אָבוֹא אֶל יְהוּדָֽה׃
translation: Moreover I said to the king, "If it pleases the king, let letters be given me to the governors beyond the River, that they may let me pass through until I come to Judah; (Nehemiah 2:7)

text: אַתָּה דִכִּאתָ כֶחָלָל רָהַב בִּזְרוֹעַ עֻזְּךָ פִּזַּרְתָּ אוֹיְבֶֽיךָ׃
translation: The heavens are yours. The earth also is yours, the world and its fullness. You have founded them. (Psalms 89:11)

text: כְּמוֹ פֹלֵחַ וּבֹקֵעַ בָּאָרֶץ נִפְזְרוּ עֲצָמֵינוּ לְפִי שְׁאֽוֹל׃
translation: "As when one plows and breaks up the earth, our bones are scattered at the mouth of Sheol." (Psalms 141:7)

text: יֵשׁ מְפַזֵּר וְנוֹסָף עוֹד וְחוֹשֵׂךְ מִיֹּשֶׁר אַךְ לְמַחְסֽוֹר׃
translation: There is one who scatters, and increases yet more. There is one who withholds more than is appropriate, but gains poverty. (Proverbs 11:24)

text: פִּזַּר נָתַן לָאֶבְיוֹנִים צִדְקָתוֹ עֹמֶדֶת לָעַד קַרְנוֹ תָּרוּם בְּכָבֽוֹד׃
translation: He has dispersed, he has given to the poor. His righteousness endures forever. His horn will be exalted with honor. (Psalms 112:9)

text: שָׁם פָּֽחֲדוּ פַחַד לֹא הָיָה פָחַד כִּֽי אֱלֹהִים פִּזַּר עַצְמוֹת חֹנָךְ הֱבִשֹׁתָה כִּֽי אֱלֹהִים מְאָסָֽם׃
translation: Oh that the salvation of Israel would come out of Zion! When God brings back his people from captivity, then Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad. (Psalms 53:6)

text: שֶׂה פְזוּרָה יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲרָיוֹת הִדִּיחוּ הָרִאשׁוֹן אֲכָלוֹ מֶלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר וְזֶה הָאַחֲרוֹן עִצְּמוֹ נְבוּכַדְרֶאצַּר מֶלֶךְ בָּבֶֽל׃
translation: "Israel is a hunted sheep. The lions have driven him away. First, the king of Assyria devoured him, and now at last Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon has broken his bones." (Jeremiah 50:17)

text: צַהֲלִי קוֹלֵךְ בַּת גַּלִּים הַקְשִׁיבִי לַיְשָׁה עֲנִיָּה עֲנָתֽוֹת׃
translation: Cry aloud with your voice, daughter of Gallim! Listen, Laishah! You poor Anathoth! (Isaiah 10:30)

text: הֵמָּה יִשְׂאוּ קוֹלָם יָרֹנּוּ בִּגְאוֹן יְהוָה צָהֲלוּ מִיָּֽם׃
translation: These shall lift up their voice. They will shout for the majesty of the LORD. They cry aloud from the sea. (Isaiah 24:14)

text: צַהֲלִי וָרֹנִּי יוֹשֶׁבֶת צִיּוֹן כִּֽי גָדוֹל בְּקִרְבֵּךְ קְדוֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
translation: Cry aloud and shout, you inhabitant of Zion, for the Holy One of Israel is great among you!" (Isaiah 12:6)

text: סוּסִים מְיֻזָּנִים מַשְׁכִּים הָיוּ אִישׁ אֶל אֵשֶׁת רֵעֵהוּ יִצְהָֽלוּ׃
translation: They were as fed horses roaming at large. Everyone neighed after his neighbor's wife. (Jeremiah 5:8)

text: וְיַיִן יְשַׂמַּח לְֽבַב אֱנוֹשׁ לְהַצְהִיל פָּנִים מִשָּׁמֶן וְלֶחֶם לְֽבַב אֱנוֹשׁ יִסְעָֽד׃
translation: wine that makes the heart of man glad, oil to make his face to shine, and bread that strengthens man's heart. (Psalms 104:15)

text: כִּי תשמחי תִשְׂמְחוּ כִּי תעלזי תַֽעֲלְזוּ שֹׁסֵי נַחֲלָתִי כִּי תפושי תָפוּשׁוּ כְּעֶגְלָה דָשָׁה ותצהלי וְתִצְהֲלוּ כָּאֲבִּרִֽים׃
translation: "Because you are glad, because you rejoice, O you who plunder my heritage, because you are wanton as a heifer that treads out the grain, and neigh as strong horses, (Jeremiah 50:11)

text: כִּֽי לֹא נִצְמַתִּי מִפְּנֵי חֹשֶׁךְ וּמִפָּנַי כִּסָּה אֹֽפֶל׃
translation: Because I was not cut off before the darkness, neither did he cover the thick darkness from my face. (Job 23:17)

text: כִּי טוֹב קִוִּיתִי וַיָּבֹא רָע וַֽאֲיַחֲלָה לְאוֹר וַיָּבֹא אֹֽפֶל׃
translation: When I looked for good, then evil came. When I waited for light, darkness came. (Job 30:26)

text: קֵץ שָׂם לַחֹשֶׁךְ וּֽלְכָל תַּכְלִית הוּא חוֹקֵר אֶבֶן אֹפֶל וְצַלְמָֽוֶת׃
translation: Man sets an end to darkness, and searches out, to the furthest bound, the stones of obscurity and of thick darkness. (Job 28:3)

text: מִדֶּבֶר בָּאֹפֶל יַהֲלֹךְ מִקֶּטֶב יָשׁוּד צָהֳרָֽיִם׃
translation: nor of the pestilence that walks in darkness, nor of the destruction that wastes at noonday. (Psalms 91:6)

text: הֲלֹא חֹשֶׁךְ יוֹם יְהוָה וְלֹא אוֹר וְאָפֵל וְלֹא נֹגַֽהּ לֽוֹ׃
translation: Won't the day of the LORD be darkness, and not light? Even very dark, and no brightness in it? (Amos 5:20)

text: וְשָׁמְעוּ בַיּוֹם הַהוּא הַחֵרְשִׁים דִּבְרֵי סֵפֶר וּמֵאֹפֶל וּמֵחֹשֶׁךְ עֵינֵי עִוְרִים תִּרְאֶֽינָה׃
translation: In that day, the deaf will hear the words of the book, and the eyes of the blind will see out of obscurity and out of darkness. (Isaiah 29:18)

text: פָּנַי חמרמרה חֳמַרְמְרוּ מִנִּי בֶכִי וְעַל עַפְעַפַּי צַלְמָֽוֶת׃
translation: My face is red with weeping. Deep darkness is on my eyelids, (Job 16:16)

text: אַל תַּחְמֹד יָפְיָהּ בִּלְבָבֶךָ וְאַל תִּקָּֽחֲךָ בְּעַפְעַפֶּֽיהָ׃
translation: Don't lust after her beauty in your heart, neither let her captivate you with her eyelids. (Proverbs 6:25)

text: יֶחְשְׁכוּ כּוֹכְבֵי נִשְׁפּוֹ יְקַו לְאוֹר וָאַיִן וְאַל יִרְאֶה בְּעַפְעַפֵּי שָֽׁחַר׃
translation: Let the stars of its twilight be dark. Let it look for light, but have none, neither let it see the eyelids of the morning, (Job 3:9)

text: עֲֽטִישֹׁתָיו תָּהֶל אוֹר וְעֵינָיו כְּעַפְעַפֵּי שָֽׁחַר׃
translation: None is so fierce that he dare stir him up. Who then is he who can stand before me? (Job 41:10)

text: אִם אֶתֵּן שְׁנַת לְעֵינָי לְֽעַפְעַפַּי תְּנוּמָֽה׃
translation: I will not give sleep to my eyes, or slumber to my eyelids, (Psalms 132:4)

text: עֵינֶיךָ לְנֹכַח יַבִּיטוּ וְעַפְעַפֶּיךָ יַיְשִׁרוּ נֶגְדֶּֽךָ׃
translation: Let your eyes look straight ahead. Fix your gaze directly before you. (Proverbs 4:25)

text: לֹֽא יַעַרְכֶנָּה פִּטְדַת כּוּשׁ בְּכֶתֶם טָהוֹר לֹא תְסֻלֶּֽה׃
translation: The topaz of Ethiopia will not equal it. It won't be valued with pure gold. (Job 28:19)

text: אִם שַׂמְתִּי זָהָב כִּסְלִי וְלַכֶּתֶם אָמַרְתִּי מִבְטַחִֽי׃
translation: "If I have made gold my hope, and have said to the fine gold, 'You are my confidence;' (Job 31:24)

text: אֵיכָה יוּעַם זָהָב יִשְׁנֶא הַכֶּתֶם הַטּוֹב תִּשְׁתַּפֵּכְנָה אַבְנֵי קֹדֶשׁ בְּרֹאשׁ כָּל חוּצֽוֹת׃
translation: How the gold has become dim! The most pure gold has changed! The stones of the sanctuary are poured out at the head of every street. (Lamentations 4:1)

text: כִּי אִם תְּכַבְּסִי בַּנֶּתֶר וְתַרְבִּי לָךְ בֹּרִית נִכְתָּם עֲוֺנֵךְ לְפָנַי נְאֻם אֲדֹנָי יְהוִֽה׃
translation: For though you wash yourself with lye, and use much soap, yet your iniquity is marked before me," says the Lord GOD. (Jeremiah 2:22)

text: וָאֶשָּׂא אֶת עֵינַי וָאֵרֶא וְהִנֵּה אִישׁ אֶחָד לָבוּשׁ בַּדִּים וּמָתְנָיו חֲגֻרִים בְּכֶתֶם אוּפָֽז׃
translation: I lifted up my eyes and looked, and behold, there was a man clothed in linen, whose waist was adorned with pure gold of Uphaz. (Daniel 10:5)

text: לֹֽא נָאוֶה לִכְסִיל תַּעֲנוּג אַף כִּֽי לְעֶבֶד מְשֹׁל בְּשָׂרִֽים׃
translation: Delicate living is not appropriate for a fool, much less for a servant to have rule over princes. (Proverbs 19:10)

text: כַּשֶּׁלֶג בַּקַּיִץ וְכַמָּטָר בַּקָּצִיר כֵּן לֹא נָאוֶה לִכְסִיל כָּבֽוֹד׃
translation: Like snow in summer, and as rain in harvest, so honor is not fitting for a fool. (Proverbs 26:1)

text: שְׁחוֹרָה אֲנִי וְֽנָאוָה בְּנוֹת יְרוּשָׁלִָם כְּאָהֳלֵי קֵדָר כִּירִיעוֹת שְׁלֹמֹֽה׃
translation: I am dark, but lovely, you daughters of Jerusalem, like Kedar's tents, like Solomon's curtains. (Song of Solomon 1:5)

text: רַנְּנוּ צַדִּיקִים בַּֽיהוָה לַיְשָׁרִים נָאוָה תְהִלָּֽה׃
translation: Rejoice in the LORD, you righteous! Praise is fitting for the upright. (Psalms 33:1)

text: הַלְלוּ יָהּ כִּי טוֹב זַמְּרָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ כִּֽי נָעִים נָאוָה תְהִלָּֽה׃
translation: Praise the LORD, for it is good to sing praises to our God; for it is pleasant and fitting to praise him. (Psalms 147:1)

text: לֹא נָאוָה לְנָבָל שְׂפַת יֶתֶר אַף כִּֽי לְנָדִיב שְׂפַת שָֽׁקֶר׃
translation: Excellent speech isn't fitting for a fool, much less do lying lips fit a prince. (Proverbs 17:7)

text: כְּמַרְעִיתָם וַיִּשְׂבָּעוּ שָׂבְעוּ וַיָּרָם לִבָּם עַל כֵּן שְׁכֵחֽוּנִי׃
translation: According to their pasture, so were they filled; they were filled, and their heart was exalted. Therefore they have forgotten me. (Hosea 13:6)

text: הוֹי רֹעִים מְאַבְּדִים וּמְפִצִים אֶת צֹאן מַרְעִיתִי נְאֻם יְהוָֽה׃
translation: "Woe to the shepherds who destroy and scatter the sheep of my pasture!" says the LORD. (Jeremiah 23:1)

text: מַשְׂכִּיל לְאָסָף לָמָה אֱלֹהִים זָנַחְתָּ לָנֶצַח יֶעְשַׁן אַפְּךָ בְּצֹאן מַרְעִיתֶֽךָ׃
translation: A contemplation by Asaph. God, why have you rejected us forever? Why does your anger smolder against the sheep of your pasture? (Psalms 74:1)

text: וַאֲנַחְנוּ עַמְּךָ וְצֹאן מַרְעִיתֶךָ נוֹדֶה לְּךָ לְעוֹלָם לְדֹר וָדֹר נְסַפֵּר תְּהִלָּתֶֽךָ׃
translation: So we, your people and sheep of your pasture, will give you thanks forever. We will praise you forever, to all generations. (Psalms 79:13)

text: קוֹל צַעֲקַת הָֽרֹעִים וִֽילְלַת אַדִּירֵי הַצֹּאן כִּֽי שֹׁדֵד יְהוָה אֶת מַרְעִיתָֽם׃
translation: A voice of the cry of the shepherds, and the wailing of the leader of the flock, for the LORD destroys their pasture. (Jeremiah 25:36)

text: וְאַתֵּן צֹאנִי צֹאן מַרְעִיתִי אָדָם אַתֶּם אֲנִי אֱלֹהֵיכֶם נְאֻם אֲדֹנָי יְהוִֽה׃
translation: You my sheep, the sheep of my pasture, are men, and I am your God,' says the Lord GOD." (Ezekiel 34:31)

text: וְכָרוֹזָא קָרֵא בְחָיִל לְכוֹן אָֽמְרִין עַֽמְמַיָּא אֻמַּיָּא וְלִשָּׁנַיָּֽא׃
translation: Then the herald cried aloud, "To you it is commanded, peoples, nations, and languages, (Daniel 3:4)

text: אַל תַּלְשֵׁן עֶבֶד אֶל אדנו אֲדֹנָיו פֶּֽן יְקַלֶּלְךָ וְאָשָֽׁמְתָּ׃
translation: "Don't slander a servant to his master, lest he curse you, and you be held guilty. (Proverbs 30:10)

text: מלושני מְלָשְׁנִי בַסֵּתֶר רֵעֵהוּ אוֹתוֹ אַצְמִית גְּֽבַהּ עֵינַיִם וּרְחַב לֵבָב אֹתוֹ לֹא אוּכָֽל׃
translation: I will silence whoever secretly slanders his neighbor. I won't tolerate one who is arrogant and conceited. (Psalms 101:5)

text: בֵּאדַיִן דָּרְיָוֶשׁ מַלְכָּא כְּתַב לְֽכָל עַֽמְמַיָּא אֻמַיָּא וְלִשָּׁנַיָּא דִּֽי דארין דָיְרִין בְּכָל אַרְעָא שְׁלָמְכוֹן יִשְׂגֵּֽא׃
translation: "I make a decree that in all the dominion of my kingdom men tremble and fear before the God of Daniel. "For he is the living God, and steadfast forever. His kingdom is that which will not be destroyed. His dominion will be even to the end. (Daniel 6:26)

text: מַה יִּתְרוֹן לָֽאָדָם בְּכָל עֲמָלוֹ שֶֽׁיַּעֲמֹל תַּחַת הַשָּֽׁמֶשׁ׃
translation: What does man gain from all his labor in which he labors under the sun? (Ecclesiastes 1:3)

text: וְיִתְרוֹן אֶרֶץ בַּכֹּל היא הוּא מֶלֶךְ לְשָׂדֶה נֶעֱבָֽד׃
translation: If you see the oppression of the poor, and the violent taking away of justice and righteousness in a district, don't marvel at the matter, for one official is eyed by a higher one, and there are officials over them. (Ecclesiastes 5:8)

text: מַה יִּתְרוֹן הָֽעוֹשֶׂה בַּאֲשֶׁר הוּא עָמֵֽל׃
translation: What profit has he who works in that in which he labors? (Ecclesiastes 3:9)

text: כִּי בְּצֵל הַֽחָכְמָה בְּצֵל הַכָּסֶף וְיִתְרוֹן דַּעַת הַֽחָכְמָה תְּחַיֶּה בְעָלֶֽיהָ׃
translation: For wisdom is a defense, even as money is a defense; but the excellency of knowledge is that wisdom preserves the life of him who has it. (Ecclesiastes 7:12)

text: אִם קֵהָה הַבַּרְזֶל וְהוּא לֹא פָנִים קִלְקַל וַחֲיָלִים יְגַבֵּר וְיִתְרוֹן הכשיר הַכְשֵׁר חָכְמָֽה׃
translation: If the ax is blunt, and one doesn't sharpen the edge, then he must use more strength; but skill brings success. (Ecclesiastes 10:10)

text: וְגַם זֹה רָעָה חוֹלָה כָּל עֻמַּת שֶׁבָּא כֵּן יֵלֵךְ וּמַה יִּתְרוֹן לוֹ שֶֽׁיַּעֲמֹל לָרֽוּחַ׃
translation: As he came out of his mother's womb, naked shall he go again as he came, and shall take nothing for his labor, which he may carry away in his hand. (Ecclesiastes 5:15)

text: וַתִּזֶן אָהֳלָה תַּחְתָּי וַתַּעְגַּב עַֽל מְאַהֲבֶיהָ אֶל אַשּׁוּר קְרוֹבִֽים׃
translation: "Oholah played the prostitute when she was mine. She doted on her lovers, on the Assyrians her neighbors, (Ezekiel 23:5)

text: ותעגב וַתַּעְגְּבָה עֲלֵיהֶם לְמַרְאֵה עֵינֶיהָ וַתִּשְׁלַח מַלְאָכִים אֲלֵיהֶם כַּשְׂדִּֽימָה׃
translation: As soon as she saw them, she lusted after them and sent messengers to them into Chaldea. (Ezekiel 23:16)

text: לָכֵן נְתַתִּיהָ בְּיַד מְאַֽהֲבֶיהָ בְּיַד בְּנֵי אַשּׁוּר אֲשֶׁר עָגְבָה עֲלֵיהֶֽם׃
translation: "Therefore I delivered her into the hand of her lovers, into the hand of the Assyrians on whom she doted. (Ezekiel 23:9)

text: וַֽתַּעְגְּבָה עַל פִּֽלַגְשֵׁיהֶם אֲשֶׁר בְּשַׂר חֲמוֹרִים בְּשָׂרָם וְזִרְמַת סוּסִים זִרְמָתָֽם׃
translation: She lusted after their lovers, whose flesh is as the flesh of donkeys, and whose issue is like the issue of horses. (Ezekiel 23:20)

text: וַתִּתֵּן תַּזְנוּתֶיהָ עֲלֵיהֶם מִבְחַר בְּנֵֽי אַשּׁוּר כֻּלָּם וּבְכֹל אֲשֶׁר עָֽגְבָה בְּכָל גִּלּוּלֵיהֶם נִטְמָֽאָה׃
translation: She gave herself as a prostitute to them, all of them the choicest men of Assyria. She defiled herself with the idols of whomever she lusted after. (Ezekiel 23:7)

text: וְהִנְּךָ לָהֶם כְּשִׁיר עֲגָבִים יְפֵה קוֹל וּמֵטִב נַגֵּן וְשָֽׁמְעוּ אֶת דְּבָרֶיךָ וְעֹשִׂים אֵינָם אוֹתָֽם׃
translation: Behold, you are to them as a very lovely song of one who has a pleasant voice, and can play well on an instrument; for they hear your words, but they don't do them. (Ezekiel 33:32)

text: סָדִין עָשְׂתָה וַתִּמְכֹּר וַחֲגוֹר נָתְנָה לַֽכְּנַעֲנִֽי׃
translation: She makes linen garments and sells them, and delivers sashes to the merchant. (Proverbs 31:24)

text: וַתִּפָּקַחְנָה עֵינֵי שְׁנֵיהֶם וַיֵּדְעוּ כִּי עֵֽירֻמִּם הֵם וַֽיִּתְפְּרוּ עֲלֵה תְאֵנָה וַיַּעֲשׂוּ לָהֶם חֲגֹרֹֽת׃
translation: Their eyes were opened, and they both knew that they were naked. They sewed fig leaves together, and made coverings for themselves. (Genesis 3:7)

text: וַיִּתְפַּשֵּׁט יְהוֹנָתָן אֶֽת הַמְּעִיל אֲשֶׁר עָלָיו וַֽיִּתְּנֵהוּ לְדָוִד וּמַדָּיו וְעַד חַרְבּוֹ וְעַד קַשְׁתּוֹ וְעַד חֲגֹרֽוֹ׃
translation: Jonathan stripped himself of the robe that was on him and gave it to David with his clothing, even including his sword, his bow, and his sash. (1 Samuel 18:4)

text: חֲגוֹרֵי אֵזוֹר בְּמָתְנֵיהֶם סְרוּחֵי טְבוּלִים בְּרָאשֵׁיהֶם מַרְאֵה שָׁלִשִׁים כֻּלָּם דְּמוּת בְּנֵֽי בָבֶל כַּשְׂדִּים אֶרֶץ מוֹלַדְתָּֽם׃
translation: dressed with belts on their waists, with flowing turbans on their heads, all of them looking like princes, after the likeness of the Babylonians in Chaldea, the land of their birth. (Ezekiel 23:15)

text: וְכָל מוֹאָב שָֽׁמְעוּ כִּֽי עָלוּ הַמְּלָכִים לְהִלָּחֶם בָּם וַיִּצָּעֲקוּ מִכֹּל חֹגֵר חֲגֹרָה וָמַעְלָה וַיַּעַמְדוּ עַֽל הַגְּבֽוּל׃
translation: Now when all the Moabites heard that the kings had come up to fight against them, they gathered themselves together, all who were able to put on armor, young and old, and stood on the border. (2 Kings 3:21)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר יוֹאָב לָאִישׁ הַמַּגִּיד לוֹ וְהִנֵּה רָאִיתָ וּמַדּוּעַ לֹֽא הִכִּיתוֹ שָׁם אָרְצָה וְעָלַי לָתֶת לְךָ עֲשָׂרָה כֶסֶף וַחֲגֹרָה אֶחָֽת׃
translation: Joab said to the man who told him, "Behold, you saw it, and why didn't you strike him there to the ground? I would have given you ten pieces of silver and a sash." (2 Samuel 18:11)

text: וְהַשְּׂעֹרִים וְהַתֶּבֶן לַסּוּסִים וְלָרָכֶשׁ יָבִאוּ אֶל הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר יִֽהְיֶה שָּׁם אִישׁ כְּמִשְׁפָּטֽוֹ׃
translation: Hiram sent to Solomon, saying, "I have heard the message which you have sent to me. I will do all your desire concerning timber of cedar, and concerning cypress timber. (1 Kings 5:8)

text: הָרָצִים רֹכְבֵי הָרֶכֶשׁ הָֽאֲחַשְׁתְּרָנִים יָֽצְאוּ מְבֹהָלִים וּדְחוּפִים בִּדְבַר הַמֶּלֶךְ וְהַדָּת נִתְּנָה בְּשׁוּשַׁן הַבִּירָֽה׃
translation: So the couriers who rode on royal horses went out, hastened and pressed on by the king's commandment. The decree was given out in the citadel of Susa. (Esther 8:14)

text: וַיִּקְחוּ אֶת מִקְנֵיהֶם וְאֶת רְכוּשָׁם אֲשֶׁר רָֽכְשׁוּ בְּאֶרֶץ כְּנַעַן וַיָּבֹאוּ מִצְרָיְמָה יַעֲקֹב וְכָל זַרְעוֹ אִתּֽוֹ׃
translation: They took their livestock, and their goods, which they had gotten in the land of Canaan, and came into Egypt—Jacob, and all his offspring with him, (Genesis 46:6)

text: רְתֹם הַמֶּרְכָּבָה לָרֶכֶשׁ יוֹשֶׁבֶת לָכִישׁ רֵאשִׁית חַטָּאת הִיא לְבַת צִיּוֹן כִּי בָךְ נִמְצְאוּ פִּשְׁעֵי יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
translation: Harness the chariot to the swift steed, inhabitant of Lachish. She was the beginning of sin to the daughter of Zion; for the transgressions of Israel were found in you. (Micah 1:13)

text: וַיִּכְתֹּב בְּשֵׁם הַמֶּלֶךְ אֲחַשְׁוֵרֹשׁ וַיַּחְתֹּם בְּטַבַּעַת הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיִּשְׁלַח סְפָרִים בְּיַד הָרָצִים בַּסּוּסִים רֹכְבֵי הָרֶכֶשׁ הָֽאֲחַשְׁתְּרָנִים בְּנֵי הָֽרַמָּכִֽים׃
translation: He wrote in the name of King Ahasuerus, and sealed it with the king's ring, and sent letters by courier on horseback, riding on royal horses that were bred from swift steeds. (Esther 8:10)

text: עֹבְרֵי בְּעֵמֶק הַבָּכָא מַעְיָן יְשִׁיתוּהוּ גַּם בְּרָכוֹת יַעְטֶה מוֹרֶֽה׃
translation: They go from strength to strength. Every one of them appears before God in Zion. (Psalms 84:7)

text: וַיַּעֲבֹר אַבְרָם בָּאָרֶץ עַד מְקוֹם שְׁכֶם עַד אֵלוֹן מוֹרֶה וְהַֽכְּנַעֲנִי אָז בָּאָֽרֶץ׃
translation: Abram passed through the land to the place of Shechem, to the oak of Moreh. At that time, Canaanites were in the land. (Genesis 12:6)

text: הֲלֹא הֵמָּה בְּעֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן אַֽחֲרֵי דֶּרֶךְ מְבוֹא הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ בְּאֶרֶץ הַֽכְּנַעֲנִי הַיֹּשֵׁב בָּעֲרָבָה מוּל הַגִּלְגָּל אֵצֶל אֵלוֹנֵי מֹרֶֽה׃
translation: Aren't they beyond the Jordan, behind the way of the going down of the sun, in the land of the Canaanites who dwell in the Arabah near Gilgal, beside the oaks of Moreh? (Deuteronomy 11:30)

text: וּבְנֵי צִיּוֹן גִּילוּ וְשִׂמְחוּ בַּיהוָה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶם כִּֽי נָתַן לָכֶם אֶת הַמּוֹרֶה לִצְדָקָה וַיּוֹרֶד לָכֶם גֶּשֶׁם מוֹרֶה וּמַלְקוֹשׁ בָּרִאשֽׁוֹן׃
translation: "Be glad then, you children of Zion, and rejoice in the LORD, your God; for he gives you the early rain in just measure, and he causes the rain to come down for you, the early rain and the latter rain, as before. (Joel 2:23)

text: וַיַּשְׁכֵּם יְרֻבַּעַל הוּא גִדְעוֹן וְכָל הָעָם אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ וַֽיַּחֲנוּ עַל עֵין חֲרֹד וּמַחֲנֵה מִדְיָן הָיָה לוֹ מִצָּפוֹן מִגִּבְעַת הַמּוֹרֶה בָּעֵֽמֶק׃
translation: Then Jerubbaal, who is Gideon, and all the people who were with him, rose up early and encamped beside the spring of Harod. Midian's camp was on the north side of them, by the hill of Moreh, in the valley. (Judges 7:1)

text: תַּחַת שְׂנוּאָה כִּי תִבָּעֵל וְשִׁפְחָה כִּֽי תִירַשׁ גְּבִרְתָּֽהּ׃
translation: for an unloved woman when she is married, and a servant who is heir to her mistress. (Proverbs 30:23)

text: וַיָּבֹא אֶל הָגָר וַתַּהַר וַתֵּרֶא כִּי הָרָתָה וַתֵּקַל גְּבִרְתָּהּ בְּעֵינֶֽיהָ׃
translation: He went in to Hagar, and she conceived. When she saw that she had conceived, her mistress was despised in her eyes. (Genesis 16:4)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר לָהּ מַלְאַךְ יְהוָה שׁוּבִי אֶל גְּבִרְתֵּךְ וְהִתְעַנִּי תַּחַת יָדֶֽיהָ׃
translation: The LORD's angel said to her, "Return to your mistress, and submit yourself under her hands." (Genesis 16:9)

text: וַתֹּאמֶר אֶל גְּבִרְתָּהּ אַחֲלֵי אֲדֹנִי לִפְנֵי הַנָּבִיא אֲשֶׁר בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן אָז יֶאֱסֹף אֹתוֹ מִצָּרַעְתּֽוֹ׃
translation: She said to her mistress, "I wish that my lord were with the prophet who is in Samaria! Then he would heal him of his leprosy." (2 Kings 5:3)

text: שְׁבִי דוּמָם וּבֹאִי בַחֹשֶׁךְ בַּת כַּשְׂדִּים כִּי לֹא תוֹסִיפִי יִקְרְאוּ לָךְ גְּבֶרֶת מַמְלָכֽוֹת׃
translation: "Sit in silence, and go into darkness, daughter of the Chaldeans. For you shall no longer be called the mistress of kingdoms. (Isaiah 47:5)

text: וַתֹּאמְרִי לְעוֹלָם אֶהְיֶה גְבָרֶת עַד לֹא שַׂמְתְּ אֵלֶּה עַל לִבֵּךְ לֹא זָכַרְתְּ אַחֲרִיתָֽהּ׃
translation: You said, 'I will be a princess forever,' so that you didn't lay these things to your heart, nor did you remember the results. (Isaiah 47:7)

text: יִכֶל בְּשָׂרוֹ מֵרֹאִי ושפי וְשֻׁפּוּ עַצְמוֹתָיו לֹא רֻאּֽוּ׃
translation: His flesh is so consumed away that it can't be seen. His bones that were not seen stick out. (Job 33:21)

text: לֹֽא תְשׁוּרֵנִי עֵין רֹאִי עֵינֶיךָ בִּי וְאֵינֶֽנִּי׃
translation: The eye of him who sees me will see me no more. Your eyes will be on me, but I will not be. (Job 7:8)

text: וְיִצְחָק בָּא מִבּוֹא בְּאֵר לַחַי רֹאִי וְהוּא יוֹשֵׁב בְּאֶרֶץ הַנֶּֽגֶב׃
translation: Isaac came from the way of Beer Lahai Roi, for he lived in the land of the South. (Genesis 24:62)

text: תַּרְקִיעַ עִמּוֹ לִשְׁחָקִים חֲזָקִים כִּרְאִי מוּצָֽק׃
translation: Can you, with him, spread out the sky, which is strong as a cast metal mirror? (Job 37:18)

text: וְהִשְׁלַכְתִּי עָלַיִךְ שִׁקֻּצִים וְנִבַּלְתִּיךְ וְשַׂמְתִּיךְ כְּרֹֽאִי׃
translation: I will throw abominable filth on you and make you vile, and will make you a spectacle. (Nahum 3:6)

text: עַל כֵּן קָרָא לַבְּאֵר בְּאֵר לַחַי רֹאִי הִנֵּה בֵין קָדֵשׁ וּבֵין בָּֽרֶד׃
translation: Therefore the well was called Beer Lahai Roi. Behold, it is between Kadesh and Bered. (Genesis 16:14)

text: וַיִּבְנֶה אֶת הָאֲבָנִים מִזְבֵּחַ בְּשֵׁם יְהוָה וַיַּעַשׂ תְּעָלָה כְּבֵית סָאתַיִם זֶרַע סָבִיב לַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃
translation: With the stones he built an altar in the LORD's name. He made a trench around the altar large enough to contain two seahs of seed. (1 Kings 18:32)

text: וַיְמַהֵר אַבְרָהָם הָאֹהֱלָה אֶל שָׂרָה וַיֹּאמֶר מַהֲרִי שְׁלֹשׁ סְאִים קֶמַח סֹלֶת לוּשִׁי וַעֲשִׂי עֻגֽוֹת׃
translation: Abraham hurried into the tent to Sarah, and said, "Quickly prepare three seahs of fine meal, knead it, and make cakes." (Genesis 18:6)

text: וַיֵּצֵא הָעָם וַיָּבֹזּוּ אֵת מַחֲנֵה אֲרָם וַיְהִי סְאָה סֹלֶת בְּשֶׁקֶל וְסָאתַיִם שְׂעֹרִים בְּשֶׁקֶל כִּדְבַר יְהוָֽה׃
translation: The people went out and plundered the camp of the Syrians. So a seah of fine flour was sold for a shekel, and two measures of barley for a shekel, according to the LORD's word. (2 Kings 7:16)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֱלִישָׁע שִׁמְעוּ דְּבַר יְהוָה כֹּה אָמַר יְהוָה כָּעֵת מָחָר סְאָֽה סֹלֶת בְּשֶׁקֶל וְסָאתַיִם שְׂעֹרִים בְּשֶׁקֶל בְּשַׁעַר שֹׁמְרֽוֹן׃
translation: Elisha said, "Hear the LORD's word. The LORD says, 'Tomorrow about this time a seah of fine flour will be sold for a shekel, and two seahs of barley for a shekel, in the gate of Samaria.'" (2 Kings 7:1)

text: וַיְהִי כְּדַבֵּר אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים אֶל הַמֶּלֶךְ לֵאמֹר סָאתַיִם שְׂעֹרִים בְּשֶׁקֶל וּֽסְאָה סֹלֶת בְּשֶׁקֶל יִהְיֶה כָּעֵת מָחָר בְּשַׁעַר שֹׁמְרֽוֹן׃
translation: It happened as the man of God had spoken to the king, saying, "Two seahs of barley for a shekel, and a seah of fine flour for a shekel, shall be tomorrow about this time in the gate of Samaria;" (2 Kings 7:18)

text: כִּי לוּלֵא הִתְמַהְמָהְנוּ כִּֽי עַתָּה שַׁבְנוּ זֶה פַעֲמָֽיִם׃
translation: for if we hadn't delayed, surely we would have returned a second time by now." (Genesis 43:10)

text: וְאֵהוּד נִמְלַט עַד הִֽתְמַהְמְהָם וְהוּא עָבַר אֶת הַפְּסִילִים וַיִּמָּלֵט הַשְּׂעִירָֽתָה׃
translation: Ehud escaped while they waited, passed beyond the stone idols, and escaped to Seirah. (Judges 3:26)

text: הִתְמַהְמְהוּ וּתְמָהוּ הִשְׁתַּֽעַשְׁעוּ וָשֹׁעוּ שָֽׁכְרוּ וְלֹא יַיִן נָעוּ וְלֹא שֵׁכָֽר׃
translation: Pause and wonder! Blind yourselves and be blind! They are drunken, but not with wine; they stagger, but not with strong drink. (Isaiah 29:9)

text: חַשְׁתִּי וְלֹא הִתְמַהְמָהְתִּי לִשְׁמֹר מִצְוֺתֶֽיךָ׃
translation: I will hurry, and not delay, to obey your commandments. (Psalms 119:60)

text: רְאוּ אָנֹכִי מִתְמַהְמֵהַּ בעברות בְּעַֽרְבוֹת הַמִּדְבָּר עַד בּוֹא דָבָר מֵעִמָּכֶם לְהַגִּיד לִֽי׃
translation: Behold, I will stay at the fords of the wilderness until word comes from you to inform me." (2 Samuel 15:28)

text: וַֽיִּתְמַהְמָהּ וַיַּחֲזִקוּ הָאֲנָשִׁים בְּיָדוֹ וּבְיַד אִשְׁתּוֹ וּבְיַד שְׁתֵּי בְנֹתָיו בְּחֶמְלַת יְהוָה עָלָיו וַיֹּצִאֻהוּ וַיַּנִּחֻהוּ מִחוּץ לָעִֽיר׃
translation: But he lingered; and the men grabbed his hand, his wife's hand, and his two daughters' hands, the LORD being merciful to him; and they took him out, and set him outside of the city. (Genesis 19:16)

text: אִם אֶרְאֶה אוֹבֵד מִבְּלִי לְבוּשׁ וְאֵין כְּסוּת לָאֶבְיֽוֹן׃
translation: if I have seen any perish for want of clothing, or that the needy had no covering; (Job 31:19)

text: אִם אַחֶרֶת יִֽקַּֽח לוֹ שְׁאֵרָהּ כְּסוּתָהּ וְעֹנָתָהּ לֹא יִגְרָֽע׃
translation: If he takes another wife to himself, he shall not diminish her food, her clothing, and her marital rights. (Exodus 21:10)

text: עָרוֹם יָלִינוּ מִבְּלִי לְבוּשׁ וְאֵין כְּסוּת בַּקָּרָֽה׃
translation: They lie all night naked without clothing, and have no covering in the cold. (Job 24:7)

text: גְּדִלִים תַּעֲשֶׂה לָּךְ עַל אַרְבַּע כַּנְפוֹת כְּסוּתְךָ אֲשֶׁר תְּכַסֶּה בָּֽהּ׃
translation: You shall make yourselves fringes on the four corners of your cloak with which you cover yourself. (Deuteronomy 22:12)

text: עָרוֹם שְׁאוֹל נֶגְדּוֹ וְאֵין כְּסוּת לָֽאֲבַדּֽוֹן׃
translation: Sheol is naked before God, and Abaddon has no covering. (Job 26:6)

text: אַלְבִּישׁ שָׁמַיִם קַדְרוּת וְשַׂק אָשִׂים כְּסוּתָֽם׃
translation: I clothe the heavens with blackness. I make sackcloth their covering." (Isaiah 50:3)

text: יוֹמָם יְפַגְּשׁוּ חֹשֶׁךְ וְכַלַּיְלָה יְֽמַשְׁשׁוּ בַֽצָּהֳרָֽיִם׃
translation: They meet with darkness in the day time, and grope at noonday as in the night. (Job 5:14)

text: יְמַֽשְׁשׁוּ חֹשֶׁךְ וְלֹא אוֹר וַיַּתְעֵם כַּשִּׁכּֽוֹר׃
translation: They grope in the dark without light. He makes them stagger like a drunken man. (Job 12:25)

text: אוּלַי יְמֻשֵּׁנִי אָבִי וְהָיִיתִי בְעֵינָיו כִּמְתַעְתֵּעַ וְהֵבֵאתִי עָלַי קְלָלָה וְלֹא בְרָכָֽה׃
translation: What if my father touches me? I will seem to him as a deceiver, and I would bring a curse on myself, and not a blessing." (Genesis 27:12)

text: וַיִּגַּשׁ יַעֲקֹב אֶל יִצְחָק אָבִיו וַיְמֻשֵּׁהוּ וַיֹּאמֶר הַקֹּל קוֹל יַעֲקֹב וְהַיָּדַיִם יְדֵי עֵשָֽׂו׃
translation: Jacob went near to Isaac his father. He felt him, and said, "The voice is Jacob's voice, but the hands are the hands of Esau." (Genesis 27:22)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה נְטֵה יָֽדְךָ עַל הַשָּׁמַיִם וִיהִי חֹשֶׁךְ עַל אֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם וְיָמֵשׁ חֹֽשֶׁךְ׃
translation: The LORD said to Moses, "Stretch out your hand toward the sky, that there may be darkness over the land of Egypt, even darkness which may be felt." (Exodus 10:21)

text: וְרָחֵל לָקְחָה אֶת הַתְּרָפִים וַתְּשִׂמֵם בְּכַר הַגָּמָל וַתֵּשֶׁב עֲלֵיהֶם וַיְמַשֵּׁשׁ לָבָן אֶת כָּל הָאֹהֶל וְלֹא מָצָֽא׃
translation: Now Rachel had taken the teraphim, put them in the camel's saddle, and sat on them. Laban felt around all the tent, but didn't find them. (Genesis 31:34)

text: כְּרֹעֶה עֶדְרוֹ יִרְעֶה בִּזְרֹעוֹ יְקַבֵּץ טְלָאִים וּבְחֵיקוֹ יִשָּׂא עָלוֹת יְנַהֵֽל׃
translation: He will feed his flock like a shepherd. He will gather the lambs in his arm, and carry them in his bosom. He will gently lead those who have their young. (Isaiah 40:11)

text: וַתִּקְחִי מִבְּגָדַיִךְ וַתַּֽעֲשִׂי לָךְ בָּמוֹת טְלֻאוֹת וַתִּזְנִי עֲלֵיהֶם לֹא בָאוֹת וְלֹא יִהְיֶֽה׃
translation: You took some of your garments, and made for yourselves high places decked with various colors, and played the prostitute on them. This shouldn't happen, neither shall it be. (Ezekiel 16:16)

text: וּנְעָלוֹת בָּלוֹת וּמְטֻלָּאוֹת בְּרַגְלֵיהֶם וּשְׂלָמוֹת בָּלוֹת עֲלֵיהֶם וְכֹל לֶחֶם צֵידָם יָבֵשׁ הָיָה נִקֻּדִֽים׃
translation: and old and patched sandals on their feet, and wore old garments. All the bread of their food supply was dry and moldy. (Joshua 9:5)

text: אֶֽעֱבֹר בְּכָל צֹֽאנְךָ הַיּוֹם הָסֵר מִשָּׁם כָּל שֶׂה נָקֹד וְטָלוּא וְכָל שֶׂה חוּם בַּכְּשָׂבִים וְטָלוּא וְנָקֹד בָּעִזִּים וְהָיָה שְׂכָרִֽי׃
translation: I will pass through all your flock today, removing from there every speckled and spotted one, and every black one among the sheep, and the spotted and speckled among the goats. This will be my hire. (Genesis 30:32)

text: אִם טָרֹף יִטָּרֵף יְבִאֵהוּ עֵד הַטְּרֵפָה לֹא יְשַׁלֵּֽם׃
translation: But if it is stolen from him, the one who stole shall make restitution to its owner. (Exodus 22:12)

text: נְבֵלָה וּטְרֵפָה לֹא יֹאכַל לְטָמְאָה בָהּ אֲנִי יְהוָֽה׃
translation: He shall not eat that which dies of itself or is torn by animals, defiling himself by it. I am the LORD. (Leviticus 22:8)

text: וְחֵלֶב נְבֵלָה וְחֵלֶב טְרֵפָה יֵעָשֶׂה לְכָל מְלָאכָה וְאָכֹל לֹא תֹאכְלֻֽהוּ׃
translation: The fat of that which dies of itself, and the fat of that which is torn of animals, may be used for any other service, but you shall in no way eat of it. (Leviticus 7:24)

text: כָּל נְבֵלָה וּטְרֵפָה מִן הָעוֹף וּמִן הַבְּהֵמָה לֹא יֹאכְלוּ הַכֹּהֲנִֽים׃
translation: The priests shall not eat of anything that dies of itself or is torn, whether it is bird or animal. (Ezekiel 44:31)

text: אַרְיֵה טֹרֵף בְּדֵי גֹֽרוֹתָיו וּמְחַנֵּק לְלִבְאֹתָיו וַיְמַלֵּא טֶרֶף חֹרָיו וּמְעֹֽנֹתָיו טְרֵפָֽה׃
translation: "Behold, I am against you," says the LORD of Armies, "and I will burn her chariots in the smoke, and the sword will devour your young lions; and I will cut off your prey from the earth, and the voice of your messengers will no longer be heard." (Nahum 2:13)

text: טְרֵפָה לֹא הֵבֵאתִי אֵלֶיךָ אָנֹכִי אֲחַטֶּנָּה מִיָּדִי תְּבַקְשֶׁנָּה גְּנֻֽבְתִי יוֹם וּגְנֻֽבְתִי לָֽיְלָה׃
translation: That which was torn of animals, I didn't bring to you. I bore its loss. Of my hand you required it, whether stolen by day or stolen by night. (Genesis 31:39)

text: וַיָּמָת יוֹבָב וַיִּמְלֹךְ תַּחְתָּיו חֻשָׁם מֵאֶרֶץ הַתֵּימָנִֽי׃
translation: Jobab died, and Husham of the land of the Temanites reigned in his place. (Genesis 36:34)

text: וַיָּמָת יוֹבָב וַיִּמְלֹךְ תַּחְתָּיו חוּשָׁם מֵאֶרֶץ הַתֵּימָנִֽי׃
translation: Jobab died, and Husham of the land of the Temanites reigned in his place. (1 Chronicles 1:45)

text: וַיַּעַן אֱלִיפַז הַֽתֵּימָנִי וַיֹּאמַֽר׃
translation: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered, (Job 4:1)

text: וַיַּעַן אֱלִיפַז הַֽתֵּימָנִי וַיֹּאמַֽר׃
translation: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered, (Job 15:1)

text: וַיַּעַן אֱלִיפַז הַֽתֵּמָנִי וַיֹּאמַֽר׃
translation: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered, (Job 22:1)

text: וַתֵּלֶד לוֹ נַעֲרָה אֶת אֲחֻזָּם וְאֶת חֵפֶר וְאֶת תֵּימְנִי וְאֶת הָאֲחַשְׁתָּרִי אֵלֶּה בְּנֵי נַעֲרָֽה׃
translation: Naarah bore him Ahuzzam, Hepher, Temeni, and Haahashtari. These were the sons of Naarah. (1 Chronicles 4:6)

text: מְכַסֶּה שִׂנְאָה שִׂפְתֵי שָׁקֶר וּמוֹצִא דִבָּה הוּא כְסִֽיל׃
translation: He who hides hatred has lying lips. He who utters a slander is a fool. (Proverbs 10:18)

text: וַיָּמֻתוּ הָֽאֲנָשִׁים מוֹצִאֵי דִבַּת הָאָרֶץ רָעָה בַּמַּגֵּפָה לִפְנֵי יְהוָֽה׃
translation: even those men who brought up an evil report of the land, died by the plague before the LORD. (Numbers 14:37)

text: פֶּֽן יְחַסֶּדְךָ שֹׁמֵעַ וְדִבָּתְךָ לֹא תָשֽׁוּב׃
translation: lest one who hears it put you to shame, and your bad reputation never depart. (Proverbs 25:10)

text: כִּי שָׁמַעְתִּי דִּבַּת רַבִּים מָגוֹר מִסָּבִיב בְּהִוָּסְדָם יַחַד עָלַי לָקַחַת נַפְשִׁי זָמָֽמוּ׃
translation: But I trust in you, LORD. I said, "You are my God." (Psalms 31:14)

text: וְהָאֲנָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר שָׁלַח מֹשֶׁה לָתוּר אֶת הָאָרֶץ וַיָּשֻׁבוּ וילונו וַיַּלִּינוּ עָלָיו אֶת כָּל הָעֵדָה לְהוֹצִיא דִבָּה עַל הָאָֽרֶץ׃
translation: The men whom Moses sent to spy out the land, who returned and made all the congregation to murmur against him by bringing up an evil report against the land, (Numbers 14:36)

text: כִּי שָׁמַעְתִּי דִּבַּת רַבִּים מָגוֹר מִסָּבִיב הַגִּידוּ וְנַגִּידֶנּוּ כֹּל אֱנוֹשׁ שְׁלוֹמִי שֹׁמְרֵי צַלְעִי אוּלַי יְפֻתֶּה וְנוּכְלָה לוֹ וְנִקְחָה נִקְמָתֵנוּ מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃
translation: For I have heard the defaming of many: "Terror on every side! Denounce, and we will denounce him!" say all my familiar friends, those who watch for my fall. "Perhaps he will be persuaded, and we will prevail against him, and we will take our revenge on him." (Jeremiah 20:10)

text: שָׁרְרֵךְ אַגַּן הַסַּהַר אַל יֶחְסַר הַמָּזֶג בִּטְנֵךְ עֲרֵמַת חִטִּים סוּגָה בַּשּׁוֹשַׁנִּֽים׃
translation: Your two breasts are like two fawns, that are twins of a roe. (Song of Solomon 7:3)

text: וַיְהִי יְהוָה אֶת יוֹסֵף וַיֵּט אֵלָיו חָסֶד וַיִּתֵּן חִנּוֹ בְּעֵינֵי שַׂר בֵּית הַסֹּֽהַר׃
translation: But the LORD was with Joseph, and showed kindness to him, and gave him favor in the sight of the keeper of the prison. (Genesis 39:21)
