text: וַיִּתֵּן אֹתָם בְּמִשְׁמַר בֵּית שַׂר הַטַבָּחִים אֶל בֵּית הַסֹּהַר מְקוֹם אֲשֶׁר יוֹסֵף אָסוּר שָֽׁם׃
translation: He put them in custody in the house of the captain of the guard, into the prison, the place where Joseph was bound. (Genesis 40:3)

text: אֵין שַׂר בֵּית הַסֹּהַר רֹאֶה אֶֽת כָּל מְאוּמָה בְּיָדוֹ בַּאֲשֶׁר יְהוָה אִתּוֹ וַֽאֲשֶׁר הוּא עֹשֶׂה יְהוָה מַצְלִֽיחַ׃
translation: The keeper of the prison didn't look after anything that was under his hand, because the LORD was with him; and that which he did, the LORD made it prosper. (Genesis 39:23)

text: וַיִּקַּח אֲדֹנֵי יוֹסֵף אֹתוֹ וַֽיִּתְּנֵהוּ אֶל בֵּית הַסֹּהַר מְקוֹם אֲשֶׁר אסורי אֲסִירֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ אֲסוּרִים וַֽיְהִי שָׁם בְּבֵית הַסֹּֽהַר׃
translation: Joseph's master took him, and put him into the prison, the place where the king's prisoners were bound, and he was there in custody. (Genesis 39:20)

text: וַיַּֽחַלְמוּ חֲלוֹם שְׁנֵיהֶם אִישׁ חֲלֹמוֹ בְּלַיְלָה אֶחָד אִישׁ כְּפִתְרוֹן חֲלֹמוֹ הַמַּשְׁקֶה וְהָאֹפֶה אֲשֶׁר לְמֶלֶךְ מִצְרַיִם אֲשֶׁר אֲסוּרִים בְּבֵית הַסֹּֽהַר׃
translation: They both dreamed a dream, each man his dream, in one night, each man according to the interpretation of his dream, the cup bearer and the baker of the king of Egypt, who were bound in the prison. (Genesis 40:5)

text: וְאֵת שַׂר הָאֹפִים תָּלָה כַּאֲשֶׁר פָּתַר לָהֶם יוֹסֵֽף׃
translation: but he hanged the chief baker, as Joseph had interpreted to them. (Genesis 40:22)

text: וַיְהִי כַּאֲשֶׁר פָּֽתַר לָנוּ כֵּן הָיָה אֹתִי הֵשִׁיב עַל כַּנִּי וְאֹתוֹ תָלָֽה׃
translation: As he interpreted to us, so it was. He restored me to my office, and he hanged him." (Genesis 41:13)

text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֵלָיו חֲלוֹם חָלַמְנוּ וּפֹתֵר אֵין אֹתוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם יוֹסֵף הֲלוֹא לֵֽאלֹהִים פִּתְרֹנִים סַפְּרוּ נָא לִֽי׃
translation: They said to him, "We have dreamed a dream, and there is no one who can interpret it." Joseph said to them, "Don't interpretations belong to God? Please tell it to me." (Genesis 40:8)

text: וְשָׁם אִתָּנוּ נַעַר עִבְרִי עֶבֶד לְשַׂר הַטַּבָּחִים וַנְּסַפֶּר לוֹ וַיִּפְתָּר לָנוּ אֶת חֲלֹמֹתֵינוּ אִישׁ כַּחֲלֹמוֹ פָּתָֽר׃
translation: There was with us there a young man, a Hebrew, servant to the captain of the guard, and we told him, and he interpreted to us our dreams. He interpreted to each man according to his dream. (Genesis 41:12)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר פַּרְעֹה אֶל יוֹסֵף חֲלוֹם חָלַמְתִּי וּפֹתֵר אֵין אֹתוֹ וַאֲנִי שָׁמַעְתִּי עָלֶיךָ לֵאמֹר תִּשְׁמַע חֲלוֹם לִפְתֹּר אֹתֽוֹ׃
translation: Pharaoh said to Joseph, "I have dreamed a dream, and there is no one who can interpret it. I have heard it said of you, that when you hear a dream you can interpret it." (Genesis 41:15)

text: וַיַּרְא שַׂר הָאֹפִים כִּי טוֹב פָּתָר וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל יוֹסֵף אַף אֲנִי בַּחֲלוֹמִי וְהִנֵּה שְׁלֹשָׁה סַלֵּי חֹרִי עַל רֹאשִֽׁי׃
translation: When the chief baker saw that the interpretation was good, he said to Joseph, "I also was in my dream, and behold, three baskets of white bread were on my head. (Genesis 40:16)

text: אֶשְׁכֹּל הַכֹּפֶר דּוֹדִי לִי בְּכַרְמֵי עֵין גֶּֽדִי׃
translation: My beloved is to me a cluster of henna blossoms from the vineyards of En Gedi. (Song of Solomon 1:14)

text: וּבַגֶּפֶן שְׁלֹשָׁה שָׂרִיגִם וְהִיא כְפֹרַחַת עָלְתָה נִצָּהּ הִבְשִׁילוּ אַשְׁכְּלֹתֶיהָ עֲנָבִֽים׃
translation: and in the vine were three branches. It was as though it budded, it blossomed, and its clusters produced ripe grapes. (Genesis 40:10)

text: זֹאת קֽוֹמָתֵךְ דָּֽמְתָה לְתָמָר וְשָׁדַיִךְ לְאַשְׁכֹּלֽוֹת׃
translation: I said, "I will climb up into the palm tree. I will take hold of its fruit." Let your breasts be like clusters of the vine, the smell of your breath like apples. (Song of Solomon 7:8)

text: אָמַרְתִּי אֶעֱלֶה בְתָמָר אֹֽחֲזָה בְּסַנְסִנָּיו וְיִֽהְיוּ נָא שָׁדַיִךְ כְּאֶשְׁכְּלוֹת הַגֶּפֶן וְרֵיחַ אַפֵּךְ כַּתַּפּוּחִֽים׃
translation: Your mouth is like the best wine, that goes down smoothly for my beloved, gliding through the lips of those who are asleep. (Song of Solomon 7:9)

text: וַיָּבֹאוּ עַד נַחַל אֶשְׁכֹּל וַיִּכְרְתוּ מִשָּׁם זְמוֹרָה וְאֶשְׁכּוֹל עֲנָבִים אֶחָד וַיִּשָּׂאֻהוּ בַמּוֹט בִּשְׁנָיִם וּמִן הָרִמֹּנִים וּמִן הַתְּאֵנִֽים׃
translation: They came to the valley of Eshcol, and cut down from there a branch with one cluster of grapes, and they bore it on a staff between two. They also brought some of the pomegranates and figs. (Numbers 13:23)

text: כֹּה אָמַר יְהוָה כַּאֲשֶׁר יִמָּצֵא הַתִּירוֹשׁ בָּֽאֶשְׁכּוֹל וְאָמַר אַל תַּשְׁחִיתֵהוּ כִּי בְרָכָה בּוֹ כֵּן אֶֽעֱשֶׂה לְמַעַן עֲבָדַי לְבִלְתִּי הַֽשְׁחִית הַכֹּֽל׃
translation: The LORD says, "As the new wine is found in the cluster, and one says, 'Don't destroy it, for a blessing is in it:' so I will do for my servants' sake, that I may not destroy them all. (Isaiah 65:8)

text: וַֽיִּקְרְעוּ שִׂמְלֹתָם וַֽיַּעֲמֹס אִישׁ עַל חֲמֹרוֹ וַיָּשֻׁבוּ הָעִֽירָה׃
translation: Then they tore their clothes, and each man loaded his donkey, and returned to the city. (Genesis 44:13)

text: בָּרוּךְ אֲדֹנָי יוֹם יוֹם יַֽעֲמָס לָנוּ הָאֵל יְֽשׁוּעָתֵנוּ סֶֽלָה׃
translation: God is to us a God of deliverance. To GOD, the Lord, belongs escape from death. (Psalms 68:20)

text: הַבּוֹנִים בַּחוֹמָה וְהַנֹּשְׂאִים בַּסֶּבֶל עֹמְשִׂים בְּאַחַת יָדוֹ עֹשֶׂה בַמְּלָאכָה וְאַחַת מַחֲזֶקֶת הַשָּֽׁלַח׃
translation: Our adversaries said, "They will not know or see, until we come in among them and kill them, and cause the work to cease." (Nehemiah 4:11)

text: כָּרַע בֵּל קֹרֵס נְבוֹ הָיוּ עֲצַבֵּיהֶם לַחַיָּה וְלַבְּהֵמָה נְשֻׂאֹתֵיכֶם עֲמוּסוֹת מַשָּׂא לַעֲיֵפָֽה׃
translation: Bel bows down. Nebo stoops. Their idols are carried by animals, and on the livestock. The things that you carried around are heavy loads, a burden for the weary. (Isaiah 46:1)

text: שִׁמְעוּ אֵלַי בֵּית יַעֲקֹב וְכָל שְׁאֵרִית בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל הַֽעֲמֻסִים מִנִּי בֶטֶן הַנְּשֻׂאִים מִנִּי רָֽחַם׃
translation: "Listen to me, house of Jacob, and all the remnant of the house of Israel, that have been carried from their birth, that have been carried from the womb. (Isaiah 46:3)

text: וְהָיָה בַיּוֹם הַהוּא אָשִׂים אֶת יְרוּשָׁלִַם אֶבֶן מַֽעֲמָסָה לְכָל הָעַמִּים כָּל עֹמְסֶיהָ שָׂרוֹט יִשָּׂרֵטוּ וְנֶאֶסְפוּ עָלֶיהָ כֹּל גּוֹיֵי הָאָֽרֶץ׃
translation: It will happen in that day that I will make Jerusalem a burdensome stone for all the peoples. All who burden themselves with it will be severely wounded, and all the nations of the earth will be gathered together against it. (Zechariah 12:3)

text: לֵב שָׂמֵחַ יֵיטִב גֵּהָה וְרוּחַ נְכֵאָה תְּיַבֶּשׁ גָּֽרֶם׃
translation: A cheerful heart makes good medicine, but a crushed spirit dries up the bones. (Proverbs 17:22)

text: בְּאֹרֶךְ אַפַּיִם יְפֻתֶּה קָצִין וְלָשׁוֹן רַכָּה תִּשְׁבָּר גָּֽרֶם׃
translation: By patience a ruler is persuaded. A soft tongue breaks the bone. (Proverbs 25:15)

text: יִשָּׂשכָר חֲמֹר גָּרֶם רֹבֵץ בֵּין הַֽמִּשְׁפְּתָֽיִם׃
translation: "Issachar is a strong donkey, lying down between the saddlebags. (Genesis 49:14)

text: עֲצָמָיו אֲפִיקֵי נְחוּשָׁה גְּרָמָיו כִּמְטִיל בַּרְזֶֽל׃
translation: His bones are like tubes of bronze. His limbs are like bars of iron. (Job 40:18)

text: אֵל מוֹצִיאוֹ מִמִּצְרַיִם כְּתוֹעֲפֹת רְאֵם לוֹ יֹאכַל גּוֹיִם צָרָיו וְעַצְמֹתֵיהֶם יְגָרֵם וְחִצָּיו יִמְחָֽץ׃
translation: God brings him out of Egypt. He has as it were the strength of the wild ox. He shall consume the nations his adversaries, shall break their bones in pieces, and pierce them with his arrows. (Numbers 24:8)

text: וַֽיְמַהֲרוּ וַיִּקְחוּ אִישׁ בִּגְדוֹ וַיָּשִׂימוּ תַחְתָּיו אֶל גֶּרֶם הַֽמַּעֲלוֹת וַֽיִּתְקְעוּ בַּשּׁוֹפָר וַיֹּאמְרוּ מָלַךְ יֵהֽוּא׃
translation: Then they hurried, and each man took his cloak, and put it under him on the top of the stairs, and blew the trumpet, saying, "Jehu is king." (2 Kings 9:13)

text: תּוֹרָה צִוָּה לָנוּ מֹשֶׁה מוֹרָשָׁה קְהִלַּת יַעֲקֹֽב׃
translation: Moses commanded us a law, an inheritance for the assembly of Jacob. (Deuteronomy 33:4)

text: לִבְנֵי קֶדֶם עַל בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן וּנְתַתִּיהָ לְמֽוֹרָשָׁה לְמַעַן לֹֽא תִזָּכֵר בְּנֵֽי עַמּוֹן בַּגּוֹיִֽם׃
translation: to the children of the east, to go against the children of Ammon; and I will give them for a possession, that the children of Ammon may not be remembered among the nations. (Ezekiel 25:10)

text: כֹּה אָמַר אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה יַעַן אָמַר הָאוֹיֵב עֲלֵיכֶם הֶאָח וּבָמוֹת עוֹלָם לְמֽוֹרָשָׁה הָיְתָה לָּֽנוּ׃
translation: The Lord GOD says: 'Because the enemy has said against you, "Aha!" and, "The ancient high places are ours in possession!"' (Ezekiel 36:2)

text: לָכֵן הִנְנִי נֹתְנָךְ לִבְנֵי קֶדֶם לְמֽוֹרָשָׁה וְיִשְּׁבוּ טִירֽוֹתֵיהֶם בָּךְ וְנָתְנוּ בָךְ מִשְׁכְּנֵיהֶם הֵמָּה יֹאכְלוּ פִרְיֵךְ וְהֵמָּה יִשְׁתּוּ חֲלָבֵֽךְ׃
translation: therefore, behold, I will deliver you to the children of the east for a possession. They will set their encampments in you and make their dwellings in you. They will eat your fruit and they will drink your milk. (Ezekiel 25:4)

text: וְהֵבֵאתִי אֶתְכֶם אֶל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר נָשָׂאתִי אֶת יָדִי לָתֵת אֹתָהּ לְאַבְרָהָם לְיִצְחָק וּֽלְיַעֲקֹב וְנָתַתִּי אֹתָהּ לָכֶם מוֹרָשָׁה אֲנִי יְהוָֽה׃
translation: I will bring you into the land which I swore to give to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob; and I will give it to you for a heritage: I am the LORD.'" (Exodus 6:8)

text: וְהַפִּשְׁתָּה וְהַשְּׂעֹרָה נֻכָּתָה כִּי הַשְּׂעֹרָה אָבִיב וְהַפִּשְׁתָּה גִּבְעֹֽל׃
translation: The flax and the barley were struck, for the barley had ripened and the flax was blooming. (Exodus 9:31)

text: הַיּוֹם אַתֶּם יֹצְאִים בְּחֹדֶשׁ הָאָבִֽיב׃
translation: Today you go out in the month Abib. (Exodus 13:4)

text: וְאִם תַּקְרִיב מִנְחַת בִּכּוּרִים לַיהוָה אָבִיב קָלוּי בָּאֵשׁ גֶּרֶשׂ כַּרְמֶל תַּקְרִיב אֵת מִנְחַת בִּכּוּרֶֽיךָ׃
translation: "'If you offer a meal offering of first fruits to the LORD, you shall offer for the meal offering of your first fruits fresh heads of grain parched with fire and crushed. (Leviticus 2:14)

text: שָׁמוֹר אֶת חֹדֶשׁ הָאָבִיב וְעָשִׂיתָ פֶּסַח לַיהוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ כִּי בְּחֹדֶשׁ הָֽאָבִיב הוֹצִיאֲךָ יְהוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ מִמִּצְרַיִם לָֽיְלָה׃
translation: Observe the month of Abib, and keep the Passover to the LORD your God; for in the month of Abib the LORD your God brought you out of Egypt by night. (Deuteronomy 16:1)

text: אֶת חַג הַמַּצּוֹת תִּשְׁמֹר שִׁבְעַת יָמִים תֹּאכַל מַצּוֹת אֲשֶׁר צִוִּיתִךָ לְמוֹעֵד חֹדֶשׁ הָאָבִיב כִּי בְּחֹדֶשׁ הָֽאָבִיב יָצָאתָ מִמִּצְרָֽיִם׃
translation: "You shall keep the feast of unleavened bread. Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread, as I commanded you, at the time appointed in the month Abib; for in the month Abib you came out of Egypt. (Exodus 34:18)

text: וָאָבוֹא אֶל הַגּוֹלָה תֵּל אָבִיב הַיֹּשְׁבִים אֶֽל נְהַר כְּבָר ואשר וָֽאֵשֵׁב הֵמָּה יוֹשְׁבִים שָׁם וָאֵשֵׁב שָׁם שִׁבְעַת יָמִים מַשְׁמִים בְּתוֹכָֽם׃
translation: Then I came to them of the captivity at Tel Aviv who lived by the river Chebar, and to where they lived; and I sat there overwhelmed among them seven days. (Ezekiel 3:15)

text: בְּעֵט בַּרְזֶל וְעֹפָרֶת לָעַד בַּצּוּר יֵחָצְבֽוּן׃
translation: That with an iron pen and lead they were engraved in the rock forever! (Job 19:24)

text: וְהִנֵּה כִּכַּר עֹפֶרֶת נִשֵּׂאת וְזֹאת אִשָּׁה אַחַת יוֹשֶׁבֶת בְּתוֹךְ הָאֵיפָֽה׃
translation: and behold, a lead cover weighing one talent was lifted up—and there was a woman sitting in the middle of the ephah basket." (Zechariah 5:7)

text: נָחַר מַפֻּחַ מאשתם מֵאֵשׁ תַּם עֹפָרֶת לַשָּׁוְא צָרַף צָרוֹף וְרָעִים לֹא נִתָּֽקוּ׃
translation: The bellows blow fiercely. The lead is consumed in the fire. In vain they go on refining, for the wicked are not plucked away. (Jeremiah 6:29)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר זֹאת הָרִשְׁעָה וַיַּשְׁלֵךְ אֹתָהּ אֶל תּוֹךְ הָֽאֵיפָה וַיַּשְׁלֵךְ אֶת אֶבֶן הָעֹפֶרֶת אֶל פִּֽיהָ׃
translation: He said, "This is Wickedness;" and he threw her down into the middle of the ephah basket; and he threw the lead weight on its mouth. (Zechariah 5:8)

text: פַּחַד קְרָאַנִי וּרְעָדָה וְרֹב עַצְמוֹתַי הִפְחִֽיד׃
translation: fear came on me, and trembling, which made all my bones shake. (Job 4:14)

text: עִבְדוּ אֶת יְהוָה בְּיִרְאָה וְגִילוּ בִּרְעָדָֽה׃
translation: Serve the LORD with fear, and rejoice with trembling. (Psalms 2:11)

text: יִרְאָה וָרַעַד יָבֹא בִי וַתְּכַסֵּנִי פַּלָּצֽוּת׃
translation: I said, "Oh that I had wings like a dove! Then I would fly away, and be at rest. (Psalms 55:6)

text: הַמַּבִּיט לָאָרֶץ וַתִּרְעָד יִגַּע בֶּהָרִים וְֽיֶעֱשָֽׁנוּ׃
translation: He looks at the earth, and it trembles. He touches the mountains, and they smoke. (Psalms 104:32)

text: רְעָדָה אֲחָזָתַם שָׁם חִיל כַּיּוֹלֵֽדָה׃
translation: With the east wind, you break the ships of Tarshish. (Psalms 48:7)

text: אָז נִבְהֲלוּ אַלּוּפֵי אֱדוֹם אֵילֵי מוֹאָב יֹֽאחֲזֵמוֹ רָעַד נָמֹגוּ כֹּל יֹשְׁבֵי כְנָֽעַן׃
translation: Then the chiefs of Edom were dismayed. Trembling takes hold of the mighty men of Moab. All the inhabitants of Canaan have melted away. (Exodus 15:15)

text: אֲשֶׁר יַחְדָּו נַמְתִּיק סוֹד בְּבֵית אֱלֹהִים נְהַלֵּךְ בְּרָֽגֶשׁ׃
translation: Let death come suddenly on them. Let them go down alive into Sheol. For wickedness is among them, in their dwelling. (Psalms 55:15)

text: לַחֲכַם לֵב יִקָּרֵא נָבוֹן וּמֶתֶק שְׂפָתַיִם יֹסִיף לֶֽקַח׃
translation: The wise in heart shall be called prudent. Pleasantness of the lips promotes instruction. (Proverbs 16:21)

text: שֶׁמֶן וּקְטֹרֶת יְשַׂמַּֽח לֵב וּמֶתֶק רֵעֵהוּ מֵֽעֲצַת נָֽפֶשׁ׃
translation: Perfume and incense bring joy to the heart; so does earnest counsel from a man's friend. (Proverbs 27:9)

text: אִם תַּמְתִּיק בְּפִיו רָעָה יַכְחִידֶנָּה תַּחַת לְשׁוֹנֽוֹ׃
translation: "Though wickedness is sweet in his mouth, though he hide it under his tongue, (Job 20:12)

text: יִשְׁכָּחֵהוּ רֶחֶם מְתָקוֹ רִמָּה עוֹד לֹֽא יִזָּכֵר וַתִּשָּׁבֵר כָּעֵץ עַוְלָֽה׃
translation: The womb will forget him. The worm will feed sweetly on him. He will be no more remembered. Unrighteousness will be broken as a tree. (Job 24:20)

text: מַֽיִם גְּנוּבִים יִמְתָּקוּ וְלֶחֶם סְתָרִים יִנְעָֽם׃
translation: "Stolen water is sweet. Food eaten in secret is pleasant." (Proverbs 9:17)

text: וּבֹקֶר וּרְאִיתֶם אֶת כְּבוֹד יְהוָה בְּשָׁמְעוֹ אֶת תְּלֻנֹּתֵיכֶם עַל יְהוָה וְנַחְנוּ מָה כִּי תלונו תַלִּינוּ עָלֵֽינוּ׃
translation: In the morning, you shall see the LORD's glory; because he hears your murmurings against the LORD. Who are we, that you murmur against us?" (Exodus 16:7)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה אֶֽל אַהֲרֹן אֱמֹר אֶֽל כָּל עֲדַת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל קִרְבוּ לִפְנֵי יְהוָה כִּי שָׁמַע אֵת תְּלֻנֹּתֵיכֶֽם׃
translation: Moses said to Aaron, "Tell all the congregation of the children of Israel, 'Come close to the LORD, for he has heard your murmurings.'" (Exodus 16:9)

text: עַד מָתַי לָעֵדָה הָֽרָעָה הַזֹּאת אֲשֶׁר הֵמָּה מַלִּינִים עָלָי אֶת תְּלֻנּוֹת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר הֵמָּה מַלִּינִים עָלַי שָׁמָֽעְתִּי׃
translation: "How long shall I bear with this evil congregation that complain against me? I have heard the complaints of the children of Israel, which they complain against me. (Numbers 14:27)

text: שָׁמַעְתִּי אֶת תְּלוּנֹּת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל דַּבֵּר אֲלֵהֶם לֵאמֹר בֵּין הָֽעַרְבַּיִם תֹּאכְלוּ בָשָׂר וּבַבֹּקֶר תִּשְׂבְּעוּ לָחֶם וִֽידַעְתֶּם כִּי אֲנִי יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃
translation: "I have heard the murmurings of the children of Israel. Speak to them, saying, 'At evening you shall eat meat, and in the morning you shall be filled with bread. Then you will know that I am the LORD your God.'" (Exodus 16:12)

text: זֹאת תּוֹרַת הַזָּב וַאֲשֶׁר תֵּצֵא מִמֶּנּוּ שִׁכְבַת זֶרַע לְטָמְאָה בָֽהּ׃
translation: This is the law of him who has a discharge, and of him who has an emission of semen, so that he is unclean by it; (Leviticus 15:32)

text: וְאִשָּׁה אֲשֶׁר יִשְׁכַּב אִישׁ אֹתָהּ שִׁכְבַת זָרַע וְרָחֲצוּ בַמַּיִם וְטָמְאוּ עַד הָעָֽרֶב׃
translation: If a man lies with a woman and there is an emission of semen, they shall both bathe themselves in water, and be unclean until the evening. (Leviticus 15:18)

text: וַיְהִי בָעֶרֶב וַתַּעַל הַשְּׂלָו וַתְּכַס אֶת הַֽמַּחֲנֶה וּבַבֹּקֶר הָֽיְתָה שִׁכְבַת הַטַּל סָבִיב לַֽמַּחֲנֶֽה׃
translation: In the evening, quail came up and covered the camp; and in the morning the dew lay around the camp. (Exodus 16:13)

text: וְאִישׁ כִּֽי תֵצֵא מִמֶּנּוּ שִׁכְבַת זָרַע וְרָחַץ בַּמַּיִם אֶת כָּל בְּשָׂרוֹ וְטָמֵא עַד הָעָֽרֶב׃
translation: "'If any man has an emission of semen, then he shall bathe all his flesh in water, and be unclean until the evening. (Leviticus 15:16)

text: וְכָל בֶּגֶד וְכָל עוֹר אֲשֶׁר יִהְיֶה עָלָיו שִׁכְבַת זָרַע וְכֻבַּס בַּמַּיִם וְטָמֵא עַד הָעָֽרֶב׃
translation: Every garment and every skin which the semen is on shall be washed with water, and be unclean until the evening. (Leviticus 15:17)

text: וְשָׁכַב אִישׁ אֹתָהּ שִׁכְבַת זֶרַע וְנֶעְלַם מֵעֵינֵי אִישָׁהּ וְנִסְתְּרָה וְהִיא נִטְמָאָה וְעֵד אֵין בָּהּ וְהִוא לֹא נִתְפָּֽשָׂה׃
translation: and a man lies with her carnally, and it is hidden from the eyes of her husband and this is kept concealed, and she is defiled, there is no witness against her, and she isn't taken in the act; (Numbers 5:13)

text: וְנָתַתָּה הַכֶּסֶף לְאַהֲרֹן וּלְבָנָיו פְּדוּיֵי הָעֹדְפִים בָּהֶֽם׃
translation: and you shall give the money, with which their remainder is redeemed, to Aaron and to his sons." (Numbers 3:48)

text: וַיִּקַּח מֹשֶׁה אֵת כֶּסֶף הַפִּדְיוֹם מֵאֵת הָעֹדְפִים עַל פְּדוּיֵי הַלְוִיִּֽם׃
translation: Moses took the redemption money from those who exceeded the number of those who were redeemed by the Levites; (Numbers 3:49)

text: וְסֶרַח הָעֹדֵף בִּירִיעֹת הָאֹהֶל חֲצִי הַיְרִיעָה הָעֹדֶפֶת תִּסְרַח עַל אֲחֹרֵי הַמִּשְׁכָּֽן׃
translation: The overhanging part that remains of the curtains of the tent—the half curtain that remains—shall hang over the back of the tabernacle. (Exodus 26:12)

text: וְאֵת פְּדוּיֵי הַשְּׁלֹשָׁה וְהַשִּׁבְעִים וְהַמָּאתָיִם הָעֹֽדְפִים עַל הַלְוִיִּם מִבְּכוֹר בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
translation: For the redemption of the two hundred seventy-three of the firstborn of the children of Israel who exceed the number of the Levites, (Numbers 3:46)

text: וַיָּמֹדּוּ בָעֹמֶר וְלֹא הֶעְדִּיף הַמַּרְבֶּה וְהַמַּמְעִיט לֹא הֶחְסִיר אִישׁ לְפִֽי אָכְלוֹ לָקָֽטוּ׃
translation: When they measured it with an omer, he who gathered much had nothing over, and he who gathered little had no lack. They each gathered according to his eating. (Exodus 16:18)

text: וְחִשַּׁב אֶת שְׁנֵי מִמְכָּרוֹ וְהֵשִׁיב אֶת הָעֹדֵף לָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר מָֽכַר לוֹ וְשָׁב לַאֲחֻזָּתֽוֹ׃
translation: then let him reckon the years since its sale, and restore the surplus to the man to whom he sold it; and he shall return to his property. (Leviticus 25:27)

text: מַרְפֵּא לָשׁוֹן עֵץ חַיִּים וְסֶלֶף בָּהּ שֶׁבֶר בְּרֽוּחַ׃
translation: A gentle tongue is a tree of life, but deceit in it crushes the spirit. (Proverbs 15:4)

text: תֻּמַּת יְשָׁרִים תַּנְחֵם וְסֶלֶף בּוֹגְדִים ושדם יְשָׁדֵּֽם׃
translation: The integrity of the upright shall guide them, but the perverseness of the treacherous shall destroy them. (Proverbs 11:3)

text: מַשְׂכִּיל צַדִּיק לְבֵית רָשָׁע מְסַלֵּף רְשָׁעִים לָרָֽע׃
translation: The Righteous One considers the house of the wicked, and brings the wicked to ruin. (Proverbs 21:12)

text: עֵינֵי יְהוָה נָצְרוּ דָעַת וַיְסַלֵּף דִּבְרֵי בֹגֵֽד׃
translation: The LORD's eyes watch over knowledge, but he frustrates the words of the unfaithful. (Proverbs 22:12)

text: וְשֹׁחַד לֹא תִקָּח כִּי הַשֹּׁחַד יְעַוֵּר פִּקְחִים וִֽיסַלֵּף דִּבְרֵי צַדִּיקִֽים׃
translation: "You shall take no bribe, for a bribe blinds those who have sight and perverts the words of the righteous. (Exodus 23:8)

text: מוֹלִיךְ כֹּהֲנִים שׁוֹלָל וְאֵֽתָנִים יְסַלֵּֽף׃
translation: He leads priests away stripped, and overthrows the mighty. (Job 12:19)

text: וַיַּעַשׂ חִירוֹם אֶת הַכִּיֹּרוֹת וְאֶת הַיָּעִים וְאֶת הַמִּזְרָקוֹת וַיְכַל חִירָם לַֽעֲשׂוֹת אֶת כָּל הַמְּלָאכָה אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה לַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה בֵּית יְהוָֽה׃
translation: Hiram made the pots, the shovels, and the basins. So Hiram finished doing all the work that he worked for King Solomon in the LORD's house: (1 Kings 7:40)

text: וְאֶת הַסִּירוֹת וְאֶת הַיָּעִים וְאֶת הַמִּזְרָקוֹת וְאֵת כָּל הַכֵּלִים האהל הָאֵלֶּה אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה חִירָם לַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה בֵּית יְהוָה נְחֹשֶׁת מְמֹרָֽט׃
translation: the pots; the shovels; and the basins. All of these vessels, which Hiram made for King Solomon in the LORD's house, were of burnished bronze. (1 Kings 7:45)

text: וַיַּעַשׂ חוּרָם אֶת הַסִּירוֹת וְאֶת הַיָּעִים וְאֶת הַמִּזְרָקוֹת וַיְכַל חירם חוּרָם לַעֲשׂוֹת אֶת הַמְּלָאכָה אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה לַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה בְּבֵית הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃
translation: Huram made the pots, the shovels, and the basins. So Huram finished doing the work that he did for King Solomon in God's house: (2 Chronicles 4:11)

text: וְלִבְנֵי אַהֲרֹן תַּעֲשֶׂה כֻתֳּנֹת וְעָשִׂיתָ לָהֶם אַבְנֵטִים וּמִגְבָּעוֹת תַּעֲשֶׂה לָהֶם לְכָבוֹד וּלְתִפְאָֽרֶת׃
translation: "You shall make tunics for Aaron's sons. You shall make sashes for them. You shall make headbands for them, for glory and for beauty. (Exodus 28:40)

text: וְהִלְבַּשְׁתִּיו כֻּתָּנְתֶּךָ וְאַבְנֵֽטְךָ אֲחַזְּקֶנּוּ וּמֶֽמְשֶׁלְתְּךָ אֶתֵּן בְּיָדוֹ וְהָיָה לְאָב לְיוֹשֵׁב יְרוּשָׁלִַם וּלְבֵית יְהוּדָֽה׃
translation: and I will clothe him with your robe, and strengthen him with your belt. I will commit your government into his hand; and he will be a father to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and to the house of Judah. (Isaiah 22:21)

text: וְֽאֶת הָאַבְנֵט שֵׁשׁ מָשְׁזָר וּתְכֵלֶת וְאַרְגָּמָן וְתוֹלַעַת שָׁנִי מַעֲשֵׂה רֹקֵם כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהוָה אֶת מֹשֶֽׁה׃
translation: the sash of fine twined linen, blue, purple, and scarlet, the work of the embroiderer, as the LORD commanded Moses. (Exodus 39:29)

text: וְחָגַרְתָּ אֹתָם אַבְנֵט אַהֲרֹן וּבָנָיו וְחָבַשְׁתָּ לָהֶם מִגְבָּעֹת וְהָיְתָה לָהֶם כְּהֻנָּה לְחֻקַּת עוֹלָם וּמִלֵּאתָ יַֽד אַהֲרֹן וְיַד בָּנָֽיו׃
translation: You shall clothe them with belts, Aaron and his sons, and bind headbands on them. They shall have the priesthood by a perpetual statute. You shall consecrate Aaron and his sons. (Exodus 29:9)

text: וַיַּקְרֵב מֹשֶׁה אֶת בְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן וַיַּלְבִּשֵׁם כֻּתֳּנֹת וַיַּחְגֹּר אֹתָם אַבְנֵט וַיַּחֲבֹשׁ לָהֶם מִגְבָּעוֹת כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהוָה אֶת מֹשֶֽׁה׃
translation: Moses brought Aaron's sons, and clothed them with tunics, and tied sashes on them, and put headbands on them, as the LORD commanded Moses. (Leviticus 8:13)

text: וְאֵלֶּה הַבְּגָדִים אֲשֶׁר יַעֲשׂוּ חֹשֶׁן וְאֵפוֹד וּמְעִיל וּכְתֹנֶת תַּשְׁבֵּץ מִצְנֶפֶת וְאַבְנֵט וְעָשׂוּ בִגְדֵי קֹדֶשׁ לְאַהֲרֹן אָחִיךָ וּלְבָנָיו לְכַהֲנוֹ לִֽי׃
translation: These are the garments which they shall make: a breastplate, an ephod, a robe, a fitted tunic, a turban, and a sash. They shall make holy garments for Aaron your brother and his sons, that he may minister to me in the priest's office. (Exodus 28:4)

text: כָּל כְּבוּדָּה בַת מֶלֶךְ פְּנִימָה מִֽמִּשְׁבְּצוֹת זָהָב לְבוּשָֽׁהּ׃
translation: She shall be led to the king in embroidered work. The virgins, her companions who follow her, shall be brought to you. (Psalms 45:14)

text: וְהַטּוּר הָֽרְבִיעִי תַּרְשִׁישׁ שֹׁהַם וְיָשְׁפֵה מֽוּסַבֹּת מִשְׁבְּצוֹת זָהָב בְּמִלֻּאֹתָֽם׃
translation: and the fourth row, a chrysolite, an onyx, and a jasper. They were enclosed in gold settings. (Exodus 39:13)

text: וַֽיַּעֲשׂוּ שְׁתֵּי מִשְׁבְּצֹת זָהָב וּשְׁתֵּי טַבְּעֹת זָהָב וַֽיִּתְּנוּ אֶת שְׁתֵּי הַטַּבָּעֹת עַל שְׁנֵי קְצוֹת הַחֹֽשֶׁן׃
translation: They made two settings of gold, and two gold rings, and put the two rings on the two ends of the breastplate. (Exodus 39:16)

text: וְאֵת שְׁתֵּי קְצוֹת שְׁתֵּי הָעֲבֹתֹת תִּתֵּן עַל שְׁתֵּי הַֽמִּשְׁבְּצוֹת וְנָתַתָּה עַל כִּתְפוֹת הָאֵפֹד אֶל מוּל פָּנָֽיו׃
translation: The other two ends of the two braided chains you shall put on the two settings, and put them on the shoulder straps of the ephod in its forepart. (Exodus 28:25)

text: וְאֵת שְׁתֵּי קְצוֹת שְׁתֵּי הָֽעֲבֹתֹת נָתְנוּ עַל שְׁתֵּי הַֽמִּשְׁבְּצֹת וַֽיִּתְּנֻם עַל כִּתְפֹת הָאֵפֹד אֶל מוּל פָּנָֽיו׃
translation: The other two ends of the two braided chains they put on the two settings, and put them on the shoulder straps of the ephod, in its front. (Exodus 39:18)

text: מִכְתָּב לְחִזְקִיָּהוּ מֶֽלֶךְ יְהוּדָה בַּחֲלֹתוֹ וַיְחִי מֵחָלְיֽוֹ׃
translation: The writing of Hezekiah king of Judah, when he had been sick, and had recovered of his sickness: (Isaiah 38:9)

text: וְהַלֻּחֹת מַעֲשֵׂה אֱלֹהִים הֵמָּה וְהַמִּכְתָּב מִכְתַּב אֱלֹהִים הוּא חָרוּת עַל הַלֻּחֹֽת׃
translation: The tablets were the work of God, and the writing was the writing of God, engraved on the tablets. (Exodus 32:16)

text: וְהָכִונוּ לְבֵית אֲבוֹתֵיכֶם כְּמַחְלְקוֹתֵיכֶם בִּכְתָב דָּוִיד מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל וּבְמִכְתַּב שְׁלֹמֹה בְנֽוֹ׃
translation: Prepare yourselves after your fathers' houses by your divisions, according to the writing of David king of Israel, and according to the writing of Solomon his son. (2 Chronicles 35:4)

text: וַֽיַּעֲשׂוּ אֶת צִיץ נֵֽזֶר הַקֹּדֶשׁ זָהָב טָהוֹר וַיִּכְתְּבוּ עָלָיו מִכְתַּב פִּתּוּחֵי חוֹתָם קֹדֶשׁ לַיהוָֽה׃
translation: They made the plate of the holy crown of pure gold, and wrote on it an inscription, like the engravings of a signet: "HOLY TO THE LORD". (Exodus 39:30)

text: וַיִּכְתֹּב עַֽל הַלֻּחֹת כַּמִּכְתָּב הָרִאשׁוֹן אֵת עֲשֶׂרֶת הַדְּבָרִים אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהוָה אֲלֵיכֶם בָּהָר מִתּוֹךְ הָאֵשׁ בְּיוֹם הַקָּהָל וַיִּתְּנֵם יְהוָה אֵלָֽי׃
translation: He wrote on the tablets, according to the first writing, the ten commandments, which the LORD spoke to you on the mountain out of the middle of the fire in the day of the assembly; and the LORD gave them to me. (Deuteronomy 10:4)

text: אֶת יִתְדֹת הַמִּשְׁכָּן וְאֶת יִתְדֹת הֶחָצֵר וְאֶת מֵיתְרֵיהֶֽם׃
translation: the pins of the tabernacle, the pins of the court, and their cords; (Exodus 35:18)

text: כִּי תְּשִׁיתֵמוֹ שֶׁכֶם בְּמֵֽיתָרֶיךָ תְּכוֹנֵן עַל פְּנֵיהֶֽם׃
translation: Be exalted, LORD, in your strength, so we will sing and praise your power. (Psalms 21:13)

text: וְעַמֻּדֵי הֶחָצֵר סָבִיב וְאַדְנֵיהֶם וִיתֵדֹתָם וּמֵֽיתְרֵיהֶֽם׃
translation: the pillars of the court around it, their sockets, their pins, and their cords. (Numbers 3:37)

text: הַרְחִיבִי מְקוֹם אָהֳלֵךְ וִירִיעוֹת מִשְׁכְּנוֹתַיִךְ יַטּוּ אַל תַּחְשֹׂכִי הַאֲרִיכִי מֵֽיתָרַיִךְ וִיתֵדֹתַיִךְ חַזֵּֽקִי׃
translation: "Enlarge the place of your tent, and let them stretch out the curtains of your habitations; don't spare; lengthen your cords, and strengthen your stakes. (Isaiah 54:2)

text: אָהֳלִי שֻׁדָּד וְכָל מֵיתָרַי נִתָּקוּ בָּנַי יְצָאֻנִי וְאֵינָם אֵין נֹטֶה עוֹד אָהֳלִי וּמֵקִים יְרִיעוֹתָֽי׃
translation: My tent has been destroyed, and all my cords are broken. My children have gone away from me, and they are no more. There is no one to spread my tent any more, to set up my curtains. (Jeremiah 10:20)

text: וְקַלְעֵי הֶֽחָצֵר וְאֶת מָסַךְ פֶּתַח הֶֽחָצֵר אֲשֶׁר עַל הַמִּשְׁכָּן וְעַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ סָבִיב וְאֵת מֵֽיתָרָיו לְכֹל עֲבֹדָתֽוֹ׃
translation: the hangings of the court, the screen for the door of the court which is by the tabernacle and around the altar, and its cords for all of its service. (Numbers 3:26)

text: נֶזֶם זָהָב בְּאַף חֲזִיר אִשָּׁה יָפָה וְסָרַת טָֽעַם׃
translation: Like a gold ring in a pig's snout, is a beautiful woman who lacks discretion. (Proverbs 11:22)

text: לְחֵזִיר שִׁבְעָה עָשָׂר לְהַפִּצֵּץ שְׁמוֹנָה עָשָֽׂר׃
translation: the seventeenth to Hezir, the eighteenth to Happizzez, (1 Chronicles 24:15)

text: יְכַרְסְמֶנָּֽה חֲזִיר מִיָּ<segtype="x-suspended">עַ<seg>ר וְזִיז שָׂדַי יִרְעֶֽנָּה׃
translation: Turn again, we beg you, God of Armies. Look down from heaven, and see, and visit this vine, (Psalms 80:14)

text: הַיֹּֽשְׁבִים בַּקְּבָרִים וּבַנְּצוּרִים יָלִינוּ הָאֹֽכְלִים בְּשַׂר הַחֲזִיר ופרק וּמְרַק פִּגֻּלִים כְּלֵיהֶֽם׃
translation: who sit among the graves, and spend nights in secret places; who eat pig's meat, and broth of abominable things is in their vessels; (Isaiah 65:4)

text: וְאֶת הַחֲזִיר כִּֽי מַפְרִיס פַּרְסָה הוּא וְלֹא גֵרָה טָמֵא הוּא לָכֶם מִבְּשָׂרָם לֹא תֹאכֵלוּ וּבְנִבְלָתָם לֹא תִגָּֽעוּ׃
translation: The pig, because it has a split hoof but doesn't chew the cud, is unclean to you. You shall not eat their meat. You shall not touch their carcasses. (Deuteronomy 14:8)

text: וּמִן הַשֶּׁמֶן יִצֹק הַכֹּהֵן עַל כַּף הַכֹּהֵן הַשְּׂמָאלִֽית׃
translation: The priest shall pour some of the oil into the palm of his own left hand; (Leviticus 14:26)

text: וְלָקַח הַכֹּהֵן מִלֹּג הַשָּׁמֶן וְיָצַק עַל כַּף הַכֹּהֵן הַשְּׂמָאלִֽית׃
translation: The priest shall take some of the log of oil, and pour it into the palm of his own left hand. (Leviticus 14:15)

text: וְהִזָּה הַכֹּהֵן בְּאֶצְבָּעוֹ הַיְמָנִית מִן הַשֶּׁמֶן אֲשֶׁר עַל כַּפּוֹ הַשְּׂמָאלִית שֶׁבַע פְּעָמִים לִפְנֵי יְהוָֽה׃
translation: and the priest shall sprinkle with his right finger some of the oil that is in his left hand seven times before the LORD. (Leviticus 14:27)

text: וַיַּעַמְדוּ הָרָצִים אִישׁ וְכֵלָיו בְּיָדוֹ מִכֶּתֶף הַבַּיִת הַיְמָנִית עַד כֶּתֶף הַבַּיִת הַשְּׂמָאלִית לַמִּזְבֵּחַ וְלַבָּיִת עַל הַמֶּלֶךְ סָבִֽיב׃
translation: The guard stood, every man with his weapons in his hand, from the right side of the house to the left side of the house, along by the altar and the house, around the king. (2 Kings 11:11)

text: וְטָבַל הַכֹּהֵן אֶת אֶצְבָּעוֹ הַיְמָנִית מִן הַשֶּׁמֶן אֲשֶׁר עַל כַּפּוֹ הַשְּׂמָאלִית וְהִזָּה מִן הַשֶּׁמֶן בְּאֶצְבָּעוֹ שֶׁבַע פְּעָמִים לִפְנֵי יְהוָֽה׃
translation: The priest shall dip his right finger in the oil that is in his left hand, and shall sprinkle some of the oil with his finger seven times before the LORD. (Leviticus 14:16)

text: וַיַּעֲמֵד אֶת כָּל הָעָם וְאִישׁ שִׁלְחוֹ בְיָדוֹ מִכֶּתֶף הַבַּיִת הַיְמָנִית עַד כֶּתֶף הַבַּיִת הַשְּׂמָאלִית לַמִּזְבֵּחַ וְלַבָּיִת עַל הַמֶּלֶךְ סָבִֽיב׃
translation: He set all the people, every man with his weapon in his hand, from the right side of the house to the left side of the house, near the altar and the house, around the king. (2 Chronicles 23:10)

text: וְנָתַתָּ עַל הַֽמַּעֲרֶכֶת לְבֹנָה זַכָּה וְהָיְתָה לַלֶּחֶם לְאַזְכָּרָה אִשֶּׁה לַֽיהוָֽה׃
translation: You shall put pure frankincense on each row, that it may be to the bread for a memorial, even an offering made by fire to the LORD. (Leviticus 24:7)

text: וְאֶת הַזָּהָב מִשְׁקָל לְשֻׁלְחֲנוֹת הַֽמַּעֲרֶכֶת לְשֻׁלְחַן וְשֻׁלְחָן וְכֶסֶף לְשֻׁלְחֲנוֹת הַכָּֽסֶף׃
translation: and the gold by weight for the tables of show bread, for every table; and silver for the tables of silver; (1 Chronicles 28:16)

text: וְשַׂמְתָּ אוֹתָם שְׁתַּיִם מַֽעֲרָכוֹת שֵׁשׁ הַֽמַּעֲרָכֶת עַל הַשֻּׁלְחָן הַטָּהֹר לִפְנֵי יְהוָֽה׃
translation: You shall set them in two rows, six on a row, on the pure gold table before the LORD. (Leviticus 24:6)

text: וּמִן בְּנֵי הַקְּהָתִי מִן אֲחֵיהֶם עַל לֶחֶם הַֽמַּעֲרָכֶת לְהָכִין שַׁבַּת שַׁבָּֽת׃
translation: Some of their brothers, of the sons of the Kohathites, were over the show bread, to prepare it every Sabbath. (1 Chronicles 9:32)

text: לְלֶחֶם הַֽמַּעֲרֶכֶת וּמִנְחַת הַתָּמִיד וּלְעוֹלַת הַתָּמִיד הַשַּׁבָּתוֹת הֶחֳדָשִׁים לַמּוֹעֲדִים וְלַקֳּדָשִׁים וְלַחַטָּאוֹת לְכַפֵּר עַל יִשְׂרָאֵל וְכֹל מְלֶאכֶת בֵּית אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃
translation: We, the priests, the Levites, and the people, cast lots for the wood offering, to bring it into the house of our God, according to our fathers' houses, at times appointed year by year, to burn on the LORD our God's altar, as it is written in the law; (Nehemiah 10:34)

text: פֶּן תֹּאמְרוּ מָצָאנוּ חָכְמָה אֵל יִדְּפֶנּוּ לֹא אִֽישׁ׃
translation: Beware lest you say, 'We have found wisdom. God may refute him, not man;' (Job 32:13)

text: פֹּעַל אוֹצָרוֹת בִּלְשׁוֹן שָׁקֶר הֶבֶל נִדָּף מְבַקְשֵׁי מָֽוֶת׃
translation: Getting treasures by a lying tongue is a fleeting vapor for those who seek death. (Proverbs 21:6)

text: הֶעָלֶה נִדָּף תַּעֲרוֹץ וְאֶת קַשׁ יָבֵשׁ תִּרְדֹּֽף׃
translation: Will you harass a driven leaf? Will you pursue the dry stubble? (Job 13:25)

text: לֹא כֵן הָרְשָׁעִים כִּי אִם כַּמֹּץ אֲֽשֶׁר תִּדְּפֶנּוּ רֽוּחַ׃
translation: The wicked are not so, but are like the chaff which the wind drives away. (Psalms 1:4)

text: כְּהִנְדֹּף עָשָׁן תִּנְדֹּף כְּהִמֵּס דּוֹנַג מִפְּנֵי אֵשׁ יֹאבְדוּ רְשָׁעִים מִפְּנֵי אֱלֹהִֽים׃
translation: But let the righteous be glad. Let them rejoice before God. Yes, let them rejoice with gladness. (Psalms 68:3)

text: עָרוֹת עַל יְאוֹר עַל פִּי יְאוֹר וְכֹל מִזְרַע יְאוֹר יִיבַשׁ נִדַּף וְאֵינֶֽנּוּ׃
translation: The meadows by the Nile, by the brink of the Nile, and all the sown fields of the Nile, will become dry, be driven away, and be no more. (Isaiah 19:7)

text: וְאֶת קַרְקַע הַבַּיִת צִפָּה זָהָב לִפְנִימָה וְלַחִיצֽוֹן׃
translation: He overlaid the floor of the house with gold, inside and outside. (1 Kings 6:30)

text: וְאוּלָם הַכִּסֵּא אֲשֶׁר יִשְׁפָּט שָׁם אֻלָם הַמִּשְׁפָּט עָשָׂה וְסָפוּן בָּאֶרֶז מֵהַקַּרְקַע עַד הַקַּרְקָֽע׃
translation: He made the porch of the throne where he was to judge, even the porch of judgment; and it was covered with cedar from floor to floor. (1 Kings 7:7)

text: וְלָקַח הַכֹּהֵן מַיִם קְדֹשִׁים בִּכְלִי חָרֶשׂ וּמִן הֶֽעָפָר אֲשֶׁר יִהְיֶה בְּקַרְקַע הַמִּשְׁכָּן יִקַּח הַכֹּהֵן וְנָתַן אֶל הַמָּֽיִם׃
translation: The priest shall take holy water in an earthen vessel; and the priest shall take some of the dust that is on the floor of the tabernacle and put it into the water. (Numbers 5:17)

text: וְיָצָא אֶל מִנֶּגֶב לְמַעֲלֵה עַקְרַבִּים וְעָבַר צִנָה וְעָלָה מִנֶּגֶב לְקָדֵשׁ בַּרְנֵעַ וְעָבַר חֶצְרוֹן וְעָלָה אַדָּרָה וְנָסַב הַקַּרְקָֽעָה׃
translation: and it went out southward of the ascent of Akrabbim, and passed along to Zin, and went up by the south of Kadesh Barnea, and passed along by Hezron, went up to Addar, and turned toward Karka; (Joshua 15:3)

text: וְאִם יֵחָֽבְאוּ בְּרֹאשׁ הַכַּרְמֶל מִשָּׁם אֲחַפֵּשׂ וּלְקַחְתִּים וְאִם יִסָּתְרוּ מִנֶּגֶד עֵינַי בְּקַרְקַע הַיָּם מִשָּׁם אֲצַוֶּה אֶת הַנָּחָשׁ וּנְשָׁכָֽם׃
translation: Though they hide themselves in the top of Carmel, I will search and take them out from there; and though they be hidden from my sight in the bottom of the sea, there I will command the serpent, and it will bite them. (Amos 9:3)

text: וַיִּבֶן אֶת עֶשְׂרִים אַמָּה מירכותי מִֽיַּרְכְּתֵי הַבַּיִת בְּצַלְעוֹת אֲרָזִים מִן הַקַּרְקַע עַד הַקִּירוֹת וַיִּבֶן לוֹ מִבַּיִת לִדְבִיר לְקֹדֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִֽׁים׃
translation: He built twenty cubits of the back part of the house with boards of cedar from the floor to the ceiling. He built this within, for an inner sanctuary, even for the most holy place. (1 Kings 6:16)

text: אֱנוֹשׁ כֶּחָצִיר יָמָיו כְּצִיץ הַשָּׂדֶה כֵּן יָצִֽיץ׃
translation: As for man, his days are like grass. As a flower of the field, so he flourishes. (Psalms 103:15)

text: בַּבֹּקֶר יָצִיץ וְחָלָף לָעֶרֶב יְמוֹלֵל וְיָבֵֽשׁ׃
translation: In the morning it sprouts and springs up. By evening, it is withered and dry. (Psalms 90:6)

text: אוֹיְבָיו אַלְבִּישׁ בֹּשֶׁת וְעָלָיו יָצִיץ נִזְרֽוֹ׃
translation: I will clothe his enemies with shame, but on himself, his crown will shine." (Psalms 132:18)

text: הַבָּאִים יַשְׁרֵשׁ יַֽעֲקֹב יָצִיץ וּפָרַח יִשְׂרָאֵל וּמָלְאוּ פְנֵי תֵבֵל תְּנוּבָֽה׃
translation: In days to come, Jacob will take root. Israel will blossom and bud. They will fill the surface of the world with fruit. (Isaiah 27:6)

text: בִּפְרֹחַ רְשָׁעִים כְּמוֹ עֵשֶׂב וַיָּצִיצוּ כָּל פֹּעֲלֵי אָוֶן לְהִשָּֽׁמְדָם עֲדֵי עַֽד׃
translation: But you, LORD, are on high forever more. (Psalms 92:8)

text: יְהִי פִסַּת בַּר בָּאָרֶץ בְּרֹאשׁ הָרִים יִרְעַשׁ כַּלְּבָנוֹן פִּרְיוֹ וְיָצִיצוּ מֵעִיר כְּעֵשֶׂב הָאָֽרֶץ׃
translation: Abundance of grain shall be throughout the land. Its fruit sways like Lebanon. Let it flourish, thriving like the grass of the field. (Psalms 72:16)

text: אֲֽנִי רָאִיתִי אֱוִיל מַשְׁרִישׁ וָאֶקּוֹב נָוֵהוּ פִתְאֹֽם׃
translation: I have seen the foolish taking root, but suddenly I cursed his habitation. (Job 5:3)

text: מָה אֶקֹּב לֹא קַבֹּה אֵל וּמָה אֶזְעֹם לֹא זָעַם יְהוָֽה׃
translation: How shall I curse whom God has not cursed? How shall I defy whom the LORD has not defied? (Numbers 23:8)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר בָּלָק אֶל בִּלְעָם גַּם קֹב לֹא תִקֳּבֶנּוּ גַּם בָּרֵךְ לֹא תְבָרֲכֶֽנּוּ׃
translation: Balak said to Balaam, "Neither curse them at all, nor bless them at all." (Numbers 23:25)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר בָּלָק אֶל בִּלְעָם מֶה עָשִׂיתָ לִי לָקֹב אֹיְבַי לְקַחְתִּיךָ וְהִנֵּה בֵּרַכְתָּ בָרֵֽךְ׃
translation: Balak said to Balaam, "What have you done to me? I took you to curse my enemies, and behold, you have blessed them altogether." (Numbers 23:11)

text: כִּֽי כַבֵּד אֲכַבֶּדְךָ מְאֹד וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר תֹּאמַר אֵלַי אֶֽעֱשֶׂה וּלְכָה נָּא קָֽבָה לִּי אֵת הָעָם הַזֶּֽה׃
translation: for I will promote you to very great honor, and whatever you say to me I will do. Please come therefore, and curse this people for me.'" (Numbers 22:17)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר בָּלָק אֶל בִּלְעָם לְכָה נָּא אֶקָּחֲךָ אֶל מָקוֹם אַחֵר אוּלַי יִישַׁר בְּעֵינֵי הָאֱלֹהִים וְקַבֹּתוֹ לִי מִשָּֽׁם׃
translation: Balak said to Balaam, "Come now, I will take you to another place; perhaps it will please God that you may curse them for me from there." (Numbers 23:27)

text: יְֽהוָה הֵפִיר עֲצַת גּוֹיִם הֵנִיא מַחְשְׁבוֹת עַמִּֽים׃
translation: The LORD brings the counsel of the nations to nothing. He makes the thoughts of the peoples to be of no effect. (Psalms 33:10)

text: יֶֽהֶלְמֵֽנִי צַדִּיק חֶסֶד וְֽיוֹכִיחֵנִי שֶׁמֶן רֹאשׁ אַל יָנִי רֹאשִׁי כִּי עוֹד וּתְפִלָּתִי בְּרָעוֹתֵיהֶֽם׃
translation: Let the righteous strike me, it is kindness; let him reprove me, it is like oil on the head; don't let my head refuse it; Yet my prayer is always against evil deeds. (Psalms 141:5)

text: וְלָמָּה תנואון תְנִיאוּן אֶת לֵב בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵֽעֲבֹר אֶל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר נָתַן לָהֶם יְהוָֽה׃
translation: Why do you discourage the heart of the children of Israel from going over into the land which the LORD has given them? (Numbers 32:7)

text: וְשָׁמַע אִישָׁהּ וְהֶחֱרִשׁ לָהּ לֹא הֵנִיא אֹתָהּ וְקָמוּ כָּל נְדָרֶיהָ וְכָל אִסָּר אֲשֶׁר אָסְרָה עַל נַפְשָׁהּ יָקֽוּם׃
translation: But if her husband made them null and void in the day that he heard them, then whatever proceeded out of her lips concerning her vows, or concerning the bond of her soul, shall not stand. Her husband has made them void. The LORD will forgive her. (Numbers 30:12)

text: וַֽיַּעֲלוּ עַד נַחַל אֶשְׁכּוֹל וַיִּרְאוּ אֶת הָאָרֶץ וַיָּנִיאוּ אֶת לֵב בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לְבִלְתִּי בֹא אֶל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר נָתַן לָהֶם יְהוָֽה׃
translation: For when they went up to the valley of Eshcol, and saw the land, they discouraged the heart of the children of Israel, that they should not go into the land which the LORD had given them. (Numbers 32:9)

text: הָאֵמִים לְפָנִים יָשְׁבוּ בָהּ עַם גָּדוֹל וְרַב וָרָם כָּעֲנָקִֽים׃
translation: (The Emim lived there before, a great and numerous people, and tall as the Anakim. (Deuteronomy 2:10)

text: רְפָאִים יֵחָשְׁבוּ אַף הֵם כָּעֲנָקִים וְהַמֹּאָבִים יִקְרְאוּ לָהֶם אֵמִֽים׃
translation: These also are considered to be Rephaim, as the Anakim; but the Moabites call them Emim. (Deuteronomy 2:11)

text: עַם גָּדוֹל וְרַב וָרָם כָּעֲנָקִים וַיַּשְׁמִידֵם יְהוָה מִפְּנֵיהֶם וַיִּירָשֻׁם וַיֵּשְׁבוּ תַחְתָּֽם׃
translation: a great people, many, and tall, as the Anakim; but the LORD destroyed them from before Israel, and they succeeded them, and lived in their place, (Deuteronomy 2:21)

text: לֹֽא נוֹתַר עֲנָקִים בְּאֶרֶץ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל רַק בְּעַזָּה בְּגַת וּבְאַשְׁדּוֹד נִשְׁאָֽרוּ׃
translation: There were none of the Anakim left in the land of the children of Israel. Only in Gaza, in Gath, and in Ashdod, did some remain. (Joshua 11:22)

text: וְשֵׁם חֶבְרוֹן לְפָנִים קִרְיַת אַרְבַּע הָאָדָם הַגָּדוֹל בָּעֲנָקִים הוּא וְהָאָרֶץ שָׁקְטָה מִמִּלְחָמָֽה׃
translation: Now the name of Hebron before was Kiriath Arba, after the greatest man among the Anakim. Then the land had rest from war. (Joshua 14:15)

text: עַֽם גָּדוֹל וָרָם בְּנֵי עֲנָקִים אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה יָדַעְתָּ וְאַתָּה שָׁמַעְתָּ מִי יִתְיַצֵּב לִפְנֵי בְּנֵי עֲנָֽק׃
translation: a people great and tall, the sons of the Anakim, whom you know, and of whom you have heard say, "Who can stand before the sons of Anak?" (Deuteronomy 9:2)

text: מַצְרֵף לַכֶּסֶף וְכוּר לַזָּהָב וּבֹחֵן לִבּוֹת יְהוָֽה׃
translation: The refining pot is for silver, and the furnace for gold, but the LORD tests the hearts. (Proverbs 17:3)

text: מַצְרֵף לַכֶּסֶף וְכוּר לַזָּהָב וְאִישׁ לְפִי מַהֲלָלֽוֹ׃
translation: The crucible is for silver, and the furnace for gold; but man is refined by his praise. (Proverbs 27:21)

text: הִנֵּה צְרַפְתִּיךָ וְלֹא בְכָסֶף בְּחַרְתִּיךָ בְּכוּר עֹֽנִי׃
translation: Behold, I have refined you, but not as silver. I have chosen you in the furnace of affliction. (Isaiah 48:10)

text: כִּֽי עַמְּךָ וְנַחֲלָתְךָ הֵם אֲשֶׁר הוֹצֵאתָ מִמִּצְרַיִם מִתּוֹךְ כּוּר הַבַּרְזֶֽל׃
translation: (for they are your people and your inheritance, which you brought out of Egypt, from the middle of the iron furnace); (1 Kings 8:51)

text: וְאֶתְכֶם לָקַח יְהוָה וַיּוֹצִא אֶתְכֶם מִכּוּר הַבַּרְזֶל מִמִּצְרָיִם לִהְיוֹת לוֹ לְעַם נַחֲלָה כַּיּוֹם הַזֶּֽה׃
translation: But the LORD has taken you, and brought you out of the iron furnace, out of Egypt, to be to him a people of inheritance, as it is today. (Deuteronomy 4:20)

text: כְּהִתּוּךְ כֶּסֶף בְּתוֹךְ כּוּר כֵּן תֻּתְּכוּ בְתוֹכָהּ וִֽידַעְתֶּם כִּֽי אֲנִי יְהוָה שָׁפַכְתִּי חֲמָתִי עֲלֵיכֶֽם׃
translation: As silver is melted in the middle of the furnace, so you will be melted in the middle of it; and you will know that I, the LORD, have poured out my wrath on you.'" (Ezekiel 22:22)

text: חִצֶּיךָ שְׁנוּנִים עַמִּים תַּחְתֶּיךָ יִפְּלוּ בְּלֵב אוֹיְבֵי הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
translation: Your throne, God, is forever and ever. A scepter of equity is the scepter of your kingdom. (Psalms 45:6)

text: אֲשֶׁר שָׁנְנוּ כַחֶרֶב לְשׁוֹנָם דָּרְכוּ חִצָּם דָּבָר מָֽר׃
translation: to shoot innocent men from ambushes. They shoot at him suddenly and fearlessly. (Psalms 64:4)

text: שָֽׁנֲנוּ לְשׁוֹנָם כְּֽמוֹ נָחָשׁ חֲמַת עַכְשׁוּב תַּחַת שְׂפָתֵימוֹ סֶֽלָה׃
translation: LORD, keep me from the hands of the wicked. Preserve me from the violent men who have determined to trip my feet. (Psalms 140:4)

text: מֵפִיץ וְחֶרֶב וְחֵץ שָׁנוּן אִישׁ עֹנֶה בְרֵעֵהוּ עֵד שָֽׁקֶר׃
translation: A man who gives false testimony against his neighbor is like a club, a sword, or a sharp arrow. (Proverbs 25:18)

text: וְשִׁנַּנְתָּם לְבָנֶיךָ וְדִבַּרְתָּ בָּם בְּשִׁבְתְּךָ בְּבֵיתֶךָ וּבְלֶכְתְּךָ בַדֶּרֶךְ וּֽבְשָׁכְבְּךָ וּבְקוּמֶֽךָ׃
translation: and you shall teach them diligently to your children, and shall talk of them when you sit in your house, and when you walk by the way, and when you lie down, and when you rise up. (Deuteronomy 6:7)

text: חִצֵּי גִבּוֹר שְׁנוּנִים עִם גַּחֲלֵי רְתָמִֽים׃
translation: Sharp arrows of the mighty, with coals of juniper. (Psalms 120:4)

text: כִּֽי יָקוּם עֵד חָמָס בְּאִישׁ לַעֲנוֹת בּוֹ סָרָֽה׃
translation: If an unrighteous witness rises up against any man to testify against him of wrongdoing, (Deuteronomy 19:16)

text: שׁוּבוּ לַאֲשֶׁר הֶעְמִיקוּ סָרָה בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
translation: Return to him from whom you have deeply revolted, children of Israel. (Isaiah 31:6)

text: עַל מֶה תֻכּוּ עוֹד תּוֹסִיפוּ סָרָה כָּל רֹאשׁ לָחֳלִי וְכָל לֵבָב דַּוָּֽי׃
translation: Why should you be beaten more, that you revolt more and more? The whole head is sick, and the whole heart faint. (Isaiah 1:5)

text: מַכֶּה עַמִּים בְּעֶבְרָה מַכַּת בִּלְתִּי סָרָה רֹדֶה בָאַף גּוֹיִם מֻרְדָּף בְּלִי חָשָֽׂךְ׃
translation: who struck the peoples in wrath with a continual stroke, who ruled the nations in anger, with a persecution that no one restrained. (Isaiah 14:6)

text: פָּשֹׁעַ וְכַחֵשׁ בַּֽיהוָה וְנָסוֹג מֵאַחַר אֱלֹהֵינוּ דַּבֶּר עֹשֶׁק וְסָרָה הֹרוֹ וְהֹגוֹ מִלֵּב דִּבְרֵי שָֽׁקֶר׃
translation: transgressing and denying the LORD, and turning away from following our God, speaking oppression and revolt, conceiving and uttering from the heart words of falsehood. (Isaiah 59:13)

text: וַיֵּצֵא יוֹאָב מֵעִם דָּוִד וַיִּשְׁלַח מַלְאָכִים אַחֲרֵי אַבְנֵר וַיָּשִׁבוּ אֹתוֹ מִבּוֹר הַסִּרָה וְדָוִד לֹא יָדָֽע׃
translation: When Joab had come out from David, he sent messengers after Abner, and they brought him back from the well of Sirah; but David didn't know it. (2 Samuel 3:26)

text: אֲשֶׁר בָּנֵינוּ כִּנְטִעִים מְגֻדָּלִים בִּֽנְעוּרֵיהֶם בְּנוֹתֵינוּ כְזָוִיֹּת מְחֻטָּבוֹת תַּבְנִית הֵיכָֽל׃
translation: Then our sons will be like well-nurtured plants, our daughters like pillars carved to adorn a palace. (Psalms 144:12)

text: טַפְּכֶם נְשֵׁיכֶם וְגֵרְךָ אֲשֶׁר בְּקֶרֶב מַחֲנֶיךָ מֵחֹטֵב עֵצֶיךָ עַד שֹׁאֵב מֵימֶֽיךָ׃
translation: All of you stand today in the presence of the LORD your God: your heads, your tribes, your elders, and your officers, even all the men of Israel, (Deuteronomy 29:10)

text: קוֹלָהּ כַּנָּחָשׁ יֵלֵךְ כִּֽי בְחַיִל יֵלֵכוּ וּבְקַרְדֻּמּוֹת בָּאוּ לָהּ כְּחֹטְבֵי עֵצִֽים׃
translation: Its sound will go like the serpent, for they will march with an army, and come against her with axes, as wood cutters. (Jeremiah 46:22)

text: וְעַתָּה אֲרוּרִים אַתֶּם וְלֹֽא יִכָּרֵת מִכֶּם עֶבֶד וְחֹטְבֵי עֵצִים וְשֹֽׁאֲבֵי מַיִם לְבֵית אֱלֹהָֽי׃
translation: Now therefore you are cursed, and some of you will never fail to be slaves, both wood cutters and drawers of water for the house of my God." (Joshua 9:23)

text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֲלֵיהֶם הַנְּשִׂיאִים יִֽחְיוּ וַיִּֽהְיוּ חֹטְבֵי עֵצִים וְשֹֽׁאֲבֵי מַיִם לְכָל הָעֵדָה כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבְּרוּ לָהֶם הַנְּשִׂיאִֽים׃
translation: The princes said to them, "Let them live." So they became wood cutters and drawers of water for all the congregation, as the princes had spoken to them. (Joshua 9:21)

text: וַיִּתְּנֵם יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא חֹטְבֵי עֵצִים וְשֹׁאֲבֵי מַיִם לָֽעֵדָה וּלְמִזְבַּח יְהוָה עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה אֶל הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר יִבְחָֽר׃
translation: That day Joshua made them wood cutters and drawers of water for the congregation and for the LORD's altar to this day, in the place which he should choose. (Joshua 9:27)

text: אָרוּר מַסִּיג גְּבוּל רֵעֵהוּ וְאָמַר כָּל הָעָם אָמֵֽן׃
translation: 'Cursed is he who removes his neighbor's landmark.' All the people shall say, 'Amen.' (Deuteronomy 27:17)

text: אַל תַּסֵּג גְּבוּל עוֹלָם וּבִשְׂדֵי יְתוֹמִים אַל תָּבֹֽא׃
translation: Don't move the ancient boundary stone. Don't encroach on the fields of the fatherless, (Proverbs 23:10)

text: אַל תַּסֵּג גְּבוּל עוֹלָם אֲשֶׁר עָשׂוּ אֲבוֹתֶֽיךָ׃
translation: Don't move the ancient boundary stone which your fathers have set up. (Proverbs 22:28)

text: הָיוּ שָׂרֵי יְהוּדָה כְּמַסִּיגֵי גְּבוּל עֲלֵיהֶם אֶשְׁפּוֹךְ כַּמַּיִם עֶבְרָתִֽי׃
translation: The princes of Judah are like those who remove a landmark. I will pour out my wrath on them like water. (Hosea 5:10)

text: אַל תַּטִּפוּ יַטִּיפוּן לֹֽא יַטִּפוּ לָאֵלֶּה לֹא יִסַּג כְּלִמּֽוֹת׃
translation: "Don't prophesy!"—they prophesy— "Don't prophesy about these things. Disgrace won't overtake us." (Micah 2:6)

text: אַתָּה תֹאכַל וְלֹא תִשְׂבָּע וְיֶשְׁחֲךָ בְּקִרְבֶּךָ וְתַסֵּג וְלֹא תַפְלִיט וַאֲשֶׁר תְּפַלֵּט לַחֶרֶב אֶתֵּֽן׃
translation: You shall eat, but not be satisfied. Your hunger will be within you. You will store up, but not save, and that which you save I will give up to the sword. (Micah 6:14)

text: בְּנוֹת מְלָכִים בְּיִקְּרוֹתֶיךָ נִצְּבָה שֵׁגַל לִֽימִינְךָ בְּכֶתֶם אוֹפִֽיר׃
translation: Listen, daughter, consider, and turn your ear. Forget your own people, and also your father's house. (Psalms 45:10)

text: וְעֹלְלֵיהֶם יְרֻטְּשׁוּ לְעֵֽינֵיהֶם יִשַּׁסּוּ בָּֽתֵּיהֶם וּנְשֵׁיהֶם תשגלנה תִּשָּׁכַֽבְנָה׃
translation: Their infants also will be dashed in pieces before their eyes. Their houses will be ransacked, and their wives raped. (Isaiah 13:16)

text: אִשָּׁה תְאָרֵשׂ וְאִישׁ אַחֵר ישגלנה יִשְׁכָּבֶנָּה בַּיִת תִּבְנֶה וְלֹא תֵשֵׁב בּוֹ כֶּרֶם תִּטַּע וְלֹא תְחַלְּלֶּֽנּוּ׃
translation: You will betroth a wife, and another man shall lie with her. You will build a house, and you won't dwell in it. You will plant a vineyard, and not use its fruit. (Deuteronomy 28:30)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר לִי הַמֶּלֶךְ וְהַשֵּׁגַל יוֹשֶׁבֶת אֶצְלוֹ עַד מָתַי יִהְיֶה מַֽהֲלָכֲךָ וּמָתַי תָּשׁוּב וַיִּיטַב לִפְנֵֽי הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיִּשְׁלָחֵנִי וָֽאֶתְּנָה לוֹ זְמָֽן׃
translation: The king said to me (the queen was also sitting by him), "How long will your journey be? When will you return?" So it pleased the king to send me, and I set a time for him. (Nehemiah 2:6)

text: וָאֶרְחָצֵךְ בַּמַּיִם וָאֶשְׁטֹף דָּמַיִךְ מֵֽעָלָיִךְ וָאֲסֻכֵךְ בַּשָּֽׁמֶן׃
translation: "'"Then I washed you with water. Yes, I thoroughly washed away your blood from you, and I anointed you with oil. (Ezekiel 16:9)

text: אַתָּה תִזְרַע וְלֹא תִקְצוֹר אַתָּה תִדְרֹֽךְ זַיִת וְלֹא תָסוּךְ שֶׁמֶן וְתִירוֹשׁ וְלֹא תִשְׁתֶּה יָּֽיִן׃
translation: You will sow, but won't reap. You will tread the olives, but won't anoint yourself with oil; and crush grapes, but won't drink the wine. (Micah 6:15)

text: וְרָחַצְתְּ וָסַכְתְּ וְשַׂמְתְּ שמלתך שִׂמְלֹתַיִךְ עָלַיִךְ וירדתי וְיָרַדְתְּ הַגֹּרֶן אַל תִּוָּדְעִי לָאִישׁ עַד כַּלֹּתוֹ לֶאֱכֹל וְלִשְׁתּֽוֹת׃
translation: Therefore wash yourself, anoint yourself, get dressed, and go down to the threshing floor; but don't make yourself known to the man until he has finished eating and drinking. (Ruth 3:3)

text: לֶחֶם חֲמֻדוֹת לֹא אָכַלְתִּי וּבָשָׂר וָיַיִן לֹא בָא אֶל פִּי וְסוֹךְ לֹא סָכְתִּי עַד מְלֹאת שְׁלֹשֶׁת שָׁבֻעִים יָמִֽים׃
translation: I ate no pleasant food. No meat or wine came into my mouth. I didn't anoint myself at all, until three whole weeks were fulfilled. (Daniel 10:3)

text: וַיָּקָם דָּוִד מֵהָאָרֶץ וַיִּרְחַץ וַיָּסֶךְ וַיְחַלֵּף שמלתו שִׂמְלֹתָיו וַיָּבֹא בֵית יְהוָה וַיִּשְׁתָּחוּ וַיָּבֹא אֶל בֵּיתוֹ וַיִּשְׁאַל וַיָּשִׂימוּ לוֹ לֶחֶם וַיֹּאכַֽל׃
translation: Then David arose from the earth, and washed and anointed himself, and changed his clothing; and he came into the LORD's house, and worshiped. Then he came to his own house; and when he requested, they set bread before him and he ate. (2 Samuel 12:20)

text: אֲנִי פִּי מֶלֶךְ שְׁמוֹר וְעַל דִּבְרַת שְׁבוּעַת אֱלֹהִֽים׃
translation: I say, "Keep the king's command!" because of the oath to God. (Ecclesiastes 8:2)

text: אוּלָם אֲנִי אֶדְרֹשׁ אֶל אֵל וְאֶל אֱלֹהִים אָשִׂים דִּבְרָתִֽי׃
translation: "But as for me, I would seek God. I would commit my cause to God, (Job 5:8)

text: אַף חֹבֵב עַמִּים כָּל קְדֹשָׁיו בְּיָדֶךָ וְהֵם תֻּכּוּ לְרַגְלֶךָ יִשָּׂא מִדַּבְּרֹתֶֽיךָ׃
translation: Yes, he loves the people. All his saints are in your hand. They sat down at your feet. Each receives your words. (Deuteronomy 33:3)

text: נִשְׁבַּע יְהוָה וְלֹא יִנָּחֵם אַתָּֽה כֹהֵן לְעוֹלָם עַל דִּבְרָתִי מַלְכִּי צֶֽדֶק׃
translation: The LORD has sworn, and will not change his mind: "You are a priest forever in the order of Melchizedek." (Psalms 110:4)

text: אָמַרְתִּֽי אֲנִי בְּלִבִּי עַל דִּבְרַת בְּנֵי הָאָדָם לְבָרָם הָאֱלֹהִים וְלִרְאוֹת שְׁהֶם בְּהֵמָה הֵמָּה לָהֶֽם׃
translation: I said in my heart, "As for the sons of men, God tests them, so that they may see that they themselves are like animals. (Ecclesiastes 3:18)

text: לַמְנַצֵּחַ עַל שֹׁשַׁנִּים לִבְנֵי קֹרַח מַשְׂכִּיל שִׁיר יְדִידֹֽת׃
translation: For the Chief Musician. Set to "The Lilies." A contemplation by the sons of Korah. A wedding song. My heart overflows with a noble theme. I recite my verses for the king. My tongue is like the pen of a skillful writer. (Psalms 45:1)

text: לְמַעַן יֵחָלְצוּן יְדִידֶיךָ הוֹשִׁיעָה יְמִֽינְךָ ועננו וַעֲנֵֽנִי׃
translation: Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine. Ephraim also is the defense of my head. Judah is my scepter. (Psalms 60:7)

text: לְמַעַן יֵחָלְצוּן יְדִידֶיךָ הוֹשִׁיעָה יְמִֽינְךָ וַעֲנֵֽנִי׃
translation: God has spoken from his sanctuary: "In triumph, I will divide Shechem, and measure out the valley of Succoth. (Psalms 108:7)

text: מַה יְּדִידוֹת מִשְׁכְּנוֹתֶיךָ יְהוָה צְבָאֽוֹת׃
translation: My soul longs, and even faints for the courts of the LORD. My heart and my flesh cry out for the living God. (Psalms 84:2)

text: אָשִׁירָה נָּא לִֽידִידִי שִׁירַת דּוֹדִי לְכַרְמוֹ כֶּרֶם הָיָה לִֽידִידִי בְּקֶרֶן בֶּן שָֽׁמֶן׃
translation: Let me sing for my well beloved a song of my beloved about his vineyard. My beloved had a vineyard on a very fruitful hill. (Isaiah 5:1)

text: שָׁוְא לָכֶם מַשְׁכִּימֵי קוּם מְאַֽחֲרֵי שֶׁבֶת אֹכְלֵי לֶחֶם הָעֲצָבִים כֵּן יִתֵּן לִֽידִידוֹ שֵׁנָֽא׃
translation: It is vain for you to rise up early, to stay up late, eating the bread of toil, for he gives sleep to his loved ones. (Psalms 127:2)

text: בְּרֵאשִׁית מַמְלְכוּת יְהוֹיָקִים בֶּן יֹאשִׁיָּהוּ מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה הָיָה הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה מֵאֵת יְהוָה לֵאמֹֽר׃
translation: In the beginning of the reign of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, this word came from the LORD: (Jeremiah 26:1)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו שְׁמוּאֵל קָרַע יְהוָה אֶֽת מַמְלְכוּת יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵעָלֶיךָ הַיּוֹם וּנְתָנָהּ לְרֵעֲךָ הַטּוֹב מִמֶּֽךָּ׃
translation: Samuel said to him, "The LORD has torn the kingdom of Israel from you today, and has given it to a neighbor of yours who is better than you. (1 Samuel 15:28)

text: כָּל מַמְלְכוּת עוֹג בַּבָּשָׁן אֲשֶׁר מָלַךְ בְּעַשְׁתָּרוֹת וּבְאֶדְרֶעִי הוּא נִשְׁאַר מִיֶּתֶר הָרְפָאִים וַיַּכֵּם מֹשֶׁה וַיֹּרִשֵֽׁם׃
translation: all the kingdom of Og in Bashan, who reigned in Ashtaroth and in Edrei (who was left of the remnant of the Rephaim); for Moses attacked these, and drove them out. (Joshua 13:12)

text: וַחֲצִי הַגִּלְעָד וְעַשְׁתָּרוֹת וְאֶדְרֶעִי עָרֵי מַמְלְכוּת עוֹג בַּבָּשָׁן לִבְנֵי מָכִיר בֶּן מְנַשֶּׁה לַחֲצִי בְנֵֽי מָכִיר לְמִשְׁפְּחוֹתָֽם׃
translation: Half Gilead, Ashtaroth, and Edrei, the cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan, were for the children of Machir the son of Manasseh, even for the half of the children of Machir according to their families. (Joshua 13:31)

text: וַיְהִי גְבוּלָם מִמַּחֲנַיִם כָּֽל הַבָּשָׁן כָּֽל מַמְלְכוּת עוֹג מֶֽלֶךְ הַבָּשָׁן וְכָל חַוֺּת יָאִיר אֲשֶׁר בַּבָּשָׁן שִׁשִּׁים עִֽיר׃
translation: Their border was from Mahanaim, all Bashan, all the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, and all the villages of Jair, which are in Bashan, sixty cities. (Joshua 13:30)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֵלָיו קְרָא שְׁמוֹ יִזְרְעֶאל כִּי עוֹד מְעַט וּפָקַדְתִּי אֶת דְּמֵי יִזְרְעֶאל עַל בֵּית יֵהוּא וְהִשְׁבַּתִּי מַמְלְכוּת בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
translation: The LORD said to him, "Call his name Jezreel, for yet a little while, and I will avenge the blood of Jezreel on the house of Jehu, and will cause the kingdom of the house of Israel to cease. (Hosea 1:4)

text: שִׁגָּיוֹן לְדָוִד אֲשֶׁר שָׁר לַיהוָה עַל דִּבְרֵי כוּשׁ בֶּן יְמִינִֽי׃
translation: A meditation by David, which he sang to the LORD, concerning the words of Cush, the Benjamite. LORD, my God, I take refuge in you. Save me from all those who pursue me, and deliver me, (Psalms 7:1)

text: הַתְּשִׁיעִי לַחֹדֶשׁ הַתְּשִׁיעִי אֲבִיעֶזֶר הָעַנְּתֹתִי לבנימיני לַבֵּן יְמִינִי וְעַל מַחֲלֻקְתּוֹ עֶשְׂרִים וְאַרְבָּעָה אָֽלֶף׃
translation: The ninth captain for the ninth month was Abiezer the Anathothite, of the Benjamites. In his division were twenty-four thousand. (1 Chronicles 27:12)

text: וַיְמַהֵר שִׁמְעִי בֶן גֵּרָא בֶּן הַיְמִינִי אֲשֶׁר מִבַּֽחוּרִים וַיֵּרֶד עִם אִישׁ יְהוּדָה לִקְרַאת הַמֶּלֶךְ דָּוִֽד׃
translation: There were a thousand men of Benjamin with him, and Ziba the servant of Saul's house, and his fifteen sons and his twenty servants with him; and they went through the Jordan in the presence of the king. (2 Samuel 19:17)

text: אִישׁ יְהוּדִי הָיָה בְּשׁוּשַׁן הַבִּירָה וּשְׁמוֹ מָרְדֳּכַי בֶּן יָאִיר בֶּן שִׁמְעִי בֶּן קִישׁ אִישׁ יְמִינִֽי׃
translation: There was a certain Jew in the citadel of Susa whose name was Mordecai, the son of Jair, the son of Shimei, the son of Kish, a Benjamite, (Esther 2:5)

text: וְהִנֵּה אִישׁ זָקֵן בָּא מִֽן מַעֲשֵׂהוּ מִן הַשָּׂדֶה בָּעֶרֶב וְהָאִישׁ מֵהַר אֶפְרַיִם וְהוּא גָר בַּגִּבְעָה וְאַנְשֵׁי הַמָּקוֹם בְּנֵי יְמִינִֽי׃
translation: Behold, an old man came from his work out of the field at evening. Now the man was from the hill country of Ephraim, and he lived in Gibeah; but the men of the place were Benjamites. (Judges 19:16)

text: וְהֶאֶזְנִיחוּ נְהָרוֹת דָּלֲלוּ וְחָרְבוּ יְאֹרֵי מָצוֹר קָנֶה וָסוּף קָמֵֽלוּ׃
translation: The rivers will become foul. The streams of Egypt will be diminished and dried up. The reeds and flags will wither away. (Isaiah 19:6)

text: וַיִּדַּל יִשְׂרָאֵל מְאֹד מִפְּנֵי מִדְיָן וַיִּזְעֲקוּ בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל יְהוָֽה׃
translation: Israel was brought very low because of Midian; and the children of Israel cried to the LORD. (Judges 6:6)

text: פָּרַץ נַחַל מֵֽעִם גָּר הַֽנִּשְׁכָּחִים מִנִּי רָגֶל דַּלּוּ מֵאֱנוֹשׁ נָֽעוּ׃
translation: He breaks open a shaft away from where people live. They are forgotten by the foot. They hang far from men, they swing back and forth. (Job 28:4)

text: שֹׁמֵר פְּתָאיִם יְהֹוָה דַּלּוֹתִי וְלִי יְהוֹשִֽׁיעַ׃
translation: The LORD preserves the simple. I was brought low, and he saved me. (Psalms 116:6)

text: דַּלְיוּ שֹׁקַיִם מִפִּסֵּחַ וּמָשָׁל בְּפִי כְסִילִֽים׃
translation: Like the legs of the lame that hang loose, so is a parable in the mouth of fools. (Proverbs 26:7)

text: אַֽל תִּזְכָּר לָנוּ עֲוֺנֹת רִאשֹׁנִים מַהֵר יְקַדְּמוּנוּ רַחֲמֶיךָ כִּי דַלּוֹנוּ מְאֹֽד׃
translation: Don't hold the iniquities of our forefathers against us. Let your tender mercies speedily meet us, for we are in desperate need. (Psalms 79:8)

text: יְדֵי נָשִׁים רַחֲמָנִיּוֹת בִּשְּׁלוּ יַלְדֵיהֶן הָיוּ לְבָרוֹת לָמוֹ בְּשֶׁבֶר בַּת עַמִּֽי׃
translation: The hands of the pitiful women have boiled their own children. They were their food in the destruction of the daughter of my people. (Lamentations 4:10)

text: וַיָּקֻמוּ זִקְנֵי בֵיתוֹ עָלָיו לַהֲקִימוֹ מִן הָאָרֶץ וְלֹא אָבָה וְלֹֽא בָרָא אִתָּם לָֽחֶם׃
translation: The elders of his house arose beside him, to raise him up from the earth; but he would not, and he didn't eat bread with them. (2 Samuel 12:17)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר אַמְנוֹן אֶל תָּמָר הָבִיאִי הַבִּרְיָה הַחֶדֶר וְאֶבְרֶה מִיָּדֵךְ וַתִּקַּח תָּמָר אֶת הַלְּבִבוֹת אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂתָה וַתָּבֵא לְאַמְנוֹן אָחִיהָ הֶחָֽדְרָה׃
translation: Amnon said to Tamar, "Bring the food into the room, that I may eat from your hand." Tamar took the cakes which she had made, and brought them into the room to Amnon her brother. (2 Samuel 13:10)

text: וַיִּשְׁכַּב אַמְנוֹן וַיִּתְחָל וַיָּבֹא הַמֶּלֶךְ לִרְאֹתוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר אַמְנוֹן אֶל הַמֶּלֶךְ תָּֽבוֹא נָא תָּמָר אֲחֹתִי וּתְלַבֵּב לְעֵינַי שְׁתֵּי לְבִבוֹת וְאֶבְרֶה מִיָּדָֽהּ׃
translation: So Amnon lay down and faked being sick. When the king came to see him, Amnon said to the king, "Please let my sister Tamar come and make me a couple of cakes in my sight, that I may eat from her hand." (2 Samuel 13:6)

text: כַּתַּר לִי זְעֵיר וַאֲחַוֶּךָּ כִּי עוֹד לֶאֱלוֹהַּ מִלִּֽים׃
translation: "Bear with me a little, and I will show you; for I still have something to say on God's behalf. (Job 36:2)

text: סְבָבוּנִי פָּרִים רַבִּים אַבִּירֵי בָשָׁן כִּתְּרֽוּנִי׃
translation: They open their mouths wide against me, lions tearing prey and roaring. (Psalms 22:13)

text: נָחֲלוּ פְתָאיִם אִוֶּלֶת וַֽעֲרוּמִים יַכְתִּרוּ דָֽעַת׃
translation: The simple inherit folly, but the prudent are crowned with knowledge. (Proverbs 14:18)

text: כִּתְּרוּ אֶת בִּנְיָמִן הִרְדִיפֻהוּ מְנוּחָה הִדְרִיכֻהוּ עַד נֹכַח הַגִּבְעָה מִמִּזְרַח שָֽׁמֶשׁ׃
translation: They surrounded the Benjamites, chased them, and trod them down at their resting place, as far as near Gibeah toward the sunrise. (Judges 20:43)

text: לְהָבִיא אֶת וַשְׁתִּי הַמַּלְכָּה לִפְנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ בְּכֶתֶר מַלְכוּת לְהַרְאוֹת הָֽעַמִּים וְהַשָּׂרִים אֶת יָפְיָהּ כִּֽי טוֹבַת מַרְאֶה הִֽיא׃
translation: to bring Vashti the queen before the king wearing the royal crown, to show the people and the princes her beauty; for she was beautiful. (Esther 1:11)

text: יָבִיאוּ לְבוּשׁ מַלְכוּת אֲשֶׁר לָֽבַשׁ בּוֹ הַמֶּלֶךְ וְסוּס אֲשֶׁר רָכַב עָלָיו הַמֶּלֶךְ וַאֲשֶׁר נִתַּן כֶּתֶר מַלְכוּת בְּרֹאשֽׁוֹ׃
translation: let royal clothing be brought which the king uses to wear, and the horse that the king rides on, and on the head of which a royal crown is set. (Esther 6:8)

text: כָּעֵת בַּמָּרוֹם תַּמְרִיא תִּֽשְׂחַק לַסּוּס וּלְרֹֽכְבֽוֹ׃
translation: When she lifts up herself on high, she scorns the horse and his rider. (Job 39:18)

text: הוֹי מֹרְאָה וְנִגְאָלָה הָעִיר הַיּוֹנָֽה׃
translation: Woe to her who is rebellious and polluted, the oppressing city! (Zephaniah 3:1)

text: דְּנָה פִשְׁרָא מַלְכָּא וּגְזֵרַת עליא עִלָּאָה הִיא דִּי מְטָת עַל מראי מָרִי מַלְכָּֽא׃
translation: whose leaves were beautiful and its fruit plentiful, and in it was food for all; under which the animals of the field lived, and on whose branches the birds of the sky had their habitation— (Daniel 4:21)

text: וַתֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶן אַל תִּקְרֶאנָה לִי נָעֳמִי קְרֶאןָ לִי מָרָא כִּי הֵמַר שַׁדַּי לִי מְאֹֽד׃
translation: She said to them, "Don't call me Naomi. Call me Mara, for the Almighty has dealt very bitterly with me. (Ruth 1:20)

text: עָנֵה מַלְכָּא לְדָנִיֵּאל וְאָמַר מִן קְשֹׁט דִּי אֱלָהֲכוֹן הוּא אֱלָהּ אֱלָהִין וּמָרֵא מַלְכִין וְגָלֵה רָזִין דִּי יְכֵלְתָּ לְמִגְלֵא רָזָה דְנָֽה׃
translation: The king answered to Daniel, and said, "Of a truth your God is the God of gods, and the Lord of kings, and a revealer of secrets, since you have been able to reveal this secret." (Daniel 2:47)

text: פָּגוֹשׁ דֹּב שַׁכּוּל בְּאִישׁ וְאַל כְּסִיל בְּאִוַּלְתּֽוֹ׃
translation: Let a bear robbed of her cubs meet a man, rather than a fool in his folly. (Proverbs 17:12)

text: יְשַׁלְּמוּנִי רָעָה תַּחַת טוֹבָה שְׁכוֹל לְנַפְשִֽׁי׃
translation: They reward me evil for good, to the bereaving of my soul. (Psalms 35:12)

text: שִׁנַּיִךְ כְּעֵדֶר הַקְּצוּבוֹת שֶׁעָלוּ מִן הָרַחְצָה שֶׁכֻּלָּם מַתְאִימוֹת וְשַׁכֻּלָה אֵין בָּהֶֽם׃
translation: Your teeth are like a newly shorn flock, which have come up from the washing, where every one of them has twins. None is bereaved among them. (Song of Solomon 4:2)

text: שִׁנַּיִךְ כְּעֵדֶר הָֽרְחֵלִים שֶׁעָלוּ מִן הָרַחְצָה שֶׁכֻּלָּם מַתְאִימוֹת וְשַׁכֻּלָה אֵין בָּהֶֽם׃
translation: Your teeth are like a flock of ewes, which have come up from the washing, of which every one has twins; not one is bereaved among them. (Song of Solomon 6:6)

text: אֶפְגְּשֵׁם כְּדֹב שַׁכּוּל וְאֶקְרַע סְגוֹר לִבָּם וְאֹכְלֵם שָׁם כְּלָבִיא חַיַּת הַשָּׂדֶה תְּבַקְּעֵֽם׃
translation: I will meet them like a bear that is bereaved of her cubs, and will tear the covering of their heart. There I will devour them like a lioness. The wild animal will tear them. (Hosea 13:8)

text: וְעַתָּה שִׁמְעִי זֹאת עֲדִינָה הַיּוֹשֶׁבֶת לָבֶטַח הָאֹֽמְרָה בִּלְבָבָהּ אֲנִי וְאַפְסִי עוֹד לֹא אֵשֵׁב אַלְמָנָה וְלֹא אֵדַע שְׁכֽוֹל׃
translation: "Now therefore hear this, you who are given to pleasures, who sit securely, who say in your heart, 'I am, and there is no one else besides me. I won't sit as a widow, neither will I know the loss of children.' (Isaiah 47:8)

text: נוּגֵי מִמּוֹעֵד אָסַפְתִּי מִמֵּךְ הָיוּ מַשְׂאֵת עָלֶיהָ חֶרְפָּֽה׃
translation: I will remove those who grieve about the appointed feasts from you. They are a burden and a reproach to you. (Zephaniah 3:18)

text: כִּי אִם הוֹגָה וְרִחַם כְּרֹב חסדו חֲסָדָֽיו׃
translation: For though he causes grief, yet he will have compassion according to the multitude of his loving kindnesses. (Lamentations 3:32)

text: כִּי לֹא עִנָּה מִלִּבּוֹ וַיַּגֶּה בְנֵי אִֽישׁ׃
translation: For he does not afflict willingly, nor grieve the children of men. (Lamentations 3:33)

text: עַד אָנָה תּוֹגְיוּן נַפְשִׁי וּֽתְדַכְּאוּנַנִי בְמִלִּֽים׃
translation: "How long will you torment me, and crush me with words? (Job 19:2)

text: וְשַׂמְתִּיהָ בְּיַד מוֹגַיִךְ אֲשֶׁר אָמְרוּ לְנַפְשֵׁךְ שְׁחִי וְנַעֲבֹרָה וַתָּשִׂימִי כָאָרֶץ גֵּוֵךְ וְכַחוּץ לַעֹבְרִֽים׃
translation: I will put it into the hand of those who afflict you, who have said to your soul, 'Bow down, that we may walk over you;' and you have laid your back as the ground, like a street to those who walk over." (Isaiah 51:23)

text: כַּאֲשֶׁר הֹגָה מִן הַֽמְסִלָּה עָבַר כָּל אִישׁ אַחֲרֵי יוֹאָב לִרְדֹּף אַחֲרֵי שֶׁבַע בֶּן בִּכְרִֽי׃
translation: When he was removed out of the highway, all the people went on after Joab to pursue Sheba the son of Bichri. (2 Samuel 20:13)

text: וְאֶת הַסִּירֹת וְאֶת הַיָּעִים וְאֶת הַֽמְזַמְּרוֹת וְאֶת הַכַּפּוֹת וְאֵת כָּל כְּלֵי הַנְּחֹשֶׁת אֲשֶׁר יְשָֽׁרְתוּ בָם לָקָֽחוּ׃
translation: They took away the pots, the shovels, the snuffers, the spoons, and all the vessels of bronze with which they ministered. (2 Kings 25:14)

text: וְהַֽמְזַמְּרוֹת וְהַמִּזְרָקוֹת וְהַכַּפּוֹת וְהַמַּחְתּוֹת זָהָב סָגוּר וּפֶתַח הַבַּיִת דַּלְתוֹתָיו הַפְּנִימִיּוֹת לְקֹדֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִׁים וְדַלְתֵי הַבַּיִת לַהֵיכָל זָהָֽב׃
translation: and the snuffers, the basins, the spoons, and the fire pans of pure gold. As for the entry of the house, its inner doors for the most holy place and the doors of the main hall of the temple were of gold. (2 Chronicles 4:22)

text: כִּֽי לִפְנֵי קָצִיר כְּתָם פֶּרַח וּבֹסֶר גֹּמֵל יִֽהְיֶה נִצָּה וְכָרַת הַזַּלְזַלִּים בַּמַּזְמֵרוֹת וְאֶת הַנְּטִישׁוֹת הֵסִיר הֵתַֽז׃
translation: For before the harvest, when the blossom is over, and the flower becomes a ripening grape, he will cut off the sprigs with pruning hooks, and he will cut down and take away the spreading branches. (Isaiah 18:5)

text: וְהַסִּפּוֹת וְהַֽמְזַמְּרוֹת וְהַמִּזְרָקוֹת וְהַכַּפּוֹת וְהַמַּחְתּוֹת זָהָב סָגוּר וְהַפֹּתוֹת לְדַלְתוֹת הַבַּיִת הַפְּנִימִי לְקֹדֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִׁים לְדַלְתֵי הַבַּיִת לַהֵיכָל זָהָֽב׃
translation: the cups, the snuffers, the basins, the spoons, and the fire pans, of pure gold; and the hinges, both for the doors of the inner house, the most holy place, and for the doors of the house, of the temple, of gold. (1 Kings 7:50)

text: וְאֶת הַסִּרוֹת וְאֶת הַיָּעִים וְאֶת הַֽמְזַמְּרוֹת וְאֶת הַמִּזְרָקֹת וְאֶת הַכַּפּוֹת וְאֵת כָּל כְּלֵי הַנְּחֹשֶׁת אֲשֶׁר יְשָׁרְתוּ בָהֶם לָקָֽחוּ׃
translation: They also took away the pots, the shovels, the snuffers, the basins, the spoons, and all the vessels of bronze with which they ministered. (Jeremiah 52:18)

text: אַךְ לֹא יֵעָשֶׂה בֵּית יְהוָה סִפּוֹת כֶּסֶף מְזַמְּרוֹת מִזְרָקוֹת חֲצֹצְרוֹת כָּל כְּלִי זָהָב וּכְלִי כָסֶף מִן הַכֶּסֶף הַמּוּבָא בֵית יְהוָֽה׃
translation: for they gave that to those who did the work, and repaired the LORD's house with it. (2 Kings 12:14)

text: עֵת לִבְכּוֹת וְעֵת לִשְׂחוֹק עֵת סְפוֹד וְעֵת רְקֽוֹד׃
translation: a time to weep, and a time to laugh; a time to mourn, and a time to dance; (Ecclesiastes 3:4)

text: קוֹל שׁוֹט וְקוֹל רַעַשׁ אוֹפָן וְסוּס דֹּהֵר וּמֶרְכָּבָה מְרַקֵּדָֽה׃
translation: The noise of the whip, the noise of the rattling of wheels, prancing horses, and bounding chariots, (Nahum 3:2)

text: הֶֽהָרִים רָקְדוּ כְאֵילִים גְּבָעוֹת כִּבְנֵי צֹֽאן׃
translation: The mountains skipped like rams, the little hills like lambs. (Psalms 114:4)

text: הֶֽהָרִים תִּרְקְדוּ כְאֵילִים גְּבָעוֹת כִּבְנֵי צֹֽאן׃
translation: You mountains, that you skipped like rams? You little hills, like lambs? (Psalms 114:6)

text: יְשַׁלְּחוּ כַצֹּאן עֲוִילֵיהֶם וְיַלְדֵיהֶם יְרַקֵּדֽוּן׃
translation: They send out their little ones like a flock. Their children dance. (Job 21:11)

text: וְרָבְצוּ שָׁם צִיִּים וּמָלְאוּ בָתֵּיהֶם אֹחִים וְשָׁכְנוּ שָׁם בְּנוֹת יַֽעֲנָה וּשְׂעִירִים יְרַקְּדוּ שָֽׁם׃
translation: But wild animals of the desert will lie there, and their houses will be full of jackals. Ostriches will dwell there, and wild goats will frolic there. (Isaiah 13:21)

text: כְּעַן תַּתְּנַי פַּחַת עֲבַֽר נַהֲרָה שְׁתַר בּוֹזְנַי וּכְנָוָתְהוֹן אֲפַרְסְכָיֵא דִּי בַּעֲבַר נַהֲרָה רַחִיקִין הֲווֹ מִן תַּמָּֽה׃
translation: Now therefore, Tattenai, governor beyond the River, Shetharbozenai, and your companions the Apharsachites, who are beyond the River, you must stay far from there. (Ezra 6:6)

text: אֱדַיִן רְחוּם בְּעֵל טְעֵם וְשִׁמְשַׁי סָֽפְרָא וּשְׁאָר כְּנָוָתְהוֹן דִּינָיֵא וַאֲפַרְסַתְכָיֵא טַרְפְּלָיֵא אֲפָֽרְסָיֵא ארכוי אַרְכְּוָיֵא בָבְלָיֵא שֽׁוּשַׁנְכָיֵא דהוא דֶּהָיֵא עֵלְמָיֵֽא׃
translation: Then Rehum the chancellor, Shimshai the scribe, and the rest of their companions, the Dinaites, and the Apharsathchites, the Tarpelites, the Apharsites, the Archevites, the Babylonians, the Shushanchites, the Dehaites, the Elamites, (Ezra 4:9)

text: וּבִימֵי אַרְתַּחְשַׁשְׂתָּא כָּתַב בִּשְׁלָם מִתְרְדָת טָֽבְאֵל וּשְׁאָר כנותו כְּנָוֺתָיו עַל ארתחששתא אַרְתַּחְשַׁשְׂתְּ מֶלֶךְ פָּרָס וּכְתָב הַֽנִּשְׁתְּוָן כָּתוּב אֲרָמִית וּמְתֻרְגָּם אֲרָמִֽית׃
translation: In the days of Artaxerxes, Bishlam, Mithredath, Tabeel, and the rest of his companions wrote to Artaxerxes king of Persia; and the writing of the letter was written in Syrian and delivered in the Syrian language. (Ezra 4:7)

text: גַּם אוֹר רְשָׁעִים יִדְעָךְ וְלֹֽא יִגַּהּ שְׁבִיב אִשּֽׁוֹ׃
translation: "Yes, the light of the wicked will be put out. The spark of his fire won't shine. (Job 18:5)

text: כִּי לֹֽא תִהְיֶה אַחֲרִית לָרָע נֵר רְשָׁעִים יִדְעָֽךְ׃
translation: for there will be no reward to the evil man. The lamp of the wicked will be snuffed out. (Proverbs 24:20)

text: סַבּוּנִי כִדְבוֹרִים דֹּעֲכוּ כְּאֵשׁ קוֹצִים בְּשֵׁם יְהוָה כִּי אֲמִילַֽם׃
translation: They surrounded me like bees. They are quenched like the burning thorns. In the LORD's name I cut them off. (Psalms 118:12)

text: בְּעֵת יְזֹרְבוּ נִצְמָתוּ בְּחֻמּוֹ נִדְעֲכוּ מִמְּקוֹמָֽם׃
translation: In the dry season, they vanish. When it is hot, they are consumed out of their place. (Job 6:17)

text: אוֹר חָשַׁךְ בְּאָהֳלוֹ וְנֵרוֹ עָלָיו יִדְעָֽךְ׃
translation: The light will be dark in his tent. His lamp above him will be put out. (Job 18:6)

text: כַּמָּה נֵר רְשָׁעִים יִדְעָךְ וְיָבֹא עָלֵימוֹ אֵידָם חֲבָלִים יְחַלֵּק בְּאַפּֽוֹ׃
translation: "How often is it that the lamp of the wicked is put out, that their calamity comes on them, that God distributes sorrows in his anger? (Job 21:17)

text: הַֽנֶּחֱמָדִים מִזָּהָב וּמִפַּז רָב וּמְתוּקִים מִדְּבַשׁ וְנֹפֶת צוּפִֽים׃
translation: Moreover your servant is warned by them. In keeping them there is great reward. (Psalms 19:11)

text: כִּֽי תְקַדְּמֶנּוּ בִּרְכוֹת טוֹב תָּשִׁית לְרֹאשׁוֹ עֲטֶרֶת פָּֽז׃
translation: He asked life of you and you gave it to him, even length of days forever and ever. (Psalms 21:4)

text: טוֹב פִּרְיִי מֵחָרוּץ וּמִפָּז וּתְבוּאָתִי מִכֶּסֶף נִבְחָֽר׃
translation: My fruit is better than gold, yes, than fine gold, my yield than choice silver. (Proverbs 8:19)

text: רֹאשׁוֹ כֶּתֶם פָּז קְוּצּוֹתָיו תַּלְתַּלִּים שְׁחֹרוֹת כָּעוֹרֵֽב׃
translation: His head is like the purest gold. His hair is bushy, black as a raven. (Song of Solomon 5:11)

text: עַל כֵּן אָהַבְתִּי מִצְוֺתֶיךָ מִזָּהָב וּמִפָּֽז׃
translation: Therefore I love your commandments more than gold, yes, more than pure gold. (Psalms 119:127)

text: אוֹקִיר אֱנוֹשׁ מִפָּז וְאָדָם מִכֶּתֶם אוֹפִֽיר׃
translation: I will make people more rare than fine gold, even a person than the pure gold of Ophir. (Isaiah 13:12)

text: בְּרֹב שַׂרְעַפַּי בְּקִרְבִּי תַּנְחוּמֶיךָ יְֽשַׁעַשְׁעוּ נַפְשִֽׁי׃
translation: In the multitude of my thoughts within me, your comforts delight my soul. (Psalms 94:19)

text: טָפַשׁ כַּחֵלֶב לִבָּם אֲנִי תּוֹרָתְךָ שִֽׁעֲשָֽׁעְתִּי׃
translation: Their heart is as callous as the fat, but I delight in your law. (Psalms 119:70)

text: בְּחֻקֹּתֶיךָ אֶֽשְׁתַּעֲשָׁע לֹא אֶשְׁכַּח דְּבָרֶֽךָ׃
translation: I will delight myself in your statutes. I will not forget your word. GIMEL (Psalms 119:16)

text: וְאֶשְׁתַּֽעֲשַׁע בְּמִצְוֺתֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר אָהָֽבְתִּי׃
translation: I will delight myself in your commandments, because I love them. (Psalms 119:47)

text: הַשְׁמֵן לֵב הָעָם הַזֶּה וְאָזְנָיו הַכְבֵּד וְעֵינָיו הָשַׁע פֶּן יִרְאֶה בְעֵינָיו וּבְאָזְנָיו יִשְׁמָע וּלְבָבוֹ יָבִין וָשָׁב וְרָפָא לֽוֹ׃
translation: Make the heart of this people fat. Make their ears heavy, and shut their eyes; lest they see with their eyes, hear with their ears, understand with their heart, and turn again, and be healed." (Isaiah 6:10)

text: כִּֽי כֹה אָמַר יְהוָה הִנְנִי נֹטֶֽה אֵלֶיהָ כְּנָהָר שָׁלוֹם וּכְנַחַל שׁוֹטֵף כְּבוֹד גּוֹיִם וִֽינַקְתֶּם עַל צַד תִּנָּשֵׂאוּ וְעַל בִּרְכַּיִם תְּשָׁעֳשָֽׁעוּ׃
translation: For the LORD says, "Behold, I will extend peace to her like a river, and the glory of the nations like an overflowing stream, and you will nurse. You will be carried on her side, and will be dandled on her knees. (Isaiah 66:12)

text: הָרִיעוּ לַֽיהוָה כָּל הָאָרֶץ פִּצְחוּ וְרַנְּנוּ וְזַמֵּֽרוּ׃
translation: Make a joyful noise to the LORD, all the earth! Burst out and sing for joy, yes, sing praises! (Psalms 98:4)

text: נָחָה שָׁקְטָה כָּל הָאָרֶץ פָּצְחוּ רִנָּֽה׃
translation: The whole earth is at rest, and is quiet. They break out in song. (Isaiah 14:7)

text: פִּצְחוּ רַנְּנוּ יַחְדָּו חָרְבוֹת יְרוּשָׁלִָם כִּֽי נִחַם יְהוָה עַמּוֹ גָּאַל יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
translation: Break out into joy! Sing together, you waste places of Jerusalem; for the LORD has comforted his people. He has redeemed Jerusalem. (Isaiah 52:9)

text: רָנּוּ שָׁמַיִם וְגִילִי אָרֶץ יפצחו וּפִצְחוּ הָרִים רִנָּה כִּֽי נִחַם יְהוָה עַמּוֹ וַעֲנִיָּו יְרַחֵֽם׃
translation: Sing, heavens, and be joyful, earth! Break out into singing, mountains! For the LORD has comforted his people, and will have compassion on his afflicted. (Isaiah 49:13)

text: וַאֲשֶׁר אָכְלוּ שְׁאֵר עַמִּי וְעוֹרָם מֵעֲלֵיהֶם הִפְשִׁיטוּ וְאֶת עַצְמֹֽתֵיהֶם פִּצֵּחוּ וּפָרְשׂוּ כַּאֲשֶׁר בַּסִּיר וּכְבָשָׂר בְּתוֹךְ קַלָּֽחַת׃
translation: who also eat the flesh of my people, and peel their skin from off them, and break their bones, and chop them in pieces, as for the pot, and as meat within the cauldron. (Micah 3:3)

text: רָנִּי עֲקָרָה לֹא יָלָדָה פִּצְחִי רִנָּה וְצַהֲלִי לֹא חָלָה כִּֽי רַבִּים בְּֽנֵי שׁוֹמֵמָה מִבְּנֵי בְעוּלָה אָמַר יְהוָֽה׃
translation: "Sing, barren, you who didn't give birth! Break out into singing, and cry aloud, you who didn't travail with child! For more are the children of the desolate than the children of the married wife," says the LORD. (Isaiah 54:1)

text: הִרְבֵּית רֹֽכְלַיִךְ מִכּוֹכְבֵי הַשָּׁמָיִם יֶלֶק פָּשַׁט וַיָּעֹֽף׃
translation: You have increased your merchants more than the stars of the skies. The grasshopper strips and flees away. (Nahum 3:16)

text: אָמַר וַיָּבֹא אַרְבֶּה וְיֶלֶק וְאֵין מִסְפָּֽר׃
translation: He spoke, and the locusts came with the grasshoppers, without number. (Psalms 105:34)

text: שָׁם תֹּאכְלֵךְ אֵשׁ תַּכְרִיתֵךְ חֶרֶב תֹּאכְלֵךְ כַּיָּלֶק הִתְכַּבֵּד כַּיֶּלֶק הִֽתְכַּבְּדִי כָּאַרְבֶּֽה׃
translation: There the fire will devour you. The sword will cut you off. It will devour you like the grasshopper. Multiply like grasshoppers. Multiply like the locust. (Nahum 3:15)

text: יֶתֶר הַגָּזָם אָכַל הָֽאַרְבֶּה וְיֶתֶר הָאַרְבֶּה אָכַל הַיָּלֶק וְיֶתֶר הַיֶּלֶק אָכַל הֶחָסִֽיל׃
translation: What the swarming locust has left, the great locust has eaten. What the great locust has left, the grasshopper has eaten. What the grasshopper has left, the caterpillar has eaten. (Joel 1:4)

text: וְשִׁלַּמְתִּי לָכֶם אֶת הַשָּׁנִים אֲשֶׁר אָכַל הָֽאַרְבֶּה הַיֶּלֶק וְהֶחָסִיל וְהַגָּזָם חֵילִי הַגָּדוֹל אֲשֶׁר שִׁלַּחְתִּי בָּכֶֽם׃
translation: I will restore to you the years that the swarming locust has eaten, the great locust, the grasshopper, and the caterpillar, my great army, which I sent among you. (Joel 2:25)

text: מְשַׂחֶקֶת בְּתֵבֵל אַרְצוֹ וְשַׁעֲשֻׁעַי אֶת בְּנֵי אָדָֽם׃
translation: rejoicing in his whole world. My delight was with the sons of men. (Proverbs 8:31)

text: יְבֹאוּנִי רַחֲמֶיךָ וְאֶֽחְיֶה כִּי תֽוֹרָתְךָ שַֽׁעֲשֻׁעָֽי׃
translation: Let your tender mercies come to me, that I may live; for your law is my delight. (Psalms 119:77)

text: לוּלֵי תוֹרָתְךָ שַׁעֲשֻׁעָי אָז אָבַדְתִּי בְעָנְיִֽי׃
translation: Unless your law had been my delight, I would have perished in my affliction. (Psalms 119:92)

text: גַּֽם עֵדֹתֶיךָ שַׁעֲשֻׁעָי אַנְשֵׁי עֲצָתִֽי׃
translation: Indeed your statutes are my delight, and my counselors. DALETH (Psalms 119:24)

text: תָּאַבְתִּי לִֽישׁוּעָתְךָ יְהוָה וְתֽוֹרָתְךָ שַׁעֲשֻׁעָֽי׃
translation: I have longed for your salvation, LORD. Your law is my delight. (Psalms 119:174)

text: וָֽאֶהְיֶה אֶצְלוֹ אָמוֹן וָֽאֶהְיֶה שַׁעֲשֻׁעִים יוֹם יוֹם מְשַׂחֶקֶת לְפָנָיו בְּכָל עֵֽת׃
translation: then I was the craftsman by his side. I was a delight day by day, always rejoicing before him, (Proverbs 8:30)

text: סִגִים הִשְׁבַּתָּ כָל רִשְׁעֵי אָרֶץ לָכֵן אָהַבְתִּי עֵדֹתֶֽיךָ׃
translation: You put away all the wicked of the earth like dross. Therefore I love your testimonies. (Psalms 119:119)

text: כֶּסֶף סִיגִים מְצֻפֶּה עַל חָרֶשׂ שְׂפָתַיִם דֹּלְקִים וְלֶב רָֽע׃
translation: Like silver dross on an earthen vessel are the lips of a fervent one with an evil heart. (Proverbs 26:23)

text: הָגוֹ סִיגִים מִכָּסֶף וַיֵּצֵא לַצֹּרֵף כֶּֽלִי׃
translation: Take away the dross from the silver, and material comes out for the refiner. (Proverbs 25:4)

text: כַּסְפֵּךְ הָיָה לְסִיגִים סָבְאֵךְ מָהוּל בַּמָּֽיִם׃
translation: Your silver has become dross, your wine mixed with water. (Isaiah 1:22)

text: לָכֵן כֹּה אָמַר אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה יַעַן הֱיוֹת כֻּלְּכֶם לְסִגִים לָכֵן הִנְנִי קֹבֵץ אֶתְכֶם אֶל תּוֹךְ יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
translation: Therefore the Lord GOD says: 'Because you have all become dross, therefore, behold, I will gather you into the middle of Jerusalem. (Ezekiel 22:19)

text: טוֹב פַּת חֲרֵבָה וְשַׁלְוָה בָהּ מִבַּיִת מָלֵא זִבְחֵי רִֽיב׃
translation: Better is a dry morsel with quietness, than a house full of feasting with strife. (Proverbs 17:1)

text: יְהִֽי שָׁלוֹם בְּחֵילֵךְ שַׁלְוָה בְּאַרְמְנוֹתָֽיִךְ׃
translation: Peace be within your walls, and prosperity within your palaces. (Psalms 122:7)

text: דִּבַּרְתִּי אֵלַיִךְ בְּשַׁלְוֺתַיִךְ אָמַרְתְּ לֹא אֶשְׁמָע זֶה דַרְכֵּךְ מִנְּעוּרַיִךְ כִּי לֹֽא שָׁמַעַתְּ בְּקוֹלִֽי׃
translation: I spoke to you in your prosperity, but you said, 'I will not listen.' This has been your way from your youth, that you didn't obey my voice. (Jeremiah 22:21)

text: וְעָמַד עַל כַּנּוֹ נִבְזֶה וְלֹא נָתְנוּ עָלָיו הוֹד מַלְכוּת וּבָא בְשַׁלְוָה וְהֶחֱזִיק מַלְכוּת בַּחֲלַקְלַקּֽוֹת׃
translation: "In his place a contemptible person will stand up, to whom they had not given the honor of the kingdom; but he will come in time of security, and will obtain the kingdom by flatteries. (Daniel 11:21)

text: וְעַל שִׂכְלוֹ וְהִצְלִיחַ מִרְמָה בְּיָדוֹ וּבִלְבָבוֹ יַגְדִּיל וּבְשַׁלְוָה יַשְׁחִית רַבִּים וְעַל שַׂר שָׂרִים יַעֲמֹד וּבְאֶפֶס יָד יִשָּׁבֵֽר׃
translation: Through his policy he will cause deceit to prosper in his hand. He will magnify himself in his heart, and he will destroy many in their security. He will also stand up against the prince of princes, but he will be broken without human hands. (Daniel 8:25)

text: הִנֵּה זֶה הָיָה עֲוֺן סְדֹם אֲחוֹתֵךְ גָּאוֹן שִׂבְעַת לֶחֶם וְשַׁלְוַת הַשְׁקֵט הָיָה לָהּ וְלִבְנוֹתֶיהָ וְיַד עָנִי וְאֶבְיוֹן לֹא הֶחֱזִֽיקָה׃
translation: "'"Behold, this was the iniquity of your sister Sodom: pride, fullness of bread, and prosperous ease was in her and in her daughters. She also didn't strengthen the hand of the poor and needy. (Ezekiel 16:49)

text: כִּי מֹצְאִי מצאי מָצָא חַיִּים וַיָּפֶק רָצוֹן מֵיְהוָֽה׃
translation: For whoever finds me finds life, and will obtain favor from the LORD. (Proverbs 8:35)

text: בְּכֶסֶף וּבְזָהָב יְיַפֵּהוּ בְּמַסְמְרוֹת וּבְמַקָּבוֹת יְחַזְּקוּם וְלוֹא יָפִֽיק׃
translation: They deck it with silver and with gold. They fasten it with nails and with hammers, so that it can't move. (Jeremiah 10:4)
