text: אַשְׁרֵי אָדָם מָצָא חָכְמָה וְאָדָם יָפִיק תְּבוּנָֽה׃
translation: Happy is the man who finds wisdom, the man who gets understanding. (Proverbs 3:13)

text: טוֹב יָפִיק רָצוֹן מֵיְהוָה וְאִישׁ מְזִמּוֹת יַרְשִֽׁיעַ׃
translation: A good man shall obtain favor from the LORD, but he will condemn a man of wicked plans. (Proverbs 12:2)

text: מָצָא אִשָּׁה מָצָא טוֹב וַיָּפֶק רָצוֹן מֵיְהוָֽה׃
translation: Whoever finds a wife finds a good thing, and obtains favor of the LORD. (Proverbs 18:22)

text: אַל תִּתֵּן יְהוָה מַאֲוַיֵּי רָשָׁע זְמָמוֹ אַל תָּפֵק יָרוּמוּ סֶֽלָה׃
translation: As for the head of those who surround me, let the mischief of their own lips cover them. (Psalms 140:9)

text: כִּי מֶֽה הֹוֶה לָֽאָדָם בְּכָל עֲמָלוֹ וּבְרַעְיוֹן לִבּו שֶׁהוּא עָמֵל תַּחַת הַשָּֽׁמֶשׁ׃
translation: For what does a man have of all his labor and of the striving of his heart, in which he labors under the sun? (Ecclesiastes 2:22)

text: וָאֶתְּנָה לִבִּי לָדַעַת חָכְמָה וְדַעַת הוֹלֵלוֹת וְשִׂכְלוּת יָדַעְתִּי שֶׁגַּם זֶה הוּא רַעְיוֹן רֽוּחַ׃
translation: I applied my heart to know wisdom, and to know madness and folly. I perceived that this also was a chasing after wind. (Ecclesiastes 1:17)

text: עַד כָּה סוֹפָא דִֽי מִלְּתָא אֲנָה דָֽנִיֵּאל שַׂגִּיא רַעְיוֹנַי יְבַהֲלֻנַּנִי וְזִיוַי יִשְׁתַּנּוֹן עֲלַי וּמִלְּתָא בְּלִבִּי נִטְרֵֽת׃
translation: "Here is the end of the matter. As for me, Daniel, my thoughts troubled me greatly, and my face was changed in me; but I kept the matter in my heart." (Daniel 7:28)

text: אֵֽין קֵץ לְכָל הָעָם לְכֹל אֲשֶׁר הָיָה לִפְנֵיהֶם גַּם הָאַחֲרוֹנִים לֹא יִשְׂמְחוּ בוֹ כִּֽי גַם זֶה הֶבֶל וְרַעְיוֹן רֽוּחַ׃
translation: There was no end of all the people, even of all them over whom he was—yet those who come after shall not rejoice in him. Surely this also is vanity and a chasing after wind. (Ecclesiastes 4:16)

text: הִנֵּה יְהוָה בּוֹקֵק הָאָרֶץ וּבֽוֹלְקָהּ וְעִוָּה פָנֶיהָ וְהֵפִיץ יֹשְׁבֶֽיהָ׃
translation: Behold, the LORD makes the earth empty, makes it waste, turns it upside down, and scatters its inhabitants. (Isaiah 24:1)

text: הִבּוֹק תִּבּוֹק הָאָרֶץ וְהִבּוֹז תִּבּוֹז כִּי יְהוָה דִּבֶּר אֶת הַדָּבָר הַזֶּֽה׃
translation: The earth will be utterly emptied and utterly laid waste; for the LORD has spoken this word. (Isaiah 24:3)

text: וְשִׁלַּחְתִּי לְבָבֶל זָרִים וְזֵרוּהָ וִיבֹקְקוּ אֶת אַרְצָהּ כִּֽי הָיוּ עָלֶיהָ מִסָּבִיב בְּיוֹם רָעָֽה׃
translation: I will send to Babylon strangers, who will winnow her. They will empty her land; for in the day of trouble they will be against her all around. (Jeremiah 51:2)

text: כִּי שָׁב יְהוָה אֶת גְּאוֹן יַעֲקֹב כִּגְאוֹן יִשְׂרָאֵל כִּי בְקָקוּם בֹּֽקְקִים וּזְמֹרֵיהֶם שִׁחֵֽתוּ׃
translation: The shield of his mighty men is made red. The valiant men are in scarlet. The chariots flash with steel in the day of his preparation, and the pine spears are brandished. (Nahum 2:3)

text: גֶּפֶן בּוֹקֵק יִשְׂרָאֵל פְּרִי יְשַׁוֶּה לּוֹ כְּרֹב לְפִרְיוֹ הִרְבָּה לַֽמִּזְבְּחוֹת כְּטוֹב לְאַרְצוֹ הֵיטִיבוּ מַצֵּבֽוֹת׃
translation: Israel is a luxuriant vine that produces his fruit. According to the abundance of his fruit he has multiplied his altars. As their land has prospered, they have adorned their sacred stones. (Hosea 10:1)

text: עָשׁוּק אֶפְרַיִם רְצוּץ מִשְׁפָּט כִּי הוֹאִיל הָלַךְ אַחֲרֵי צָֽו׃
translation: Ephraim is oppressed, he is crushed in judgment, because he is intent in his pursuit of idols. (Hosea 5:11)

text: כִּי צַו לָצָו צַו לָצָו קַו לָקָו קַו לָקָו זְעֵיר שָׁם זְעֵיר שָֽׁם׃
translation: For it is precept on precept, precept on precept; line on line, line on line; here a little, there a little. (Isaiah 28:10)

text: שָׁם מֶשֶׁךְ תֻּבַל וְכָל הֲמוֹנָהּ סְבִֽיבוֹתָיו קִבְרוֹתֶיהָ כֻּלָּם עֲרֵלִים מְחֻלְלֵי חֶרֶב כִּֽי נָתְנוּ חִתִּיתָם בְּאֶרֶץ חַיִּֽים׃
translation: "There is Meshech, Tubal, and all their multitude. Their graves are around them, all of them uncircumcised, slain by the sword; for they caused their terror in the land of the living. (Ezekiel 32:26)

text: אֲשֶׁר נִתְּנוּ קִבְרֹתֶיהָ בְּיַרְכְּתֵי בוֹר וַיְהִי קְהָלָהּ סְבִיבוֹת קְבֻרָתָהּ כֻּלָּם חֲלָלִים נֹפְלִים בַּחֶרֶב אֲשֶׁר נָתְנוּ חִתִּית בְּאֶרֶץ חַיִּֽים׃
translation: whose graves are set in the uttermost parts of the pit, and her company is around her grave, all of them slain, fallen by the sword, who caused terror in the land of the living. (Ezekiel 32:23)

text: כִּֽי נָתַתִּי אֶת חתיתו חִתִּיתִי בְּאֶרֶץ חַיִּים וְהֻשְׁכַּב בְּתוֹךְ עֲרֵלִים אֶת חַלְלֵי חֶרֶב פַּרְעֹה וְכָל הֲמוֹנֹה נְאֻם אֲדֹנָי יְהוִֽה׃
translation: "For I have put his terror in the land of the living. He will be laid among the uncircumcised, with those who are slain by the sword, even Pharaoh and all his multitude," says the Lord GOD. (Ezekiel 32:32)

text: אֱדַיִן לְדָנִיֵּאל בְּחֶזְוָא דִֽי לֵילְיָא רָזָה גֲלִי אֱדַיִן דָּֽנִיֵּאל בָּרִךְ לֶאֱלָהּ שְׁמַיָּֽא׃
translation: Then the secret was revealed to Daniel in a vision of the night. Then Daniel blessed the God of heaven. (Daniel 2:19)

text: עָנֵה דָנִיֵּאל קֳדָם מַלְכָּא וְאָמַר רָזָה דִּֽי מַלְכָּא שָׁאֵל לָא חַכִּימִין אָֽשְׁפִין חַרְטֻמִּין גָּזְרִין יָכְלִין לְהַֽחֲוָיָה לְמַלְכָּֽא׃
translation: Daniel answered before the king, and said, "The secret which the king has demanded can't be shown to the king by wise men, enchanters, magicians, or soothsayers; (Daniel 2:27)

text: אַנְתְּה מַלְכָּא רַעְיוֹנָךְ עַל מִשְׁכְּבָךְ סְלִקוּ מָה דִּי לֶהֱוֵא אַחֲרֵי דְנָה וְגָלֵא רָזַיָּא הוֹדְעָךְ מָה דִי לֶהֱוֵֽא׃
translation: "As for you, O king, your thoughts came on your bed, what should happen hereafter; and he who reveals secrets has made known to you what will happen. (Daniel 2:29)

text: וְרַחֲמִין לְמִבְעֵא מִן קֳדָם אֱלָהּ שְׁמַיָּא עַל רָזָה דְּנָה דִּי לָא יְהֹֽבְדוּן דָּנִיֵּאל וְחַבְרוֹהִי עִם שְׁאָר חַכִּימֵי בָבֶֽל׃
translation: that they would desire mercies of the God of heaven concerning this secret, that Daniel and his companions would not perish with the rest of the wise men of Babylon. (Daniel 2:18)

text: וּכְדִי רִם לִבְבֵהּ וְרוּחֵהּ תִּֽקְפַת לַהֲזָדָה הָנְחַת מִן כָּרְסֵא מַלְכוּתֵהּ וִֽיקָרָה הֶעְדִּיוּ מִנֵּֽהּ׃
translation: But when his heart was lifted up, and his spirit was hardened so that he dealt proudly, he was deposed from his kingly throne, and they took his glory from him. (Daniel 5:20)

text: וְהוּא מְהַשְׁנֵא עִדָּנַיָּא וְזִמְנַיָּא מְהַעְדֵּה מַלְכִין וּמְהָקֵים מַלְכִין יָהֵב חָכְמְתָא לְחַכִּימִין וּמַנְדְּעָא לְיָדְעֵי בִינָֽה׃
translation: He changes the times and the seasons. He removes kings and sets up kings. He gives wisdom to the wise, and knowledge to those who have understanding. (Daniel 2:21)

text: עוֹד מִלְּתָא בְּפֻם מַלְכָּא קָל מִן שְׁמַיָּא נְפַל לָךְ אָֽמְרִין נְבוּכַדְנֶצַּר מַלְכָּא מַלְכוּתָה עֲדָת מִנָּֽךְ׃
translation: All this came on the King Nebuchadnezzar. (Daniel 4:28)

text: שָׁקוֹהִי דִּי פַרְזֶל רַגְלוֹהִי מנהון מִנְּהֵין דִּי פַרְזֶל ומנהון וּמִנְּהֵין דִּי חֲסַֽף׃
translation: its legs of iron, its feet part of iron and part of clay. (Daniel 2:33)

text: וְאֶצְבְּעָת רַגְלַיָּא מנהון מִנְּהֵין פַּרְזֶל ומנהון וּמִנְּהֵין חֲסַף מִן קְצָת מַלְכוּתָא תֶּהֱוֵה תַקִּיפָה וּמִנַּהּ תֶּהֱוֵה תְבִירָֽה׃
translation: As the toes of the feet were part of iron, and part of clay, so the kingdom will be partly strong and partly brittle. (Daniel 2:42)

text: חָזֵה הֲוַיְתָ עַד דִּי הִתְגְּזֶרֶת אֶבֶן דִּי לָא בִידַיִן וּמְחָת לְצַלְמָא עַל רַגְלוֹהִי דִּי פַרְזְלָא וְחַסְפָּא וְהַדֵּקֶת הִמּֽוֹן׃
translation: You saw until a stone was cut out without hands, which struck the image on its feet that were of iron and clay, and broke them in pieces. (Daniel 2:34)

text: הֵן אִיתַי אֱלָהַנָא דִּֽי אֲנַחְנָא פָֽלְחִין יָכִל לְשֵׁיזָבוּתַנָא מִן אַתּוּן נוּרָא יָקִֽדְתָּא וּמִן יְדָךְ מַלְכָּא יְשֵׁיזִֽב׃
translation: If it happens, our God whom we serve is able to deliver us from the burning fiery furnace; and he will deliver us out of your hand, O king. (Daniel 3:17)

text: אֱדַיִן מַלְכָּא כְּדִי מִלְּתָא שְׁמַע שַׂגִּיא בְּאֵשׁ עֲלוֹהִי וְעַל דָּנִיֵּאל שָׂם בָּל לְשֵׁיזָבוּתֵהּ וְעַד מֶֽעָלֵי שִׁמְשָׁא הֲוָא מִשְׁתַּדַּר לְהַצָּלוּתֵֽהּ׃
translation: Then these men assembled together to the king, and said to the king, "Know, O king, that it is a law of the Medes and Persians, that no decree nor statute which the king establishes may be changed." (Daniel 6:15)

text: אֱדַיִן מַלְכָּא בֵלְשַׁאצַּר שַׂגִּיא מִתְבָּהַל וְזִיוֺהִי שָׁנַיִן עֲלוֹהִי וְרַבְרְבָנוֹהִי מִֽשְׁתַּבְּשִֽׁין׃
translation: Then King Belshazzar was greatly troubled, and his face was changed in him, and his lords were perplexed. (Daniel 5:9)

text: בֵּלְשַׁאצַּר מַלְכָּא עֲבַד לְחֶם רַב לְרַבְרְבָנוֹהִי אֲלַף וְלָקֳבֵל אַלְפָּא חַמְרָא שָׁתֵֽה׃
translation: Belshazzar the king made a great feast to a thousand of his lords, and drank wine before the thousand. (Daniel 5:1)

text: וְהֵיתָיִת אֶבֶן חֲדָה וְשֻׂמַת עַל פֻּם גֻּבָּא וְחַתְמַהּ מַלְכָּא בְּעִזְקְתֵהּ וּבְעִזְקָת רַבְרְבָנוֹהִי דִּי לָא תִשְׁנֵא צְבוּ בְּדָנִיֵּֽאל׃
translation: Then the king went to his palace, and passed the night fasting. No musical instruments were brought before him; and his sleep fled from him. (Daniel 6:18)

text: כְּחוּט הַשָּׁנִי שִׂפְתֹתַיִךְ וּמִדְבָּרֵיךְ נָאוֶה כְּפֶלַח הָֽרִמּוֹן רַקָּתֵךְ מִבַּעַד לְצַמָּתֵֽךְ׃
translation: Your lips are like scarlet thread. Your mouth is lovely. Your temples are like a piece of a pomegranate behind your veil. (Song of Solomon 4:3)

text: וְאִֽם יִתְקְפוֹ הָאֶחָד הַשְּׁנַיִם יַעַמְדוּ נֶגְדּוֹ וְהַחוּט הַֽמְשֻׁלָּשׁ לֹא בִמְהֵרָה יִנָּתֵֽק׃
translation: If a man prevails against one who is alone, two shall withstand him; and a threefold cord is not quickly broken. (Ecclesiastes 4:12)

text: אִם מִחוּט וְעַד שְׂרֽוֹךְ נַעַל וְאִם אֶקַּח מִכָּל אֲשֶׁר לָךְ וְלֹא תֹאמַר אֲנִי הֶעֱשַׁרְתִּי אֶת אַבְרָֽם׃
translation: that I will not take a thread nor a sandal strap nor anything that is yours, lest you should say, 'I have made Abram rich.' (Genesis 14:23)

text: וְהָעַמּוּדִים שְׁמֹנֶה עֶשְׂרֵה אַמָּה קומה קוֹמַת הָעַמֻּד הָאֶחָד וְחוּט שְׁתֵּים עֶשְׂרֵה אַמָּה יְסֻבֶּנּוּ וְעָבְיוֹ אַרְבַּע אַצְבָּעוֹת נָבֽוּב׃
translation: As for the pillars, the height of the one pillar was eighteen cubits; and a line of twelve cubits encircled it; and its thickness was four fingers. It was hollow. (Jeremiah 52:21)

text: וַתִּקַּח דְּלִילָה עֲבֹתִים חֲדָשִׁים וַתַּאַסְרֵהוּ בָהֶם וַתֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו פְּלִשְׁתִּים עָלֶיךָ שִׁמְשׁוֹן וְהָאֹרֵב יֹשֵׁב בֶּחָדֶר וַֽיְנַתְּקֵם מֵעַל זְרֹעֹתָיו כַּחֽוּט׃
translation: So Delilah took new ropes and bound him with them, then said to him, "The Philistines are on you, Samson!" The ambush was waiting in the inner room. He broke them off his arms like a thread. (Judges 16:12)

text: וַיָּצַר אֶת שְׁנֵי הָעַמּוּדִים נְחֹשֶׁת שְׁמֹנֶה עֶשְׂרֵה אַמָּה קוֹמַת הָעַמּוּד הָאֶחָד וְחוּט שְׁתֵּים עֶשְׂרֵה אַמָּה יָסֹב אֶת הָעַמּוּד הַשֵּׁנִֽי׃
translation: For he fashioned the two pillars of bronze, eighteen cubits high apiece; and a line of twelve cubits encircled either of them. (1 Kings 7:15)

text: וּשְׁקֻפִים שְׁלֹשָׁה טוּרִים וּמֶחֱזָה אֶל מֶחֱזָה שָׁלֹשׁ פְּעָמִֽים׃
translation: There were beams in three rows, and window was facing window in three ranks. (1 Kings 7:4)

text: נְאֻם שֹׁמֵעַ אִמְרֵי אֵל אֲשֶׁר מַחֲזֵה שַׁדַּי יֶֽחֱזֶה נֹפֵל וּגְלוּי עֵינָֽיִם׃
translation: he says, who hears the words of God, who sees the vision of the Almighty, falling down, and having his eyes open: (Numbers 24:4)

text: וְכָל הַפְּתָחִים וְהַמְּזוּזוֹת רְבֻעִים שָׁקֶף וּמוּל מֶחֱזָה אֶל מֶחֱזָה שָׁלֹשׁ פְּעָמִֽים׃
translation: All the doors and posts were made square with beams; and window was facing window in three ranks. (1 Kings 7:5)

text: נְאֻם שֹׁמֵעַ אִמְרֵי אֵל וְיֹדֵעַ דַּעַת עֶלְיוֹן מַחֲזֵה שַׁדַּי יֶֽחֱזֶה נֹפֵל וּגְלוּי עֵינָֽיִם׃
translation: he says, who hears the words of God, knows the knowledge of the Most High, and who sees the vision of the Almighty, falling down, and having his eyes open: (Numbers 24:16)

text: הֲלוֹא מַֽחֲזֵה שָׁוְא חֲזִיתֶם וּמִקְסַם כָּזָב אֲמַרְתֶּם וְאֹֽמְרִים נְאֻם יְהוָה וַאֲנִי לֹא דִבַּֽרְתִּי׃
translation: Haven't you seen a false vision, and haven't you spoken a lying divination, in that you say, 'The LORD says;' but I have not spoken?" (Ezekiel 13:7)

text: אַחַר הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה הָיָה דְבַר יְהוָה אֶל אַבְרָם בַּֽמַּחֲזֶה לֵאמֹר אַל תִּירָא אַבְרָם אָנֹכִי מָגֵן לָךְ שְׂכָרְךָ הַרְבֵּה מְאֹֽד׃
translation: After these things the LORD's word came to Abram in a vision, saying, "Don't be afraid, Abram. I am your shield, your exceedingly great reward." (Genesis 15:1)

text: כִּֽי מִצְוַת הַמֶּלֶךְ עֲלֵיהֶם וַאֲמָנָה עַל הַמְשֹׁרְרִים דְּבַר יוֹם בְּיוֹמֽוֹ׃
translation: For there was a commandment from the king concerning them, and a settled provision for the singers, as every day required. (Nehemiah 11:23)

text: וּבְכָל זֹאת אֲנַחְנוּ כֹּרְתִים אֲמָנָה וְכֹתְבִים וְעַל הֶֽחָתוּם שָׂרֵינוּ לְוִיֵּנוּ כֹּהֲנֵֽינוּ׃
translation: Now those who sealed were: Nehemiah the governor, the son of Hacaliah, and Zedekiah, (Nehemiah 10:1)

text: וְגַם אָמְנָה אֲחֹתִי בַת אָבִי הִוא אַךְ לֹא בַת אִמִּי וַתְּהִי לִי לְאִשָּֽׁה׃
translation: Besides, she is indeed my sister, the daughter of my father, but not the daughter of my mother; and she became my wife. (Genesis 20:12)

text: וַיַּעַן עָכָן אֶת יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וַיֹּאמַר אָמְנָה אָנֹכִי חָטָאתִי לַֽיהוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְכָזֹאת וְכָזֹאת עָשִֽׂיתִי׃
translation: Achan answered Joshua, and said, "I have truly sinned against the LORD, the God of Israel, and this is what I have done. (Joshua 7:20)

text: הֲלֹא טוֹב אבנה אֲמָנָה וּפַרְפַּר נַהֲרוֹת דַּמֶּשֶׂק מִכֹּל מֵימֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הֲלֹֽא אֶרְחַץ בָּהֶם וְטָהָרְתִּי וַיִּפֶן וַיֵּלֶךְ בְּחֵמָֽה׃
translation: Aren't Abanah and Pharpar, the rivers of Damascus, better than all the waters of Israel? Couldn't I wash in them and be clean?" So he turned and went away in a rage. (2 Kings 5:12)

text: בָּעֵת הַהִיא קִצַּץ חִזְקִיָּה אֶת דַּלְתוֹת הֵיכַל יְהוָה וְאֶת הָאֹמְנוֹת אֲשֶׁר צִפָּה חִזְקִיָּה מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה וַֽיִּתְּנֵם לְמֶלֶךְ אַשּֽׁוּר׃
translation: At that time, Hezekiah cut off the gold from the doors of the LORD's temple, and from the pillars which Hezekiah king of Judah had overlaid, and gave it to the king of Assyria. (2 Kings 18:16)

text: וַיַּצֵּב אַבְרָהָם אֶת שֶׁבַע כִּבְשֹׂת הַצֹּאן לְבַדְּהֶֽן׃
translation: Abraham set seven ewe lambs of the flock by themselves. (Genesis 21:28)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲבִימֶלֶךְ אֶל אַבְרָהָם מָה הֵנָּה שֶׁבַע כְּבָשֹׂת הָאֵלֶּה אֲשֶׁר הִצַּבְתָּ לְבַדָּֽנָה׃
translation: Abimelech said to Abraham, "What do these seven ewe lambs, which you have set by themselves, mean?" (Genesis 21:29)

text: וְאֶת הַכִּבְשָׂה יְשַׁלֵּם אַרְבַּעְתָּיִם עֵקֶב אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה אֶת הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה וְעַל אֲשֶׁר לֹֽא חָמָֽל׃
translation: He must restore the lamb fourfold, because he did this thing and because he had no pity!" (2 Samuel 12:6)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר כִּי אֶת שֶׁבַע כְּבָשֹׂת תִּקַּח מִיָּדִי בַּעֲבוּר תִּֽהְיֶה לִּי לְעֵדָה כִּי חָפַרְתִּי אֶת הַבְּאֵר הַזֹּֽאת׃
translation: He said, "You shall take these seven ewe lambs from my hand, that it may be a witness to me, that I have dug this well." (Genesis 21:30)

text: וּבַיּוֹם הַשְּׁמִינִי יִקַּח שְׁנֵֽי כְבָשִׂים תְּמִימִים וְכַבְשָׂה אַחַת בַּת שְׁנָתָהּ תְּמִימָה וּשְׁלֹשָׁה עֶשְׂרֹנִים סֹלֶת מִנְחָה בְּלוּלָה בַשֶּׁמֶן וְלֹג אֶחָד שָֽׁמֶן׃
translation: "On the eighth day he shall take two male lambs without defect, one ewe lamb a year old without defect, three tenths of an ephah of fine flour for a meal offering, mixed with oil, and one log of oil. (Leviticus 14:10)

text: וְהִקְרִיב אֶת קָרְבָּנוֹ לַיהוָה כֶּבֶשׂ בֶּן שְׁנָתוֹ תָמִים אֶחָד לְעֹלָה וְכַבְשָׂה אַחַת בַּת שְׁנָתָהּ תְּמִימָה לְחַטָּאת וְאַֽיִל אֶחָד תָּמִים לִשְׁלָמִֽים׃
translation: and he shall offer his offering to the LORD: one male lamb a year old without defect for a burnt offering, one ewe lamb a year old without defect for a sin offering, one ram without defect for peace offerings, (Numbers 6:14)

text: בַּרְזֶל בְּבַרְזֶל יָחַד וְאִישׁ יַחַד פְּנֵֽי רֵעֵֽהוּ׃
translation: Iron sharpens iron; so a man sharpens his friend's countenance. (Proverbs 27:17)

text: חֲדַד וְתֵימָא יְטוּר נָפִישׁ וָקֵֽדְמָה׃
translation: Hadad, Tema, Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah. (Genesis 25:15)

text: מִשְׁמָע וְדוּמָה מַשָּׂא חֲדַד וְתֵימָֽא׃
translation: Mishma, Dumah, Massa, Hadad, Tema, (1 Chronicles 1:30)

text: בֶּן אָדָם הִנָּבֵא וְאָמַרְתָּ כֹּה אָמַר אֲדֹנָי אֱמֹר חֶרֶב חֶרֶב הוּחַדָּה וְגַם מְרוּטָֽה׃
translation: "You therefore, son of man, prophesy, and strike your hands together. Let the sword be doubled the third time, the sword of the fatally wounded. It is the sword of the great one who is fatally wounded, which enters into their rooms. (Ezekiel 21:14)

text: וַיִּתֵּן אֹתָהּ לְמָרְטָה לִתְפֹּשׂ בַּכָּף הִֽיא הוּחַדָּה חֶרֶב וְהִיא מֹרָטָּה לָתֵת אוֹתָהּ בְּיַד הוֹרֵֽג׃
translation: Gather yourselves together. Go to the right. Set yourselves in array. Go to the left, wherever your face is set. (Ezekiel 21:16)

text: לְמַעַן טְבֹחַ טֶבַח הוּחַדָּה לְמַעַן הֱיֵה לָהּ בָּרָק מֹרָטָּה אוֹ נָשִׂישׂ שֵׁבֶט בְּנִי מֹאֶסֶת כָּל עֵֽץ׃
translation: I have set the threatening sword against all their gates, that their heart may melt, and their stumblings be multiplied. Ah! It is made as lightning. It is pointed for slaughter. (Ezekiel 21:15)

text: וַיְהִי כִּרְאוֹתָם אוֹתוֹ וַיִּקְחוּ שְׁלֹשִׁים מֵֽרֵעִים וַיִּהְיוּ אִתּֽוֹ׃
translation: When they saw him, they brought thirty companions to be with him. (Judges 14:11)

text: וַאֲבִימֶלֶךְ הָלַךְ אֵלָיו מִגְּרָר וַאֲחֻזַּת מֵֽרֵעֵהוּ וּפִיכֹל שַׂר צְבָאֽוֹ׃
translation: Then Abimelech went to him from Gerar with Ahuzzath his friend, and Phicol the captain of his army. (Genesis 26:26)

text: וַתְּהִי אֵשֶׁת שִׁמְשׁוֹן לְמֵרֵעֵהוּ אֲשֶׁר רֵעָה לֽוֹ׃
translation: But Samson's wife was given to his companion, who had been his friend. (Judges 14:20)

text: כָּל אֲחֵי רָשׁ שְֽׂנֵאֻהוּ אַף כִּי מְרֵעֵהוּ רָחֲקוּ מִמֶּנּוּ מְרַדֵּף אֲמָרִים לא לוֹ הֵֽמָּה׃
translation: All the relatives of the poor shun him; how much more do his friends avoid him! He pursues them with pleas, but they are gone. (Proverbs 19:7)

text: וּשְׁנֵיהֶם הַמְּלָכִים לְבָבָם לְמֵרָע וְעַל שֻׁלְחָן אֶחָד כָּזָב יְדַבֵּרוּ וְלֹא תִצְלָח כִּי עוֹד קֵץ לַמּוֹעֵֽד׃
translation: As for both these kings, their hearts will be to do evil, and they will speak lies at one table; but it won't prosper, for the end will still be at the appointed time. (Daniel 11:27)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר אָבִיהָ אָמֹר אָמַרְתִּי כִּי שָׂנֹא שְׂנֵאתָהּ וָאֶתְּנֶנָּה לְמֵרֵעֶךָ הֲלֹא אֲחֹתָהּ הַקְּטַנָּה טוֹבָה מִמֶּנָּה תְּהִי נָא לְךָ תַּחְתֶּֽיהָ׃
translation: Her father said, "I most certainly thought that you utterly hated her; therefore I gave her to your companion. Isn't her younger sister more beautiful than she? Please, take her instead." (Judges 15:2)

text: וַיֵּלֶךְ וַיִּקַּח וַיָּבֵא לְאִמּוֹ וַתַּעַשׂ אִמּוֹ מַטְעַמִּים כַּאֲשֶׁר אָהֵב אָבִֽיו׃
translation: He went, and got them, and brought them to his mother. His mother made savory food, such as his father loved. (Genesis 27:14)

text: וַתִּתֵּן אֶת הַמַּטְעַמִּים וְאֶת הַלֶּחֶם אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂתָה בְּיַד יַעֲקֹב בְּנָֽהּ׃
translation: She gave the savory food and the bread, which she had prepared, into the hand of her son Jacob. (Genesis 27:17)

text: אַל תִּתְאָו לְמַטְעַמּוֹתָיו וְהוּא לֶחֶם כְּזָבִֽים׃
translation: Don't be desirous of his dainties, since they are deceitful food. (Proverbs 23:3)

text: אַל תִּלְחַם אֶת לֶחֶם רַע עָיִן וְאַל תתאו תִּתְאָיו לְמַטְעַמֹּתָֽיו׃
translation: Don't eat the food of him who has a stingy eye, and don't crave his delicacies, (Proverbs 23:6)

text: הָבִיאָה לִּי צַיִד וַעֲשֵׂה לִי מַטְעַמִּים וְאֹכֵלָה וַאֲבָרֶכְכָה לִפְנֵי יְהוָה לִפְנֵי מוֹתִֽי׃
translation: 'Bring me venison, and make me savory food, that I may eat, and bless you before the LORD before my death.' (Genesis 27:7)

text: וַעֲשֵׂה לִי מַטְעַמִּים כַּאֲשֶׁר אָהַבְתִּי וְהָבִיאָה לִּי וְאֹכֵלָה בַּעֲבוּר תְּבָרֶכְךָ נַפְשִׁי בְּטֶרֶם אָמֽוּת׃
translation: Make me savory food, such as I love, and bring it to me, that I may eat, and that my soul may bless you before I die." (Genesis 27:4)

text: וְעַל מַחֲלֹקֶת הַחֹדֶשׁ הַשֵּׁנִי דּוֹדַי הָאֲחוֹחִי וּמַחֲלֻקְתּוֹ וּמִקְלוֹת הַנָּגִיד וְעַל מַחֲלֻקְתּוֹ עֶשְׂרִים וְאַרְבָּעָה אָֽלֶף׃
translation: Over the division of the second month was Dodai the Ahohite and his division, and Mikloth the ruler; and in his division were twenty-four thousand. (1 Chronicles 27:4)

text: וַתֹּאמֶר לָהּ הַמְעַט קַחְתֵּךְ אֶת אִישִׁי וְלָקַחַת גַּם אֶת דּוּדָאֵי בְּנִי וַתֹּאמֶר רָחֵל לָכֵן יִשְׁכַּב עִמָּךְ הַלַּיְלָה תַּחַת דּוּדָאֵי בְנֵֽךְ׃
translation: Leah said to her, "Is it a small matter that you have taken away my husband? Would you take away my son's mandrakes, also?" Rachel said, "Therefore he will lie with you tonight for your son's mandrakes." (Genesis 30:15)

text: וַיָּבֹא יַעֲקֹב מִן הַשָּׂדֶה בָּעֶרֶב וַתֵּצֵא לֵאָה לִקְרָאתוֹ וַתֹּאמֶר אֵלַי תָּבוֹא כִּי שָׂכֹר שְׂכַרְתִּיךָ בְּדוּדָאֵי בְּנִי וַיִּשְׁכַּב עִמָּהּ בַּלַּיְלָה הֽוּא׃
translation: Jacob came from the field in the evening, and Leah went out to meet him, and said, "You must come in to me; for I have surely hired you with my son's mandrakes." He lay with her that night. (Genesis 30:16)

text: וַיִּוָּתֵר יַעֲקֹב לְבַדּוֹ וַיֵּאָבֵק אִישׁ עִמּוֹ עַד עֲלוֹת הַשָּֽׁחַר׃
translation: When he saw that he didn't prevail against him, the man touched the hollow of his thigh, and the hollow of Jacob's thigh was strained as he wrestled. (Genesis 32:25)

text: וְהָיָה כְּאָבָק דַּק הֲמוֹן זָרָיִךְ וּכְמֹץ עֹבֵר הֲמוֹן עָֽרִיצִים וְהָיָה לְפֶתַע פִּתְאֹֽם׃
translation: But the multitude of your foes will be like fine dust, and the multitude of the ruthless ones like chaff that blows away. Yes, it will be in an instant, suddenly. (Isaiah 29:5)

text: יִתֵּן יְהוָה אֶת מְטַר אַרְצְךָ אָבָק וְעָפָר מִן הַשָּׁמַיִם יֵרֵד עָלֶיךָ עַד הִשָּׁמְדָֽךְ׃
translation: The LORD will make the rain of your land powder and dust. It will come down on you from the sky, until you are destroyed. (Deuteronomy 28:24)

text: וַיַּרְא כִּי לֹא יָכֹל לוֹ וַיִּגַּע בְּכַף יְרֵכוֹ וַתֵּקַע כַּף יֶרֶךְ יַעֲקֹב בְּהֵֽאָבְקוֹ עִמּֽוֹ׃
translation: The man said, "Let me go, for the day breaks." Jacob said, "I won't let you go unless you bless me." (Genesis 32:26)

text: מִשִּׁפְעַת סוּסָיו יְכַסֵּךְ אֲבָקָם מִקּוֹל פָּרַשׁ וְגַלְגַּל וָרֶכֶב תִּרְעַשְׁנָה חֽוֹמוֹתַיִךְ בְּבֹאוֹ בִּשְׁעָרַיִךְ כִּמְבוֹאֵי עִיר מְבֻקָּעָֽה׃
translation: By reason of the abundance of his horses, their dust will cover you. Your walls will shake at the noise of the horsemen, of the wagons, and of the chariots, when he enters into your gates, as men enter into a city which is broken open. (Ezekiel 26:10)

text: יְהֹוָה אֶרֶךְ אַפַּיִם וגדול וּגְדָל כֹּחַ וְנַקֵּה לֹא יְנַקֶּה יְהוָה בְּסוּפָה וּבִשְׂעָרָה דַּרְכּוֹ וְעָנָן אֲבַק רַגְלָֽיו׃
translation: The LORD is slow to anger, and great in power, and will by no means leave the guilty unpunished. The LORD has his way in the whirlwind and in the storm, and the clouds are the dust of his feet. (Nahum 1:3)

text: הִוָּסְרִי יְרוּשָׁלִַם פֶּן תֵּקַע נַפְשִׁי מִמֵּךְ פֶּן אֲשִׂימֵךְ שְׁמָמָה אֶרֶץ לוֹא נוֹשָֽׁבָה׃
translation: Be instructed, Jerusalem, lest my soul be alienated from you, lest I make you a desolation, an uninhabited land." (Jeremiah 6:8)

text: וַיַּעַל מִשָּׁם אֶת עַצְמוֹת שָׁאוּל וְאֶת עַצְמוֹת יְהוֹנָתָן בְּנוֹ וַיַּאַסְפוּ אֶת עַצְמוֹת הַמּוּקָעִֽים׃
translation: and he brought up from there the bones of Saul and the bones of Jonathan his son. They also gathered the bones of those who were hanged. (2 Samuel 21:13)

text: וַתְּגַל תַּזְנוּתֶיהָ וַתְּגַל אֶת עֶרְוָתָהּ וַתֵּקַע נַפְשִׁי מֵֽעָלֶיהָ כַּאֲשֶׁר נָקְעָה נַפְשִׁי מֵעַל אֲחוֹתָֽהּ׃
translation: So she uncovered her prostitution and uncovered her nakedness. Then my soul was alienated from her, just like my soul was alienated from her sister. (Ezekiel 23:18)

text: וַיָּבֹאוּ אֵלֶיהָ בְנֵֽי בָבֶל לְמִשְׁכַּב דֹּדִים וַיְטַמְּאוּ אוֹתָהּ בְּתַזְנוּתָם וַתִּטְמָא בָם וַתֵּקַע נַפְשָׁהּ מֵהֶֽם׃
translation: The Babylonians came to her into the bed of love, and they defiled her with their prostitution. She was polluted with them, and her soul was alienated from them. (Ezekiel 23:17)

text: ינתן יֻתַּן לָנוּ שִׁבְעָה אֲנָשִׁים מִבָּנָיו וְהוֹקַֽעֲנוּם לַֽיהוָה בְּגִבְעַת שָׁאוּל בְּחִיר יְהוָה וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ אֲנִי אֶתֵּֽן׃
translation: let seven men of his sons be delivered to us, and we will hang them up to the LORD in Gibeah of Saul, the chosen of the LORD." The king said, "I will give them." (2 Samuel 21:6)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה קַח אֶת כָּל רָאשֵׁי הָעָם וְהוֹקַע אוֹתָם לַיהוָה נֶגֶד הַשָּׁמֶשׁ וְיָשֹׁב חֲרוֹן אַף יְהוָה מִיִּשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
translation: The LORD said to Moses, "Take all the chiefs of the people, and hang them up to the LORD before the sun, that the fierce anger of the LORD may turn away from Israel." (Numbers 25:4)

text: טוֹב אֲרֻחַת יָרָק וְאַהֲבָה שָׁם מִשּׁוֹר אָבוּס וְשִׂנְאָה בֽוֹ׃
translation: Better is a dinner of herbs, where love is, than a fattened calf with hatred. (Proverbs 15:17)

text: מַשָּׂא בַּעְרָב בַּיַּעַר בַּעְרַב תָּלִינוּ אֹֽרְחוֹת דְּדָנִֽים׃
translation: The burden on Arabia. You will lodge in the thickets in Arabia, you caravans of Dedanites. (Isaiah 21:13)

text: וַאֲרֻחָתוֹ אֲרֻחַת תָּמִיד נִתְּנָה לּוֹ מֵאֵת הַמֶּלֶךְ דְּבַר יוֹם בְּיוֹמוֹ כֹּל יְמֵי חַיָּֽו׃
translation: and for his allowance, there was a continual allowance given him from the king, every day a portion, all the days of his life. (2 Kings 25:30)

text: וַאֲרֻחָתוֹ אֲרֻחַת תָּמִיד נִתְּנָה לּוֹ מֵאֵת מֶֽלֶךְ בָּבֶל דְּבַר יוֹם בְּיוֹמוֹ עַד יוֹם מוֹתוֹ כֹּל יְמֵי חַיָּֽיו׃
translation: For his allowance, there was a continual allowance given him by the king of Babylon, every day a portion until the day of his death, all the days of his life. (Jeremiah 52:34)

text: וַיֵּשְׁבוּ לֶֽאֱכָל לֶחֶם וַיִּשְׂאוּ עֵֽינֵיהֶם וַיִּרְאוּ וְהִנֵּה אֹרְחַת יִשְׁמְעֵאלִים בָּאָה מִגִּלְעָד וּגְמַלֵּיהֶם נֹֽשְׂאִים נְכֹאת וּצְרִי וָלֹט הוֹלְכִים לְהוֹרִיד מִצְרָֽיְמָה׃
translation: They sat down to eat bread, and they lifted up their eyes and looked, and saw a caravan of Ishmaelites coming from Gilead, with their camels bearing spices and balm and myrrh, going to carry it down to Egypt. (Genesis 37:25)

text: וַאֲבִיגַיִל יָלְדָה אֶת עֲמָשָׂא וַאֲבִי עֲמָשָׂא יֶתֶר הַיִּשְׁמְעֵאלִֽי׃
translation: Abigail bore Amasa; and the father of Amasa was Jether the Ishmaelite. (1 Chronicles 2:17)

text: וְעַל הַגְּמַלִּים אוֹבִיל הַיִּשְׁמְעֵלִי וְעַל הָאֲתֹנוֹת יֶחְדְּיָהוּ הַמֵּרֹנֹתִֽי׃
translation: Over the camels was Obil the Ishmaelite. Over the donkeys was Jehdeiah the Meronothite. Over the flocks was Jaziz the Hagrite. (1 Chronicles 27:30)

text: אָהֳלֵי אֱדוֹם וְיִשְׁמְעֵאלִים מוֹאָב וְהַגְרִֽים׃
translation: Gebal, Ammon, and Amalek; Philistia with the inhabitants of Tyre; (Psalms 83:7)

text: לְכוּ וְנִמְכְּרֶנּוּ לַיִּשְׁמְעֵאלִים וְיָדֵנוּ אַל תְּהִי בוֹ כִּֽי אָחִינוּ בְשָׂרֵנוּ הוּא וַֽיִּשְׁמְעוּ אֶחָֽיו׃
translation: Come, and let's sell him to the Ishmaelites, and not let our hand be on him; for he is our brother, our flesh." His brothers listened to him. (Genesis 37:27)

text: וְיוֹסֵף הוּרַד מִצְרָיְמָה וַיִּקְנֵהוּ פּוֹטִיפַר סְרִיס פַּרְעֹה שַׂר הַטַּבָּחִים אִישׁ מִצְרִי מִיַּד הַיִּשְׁמְעֵאלִים אֲשֶׁר הוֹרִדֻהוּ שָֽׁמָּה׃
translation: Joseph was brought down to Egypt. Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh's, the captain of the guard, an Egyptian, bought him from the hand of the Ishmaelites that had brought him down there. (Genesis 39:1)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם גִּדְעוֹן אֶשְׁאֲלָה מִכֶּם שְׁאֵלָה וּתְנוּ לִי אִישׁ נֶזֶם שְׁלָלוֹ כִּֽי נִזְמֵי זָהָב לָהֶם כִּי יִשְׁמְעֵאלִים הֵֽם׃
translation: Gideon said to them, "I do have a request: that you would each give me the earrings of his plunder." (For they had golden earrings, because they were Ishmaelites.) (Judges 8:24)

text: וַיַּֽעֲשׂוּ כֵן הַֽחֲרְטֻמִּים בְּלָטֵיהֶם וַיַּעֲלוּ אֶת הַֽצְפַרְדְּעִים עַל אֶרֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
translation: The river will swarm with frogs, which will go up and come into your house, and into your bedroom, and on your bed, and into the house of your servants, and on your people, and into your ovens, and into your kneading troughs. (Exodus 8:3)

text: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ כֵן הַחַרְטֻמִּים בְּלָטֵיהֶם לְהוֹצִיא אֶת הַכִּנִּים וְלֹא יָכֹלוּ וַתְּהִי הַכִּנָּם בָּאָדָם וּבַבְּהֵמָֽה׃
translation: They gathered them together in heaps, and the land stank. (Exodus 8:14)

text: וַיַּֽעֲשׂוּ כֵן חַרְטֻמֵּי מִצְרַיִם בְּלָטֵיהֶם וַיֶּחֱזַק לֵב פַּרְעֹה וְלֹא שָׁמַע אֲלֵהֶם כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהוָֽה׃
translation: The magicians of Egypt did the same thing with their enchantments. So Pharaoh's heart was hardened, and he didn't listen to them, as the LORD had spoken. (Exodus 7:22)

text: וַיֹּאכַל בֹּעַז וַיֵּשְׁתְּ וַיִּיטַב לִבּוֹ וַיָּבֹא לִשְׁכַּב בִּקְצֵה הָעֲרֵמָה וַתָּבֹא בַלָּט וַתְּגַל מַרְגְּלֹתָיו וַתִּשְׁכָּֽב׃
translation: When Boaz had eaten and drunk, and his heart was merry, he went to lie down at the end of the heap of grain. She came softly, uncovered his feet, and lay down. (Ruth 3:7)

text: וַיְצַו שָׁאוּל אֶת עֲבָדָו דַּבְּרוּ אֶל דָּוִד בַּלָּט לֵאמֹר הִנֵּה חָפֵץ בְּךָ הַמֶּלֶךְ וְכָל עֲבָדָיו אֲהֵבוּךָ וְעַתָּה הִתְחַתֵּן בַּמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
translation: Saul commanded his servants, "Talk with David secretly, and say, 'Behold, the king has delight in you, and all his servants love you. Now therefore be the king's son-in-law.'" (1 Samuel 18:22)

text: וַיִּצְבְּרוּ אֹתָם חֳמָרִם חֳמָרִם וַתִּבְאַשׁ הָאָֽרֶץ׃
translation: Pharaoh said, "Tomorrow." Moses said, "Let it be according to your word, that you may know that there is no one like the LORD our God. (Exodus 8:10)

text: וַתִּבֶן צֹר מָצוֹר לָהּ וַתִּצְבָּר כֶּסֶף כֶּֽעָפָר וְחָרוּץ כְּטִיט חוּצֽוֹת׃
translation: Tyre built herself a stronghold, and heaped up silver like the dust, and fine gold like the mire of the streets. (Zechariah 9:3)

text: אַךְ בְּצֶלֶם יִֽתְהַלֶּךְ אִישׁ אַךְ הֶבֶל יֶהֱמָיוּן יִצְבֹּר וְֽלֹא יֵדַע מִי אֹסְפָֽם׃
translation: Now, Lord, what do I wait for? My hope is in you. (Psalms 39:7)

text: וַיִּצְבֹּר יוֹסֵף בָּר כְּחוֹל הַיָּם הַרְבֵּה מְאֹד עַד כִּי חָדַל לִסְפֹּר כִּי אֵין מִסְפָּֽר׃
translation: Joseph laid up grain as the sand of the sea, very much, until he stopped counting, for it was without number. (Genesis 41:49)

text: וְיִקְבְּצוּ אֶת כָּל אֹכֶל הַשָּׁנִים הַטֹּבֹת הַבָּאֹת הָאֵלֶּה וְיִצְבְּרוּ בָר תַּחַת יַד פַּרְעֹה אֹכֶל בֶּעָרִים וְשָׁמָֽרוּ׃
translation: Let them gather all the food of these good years that come, and store grain under the hand of Pharaoh for food in the cities, and let them keep it. (Genesis 41:35)

text: וַיָּבֹא הַמַּלְאָךְ וַיַּגֶּד לוֹ לֵאמֹר הֵבִיאוּ רָאשֵׁי בְנֵֽי הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיֹּאמֶר שִׂימוּ אֹתָם שְׁנֵי צִבֻּרִים פֶּתַח הַשַּׁעַר עַד הַבֹּֽקֶר׃
translation: A messenger came and told him, "They have brought the heads of the king's sons." He said, "Lay them in two heaps at the entrance of the gate until the morning." (2 Kings 10:8)

text: וַיְהִי בַדֶּרֶךְ בַּמָּלוֹן וַיִּפְגְּשֵׁהוּ יְהוָה וַיְבַקֵּשׁ הֲמִיתֽוֹ׃
translation: On the way at a lodging place, the LORD met Moses and wanted to kill him. (Exodus 4:24)

text: עָֽבְרוּ מַעְבָּרָה גֶּבַע מָלוֹן לָנוּ חָֽרְדָה הָֽרָמָה גִּבְעַת שָׁאוּל נָֽסָה׃
translation: They have gone over the pass. They have taken up their lodging at Geba. Ramah trembles. Gibeah of Saul has fled. (Isaiah 10:29)

text: וַיִּפְתַּח הָאֶחָד אֶת שַׂקּוֹ לָתֵת מִסְפּוֹא לַחֲמֹרוֹ בַּמָּלוֹן וַיַּרְא אֶת כַּסְפּוֹ וְהִנֵּה הוּא בְּפִי אַמְתַּחְתּֽוֹ׃
translation: As one of them opened his sack to give his donkey food in the lodging place, he saw his money. Behold, it was in the mouth of his sack. (Genesis 42:27)

text: מִֽי יִתְּנֵנִי בַמִּדְבָּר מְלוֹן אֹֽרְחִים וְאֶֽעֶזְבָה אֶת עַמִּי וְאֵלְכָה מֵֽאִתָּם כִּי כֻלָּם מְנָאֲפִים עֲצֶרֶת בֹּגְדִֽים׃
translation: Oh that my head were waters, and my eyes a spring of tears, that I might weep day and night for the slain of the daughter of my people! (Jeremiah 9:1)

text: וַֽיְהִי כִּי בָאנוּ אֶל הַמָּלוֹן וַֽנִּפְתְּחָה אֶת אַמְתְּחֹתֵינוּ וְהִנֵּה כֶֽסֶף אִישׁ בְּפִי אַמְתַּחְתּוֹ כַּסְפֵּנוּ בְּמִשְׁקָלוֹ וַנָּשֶׁב אֹתוֹ בְּיָדֵֽנוּ׃
translation: When we came to the lodging place, we opened our sacks, and behold, each man's money was in the mouth of his sack, our money in full weight. We have brought it back in our hand. (Genesis 43:21)

text: וְרָאָה הַכֹּהֵן וְהִנֵּה שְׂאֵת לְבָנָה בָּעוֹר וְהִיא הָפְכָה שֵׂעָר לָבָן וּמִֽחְיַת בָּשָׂר חַי בַּשְׂאֵֽת׃
translation: and the priest shall examine him. Behold, if there is a white swelling in the skin, and it has turned the hair white, and there is raw flesh in the swelling, (Leviticus 13:10)

text: וְעַתָּה אַל תֵּעָצְבוּ וְאַל יִחַר בְּעֵינֵיכֶם כִּֽי מְכַרְתֶּם אֹתִי הֵנָּה כִּי לְמִֽחְיָה שְׁלָחַנִי אֱלֹהִים לִפְנֵיכֶֽם׃
translation: Now don't be grieved, nor angry with yourselves, that you sold me here, for God sent me before you to preserve life. (Genesis 45:5)

text: אוֹ בָשָׂר כִּֽי יִהְיֶה בְעֹרוֹ מִכְוַת אֵשׁ וְֽהָיְתָה מִֽחְיַת הַמִּכְוָה בַּהֶרֶת לְבָנָה אֲדַמְדֶּמֶת אוֹ לְבָנָֽה׃
translation: "Or when the body has a burn from fire on its skin, and the raw flesh of the burn becomes a bright spot, reddish-white, or white, (Leviticus 13:24)

text: וַיַּחֲנוּ עֲלֵיהֶם וַיַּשְׁחִיתוּ אֶת יְבוּל הָאָרֶץ עַד בּוֹאֲךָ עַזָּה וְלֹֽא יַשְׁאִירוּ מִֽחְיָה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וְשֶׂה וָשׁוֹר וַחֲמֽוֹר׃
translation: They encamped against them, and destroyed the increase of the earth, until you come to Gaza. They left no sustenance in Israel, and no sheep, ox, or donkey. (Judges 6:4)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ מִיכָה שְׁבָה עִמָּדִי וֶֽהְיֵה לִי לְאָב וּלְכֹהֵן וְאָנֹכִי אֶֽתֶּן לְךָ עֲשֶׂרֶת כֶּסֶף לַיָּמִים וְעֵרֶךְ בְּגָדִים וּמִחְיָתֶךָ וַיֵּלֶךְ הַלֵּוִֽי׃
translation: Micah said to him, "Dwell with me, and be to me a father and a priest, and I will give you ten pieces of silver per year, a suit of clothing, and your food." So the Levite went in. (Judges 17:10)

text: הֲיָדַעְתָּ עֵת לֶדֶת יַעֲלֵי סָלַע חֹלֵל אַיָּלוֹת תִּשְׁמֹֽר׃
translation: "Do you know the time when the mountain goats give birth? Do you watch when the doe bears fawns? (Job 39:1)

text: מְשַׁוֶּה רגליו רַגְלַי כָּאַיָּלוֹת וְעַל בָּמוֹתַי יַעֲמִדֵֽנִי׃
translation: He makes his feet like hinds' feet, and sets me on my high places. (2 Samuel 22:34)

text: מְשַׁוֶּה רַגְלַי כָּאַיָּלוֹת וְעַל בָּמֹתַי יַעֲמִידֵֽנִי׃
translation: He teaches my hands to war, so that my arms bend a bow of bronze. (Psalms 18:34)

text: קוֹל יְהוָה יְחוֹלֵל אַיָּלוֹת וַֽיֶּחֱשֹׂף יְעָרוֹת וּבְהֵיכָלוֹ כֻּלּוֹ אֹמֵר כָּבֽוֹד׃
translation: The LORD's voice makes the deer calve, and strips the forests bare. In his temple everything says, "Glory!" (Psalms 29:9)

text: יְהוִהּ אֲדֹנָי חֵילִי וַיָּשֶׂם רַגְלַי כָּֽאַיָּלוֹת וְעַל בָּמוֹתַי יַדְרִכֵנִי לַמְנַצֵּחַ בִּנְגִינוֹתָֽי׃
translation: GOD, the Lord, is my strength. He makes my feet like deer's feet, and enables me to go in high places. For the music director, on my stringed instruments. (Habakkuk 3:19)

text: הִשְׁבַּעְתִּי אֶתְכֶם בְּנוֹת יְרוּשָׁלִַם בִּצְבָאוֹת אוֹ בְּאַיְלוֹת הַשָּׂדֶה אִם תָּעִירוּ וְֽאִם תְּעֽוֹרְרוּ אֶת הָאַהֲבָה עַד שֶׁתֶּחְפָּֽץ׃
translation: I adjure you, daughters of Jerusalem, by the roes, or by the hinds of the field, that you not stir up, nor awaken love, until it so desires. (Song of Solomon 2:7)

text: כָּֽל דֶּרֶךְ אִישׁ יָשָׁר בְּעֵינָיו וְתֹכֵן לִבּוֹת יְהוָֽה׃
translation: Every way of a man is right in his own eyes, but the LORD weighs the hearts. (Proverbs 21:2)

text: שְׁאוֹל וַאֲבַדּוֹן נֶגֶד יְהוָה אַף כִּֽי לִבּוֹת בְּֽנֵי אָדָֽם׃
translation: Sheol and Abaddon are before the LORD— how much more then the hearts of the children of men! (Proverbs 15:11)

text: יִגְמָר נָא רַע רְשָׁעִים וּתְכוֹנֵן צַדִּיק וּבֹחֵן לִבּוֹת וּכְלָיוֹת אֱלֹהִים צַדִּֽיק׃
translation: My shield is with God, who saves the upright in heart. (Psalms 7:10)

text: הֵיטִיבָה יְהוָה לַטּוֹבִים וְלִֽישָׁרִים בְּלִבּוֹתָֽם׃
translation: Do good, LORD, to those who are good, to those who are upright in their hearts. (Psalms 125:4)

text: מָה אֲמֻלָה לִבָּתֵךְ נְאֻם אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה בַּעֲשׂוֹתֵךְ אֶת כָּל אֵלֶּה מַעֲשֵׂה אִשָּֽׁה זוֹנָה שַׁלָּֽטֶת׃
translation: "'"How weak is your heart," says the Lord GOD, "since you do all these things, the work of an impudent prostitute; (Ezekiel 16:30)

text: כִּֽי תֹאמַר הֵן לֹא יָדַעְנוּ זֶה הֲֽלֹא תֹכֵן לִבּוֹת הֽוּא יָבִין וְנֹצֵר נַפְשְׁךָ הוּא יֵדָע וְהֵשִׁיב לְאָדָם כְּפָעֳלֽוֹ׃
translation: If you say, "Behold, we didn't know this," doesn't he who weighs the hearts consider it? He who keeps your soul, doesn't he know it? Shall he not give to every man according to his work? (Proverbs 24:12)

text: וְדַנָּה וְקִרְיַת סַנָּה הִיא דְבִֽר׃
translation: Dannah, Kiriath Sannah (which is Debir), (Joshua 15:49)

text: וּמִמֶּגֶד אֶרֶץ וּמְלֹאָהּ וּרְצוֹן שֹׁכְנִי סְנֶה תָּבוֹאתָה לְרֹאשׁ יוֹסֵף וּלְקָדְקֹד נְזִיר אֶחָֽיו׃
translation: for the precious things of the earth and its fullness, the good will of him who lived in the bush. Let this come on the head of Joseph, on the crown of the head of him who was separated from his brothers. (Deuteronomy 33:16)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה אָסֻֽרָה נָּא וְאֶרְאֶה אֶת הַמַּרְאֶה הַגָּדֹל הַזֶּה מַדּוּעַ לֹא יִבְעַר הַסְּנֶֽה׃
translation: Moses said, "I will go now, and see this great sight, why the bush is not burned." (Exodus 3:3)

text: וַיַּרְא יְהוָה כִּי סָר לִרְאוֹת וַיִּקְרָא אֵלָיו אֱלֹהִים מִתּוֹךְ הַסְּנֶה וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה מֹשֶׁה וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֵּֽנִי׃
translation: When the LORD saw that he came over to see, God called to him out of the middle of the bush, and said, "Moses! Moses!" He said, "Here I am." (Exodus 3:4)

text: וַיֵּרָא מַלְאַךְ יְהֹוָה אֵלָיו בְּלַבַּת אֵשׁ מִתּוֹךְ הַסְּנֶה וַיַּרְא וְהִנֵּה הַסְּנֶה בֹּעֵר בָּאֵשׁ וְהַסְּנֶה אֵינֶנּוּ אֻכָּֽל׃
translation: The LORD's angel appeared to him in a flame of fire out of the middle of a bush. He looked, and behold, the bush burned with fire, and the bush was not consumed. (Exodus 3:2)

text: וַיָּפֶץ הָעָם בְּכָל אֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם לְקֹשֵׁשׁ קַשׁ לַתֶּֽבֶן׃
translation: So the people were scattered abroad throughout all the land of Egypt to gather stubble for straw. (Exodus 5:12)

text: וַיִּהְיוּ בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵל בַּמִּדְבָּר וַֽיִּמְצְאוּ אִישׁ מְקֹשֵׁשׁ עֵצִים בְּיוֹם הַשַּׁבָּֽת׃
translation: While the children of Israel were in the wilderness, they found a man gathering sticks on the Sabbath day. (Numbers 15:32)

text: הִֽתְקוֹשְׁשׁוּ וָקוֹשּׁוּ הַגּוֹי לֹא נִכְסָֽף׃
translation: Gather yourselves together, yes, gather together, you nation that has no shame, (Zephaniah 2:1)

text: וַיַּקְרִיבוּ אֹתוֹ הַמֹּצְאִים אֹתוֹ מְקֹשֵׁשׁ עֵצִים אֶל מֹשֶׁה וְאֶֽל אַהֲרֹן וְאֶל כָּל הָעֵדָֽה׃
translation: Those who found him gathering sticks brought him to Moses and Aaron, and to all the congregation. (Numbers 15:33)

text: לֹא תֹאסִפוּן לָתֵת תֶּבֶן לָעָם לִלְבֹּן הַלְּבֵנִים כִּתְמוֹל שִׁלְשֹׁם הֵם יֵֽלְכוּ וְקֹשְׁשׁוּ לָהֶם תֶּֽבֶן׃
translation: "You shall no longer give the people straw to make brick, as before. Let them go and gather straw for themselves. (Exodus 5:7)

text: וּבְנֵי קֹרַח אַסִּיר וְאֶלְקָנָה וַאֲבִיאָסָף אֵלֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹת הַקָּרְחִֽי׃
translation: The sons of Korah: Assir, Elkanah, and Abiasaph; these are the families of the Korahites. (Exodus 6:24)

text: לְמַחְלְקוֹת לְשֹׁעֲרִים לַקָּרְחִים מְשֶֽׁלֶמְיָהוּ בֶן קֹרֵא מִן בְּנֵי אָסָֽף׃
translation: For the divisions of the doorkeepers: of the Korahites, Meshelemiah the son of Kore, of the sons of Asaph. (1 Chronicles 26:1)

text: אֵלֶּה מַחְלְקוֹת הַשֹּׁעֲרִים לִבְנֵי הַקָּרְחִי וְלִבְנֵי מְרָרִֽי׃
translation: These were the divisions of the doorkeepers; of the sons of the Korahites, and of the sons of Merari. (1 Chronicles 26:19)

text: אֶלְקָנָה וְיִשִּׁיָּהוּ וַעֲזַרְאֵל וְיוֹעֶזֶר וְיָשָׁבְעָם הַקָּרְחִֽים׃
translation: and Joelah and Zebadiah, the sons of Jeroham of Gedor. (1 Chronicles 12:7)

text: וּמַתִּתְיָה מִן הַלְוִיִּם הוּא הַבְּכוֹר לְשַׁלֻּם הַקָּרְחִי בֶּאֱמוּנָה עַל מַעֲשֵׂה הַחֲבִתִּֽים׃
translation: Mattithiah, one of the Levites, who was the firstborn of Shallum the Korahite, had the office of trust over the things that were baked in pans. (1 Chronicles 9:31)

text: וַיָּקֻמוּ הַלְוִיִּם מִן בְּנֵי הַקְּהָתִים וּמִן בְּנֵי הַקָּרְחִים לְהַלֵּל לַיהוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּקוֹל גָּדוֹל לְמָֽעְלָה׃
translation: The Levites, of the children of the Kohathites and of the children of the Korahites, stood up to praise the LORD, the God of Israel, with an exceedingly loud voice. (2 Chronicles 20:19)

text: כִּֽי יַעֲקֹב בָּחַר לוֹ יָהּ יִשְׂרָאֵל לִסְגֻלָּתֽוֹ׃
translation: For the LORD has chosen Jacob for himself, Israel for his own possession. (Psalms 135:4)

text: וַֽיהוָה הֶאֱמִֽירְךָ הַיּוֹם לִהְיוֹת לוֹ לְעַם סְגֻלָּה כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר לָךְ וְלִשְׁמֹר כָּל מִצְוֺתָֽיו׃
translation: The LORD has declared today that you are a people for his own possession, as he has promised you, and that you should keep all his commandments. (Deuteronomy 26:18)

text: וְעַתָּה אִם שָׁמוֹעַ תִּשְׁמְעוּ בְּקֹלִי וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם אֶת בְּרִיתִי וִהְיִיתֶם לִי סְגֻלָּה מִכָּל הָעַמִּים כִּי לִי כָּל הָאָֽרֶץ׃
translation: Now therefore, if you will indeed obey my voice and keep my covenant, then you shall be my own possession from among all peoples; for all the earth is mine; (Exodus 19:5)

text: וְעוֹד בִּרְצוֹתִי בְּבֵית אֱלֹהַי יֶשׁ לִי סְגֻלָּה זָהָב וָכָסֶף נָתַתִּי לְבֵית אֱלֹהַי לְמַעְלָה מִכָּל הֲכִינוֹתִי לְבֵית הַקֹּֽדֶשׁ׃
translation: In addition, because I have set my affection on the house of my God, since I have a treasure of my own of gold and silver, I give it to the house of my God, over and above all that I have prepared for the holy house: (1 Chronicles 29:3)

text: כִּי עַם קָדוֹשׁ אַתָּה לַיהוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ וּבְךָ בָּחַר יְהוָה לִֽהְיוֹת לוֹ לְעַם סְגֻלָּה מִכֹּל הָֽעַמִּים אֲשֶׁר עַל פְּנֵי הָאֲדָמָֽה׃
translation: For you are a holy people to the LORD your God, and the LORD has chosen you to be a people for his own possession, above all peoples who are on the face of the earth. (Deuteronomy 14:2)

text: וְהָיוּ לִי אָמַר יְהוָה צְבָאוֹת לַיּוֹם אֲשֶׁר אֲנִי עֹשֶׂה סְגֻלָּה וְחָמַלְתִּי עֲלֵיהֶם כַּֽאֲשֶׁר יַחְמֹל אִישׁ עַל בְּנוֹ הָעֹבֵד אֹתֽוֹ׃
translation: They shall be mine," says the LORD of Armies, "my own possession in the day that I make. I will spare them, as a man spares his own son who serves him. (Malachi 3:17)

text: וַֽיַּעֲשׂוּ שְׁתֵּי טַבְּעֹת זָהָב וַֽיִּתְּנֻם עַל שְׁתֵּי כִתְפֹת הָאֵפֹד מִלְמַטָּה מִמּוּל פָּנָיו לְעֻמַּת מֶחְבַּרְתּוֹ מִמַּעַל לְחֵשֶׁב הָאֵפֹֽד׃
translation: They made two more rings of gold, and put them on the two shoulder straps of the ephod underneath, in its front, close by its coupling, above the skillfully woven band of the ephod. (Exodus 39:20)

text: וְעָשִׂיתָ שְׁתֵּי טַבְּעוֹת זָהָב וְנָתַתָּה אֹתָם עַל שְׁתֵּי כִתְפוֹת הָאֵפוֹד מִלְּמַטָּה מִמּוּל פָּנָיו לְעֻמַּת מֶחְבַּרְתּוֹ מִמַּעַל לְחֵשֶׁב הָאֵפֽוֹד׃
translation: You shall make two rings of gold, and shall put them on the two shoulder straps of the ephod underneath, in its forepart, close by its coupling, above the skillfully woven band of the ephod. (Exodus 28:27)

text: חֲמִשִּׁים לֻלָאֹת עָשָׂה בַּיְרִיעָה הָאֶחָת וַחֲמִשִּׁים לֻלָאֹת עָשָׂה בִּקְצֵה הַיְרִיעָה אֲשֶׁר בַּמַּחְבֶּרֶת הַשֵּׁנִית מַקְבִּילֹת הַלֻּלָאֹת אַחַת אֶל אֶחָֽת׃
translation: He made fifty loops in the one curtain, and he made fifty loops in the edge of the curtain that was in the second coupling. The loops were opposite to one another. (Exodus 36:12)

text: מִֽי גִלָּה פְּנֵי לְבוּשׁוֹ בְּכֶפֶל רִסְנוֹ מִי יָבֽוֹא׃
translation: Will you play with him as with a bird? Or will you bind him for your girls? (Job 41:5)

text: וְיַגֶּד לְךָ תַּֽעֲלֻמוֹת חָכְמָה כִּֽי כִפְלַיִם לְֽתוּשִׁיָּה וְדַע כִּֽי יַשֶּׁה לְךָ אֱלוֹהַ מֵעֲוֺנֶֽךָ׃
translation: that he would show you the secrets of wisdom! For true wisdom has two sides. Know therefore that God exacts of you less than your iniquity deserves. (Job 11:6)

text: וְחִבַּרְתָּ אֶת חֲמֵשׁ הַיְרִיעֹת לְבָד וְאֶת שֵׁשׁ הַיְרִיעֹת לְבָד וְכָפַלְתָּ אֶת הַיְרִיעָה הַשִּׁשִּׁית אֶל מוּל פְּנֵי הָאֹֽהֶל׃
translation: You shall couple five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves, and shall double over the sixth curtain in the forefront of the tent. (Exodus 26:9)

text: דַּבְּרוּ עַל לֵב יְרֽוּשָׁלִַם וְקִרְאוּ אֵלֶיהָ כִּי מָֽלְאָה צְבָאָהּ כִּי נִרְצָה עֲוֺנָהּ כִּי לָקְחָה מִיַּד יְהוָה כִּפְלַיִם בְּכָל חַטֹּאתֶֽיהָ׃
translation: "Speak comfortably to Jerusalem, and call out to her that her warfare is accomplished, that her iniquity is pardoned, that she has received of the LORD's hand double for all her sins." (Isaiah 40:2)

text: וְאַתָּה בֶן אָדָם הִנָּבֵא וְהַךְ כַּף אֶל כָּף וְתִכָּפֵל חֶרֶב שְׁלִישִׁתָה חֶרֶב חֲלָלִים הִיא חֶרֶב חָלָל הַגָּדוֹל הַחֹדֶרֶת לָהֶֽם׃
translation: "Also, you son of man, appoint two ways, that the sword of the king of Babylon may come. They both will come out of one land, and mark out a place. Mark it out at the head of the way to the city. (Ezekiel 21:19)

text: וּלְלֶחֶם הַֽמַּעֲרֶכֶת וּלְסֹלֶת לְמִנְחָה וְלִרְקִיקֵי הַמַּצּוֹת וְלַֽמַּחֲבַת וְלַמֻּרְבָּכֶת וּלְכָל מְשׂוּרָה וּמִדָּֽה׃
translation: for the show bread also, and for the fine flour for a meal offering, whether of unleavened wafers, or of that which is baked in the pan, or of that which is soaked, and for all measurements of quantity and size; (1 Chronicles 23:29)

text: וְסַל מַצּוֹת סֹלֶת חַלֹּת בְּלוּלֹת בַּשֶּׁמֶן וּרְקִיקֵי מַצּוֹת מְשֻׁחִים בַּשָּׁמֶן וּמִנְחָתָם וְנִסְכֵּיהֶֽם׃
translation: a basket of unleavened bread, cakes of fine flour mixed with oil, and unleavened wafers anointed with oil with their meal offering and their drink offerings. (Numbers 6:15)

text: וְלֶחֶם מַצּוֹת וְחַלֹּת מַצֹּת בְּלוּלֹת בַּשֶּׁמֶן וּרְקִיקֵי מַצּוֹת מְשֻׁחִים בַּשָּׁמֶן סֹלֶת חִטִּים תַּעֲשֶׂה אֹתָֽם׃
translation: unleavened bread, unleavened cakes mixed with oil, and unleavened wafers anointed with oil. You shall make them of fine wheat flour. (Exodus 29:2)

text: וְכִכַּר לֶחֶם אַחַת וַֽחַלַּת לֶחֶם שֶׁמֶן אַחַת וְרָקִיק אֶחָד מִסַּל הַמַּצּוֹת אֲשֶׁר לִפְנֵי יְהוָֽה׃
translation: and one loaf of bread, one cake of oiled bread, and one wafer out of the basket of unleavened bread that is before the LORD. (Exodus 29:23)

text: וְכִי תַקְרִב קָרְבַּן מִנְחָה מַאֲפֵה תַנּוּר סֹלֶת חַלּוֹת מַצֹּת בְּלוּלֹת בַּשֶּׁמֶן וּרְקִיקֵי מַצּוֹת מְשֻׁחִים בַּשָּֽׁמֶן׃
translation: "'When you offer an offering of a meal offering baked in the oven, it shall be unleavened cakes of fine flour mixed with oil, or unleavened wafers anointed with oil. (Leviticus 2:4)

text: וַיִּשְׁחָט וַיִּקַּח מֹשֶׁה מִדָּמוֹ וַיִּתֵּן עַל תְּנוּךְ אֹֽזֶן אַהֲרֹן הַיְמָנִית וְעַל בֹּהֶן יָדוֹ הַיְמָנִית וְעַל בֹּהֶן רַגְלוֹ הַיְמָנִֽית׃
translation: He killed it; and Moses took some of its blood, and put it on the tip of Aaron's right ear, and on the thumb of his right hand, and on the great toe of his right foot. (Leviticus 8:23)

text: וְלָקַח הַכֹּהֵן מִדַּם הָאָשָׁם וְנָתַן הַכֹּהֵן עַל תְּנוּךְ אֹזֶן הַמִּטַּהֵר הַיְמָנִית וְעַל בֹּהֶן יָדוֹ הַיְמָנִית וְעַל בֹּהֶן רַגְלוֹ הַיְמָנִֽית׃
translation: The priest shall take some of the blood of the trespass offering, and the priest shall put it on the tip of the right ear of him who is to be cleansed, and on the thumb of his right hand, and on the big toe of his right foot. (Leviticus 14:14)

text: תִּטְחַן לְאַחֵר אִשְׁתִּי וְעָלֶיהָ יִכְרְעוּן אֲחֵרִֽין׃
translation: then let my wife grind for another, and let others sleep with her. (Job 31:10)

text: מלכם מַה לָּכֶם תְּדַכְּאוּ עַמִּי וּפְנֵי עֲנִיִּים תִּטְחָנוּ נְאֻם אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה צְבָאֽוֹת׃
translation: What do you mean that you crush my people, and grind the face of the poor?" says the Lord, GOD of Armies. (Isaiah 3:15)

text: קְחִי רֵחַיִם וְטַחֲנִי קָמַח גַּלִּי צַמָּתֵךְ חֶשְׂפִּי שֹׁבֶל גַּלִּי שׁוֹק עִבְרִי נְהָרֽוֹת׃
translation: Take the millstones and grind flour. Remove your veil, lift up your skirt, uncover your legs, and wade through the rivers. (Isaiah 47:2)

text: וַיִּקַּח אֶת הָעֵגֶל אֲשֶׁר עָשׂוּ וַיִּשְׂרֹף בָּאֵשׁ וַיִּטְחַן עַד אֲשֶׁר דָּק וַיִּזֶר עַל פְּנֵי הַמַּיִם וַיַּשְׁקְ אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
translation: He took the calf which they had made, and burned it with fire, ground it to powder, and scattered it on the water, and made the children of Israel drink it. (Exodus 32:20)

text: וַיִּשְׁמְעוּ אֵלָיו גּוֹיִם בְּשַׁחְתָּם נִתְפָּשׂ וַיְבִאֻהוּ בַֽחַחִים אֶל אֶרֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
translation: The nations also heard of him. He was taken in their pit; and they brought him with hooks to the land of Egypt. (Ezekiel 19:4)

text: יַעַן הִתְרַגֶּזְךָ אֵלַי וְשַׁאֲנַנְךָ עָלָה בְאָזְנָי וְשַׂמְתִּי חַחִי בְּאַפֶּךָ וּמִתְגִּי בִּשְׂפָתֶיךָ וַהֲשִׁבֹתִיךָ בַּדֶּרֶךְ אֲשֶׁר בָּאתָ בָּֽהּ׃
translation: Because of your raging against me, and because your arrogance has come up into my ears, therefore I will put my hook in your nose, and my bridle in your lips, and I will turn you back by the way by which you came.' (2 Kings 19:28)

text: יַעַן הִתְרַגֶּזְךָ אֵלַי וְשַׁאֲנַנְךָ עָלָה בְאָזְנָי וְשַׂמְתִּי חַחִי בְּאַפֶּךָ וּמִתְגִּי בִּשְׂפָתֶיךָ וַהֲשִׁיבֹתִיךָ בַּדֶּרֶךְ אֲשֶׁר בָּאתָ בָּֽהּ׃
translation: Because of your raging against me, and because your arrogance has come up into my ears, therefore I will put my hook in your nose and my bridle in your lips, and I will turn you back by the way by which you came. (Isaiah 37:29)

text: וַֽיִּתְּנֻהוּ בַסּוּגַר בַּֽחַחִים וַיְבִאֻהוּ אֶל מֶלֶךְ בָּבֶל יְבִאֻהוּ בַּמְּצֹדוֹת לְמַעַן לֹא יִשָּׁמַע קוֹלוֹ עוֹד אֶל הָרֵי יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
translation: They put him in a cage with hooks, and brought him to the king of Babylon. They brought him into strongholds, so that his voice should no more be heard on the mountains of Israel. (Ezekiel 19:9)

text: וְנָתַתִּי חחיים חַחִים בִּלְחָיֶיךָ וְהִדְבַּקְתִּי דְגַת יְאֹרֶיךָ בְּקַשְׂקְשֹׂתֶיךָ וְהַעֲלִיתִיךָ מִתּוֹךְ יְאֹרֶיךָ וְאֵת כָּל דְּגַת יְאֹרֶיךָ בְּקַשְׂקְשֹׂתֶיךָ תִּדְבָּֽק׃
translation: I will put hooks in your jaws, and I will make the fish of your rivers stick to your scales. I will bring you up out of the middle of your rivers, with all the fish of your rivers which stick to your scales. (Ezekiel 29:4)

text: כֹּל אֲשֶׁר אֵֽין לוֹ סְנַפִּיר וְקַשְׂקֶשֶׂת בַּמָּיִם שֶׁקֶץ הוּא לָכֶֽם׃
translation: Whatever has no fins nor scales in the waters is an abomination to you. (Leviticus 11:12)

text: וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר אֵֽין לוֹ סְנַפִּיר וְקַשְׂקֶשֶׂת לֹא תֹאכֵלוּ טָמֵא הוּא לָכֶֽם׃
translation: You shall not eat whatever doesn't have fins and scales. It is unclean to you. (Deuteronomy 14:10)

text: אֶת זֶה תֹּֽאכְלוּ מִכֹּל אֲשֶׁר בַּמָּיִם כֹּל אֲשֶׁר לוֹ סְנַפִּיר וְקַשְׂקֶשֶׂת תֹּאכֵֽלוּ׃
translation: These you may eat of all that are in the waters: you may eat whatever has fins and scales. (Deuteronomy 14:9)

text: וְכוֹבַע נְחֹשֶׁת עַל רֹאשׁוֹ וְשִׁרְיוֹן קַשְׂקַשִּׂים הוּא לָבוּשׁ וּמִשְׁקַל הַשִּׁרְיוֹן חֲמֵשֶׁת אֲלָפִים שְׁקָלִים נְחֹֽשֶֽׁת׃
translation: He had a helmet of bronze on his head, and he wore a coat of mail; and the weight of the coat was five thousand shekels of bronze. (1 Samuel 17:5)

text: אֶת זֶה תֹּֽאכְלוּ מִכֹּל אֲשֶׁר בַּמָּיִם כֹּל אֲשֶׁר לוֹ סְנַפִּיר וְקַשְׂקֶשֶׂת בַּמַּיִם בַּיַּמִּים וּבַנְּחָלִים אֹתָם תֹּאכֵֽלוּ׃
translation: "'You may eat of all these that are in the waters: whatever has fins and scales in the waters, in the seas, and in the rivers, that you may eat. (Leviticus 11:9)

text: וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר אֵֽין לוֹ סְנַפִּיר וְקַשְׂקֶשֶׂת בַּיַּמִּים וּבַנְּחָלִים מִכֹּל שֶׁרֶץ הַמַּיִם וּמִכֹּל נֶפֶשׁ הַחַיָּה אֲשֶׁר בַּמָּיִם שֶׁקֶץ הֵם לָכֶֽם׃
translation: All that don't have fins and scales in the seas and rivers, all that move in the waters, and all the living creatures that are in the waters, they are an abomination to you, (Leviticus 11:10)

text: וְאֵת בַּת הַֽיַּעֲנָה וְאֶת הַתַּחְמָס וְאֶת הַשָּׁחַף וְאֶת הַנֵּץ לְמִינֵֽהוּ׃
translation: the horned owl, the screech owl, the gull, any kind of hawk, (Leviticus 11:16)

text: וְאֵת בַּת הַֽיַּעֲנָה וְאֶת הַתַּחְמָס וְאֶת הַשָּׁחַף וְאֶת הַנֵּץ לְמִינֵֽהוּ׃
translation: the ostrich, the owl, the seagull, the hawk of any kind, (Deuteronomy 14:15)

text: אָח הָיִיתִי לְתַנִּים וְרֵעַ לִבְנוֹת יַעֲנָֽה׃
translation: I am a brother to jackals, and a companion to ostriches. (Job 30:29)

text: עַל זֹאת אֶסְפְּדָה וְאֵילִילָה אֵילְכָה שילל שׁוֹלָל וְעָרוֹם אֶעֱשֶׂה מִסְפֵּד כַּתַּנִּים וְאֵבֶל כִּבְנוֹת יַעֲנָֽה׃
translation: For this I will lament and wail. I will go stripped and naked. I will howl like the jackals and mourn like the ostriches. (Micah 1:8)

text: תְּכַבְּדֵנִי חַיַּת הַשָּׂדֶה תַּנִּים וּבְנוֹת יַֽעֲנָה כִּֽי נָתַתִּי בַמִּדְבָּר מַיִם נְהָרוֹת בִּֽישִׁימֹן לְהַשְׁקוֹת עַמִּי בְחִירִֽי׃
translation: The animals of the field, the jackals and the ostriches, shall honor me, because I give water in the wilderness and rivers in the desert, to give drink to my people, my chosen, (Isaiah 43:20)

text: לָכֵן יֵשְׁבוּ צִיִּים אֶת אִיִּים וְיָשְׁבוּ בָהּ בְּנוֹת יַֽעֲנָה וְלֹֽא תֵשֵׁב עוֹד לָנֶצַח וְלֹא תִשְׁכּוֹן עַד דּוֹר וָדֽוֹר׃
translation: Therefore the wild animals of the desert with the wolves will dwell there. The ostriches will dwell therein. It will be inhabited no more forever, neither will it be lived in from generation to generation. (Jeremiah 50:39)

text: וְהִתְאַוִּיתֶם לָכֶם לִגְבוּל קֵדְמָה מֵחֲצַר עֵינָן שְׁפָֽמָה׃
translation: "'You shall mark out your east border from Hazar Enan to Shepham. (Numbers 34:10)

text: יוֹאֵל הָרֹאשׁ וְשָׁפָם הַמִּשְׁנֶה וְיַעְנַי וְשָׁפָט בַּבָּשָֽׁן׃
translation: Joel the chief, Shapham the second, Janai, and Shaphat in Bashan. (1 Chronicles 5:12)

text: וַעֲשִׂיתֶם כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשִׂיתִי עַל שָׂפָם לֹא תַעְטוּ וְלֶחֶם אֲנָשִׁים לֹא תֹאכֵֽלוּ׃
translation: You will do as I have done. You won't cover your lips or eat mourner's bread. (Ezekiel 24:22)

text: וּבֹשׁוּ הַחֹזִים וְחָֽפְרוּ הַקֹּסְמִים וְעָטוּ עַל שָׂפָם כֻּלָּם כִּי אֵין מַעֲנֵה אֱלֹהִֽים׃
translation: The seers shall be disappointed, and the diviners confounded. Yes, they shall all cover their lips, for there is no answer from God." (Micah 3:7)

text: וְיָרַד הַגְּבֻל מִשְּׁפָם הָרִבְלָה מִקֶּדֶם לָעָיִן וְיָרַד הַגְּבוּל וּמָחָה עַל כֶּתֶף יָם כִּנֶּרֶת קֵֽדְמָה׃
translation: The border shall go down from Shepham to Riblah, on the east side of Ain. The border shall go down, and shall reach to the side of the sea of Chinnereth eastward. (Numbers 34:11)

text: וְהַצָּרוּעַ אֲשֶׁר בּוֹ הַנֶּגַע בְּגָדָיו יִהְיוּ פְרֻמִים וְרֹאשׁוֹ יִהְיֶה פָרוּעַ וְעַל שָׂפָם יַעְטֶה וְטָמֵא טָמֵא יִקְרָֽא׃
translation: "The leper in whom the plague is shall wear torn clothes, and the hair of his head shall hang loose. He shall cover his upper lip, and shall cry, 'Unclean! Unclean!' (Leviticus 13:45)

text: וַתִּטְמָא הָאָרֶץ וָאֶפְקֹד עֲוֺנָהּ עָלֶיהָ וַתָּקִא הָאָרֶץ אֶת יֹשְׁבֶֽיהָ׃
translation: The land was defiled. Therefore I punished its iniquity, and the land vomited out her inhabitants. (Leviticus 18:25)

text: דְּבַשׁ מָצָאתָ אֱכֹל דַּיֶּךָּ פֶּן תִּשְׂבָּעֶנּוּ וַהֲקֵֽאתֽוֹ׃
translation: Have you found honey? Eat as much as is sufficient for you, lest you eat too much, and vomit it. (Proverbs 25:16)

text: חַיִל בָּלַע וַיְקִאֶנּוּ מִבִּטְנוֹ יוֹרִשֶׁנּוּ אֵֽל׃
translation: He has swallowed down riches, and he will vomit them up again. God will cast them out of his belly. (Job 20:15)

text: פִּֽתְּךָ אָכַלְתָּ תְקִיאֶנָּה וְשִׁחַתָּ דְּבָרֶיךָ הַנְּעִימִֽים׃
translation: You will vomit up the morsel which you have eaten and waste your pleasant words. (Proverbs 23:8)

text: וְלֹֽא תָקִיא הָאָרֶץ אֶתְכֶם בְּטַֽמַּאֲכֶם אֹתָהּ כַּאֲשֶׁר קָאָה אֶת הַגּוֹי אֲשֶׁר לִפְנֵיכֶֽם׃
translation: that the land not vomit you out also, when you defile it, as it vomited out the nation that was before you. (Leviticus 18:28)

text: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם אֶת כָּל חֻקֹּתַי וְאֶת כָּל מִשְׁפָּטַי וַעֲשִׂיתֶם אֹתָם וְלֹא תָקִיא אֶתְכֶם הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר אֲנִי מֵבִיא אֶתְכֶם שָׁמָּה לָשֶׁבֶת בָּֽהּ׃
translation: "'You shall therefore keep all my statutes and all my ordinances, and do them, that the land where I am bringing you to dwell may not vomit you out. (Leviticus 20:22)

text: וְנָשַׁמּוּ מִזְבְּחוֹתֵיכֶם וְנִשְׁבְּרוּ חַמָּֽנֵיכֶם וְהִפַּלְתִּי חַלְלֵיכֶם לִפְנֵי גִּלּוּלֵיכֶֽם׃
translation: Your altars will become desolate, and your incense altars will be broken. I will cast down your slain men before your idols. (Ezekiel 6:4)

text: וַיָּסַר מִכָּל עָרֵי יְהוּדָה אֶת הַבָּמוֹת וְאֶת הַֽחַמָּנִים וַתִּשְׁקֹט הַמַּמְלָכָה לְפָנָֽיו׃
translation: and commanded Judah to seek the LORD, the God of their fathers, and to obey his law and command. (2 Chronicles 14:4)

text: וְלֹא יִשְׁעֶה אֶל הַֽמִּזְבְּחוֹת מַעֲשֵׂה יָדָיו וַאֲשֶׁר עָשׂוּ אֶצְבְּעֹתָיו לֹא יִרְאֶה וְהָאֲשֵׁרִים וְהָחַמָּנִֽים׃
translation: They will not look to the altars, the work of their hands; neither shall they respect that which their fingers have made, either the Asherah poles or the incense altars. (Isaiah 17:8)

text: וְהִשְׁמַדְתִּי אֶת בָּמֹֽתֵיכֶם וְהִכְרַתִּי אֶת חַמָּנֵיכֶם וְנָֽתַתִּי אֶת פִּגְרֵיכֶם עַל פִּגְרֵי גִּלּוּלֵיכֶם וְגָעֲלָה נַפְשִׁי אֶתְכֶֽם׃
translation: I will destroy your high places, and cut down your incense altars, and cast your dead bodies upon the bodies of your idols; and my soul will abhor you. (Leviticus 26:30)

text: וַיְנַתֵּץ אֶת הַֽמִּזְבְּחוֹת וְאֶת הָאֲשֵׁרִים וְהַפְּסִלִים כִּתַּת לְהֵדַק וְכָל הַֽחַמָּנִים גִּדַּע בְּכָל אֶרֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיָּשָׁב לִירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
translation: He broke down the altars, beat the Asherah poles and the engraved images into powder, and cut down all the incense altars throughout all the land of Israel, then returned to Jerusalem. (2 Chronicles 34:7)

text: מִזְמוֹר שִׁיר חֲנֻכַּת הַבַּיִת לְדָוִֽד׃
translation: A Psalm. A Song for the Dedication of the Temple. By David. I will extol you, LORD, for you have raised me up, and have not made my foes to rejoice over me. (Psalms 30:1)

text: וַֽיַּעֲשׂוּ בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁמִינִי עֲצָרֶת כִּי חֲנֻכַּת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ עָשׂוּ שִׁבְעַת יָמִים וְהֶחָג שִׁבְעַת יָמִֽים׃
translation: On the eighth day, they held a solemn assembly; for they kept the dedication of the altar seven days, and the feast seven days. (2 Chronicles 7:9)

text: וַיַּקְרִיבוּ הַנְּשִׂאִים אֵת חֲנֻכַּת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ בְּיוֹם הִמָּשַׁח אֹתוֹ וַיַּקְרִיבוּ הַנְּשִׂיאִם אֶת קָרְבָּנָם לִפְנֵי הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃
translation: The princes gave offerings for the dedication of the altar in the day that it was anointed. The princes gave their offerings before the altar. (Numbers 7:10)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה נָשִׂיא אֶחָד לַיּוֹם נָשִׂיא אֶחָד לַיּוֹם יַקְרִיבוּ אֶת קָרְבָּנָם לַחֲנֻכַּת הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃
translation: The LORD said to Moses, "They shall offer their offering, each prince on his day, for the dedication of the altar." (Numbers 7:11)

text: וּבַחֲנֻכַּת חוֹמַת יְרוּשָׁלִַם בִּקְשׁוּ אֶת הַלְוִיִּם מִכָּל מְקוֹמֹתָם לַהֲבִיאָם לִֽירוּשָׁלִָם לַעֲשֹׂת חֲנֻכָּה וְשִׂמְחָה וּבְתוֹדוֹת וּבְשִׁיר מְצִלְתַּיִם נְבָלִים וּבְכִנֹּרֽוֹת׃
translation: At the dedication of the wall of Jerusalem, they sought the Levites out of all their places, to bring them to Jerusalem to keep the dedication with gladness, both with giving thanks and with singing, with cymbals, stringed instruments, and with harps. (Nehemiah 12:27)

text: וַֽיהוָה בְּהֵיכַל קָדְשׁוֹ הַס מִפָּנָיו כָּל הָאָֽרֶץ׃
translation: But the LORD is in his holy temple. Let all the earth be silent before him!" (Habakkuk 2:20)

text: וְהַלְוִיִּם מַחְשִׁים לְכָל הָעָם לֵאמֹר הַסּוּ כִּי הַיּוֹם קָדֹשׁ וְאַל תֵּעָצֵֽבוּ׃
translation: So the Levites calmed all the people, saying, "Hold your peace, for the day is holy. Don't be grieved." (Nehemiah 8:11)

text: וְהֵילִילוּ שִׁירוֹת הֵיכָל בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא נְאֻם אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה רַב הַפֶּגֶר בְּכָל מָקוֹם הִשְׁלִיךְ הָֽס׃
translation: The songs of the temple will be wailing in that day," says the Lord GOD. "The dead bodies will be many. In every place they will throw them out with silence. (Amos 8:3)

text: הַס מִפְּנֵי אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה כִּי קָרוֹב יוֹם יְהוָה כִּֽי הֵכִין יְהוָה זֶבַח הִקְדִּישׁ קְרֻאָֽיו׃
translation: Be silent at the presence of the Lord GOD, for the day of the LORD is at hand. For the LORD has prepared a sacrifice. He has consecrated his guests. (Zephaniah 1:7)

text: וַיַּהַס כָּלֵב אֶת הָעָם אֶל מֹשֶׁה וַיֹּאמֶר עָלֹה נַעֲלֶה וְיָרַשְׁנוּ אֹתָהּ כִּֽי יָכוֹל נוּכַל לָֽהּ׃
translation: Caleb stilled the people before Moses, and said, "Let's go up at once, and possess it; for we are well able to overcome it!" (Numbers 13:30)

text: וְהוּא שָׁב מִן הַפְּסִילִים אֲשֶׁר אֶת הַגִּלְגָּל וַיֹּאמֶר דְּבַר סֵתֶר לִי אֵלֶיךָ הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיֹּאמֶר הָס וַיֵּֽצְאוּ מֵֽעָלָיו כָּל הָעֹמְדִים עָלָֽיו׃
translation: But he himself turned back from the stone idols that were by Gilgal, and said, "I have a secret message for you, O king." The king said, "Keep silence!" All who stood by him left him. (Judges 3:19)

text: אֲנִי קַרְתִּי וְשָׁתִיתִי מָיִם וְאַחְרִב בְּכַף פְּעָמַי כֹּל יְאֹרֵי מָצֽוֹר׃
translation: I have dug and drunk water, and with the sole of my feet I will dry up all the rivers of Egypt." (Isaiah 37:25)

text: אֲנִי קַרְתִּי וְשָׁתִיתִי מַיִם זָרִים וְאַחְרִב בְּכַף פְּעָמַי כֹּל יְאֹרֵי מָצֽוֹר׃
translation: I have dug and drunk strange waters, and I will dry up all the rivers of Egypt with the sole of my feet." (2 Kings 19:24)

text: קֽוּרֵיהֶם לֹא יִהְיוּ לְבֶגֶד וְלֹא יִתְכַּסּוּ בְּמַֽעֲשֵׂיהֶם מַֽעֲשֵׂיהֶם מַֽעֲשֵׂי אָוֶן וּפֹעַל חָמָס בְּכַפֵּיהֶֽם׃
translation: Their webs won't become garments. They won't cover themselves with their works. Their works are works of iniquity, and acts of violence are in their hands. (Isaiah 59:6)

text: כִּי יוֹם מְהוּמָה וּמְבוּסָה וּמְבוּכָה לַֽאדֹנָי יְהוִה צְבָאוֹת בְּגֵיא חִזָּיוֹן מְקַרְקַר קִר וְשׁוֹעַ אֶל הָהָֽר׃
translation: For it is a day of confusion, and of treading down, and of perplexity from the Lord, GOD of Armies, in the valley of vision, a breaking down of the walls, and a crying to the mountains." (Isaiah 22:5)

text: כְּהָקִיר בור בַּיִר מֵימֶיהָ כֵּן הֵקֵרָה רָעָתָהּ חָמָס וָשֹׁד יִשָּׁמַע בָּהּ עַל פָּנַי תָּמִיד חֳלִי וּמַכָּֽה׃
translation: As a well produces its waters, so she produces her wickedness. Violence and destruction is heard in her. Sickness and wounds are continually before me. (Jeremiah 6:7)

text: אֶרְאֶנּוּ וְלֹא עַתָּה אֲשׁוּרֶנּוּ וְלֹא קָרוֹב דָּרַךְ כּוֹכָב מִֽיַּעֲקֹב וְקָם שֵׁבֶט מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל וּמָחַץ פַּאֲתֵי מוֹאָב וְקַרְקַר כָּל בְּנֵי שֵֽׁת׃
translation: I see him, but not now. I see him, but not near. A star will come out of Jacob. A scepter will rise out of Israel, and shall strike through the corners of Moab, and crush all the sons of Sheth. (Numbers 24:17)

text: בְּנֵי שִׁמְעוֹן לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם לִנְמוּאֵל מִשְׁפַּחַת הַנְּמוּאֵלִי לְיָמִין מִשְׁפַּחַת הַיָּמִינִי לְיָכִין מִשְׁפַּחַת הַיָּכִינִֽי׃
translation: The sons of Simeon after their families: of Nemuel, the family of the Nemuelites; of Jamin, the family of the Jaminites; of Jachin, the family of the Jachinites; (Numbers 26:12)

text: וַיַּעֲבֹר בְּהַר אֶפְרַיִם וַיַּעֲבֹר בְּאֶֽרֶץ שָׁלִשָׁה וְלֹא מָצָאוּ וַיַּעַבְרוּ בְאֶֽרֶץ שַׁעֲלִים וָאַיִן וַיַּעֲבֹר בְּאֶֽרֶץ יְמִינִי וְלֹא מָצָֽאוּ׃
translation: He passed through the hill country of Ephraim, and passed through the land of Shalishah, but they didn't find them. Then they passed through the land of Shaalim, and they weren't there. Then he passed through the land of the Benjamites, but they didn't find them. (1 Samuel 9:4)

text: וַיָּקֶם אֶת הָֽעַמּוּדִים עַל פְּנֵי הַהֵיכָל אֶחָד מִיָּמִין וְאֶחָד מֵֽהַשְּׂמֹאול וַיִּקְרָא שֵׁם הימיני הַיְמָנִי יָכִין וְשֵׁם הַשְּׂמָאלִי בֹּֽעַז׃
translation: He set up the pillars before the temple, one on the right hand and the other on the left; and called the name of that on the right hand Jachin, and the name of that on the left Boaz. (2 Chronicles 3:17)

text: וַֽיְהִי אִישׁ מבן ימין מִבִּנְיָמִין וּשְׁמוֹ קִישׁ בֶּן אֲבִיאֵל בֶּן צְרוֹר בֶּן בְּכוֹרַת בֶּן אֲפִיחַ בֶּן אִישׁ יְמִינִי גִּבּוֹר חָֽיִל׃
translation: Now there was a man of Benjamin, whose name was Kish the son of Abiel, the son of Zeror, the son of Becorath, the son of Aphiah, the son of a Benjamite, a mighty man of valor. (1 Samuel 9:1)

text: וַיִּקְחוּ אֶת כָּל הַשָּׁלָל וְאֵת כָּל הַמַּלְקוֹחַ בָּאָדָם וּבַבְּהֵמָֽה׃
translation: They took all the captives, and all the plunder, both of man and of animal. (Numbers 31:11)

text: הֲיֻקַּח מִגִּבּוֹר מַלְקוֹחַ וְאִם שְׁבִי צַדִּיק יִמָּלֵֽט׃
translation: Shall the plunder be taken from the mighty, or the lawful captives be delivered? (Isaiah 49:24)

text: וְחָצִיתָ אֶת הַמַּלְקוֹחַ בֵּין תֹּפְשֵׂי הַמִּלְחָמָה הַיֹּצְאִים לַצָּבָא וּבֵין כָּל הָעֵדָֽה׃
translation: and divide the plunder into two parts: between the men skilled in war, who went out to battle, and all the congregation. (Numbers 31:27)

text: שָׂא אֵת רֹאשׁ מַלְקוֹחַ הַשְּׁבִי בָּאָדָם וּבַבְּהֵמָה אַתָּה וְאֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן וְרָאשֵׁי אֲבוֹת הָעֵדָֽה׃
translation: "Count the plunder that was taken, both of man and of animal, you, and Eleazar the priest, and the heads of the fathers' households of the congregation; (Numbers 31:26)

text: וַיְהִי הַמַּלְקוֹחַ יֶתֶר הַבָּז אֲשֶׁר בָּזְזוּ עַם הַצָּבָא צֹאן שֵׁשׁ מֵאוֹת אֶלֶף וְשִׁבְעִים אֶלֶף וַחֲמֵֽשֶׁת אֲלָפִֽים׃
translation: Now the plunder, over and above the booty which the men of war took, was six hundred seventy-five thousand sheep, (Numbers 31:32)

text: כִּי כֹה אָמַר יְהוָה גַּם שְׁבִי גִבּוֹר יֻקָּח וּמַלְקוֹחַ עָרִיץ יִמָּלֵט וְאֶת יְרִיבֵךְ אָנֹכִי אָרִיב וְאֶת בָּנַיִךְ אָנֹכִי אוֹשִֽׁיעַ׃
translation: But the LORD says, "Even the captives of the mighty shall be taken away, and the plunder retrieved from the fierce, for I will contend with him who contends with you and I will save your children. (Isaiah 49:25)

text: הֲיֵאָכֵל תָּפֵל מִבְּלִי מֶלַח אִם יֶשׁ טַעַם בְּרִיר חַלָּמֽוּת׃
translation: Can that which has no flavor be eaten without salt? Or is there any taste in the white of an egg? (Job 6:6)

text: וְכִלֵּיתִי אֶת חֲמָתִי בַּקִּיר וּבַטָּחִים אֹתוֹ תָּפֵל וְאֹמַר לָכֶם אֵין הַקִּיר וְאֵין הַטָּחִים אֹתֽוֹ׃
translation: Thus I will accomplish my wrath on the wall, and on those who have plastered it with whitewash. I will tell you, 'The wall is no more, nor those who plastered it— (Ezekiel 13:15)

text: אֱמֹר אֶל טָחֵי תָפֵל וְיִפֹּל הָיָה גֶּשֶׁם שׁוֹטֵף וְאַתֵּנָה אַבְנֵי אֶלְגָּבִישׁ תִּפֹּלְנָה וְרוּחַ סְעָרוֹת תְּבַקֵּֽעַ׃
translation: Tell those who plaster it with whitewash that it will fall. There will be an overflowing shower; and you, great hailstones, will fall. A stormy wind will tear it. (Ezekiel 13:11)

text: יַעַן וּבְיַעַן הִטְעוּ אֶת עַמִּי לֵאמֹר שָׁלוֹם וְאֵין שָׁלוֹם וְהוּא בֹּנֶה חַיִץ וְהִנָּם טָחִים אֹתוֹ תָּפֵֽל׃
translation: "'Because, even because they have seduced my people, saying, "Peace;" and there is no peace. When one builds up a wall, behold, they plaster it with whitewash. (Ezekiel 13:10)

text: נְבִיאַיִךְ חָזוּ לָךְ שָׁוְא וְתָפֵל וְלֹֽא גִלּוּ עַל עֲוֺנֵךְ לְהָשִׁיב שביתך שְׁבוּתֵךְ וַיֶּחֱזוּ לָךְ מַשְׂאוֹת שָׁוְא וּמַדּוּחִֽים׃
translation: Your prophets have seen false and foolish visions for you. They have not uncovered your iniquity, to reverse your captivity, but have seen for you false revelations and causes of banishment. (Lamentations 2:14)

text: וּנְבִיאֶיהָ טָחוּ לָהֶם תָּפֵל חֹזִים שָׁוְא וְקֹסְמִים לָהֶם כָּזָב אֹמְרִים כֹּה אָמַר אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה וַֽיהוָה לֹא דִבֵּֽר׃
translation: Her prophets have plastered for them with whitewash, seeing false visions, and divining lies to them, saying, 'The Lord GOD says,' when the LORD has not spoken. (Ezekiel 22:28)

text: אֱלִיפֶלֶט בֶּן אֲחַסְבַּי בֶּן הַמַּֽעֲכָתִי אֱלִיעָם בֶּן אֲחִיתֹפֶל הַגִּלֹנִֽי׃
translation: Eliphelet the son of Ahasbai, the son of the Maacathite, Eliam the son of Ahithophel the Gilonite, (2 Samuel 23:34)

text: וּבְנֵי אֵשֶׁת הֽוֹדִיָּה אֲחוֹת נַחַם אֲבִי קְעִילָה הַגַּרְמִי וְאֶשְׁתְּמֹעַ הַמַּעֲכָתִֽי׃
translation: The sons of the wife of Hodiah, the sister of Naham, were the fathers of Keilah the Garmite and Eshtemoa the Maacathite. (1 Chronicles 4:19)

text: וְהַגִּלְעָד וּגְבוּל הַגְּשׁוּרִי וְהַמַּעֲכָתִי וְכֹל הַר חֶרְמוֹן וְכָל הַבָּשָׁן עַד סַלְכָֽה׃
translation: and Gilead, and the border of the Geshurites and Maacathites, and all Mount Hermon, and all Bashan to Salecah; (Joshua 13:11)

text: וּמֹשֵׁל בְּהַר חֶרְמוֹן וּבְסַלְכָה וּבְכָל הַבָּשָׁן עַד גְּבוּל הַגְּשׁוּרִי וְהַמַּעֲכָתִי וַחֲצִי הַגִּלְעָד גְּבוּל סִיחוֹן מֶֽלֶךְ חֶשְׁבּֽוֹן׃
translation: and ruled in Mount Hermon, and in Salecah, and in all Bashan, to the border of the Geshurites and the Maacathites, and half Gilead, the border of Sihon king of Heshbon. (Joshua 12:5)

text: וְלֹא הוֹרִישׁוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת הַגְּשׁוּרִי וְאֶת הַמַּעֲכָתִי וַיֵּשֶׁב גְּשׁוּר וּמַֽעֲכָת בְּקֶרֶב יִשְׂרָאֵל עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּֽה׃
translation: Nevertheless the children of Israel didn't drive out the Geshurites, nor the Maacathites: but Geshur and Maacath live within Israel to this day. (Joshua 13:13)

text: שָׁמְרֵנִי מִידֵי פַח יָקְשׁוּ לִי וּמֹקְשׁוֹת פֹּעֲלֵי אָֽוֶן׃
translation: Keep me from the snare which they have laid for me, from the traps of the workers of iniquity. (Psalms 141:9)

text: נַפְשֵׁנוּ כְּצִפּוֹר נִמְלְטָה מִפַּח יוֹקְשִׁים הַפַּח נִשְׁבָּר וַאֲנַחְנוּ נִמְלָֽטְנוּ׃
translation: Our soul has escaped like a bird out of the fowler's snare. The snare is broken, and we have escaped. (Psalms 124:7)

text: וְכָשְׁלוּ בָם רַבִּים וְנָפְלוּ וְנִשְׁבָּרוּ וְנוֹקְשׁוּ וְנִלְכָּֽדוּ׃
translation: Many will stumble over it, fall, be broken, be snared, and be captured." (Isaiah 8:15)

text: נוֹקַשְׁתָּ בְאִמְרֵי פִיךָ נִלְכַּדְתָּ בְּאִמְרֵי פִֽיךָ׃
translation: you are trapped by the words of your mouth; you are ensnared with the words of your mouth. (Proverbs 6:2)

text: יָקֹשְׁתִּי לָךְ וְגַם נִלְכַּדְתְּ בָּבֶל וְאַתְּ לֹא יָדָעַתְּ נִמְצֵאת וְגַם נִתְפַּשְׂתְּ כִּי בַֽיהוָה הִתְגָּרִֽית׃
translation: I have laid a snare for you, and you are also taken, Babylon, and you weren't aware. You are found, and also caught, because you have fought against the LORD. (Jeremiah 50:24)

text: פְּסִילֵי אֱלֹהֵיהֶם תִּשְׂרְפוּן בָּאֵשׁ לֹֽא תַחְמֹד כֶּסֶף וְזָהָב עֲלֵיהֶם וְלָקַחְתָּ לָךְ פֶּן תִּוָּקֵשׁ בּוֹ כִּי תוֹעֲבַת יְהוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ הֽוּא׃
translation: You shall burn the engraved images of their gods with fire. You shall not covet the silver or the gold that is on them, nor take it for yourself, lest you be snared in it; for it is an abomination to the LORD your God. (Deuteronomy 7:25)

text: בְּאוֹר פְּנֵי מֶלֶךְ חַיִּים וּרְצוֹנוֹ כְּעָב מַלְקֽוֹשׁ׃
translation: In the light of the king's face is life. His favor is like a cloud of the spring rain. (Proverbs 16:15)

text: וְנָתַתִּי מְטַֽר אַרְצְכֶם בְּעִתּוֹ יוֹרֶה וּמַלְקוֹשׁ וְאָסַפְתָּ דְגָנֶךָ וְתִֽירֹשְׁךָ וְיִצְהָרֶֽךָ׃
translation: that I will give the rain for your land in its season, the early rain and the latter rain, that you may gather in your grain, your new wine, and your oil. (Deuteronomy 11:14)

text: וְיִֽחֲלוּ כַמָּטָר לִי וּפִיהֶם פָּעֲרוּ לְמַלְקֽוֹשׁ׃
translation: They waited for me as for the rain. Their mouths drank as with the spring rain. (Job 29:23)

text: וְנֵדְעָה נִרְדְּפָה לָדַעַת אֶת יְהוָה כְּשַׁחַר נָכוֹן מֽוֹצָאוֹ וְיָבוֹא כַגֶּשֶׁם לָנוּ כְּמַלְקוֹשׁ יוֹרֶה אָֽרֶץ׃
translation: Let's acknowledge the LORD. Let's press on to know the LORD. As surely as the sun rises, the LORD will appear. He will come to us like the rain, like the spring rain that waters the earth." (Hosea 6:3)

text: שַׁאֲלוּ מֵיְהוָה מָטָר בְּעֵת מַלְקוֹשׁ יְהוָה עֹשֶׂה חֲזִיזִים וּמְטַר גֶּשֶׁם יִתֵּן לָהֶם לְאִישׁ עֵשֶׂב בַּשָּׂדֶֽה׃
translation: Ask of the LORD rain in the spring time, the LORD who makes storm clouds, and he gives rain showers to everyone for the plants in the field. (Zechariah 10:1)

text: וְלֹֽא אָמְרוּ בִלְבָבָם נִירָא נָא אֶת יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ הַנֹּתֵן גֶּשֶׁם וירה יוֹרֶה וּמַלְקוֹשׁ בְּעִתּוֹ שְׁבֻעוֹת חֻקּוֹת קָצִיר יִשְׁמָר לָֽנוּ׃
translation: They don't say in their heart, 'Let's now fear the LORD our God, who gives rain, both the former and the latter, in its season, who preserves to us the appointed weeks of the harvest.' (Jeremiah 5:24)

text: וַיִּשְׂרֹף יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶת הָעָי וַיְשִׂימֶהָ תֵּל עוֹלָם שְׁמָמָה עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּֽה׃
translation: So Joshua burned Ai and made it a heap forever, even a desolation, to this day. (Joshua 8:28)

text: רַק כָּל הֶעָרִים הָעֹֽמְדוֹת עַל תִּלָּם לֹא שְׂרָפָם יִשְׂרָאֵל זוּלָתִי אֶת חָצוֹר לְבַדָּהּ שָׂרַף יְהוֹשֻֽׁעַ׃
translation: But as for the cities that stood on their mounds, Israel burned none of them, except Hazor only. Joshua burned that. (Joshua 11:13)

text: וְאֵלֶּה הָֽעֹלִים מִתֵּל מֶלַח תֵּל חַרְשָׁא כְּרוּב אַדָּן אִמֵּר וְלֹא יָֽכְלוּ לְהַגִּיד בֵּית אֲבוֹתָם וְזַרְעָם אִם מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל הֵֽם׃
translation: These were those who went up from Tel Melah, Tel Harsha, Cherub, Addan, and Immer; but they could not show their fathers' houses and their offspring, whether they were of Israel: (Ezra 2:59)

text: וְאֵלֶּה הָֽעוֹלִים מִתֵּל מֶלַח תֵּל חַרְשָׁא כְּרוּב אַדּוֹן וְאִמֵּר וְלֹא יָכְלוּ לְהַגִּיד בֵּית אֲבוֹתָם וְזַרְעָם אִם מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל הֵֽם׃
translation: These were those who went up from Tel Melah, Tel Harsha, Cherub, Addon, and Immer; but they could not show their fathers' houses, nor their offspring, whether they were of Israel: (Nehemiah 7:61)

text: כֹּה אָמַר יְהוָה הִנְנִי שָׁב שְׁבוּת אָהֳלֵי יַֽעֲקוֹב וּמִשְׁכְּנֹתָיו אֲרַחֵם וְנִבְנְתָה עִיר עַל תִּלָּהּ וְאַרְמוֹן עַל מִשְׁפָּטוֹ יֵשֵֽׁב׃
translation: The LORD says: "Behold, I will reverse the captivity of Jacob's tents, and have compassion on his dwelling places. The city will be built on its own hill, and the palace will be inhabited in its own place. (Jeremiah 30:18)

text: חָלְקוּ מַחְמָאֹת פִּיו וּֽקֲרָב לִבּוֹ רַכּוּ דְבָרָיו מִשֶּׁמֶן וְהֵמָּה פְתִחֽוֹת׃
translation: Cast your burden on the LORD and he will sustain you. He will never allow the righteous to be moved. (Psalms 55:22)

text: וְאֵל הֵרַךְ לִבִּי וְשַׁדַּי הִבְהִילָֽנִי׃
translation: For God has made my heart faint. The Almighty has terrified me. (Job 23:16)

text: מִכַּף רֶגֶל וְעַד רֹאשׁ אֵֽין בּוֹ מְתֹם פֶּצַע וְחַבּוּרָה וּמַכָּה טְרִיָּה לֹא זֹרוּ וְלֹא חֻבָּשׁוּ וְלֹא רֻכְּכָה בַּשָּֽׁמֶן׃
translation: From the sole of the foot even to the head there is no soundness in it, but wounds, welts, and open sores. They haven't been closed, bandaged, or soothed with oil. (Isaiah 1:6)

text: וּפֶן יֵרַךְ לְבַבְכֶם וְתִֽירְאוּ בַּשְּׁמוּעָה הַנִּשְׁמַעַת בָּאָרֶץ וּבָא בַשָּׁנָה הַשְּׁמוּעָה וְאַחֲרָיו בַּשָּׁנָה הַשְּׁמוּעָה וְחָמָס בָּאָרֶץ וּמֹשֵׁל עַל מֹשֵֽׁל׃
translation: Don't let your heart faint. Don't fear for the news that will be heard in the land. For news will come one year, and after that in another year news will come, and violence in the land, ruler against ruler. (Jeremiah 51:46)

text: וְאָמַר אֲלֵהֶם שְׁמַע יִשְׂרָאֵל אַתֶּם קְרֵבִים הַיּוֹם לַמִּלְחָמָה עַל אֹיְבֵיכֶם אַל יֵרַךְ לְבַבְכֶם אַל תִּֽירְאוּ וְאַֽל תַּחְפְּזוּ וְאַל תַּֽעַרְצוּ מִפְּנֵיהֶֽם׃
translation: and shall tell them, "Hear, Israel, you draw near today to battle against your enemies. Don't let your heart faint! Don't be afraid, nor tremble, neither be scared of them; (Deuteronomy 20:3)

text: וְאָמַרְתָּ אֵלָיו הִשָּׁמֵר וְהַשְׁקֵט אַל תִּירָא וּלְבָבְךָ אַל יֵרַךְ מִשְּׁנֵי זַנְבוֹת הָאוּדִים הָעֲשֵׁנִים הָאֵלֶּה בָּחֳרִי אַף רְצִין וַאֲרָם וּבֶן רְמַלְיָֽהוּ׃
translation: Tell him, 'Be careful, and keep calm. Don't be afraid, neither let your heart be faint because of these two tails of smoking torches, for the fierce anger of Rezin and Syria, and of the son of Remaliah. (Isaiah 7:4)

text: נוֹצֵר תּוֹרָה בֵּן מֵבִין וְרֹעֶה זֽוֹלְלִים יַכְלִים אָבִֽיו׃
translation: Whoever keeps the law is a wise son; but he who is a companion of gluttons shames his father. (Proverbs 28:7)

text: בַּעֲשׂוֹתְךָ נוֹרָאוֹת לֹא נְקַוֶּה יָרַדְתָּ מִפָּנֶיךָ הָרִים נָזֹֽלּוּ׃
translation: as when fire kindles the brushwood, and the fire causes the water to boil. Make your name known to your adversaries, that the nations may tremble at your presence! (Isaiah 64:2)

text: אַל תְּהִי בְסֹֽבְאֵי יָיִן בְּזֹלֲלֵי בָשָׂר לָֽמוֹ׃
translation: Don't be among ones drinking too much wine, or those who gorge themselves on meat; (Proverbs 23:20)

text: כִּי סֹבֵא וְזוֹלֵל יִוָּרֵשׁ וּקְרָעִים תַּלְבִּישׁ נוּמָֽה׃
translation: for the drunkard and the glutton shall become poor; and drowsiness clothes them in rags. (Proverbs 23:21)

text: וְאָמְרוּ אֶל זִקְנֵי עִירוֹ בְּנֵנוּ זֶה סוֹרֵר וּמֹרֶה אֵינֶנּוּ שֹׁמֵעַ בְּקֹלֵנוּ זוֹלֵל וְסֹבֵֽא׃
translation: They shall tell the elders of his city, "This our son is stubborn and rebellious. He will not obey our voice. He is a glutton and a drunkard." (Deuteronomy 21:20)

text: הָיִינוּ מֵֽעוֹלָם לֹֽא מָשַׁלְתָּ בָּם לֹֽא נִקְרָא שִׁמְךָ עֲלֵיהֶם לוּא קָרַעְתָּ שָׁמַיִם יָרַדְתָּ מִפָּנֶיךָ הָרִים נָזֹֽלּוּ׃
translation: We have become like those over whom you never ruled, like those who were not called by your name. (Isaiah 63:19)

text: וְהָֽאֲנָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר לֹא מֵתוּ הֻכּוּ בעפלים בַּטְּחֹרִים וַתַּעַל שַֽׁוְעַת הָעִיר הַשָּׁמָֽיִם׃
translation: The men who didn't die were struck with the tumors; and the cry of the city went up to heaven. (1 Samuel 5:12)

text: יַכְּכָה יְהוָה בִּשְׁחִין מִצְרַיִם ובעפלים וּבַטְּחֹרִים וּבַגָּרָב וּבֶחָרֶס אֲשֶׁר לֹא תוּכַל לְהֵרָפֵֽא׃
translation: The LORD will strike you with the boils of Egypt, with the tumors, with the scurvy, and with the itch, of which you can not be healed. (Deuteronomy 28:27)

text: וְאֵלֶּה טְחֹרֵי הַזָּהָב אֲשֶׁר הֵשִׁיבוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים אָשָׁם לַֽיהוָה לְאַשְׁדּוֹד אֶחָד לְעַזָּה אֶחָד לְאַשְׁקְלוֹן אֶחָד לְגַת אֶחָד לְעֶקְרוֹן אֶחָֽד׃
translation: These are the golden tumors which the Philistines returned for a trespass offering to the LORD: for Ashdod one, for Gaza one, for Ashkelon one, for Gath one, for Ekron one; (1 Samuel 6:17)

text: הַשֵּׁן הָאֶחָד מָצוּק מִצָּפוֹן מוּל מִכְמָשׂ וְהָאֶחָד מִנֶּגֶב מוּל גָּֽבַע׃
translation: The one crag rose up on the north in front of Michmash, and the other on the south in front of Geba. (1 Samuel 14:5)

text: צַר וּמָצוֹק מְצָאוּנִי מִצְוֺתֶיךָ שַׁעֲשֻׁעָֽי׃
translation: Trouble and anguish have taken hold of me. Your commandments are my delight. (Psalms 119:143)

text: וְאָכַלְתָּ פְרִֽי בִטְנְךָ בְּשַׂר בָּנֶיךָ וּבְנֹתֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר נָֽתַן לְךָ יְהוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בְּמָצוֹר וּבְמָצוֹק אֲשֶׁר יָצִיק לְךָ אֹיְבֶֽךָ׃
translation: You will eat the fruit of your own body, the flesh of your sons and of your daughters, whom the LORD your God has given you, in the siege and in the distress with which your enemies will distress you. (Deuteronomy 28:53)

text: מִתֵּת לְאַחַד מֵהֶם מִבְּשַׂר בָּנָיו אֲשֶׁר יֹאכֵל מִבְּלִי הִשְׁאִֽיר לוֹ כֹּל בְּמָצוֹר וּבְמָצוֹק אֲשֶׁר יָצִיק לְךָ אֹיִבְךָ בְּכָל שְׁעָרֶֽיךָ׃
translation: so that he will not give to any of them of the flesh of his children whom he will eat, because he has nothing left to him, in the siege and in the distress with which your enemy will distress you in all your gates. (Deuteronomy 28:55)

text: וּֽבְשִׁלְיָתָהּ הַיּוֹצֵת מִבֵּין רַגְלֶיהָ וּבְבָנֶיהָ אֲשֶׁר תֵּלֵד כִּֽי תֹאכְלֵם בְּחֹֽסֶר כֹּל בַּסָּתֶר בְּמָצוֹר וּבְמָצוֹק אֲשֶׁר יָצִיק לְךָ אֹיִבְךָ בִּשְׁעָרֶֽיךָ׃
translation: toward her young one who comes out from between her feet, and toward her children whom she bears; for she will eat them secretly for lack of all things in the siege and in the distress with which your enemy will distress you in your gates. (Deuteronomy 28:57)
