text: וְקוֹל הָמוֹן שָׁלֵו בָהּ וְאֶל אֲנָשִׁים מֵרֹב אָדָם מוּבָאִים סובאים סָבָאִים מִמִּדְבָּר וַֽיִּתְּנוּ צְמִידִים אֶל יְדֵיהֶן וַעֲטֶרֶת תִּפְאֶרֶת עַל רָאשֵׁיהֶֽן׃
translation: "The voice of a multitude being at ease was with her. With men of the common sort were brought drunkards from the wilderness; and they put bracelets on their hands, and beautiful crowns on their heads. (Ezekiel 23:42)

text: שִׁשִּׁים הֵמָּה מְּלָכוֹת וּשְׁמֹנִים פִּֽילַגְשִׁים וַעֲלָמוֹת אֵין מִסְפָּֽר׃
translation: There are sixty queens, eighty concubines, and virgins without number. (Song of Solomon 6:8)

text: קִדְּמוּ שָׁרִים אַחַר נֹגְנִים בְּתוֹךְ עֲלָמוֹת תּוֹפֵפֽוֹת׃
translation: "Bless God in the congregations, even the Lord in the assembly of Israel!" (Psalms 68:26)

text: לְרֵיחַ שְׁמָנֶיךָ טוֹבִים שֶׁמֶן תּוּרַק שְׁמֶךָ עַל כֵּן עֲלָמוֹת אֲהֵבֽוּךָ׃
translation: Your oils have a pleasing fragrance. Your name is oil poured out, therefore the virgins love you. (Song of Solomon 1:3)

text: וַתֹּֽאמֶר לָהּ בַּת פַּרְעֹה לֵכִי וַתֵּלֶךְ הָֽעַלְמָה וַתִּקְרָא אֶת אֵם הַיָּֽלֶד׃
translation: Pharaoh's daughter said to her, "Go." The young woman went and called the child's mother. (Exodus 2:8)

text: דֶּרֶךְ הַנֶּשֶׁר בַּשָּׁמַיִם דֶּרֶךְ נָחָשׁ עֲלֵי צוּר דֶּֽרֶךְ אֳנִיָּה בְלֶב יָם וְדֶרֶךְ גֶּבֶר בְּעַלְמָֽה׃
translation: The way of an eagle in the air, the way of a serpent on a rock, the way of a ship in the middle of the sea, and the way of a man with a maiden. (Proverbs 30:19)

text: לָכֵן יִתֵּן אֲדֹנָי הוּא לָכֶם אוֹת הִנֵּה הָעַלְמָה הָרָה וְיֹלֶדֶת בֵּן וְקָרָאת שְׁמוֹ עִמָּנוּ אֵֽל׃
translation: Therefore the Lord himself will give you a sign. Behold, the virgin will conceive, and bear a son, and shall call his name Immanuel. (Isaiah 7:14)

text: כִּי שָׁחָה אֶל מָוֶת בֵּיתָהּ וְאֶל רְפָאִים מַעְגְּלֹתֶֽיהָ׃
translation: for her house leads down to death, her paths to the departed spirits. (Proverbs 2:18)

text: כִּי שָׁחָה לֶעָפָר נַפְשֵׁנוּ דָּבְקָה לָאָרֶץ בִּטְנֵֽנוּ׃
translation: Rise up to help us. Redeem us for your loving kindness' sake. (Psalms 44:26)

text: זָכוֹר תִּזְכּוֹר ותשיח וְתָשׁוֹחַ עָלַי נַפְשִֽׁי׃
translation: My soul still remembers them, and is bowed down within me. (Lamentations 3:20)

text: וַיֵּצֵא יִצְחָק לָשׂוּחַ בַּשָּׂדֶה לִפְנוֹת עָרֶב וַיִּשָּׂא עֵינָיו וַיַּרְא וְהִנֵּה גְמַלִּים בָּאִֽים׃
translation: Isaac went out to meditate in the field at the evening. He lifted up his eyes and looked. Behold, there were camels coming. (Genesis 24:63)

text: וַתֵּלֶד לוֹ אֶת זִמְרָן וְאֶת יָקְשָׁן וְאֶת מְדָן וְאֶת מִדְיָן וְאֶת יִשְׁבָּק וְאֶת שֽׁוּחַ׃
translation: She bore him Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah. (Genesis 25:2)

text: וּבְנֵי קְטוּרָה פִּילֶגֶשׁ אַבְרָהָם יָלְדָה אֶת זִמְרָן וְיָקְשָׁן וּמְדָן וּמִדְיָן וְיִשְׁבָּק וְשׁוּחַ וּבְנֵי יָקְשָׁן שְׁבָא וּדְדָֽן׃
translation: The sons of Keturah, Abraham's concubine: she bore Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah. The sons of Jokshan: Sheba and Dedan. (1 Chronicles 1:32)

text: וְאֵת כָּל עָרֵיהֶם בְּמוֹשְׁבֹתָם וְאֵת כָּל טִֽירֹתָם שָׂרְפוּ בָּאֵֽשׁ׃
translation: All their cities in the places in which they lived, and all their encampments, they burned with fire. (Numbers 31:10)

text: תְּהִי טִֽירָתָם נְשַׁמָּה בְּאָהֳלֵיהֶם אַל יְהִי יֹשֵֽׁב׃
translation: For they persecute him whom you have wounded. They tell of the sorrow of those whom you have hurt. (Psalms 69:26)

text: וְטוּר סָבִיב בָּהֶם סָבִיב לְאַרְבַּעְתָּם וּמְבַשְּׁלוֹת עָשׂוּי מִתַּחַת הַטִּירוֹת סָבִֽיב׃
translation: There was a wall around in them, around the four, and boiling places were made under the walls all around. (Ezekiel 46:23)

text: אֵלֶּה הֵם בְּנֵי יִשְׁמָעֵאל וְאֵלֶּה שְׁמֹתָם בְּחַצְרֵיהֶם וּבְטִֽירֹתָם שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר נְשִׂיאִם לְאֻמֹּתָֽם׃
translation: These are the sons of Ishmael, and these are their names, by their villages, and by their encampments: twelve princes, according to their nations. (Genesis 25:16)

text: וְאֵלֶּה מוֹשְׁבוֹתָם לְטִירוֹתָם בִּגְבוּלָם לִבְנֵי אַהֲרֹן לְמִשְׁפַּחַת הַקְּהָתִי כִּי לָהֶם הָיָה הַגּוֹרָֽל׃
translation: His brother Asaph, who stood on his right hand, even Asaph the son of Berechiah, the son of Shimea, (1 Chronicles 6:39)

text: אִם חוֹמָה הִיא נִבְנֶה עָלֶיהָ טִירַת כָּסֶף וְאִם דֶּלֶת הִיא נָצוּר עָלֶיהָ לוּחַ אָֽרֶז׃
translation: If she is a wall, we will build on her a turret of silver. If she is a door, we will enclose her with boards of cedar. (Song of Solomon 8:9)

text: וּבְנֵיהֶם חֲצִי מְדַבֵּר אַשְׁדּוֹדִית וְאֵינָם מַכִּירִים לְדַבֵּר יְהוּדִית וְכִלְשׁוֹן עַם וָעָֽם׃
translation: and their children spoke half in the speech of Ashdod, and could not speak in the Jews' language, but according to the language of each people. (Nehemiah 13:24)

text: וַֽיַּעֲמֹד רַב שָׁקֵה וַיִּקְרָא בְקוֹל גָּדוֹל יְהוּדִית וַיְדַבֵּר וַיֹּאמֶר שִׁמְעוּ דְּבַר הַמֶּלֶךְ הַגָּדוֹל מֶלֶךְ אַשּֽׁוּר׃
translation: Then Rabshakeh stood and cried with a loud voice in the Jews' language, and spoke, saying, "Hear the word of the great king, the king of Assyria. (2 Kings 18:28)

text: וַֽיַּעֲמֹד רַב שָׁקֵה וַיִּקְרָא בְקוֹל גָּדוֹל יְהוּדִית וַיֹּאמֶר שִׁמְעוּ אֶת דִּבְרֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ הַגָּדוֹל מֶלֶךְ אַשּֽׁוּר׃
translation: Then Rabshakeh stood, and called out with a loud voice in the Jews' language, and said, "Hear the words of the great king, the king of Assyria! (Isaiah 36:13)

text: וַיִּקְרְאוּ בְקוֹל גָּדוֹל יְהוּדִית עַל עַם יְרוּשָׁלִַם אֲשֶׁר עַל הַֽחוֹמָה לְיָֽרְאָם וּֽלְבַהֲלָם לְמַעַן יִלְכְּדוּ אֶת הָעִֽיר׃
translation: They called out with a loud voice in the Jews' language to the people of Jerusalem who were on the wall, to frighten them and to trouble them, that they might take the city. (2 Chronicles 32:18)

text: וַיְהִי עֵשָׂו בֶּן אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה וַיִּקַּח אִשָּׁה אֶת יְהוּדִית בַּת בְּאֵרִי הַֽחִתִּי וְאֶת בָּשְׂמַת בַּת אֵילֹן הַֽחִתִּֽי׃
translation: When Esau was forty years old, he took as wife Judith, the daughter of Beeri the Hittite, and Basemath, the daughter of Elon the Hittite. (Genesis 26:34)

text: וְאַף אֱלֹהִים עָלָה בָהֶם וַֽיַּהֲרֹג בְּמִשְׁמַנֵּיהֶם וּבַחוּרֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הִכְרִֽיעַ׃
translation: when the anger of God went up against them, killed some of their strongest, and struck down the young men of Israel. (Psalms 78:31)

text: וְהָיָה בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא יִדַּל כְּבוֹד יַעֲקֹב וּמִשְׁמַן בְּשָׂרוֹ יֵרָזֶֽה׃
translation: "It will happen in that day that the glory of Jacob will be made thin, and the fatness of his flesh will become lean. (Isaiah 17:4)

text: וְיִֽתֶּן לְךָ הָאֱלֹהִים מִטַּל הַשָּׁמַיִם וּמִשְׁמַנֵּי הָאָרֶץ וְרֹב דָּגָן וְתִירֹֽשׁ׃
translation: God give you of the dew of the sky, of the fatness of the earth, and plenty of grain and new wine. (Genesis 27:28)

text: וַיַּעַן יִצְחָק אָבִיו וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו הִנֵּה מִשְׁמַנֵּי הָאָרֶץ יִהְיֶה מֽוֹשָׁבֶךָ וּמִטַּל הַשָּׁמַיִם מֵעָֽל׃
translation: Isaac his father answered him, "Behold, your dwelling will be of the fatness of the earth, and of the dew of the sky from above. (Genesis 27:39)

text: לָכֵן יְשַׁלַּח הָאָדוֹן יְהוָה צְבָאוֹת בְּמִשְׁמַנָּיו רָזוֹן וְתַחַת כְּבֹדוֹ יֵקַד יְקֹד כִּיקוֹד אֵֽשׁ׃
translation: Therefore the Lord, GOD of Armies, will send among his fat ones leanness; and under his glory a burning will be kindled like the burning of fire. (Isaiah 10:16)

text: וּמֹשֶׁה בֶּן מֵאָה וְעֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה בְּמֹתוֹ לֹֽא כָהֲתָה עֵינוֹ וְלֹא נָס לֵחֹֽה׃
translation: Moses was one hundred twenty years old when he died. His eye was not dim, nor his strength gone. (Deuteronomy 34:7)

text: וַיַּעֲלוּ לָהּ סַרְנֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים שִׁבְעָה יְתָרִים לַחִים אֲשֶׁר לֹא חֹרָבוּ וַתַּאַסְרֵהוּ בָּהֶֽם׃
translation: Then the lords of the Philistines brought up to her seven green cords which had not been dried, and she bound him with them. (Judges 16:8)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלֶיהָ שִׁמְשׁוֹן אִם יַאַסְרֻנִי בְּשִׁבְעָה יְתָרִים לַחִים אֲשֶׁר לֹא חֹרָבוּ וְחָלִיתִי וְהָיִיתִי כְּאַחַד הָאָדָֽם׃
translation: Samson said to her, "If they bind me with seven green cords that were never dried, then shall I become weak, and be as another man." (Judges 16:7)

text: וַיִּֽקַּֽח לוֹ יַעֲקֹב מַקַּל לִבְנֶה לַח וְלוּז וְעֶרְמוֹן וַיְפַצֵּל בָּהֵן פְּצָלוֹת לְבָנוֹת מַחְשֹׂף הַלָּבָן אֲשֶׁר עַל הַמַּקְלֽוֹת׃
translation: Jacob took to himself rods of fresh poplar, almond, and plane tree, peeled white streaks in them, and made the white appear which was in the rods. (Genesis 30:37)

text: מִיַּיִן וְשֵׁכָר יַזִּיר חֹמֶץ יַיִן וְחֹמֶץ שֵׁכָר לֹא יִשְׁתֶּה וְכָל מִשְׁרַת עֲנָבִים לֹא יִשְׁתֶּה וַעֲנָבִים לַחִים וִיבֵשִׁים לֹא יֹאכֵֽל׃
translation: he shall separate himself from wine and strong drink. He shall drink no vinegar of wine, or vinegar of fermented drink, neither shall he drink any juice of grapes, nor eat fresh grapes or dried. (Numbers 6:3)

text: יַחְפֹּץ זְנָבוֹ כְמוֹ אָרֶז גִּידֵי פחדו פַחֲדָיו יְשֹׂרָֽגוּ׃
translation: He moves his tail like a cedar. The sinews of his thighs are knit together. (Job 40:17)

text: מִדַּעְתִּי כִּי קָשֶׁה אָתָּה וְגִיד בַּרְזֶל עָרְפֶּךָ וּמִצְחֲךָ נְחוּשָֽׁה׃
translation: Because I knew that you are obstinate, and your neck is an iron sinew, and your brow bronze; (Isaiah 48:4)

text: עוֹר וּבָשָׂר תַּלְבִּישֵׁנִי וּֽבַעֲצָמוֹת וְגִידִים תְּסֹכְכֵֽנִי׃
translation: You have clothed me with skin and flesh, and knit me together with bones and sinews. (Job 10:11)

text: וְרָאִיתִי וְהִנֵּֽה עֲלֵיהֶם גִּדִים וּבָשָׂר עָלָה וַיִּקְרַם עֲלֵיהֶם עוֹר מִלְמָעְלָה וְרוּחַ אֵין בָּהֶֽם׃
translation: I saw, and, behold, there were sinews on them, and flesh came up, and skin covered them above; but there was no breath in them. (Ezekiel 37:8)

text: וְנָתַתִּי עֲלֵיכֶם גִּדִים וְֽהַעֲלֵתִי עֲלֵיכֶם בָּשָׂר וְקָרַמְתִּי עֲלֵיכֶם עוֹר וְנָתַתִּי בָכֶם רוּחַ וִחְיִיתֶם וִידַעְתֶּם כִּֽי אֲנִי יְהוָֽה׃
translation: I will lay sinews on you, and will bring up flesh on you, and cover you with skin, and put breath in you, and you will live. Then you will know that I am the LORD."'" (Ezekiel 37:6)

text: וְיִשְׂרָאֵל אָהַב אֶת יוֹסֵף מִכָּל בָּנָיו כִּֽי בֶן זְקֻנִים הוּא לוֹ וְעָשָׂה לוֹ כְּתֹנֶת פַּסִּֽים׃
translation: Now Israel loved Joseph more than all his children, because he was the son of his old age, and he made him a tunic of many colors. (Genesis 37:3)

text: וַֽיְהִי כַּֽאֲשֶׁר בָּא יוֹסֵף אֶל אֶחָיו וַיַּפְשִׁיטוּ אֶת יוֹסֵף אֶת כֻּתָּנְתּוֹ אֶת כְּתֹנֶת הַפַּסִּים אֲשֶׁר עָלָֽיו׃
translation: When Joseph came to his brothers, they stripped Joseph of his tunic, the tunic of many colors that was on him; (Genesis 37:23)

text: וַֽיְשַׁלְּחוּ אֶת כְּתֹנֶת הַפַּסִּים וַיָּבִיאוּ אֶל אֲבִיהֶם וַיֹּאמְרוּ זֹאת מָצָאנוּ הַכֶּר נָא הַכְּתֹנֶת בִּנְךָ הִוא אִם לֹֽא׃
translation: They took the tunic of many colors, and they brought it to their father, and said, "We have found this. Examine it, now, and see if it is your son's tunic or not." (Genesis 37:32)

text: וְעָלֶיהָ כְּתֹנֶת פַּסִּים כִּי כֵן תִּלְבַּשְׁןָ בְנוֹת הַמֶּלֶךְ הַבְּתוּלֹת מְעִילִים וַיֹּצֵא אוֹתָהּ מְשָֽׁרְתוֹ הַחוּץ וְנָעַל הַדֶּלֶת אַחֲרֶֽיהָ׃
translation: She had a garment of various colors on her, for the king's daughters who were virgins dressed in such robes. Then his servant brought her out and bolted the door after her. (2 Samuel 13:18)

text: וַתִּקַּח תָּמָר אֵפֶר עַל רֹאשָׁהּ וּכְתֹנֶת הַפַּסִּים אֲשֶׁר עָלֶיהָ קָרָעָה וַתָּשֶׂם יָדָהּ עַל רֹאשָׁהּ וַתֵּלֶךְ הָלוֹךְ וְזָעָֽקָה׃
translation: Tamar put ashes on her head, and tore her garment of various colors that was on her; and she laid her hand on her head and went her way, crying aloud as she went. (2 Samuel 13:19)

text: נְקֹם נִקְמַת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵאֵת הַמִּדְיָנִים אַחַר תֵּאָסֵף אֶל עַמֶּֽיךָ׃
translation: "Avenge the children of Israel on the Midianites. Afterward you shall be gathered to your people." (Numbers 31:2)

text: צָרוֹר אֶת הַמִּדְיָנִים וְהִכִּיתֶם אוֹתָֽם׃
translation: "Harass the Midianites, and strike them; (Numbers 25:17)

text: וְשֵׁם הָֽאִשָּׁה הַמֻּכָּה הַמִּדְיָנִית כָּזְבִּי בַת צוּר רֹאשׁ אֻמּוֹת בֵּֽית אָב בְּמִדְיָן הֽוּא׃
translation: The name of the Midianite woman who was slain was Cozbi, the daughter of Zur. He was head of the people of a fathers' house in Midian. (Numbers 25:15)

text: וְשֵׁם אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל הַמֻּכֶּה אֲשֶׁר הֻכָּה אֶת הַמִּדְיָנִית זִמְרִי בֶּן סָלוּא נְשִׂיא בֵֽית אָב לַשִּׁמְעֹנִֽי׃
translation: Now the name of the man of Israel that was slain, who was slain with the Midianite woman, was Zimri, the son of Salu, a prince of a fathers' house among the Simeonites. (Numbers 25:14)

text: וַיַּֽעַבְרוּ אֲנָשִׁים מִדְיָנִים סֹֽחֲרִים וַֽיִּמְשְׁכוּ וַיַּֽעֲלוּ אֶת יוֹסֵף מִן הַבּוֹר וַיִּמְכְּרוּ אֶת יוֹסֵף לַיִּשְׁמְעֵאלִים בְּעֶשְׂרִים כָּסֶף וַיָּבִיאוּ אֶת יוֹסֵף מִצְרָֽיְמָה׃
translation: Midianites who were merchants passed by, and they drew and lifted up Joseph out of the pit, and sold Joseph to the Ishmaelites for twenty pieces of silver. The merchants brought Joseph into Egypt. (Genesis 37:28)

text: וַתַּעַשׂ הָאָרֶץ בְּשֶׁבַע שְׁנֵי הַשָּׂבָע לִקְמָצִֽים׃
translation: In the seven plenteous years the earth produced abundantly. (Genesis 41:47)

text: וְקָמַץ הַכֹּהֵן מִן הַמִּנְחָה אֶת אַזְכָּרָתָהּ וְהִקְטִיר הַמִּזְבֵּחָה וְאַחַר יַשְׁקֶה אֶת הָאִשָּׁה אֶת הַמָּֽיִם׃
translation: The priest shall take a handful of the meal offering, as its memorial portion, and burn it on the altar, and afterward shall make the woman drink the water. (Numbers 5:26)

text: וֶהֱבִיאָהּ אֶל הַכֹּהֵן וְקָמַץ הַכֹּהֵן מִמֶּנָּה מְלוֹא קֻמְצוֹ אֶת אַזְכָּרָתָה וְהִקְטִיר הַמִּזְבֵּחָה עַל אִשֵּׁי יְהוָה חַטָּאת הִֽוא׃
translation: He shall bring it to the priest, and the priest shall take his handful of it as the memorial portion, and burn it on the altar, on the offerings of the LORD made by fire. It is a sin offering. (Leviticus 5:12)

text: וְהֵרִים מִמֶּנּוּ בְּקֻמְצוֹ מִסֹּלֶת הַמִּנְחָה וּמִשַּׁמְנָהּ וְאֵת כָּל הַלְּבֹנָה אֲשֶׁר עַל הַמִּנְחָה וְהִקְטִיר הַמִּזְבֵּחַ רֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ אַזְכָּרָתָהּ לַיהוָֽה׃
translation: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying, (Leviticus 6:8)

text: וַיַּסְגֵּר לַבָּרָד בְּעִירָם וּמִקְנֵיהֶם לָרְשָׁפִֽים׃
translation: He also gave over their livestock to the hail, and their flocks to hot thunderbolts. (Psalms 78:48)

text: וְלָמָה הֲבֵאתֶם אֶת קְהַל יְהוָה אֶל הַמִּדְבָּר הַזֶּה לָמוּת שָׁם אֲנַחְנוּ וּבְעִירֵֽנוּ׃
translation: Why have you brought the LORD's assembly into this wilderness, that we should die there, we and our animals? (Numbers 20:4)

text: וַיָּרֶם מֹשֶׁה אֶת יָדוֹ וַיַּךְ אֶת הַסֶּלַע בְּמַטֵּהוּ פַּעֲמָיִם וַיֵּצְאוּ מַיִם רַבִּים וַתֵּשְׁתְּ הָעֵדָה וּבְעִירָֽם׃
translation: Moses lifted up his hand, and struck the rock with his rod twice, and water came out abundantly. The congregation and their livestock drank. (Numbers 20:11)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר פַּרְעֹה אֶל יוֹסֵף אֱמֹר אֶל אַחֶיךָ זֹאת עֲשׂוּ טַֽעֲנוּ אֶת בְּעִירְכֶם וּלְכוּ בֹאוּ אַרְצָה כְּנָֽעַן׃
translation: Pharaoh said to Joseph, "Tell your brothers, 'Do this: Load your animals, and go, travel to the land of Canaan. (Genesis 45:17)

text: זְבוּלֻן לְחוֹף יַמִּים יִשְׁכֹּן וְהוּא לְחוֹף אֳנִיּוֹת וְיַרְכָתוֹ עַל צִידֹֽן׃
translation: "Zebulun will dwell at the haven of the sea. He will be for a haven of ships. His border will be on Sidon. (Genesis 49:13)

text: אֵיךְ תִּשְׁקֹטִי וַֽיהוָה צִוָּה לָהּ אֶֽל אַשְׁקְלוֹן וְאֶל חוֹף הַיָּם שָׁם יְעָדָֽהּ׃
translation: "How can you be quiet, since the LORD has given you a command? Against Ashkelon, and against the seashore, there he has appointed it." (Jeremiah 47:7)

text: גִּלְעָד בְּעֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן שָׁכֵן וְדָן לָמָּה יָגוּר אֳנִיּוֹת אָשֵׁר יָשַׁב לְחוֹף יַמִּים וְעַל מִפְרָצָיו יִשְׁכּֽוֹן׃
translation: Gilead lived beyond the Jordan. Why did Dan remain in ships? Asher sat still at the haven of the sea, and lived by his creeks. (Judges 5:17)

text: לָכֵן כֹּה אָמַר אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה הִנְנִי נוֹטֶה יָדִי עַל פְּלִשְׁתִּים וְהִכְרַתִּי אֶת כְּרֵתִים וְהַאֲבַדְתִּי אֶת שְׁאֵרִית חוֹף הַיָּֽם׃
translation: therefore the Lord GOD says, "Behold, I will stretch out my hand on the Philistines, and I will cut off the Cherethites, and destroy the remnant of the sea coast. (Ezekiel 25:16)

text: חֲבָלִים נָֽפְלוּ לִי בַּנְּעִמִים אַף נַחֲלָת שָֽׁפְרָה עָלָֽי׃
translation: The lines have fallen to me in pleasant places. Yes, I have a good inheritance. (Psalms 16:6)

text: נַפְתָּלִי אַיָּלָה שְׁלֻחָה הַנֹּתֵן אִמְרֵי שָֽׁפֶר׃
translation: "Naphtali is a doe set free, who bears beautiful fawns. (Genesis 49:21)

text: וַיִּסְעוּ מִקְּהֵלָתָה וַֽיַּחֲנוּ בְּהַר שָֽׁפֶר׃
translation: They traveled from Kehelathah, and encamped in Mount Shepher. (Numbers 33:23)

text: לָהֵן מַלְכָּא מִלְכִּי יִשְׁפַּר עליך עֲלָךְ וחטיך וַחֲטָאָךְ בְּצִדְקָה פְרֻק וַעֲוָיָתָךְ בְּמִחַן עֲנָיִן הֵן תֶּהֱוֵא אַרְכָה לִשְׁלֵוְתָֽךְ׃
translation: "This is the interpretation, O king, and it is the decree of the Most High, which has come on my lord the king: (Daniel 4:24)

text: וַיִּבֶן אֶת תַּדְמֹר בַּמִּדְבָּר וְאֵת כָּל עָרֵי הַֽמִּסְכְּנוֹת אֲשֶׁר בָּנָה בַּחֲמָֽת׃
translation: He built Tadmor in the wilderness, and all the storage cities, which he built in Hamath. (2 Chronicles 8:4)

text: וַיְהִי יְהוֹשָׁפָט הֹלֵךְ וְגָדֵל עַד לְמָעְלָה וַיִּבֶן בִּֽיהוּדָה בִּירָנִיּוֹת וְעָרֵי מִסְכְּנֽוֹת׃
translation: Jehoshaphat grew great exceedingly; and he built fortresses and store cities in Judah. (2 Chronicles 17:12)

text: וּמִסְכְּנוֹת לִתְבוּאַת דָּגָן וְתִירוֹשׁ וְיִצְהָר וְאֻֽרָוֺת לְכָל בְּהֵמָה וּבְהֵמָה וַעֲדָרִים לָאֲוֵרֽוֹת׃
translation: also storehouses for the increase of grain, new wine, and oil; and stalls for all kinds of animals, and flocks in folds. (2 Chronicles 32:28)

text: וַיָּשִׂימוּ עָלָיו שָׂרֵי מִסִּים לְמַעַן עַנֹּתוֹ בְּסִבְלֹתָם וַיִּבֶן עָרֵי מִסְכְּנוֹת לְפַרְעֹה אֶת פִּתֹם וְאֶת רַעַמְסֵֽס׃
translation: Therefore they set taskmasters over them to afflict them with their burdens. They built storage cities for Pharaoh: Pithom and Raamses. (Exodus 1:11)

text: זֵיתִים יִהְיוּ לְךָ בְּכָל גְּבוּלֶךָ וְשֶׁמֶן לֹא תָסוּךְ כִּי יִשַּׁל זֵיתֶֽךָ׃
translation: You will have olive trees throughout all your borders, but you won't anoint yourself with the oil, for your olives will drop off. (Deuteronomy 28:40)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר אַל תִּקְרַב הֲלֹם שַׁל נְעָלֶיךָ מֵעַל רַגְלֶיךָ כִּי הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה עוֹמֵד עָלָיו אַדְמַת קֹדֶשׁ הֽוּא׃
translation: He said, "Don't come close. Take off your sandals, for the place you are standing on is holy ground." (Exodus 3:5)

text: וְנָשַׁל יְהוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֶת הַגּוֹיִם הָאֵל מִפָּנֶיךָ מְעַט מְעָט לֹא תוּכַל כַּלֹּתָם מַהֵר פֶּן תִּרְבֶּה עָלֶיךָ חַיַּת הַשָּׂדֶֽה׃
translation: The LORD your God will cast out those nations before you little by little. You may not consume them at once, lest the animals of the field increase on you. (Deuteronomy 7:22)

text: וּדְעוּ כִּֽי הִפְלָה יְהוָה חָסִיד לוֹ יְהוָה יִשְׁמַע בְּקָרְאִי אֵלָֽיו׃
translation: Stand in awe, and don't sin. Search your own heart on your bed, and be still. Selah. (Psalms 4:4)

text: הַפְלֵה חֲסָדֶיךָ מוֹשִׁיעַ חוֹסִים מִמִּתְקוֹמְמִים בִּֽימִינֶֽךָ׃
translation: Show your marvelous loving kindness, you who save those who take refuge by your right hand from their enemies. (Psalms 17:7)

text: אֽוֹדְךָ עַל כִּי נוֹרָאוֹת נִפְלֵיתִי נִפְלָאִים מַעֲשֶׂיךָ וְנַפְשִׁי יֹדַעַת מְאֹֽד׃
translation: I will give thanks to you, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made. Your works are wonderful. My soul knows that very well. (Psalms 139:14)

text: וְהִפְלָה יְהוָה בֵּין מִקְנֵה יִשְׂרָאֵל וּבֵין מִקְנֵה מִצְרָיִם וְלֹא יָמוּת מִכָּל לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל דָּבָֽר׃
translation: The LORD will make a distinction between the livestock of Israel and the livestock of Egypt; and nothing shall die of all that belongs to the children of Israel."'" (Exodus 9:4)

text: וּלְכֹל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֹא יֶֽחֱרַץ כֶּלֶב לְשֹׁנוֹ לְמֵאִישׁ וְעַד בְּהֵמָה לְמַעַן תֵּֽדְעוּן אֲשֶׁר יַפְלֶה יְהוָה בֵּין מִצְרַיִם וּבֵין יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
translation: But against any of the children of Israel a dog won't even bark or move its tongue, against man or animal, that you may know that the LORD makes a distinction between the Egyptians and Israel. (Exodus 11:7)

text: שִׂמְלָתְךָ לֹא בָֽלְתָה מֵֽעָלֶיךָ וְרַגְלְךָ לֹא בָצֵקָה זֶה אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָֽה׃
translation: Your clothing didn't grow old on you, neither did your foot swell, these forty years. (Deuteronomy 8:4)

text: וַיִּשָּׂא הָעָם אֶת בְּצֵקוֹ טֶרֶם יֶחְמָץ מִשְׁאֲרֹתָם צְרֻרֹת בְּשִׂמְלֹתָם עַל שִׁכְמָֽם׃
translation: The people took their dough before it was leavened, their kneading troughs being bound up in their clothes on their shoulders. (Exodus 12:34)

text: וְאַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה כִּלְכַּלְתָּם בַּמִּדְבָּר לֹא חָסֵרוּ שַׂלְמֹֽתֵיהֶם לֹא בָלוּ וְרַגְלֵיהֶם לֹא בָצֵֽקוּ׃
translation: "Yes, forty years you sustained them in the wilderness. They lacked nothing. Their clothes didn't grow old, and their feet didn't swell. (Nehemiah 9:21)

text: אִם זְכַרְתִּיךָ עַל יְצוּעָי בְּאַשְׁמֻרוֹת אֶהְגֶּה בָּֽךְ׃
translation: For you have been my help. I will rejoice in the shadow of your wings. (Psalms 63:7)

text: כִּי אֶלֶף שָׁנִים בְּֽעֵינֶיךָ כְּיוֹם אֶתְמוֹל כִּי יַעֲבֹר וְאַשְׁמוּרָה בַלָּֽיְלָה׃
translation: For a thousand years in your sight are just like yesterday when it is past, like a watch in the night. (Psalms 90:4)

text: קִדְּמוּ עֵינַי אַשְׁמֻרוֹת לָשִׂיחַ בְּאִמְרָתֶֽךָ׃
translation: My eyes stay open through the night watches, that I might meditate on your word. (Psalms 119:148)

text: וַֽיְהִי בְּאַשְׁמֹרֶת הַבֹּקֶר וַיַּשְׁקֵף יְהוָה אֶל מַחֲנֵה מִצְרַיִם בְּעַמּוּד אֵשׁ וְעָנָן וַיָּהָם אֵת מַחֲנֵה מִצְרָֽיִם׃
translation: In the morning watch, the LORD looked out on the Egyptian army through the pillar of fire and of cloud, and confused the Egyptian army. (Exodus 14:24)

text: גְּבָל וְעַמּוֹן וַעֲמָלֵק פְּלֶשֶׁת עִם יֹשְׁבֵי צֽוֹר׃
translation: Assyria also is joined with them. They have helped the children of Lot. Selah. (Psalms 83:8)

text: וְגַם חֲמָת תִּגְבָּל בָּהּ צֹר וְצִידוֹן כִּי חָֽכְמָה מְאֹֽד׃
translation: and Hamath, also, which borders on it, Tyre and Sidon, because they are very wise. (Zechariah 9:2)

text: וְהַיַּרְדֵּן יִגְבֹּל אֹתוֹ לִפְאַת קֵדְמָה זֹאת נַחֲלַת בְּנֵי בִנְיָמִן לִגְבֽוּלֹתֶיהָ סָבִיב לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָֽם׃
translation: The Jordan was its border on the east quarter. This was the inheritance of the children of Benjamin, by the borders around it, according to their families. (Joshua 18:20)

text: וְהִגְבַּלְתָּ אֶת הָעָם סָבִיב לֵאמֹר הִשָּׁמְרוּ לָכֶם עֲלוֹת בָּהָר וּנְגֹעַ בְּקָצֵהוּ כָּל הַנֹּגֵעַ בָּהָר מוֹת יוּמָֽת׃
translation: You shall set bounds to the people all around, saying, 'Be careful that you don't go up onto the mountain, or touch its border. Whoever touches the mountain shall be surely put to death. (Exodus 19:12)

text: לֹא תַסִּיג גְּבוּל רֵֽעֲךָ אֲשֶׁר גָּבְלוּ רִאשֹׁנִים בְּנַחֲלָֽתְךָ אֲשֶׁר תִּנְחַל בָּאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר יְהוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ נֹתֵן לְךָ לְרִשְׁתָּֽהּ׃
translation: You shall not remove your neighbor's landmark, which they of old time have set, in your inheritance which you shall inherit, in the land that the LORD your God gives you to possess. (Deuteronomy 19:14)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה אֶל יְהוָה לֹא יוּכַל הָעָם לַעֲלֹת אֶל הַר סִינָי כִּֽי אַתָּה הַעֵדֹתָה בָּנוּ לֵאמֹר הַגְבֵּל אֶת הָהָר וְקִדַּשְׁתּֽוֹ׃
translation: Moses said to the LORD, "The people can't come up to Mount Sinai, for you warned us, saying, 'Set bounds around the mountain, and sanctify it.'" (Exodus 19:23)

text: שָֽׁלְחָה נַעֲרֹתֶיהָ תִקְרָא עַל גַּפֵּי מְרֹמֵי קָֽרֶת׃
translation: She has sent out her maidens. She cries from the highest places of the city: (Proverbs 9:3)

text: אִם בְּגַפּוֹ יָבֹא בְּגַפּוֹ יֵצֵא אִם בַּעַל אִשָּׁה הוּא וְיָצְאָה אִשְׁתּוֹ עִמּֽוֹ׃
translation: If he comes in by himself, he shall go out by himself. If he is married, then his wife shall go out with him. (Exodus 21:3)

text: אִם אֲדֹנָיו יִתֶּן לוֹ אִשָּׁה וְיָלְדָה לוֹ בָנִים אוֹ בָנוֹת הָאִשָּׁה וִילָדֶיהָ תִּהְיֶה לַֽאדֹנֶיהָ וְהוּא יֵצֵא בְגַפּֽוֹ׃
translation: If his master gives him a wife and she bears him sons or daughters, the wife and her children shall be her master's, and he shall go out by himself. (Exodus 21:4)

text: וְעָשִׂיתָ סִּֽירֹתָיו לְדַשְּׁנוֹ וְיָעָיו וּמִזְרְקֹתָיו וּמִזְלְגֹתָיו וּמַחְתֹּתָיו לְכָל כֵּלָיו תַּעֲשֶׂה נְחֹֽשֶׁת׃
translation: You shall make its pots to take away its ashes; and its shovels, its basins, its meat hooks, and its fire pans. You shall make all its vessels of bronze. (Exodus 27:3)

text: וְהַמִּזְלָגוֹת וְהַמִּזְרָקוֹת וְהַקְּשָׂוֺת זָהָב טָהוֹר וְלִכְפוֹרֵי הַזָּהָב בְּמִשְׁקָל לִכְפוֹר וּכְפוֹר וְלִכְפוֹרֵי הַכֶּסֶף בְּמִשְׁקָל לִכְפוֹר וּכְפֽוֹר׃
translation: and the forks, the basins, and the cups, of pure gold; and for the golden bowls by weight for every bowl; and for the silver bowls by weight for every bowl; (1 Chronicles 28:17)

text: וּמִשְׁפַּט הַכֹּהֲנִים אֶת הָעָם כָּל אִישׁ זֹבֵחַ זֶבַח וּבָא נַעַר הַכֹּהֵן כְּבַשֵּׁל הַבָּשָׂר וְהַמַּזְלֵג שְׁלֹשׁ הַשִּׁנַּיִם בְּיָדֽוֹ׃
translation: The custom of the priests with the people was that when anyone offered a sacrifice, the priest's servant came while the meat was boiling, with a fork of three teeth in his hand; (1 Samuel 2:13)

text: וְאֶת הַסִּירוֹת וְאֶת הַיָּעִים וְאֶת הַמִּזְלָגוֹת וְאֶת כָּל כְּלֵיהֶם עָשָׂה חוּרָם אָבִיו לַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה לְבֵית יְהוָה נְחֹשֶׁת מָרֽוּק׃
translation: Huram-abi also made the pots, the shovels, the forks, and all its vessels for King Solomon, for the LORD's house, of bright bronze. (2 Chronicles 4:16)

text: וַיַּעַשׂ אֶֽת כָּל כְּלֵי הַמִּזְבֵּחַ אֶת הַסִּירֹת וְאֶת הַיָּעִים וְאֶת הַמִּזְרָקֹת אֶת הַמִּזְלָגֹת וְאֶת הַמַּחְתֹּת כָּל כֵּלָיו עָשָׂה נְחֹֽשֶׁת׃
translation: He made all the vessels of the altar: the pots, the shovels, the basins, the forks, and the fire pans. He made all its vessels of bronze. (Exodus 38:3)

text: וַיִּצֹק אַרְבַּע טַבָּעֹת בְּאַרְבַּע הַקְּצָוֺת לְמִכְבַּר הַנְּחֹשֶׁת בָּתִּים לַבַּדִּֽים׃
translation: He cast four rings for the four corners of bronze grating, to be places for the poles. (Exodus 38:5)

text: וַיַּעַשׂ לַמִּזְבֵּחַ מִכְבָּר מַעֲשֵׂה רֶשֶׁת נְחֹשֶׁת תַּחַת כַּרְכֻּבּוֹ מִלְּמַטָּה עַד חֶצְיֽוֹ׃
translation: He made for the altar a grating of a network of bronze, under the ledge around it beneath, reaching halfway up. (Exodus 38:4)

text: וַיְהִי מִֽמָּחֳרָת וַיִּקַּח הַמַּכְבֵּר וַיִּטְבֹּל בַּמַּיִם וַיִּפְרֹשׂ עַל פָּנָיו וַיָּמֹת וַיִּמְלֹךְ חֲזָהאֵל תַּחְתָּֽיו׃
translation: On the next day, he took a thick cloth, dipped it in water, and spread it on the king's face, so that he died. Then Hazael reigned in his place. (2 Kings 8:15)

text: וְעָשִׂיתָ לּוֹ מִכְבָּר מַעֲשֵׂה רֶשֶׁת נְחֹשֶׁת וְעָשִׂיתָ עַל הָרֶשֶׁת אַרְבַּע טַבְּעֹת נְחֹשֶׁת עַל אַרְבַּע קְצוֹתָֽיו׃
translation: You shall make a grating for it of network of bronze. On the net you shall make four bronze rings in its four corners. (Exodus 27:4)

text: אֵת מִזְבַּח הָעֹלָה וְאֶת מִכְבַּר הַנְּחֹשֶׁת אֲשֶׁר לוֹ אֶת בַּדָּיו וְאֶת כָּל כֵּלָיו אֶת הַכִּיֹּר וְאֶת כַּנּֽוֹ׃
translation: the altar of burnt offering, with its grating of bronze, its poles, and all its vessels, the basin and its base; (Exodus 35:16)

text: אֵת מִזְבַּח הַנְּחֹשֶׁת וְאֶת מִכְבַּר הַנְּחֹשֶׁת אֲשֶׁר לוֹ אֶת בַּדָּיו וְאֶת כָּל כֵּלָיו אֶת הַכִּיֹּר וְאֶת כַּנּֽוֹ׃
translation: the bronze altar, its grating of bronze, its poles, all of its vessels, the basin and its base, (Exodus 39:39)

text: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ עַל הַחֹשֶׁן שַׁרְשְׁרֹת גַּבְלֻת מַעֲשֵׂה עֲבֹת זָהָב טָהֽוֹר׃
translation: They made on the breastplate chains like cords, of braided work of pure gold. (Exodus 39:15)

text: וַיַּעַשׂ שַׁרְשְׁרוֹת בַּדְּבִיר וַיִּתֵּן עַל רֹאשׁ הָעַמֻּדִים וַיַּעַשׂ רִמּוֹנִים מֵאָה וַיִּתֵּן בַּֽשַּׁרְשְׁרֽוֹת׃
translation: He made chains in the inner sanctuary, and put them on the tops of the pillars; and he made one hundred pomegranates, and put them on the chains. (2 Chronicles 3:16)

text: וְאֵת הַבַּיִת הַגָּדוֹל חִפָּה עֵץ בְּרוֹשִׁים וַיְחַפֵּהוּ זָהָב טוֹב וַיַּעַל עָלָיו תִּמֹרִים וְשַׁרְשְׁרֽוֹת׃
translation: He made the larger room with a ceiling of cypress wood, which he overlaid with fine gold, and ornamented it with palm trees and chains. (2 Chronicles 3:5)

text: וּשְׁתֵּי שַׁרְשְׁרֹת זָהָב טָהוֹר מִגְבָּלֹת תַּעֲשֶׂה אֹתָם מַעֲשֵׂה עֲבֹת וְנָתַתָּה אֶת שַׁרְשְׁרֹת הָעֲבֹתֹת עַל הַֽמִּשְׁבְּצֹֽת׃
translation: and two chains of pure gold; you shall make them like cords of braided work. You shall put the braided chains on the settings. (Exodus 28:14)

text: שְׂבָכִים מַעֲשֵׂה שְׂבָכָה גְּדִלִים מַעֲשֵׂה שַׁרְשְׁרוֹת לַכֹּתָרֹת אֲשֶׁר עַל רֹאשׁ הָעַמּוּדִים שִׁבְעָה לַכֹּתֶרֶת הָאֶחָת וְשִׁבְעָה לַכֹּתֶרֶת הַשֵּׁנִֽית׃
translation: There were nets of checker work and wreaths of chain work for the capitals which were on the top of the pillars: seven for the one capital, and seven for the other capital. (1 Kings 7:17)

text: רָבוּעַ יִֽהְיֶה כָּפוּל זֶרֶת אָרְכּוֹ וְזֶרֶת רָחְבּֽוֹ׃
translation: It shall be square and folded double; a span shall be its length, and a span its width. (Exodus 28:16)

text: רָבוּעַ הָיָה כָּפוּל עָשׂוּ אֶת הַחֹשֶׁן זֶרֶת אָרְכּוֹ וְזֶרֶת רָחְבּוֹ כָּפֽוּל׃
translation: It was square. They made the breastplate double. Its length was a span, and its width a span, being double. (Exodus 39:9)

text: וַיֵּצֵא אִֽישׁ הַבֵּנַיִם מִמַּחֲנוֹת פְּלִשְׁתִּים גָּלְיָת שְׁמוֹ מִגַּת גָּבְהוֹ שֵׁשׁ אַמּוֹת וָזָֽרֶת׃
translation: A champion out of the camp of the Philistines named Goliath of Gath, whose height was six cubits and a span went out. (1 Samuel 17:4)

text: מִֽי מָדַד בְּשָׁעֳלוֹ מַיִם וְשָׁמַיִם בַּזֶּרֶת תִּכֵּן וְכָל בַּשָּׁלִשׁ עֲפַר הָאָרֶץ וְשָׁקַל בַּפֶּלֶס הָרִים וּגְבָעוֹת בְּמֹאזְנָֽיִם׃
translation: Who has measured the waters in the hollow of his hand, and marked off the sky with his span, and calculated the dust of the earth in a measuring basket, and weighed the mountains in scales, and the hills in a balance? (Isaiah 40:12)

text: וְאֵלֶּה מִדּוֹת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ בָּֽאַמּוֹת אַמָּה אַמָּה וָטֹפַח וְחֵיק הָאַמָּה וְאַמָּה רֹחַב וּגְבוּלָהּ אֶל שְׂפָתָהּ סָבִיב זֶרֶת הָאֶחָד וְזֶה גַּב הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃
translation: "These are the measurements of the altar by cubits (the cubit is a cubit and a hand width): the bottom shall be a cubit, and the width a cubit, and its border around its edge a span; and this shall be the base of the altar. (Ezekiel 43:13)

text: וַיָּשֶׂם עָלָיו אֶת הַחֹשֶׁן וַיִּתֵּן אֶל הַחֹשֶׁן אֶת הָאוּרִים וְאֶת הַתֻּמִּֽים׃
translation: He placed the breastplate on him. He put the Urim and Thummim in the breastplate. (Leviticus 8:8)

text: וַיִּשְׁאַל שָׁאוּל בַּֽיהוָה וְלֹא עָנָהוּ יְהוָה גַּם בַּחֲלֹמוֹת גַּם בָּאוּרִים גַּם בַּנְּבִיאִֽם׃
translation: When Saul inquired of the LORD, the LORD didn't answer him by dreams, by Urim, or by prophets. (1 Samuel 28:6)

text: וּלְלֵוִי אָמַר תֻּמֶּיךָ וְאוּרֶיךָ לְאִישׁ חֲסִידֶךָ אֲשֶׁר נִסִּיתוֹ בְּמַסָּה תְּרִיבֵהוּ עַל מֵי מְרִיבָֽה׃
translation: About Levi he said, "Your Thummim and your Urim are with your godly one, whom you proved at Massah, with whom you contended at the waters of Meribah. (Deuteronomy 33:8)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר הַתִּרְשָׁתָא לָהֶם אֲשֶׁר לֹא יֹאכְלוּ מִקֹּדֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִׁים עַד עֲמֹד כֹּהֵן לְאוּרִים וּלְתֻמִּֽים׃
translation: The governor told them that they should not eat of the most holy things until a priest stood up to serve with Urim and with Thummim. (Ezra 2:63)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר הַתִּרְשָׁתָא לָהֶם אֲשֶׁר לֹא יֹאכְלוּ מִקֹּדֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִׁים עַד עֲמֹד הַכֹּהֵן לְאוּרִים וְתוּמִּֽים׃
translation: The governor told them not to eat of the most holy things until a priest stood up to minister with Urim and Thummim. (Nehemiah 7:65)

text: פַּעֲמֹן זָהָב וְרִמּוֹן פַּֽעֲמֹן זָהָב וְרִמּוֹן עַל שׁוּלֵי הַמְּעִיל סָבִֽיב׃
translation: a golden bell and a pomegranate, a golden bell and a pomegranate, around the hem of the robe. (Exodus 28:34)

text: פַּעֲמֹן וְרִמֹּן פַּעֲמֹן וְרִמֹּן עַל שׁוּלֵי הַמְּעִיל סָבִיב לְשָׁרֵת כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהוָה אֶת מֹשֶֽׁה׃
translation: a bell and a pomegranate, a bell and a pomegranate, around the skirts of the robe, to minister in, as the LORD commanded Moses. (Exodus 39:26)

text: וְעָשִׂיתָ עַל שׁוּלָיו רִמֹּנֵי תְּכֵלֶת וְאַרְגָּמָן וְתוֹלַעַת שָׁנִי עַל שׁוּלָיו סָבִיב וּפַעֲמֹנֵי זָהָב בְּתוֹכָם סָבִֽיב׃
translation: On its hem you shall make pomegranates of blue, and of purple, and of scarlet, all around its hem; with bells of gold between and around them: (Exodus 28:33)

text: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ פַעֲמֹנֵי זָהָב טָהוֹר וַיִּתְּנוּ אֶת הַפַּֽעֲמֹנִים בְּתוֹךְ הָרִמֹּנִים עַל שׁוּלֵי הַמְּעִיל סָבִיב בְּתוֹךְ הָרִמֹּנִֽים׃
translation: They made bells of pure gold, and put the bells between the pomegranates around the skirts of the robe, between the pomegranates; (Exodus 39:25)

text: וְהִקְטִיר הַכֹּהֵן אֶת אַזְכָּרָתָהּ מִגִּרְשָׂהּ וּמִשַּׁמְנָהּ עַל כָּל לְבֹנָתָהּ אִשֶּׁה לַיהוָֽה׃
translation: The priest shall burn as its memorial part of its crushed grain and part of its oil, along with all its frankincense. It is an offering made by fire to the LORD. (Leviticus 2:16)

text: וְהֵרִים הַכֹּהֵן מִן הַמִּנְחָה אֶת אַזְכָּרָתָהּ וְהִקְטִיר הַמִּזְבֵּחָה אִשֵּׁה רֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ לַיהוָֽה׃
translation: The priest shall take from the meal offering its memorial, and shall burn it on the altar, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to the LORD. (Leviticus 2:9)

text: אִסְרוּ הַסּוּסִים וַֽעֲלוּ הַפָּרָשִׁים וְהִֽתְיַצְּבוּ בְּכוֹבָעִים מִרְקוּ הָֽרְמָחִים לִבְשׁוּ הַסִּרְיֹנֹֽת׃
translation: Harness the horses, and get up, you horsemen, and stand up with your helmets. Polish the spears, put on the coats of mail. (Jeremiah 46:4)

text: וּכְלִי חֶרֶשׂ אֲשֶׁר תְּבֻשַּׁל בּוֹ יִשָּׁבֵר וְאִם בִּכְלִי נְחֹשֶׁת בֻּשָּׁלָה וּמֹרַק וְשֻׁטַּף בַּמָּֽיִם׃
translation: It shall be made with oil in a griddle. When it is soaked, you shall bring it in. You shall offer the meal offering in baked pieces for a pleasant aroma to the LORD. (Leviticus 6:21)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו מַלְאַךְ הָאֱלֹהִים קַח אֶת הַבָּשָׂר וְאֶת הַמַּצּוֹת וְהַנַּח אֶל הַסֶּלַע הַלָּז וְאֶת הַמָּרַק שְׁפוֹךְ וַיַּעַשׂ כֵּֽן׃
translation: The angel of God said to him, "Take the meat and the unleavened cakes, and lay them on this rock, and pour out the broth." He did so. (Judges 6:20)

text: וְגִדְעוֹן בָּא וַיַּעַשׂ גְּדִֽי עִזִּים וְאֵיפַת קֶמַח מַצּוֹת הַבָּשָׂר שָׂם בַּסַּל וְהַמָּרַק שָׂם בַּפָּרוּר וַיּוֹצֵא אֵלָיו אֶל תַּחַת הָאֵלָה וַיַּגַּֽשׁ׃
translation: Gideon went in and prepared a young goat and unleavened cakes of an ephah of meal. He put the meat in a basket and he put the broth in a pot, and brought it out to him under the oak, and presented it. (Judges 6:19)

text: וּֽלֲהַבְדִּיל בֵּין הַקֹּדֶשׁ וּבֵין הַחֹל וּבֵין הַטָּמֵא וּבֵין הַטָּהֽוֹר׃
translation: You are to make a distinction between the holy and the common, and between the unclean and the clean. (Leviticus 10:10)

text: וְאֶת עַמִּי יוֹרוּ בֵּין קֹדֶשׁ לְחֹל וּבֵין טָמֵא לְטָהוֹר יוֹדִעֻֽם׃
translation: They shall teach my people the difference between the holy and the common, and cause them to discern between the unclean and the clean. (Ezekiel 44:23)

text: לְאַרְבַּע רוּחוֹת מְדָדוֹ חוֹמָה לוֹ סָבִיב סָבִיב אֹרֶךְ חֲמֵשׁ מֵאוֹת וְרֹחַב חֲמֵשׁ מֵאוֹת לְהַבְדִּיל בֵּין הַקֹּדֶשׁ לְחֹֽל׃
translation: He measured it on the four sides. It had a wall around it, the length five hundred cubits, and the width five hundred cubits, to make a separation between that which was holy and that which was common. (Ezekiel 42:20)

text: וַחֲמֵשֶׁת אֲלָפִים הַנּוֹתָר בָּרֹחַב עַל פְּנֵי חֲמִשָּׁה וְעֶשְׂרִים אֶלֶף חֹֽל הוּא לָעִיר לְמוֹשָׁב וּלְמִגְרָשׁ וְהָיְתָה הָעִיר בתוכה בְּתוֹכֽוֹ׃
translation: "The five thousand cubits that are left in the width, in front of the twenty-five thousand, shall be for common use, for the city, for dwelling and for pasture lands; and the city shall be in the middle of it. (Ezekiel 48:15)

text: כֹּהֲנֶיהָ חָמְסוּ תוֹרָתִי וַיְחַלְּלוּ קָדָשַׁי בֵּֽין קֹדֶשׁ לְחֹל לֹא הִבְדִּילוּ וּבֵין הַטָּמֵא לְטָהוֹר לֹא הוֹדִיעוּ וּמִשַׁבְּתוֹתַי הֶעְלִימוּ עֵֽינֵיהֶם וָאֵחַל בְּתוֹכָֽם׃
translation: Her priests have done violence to my law and have profaned my holy things. They have made no distinction between the holy and the common, neither have they caused men to discern between the unclean and the clean, and have hidden their eyes from my Sabbaths. So I am profaned among them. (Ezekiel 22:26)

text: שִׁמְעוּ זֹאת כָּל הָֽעַמִּים הַאֲזִינוּ כָּל יֹשְׁבֵי חָֽלֶד׃
translation: both low and high, rich and poor together. (Psalms 49:2)

text: מַהְרַי הַנְּטֹפָתִי חֵלֶד בֶּֽן בַּֽעֲנָה הַנְּטוֹפָתִֽי׃
translation: Maharai the Netophathite, Heled the son of Baanah the Netophathite, (1 Chronicles 11:30)

text: וּֽמִצָּהֳרַיִם יָקוּם חָלֶד תָּעֻפָה כַּבֹּקֶר תִּהְיֶֽה׃
translation: Life will be clearer than the noonday. Though there is darkness, it will be as the morning. (Job 11:17)

text: זְכָר אֲנִי מֶה חָלֶד עַל מַה שָּׁוְא בָּרָאתָ כָל בְּנֵי אָדָֽם׃
translation: What man is he who shall live and not see death, who shall deliver his soul from the power of Sheol? Selah. (Psalms 89:48)

text: הִנֵּה טְפָחוֹת נָתַתָּה יָמַי וְחֶלְדִּי כְאַיִן נֶגְדֶּךָ אַךְ כָּֽל הֶבֶל כָּל אָדָם נִצָּב סֶֽלָה׃
translation: "Surely every man walks like a shadow. Surely they busy themselves in vain. He heaps up, and doesn't know who shall gather. (Psalms 39:6)

text: מִֽמְתִים יָדְךָ יְהוָה מִֽמְתִים מֵחֶלֶד חֶלְקָם בַּֽחַיִּים וצפינך וּֽצְפוּנְךָ תְּמַלֵּא בִטְנָם יִשְׂבְּעוּ בָנִים וְהִנִּיחוּ יִתְרָם לְעוֹלְלֵיהֶֽם׃
translation: from men by your hand, LORD, from men of the world, whose portion is in this life. You fill the belly of your cherished ones. Your sons have plenty, and they store up wealth for their children. (Psalms 17:14)

text: מִשְׁכָּב וְסַפּוֹת וּכְלִי יוֹצֵר וְחִטִּים וּשְׂעֹרִים וְקֶמַח וְקָלִי וּפוֹל וַעֲדָשִׁים וְקָלִֽי׃
translation: brought beds, basins, earthen vessels, wheat, barley, meal, parched grain, beans, lentils, roasted grain, (2 Samuel 17:28)

text: לְסַלַּי קַלָּי לְעָמוֹק עֵֽבֶר׃
translation: of Sallai, Kallai; of Amok, Eber; (Nehemiah 12:20)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר יִשַׁי לְדָוִד בְּנוֹ קַח נָא לְאַחֶיךָ אֵיפַת הַקָּלִיא הַזֶּה וַעֲשָׂרָה לֶחֶם הַזֶּה וְהָרֵץ הַֽמַּחֲנֶה לְאַחֶֽיךָ׃
translation: Jesse said to David his son, "Now take for your brothers an ephah of this parched grain and these ten loaves, and carry them quickly to the camp to your brothers; (1 Samuel 17:17)

text: וְלֶחֶם וְקָלִי וְכַרְמֶל לֹא תֹֽאכְלוּ עַד עֶצֶם הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה עַד הֲבִיאֲכֶם אֶת קָרְבַּן אֱלֹהֵיכֶם חֻקַּת עוֹלָם לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶם בְּכֹל מֹשְׁבֹֽתֵיכֶֽם׃
translation: You must not eat bread, or roasted grain, or fresh grain, until this same day, until you have brought the offering of your God. This is a statute forever throughout your generations in all your dwellings. (Leviticus 23:14)

text: מַרְבֶּה הוֹנוֹ בְּנֶשֶׁךְ ובתרבית וְתַרְבִּית לְחוֹנֵן דַּלִּים יִקְבְּצֶֽנּוּ׃
translation: He who increases his wealth by excessive interest gathers it for one who has pity on the poor. (Proverbs 28:8)

text: אַל תִּקַּח מֵֽאִתּוֹ נֶשֶׁךְ וְתַרְבִּית וְיָרֵאתָ מֵֽאֱלֹהֶיךָ וְחֵי אָחִיךָ עִמָּֽךְ׃
translation: Take no interest from him or profit; but fear your God, that your brother may live among you. (Leviticus 25:36)

text: בַּנֶּשֶׁךְ לֹֽא יִתֵּן וְתַרְבִּית לֹא יִקָּח מֵעָוֶל יָשִׁיב יָדוֹ מִשְׁפַּט אֱמֶת יַֽעֲשֶׂה בֵּין אִישׁ לְאִֽישׁ׃
translation: he who hasn't lent to them with interest, hasn't taken any increase from them, who has withdrawn his hand from iniquity, has executed true justice between man and man, (Ezekiel 18:8)

text: בַּנֶּשֶׁךְ נָתַן וְתַרְבִּית לָקַח וָחָי לֹא יִֽחְיֶה אֵת כָּל הַתּוֹעֵבוֹת הָאֵלֶּה עָשָׂה מוֹת יוּמָת דָּמָיו בּוֹ יִהְיֶֽה׃
translation: has lent with interest, and has taken increase from the poor, shall he then live? He shall not live. He has done all these abominations. He shall surely die. His blood will be on him. (Ezekiel 18:13)

text: שֹׁחַד לָֽקְחוּ בָךְ לְמַעַן שְׁפָךְ דָּם נֶשֶׁךְ וְתַרְבִּית לָקַחַתְּ וַתְּבַצְּעִי רֵעַיִךְ בַּעֹשֶׁק וְאֹתִי שָׁכַחַתְּ נְאֻם אֲדֹנָי יְהוִֽה׃
translation: In you have they taken bribes to shed blood. You have taken interest and increase, and you have greedily gained of your neighbors by oppression, and have forgotten me," says the Lord GOD. (Ezekiel 22:12)

text: מֵעָנִי הֵשִׁיב יָדוֹ נֶשֶׁךְ וְתַרְבִּית לֹא לָקָח מִשְׁפָּטַי עָשָׂה בְּחֻקּוֹתַי הָלָךְ הוּא לֹא יָמוּת בַּעֲוֺן אָבִיו חָיֹה יִחְיֶֽה׃
translation: who has withdrawn his hand from the poor, who hasn't received interest or increase, has executed my ordinances, has walked in my statutes; he shall not die for the iniquity of his father. He shall surely live. (Ezekiel 18:17)

text: יָמִים עַל שָׁנָה תִּרְגַּזְנָה בֹּֽטְחוֹת כִּי כָּלָה בָצִיר אֹסֶף בְּלִי יָבֽוֹא׃
translation: For days beyond a year you will be troubled, you careless women; for the vintage will fail. The harvest won't come. (Isaiah 32:10)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם מֶה עָשִׂיתִי עַתָּה כָּכֶם הֲלוֹא טוֹב עֹלְלוֹת אֶפְרַיִם מִבְצִיר אֲבִיעֶֽזֶר׃
translation: He said to them, "What have I now done in comparison with you? Isn't the gleaning of the grapes of Ephraim better than the vintage of Abiezer? (Judges 8:2)

text: כִּי כֹה יִהְיֶה בְּקֶרֶב הָאָרֶץ בְּתוֹךְ הָֽעַמִּים כְּנֹקֶף זַיִת כְּעוֹלֵלֹת אִם כָּלָה בָצִֽיר׃
translation: For it will be so within the earth among the peoples, as the shaking of an olive tree, as the gleanings when the vintage is done. (Isaiah 24:13)

text: אַלְלַי לִי כִּי הָיִיתִי כְּאָסְפֵּי קַיִץ כְּעֹלְלֹת בָּצִיר אֵין אֶשְׁכּוֹל לֶאֱכוֹל בִּכּוּרָה אִוְּתָה נַפְשִֽׁי׃
translation: Misery is mine! Indeed, I am like one who gathers the summer fruits, as gleanings of the vineyard. There is no cluster of grapes to eat. My soul desires to eat the early fig. (Micah 7:1)

text: וְהִשִּׂיג לָכֶם דַּיִשׁ אֶת בָּצִיר וּבָצִיר יַשִּׂיג אֶת זָרַע וַאֲכַלְתֶּם לַחְמְכֶם לָשֹׂבַע וִֽישַׁבְתֶּם לָבֶטַח בְּאַרְצְכֶֽם׃
translation: Your threshing shall continue until the vintage, and the vintage shall continue until the sowing time. You shall eat your bread to the full, and dwell in your land safely. (Leviticus 26:5)

text: מִבְּכִי יַעְזֵר אֶבְכֶּה לָּךְ הַגֶּפֶן שִׂבְמָה נְטִֽישֹׁתַיִךְ עָבְרוּ יָם עַד יָם יַעְזֵר נָגָעוּ עַל קֵיצֵךְ וְעַל בְּצִירֵךְ שֹׁדֵד נָפָֽל׃
translation: With more than the weeping of Jazer I will weep for you, vine of Sibmah. Your branches passed over the sea. They reached even to the sea of Jazer. The destroyer has fallen on your summer fruits and on your vintage. (Jeremiah 48:32)

text: וְאִם בְּאֵלֶּה לֹא תִוָּסְרוּ לִי וַהֲלַכְתֶּם עִמִּי קֶֽרִי׃
translation: "'If by these things you won't be turned back to me, but will walk contrary to me, (Leviticus 26:23)

text: וְאִם בְּזֹאת לֹא תִשְׁמְעוּ לִי וַהֲלַכְתֶּם עִמִּי בְּקֶֽרִי׃
translation: "'If you in spite of this won't listen to me, but walk contrary to me, (Leviticus 26:27)

text: וְהָלַכְתִּי עִמָּכֶם בַּחֲמַת קֶרִי וְיִסַּרְתִּי אֶתְכֶם אַף אָנִי שֶׁבַע עַל חַטֹּאתֵיכֶם׃
translation: then I will walk contrary to you in wrath. I will also chastise you seven times for your sins. (Leviticus 26:28)

text: וְהָלַכְתִּי אַף אֲנִי עִמָּכֶם בְּקֶרִי וְהִכֵּיתִי אֶתְכֶם גַּם אָנִי שֶׁבַע עַל חַטֹּאתֵיכֶֽם׃
translation: then I will also walk contrary to you; and I will strike you, even I, seven times for your sins. (Leviticus 26:24)

text: וְאִם תֵּֽלְכוּ עִמִּי קֶרִי וְלֹא תֹאבוּ לִשְׁמֹעַֽ לִי וְיָסַפְתִּי עֲלֵיכֶם מַכָּה שֶׁבַע כְּחַטֹּאתֵיכֶֽם׃
translation: "'If you walk contrary to me, and won't listen to me, then I will bring seven times more plagues on you according to your sins. (Leviticus 26:21)

text: וְהִתְוַדּוּ אֶת עֲוֺנָם וְאֶת עֲוֺן אֲבֹתָם בְּמַעֲלָם אֲשֶׁר מָֽעֲלוּ בִי וְאַף אֲשֶׁר הָֽלְכוּ עִמִּי בְּקֶֽרִי׃
translation: "'If they confess their iniquity and the iniquity of their fathers, in their trespass which they trespassed against me; and also that because they walked contrary to me, (Leviticus 26:40)

text: אִישׁ תּוֹכָחוֹת מַקְשֶׁה עֹרֶף פֶּתַע יִשָּׁבֵר וְאֵין מַרְפֵּֽא׃
translation: He who is often rebuked and stiffens his neck will be destroyed suddenly, with no remedy. (Proverbs 29:1)

text: עַל כֵּן פִּתְאֹם יָבוֹא אֵידוֹ פֶּתַע יִשָּׁבֵר וְאֵין מַרְפֵּֽא׃
translation: Therefore his calamity will come suddenly. He will be broken suddenly, and that without remedy. (Proverbs 6:15)

text: וְאִם בְּפֶתַע בְּלֹא אֵיבָה הֲדָפוֹ אוֹ הִשְׁלִיךְ עָלָיו כָּל כְּלִי בְּלֹא צְדִיָּֽה׃
translation: "'But if he shoved him suddenly without hostility, or hurled on him anything without lying in wait, (Numbers 35:22)

text: לָכֵן יִֽהְיֶה לָכֶם הֶעָוֺן הַזֶּה כְּפֶרֶץ נֹפֵל נִבְעֶה בְּחוֹמָה נִשְׂגָּבָה אֲשֶׁר פִּתְאֹם לְפֶתַע יָבוֹא שִׁבְרָֽהּ׃
translation: therefore this iniquity shall be to you like a breach ready to fall, swelling out in a high wall, whose breaking comes suddenly in an instant. (Isaiah 30:13)

text: וְכִֽי יָמוּת מֵת עָלָיו בְּפֶתַע פִּתְאֹם וְטִמֵּא רֹאשׁ נִזְרוֹ וְגִלַּח רֹאשׁוֹ בְּיוֹם טָהֳרָתוֹ בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי יְגַלְּחֶֽנּוּ׃
translation: "'If any man dies very suddenly beside him, and he defiles the head of his separation, then he shall shave his head in the day of his cleansing. On the seventh day he shall shave it. (Numbers 6:9)

text: מִקּוֹל מְחָרֵף וּמְגַדֵּף מִפְּנֵי אוֹיֵב וּמִתְנַקֵּֽם׃
translation: All this has come on us, yet we haven't forgotten you. We haven't been false to your covenant. (Psalms 44:17)

text: אֶת מִי חֵרַפְתָּ וְגִדַּפְתָּ וְעַל מִי הֲרִימוֹתָ קּוֹל וַתִּשָּׂא מָרוֹם עֵינֶיךָ עַל קְדוֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
translation: Whom have you defied and blasphemed? Against whom have you exalted your voice and lifted up your eyes on high? Against the Holy One of Israel! (2 Kings 19:22)

text: אֶת מִי חֵרַפְתָּ וְגִדַּפְתָּ וְעַל מִי הֲרִימוֹתָה קּוֹל וַתִּשָּׂא מָרוֹם עֵינֶיךָ אֶל קְדוֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
translation: Whom have you defied and blasphemed? Against whom have you exalted your voice and lifted up your eyes on high? Against the Holy One of Israel. (Isaiah 37:23)

text: וְהַנֶּפֶשׁ אֲשֶֽׁר תַּעֲשֶׂה בְּיָד רָמָה מִן הָֽאֶזְרָח וּמִן הַגֵּר אֶת יְהוָה הוּא מְגַדֵּף וְנִכְרְתָה הַנֶּפֶשׁ הַהִוא מִקֶּרֶב עַמָּֽהּ׃
translation: "'But the soul who does anything with a high hand, whether he is native-born or a foreigner, blasphemes the LORD. That soul shall be cut off from among his people. (Numbers 15:30)

text: הֲשָׁכַח חַנּוֹת אֵל אִם קָפַץ בְּאַף רַחֲמָיו סֶֽלָה׃
translation: Then I thought, "I will appeal to this: the years of the right hand of the Most High." (Psalms 77:10)

text: יִרְאוּ יְשָׁרִים וְיִשְׂמָחוּ וְכָל עַוְלָה קָפְצָה פִּֽיהָ׃
translation: The upright will see it, and be glad. All the wicked will shut their mouths. (Psalms 107:42)

text: וַתְּהִי לַדַּל תִּקְוָה וְעֹלָתָה קָפְצָה פִּֽיהָ׃
translation: So the poor has hope, and injustice shuts her mouth. (Job 5:16)

text: קוֹל דּוֹדִי הִנֵּה זֶה בָּא מְדַלֵּג עַל הֶהָרִים מְקַפֵּץ עַל הַגְּבָעֽוֹת׃
translation: The voice of my beloved! Behold, he comes, leaping on the mountains, skipping on the hills. (Song of Solomon 2:8)

text: כֵּן יַזֶּה גּוֹיִם רַבִּים עָלָיו יִקְפְּצוּ מְלָכִים פִּיהֶם כִּי אֲשֶׁר לֹֽא סֻפַּר לָהֶם רָאוּ וַאֲשֶׁר לֹֽא שָׁמְעוּ הִתְבּוֹנָֽנוּ׃
translation: so he will cleanse many nations. Kings will shut their mouths at him; for they will see that which had not been told them, and they will understand that which they had not heard. (Isaiah 52:15)

text: לֹֽא יָבֹא פְצֽוּעַ דַּכָּא וּכְרוּת שָׁפְכָה בִּקְהַל יְהוָֽה׃
translation: A person born of a forbidden union shall not enter into the LORD's assembly; even to the tenth generation shall no one of his enter into the LORD's assembly. (Deuteronomy 23:2)

text: ודכה יִדְכֶּה יָשֹׁחַ וְנָפַל בַּעֲצוּמָיו חלכאים חֵיל כָּאִֽים׃
translation: The helpless are crushed. They collapse. They fall under his strength. (Psalms 10:10)

text: נְפוּגוֹתִי וְנִדְכֵּיתִי עַד מְאֹד שָׁאַגְתִּי מִֽנַּהֲמַת לִבִּֽי׃
translation: Lord, all my desire is before you. My groaning is not hidden from you. (Psalms 38:9)

text: כִּי דִכִּיתָנוּ בִּמְקוֹם תַּנִּים וַתְּכַס עָלֵינוּ בְצַלְמָֽוֶת׃
translation: If we have forgotten the name of our God, or spread out our hands to a strange god, (Psalms 44:20)

text: תַּשְׁמִיעֵנִי שָׂשׂוֹן וְשִׂמְחָה תָּגֵלְנָה עֲצָמוֹת דִּכִּֽיתָ׃
translation: Create in me a clean heart, O God. Renew a right spirit within me. (Psalms 51:10)

text: זִֽבְחֵי אֱלֹהִים רוּחַ נִשְׁבָּרָה לֵב נִשְׁבָּר וְנִדְכֶּה אֱלֹהִים לֹא תִבְזֶֽה׃
translation: Then you will delight in the sacrifices of righteousness, in burnt offerings and in whole burnt offerings. Then they will offer bulls on your altar. (Psalms 51:19)

text: וְהָיִיתָ מְשֻׁגָּע מִמַּרְאֵה עֵינֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר תִּרְאֶֽה׃
translation: so that the sights that you see with your eyes will drive you mad. (Deuteronomy 28:34)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר אָכִישׁ אֶל עֲבָדָיו הִנֵּה תִרְאוּ אִישׁ מִשְׁתַּגֵּעַ לָמָּה תָּבִיאוּ אֹתוֹ אֵלָֽי׃
translation: Do I lack madmen, that you have brought this fellow to play the madman in my presence? Should this fellow come into my house?" (1 Samuel 21:15)

text: בָּאוּ יְמֵי הַפְּקֻדָּה בָּאוּ יְמֵי הַשִׁלֻּם יֵדְעוּ יִשְׂרָאֵל אֱוִיל הַנָּבִיא מְשֻׁגָּע אִישׁ הָרוּחַ עַל רֹב עֲוֺנְךָ וְרַבָּה מַשְׂטֵמָֽה׃
translation: The days of visitation have come. The days of reckoning have come. Israel will consider the prophet to be a fool, and the man who is inspired to be insane, because of the abundance of your sins, and because your hostility is great. (Hosea 9:7)

text: יְהוָה נְתָנְךָ כֹהֵן תַּחַת יְהוֹיָדָע הַכֹּהֵן לִֽהְיוֹת פְּקִדִים בֵּית יְהוָה לְכָל אִישׁ מְשֻׁגָּע וּמִתְנַבֵּא וְנָתַתָּה אֹתוֹ אֶל הַמַּהְפֶּכֶת וְאֶל הַצִּינֹֽק׃
translation: "The LORD has made you priest in the place of Jehoiada the priest, that there may be officers in the LORD's house, for every man who is crazy and makes himself a prophet, that you should put him in the stocks and in shackles. (Jeremiah 29:26)

text: הַעֵת לָכֶם אַתֶּם לָשֶׁבֶת בְּבָתֵּיכֶם סְפוּנִים וְהַבַּיִת הַזֶּה חָרֵֽב׃
translation: "Is it a time for you yourselves to dwell in your paneled houses, while this house lies waste? (Haggai 1:4)

text: וַיִּבֶן אֶת הַבַּיִת וַיְכַלֵּהוּ וַיִּסְפֹּן אֶת הַבַּיִת גֵּבִים וּשְׂדֵרֹת בָּאֲרָזִֽים׃
translation: So he built the house and finished it; and he covered the house with beams and planks of cedar. (1 Kings 6:9)

text: וְסָפֻן בָּאֶרֶז מִמַּעַל עַל הַצְּלָעֹת אֲשֶׁר עַל הָֽעַמּוּדִים אַרְבָּעִים וַחֲמִשָּׁה חֲמִשָּׁה עָשָׂר הַטּֽוּר׃
translation: It was covered with cedar above over the forty-five beams that were on the pillars, fifteen in a row. (1 Kings 7:3)

text: הָאֹמֵר אֶבְנֶה לִּי בֵּית מִדּוֹת וַעֲלִיּוֹת מְרֻוָּחִים וְקָרַֽע לוֹ חַלּוֹנָי וְסָפוּן בָּאָרֶז וּמָשׁוֹחַ בַּשָּׁשַֽׁר׃
translation: who says, 'I will build myself a wide house and spacious rooms,' and cuts out windows for himself, with a cedar ceiling, and painted with red. (Jeremiah 22:14)

text: וַיַּרְא רֵאשִׁית לוֹ כִּי שָׁם חֶלְקַת מְחֹקֵק סָפוּן וַיֵּתֵא רָאשֵׁי עָם צִדְקַת יְהוָה עָשָׂה וּמִשְׁפָּטָיו עִם יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
translation: He provided the first part for himself, for the lawgiver's portion was reserved for him. He came with the heads of the people. He executed the righteousness of the LORD, His ordinances with Israel." (Deuteronomy 33:21)

text: הַֽחָכְמָה וְהַמַּדָּע נָתוּן לָךְ וְעֹשֶׁר וּנְכָסִים וְכָבוֹד אֶתֶּן לָךְ אֲשֶׁר לֹא הָיָה כֵן לַמְּלָכִים אֲשֶׁר לְפָנֶיךָ וְאַחֲרֶיךָ לֹא יִֽהְיֶה כֵּֽן׃
translation: therefore wisdom and knowledge is granted to you. I will give you riches, wealth, and honor, such as none of the kings have had who have been before you, and none after you will have." (2 Chronicles 1:12)

text: אֹגֵר בַּקַּיִץ בֵּן מַשְׂכִּיל נִרְדָּם בַּקָּצִיר בֵּן מֵבִֽישׁ׃
translation: He who gathers in summer is a wise son, but he who sleeps during the harvest is a son who causes shame. (Proverbs 10:5)

text: מִגַּעֲרָתְךָ אֱלֹהֵי יַעֲקֹב נִרְדָּם וְרֶכֶב וָסֽוּס׃
translation: You, even you, are to be feared. Who can stand in your sight when you are angry? (Psalms 76:7)

text: וּבְדַבְּרוֹ עִמִּי נִרְדַּמְתִּי עַל פָּנַי אָרְצָה וַיִּגַּע בִּי וַיַּֽעֲמִידֵנִי עַל עָמְדִֽי׃
translation: Now as he was speaking with me, I fell into a deep sleep with my face toward the ground; but he touched me and set me upright. (Daniel 8:18)

text: וָאֶשְׁמַע אֶת קוֹל דְּבָרָיו וּכְשָׁמְעִי אֶת קוֹל דְּבָרָיו וַאֲנִי הָיִיתִי נִרְדָּם עַל פָּנַי וּפָנַי אָֽרְצָה׃
translation: Yet I heard the voice of his words. When I heard the voice of his words, then I fell into a deep sleep on my face, with my face toward the ground. (Daniel 10:9)

text: וַיִּקְרַב אֵלָיו רַב הַחֹבֵל וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ מַה לְּךָ נִרְדָּם קוּם קְרָא אֶל אֱלֹהֶיךָ אוּלַי יִתְעַשֵּׁת הָאֱלֹהִים לָנוּ וְלֹא נֹאבֵֽד׃
translation: So the ship master came to him, and said to him, "What do you mean, sleeper? Arise, call on your God! Maybe your God will notice us, so that we won't perish." (Jonah 1:6)

text: כִּֽי הֵמָּה עָלוּ אַשּׁוּר פֶּרֶא בּוֹדֵד לוֹ אֶפְרַיִם הִתְנוּ אֲהָבִֽים׃
translation: For they have gone up to Assyria, like a wild donkey wandering alone. Ephraim has hired lovers for himself. (Hosea 8:9)

text: גַּם כִּֽי יִתְנוּ בַגּוֹיִם עַתָּה אֲקַבְּצֵם וַיָּחֵלּוּ מְּעָט מִמַּשָּׂא מֶלֶךְ שָׂרִֽים׃
translation: But although they sold themselves among the nations, I will now gather them; and they begin to waste away because of the oppression of the king of mighty ones. (Hosea 8:10)

text: וְאֶת עֵשָׂו שָׂנֵאתִי וָאָשִׂים אֶת הָרָיו שְׁמָמָה וְאֶת נַחֲלָתוֹ לְתַנּוֹת מִדְבָּֽר׃
translation: but Esau I hated, and made his mountains a desolation, and gave his heritage to the jackals of the wilderness." (Malachi 1:3)

text: מִיָּמִים יָמִימָה תֵּלַכְנָה בְּנוֹת יִשְׂרָאֵל לְתַנּוֹת לְבַת יִפְתָּח הַגִּלְעָדִי אַרְבַּעַת יָמִים בַּשָּׁנָֽה׃
translation: that the daughters of Israel went yearly to celebrate the daughter of Jephthah the Gileadite four days in a year. (Judges 11:40)

text: גַּם תנין תַּנִּים חָלְצוּ שַׁד הֵינִיקוּ גּוּרֵיהֶן בַּת עַמִּי לְאַכְזָר כי ענים כַּיְעֵנִים בַּמִּדְבָּֽר׃
translation: Even the jackals offer their breast. They nurse their young ones. But the daughter of my people has become cruel, like the ostriches in the wilderness. (Lamentations 4:3)

text: מִקּוֹל מְחַֽצְצִים בֵּין מַשְׁאַבִּים שָׁם יְתַנּוּ צִדְקוֹת יְהוָה צִדְקֹת פִּרְזֹנוֹ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל אָז יָרְדוּ לַשְּׁעָרִים עַם יְהוָֽה׃
translation: Far from the noise of archers, in the places of drawing water, there they will rehearse the LORD's righteous acts, the righteous acts of his rule in Israel. "Then the LORD's people went down to the gates. (Judges 5:11)

text: וַיִּשְׁטֹף אֶת הָרֶכֶב עַל בְּרֵכַת שֹׁמְרוֹן וַיָּלֹקּוּ הַכְּלָבִים אֶת דָּמוֹ וְהַזֹּנוֹת רָחָצוּ כִּדְבַר יְהוָה אֲשֶׁר דִּבֵּֽר׃
translation: They washed the chariot by the pool of Samaria; and the dogs licked up his blood where the prostitutes washed themselves, according to the LORD's word which he spoke. (1 Kings 22:38)

text: וַיְהִי מִסְפַּר הַֽמֲלַקְקִים בְּיָדָם אֶל פִּיהֶם שְׁלֹשׁ מֵאוֹת אִישׁ וְכֹל יֶתֶר הָעָם כָּרְעוּ עַל בִּרְכֵיהֶם לִשְׁתּוֹת מָֽיִם׃
translation: The number of those who lapped, putting their hand to their mouth, was three hundred men; but all the rest of the people bowed down on their knees to drink water. (Judges 7:6)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֶל גִּדְעוֹן בִּשְׁלֹשׁ מֵאוֹת הָאִישׁ הַֽמֲלַקְקִים אוֹשִׁיעַ אֶתְכֶם וְנָתַתִּי אֶת מִדְיָן בְּיָדֶךָ וְכָל הָעָם יֵלְכוּ אִישׁ לִמְקֹמֽוֹ׃
translation: The LORD said to Gideon, "I will save you by the three hundred men who lapped, and deliver the Midianites into your hand. Let all the other people go, each to his own place." (Judges 7:7)

text: סָלִיתָ כָּל שׁוֹגִים מֵחֻקֶּיךָ כִּי שֶׁקֶר תַּרְמִיתָֽם׃
translation: You reject all those who stray from your statutes, for their deceit is in vain. (Psalms 119:118)

text: עַד מָתַי הֲיֵשׁ בְּלֵב הַנְּבִאִים נִבְּאֵי הַשָּׁקֶר וּנְבִיאֵי תַּרְמִת לִבָּֽם׃
translation: How long will this be in the heart of the prophets who prophesy lies, even the prophets of the deceit of their own heart? (Jeremiah 23:26)

text: מַדּוּעַ שׁוֹבְבָה הָעָם הַזֶּה יְרוּשָׁלִַם מְשֻׁבָה נִצַּחַת הֶחֱזִיקוּ בַּתַּרְמִית מֵאֲנוּ לָשֽׁוּב׃
translation: Why then have the people of Jerusalem fallen back by a perpetual backsliding? They cling to deceit. They refuse to return. (Jeremiah 8:5)

text: וַיִּשְׁלַח מַלְאָכִים אֶל אֲבִימֶלֶךְ בְּתָרְמָה לֵאמֹר הִנֵּה גַעַל בֶּן עֶבֶד וְאֶחָיו בָּאִים שְׁכֶמָה וְהִנָּם צָרִים אֶת הָעִיר עָלֶֽיךָ׃
translation: He sent messengers to Abimelech craftily, saying, "Behold, Gaal the son of Ebed and his brothers have come to Shechem; and behold, they incite the city against you. (Judges 9:31)

text: שְׁאֵרִית יִשְׂרָאֵל לֹֽא יַעֲשׂוּ עַוְלָה וְלֹא יְדַבְּרוּ כָזָב וְלֹֽא יִמָּצֵא בְּפִיהֶם לְשׁוֹן תַּרְמִית כִּֽי הֵמָּה יִרְעוּ וְרָבְצוּ וְאֵין מַחֲרִֽיד׃
translation: The remnant of Israel will not do iniquity nor speak lies, neither will a deceitful tongue be found in their mouth, for they will feed and lie down, and no one will make them afraid." (Zephaniah 3:13)

text: הָאֹֽכְלִים לְמַעֲדַנִּים נָשַׁמּוּ בַּחוּצוֹת הָאֱמֻנִים עֲלֵי תוֹלָע חִבְּקוּ אַשְׁפַּתּֽוֹת׃
translation: Those who ate delicacies are desolate in the streets. Those who were brought up in purple embrace dunghills. (Lamentations 4:5)

text: מְקִֽימִי מֵעָפָר דָּל מֵֽאַשְׁפֹּת יָרִים אֶבְיֽוֹן׃
translation: He raises up the poor out of the dust, and lifts up the needy from the ash heap, (Psalms 113:7)

text: וָאַעֲלֶה אֶת שָׂרֵי יְהוּדָה מֵעַל לַחוֹמָה וָאַעֲמִידָה שְׁתֵּי תוֹדֹת גְּדוֹלֹת וְתַהֲלֻכֹת לַיָּמִין מֵעַל לַחוֹמָה לְשַׁעַר הָאַשְׁפֹּֽת׃
translation: Then I brought the princes of Judah up on the wall, and appointed two great companies who gave thanks and went in procession. One went on the right hand on the wall toward the dung gate; (Nehemiah 12:31)

text: וְאֵת שַׁעַר הָאַשְׁפּוֹת הֶחֱזִיק מַלְכִּיָּה בֶן רֵכָב שַׂר פֶּלֶךְ בֵּית הַכָּרֶם הוּא יִבְנֶנּוּ וְיַעֲמִיד דַּלְתֹתָיו מַנְעֻלָיו וּבְרִיחָֽיו׃
translation: Malchijah the son of Rechab, the ruler of the district of Beth Haccherem, repaired the dung gate. He built it, and set up its doors, its bolts, and its bars. (Nehemiah 3:14)

text: מֵקִים מֵעָפָר דָּל מֵֽאַשְׁפֹּת יָרִים אֶבְיוֹן לְהוֹשִׁיב עִם נְדִיבִים וְכִסֵּא כָבוֹד יַנְחִלֵם כִּי לַֽיהוָה מְצֻקֵי אֶרֶץ וַיָּשֶׁת עֲלֵיהֶם תֵּבֵֽל׃
translation: He raises up the poor out of the dust. He lifts up the needy from the dunghill to make them sit with princes and inherit the throne of glory. For the pillars of the earth are the LORD's. He has set the world on them. (1 Samuel 2:8)

text: אֵת שַׁעַר הַגַּיְא הֶחֱזִיק חָנוּן וְיֹשְׁבֵי זָנוֹחַ הֵמָּה בָנוּהוּ וַֽיַּעֲמִידוּ דַּלְתֹתָיו מַנְעֻלָיו וּבְרִיחָיו וְאֶלֶף אַמָּה בַּחוֹמָה עַד שַׁעַר הָשֲׁפֽוֹת׃
translation: Hanun and the inhabitants of Zanoah repaired the valley gate. They built it, and set up its doors, its bolts, and its bars, and one thousand cubits of the wall to the dung gate. (Nehemiah 3:13)

text: וַתְּחַסְּרֵהוּ מְּעַט מֵאֱלֹהִים וְכָבוֹד וְהָדָר תְּעַטְּרֵֽהוּ׃
translation: You make him ruler over the works of your hands. You have put all things under his feet: (Psalms 8:6)

text: עִטַּרְתָּ שְׁנַת טוֹבָתֶךָ וּמַעְגָּלֶיךָ יִרְעֲפוּן דָּֽשֶׁן׃
translation: The wilderness grasslands overflow. The hills are clothed with gladness. (Psalms 65:12)

text: הַגּוֹאֵל מִשַּׁחַת חַיָּיְכִי הַֽמְעַטְּרֵכִי חֶסֶד וְרַחֲמִֽים׃
translation: who redeems your life from destruction, who crowns you with loving kindness and tender mercies, (Psalms 103:4)

text: מִי יָעַץ זֹאת עַל צֹר הַמַּֽעֲטִירָה אֲשֶׁר סֹחֲרֶיה שָׂרִים כִּנְעָנֶיהָ נִכְבַּדֵּי אָֽרֶץ׃
translation: Who has planned this against Tyre, the giver of crowns, whose merchants are princes, whose traders are the honorable of the earth? (Isaiah 23:8)

text: צְאֶינָה וּֽרְאֶינָה בְּנוֹת צִיּוֹן בַּמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה בָּעֲטָרָה שֶׁעִטְּרָה לּוֹ אִמּוֹ בְּיוֹם חֲתֻנָּתוֹ וּבְיוֹם שִׂמְחַת לִבּֽוֹ׃
translation: Go out, you daughters of Zion, and see King Solomon, with the crown with which his mother has crowned him, in the day of his weddings, in the day of the gladness of his heart. (Song of Solomon 3:11)

text: וַיַּבֵּט וְהִנֵּה מְרַאֲשֹׁתָיו עֻגַת רְצָפִים וְצַפַּחַת מָיִם וַיֹּאכַל וַיֵּשְׁתְּ וַיָּשָׁב וַיִּשְׁכָּֽב׃
translation: He looked, and behold, there was at his head a cake baked on the coals, and a jar of water. He ate and drank, and lay down again. (1 Kings 19:6)

text: כַּד הַקֶּמַח לֹא כָלָתָה וְצַפַּחַת הַשֶּׁמֶן לֹא חָסֵר כִּדְבַר יְהוָה אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר בְּיַד אֵלִיָּֽהוּ׃
translation: The jar of meal didn't run out and the jar of oil didn't fail, according to the LORD's word, which he spoke by Elijah. (1 Kings 17:16)

text: חָלִילָה לִּי מֵֽיהוָה מִשְּׁלֹחַ יָדִי בִּמְשִׁיחַ יְהוָה וְעַתָּה קַח נָא אֶֽת הַחֲנִית אֲשֶׁר מראשתו מְרַאֲשֹׁתָיו וְאֶת צַפַּחַת הַמַּיִם וְנֵלֲכָה לָּֽנוּ׃
translation: The LORD forbid that I should stretch out my hand against the LORD's anointed; but now please take the spear that is at his head and the jar of water, and let's go." (1 Samuel 26:11)

text: וּבְנָיָהוּ בֶּן יְהוֹיָדָע וְהַכְּרֵתִי וְהַפְּלֵתִי וּבְנֵי דָוִד כֹּהֲנִים הָיֽוּ׃
translation: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and David's sons were chief ministers. (2 Samuel 8:18)

text: וּבְנָיָהוּ בֶּן יְהוֹיָדָע עַל הַכְּרֵתִי וְהַפְּלֵתִי וּבְנֵי דָוִיד הָרִאשֹׁנִים לְיַד הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
translation: and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and the sons of David were chief officials serving the king. (1 Chronicles 18:17)

text: וְיוֹאָב אֶל כָּל הַצָּבָא יִשְׂרָאֵל וּבְנָיָה בֶּן יְהוֹיָדָע עַל הכרי הַכְּרֵתִי וְעַל הַפְּלֵתִֽי׃
translation: Now Joab was over all the army of Israel, Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and over the Pelethites, (2 Samuel 20:23)

text: וַיֵּצְאוּ אַֽחֲרָיו אַנְשֵׁי יוֹאָב וְהַכְּרֵתִי וְהַפְּלֵתִי וְכָל הַגִּבֹּרִים וַיֵּֽצְאוּ מִירוּשָׁלִַם לִרְדֹּף אַחֲרֵי שֶׁבַע בֶּן בִּכְרִֽי׃
translation: Joab's men went out after him with the Cherethites, the Pelethites, and all the mighty men; and they went out of Jerusalem to pursue Sheba the son of Bichri. (2 Samuel 20:7)

text: וַיִּשְׁלַח אִתּֽוֹ הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת צָדוֹק הַכֹּהֵן וְאֶת נָתָן הַנָּבִיא וּבְנָיָהוּ בֶּן יְהוֹיָדָע וְהַכְּרֵתִי וְהַפְּלֵתִי וַיַּרְכִּבוּ אֹתוֹ עַל פִּרְדַּת הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
translation: The king has sent with him Zadok the priest, Nathan the prophet, Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and they have caused him to ride on the king's mule. (1 Kings 1:44)

text: חֶלֶץ הַפַּלְטִי עִירָא בֶן עִקֵּשׁ הַתְּקוֹעִֽי׃
translation: Helez the Paltite, Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite, (2 Samuel 23:26)

text: עִירָא בֶן עִקֵּשׁ הַתְּקוֹעִי אֲבִיעֶזֶר הָעֲנְּתוֹתִֽי׃
translation: Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite, Abiezer the Anathothite, (1 Chronicles 11:28)

text: וְעַל יָדָם הֶחֱזִיקוּ הַתְּקוֹעִים וְאַדִּֽירֵיהֶם לֹא הֵבִיאוּ צַוָּרָם בַּעֲבֹדַת אֲדֹנֵיהֶֽם׃
translation: Next to them, the Tekoites made repairs; but their nobles didn't put their necks to the Lord's work. (Nehemiah 3:5)

text: הַשִּׁשִּׁי לַחֹדֶשׁ הַשִּׁשִּׁי עִירָא בֶן עִקֵּשׁ הַתְּקוֹעִי וְעַל מַחֲלֻקְתּוֹ עֶשְׂרִים וְאַרְבָּעָה אָֽלֶף׃
translation: The sixth captain for the sixth month was Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite. In his division were twenty-four thousand. (1 Chronicles 27:9)

text: אַחֲרָיו הֶחֱזִיקוּ הַתְּקֹעִים מִדָּה שֵׁנִית מִנֶּגֶד הַמִּגְדָּל הַגָּדוֹל הַיּוֹצֵא וְעַד חוֹמַת הָעֹֽפֶל׃
translation: After him the Tekoites repaired another portion, opposite the great tower that stands out, and to the wall of Ophel. (Nehemiah 3:27)

text: וַתֹּאמֶר הָאִשָּׁה הַתְּקֹעִית אֶל הַמֶּלֶךְ וַתִּפֹּל עַל אַפֶּיהָ אַרְצָה וַתִּשְׁתָּחוּ וַתֹּאמֶר הוֹשִׁעָה הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
translation: When the woman of Tekoa spoke to the king, she fell on her face to the ground, showed respect, and said, "Help, O king!" (2 Samuel 14:4)

text: וְֽלֹא אָמַר אַיֵּה אֱלוֹהַּ עֹשָׂי נֹתֵן זְמִרוֹת בַּלָּֽיְלָה׃
translation: But no one says, 'Where is God my Maker, who gives songs in the night, (Job 35:10)

text: נְקַדְּמָה פָנָיו בְּתוֹדָה בִּזְמִרוֹת נָרִיעַֽ לֽוֹ׃
translation: Let's come before his presence with thanksgiving. Let's extol him with songs! (Psalms 95:2)

text: זְמִרוֹת הָֽיוּ לִי חֻקֶּיךָ בְּבֵית מְגוּרָֽי׃
translation: Your statutes have been my songs in the house where I live. (Psalms 119:54)

text: הַנִּצָּנִים נִרְאוּ בָאָרֶץ עֵת הַזָּמִיר הִגִּיעַ וְקוֹל הַתּוֹר נִשְׁמַע בְּאַרְצֵֽנוּ׃
translation: The flowers appear on the earth. The time of the singing has come, and the voice of the turtledove is heard in our land. (Song of Solomon 2:12)

text: כְּחֹרֶב בְּצָיוֹן שְׁאוֹן זָרִים תַּכְנִיעַ חֹרֶב בְּצֵל עָב זְמִיר עָֽרִיצִים יַעֲנֶֽה׃
translation: As the heat in a dry place you will bring down the noise of strangers; as the heat by the shade of a cloud, the song of the dreaded ones will be brought low. (Isaiah 25:5)

text: וְאֵלֶּה דִּבְרֵי דָוִד הָאַֽחֲרֹנִים נְאֻם דָּוִד בֶּן יִשַׁי וּנְאֻם הַגֶּבֶר הֻקַם עָל מְשִׁיחַ אֱלֹהֵי יַֽעֲקֹב וּנְעִים זְמִרוֹת יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
translation: Now these are the last words of David. David the son of Jesse says, the man who was raised on high says, the anointed of the God of Jacob, the sweet psalmist of Israel: (2 Samuel 23:1)

text: כֹּֽבֶד אֶבֶן וְנֵטֶל הַחוֹל וְכַעַס אֱוִיל כָּבֵד מִשְּׁנֵיהֶֽם׃
translation: A stone is heavy, and sand is a burden; but a fool's provocation is heavier than both. (Proverbs 27:3)

text: יֵשֵׁב בָּדָד וְיִדֹּם כִּי נָטַל עָלָֽיו׃
translation: Let him sit alone and keep silence, because he has laid it on him. (Lamentations 3:28)

text: הֵן גּוֹיִם כְּמַר מִדְּלִי וּכְשַׁחַק מֹאזְנַיִם נֶחְשָׁבוּ הֵן אִיִּים כַּדַּק יִטּֽוֹל׃
translation: Behold, the nations are like a drop in a bucket, and are regarded as a speck of dust on a balance. Behold, he lifts up the islands like a very little thing. (Isaiah 40:15)

text: הָלוֹךְ וְדִבַּרְתָּ אֶל דָּוִד כֹּה אָמַר יְהוָה שָׁלֹשׁ אָנֹכִי נוֹטֵל עָלֶיךָ בְּחַר לְךָ אַֽחַת מֵהֶם וְאֶֽעֱשֶׂה לָּֽךְ׃
translation: "Go and speak to David, 'The LORD says, "I offer you three things. Choose one of them, that I may do it to you."'" (2 Samuel 24:12)

text: בְּֽכָל צָרָתָם לא לוֹ צָר וּמַלְאַךְ פָּנָיו הֽוֹשִׁיעָם בְּאַהֲבָתוֹ וּבְחֶמְלָתוֹ הוּא גְאָלָם וַֽיְנַטְּלֵם וַֽיְנַשְּׂאֵם כָּל יְמֵי עוֹלָֽם׃
translation: In all their affliction he was afflicted, and the angel of his presence saved them. In his love and in his pity he redeemed them. He bore them, and carried them all the days of old. (Isaiah 63:9)

text: הָפַכְתָּ מִסְפְּדִי לְמָחוֹל לִי פִּתַּחְתָּ שַׂקִּי וַֽתְּאַזְּרֵנִי שִׂמְחָֽה׃
translation: to the end that my heart may sing praise to you, and not be silent. LORD my God, I will give thanks to you forever! (Psalms 30:12)

text: יְהַֽלְלוּ שְׁמוֹ בְמָחוֹל בְּתֹף וְכִנּוֹר יְזַמְּרוּ לֽוֹ׃
translation: Let them praise his name in the dance! Let them sing praises to him with tambourine and harp! (Psalms 149:3)

text: הַֽלְלוּהוּ בְתֹף וּמָחוֹל הַֽלְלוּהוּ בְּמִנִּים וְעוּגָֽב׃
translation: Praise him with tambourine and dancing! Praise him with stringed instruments and flute! (Psalms 150:4)

text: שָׁבַת מְשׂוֹשׂ לִבֵּנוּ נֶהְפַּךְ לְאֵבֶל מְחֹלֵֽנוּ׃
translation: The joy of our heart has ceased. Our dance is turned into mourning. (Lamentations 5:15)

text: עוֹד אֶבְנֵךְ וְֽנִבְנֵית בְּתוּלַת יִשְׂרָאֵל עוֹד תַּעְדִּי תֻפַּיִךְ וְיָצָאת בִּמְחוֹל מְשַׂחֲקִֽים׃
translation: I will build you again, and you will be built, O virgin of Israel. You will again be adorned with your tambourines, and will go out in the dances of those who make merry. (Jeremiah 31:4)

text: אָז תִּשְׂמַח בְּתוּלָה בְּמָחוֹל וּבַחֻרִים וּזְקֵנִים יַחְדָּו וְהָפַכְתִּי אֶבְלָם לְשָׂשׂוֹן וְנִחַמְתִּים וְשִׂמַּחְתִּים מִיגוֹנָֽם׃
translation: Then the virgin will rejoice in the dance, the young men and the old together; for I will turn their mourning into joy, and will comfort them, and make them rejoice from their sorrow. (Jeremiah 31:13)

text: לְבֵנִים נָפָלוּ וְגָזִית נִבְנֶה שִׁקְמִים גֻּדָּעוּ וַאֲרָזִים נַחֲלִֽיף׃
translation: All the people will know, including Ephraim and the inhabitants of Samaria, who say in pride and in arrogance of heart, (Isaiah 9:9)

text: יַהֲרֹג בַּבָּרָד גַּפְנָם וְשִׁקְמוֹתָם בַּֽחֲנָמַֽל׃
translation: He destroyed their vines with hail, their sycamore fig trees with frost. (Psalms 78:47)

text: וְעַל הַזֵּיתִים וְהַשִּׁקְמִים אֲשֶׁר בַּשְּׁפֵלָה בַּעַל חָנָן הַגְּדֵרִי וְעַל אֹצְרוֹת הַשֶּׁמֶן יוֹעָֽשׁ׃
translation: Over the olive trees and the sycamore trees that were in the lowland was Baal Hanan the Gederite. Over the cellars of oil was Joash. (1 Chronicles 27:28)

text: וַיִּתֵּן הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת הַכֶּסֶף בִּירוּשָׁלִַם כָּאֲבָנִים וְאֵת הָאֲרָזִים נָתַן כַּשִּׁקְמִים אֲשֶׁר בַּשְּׁפֵלָה לָרֹֽב׃
translation: The king made silver as common as stones in Jerusalem, and cedars as common as the sycamore trees that are in the lowland. (1 Kings 10:27)

text: וַיִּתֵּן הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת הַכֶּסֶף בִּירוּשָׁלִַם כָּאֲבָנִים וְאֵת הָאֲרָזִים נָתַן כַּשִּׁקְמִים אֲשֶׁר בַּשְּׁפֵלָה לָרֹֽב׃
translation: The king made silver as common in Jerusalem as stones, and he made cedars to be as abundant as the sycamore trees that are in the lowland. (2 Chronicles 9:27)

text: וַיִּתֵּן הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת הַכֶּסֶף וְאֶת הַזָּהָב בִּירוּשָׁלִַם כָּאֲבָנִים וְאֵת הָאֲרָזִים נָתַן כַּשִּׁקְמִים אֲשֶׁר בַּשְּׁפֵלָה לָרֹֽב׃
translation: The king made silver and gold to be as common as stones in Jerusalem, and he made cedars to be as common as the sycamore trees that are in the lowland. (2 Chronicles 1:15)

text: הַקְּרֹבוֹת וְהָרְחֹקוֹת מִמֵּךְ יִתְקַלְּסוּ בָךְ טְמֵאַת הַשֵּׁם רַבַּת הַמְּהוּמָֽה׃
translation: Those who are near and those who are far from you will mock you, you infamous one, full of tumult. (Ezekiel 22:5)

text: תְּשִׂימֵנוּ חֶרְפָּה לִשְׁכֵנֵינוּ לַעַג וָקֶלֶס לִסְבִיבוֹתֵֽינוּ׃
translation: You make us a byword among the nations, a shaking of the head among the peoples. (Psalms 44:14)

text: הָיִינוּ חֶרְפָּה לִשְׁכֵנֵינוּ לַעַג וָקֶלֶס לִסְבִיבוֹתֵֽינוּ׃
translation: We have become a reproach to our neighbors, a scoffing and derision to those who are around us. (Psalms 79:4)

text: וְהוּא בַּמְּלָכִים יִתְקַלָּס וְרֹזְנִים מִשְׂחָק לוֹ הוּא לְכָל מִבְצָר יִשְׂחָק וַיִּצְבֹּר עָפָר וַֽיִּלְכְּדָֽהּ׃
translation: Yes, they scoff at kings, and princes are a derision to them. They laugh at every stronghold, for they build up an earthen ramp and take it. (Habakkuk 1:10)

text: כִּֽי מִדֵּי אֲדַבֵּר אֶזְעָק חָמָס וָשֹׁד אֶקְרָא כִּֽי הָיָה דְבַר יְהוָה לִי לְחֶרְפָּה וּלְקֶלֶס כָּל הַיּֽוֹם׃
translation: For as often as I speak, I cry out; I cry, "Violence and destruction!" because the LORD's word has been made a reproach to me, and a derision, all day. (Jeremiah 20:8)

text: בִּבְנוֹתַיִךְ גַּבֵּךְ בְּרֹאשׁ כָּל דֶּרֶךְ וְרָמָתֵךְ עשיתי עָשִׂית בְּכָל רְחוֹב וְלֹא הייתי הָיִית כַּזּוֹנָה לְקַלֵּס אֶתְנָֽן׃
translation: in that you build your vaulted place at the head of every way, and make your lofty place in every street, and have not been as a prostitute, in that you scorn pay. (Ezekiel 16:31)

text: יָבֵשׁ כַּחֶרֶשׂ כֹּחִי וּלְשׁוֹנִי מֻדְבָּק מַלְקוֹחָי וְֽלַעֲפַר מָוֶת תִּשְׁפְּתֵֽנִי׃
translation: For dogs have surrounded me. A company of evildoers have enclosed me. They have pierced my hands and feet. (Psalms 22:16)

text: יְהוָה תִּשְׁפֹּת שָׁלוֹם לָנוּ כִּי גַּם כָּֽל מַעֲשֵׂינוּ פָּעַלְתָּ לָּֽנוּ׃
translation: LORD, you will ordain peace for us, for you have also done all our work for us. (Isaiah 26:12)

text: אִֽם תִּשְׁכְּבוּן בֵּין שְׁפַתָּיִם כַּנְפֵי יוֹנָה נֶחְפָּה בַכֶּסֶף וְאֶבְרוֹתֶיהָ בִּֽירַקְרַק חָרֽוּץ׃
translation: When the Almighty scattered kings in her, it snowed on Zalmon. (Psalms 68:14)

text: וְהַֽשְׁפַתַּיִם טֹפַח אֶחָד מוּכָנִים בַּבַּיִת סָבִיב סָבִיב וְאֶל הַשֻּׁלְחָנוֹת בְּשַׂר הַקָּרְבָֽן׃
translation: The hooks, a hand width long, were fastened within all around. The meat of the offering was on the tables. (Ezekiel 40:43)

text: וּמְשֹׁל אֶל בֵּית הַמֶּרִי מָשָׁל וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵיהֶם כֹּה אָמַר אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה שְׁפֹת הַסִּיר שְׁפֹת וְגַם יְצֹק בּוֹ מָֽיִם׃
translation: Utter a parable to the rebellious house, and tell them, 'The Lord GOD says, "Put the cauldron on the fire. Put it on, and also pour water into it. (Ezekiel 24:3)

text: לִפְקֹחַ עֵינַיִם עִוְרוֹת לְהוֹצִיא מִמַּסְגֵּר אַסִּיר מִבֵּית כֶּלֶא יֹשְׁבֵי חֹֽשֶׁךְ׃
translation: to open the blind eyes, to bring the prisoners out of the dungeon, and those who sit in darkness out of the prison. (Isaiah 42:7)

text: וְאֻסְּפוּ אֲסֵפָה אַסִּיר עַל בּוֹר וְסֻגְּרוּ עַל מַסְגֵּר וּמֵרֹב יָמִים יִפָּקֵֽדוּ׃
translation: They will be gathered together, as prisoners are gathered in the pit, and will be shut up in the prison; and after many days they will be visited. (Isaiah 24:22)

text: אַחֲרֵי צֵאת יְכָנְיָֽה הַמֶּלֶךְ וְהַגְּבִירָה וְהַסָּרִיסִים שָׂרֵי יְהוּדָה וִירוּשָׁלִַם וְהֶחָרָשׁ וְהַמַּסְגֵּר מִירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
translation: (after Jeconiah the king, the queen mother, the eunuchs, the princes of Judah and Jerusalem, the craftsmen, and the smiths had departed from Jerusalem), (Jeremiah 29:2)

text: וְאֵת כָּל אַנְשֵׁי הַחַיִל שִׁבְעַת אֲלָפִים וְהֶחָרָשׁ וְהַמַּסְגֵּר אֶלֶף הַכֹּל גִּבּוֹרִים עֹשֵׂי מִלְחָמָה וַיְבִיאֵם מֶֽלֶךְ בָּבֶל גּוֹלָה בָּבֶֽלָה׃
translation: All the men of might, even seven thousand, and the craftsmen and the smiths one thousand, all of them strong and fit for war, even them the king of Babylon brought captive to Babylon. (2 Kings 24:16)

text: וּלְאַשְׁחוּר אֲבִי תְקוֹעַ הָיוּ שְׁתֵּי נָשִׁים חֶלְאָה וְנַעֲרָֽה׃
translation: Ashhur the father of Tekoa had two wives, Helah and Naarah. (1 Chronicles 4:5)

text: תְּאֻנִים הֶלְאָת וְלֹֽא תֵצֵא מִמֶּנָּה רַבַּת חֶלְאָתָהּ בְּאֵשׁ חֶלְאָתָֽהּ׃
translation: She is weary with toil; yet her great rust, rust by fire, doesn't leave her. (Ezekiel 24:12)

text: וּבְנֵי חֶלְאָה צֶרֶת יצחר וְצֹחַר וְאֶתְנָֽן׃
translation: The sons of Helah were Zereth, Izhar, and Ethnan. (1 Chronicles 4:7)

text: וְהַעֲמִידֶהָ עַל גֶּחָלֶיהָ רֵקָה לְמַעַן תֵּחַם וְחָרָה נְחֻשְׁתָּהּ וְנִתְּכָה בְתוֹכָהּ טֻמְאָתָהּ תִּתֻּם חֶלְאָתָֽהּ׃
translation: Then set it empty on its coals, that it may be hot, and its bronze may burn, and that its filthiness may be molten in it, that its rust may be consumed. (Ezekiel 24:11)

text: כִּי יֵשׁ לַכֶּסֶף מוֹצָא וּמָקוֹם לַזָּהָב יָזֹֽקּוּ׃
translation: "Surely there is a mine for silver, and a place for gold which they refine. (Job 28:1)

text: כִּי יְגָרַע נִטְפֵי מָיִם יָזֹקּוּ מָטָר לְאֵדֽוֹ׃
translation: For he draws up the drops of water, which distill in rain from his vapor, (Job 36:27)

text: שְׁלֹשֶׁת אֲלָפִים כִּכְּרֵי זָהָב מִזְּהַב אוֹפִיר וְשִׁבְעַת אֲלָפִים כִּכַּר כֶּסֶף מְזֻקָּק לָטוּחַ קִירוֹת הַבָּתִּֽים׃
translation: even three thousand talents of gold, of the gold of Ophir, and seven thousand talents of refined silver, with which to overlay the walls of the houses; (1 Chronicles 29:4)

text: וּלְמִזְבַּח הַקְּטֹרֶת זָהָב מְזֻקָּק בַּמִּשְׁקָל וּלְתַבְנִית הַמֶּרְכָּבָה הַכְּרֻבִים זָהָב לְפֹרְשִׂים וְסֹכְכִים עַל אֲרוֹן בְּרִית יְהוָֽה׃
translation: and for the altar of incense, refined gold by weight; and gold for the plans for the chariot, and the cherubim that spread out and cover the ark of the LORD's covenant. (1 Chronicles 28:18)

text: וְעָשָׂה יְהוָה צְבָאוֹת לְכָל הָֽעַמִּים בָּהָר הַזֶּה מִשְׁתֵּה שְׁמָנִים מִשְׁתֵּה שְׁמָרִים שְׁמָנִים מְמֻחָיִם שְׁמָרִים מְזֻקָּקִֽים׃
translation: In this mountain, the LORD of Armies will make all peoples a feast of choice meat, a feast of choice wines, of choice meat full of marrow, of well refined choice wines. (Isaiah 25:6)

text: וְיָשַׁב מְצָרֵף וּמְטַהֵר כֶּסֶף וְטִהַר אֶת בְּנֵֽי לֵוִי וְזִקַּק אֹתָם כַּזָּהָב וְכַכָּסֶף וְהָיוּ לַֽיהוָה מַגִּישֵׁי מִנְחָה בִּצְדָקָֽה׃
translation: and he will sit as a refiner and purifier of silver, and he will purify the sons of Levi, and refine them as gold and silver; and they shall offer to the LORD offerings in righteousness. (Malachi 3:3)

text: מְזָוֵינוּ מְלֵאִים מְפִיקִים מִזַּן אֶל זַן צֹאונֵנוּ מַאֲלִיפוֹת מְרֻבָּבוֹת בְּחוּצוֹתֵֽינוּ׃
translation: Our barns are full, filled with all kinds of provision. Our sheep produce thousands and ten thousands in our fields. (Psalms 144:13)

text: וְעָמְדוּ זָרִים וְרָעוּ צֹאנְכֶם וּבְנֵי נֵכָר אִכָּרֵיכֶם וְכֹרְמֵיכֶֽם׃
translation: Strangers will stand and feed your flocks. Foreigners will work your fields and your vineyards. (Isaiah 61:5)

text: וְיָשְׁבוּ בָהּ יְהוּדָה וְכָל עָרָיו יַחְדָּו אִכָּרִים וְנָסְעוּ בַּעֵֽדֶר׃
translation: Judah and all its cities will dwell therein together, the farmers, and those who go about with flocks. (Jeremiah 31:24)

text: בַּעֲבוּר הָאֲדָמָה חַתָּה כִּי לֹא הָיָה גֶשֶׁם בָּאָרֶץ בֹּשׁוּ אִכָּרִים חָפוּ רֹאשָֽׁם׃
translation: Because of the ground which is cracked, because no rain has been in the land, the plowmen are disappointed. They cover their heads. (Jeremiah 14:4)

text: וְנִפַּצְתִּי בְךָ רֹעֶה וְעֶדְרוֹ וְנִפַּצְתִּי בְךָ אִכָּר וְצִמְדּוֹ וְנִפַּצְתִּי בְךָ פַּחוֹת וּסְגָנִֽים׃
translation: With you I will break in pieces the shepherd and his flock. With you I will break in pieces the farmer and his yoke. With you I will break in pieces governors and deputies. (Jeremiah 51:23)

text: הֹבִישׁוּ אִכָּרִים הֵילִילוּ כֹּֽרְמִים עַל חִטָּה וְעַל שְׂעֹרָה כִּי אָבַד קְצִיר שָׂדֶֽה׃
translation: Be confounded, you farmers! Wail, you vineyard keepers, for the wheat and for the barley; for the harvest of the field has perished. (Joel 1:11)

text: וַיְהִי קֶצֶף יְהוָה עַל יְהוּדָה וִירוּשָׁלִָם וַיִּתְּנֵם לזועה לְזַֽעֲוָה לְשַׁמָּה וְלִשְׁרֵקָה כַּאֲשֶׁר אַתֶּם רֹאִים בְּעֵינֵיכֶֽם׃
translation: Therefore the LORD's wrath was on Judah and Jerusalem, and he has delivered them to be tossed back and forth, to be an astonishment and a hissing, as you see with your eyes. (2 Chronicles 29:8)

text: מִדֵּי עָבְרוֹ יִקַּח אֶתְכֶם כִּֽי בַבֹּקֶר בַּבֹּקֶר יַעֲבֹר בַּיּוֹם וּבַלָּיְלָה וְהָיָה רַק זְוָעָה הָבִין שְׁמוּעָֽה׃
translation: As often as it passes through, it will seize you; for morning by morning it will pass through, by day and by night; and it will be nothing but terror to understand the message." (Isaiah 28:19)

text: וּנְתַתִּים לזועה לְזַֽעֲוָה לְכֹל מַמְלְכוֹת הָאָרֶץ בִּגְלַל מְנַשֶּׁה בֶן יְחִזְקִיָּהוּ מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה עַל אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה בִּירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
translation: I will cause them to be tossed back and forth among all the kingdoms of the earth, because of Manasseh, the son of Hezekiah, king of Judah, for that which he did in Jerusalem. (Jeremiah 15:4)

text: וּנְתַתִּים לזועה לְזַעֲוָה לְרָעָה לְכֹל מַמְלְכוֹת הָאָרֶץ לְחֶרְפָּה וּלְמָשָׁל לִשְׁנִינָה וְלִקְלָלָה בְּכָל הַמְּקֹמוֹת אֲשֶֽׁר אַדִּיחֵם שָֽׁם׃
translation: I will even give them up to be tossed back and forth among all the kingdoms of the earth for evil, to be a reproach and a proverb, a taunt and a curse, in all places where I will drive them. (Jeremiah 24:9)

text: וְרָֽדַפְתִּי אַֽחֲרֵיהֶם בַּחֶרֶב בָּרָעָב וּבַדָּבֶר וּנְתַתִּים לזועה לְזַעֲוָה לְכֹל מַמְלְכוֹת הָאָרֶץ לְאָלָה וּלְשַׁמָּה וְלִשְׁרֵקָה וּלְחֶרְפָּה בְּכָל הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר הִדַּחְתִּים שָֽׁם׃
translation: I will pursue after them with the sword, with the famine, and with the pestilence, and will deliver them to be tossed back and forth among all the kingdoms of the earth, to be an object of horror, an astonishment, a hissing, and a reproach among all the nations where I have driven them, (Jeremiah 29:18)

text: וְהַצָּפִיר הַשָּׂעִיר מֶלֶךְ יָוָן וְהַקֶּרֶן הַגְּדוֹלָה אֲשֶׁר בֵּין עֵינָיו הוּא הַמֶּלֶךְ הָרִאשֽׁוֹן׃
translation: The rough male goat is the king of Greece. The great horn that is between his eyes is the first king. (Daniel 8:21)

text: וּצְפִיר הָעִזִּים הִגְדִּיל עַד מְאֹד וּכְעָצְמוֹ נִשְׁבְּרָה הַקֶּרֶן הַגְּדוֹלָה וַֽתַּעֲלֶנָה חָזוּת אַרְבַּע תַּחְתֶּיהָ לְאַרְבַּע רוּחוֹת הַשָּׁמָֽיִם׃
