translation: The male goat magnified himself exceedingly. When he was strong, the great horn was broken; and instead of it there came up four notable horns toward the four winds of the sky. (Daniel 8:8)

text: יַגִּירֻהוּ עַל יְדֵי חָרֶב מְנָת שֻׁעָלִים יִהְיֽוּ׃
translation: But the king shall rejoice in God. Everyone who swears by him will praise him, for the mouth of those who speak lies shall be silenced. (Psalms 63:11)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר לָעָם לְיוֹשְׁבֵי יְרוּשָׁלִַם לָתֵת מְנָת הַכֹּהֲנִים וְהַלְוִיִּם לְמַעַן יֶחֶזְקוּ בְּתוֹרַת יְהוָֽה׃
translation: Moreover he commanded the people who lived in Jerusalem to give the portion of the priests and the Levites, that they might give themselves to the LORD's law. (2 Chronicles 31:4)

text: וָאֵדְעָה כִּֽי מְנָיוֹת הַלְוִיִּם לֹא נִתָּנָה וַיִּבְרְחוּ אִישׁ לְשָׂדֵהוּ הַלְוִיִּם וְהַמְשֹׁרְרִים עֹשֵׂי הַמְּלָאכָֽה׃
translation: I perceived that the portions of the Levites had not been given them, so that the Levites and the singers, who did the work, had each fled to his field. (Nehemiah 13:10)

text: וּמְנָת הַמֶּלֶךְ מִן רְכוּשׁוֹ לָעֹלוֹת לְעֹלוֹת הַבֹּקֶר וְהָעֶרֶב וְהָעֹלוֹת לַשַּׁבָּתוֹת וְלֶחֳדָשִׁים וְלַמֹּעֲדִים כַּכָּתוּב בְּתוֹרַת יְהוָֽה׃
translation: He also appointed the king's portion of his possessions for the burnt offerings: for the morning and evening burnt offerings, and the burnt offerings for the Sabbaths, for the new moons, and for the set feasts, as it is written in the LORD's law. (2 Chronicles 31:3)

text: וְכָל יִשְׂרָאֵל בִּימֵי זְרֻבָּבֶל וּבִימֵי נְחֶמְיָה נֹֽתְנִים מְנָיוֹת הַמְשֹׁרְרִים וְהַשֹּׁעֲרִים דְּבַר יוֹם בְּיוֹמוֹ וּמַקְדִּשִׁים לַלְוִיִּם וְהַלְוִיִּם מַקְדִּשִׁים לִבְנֵי אַהֲרֹֽן׃
translation: All Israel in the days of Zerubbabel and in the days of Nehemiah gave the portions of the singers and the gatekeepers, as every day required; and they set apart that which was for the Levites; and the Levites set apart that which was for the sons of Aaron. (Nehemiah 12:47)

text: דְּנָה פַּרְשֶׁגֶן אִגַּרְתָּא דִּי שְׁלַחוּ עֲלוֹהִי עַל אַרְתַּחְשַׁשְׂתְּא מַלְכָּא עַבְדָיךְ אֱנָשׁ עֲבַֽר נַהֲרָה וּכְעֶֽנֶת׃
translation: This is the copy of the letter that they sent: To King Artaxerxes, from your servants, the people beyond the River. (Ezra 4:11)

text: פַּתְשֶׁגֶן הַכְּתָב לְהִנָּתֵֽן דָּת בְּכָל מְדִינָה וּמְדִינָה גָּלוּי לְכָל הָֽעַמִּים לִהְיוֹת עֲתִדִים לַיּוֹם הַזֶּֽה׃
translation: A copy of the letter, that the decree should be given out in every province, was published to all the peoples, that they should be ready against that day. (Esther 3:14)

text: וְזֶה פַּרְשֶׁגֶן הַֽנִּשְׁתְּוָן אֲשֶׁר נָתַן הַמֶּלֶךְ אַרְתַּחְשַׁסְתְּא לְעֶזְרָא הַכֹּהֵן הַסֹּפֵר סֹפֵר דִּבְרֵי מִצְוֺת יְהוָה וְחֻקָּיו עַל יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
translation: Now this is the copy of the letter that King Artaxerxes gave to Ezra the priest, the scribe, even the scribe of the words of the LORD's commandments, and of his statutes to Israel: (Ezra 7:11)

text: פַּרְשֶׁגֶן אִגַּרְתָּא דִּֽי שְׁלַח תַּתְּנַי פַּחַת עֲבַֽר נַהֲרָה וּשְׁתַר בּוֹזְנַי וּכְנָוָתֵהּ אֲפַרְסְכָיֵא דִּי בַּעֲבַר נַהֲרָה עַל דָּרְיָוֶשׁ מַלְכָּֽא׃
translation: The copy of the letter that Tattenai, the governor beyond the River, and Shetharbozenai, and his companions the Apharsachites who were beyond the River, sent to Darius the king follows. (Ezra 5:6)

text: פַּתְשֶׁגֶן הַכְּתָב לְהִנָּתֵֽן דָּת בְּכָל מְדִינָה וּמְדִינָה גָּלוּי לְכָל הָעַמִּים וְלִהְיוֹת היהודיים הַיְּהוּדִים עתודים עֲתִידִים לַיּוֹם הַזֶּה לְהִנָּקֵם מֵאֹיְבֵיהֶֽם׃
translation: A copy of the letter, that the decree should be given out in every province, was published to all the peoples, that the Jews should be ready for that day to avenge themselves on their enemies. (Esther 8:13)

text: כְּעַן שִׂימוּ טְּעֵם לְבַטָּלָא גֻּבְרַיָּא אִלֵּךְ וְקִרְיְתָא דָךְ לָא תִתְבְּנֵא עַד מִנִּי טַעְמָא יִתְּשָֽׂם׃
translation: Make a decree now to cause these men to cease, and that this city not be built until a decree is made by me. (Ezra 4:21)

text: בֵּאדַיִן בְּטֵלַת עֲבִידַת בֵּית אֱלָהָא דִּי בִּירוּשְׁלֶם וַהֲוָת בָּֽטְלָא עַד שְׁנַת תַּרְתֵּין לְמַלְכוּת דָּרְיָוֶשׁ מֶֽלֶךְ פָּרָֽס׃
translation: Then work stopped on God's house which is at Jerusalem. It stopped until the second year of the reign of Darius king of Persia. (Ezra 4:24)

text: אֱדַיִן תַּתְּנַי פַּחַת עֲבַֽר נַהֲרָה שְׁתַר בּוֹזְנַי וּכְנָוָתְהוֹן לָקֳבֵל דִּֽי שְׁלַח דָּרְיָוֶשׁ מַלְכָּא כְּנֵמָא אָסְפַּרְנָא עֲבַֽדוּ׃
translation: Then Tattenai, the governor beyond the River, Shetharbozenai, and their companions did accordingly with all diligence, because Darius the king had sent a decree. (Ezra 6:13)

text: נְהָרוֹת יִמְחֲאוּ כָף יַחַד הָרִים יְרַנֵּֽנוּ׃
translation: Let the rivers clap their hands. Let the mountains sing for joy together. (Psalms 98:8)

text: כִּֽי בְשִׂמְחָה תֵצֵאוּ וּבְשָׁלוֹם תּֽוּבָלוּן הֶהָרִים וְהַגְּבָעוֹת יִפְצְחוּ לִפְנֵיכֶם רִנָּה וְכָל עֲצֵי הַשָּׂדֶה יִמְחֲאוּ כָֽף׃
translation: For you shall go out with joy, and be led out with peace. The mountains and the hills will break out before you into singing; and all the trees of the fields will clap their hands. (Isaiah 55:12)

text: כִּי כֹה אָמַר אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה יַעַן מַחְאֲךָ יָד וְרַקְעֲךָ בְּרָגֶל וַתִּשְׂמַח בְּכָל שָֽׁאטְךָ בְּנֶפֶשׁ אֶל אַדְמַת יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
translation: For the Lord GOD says: "Because you have clapped your hands, stamped with the feet, and rejoiced with all the contempt of your soul against the land of Israel, (Ezekiel 25:6)

text: הֲלוֹא פֶתַע יָקוּמוּ נֹשְׁכֶיךָ וְיִקְצוּ מְזַעְזְעֶיךָ וְהָיִיתָ לִמְשִׁסּוֹת לָֽמוֹ׃
translation: Won't your debtors rise up suddenly, and wake up those who make you tremble, and you will be their victim? (Habakkuk 2:7)

text: בַּיּוֹם שֶׁיָּזֻעוּ שֹׁמְרֵי הַבַּיִת וְהִֽתְעַוְּתוּ אַנְשֵׁי הֶחָיִל וּבָטְלוּ הַטֹּֽחֲנוֹת כִּי מִעֵטוּ וְחָשְׁכוּ הָרֹאוֹת בָּאֲרֻבּֽוֹת׃
translation: in the day when the keepers of the house shall tremble, and the strong men shall bow themselves, and the grinders cease because they are few, and those who look out of the windows are darkened, (Ecclesiastes 12:3)

text: כִּֽי לִפְנֵי לַחְמִי אַנְחָתִי תָבֹא וַֽיִּתְּכוּ כַמַּיִם שַׁאֲגֹתָֽי׃
translation: For my sighing comes before I eat. My groanings are poured out like water. (Job 3:24)

text: אֵלִי אֵלִי לָמָה עֲזַבְתָּנִי רָחוֹק מִֽישׁוּעָתִי דִּבְרֵי שַׁאֲגָתִֽי׃
translation: My God, I cry in the daytime, but you don't answer; in the night season, and am not silent. (Psalms 22:2)

text: שַׁאֲגַת אַרְיֵה וְקוֹל שָׁחַל וְשִׁנֵּי כְפִירִים נִתָּֽעוּ׃
translation: The roaring of the lion, and the voice of the fierce lion, the teeth of the young lions, are broken. (Job 4:10)

text: כִּֽי הֶחֱרַשְׁתִּי בָּלוּ עֲצָמָי בְּשַׁאֲגָתִי כָּל הַיּֽוֹם׃
translation: When I kept silence, my bones wasted away through my groaning all day long. (Psalms 32:3)

text: שְׁאָגָה לוֹ כַּלָּבִיא ושאג יִשְׁאַג כַּכְּפִירִים וְיִנְהֹם וְיֹאחֵז טֶרֶף וְיַפְלִיט וְאֵין מַצִּֽיל׃
translation: Their roaring will be like a lioness. They will roar like young lions. Yes, they shall roar, and seize their prey and carry it off, and there will be no one to deliver. (Isaiah 5:29)

text: קוֹל יִֽלְלַת הָרֹעִים כִּי שֻׁדְּדָה אַדַּרְתָּם קוֹל שַׁאֲגַת כְּפִירִים כִּי שֻׁדַּד גְּאוֹן הַיַּרְדֵּֽן׃
translation: A voice of the wailing of the shepherds! For their glory is destroyed—a voice of the roaring of young lions! For the pride of the Jordan is ruined. (Zechariah 11:3)

text: לֹֽא הִדְרִיכֻהוּ בְנֵי שָׁחַץ לֹֽא עָדָה עָלָיו שָֽׁחַל׃
translation: The proud animals have not trodden it, nor has the fierce lion passed by there. (Job 28:8)

text: אָמַר עָצֵל שַׁחַל בַּדָּרֶךְ אֲרִי בֵּין הָרְחֹבֽוֹת׃
translation: The sluggard says, "There is a lion in the road! A fierce lion roams the streets!" (Proverbs 26:13)

text: וְיִגְאֶה כַּשַּׁחַל תְּצוּדֵנִי וְתָשֹׁב תִּתְפַּלָּא בִֽי׃
translation: If my head is held high, you hunt me like a lion. Again you show yourself powerful to me. (Job 10:16)

text: כִּי אָנֹכִי כַשַּׁחַל לְאֶפְרַיִם וְכַכְּפִיר לְבֵית יְהוּדָה אֲנִי אֲנִי אֶטְרֹף וְאֵלֵךְ אֶשָּׂא וְאֵין מַצִּֽיל׃
translation: For I will be to Ephraim like a lion, and like a young lion to the house of Judah. I myself will tear in pieces and go away. I will carry off, and there will be no one to deliver. (Hosea 5:14)

text: הִבִּיטוּ אָרְחוֹת תֵּמָא הֲלִיכֹת שְׁבָא קִוּוּ לָֽמוֹ׃
translation: The caravans of Tema looked. The companies of Sheba waited for them. (Job 6:19)

text: רָאוּ הֲלִיכוֹתֶיךָ אֱלֹהִים הֲלִיכוֹת אֵלִי מַלְכִּי בַקֹּֽדֶשׁ׃
translation: The singers went before, the minstrels followed after, among the ladies playing with tambourines, (Psalms 68:25)

text: צוֹפִיָּה הֲלִיכוֹת בֵּיתָהּ וְלֶחֶם עַצְלוּת לֹא תֹאכֵֽל׃
translation: She looks well to the ways of her household, and doesn't eat the bread of idleness. (Proverbs 31:27)

text: יִזְכֹּר אַדִּירָיו יִכָּשְׁלוּ בהלכותם בַּהֲלִֽיכָתָם יְמַֽהֲרוּ חֽוֹמָתָהּ וְהֻכַן הַסֹּכֵֽךְ׃
translation: The gates of the rivers are opened, and the palace is dissolved. (Nahum 2:6)

text: עָמַד וַיְמֹדֶד אֶרֶץ רָאָה וַיַּתֵּר גּוֹיִם וַיִּתְפֹּֽצְצוּ הַרְרֵי עַד שַׁחוּ גִּבְעוֹת עוֹלָם הֲלִיכוֹת עוֹלָם לֽוֹ׃
translation: He stood, and shook the earth. He looked, and made the nations tremble. The ancient mountains were crumbled. The age-old hills collapsed. His ways are eternal. (Habakkuk 3:6)

text: אֵֽשֶׁת חַיִל עֲטֶרֶת בַּעְלָהּ וּכְרָקָב בְּעַצְמוֹתָיו מְבִישָֽׁה׃
translation: A worthy woman is the crown of her husband, but a disgraceful wife is as rottenness in his bones. (Proverbs 12:4)

text: חַיֵּי בְשָׂרִים לֵב מַרְפֵּא וּרְקַב עֲצָמוֹת קִנְאָֽה׃
translation: The life of the body is a heart at peace, but envy rots the bones. (Proverbs 14:30)

text: וְהוּא כְּרָקָב יִבְלֶה כְּבֶגֶד אֲכָלוֹ עָֽשׁ׃
translation: though I am decaying like a rotten thing, like a garment that is moth-eaten. (Job 13:28)

text: זֵכֶר צַדִּיק לִבְרָכָה וְשֵׁם רְשָׁעִים יִרְקָֽב׃
translation: The memory of the righteous is blessed, but the name of the wicked will rot. (Proverbs 10:7)

text: וַאֲנִי כָעָשׁ לְאֶפְרָיִם וְכָרָקָב לְבֵית יְהוּדָֽה׃
translation: Therefore I am to Ephraim like a moth, and to the house of Judah like rottenness. (Hosea 5:12)

text: הַֽמְסֻכָּן תְּרוּמָה עֵץ לֹֽא יִרְקַב יִבְחָר חָרָשׁ חָכָם יְבַקֶּשׁ לוֹ לְהָכִין פֶּסֶל לֹא יִמּֽוֹט׃
translation: He who is too impoverished for such an offering chooses a tree that will not rot. He seeks a skillful workman to set up a carved image for him that will not be moved. (Isaiah 40:20)

text: וַיִּצְעֲקוּ אֶל יְהוָה בַּצַּר לָהֶם מִמְּצֽוּקוֹתֵיהֶם יַצִּילֵֽם׃
translation: Then they cried to the LORD in their trouble, and he delivered them out of their distresses. (Psalms 107:6)

text: וַיִּזְעֲקוּ אֶל יְהוָה בַּצַּר לָהֶם מִמְּצֻֽקוֹתֵיהֶם יוֹשִׁיעֵֽם׃
translation: Then they cried to the LORD in their trouble, and he saved them out of their distresses. (Psalms 107:13)

text: וַיִּזְעֲקוּ אֶל יְהוָה בַּצַּר לָהֶם מִמְּצֻֽקוֹתֵיהֶם יוֹשִׁיעֵֽם׃
translation: Then they cry to the LORD in their trouble, and he saves them out of their distresses. (Psalms 107:19)

text: וַיִּצְעֲקוּ אֶל יְהוָה בַּצַּר לָהֶם וּֽמִמְּצֽוּקֹתֵיהֶם יוֹצִיאֵֽם׃
translation: Then they cry to the LORD in their trouble, and he brings them out of their distress. (Psalms 107:28)

text: צָרוֹת לְבָבִי הִרְחִיבוּ מִמְּצֽוּקוֹתַי הוֹצִיאֵֽנִי׃
translation: The troubles of my heart are enlarged. Oh bring me out of my distresses. (Psalms 25:17)

text: יוֹם עֶבְרָה הַיּוֹם הַהוּא יוֹם צָרָה וּמְצוּקָה יוֹם שֹׁאָה וּמְשׁוֹאָה יוֹם חֹשֶׁךְ וַאֲפֵלָה יוֹם עָנָן וַעֲרָפֶֽל׃
translation: That day is a day of wrath, a day of distress and anguish, a day of trouble and ruin, a day of darkness and gloom, a day of clouds and blackness, (Zephaniah 1:15)

text: יֵשׁ זָהָב וְרָב פְּנִינִים וּכְלִי יְקָר שִׂפְתֵי דָֽעַת׃
translation: There is gold and abundance of rubies, but the lips of knowledge are a rare jewel. (Proverbs 20:15)

text: רָאמוֹת וְגָבִישׁ לֹא יִזָּכֵר וּמֶשֶׁךְ חָכְמָה מִפְּנִינִֽים׃
translation: No mention will be made of coral or of crystal. Yes, the price of wisdom is above rubies. (Job 28:18)

text: יְקָרָה הִיא מפניים מִפְּנִינִים וְכָל חֲפָצֶיךָ לֹא יִֽשְׁווּ בָֽהּ׃
translation: She is more precious than rubies. None of the things you can desire are to be compared to her. (Proverbs 3:15)

text: כִּֽי טוֹבָה חָכְמָה מִפְּנִינִים וְכָל חֲפָצִים לֹא יִֽשְׁווּ בָֽהּ׃
translation: For wisdom is better than rubies. All the things that may be desired can't be compared to it. (Proverbs 8:11)

text: אֵֽשֶׁת חַיִל מִי יִמְצָא וְרָחֹק מִפְּנִינִים מִכְרָֽהּ׃
translation: Who can find a worthy woman? For her value is far above rubies. (Proverbs 31:10)

text: זַכּוּ נְזִירֶיהָ מִשֶּׁלֶג צַחוּ מֵחָלָב אָדְמוּ עֶצֶם מִפְּנִינִים סַפִּיר גִּזְרָתָֽם׃
translation: Her nobles were purer than snow. They were whiter than milk. They were more ruddy in body than rubies. Their polishing was like sapphire. (Lamentations 4:7)

text: וְאִם אֲסוּרִים בַּזִּקִּים יִלָּכְדוּן בְּחַבְלֵי עֹֽנִי׃
translation: If they are bound in fetters, and are taken in the cords of afflictions, (Job 36:8)

text: לֶאְסֹר מַלְכֵיהֶם בְּזִקִּים וְנִכְבְּדֵיהֶם בְּכַבְלֵי בַרְזֶֽל׃
translation: to bind their kings with chains, and their nobles with fetters of iron; (Psalms 149:8)

text: כְּֽמִתְלַהְלֵהַּ הַיֹּרֶה זִקִּים חִצִּים וָמָֽוֶת׃
translation: Like a madman who shoots torches, arrows, and death, (Proverbs 26:18)

text: הֵן כֻּלְּכֶם קֹדְחֵי אֵשׁ מְאַזְּרֵי זִיקוֹת לְכוּ בְּאוּר אֶשְׁכֶם וּבְזִיקוֹת בִּֽעַרְתֶּם מִיָּדִי הָיְתָה זֹּאת לָכֶם לְמַעֲצֵבָה תִּשְׁכָּבֽוּן׃
translation: Behold, all you who kindle a fire, who adorn yourselves with torches around yourselves, walk in the flame of your fire, and among the torches that you have kindled. You will have this from my hand: you will lie down in sorrow. (Isaiah 50:11)

text: גַּם הִיא לַגֹּלָה הָלְכָה בַשֶּׁבִי גַּם עֹלָלֶיהָ יְרֻטְּשׁוּ בְּרֹאשׁ כָּל חוּצוֹת וְעַל נִכְבַּדֶּיהָ יַדּוּ גוֹרָל וְכָל גְּדוֹלֶיהָ רֻתְּקוּ בַזִּקִּֽים׃
translation: Yet was she carried away. She went into captivity. Her young children also were dashed in pieces at the head of all the streets, and they cast lots for her honorable men, and all her great men were bound in chains. (Nahum 3:10)

text: כִּי בְתַחְבֻּלוֹת תַּעֲשֶׂה לְּךָ מִלְחָמָה וּתְשׁוּעָה בְּרֹב יוֹעֵֽץ׃
translation: for by wise guidance you wage your war, and victory is in many advisors. (Proverbs 24:6)

text: יִשְׁמַע חָכָם וְיוֹסֶף לֶקַח וְנָבוֹן תַּחְבֻּלוֹת יִקְנֶֽה׃
translation: that the wise man may hear, and increase in learning; that the man of understanding may attain to sound counsel; (Proverbs 1:5)

text: בְּאֵין תַּחְבֻּלוֹת יִפָּל עָם וּתְשׁוּעָה בְּרֹב יוֹעֵֽץ׃
translation: Where there is no wise guidance, the nation falls, but in the multitude of counselors there is victory. (Proverbs 11:14)

text: מַחְשְׁבוֹת צַדִּיקִים מִשְׁפָּט תַּחְבֻּלוֹת רְשָׁעִים מִרְמָֽה׃
translation: The thoughts of the righteous are just, but the advice of the wicked is deceitful. (Proverbs 12:5)

text: מַחֲשָׁבוֹת בְּעֵצָה תִכּוֹן וּבְתַחְבֻּלוֹת עֲשֵׂה מִלְחָמָֽה׃
translation: Plans are established by advice; by wise guidance you wage war! (Proverbs 20:18)

text: וְהוּא מְסִבּוֹת מִתְהַפֵּךְ בתחבולתו בְּתַחְבּוּלֹתָיו לְפָעֳלָם כֹּל אֲשֶׁר יְצַוֵּם עַל פְּנֵי תֵבֵל אָֽרְצָה׃
translation: It is turned around by his guidance, that they may do whatever he commands them on the surface of the habitable world, (Job 37:12)

text: הֲלֹא כָתַבְתִּי לְךָ שלשום שָׁלִישִׁים בְּמוֹעֵצֹת וָדָֽעַת׃
translation: Haven't I written to you thirty excellent things of counsel and knowledge, (Proverbs 22:20)

text: וְחָלָה חֶרֶב בְּעָרָיו וְכִלְּתָה בַדָּיו וְאָכָלָה מִֽמֹּעֲצוֹתֵיהֶֽם׃
translation: The sword will fall on their cities, and will destroy the bars of their gates, and will put an end to their plans. (Hosea 11:6)

text: הַֽאֲשִׁימֵם אֱֽלֹהִים יִפְּלוּ מִֽמֹּעֲצוֹתֵיהֶם בְּרֹב פִּשְׁעֵיהֶם הַדִּיחֵמוֹ כִּי מָרוּ בָֽךְ׃
translation: But let all those who take refuge in you rejoice. Let them always shout for joy, because you defend them. Let them also who love your name be joyful in you. (Psalms 5:11)

text: וְֽיֹאכְלוּ מִפְּרִי דַרְכָּם וּֽמִמֹּעֲצֹתֵיהֶם יִשְׂבָּֽעוּ׃
translation: Therefore they will eat of the fruit of their own way, and be filled with their own schemes. (Proverbs 1:31)

text: פִּֽי צַדִּיק יָנוּב חָכְמָה וּלְשׁוֹן תַּהְפֻּכוֹת תִּכָּרֵֽת׃
translation: The mouth of the righteous produces wisdom, but the perverse tongue will be cut off. (Proverbs 10:31)

text: עוֹד יְנוּבוּן בְּשֵׂיבָה דְּשֵׁנִים וְרַֽעֲנַנִּים יִהְיֽוּ׃
translation: to show that the LORD is upright. He is my rock, and there is no unrighteousness in him. (Psalms 92:15)

text: כִּי מַה טּוּבוֹ וּמַה יָפְיוֹ דָּגָן בַּֽחוּרִים וְתִירוֹשׁ יְנוֹבֵב בְּתֻלֽוֹת׃
translation: For how great is his goodness, and how great is his beauty! Grain will make the young men flourish, and new wine the virgins. (Zechariah 9:17)

text: בּוֹרֵא נוב נִיב שְׂפָתָיִם שָׁלוֹם שָׁלוֹם לָרָחוֹק וְלַקָּרוֹב אָמַר יְהוָה וּרְפָאתִֽיו׃
translation: I create the fruit of the lips: Peace, peace, to him who is far off and to him who is near," says the LORD; "and I will heal them." (Isaiah 57:19)

text: וְאַתֶּם מְחַלְּלִים אוֹתוֹ בֶּאֱמָרְכֶם שֻׁלְחַן אֲדֹנָי מְגֹאָל הוּא וְנִיבוֹ נִבְזֶה אָכְלֽוֹ׃
translation: "But you profane it when you say, 'The LORD's table is polluted, and its fruit, even its food, is contemptible.' (Malachi 1:12)

text: אַל תִּבְטְחוּ בְעֹשֶׁק וּבְגָזֵל אַל תֶּהְבָּלוּ חַיִל כִּֽי יָנוּב אַל תָּשִׁיתוּ לֵֽב׃
translation: God has spoken once; twice I have heard this, that power belongs to God. (Psalms 62:11)

text: הַבֵּט לַבְּרִית כִּי מָלְאוּ מַחֲשַׁכֵּי אֶרֶץ נְאוֹת חָמָֽס׃
translation: Honor your covenant, for haunts of violence fill the dark places of the earth. (Psalms 74:20)

text: שַׁתַּנִי בְּבוֹר תַּחְתִּיּוֹת בְּמַחֲשַׁכִּים בִּמְצֹלֽוֹת׃
translation: Your wrath lies heavily on me. You have afflicted me with all your waves. Selah. (Psalms 88:7)

text: כִּי רָדַף אוֹיֵב נַפְשִׁי דִּכָּא לָאָרֶץ חַיָּתִי הוֹשִׁיבַנִי בְמַחֲשַׁכִּים כְּמֵתֵי עוֹלָֽם׃
translation: For the enemy pursues my soul. He has struck my life down to the ground. He has made me live in dark places, as those who have been long dead. (Psalms 143:3)

text: בְּמַחֲשַׁכִּים הוֹשִׁיבַנִי כְּמֵתֵי עוֹלָֽם׃
translation: He has made me dwell in dark places, as those who have been long dead. (Lamentations 3:6)

text: הוֹי הַמַּעֲמִיקִים מֵֽיהוָה לַסְתִּר עֵצָה וְהָיָה בְמַחְשָׁךְ מַֽעֲשֵׂיהֶם וַיֹּאמְרוּ מִי רֹאֵנוּ וּמִי יוֹדְעֵֽנוּ׃
translation: Woe to those who deeply hide their counsel from the LORD, and whose deeds are in the dark, and who say, "Who sees us?" and "Who knows us?" (Isaiah 29:15)

text: וְהוֹלַכְתִּי עִוְרִים בְּדֶרֶךְ לֹא יָדָעוּ בִּנְתִיבוֹת לֹֽא יָדְעוּ אַדְרִיכֵם אָשִׂים מַחְשָׁךְ לִפְנֵיהֶם לָאוֹר וּמַֽעֲקַשִּׁים לְמִישׁוֹר אֵלֶּה הַדְּבָרִים עֲשִׂיתִם וְלֹא עֲזַבְתִּֽים׃
translation: I will bring the blind by a way that they don't know. I will lead them in paths that they don't know. I will make darkness light before them, and crooked places straight. I will do these things, and I will not forsake them. (Isaiah 42:16)

text: נַהַם כַּכְּפִיר זַעַף מֶלֶךְ וּכְטַל עַל עֵשֶׂב רְצוֹנֽוֹ׃
translation: The king's wrath is like the roaring of a lion, but his favor is like dew on the grass. (Proverbs 19:12)

text: נַהַם כַּכְּפִיר אֵימַת מֶלֶךְ מִתְעַבְּרוֹ חוֹטֵא נַפְשֽׁוֹ׃
translation: The terror of a king is like the roaring of a lion. He who provokes him to anger forfeits his own life. (Proverbs 20:2)

text: אֲרִי נֹהֵם וְדֹב שׁוֹקֵק מֹשֵׁל רָשָׁע עַל עַם דָּֽל׃
translation: As a roaring lion or a charging bear, so is a wicked ruler over helpless people. (Proverbs 28:15)

text: וְנָהַמְתָּ בְאַחֲרִיתֶךָ בִּכְלוֹת בְּשָׂרְךָ וּשְׁאֵרֶֽךָ׃
translation: You will groan at your latter end, when your flesh and your body are consumed, (Proverbs 5:11)

text: וְיִנְהֹם עָלָיו בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא כְּנַהֲמַת יָם וְנִבַּט לָאָרֶץ וְהִנֵּה חֹשֶׁךְ צַר וָאוֹר חָשַׁךְ בַּעֲרִיפֶֽיהָ׃
translation: They will roar against them in that day like the roaring of the sea. If one looks to the land, behold, darkness and distress. The light is darkened in its clouds. (Isaiah 5:30)

text: עֹבֵד אַדְמָתוֹ יִֽשְׂבַּֽע לָחֶם וּמְרַדֵּף רֵקִים יִֽשְׂבַּֽע רִֽישׁ׃
translation: One who works his land will have an abundance of food; but one who chases fantasies will have his fill of poverty. (Proverbs 28:19)

text: הוֹן עָשִׁיר קִרְיַת עֻזּוֹ מְחִתַּת דַּלִּים רֵישָֽׁם׃
translation: The rich man's wealth is his strong city. The destruction of the poor is their poverty. (Proverbs 10:15)

text: רֵישׁ וְקָלוֹן פּוֹרֵעַ מוּסָר וְשׁוֹמֵר תּוֹכַחַת יְכֻבָּֽד׃
translation: Poverty and shame come to him who refuses discipline, but he who heeds correction shall be honored. (Proverbs 13:18)

text: יִשְׁתֶּה וְיִשְׁכַּח רִישׁוֹ וַעֲמָלוֹ לֹא יִזְכָּר עֽוֹד׃
translation: Let him drink, and forget his poverty, and remember his misery no more. (Proverbs 31:7)

text: וּבָֽא כִמְהַלֵּךְ רֵאשֶׁךָ וּמַחְסֹֽרְךָ כְּאִישׁ מָגֵֽן׃
translation: so your poverty will come as a robber, and your scarcity as an armed man. (Proverbs 6:11)

text: וּבָֽא מִתְהַלֵּךְ רֵישֶׁךָ וּמַחְסֹרֶיךָ כְּאִישׁ מָגֵֽן׃
translation: so your poverty will come as a robber and your want as an armed man. (Proverbs 24:34)

text: הֲבֵל הֲבָלִים אָמַר קֹהֶלֶת הֲבֵל הֲבָלִים הַכֹּל הָֽבֶל׃
translation: "Vanity of vanities," says the Preacher; "Vanity of vanities, all is vanity." (Ecclesiastes 1:2)

text: אֲנִי קֹהֶלֶת הָיִיתִי מֶלֶךְ עַל יִשְׂרָאֵל בִּירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
translation: I, the Preacher, was king over Israel in Jerusalem. (Ecclesiastes 1:12)

text: רְאֵה זֶה מָצָאתִי אָמְרָה קֹהֶלֶת אַחַת לְאַחַת לִמְצֹא חֶשְׁבּֽוֹן׃
translation: "Behold, I have found this," says the Preacher, "to one another, to find an explanation (Ecclesiastes 7:27)

text: בִּקֵּשׁ קֹהֶלֶת לִמְצֹא דִּבְרֵי חֵפֶץ וְכָתוּב יֹשֶׁר דִּבְרֵי אֱמֶֽת׃
translation: The Preacher sought to find out acceptable words, and that which was written blamelessly, words of truth. (Ecclesiastes 12:10)

text: דִּבְרֵי קֹהֶלֶת בֶּן דָּוִד מֶלֶךְ בִּירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
translation: The words of the Preacher, the son of David, king in Jerusalem: (Ecclesiastes 1:1)

text: הֲבֵל הֲבָלִים אָמַר הַקּוֹהֶלֶת הַכֹּל הָֽבֶל׃
translation: "Vanity of vanities," says the Preacher. "All is vanity!" (Ecclesiastes 12:8)

text: תְּחִלַּת דִּבְרֵי פִיהוּ סִכְלוּת וְאַחֲרִית פִּיהוּ הוֹלֵלוּת רָעָֽה׃
translation: The beginning of the words of his mouth is foolishness; and the end of his talk is mischievous madness. (Ecclesiastes 10:13)

text: וְרָאִיתִי אָנִי שֶׁיֵּשׁ יִתְרוֹן לַֽחָכְמָה מִן הַסִּכְלוּת כִּֽיתְרוֹן הָאוֹר מִן הַחֹֽשֶׁךְ׃
translation: Then I saw that wisdom excels folly, as far as light excels darkness. (Ecclesiastes 2:13)

text: זְבוּבֵי מָוֶת יַבְאִישׁ יַבִּיעַ שֶׁמֶן רוֹקֵחַ יָקָר מֵחָכְמָה מִכָּבוֹד סִכְלוּת מְעָֽט׃
translation: Dead flies cause the oil of the perfumer to produce an evil odor; so does a little folly outweigh wisdom and honor. (Ecclesiastes 10:1)

text: סַבּוֹתִֽי אֲנִי וְלִבִּי לָדַעַת וְלָתוּר וּבַקֵּשׁ חָכְמָה וְחֶשְׁבּוֹן וְלָדַעַת רֶשַׁע כֶּסֶל וְהַסִּכְלוּת הוֹלֵלֽוֹת׃
translation: I turned around, and my heart sought to know and to search out, and to seek wisdom and the scheme of things, and to know that wickedness is stupidity, and that foolishness is madness. (Ecclesiastes 7:25)

text: וּפָנִיתִֽי אֲנִי לִרְאוֹת חָכְמָה וְהוֹלֵלוֹת וְסִכְלוּת כִּי מֶה הָאָדָם שֶׁיָּבוֹא אַחֲרֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ אֵת אֲשֶׁר כְּבָר עָשֽׂוּהוּ׃
translation: I turned myself to consider wisdom, madness, and folly; for what can the king's successor do? Just that which has been done long ago. (Ecclesiastes 2:12)

text: וָאֱהִי לָהֶם כְּמוֹ שָׁחַל כְּנָמֵר עַל דֶּרֶךְ אָשֽׁוּר׃
translation: Therefore I am like a lion to them. Like a leopard, I will lurk by the path. (Hosea 13:7)

text: הֲיַהֲפֹךְ כּוּשִׁי עוֹרוֹ וְנָמֵר חֲבַרְבֻּרֹתָיו גַּם אַתֶּם תּוּכְלוּ לְהֵיטִיב לִמֻּדֵי הָרֵֽעַ׃
translation: Can the Ethiopian change his skin, or the leopard his spots? Then may you also do good, who are accustomed to do evil. (Jeremiah 13:23)

text: וְקַלּוּ מִנְּמֵרִים סוּסָיו וְחַדּוּ מִזְּאֵבֵי עֶרֶב וּפָשׁוּ פָּֽרָשָׁיו וּפָֽרָשָׁיו מֵרָחוֹק יָבֹאוּ יָעֻפוּ כְּנֶשֶׁר חָשׁ לֶאֱכֽוֹל׃
translation: Their horses also are swifter than leopards, and are more fierce than the evening wolves. Their horsemen press proudly on. Yes, their horsemen come from afar. They fly as an eagle that hurries to devour. (Habakkuk 1:8)

text: אִתִּי מִלְּבָנוֹן כַּלָּה אִתִּי מִלְּבָנוֹן תָּבוֹאִי תָּשׁוּרִי מֵרֹאשׁ אֲמָנָה מֵרֹאשׁ שְׂנִיר וְחֶרְמוֹן מִמְּעֹנוֹת אֲרָיוֹת מֵֽהַרְרֵי נְמֵרִֽים׃
translation: Come with me from Lebanon, my bride, with me from Lebanon. Look from the top of Amana, from the top of Senir and Hermon, from the lions' dens, from the mountains of the leopards. (Song of Solomon 4:8)

text: וְגָר זְאֵב עִם כֶּבֶשׂ וְנָמֵר עִם גְּדִי יִרְבָּץ וְעֵגֶל וּכְפִיר וּמְרִיא יַחְדָּו וְנַעַר קָטֹן נֹהֵג בָּֽם׃
translation: The wolf will live with the lamb, and the leopard will lie down with the young goat, the calf, the young lion, and the fattened calf together; and a little child will lead them. (Isaiah 11:6)

text: וְצֹאנִי מִרְמַס רַגְלֵיכֶם תִּרְעֶינָה וּמִרְפַּשׂ רַגְלֵיכֶם תִּשְׁתֶּֽינָה׃
translation: As for my sheep, they eat that which you have trodden with your feet, and they drink that which you have fouled with your feet.' (Ezekiel 34:19)

text: בְּגוֹי חָנֵף אֲשַׁלְּחֶנּוּ וְעַל עַם עֶבְרָתִי אֲצַוֶּנּוּ לִשְׁלֹל שָׁלָל וְלָבֹז בַּז ולשימו וּלְשׂוּמוֹ מִרְמָס כְּחֹמֶר חוּצֽוֹת׃
translation: I will send him against a profane nation, and against the people who anger me I will give him a command to take the plunder and to take the prey, and to tread them down like the mire of the streets. (Isaiah 10:6)

text: וְעַתָּה אוֹדִֽיעָה נָּא אֶתְכֶם אֵת אֲשֶׁר אֲנִי עֹשֶׂה לְכַרְמִי הָסֵר מְשׂוּכָּתוֹ וְהָיָה לְבָעֵר פָּרֹץ גְּדֵרוֹ וְהָיָה לְמִרְמָֽס׃
translation: Now I will tell you what I will do to my vineyard. I will take away its hedge, and it will be eaten up. I will break down its wall, and it will be trampled down. (Isaiah 5:5)

text: וְתֵרֶא אֹיַבְתִּי וּתְכַסֶּהָ בוּשָׁה הָאֹמְרָה אֵלַי אַיּוֹ יְהוָה אֱלֹהָיִךְ עֵינַי תִּרְאֶינָּה בָּהּ עַתָּה תִּֽהְיֶה לְמִרְמָס כְּטִיט חוּצֽוֹת׃
translation: Then my enemy will see it, and shame will cover her who said to me, "Where is the LORD your God?" My eyes will see her. Now she will be trodden down like the mire of the streets. (Micah 7:10)

text: וָאֶשְׁמְעָה אֶֽחָד קָדוֹשׁ מְדַבֵּר וַיֹּאמֶר אֶחָד קָדוֹשׁ לַפַּֽלְמוֹנִי הַֽמְדַבֵּר עַד מָתַי הֶחָזוֹן הַתָּמִיד וְהַפֶּשַׁע שֹׁמֵם תֵּת וְקֹדֶשׁ וְצָבָא מִרְמָֽס׃
translation: Then I heard a holy one speaking; and another holy one said to that certain one who spoke, "How long will the vision about the continual burnt offering, and the disobedience that makes desolate, to give both the sanctuary and the army to be trodden under foot be?" (Daniel 8:13)

text: אֲנִי צִוֵּיתִי לִמְקֻדָּשָׁי גַּם קָרָאתִי גִבּוֹרַי לְאַפִּי עַלִּיזֵי גַּאֲוָתִֽי׃
translation: I have commanded my consecrated ones; yes, I have called my mighty men for my anger, even my proudly exulting ones. (Isaiah 13:3)

text: שָׁבַת מְשׂוֹשׂ תֻּפִּים חָדַל שְׁאוֹן עַלִּיזִים שָׁבַת מְשׂוֹשׂ כִּנּֽוֹר׃
translation: The mirth of tambourines ceases. The sound of those who rejoice ends. The joy of the harp ceases. (Isaiah 24:8)

text: הֲזֹאת לָכֶם עַלִּיזָה מִֽימֵי קֶדֶם קַדְמָתָהּ יֹבִלוּהָ רַגְלֶיהָ מֵֽרָחוֹק לָגֽוּר׃
translation: Is this your joyous city, whose antiquity is of ancient days, whose feet carried her far away to travel? (Isaiah 23:7)

text: תְּשֻׁאוֹת מְלֵאָה עִיר הֽוֹמִיָּה קִרְיָה עַלִּיזָה חֲלָלַיִךְ לֹא חַלְלֵי חֶרֶב וְלֹא מֵתֵי מִלְחָמָֽה׃
translation: You that are full of shouting, a tumultuous city, a joyous town, your slain are not slain with the sword, neither are they dead in battle. (Isaiah 22:2)

text: עַל אַדְמַת עַמִּי קוֹץ שָׁמִיר תַּֽעֲלֶה כִּי עַל כָּל בָּתֵּי מָשׂוֹשׂ קִרְיָה עַלִּיזָֽה׃
translation: Thorns and briers will come up on my people's land; yes, on all the houses of joy in the joyous city. (Isaiah 32:13)

text: וְנָתַתִּי אֶת הָאָרֶץ שְׁמָמָה וּמְשַׁמָּה וְנִשְׁבַּת גְּאוֹן עֻזָּהּ וְשָֽׁמְמוּ הָרֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵאֵין עוֹבֵֽר׃
translation: I will make the land a desolation and an astonishment. The pride of her power will cease. The mountains of Israel will be desolate, so that no one will pass through. (Ezekiel 33:28)

text: וְיָדְעוּ כִּֽי אֲנִי יְהוָה בְּתִתִּי אֶת הָאָרֶץ שְׁמָמָה וּמְשַׁמָּה עַל כָּל תּוֹעֲבֹתָם אֲשֶׁר עָשֽׂוּ׃
translation: Then they will know that I am the LORD, when I have made the land a desolation and an astonishment because of all their abominations which they have committed."' (Ezekiel 33:29)

text: וְאָמַרְתָּ לּוֹ כֹּה אָמַר אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה הִנְנִי אֵלֶיךָ הַר שֵׂעִיר וְנָטִיתִי יָדִי עָלֶיךָ וּנְתַתִּיךָ שְׁמָמָה וּמְשַׁמָּֽה׃
translation: and tell it, 'The Lord GOD says: "Behold, I am against you, Mount Seir, and I will stretch out my hand against you. I will make you a desolation and an astonishment. (Ezekiel 35:3)

text: וְנָטִיתִי אֶת יָדִי עֲלֵיהֶם וְנָתַתִּי אֶת הָאָרֶץ שְׁמָמָה וּמְשַׁמָּה מִמִּדְבַּר דִּבְלָתָה בְּכֹל מוֹשְׁבֽוֹתֵיהֶם וְיָדְעוּ כִּֽי אֲנִי יְהוָֽה׃
translation: I will stretch out my hand on them and make the land desolate and waste, from the wilderness toward Diblah, throughout all their habitations. Then they will know that I am the LORD.'" (Ezekiel 6:14)

text: וְֽהָיְתָה חֶרְפָּה וּגְדוּפָה מוּסָר וּמְשַׁמָּה לַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר סְבִיבוֹתָיִךְ בַּעֲשׂוֹתִי בָךְ שְׁפָטִים בְּאַף וּבְחֵמָה וּבְתֹכְחוֹת חֵמָה אֲנִי יְהוָה דִּבַּֽרְתִּי׃
translation: So it will be a reproach and a taunt, an instruction and an astonishment, to the nations that are around you, when I execute judgments on you in anger and in wrath, and in wrathful rebukes—I, the LORD, have spoken it— (Ezekiel 5:15)

text: מִזַּעֲקַת חֶשְׁבּוֹן עַד אֶלְעָלֵה עַד יַהַץ נָתְנוּ קוֹלָם מִצֹּעַר עַד חֹרֹנַיִם עֶגְלַת שְׁלִֽשִׁיָּה כִּי גַּם מֵי נִמְרִים לִמְשַׁמּוֹת יִהְיֽוּ׃
translation: From the cry of Heshbon even to Elealeh, even to Jahaz they have uttered their voice, from Zoar even to Horonaim, to Eglath Shelishiyah; for the waters of Nimrim will also become desolate. (Jeremiah 48:34)

text: נִשְׁבַּע יְהוָה צְבָאוֹת בְּנַפְשׁוֹ כִּי אִם מִלֵּאתִיךְ אָדָם כַּיֶּלֶק וְעָנוּ עָלַיִךְ הֵידָֽד׃
translation: The LORD of Armies has sworn by himself, saying, 'Surely I will fill you with men, as with locusts, and they will lift up a shout against you.' (Jeremiah 51:14)

text: וְנֶאֶסְפָה שִׂמְחָה וָגִיל מִכַּרְמֶל וּמֵאֶרֶץ מוֹאָב וְיַיִן מִיקָבִים הִשְׁבַּתִּי לֹֽא יִדְרֹךְ הֵידָד הֵידָד לֹא הֵידָֽד׃
translation: Gladness and joy is taken away from the fruitful field and from the land of Moab. I have caused wine to cease from the wine presses. No one will tread with shouting. The shouting will be no shouting. (Jeremiah 48:33)

text: וְנֶאֱסַף שִׂמְחָה וָגִיל מִן הַכַּרְמֶל וּבַכְּרָמִים לֹֽא יְרֻנָּן לֹא יְרֹעָע יַיִן בַּיְקָבִים לֹֽא יִדְרֹךְ הַדֹּרֵךְ הֵידָד הִשְׁבַּֽתִּי׃
translation: Gladness is taken away, and joy out of the fruitful field; and in the vineyards there will be no singing, neither joyful noise. Nobody will tread out wine in the presses. I have made the shouting stop. (Isaiah 16:10)

text: עַל כֵּן אֶבְכֶּה בִּבְכִי יַעְזֵר גֶּפֶן שִׂבְמָה אֲרַיָּוֶךְ דִּמְעָתִי חֶשְׁבּוֹן וְאֶלְעָלֵה כִּי עַל קֵיצֵךְ וְעַל קְצִירֵךְ הֵידָד נָפָֽל׃
translation: Therefore I will weep with the weeping of Jazer for the vine of Sibmah. I will water you with my tears, Heshbon, and Elealeh: for on your summer fruits and on your harvest the battle shout has fallen. (Isaiah 16:9)

text: וְשַׂמְתִּי שֹׁמְרוֹן לְעִי הַשָּׂדֶה לְמַטָּעֵי כָרֶם וְהִגַּרְתִּי לַגַּי אֲבָנֶיהָ וִיסֹדֶיהָ אֲגַלֶּֽה׃
translation: Therefore I will make Samaria like a rubble heap of the field, like places for planting vineyards; and I will pour down its stones into the valley, and I will uncover its foundations. (Micah 1:6)

text: וְעַמֵּךְ כֻּלָּם צַדִּיקִים לְעוֹלָם יִירְשׁוּ אָרֶץ נֵצֶר מטעו מַטָּעַי מַעֲשֵׂה יָדַי לְהִתְפָּאֵֽר׃
translation: Then your people will all be righteous. They will inherit the land forever, the branch of my planting, the work of my hands, that I may be glorified. (Isaiah 60:21)

text: וַהֲקִמֹתִי לָהֶם מַטָּע לְשֵׁם וְלֹֽא יִהְיוּ עוֹד אֲסֻפֵי רָעָב בָּאָרֶץ וְלֹֽא יִשְׂאוּ עוֹד כְּלִמַּת הַגּוֹיִֽם׃
translation: I will raise up to them a plantation for renown, and they will no more be consumed with famine in the land, and not bear the shame of the nations any more. (Ezekiel 34:29)

text: מַיִם גִּדְּלוּהוּ תְּהוֹם רֹֽמְמָתְהוּ אֶת נַהֲרֹתֶיהָ הֹלֵךְ סְבִיבוֹת מַטָּעָהּ וְאֶת תְּעָלֹתֶיהָ שִׁלְחָה אֶל כָּל עֲצֵי הַשָּׂדֶֽה׃
translation: The waters nourished it. The deep made it to grow. Its rivers ran all around its plantation. It sent out its channels to all the trees of the field. (Ezekiel 31:4)

text: וּתְמַהֵרְנָה וְתִשֶּׂנָה עָלֵינוּ נֶהִי וְתֵרַדְנָה עֵינֵינוּ דִּמְעָה וְעַפְעַפֵּינוּ יִזְּלוּ מָֽיִם׃
translation: The LORD of Armies says, "Consider, and call for the mourning women, that they may come. Send for the skillful women, that they may come. (Jeremiah 9:17)

text: כִּי קוֹל נְהִי נִשְׁמַע מִצִּיּוֹן אֵיךְ שֻׁדָּדְנוּ בֹּשְׁנֽוּ מְאֹד כִּֽי עָזַבְנוּ אָרֶץ כִּי הִשְׁלִיכוּ מִשְׁכְּנוֹתֵֽינוּ׃
translation: Let them make haste and take up a wailing for us, that our eyes may run down with tears and our eyelids gush out with waters. (Jeremiah 9:18)

text: כִּֽי שְׁמַעְנָה נָשִׁים דְּבַר יְהוָה וְתִקַּח אָזְנְכֶם דְּבַר פִּיו וְלַמֵּדְנָה בְנֽוֹתֵיכֶם נֶהִי וְאִשָּׁה רְעוּתָהּ קִינָֽה׃
translation: For a voice of wailing is heard out of Zion, 'How we are ruined! We are greatly confounded because we have forsaken the land, because they have cast down our dwellings.'" (Jeremiah 9:19)

text: כֹּה אָמַר יְהוָה קוֹל בְּרָמָה נִשְׁמָע נְהִי בְּכִי תַמְרוּרִים רָחֵל מְבַכָּה עַל בָּנֶיהָ מֵאֲנָה לְהִנָּחֵם עַל בָּנֶיהָ כִּי אֵינֶֽנּוּ׃
translation: The LORD says: "A voice is heard in Ramah, lamentation and bitter weeping, Rachel weeping for her children. She refuses to be comforted for her children, because they are no more." (Jeremiah 31:15)

text: בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא יִשָּׂא עֲלֵיכֶם מָשָׁל וְנָהָה נְהִי נִֽהְיָה אָמַר שָׁדוֹד נְשַׁדֻּנוּ חֵלֶק עַמִּי יָמִיר אֵיךְ יָמִישׁ לִי לְשׁוֹבֵב שָׂדֵינוּ יְחַלֵּֽק׃
translation: In that day they will take up a parable against you, and lament with a doleful lamentation, saying, 'We are utterly ruined! My people's possession is divided up. Indeed he takes it from me and assigns our fields to traitors!'" (Micah 2:4)

text: וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר סְבִיבֹתָיו עזרה עֶזְרוֹ וְכָל אֲגַפָּיו אֱזָרֶה לְכָל רוּחַ וְחֶרֶב אָרִיק אַחֲרֵיהֶֽם׃
translation: I will scatter toward every wind all who are around him to help him, and all his bands. I will draw out the sword after them. (Ezekiel 12:14)

text: גֹּמֶר וְכָל אֲגַפֶּיהָ בֵּית תּֽוֹגַרְמָה יַרְכְּתֵי צָפוֹן וְאֶת כָּל אֲגַפָּיו עַמִּים רַבִּים אִתָּֽךְ׃
translation: Gomer, and all his hordes; the house of Togarmah in the uttermost parts of the north, and all his hordes—even many peoples with you. (Ezekiel 38:6)

text: וְעָלִיתָ כַּשֹּׁאָה תָבוֹא כֶּעָנָן לְכַסּוֹת הָאָרֶץ תִּֽהְיֶה אַתָּה וְכָל אֲגַפֶּיךָ וְעַמִּים רַבִּים אוֹתָֽךְ׃
translation: You will ascend. You will come like a storm. You will be like a cloud to cover the land, you and all your hordes, and many peoples with you." (Ezekiel 38:9)

text: וְאֵת כָּל מברחו מִבְרָחָיו בְּכָל אֲגַפָּיו בַּחֶרֶב יִפֹּלוּ וְהַנִּשְׁאָרִים לְכָל רוּחַ יִפָּרֵשׂוּ וִידַעְתֶּם כִּי אֲנִי יְהוָה דִּבַּֽרְתִּי׃
translation: All his fugitives in all his bands will fall by the sword, and those who remain will be scattered toward every wind. Then you will know that I, the LORD, have spoken it.' (Ezekiel 17:21)

text: עַל הָרֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל תִּפּוֹל אַתָּה וְכָל אֲגַפֶּיךָ וְעַמִּים אֲשֶׁר אִתָּךְ לְעֵיט צִפּוֹר כָּל כָּנָף וְחַיַּת הַשָּׂדֶה נְתַתִּיךָ לְאָכְלָֽה׃
translation: You will fall on the mountains of Israel, you, and all your hordes, and the peoples who are with you. I will give you to the ravenous birds of every sort and to the animals of the field to be devoured. (Ezekiel 39:4)

text: מִבֵּית תּוֹגַרְמָה סוּסִים וּפָֽרָשִׁים וּפְרָדִים נָתְנוּ עִזְבוֹנָֽיִךְ׃
translation: "'"They of the house of Togarmah traded for your wares with horses, war horses, and mules. (Ezekiel 27:14)

text: תַּרְשִׁישׁ סֹחַרְתֵּךְ מֵרֹב כָּל הוֹן בְּכֶסֶף בַּרְזֶל בְּדִיל וְעוֹפֶרֶת נָתְנוּ עִזְבוֹנָֽיִךְ׃
translation: "'"Tarshish was your merchant by reason of the multitude of all kinds of riches. They traded for your wares with silver, iron, tin, and lead. (Ezekiel 27:12)

text: וְדָן וְיָוָן מְאוּזָּל בְּעִזְבוֹנַיִךְ נָתָנּוּ בַּרְזֶל עָשׁוֹת קִדָּה וְקָנֶה בְּמַעֲרָבֵךְ הָיָֽה׃
translation: "'"Vedan and Javan traded with yarn for your wares; wrought iron, cassia, and calamus were among your merchandise. (Ezekiel 27:19)

text: בְּצֵאת עִזְבוֹנַיִךְ מִיַּמִּים הִשְׂבַּעַתְּ עַמִּים רַבִּים בְּרֹב הוֹנַיִךְ וּמַעֲרָבַיִךְ הֶעֱשַׁרְתְּ מַלְכֵי אָֽרֶץ׃
translation: When your wares came from the seas, you filled many peoples. You enriched the kings of the earth with the multitude of your riches and of your merchandise. (Ezekiel 27:33)

text: רֹכְלֵי שְׁבָא וְרַעְמָה הֵמָּה רֹכְלָיִךְ בְּרֹאשׁ כָּל בֹּשֶׂם וּבְכָל אֶבֶן יְקָרָה וְזָהָב נָתְנוּ עִזְבוֹנָֽיִךְ׃
translation: "'"The traders of Sheba and Raamah were your traders. They traded for your wares with the best of all spices, all precious stones, and gold. (Ezekiel 27:22)

text: וְנִמְצָא יְשַׁלֵּם שִׁבְעָתָיִם אֶת כָּל הוֹן בֵּיתוֹ יִתֵּֽן׃
translation: but if he is found, he shall restore seven times. He shall give all the wealth of his house. (Proverbs 6:31)

text: כִּי שִׁבְעָתַיִם יֻקַּם קָיִן וְלֶמֶךְ שִׁבְעִים וְשִׁבְעָֽה׃
translation: If Cain will be avenged seven times, truly Lamech seventy-seven times." (Genesis 4:24)

text: וְהָשֵׁב לִשְׁכֵנֵינוּ שִׁבְעָתַיִם אֶל חֵיקָם חֶרְפָּתָם אֲשֶׁר חֵרְפוּךָ אֲדֹנָֽי׃
translation: Pay back to our neighbors seven times into their bosom their reproach with which they have reproached you, Lord. (Psalms 79:12)

text: אִֽמֲרוֹת יְהוָה אֲמָרוֹת טְהֹרוֹת כֶּסֶף צָרוּף בַּעֲלִיל לָאָרֶץ מְזֻקָּק שִׁבְעָתָֽיִם׃
translation: You will keep them, LORD. You will preserve them from this generation forever. (Psalms 12:7)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ יְהוָה לָכֵן כָּל הֹרֵג קַיִן שִׁבְעָתַיִם יֻקָּם וַיָּשֶׂם יְהוָה לְקַיִן אוֹת לְבִלְתִּי הַכּוֹת אֹתוֹ כָּל מֹצְאֽוֹ׃
translation: The LORD said to him, "Therefore whoever slays Cain, vengeance will be taken on him sevenfold." The LORD appointed a sign for Cain, so that anyone finding him would not strike him. (Genesis 4:15)

text: שָׂרֵי יְהוּדָה וְשָׂרֵי יְרוּשָׁלִַם הַסָּֽרִסִים וְהַכֹּהֲנִים וְכֹל עַם הָאָרֶץ הָעֹבְרִים בֵּין בִּתְרֵי הָעֵֽגֶל׃
translation: the princes of Judah, the princes of Jerusalem, the eunuchs, the priests, and all the people of the land, who passed between the parts of the calf. (Jeremiah 34:19)

text: עַד שֶׁיָּפוּחַ הַיּוֹם וְנָסוּ הַצְּלָלִים סֹב דְּמֵה לְךָ דוֹדִי לִצְבִי אוֹ לְעֹפֶר הָאַיָּלִים עַל הָרֵי בָֽתֶר׃
translation: Until the day is cool, and the shadows flee away, turn, my beloved, and be like a roe or a young deer on the mountains of Bether. (Song of Solomon 2:17)

text: וַיִּֽקַּֽח לוֹ אֶת כָּל אֵלֶּה וַיְבַתֵּר אֹתָם בַּתָּוֶךְ וַיִּתֵּן אִישׁ בִּתְרוֹ לִקְרַאת רֵעֵהוּ וְאֶת הַצִפֹּר לֹא בָתָֽר׃
translation: He brought him all these, and divided them in the middle, and laid each half opposite the other; but he didn't divide the birds. (Genesis 15:10)

text: יָשֶׁת חֹשֶׁךְ סִתְרוֹ סְבִֽיבוֹתָיו סֻכָּתוֹ חֶשְׁכַת מַיִם עָבֵי שְׁחָקִֽים׃
translation: At the brightness before him his thick clouds passed, hailstones and coals of fire. (Psalms 18:12)

text: לֹא יָֽדְעוּ וְלֹא יָבִינוּ בַּחֲשֵׁכָה יִתְהַלָּכוּ יִמּוֹטוּ כָּל מוֹסְדֵי אָֽרֶץ׃
translation: They don't know, neither do they understand. They walk back and forth in darkness. All the foundations of the earth are shaken. (Psalms 82:5)

text: גַּם חֹשֶׁךְ לֹֽא יַחְשִׁיךְ מִמֶּךָ וְלַיְלָה כַּיּוֹם יָאִיר כַּחֲשֵׁיכָה כָּאוֹרָֽה׃
translation: even the darkness doesn't hide from you, but the night shines as the day. The darkness is like light to you. (Psalms 139:12)

text: וְאֶל אֶרֶץ יַבִּיט וְהִנֵּה צָרָה וַחֲשֵׁכָה מְעוּף צוּקָה וַאֲפֵלָה מְנֻדָּֽח׃
translation: then look to the earth and see distress, darkness, and the gloom of anguish. They will be driven into thick darkness. (Isaiah 8:22)

text: מִי בָכֶם יְרֵא יְהוָה שֹׁמֵעַ בְּקוֹל עַבְדּוֹ אֲשֶׁר הָלַךְ חֲשֵׁכִים וְאֵין נֹגַהּ לוֹ יִבְטַח בְּשֵׁם יְהוָה וְיִשָּׁעֵן בֵּאלֹהָֽיו׃
translation: Who among you fears the LORD and obeys the voice of his servant? He who walks in darkness and has no light, let him trust in the LORD's name, and rely on his God. (Isaiah 50:10)

text: לַמִּצְעָר יָרְשׁוּ עַם קָדְשֶׁךָ צָרֵינוּ בּוֹסְסוּ מִקְדָּשֶֽׁךָ׃
translation: Your holy people possessed it but a little while. Our adversaries have trodden down your sanctuary. (Isaiah 63:18)

text: וְהָיָה רֵאשִׁיתְךָ מִצְעָר וְאַחֲרִיתְךָ יִשְׂגֶּה מְאֹֽד׃
translation: Though your beginning was small, yet your latter end would greatly increase. (Job 8:7)

text: אֱֽלֹהַי עָלַי נַפְשִׁי תִשְׁתּוֹחָח עַל כֵּן אֶזְכָּרְךָ מֵאֶרֶץ יַרְדֵּן וְחֶרְמוֹנִים מֵהַר מִצְעָֽר׃
translation: Deep calls to deep at the noise of your waterfalls. All your waves and your billows have swept over me. (Psalms 42:7)

text: הִנֵּה נָא הָעִיר הַזֹּאת קְרֹבָה לָנוּס שָׁמָּה וְהִיא מִצְעָר אִמָּלְטָה נָּא שָׁמָּה הֲלֹא מִצְעָר הִוא וּתְחִי נַפְשִֽׁי׃
translation: See now, this city is near to flee to, and it is a little one. Oh let me escape there (isn't it a little one?), and my soul will live." (Genesis 19:20)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר לָבָן לֹא יֵעָשֶׂה כֵן בִּמְקוֹמֵנוּ לָתֵת הַצְּעִירָה לִפְנֵי הַבְּכִירָֽה׃
translation: Laban said, "It is not done so in our place, to give the younger before the firstborn. (Genesis 29:26)

text: וַתֵּלֶד הַבְּכִירָה בֵּן וַתִּקְרָא שְׁמוֹ מוֹאָב הוּא אֲבִֽי מוֹאָב עַד הַיּֽוֹם׃
translation: The firstborn bore a son, and named him Moab. He is the father of the Moabites to this day. (Genesis 19:37)

text: וַתֹּאמֶר הַבְּכִירָה אֶל הַצְּעִירָה אָבִינוּ זָקֵן וְאִישׁ אֵין בָּאָרֶץ לָבוֹא עָלֵינוּ כְּדֶרֶךְ כָּל הָאָֽרֶץ׃
translation: The firstborn said to the younger, "Our father is old, and there is not a man in the earth to come in to us in the way of all the earth. (Genesis 19:31)

text: וַתַּשְׁקֶיןָ אֶת אֲבִיהֶן יַיִן בַּלַּיְלָה הוּא וַתָּבֹא הַבְּכִירָה וַתִּשְׁכַּב אֶת אָבִיהָ וְלֹֽא יָדַע בְּשִׁכְבָהּ וּבְקׄוּמָֽהּ׃
translation: They made their father drink wine that night: and the firstborn went in, and lay with her father. He didn't know when she lay down, nor when she arose. (Genesis 19:33)

text: וַיִּֽהְיוּ בְּנֵי שָׁאוּל יוֹנָתָן וְיִשְׁוִי וּמַלְכִּי שׁוּעַ וְשֵׁם שְׁתֵּי בְנֹתָיו שֵׁם הַבְּכִירָה מֵרַב וְשֵׁם הַקְּטַנָּה מִיכַֽל׃
translation: Now the sons of Saul were Jonathan, Ishvi, and Malchishua; and the names of his two daughters were these: the name of the firstborn Merab, and the name of the younger Michal. (1 Samuel 14:49)

text: וַיִּשְׁלַח אַבְרָהָם אֶת יָדוֹ וַיִּקַּח אֶת הַֽמַּאֲכֶלֶת לִשְׁחֹט אֶת בְּנֽוֹ׃
translation: Abraham stretched out his hand, and took the knife to kill his son. (Genesis 22:10)

text: דּוֹר חֲרָבוֹת שִׁנָּיו וּֽמַאֲכָלוֹת מְֽתַלְּעֹתָיו לֶאֱכֹל עֲנִיִּים מֵאֶרֶץ וְאֶבְיוֹנִים מֵאָדָֽם׃
translation: There is a generation whose teeth are like swords, and their jaws like knives, to devour the poor from the earth, and the needy from among men. (Proverbs 30:14)

text: כִּי כָל סְאוֹן סֹאֵן בְּרַעַשׁ וְשִׂמְלָה מְגוֹלָלָה בְדָמִים וְהָיְתָה לִשְׂרֵפָה מַאֲכֹלֶת אֵֽשׁ׃
translation: For the yoke of his burden, and the staff of his shoulder, the rod of his oppressor, you have broken as in the day of Midian. (Isaiah 9:4)

text: בְּעֶבְרַת יְהוָה צְבָאוֹת נֶעְתַּם אָרֶץ וַיְהִי הָעָם כְּמַאֲכֹלֶת אֵשׁ אִישׁ אֶל אָחִיו לֹא יַחְמֹֽלוּ׃
translation: For wickedness burns like a fire. It devours the briers and thorns; yes, it kindles in the thickets of the forest, and they roll upward in a column of smoke. (Isaiah 9:18)

text: וַיָּבֹא אֶל בֵּיתוֹ וַיִּקַּח אֶת הַֽמַּאֲכֶלֶת וַיַּחֲזֵק בְּפִֽילַגְשׁוֹ וַֽיְנַתְּחֶהָ לַעֲצָמֶיהָ לִשְׁנֵים עָשָׂר נְתָחִים וַֽיְשַׁלְּחֶהָ בְּכֹל גְּבוּל יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
translation: When he had come into his house, he took a knife and cut up his concubine, and divided her, limb by limb, into twelve pieces, and sent her throughout all the borders of Israel. (Judges 19:29)

text: וַיִּקַּח אַבְרָהָם אֶת עֲצֵי הָעֹלָה וַיָּשֶׂם עַל יִצְחָק בְּנוֹ וַיִּקַּח בְּיָדוֹ אֶת הָאֵשׁ וְאֶת הַֽמַּאֲכֶלֶת וַיֵּלְכוּ שְׁנֵיהֶם יַחְדָּֽו׃
translation: Abraham took the wood of the burnt offering and laid it on Isaac his son. He took in his hand the fire and the knife. They both went together. (Genesis 22:6)

text: הֲיִֽגְאֶה גֹּמֶא בְּלֹא בִצָּה יִשְׂגֶּה אָחוּ בְלִי מָֽיִם׃
translation: "Can the papyrus grow up without mire? Can the rushes grow without water? (Job 8:11)

text: וַיָּרָץ הָעֶבֶד לִקְרָאתָהּ וַיֹּאמֶר הַגְמִיאִינִי נָא מְעַט מַיִם מִכַּדֵּֽךְ׃
translation: The servant ran to meet her, and said, "Please give me a drink, a little water from your pitcher." (Genesis 24:17)

text: בְּרַעַשׁ וְרֹגֶז יְגַמֶּא אָרֶץ וְלֹֽא יַאֲמִין כִּי קוֹל שׁוֹפָֽר׃
translation: He eats up the ground with fierceness and rage, neither does he stand still at the sound of the trumpet. (Job 39:24)

text: וְהָיָה הַשָּׁרָב לַאֲגַם וְצִמָּאוֹן לְמַבּוּעֵי מָיִם בִּנְוֵה תַנִּים רִבְצָהּ חָצִיר לְקָנֶה וָגֹֽמֶא׃
translation: The burning sand will become a pool, and the thirsty ground springs of water. Grass with reeds and rushes will be in the habitation of jackals, where they lay. (Isaiah 35:7)

text: וְלֹא יָכְלָה עוֹד הַצְּפִינוֹ וַתִּֽקַּֽח לוֹ תֵּבַת גֹּמֶא וַתַּחְמְרָה בַחֵמָר וּבַזָּפֶת וַתָּשֶׂם בָּהּ אֶת הַיֶּלֶד וַתָּשֶׂם בַּסּוּף עַל שְׂפַת הַיְאֹֽר׃
translation: When she could no longer hide him, she took a papyrus basket for him, and coated it with tar and with pitch. She put the child in it, and laid it in the reeds by the river's bank. (Exodus 2:3)

text: וַיֵּדַע אַלְמְנוֹתָיו וְעָרֵיהֶם הֶחֱרִיב וַתֵּשַׁם אֶרֶץ וּמְלֹאָהּ מִקּוֹל שַׁאֲגָתֽוֹ׃
translation: He knew their palaces, and laid waste their cities. The land was desolate with its fullness, because of the noise of his roaring. (Ezekiel 19:7)

text: וַיָּמָת יוֹסֵף בֶּן מֵאָה וָעֶשֶׂר שָׁנִים וַיַּחַנְטוּ אֹתוֹ וַיִּישֶׂם בָּאָרוֹן בְּמִצְרָֽיִם׃
translation: So Joseph died, being one hundred ten years old, and they embalmed him, and he was put in a coffin in Egypt. (Genesis 50:26)

text: ויישם וַיּוּשַׂם לְפָנָיו לֶאֱכֹל וַיֹּאמֶר לֹא אֹכַל עַד אִם דִּבַּרְתִּי דְּבָרָי וַיֹּאמֶר דַּבֵּֽר׃
translation: Food was set before him to eat, but he said, "I will not eat until I have told my message." Laban said, "Speak on." (Genesis 24:33)

text: בְּכֹל מוֹשְׁבוֹתֵיכֶם הֶעָרִים תֶּחֱרַבְנָה וְהַבָּמוֹת תִּישָׁמְנָה לְמַעַן יֶחֶרְבוּ וְיֶאְשְׁמוּ מִזְבְּחֽוֹתֵיכֶם וְנִשְׁבְּרוּ וְנִשְׁבְּתוּ גִּלּוּלֵיכֶם וְנִגְדְּעוּ חַמָּנֵיכֶם וְנִמְחוּ מַעֲשֵׂיכֶֽם׃
translation: In all your dwelling places, the cities will be laid waste and the high places will be desolate, so that your altars may be laid waste and made desolate, and your idols may be broken and cease, and your incense altars may be cut down, and your works may be abolished. (Ezekiel 6:6)

text: אַֽל תַּשְׁלִיכֵנִי לְעֵת זִקְנָה כִּכְלוֹת כֹּחִי אַֽל תַּעַזְבֵֽנִי׃
translation: Don't reject me in my old age. Don't forsake me when my strength fails. (Psalms 71:9)

text: וַתֵּלֶד שָׂרָה אֵשֶׁת אֲדֹנִי בֵן לַֽאדֹנִי אַחֲרֵי זִקְנָתָהּ וַיִּתֶּן לּוֹ אֶת כָּל אֲשֶׁר לֽוֹ׃
translation: Sarah, my master's wife, bore a son to my master when she was old. He has given all that he has to him. (Genesis 24:36)

text: וְגַם עַד זִקְנָה וְשֵׂיבָה אֱלֹהִים אַֽל תַּעַזְבֵנִי עַד אַגִּיד זְרוֹעֲךָ לְדוֹר לְכָל יָבוֹא גְּבוּרָתֶֽךָ׃
translation: Yes, even when I am old and gray-haired, God, don't forsake me, until I have declared your strength to the next generation, your might to everyone who is to come. (Psalms 71:18)

text: וְעַד זִקְנָה אֲנִי הוּא וְעַד שֵיבָה אֲנִי אֶסְבֹּל אֲנִי עָשִׂיתִי וַאֲנִי אֶשָּׂא וַאֲנִי אֶסְבֹּל וַאֲמַלֵּֽט׃
translation: Even to old age I am he, and even to gray hairs I will carry you. I have made, and I will bear. Yes, I will carry, and will deliver. (Isaiah 46:4)

text: וַיָּזֶד יַעֲקֹב נָזִיד וַיָּבֹא עֵשָׂו מִן הַשָּׂדֶה וְהוּא עָיֵֽף׃
translation: Jacob boiled stew. Esau came in from the field, and he was famished. (Genesis 25:29)

text: וְיַעֲקֹב נָתַן לְעֵשָׂו לֶחֶם וּנְזִיד עֲדָשִׁים וַיֹּאכַל וַיֵּשְׁתְּ וַיָּקָם וַיֵּלַךְ וַיִּבֶז עֵשָׂו אֶת הַבְּכֹרָֽה׃
translation: Jacob gave Esau bread and lentil stew. He ate and drank, rose up, and went his way. So Esau despised his birthright. (Genesis 25:34)

text: וַיִּֽצְקוּ לַאֲנָשִׁים לֶאֱכוֹל וַיְהִי כְּאָכְלָם מֵהַנָּזִיד וְהֵמָּה צָעָקוּ וַיֹּֽאמְרוּ מָוֶת בַּסִּיר אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים וְלֹא יָכְלוּ לֶאֱכֹֽל׃
translation: So they poured out for the men to eat. As they were eating some of the stew, they cried out and said, "Man of God, there is death in the pot!" And they could not eat it. (2 Kings 4:40)

text: וֶאֱלִישָׁע שָׁב הַגִּלְגָּלָה וְהָרָעָב בָּאָרֶץ וּבְנֵי הַנְּבִיאִים יֹשְׁבִים לְפָנָיו וַיֹּאמֶר לְנַעֲרוֹ שְׁפֹת הַסִּיר הַגְּדוֹלָה וּבַשֵּׁל נָזִיד לִבְנֵי הַנְּבִיאִֽים׃
translation: Elisha came again to Gilgal. There was a famine in the land; and the sons of the prophets were sitting before him; and he said to his servant, "Get the large pot, and boil stew for the sons of the prophets." (2 Kings 4:38)

text: אַפּוֹ טָרַף וַֽיִּשְׂטְמֵנִי חָרַק עָלַי בְּשִׁנָּיו צָרִי יִלְטוֹשׁ עֵינָיו לִֽי׃
translation: He has torn me in his wrath and persecuted me. He has gnashed on me with his teeth. My adversary sharpens his eyes on me. (Job 16:9)

text: תֵּהָפֵךְ לְאַכְזָר לִי בְּעֹצֶם יָדְךָ תִשְׂטְמֵֽנִי׃
translation: You have turned to be cruel to me. With the might of your hand you persecute me. (Job 30:21)

text: וַֽיְמָרֲרֻהוּ וָרֹבּוּ וַֽיִּשְׂטְמֻהוּ בַּעֲלֵי חִצִּֽים׃
translation: The archers have severely grieved him, shot at him, and persecuted him: (Genesis 49:23)

text: מִקּוֹל אוֹיֵב מִפְּנֵי עָקַת רָשָׁע כִּי יָמִיטוּ עָלַי אָוֶן וּבְאַף יִשְׂטְמֽוּנִי׃
translation: My heart is severely pained within me. The terrors of death have fallen on me. (Psalms 55:4)

text: וַיִּרְאוּ אֲחֵֽי יוֹסֵף כִּי מֵת אֲבִיהֶם וַיֹּאמְרוּ לוּ יִשְׂטְמֵנוּ יוֹסֵף וְהָשֵׁב יָשִׁיב לָנוּ אֵת כָּל הָרָעָה אֲשֶׁר גָּמַלְנוּ אֹתֽוֹ׃
translation: When Joseph's brothers saw that their father was dead, they said, "It may be that Joseph will hate us, and will fully pay us back for all the evil which we did to him." (Genesis 50:15)

text: וַיִּשְׂטֹם עֵשָׂו אֶֽת יַעֲקֹב עַל הַבְּרָכָה אֲשֶׁר בֵּרֲכוֹ אָבִיו וַיֹּאמֶר עֵשָׂו בְּלִבּוֹ יִקְרְבוּ יְמֵי אֵבֶל אָבִי וְאַֽהַרְגָה אֶת יַעֲקֹב אָחִֽי׃
translation: Esau hated Jacob because of the blessing with which his father blessed him. Esau said in his heart, "The days of mourning for my father are at hand. Then I will kill my brother Jacob." (Genesis 27:41)

text: כִּי פַחַד פָּחַדְתִּי וַיֶּאֱתָיֵנִי וַאֲשֶׁר יָגֹרְתִּי יָבֹא לִֽי׃
translation: For the thing which I fear comes on me, that which I am afraid of comes to me. (Job 3:25)

text: וַיִּקְרָא לוֹ לָבָן יְגַר שָׂהֲדוּתָא וְיַֽעֲקֹב קָרָא לוֹ גַּלְעֵֽד׃
translation: Laban called it Jegar Sahadutha, but Jacob called it Galeed. (Genesis 31:47)

text: יָגֹרְתִּי כָל עַצְּבֹתָי יָדַעְתִּי כִּי לֹא תְנַקֵּֽנִי׃
translation: I am afraid of all my sorrows. I know that you will not hold me innocent. (Job 9:28)

text: הַעֲבֵר חֶרְפָּתִי אֲשֶׁר יָגֹרְתִּי כִּי מִשְׁפָּטֶיךָ טוֹבִֽים׃
translation: Take away my disgrace that I dread, for your ordinances are good. (Psalms 119:39)

text: וְהֵשִׁיב בְּךָ אֵת כָּל מַדְוֵה מִצְרַיִם אֲשֶׁר יָגֹרְתָּ מִפְּנֵיהֶם וְדָבְקוּ בָּֽךְ׃
translation: He will bring on you again all the diseases of Egypt, which you were afraid of; and they will cling to you. (Deuteronomy 28:60)

text: כִּי יָגֹרְתִּי מִפְּנֵי הָאַף וְהַחֵמָה אֲשֶׁר קָצַף יְהוָה עֲלֵיכֶם לְהַשְׁמִיד אֶתְכֶם וַיִּשְׁמַע יְהוָה אֵלַי גַּם בַּפַּעַם הַהִֽוא׃
translation: For I was afraid of the anger and hot displeasure with which the LORD was angry against you to destroy you. But the LORD listened to me that time also. (Deuteronomy 9:19)

text: הַמְעַט מִמְּךָ תַּנְחֻמוֹת אֵל וְדָבָר לָאַט עִמָּֽךְ׃
translation: Are the consolations of God too small for you, even the word that is gentle toward you? (Job 15:11)

text: יַעַן כִּי מָאַס הָעָם הַזֶּה אֵת מֵי הַשִּׁלֹחַ הַהֹלְכִים לְאַט וּמְשׂוֹשׂ אֶת רְצִין וּבֶן רְמַלְיָֽהוּ׃
translation: "Because this people has refused the waters of Shiloah that go softly, and rejoice in Rezin and Remaliah's son; (Isaiah 8:6)

text: וְנָבְקָה רֽוּחַ מִצְרַיִם בְּקִרְבּוֹ וַעֲצָתוֹ אֲבַלֵּעַ וְדָרְשׁוּ אֶל הָֽאֱלִילִים וְאֶל הָאִטִּים וְאֶל הָאֹבוֹת וְאֶל הַיִּדְּעֹנִֽים׃
translation: The spirit of the Egyptians will fail within them. I will destroy their counsel. They will seek the idols, the charmers, those who have familiar spirits, and the wizards. (Isaiah 19:3)

text: וַיְהִי כִשְׁמֹעַ אַחְאָב אֶת הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה וַיִּקְרַע בְּגָדָיו וַיָּֽשֶׂם שַׂק עַל בְּשָׂרוֹ וַיָּצוֹם וַיִּשְׁכַּב בַּשָּׂק וַיְהַלֵּךְ אַֽט׃
translation: When Ahab heard those words, he tore his clothes, put sackcloth on his body, fasted, lay in sackcloth, and went about despondently. (1 Kings 21:27)

text: יַעֲבָר נָא אֲדֹנִי לִפְנֵי עַבְדּוֹ וַאֲנִי אֶֽתְנָהֲלָה לְאִטִּי לְרֶגֶל הַמְּלָאכָה אֲשֶׁר לְפָנַי וּלְרֶגֶל הַיְלָדִים עַד אֲשֶׁר אָבֹא אֶל אֲדֹנִי שֵׂעִֽירָה׃
translation: Please let my lord pass over before his servant, and I will lead on gently, according to the pace of the livestock that are before me and according to the pace of the children, until I come to my lord to Seir." (Genesis 33:14)

text: וַיַּצֵּב יַעֲקֹב מַצֵּבָה עַל קְבֻרָתָהּ הִוא מַצֶּבֶת קְבֻֽרַת רָחֵל עַד הַיּֽוֹם׃
translation: Jacob set up a pillar on her grave. The same is the Pillar of Rachel's grave to this day. (Genesis 35:20)

text: וַיַּצֵּב יַעֲקֹב מַצֵּבָה בַּמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר אִתּוֹ מַצֶּבֶת אָבֶן וַיַּסֵּךְ עָלֶיהָ נֶסֶךְ וַיִּצֹק עָלֶיהָ שָֽׁמֶן׃
translation: Jacob set up a pillar in the place where he spoke with him, a pillar of stone. He poured out a drink offering on it, and poured oil on it. (Genesis 35:14)

text: וְעוֹד בָּהּ עֲשִׂרִיָּה וְשָׁבָה וְהָיְתָה לְבָעֵר כָּאֵלָה וְכָאַלּוֹן אֲשֶׁר בְּשַׁלֶּכֶת מַצֶּבֶת בָּם זֶרַע קֹדֶשׁ מַצַּבְתָּֽהּ׃
translation: If there is a tenth left in it, that also will in turn be consumed, as a terebinth, and as an oak whose stump remains when they are cut down, so the holy seed is its stump." (Isaiah 6:13)

text: וַיּוֹשֵׁב יוֹסֵף אֶת אָבִיו וְאֶת אֶחָיו וַיִּתֵּן לָהֶם אֲחֻזָּה בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם בְּמֵיטַב הָאָרֶץ בְּאֶרֶץ רַעְמְסֵס כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה פַרְעֹֽה׃
translation: Joseph placed his father and his brothers, and gave them a possession in the land of Egypt, in the best of the land, in the land of Rameses, as Pharaoh had commanded. (Genesis 47:11)

text: כִּי יַבְעֶר אִישׁ שָׂדֶה אוֹ כֶרֶם וְשִׁלַּח אֶת בעירה בְּעִירוֹ וּבִעֵר בִּשְׂדֵה אַחֵר מֵיטַב שָׂדֵהוּ וּמֵיטַב כַּרְמוֹ יְשַׁלֵּֽם׃
translation: If the stolen property is found in his hand alive, whether it is ox, donkey, or sheep, he shall pay double. (Exodus 22:4)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל מֵעֲמָלֵקִי הֱבִיאוּם אֲשֶׁר חָמַל הָעָם עַל מֵיטַב הַצֹּאן וְהַבָּקָר לְמַעַן זְבֹחַ לַיהוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ וְאֶת הַיּוֹתֵר הֶחֱרַֽמְנוּ׃
translation: Saul said, "They have brought them from the Amalekites; for the people spared the best of the sheep and of the cattle, to sacrifice to the LORD your God. We have utterly destroyed the rest." (1 Samuel 15:15)

text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ כָל הָעֵצִים אֶל הָאָטָד לֵךְ אַתָּה מְלָךְ עָלֵֽינוּ׃
translation: "Then all the trees said to the bramble, 'Come and reign over us.' (Judges 9:14)

text: בְּטֶרֶם יָבִינוּ סִּֽירֹתֵיכֶם אָטָד כְּמוֹ חַי כְּמוֹ חָרוֹן יִשְׂעָרֶֽנּוּ׃
translation: The righteous shall rejoice when he sees the vengeance. He shall wash his feet in the blood of the wicked, (Psalms 58:10)

text: וַיָּבֹאוּ עַד גֹּרֶן הָאָטָד אֲשֶׁר בְּעֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן וַיִּסְפְּדוּ שָׁם מִסְפֵּד גָּדוֹל וְכָבֵד מְאֹד וַיַּעַשׂ לְאָבִיו אֵבֶל שִׁבְעַת יָמִֽים׃
translation: They came to the threshing floor of Atad, which is beyond the Jordan, and there they lamented with a very great and severe lamentation. He mourned for his father seven days. (Genesis 50:10)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר פַּרְעֹה הֵן רַבִּים עַתָּה עַם הָאָרֶץ וְהִשְׁבַּתֶּם אֹתָם מִסִּבְלֹתָֽם׃
translation: Pharaoh said, "Behold, the people of the land are now many, and you make them rest from their burdens." (Exodus 5:5)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם מֶלֶךְ מִצְרַיִם לָמָּה מֹשֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן תַּפְרִיעוּ אֶת הָעָם מִמַּֽעֲשָׂיו לְכוּ לְסִבְלֹתֵיכֶֽם׃
translation: The king of Egypt said to them, "Why do you, Moses and Aaron, take the people from their work? Get back to your burdens!" (Exodus 5:4)

text: וַיְהִי בַּיָּמִים הָהֵם וַיִּגְדַּל מֹשֶׁה וַיֵּצֵא אֶל אֶחָיו וַיַּרְא בְּסִבְלֹתָם וַיַּרְא אִישׁ מִצְרִי מַכֶּה אִישׁ עִבְרִי מֵאֶחָֽיו׃
translation: In those days, when Moses had grown up, he went out to his brothers and saw their burdens. He saw an Egyptian striking a Hebrew, one of his brothers. (Exodus 2:11)

text: וְלָקַחְתִּי אֶתְכֶם לִי לְעָם וְהָיִיתִי לָכֶם לֵֽאלֹהִים וִֽידַעְתֶּם כִּי אֲנִי יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם הַמּוֹצִיא אֶתְכֶם מִתַּחַת סִבְלוֹת מִצְרָֽיִם׃
translation: I will take you to myself for a people. I will be your God; and you shall know that I am the LORD your God, who brings you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians. (Exodus 6:7)

text: לָכֵן אֱמֹר לִבְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲנִי יְהוָה וְהוֹצֵאתִי אֶתְכֶם מִתַּחַת סִבְלֹת מִצְרַיִם וְהִצַּלְתִּי אֶתְכֶם מֵעֲבֹדָתָם וְגָאַלְתִּי אֶתְכֶם בִּזְרוֹעַ נְטוּיָה וּבִשְׁפָטִים גְּדֹלִֽים׃
translation: Therefore tell the children of Israel, 'I am the LORD, and I will bring you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians, and I will rid you out of their bondage, and I will redeem you with an outstretched arm, and with great judgments. (Exodus 6:6)

text: כִּשְׂכִיר שָׁנָה בְּשָׁנָה יִהְיֶה עִמּוֹ לֹֽא יִרְדֶּנּֽוּ בְּפֶרֶךְ לְעֵינֶֽיךָ׃
translation: As a servant hired year by year shall he be with him. He shall not rule with harshness over him in your sight. (Leviticus 25:53)

text: וַיַּעֲבִדוּ מִצְרַיִם אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּפָֽרֶךְ׃
translation: The Egyptians ruthlessly made the children of Israel serve, (Exodus 1:13)

text: לֹא תִרְדֶּה בוֹ בְּפָרֶךְ וְיָרֵאתָ מֵאֱלֹהֶֽיךָ׃
translation: You shall not rule over him with harshness, but shall fear your God. (Leviticus 25:43)

text: וַיְמָרְרוּ אֶת חַיֵּיהֶם בַּעֲבֹדָה קָשָׁה בְּחֹמֶר וּבִלְבֵנִים וּבְכָל עֲבֹדָה בַּשָּׂדֶה אֵת כָּל עֲבֹדָתָם אֲשֶׁר עָבְדוּ בָהֶם בְּפָֽרֶךְ׃
translation: and they made their lives bitter with hard service in mortar and in brick, and in all kinds of service in the field, all their service, in which they ruthlessly made them serve. (Exodus 1:14)

text: וְהִתְנַחֲלְתֶּם אֹתָם לִבְנֵיכֶם אַחֲרֵיכֶם לָרֶשֶׁת אֲחֻזָּה לְעֹלָם בָּהֶם תַּעֲבֹדוּ וּבְאַחֵיכֶם בְּנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵל אִישׁ בְּאָחִיו לֹא תִרְדֶּה בוֹ בְּפָֽרֶךְ׃
translation: You may make them an inheritance for your children after you, to hold for a possession. Of them you may take your slaves forever, but over your brothers the children of Israel you shall not rule, one over another, with harshness. (Leviticus 25:46)

text: טוֹב מְלֹא כַף נָחַת מִמְּלֹא חָפְנַיִם עָמָל וּרְעוּת רֽוּחַ׃
translation: Better is a handful, with quietness, than two handfuls with labor and chasing after wind. (Ecclesiastes 4:6)

text: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה וְאֶֽל אַהֲרֹן קְחוּ לָכֶם מְלֹא חָפְנֵיכֶם פִּיחַ כִּבְשָׁן וּזְרָקוֹ מֹשֶׁה הַשָּׁמַיְמָה לְעֵינֵי פַרְעֹֽה׃
translation: The LORD said to Moses and to Aaron, "Take handfuls of ashes of the furnace, and let Moses sprinkle it toward the sky in the sight of Pharaoh. (Exodus 9:8)

text: וְלָקַח מְלֹֽא הַמַּחְתָּה גַּֽחֲלֵי אֵשׁ מֵעַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ מִלִּפְנֵי יְהוָה וּמְלֹא חָפְנָיו קְטֹרֶת סַמִּים דַּקָּה וְהֵבִיא מִבֵּית לַפָּרֹֽכֶת׃
translation: He shall take a censer full of coals of fire from off the altar before the LORD, and two handfuls of sweet incense beaten small, and bring it within the veil. (Leviticus 16:12)

text: וַיִּשְׁלַח הַכְּרוּב אֶת יָדוֹ מִבֵּינוֹת לַכְּרוּבִים אֶל הָאֵשׁ אֲשֶׁר בֵּינוֹת הַכְּרֻבִים וַיִּשָּׂא וַיִּתֵּן אֶל חָפְנֵי לְבֻשׁ הַבַּדִּים וַיִּקַּח וַיֵּצֵֽא׃
translation: The cherub stretched out his hand from between the cherubim to the fire that was between the cherubim, and took some of it, and put it into the hands of him who was clothed in linen, who took it and went out. (Ezekiel 10:7)

text: כֹּנֵס כַּנֵּד מֵי הַיָּם נֹתֵן בְּאֹצָרוֹת תְּהוֹמֽוֹת׃
translation: He gathers the waters of the sea together as a heap. He lays up the deeps in storehouses. (Psalms 33:7)

text: בָּקַע יָם וַיַּֽעֲבִירֵם וַֽיַּצֶּב מַיִם כְּמוֹ נֵֽד׃
translation: He split the sea, and caused them to pass through. He made the waters stand as a heap. (Psalms 78:13)

text: וּבְרוּחַ אַפֶּיךָ נֶעֶרְמוּ מַיִם נִצְּבוּ כְמוֹ נֵד נֹזְלִים קָֽפְאוּ תְהֹמֹת בְּלֶב יָֽם׃
translation: With the blast of your nostrils, the waters were piled up. The floods stood upright as a heap. The deeps were congealed in the heart of the sea. (Exodus 15:8)

text: בְּיוֹם נִטְעֵךְ תְּשַׂגְשֵׂגִי וּבַבֹּקֶר זַרְעֵךְ תַּפְרִיחִי נֵד קָצִיר בְּיוֹם נַחֲלָה וּכְאֵב אָנֽוּשׁ׃
translation: In the day of your planting, you hedge it in. In the morning, you make your seed blossom, but the harvest flees away in the day of grief and of desperate sorrow. (Isaiah 17:11)

text: וּדְבוֹרָה אִשָּׁה נְבִיאָה אֵשֶׁת לַפִּידוֹת הִיא שֹׁפְטָה אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל בָּעֵת הַהִֽיא׃
translation: Now Deborah, a prophetess, the wife of Lappidoth, judged Israel at that time. (Judges 4:4)

text: וַתִּקַּח מִרְיָם הַנְּבִיאָה אֲחוֹת אַהֲרֹן אֶת הַתֹּף בְּיָדָהּ וַתֵּצֶאןָ כָֽל הַנָּשִׁים אַחֲרֶיהָ בְּתֻפִּים וּבִמְחֹלֹֽת׃
translation: Miriam the prophetess, the sister of Aaron, took a tambourine in her hand; and all the women went out after her with tambourines and with dances. (Exodus 15:20)

text: זָכְרָה אֱלֹהַי לְטוֹבִיָּה וּלְסַנְבַלַּט כְּמַעֲשָׂיו אֵלֶּה וְגַם לְנוֹעַדְיָה הַנְּבִיאָה וּלְיֶתֶר הַנְּבִיאִים אֲשֶׁר הָיוּ מְיָֽרְאִים אוֹתִֽי׃
translation: "Remember, my God, Tobiah and Sanballat according to these their works, and also the prophetess Noadiah and the rest of the prophets that would have put me in fear." (Nehemiah 6:14)

text: וָאֶקְרַב אֶל הַנְּבִיאָה וַתַּהַר וַתֵּלֶד בֵּן וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֵלַי קְרָא שְׁמוֹ מַהֵר שָׁלָל חָשׁ בַּֽז׃
translation: I went to the prophetess, and she conceived, and bore a son. Then the LORD said to me, "Call his name 'Maher Shalal Hash Baz.' (Isaiah 8:3)

text: לֹֽא תְאֻנֶּה אֵלֶיךָ רָעָה וְנֶגַע לֹא יִקְרַב בְּאָהֳלֶֽךָ׃
translation: no evil shall happen to you, neither shall any plague come near your dwelling. (Psalms 91:10)

text: לֹא יְאֻנֶּה לַצַּדִּיק כָּל אָוֶן וּרְשָׁעִים מָלְאוּ רָֽע׃
translation: No mischief shall happen to the righteous, but the wicked shall be filled with evil. (Proverbs 12:21)

text: וְאָנוּ וְאָבְלוּ פְּתָחֶיהָ וְנִקָּתָה לָאָרֶץ תֵּשֵֽׁב׃
translation: Her gates shall lament and mourn. She shall be desolate and sit on the ground. (Isaiah 3:26)

text: וַאֲשֶׁר לֹא צָדָה וְהָאֱלֹהִים אִנָּה לְיָדוֹ וְשַׂמְתִּי לְךָ מָקוֹם אֲשֶׁר יָנוּס שָֽׁמָּה׃
translation: but not if it is unintentional, but God allows it to happen; then I will appoint you a place where he shall flee. (Exodus 21:13)

text: וְאָנוּ הַדַּיָּגִים וְאָבְלוּ כָּל מַשְׁלִיכֵי בַיְאוֹר חַכָּה וּפֹרְשֵׂי מִכְמֹרֶת עַל פְּנֵי מַיִם אֻמְלָֽלוּ׃
translation: The fishermen will lament, and all those who fish in the Nile will mourn, and those who spread nets on the waters will languish. (Isaiah 19:8)

text: שְׁאוֹל ואבדה וַאֲבַדּוֹ לֹא תִשְׂבַּעְנָה וְעֵינֵי הָאָדָם לֹא תִשְׂבַּֽעְנָה׃
translation: Sheol and Abaddon are never satisfied; and a man's eyes are never satisfied. (Proverbs 27:20)

text: וְכֵן תַּעֲשֶׂה לַחֲמֹרוֹ וְכֵן תַּעֲשֶׂה לְשִׂמְלָתוֹ וְכֵן תַּעֲשֶׂה לְכָל אֲבֵדַת אָחִיךָ אֲשֶׁר תֹּאבַד מִמֶּנּוּ וּמְצָאתָהּ לֹא תוּכַל לְהִתְעַלֵּֽם׃
translation: So you shall do with his donkey. So you shall do with his garment. So you shall do with every lost thing of your brother's, which he has lost and you have found. You may not hide yourself. (Deuteronomy 22:3)

text: וַיַּעַשׂ אֶת נֵרֹתֶיהָ שִׁבְעָה וּמַלְקָחֶיהָ וּמַחְתֹּתֶיהָ זָהָב טָהֽוֹר׃
translation: He made its seven lamps, and its snuffers, and its snuff dishes, of pure gold. (Exodus 37:23)

text: וְהַפֶּרַח וְהַנֵּרוֹת וְהַמֶּלְקַחַיִם זָהָב הוּא מִכְלוֹת זָהָֽב׃
translation: and the flowers, the lamps, and the tongs of gold that was purest gold; (2 Chronicles 4:21)

text: וַיָּעָף אֵלַי אֶחָד מִן הַשְּׂרָפִים וּבְיָדוֹ רִצְפָּה בְּמֶלְקַחַיִם לָקַח מֵעַל הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃
translation: Then one of the seraphim flew to me, having a live coal in his hand, which he had taken with the tongs from off the altar. (Isaiah 6:6)

text: וּמַלְקָחֶיהָ וּמַחְתֹּתֶיהָ זָהָב טָהֽוֹר׃
translation: Its snuffers and its snuff dishes shall be of pure gold. (Exodus 25:38)

text: וְאֶת הַמְּנֹרוֹת חָמֵשׁ מִיָּמִין וְחָמֵשׁ מִשְּׂמֹאול לִפְנֵי הַדְּבִיר זָהָב סָגוּר וְהַפֶּרַח וְהַנֵּרֹת וְהַמֶּלְקַחַיִם זָהָֽב׃
translation: and the lamp stands, five on the right side and five on the left, in front of the inner sanctuary, of pure gold; and the flowers, the lamps, and the tongs, of gold; (1 Kings 7:49)

text: וְאֵת בִּגְדֵי הַשְּׂרָד וְאֶת בִּגְדֵי הַקֹּדֶשׁ לְאַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֵן וְאֶת בִּגְדֵי בָנָיו לְכַהֵֽן׃
translation: the finely worked garments—the holy garments for Aaron the priest, the garments of his sons to minister in the priest's office— (Exodus 31:10)

text: אֶת בִּגְדֵי הַשְּׂרָד לְשָׁרֵת בַּקֹּדֶשׁ אֶת בִּגְדֵי הַקֹּדֶשׁ לְאַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֵן וְאֶת בִּגְדֵי בָנָיו לְכַהֵֽן׃
translation: the finely worked garments for ministering in the holy place—the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons—to minister in the priest's office.'" (Exodus 35:19)

text: אֶת בִּגְדֵי הַשְּׂרָד לְשָׁרֵת בַּקֹּדֶשׁ אֶת בִּגְדֵי הַקֹּדֶשׁ לְאַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֵן וְאֶת בִּגְדֵי בָנָיו לְכַהֵֽן׃
translation: the finely worked garments for ministering in the holy place, the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons, to minister in the priest's office. (Exodus 39:41)

text: חָרַשׁ עֵצִים נָטָה קָו יְתָאֲרֵהוּ בַשֶּׂרֶד יַעֲשֵׂהוּ בַּמַּקְצֻעוֹת וּבַמְּחוּגָה יְתָאֳרֵהוּ וַֽיַּעֲשֵׂהוּ כְּתַבְנִית אִישׁ כְּתִפְאֶרֶת אָדָם לָשֶׁבֶת בָּֽיִת׃
translation: The carpenter stretches out a line. He marks it out with a pencil. He shapes it with planes. He marks it out with compasses, and shapes it like the figure of a man, with the beauty of a man, to reside in a house. (Isaiah 44:13)

text: וַיְהִי כְּכַלּוֹת יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לְהַכּוֹתָם מַכָּה גְדוֹלָֽה מְאֹד עַד תֻּמָּם וְהַשְּׂרִידִים שָׂרְדוּ מֵהֶם וַיָּבֹאוּ אֶל עָרֵי הַמִּבְצָֽר׃
translation: When Joshua and the children of Israel had finished killing them with a very great slaughter until they were consumed, and the remnant which remained of them had entered into the fortified cities, (Joshua 10:20)

text: יְהוָה בְּמִשְׁפָּט יָבוֹא עִם זִקְנֵי עַמּוֹ וְשָׂרָיו וְאַתֶּם בִּֽעַרְתֶּם הַכֶּרֶם גְּזֵלַת הֶֽעָנִי בְּבָתֵּיכֶֽם׃
translation: The LORD will enter into judgment with the elders of his people and their leaders: "It is you who have eaten up the vineyard. The plunder of the poor is in your houses. (Isaiah 3:14)

text: עָנִי וְאֶבְיוֹן הוֹנָה גְּזֵלוֹת גָּזָל חֲבֹל לֹא יָשִׁיב וְאֶל הַגִּלּוּלִים נָשָׂא עֵינָיו תּוֹעֵבָה עָשָֽׂה׃
translation: has wronged the poor and needy, has taken by robbery, has not restored the pledge, and has lifted up his eyes to the idols, has committed abomination, (Ezekiel 18:12)

text: וְאִישׁ לֹא יוֹנֶה חֲבֹלָתוֹ חוֹב יָשִׁיב גְּזֵלָה לֹא יִגְזֹל לַחְמוֹ לְרָעֵב יִתֵּן וְעֵירֹם יְכַסֶּה בָּֽגֶד׃
translation: and has not wronged any, but has restored to the debtor his pledge, has taken nothing by robbery, has given his bread to the hungry, and has covered the naked with a garment; (Ezekiel 18:7)

text: וְאִישׁ לֹא הוֹנָה חֲבֹל לֹא חָבָל וּגְזֵלָה לֹא גָזָל לַחְמוֹ לְרָעֵב נָתָן וְעֵרוֹם כִּסָּה בָֽגֶד׃
translation: hasn't wronged any, hasn't taken anything to pledge, hasn't taken by robbery, but has given his bread to the hungry, and has covered the naked with a garment; (Ezekiel 18:16)

text: חֲבֹל יָשִׁיב רָשָׁע גְּזֵלָה יְשַׁלֵּם בְּחֻקּוֹת הַֽחַיִּים הָלַךְ לְבִלְתִּי עֲשׂוֹת עָוֶל חָיוֹ יִֽחְיֶה לֹא יָמֽוּת׃
translation: if the wicked restore the pledge, give again that which he had taken by robbery, walk in the statutes of life, committing no iniquity, he will surely live. He will not die. (Ezekiel 33:15)

text: וְאֵת הַחֲסִידָה הָאֲנָפָה לְמִינָהּ וְאֶת הַדּוּכִיפַת וְאֶת הָעֲטַלֵּֽף׃
translation: the stork, any kind of heron, the hoopoe, and the bat. (Leviticus 11:19)

text: כְּנַף רְנָנִים נֶעֱלָסָה אִם אֶבְרָה חֲסִידָה וְנֹצָֽה׃
translation: "The wings of the ostrich wave proudly, but are they the feathers and plumage of love? (Job 39:13)

text: אֲשֶׁר שָׁם צִפֳּרִים יְקַנֵּנוּ חֲסִידָה בְּרוֹשִׁים בֵּיתָֽהּ׃
translation: where the birds make their nests. The stork makes its home in the cypress trees. (Psalms 104:17)

text: וְהַחֲסִידָה וְהָאֲנָפָה לְמִינָהּ וְהַדּוּכִיפַת וְהָעֲטַלֵּֽף׃
translation: the stork, the heron after its kind, the hoopoe, and the bat. (Deuteronomy 14:18)

text: גַּם חֲסִידָה בַשָּׁמַיִם יָֽדְעָה מֽוֹעֲדֶיהָ וְתֹר וסוס וְסִיס וְעָגוּר שָׁמְרוּ אֶת עֵת בֹּאָנָה וְעַמִּי לֹא יָֽדְעוּ אֵת מִשְׁפַּט יְהוָֽה׃
translation: Yes, the stork in the sky knows her appointed times. The turtledove, the swallow, and the crane observe the time of their coming; but my people don't know the LORD's law. (Jeremiah 8:7)

text: וָאֶשָּׂא עֵינַי וָאֵרֶא וְהִנֵּה שְׁתַּיִם נָשִׁים יֽוֹצְאוֹת וְרוּחַ בְּכַנְפֵיהֶם וְלָהֵנָּה כְנָפַיִם כְּכַנְפֵי הַחֲסִידָה וַתִּשֶּׂאנָה אֶת הָאֵיפָה בֵּין הָאָרֶץ וּבֵין הַשָּׁמָֽיִם׃
translation: Then I lifted up my eyes and saw, and behold, there were two women; and the wind was in their wings. Now they had wings like the wings of a stork, and they lifted up the ephah basket between earth and the sky. (Zechariah 5:9)

text: בְּנֵי חָגָב בְּנֵי שמלי שַׁלְמַי בְּנֵי חָנָֽן׃
translation: the children of Hagab, the children of Shamlai, the children of Hanan, (Ezra 2:46)

text: הַיֹּשֵׁב עַל חוּג הָאָרֶץ וְיֹשְׁבֶיהָ כַּחֲגָבִים הַנּוֹטֶה כַדֹּק שָׁמַיִם וַיִּמְתָּחֵם כָּאֹהֶל לָשָֽׁבֶת׃
translation: It is he who sits above the circle of the earth, and its inhabitants are like grasshoppers; who stretches out the heavens like a curtain, and spreads them out like a tent to dwell in, (Isaiah 40:22)

text: וְשָׁם רָאִינוּ אֶת הַנְּפִילִים בְּנֵי עֲנָק מִן הַנְּפִלִים וַנְּהִי בְעֵינֵינוּ כַּֽחֲגָבִים וְכֵן הָיִינוּ בְּעֵינֵיהֶֽם׃
translation: There we saw the Nephilim, the sons of Anak, who come from the Nephilim. We were in our own sight as grasshoppers, and so we were in their sight." (Numbers 13:33)

text: אֶת אֵלֶּה מֵהֶם תֹּאכֵלוּ אֶת הָֽאַרְבֶּה לְמִינוֹ וְאֶת הַסָּלְעָם לְמִינֵהוּ וְאֶת הַחַרְגֹּל לְמִינֵהוּ וְאֶת הֶחָגָב לְמִינֵֽהוּ׃
translation: Even of these you may eat: any kind of locust, any kind of katydid, any kind of cricket, and any kind of grasshopper. (Leviticus 11:22)

text: הֵן אֶֽעֱצֹר הַשָּׁמַיִם וְלֹֽא יִהְיֶה מָטָר וְהֵן אֲצַוֶּה עַל חָגָב לֶאֱכוֹל הָאָרֶץ וְאִם אֲשַׁלַּח דֶּבֶר בְּעַמִּֽי׃
translation: "If I shut up the sky so that there is no rain, or if I command the locust to devour the land, or if I send pestilence among my people, (2 Chronicles 7:13)

text: גַּם מִגָּבֹהַּ יִרָאוּ וְחַתְחַתִּים בַּדֶּרֶךְ וְיָנֵאץ הַשָּׁקֵד וְיִסְתַּבֵּל הֶֽחָגָב וְתָפֵר הָֽאֲבִיּוֹנָה כִּֽי הֹלֵךְ הָאָדָם אֶל בֵּית עוֹלָמוֹ וְסָבְבוּ בָשּׁוּק הַסֹּפְדִֽים׃
translation: yes, they shall be afraid of heights, and terrors will be on the way; and the almond tree shall blossom, and the grasshopper shall be a burden, and desire shall fail; because man goes to his everlasting home, and the mourners go about the streets; (Ecclesiastes 12:5)

text: וְזֶה לָכֶם הַטָּמֵא בַּשֶּׁרֶץ הַשֹּׁרֵץ עַל הָאָרֶץ הַחֹלֶד וְהָעַכְבָּר וְהַצָּב לְמִינֵֽהוּ׃
translation: "'These are they which are unclean to you among the creeping things that creep on the earth: the weasel, the rat, any kind of great lizard, (Leviticus 11:29)

text: וַיָּשִׂמוּ אֶת אֲרוֹן יְהוָה אֶל הָעֲגָלָה וְאֵת הָאַרְגַּז וְאֵת עַכְבְּרֵי הַזָּהָב וְאֵת צַלְמֵי טְחֹרֵיהֶֽם׃
translation: They put the LORD's ark on the cart, and the box with the golden mice and the images of their tumors. (1 Samuel 6:11)

text: הַמִּתְקַדְּשִׁים וְהַמִּֽטַּהֲרִים אֶל הַגַּנּוֹת אַחַר אחד אַחַת בַּתָּוֶךְ אֹֽכְלֵי בְּשַׂר הַחֲזִיר וְהַשֶּׁקֶץ וְהָעַכְבָּר יַחְדָּו יָסֻפוּ נְאֻם יְהוָֽה׃
translation: "Those who sanctify themselves and purify themselves to go to the gardens, following one in the middle, eating pig's meat, abominable things, and the mouse, they shall come to an end together," says the LORD. (Isaiah 66:17)

text: עַל זֶה הָיָה דָוֶה לִבֵּנוּ עַל אֵלֶּה חָשְׁכוּ עֵינֵֽינוּ׃
translation: For this our heart is faint. For these things our eyes are dim: (Lamentations 5:17)

text: וְהַדָּוָה בְּנִדָּתָהּ וְהַזָּב אֶת זוֹבוֹ לַזָּכָר וְלַנְּקֵבָה וּלְאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יִשְׁכַּב עִם טְמֵאָֽה׃
translation: and of her who has her period, and of a man or woman who has a discharge, and of him who lies with her who is unclean. (Leviticus 15:33)

text: וְטִמֵּאתֶם אֶת צִפּוּי פְּסִילֵי כַסְפֶּךָ וְאֶת אֲפֻדַּת מַסֵּכַת זְהָבֶךָ תִּזְרֵם כְּמוֹ דָוָה צֵא תֹּאמַר לֽוֹ׃
translation: You shall defile the overlaying of your engraved images of silver, and the plating of your molten images of gold. You shall cast them away as an unclean thing. You shall tell it, "Go away!" (Isaiah 30:22)

text: מִמָּרוֹם שָֽׁלַח אֵשׁ בְּעַצְמֹתַי וַיִּרְדֶּנָּה פָּרַשׂ רֶשֶׁת לְרַגְלַי הֱשִׁיבַנִי אָחוֹר נְתָנַנִי שֹֽׁמֵמָה כָּל הַיּוֹם דָּוָֽה׃
translation: "From on high has he sent fire into my bones, and it prevails against them. He has spread a net for my feet. He has turned me back. He has made me desolate and I faint all day long. (Lamentations 1:13)

text: דַּבֵּר אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר אִשָּׁה כִּי תַזְרִיעַ וְיָלְדָה זָכָר וְטָֽמְאָה שִׁבְעַת יָמִים כִּימֵי נִדַּת דְּוֺתָהּ תִּטְמָֽא׃
translation: "Speak to the children of Israel, saying, 'If a woman conceives, and bears a male child, then she shall be unclean seven days; as in the days of her monthly period she shall be unclean. (Leviticus 12:2)

text: וְהָיָה בִּמְקוֹם הַשְּׁחִין שְׂאֵת לְבָנָה אוֹ בַהֶרֶת לְבָנָה אֲדַמְדָּמֶת וְנִרְאָה אֶל הַכֹּהֵֽן׃
translation: and in the place of the boil there is a white swelling, or a bright spot, reddish-white, then it shall be shown to the priest. (Leviticus 13:19)

text: וְכִֽי יִהְיֶה בַקָּרַחַת אוֹ בַגַּבַּחַת נֶגַע לָבָן אֲדַמְדָּם צָרַעַת פֹּרַחַת הִוא בְּקָרַחְתּוֹ אוֹ בְגַבַּחְתּֽוֹ׃
translation: But if a reddish-white plague is in the bald head or the bald forehead, it is leprosy breaking out in his bald head or his bald forehead. (Leviticus 13:42)

text: וְרָאָה אֹתוֹ הַכֹּהֵן וְהִנֵּה שְׂאֵת הַנֶּגַע לְבָנָה אֲדַמְדֶּמֶת בְּקָרַחְתּוֹ אוֹ בְגַבַּחְתּוֹ כְּמַרְאֵה צָרַעַת עוֹר בָּשָֽׂר׃
translation: Then the priest shall examine him. Behold, if the swelling of the plague is reddish-white in his bald head, or in his bald forehead, like the appearance of leprosy in the skin of the body, (Leviticus 13:43)

text: וְרָאָה אֶת הַנֶּגַע וְהִנֵּה הַנֶּגַע בְּקִירֹת הַבַּיִת שְׁקַֽעֲרוּרֹת יְרַקְרַקֹּת אוֹ אֲדַמְדַּמֹּת וּמַרְאֵיהֶן שָׁפָל מִן הַקִּֽיר׃
translation: He shall examine the plague; and behold, if the plague is in the walls of the house with hollow streaks, greenish or reddish, and it appears to be deeper than the wall, (Leviticus 14:37)

text: הוֹלֵךְ רָכִיל מְגַלֶּה סּוֹד וְנֶאֱמַן רוּחַ מְכַסֶּה דָבָֽר׃
translation: One who brings gossip betrays a confidence, but one who is of a trustworthy spirit is one who keeps a secret. (Proverbs 11:13)

text: גּֽוֹלֶה סּוֹד הוֹלֵךְ רָכִיל וּלְפֹתֶה שְׂפָתָיו לֹא תִתְעָרָֽב׃
translation: He who goes about as a tale-bearer reveals secrets; therefore don't keep company with him who opens wide his lips. (Proverbs 20:19)

text: כֻּלָּם סָרֵי סֽוֹרְרִים הֹלְכֵי רָכִיל נְחֹשֶׁת וּבַרְזֶל כֻּלָּם מַשְׁחִיתִים הֵֽמָּה׃
translation: They are all grievous rebels, going around to slander. They are bronze and iron. All of them deal corruptly. (Jeremiah 6:28)

text: לֹא תֵלֵךְ רָכִיל בְּעַמֶּיךָ לֹא תַעֲמֹד עַל דַּם רֵעֶךָ אֲנִי יְהוָֽה׃
translation: "'You shall not go around as a slanderer among your people. "'You shall not endanger the life of your neighbor. I am the LORD. (Leviticus 19:16)

text: אַנְשֵׁי רָכִיל הָיוּ בָךְ לְמַעַן שְׁפָךְ דָּם וְאֶל הֶֽהָרִים אָכְלוּ בָךְ זִמָּה עָשׂוּ בְתוֹכֵֽךְ׃
translation: Slanderous men have been in you to shed blood. In you they have eaten on the mountains. They have committed lewdness among you. (Ezekiel 22:9)

text: אִישׁ מֵרֵעֵהוּ הִשָּׁמֵרוּ וְעַל כָּל אָח אַל תִּבְטָחוּ כִּי כָל אָח עָקוֹב יַעְקֹב וְכָל רֵעַ רָכִיל יַהֲלֹֽךְ׃
translation: "They bend their tongue, as their bow, for falsehood. They have grown strong in the land, but not for truth; for they proceed from evil to evil, and they don't know me," says the LORD. (Jeremiah 9:3)

text: וְיָצָא עוֹד קוה קָו הַמִּדָּה נֶגְדּוֹ עַל גִּבְעַת גָּרֵב וְנָסַב גֹּעָֽתָה׃
translation: The measuring line will go out further straight onward to the hill Gareb, and will turn toward Goah. (Jeremiah 31:39)

text: עִירָא הַיִּתְרִי גָּרֵב הַיִּתְרִֽי׃
translation: Ira the Ithrite, Gareb the Ithrite, (2 Samuel 23:38)

text: עִירָא הַיִּתְרִי גָּרֵב הַיִּתְרִֽי׃
translation: Ira the Ithrite, Gareb the Ithrite, (1 Chronicles 11:40)

text: אֽוֹ גִבֵּן אוֹ דַק אוֹ תְּבַלֻּל בְּעֵינוֹ אוֹ גָרָב אוֹ יַלֶּפֶת אוֹ מְרוֹחַ אָֽשֶׁךְ׃
translation: or hunchbacked, or a dwarf, or one who has a defect in his eye, or an itching disease, or scabs, or who has damaged testicles. (Leviticus 21:20)

text: תַּפּוּחֵי זָהָב בְּמַשְׂכִּיּוֹת כָּסֶף דָּבָר דָּבֻר עַל אָפְנָֽיו׃
translation: A word fitly spoken is like apples of gold in settings of silver. (Proverbs 25:11)

text: הוֹן עָשִׁיר קִרְיַת עֻזּוֹ וּכְחוֹמָה נִשְׂגָּבָה בְּמַשְׂכִּיתֽוֹ׃
translation: The rich man's wealth is his strong city, like an unscalable wall in his own imagination. (Proverbs 18:11)

text: יָצָא מֵחֵלֶב עֵינֵמוֹ עָבְרוּ מַשְׂכִּיּוֹת לֵבָֽב׃
translation: Their eyes bulge with fat. Their minds pass the limits of conceit. (Psalms 73:7)

text: וְהוֹרַשְׁתֶּם אֶת כָּל יֹשְׁבֵי הָאָרֶץ מִפְּנֵיכֶם וְאִבַּדְתֶּם אֵת כָּל מַשְׂכִּיֹּתָם וְאֵת כָּל צַלְמֵי מַסֵּֽכֹתָם תְּאַבֵּדוּ וְאֵת כָּל בָּמֹתָם תַּשְׁמִֽידוּ׃
translation: then you shall drive out all the inhabitants of the land from before you, destroy all their stone idols, destroy all their molten images, and demolish all their high places. (Numbers 33:52)

text: לֹֽא תַעֲשׂוּ לָכֶם אֱלִילִם וּפֶסֶל וּמַצֵּבָה לֹֽא תָקִימוּ לָכֶם וְאֶבֶן מַשְׂכִּית לֹא תִתְּנוּ בְּאַרְצְכֶם לְהִֽשְׁתַּחֲוֺת עָלֶיהָ כִּי אֲנִי יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃
translation: "'You shall make for yourselves no idols, and you shall not raise up a carved image or a pillar, and you shall not place any figured stone in your land, to bow down to it; for I am the LORD your God. (Leviticus 26:1)

text: מֵשִׁיב יָגָע וְלֹא יִבְלָע כְּחֵיל תְּמוּרָתוֹ וְלֹא יַעֲלֹֽס׃
translation: He will restore that for which he labored, and will not swallow it down. He will not rejoice according to the substance that he has gotten. (Job 20:18)

text: אַל יַאֲמֵן בשו בַּשָּׁיו נִתְעָה כִּי שָׁוְא תִּהְיֶה תְמוּרָתֽוֹ׃
translation: Let him not trust in emptiness, deceiving himself, for emptiness will be his reward. (Job 15:31)

text: לֹא יַעַרְכֶנָּה זָהָב וּזְכוֹכִית וּתְמוּרָתָהּ כְּלִי פָֽז׃
translation: Gold and glass can't equal it, neither will it be exchanged for jewels of fine gold. (Job 28:17)
